reviews.author: Momo
reviews.title: I did not earn the point
reviews.body: I logged in my account when I booked the hotel but my APP does not show this booking and earn points. I am disappointed.

reviews.author: Megan R
reviews.title: Great stay with friendly service
reviews.body: This hotel is excellently located, with clean rooms and great services. Crema cafe next door provides great access for simple meals. Mezzanine coffee and tea facilities excellent and used by many people- really excellent idea!

reviews.author: College mom
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.body:
Ideal location near Grand Central
Nicely sized rooms
Friendly and helpful staff all around
Clean, well maintained

reviews.author: FL travael
reviews.title: Everything was great!
reviews.body: This was a great trip! We were able to get into our room early on the day of our arrival. The entire staff was helpful and friendly the entire time.  When we walked into the lobby, one evening, I jokingly asked for someone to bring us ice to our room, since we were on a high floor, and the only ice machine working was on the fifth floor. The girl behind the desk said I’ll ask someone for you! And they certainly brought it to us. It’s the small things that add up!  The location of the hotel is perfect for a NYC visit!

reviews.author: Jordan
reviews.title: NYC stay
reviews.body: Great location and experience

reviews.author: Salguero
reviews.title: Marriott on Fifth Ave -great location
reviews.body: The Marriott on 40 East & Fifth Ave, the location was great, the front desk staff and cleaning staff were courteous and pleasant; however, this Marriott is not worth the exorbitant rate I was charged for an old, shabby, and dirty room in the dungeon. This Marriott is way overpriced. I was extremely disappointed. I have been a Marriott customer, domestic and international, for a while, but I'm no longer interested in this chain of hotels.

reviews.author: chicagoadam
reviews.title: Poorly maintained property and rude staff
reviews.body: This Courtyard is not well maintained--checkin was delayed hours because the system was down, an elevator broke during our stay and made leaving and returning to the hotel miserable for the remainder of our time there, and the complementary coffee station was out of order the entire time. Staff were rude and non-communicative. You could tell nobody working there wanted to be there. Very disappointed as a longtime Marriott customer. Our stay didn't ruin our anniversary trip, but it came close.

reviews.author: Not a liberal
reviews.title: Horrible!
reviews.body: Just make this place one of Hochuls’s FAMOUS sanctuary hotels and then demolish the place when the migrants steal everything including the windows and doors!

reviews.author: Patrick
reviews.title: Elevators are a mess, expect to wait a long time
reviews.body:
Elevators are an absolute joke here. Thirty floors with just 2 elevators and one seems to be out of service half the time. Expect to wait 10+ minutes to get out of the building.  

The gym is also incredibly tiny and nonfunctional. I had to pay to go outside to another gym.

reviews.author: Jake F
reviews.title: Broken down hotel
reviews.body: Building falling apart. Only amenity besides gym (coffee bar) was broken all weekend. Elevator was busted. Ice machine busted.

reviews.author: Michigantraveler
reviews.title: No amenities, not a friendly staff, except for Frank.
reviews.body: Unfriendly reception, no amenities. No refrigerator, no microwave, no kitchen, dirty carpet throughout the hotel, someone went through my daughter’s luggage and tossed our food. Broken elevator, couldn’t check-in on time because their system was down, filthy windows.

reviews.author: Gina B
reviews.title: Not a good experience
reviews.body: Booked an overnight stay at the 5th Avenue Marriott for a celebratory 16th Birthday weekend. 30 story hotel down on 5th - summer weekend fully booked and with only a single elevator working. I am presently disabled wearing a boot and using a knee scooter so walking down 8 flights is not an option. Waiting for the elevator sometimes took in excess of 10mins and impacted our making dinner reservation tines. When inquired with management and staff, because we saw the maintenance team moving refrigerators amongst guests in the single elevator, I was told there is no service elevator and the elevator repair team would not be in until Monday! Really Marriot? Very disappointing and I do not recommend staying here.

reviews.author: mhs
reviews.title: Done even give out water
reviews.body: Basic necessity of life and for the price we’re pay for rooms they can give us a bottle or two of water.  After a long journey had to walk out and down the block to get water.

reviews.author: Ado R Breedy
reviews.title: An apartment building name Courtyard
reviews.body: Very well located, this is an apart hotel building. Do not expect too much, you use just to sleep in a clean room and bed.

reviews.author: GN3
reviews.title: Good room in mid-town Manhattan
reviews.body: Great option to stay at! Clean room, good room size!

reviews.author: Biztraveler
reviews.title: Don’t stay here!
reviews.body: Creepy vibe. Not clean. Peeling wallpaper. Non existent decor. No bottled water.

reviews.author: RH83
reviews.title: Worst stay
reviews.body: I wouldn’t recommend the hotel unless it is for the location. Unfriendly staff. Poor maintenance specially for elevators, usually 1 out of service with 30 floors you can imagine. I stayed for 12 nights, on the bonvoy app the are recognizing only 2 nights not sure why

reviews.author: Unfair Experience
reviews.title: Unfair Experience
reviews.body:
I wish I could give this Courtyard by Marriott zero stars. This was not my first time staying at a Courtyard Marriott, but it was absolutely the first time I felt that staff intentionally created an unnecessary issue for a customer.

I had already paid for my room online in advance, but at check\-in they refused my credit card because the name did not exactly match my driver’s license due to a name change. They refunded my prepaid amount right then and required another card.

What made no sense was that my friend’s credit card also had a different name from her driver’s license, yet they accepted hers without any issue.

Thankfully, I wasn’t alone but What if I had been traveling by myself? I had a confirmed, fully paid reservation—would I have simply been left without a room?

I understand hotel policies, but they should be applied consistently and fairly to every customer. This experience was unnecessarily stressful, unprofessional, and extremely disappointing.

reviews.author: Don S
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!
reviews.body: We were very pleased with our overall stay here. The staff was wonderful and the accommodations were great! The hotel location was perfect for a stay in midtown Manhattan, with only a few blocks walk to Grand Central Station and the 4 and 5 Express subways downtown, as well as a short walk to Time Square.

reviews.author: AJM56
reviews.title: recommend fifth avenue Marriott Courtyard
reviews.body: A clean and conveniently located property with attentive and omnipresent staff. Cold water and hot coffee 24/7.

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.body:
I was extremely disappointed with my stay at this hotel. My room was located right next to the hotel air-conditioning units, and the noise was extremely loud and disturbing. I could barely sleep because of the constant noise.

I informed the front desk about the issue, but unfortunately, they did not seem to take my complaint seriously or make any real effort to help.

reviews.title: 4 days in nyc
reviews.body: Great location and good value

reviews.author: Ali
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Great stay in an excellent location in Manhattan

reviews.author: Kpl
reviews.title: Update the hotel and give your great staff something to be proud of.
reviews.body: Hotel was a bit dated with poor lighting in the bathroom and no refrigerator or microwave in the rooms. Only one ice machine for 25+ floors as on was broken. Check-in was late, lots of people waiting for rooms in the lobby every afternoon around check in time. The staff balanced out the bad as they were friendly.

reviews.author: Anomomys
reviews.title: Underwhelmed
reviews.body: I stayed at the hotel hoping to have experiences equal to other Marriott’s in NYC.  I was disappointed.  Staff was ok no extra effort towards anything.  Hotel is in a great location but very few amenities.  If you just want a bed this might be your choice.  Also you can hear all the noise outside.  We experienced construction on our street below our window and you heard everything all night.  When I called the front desk they said they were not aware of the work and offered us earplugs

reviews.author: LAW
reviews.title: Not quite up to Marriott standards
reviews.body: As Marriott Reward members, we always know we will have a comfortable stay at a Marriott property, however this location was not quite up to Marriott standards. We were not given the opportunity for early check in or late check out, were charged (and expecting) a King size bed but were disappointed to find a King headboard but a Queen size mattress, the bathroom door did not close or lock properly, there was a long dark hair (not ours) on one of the towels, no curtains on the windows, although the hooks were still visible under the cornice board, and the automatic shade was very worn. Just not what we typically find in a Marriott property.

reviews.author: FK
reviews.title: Worst stay ever.
reviews.body: I cannot believe how horrible the hotel rooms were. Definitely do not stay here.

reviews.author: Family travel
reviews.title: Great location for budget stay
reviews.body: We chose this location bc of space ans location. They offer 2 queens beds in a room and the room was good size. The bathroom was on the small side but we had no issues except for the paint was peeling around the bathtub. Overall noise level wasn’t an issue at all and we didn’t encounter any issues needing assistance during our stay

reviews.author: jb
reviews.title: gross place, broken A/C
reviews.body: Bathroom was gross, bed had hair in it, A/C was broken so staff gave me a fan.

reviews.author: GG
reviews.title: Good Place To Stay
reviews.body: This is a nice place to stay but the lack of water bottles or vending machines is concerning.  Also, no refrigerators in the rooms is a negative.

reviews.author: MaryannF
reviews.title: Weekend in NYC
reviews.body: Our 2-night stay in NYC was a delight thanks to  the Algonquin Hotel. Located near so many restaurants, near to the subway and Bryant Park….you can’t miss!

reviews.author: Catherine
reviews.title: Outstanding Stay
reviews.body: Completely love this hotel, looking forward to my next stay.

reviews.author: Y soto
reviews.title: Unforgettable stay in NYC
reviews.body: Excellent location and service at Algonquin Hotel. Recently renovated rooms and amenities made our stay exceptional. Kudos to Maria and the rest of the front desk staff for making our stay unforgettable. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Steve B
reviews.title: A Trip Back to Quintessential New York
reviews.body: Whenever my travels take me to New York, my hotel of choice is always the Algonquin.  It’s an oasis of peace amongst the hustle and bustle of the City and it holds a history that somehow you feel a part of.  The Algonquin is in a class by itself.

reviews.author: Theresa k
reviews.title: Algonquin and us open
reviews.body: Tak 9/1-2/2026 nyc the best hotel in nyc

reviews.author: Cathy
reviews.title: Recently renovated grand hotel
reviews.body: The recent renovations kept the charm and beauty of the grand hotel.

reviews.author: DJMAZ
reviews.title: Wonderful historic hotel in midtown NYC
reviews.body: Excellent staff and well appointed property with history and beauty. Would gladly stay again.

reviews.author: Chicago 68
reviews.title: An oasis in Manhattan
reviews.body: If you value a sense of history, even legacy; if the personal touch works for you; if you want the essentials of a hotel all done well including lobby coffee and copies of the NYTs; it you want comfortable; and you value all of this in the midst of Manhattan, then this is your oasis- the Algonquin.

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.body: A box ac with a window half opened and noice

reviews.author: Broadway theater goer
reviews.title: Storied hotel in a great location.
reviews.body: Visited on a three show theater weekend. The hotel is perfectly located for broadway. Inside the hotel highlights the storied Algonquin round table itself along with lithographs of the famous people who were a part of that group. The lobby also has a free espresso/coffee/tea station which is a nice touch. The room was comfortable, clean and well appointed. The only minor issues were no hand wand in the shower and the TV was Roku without cable. The staff was excellent and friendly. We had a minor maintenance issue with the TV that was resolved within 10 minutes of calling the front desk.

reviews.author: Ann S
reviews.title: Go see the Algonquin!
reviews.body: My return visit after 25 years was so nice. My room was still small, but was very nicely appointed. The renovated lobby is very pretty with the Blue Bar being front and center.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: A hidden gem.
reviews.body: Great historic hotel.  Times Square is chaotic in the summer and during the holidays.  Algonquin is a bit of a haven from the craziness just a couple blocks away.

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.title: Beautiful historic hotel in the heart of Midtown
reviews.body: I am a huge Dorothy Parker fan so was excited about staying at the Algonquin. I love Art Deco so that was a plus. The food and drinks were very good, although expensive (but not more than you would expect for NYC). The service was truly exceptional; I absolutely loved all the staff. And to my surprise, the fitness center was exceptional; I was not expecting multiple cable machines with a pull-up bar in an older hotel but it was one of the best hotel fitness centers I've seen. Having only one elevator working because of the renovations was the only negative part of my stay, but even that was not a major inconvenience.

reviews.author: Ms Meg
reviews.title: The Algonquin Hotel: Timeless Perfection
reviews.body: Our stay at the Algonquin can only be described as timeless perfection. From the moment we walked into the lobby, we stepped into a classy 1920s bubble. This was the perfect girls’ weekend destination! All dolled up in our flapper dresses, we were treated like celebrities by all of the staff! They took our pictures and shared historic stories with us of this magnificent hotel, giving us memories to last a lifetime! Right smack in the middle of the hustle and bustle of the streets of present-day NYC, the Algonquin is like a peaceful oasis of a simpler time. We called it home for a weekend and cannot wait to return!

reviews.author: Traveler One
reviews.title: Historic Hotel in Times Square
reviews.body:
The hotel and lobby look architecturally impressive. The rooms are comfortable and the bed as well even though they are very tiny.
On this stay only one elevator was in service and very inconvenient. The food at the restaurant was good. Since I'm not a drinker there are very few amenities to absorb the $45.00 nightly charge.  No snacks, grill or kiosk for drinks to take, or quick food bites.  
Otherwise it is a safe stay in Times Square location if that appeals.
The staff and door men were pleasant and eager to provide above average service.

reviews.author: NYC Junkie 2026
reviews.title: Our New Go To Hotel
reviews.body: Great stay. Our new go to hotel after our experience. Hotel was undergoing renovation, but you would not have known it by the way the staff and everyone carries themselves. The guys working the door were especially helpful in assisting with anything we needed including directions, transportation, and recommendations. Just a few short blocks from Times Square, Bryant Park, and Rockefeller Center in the heart of Midtown. We will be back as we travel to Manhattan regularly.

reviews.author: Ernie
reviews.title: Best Hotel Staff in NYC!!
reviews.body: The brand-new refurbished Algonquin is a gem in the heart of Midtown! The staff is world class and treats all guests with respect! The staff does a great job of making everyone feel special in the Big City!! It is a unique City experience.

reviews.author: Alain
reviews.title: Very Disappointing Experience
reviews.body:
This hotel was far below our expectations, especially considering the high room rate. We had to change rooms upon arrival, and the second room was still extremely small, with a noisy air conditioning system and poor soundproofing, making it difficult to sleep.
The lobby and bar felt dark and unwelcoming, one of the two elevators was out of service during our stay, and we also experienced a concerning overnight safety incident that was not handled in a reassuring manner.
The only positives were the excellent housekeeping service and the front desk staff at both check-in and check-out, who were kind, welcoming, and professional.

reviews.author: W Youngjr
reviews.title: Wonderful Property and Experience
reviews.body: We like historic properties and try to choose them when traveling (which we do quite a bit) and they are in the location we are visiting. This hotel did not disappoint from the history, the architecture and mostly due to a very friendly and attentive staff. We interacted with at least 6-7 of the hotel staff and all were as helpful and cheerful as any we have ever encountered. We will definitely return!

reviews.author: KLML333
reviews.title: A lovely experience in NYC
reviews.body: We loved the hotel and the experience overall - what a beautiful renovation. The location is fantastic, and the restaurant is a great place to sit for a drink and a snack.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Convenient and Comfortable
reviews.body: We’ve stayed here many times.   Newly renovated suite was comfortable.   AC worked well.    Comfortable bed and sofa.   Very clean.   Conveniently located in between Grand Central and Times Square but far enough away to avoid crowds.    Steps away from Bryant Park and a short walk to MSG.    Food in lounge is mediocre.  Service has improved in lounge.

reviews.author: Another Wonderful Stay
reviews.title: Another Wonderful Visit to the Algonquin.
reviews.body: I am a frequent guest at the Algonquin and it never disappoints.  My room was very comfortable, well-appointed and clean.  The food in the restaurant was very good, and the service is absolutely superb.  The staff s top notch.

reviews.author: Tmark
reviews.title: Small tiny bathroom grumpy waitstaff
reviews.body:
Extremely small bathroom elevator out of service
For two days

reviews.author: JD14
reviews.title: Excellent NYC Stay
reviews.body: Excellent location excellent stay.  Been twice now.

reviews.author: Vincent from Asia
reviews.title: Classic Stay for the Historic Day
reviews.body: As July 4th 2026 - the 250th birthday - was approaching, I couldn't think of anywhere better to stay than The Algonquin. A Classic Hotel for a Historic Day. As usual, staying at The Algonquin was a great experience, and I had flown in to New York from Asia specially for Independence Day weekend. It was a bit quieter in the Bar than usual -I guess most folks were out partying - but it this historic hotel still has its unique charm. The rooms have been nicely refurbished, still very comfortable. There's a bit of inconvenience as one elevator is being replaced, but it doesn't detract from the pleasure of being in one of New York's fabled old hotels. And as it's right in the heart of the action, I don't think I'll stay anywhere else next time I'm in town.

reviews.author: Family from abroad
reviews.title: Wonderful City Experience
reviews.body: This is a beautiful hotel with very attentive staff. Situated perfectly in Midtown you have walking access to shopping on 5th avenue and Rockefeller center, as well as Times Square and Broadway. The hotel is quiet for this area of the city. The hotel bar and lounge area provide a wonderful extra space to occupy at your leisure and neither are hard to find a quiet seat to enjoy.

reviews.author: T Lee
reviews.title: Fails basic hotel expectations
reviews.body:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this stay was genuinely one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve had because I barely slept.

The HVAC system was unbelievably loud. Even after it reached the set temperature and stopped actively cooling, the unit itself continued making enough noise that it was impossible to sleep. I tried earplugs, pillows over my head, and even playing sleep meditations, and none of it was enough to mask the sound. I slept about two hours out of an eight-hour night.

A colleague requested a room change around 11:00 p.m. hoping it was an isolated issue, but the replacement room was no better. They also barely slept, so this doesn’t appear to have been a one-off problem.

Beyond the noise, the sheets were surprisingly rough and uncomfortable, there were no slippers in the room, the lighting was so harsh it felt like an operating room, and there was a dog across the hall that barked whenever anyone walked by, adding even more disruption.

To make matters worse, the front desk couldn’t even be reached by phone, making it difficult to get help when there was an issue.

A hotel’s primary responsibility is to provide a comfortable place to sleep, and unfortunately this stay failed on that most basic expectation. I won’t be staying here again.

reviews.author: Davida
reviews.title: Home in the City
reviews.body:
I have been visiting NY frequently for many years and have stayed in a number of hotels in the midtown area. The difference between all of those other hotels and the Algonquin is that it feels like coming home. All of the staff are friendly and professional in equal measure from the guys who greet you at the door, the wonderful reception ladies, to the efficient and knowledgeable barmen. 
I travel predominantly on my own and I feel very safe and secure coming home to the Algonquin. I am very comfortable sitting at the friendly bar on my own and not some of the other impersonal hotel bars I’ve been in.

reviews.author: Advocat
reviews.title: Classic New York
reviews.body: If you want to stay in a clean, historic, friendly, newley renovated hotel in a great location, this is it.

reviews.author: RHB1
reviews.title: A Classic Reborn
reviews.body:
Always a pleasure to stay in the updated Algonquin : fresh and new with a nod to its literary past! 
Service is consistent and always 5 star.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Hotel in general dirty
reviews.body: Lobby and in my room was dirty, dental floss from the prior guest was stuck to the outside of my trashcan. The sink in the bathroom never drained, the carpet had coffee or some other substance spilled on it, not a hotel that I would stay in again.

reviews.author: Mamaped2
reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.body: Clean and spacious room, friendly staff, good breakfast and excellent location!!

reviews.author: MNAM
reviews.title: VERY NICE HOTEL
reviews.body:
We have been staying in this hotel many years, quality of hotel always same.
Off course excellent staff, espeacially front desk people.

reviews.author: Alphatango
reviews.title: Tiny rooms marketed as suites, uninviting staff
reviews.body: No real benefit for elite members to choose this property over other Marriott properties…better options exist in the vicinity especially towards Central Park and Times Square…the staff acts more like snooty NYC doormen than people working in the hospitality industry…worst experience of all my 500 nights stayed at Marriott properties

reviews.author: Manish
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.body: Leaky bathroom, Badly situated bathroom right in front of your bed, badly situated TV in the room no where to be comfortably seen from bed or from sofa. Super disturbing location of the room right near the elevator.

reviews.author: Jimmy N
reviews.title: Quite Small, Generally Clean, Odor, Good Location
reviews.body:
Lower to mid- level hotel. Small rooms but generally clean and comfortable. There was a BO odor that we could smell each time we entered the room but we couldn’t smell it after a while. 

We went Labor Day weekend and paid the same price as we pay at the Marriott Marquis on other trips. Our bad. US Open was on as well. 

Good location.

reviews.author: UnpleasantlySuprised
reviews.title: Choose a Different Property
reviews.body: Was berated, ridiculed, and spoken down to by Guy.  Again and again. Nothing special with the property and a horrible way to treat any guest, let alone a status member.  Mediocre a best.

reviews.author: LOO
reviews.title: Poor Interaction/Service
reviews.body: We were welcomed with 'we don't do that here, you have to buy your own water bottles' VS welcoming you with a gift, even if it's just water bottles. our experience with other Marriot hotels, they give you something! even as little as a cookie to welcome you.

reviews.author: Brooke P
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.body: Our stay at the SpringHill Suites was food. Conveniently located to food and transit. Rooms were large by New York Standards.  Our room had a smell that I thought would disappear with some air flow but never did. We were too busy to request a room change, but I wish I would have.

reviews.author: Juan97
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.body: Excellent service above and beyond

reviews.author: Business Traveller
reviews.title: Do not expect any Bonvoy experience
reviews.body: Worst hotel around NY city. I wish I had booked another hotel

reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: No value of Bonvoy Membership
reviews.body:
After reaching New York from a long flights & travel time of 24 hrs staff was not interested to listen for request of early check in even after 12 pm. Got checked-in after 2 pm. No water in room even to start with. 
Evrn a request of late check out by 30 minutes was denied

reviews.author: Jacky
reviews.title: Birthday trip w mom
reviews.body: It was a short distance from things we needed: Penn Station, CVS, and Time Square. This stay was excellent for someone who was navigating NY for their first time.

reviews.author: DB
reviews.title: Weekend in New York
reviews.body: Arrived early on a Friday tried to check in. Told no rooms available even though lots of keys in the return basket on the desk. As a Titanium/Platinum  member of 30 plus years i was quite  disappointed. The ldesk clerk didn't even check. Convenient location. Near Times Square, theater and other attractions. Nice room but no view. I believe the hotel shares space with a Marriott Vacation Club although there is a separate entrance next door. Breakfast not very appetizing and really crowded but breakfast staff friendly and helpful. Would consider staying again

reviews.author: LQ
reviews.title: Perfect for my purposes
reviews.body:
I found this hotel to be exactly perfect for what I needed, and within its class it is excellent.  At check in the staff were pleasant and professional.  We arrived early and they stored our bags while we went out exploring.  The room was clean and bright, there was plenty of room for two people's belongings, and we did not experience any disturbing outside noises from either the hall or the outside.  Breakfast was included, and had a good selection of hot (eggs/sausage) and continental (toast/bagels) with fruit and yogurt.  Impressively, the hot food and coffee were still fresh and stocked even two hours into service.  

Location was great - I flew into Newark, took the train to Penn Station, and then walked 5 blocks with my carry on, avoiding cabs and ubers.  Once there, super convenient to trains or just walking through mid-town and the theater district.    

As I said, I am rating this against its class - if you are looking for the St Regis, this is not it.  But if you want to stay someplace at a good price point that is clean, nice, safe and convenient while you explore NYC, this is a gem.

reviews.author: DCWNYC
reviews.title: Great place to stay while in midtown
reviews.body: This property is in the heart of midtown which is super convenient.  This property is very clean with a great team.  Each morning you get a full breakfast which is delicious. I highly recommend this property.

reviews.author: KM
reviews.title: Stay at the one on 28th instead
reviews.body: Very old and gross. Room smelled like cigs and mold. Bathroom was visibly discolored from age and grime. Needs a renovation badly.

reviews.author: MDR
reviews.title: Springhill 5th
reviews.body: I visit NYC once a month, and this Hotel is located where I can reach pretty much everything I need (Whole Foods, train, Metro-North, etc), and I love being able to walk to Bryant Park and enjoying the entertainment and ice cream.

reviews.author: Traveling with Teens
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.body: We were traveling with our two teens and decided to stay in Midtown as it’s close to a lot of activities that teens like as first time tourists in New York City. The Springhill Suites is a convenient location. However, we did not like how tight the dining room area was as most mornings we had to wait for a table. Though our hotel room was a good size, we  didn’t like the translucent bathroom sliding door. Teens are pretty self-conscious and they didn’t like that their shadow could be seen while they were using the toilet! Another note about the translucent door was that once lights were out and everybody went to bed, if someone uses the bathroom and turns that light on,  it illuminated the whole room!

reviews.author: Weekend get away
reviews.title: Location, location, location
reviews.body: We have stayed at this location multiple times and love the location. It is centrally located to so many of the things that you want to see in New York or just jump on the subway. The staff are friendly and the rooms are spacious. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Nfl
reviews.title: Terrible room& customer service!
reviews.body: There are too many better hotels to stay at! Front desk person at check in was rude and unfriendly. Room is nothing like described - glass bathroom door directly facing bed nearly transparent. No pull out couch as advertised

reviews.author: AMS
reviews.title: Great location, clean room, friendly staff
reviews.body:
We had a great experience at this SpringHill Suites Hotel.  Great location for shopping, restaurants, and train station.  There are several other properties in the same block but this one is by far best: cleaner, friendlier, and roomier.  
The room and bathroom size was comfortable for three people.  Many NY hotels do not have options for 2 queen beds.  Breakfast was convenient. I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Spring
reviews.title: Good location
reviews.body: Small room, good location

reviews.author: Amber
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Great stay in the middle of everything

reviews.author: Melanie
reviews.title: Great View
reviews.body: We loved the view of the Empire State building from our room!  We all slept very well in the comfortable beds.  This was a perfect location for us to explore midtown Manhattan.  The filtered water station in the exercise room was another excellent amenity!

reviews.author: Lauren 2001
reviews.title: Steps away from the action
reviews.body: This was my second time staying at this Marriott in NYC which is steps away from the action.  I jumped out of bed and was instantly on 5th avenue walking to my favorite sites.  Steps away from Penn Station and Madison Square Garden I was not afraid to walk to and fro by myself.  Location, location, location.  I did not walk to Times Square but on my way home I could see that it was only a few blocks away.  So if you want an affordable stay with an Empire State view with steps away from Broadway, 5th Avenue, and Madison Square Garden, this is your place!

reviews.author: Road trip
reviews.title: Quick visit
reviews.body: A favorite stop when we visit our kids in Manhattan. Service/location are perfect. Lone issue was only one elevator working, causing long waits.

reviews.author: Ranman113
reviews.title: Not the best first choice
reviews.body: The staff at this hotel was very mediocre. Not super friendly but also not rude. Just standard service checking you in. The lobby and breakfast cafe needs a lot of updating. It’s not very inviting. Lastly the shower drain in our room was slow in draining where it overflowed onto the floor. No bath tub. It’s very conveniently located in the city so that is a plus but going forward this hotel will not be my first choice.

reviews.author: Lee L
reviews.title: Great Staff Location But Unclean!
reviews.body: Location and staff were really good. Very eager to help. However the room had stained carpet and there was dirt and debris in bedding. Bathroom has dirty towels and was wiped but not decently clean. Looked used and then not cleaned like it was forgotten. View wonderful and again staff was great. The room was the worse part and when asked about it the front desk was nice but housekeeping never followed thru. Likely not stay here again due to this.

reviews.author: DC
reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.body: Very disappointed. Services were negative did not meet our expectation.

reviews.author: Blu
reviews.title: Renovations Necessary
reviews.body: Hotel in desperate need of renovation

reviews.author: Laurie Kelsey
reviews.title: Marriott do not put your name on this establishment
reviews.body:
I have to be honest with my friends about this stay because I was really disappointed.

The staff was absolutely wonderful — friendly, helpful, and professional. I honestly feel bad even writing a negative review because the staff themselves were not the problem at all. They can only do so much when the hotel itself is in such poor condition.

Unfortunately, our room was really not acceptable. It smelled when we walked in, the floor was sticky, the bathroom door had been poorly repaired, and there was actually a hole in the wall. The lampshade was also filthy. 😳

These are the kinds of things you just shouldn’t have to deal with when staying at a Marriott property.

I’m not sure what is happening with the upkeep of this hotel, but it definitely needs some attention. What makes it even more frustrating is that the staff was so nice — they deserve credit, but they also shouldn’t have to take the blame for conditions that are clearly beyond their control.

I’ve stayed at many Marriott properties over the years, and this was honestly one of the most disappointing experiences I’ve had. I hope management takes a serious look at this property because the staff deserves better, and so do the guests.

reviews.author: Happy Guest
reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.body: The front desk staff took very good care of us. They made us feel welcome and at home, after we arrived, even though we were very early.

reviews.author: Katherine
reviews.title: Extremely Disappointed
reviews.body:
This was by far the worst Fairfield stay I have experienced, and I was particularly disappointed by both the condition of the rooms and the lack of any meaningful response from the hotel during or after the stay.

When we initially checked in around 1:00 AM on Sept 5th, the carpet in our room was wet enough that our socks became soaked when walking across it, and the room had a strong mildew smell. We immediately asked to change rooms, but we were told the hotel was fully booked and that there was nothing available until the following day.

What was particularly frustrating was that, despite the wet carpet, the front desk told us there were not even any extra towels available for us to put down because housekeeping had already left for the night. It was difficult to understand how a hotel could have no towels available whatsoever for a guest dealing with a soaking-wet carpet at 1:00 AM.

The following day, we were moved to another room, only to encounter another serious maintenance issue. The shower was not draining properly, so maintenance came to address it. The maintenance employee applied a chemical treatment that produced an extremely strong and toxic-smelling odor. The smell was so overwhelming that the employee himself commented that his eyes were watering. The odor smelled like dead fish and was so strong that we could not remain in the room. 

We had to move rooms yet again. In the third room, the carpet was still damp, although thankfully it did not have the same mildew odor.

At this point, we had been forced to deal with three different rooms and multiple significant issues: wet and/or damp carpeting, a mildew odor, an inability to obtain basic towels when we first reported the problem, a non-draining shower, and chemical fumes severe enough that even the maintenance employee was experiencing eye irritation.

What is most disappointing is that despite all of this disruption, no manager offered any compensation, room upgrade, rate adjustment, or other meaningful gesture. We had to repeatedly pack up and relocate ourselves because the rooms provided were not reasonably suitable for a hotel stay.

We understand that maintenance issues can occasionally occur, but the combination and severity of these problems, along with the way they were handled, fell far below the standard I would expect from a Marriott property.

reviews.author: ManhattanTraveler1
reviews.title: So bad I had to leave
reviews.body: The rooms are in such poor shape. My particular room had such a strong odor that it gave me a migraine and I left to book another hotel at 8pm an hour after I checked in. Stay far away!

reviews.author: Alex C
reviews.title: Fair price / product ratio.
reviews.body:
Fair price / product ratio. 
I' ll come back.

reviews.author: CMCH
reviews.title: Need repairs!
reviews.body:
The good..  The hotel was in a great location and the employees were fantastic.  The breakfast was a nice perk as well as the 24 hour coffee.
The BAD:  We had a Suite. The room was in desperate need of repair. Balcony furniture broken. Bathroom old. Furniture didn't have any drawers.  You book a Suite at over $500 a night and you don't have a single drawer to put your clothes in???  
I have stayed at nicer and more reasonable hotels, right on that same block that I would book again, bypassing this one.

reviews.author: Babe in NY
reviews.title: A Little Gem
reviews.body: This little hotel delivers big! The staff was friendly and efficient. The room was comfy and clean. The breakfast was simple and yummy. The location was great.

reviews.author: DM
reviews.title: 4 nights, Terrible stay.
reviews.body:
Outdated hotel, extremely noisy air conditioning that doesn’t let you sleep at all.

I was supposed to have free bottled water for being gold status, but I wasn’t given even one. I grabbed one from the hotel pantry and told the front desk, but they did charge to the room! 

Bed was outdated and uneven and sunk more on one side vs the other. 

We requested the room to be cleaned again on the first night as there was a ring of dust around the cups by the coffee maker.  The room was not cleaned the following day and we had to request again. 

No hair conditioning in the shower on the first night and they never replenished it. Terrible stay. Outdated hotel, extremely noisy air conditioning. I had free bottled water for being gold status, I wasn’t given even one, but the one that I did grab was charged to the room! 

Bed was outdated and uneven. 

Requested the room to be clean as there was a ring of dust around the cups by the coffee maker, but the room was not cleaned until the following day when we had to ask again. 

We run out of hair conditioner on the first night and they never replenished. 

This is barely a 1 star hotel.

reviews.author: Rich from London
reviews.title: Very good value stay
reviews.body: The hotel is very competitively priced, particularly for such a central location, with quick access to the subway. The complimentary breakfast is really appreciated, with a good variety of hot dishes. The room is cleaned daily (which, in my experience, is not the norm in NY). The hotel would benefit from some updating - the furniture and carpets are tired - but it is nevertheless excellent value. The reception staff, Tracey and the guys, are all warm and helpful.

reviews.author: EA2026
reviews.title: This hotel needs an update and better management
reviews.body:
We booked a 3 night stay at this hotel. Our first room has mold on the curtains. The second room we changed to had less mold on the curtain but all furnitures other than the bed are damaged. The wardrobe didn’t even have a door. 
The 3rd room is tiny and not quite the same set up as the first two. There’s no normal wardrobe or desk space or a desk chair. As a Titanium member of Marriott, I felt very unappreciated. We had to accept the 3rd room reluctantly due to the hotel staff is getting annoyed. 
We travel to NYC quite often and this is the worst hotel we have ever stayed.

reviews.author: Jim Kee
reviews.title: Great value!
reviews.body: Clean, quiet, with modern amenities and in a great location. breakfast buffet was outstanding and staff went out of their way to help!

reviews.author: DMad
reviews.title: The staff is what makes this hotel a four star!
reviews.body: The staff at this hotel is friendly, empathetic and accommodating! The room was larger than most New York hotel rooms for the same price. The location is outstanding. I cannot say enough nice things about these folks!

reviews.author: Steven V
reviews.title: Great front desk and customer servicr
reviews.body: Malachi Was awesome! He is very friendly and made me feel special.

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: The room was great, the people were incredible.
reviews.body: Simply put, each and every member of the staff was warm, engaging, and helpful.

reviews.author: Lori
reviews.title: Great staffing, poorly kept building, poor practices.
reviews.body: Staff was very kind and respectful, building is poorly run.

reviews.author: Keriann
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.body: The hotel was clean but small. Our room was not ready when we arrived and he arrived after the check in time. We only had a view of the alley. But overall it was clean and the breakfast was good.

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Terrible first night stay as the ac was not working on a hot night
reviews.body: The ac was not working and spoke to other guests, they also faced the same problem .there was no onsite technicians present who can fix this

reviews.author: Irena 777
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.body: Great job on clean room, wonderful breakfast and access to coffee/tea during the day, front desk staff was very friendly and informative.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Completely rundown
reviews.body:
This hotel is completely rundown. The worst condition you can even come across. I was not able to find a single thing being in a good/normal condition. On too of it, I got bitten in my arm by bed bugs!
The staff though is very nice and helpful, kudos to them.
Breakfast is decent.

reviews.author: Lew
reviews.title: Front Desk Personnel the Best!
reviews.body: We had a great visit due to the front desk, personnel, being very helpful and making it an easy stay!

reviews.author: Sookton111
reviews.title: Nice clean hotel friendly staff
reviews.body: We had a great stay at the beautiful hotel. The rooms were very clean and the furniture was so pretty. The pool was great though it was closed the next day for renovation. I appreciated the helpful staff, they were friendly and welcoming. Will stay again and definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Needs Renovation
reviews.body: The front desk staff was warm and welcoming. However, everything in the room felt dirty and in need of renovation. I put my makeup bag on the shelf in the bathroom, which immediately tilted down as it wasn't anchored into the wall properly. The shower was filled with mildew. The carpet felt mildew-y under my feet. The mirror had water spots. The lamps were tilting off of the wall like they were going to fall out. And lastly, the towels were laughably small and barely covered my body.

reviews.author: Of
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.body:
The service nade the stay. 
The hotel is little old and not most clean.

reviews.author: Jackie
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.body: I had a wonderful stay at this property. Every staff member was great, particularly the front desk staff. They were incredibly welcoming and accommodating, and made sure that there were no issues with my stay. The room was clean, the location was convenient, and I felt the rate I paid was appropriate for the value of the stay.

reviews.author: MGoBlue
reviews.title: Stay someone else
reviews.body: Stay far away from this Fairfield. It's not worthy of carrying the Marriott name. The staff is super friendly and accommodating however the hotel hasn't been renovated in way too many years. The rooms have disgusting carpet, very limited space for clothing, rust on metal surface around doors which has been eroded away, and peeling wallpaper. The AC never got below 70 even when set lower and maintenance looking at it twice. Overall, the rooms are very dirty and there are way too many other options to stay in NY.

reviews.author: Mel
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body: Hotel was well located for our planned itinerary. The team staff were extremely helpful and kind during our stay.

reviews.author: Jose
reviews.title: Hotel needs renovations
reviews.body: Great location, good staff, good breakfast, hotel needs urgent renovations

reviews.author: BDev
reviews.title: Cleaning & renovation needed STAT!
reviews.body: The staff were lovely, but the room was very dirty and uncomfortable

reviews.author: Wayne and Connie
reviews.title: Great Manhattan location.
reviews.body: The hotel was very nice and the staff were very friendly and professional. It is a great location.

reviews.author: Sam Jackson
reviews.title: Great location in the city
reviews.body: Great spot, fairly large room in midtown, good HVAC, hot shower, friendly staff, thick walls.  I slept great, would stay again for sure.

reviews.author: venkat

reviews.body: Hotel needs to be renovated, staff is kind but experience was pretty bad for money paid north of $500 per night

reviews.title: Weekend stay

reviews.body: Nothing but amazing things to say about our stay and the staff. Room was quiet and clean!  Staff went above and beyond! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Silvia

reviews.body: The location Is excellent

reviews.author: yael
reviews.title: excellent place to stay in manhattan

reviews.body: I found the staff to be very friendly and helpful.  I was very pleased by all the staff.  Hotel location is perfect.  It’s an older hotel but the large fridge in room with microwave and dishes is very nice to have .  I will stay here again.

reviews.author: Aria
reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.body: Good location close to a lot of places, shopping areas. Very helpful staffs.

reviews.author: Isabela
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel's location is excellent. You can explore Manhattan on foot and enjoy Bryant Park, which is very close by. The room had a view of the Empire State Building and was spacious, though the sofa bed wasn't very comfortable. Cleanliness was fine, and the breakfast was hearty. The staff were very polite. My only complaint concerns the security deposit required by the hotel, which wasn't mentioned in the policy when I made the reservation; even now, eight days after checkout, the funds still haven't been released.

reviews.author: Member 20
reviews.title: Worst hotel
reviews.body: The front desk staff is rude very very rude. They don’t make you feel respected at all. The hotel is old and worn out everywhere also. There is no point staying here.

reviews.author: Stephanie from Brisbane
reviews.title: Location and Service was Excellent
reviews.body: Location and Staff were outstanding.  Breakfast was delicious daily.  Nothing was too much trouble. Definitely would stay here again.

reviews.author: Alru26
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Great location. Good breakfast

reviews.author: PghPinot
reviews.title: Spacious rooms in heart of Manhattan
reviews.body: As a former New Yorker, I find the rooms here to be spacious and equivalent to a studio apartment. The staff is kind and the daily breakfast generous. The gym is below expectations for a business traveller. I choose this hotel first for location / convenience to subways and second for the staff.

reviews.author: Nanz
reviews.title: Good location
reviews.body: It was decently clean ,comfortable and well connected by the T .

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Worth it!
reviews.body: Central location! Good value for the area. Breakfast was excellent with many options. Staff very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Cmac
reviews.title: Well-staffed with friendly people
reviews.body: I felt welcomed by every staff person I met. This is a safe and convenient location,  walkable for Penn Station,  Times Square, Bryant Park, 5th Ave shopping.

reviews.author: Trevor
reviews.title: Suitable place for business stay
reviews.body: Had a 7 day vacation stay with family recently.  Location was excellent, front desk staff were helpful.  Things to note were the lack of hot water after 9 or so in the morning.  If you needed to shower around then you were out of luck until noon.  Elevators made us late on the first morning as it took almost half an hour to get down 24 floors.  We had to call front desk to get things sent up a few times and they were extremely quick delivering compared to any other hotel we have stayed at.  The pull out couch mattress was completely springs, but when we called down to request a comforter or something to help, they showed up with a complete replacement mattress and sheets within 10 minutes.   Laundromat seemed all new ($5.00 per wash/dry) and worked perfect for us on day 6.  Breakfast buffet was so busy they had a staff person to line people up for elevator leaving.  Ended up taking stairs down  and didn't get a chance to try it.

reviews.author: Lucian
reviews.title: Best value and location!
reviews.body: Very well priced and good location in Midtown Manhattan.

reviews.author: Asil
reviews.body:
A $300 deposit was collected from me upon check-in. I was told that the money would be refunded to my credit card if I dic not make any charges during my stay. Althouah I did not make any purchases at the hotel, only $155.90 was credited back to my account. I would like to know the reason for this and request that the remaining balance be refunded to my credit card as soon as possible
Best reqards

reviews.author: Nadine
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.body:
Our stay as a family was very good. The rooms were clean and spotless.
The elevators were fast, but extremely busy during breakfast times, so you sometimes had to wait 10 minutes for a free elevator.
Breakfast was the only thing I personally didn't like. But that's a matter of taste. The coffee was good though!

Overall, I would always come back.
The location is perfect and the staff very, very friendly.

reviews.author: Risaura
reviews.title: Amazing people and location
reviews.body: This hotel is very nice and well kept. Had to be relocated due to a water leak and they made up for it well. The people where kind and willing to help you with anything you need. I liked how in high traffic hours like breakfast, there is someone directing the crowd and helping load elevators. Shout to Merrick, John the manager and my favorite Jessica. Though I could not put a face to the name, she has left a wonderful impression. Will  definitely stay again.

reviews.author: GR2026
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: this hotel is centrally located to most major sites and shopping , restaurants, times square etc... great if you want to be able to walk as opposed to taking taxis and/ or Ubers.  The hotel though obviously old... is clean and well maintained.... staff is friendly and helpful. If you are relying on a sofa bed for extra sleeping... don't! the mattress is very thin and extremely uncomfortable!

reviews.author: HappyGuest
reviews.title: Great location and service, highly recommended
reviews.body: a wonderful location and helpful staff. all that you need for your stay, comfortable beds, good shower, great laundry room and fitness center.

reviews.author: Kapfam
reviews.title: Great, all inclusive hotel
reviews.body: This was a quaint hotel with everything we needed. It was just my daughter and I on vacation, and the suite worked perfectly. The breakfast was included and very good. The hotel was very clean with comfortable beds! The elevators were fast and the staff was very friendly.

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.title: Excellent location, staff and services
reviews.body: We chose this place because of location to where our daughter was staying. However it was the perfect location to get anywhere in NYC. Subway across the road with lift, Bryant Park across the road. And 5 mins walk to Times Square, Macy's, Empire State Building, and lots of other places, yet once inside you felt like you were home.

reviews.author: UnhappyBonvoyMember
reviews.title: Constant erroneous charges to my credit card.
reviews.body: If you do not want to battle constant erroneous daily charges to your credit card, be sure to avoid this Residence Inn near Times Square at all costs. Daily reassurances by the staff of fixing their "mistakes" were only followed up by additional daily erroneous charges. I pre-paid for my stay 10 months in advance. I was charged for my stay a second time as well after I left. A full eight days after I have checked out I am now fully engaged with my credit card company to dispute the double charges.

reviews.author: DO BETTER
reviews.title: Better communication! Beware
reviews.body:
Beware if you ask if any rooms
Available they will give you a room
And charge you for early check in without telling you! Also if you book
With points they will still charge you cash and say your points didn’t go through. 
The front desk manager was not helpful with the questions I asked. I understand  he may have been overwhelmed but that’s why you are in a managerial role for instances like these.
It’s very frustrating that no one communicated when I left my points were not applied.

reviews.author: Broadway fan
reviews.title: Nice location, helpful staff
reviews.body: This was my 4th stay at this hotel.  I like the location and the rooms are clean and spacious.  On this particular stay one of the elevators was out of service so it often took 10+ minutes to get from higher floors down as many elevator cars stopped but were full.  I will likely try again though.

reviews.author: a
reviews.title: GREAT
reviews.body: The hotel staff was so kind. I have 3 more New York vacation within the next six months and I wish this hotel was available. It was so great and so friendly.

reviews.author: Dan M
reviews.title: Times Square Gem
reviews.body: We love staying at the Times Square Courtyard. Excellent location for dining, the theater and  a quick ride on the 7 train to the US Open. I especially like that Miguel at the front desk remembers us and greets us by name every time. That's exceptional service!

reviews.author: B  K
reviews.title: Dirty, awful
reviews.body: This hotel is a complete disaster.  The service is nice and that's where it ends.  Dirty!!!  There is peeling paint, dirty grout and silicones in the bathroom.  Dirty water in which I was disgusted to bathe!!! Cracked tiles, dirty room, tables by the bed disgusting.  The bed headboard is disgusting.  breakfast - anyone who called it that probably never ate breakfast. I asked 2 months earlier what they are serving for breakfast, but never get an answer. Avoid!!! Do not recommend it

reviews.author: dirty room hotel
reviews.title: my last hotel
reviews.body: the hotel is so dirty then I file a complaint but  ignored my complaint.

reviews.author: S V
reviews.title: Great people, a comfortable stay.
reviews.body: The staff were amazing and the the room as quiet and clean.

reviews.author: Ron
reviews.title: Location
reviews.body:
Perfect location
  Could walk everywhere.

reviews.author: Jesse
reviews.title: Broken elevators all stay long
reviews.body:
Hello,

Our recent stay - booked on points - at the Courtyard Times Square was quite a mixed bag. First, I'd like to stress that I thought the staff at this location were excellent in every regard. The luggage stuff were hopeful both on check-in and check-out and everyone was friendly throughout and made great effort to make the hotel's difficulties manageable.

Unfortunately, the elevator issues were significant and constant and had a negative impact on our overall vacation.

On the morning of our check-in, we received an email that said "Elevator upgrades are currently underway, which may result in occasional delays and longer-than-usual wait times. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to improve the hotel experience."

Had I been alerted to such issues in advance, I would have selected another hotel.

We were placed on the 31st floor and told on check-in that 1 of the 3 elevators was in the process of being replaced and that delays might occur. Unfortunately, this was the least of it. Regularly during our stay, a second elevator was not operational and only 1 elevator was servicing 33 floors.

The result was occasionally waiting for the elevator for upwards of 30 minutes. This happened regularly during our stay. Worse, it meant that we had to constantly plan for the possibility of such a wait, even if the elevator  ultimately showed up quickly. We just never knew what was going to happen which meant either risk being really late for something, or perhaps really early. The reason we chose this hotel was because of it's location and proximity to broadway. Being late wasn't an option but being unnecessary early, especially with our young children, was also a problem.

To compound everything, on our very last evening there was a large storm and we returned from our show damp and cold to find that all elevators had been shut down. It took over an hour (from the time we arrived at the hotel) before the electrician arrived and got a single elevator working. The staff were absolutely incredible during this, but instead of drying off and packing, we had to wait in the lobby in our wet clothes.

I appreciate that these things happen and that it's not in the hotel's interest to advertise it's elevator issues, but had Marriott/the hotel been honest with us at the time of booking or any time in advance, we would have had an significantly improved experience at a different Marriott property.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Time Square
reviews.body: The rooms were fine and as expected. The staff was helpful and polite. The TV did not work properly and not all channels were not available. Maintenance was called and could not fix the issue. The elevators were very slow and were no reliable. In fact one night they did not work and we had to walk up the stairs 21 flight to get to our room. Glad I didn’t have luggage. All in all it was not my best stay in a Marriott property. There is discrepancies on the billing that need to be resolved. Charges for services were added that we did not use and there is inconsistency in the quote room cost and what was actually changed??? As stated earlier not my best stay.

reviews.author: Faith
reviews.title: Okay could be better
reviews.body: During my stay the elevators went out because of a storm so only one was functional when needed. They don’t have many breakfast options and no microwave in the rooms only in the lobby level. Upon entry to our room we noticed that our bathroom door was partially broken and one of the bed sheets were dirty. The location is great especially for the price, we were able to get anywhere via walk or subway pretty easily. Also very quiet, not noisy at all from the street. Overall: okay but could be better.

reviews.author: KM
reviews.title: First Trip
reviews.body: Brought my daughter on her first trip to NYC to see a Broadway show. The location was great. Reserved an “Empire State View” room and was not disappointed. Definitely got some good pictures. Walking distance to shopping and attractions. Will definitely be staying here on future trips.

reviews.author: Thepaalmans
reviews.title: A Once‑Reliable Courtyard That No Longer Delivers on the Brand Promise
reviews.body:
I gave an average rating because the hotel didn’t deliver on Courtyard’s promise of inviting, flexible spaces and classic style. The staff wasn’t particularly welcoming and didn’t acknowledge my Silver Elite status or offer the usual arrival amenities like water. The lobby and common areas felt small and not very inviting, the spaces weren’t flexible for working or relaxing, and while the design was clean, it felt generic rather than classic.

In addition to the brand‑promise concerns, the property is clearly showing its age, and several maintenance issues directly affect the guest experience. The bathroom hardware is inconsistent and in some cases improperly installed — for example, a bath handle was mounted onto the shower instead of replacing the correct shower handle, which suggests patchwork fixes rather than proper repairs. The toilet only flushes if the handle is held down fully, and the bathroom sink does not provide any true cold water; the only temperatures available are warm, hot, and very hot. These issues, combined with the dated feel of the room, indicate that the hotel is overdue for a comprehensive update.

After seven stays over the past ten years, it’s disappointing to see the experience decline rather than improve. The lack of inviting or flexible spaces, the absence of expected elite recognition, and the noticeable maintenance issues all contributed to my average rating.

reviews.author: Sylvia
reviews.title: Return of charged deposit
reviews.body: The deposit that was charge to was not yet initiated and return back to my credit card. It is more than 7 days already! They didn’t even send the copy of my invoice

reviews.author: overall it was ok
reviews.title: Okay but the noise and smrll from bathroom
reviews.body:
overallgood....
smell from bathroom and the bell noise was the problem

reviews.author: Travis
reviews.title: Times Square Courtyard Review
reviews.body: Overall, my experience was not the greatest during our stay. The only thing that was positive from the stay was the hospitality of the staff and how considerate they were given the circumstances that we were faced with. With that being said, between not having air conditioning in our rooms and the elevators being down and creating long wait times to get to the lobby, it was very disappointing. Having to walk down 28 flights of stairs because the elevator was down for over an hour, having to have a fan in our room because the air wasn't working was just an extreme inconvenience. For the price that was paid, this was just unacceptable. Given everything that occurred, if I ever visit again, I probably will look for a different hotel to stay at.

reviews.author: zack auth
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.body:
1 elevator for entire hotel
Hot room despite setting it in 60 and never used covers at night.

Just to many hotels around that area to settle for this one.

If I were you, I'd look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Yogi R
reviews.title: I wouldn't stay here again
reviews.body: The room had multiple issues from dust, mildew, cockroach and TV not working. The doors are think so you wake up when the neighbor's door shuts or when people are talking in the hall. There is a large gap under the door so the sound carries too.

reviews.author: loyalMarriottmember
reviews.title: Do not be fooled
reviews.body: Please stay away. It is not worth your time and money.

reviews.author: Nick T
reviews.title: Great location and accommodations
reviews.body: We had a great stay to do some fun things in the NYC area.

reviews.author: CeeDee
reviews.title: Worse Marriott I ever stayed in
reviews.body: This Marriott was well below average when you think of Courtyard by Marriott. I was slightly disgusted with my stay. You don’t expect the A/C to not function properly or at all in 3 of the 4 rooms my party booked, which was the case our entire visit. Broken elevator only 2 working, that one broke with guest stuck in it. The  Fire dept who came said they have the worse elevators in the city and wished us luck riding on them when we asked was it fixed. The elevators were not safe. Valet suspended bringing cars to guest without notice from 4am-3pm because of a parade so we had to go find the lot & get our car ourselves after paying for valet service. It was a terrible hotel & a terrible stay. The ONLY redeeming quality was the staff. The fact they had to deal with irate guest talking to them like they owned the hotel & were responsible for its sad condition was awful. My heart went out to them that they had to represent the hot mess this hotel is. The owners should be shame & Marriott should take their name off the building until it gets up to standard. I loved staff the hotel sucks for real. To top it off on my way out a huge roach ran past me. Most importantly the elevators are not safe in my opinion.

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.title: Worst Marriott Property I’ve stayed at
reviews.body: Hotel was generally very dirty in common areas, elevators were frustratingly slow, air conditioning in room did not work (even after being told they would fix it)….all for 250+ a night. Hard pass.

reviews.author: Rosie O
reviews.title: Great location but would not recommend for a summer stay
reviews.body: Great location and friendly staff but the a/c barely worked.

reviews.author: Stay somewhere else
reviews.title: Horrible hotel
reviews.body: This hotel needs a complete refurbishment.  The elevators are scary.  Half the stuff in the room is broken, cracked, doesn't work.  The shower is the weirdest configuration.  Could have stayed in nicer hotel for similar money.

reviews.author: Jkray
reviews.title: Broken elevators, broke my my trip
reviews.body: Very poor hotel maintenance and the lack of a working elevator made this trip very difficult

reviews.author: M Walker
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience!
reviews.body: Absolutely amazing in every way.

reviews.author: MS
reviews.title: Don’t use Valet!
reviews.body: DO NOT use the hotel valet service. It is inefficient and provide excessively poor service. The Courtyard Marriott contracts out the service so they remove themselves of culpability when things go wrong. We followed the Marriott staff given directions to retrieve our car for a safe, timely departure to the airport but were made to wait over 2 hours for our car. Excuses given, but zero assistance and accountability. Buyer beware!

reviews.author: Al
reviews.title: Smelly rooms;  only one elevator worked consistently
reviews.body: Fair hotel.  But our room has poor views and smelled awful

reviews.author: Mimi David
reviews.title: Excellent Service and Location!
reviews.body: You will never  go wrong in choosing Courtyard by Marriott Times Square/Manhattan.  The location is perfect and to top it off, all the staff are very friendly and accommodating.

reviews.author: Tino
reviews.title: Family stay with issues
reviews.body: Good time with the but door issues and elevator issues shadowed the experience.

reviews.author: Tony O
reviews.title: Hotel didn't meet any of our expectations
reviews.body:
Check in time was delayed  
Room ac was not working 
Room was across from linen closet dirty towels everywhere

reviews.author: Kcme
reviews.title: Nice hotel and great location
reviews.body: The hotel waa lovely. Really enjoyed my stay although it was very expensive. My rate was $769 per night but was the least expensive rate i could find in the area. My room was very nice and the staff was kind and welcoming. The appetizers and evening cocktail were lovely. Skip the breakfast buffet. It was one of the worst I have ever experienced. Very dry and bland eggs, not much of a selection at all. Bagels were part of the buffet but only offered chive and garlic cream cheese.  Breakfast was downright awful. Definitely not worth the purchase. Save your $35 per day credit for the evening.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: We continue to enjoy staying at The Lexington Hotel
reviews.body: The Lexington hotel is our go to stay when visiting New York. The staff is incredibly attentive and the service is great! Highly recommend. We will be back.

reviews.author: Biz traveler
reviews.title: Cool  hotel in a great location
reviews.body: Stay here regularly - is it the best? Probably not but it works for me.

reviews.author: Nolex
reviews.title: Tired hotel
reviews.body: The Lexington might have a lot of history but my experience left much to be desired. Staff were accommodating but the rooms I had (yes two rooma, because the first was really bad) were not in great shape. Bathroom mirror falling off the wall and missing reflective backing. The air system basically didn't function.  Won't be staying again.

reviews.author: Kaoutar chaoui
reviews.title: Lexington
reviews.body: Far below my expectations.

reviews.author: David Nairn
reviews.title: Never go back!
reviews.body:
My wife and I stayed at The Lexington back in 2019 and had an amazing experience so it seemed logical to stay there again in September 2026, our next New York stay - oh dear, what a huge disappointment. The room we were allocated had clearly not been decorated since we were last there 7 years ago! The bathtub had rust around the drain hole and had a number of chips in the enamel. The reception staff were completely uninterested in trying to resolve and were completely passive aggressive, claiming they were completely full so there was nothing they could (would) do about it.
It got worse…….when retrieving a pillow that had slipped down the gap between the mattress and headboard, it was full of dust, clearly not been cleaned since the fixed bed frame had been installed

reviews.author: Scottsdale AZ
reviews.title: Great location - "ok" experience
reviews.body:
Love the Lexington hotel. 
But it desperately needs a refresh and plumbing update. 
Tub always back up while showering.

reviews.author: Greg and Bill
reviews.title: Great location for those wanting to stay in the midtown area.
reviews.body: The Lexington Hotel is a great choice location wise for those wanting to stay in the midtown area.  They have a GREAT breakfast buffet.  The rooms are nice, although a bit small - but probably "normal" for NYC.  The staff is exceptionally friendly.  They do host a lot of tour groups, so the lobby gets quite busy during the times tour groups arrive.  There are 5 elevators, so you never have to wait long at all for an elevator.  The only negative is that the windows in our room were unbelievably dirty - you literally could not see out of them - it was almost as thought there was an opaque film on them, but there wasn't.  We had a corner room with what probably had typical NYC views, but we weren't able to enjoy the views at all; however, there was a LOT of construction going on around the hotel, so possibly it's not possible for them to keep the windows clean at the moment.

reviews.author: Priscilla
reviews.title: Costumer service!
reviews.body: Amazing stay, great costumer service. Bellman team was phenomenal.

reviews.author: Jacket Racket
reviews.title: Not an Autograph
reviews.body:
Hotel (rooms and hallways) needs a refresh at these prices.  

But big issue is that I left a jacket and shirt in my closet when I checked out.  I called the hotel no more than 2 hours later to let them know, and was routed to a 3rd party web service who was going to connect with the hotel and get back to me.  7 days later I heard back that they didn’t have it, which, had the hotel just handled this personally, they would have found because I followed up so quickly.  Now I’m out $400 in clothing

reviews.author: Alan C
reviews.title: AVOID THIS HOTEL AT ALL COSTS
reviews.body: Not even remotely worth the $$$ ($600-700/night for a single room which was tiny, dated and with the smallest bathroom and toilet I have ever experienced). Paint chips peeling off the wall over the sink and questionable cleaning practices are major concerns. Poor staffing and responses to these aforementioned concerns is also a RED FLAG for me - esp at these price points and presumed level of service promised for an "AUTOGRAPH COLLECTION" level historical hotel. It doesn't matter to me if Marylin Monroe stayed here 50+ year ago, what matters to me is that it has been properly cleaned and updated to justify the cost of $600-700+/night today ! AVOID THIS HOTEL AT ALL COSTS. Awful.

reviews.author: Paull
reviews.title: An underwhelming Experience
reviews.body: Great Hotel , location superb, however a lot to be improved. From a very tedious, slow and frustrating check in experience to a struggling air conditioning room I expected more. They have a great shared gym down in LL, which was fantastic.

reviews.author: Elhoso
reviews.title: Gracious, quiet and conveniently located
reviews.body: We’ve stayed here a few times and have always had excellent service and accommodations, from check in to departure. Yes, it could use some updating but the value compensates for that. We typically stay in Midtown East because not only is it conveniently located, it is also much quieter than many of the other central districts. The one new practice which dismayed was being charged to store our luggage a couple of hours  when we were leaving.

reviews.author: emmbarr5
reviews.title: If you want to be scammed, look no further
reviews.body: Upon check in, my card was charged twice for two nights amounting to almost $2000. When questioned they assured me it would be corrected upon check out. though i received an invoice for $924 upon check out, my card was charged $924 plus an additional $367. I tried numerous times to get this corrected

reviews.author: Outoftowners
reviews.title: Nice experience
reviews.body: We use this hotel whenever we come to the city. The restaurant and lobby are very chic. Nice place to have a cocktail. The rooms are nice, some on the small side and bathrooms also small.

reviews.author: NYWeekender
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: Loved the hotel and the location. Everything was top rated.

reviews.author: CeCeL
reviews.title: Dirty and very Poorly Maintained- not worth the money!
reviews.body:
We stayed here over Labor Day weekend specifically for the US Open. After being a NYC resident for over a decade, this was my first time needing a hotel for the tournament. The location is undeniably convenient for the US Open, and I typically love an Autograph Collection hotel. Unfortunately, this property was nowhere near worth the price, and I would strongly caution anyone with concerns about dust, mold, or mildew against staying here.

There are really two separate issues: the level of service (or lack thereof) and, more importantly, the cleanliness and upkeep of the property.

First, the service. We checked in early and were told we would be called when our room was ready. We never received a call. We were then charged $3 per bag to store our luggage while we waited. At nearly $500 a night, charging guests to hold their bags while waiting for their room feels completely unreasonable.

We also did not receive housekeeping or fresh linens during our stay, despite specifically requesting service and being out of the hotel all day Saturday.

Our first room was another major issue. There was no functioning AC and the room was 78 degrees. There was a tower fan already sitting in the room, which made it seem as though the hotel was aware of the issue and was still attempting to put guests in the room. When I tried to adjust the temperature, the entire thermostat fell off the wall. I brought the piece downstairs and showed management, who ultimately moved us to another room. While waiting in line, the woman behind me was also requesting a new room because her room didn’t have water. At that point, it was pretty clear that basic upkeep was not a priority at this property.

The biggest issue, however, was the cleanliness.

I’m very familiar with older NYC buildings and hotels, and I completely understand that older properties can have quirks and wear — but old does not have to mean dirty. This room was dirty.

There was visible dust throughout the room — on the windowsills, light bulbs, headboard, and vents. The dust on the vents was approximately half an inch thick. The room had a persistent musty smell, and there was visible mildew/mold around the shower drain. Paint was also visibly cracking and peeling from the walls.

I spent much of the stay with the windows open and tried to avoid spending time in the room because the air and overall condition made me uncomfortable.

The location is excellent for the US Open, but unfortunately, that convenience does not justify the price. There are cleaner, better-maintained options in NYC for significantly less money. Given the combination of poor service, maintenance issues, and cleanliness concerns, I would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Tony Contessa
reviews.title: Loud noise backed up tub horrible service
reviews.body: Bad service. Loud noises tub was clogged and there was debris backing up. Not addressed

reviews.author: Ahmed
reviews.title: Disappointing Service and Attention to Detail
reviews.body: The hotel is generally nice, but the service and attention to detail were disappointing. There was no drinking water or tissues in the room, and the room phone was not working. Late checkout was refused despite my Gold membership benefits. I was also charged $3 per piece of luggage for storage. Overall, I expected a more welcoming and attentive experience.

reviews.author: Traveler 5218
reviews.title: Hotel Stsy
reviews.body: Only stayed for 2 nights and both of the nights the air conditioner didn't work. Notified front desk and house keeping and still no answer. Very disappointed

reviews.author: Renee
reviews.title: Good value for NYC hotel
reviews.body: I enjoyed a very nice updated room, and as a Platinum elite member was given a room on the very top floor.   Small room but a nice view.  There is no lounge at this hotel, however they compensate by giving free buffet breakfast in their restaurant and a $35 credit at the bar each day of your stay.   The breakfast food was quite delicious, better quality than the typical included hotel breakfast.  They also provide free bottles of water to take to your room.   Overall this is a very comfortable, cozy, well decorated hotel in a great central location in Manhattan!

reviews.author: Chris C
reviews.title: Good location; Disappointing experience
reviews.body:
While the location was great, my experience was unfortunately marred by a few significant issues.

First, the check-in process was quite disorganized. I was initially told my room was not ready after the 4:00 PM check-in time. However, another staff member was able to find a room for me just five minutes later.
