Second, there was a stain on the fitted sheet upon my arrival. Furthermore, the bedding was not changed for two nights, which required me to escalate the issue to a manager before it was resolved.

Finally, as a Lifetime Gold Elite member, I requested a late checkout to accommodate my afternoon flight. The desk agent who assisted me was dismissive, avoiding eye contact and smirking during our interaction. While my request was eventually granted, the lack of professionalism was disappointing.

I hope this feedback helps improve future guest experiences.

reviews.author: Anne
reviews.title: Not up to Marriott Bonvoy standards
reviews.body:
I have stayed at this location previously and my husband has also stayed at this location for business and I even had recommended the hotel to my cousin. 

This visit I was a bit disappointed and feel like the services were not up to Marriott Bonvoy standards. I had trouble reaching the front desk from my room several times during the stay. And also had asked house keeping for wash clothes that were not supplied on 2 days. One of the days I had asked for 4 wash clothes and when they were brought up to the room I was told that they could only spare 3 because the hotel was running low on wash clothes.

The rooms have since better days. They are showing their age.

Also the thermostat/air conditioner was not working. There were only 2 options since the temperature could not be regulated the only option was to leave it running or to turn it off.

reviews.author: George
reviews.title: Bad
reviews.body: Everything was quite bad—from waiting six hours for our room to the communication with the front desk and the manager. We had cockroaches in our room. The manager who moved us to another room later pretended not to remember that we had reported the cockroaches. The attitude was arrogant, we were lied to, and the hotel was an absolute dump. The rooms were old, tiny, run-down, and smelly. Apart from its location, this was probably the worst hotel we have ever stayed in—and we have travelled extensively all over the world.

reviews.author: Term123
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.body: Very nice stay, well located, quiet for NY.

reviews.author: Ty C
reviews.title: Underwhelming
reviews.body: AC went out first night and never got fixed. Window broke first night. Got fixed that day. Decent room.

reviews.author: Unhappy Marriott customer
reviews.title: Do not book here
reviews.body: Read reviews online before you stay

reviews.author: Krista
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Central Location
reviews.body: Very close to the subway, Times Square, and Grand Central.  Clean rooms, we were able to leave our luggage with the bell hope before check in, friendly staff and lots of amenities.  We did have an issue connecting to the TV, but we called the desk and they immediately sent someone to fix it.  No refrigerator in the room, but we didn't need one.  Very pleased, will stay again.

reviews.author: S CC
reviews.title: Clean but Horrible experience
reviews.body: The staff completely messed up our reservation and did not communicate at all between shift changes. Other guests tried to get into our room at 1:30am on night 1 and then a hotel staff came banging on our door at 1:45am!! Next morning I had put the do not disturb sign on the door and took a shower. I had just stepped out of the shower and a hotel staff just walked into the room, let themselves right in while I was naked! Then an hour later a different staff member came and knocked this time asking when my checkout is and I told them I check out tomorrow I am here for another night. They said and I quote "Okay thats all I needed thank you!" Then later that day I came back at 12:30am after a concert and hotel security (who I did not know was security at the time, just a man at my door trying ti get in as I approached) was waiting by my door telling me my room is “locked out” and to come with him to the front desk. He wouldnt explain anything further than that, leaving me feeling like I did something wrong. Also did not identify himself which can be very dangerous  for a young woman. Then at the desk, I'm being told thats not my room and that I was booked for 1 night. After showing my email confirmation, searching my name on the system, and what I paid for it was a clear mix up with the hotel staff. This mix up was happening for a whole 24 hours and I was bothered 4 different times by staff and NONE OF THEM communicated with each other to clear this. It could have been solved when the guy knocked and I told him I was booked for 2 nights. My sleep was disturbed BOTH NIGHTS!! I was only in NYC for 2 nights and I got interrupted both nights and was on edge when in my room that someone was going to just walk in or knock again saying something else was wrong. I paid $500 to get little to no sleep and no privacy at all. I feel like I was treated horribly as a guest.

reviews.author: Tweetyluvr83
reviews.title: Birthday Weekend
reviews.body: We had an absolute FANTASTIC weekend staying here for the first time. From the staff, rooms, food and drinks, it was a wonderful experience! We will definitely be staying here again!!

reviews.author: Faz s
reviews.title: Place was great, but they were hidden fees.
reviews.body: Great location. Great hotel and staff. However, got the bill and there was two extra charges that I’m not understanding.

reviews.author: Esmie
reviews.title: Special trip for a special birthday
reviews.body: Hotel staff very friendly. Hotel and room clean although furniture in our room was rather tired. Very disappointed with complete lack of vegan options in the restaurant.  Food I did eat was very good but my daughter was only able to eat pasta

reviews.author: Safety
reviews.title: Safe
reviews.body: The most important concern for me as a women traveling alone for work is safety!

reviews.author: Brandon
reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.body: Poor hospitality, old rooms.

reviews.author: Mikeb
reviews.title: US Open Review
reviews.body: Early arrival, assigned a room.  Very Good overall.

reviews.author: MFL26
reviews.title: Tennis brings me back to the Westin!
reviews.body: Great location, Erica at the front desk is wonderful, spent three weeks and had a great stay…..

reviews.author: Ricardo
reviews.title: Mine
reviews.body: Only situation was the lack of ice machines in every floor, to many out of service

reviews.author: Pablo 86
reviews.title: Westin NY Grand Central
reviews.body: Excellent location and service provided.

reviews.author: MLing
reviews.title: Great choice in the NYC
reviews.body: I stayed here before the renovation. It wasn’t great. So this time I had same expectation to come here, only because the price it’s a reasonable for me.But as soon as I arrive, I found out they recently renovated and it’s worth every penny of it! especially at the front desk, lady Naomi make my life much easier and feeling welcomed. The only down side I have is the valet parking service. I informed one valet that I will go check in here, and he agreed, but the other Wally manager popping into the lobby saying some sarcasm language to me because he think I was just trying to get some free parking time over there and it was horrible.

reviews.author: A Bryzzo
reviews.title: Very good hotel
reviews.body:
Very good hotel close to everything. Valet is a huge factor for me, along with a gym.
Deidre is amazing 👏.

reviews.author: Happy Traveler
reviews.title: Clean hotel with great staff in central location.
reviews.body: Really liked this hotel and would stay again. It was very clean, well-appointed and had nice touches like fitness equipment you could borrow. Great location and convenient valet parking.

reviews.author: F Begum
reviews.title: Prime location & excellent facilities
reviews.body: The westin is located in the best possible spot to explore NYC especially if it’s your first time, with or without family. It’s close to all major tourist spots and subways. Just a short walk from grand central station, making it ideal to travel further upstate if needed. So much food and drink options dotted around, easy access to uber/taxis and public transportation. The area is what makes it the best, super clean and quiet, ideal for resting after a long day of walking around the lively neighbourhoods of NYC

reviews.author: 10sfever
reviews.title: Fantastic staff!
reviews.body:
I look forward to ensconcement at the Westin every year while working the US Open.
We are always treated with genuine care.
Erica Kushkin at the front desk and Thomas in concierge are top level. You are blessed to have them in your employ.

reviews.author: Room was not safe
reviews.title: Rooms not safe
reviews.body: Poor baby on was not safe

reviews.author: Tracy
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.body: Excellent hotel all round and perfectly positioned to move around the city

reviews.author: DavKimAug
reviews.title: Midtown Miracle
reviews.body: Was in NYC for meetings and had the opportunity to stay at the Westin GC and it did not disappoint! Everything that one would expect, this hotel delivered on.

reviews.author: JHDelMar1
reviews.title: So Many Better Options
reviews.body: Manager was super nice and helped out immediately with our room with broken shades, holes in the sheets and pillows, wet carpet.  That’s the only positive.  Poorly maintained rooms.  Very noisy intersection so both a good and bad location at the same time. Food and drink plan is a rip off.  On top of the high prices they treat themselves to a 20% service on everything.  So many better options. Avoid this place.

reviews.author: RodHerr082026
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.body: Had a great three nights at this Westin and while we were off property during the days, the evenings and overnights were great!

reviews.author: From SF CA
reviews.title: Well, it is not a Westin experience
reviews.body: I have been with Westin brand many times and this place was not up to my expectations at all. Please lower your expectations or find other hotels. The location was good though

reviews.author: Danielle UK
reviews.title: Great stay at the Westin
reviews.body: Lovely hotel, great location. The receptionist who checked up in was absolutely lovely. I would definitely stay here again. The rooms where clean and equipped with everything you'd need for a New York stay!

reviews.author: Angie
reviews.title: Solo trip
reviews.body: Excellent service, beautiful clean rooms.

reviews.author: Magda G
reviews.title: The Westin
reviews.body:
Great Location,  Excellent Staff, Very Clean.
I will definitely recommend and return to 
The Westin

reviews.title: STAY here because of IRINA & the STAFF!
reviews.body: You will want to stay HERE because of an INCREDIBLE Manager: Ms. Irina Burukhov & her amazing staff.  I will name as many as I can but if I fail to name them all, simply ask HER.  She knows all of them!  First, begin with the outside doormen:  HECTOR, Andy..two of them & the others.  ALL are great.  AND, there is a wonderful taxi driver you should request:  His name is Harry.  His number is: 718,674.5010.  Forget Lyft/Uber.  HARRY works with the HOTEL and is your guy!  Once inside, the CONCIERGE is amazing: Sandra, Eve, Jose-Miguel, Charles.  The Front desk is fabulous as well especially if Erica, Lilly or Gus is around!  In baggage is the ever delightful Joe & Trevor.  At the Amore Restaurant/Bar, you will find Neville/Marlene/Octavia/Max/Roman/Guil/Kate/Douglas...and the list continues!

reviews.author: JulieG
reviews.title: absolutely no complaints
reviews.body: The physical plant was wonderful and the staff was extraordinary from the housekeepers, front desk, bellmen and valet. Efficient and friendly

reviews.author: Mary D
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!
reviews.body: Our experience at the Westin New York Grand Central was excellent. As soon as we pulled up to the Valet attendants, we were greeted and helped right away. The front desk staff and concierge were friendly and the process was quick and easy.  The rooms were ready and clean and we had no problems through check-out. Allowed us to focus on the special event we were in town for. Will definitely stay again and recommend to friends and family.

reviews.author: Obakir62
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: It was very convenient for us. The location was great close to Times Square not too far from Rockefeller Center right next to the Grand Central everything that we wanted, we will definitely be back. Most of all I loved the corner room very nice and quiet.

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.title: I will stay here everytime.
reviews.body: Had a great stay here! I stayed with my company but then stayed a couple extra days for a personal vacation and ended up just extending my stay at the Westin. The doorman, Hector, is my absolute favorite. He is so warm, kind and welcoming and has a fantastic memory. He remembered one of my co-workers and he only sees her once every year! They were both so excited to see each other. So then I introduced myself to Hector and he immediately welcomed me and offered to take a picture for us. He is so thoughtful and energetic and is the perfect person to greet you and walk you into this fabulous hotel.

reviews.author: Jeff Q
reviews.title: Wonderful as always!
reviews.body: I stay at this particular Westin at least once a year and am always impressed by the incredible customer service. Rooms are always spotless and F&B is terrific as well! Location is great, alot within walking distance and a short jump to Laguardia.

reviews.author: Family of 3
reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.body: Location but poor upkeep and lack of ac

reviews.author: KandyStar
reviews.title: Stay At The Westin
reviews.body: Staff at this location were amazing from the concierge to the restaurant staff to the valet welcoming as you enter. The beds were comfortable and rooms clean. The only change is the rooms only go down to a certain temp and at night it just felt too hot in the rooms. Other than that I would definitely stay again and recommend to others.

reviews.author: Luis
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body:
My wife and I had an amazing stay at The Times Square EDITION for a much-needed kid-free weekend, and it couldn’t have been better. From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive. Everyone went above and beyond to make our stay special.

The hotel itself was beautiful, the atmosphere was great, and the entire experience was exactly what we were hoping for. It was the perfect place for a relaxing weekend away in NYC. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: DLNYC2026
reviews.title: Wedding anniversary trip
reviews.body: Just returned back to the UK from our trip to NYC. This Hotel and its team have raised the bar on what my expectations are from a Hotel

reviews.author: Stella
reviews.title: Great Stay in Times Square
reviews.body: My wife and I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: TaratheNYer77
reviews.title: Best hotel experience of my life!
reviews.body: The Edition is set apart from every other stay I’ve ever experienced. The entire staff encountered made me feel like a high class citizen from beginning to end, with such class, respect, kindness and professionalism. The sheer smell of the spa like heaven of this hotel grips you from around the corner and pulls you into its safety away from the insane Times Square hustle and bustle on the street. They provided complimentary wine and cake for my husband’s birthday as a great surprise, and it was literally the best bite of chocolate I have ever put in my mouth! The amenities and entire experience was top class, for this very non-high-class New Yorker. If I could afford to stay here again, I would not even hesitate to stay when I come back to NY. Thank you for an unforgettable and perfectly helpful night. You made our trip the best!

reviews.author: Disappointed Traveler
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body:
We recently stayed at The Times Square EDITION and, unfortunately, were quite disappointed with our experience. We had two separate rooms during our stay, and both rooms had noticeable cleanliness issues.

Both bathrooms had hair left in the shower, which was particularly concerning. One of the rooms had a visibly dirty carpet, and the curtains and overall condition of the rooms also appeared to need a much deeper cleaning. Given the reputation and price point of this hotel, we expected a much higher standard of cleanliness and attention to detail.

Unfortunately, our experience was made even more concerning when, as we were leaving the hotel and heading to the airport, we saw a family of rats outside near the entrance. That was certainly not the impression we expected to leave with.

I will say that the front desk staff was nice, and the staff overall was courteous and pleasant. However, good customer service cannot make up for significant cleanliness and maintenance concerns.

The Times Square EDITION is a beautiful property with the potential to be a wonderful hotel, but based on our experience, it would greatly benefit from a thorough deep cleaning and closer attention to housekeeping and the surrounding property. We were disappointed, particularly because we expected much more from an EDITION property.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Let down
reviews.body:
I was genuinely floored by this experience and not in the least bit positive. From the moment I entered this location, I was dumbfounded as to how this was a Chase recommended property. To begin, after a long day of traveling, I was told your property does not accept ApplePay, and instead of working with me to find a solution, I was told I would need to produce a physical card (despite having prepaid for my visit and having a card on file) or go pull out hundreds of dollars worth of cash. After spending much of this summer in Europe, where small shopkeepers have the means to  accept this form of payment, I was certainly surprised to learn a large hotel that claims to be 5- star worthy does not have the same infrastructure. While lecturing me about the payment policies, the woman checking me in did little to educate me on the property or facilities—is there a gym? A restaurant? Would I need a reservation? None of these issues were addressed despite me making it clear this was my first visit, which was especially disheartening as I saw several other staff provide an orientation of sorts to other guests, a privilege it appears I was not allotted.

Regardless, I made that issue work despite the large inconvenience it posed as I had been traveling very lightly for work and unsure of whether or not I had a physical card, only to arrive to my room where the sheets were stained orange and spotted all over. When I went downstairs, bags in hand and showed the front desk photos of the state of the room, they mustered a “sorry”, changed my room wordlessly and watched me trudge along with my bags without so much as as an offer to help coordinate this room change. When I arrived at the second room, I was met with an overwhelming scent of sewer and was less than pleased, causing me to go downstairs yet again, where my room was changed, and again no offer of assistance was made. While I settled in this last room, it was hardly the experience I paid for as there was mold in the steamer, and in the fridge I requested be brought into the room (of which I have photos of). The paint on the ceiling was also peeling, there were scuffs and stains all over the room, and I could not shake the feeling that I was sitting in a room that thousands before me had clearly had their way with. Add that to the fact that each and every staff member was as unhelpful as they could be and that is why I will be avoiding this property and perhaps this chain altogether for the foreseeable future. Disappointed does not begin to describe my thoughts after this stay.

reviews.author: CorpPlanner RoadWarrior
reviews.title: A ‘meh’ would be generous.
reviews.body: As a corporate planner who travels and works with venues all over the world, I can attest my stay this past weekend was subpar, at best. Front desk was lovely but the overall hotel is tired and due for a refresh. I was in a suite and wires were hanging down off the automated sheets and room in general was a bit beat up — long crack in the sink, chips in the paint/paneling on the toilet door, etc. The loo y bar staff was nice whereas the Terace bar staff were unprofessional — on their phones, gossiping, and mildly attentive. Additionally, I had breakfast both mornings of my stay at the Terrace and the service was a clown show — you’d place an order and had to flag people down for it — and forget if you ordered something wild like a poached egg with your avo toast. The whole experience was odd. Now, if you want lux Edition service, go to the one in Toykyo — now that’s a chef’s kiss. Overall, bummed.

reviews.author: MTO73
reviews.title: Always stay at Edition!
reviews.body:
Stayed at the
Times Square Edition for the
5th time.  Always enjoy our stay.  Staff is professional and courteous. Great location!

reviews.author: VAChix
reviews.title: True luxury in heart of Times Square
reviews.body:
You never know the baseline of people leaving reviews & we all have our "opinions."  We only stay at 5-star, luxury hotels.  Times Square is not our thing, but the area we have to be in for the reason we come.  So thrilled we finally found TS Edition- I hate to bad mouth other properties, but if you are in the same boat & struggling b/n this price point vs Knickerbocker or the Chatwal...look no further.  This is the ONLY property we will ever stay at again when we come to the theatre district/TS.  Truly it's so well appointed to the midtown area as a whole & a quiet, oasis.  Not once during our stay did we hear a siren, car, horn, trash truck, etc.   We were pampered our entire stay.  Hotel is modern, clean, fresh & smells amazing.   The staff are extremely well trained & polished.      

You will not get the biggest rooms in the city here by any means & def take note of the sq footage to get the room you want.  The 2 doubles is very small, but they make good use of the space.  Beds are platform beds so just a mattress & not the most comfortable in the business, but they were fine.                                               

There are a few staff I must recognize who blew us away & due to them, this is now our city hotel of choice.
Front desk: Angelo
Bellman:  Jerome
Housekeeping: Phoebe
Terrace Restaurant:  Alan, Mgr
Guest services: Karen & Nephi

reviews.author: Helen August 2026
reviews.title: 5 Star hotel should be 6 star
reviews.body: Fantastic hotel great location beautiful room staff friendly helpful couldn’t do enough for you

reviews.author: Hugo M
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.body: An excellent service and beautiful hotel

reviews.author: Amy L
reviews.title: Not a 5 star bonvoy hotel
reviews.body: They didn’t honour any of my request. Tick bite incident in hotel room. It is unthinkable in the heart of Manhattan. After I reported the tick bite, the whole management team ignored my request, not reply to my email, calls, nor in person communication. Manager tried hard to avoid us. Very suspicious.

reviews.author: Danielle Rudnick
reviews.title: The best hotel in Times Square
reviews.body:
We had an incredible stay at The Times Square EDITION, made especially memorable by Talia. From the moment we connected, she took the time to understand the personal significance of our trip and went above and beyond to make my mom and me feel genuinely cared for. Her kindness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail created such a personalized experience—it never felt routine or transactional.

The hotel itself was beautiful, the service was excellent, and the location was perfect, but Talia’s warmth is what truly set this stay apart. She is an exceptional example of hospitality, and we are so grateful for everything she did to make our visit feel special. We would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.author: CAM P
reviews.title: One of my Favorites but Personalized Service Lacking
reviews.body:
This property continues to be one of my most frequently visited hotels in NYC and I always look forward to staying here. The location is wonderful, and the rooms are fantastic.

However, I have been disappointed lately in the lack of personalized service which has been noticeable over the last few months (especially as a Marriott Ambassador staying in their suites). I hope they fix this to make frequent customers feel more appreciated in the future and not just like another number given their status as a luxury property.

reviews.author: E Ward
reviews.title: Always the best.
reviews.body: Every time we visit this is one of our favorite NYC hotels. From the moment you walk up and smell that special Edition scent it’s a special experience. We had such amazing service from door staff, desk staff, housekeeping and Terrace bar. We will be back!!

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.title: “Luxury” Brand, Hostel-Sized Room — Deeply Disappointing Stay
reviews.body:
When we complained, we were told an upgrade to a properly sized room would cost $400 plus fees — around $500 — which is an extraordinary response to a legitimate complaint. We were eventually moved to a slightly larger 240 sq ft room, which at least allowed us to set our luggage down, though it was still cramped.

On top of this, the furniture on the terrace bar was flimsy and poor quality — well below the standard the brand promises and overdue for replacement.

The EDITION positions itself as a luxury experience. This was anything but. I’d think very carefully before booking here again, particularly if you’re redeeming points.

reviews.author: ASE Conference Attendees
reviews.title: Amazingly Comfortable and Upscale Service
reviews.body: Definitely staying again for the next conference!

reviews.author: E Wah
reviews.title: Care and hospitality in the center of Manhattan
reviews.body: Team is so hospitable and caring throughout our stay. The decor and quality of the rooms and spaces were excellent and beautiful. They made our stay memorable in every way

reviews.author: Marian J
reviews.title: It’s ok
reviews.body:
Rooms are nice
Food is ok
How ever service is poor

reviews.author: Annie
reviews.title: Edition
reviews.body:
I’ve always had a great impression of EDITION Hotels. However, during this stay at the Times Square EDITION, the front desk staff felt a bit cold and not as welcoming as I had expected, which slightly affected my first impression.

That said, once I checked in, everything changed. The hotel’s quality, atmosphere, and overall experience completely lived up to the EDITION standard. In the end, I really enjoyed my stay. My only minor complaint would be that the room was a bit on the small side.

reviews.author: Rich
reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.body: Disappointed in my recent experience

reviews.author: Married9Years
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay: Ignored Anniversary Request, Warm Water, and a Cockroach
reviews.body:
This was my third stay at the Edition since 2023, and by far the worst experience.
1. Anniversary Celebration
We were celebrating our 9th wedding anniversary. I called a few days before our arrival and asked the team to arrange something special to help us mark the occasion. The person I spoke with agreed and noted it on my account. However, when we checked in and went to our room, nothing was there. I went to the front desk to mention it, and they apologized, assuring me that something would be in the room by the end of the day when we returned. When we got back, the room was still empty.
The next morning (Saturday), I raised it again with the front desk, who assured us something would be waiting when we returned from our day out. Unfortunately, there was still nothing. The following day (Sunday), I mentioned it for a third time, and once again the front desk apologized and promised to take care of it—yet when we returned at 3 a.m., nothing had been done. Finally, during checkout on Monday, I brought up the situation once more, and the front desk said they would inform the manager. It has now been three days, and I have not heard from the manager.
2. Hot Water
Our shower water never got hot. I spoke with the front desk on Friday, and they explained it was a safety latch on the shower. We pressed the button as instructed, but the water still never heated up.
3. Cockroach Sighting
During checkout on Monday, my wife and another guest saw a cockroach run across the floor and under my luggage while I was standing at the front desk—checking out and once again explaining the issue with our anniversary.
I am very disappointed. I was hoping to show my wife a wonderful time for our anniversary. Sadly, these issues were the only sour note on what should have been a special weekend.

reviews.author: Bad Experience
reviews.title: Highly Disapointed
reviews.body: I am very disappointed about my recent stay. I reached out to Chad and Rania about my invoice issue given the misleading issues provided by the front desk but no one responded back to me. This is an extremely bad and disappointing experience for me as a customer. I would not recommend anyone to go back.

reviews.author: abwatts22
reviews.title: Find Somewhere Else
reviews.body:
Summary: A gilded hotel. This place is not worth the price. Worst $500+ hotel room I’ve ever experienced.
I’m a really laid back person and don’t like speaking negatively about experiences— and maybe mine was rare…but just don’t go here thinking you’re going to get your moneys worth. Because you won’t. Unless, perhaps, you have a $1,000/night room or something. Those folks seem more pleased with their experience in the reviews.
Rooms: The basic rooms (anything that’s not a suite) are extremely small, which is okay, but just really unexpected at the price point.

Then there was the upkeep of it…or lack thereof. We were first given a room on the 27th floor that had scuff and cracks on literally almost everything: the walls, bed frame, floor, small bathroom mirror, garbage bins, side tables, shelves etc. There was a panel that was also falling off of the wall. And the bedside table lights had glue stains on them and were super cheap looking. 

I hate making an issue of things, but given the insane price for the teeny tiny rooms and the disrepair literally everywhere, I asked for another room. The room was on the 32nd floor and had a better view and less scuffs. The bathroom sink was cracking though, there was a large chip off in the middle of the headboard, ans there 2 clusters of water damage bubbles on the ceiling. My partner said the shower was great though.

If you want a high rise view over Times Square, go level 32 or above. And ask for a room on the southern side, closer to Times Square.

I usually stay in basic hotels, but I wanted to splurge for a higher scale vibe — and the EDITION was a giant swing and a miss with that. The cheap everything and general disrepair made me feel like I was back in a cheap hotel.
Service: The humans were the best part of the place. Room service staff were incredibly friendly and kind. Front desk women were accommodating and apologetic. The manager guy at the front desk though didn’t even acknowledge our concerns. Whatever.

Food: Ordered afternoon drinks and then late night room service.  The staff were wonderful and so kind.  The drinks were great (canned cocktails).  The late night grilled cheese was a joke.  I know its simple, but I naively assumed they'd put some care into it and maybe just maybe have it cooked melted all the way through. Something Id expect somewhere else, but not at a place that charges you half a thousand dollars/night. I know we're all humans, and Im grateful for the folks working in the kitchen...just really sucks to splurge when I shouldve just gone to a best western and had a better experience. 

Location: Centrally located. Looks directly over Times Square. Close to loads of theaters, Grand Central, and museums.

reviews.author: Knarf
reviews.title: The edition
reviews.body: We had a wonderful stay! The hotel was clean, comfortable, and the staff was friendly and welcoming. The location was great, and everything exceeded our expectations. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Kimmie T
reviews.title: Lovely Room, View, and Stay!
reviews.body:
I love this hotel! My family and I come annually to see the orchestra play the Star Wars score and stay at the Edition.  We love that you can smell the hotel as soon as you turn onto 47th from 7th.   I also like that you can access 7th ave if you want to deal with the tourist traffic in Times Square, but if you walk to 6th, you get a much quieter vibe. 

The ground lobby is a nice waiting alcove. We took a short elevator ride up to the lobby where we were met by friendly staff.   The staff are caring and engaging. The lovely man at the desk spoke to us about room views and hotel details. He also took care of our extra water request - which arrived so quickly.  The rooms are ample and use the space well.  We were there during the World Cup and we could hear Times Square in our 20th floor hotel room at night. No biggie for us, but if you need silence, maybe don’t get a room with a view of Times Square - or go stay at the other Edition.    

The bed was comfy. The shower was phenomenal - like the perfect rain.  The le labo (yes! Le labo!) toiletries smell sooooo good.  (I actually purchased the Edition scent diffuser for my office!)   

I have zero complaints about this hotel. It is great! I plan on coming back next year for Star Wars and the Edition!

reviews.author: Fugefan
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.body: Stayed at the Times Square EDITION for the weekend. Staff was friendly and very helpful. Location was perfect for multiple theater visits.  No complaints. Would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: Torres
reviews.title: Amazing Birthday Vacation
reviews.body: This is our 4th time staying at The Edition, and they have never disappointed us!

reviews.author: Platinum Elite traveler
reviews.title: Incredible staff.  Not as ADA friendly as other Marriott brands.
reviews.body: Staff help and response is a 10.  Room maintenance needs periodic checks. tv, phone, ADA door openers had issues. As an ADA traveler I had problems getting into bed or exiting or getting on elevators before closing. Hotel took full advantage of increase visitors for Knicks, soccer game and parade by substantially raising room rates.

reviews.author: Ashley D
reviews.title: Delivered Beyond Expectations
reviews.body: We were overly satisfied by our stay at The Time Square EDITION. Upon arrival the hotel employees were accommodating and knowledgeable. When we entered our room it was clean and continued to stay clean throughout our entire stay. Every time we entered the room our bed was made and room was picked up. We loved being right in the center of Time Square as well. We were close to everything.

reviews.author: Ross26
reviews.title: Poor stay.
reviews.body: The rooms were not to W Hotel standards, very dated and the manager Stuart was horrible.

reviews.author: Val0501
reviews.title: Front desk managers need a review and attitude check
reviews.body: Take care of the gues who spend a lot of money there and have a better attitude .

reviews.author: Nina
reviews.title: Not a luxury hotel
reviews.body: To expensive for what you get. Worn down rooms

reviews.author: Joe the Photog
reviews.title: Excellent Place to Stay!
reviews.body: Always a pleasure. And the truly most exceptional piece of this hotel's overall excellence is the bell staff. "The guys" are just great, always helpful. Important to me cause I show up with. Suburban loaded with gear sometimes.

reviews.author: Kristen
reviews.title: Wants to be considered luxury but lacks the customer service to deserve that title
reviews.body: The hotel got our reservation wrong changing it from 1 king and 2 doubles to 2 kings and 1 double deleting an entire bed from our reservation and said they could not offer any solution other then a few points back that equalled about 10% of what we paid for one of the rooms.  The manager was incompetent and didn't even offer a free drink to offset their mistake and inability to fix it.

reviews.author: Dana12
reviews.title: Rooms are not well kept-Dead Cockroach in room
reviews.body: First room we got had a horrible smell, my daughter found a used beauty blender in the bathroom. The next day we found a dead cockroach in the corner of the room. All we were offered was to waive the $40 destination fee. We got moved to the same room category but at least it was a clean room.

reviews.author: Loucious
reviews.title: Fabulous Locale
reviews.body: Top Notch Amenities Abound When Staying at This Hotel. Will Not Go Wrong Here. A+++

reviews.author: Phoebe H
reviews.title: Charged Twice and Treated Rudely by Management
reviews.body: I prepaid for my stay but was charged again at the hotel, resulting in two charges for the same reservation. Resolving this billing issue required considerable time and caused unnecessary stress. When I raised the problem, the manager was rude and confrontational rather than helpful or apologetic. This was not the professional or luxury service I expected from the W brand. Because of the billing error and the way management treated me, I will not stay at this property again.

reviews.author: Cowfamar
reviews.title: Been to bettet
reviews.body:
The W By Marriott is older and needs some work, at least a new coat of paint in the rooms with some work on the floors snd floor boards.  
The staff was attentive and courteous and the room was clean.  But the bed was way too soft and no drawers for the clothes was a disappointment.  Also no coffee maker until we asked two times.  Finally went to the front desk and she called housekeeping herself and then we hog one.  The breakfast was good but not great and several things needed an extra charge.  Our servers at the restaurant and living room bar were friendly and efficient.  Maybe we are just too old to appreciate the less us more style!  Probably would not stay there again.  Also they had a Concierge desk but not once when we were there was there anyone to help at that desk.  We were very disappointed.

reviews.author: Happy traveler
reviews.title: From Pittsburgh to New York
reviews.body: We had a really good time door men made sure we had a ride to get around New York

reviews.author: Unwelcome at the W
reviews.title: Unwelcome
reviews.body: Disappointing experience thanks to the reception

reviews.author: The Williams
reviews.title: Birthday getaway
reviews.body:
As someone who has worked in the industry, particularly in front desk and customer service, for more than 22 years, I know what exceptional hospitality looks and feels like. I’ve also had the opportunity to travel to quite a few places, especially throughout the Caribbean, and experience some truly amazing service. However, my experience at the W Times Square exceeded my expectations from the moment I arrived.Before my arrival and throughout the check-in process, the level of service was exceptional. Michael from Customer Service was absolutely amazing and immediately put any doubts I had to rest. His warmth and professionalism set the tone for what would become an incredible birthday getaway.Then came check-in, and this was the moment I thought, “YES! I made the right choice!” Wendy was so warm and welcoming—exactly what true customer service should be. And Yara, the front desk agent, was simply wonderful. Her genuine warmth, kindness, and professionalism represent customer service at its highest level.Thank you to the entire team for making my birthday getaway so memorable. We truly felt the love and hospitality, and we cannot wait to come back!

Lastly there is always 1 person that can disrupt the flow of an excellent stay however I just didn't allow him to.. Manager i believe is name is Stewart very dismissive seems very annoyed to even answer the phone I was very disappointed.

reviews.author: Limon
reviews.title: excellent stay
reviews.body: excellent we love this hotel very close to all safe and its right around the corner from time square a few steps away

reviews.author: Nesha B
reviews.title: Must book
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at the W New York and had an amazing experience from beginning to end! The hotel is beautiful, stylish, and in a perfect location for enjoying everything New York City has to offer.

What really stood out to me was the customer service and attentiveness of the staff. Everyone I encountered was welcoming, professional, and genuinely willing to help. The level of attention made me feel valued as a guest, and that truly made my stay even more enjoyable.

The atmosphere of the hotel was fun, modern, and upscale, while still feeling comfortable and welcoming. I loved the overall vibe and energy of the property.

This was my first stay, and I honestly left feeling like I had found a hotel I would definitely return to. If you're looking for a great NYC experience with excellent service, a beautiful atmosphere, and a fantastic location, I highly recommend the W New York!

reviews.author: Zakiathediva
reviews.title: AMAZING experience!
reviews.body:
My stay at W New York – Times Square was absolutely exceptional from beginning to end. The hotel’s location is unbeatable—right in the heart of Times Square and within easy walking distance of so many restaurants, attractions, shopping, and entertainment options.
The hotel has a stylish, modern, and energetic atmosphere that perfectly captures the spirit of New York City. My room was beautiful, comfortable, and well-appointed, with everything I needed for a relaxing stay. The attention to detail throughout the property really stood out.
What truly made my experience memorable, however, was the exceptional service. The staff were welcoming, professional, attentive, and genuinely committed to making sure I had a great experience. Every interaction felt warm and accommodating, which made the stay even more enjoyable.
I also appreciated the overall ambiance of the hotel. It feels upscale and sophisticated while still being fun, vibrant, and distinctly New York. Whether you’re visiting for a weekend getaway, business, a special occasion, or simply want to experience the city in style, this is an excellent choice.
I would absolutely stay at W New York – Times Square again and highly recommend it. Five stars without hesitation!

reviews.author: Kevin P
reviews.title: Annual getaway
reviews.body: Quick easy check in with friendly staff. Only con was one of the elevators was down the entire tacos at times you had to wait an extended period of time.

reviews.author: John Doe
reviews.title: Average hotel compared to other Marriott's hotels
reviews.body: The Hotel was good. But I was disappointed with the amenities. There was no coffee machine or microwave, and the fridge was full of drinks, so I didn't have space to put anything in it. I don't think I will ever stay there.

reviews.author: KinCo99
reviews.title: Best Hotel I have ever stayed at!
reviews.body: Super clean. Super friendly and personable staff! The aesthetic is very artful and you just cant beat the location. Its right off of Times Square and central to a lot of cool locations! Me and my husband was able to walk to the majority of the places we wanted to see!

reviews.author: Jaime Nicole
reviews.title: Not Worth the Price — Spend Extra Elsewhere
reviews.body:
This hotel gets a 2/10. The photos lack pictures of the majority of the room views, which I found very misleading. When you arrive at the lobby entrance, there is no one there to greet or direct you. Instead, you’re left confused and have to take a hot elevator upstairs just to find the actual lobby.

The lobby/bar area itself is cool and has a nice dark, moody theme, but unfortunately, that’s where the positives end. The elevators are confusing, the hallways are extremely dark, and the entire hotel needs major updating.

The rooms are also disappointing. The carpets have stains, the surrounding furniture is worn and outdated, and the bathrooms don’t have vent fans. Because of this, any bad odor from the bathroom can linger for hours and make the entire room smell.

Overall, the hotel looks much better in the photos than it does in person and is definitely not worth the price. I’d spend the extra $100 a night and stay at The EDITION for the same view and a much better overall experience.

reviews.author: SMJ94
reviews.title: Not worth the cost
reviews.body: I wouldn’t stay here if you expect a clean shower, bottled water or decent staff.

reviews.author: Brenda
reviews.title: The only place to stay in New York
reviews.body: Location, service, professionalism, amenities, cleanliness 5 star experience!

reviews.author: ShrWILL
reviews.title: Never disappoints
reviews.body: I come here every year and it exceeds my expectations every time. Look forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Art4444
reviews.title: A Special Stay
reviews.body: Between the W staff and location things were excellent and special. We had a beautiful 5 days going to several Broadway shows and eating very well. All within walking distance.

reviews.author: NJ and NY Group
reviews.title: Great Experience and Awesome Location
reviews.body: Room was very clean, attractive and spacious.  Loved the 7th floor lobby away from the hustle and noise of the outside and the seating area and bar were awesome! A live DJ and music played was a great and made the atmosphere so much fun!  The restaurants were so nicely decorated and food and drinks were great. The staff was super courteous and helpful. Appreciated that our luggage was held for us for the day after we had checked out.

reviews.author: ATJones
reviews.title: Best New York City hotel experience
reviews.body: There a lot of choices for accommodations around Times Square. If you are looking for the perfect Times Square location, very clean rooms, and the best hotel staff in the business, this is the place I would recommend for anyone.

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.title: It was OK.
reviews.body: No pool, a little out dated, staff was friendly. It just seems like an old hotel that hasn't been updated.

reviews.author: MadelineY
reviews.title: Disappointing 5-Night Stay That Fell Short of Marriott Standards
reviews.body:
I stayed at this W Hotel for five nights, and unfortunately it was one of the most disappointing experiences I’ve had within the Marriott brand.

The biggest issue was the connecting room. The noise from the adjoining room was extremely disruptive, and I wasn’t able to sleep well for most of my stay.

Housekeeping was also inconsistent. One day, I returned to my room to find the window left open and the trash had not been removed. I’m not sure what happened, but it certainly didn’t reflect the level of attention I expected.

Room service got off to a rough start as well. On my first morning, breakfast was significantly delayed because I was told they had never received my order. Later, they realized that I had in fact placed the order the night before, making the delay avoidable.

The billing process has also been frustrating. My final folio included a charge of $178.56 in addition to the room charges totaling $1,997.36. I requested an itemized breakdown of the $178.56 charge, but I have yet to receive a response.

As a Marriott Gold Elite member, I expected a higher level of service and attention to detail. Instead, I felt like just another guest. Compared with my experiences at Edition, Ritz-Carlton, Marriott, and Renaissance properties, this stay fell well below the standards I’ve come to expect from the Marriott portfolio.

Overall, this was unfortunately the worst Marriott-brand hotel experience I’ve had, and I would hesitate to stay at this W Hotel again unless there are significant improvements in service, housekeeping, and guest communication.

reviews.title: Excellent Location, Terrible Hotel
reviews.body:
I was very disappointed with my stay at the W New York - Times Square. While the location is excellent and very convenient, that’s the only positive thing I can say about this hotel.

The room was not clean, and we even found a bug on one of the pillows, which was unacceptable and made us very uncomfortable. The room itself looked worn out, the bathroom was of poor quality, and the overall condition did not match what I expected from a W Hotel.

The beds were small and uncomfortable, the view from our room was disappointing, and the hotel was extremely noisy, making it difficult to get a good night’s sleep.

Overall, this stay did not meet my expectations. I would not recommend this hotel, and I would not choose to stay here again.

reviews.author: GetWhatUpay4
reviews.title: Do. your homework
reviews.body: So many choices. This should be at the bottom of your list.

reviews.author: kf33
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.body: W Times Square delivered for my best friend's birthday trip. The hotel was clean and fun, it felt luxurious without being super expensive or pretentious feeling. The staff was so friendly and went above and beyond to assist. The Living Room Bar was the perfect spot to start and end out night. Blue Fin was a wonderful dinner spot with fresh options, I'm still thinking about the Sea Bass bites!!

reviews.author: CHARLIE COCHOL HOBBICK
reviews.title: SKIP THE FULL SERVICE PROPERTIES
reviews.body: THIS PROPERTY GIVES YOU EVERYTHING YOU NEED. WITH THE BONUS OF A GREAT STAFF. HAVING ALWAYS STAYED AT FULL SERVICE PROPERTIES I FOUND THIS TO BE REFRESHING AND MMORE PEOPLE FRIENDLY.

reviews.author: Chris C
reviews.title: Great centrally located but outside tourist area
reviews.body: Came in for the US open.  Easy walk to grand central.  Nice residential neighborhood.  Big room for Macy and nice kitchenette.

reviews.author: R0gieP
reviews.title: Great stay and SUPERB Staff
reviews.body: Hotel and room were great.  Just the right size for the three of us.   What really stood out was the EXCEPTIONAL hotel staff.  I can't say enough about how welcoming, helpful and accommodating they were.  Such a great staff !!!      They made all the difference and would be the very first reason I would choose to stay at this hotel over any other hotel in the area.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Hotel great, service lacking.
reviews.body: Customer service is lacking, had an issue w/ payment (was trying to pay remotely). Manager (Justin) could have cared less to help me resolve it (and I have status with Marriott). If they treat customers who have status like this, would hate to see how they treat others.

reviews.author: Luke
reviews.title: Very Good Hotel
reviews.body:
Very good Hotel ! 
Very good value fantastic location for MIDTOWN

reviews.author: NYC Lover
reviews.title: Top Shelf
reviews.body: Perfect location, perfect room

reviews.author: Aliia S
reviews.title: nice time in NYC with my mom
reviews.body: Traveled from Boston with my mom, who was visiting us from Kyrgyzstan. The hotel’s location is perfect—within walking distance of many major sights. Breakfast was delicious, the staff was kind and welcoming, and the room was great. We really enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Sokabilities
reviews.title: Hospital Visit
reviews.body: Easy in and out .Aplace that takes Bonvoy Points .A bit less then some others with in walking distance to MSK! The other hotel closer did not take Bonvoy points! Thank You very much!

reviews.author: Joseph andPeter
reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.body: We were there for medical appointments at MSK cancer hospital. The staff knew us from previous visits, showed genuine concern and compassion! Carlos and Claudia in the breakfast are helped with dietary concerns and were so loving.. Claudia the manager help with our reservations several times.  John the doorman was very helpful with our disability requirements.

reviews.author: Senior travelers
reviews.title: Comfortable clean stay.
reviews.body: Fair pricing, clean, great king bed, attentive staff. Everything is in the room to make you feel relaxed. Other needs for food and snacks are available. Very good value.

reviews.author: Brett
reviews.title: I appreciate this hotel!
reviews.body: I've stayed at this hotel a couple of times, and I'll stay there again. The staff is courteous and helpful, the rooms are clean and feature a nicely designed kitchenette, and the included breakfast has a nice variety of breakfast foods that go way beyond what you might see at a normal continental breakfast.

reviews.author: Kruth1973
reviews.title: Well Located, Excellent Service
reviews.body: We had a wonderful, though short, stay at the Residence Inn. It was just a few blocks from two different MTA stops, and about 1 mile from Times Square. Lamont, the desk agent, was fantastic. All around, a good value for the money in what could be a pricey location.

reviews.author: Wedding weekend
reviews.title: Wedding weekend
reviews.body: Excellent staff and service. Hotel is  clean.

reviews.author: Marriottguesr
reviews.title: Service and some amenities not up to Marriott standards.
reviews.body: Disappointed in the level of service. Fitness center very small and limited. No amenities

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.title: Needs an update
reviews.body: Beds are old and lumpy, light from the hall shine through the edges of the door(which face the bed) staff was not very attentive. Decent location, but not worth the $400 per night

reviews.author: Karuna
reviews.title: Comfortable stay
reviews.body: Clean and comfortable stay. Professional and good staff.

reviews.author: Lety
reviews.title: My stay
reviews.body: Great time at our trip. Everything went as planned. We had a clean room, yummy breakfast, and all the staff was super friendly and courteous.

reviews.author: Gwen H
reviews.title: A Wonderful Stay at Residence Inn - Our Favorable Midtown Hotel
reviews.body:
Of all the hotels we have stayed at in Midtown, this has been our absolute favorite.
From the warm welcome we received from Ms. Chanel at check-in to our seamless check-out experience, every aspect of our stay was delightful. The entire staff was friendly, professional, attentive, and genuinely helpful, making us feel valued throughout our visit. Even our interactions with other guests added to the welcoming atmosphere.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would gladly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Midtown. We look forward to staying here again on our next trip.

reviews.author: aristulipan
reviews.title: great services
reviews.body: I would definitely recommend Residence Inn by Marriott New York Manhattan/Midtown East to friends or business associates. The location is excellent, making it easy to get around Manhattan and access major attractions, restaurants, and business districts. The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-equipped, with a kitchenette that was especially convenient for a longer stay. The staff was friendly, professional, and always willing to help. The complimentary breakfast was a great bonus, offering a good variety of options to start the day. Overall, it was a comfortable, convenient, and enjoyable stay, and I would gladly stay there again.

reviews.author: Tom R
reviews.title: Most Incredible Service
reviews.body: If you are between two hotels, pick this one. The staff is always welcoming and overly helpful.

reviews.author: Pedal Biker
reviews.title: Close enough to all the right things
reviews.body: Nice family accommodations for an extended weekend stay. Love the quiet location and not being too close to Time Square, but a short enough walk if you choose to explore. Local restaurant selection is off the charts only a few blocks away on 2nd Ave with additional delicious decisions on 53rd like Café Luce. Easy walk to broadway theaters. Took the subway to Barney Greengrass and walked back to the hotel thru Central Park with ease. The breakfast buffet was adequate and well maintained by staff. Hotel check in staff and bell service were very pleasant and accommodating. Not too far away from multiple subway lines and the best kept secret may be the reasonable and extraordinarily friendly 24hr bike rental 2 blocks away at Kickstand Bicycles.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Discriminatory w/o refund
reviews.body: I was racially discriminated. I was accused of stealing the breakfast and then followed around and hackled.   I did not feel safe staying at these properties neither did I want to. I left my keys and asked for a refund that evening through the third party. Marriott properties did not want to give a refund. Complete disappointment and disgraceful. Not to mention the flags put up.

reviews.author: Samjay94
reviews.title: Sam94
reviews.body: Great place to stay and location to move around the city.

reviews.author: Joy Debru
reviews.title: Safe oasis in Manhattan
reviews.body: I was very happy with my stay at this property and pleasantly surprised! It’s spacious and very clean.

reviews.author: Visiting from Florida
reviews.title: A great place to stay!
reviews.body: Stay in the heart of Manhattan with all the comforts of home.

reviews.author: HiLi
reviews.title: Well located and highly recommended for stays of any length
reviews.body: Incredibly comfortable hotel in a nice area but quiet enough to get good quality sleep. Free breakfast and a host of amenities. The room amenities made it incredibly comfortable.

reviews.author: TheLaths
reviews.title: Great stay for a couple nights.
reviews.body:
Front desk staff was professional and friendly, quick check in.  The front walk of the hotel was very neat.  Room itself was clean and comfortable, at first I didn't think we had a stove top but my daughter found the plug in burner in one of the cabinets.  Refrigerator was smallish but full size and clean. Microwave was clean. Kitchen was well stocked with dishes, glasses, and silverware.  However I think the one burner plug in was convenient but doesn't really lend itself to "residential" living. There is only 2 elevators for 18 floors so there could be a line and a bit of a wait.
The included breakfast was the best I have ever had at a Marriott!  Food was hot fresh and tasty.  With a good variety rather than the typical scrambled eggs and sausage, although they did have those too -  but for the 2 mornings we were there there was kielbasa, shredded chicken, biscuits baked perfectly with a nice crust and gravy that was delicious. Breakfast was the best part of our stay LOL
Staff was friendly and quick to clear tables so there was always plenty of room during a busy Breakfast time.  They even had take away boxes at the bread station
Location is great for what we were there for.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: LornaAi
reviews.title: Good location, hotel well maintained. Friendly staff. Great breakfast
reviews.body: Convenient location. My room was smaller than expected but clean and well appointed for my 2 night stay. No views, but there was a terrace access to a small, enclosed area. Im not sure the purpose of this terrace. The glass door was right next to the bed as well as the only window though, the curtains gapped so I had to pin them close to maintain privacy within the room. Didnt use the kitchen but it looked like it had most of everything you would need if you wanted to. Staff was very friendly. Very good free breakfast! Except I wasn't a fan of the coffee for some reason. They have water infused with fruit and/or cucumber and mint in the Lobby which could use some attention because it was hot while we were there so it was popular and often only had ice. All common areas on the ground floor were clean, too. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: TiffKG
reviews.title: The Best Marriott staff, breakfast, etc!
reviews.body: I was very pleased with everything at this great Marriott. The staff was amazing, breakfast was great and the service was out of this world! I am from south Carolina so I didn’t expect to have soooo many nice ppl at a “NYC” hotel! Really exceeded my expectations!

reviews.author: Perfect 10
reviews.title: Expectations at the Residence Inn, Midtown East NYC
reviews.body: Excellent hotel to travel for business or pleasure with a twist of style!

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.title: The Ritz Experience
reviews.body: We always have a wonderful stay here.  The personalized service, and the hotel excellence are outstanding!

reviews.author: Frequent hotel guest
reviews.title: Well run hotel with excellent service
reviews.body: Excellent hotel with excellent service.  One caveat:  public areas are tired and need attention. Fabrics worn and look dirty.

reviews.author: DunyoA
reviews.title: Expected More
reviews.body: Did not live up to my expectations

reviews.author: TrevorAndMichy
reviews.title: This Is What The Ritz-Carlton Is Supposed to Be
reviews.body:
We stayed at The Ritz-Carlton, Boston for three nights while celebrating our 13th wedding anniversary, and it became one of the highlights of an already incredible trip.

The hotel is beautiful, but the people are what made this stay extraordinary. From the warmth of our arrival to the remarkable team in the Club Lounge, we were made to feel genuinely welcome and cared for throughout our stay.

One evening captures the experience perfectly. After a full day exploring Boston, my wife and I were debating whether to go back out or stay in and relax. A member of the Club Lounge team picked up on that and encouraged us to enjoy a quiet anniversary evening together. The team prepared dinner, drinks, dessert, and even popcorn for us to take back to our room and enjoy with a movie.

It sounds like a small thing, but it wasn’t. They understood what we needed in that moment and turned an ordinary night in into one of our favorite memories from the entire anniversary trip.

That is what personalized hospitality looks like. We arrived expecting a great Ritz-Carlton experience and left with one of our new favorite hotels in the world. We cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: tophat617
reviews.title: Average hotel experience
reviews.body: There was nothing wrong with the hotel it was fine but just bland. It could have been any hotel in any city. No gym, no spa, no hotel car service. Check in was impersonal, but the doormen, concierge and bellmen were lovely, fun and engaging. We booked through The Edit program at Chase and at check in there was no acknowledgement of that and the perks that come along with it. The lack of amenities such as a mini bar or honor bar in the room was surprising. And I don't want to use a QR code ever again after covid so having to use one, and thus my phone, to get a room service menu was less than desirable. Also it would have been great to be able to access all streaming services on the tv (and not have to cast from the phone for Prime, Apple etc). Despite the minibar being empty, its power lights, the bedside clock and other devices in the room throw a lot of light when the room lights are off. For the same price there are better options in Boston.

reviews.author: Michael Kelly
reviews.title: Boston drop off
reviews.body: Ritz Carlton experience for Emerson drop off trip

reviews.author: JOHN S
reviews.title: Check in very poor
reviews.body: Our check in experience was awful. The room was prepaid but we were made to feel unwelcome and we were treated poorly. This essentially ruined our three night stay and made the hotel portion of our trip awkward and uncomfortable. This is not acceptable at this price point.

reviews.author: Boston Visitor
reviews.title: Not worthy of the brand.
reviews.body: The staff treated us horribly.

reviews.author: MIMD
reviews.title: Not Ritz level whatsoever,, very below average
reviews.body: Wasn’t luxury experience at all. Shouldn’t be called Ritz. I had way better experience at a nicer building at lower price same city. Didn’t feel anything special about my gold membership. Was not clean. Others Garbage was already in the garbage can, hair on the floor. Differently wouldn’t come again. Disappointed.

reviews.author: Patti N
reviews.title: Boston Getaway
reviews.body:
We had a wonderful stay at The at Ritz-Carlton . It was a girls getaway before the school year starts.  We were up graded to a suite and treated like royalty . 
It was an important reminder to take the time off and relax . Our stay was luxurious and lots of fun. This maybe come a yearly tradition

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Perhaps my expectations were too high
reviews.body:
I have been a long time Marriott elite member and have stayed at every level from A Fairfield to the JW and Marquis. It was time to try the Ritz Carlton for the first time. I had read the book The New Gold Standard and even present the customer experience obsession to my company in various formats. 

I really didn’t see anything that wouldn’t have been delivered by a standard Marriott property… except I didn’t even get an M Club amenity.  For the money spent, I expected more..

reviews.author: AliMac
reviews.title: great expectations, not met
reviews.body: I booked 1 night between work meetings snd flying home. I hadn't stayed at this hotel but figured it must be very good because of its rating.  The hallway literally stunk like a wet dog.  The room was nothing special.  - i put a family member on the reservation but the room only had 1 robe snd slipper set. I was told it has a city view but it didn't.  Id made a request that was confirmed but the item wasnt in the room.  I ordered room svc and was told “30 min or less” but it took over sn hr.  I didn't dare call for dishes to be picked up for fear that they wouldn't come and I’d have to stay awake waiting for someone. I used Delta Stay and seriously wonder if its why I was given the crappy room snd poor service.  either way, never again!

reviews.author: so memorable
reviews.title: elegant, and the perfect place to relax
reviews.body: my stay so memorable. I would absolutely recommend this hotel to anyone

reviews.author: Ken C
reviews.title: Weekend Stay
reviews.body: Perfect family stay for a weekend in Boston. Service was standout, one of the best non-resort stay in recent memory. Would recommend and would stay again.

reviews.author: CBC123
reviews.title: Hotel and Staff were terrible.  Do not recommend
reviews.body: Stay at Marriott hotels all over the world and this was the worst stay.  Concierge dinner recommendation for family of four was Legal Seafood (chain restaurant), room service was terrible (overcooked food, arrived significantly late, couldn't figure out what room we were in), staff completely unhelpful (waited 10 minutes for valet, no one to help with bags), mess up room bill.

reviews.author: Paige Marie
reviews.title: 5 Stars!!
reviews.body: Although it was a quick stay, the staff and service blew me away! I hope to come back soon! First Class!

reviews.author: BSE2014
reviews.title: Traditional Luxury Stay
reviews.body: The hotel was a traditional luxury hotel, with nicely appointed rooms. I’ve stayed in luxury properties in the city and across the country and this property was a bit underwhelming. Perhaps because we usually have a larger room. We had a traditional king room that was well-furnished. The bed and pillows were comfortable. The bathroom was beautiful and we love the philosykos toiletries. The turn down service and Club access were nice touches that made the stay, otherwise, it would have been a disappointment. There were some stains on the loveseat and carpet, so we were given a different room. There were some missteps in cleanliness that I would not have expected from a 5-star hotel and a lackluster response to an issue from the front desk agent. The saving grace was the customer service from the operator. She went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable, pleasant and enjoyable. The staff in the Club was also admirable. I also love how most of the staff members greet you when in the hallways or the elevator. Overall, I could stay here again, but I would probably choose a different 5-star property for the full package and price.

reviews.author: Hermano Lima
reviews.title: Medíocre stay
reviews.body: I forgot to mention: I made a point of stating I was a member upon arrival and showing my Elite card, which resulted in a polite "thank you" and nothing more. Very frustrating. I’ve been visiting Boston for a long time and had always wanted to stay at the Ritz-Carlton there. Unfortunately, it didn't live up to expectations. The hotel is indeed 5-star (24-hour room service, housekeeping always available), but nothing more than that. In fact, the hotel is clearly dated, and the restaurant menu didn't entice me to visit even once. A basically mediocre stay.

reviews.author: Happy
reviews.title: The Ritz Carlton will be my home in Boston every time moving forward
reviews.body:
I'm not a rich person but I tend to ensure that I stay at a nice hotel when I travel because it really make a difference to me and my family.  The Ritz Carlton made me feel like a rich person for a few days.  The service was excellent.  The Club Lounge was the best part for me.  It allowed my family to eat healthy substantial meals without even leaving.  We didn't have to spend 100 dollars per day at a standard diner.

The beds were extremely comfortable including the sofabed where we slept momentarily to give the children some extra comfort.  Although we didn't get a great view of the city, we did get a lovely view of a rooftop garden which might have been better.

For any prospective people, spend a little more to get the suite if there are a few of you.

This was recommended to me by a famous retired NBA player who said this is where he stays in Boston and I could not be more satisfied.

reviews.author: TBH4Life
reviews.title: Best hotel in Boston
reviews.body: I always have an amazing stay at The Ritz-Carlton in Boston. Great location and with an excellent staff. Will be back.

reviews.author: Jennifer G
reviews.title: Exceptional Hospitality When It Mattered Most
reviews.body: Even though this stay came under unexpected circumstances due to a family emergency, The Ritz-Carlton, Boston provided a level of comfort and hospitality that made all the difference. From the moment I arrived, the staff demonstrated genuine warmth, professionalism, and impeccable attention to detail. Every interaction felt thoughtful and effortless, creating a true sense of calm during a difficult time. The elegant accommodations, exceptional service, and timeless luxury are exactly what you would expect from this iconic property. A memorable stay, not because of the reason for the visit, but because of the extraordinary people who made it feel like home.

reviews.author: Barbara BL
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.body: Great hotel! Excellent service and recommendations.

reviews.author: Harvard family
reviews.title: Five Star Hotel in perfect Boston Commons location.
reviews.body: This is a beautiful and storied hotel with all the benefits and consistency of Ritz Carton quality and service. We had two suites to accommodate family and the Ritz Carlton had the crib and milk for our infant in the room upon check-in.  Both suites had high finish quality, outstanding comfort, and all the functional features expected.  Outstanding service throughout.

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.title: Handsome Hotel
reviews.body: Wonderful place to stay. White glove treatment.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: There’s no service like Ritz Service
reviews.body: We checked in at The Ritz-Carlton, Boston before the Bruce Springsteen concert at TD North Garden. I’d mentioned in my reservation that we’d gotten engaged 33 years ago at the old Ritz location on Boston Common. Well, they had this spread and an upgraded room for us when we arrived.  There is no service better than “Ritz service.”

reviews.author: DE 16
reviews.title: Ritz Boston
reviews.body: The hotel did not deliver a Ritz Carlton experience. Certainly mot up to the Ritz standard

reviews.author: JC Review
reviews.title: Red Sox Trip
reviews.body:
Overall Excellent: What could be improved:

1. RC Club Lounge is set up for eating only. Would be nice to have some more comforatable chairs and occasional tables like other RC Club Rooms

2. Personal preference - At a corporate level, Asprey Purple Water for bath was much better than current selection.

3. Food in the RC Club was outstanding! Some of the best we've had.

reviews.author: RunBos
reviews.title: Amazing Experience!
reviews.body: The Ritz took such great care of us during our stay for the marathon! They met all our needs, gave us a personalized gift after the race and cheered for us! The food was excellent!! The room was very nice with a great shower head!

reviews.author: Carol
reviews.title: Classy
reviews.body: My family and I were in town to run the Boston Marathon.  From the moment we got there as the doorman greeted us until we left everything was spectacular.  The Ritz treated the runners like VIP!  A celebration for the runners as they came back from the race was a very unexpected surprise!  I received a bag of gifts after the race that was as thoughtful as a family member would have given.  The gym Equinox is every athlete’s dream of a gym. All the employees were incredibly gracious and kind.  If I get into the race in 2027 I will definitely be back to stay at the Ritz.

reviews.author: Hannah0104
reviews.title: Unhelpful Staff
reviews.body: No one was willing to help with the door, luggage, or bring my delivery up to my room. Also no free workout facility.

reviews.author: Kurzynskij
reviews.title: Good Stay Overshadowed By Excessive Resort Fees
reviews.body:
Great location with excellent amenities. As a Marriott Bonvoy member, I was disappointed by the daily resort/destination fees, especially since some of the included benefits were things I either didn’t use or would normally receive at no additional cost as a member, such as Wi-Fi.

We really enjoyed the Waterline—the bartender was great and the drinks were excellent. Service was a little inconsistent, though, and we had to flag down our waitress several times throughout our visit.

Overall, a great location and enjoyable stay, but the additional fees and uneven service took away from the experience a bit.

reviews.author: Jim1406
reviews.title: Cleanliness
reviews.body: The room we stayed in was not very satisfactory. The shower was dirty and gross. The shower fan did not work the ceiling was spot painted. The table in between the 2 queen bed had a glass top and underneath the top was so filthy and gross 🤮. It was disgustingly unfortunate to look at. To take a shower in this room felt terrible on you feet it was not a good feeling. I couldn’t figure out why the window would be allowed to open and have no screen or protection from stopping a child from falling out the window on the 5th floor! The hallway carpet was also dirty you could see the clean carpet close the walls. Just for you records we stayed in room 509 9/13-9/15

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.title: The app is horrible and cost us valuable time.
reviews.body: We fought with the mobile app until we couldn’t. Getting into our room, secure areas, elevator. So much time wasted before we gave up, relied on others to get us on elevator and went to desk for physical keys.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Stay Here!
reviews.body: Spent 4 nights here and it was great! Everything is walkable and the views are incredible. Subway stop right outside the entrance of the hotel. Room was clean, kids loved the pool, staff always helpful. Walls are thick and we didn't get any complaints about my loud kids lol. Will definitely be back. Loved this place!

reviews.author: Helen UK 2026
reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.body: I am glad we stayed at the Long Wharf.  However it is dated and a little soulless. The walls are not very thick I could hear noises both day and night.

reviews.author: Donn
reviews.title: Location, Location,Location!
reviews.body: The location of the Boston Marriott Long wharf is ideal for tourists visiting Boston. The Boston subway has a station right outside the front door, a Duck Tour Station is only 30 steps away next to the New England Aquarium, and the Long Wharf itself provides water taxis, boat tours and an airport ferry transport.The Old Northside of Boston’s Little Italy is 4 short blocks away and the Freedom Trail is a half mile away. The Marriott has a large well equipped workout facility and a small indoor pool with a nice outdoor deck overlooking the harbor

reviews.title: Beautiful Stay, but Serious Housekeeping & Noise Issues
reviews.body: Beautiful Stay, but Serious Housekeeping & Noise Issues

reviews.author: Star05
reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.body:
Very disappointing stay, especially for the price.
The location of the Boston Marriott Long Wharf is excellent, but unfortunately that is about the only thing I can recommend. At more than $500 per night, I expected a much higher-end experience. Instead, the hotel felt dated, dingy, and nowhere near the standard I would expect at this price point.
The staff we encountered were also less than pleasant and did little to make us feel welcomed. When you are paying this much for a hotel, both the condition of the property and the level of service should reflect that premium price, and neither did.
I understand that the waterfront location comes at a premium, but location alone does not justify $500+ per night. There are too many hotel options in Boston to pay this much for an experience that feels average at best.
I would not stay here again.

reviews.author: The brides mother
reviews.title: Lacking in many wsys
reviews.body: Very very inadequate room with poor lighting, no chair and a bathtub that was difficult to shower in.  Not up to my impression of what a Marriott used to b

reviews.author: Claudia216
reviews.title: Great stay through the generations!
reviews.body: I first stayed as a baby at the Marriot Longwharf with my parents in 1982 right after in opened ! I returned last week to celebrate my 7 yo son's bday! We live in Boston but did a staycation to enjoy the pool and walk to the North End for dinner. It was a perfect room, perfect view and perfect stay - a lovely spot in the city!

reviews.author: RFamElite
reviews.title: GREAT PROPERTY AND EXCEPTIONAL STAFF!!
reviews.body:
All services and staff were exceptional. All aspects of the property were spotless and well kept. Needless to say the location is ultra convenient to a significant amount of shopping, dining and waterfront activities.

Staff is very professional and attentive without being overbearing. The food and drinks at the Waterline restaurant were delicious.

Don’t miss staying here!

reviews.author: TJ46
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: If you're looking for a great hotel with full amenities right in the heart of Boston this is the hotel for you.  The rooms were very nice, but the staff was exceptional.

reviews.author: Deborah
reviews.title: Great hotel, perfect location!
reviews.body: We couldn’t have been happier with the location of this hotel! The staff were friendly and helpful since this was our first trip to Boston. Clean, well maintained, very good food at Waterline and excellent breakfast buffet available. Very comfortable beds with the best black out curtains! We would definitely stay at this location again.

reviews.author: OutandAbout
reviews.title: What a great experience!
reviews.body:
