We were traveling through parts of New England for our anniversary.  We had contact with four Marriotts across Mystic, Newport, Cambridge and Boston.  Hands down Marriott Long Wharf was the best. 

A great location.  Great staff (Thank you Abby, Justin, and Lisa).  Great food.  Did I mention great location? Clean room! Clean common areas!  Excellent views!  Easy airport access!  Helpful Concierge, Front Desk, and Customer Experience Manager! 

Sincerely one of the best hotel stays I've had.

reviews.author: Jayne
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.body: Our annual stay at Long Wharf Marriott did not disappoint.  The location is great, service is good, and the outdoor pool deck is the perfect place to relax.   Always clean and the staff is courteous.   The destination fee is annoying given the rates for room and valet but I guess it is to be expected for a popular city hotel.

reviews.author: R and R
reviews.title: First time to Boston, we were pleasantly surprised with the location.
reviews.body: We had a wonderful time staying here, the location was walkable and relaxing to view from our room. Having Starbucks in the building was a bonus too!

reviews.author: Suburban girl
reviews.title: Weekend at the wharf
reviews.body: Despite the rain Marriott delivered  as always. Courteous staff and clean room

reviews.author: Rachael B
reviews.title: Wonderful family stay
reviews.body: We traveled as a family of four with two kids. The Boston Marriott Long Wharf was excellent during our stay. The location is fantastic and our children enjoyed every aspect of being near the wharf. We were close to shopping and food and in the evenings, the area quieted down and had a relaxing feel. The staff was great and we never encountered a negative experience. Our kids enjoyed utilizing the pool and we enjoyed the outside viewing area. Room service was great, always on time. We loved the cookies and milk in the evening. Our family is looking forward to coming back here for another family trip, as well as a much needed, mom and dad get away.

reviews.author: California Gal 2026
reviews.title: Happy Days
reviews.body: Wonderful time, enjoyed ourselves immensely.

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay
reviews.body: Wonderful staff, clean, and had my towels refreshed daily and my bed made.  It was a wonderful experience! With great views to boot.

reviews.author: Birthday Papa
reviews.title: Marriott Long Wharf is a Special Place
reviews.body: The Marriot Long Wharf was the perfect hotel for a downtown Boston vacation.  It is literally right in the middle of everything, and is a really cool hotel to boot.  We will definitely stay here again on our next visit to Boston.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Excellent property
reviews.body: Property was expectations we were

reviews.author: The Sanborns
reviews.title: A True Boston Favorite
reviews.body: We absolutely love the Marriott Long Wharf! First and foremost, the staff are simply wonderful—we’ve come to think of them as our Boston family. ❤️ The location is perfect, and the hotel gives us all the comforts, convenience, and little extras that make every visit feel like coming home. We wouldn’t stay anywhere else when we’re in Boston! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: JDC 68
reviews.title: Great location and views
reviews.body: Great location and views from the hotel easy to walk around close to everything needed either touristy or bar crawling through the city

reviews.author: Italy
reviews.title: Family vacation in August
reviews.body: We never felt welcome. The reception was rude, not helpful, unprofessional, and not friendly. The waiter was not friendly, we waited one hour for a simple burger.

reviews.author: Don M
reviews.title: Boston Long Wharf
reviews.body: Excellent Location and Staff

reviews.author: Nick D
reviews.title: **Outstanding Service in an Unbeatable Waterfront Location**
reviews.body:
We had a fantastic stay at the Boston Marriott Long Wharf. The location is hard to beat, the amenities were excellent, and our room was comfortable, well appointed, and had a beautiful view of the waterfront.

What really stood out, though, was the service. We had a minor issue when a bird left quite a mess on our window, which unfortunately spoiled the water view we had been looking forward to. When I mentioned it at the front desk, the receptionist’s immediate response was essentially, “What can we do to make your stay great?” That attitude said a lot about the level of service at this hotel.

When they realized they wouldn’t be able to get the window cleaned quickly, they didn’t make excuses or brush it off. They moved us to another room with a great water view and made sure we were happy with the solution.

Every staff member we interacted with was friendly, helpful, and professional. Between the outstanding service, great amenities, beautiful rooms, and incredible location right on Long Wharf, we had a great experience and would absolutely stay here again.

Five stars and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Scott from Maine
reviews.title: Boston trip with kids & grandkids
reviews.body: Perfect location, great staff, good food, Michael the Valet is exceptionally helpful!

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Great location but beware of ants and musty odors.
reviews.body: Perfect location for many tourist attractions. However, our harbor view room had ants and a musty odor. When we checked with staff about switching rooms we were told that there were no other rooms. Supposedly all rooms near the pool had a similar odor. I paid for a view of the harbor not a musty smell and bugs. If this is a known issue, it should have been addressed, stated in the room description, and/or discounted accordingly.

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.title: 3 day stay
reviews.body: Excellent Service, Timely response to valet service. Some disapointment with exercise room bike equipment.

reviews.author: Steph
reviews.title: Scam
reviews.body:
This was truly the worst hotel experience we have ever had. To begin, the room was not ready when we arrived at 4 pm (check in is supposed to be 3 pm and then, no one even called us to tell us the room was ready while we waited at the rooftop bar, we had to finally approach the front desk at 5:15 to ask, and the young man responded by saying 'oh yea, we tried to call you'....which was also untrue).

The worst part is that we are now being accused by staff of "damaging" the room's television, which is comical to say the least. They are trying to charge us 1,500.00 for said damage, when we did not touch the television ONCE. Not one staff member tried to contact us about this supposed damage, instead we were just slapped with the bill. This truly feels like some sort of scam to get money, so beware when considering booking this hotel. I would NOT recommend. 

The gentleman on the phone was completely rude and disrespectful when we tried to discuss the matter. As long time Marriott elite members, we are truly disappointed.

reviews.author: Henry K
reviews.title: Stay at the Envoy
reviews.body: The room was beautiful and I really enjoyed the decor! The view was even better and the hotel was very clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: Rude Restaurant staff
reviews.title: Rude Restaurant Staff
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel the staff at front was nice and accommodating , but staff at downstairs restaurant was rude and treated my wife very badly, they had 2 servers that seemed to overwhelmed and plain rude. Nobody welcomes you they don’t seem to interest and being pleasant and respectful just rude. I did visit the rooftop twice with my wife and bartenders were awesome. It’s just sad because was our honeymoon and my wife really felt uncomfortable. To be honest it was just a weird vibe

reviews.author: Hot sleeper
reviews.title: Poor AC
reviews.body:
Nice hotel, clean, fun. 

Gotta fix AC i need 63 when i sleep

reviews.author: Michelle S
reviews.title: Amazing hotel!
reviews.body: If you choose this hotel, I promise that you will not be sorry! I am definitely going to stay there again.

reviews.author: Amber
reviews.title: Worst Hotel Ever
reviews.body: The room was wonderful- however the noise and music from the rooftop lounge was absolutely unbearable. You cannot get any sleep or rest with the noise plus the drunk people that were using an occupying both elevators all evening and room in the hallways. There was no security or any kind of monitoring the situation. Parking was incredibly expensive no decent coffee pot in the rooms nor coffee available downstairs unless you went to the restaurant.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Boston trip
reviews.body: Loved this hotel and location. Everything was perfect except our rooftop experience.

reviews.author: Christine12531
reviews.title: Sail Boston trip
reviews.body: Average accomodations, average to Good service. Rooftop is overrated. Would have been a fabulous view if not for the large eyesore of old, rusted, abandoned bridge sections sitting in the harbor right in front of the hotel covered in grafiti, trash and overgrown brush.

reviews.author: Sail250 weekend
reviews.title: Sail 250 weekend
reviews.body:
Room small
Price not commensurate with hotel experience 
Roottop restaurant should have been open to hotel gusts only until 10:00 PM THEN let outsiders in.

reviews.author: Anne N
reviews.title: Perfect weekend in Boston with view
reviews.body: Everything at the hotel was perfect, and the service was absolutely impeccable. The staff went out of their way for us in every way possible. The bartenders on the rooftop were amazing. Mike even ran downstairs and got an espresso for me. The food at the restaurants was top-tier and we enjoyed everything immensely. The hotel location is also perfect and everything was in walking distance. There were restaurants all around the hotel. This is my favorite place that we have stayed in Boston.

reviews.author: Envoy take 2
reviews.title: Wonderful location, clean, good service
reviews.body: Our second stay at a beautiful hotel that is clean and has wonderful service… the rooftop view is exceptional for gatherings of a couple or a group… the hotel is centrally located for tourists to enjoy varied activities within Boston

reviews.author: Missy C
reviews.title: Poor housekeeping
reviews.body: Front desk staff were friendly and helpful, and the location in the Seaport is excellent and easy to get around, with a great rooftop bar. Unfortunately, housekeeping let it down. The shower was missing its body wash entirely, so I had to call to get some sent up. Over three nights, the sink area was never wiped down, and the night before we left, housekeeping left used pillowcases on the floor. The curtains also had noticeable holes and stains. Great bones and a fantastic spot, but the room upkeep needs serious attention.

reviews.author: Awesome O
reviews.title: Good but gimmicky
reviews.body: The hotel rooms themselves are decent size, nicely decorated and comfortable. Staff was all friendly and helpful. They lack certain basics like any parking or valet, and no place to grab a bottle of water or a bag of chips. Constant stream of tourists and wannabes trying to access the roof is an annoyance.

reviews.author: Bob S
reviews.title: Boston’s Bsdt
reviews.body: If you are in Boston you will not be disappointed staying here

reviews.author: Nate
reviews.title: Overpriced budget-style hotel with great rooftop
reviews.body: Prior to arrival I had messaged to ensure my room would be feather free. I also got a message from the hotel the day before asking about anything you might need in the room and I asked for a mini fridge from that list. When I arrived for check in the room request had not been handled and I had to wait 20 minutes to get a room. Also there was no mini fridge and no mention of it. I also don't think my status was acknowledged at check in but I did get a room with an ok view of the harbor. The rooms are small, it was a tight fit between the end of the bed and the tv. The water pressure in the shower wasn't great so much so that the hand-wand was useless. I was also awakened at 4am each morning by the beeping and banging of a garbage truck below my 5th floor window. I have lived downtown for the last 20 years of my life including for awhile in Boston and this was a somewhat noisy location. Also the blackout curtain would not close all the way - stopping about 6 inches short of the end of the track leaving a gap for light. The room and the hotel were clean although the cheap buildout is starting to age poorly. The fitness room was well equipped but too small and crowded. Of course the rooftop is the best spot in Boston but you can visit that without a room here.

reviews.author: Gina Gigi
reviews.title: Gigi
reviews.body:
We had an amazing stay at the The Envoy Hotel! The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming from the moment we arrived. Our room was beautiful, spotless, and had gorgeous views overlooking the harbor. Everything felt modern, clean, and well-maintained.
The rooftop bar was definitely a highlight of our stay. The views of the Boston skyline at night were absolutely stunning, and the live music and atmosphere made it such a fun experience.
The location couldn't have been better—within walking distance to restaurants, coffee shops, the waterfront, and many of Boston's top attractions. We hardly needed transportation because everything was so convenient.
Overall, it was an unforgettable experience, and we would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: micsim
reviews.title: Too loud.
reviews.body: Be prepared to get bounced out of bed.

reviews.author: pnichols0100
reviews.title: Facilities nice however was it worth the money
reviews.body: We arrived at 3pm for check in, which was the advertised check-in time, and was told our room was not yet ready. We were directed to the rooftop bar. We got drinks at the bar ($65) and at 3:45pm headed back to the front desk for check-in. We were told our room still was not ready. We notified staff that we had a 5pm appointment and all in our party needed to change, etc. to depart at 4:30pm therefore it was necessary that we check in asap. We spent time exploring the option of separate rooms vs. a room with 2 beds, but were then told that a manager was on the way to inspect the room. We waited another 10min. and received our room keys at 4:10pm. The room was a nice size, clean and decorated well.  Upon our return to the room we noted there was not a mini fridge and had some items that needed refrigeration so called down to determine where an ice machine was located. We were told there was not an ice machine but that they would send ice to the room. No ice was ever delivered to the room. In the morning, the in-room coffee maker was not functioning but a new one was delivered to the room.

reviews.author: Eliza
reviews.title: Great weekend
reviews.body: One of the best weekends I’ve had in a while. Quiet and stress free. Love the rooftop experience and dining also. The food was great I would recommend the teriyaki salmon bites with coconut rice!!

reviews.author: 2meTraveler
reviews.title: Best Staff!
reviews.body: The staff made me feel so welcome, it was a wonderful experience at check-in.

reviews.author: Christmas
reviews.title: OVERNIGHT GETAWAY
reviews.body: Place was amazing. Customer service was awesome. Definitely would come back.

reviews.author: Natalie M
reviews.title: An Amazing Bachelorette at the Enboy
reviews.body: We had such a great stay at the Envoy for one of my best friend's bachelorette. The front desk staff were fun, friendly and extremely helpful at check in. Our rooms were clean and spacious. Shortly after check in champagne and sweet treats were sent up in congratulations to the bride which was a really nice touch! We had reservations at the rooftop igloos and the staff at the rooftop was also excellent. The drinks were great and it was an unforgettable experience. The location of the Envoy in the Seaport was perfect and it was very easy to get around to different restaurants and bars. Overall, I would love to stay at the Envoy again and highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Bklyn 191
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: Great experience  clean  polite staff location is great easy access  to just about everything  at the seaport at the evvoy

reviews.author: Appreciative Guest
reviews.title: Excellent staff
reviews.body: Gentleman staff member assisted me with getting an Uber, carrying luggage to car, and making sure it was a safe transition from hotel to car in inclement weather.  Greatly appreciated his kindness. His first name began w/ an "M" as names not allowed in review. As a well traveled elderly guest, I found his service above and beyond the ordinary. Many thanks.

reviews.author: Lynn and Rob
reviews.title: Can't ask for anything better
reviews.body:
Can never ask for anything more!  the staff is unmatched!   from the minute you walk through the front door and get to see Marty.... he will make your day from start to finish!  He is aiming to please and makes sure you are right when you walk through the doors!  HAMZA is the man to make your stay the stay it should be!   Front desk fire and more!  He will hook you up the way it should be and more! This property is always our "go to" and lends itself to that faction because of the staff and how they appreciate the guest! I cannot say enough about the property cleanliness, the view from the rooms, property amenities, etc.... never have had a bad stay!
Always have a wonderful experience in Para Maria!  Esther and Ken are bar none the best bartenders I've ever had an experience with!  Accomodating, pleasant, and engaging would be how I could describe them!  Not a place to  be missed!

reviews.author: Niki
reviews.title: staycation
reviews.body:
We stayed overnight at Envoy Hotel as a staycation and had such a great experience. The room was beautiful, super clean, and had a great water view. It was cold and snowing outside, but everything was so close and easy to walk to—restaurants, bars, and nightlife were all right there.

We had drinks upstairs and breakfast downstairs, which was delicious. Honestly, one of the best Eggs Benedict I’ve ever had. The staff were incredibly gracious and made everything feel simple and effortless, which was exactly what we needed.

The room layout was really well thought out—everything was where it should be, with plenty of storage to keep things out of sight and make packing up easy. It was a much-needed little getaway and just an all-around really great stay.

reviews.author: Bc59
reviews.title: Feeling special at the Envoy
reviews.body: Fantastic hotel. Great staff who go above and beyond to make it a memorable experience for the guests.

reviews.author: Jose G
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: Food was great as well as the hotel room

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: Amazing stay on NYE
reviews.body: It was amazing!  The staff went above and beyond.

reviews.author: NYE
reviews.title: NYE
reviews.body: Great service-great room.

reviews.author: Robby Nunn
reviews.title: first trip
reviews.body: great location and fun atmoaphere

reviews.author: cortm
reviews.title: Great Location & High-Floor Perks in Downtown Boston
reviews.body:
We stayed at the Moxy Boston Downtown for a group trip and had a fantastic experience overall. Even as Gen Xers, we really enjoyed the lively, younger crowd vibe of the hotel.

The Good

Unbeatable Location: Extremely walkable to almost everything, right near Boston Common, and super close to a T stop, making getting around the city effortless.

Quiet High-Floor Rooms: We stayed on the 21st floor and had zero issues with noise (which some other reviews warned about). The in-room white noise machine was also a very thoughtful touch that came in handy.

Atmosphere & Amenities: The lobby bar has a great vibe and is a fun spot to grab a drink. While we didn't use the gym, it looked clean and well-equipped.

Responsive Service: We ran into a minor issue with our room key and the key reader, but the staff handled it quickly and efficiently.

Things to Keep in Mind

Room Size: As expected with the Moxy brand, the rooms are small with minimal storage space. It worked completely fine for us since we packed light, but it might be tight if you bring a lot of luggage.

Rooftop Access: The rooftop area is a bit underwhelming unless an event is happening, as the outdoor portion remains closed otherwise.

Bar Food: The bar is great for drinks, but the food menu is just okay—you’re better off exploring nearby restaurants for meals.

Verdict:
We would definitely stay here again! Perfect for travelers who want a central, energetic base to explore Boston.

reviews.author: 42fun
reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.body: Wonderful stay! Great room with a view and so quiet! Walkable to everything! Restaurant and bar fun and delicious! Staff unbelievable upbeat and helpful! Definitely will stay again!

reviews.author: BotonVisitor
reviews.title: Great location, good hotel
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location. Very central. Very clean hotel. The room can be noisy, bring earplugs. Small rooms which seems to be the norm in the city.

reviews.author: Tash
reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.body: We had such a fabulous time at the Moxy! Everyone on the staff was so lovely, and the bar was so much fun! I loved all of the games, and the photo booth was a really nice touch. I would love to come back!

reviews.author: Random Person
reviews.title: Overall, a good stay but room was noisy
reviews.body: The hotel is worth the affordable price, but the room I stayed in was noisy. Even the earplugs didn't help that much. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom was nice.

reviews.author: Bw
reviews.title: Loud Hotel
reviews.body: Asked for a quiet room and was “upgraded” to a low floor on the corner of two of the busiest, loudest, streets in Boston.

reviews.author: Sofia
reviews.title: An excellent and enjoyable stay in Boston
reviews.body: Our stay at the hotel was thoroughly brilliant. The service and attentiveness of the staff were ten out of ten, and everyone was very kind and helpful. The layout and facilities were exceptionally comfortable, which made our trip to Boston an absolute delight. We would certainly stay here again!

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: Fun, great view, great location!
reviews.body: The staff was so friendly, helpful, and FUN! We loved the 2nd floor gathering space and the roof area as well. We were able to walk and jog in Boston Common, and had terrific access to the Freedom Trail and Bunker Hill. Our view from our room was amazing too! We would definitely stay here again!!

reviews.author: MN
reviews.title: Great stay downtown
reviews.body: Lovely new hotel with AMAZING, friendly, courteous and very helpful staff. Lots of areas to lounge and always something happening. Great location; we avoided the nearby strip of college bars on the weekend evenings. Free morning snacks, water etc was a lovely touch too. The room was quite small, no desk or chair, so wouldn’t plan to work from here. However, for a leisure trip, we found it to be decent enough. We made use of the $35 vouchers we were given for the restaurant and the food was pretty good but not a ton of options - pretty great still for compensated eating. Definitely would stay here again if we return!

reviews.author: Andrew Donoghue
reviews.title: Boston Escape
reviews.body: Fantastic stay! Great staff, excellent location and great value for the money. Thank you Moxy for an amazing Boston getaway!

reviews.author: Dr CS
reviews.title: Upbeat, Fresh, and Decent
reviews.body: Most is a decent hotel experience. While beg of them to get new pillows to replace the flat, uncomfortable ones we experienced, everything else was lovely. The bed was comfortable, nice decor, great water pressure in the shower, and clean. Food at Bar Moxy is tasty. The street is very loud, but ear plugs are provided so all is well. Excellent location and parking nearby at the garage in Beacb St.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Luxury with a view
reviews.body: Love everything about this place, the front desk concierge was amazing very helpful and accommodating, the maintenance was always on point, and the food and bar waiters were very attentive and accommodating as well, ate a chocolate bar at night when no one was around and paid it in the morning with no problems. The best experience ever. This will be my go to place when ever I am in Boston.

reviews.author: MoxyMarriotMama
reviews.title: Great stay, note the destination fee
reviews.body: This Moxy is in a great location for access to downtown, back bay, fenway, north end, etc. Easy walking, public transportation nearby, easy uber/lyft, tons of food options everywhere. The hotel was staffed with friendly and helpful people, the room and gathering spaces were very clean, and the shower in the room was good! The rooms are small and do not have much space to store clothing (3 hangers and several wall pegs to hang some clothes against the wall), but this is expected in a city, and there are lockers downstairs if you need to store something. Note the hotel has a destination fee ($35+ tax per night currently). We received two $35 vouchers to use at the bar/restaurant (presumably one for each night we stayed?), which was nice and we used most of the value, but if you don't drink, don't want chips/soda, or plan to eat breakfast elsewhere, keep in mind you won't necessarily get the value of the fee. The breakfast food was similar to airport breakfast food... serviceable, but if you're a foodie you may want to go elsewhere in the city. Overall, it was a great stay and I'd stay again. Just keep in mind the $35 per night fee.

reviews.author: GT
reviews.title: Customer Service
reviews.body: My wife and I were very pleased with the level of service provided by the Moxy staff.  Dwaine, Julio and Jay were amazing.  The food morning crews were also in the very attentive to customers need.  Will definitely go back to Moxy downtown.  This hotel is an easy 15-20 minutes walk to the very vibrant North end Boston.  If u visit Boston, the North end area is a must visit. Great restaurants and bakery.

reviews.author: AJones
reviews.title: Great location, needs some sound proofing
reviews.body:
My husband and I recently stayed at the Moxy Boston Downtown location. The location was great, very close to Boston Common, other points of interest in the Boston area, and public transportation. The hotel itself was nice and what I have come to expect from the Moxy brand. Additionally, all of the employees we professional, kind and helpful. The only downside was that we could hear absolutely every that was happening at street level overnight. Lots of sirens, loud engine noise and loud music. While I expected some noise to filter in, Boston is a big bustling city, I didn't expect that on the 23rd floor we would hear everything like it was directly outside our window. 
I would stay here again, for all of the above mentioned positives, but would plan on earplugs and would look harder for the included white noise machine prior to turning in for the night.

reviews.author: BOS Fan
reviews.title: DeWoxsy at Moxy
reviews.body: DeWayne will brighten your next stay at Moxy Boston Downtown.  You just feel better around him.  He's the real deal with a heart of gold.  He's got something deep in his soul that we all need:  LOVE!

reviews.author: LeahZ
reviews.title: Love the Moxy
reviews.body: This hotel is super fun. The decor is on point and the environment is really lively and chill. The bar/game room is super fun and our room was perfect. We were in town to drop our son at college and we will definitely book again!

reviews.author: Jess B
reviews.title: This place got MOXY!
reviews.body: Fun, clean, and super friendly! Several little touches that made our stay that much better! Truly appreciated the sound machine in the room and the little package of earplugs with a face mask! Also, the self serve donut station in the morning was amazing! we had an electrical issue in the room, however, it was resolved immediately, and staff was quite accommodating.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.title: Good people worse logistics
reviews.body: The restaurant and bar staff were beyond expectation. Really professional, friendly, and kept the Moxy vibe. Only problem: there are so many items and drinks they cannot make because they are out of some ingredient. They probably had a really good weekend and were out of everything on a Monday. Could do better there.

reviews.author: J and J
reviews.title: Cute rooms with rude staff
reviews.body: Our room was welcoming and well designed, as we have come to expect from Marriott properties. However, the staff at the front desk were the worst we've encountered at any Marriott property where we've stayed. Unfortunately, I'd say stay at a different property for a better experience.

reviews.author: Deb
reviews.title: Very cool place to stay or just hang out
reviews.body: Awesome staff and perfect location! Small but very nice, comfortable, well-designed rooms. Clean & well-maintained. Great bar / lobby area with lots of fun spots to hang out. Live entertainment. Cool, industrial style that's definitely geared toward younger guests, but I'm pushing 60 and loved it too! I wish I'd had more time to just spend in the hotel.

reviews.author: Lobo
reviews.title: Foxy Moxy
reviews.body: I enjoyed my first time visit to Moxy Boston. My room was cozy and comfortable and the city view made me feel like I belonged to the city. The Boston Moxy felt like a home visit with family.

reviews.author: LaLa 1111
reviews.title: Great stay, great people
reviews.body: So impressed with this hotel, the staff and services. Our stay could not have been better. I had messaged a few days ahead to ask about luggage storage and early check-in since we were arriving mid morning. We were happily surprised to have a room ready at 10am when we arrived at the hotel. Check in was smooth and easy because I had paid ahead and we LOVE the bottle waters available anytime. We quickly brought our items to our room and refreshed from our flights. We took a quick tour of the rest of the hotel before heading out to explore. Loved the many lounging areas, the bar and food area, as well as the indoor rooftop space. Rooms were small as expected but all the thoughtful storage options made our 3 day stay perfect. Everyone we encountered was kind, helpful and genuinely lovely. I would highly recommend this hotel and will stay here again when in Boston.

reviews.author: Hopeless wanderer
reviews.title: Great location, fun hotel
reviews.body: Excellent location. Staff was great- check in process was a breeze. The rooms, while not the biggest, have everything you need for a night/ weekend away. Bathroom is updated and rooms were very clean. The only downside was the noise. It’s close to some night life so be aware of that but honestly wouldn’t hesitate to go back.

reviews.author: Nini
reviews.title: Unfriendly staff and loud music at 3am
reviews.body:
We stayed at this hotel while attending a convention and this was probably the worst experience I've had at a Marriott property. 
I'll start with the positive, the room itself was very nice and clean. It's small but had everything we need. But the soundproofing is absolutely terrible. We were woken up multiple nights between 2-3am by extremely loud music. 

The bigger disappointment though was the service. None of the front desk staff we came across was particularly friendly or welcoming. My experience at checkout was especially bad. The front desk agent barely greeted me or made eye contact. I had specifically stopped at the front desk because I wanted to change the method of payment on file. Before I even had the chance to explain that, she had already checked me out and charged the card on file, WITHOUT asking me anything whether how my stay was, or if there's anything they can help with before immediately processing the checkout. 

I understand that Moxy is supposed to have a fun, hip, trendy and more casual atmosphere, and I'm not expecting a 5-star hotel service. But casual shouldn't mean unprofessional or lacking basic decent customer service. There's still a level of hospitality I expect when staying at a Marriott property. I've stayed at many Marriott properties, and this was easily one of the worst experiences I've had. I would not stay at this location again.

reviews.author: Green Earth Art
reviews.title: Moxy in Boston totally underrated!
reviews.body: Best unexpected experience ever!

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Unable to recommend
reviews.body: Forced to pay for food I didn't want. Inadequate seating options while eating. Unable to sleep at night due to excessive street noise. Reached out for assistance, was brushed off as race car modified exhaust drivers being 'extra rambunctious that night'. Felt like I was scammed.

reviews.author: Ross
reviews.title: Most very disappointing
reviews.body: Not a welcoming place. Decor is crude and cold. Food was terrible for breakfast. Dried out scrambled eggs which when returned came back worse. Felt like I was in a prison with the decor and food. Stay at the Marriott Courtyard across the street.

reviews.author: Concert Goer
reviews.title: Social but poor sleep
reviews.body: Social and good value but windows block out zero sound so expect to be woken early

reviews.author: TASfromChicago
reviews.title: Super loud hotel that thumps at night
reviews.body: We came to the hotel for a celebration of 2 16- year old twins and they had a room ready. They put us on the 4th floor right across from the gym, an accessible room, and one that was right on top of the nightclub that the property failed to tell us would play music until 3am and feel like you were in the middle of a rave (room 408). The response when we called down was to bring us earplugs. The shower was dirty and to use the remote we had to get out of bed as the range did not pick up. We asked the hotel for a room change the next day and we were told that they had a high floor. Once we got back from exploring the city, we came back to a room on the 7th floor (room 705). The room was no better in terms of the club music and it was even louder. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone who is not a club-goer. The staff were nice and the gym was clean though.  I should mention that one of the two elevators was out of service too during our stay.

reviews.author: Matt Albert
reviews.title: Best staff and experience ever
reviews.body: We had the most incredible stay! We arrived early and Brianna welcomed us with the biggest smile and was so kind and helpful with all of our questions and requests. We were there for a friend’s birthday and she helped facilitate to make it so special for our friend. Additionally my wife had something shipped to the hotel and Emmanuel and Brianna both kept checking in to make sure everything was ok. Truly the most incredible service staff I’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting.

reviews.author: Ashlee
reviews.title: Perfect stay at the W Boston
reviews.body: This was our first time in Boston and we had the most wonderful stay at the W Boston. The staff was phenomenal, so friendly and helpful. The lounge was great, fantastic music and great drinks and food. Our room was spacious and had everything we needed for the perfect stay. I would recommend this hotel to anyone and will be staying here on our next trip to Boston.

reviews.author: Charl13
reviews.title: One of my new favorites
reviews.body: Such an enjoyable place in a perfect location

reviews.author: Flawless W Execution
reviews.title: A Flawless W Event!
reviews.body: My recent stay at the W proved it was the perfect location to host an upscale event with flawless dinner service.

reviews.author: AmberNYC
reviews.title: Fantastic stay at W Boston
reviews.body: We had an amazing summer vacation at W Boston. I want to especially thank Brianna (Bree) at the front desk for her incredible service - she formed a special connection with our 10 year old son Max, and made his day! She was kind and funny, and he can't wait to go back to visit her again. The hotel is beautiful and clean, and the service we received from everyone was excellent.

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Room
reviews.body: Extremely clean and comfortable hotel. Thanks for warning us about the elevator room

reviews.author: DHArn25
reviews.title: FUN AT THE W!!!
reviews.body: Staff was incredible! Bed was heavenly! Help with luggage unsurpassable! Concierge right on! Can’t ask for more!

reviews.author: KH81826
reviews.title: KH Stay at the W
reviews.body: I was very pleased with my visit.  The only two things...I wasn't aware that you had to place your card at the canner inside the elevator and I never did find where to eat breakfast - or if it was included or extra.  (I suppose I could have asked about that though!  They mentioned it when I checked in but I didn't recall.)  Overall, a great place to stay!    I wasn't the one financially responsible so I can't really answer that question.

reviews.author: FloB
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.body: My W Hotel stay was flawless. The staff was very accommodating and friendly; room was clean and bed very comfortable; ambience was warm and contemporary. Musical entertainment in the W lounge  was great.

reviews.author: Happy in Boston
reviews.title: Perfect choice
reviews.body: If you are trying to decide about this hotel, this is your sign to book. The facility is located in a convenient location. The staff are friendly and the rooms are clean. Room service is great and a nice bar to match. It has all the needs of a stay without leaving the hotel. I stayed for a birthday trip and would give it 10 out of 10. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.author: MSC from New York
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel Stay
reviews.body: We were thrilled with our recent stay at the W in Boston. The room was spotless, and I truly appreciate that the room had minimal carpeted areas (carpet is not to my liking in a hotel). Every staff member that we interacted with was so kind- from the valets (which I highly recommend using the valet service!) to the front desk to the amazing cleaning staff. I really got the sense that every person there really wanted to make sure we had a good stay, and we did! It exceeded expectations.

reviews.author: SleeplessinBoston1
reviews.title: So loud you can’t sleep!
reviews.body: Do stay here! Road noise was intolerable, even from the 8th floor!

reviews.author: Erin C
reviews.title: AMAZING EXPERIENCE!!
reviews.body: Have only good things to say about this place. We had a very warm welcome from the front desk who was extremely accommodating and making sure we had a room we would be happy with. We LOVED our breakfast experience both days, everyone was so friendly from - the Host, all the servers on the floor and even the manager made us feel special and the food was delicious, everything we ordered we loved, especially the Caboccino. Every time we came back to the hotel the doormen/valet gave us a warm welcome back with big smiles and helped us with our bags. We had cocktails at the W Lounge and the bartenders were so warm and friendly, offering advice on places to go in the city. We felt at home at the W and the staff in all departments went above and beyond in all aspects of service! Truly one of the best hotel experiences I have ever had, would 100% come back again!

reviews.author: Xming
reviews.title: Pet pee smell and sticky carpet
reviews.body: There are pet pee smell and sticky carpet in the room.

reviews.author: C from VT
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.body: The staff at this hotel was second to none. They were helpful and prompt. I used text to communicate and it was real time response. Could not have been happier.

reviews.author: Mrfamily123
reviews.title: Very average stay
reviews.body: The view sucked even on 14 floor. The water was hard to adjust. The calet was rude. Construction everywhere. Very little of that cool W experience that you get in other cities

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: W Hotel in the Middle of Boston
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay at the WHotel, the ambience and the experience was exceptional!

reviews.author: Tom M
reviews.title: Nothing special at all
reviews.body: As an Ambassador elite Marriott member there was no upgrade and the arrival requests were completely ignored. For the money this was not a good deal and certainly nothing special

reviews.author: Dtravel
reviews.title: Way to much noise
reviews.body: Would never stay again, way too noisy police cars, and firetrucks all night till 4 AM could not sleep.

reviews.author: maridanisa
reviews.title: When Business becomes Pleasure
reviews.body: I really enjoyed my stay at the Boston W Hotel. The location is fantastic. It was close to the conference center ($10 taxi or a 30 minute walk), it was close to the seaport and great restaurants. The room was one of the best I have stayed in because it had a comfortable seating for working and also stools by the bar. The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom had everything you needed.

reviews.author: Aly14
reviews.title: One of the Best Stays We've Had!
reviews.body: The W staff was extremely pleasant and helpful! They were always available for questions and suggested some excellent places to eat.

reviews.author: Jess
reviews.title: W Above and Beyond
reviews.body: As always the W Hotel went above and beyond from the front desk to dining. Style, quality, INCREDIBLE FOOD and drinks. The flavored water dispenser. The decor. The valet. When my 10 year old was referring to the man at the front desk by first name since the trip, it says a lot! Thank you 👏 you made our trip to Regionals Junior Olympics memorable. Even when I was having a mom moment checking our bags after late checkout, the front desk went above and beyond w care and compassion!

reviews.author: NYC MM
reviews.title: Nearly Perfect
reviews.body: Loved my stay! The staff was excellent, everyone from the front desk to bartenders. Such a great vibe! The one thing I would say diminished the experience was street noise, which surprised me as I was on the 12th floor. The street below has lots of nightlife, and the souped-up car engines and motorcycles went well past midnight. I'd advise bringing earplugs, or asking for a room not facing the street. I'll also say it was during summer, and that surely factored into it. But other than that, it's a great place to stay.

reviews.author: W Boston
reviews.title: W hotel
reviews.body: One of the best hotels I've stayed at.

reviews.author: AC Auto
reviews.title: Excellent as always
reviews.body: This Hotel could become outdated someday and as long as the staff remain as pleasant it would never matter. This is one of the only places in Boston where the staff always go above and beyound.

reviews.author: Edan
reviews.title: 5 Stars!
reviews.body: WOW!! Excellent hotel all around. Staff A+++!!! Every person was amazing. Thank you!! Best VACA!

reviews.author: Happy guest
reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.body: I stay at the W Boston regularly. It is always a treat that I look forward to.

reviews.author: Dethstar1
reviews.title: No review.
reviews.body: I don’t want to type, and the fact you are making me do this proves my point.

reviews.author: Boston June 2026
reviews.title: Horrible bar staff and noise
reviews.body:
I was extremely disappointed with my stay at this hotel. The bar staff were unfriendly and unprofessional. Guests were not allowed to order drinks directly at the bar and were instead required to sit at a table and wait for service. Despite there being four bartenders behind the bar, they spent more time talking amongst themselves than assisting customers. I waited over 20 minutes just to order a drink.

The noise level throughout the hotel was unacceptable and among the worst I have ever experienced. The bar remained extremely loud until nearly 3:00 a.m. each night. Even from my room on the 9th floor, the noise was constant and made it nearly impossible to sleep. During my stay, I averaged less than two hours of sleep per night.

A hotel should provide a comfortable and restful environment, and unfortunately this property failed in that regard. Between the poor service and excessive noise, this was a very frustrating experience. I will not be staying at this hotel again and cannot recommend it to others seeking a relaxing stay.

reviews.author: Keith M
reviews.title: Surprising Style
reviews.body: I reserved this hotel because of its proximity to the cruise terminal.  I wasn’t expecting a historic building with such elegance.  Most Residences Inn locations that I’ve stayed with have newer buildings in a more modern format.  I loved the old style architecture of this hotel but it still has modern appointments in the rooms.

reviews.author: Mike L
reviews.title: Excellent Marriott experience
reviews.body: I typically do much of my traveling solo for business. This was a different trip. We travelled as a family and this was far and away one of the best Marriott experiences I've had. I am grateful for the friendly and professional staff that made our trip with the kids and grandparents a very positive experience - particularly, "Thank you" to Windlefry and Joel! Rooms/hotel are very clean - no issues. And the hotel is in a great location! Will definitely be part of our future trips!

reviews.author: Kirsten
reviews.title: Great location / traveling with kids
reviews.body: This was a great place to stay for two night with kids while we explored the Seaport. It was safe, clean, in a location that was walkable to many restaurants and attractions, and the rooms were large and accommodating to a family. My kids really liked the included breakfast and the glass elevators. I would stay here again.

reviews.author: CynthiaB
reviews.title: Absolutely Outstanding Hotel
reviews.body: The suites, the breakfast, and the staff all contribute to  making this an excellent experience. I highly recommend this place and will come back soon. Beautiful location, town with historic significance. The walkability, the sights, and the relaxing home-like atmosphere at the end of the day, makes this hotel a home away from home!

reviews.author: Susan and Eric
reviews.title: Hope to stay here again
reviews.body: We were delighted with our stay at Residence Inn by Marriott Boston Downtown/Seaport. The location is perfect--within walking distance to South Station, the ICA, Fan Pier park and restaurants. The hotel itself is really cool; the architecture and design reflect the 1901 original building and we loved the exposed beams, brickwork, and skylight in our room and throughout the hotel. The courtyard is really cool and there are a ton of cozy places to sit within the hotel, as well as a lovely patio outside. Everyone we interacted with was very attentive and welcoming. Ashly in particular was friendly and fun to chat with--and made excellent cocktails at the lobby bar. The room was very clean and we were delighted that it was totally equipped for dining, along with a dishwasher. We really hope to get back to the Seaport and stay again.

reviews.author: VtCouple1
reviews.title: Great stay at south seaport
reviews.body: Very happy with stay. Staff welcoming, informative and helpful. Great little bar . Giovanni’s attitude and skills behind the bar made the evening a delight.

reviews.author: Tanya Duffy
reviews.title: More than expected!
reviews.body: This hotel delivered on every promise. The facilities were great, the location was great and they allowed us to park even after checkout, that was a huge benefit that enabled us to make an aquarium visit.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Spacious Rooms, Great Gym, Would Stay Again
reviews.body:
I had a great stay at the Residence Inn Boston Seaport. I was upgraded to a spacious one-bedroom suite when I arrived, which was a nice surprise. The room was comfortable, clean, and had plenty of space.

The gym was also better than I expected for a hotel, with newer, well-maintained equipment including weight machines, free weights, a cable machine, and treadmills. The complimentary breakfast was adequate and had everything you’d expect from a hotel breakfast.

Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would absolutely stay here again. Great location, comfortable accommodations, and solid amenities. I’d recommend it without hesitation.

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.title: Great stay for families
reviews.body: I stayed here with my family (which includes small children) and it was perfect. The rooms themselves were spacious and the kitchenette allowed us to have a comfortable night inn if the kids got tired. The location was also great. So many restaurants in the area, one block away from a Trader Joe’s, children’s museum and Martin’s park. We would absolutely come back.

reviews.author: Nancy
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Upon our early arrival our room was ready. The staff could not have been more accommodating and nice. Our room was clean, cool and well complete with amenities. The location was convenient and walkable to most locations.

reviews.author: Brian K
reviews.title: Staff very friendly and helpful
reviews.body: We had a 3 night stay and rented a conference room for one night.  The every employee we came into contact with was extremely friendly and helpful.  The room was clean and comfortable

reviews.author: Emmy
reviews.title: Cleans great location
reviews.body: Our room was very clean and I loved the layout. The location was perfect for a family stay - super close to the children’s museum and Seaport along with parks. Staff was very kind and helpful.

reviews.author: Travler
reviews.title: Great place !
reviews.body: Clean, well run, kind staff, great bartender. What else do I need to say. I will be back!

reviews.author: Bob D
reviews.title: SeaPort
reviews.body: Good spot with many bars, restaurants in walking distance.

reviews.author: Texas travelers
reviews.title: Great room.
reviews.body: Room decor is old town Boston with wooden beams and red bricks.   Bed is super comfortable.  Breakfast was great.

reviews.author: Mary K
reviews.title: Great stay. Highly recommend.
reviews.body: Great hotel in a perfect location. I would highly recommend staying here if you’re coming to the Boston area.

reviews.author: Dsfgzs9
reviews.title: Marriott Boston Seaport
reviews.body:
The property is an excellent place to stay and has a nice location near many tourist attractions.  The building is exotic as the hotel was renovated from an old factory.

The rooms are very nice and spacious.

reviews.author: Dr C
reviews.title: Great last minute stay!
reviews.body: Great last minute stay on the Fourth of July weekend right in the heart of the Seaport district in Boston. Free breakfast was one of the best we have had.

reviews.author: Pilotmmck
reviews.title: Fantastic location!
reviews.body: No issues. Checked in a little early. Location was great and food fantastic. Room was clean and nice.

reviews.author: Beagle 1
reviews.title: Best Marriott
reviews.body:
The Seaport Residence Inn always delivers the best 10+ service. This hotel is a Marriott gem that outranks the full service hotels. 
Staff are excellent, attentive and friendly. Rooms are super clean. 
Front desk team is always at your service.
The breakfast ladies take great pride in keeping their buffet full with many goodies.
When in Boston, this is our home away from home.

reviews.author: Natalie S
reviews.title: Great place to heal after a surgery!
reviews.body: I stayed here for 14 days after donating a kidney. I felt safe and comfortable. The complimentary breakfast was nice. The staff were nice. I loved my room and the overall hotel. I also loved the area it was located. The only downfall was my room was 612 and we could hear the people in the room next to us just talking. We could hear phone conversations and things throughout the night we definitely didn’t want to hear. There is an air filtration system you can turn on that works as an amazing noise machine, but you can’t hear your TV if that is in. I still would stay in that exact room again. I loved it there!

reviews.author: Shelby M
reviews.title: A place you'll want to return to
reviews.body: We loved our experience at this Marriott property. From check-in, to relaxing, to exploring the surrounding area, to breakfast (included!) the next morning, everything was excellent! Our room was cozy, inviting and relaxing with all of the necessary comforts of home. Had this been a business trip our room would have been an excellent place to focus and be productive. The front staff were gracious, efficient and helpful. The hotel's location was perfect for our needs - we were visiting Boston Children's Hospital the next day. We walked around the Seaport and enjoyed the area, feeling safe and having fun. Access to nearby parking was excellent and easy.

reviews.author: April26
reviews.title: Amazing Marriott Property
reviews.body: For any Marriott Bonvoy frequent users or just guests looking for a great place to stay...look no further.   This amazing property was built in an old historic molasses factory in the trendy seaport/harbor area of Boston.  The rooms are tragically hip  and have the east coast 'Loft' vibe that one would love to live in normally.   There's a ton of restaurants and things to do around there as well...it's an incredible location!

reviews.author: Enrique H
reviews.title: Marriott Boston Downtown/Seaport
reviews.body: Excellent place to be near to downtown and restaurants

reviews.author: California greetings
reviews.title: Would stay again
reviews.body:
I came here with my husband while attending my hooding ceremony from out of state. My favorite part about Residence Inn at Seaport was how spacey the rooms were. It felt like staying in someone's guest house rather than just any hotel. We forgot to pack a few things for our trip but it was no problem because there are so many stores nearby for essentials (CVS, Trader Joes, Sephora) but they also have delicious restaurants and shopping nearby. THe area is safe and we didn't need uber the entire time we were here because of how close it was (2 blocks?) from the silver line which connects to everywhere you need to go to in Boston (including our day trip to Salem).
Tips for travelers: Utilize the public transport. We bought a week pass for $22 and it gave us unlimited use of their public transport. Highly recommend Taco Bar across the street. The hotel breakfast is pretty good we ate here every morning before leaving.

reviews.author: Capespasister12
reviews.title: Mother's day weekend in Boston's Seaport district
reviews.body: I would highly recommend this hotel.  The rooms were spacious, comfortable, quiet and very clean.  The brick walls made it seem more like an apartment than a hotel room.  We would love to stay here again the next time we are in Boston.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.body: Lovely Room with full kitchen. Very comfortable pull out couch and separate bedroom. The room service was great on cleaning room before we returned.

reviews.author: SeaportBoston
reviews.title: Nice stay in the new seaport boston
reviews.body: Nice stay in the seaport area of boston, next to some great eats, SAVR, WOODS WHOLE, Tatte Cafe, take a walk on the water - a beautiful stay.

reviews.author: Alari S
reviews.title: Our favorite Boston hotel
reviews.body: We have stayed here probably 22 nights in 4 years for weekend family vacation visits. Always super clean, the staff is incredibly nice and the location and parking is super convenient.

reviews.author: Joe from San Francisco
reviews.title: Fantastic location and property
reviews.body:
Great experience. Arrived early on red eye and was checked in. Room was spacious and good lighting. 
Kitchen and living room was spacious and super clean. 
Bed was comfortable and breakfast was as expected. 
Location is great. Never been here but this is the new hot spot. 
Convenient Access to trains and restaurants entertainment.
Was there for a college tour and had a great experience with checking checkout room and service. 5 stars.

reviews.author: ES
reviews.title: Wouldn’t recommend
reviews.body: Wouldn’t recommend this hotel.  My room smelled like old cigarettes.  Very dated rooms.  It was too expensive for what it was.

reviews.author: Boston Fan
reviews.title: A Reliable Favorite in Boston
reviews.body:
The Courtyard by Marriott Boston Downtown is my go-to hotel whenever I’m in Boston. The location is hard to beat. It’s conveniently close to the T, which makes getting around the city easy, and it’s also within walking distance of many of my favorite restaurants and places to eat.

The hotel itself is always clean and well maintained, which makes coming back after a busy day in the city a pleasure. The staff is consistently friendly, welcoming, and helpful, and the service is quick and efficient. I’ve stayed here multiple times and have always had a great experience.

For me, it’s the combination of the convenient location, cleanliness, friendly staff, and reliable service that keeps me coming back. It feels comfortable and familiar every time I visit Boston. Definitely a 5-star stay and highly recommended!

reviews.author: Rita
reviews.title: Boston visit
reviews.body: We had a great stay and enjoyed all the sights. Restaurants were great too.

reviews.author: Elite Ambassador
reviews.title: Extremely bad experience - Stay away
reviews.body: Small rooms, bad services. Subpar property

reviews.author: TG
reviews.title: Lots of work to be done
reviews.body: I was very disappointed with this stay, it was chosen as a conference hotel. There were issues with my room and lots of construction noise.

reviews.author: SH
reviews.title: All around great
reviews.body: Excellent choice for a quiet, clean and spacious accommodation with excellent customer service.

reviews.author: KS12345
reviews.title: Not for us
reviews.body: There was a club and hospital right next to the hotel and both went off at all hours of the night. When we checked in, we couldn’t even get into the hotel because there was like a 1000 people there. There was no breakfast or fitness club but were still charged all the amenities. The rooms were tiny and so oddly shaped. Just not for us and we will not be back ever again. It was so expensive for such a poor experience.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Awful
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, this stay was disappointing from the very beginning. I originally booked the Elk Suite which was a one-bedroom king suite on the top floor. Two hours before check-in, I received an email letting me know that the room I specifically booked was suddenly no longer available and that I had been moved to a standard king room instead. Not exactly a great start. 
When we arrived, the room smelled strongly of cigarettes. Considering I was traveling with my infant, I obviously wasn’t comfortable staying in a room that smelled like smoke. I messaged through the app and was told to come down to the front desk so they could help find another room. So I packed everything back up, lugged my luggage AND my baby downstairs, only to be told the sole alternative was a room with two double beds that the employee described as “half the size.” That information probably could have been shared through the app before having a mother traveling with an infant haul everything back downstairs. The gentleman working at the front desk was also not particularly friendly or accommodating throughout any of this.

Unfortunately, the cleanliness was also concerning. There was a USED RAZOR in the shower. It absolutely did not belong to us. Nothing says “newly renovated luxury” quite like discovering the previous guest’s personal hygiene products ***hair included**** waiting for you in the shower. At that point, I really didn’t want to think too hard about what else may not have been cleaned. 

Ironically, the $75 valet (while extremely overpriced) was probably the best part of the experience. The valet staff/service was good, but unfortunately that was one of the very few positives. 
For the price this hotel charges, I expected significantly better accommodations, cleanliness, and service.

reviews.author: ABC
reviews.title: Good Location. Clean Hotel. Warm Rooms. Hard Beds.
reviews.body:
TL;DR: I wouldn't choose to stay here again.
The service was good. The hotel was clean.
Overall, the temperature of the room never got to a temperature I want to sleep in. I had an engineer come by and tinkered with the AC, which made it slightly better the 2nd night, but still not a desirable sleeping temperature. 
The beds were rock hard and gave us back pain the subsequent days of our trip.

reviews.author: Mal
reviews.title: Weekend stay
reviews.body: First , I think it’s hard water in the bathroom. The sink water smells. Super thin walls and doors that slam. You can hear everything and service desk acts like they don’t know this and offers to send security to check it out. Wouldn’t recommend .

reviews.author: Mehhhhhh
reviews.title: Bait and switch - renovation not complete
reviews.body:
Do not believe the press release this hotel put out on August 18 that says the gym and public spaces have been renovated. It is not true. The gym is in some little party room off the lobby with no water and a very poor set up. Hallways are still the old dated decor. My room was fine, nothing spectacular. Noise travels in the hotel. Thin walls. 

Also, don’t get too excited when you see the flavored seltzer machine in the lobby. Chances are staff didn’t feel like changing the empty cartridges so you’ll just be having plain water for your stay. 

Would only stay here again if it is the cheapest option by far.

reviews.author: Short sheeted
reviews.title: Can we use the correct sheets please
reviews.body: I had a king size bed with incorrect size fitted sheet.  Sheet wouldn’t stay on mattress.  Very annoying ….don’t want to lay on exposed mattress topper.

reviews.author: Lisac2500
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Very convenient location - could walk to most areas from here with no issue. Yum only complaint is the loud music from the nightclub next door late into the night. You will definitely hear the booming music. If you are a light sleeper, may want to bring earplugs.

reviews.author: tomr
reviews.title: Great friendly staff I’d use again and recommend
reviews.body: Perfect visit. Staff was engaged helpful to a fault and extremely pleasant

reviews.author: PSur430
reviews.title: Highly Recommend Staying Here
reviews.body: This hotel has a beautiful classic hotel lobby aesthetic. The staff is professional and friendly. The rooms and common areas are always clean. They have reasonably priced in-house dining options as well as a convenient valet service. There is also a public parking garage directly across the street, if one does not want to user the valet service. I've stayed here twice and have a third stay already booked.

reviews.author: DJ CLUS
reviews.title: Less Room More Boston
reviews.body:
My stay at the Courtyard Marriott Boston Downtown was, overall, a very pleasant one. While the room itself was rather small and perhaps a touch melancholy in its décor, it was perfectly sufficient for my needs and provided a comfortable place to retire after a full day enjoying the city.

Where this hotel truly shines is its location. Being within easy walking distance of Boston Common, restaurants, shops, historic sites, and so much of what makes downtown Boston worth exploring was absolutely fantastic. In fact, the modest room gave me all the more reason to venture out, mingle with my fellow travelers and the locals, and enjoy this wonderful city rather than spend my time sitting in a hotel room.

The price was right on point for the location, the accommodations served their purpose well, and the overall experience was a positive one. I would certainly stay here again and would comfortably recommend it to a friend looking for a reasonably priced, wonderfully located home base from which to explore Boston.

Our NADA 20 Group utilized the conference facilities for three days, and the experience was excellent. Breakfast and lunch were provided on two of those days, and the hotel gave our group a comfortable, professional environment in which to meet, learn, and work.

I was especially impressed with the flexibility of the common areas. The downstairs spaces were welcoming, the chairs were comfortable, and there were plenty of places to sit, work, have a conversation, or simply relax. I also spent quite a bit of time after hours on the fifth floor near the conference area completing classwork. The tables, seating, lighting, and overall environment made it very easy to remain productive without feeling as though I was still confined to a classroom.

As mentioned previously, my guest room itself was rather small and somewhat uninspiring; however, perhaps there was an unintended benefit—the room encouraged me to get out and actually use the hotel. In doing so, I discovered that the Courtyard’s common spaces truly do live up to the promise of being flexible, comfortable, and useful.

For a business traveler attending meetings or training, I believe this property does an outstanding job of providing spaces where you can work when you need to work, relax when you need to relax, and connect with others when the opportunity presents itself.

reviews.author: JAMES
reviews.title: amazing hotel
reviews.body: Hotel is modern and spotless.  Every single staff member I encountered could not have been any nicer, not one employee walks past you without greeting you.  We had breakfast both days of our stay everything was fresh and delicious and they had tons of choices.

reviews.author: Thankful Traveler
reviews.title: Setting the pace in Boston for hotel service and accommodation.
reviews.body: Please refer to 1st description in this survey.

reviews.author: Chris S
reviews.title: TINY ROOMS
reviews.body: The rooms here are very small.  There is no place to put a suitcase and little space to move around.  The room was clean and limited interaction with staff was good.  I would not stay here again due to the small size of the rooms.

reviews.author: Jenn
reviews.title: Recommend
reviews.body: Lovely hotel in a great location. We had the car valet parked and walked around downtown Boston.  Room was clean & had amazing views. Had corner room which was a good size room, bathroom/shower a little small but worked for us.  Hotel staff was friendly!

reviews.author: Herb
reviews.title: Good but noisy
reviews.body: Good rooms but lot of noise from other rooms and external party sites.

reviews.author: hc
reviews.title: Comfortable stay in a central location
reviews.body: The Courtyard Boston Downtown is a great choice for visiting Boston. It is centrally located, and walkable to multiple T lines. There were a lot of restaurants nearby, and our 12th floor room was quiet despite activity on the street from theaters nearby.

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.body: I will recommend this hotel to others

reviews.author: Robin H
reviews.title: A great hotel. Highly recommend.
reviews.body: Stayed here for a family vacation. We had never been to Boston before. The location was perfect, the staff was friendly and the mattress was a dream to sleep on. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rachel B
reviews.title: Excellent Venue, Professional Staff
reviews.body: The staff was very professional, helpful, and friendly. We had no issues throughout the entirety of our stay here, they had the most gorgeous venue that was truly stunning and perfect for our event, and we would be happy to come to this location again if we have another event in Boston. Also, Jonica was the best! She was super helpful and friendly, when we finally got on site she was quick to help answer any questions we had, was super chill with our crew, and just let our event go off without a hitch! 10/10 interactions, we are very grateful to be able to have our event at this location. This was also a great location in Boston, close to everything and easy to access by public transportation.

reviews.author: Guest1
reviews.title: Not Goood
reviews.body: Not good. Extra money was collected when the thunder strom caused the flight canceled. I called and ask transfer the nigh to the night after, declined.

reviews.author: Roxanne
reviews.title: Very comfortable stay
reviews.body: Clean room. Comfortable bed. Accommodating staff. Great location. Can’t asked for much more!

reviews.author: Phil28
reviews.title: Good location, basics with no extras
reviews.body: Very well located hotel with barely basic amenities. Small rooms with no seating area, just a desk chair. No place to open your suitcase other than the bed or desk. But overall clean and efficient. Personnel were very nice. As a platinum member, my "upgrade" was the same small room facing some buildings instead of an alley.  Coffee counter was not very good and pastries were poor quaility. Doormen were not doorment, mostly lurkers never greeting guests. I guess they were there for valet parking at $70 per day.

reviews.author: RoManso
reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.body: Good location, close to China town, Emerson College, south Boston

reviews.author: aterrell9
reviews.title: Good Location That Will Work in a Pinch, but I Wouldn’t Choose it Otherwise
reviews.body: This property has a good location and the customer service was great. However, the air conditioning system is quite inadequate, so if you’re here in the summer, prepare to roast in the humidity. Additionally, the beds—specifically the flat pillows—were terrible. They’re old and need to be replaced.

reviews.author: DJatV
reviews.title: Great room but way overpriced
reviews.body: The hotel was super. The only exception was the price at over $900 a night. Definitely not worth it.

reviews.author: Female RUSH fan
reviews.title: It’s like a super cool art museum!
reviews.body: I felt like I was in a modern art museum. Really clean and friendly atmosphere. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Rsdavis59
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Wonderful spot on the north end of Boston. Employees are so friendly. Comfy bed

reviews.author: Phil G
reviews.title: Great location for Boston vacation
reviews.body: Warm and friendly, helpful greeting, great room , very comfy bed

reviews.author: Chris C
reviews.title: Great Location, Clean Hotel & Friendly Staff
reviews.body:
The hotel was very clean, the staff was friendly, and the location was incredibly convenient. There were plenty of restaurants within walking distance, and the train station was right nearby, making it easy to get around Boston.

The only thing to be aware of is that the rooms are definitely on the smaller side—more of a European-style “micro room.” It was a little tight for my wife and me, so if you prefer more space, it may not be the best fit. That said, we were very satisfied with our stay, had no complaints, and would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Visit relative a success
reviews.title: citizenM Boston is a winner
reviews.body: Really cool hotel & location in Boston

reviews.author: Al G
reviews.title: Basic amenities but very good at what they do provide
reviews.body: Yes, the rooms are small and the beds located in a tight space. Perfect for one person just needing a place to sleep for the night. Room was very clean and comfortable. The pad controlling all the room functions was a nice touch.  The only issue I found (and should be receive high priority from management) is the shower stall floor. It was VERY slippery. No shower traction mat was provided. People will slip and fall.

reviews.author: Nell
reviews.title: Beautiful stay in the perfect location
reviews.body: Amazing hotel room, the staff were very nice and welcoming nice and clean and super quiet with a beautiful view! Rooms are small but if your only with a husband, wife or boyfriend/girlfriend it’s perfect!

reviews.author: DoraBatty
reviews.title: Our Boston Stay
reviews.body:
We stayed at the citizenM for 4 nights early September. Everything about this hotel impressed us. The location was perfect- a 15 minute walk to Faneuil Hall a great place and an ideal start for exploring the harbour area or downtown. And only a few minutes walk to North Station where we caught our train to Salem for the day. 
The staff here were some of the best we’ve ever encountered. Very friendly and helpful. Also knowledgeable about the area and able to give us some great tips for exploring. 
Our room was small but perfect with an amazing view over the city and the harbour. 
If we ever make it back to Boston we would definitely stay here again

reviews.author: Fern 13
reviews.title: Stay at CitizenM
reviews.body: Andrew was great - I let him know that I was celebrating a special occasion. He went above and beyond to help us celebrate. Top class hospitality from Andrew.

reviews.author: Frank C
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Right at North station very convenient to get to anything from TD garden, Fenway (train) or the Freedom trail. Super clean modern style rooms and friendly staff.

reviews.author: Krystle N
reviews.title: My New Favorite Hotel
reviews.body: Staff was absolutely AMAZING super friendly and helpful it set the tone for our visit. The hotel is stunning with the art pieces and the views from the rooftop of the beautiful city, perfectly located to getting around the city. Breakfast and coffee were really good definitely had to opt in for that!

reviews.author: ghldr
reviews.title: Post Stay Support
reviews.body:
The post-stay service I have received has not reflected the level of support I would expect as a Titanium Elite member.

I am currently being charged both a cancellation fee of $545.31 and the $1,142.10 charge for the stay itself. This does not make sense, as it is not possible to both cancel a reservation and stay during the same dates.

I have attempted to explain this situation to Taylor; however, it appears there is still a misunderstanding regarding the issue. I would appreciate having this matter reviewed by someone who can resolve the billing discrepancy and remove the incorrect cancellation charge.

After a hold period, she returned to the line and advised that the charge will be credited. There was no apology for the issue, or apology for a misunderstanding, or apology for the situation or experience. Lack of empathy and appropriate customer from a Marriott Representative.

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.title: Amazing location
reviews.body: Everything was really good. The room is small but super crean and the locación the best.

reviews.author: LJackson
reviews.title: Nightmarish Customer Service Experience
reviews.body: Do not use for business travel! If you have a need for customer care, you will be treated in the most unprofessional manner. Do not recommend!

reviews.author: DH in Canada
reviews.title: Small room
reviews.body: I didn't realize that the Premium King room would have a bed that had no space around it. We had to crawl over each other to get in/out of the bed. I should have booked an accessible room instead.  Overall location of the hotel is very good.

reviews.author: Celeste Amor
reviews.title: An amazing stay and loving memories!
reviews.body: One hundred percent satisfied.

reviews.author: Jan K
reviews.title: Too Small!
reviews.body:
When you get in, there is little too no signage.  You go up in the elevator and then you have to check yourself in.  Be prepared when you get to the so called room.  Is like your in a capsule. The room is only as wide as the bed.  If there are two people, one of you will have to climb in and pay you don't need to get up in the morning.  If you have any mobility issues, don't book there!
There is one tiny counter with a hard chair.  No where else to sit. 
The bathroom is difficult to describe. The best way i can say it, is it's like a one piece pod that's just sitting in room.  The shower and toilet are in there.  Oh and be prepared to deal with a wet floor in front of the toilet because that's no way too confine it to the shower.  The only sink is in the open area.  It's so small you're barely able to wash your hands or brush your teeth. 
But, on a positive note,  it's in a fantastic location!

reviews.author: Eric 1
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Hotel was clean and comfortable, staff was great and price was awesome for being in downtown Boston

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.body: I stayed with my family to visit Boston

reviews.author: Jay D
reviews.title: Best view of Boston and the Harbor, great location
reviews.body: My room was on the top floor and had an incredible view of the city, harbor, and Logan Airport. Watching the planes take off, sail boats and downtown from my bed was so lovely. I could lay there all day! Staff was fantastic: kind, friendly, and solve an issue I had with my stay quickly. The bar, lobby and patio were such a great space and this would be a perfect place just to socialize. Main issue was finding a red stain in the bed and the light system not working properly which is one of the coolest things about CitizenM, so that was disappointing. I'd stay here again though!

reviews.author: Zoe1
reviews.title: Best place to stay in Boston
reviews.body: We got amazing service from the staff, room was clean all the time, cool iPad settings in the room. Location was unmatched in boston

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!!
reviews.body: My stay at citizenM Boston North Station was the best! From the moment I arrived, the entire team was welcoming, attentive, and genuinely made me feel right at home. The service and atmosphere were excellent, and it’s clear the team takes pride in creating a great guest experience. I would highly recommend citizenM Boston North Station and can’t wait to stay again!

reviews.author: Jimmy
reviews.title: Do not stay
reviews.body: The room was tiny and dirty, controlled by a slow ipad with cracks in it that scratched my finger.

reviews.author: Tracy
reviews.title: Boston weekend
reviews.body: Great hotel, would definitely return.

reviews.author: Jamie
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.body: This hotel was fun, beautifully decorated, had friendly staff and a comfortable and cool room with lots of fun features (colorful lights you can choose in the bathroom) The bed was amazingly comfortable, best I've ever slept in.

reviews.author: Visiting from Vermont
reviews.title: Perfect location with amazing views and service
reviews.body: The hotel is conveniently located at TD Garden.  The check-in/main floor was incredibly decorated, clean and appealing.  It provided tablets for check-in with helpful staff if there was a question.  There were many comfortable seating areas, a bar, breakfast area, conference rooms and a long comfortable balcony with great views of Boston.  The staff was super helpful and polite.  Cleanliness was above and beyond.  While the rooms were small, they provided for a comfortable, relaxing stay.  Much in the room is controlled via a tablet - the shades, blinds, lights, temperature, tv, etc.  Even if you are not a "computer person", it was pretty easy to operate.  We were also able to store our luggage before our rooms were ready so we could enjoy Boston, and also store luggage after check-out.  Couldn't be more accommodating!
