reviews.author: Nomi
reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.body: The location, the stall, the room, the view, the breakfast all was good except for the temperature of water in the shower

reviews.author: Marriott fans
reviews.title: Our favorite place to stay in Boston
reviews.body: Citizen M is so modern and fun for travelers, yet is set up great for business time also. Location is the best. It is definitely a place we look forward to staying at again.

reviews.author: KellyH
reviews.title: Small rooms
reviews.body:
Hotel has a cool vibe. Very clean and the common spaces are comfortable. Check in was via self service kiosk. My room was very small. The bed was under the window and the walls serve as the headboard and footboard.
Small shower and toilet room. The sink is in the living space. A younger person traveling solo would probably think it was a fun space. It was much too small for my husband and me.

reviews.author: Great Stay
reviews.title: A Great Stay
reviews.body: The lynch pin of a great trip.

reviews.author: Dougnmyra
reviews.title: Sep 2026
reviews.body: Our stay in Boston was excellent.

reviews.author: Jsinger
reviews.title: Boston North end Marriot 9/10/26
reviews.body: Excellent hotel with a spacious lobby and welcoming and helpful staff. Room was nice with a nice restroom and shower. Excellent location near many historic locations and resteraunts/bars. If you’re traveling to the North End and looking for a comfortable stay, I’d reccomend this.

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: First time in Boston. This hotel had an amazing location, great staff, and very nice rooms and amenities. We will definitely be back on our next trip.

reviews.author: ZP
reviews.title: Fabulous hotel
reviews.body: Amazing hotel. Great location near to TD Garden and other attractions. Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: Tanya F
reviews.title: Go to see Todd- stay for a great hotel and location!
reviews.body: Todd at check-in is amazing and so welcoming! Truly treats all guests right, especially loyalty members! Convenient location to the Garden and North end.

reviews.author: Mikey T
reviews.title: Rush
reviews.body: Great location! So close to everything we wanted!

reviews.author: EG1001
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Perfect location,we were disappointed in our room, there was a musty smell.Furniture was old,bathroom faucet needed repaired.We’ve stayed at Marriott locations all over the USA and out of the country and have never been disappointed until now.

reviews.author: JB
reviews.title: Prime location
reviews.body: This hotel is located right across from the TD Garden steps away from the T orange and green line which makes it easy to get around. We love that it’s also very close to little Italy it’s actually about a 7 min walk. The grounds and rooms are very very nice we recommend staying here

reviews.author: Catherina Raymond
reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.body:
Both Emmit and Tony helped me resolved an issue with my reservation. They provided great customer service and made my stay 10x more amazing. 

Thanks again for your help!

reviews.author: Tmdmw
reviews.title: Best hotel and location for a trip to Boston
reviews.body:
We absolutely love our stay here! The location couldn’t be better—just a 2-minute walk to TD Garden, about an 8-minute walk to Boston’s North End and Faneuil Hall, and with easy access to the train stations, it was incredibly convenient to get around the city without needing to rent a car.
The staff was truly amazing and consistently went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable. Everyone was friendly, welcoming, and helpful, and their level of service really stood out.
Between the unbeatable location and exceptional staff, this hotel made exploring Boston so easy and enjoyable. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Boston!

reviews.author: JWL371
reviews.title: Will be back
reviews.body: Stayed here for a few days vacation and to sightsee.  The location was fantastic and easy to get anywhere.  Hotel was very clean and staff very friendly.  Quiet at night as well.  Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: mstap
reviews.title: Beware of room 405.
reviews.body:
Beware of room 405.  First some background—I am a gold elite status with Marriott, made my reservation over 60-days prior to my stay through Marriott (not some discount travel site), was paying the full rate. and used mobile check-in 2-days prior (no room selection available).  Average daily rate over $300.  My profile preference is for a high floor.  After a day of traveling, we checked in at 3:45 PM.  Reception handed me a key for room 405, I thought that was odd for a 14-story building.  No acknowledgment, gift, or thank you for my loyalty and status during check-in as is the norm at other Marriott properties.  

We walked in the room, and were completely shocked to see the view… of a wall with a mural.  No daylight visible without craning your neck, pressing your cheek to the glass, and catching a glimpse of the sky.  Went back downstairs, and relayed the room was unacceptable.  Receptionist didn’t even ask why—they 100% knew.  Then proceeded to blame me for getting that room, because I had used mobile check in.  What?  Mind you… room selection is not part of mobile check in for Marriott.  Receptionist did the shoulder shrug and said there was nothing they could do as the room was already assigned and I had checked in with the app.  The tone and blaming nature of the conversation was not what I would have expected. I repeated that it was unacceptable and they needed to change the room.  Another receptionist came over, there were some whispers, and I did end up getting a room change.  

I find it absolutely reprehensible that this room would be given to any guest without a significant discount, and the lack of front desk courtesy and demeanor was not what I would expect of a Marriott property.

The next room we had was fine.   Clean, could see out the window.  Bathroom faucet couldn’t hold temperature, but shower was fine.  Hotel is in a great spot for touring and getting on the T. 

Overall 3/10 rating is based upon check-in and initial room.  I feel sorry for whoever got it that night and in the future, and I will think twice about staying here again out of caution… who knows who the next occupant of room 405 will be?

reviews.author: Peggy
reviews.title: Very nice hotel
reviews.body: The hotel is nicer than other Courtyards I’ve stayed in and the front desk staff were very helpful. Tony helped with where to go in Boston and restaurant recommendations. The room is clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: Sam1212
reviews.title: Wonderful stay!
reviews.body: This hotel was clean and in a perfect location. What made the hotel too notch was the front desk workers. They were all very professional and friendly. Emet checked us in and accommodated us for an earlier check in since our flight arrived early. My foot was hurting due to a recent foot surgery and Emet was kind and empathetic and allowed me to check in early so I could rest my foot and freshen up before our night event. Emet made our entire stay wonderful.

reviews.author: Lenny L From Chicago
reviews.title: My Favorite Boston Hotel for convenience to North End!
reviews.body: So clean, great location to North End and the staff and front desk are second to none! We will be back next year!

reviews.author: Nan Jean
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Although the hotel was very nice, check in was delayed beyond the 4:00pm check in time. They did not give us the room we booked and were told later on they had a leak. Spoke to the manager and he gave us what he called a 15% discount which was not accurate. When I emailed the manager I didn’t not get a response, only a copy of the bill.

reviews.author: Family Trip
reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.body: This hotel is in a great location for visiting Boston.   The room was clean and had everything we need.   The staff is extremely friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Kathy Rheault
reviews.title: Bachelorette Party Stay
reviews.body: We rented 3 rooms so we could be close to attractions which included an escape game and dinner in the North End. Everything we did was within walking distance. This hotel is perfect for North End activities. The staff was exception, including front desk and bartender.

reviews.author: EMMC
reviews.title: Great stay !
reviews.body: Fantastic location and the staff are outstanding!  So helpful recommending restaurants and highlights of the North End!

reviews.author: Bea
reviews.title: An amazing stay!
reviews.body: The front desk attendant was so nice and was able to me the last room available. When I went up to my room it smelled so good and so clean!! It was an incredible experience and will 100% be staying there again!!!

reviews.author: Great North End stay
reviews.title: Great North End stay
reviews.body: From making reservations to check in to room accommodation, everything was seamless and stress-free. It’s a great location very convenient to the north end and TD Garden. The staff was attentive and friendly and was very helpful to our requests. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Boston.

reviews.author: J and A
reviews.title: Great Location in Boston!
reviews.body: Great location to stay in Boston. Walkable to a lot of great sites. Easy access to public transportation. Clean room. Up to date hotel. Friendly front desk staff that greeted us each time we walked in and wished us a good day on the way out.

reviews.author: Positive experience
reviews.title: Positive experience
reviews.body: Courtyard was located in a great location for accessing the city tours and subway.  Hotel was very clean, staff was very friendly and helpful, room had an amazing view.  Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Charles C
reviews.title: Stay in North Boston Marriot
reviews.body: Stayed recently at the North Station Courtyard Marriot in Boston. The stay was very comfortable and the hotel as very clean. The front desk staff were very helpful and provided a seamless checking in experience for my wife and I during our stay.

reviews.author: NCA
reviews.title: DO NOT TRY ROOM SERVICE
reviews.body: I already wrote it earlier.  If you want it here, someone can cut and paste.  I didn't know this box was coming and I already took the time to answer this question;

reviews.author: DC visitor
reviews.title: Great location - upscale courtyard!
reviews.body: Hotel is perfectly situated for exploring downtown Boston, very walkable and close to many restaurants and public transport too. Next to TD Garden which can overwhelm local restaurants when there’s an event. We found the location excellent.  Inviting lobby and well appointed rooms. Housekeeping could do better. Best made to order breakfast in this category of hotel and reasonable rates compared to others.

reviews.author: S Phillips
reviews.title: Exceptional service
reviews.body: You will not be disappointed if you are greeted by Tony, Robel or Emet at the front desk. Exceptional service.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.body: We had three days stay at the North Station location and it was perfect for our family. The location is convenient to everywhere and easy to get to. Tony was amazing at his customer service and all his recommendations were on point. You will not be disappointed with a stay here.

reviews.author: Mel
reviews.title: Marriott Review Boston
reviews.body: Excellent services provided by the front desk staff, especially Tony. The room was amazing and awesome location.

reviews.author: Mandito
reviews.title: Ok stay
reviews.body: Everything was great except for breakfast. The breakfast lady did not want to serve eggs as advertized.

reviews.author: NWT
reviews.title: Nice place but highway is loud at night
reviews.body: Standard hotel room done well, clean, bathroom good, good beds. Gym is bigger than average, has big windows, has cardio and weights. $25 per night credit for food covers one person at breakfast, but be sure the staff credits you properly at checkout, I had to go back to request my bill be corrected for 2 nights of credit. The transit pass is also good, would have liked one per person. Good location for Tufts medical center, Chinatown. A bit far from Back Bay, North End but expected. Biggest negative is road noise at night for rooms facing the highway. We requested a room facing Whole Foods but did not get that. Overall OK value.

reviews.author: Room 624
reviews.title: Literally on the highway
reviews.body: Too noisy - no soundproofed windows

reviews.author: AZ to Boston
reviews.title: Perfect Stay for Our Ladies’ Boston Getaway!” 💕
reviews.body: Great stay at the W Marriott Boston! The hotel was very clean, the staff was kind and welcoming, and we had a wonderful experience from start to finish. We were there for a ladies’ trip, and it was the perfect place for our Boston getaway. Great location, great service, and an overall enjoyable stay. Would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: Syracuse to Boston
reviews.title: Very good choice for the area of Boston we wanted to be near.
reviews.body: Safe hotel that was walking distance to everything we wanted.  Easy parking at the Ink Block parking garage.  Only downside was noise from the highway but in our room there was a "white noise" machine which solved the problem (for us)

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: Convenient Downtown Location
reviews.body: We enjoyed our time at the AC Hotel as we were attending a family wedding with the reception held a block walk away at Bar Mezzana.  Overall a pleasant stay at this clean hotel close to alot of shops and restaurants and an easy walk to the local train and bus stations.  Getting an Uber was easy with good access to the downtown freeway on and off ramps.  The only issue was we had asked for the room to be serviced because they did not service it earlier when we had a door tag to request it and when we called they said it was too late at 3 pm.  We had to ask for towels daily and often missing wash cloths for our party of 4.

reviews.author: Tryhotel
reviews.title: Decent hotel but not any benefit for platinum member
reviews.body: The hotel is new but the room is not that clean. Found several lipstick mark on sofa. No benefit at all for elite member. No free breakfast no late checkout. Definitely not recommended for elite member

reviews.author: Juskim
reviews.title: Awesome stay
reviews.body: The hotel is amazing as are the meeting facilities!

reviews.author: MM
reviews.title: Comfortable and convenient downtown hotel
reviews.body: My wife and I really enjoyed our stay at AC Boston Downtown. Service, cleanliness, convenience and amenities all first class. We will stay here again!

reviews.author: MD
reviews.title: Poorly trained apathetic staff
reviews.body: Left something critical in room and just 2 hours later they claimed not there.  Poorly trained housekeeping. Disrupted intl trip to try and replace medication.

reviews.author: Buckikell
reviews.title: Great hotel with one complaint
reviews.body: We really liked this hotel. Everything was great except for the noise of the highway. My advice is to ask for an inside room or one that does not face the highway. The staff were friendly and helpful. The room was clean and comfortable. Drinks at the bar we’re good as well.

reviews.author: Not2happy
reviews.title: Albany
reviews.body: Walls inside room were dirty. No mention when booking of having to pay for parking or an additional $25 for incidentals whether you purchased anything else or not. Basically forced to spend $25 whether you wanted to or not. Very petty when you’ve already dished out over $300 for an okay room with a lousy view and dirty walls.

reviews.author: De Har
reviews.title: This hotel is on the side of a highway-Stay elsewhere
reviews.body: Hotel is located on the side of the highway surrounded by apartment buildings and in the back of a Whole Food Parking Lot. Very odd location. There is no restaurant as described only a lobby bar. Definitely stay somewhere else, the cost for the room and location isn't worth it.

reviews.author: amhmtp
reviews.title: Would definitely stay again.
reviews.body: Great property, service and amenities.  Fun neighborhood options.

reviews.author: Mo
reviews.title: Wouldn’t come here again
reviews.body:
Awful breakfast, for 25 bucks ide rather go to Denny’s! Frozen waffles, stale eggs.
Staff were overall not very helpful

reviews.author: NDM
reviews.title: Okay Stay
reviews.body: The staff was great and very helpful. The room was mostly clean. Unfortunately, the blackout curtain did not close fully and a very bright light from the adjacent parking lot would shine in the room at night. There was also a large ventilation machine outside below our window that was noisy and made it difficult to sleep.

reviews.author: Ian
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Meets or exceeds what you would expect from Marriott

reviews.author: MP
reviews.title: Excellent location and facility in Boston
reviews.body:
Close to transit and/or walking to down town.
Staff was super friendly and accommodating.
I checked in early and they provide me a conference room for one hour since I arrived very early.

reviews.author: Kelly B
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.body: This was a great hotel in a really good location!

reviews.author: J
reviews.title: Give Jeffrey a raise
reviews.body: Jeffrey was the best front desk staff person ive ever come across.

reviews.author: RLR
reviews.title: Great stay, at great hotel
reviews.body:
Very nice hotel
Staff very nice and helpful 
Great location

reviews.author: Larry
reviews.title: Clean!! Well worth the cost
reviews.body: Clean and Comfortable! The front desk and kitchen staff I interfaced with during my stay were quite friendly and helpful! Certainly, I'll return.

reviews.author: Samara
reviews.title: Loved this hotel!
reviews.body: Great hotel, clean and comfortable- great staff, lots of restaurants within walking distance

reviews.author: Chris14
reviews.title: Chris
reviews.body: Location was great but outside road noise was bad

reviews.author: Wes
reviews.title: Kings of hidden charges
reviews.body: Hotel is ok. Be prepared for enormous hidden charges.

reviews.author: Don and Mary
reviews.title: A little disappointed.
reviews.body: This was the end of our trip for our 30th wedding anniversary.  Overall the hotel was nice.  But there were no microwave in the room.  And we were on the 5th floor right over the highways.  The noise was awful.

reviews.author: Last Minute
reviews.title: Last Minute
reviews.body: Had flight cancelled last minute and Marriott was able to accommodate us on our trip.

reviews.author: EWM
reviews.title: Great hotel but watch the bar charges
reviews.body: Great little lobby bar with live music but watch the bartender. She will pour standard wine glass but charge you for 9 pounce pour. When brought to her attention, she was defensive and misinformed. I took photos later but management didn’t care either. Only about $25 in overcharging but the point is that no one cares. Disappointing experience for an otherwise great stay.

reviews.author: Caguy
reviews.title: Great Hotel With Cold Showers
reviews.body: Nicely located modern hotel with nice staff.  Stayed 3 days but shower lukewarm in the AM and PM. Located near freeway so noisy.

reviews.author: Buffy1
reviews.title: Five-Star Service from Start to Finish
reviews.body:
My daughter and I had a wonderful stay on Friday night, made especially memorable by the exceptional staff who went above and beyond to ensure we were well taken care of. Jeffrey and Damien were incredibly kind and attentive throughout our visit. From arranging extra blankets for our room, to storing our bags for a few hours after checkout, to helping load our suitcases into our Uber in the pouring rain, their hospitality truly stood out.

We are so grateful for the warmth and care they showed us. Thanks to the entire team, our one-night stay at the AC Hotel Boston felt luxurious, relaxing, and seamless from start to finish. We will absolutely be returning soon. Thank you again to everyone who made our stay so special.

reviews.author: Joe and Jenn
reviews.title: 1st visit... will certainly return
reviews.body: phenomenal experience from time of arrival (vallet and check-in process and staff), to room clenliness / housekeeping, to evening drinks at lobby bar Clink, to morning coffee in lobby, thru check-out

reviews.author: NO RESPONSE
reviews.title: Business & Leisure Accommodations
reviews.body: Overall met all expectations.  The unique aspect of the prison was fascinating and was creatively designed into a luxury hotel

reviews.author: Chelsea
reviews.title: Character meets elevated luxury
reviews.body: The Liberty Hotel was the perfect location for our company event—we hosted over 40 guests and from planning to execution had a top-notch experience. Everyone was very communicative and flexible. My personal favorite was the cocktail and dinner we hosted at the Yard. All guests felt special, cared for and impressed by the space, food and evening. The rooms were the perfect place to settle in and rest between activities.

reviews.author: Awesome Experience
reviews.title: Made a special trip memorable, great experience.
reviews.body:
This was a special trip, a mother and daughter trip.  The property went out of their way to make us feel special and our stay a memorable one.

Thank you for being one of the best parts of our trip.

reviews.author: Boston Traveler
reviews.title: Lovely hotel close to hospital and loud noises all night
reviews.body: This hotel, while lovely and historic (and they lean into the history of this location), was not up to the standards of being a Preferred American Express hotel, in my opinion. The lcoation is nice for walking the city, but the proximity to the hopsital means loud ambulance and police sirens all night and day. The restaurants were just so so and overpriced.

reviews.author: Jeremy
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.body: Mark the concierge is amazing

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.title: Great Location & Room
reviews.body: Fantastic location with easy walkability in Beacon Hill. Great lobby to hang out - and plenty of space to work/meet. Comfortable beds. Clean rooms. My go-to when in Boston!

reviews.author: Rangers Lead the Way
reviews.title: Best hotel stay ever
reviews.body: I would recommend this Property/ Hotel to anyone who would like to be blown away by Management and Staff- anticipating needs , friendly and very personable. The dinner we had in Scampo was over the top! Bartenders were great - This property use to house many people who made mistakes. The Liberty made zero mistakes- Thank you all and to the Marine Veteran who gave us 2 horses on our way to Ireland!!

reviews.author: Morell Family
reviews.title: Morell Family
reviews.body: Morell family very pleased.

reviews.author: Bamboo Lady
reviews.title: Great location, depressing suite
reviews.body: the Oberon (SP?) suite was quite large, but the rooms and decor did not make sense. It was very dark and depressing, filled with ugly mismatched furniture. The live orchid didnt seem to have been watered in weeks and was half dead

reviews.author: Drmom1
reviews.title: Going downhill
reviews.body: Sé havé stayer here for our MGH appointements since The hotel was One year old. It seems maintenance has been ¨deferred¨ indefinitely. Cleanliness has been an issue, mirrors missing in bathrooms, and AC and internet are spotty

reviews.author: NChi
reviews.title: Over charged for water that was never there
reviews.body: Over charged me for a bottle of water that they did but put in my room to begin with

reviews.author: Lilian3
reviews.title: No service at this hotel
reviews.body:
Not luxury service 
No one takes bags from car
No one takes bags to room

reviews.author: WeekendGuest26
reviews.title: Looks nice, but fell short
reviews.body: The hotel looks nice, but our stay was a letdown. Our room didn’t have the advertised bathtub, the TV didn’t work, and the shower kept dripping until it was repaired. These are basic things a luxury hotel should get right.

reviews.author: Boston Rocks
reviews.title: Great Boston visit
reviews.body: Everyone very accommodating especially Mark at concierge!!!

reviews.author: Cportr
reviews.title: Beds were hard
reviews.body: The valet system was impeccable, and each of the drivers was very nice being very professional

reviews.author: Robert T
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.body: The ambience, the interior design, the activities, and the Rich history of the hotel gave us a fantastic experience. As soon as we arrived, the Concierge met us and gave us a full understanding of the city, where to walk, and other restaurants. When we checked in the check-in staff seemed to be annoyed in general, we could’ve had a better experience with them, but that was the only downside. It has a great gym, but I believe you’re limited to how many people can be in there at one time. The location is perfect. It’s within walking distance to anywhere you really wanna be in downtown Boston. There was actually a wedding going on, and it was an amazing wedding to watch, but also it did not disturb our time they’re in our room. There was also a nightclub downstairs and that did not disturb us while we were there. Overall great experience and we will be back.

reviews.author: AGuerrero
reviews.title: Kasey is the best
reviews.body: Amazing surprise finding this hotel at the last minute since I needed a place to recharge before a flight the following morning. Kasey from front desk checked me in and was a delight to me. The professionalism and good service in her was the the reason I got to enjoy my short stay. I was put on the 15th floor and although the view was amazing, next time would be great to stay in a room more in the middle of the floor. Be able to appreciate better the other side of Boston. The view at night is magical with all the lights coming out of the high line.

reviews.author: M Baker
reviews.title: Doesn't Live Up to the Hype
reviews.body: While the hotel itself is lovely, the rooms leave a lot to be desired.

reviews.author: Anja
reviews.title: The Liberty Hotel Exceptional Stay
reviews.body: The hotel is extremely nice, clean, with an amazing staff. Well worth the visit staying here.

reviews.author: Great vacation
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.body: Terrific details in rooms. Nd public spaces to reflect previous use as a jail. Mark st the Concierge desk was very helpful and made our stay very enjoyable. Definitely will stay here again.

reviews.author: maRty b
reviews.title: The Most Welcoming, Gracious Staff
reviews.body: Beyond its prime location, its historic infrastructure, and its dazzling facade and interior, what makes The Liberty stand out is the staff. From the moment I was greeted by the valet service staff, to the housekeepers who kept my room spotlessly clean and stocked with fresh towels, to the wait staff at Clink who recognized me each morning and greeted my like a friend, every interaction with staff was professional yet personal, caring, and genuinely concerned for my wellbeing. I highly recommend a visit to this remarkable Marriott property.

reviews.author: NRhornet
reviews.title: Concert night
reviews.body: Staying at the Liberty exceeded expectation and just enhanced our concert experience.

reviews.author: Gaylynn K
reviews.title: First time visiting Boston
reviews.body:
The Liberty Hotel could not have been more perfect for our first time visiting Boston.  The location was so very convenient to walking daily and taking in all the sights and history.  There were so many amazing areas to enjoy coffee, drinks, dining or just visiting within the hotel property.  
Our room was spacious and clean, as well as the rest of the hotel.  Looking forward to returning in the near future!

reviews.author: SyntheticPlastic
reviews.title: Management/front-desk failure
reviews.body: Rude/improper treatment for a small issue

reviews.author: Tanya K
reviews.title: The Liberty Hotel is easily one of the most striking places to stay in Boston.
reviews.body:
The Liberty Hotel is easily one of the most striking places to stay in Boston. The historic architecture of the former Charles Street Jail is stunning inside and out, and the unique, prison-chic decor throughout the grand lobby and individual guest rooms makes for a genuinely cool vibe you won't find anywhere else.
​Where it falls a bit short of its high-end price tag is the service. The staff is polite enough, but the experience lacks that polished, attentive touch you expect from a true luxury establishment. We also dined at Clink—the food was decent, but ultimately nothing amazing or memorable.
​Come for the incredible atmosphere, unique design, and bustling bar scene, but adjust your expectations slightly when it comes to the service and dining.

Valet - Wonderful Service, Gentlemen here did impress me as they were very extremely helpful and polite.

reviews.author: Donna
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.body: The staff at this hotel deserve a five star rating.  They were wonderful and went above and beyond to make our stay extra special.

reviews.author: ADC1005
reviews.title: Not a luxury experience
reviews.body: Stayed here for four nights. Very mediocre service and staff engagement.

reviews.author: visitor
reviews.title: Disappointing experience for a luxury property
reviews.body:
My recent 5-night stay fell short of the 5-star expectations for a Luxury Collection property.

Ahead of arrival, I was invited to fill out a pre-stay form to coordinate special details for a reunion, with a promise of follow-up within two business days. Unfortunately, no one reached out, and none of the preferences were arranged, which was frustrating and disappointing. Additionally, the bathroom in the room lacked proper ventilation, leading to persistent humidity and unpleasant odors throughout the stay. Lastly, there were noticeable inconsistencies between the room tier booked and the floor placement assigned relative to lower room categories.

Given the premium positioning of the hotel, the lack of follow-through and room issues were very disappointing. I hope management addresses these operational and room maintenance gaps.

reviews.author: Elizabeth
reviews.title: Food and Beverage is great - accommodation and basic amenities are sorely lacking for a ‘luxury’ hotel
reviews.body:
Dinner at Scampo and cocktails later in the atrium for date night with my partner was lovely; every staff member we came into contact with was great —- but… the room, 333 was abysmal. So insanely loud with the bass pumping club music until 2AM followed by partiers in the adjacent rooms that I think I finally dozed off briefly at 330AM. The curtains in the room didn’t fully close so there was a bright 2 inch gap that light poured through and promptly woke me up at 630AM.  I had hoped to sleep in and order room service for a full experience, alas. 

The temp of the room was hot according to my personal thermostat (81) but the temp displayed on the wall thermostat was 70F and cycled loudly every 8-10 minutes.

The nightstands were chipped and all furniture just looked very…. Worn. No coffee maker or welcome amenities (odd as I’ve always had some sort of personalized experience as a Bonvoy member) and just a generally underwhelming, basic level room. Certainly not worth the $700 or so posted online.

I do understand that I booked this with points as a treat and my digital check in via the all supposedly hadn’t ’been caught by the system’ and the room was hastily selected upon arrival at 540, but honestly- staying home and booking a private meal would have been a better value in the end. 

Oddly, the messaging and request options on the app were only available briefly early in the morning Saturday (at 7am I requested a late checkout hoping I’d be able to catch up on some sleep - I could not) therefore we had no way to contact the front desk or order food. The phone in the room would not connect - no dial tone, no options to call out.

Once again, all staff were wonderful- the room, however, was most definitely NOT a luxury experience or worth redeeming the points.

reviews.author: Family with Little ones
reviews.title: No bedroom door in 1-bedroom suite
reviews.body: My young family have been loyal Residence Inn customers because we require 1-bedroom suites with separate areas and the privacy of a bedroom door. This location advertised 1-bedroom suites, but our room did not have a bedroom door. We got in too late to request a change that night, so I contacted the front desk in the morning. The front desk confirmed some 1-bedroom suites have bedroom doors, so I requested a room change. They failed twice to follow up. This made our stay very difficult with small children. As a regular customer, I pay a premium to have the comfort and privacy of a 1-bedroom suite. I could have easily stayed at a competitor and saved money. Very disappointed in our experience. Do not recommend for young families.

reviews.author: MASO
reviews.title: Restful
reviews.body: Excellent service, courteous staff

reviews.author: Abhishek Dutta
reviews.title: Very poor experience and extremely rude staff
reviews.body:
My wife had a terrible experience this time .

1. She wasn't offered help when she had 6 luggages and a kid . She had to go up to 8th floor and had explicitly asked for help . The front desk assistance rudely declined her saying - "it is your problem" .
2. The valet guy was rude . He was pointed at a trash near the sitting area in the first floor and was requested to remove it or at least ask the right person to help right away . My kid was around and we didn't want him to accidentally put it in the mouth . The valet guy replied with - "Not my problem" - kind of statement.
3. The receptionist refused giving 2 complimentary bottles for the night to my wife . She also misguided my wife when my wife asked about our food that was kept there . She made her go back to 1st floor only to find nothing .
4. The room carpet was extremely dirty . At $277/night such a room is just unacceptable . 

The experience this time was nothing short of harrowing . We will think thrice before visiting again . The only good thing was breakfast but still it wasn't at par with what we had 3 years back . Overall quality has severely declined over the years .

reviews.author: Visitor from Southwest
reviews.title: Marriott Chicago Downtown Loop
reviews.body:
Check in was ok.  I asked for a high floor (wanted a decent view). I got the 5th floor. =( My colleagues got high floors. =( Room was good.  Amenities in room were good. The fridge did its job admirably.  AC was better than satisfactory. TV channel options were disappointingly limited. Pillows were super soft, which is great, if you like that sort of thing.  I’m a firm pillow kind of guy, so I had to stack 3 pillows which made my neck a little sore the first few nights.

Breakfast was the reason I chose this hotel even though the conference hotel was 3 blocks away.  Breakfast did not disappoint, and I would consider myself semi-healthy and diet-conscious. Kitchen staff were friendly and very attentive. Kudos to them. I reserved 5 nights. After the fourth night, my stay was closed.  I was locked out of my room.  I was told I was lucky there was still availability. Very unsatisfactory.

Overall, I can’t really complain. I was glad to receive more member points.

reviews.author: Mom and 1 daughter
reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.body: My daughter and I wanted an extended weekend getaway to Chicago. This was the best trip and experience, starting with our hotel stay. The only downside was the cost of parking at the hotel each night.

reviews.author: familytraveller
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.body: The Building and facilities have been in need of a total renovation for about 50 years. Most of The staff are unfriendly, unhelpful, rude, and sometimes downright hostile toward Guests. The General Manager only returns the calls of Guests 5 days later. Then only wants to argue about the hotel's "Policies" of lack of service, lack of housekeeping, lack of calling a guest when someone delivers something for the Guest.

reviews.author: Anne R
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay!
reviews.body: If you want to stay at a hotel with a great staff and excellent rooms, The Residence Inn at 11 La Salle Street should be your next Chicago Hotel.  It’s in a great spot, walkable to many restaurants and activities and close to El Stations if you want to use Chicago’s excellent transit systems.  The staff is awesome.  The rooms are large and well-kept and the hotel exudes the friendly midwestern vibe that makes you want to stay there again and again.  We had lots of family staying there are there were planets of gathering spots to hang out and everyone felt very welcome.  I highly recommend staying there for your next trip.

reviews.author: Sallie
reviews.title: Good location a comfortable hotel
reviews.body: We love how close this hotel is to public transit and places we enjoy, such as the Art Institute. Staff is very pleasant, breakfast is pretty good, hotel is quiet and clean, and we like having a kitchen. The only issue is that the mattress was very saggy and uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Suzie
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: Excellent place to stay when in Chicago.  Close to attractions and shopping. Suites are very roomy and comfortable.

reviews.author: Raeoflite
reviews.title: It was cool
reviews.body: I will keep this short and sweet. We paid $1000 for a double room Suite. Which wasn't really worth it at all. It was cool but not $1000 cool. We should have went somewhere else and just got connecting rooms at maybe $300-$400.per room at a 4 star hotel. Lobby carpet was filthy. We brought my dad to Chicago for the first time and we thought we got a very nice hotel. I was hurt to see the lobby looked so ran down. The elevators are the tiniest I've ever seen. My family of 5 can usually fit on all hotel elevators WITH our luggages and stroller. We barely fit 6 of us with NO STROLLER AND NO LUGGAGE. I could keep going on.  But that's enough. Not to mention the stopped up sink that I had my husband pull out the stopper with so much hair and grime. 🥴🤢....My dad was the only one that got up for breakfast he enjoyed it very much. They were good with late checkout. But luggage system sucks. They did bless us with a credit for not having yhe island which was nice. But I asked when we checked in, if our room had it. And TWO people were like "OH yes!" 🙄 you should've seen my face when there was NO ISLAND.

reviews.author: Could be better
reviews.title: Good location, poor service
reviews.body: I stayed here for 4 nights first business. Cleanliness was fine. Bar area was nice. Location is great. I gave a low rating because at 8:15 am, 1.5 hours prior to the conclusion of breakfast, staff was putting away food items. I asked restaurant staff if they could grab me a yogurt and a banana and they told me no. I then relayed the same to the receptionist and she also told me no, and said I could go buy something at the nearby 7/11 or Starbucks. If i had asked like 15-20 minutes before breakfast ended, I would have totally understood. But 1.5 hours before??? Ridiculous and rude and a bad reflection on the Marriott brand.

reviews.author: Fiona
reviews.title: Safety concern
reviews.body:
All of the staff were incredibly nice and professional; however, I ran into two primary issues during my stay:

1. The check-in experience was lacking. The woman who checked me in essentially just handed me my room key. She never told me what floor my room was on (I had to confirm that myself), nor did she provide any information about the property’s amenities, such as where and what time breakfast was served, where the gym was located, etc. A quick overview of the property and its amenities would have made the check-in experience much more helpful.
2. The handling of room numbers was a serious safety concern and the primary reason for my low rating. During my stay, three different employees asked me to verbally provide my room number. As a woman traveling alone for business, I find it incredibly concerning and unsafe to have employees ask guests to say their room numbers out loud where other people could overhear them. The hotel needs to retrain its staff on Marriott’s policies and best practices regarding guest privacy and not prompting guests to disclose their room numbers publicly.

This became particularly frustrating when I returned to the property and went to the first floor to ask security where breakfast was located, since I had never been given that information at check-in. The security employee first asked whether I was staying at the property, which I confirmed. He then asked me for my room number. I explained that asking me to say my room number out loud was unsafe and against policy. Rather than understanding the concern, he became incredibly defensive and argumentative.

I explained that there were much safer ways to verify that I was a guest, such as asking to see my physical room key or verifying my last name with the front desk. Either of those options would have been completely sufficient. His attitude throughout the interaction was very unwelcoming and made an already frustrating situation worse.

I want to emphasize that the staff were otherwise very nice and professional, but the repeated requests for guests to verbally disclose room numbers are a significant privacy and safety concern that management should address with the entire team.

reviews.author: Nadine K
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body:
We enjoyed our stay here. However the hotel could be cleaned more frequently and efficiently especially in the common areas.
Additionally, while breakfast is offered it’s usually the same selections. I suggest the hotel move the Canadian bacon out of rotation as guests don’t seem to like it especially how it’s prepared here.

reviews.author: Ch53
reviews.title: An adequate staycation
reviews.body: This Marriott property would not be my first choice in the Chicago/Loop area in the future. Our bedroom had great blackout curtains but, the shower had terrible pressure and temperature moderation. The mattresses on both Queen beds were hard and unforgiving. We were on the fourth floor and had an awful view but this wasn’t an issue for our family because we were busy outside of the hotel during our short stay. The valet team was incredibly responsive and kind, which we appreciated. However, the staff in the dining area during the complimentary breakfast period was really struggling to ensure there was adequate silverware and that items were being replenished as timely as possible. Our criticism stems from the fact that this was a busy summer weekend in Chicago/the Loop area and yet this property (which has been a mainstay for years), seemed to really struggle with how busy they were. The same elevator came for us each time we went out and it was always jam packed. The interior of this property and the rooms could really use a “refresh” based on our experience.

reviews.author: A Moo
reviews.title: Good Stay on Points, Wouldn't Pay Cash
reviews.body:
I stayed at the Residence Inn Chicago using Marriott points. The location was excellent and made it easy to get around the city, especially for the events I was attending. The staff was friendly, welcoming, and provided great service throughout my stay.
That said, the room felt outdated and could definitely use a refresh. The hotel has several elevators, but during my stay only one or two appeared to be operating, resulting in long wait times and crowded elevators, especially during busy periods.
Using points made this stay worthwhile, but if I were paying the cash rate, I would likely choose a different hotel. While I appreciated the convenient location and great service, the outdated rooms and elevator issues would make me look elsewhere for my next stay.

reviews.author: Elena P
reviews.title: Wonderful property! Close to everything!
reviews.body: My husband and I booked this hotel to see an event at the Palmer House. We had a one-bedroom suite which was perfect! Everything was clean and in working order. The staff are so nice! The bed was very comfy and the bathroom had great lighting. We had a very nice stay.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.title: Review
reviews.body: Room was nice and spacious. Breakfast was decent. However the elevator situation was very frustrating. Our party had to wait nearly 30 minutes just to take an elevator up to our room, and same with coming down. This is important considering we needed to depart. Of the several elevators, only one was operating, and it stayed that way for our entire stay. This seems to be  an ongoing issue that is not getting resolved anytime soon.

reviews.author: Points Member
reviews.title: fix elevators please
reviews.body: fix elevators please, of 6 elevators only 2 were working over the 4 days we were there. We had to use the stairs on occasion and we were on the 10th floor!!

reviews.author: JMR67
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Downtown
reviews.body: I stayed in a one bedroom suite on the 31st floor. The suite was amazing, roomy and comfortable. The bedding was soft and luxurious. The shower was roomy and came to temperature quickly. The options for breakfast included everything from healthy to heavy and meaty to vegetarian. I chose light breakfast one day and a heavy one the next and both were perfection. The bar had many options and the common areas had charging options as well as great seating. I can't say enough about how wonderful the experience.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Front Desk Staff Unfriendly
reviews.body: Looking forward to a nice weekend and was treated by the front desk very poorly.

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.title: Convenient Location, Disappointing Customer Service
reviews.body:
I don't write many negative reviews, but I felt this experience was worth sharing because it was disappointing in a way that could have been easily avoided.

I chose this hotel largely because of its location and the convenience of valet parking. I was traveling with my wife and our two-year-old daughter for a quick overnight trip, so having simple, hassle-free parking was an important factor in choosing this property.

When we arrived during rush hour with our luggage, the valet informed me that he would not park my Dodge Durango because he believed it was at risk of being stolen. Regardless of the reason, this was the first time I was hearing about it—after I had already arrived and prepaid for valet parking. Standing at the entrance with a tired toddler, luggage, and traffic around us was not the ideal time to find out that the service I had reserved wasn't actually available.

What disappointed me most wasn't the valet's decision—it was the hotel's response.

A manager came outside after I explained that valet parking had already been prepaid. I was simply told that the valet fee would be refunded and that I would need to find parking on my own because the valet company was separate from the hotel. There was no effort to offer nearby parking suggestions, no acknowledgment that this created a difficult situation for my family, and no indication that anyone understood why the experience was frustrating.

I wasn't looking for compensation or even necessarily an apology. A simple acknowledgment that the situation was inconvenient and a willingness to help find a solution would have made a significant difference. Instead, I was left feeling like the problem had simply been handed back to me to solve.

The hotel itself was fine, but customer service is often what guests remember most. Unfortunately, this interaction left me with a much different impression of the property than I expected when I booked.

I like this version because it makes you sound like a reasonable traveler rather than someone venting. You explain *why* the experience mattered, acknowledge that the hotel may not control the valet, and focus on the absence of empathy and problem-solving. Those are points that prospective guests—and hotel management—are likely to find credible.

reviews.author: Frequent Guest
reviews.title: Great location, needs better service
reviews.body: My husband and I have stayed at the Residence Marriott Downtown/Loop probably four times before this stay. We choose this hotel because of my Bonvoy membership and the great location--walking distance to shopping, restaurants, and public transportation.  We were very disappointed with our stay this time around.  There was inadequate housekeeping staff.  So our room was not cleaned on a day when requested.  We requested and did receive body wash and clean towels. However, the rest of the room was not serviced.  Additionally, although there are six elevators, only one or two is being used at a time.  So this causes long wait times before arrival--sometimes 18 minutes or longer.  Granted, this is an old building so no doubt the elevators require a lot of care and maintenance. However, the staff was pleasant and approachable.

reviews.author: Juergen
reviews.title: Perfect private travel accommodation in downtown Chicago
reviews.body:
Excellent geographical location
The room is spacious and well-equipped
The breakfast was very sumptuous

reviews.author: Adri1980
reviews.title: Chicago Family Trip
reviews.body:
Overall, my stay had both positive and negative aspects, but there were several issues that significantly affected the experience.

The biggest concern was that only one elevator was operational during our stay. This resulted in long wait times and frequent delays, which became especially frustrating during busy hours.

Another issue was the bathroom design. The shower did not have a glass door or adequate barrier to keep water contained, so the bathroom floor would become covered in water every time we showered. This was inconvenient and created a slippery, messy space.

While the housekeeping staff were consistently kind, helpful, and professional, the reception staff were noticeably less welcoming. Their interactions felt unfriendly, making the overall customer service at the front desk seem mediocre.

On a positive note, the complimentary breakfast was a great amenity, and the kitchen staff were exceptional. They were friendly, attentive, and helped make each morning enjoyable. The hotel's location was also very convenient, making it easy to get around and access nearby attractions.

Overall, while I appreciated the breakfast, the excellent kitchen staff, and the convenient location, the elevator issues, bathroom design, and inconsistent customer service made the stay less enjoyable than expected.

reviews.author: nytravel
reviews.title: Good Location
reviews.body: Residence Inn is a convenient location, quick walk to Riverwalk and Red Line. Staff was friendly and professional. Only negative is elevators are very slow.

reviews.author: Nikita
reviews.title: Not what we expected
reviews.body:
This is an older hotel. The carpets were dirty and they need to be replaced or if not at least a good shampooing. Our rooms were not clean. We found hairs in the sink and shower and there was leftover food in the refrigerator. 

There was a nice lady in the hall that at least greeted us but the man downstairs with the beard was extremely rude. He just looked mad all the time and we were afraid to even ask a question.

The hotel staff was ok when we first arrived but I had to leave early because my mom died. 

I asked the staff am I able to get a refund and she said no and can you let us know when you leave so we can clean the room. 

The breakfast was the best thing. They had a variety and everything was good. 

My daughter plays for the WNBA and I told the organization that I would never recommend this hotel to any of the other parents or anyone in general.

We usually always stay at Marriott but not this one.

reviews.author: D Corts
reviews.title: A Perfect Family Vacation
reviews.body: We stayed at the hotel while in town for a concert.  Used the hotel as a home base to walk to many downtown locations and got help from so many of the hotel staff when it came to directions or recommendations or even what to do with our stuff when waiting for our train!  The hotel is literally in the heart of it all with large rooms to relax in when needed!

reviews.author: MillennialSoloTourist
reviews.title: Great overall with a few nitpicky wishes!
reviews.body:
My stay was great! Loved that my room had a full kitchen which made eating leftovers so much easier and better, especially with the plates, cutlery, and cookware all provided, along with dish washing soap and a single use sponge. The bed was comfortable, loved that the TV was on a swivel so you could watch it from anywhere in the room, and loved the area in between the bed and the bathroom that I used as my vanity to get ready in the mornings. It was also so quiet and I barely heard people coming or going outside of my room even though I was next to the elevators. I also didn’t hear my neighbors at all and barely heard other room doors slamming or closing nearby. Having breakfast provided downstairs every morning was a great way to save money as well and loved that the breakfast menu changed every day. The front desk employees were always kind and helpful too!

However, I wish the shower had better water pressure since it felt SO weak and wish there was also a detachable shower head option, the smooth shower floor got very slippery since the drain didn’t drain very quickly and the soap would get leftover on the floor and there weren't any sticky grips so I could see someone slipping and falling eventually, and I wish the shower had a door or a curtain since the floor ended up getting wet afterwards. The elevators are pretty small and would make a lot of troubling noise going up and down and they would take a while to get to your floor even though there were four elevators. I wish breakfast was offered a little later until 10 AM during the week and wished the employees would replenish food a little bit more towards the end of service but I understand it’s to limit food waste. I also wish there were water bottle filling stations on every floor or in the rooms as part of the sink instead of having to wait for the elevators again to go down to the gym or the lobby to refill water every time.

Otherwise, I’d definitely stay here again! The location was great and there were so many bus and train stops available a few steps away and it was so close to Michigan Ave so it was a breeze to get anywhere! The blue line to and from the airport was a 5 minute walk from the hotel which was so convenient compared to paying $50+ for an uber. All that plus having the full kitchen and breakfast provided every morning (including hot/iced coffee) made it so worth it to me, I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: casper the ghost
reviews.title: great hotel in the city
reviews.body: excellent hotel, staff was very helpful and the rooms were huge.

reviews.author: Group activity stay
reviews.title: Very bad stay with poor customer service
reviews.body: We were 4 different families and all had the same concerns and issues with the management service and hospitality of this hotel. They did not care! Even when we raised our concerns all the way up to the GM he did not take the time to help or understand our problems.

reviews.author: Tower
reviews.title: Sorely lacking - do not stay here
reviews.body: For over a period of 4 nights:  2 out of 4 elevators were operating, the temperature was 60 Degrees and cold air blasting out of vents, the main chair looked like a cat had attacked it, the rooms were dark, the acoustics for an event are terrible.

reviews.author: CK54321
reviews.title: Don’t Stay Here!!
reviews.body:
This hotel is so gross! Very dirty and even had a microwave on top of a trash can in a hallway. Who in the world would heat food on a trash can??
Oh- had no shower gel but 2 bottles of conditioner in the shower.

reviews.author: Jen1979
reviews.title: Not to Marriott standards
reviews.body: Unfortunately, the rooms were not clean, and the lack of follow up from management leads me to believe that the issue stem from the top

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Super Disappointing
reviews.body: The room was dirty, cleaning staff came into the room with a DND sign on the door and threw away my suit bag, I was given attitude by the from desk staff. I left disappointed and severely overpaid.

reviews.author: Michael Kiefer
reviews.title: DO NOT GO!!!
reviews.body: Hotel is well restored and kept in great shape.  People are not caring, insensitive and getting paid to watch.

reviews.author: Worldtravels600
reviews.title: Great staff and location, rooms need help.
reviews.body: Location is fantastic, and the staff was amazing. The lobby is gorgeous and well kept. Once you leave the lobby, be prepared to be disappointed with old, dated rooms and halls in poor condition. Obvious signs of water damage on most surfaces from possible HVAC issues. Musty smell and terrible lighting. It did the trick for this quick trip, but I won’t seek out this location in the future.

reviews.author: Noah
reviews.title: Moldy Food and fire alarms went off
reviews.body: We got to the hotel and when we checked into the room there was moldy food and the bathroom still had used soap in it and has not been turned over. At midnight the fire alarm went off in our room and wouldn't turn off so we had to have an engineer come into our room and they moved us into a smaller room. The front desk said they would move us into a larger room the next day but never followed up. Very disappointing. Absolutely disgusting the room was not clean. I would NOT stay here again

reviews.author: Katherine
reviews.title: Disappointing stay
reviews.body: The showers DID NOT WORK throughout our entire stay for our daughter's wedding.  There were many other smaller issues, but at a total of $4,300 for four nights, this is unacceptable.  The staff is pleasant enough but does not follow-through on issues - both during and after our stay.  They added a $300 per room charge to four of the rooms we booked as a pet charge - even though the pets stayed in one room for one night - when asked to remove, they removed one of the charges and I have had to continually had to follow-up. I would not recommend staying at this hotel.  Too many issues and no solutions.

reviews.author: Rolanda921
reviews.title: Great Solo Stay
reviews.body:
When I say this hotel was GORGEOUS, I mean GORGEOUS! 😍 From the moment I walked in, I fell in love with the architectural design of the lobby. It has so much character and immediately made the hotel feel like part of the Chicago experience.

I arrived earlier than the normal check-in time, and they were able to check me in early with no issues at all. The entire process was quick and smooth, which I really appreciated after traveling.

My room was clean, spacious, and perfect for my stay. As a solo female traveler, I also felt very comfortable and safe staying here, which was extremely important to me. I never felt uneasy coming or going by myself.

The location was another huge plus! I was the perfect distance from all of the activities I had planned, which made getting around Chicago and fitting so much into such a short trip a lot easier.

Overall, I had a great experience at The Midland and would absolutely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago. Definitely a 5/5 stay for me! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: MelB
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.body: This hotel is great! Very good location in the middle of downtown Chicago, the rooms are a great size, elevators work, they have a bar inside the hotel, overall extremely happy!

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.title: Unhappy guest
reviews.body: If I could give negative stars I would!!

reviews.author: Travelers
reviews.title: Exceptional Service From Check-In to Check-Out
reviews.body:
This was my first trip to Chicago ever I didn’t want the hotel knowing but now they do .and The Midland put a wonderful stamp on it. From the moment my boyfriend and I walked in, we received genuine five star service. Zero complaints.
We were given a wonderful room with an incredible view. The whole team especially the front desk and the gentleman who worked overnight  went above and beyond. You know who you are. Every interaction was warm, professional, and always with a smile.
Food, drinks, hospitality, and cleanliness were impeccable. I notice the little details, and everything from the door handles to the ceilings was spotless.
I can’t relate to the negative reviews at all. This hotel exceeded our expectations. The only reason I’m coming back to Chicago is this hotel  I didn’t want to leave. 10/10.

reviews.author: Spedguru
reviews.title: Staff and hotel nice, rooms are old
reviews.body: The staff, location and lobby were really nice. The rooms were old and outdated. Our room had a wet spot and smelled of mildew

reviews.author: Family of Lucas
reviews.title: Great hotel, great staff… bathroom is inadequate
reviews.body: Front of house staff were very accommodating and willing to bring up and extra coffee maker. Check out was flawless and manager was very friendly. Room was bigger than I expected, which is not a bad thing. However, the room lights are not as bright and the toilet was literally facing a corner support. It was impossible for an adult to use the toilet. Sadly, we had to take the elevator downstairs to use the public toilet because the rooms toilet was not physically functional to sit on.

reviews.author: IN1913
reviews.title: It could have been better
reviews.body: It was not what I expected- a lot of updates is necessary

reviews.author: BusinessTraveler
reviews.title: Don't stay; exceptoinally poor plumbing
reviews.body: Hotel is in an old building, but uses that as an excuse to not invest in updating it's plumbing. I had zero-to-inadequate water pressure, and water dripping from the light in the ceiling of the shower that kept me awake at night. Colleagues reported similiar types water pressure (and temperature) problems. I hear the 9th floor did not have any problems. Stay there if you must. There is a JW Marriott across the street if you're Bonvoy.

reviews.author: Hj115
reviews.title: Motel 6 at Best
reviews.body: This is directed at the hotel NOT the front desk staff or other staff members. The front desk staff were so nice and tried their best to remedy the situation as best as possible. The room I stayed in had mystery stains on the sheets (staff did replace this was upon my initial entry), the bathroom mirror light didn't work, water damage next to the bathtub, the bathroom wall next to the toilet was dirty, the trash can in the main room area was dirty, the room had a slight stale moisture smell, and there was mold on the vent. I woke up the following morning feeling congested and even through today. i checked out after the wedding I worked on 8 Aug 26 because I didn't want to sleep in the room for another night. I paid $749 for two nights and got a Motel 6 at best. Again, front desk staff and the other staff were extremely nice and tried their best in their power to fix it, but I know these things aren't majority something they can fix.

reviews.author: Soxfans
reviews.title: Overnight getaway
reviews.body: My husband and I came to see a Sox game. We chose Midland because of its location to the field and Union Station. This hotel did not disappoint. It was clean, reasonably priced and the staff were friendly! We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: ASBH39
reviews.title: Excellent all in all and over all
reviews.body: Thanknyou for beautiful accomodation for two weeks in your hotel you made me feel like home. This is Chicago!!

reviews.author: Chris P
reviews.title: Dated hotel rooms at premium rates
reviews.body: Room was very small, very dated, with inadequate maintenance and upkeep.  It was clean though.  Getting in and out of the shower was a hazard due to them wedging in a small toilet in between the shower and the sink.  They have some nerve charging almost $900 per night for this room.  Will never stay here again.  JW across the street.

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: My last option
reviews.body: Average the hotel is in need of a lot of maintenance. Everything’s very tired. Very average and then it is televisions are not up-to-date. Telephones are not answered. Don’t plan on streaming in your room no Internet connection.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Bad attention
reviews.body: Bad attention for the staff racists

reviews.author: Kent
reviews.title: Avoid this hotel
reviews.body: My room was dirty - torn carpet, leaky shower, no hot water

reviews.author: Molly
reviews.title: Horrible and smelly
reviews.body: Don’t stay here. The hotel smelled like stale sweat and I tried two separate rooms. Absolutely filthy.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Beautiful building, slightly tight rooms
reviews.body: I’d recommend… great, convenient location. Lobby coffee wasn’t great. :)

reviews.author: sallyhanna
reviews.title: Poor, Dirty, Expensive
reviews.body: Poor, Dirty, Expensive. Towels had yello marks, bed sheets looked old and not clean, no fridge in room, carpet is dirty, room smells disgusting, loud noises of train in the middle of the night.

reviews.author: M Phillips
reviews.title: Do not waste your money!
reviews.body: Smells of stale cigarettes and liquor. The rooms are extremely small, the shower didn't work, at one point there was no water and the elevators stopped working and my room was on the 12th floor!

reviews.author: Great stay
reviews.title: Made an incredible memory for me and my daughter
reviews.body: Great staff, went above and beyond to make us feel valued, even though we are just regular people.

reviews.author: Minnie
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.body: Throughly enjoyed our anniversary stay!

reviews.author: Marilyn from Atlanta
reviews.title: The Midland Hotel surprise!
reviews.body: A hidden gem, with authentic Chicago vibes, great service and extremely comfortable rooms. I was surprised with the professional staff and the meticulous upkeep of the hotel. The convenience to the Loop, Union Station, and nearby restaurants was a major factor for booking.  I will be back!

reviews.author: Jal lev
reviews.title: JW Marriott Chicago
reviews.body: Great service and staff, hotel a little old

reviews.author: TCPhins
reviews.title: Great stay and time in Chicago
reviews.body: We had the joy of staying at the JW for a quick night stay for fun in Chicago.  We can not wait to do it again.  This hotel was the cherry on top and made it all perfect.

reviews.author: Holly G
reviews.title: A completely enjoyable environment not just a stay.
reviews.body: There are many reasons to stay at the JW Marriott Chicago in addition to the great location near Union Station, the Redline subway station, shops, and restaurants. What differentiates this hotel from other hotels is the quality of the staff in each area. The environment is great and the people are very efficient, professional and are there to make your stay easy.

reviews.author: Tracey JB
reviews.title: Used wash cloth left in bedroom - yuck!
reviews.body: Without doubt, this was the worst Marriott experience with a used wash cloth left in the bedroom and a used dental floss string left on the bathroom floor. 10/10 yuck rating! In addition, the snack shop next to check-in had a salad in the refrigerated display next to the register, but would not sell it as it was their “display” salad (although it was boxed and ready to go). Inexplicable! I’ve never seen a QSR unwilling to sell their goods!?!?

reviews.author: Tom K
reviews.title: Just book it!
reviews.body: Loved it! It's a great location! It's a little bit more expense but honestly so worth it!

reviews.author: Alicia Latrice Holsey
reviews.title: Labor Day Weekend in Chicago with JW Marriott
reviews.body:
I came into town to spend time with family, and not only did I have an amazing time exploring the city, but I also had an incredible stay at the JW Marriott Chicago! From the moment I arrived, the staff was warm, welcoming, and incredibly pleasant, making my experience even more enjoyable.

The hotel itself was beautiful, and the dining experience was absolutely phenomenal. And let me just say—the steak fried rice is an absolute MUST-TRY! 😋✨

Thank you, JW Marriott Chicago, for helping make my visit to the city such a memorable one. I’ll definitely be back! ❤️🏙️

reviews.author: Phillyangel215
reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.body:
I checked in on a Saturday early afternoon (12:42PM - earlier than check-in time) but I know the hotel offers a luggage holding space, so this was not an issue. I went to the Marriott Bonvoy check-in desk. I provided my ID and credit card for incidentals. My phone number was checked, and I was informed that I would receive a text message when a room was ready. My travel companion left our bags with the bellman, we received out bag tags, and we proceeded to go grab lunch and then head out to the museum for the day. 

We returned sometime after 6PM having not received a text message that the room was ready. I was asked to provide my ID and credit card again. Then there was a bit of a wait while the front desk representative went to the back to check on something before returning to finish checking us in. This was a bit disappointing since this step was already completed (or at least I thought it was). 

We were only in town for a 1-night to visit a museum and have dinner, but the room (1019) was very nice. Spacious, clean, and very comfortable.

Upon our return to the hotel (approximately 10:10-10:15PM), we noticed a lot of guests in the lobby. We proceeded to the elevators only to find all six were out of service. We were told that there was an incident and it wasn't clear how long the elevators would be out of service. Since we had an early morning pickup to take us to the airport (5:30AM pickup) we opted not to sit in the lobby until the elevators came back online and walked up the stairs. We were on the 10th floor, so this was definitely an inconvenience especially after a day of travel and then exploring the city. I'm not sure what time the elevators came back online but they were operational by morning, so we did not have to walk down the stairs to checkout.

reviews.author: BusinessTraveler2026
reviews.title: JW Chicago - Disappointing
reviews.body:
It was very disappointing.  It felt more like a Motel 6 than a JW Marriott (especially in Chicago).  I checked into my room and a reading lamp connected to the wall above the bed was broken off.  I touched it and got a slight cut on my finger as there was a sharpe metal shard that was exposed.  I informed the front desk two times out of my four day stay and both times the person I spoke with sounded concerned and apologetic stating that maintenance would be by during the day while I was out of the room and they would fix it - it was never fixed or in any way attended to during my stay.   Additionally,  large amounts of water seems to spill from the shower and leaves a large puddle of water in the bathroom toilet area.  This is clearly an ongoing issue as it looks like there is a very slight mold build up by the door jam.  Lastly, many days I did not have water bottles left in my room by the cleaning staff and the weather was 80+ degrees and humid.  

I am a avid and loyal Marriott customer, however, I will be avoiding the JW in Chicago on future trips.

reviews.author: Jguzman70
reviews.title: JW Marriott Chicago is a hotel exceptional, outstanding, and a high five-star experience.
reviews.body: As expected from a JW Marriott level property, this hotel was exceptionally clean and well-maintained. The entire staff was professional and highly attentive. Cara and Kyle at the front desk provided outstanding service at check-in and throughout my visit. The dinner service team at the first-floor lobby lounge was also fantastic and welcoming.As a paraplegic traveler who uses a wheelchair, I found Room 861 to be perfectly ADA compliant and a true handicap room. The bed and toilet were at the correct heights, and the roll-in shower was fantastic—the bathroom was easily the best part of the room!I highly recommend this property to other paraplegic travelers, especially guests with special needs who are confined to a wheelchair. I will definitely stay here again on my next visit to Chicago if the nightly rates reasonable.

reviews.author: LolitaRealtor10
reviews.title: Awesome Service
reviews.body:
My stay at the JW Marriott in Chicago was amazing! My room was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the staff was extremely friendly, helpful, and attentive throughout my stay.

Shortly after I arrived, the fire alarm in my room went off and continued for quite a while, even though there was no fire emergency. I believe the steam from the iron may have activated it. Since the alarm had been going off for more than 15 minutes, one of the managers came to my room to check on the situation and graciously offered me complimentary access to the Executive Lounge while they worked to get it resolved.

Unfortunately, I wasn't able to take advantage of the offer because I was in a hurry to meet some of my Sorors at the Obama Presidential Center! 😊 Another manager remained outside my room to make sure the alarm was completely turned off shortly afterward.

I truly appreciated the concern, attentiveness, and level of customer service they showed. What could have been a frustrating situation was handled with genuine care and professionalism. Overall, I had a wonderful stay and would definitely stay at the JW Marriott Chicago again!

reviews.author: Demo Chicago 2026
reviews.title: Life in chicago
reviews.body: Overall, the hotel was very nice the check-in they had some issues with the credit card machines. This is all understandable. The bar area lacked some ambience. It felt a little bit like a cafeteria, but yet drink prices are at a premium.

reviews.author: Dick
reviews.title: Dickie
reviews.body: Great hotel one of the best we have stayed in

reviews.author: BFitzgerald
reviews.title: Exceptional service made our celebration extra special
reviews.body:
The JW Marriott Chicago continues to be one of my favorite properties for celebrating special occasions. The hotel itself is beautiful, but what truly sets this property apart is the exceptional staff and the level of care they provide.

We recently stayed to celebrate my daughter’s Sweet 16, and Viviana, Melissa, and Alaina went above and beyond to make our visit memorable. From helping ensure our adjoining rooms and upgrade were taken care of to adding thoughtful touches to celebrate my daughter, their kindness and attention made her birthday feel incredibly special.

As a longtime Marriott Titanium member, I’ve stayed at many Marriott properties, and it’s experiences like this that keep me coming back to the JW Marriott Chicago. The team consistently finds a way to not only meet expectations, but exceed them.

Thank you to the entire JW team for another wonderful stay. We’re already looking forward to returning for our next special occasion in November!

reviews.author: Flo11
reviews.title: Staying at JW
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, my stay got off to a very disappointing start. Check-in was at 4:00 PM, but when I arrived, my room was not ready. There were several other guests also waiting for their rooms, and I overheard that they were being offered a $100 hotel credit for the inconvenience. No compensation was offered to me at that time.
Around 4:30 PM, I went back to the front desk to check on my room. I was told that I had been given an upgraded room, but when I went to the room, it was a double-bed room even though I had specifically booked a king-size bed. I had to return to the front desk and explain that this was not an upgrade and was not the room I reserved.
Only after I brought the issue to their attention did the front desk employee suddenly locate a king-size room for me. I ultimately did not get checked in until approximately 5:00 PM, an hour after the scheduled check-in time.
What made the situation even more frustrating was that when I mentioned that other guests had been offered a $100 credit for the delay, I was only offered a $50 credit.
Mistakes and delays can happen, but I expected better communication, honesty, and consistency in how guests were compensated for the same inconvenience. If guests are being offered compensation for a delayed check-in, it should be handled fairly and consistently.
Overall, the check-in experience was frustrating and did not make me feel valued as a guest. I hope management addresses how these situations are handled in the future.

reviews.author: Cptmorgemaker
reviews.title: Not Safe, Entrance and Pool filthy
reviews.body: My wife got to watch a possible drug deal but definitely drug use in the corner of the lobby early in the morning involving a valet guy allowing random drug users to come in and do meth or heroin was a great highlight to say the least. So safety is a joke. The pool was absolutely disgusting and filthy. The pool would turn Brown if anyone used the disability chairlifts with how Rusty and disgusting they were. Hair, dirt, filthy used towels and sitting water surrounded the pool. The front of the lobby entrance was covered with trash that they're going to say oh that's on the city to clean. If you wanted to be welcoming and nice you would have someone clean it up just so it looks more presenting. Room was ok but didnt matter at the fact of the rest of the hotel was a mess. Food and full alcohol bottles sat in the hallway from check in at 2pm till the next morning. You can walk to the second floor from the lobby and get on the elevators and it will register your in the hotel already so you dont need a card to go to any floor but if your on the main or spa floor you do need a card so i guess at least that was a failed attempt at presenting some saftey. Would not recommend for business or expecially family.

reviews.author: Aims4ScF
reviews.title: A great downtown hotel
reviews.body: This is a luxury hotel centrally located in downtown Chicago. The facilities are very clean and well kept. The staff is professional and courteous. A great value for the price.

reviews.author: Visitor
reviews.title: It was just okay.
reviews.body: The staff was fine but lacked the basic hospitality accommodations you’d expect from a 5 star hotel. I was visiting for an anniversary and shared this with the front desk prior to my visit and upon check-in to see if anything could be done to add to the room. I was told that something would be sent up and it never was. We also requested water replenishment several times and we’re still waiting until this day. Basic requests were ignored by staff and to my surprise we were charged almost $50+/day for a dest-fee. I will find somewhere with better accommodations and more transparent pricing in the future.

reviews.author: SM9411
reviews.title: Good but getting worse
reviews.body: Used to be a gem, not anymore

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Wonderful stay with Granddaughters
