reviews.body: Primary trip was to take granddaughters to American girl store via Amtrak from Mattoon to Chicago Chicago back to Mattoon. It was a very exciting trip. The hotel was magnificent and beautiful and the pool was really great. This will be a core memory for the granddaughters for their memory bank. We were there a total of 36 hours and we couldn’t have had a better experience.

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.title: Maybe I was expecting too much on JW Marriot
reviews.body: When I book a room from JW Marriot, I have somewhat higher expectation compared to other 4-star hotels. However, my last trip was quite disappointing. One of the lights was out, and worst of all, wif-fi did not work at all for two days among three nights of stay. The staff just repeated that nothing can be done. Glad I wasn't there for the conference.

reviews.author: Frequent traveler
reviews.title: Quietly Elegant
reviews.body:
This is my favorite place to stay when I travel to Chicago for work. It feels luxurious without being pretentious, and the staff is courteous and helpful without being too much.
I also feel very safe in the facility.

reviews.author: MidwestExec
reviews.title: Extremely disappointing stay
reviews.body: The room was filthy. The towels in my room were covered with hair that looked like beard trimmings. The hair was also on the sink, floor, tub and bed. I alerted and showed pictures of the mess to the housekeeping staff, front desk, concierge when I arrived at 6:45pm but they did not clean the room or remove towels until around 10:30pm. They refused to move me to a different room. If this is how they treat bonvoy platinum elite members I shudder to think how they treat the rest of their guests. I stay at JW and other Marriott hotels world wide and have never experienced such a disappointing stay before.

reviews.author: David E
reviews.title: Bad
reviews.body: The people in the room next door were unbearably loud from 9 pm until 3 am. They probably had ten people in the room. It was terrible. This was both nights of my stay.  There were no coffee cups in my room which made the coffee machine useless.  And when I asked for extended checkout they said NO.  Shocking since I am a platinum elite member who is guaranteed a late checkout.

reviews.author: FrustratedBonvoyTitanium
reviews.title: Great location poor customer service
reviews.body: No one cared about any requirements that I asked for prior to check in

reviews.author: Kaye25
reviews.title: Lack of communication
reviews.body: No communication regarding fixing the next room

reviews.author: Eessig1
reviews.title: Trip
reviews.body: The hotel was clean, the staff was friendly, and helpful.

reviews.author: Jade
reviews.title: Great hotel but terrible staff
reviews.body: Colin at the front desk was very rude, had a horrible attitude and should not be the front face of the hotel. Great hotel over all but the customer service is what is making this place not worth it.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great Place for a Conference
reviews.body: The hotel is centrally located in downtown Chicago.  Walking distance to many sites and restaurants.  The hotel is very lovely and served my needs.

reviews.author: Natasha Chapuma
reviews.title: It’s was phenomenal
reviews.body: I enjoyed my stay and would definitely love to come back again. The hotel is clean and the rooms are well organized.

reviews.author: FunTime In CHICAGO
reviews.title: Family Vacations
reviews.body: Chicago is a busy city. I enjoyed every moment.

reviews.author: Winner
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Great time! Love the location, made everything very walkable and so close to the river!

reviews.author: Marshtravel
reviews.title: IMTS travel
reviews.body: Very average, received a room upgrade to a dated room with no hot water.

reviews.author: klmwc
reviews.title: From 9/12 - 9/16/2026 - Great Vacation because of our hotel
reviews.body: From the moment the hotel's guest services and housekeeping replied that they could create an allergy-free room to when they actually did to the awesome pillows and bedding to great food to awesome staff, this hotel delivered an amazing experience for us.

reviews.author: JFerris571
reviews.title: Labor Day
reviews.body: John concierge helped get my daughter an upgrade as she was getting engaged. Room view was amazing, room itself fantastic and staff was excellent. Very impressed!

reviews.author: Charles Venanzi
reviews.title: Great location to enjoy the Coty
reviews.body: If you are looking for a Hotel that has it all this is it to see Chicago. Sits right on the rive, next to the Riverwalk and close proximity to the lake and most attractions. Also, this hotel makes travel to and from Midway airport a great cheap adventure (11 stops on the Orange loop) just 2 short blocks away. No need for an expensive lyft or Uber ride.

reviews.author: Venita
reviews.title: Marriott - Riverwalk
reviews.body:
⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great Location & Beautiful Hotel, But Room Could Use Some Updating

I had a nice stay at the Renaissance Downtown Chicago Hotel. The location is excellent—perfectly situated right along the Riverwalk and incredibly convenient for enjoying all of the downtown amenities, restaurants, attractions, and activities. The hotel lobby is beautiful, with a nice bar and dining area, as well as several cozy nooks and seating areas throughout the property that are perfect for relaxing, working, or taking pictures. I also appreciated the charging stations and workstation areas. The check-in process was seamless and delightful, and the overall atmosphere of the hotel was very welcoming.

The room, however, was pretty basic for the price. The furniture felt a little dated, and there was a constant running water sound coming from the bathroom that was noticeable during my stay. I also noticed a somewhat sloppy touch-up paint job on the bathroom door. These things didn’t ruin my experience, but they definitely kept the room from feeling as polished or luxurious as I expected.

I imagine upgrading to a different room or suite may provide a more elevated experience. Overall, the room was decent, but the location, amenities, beautiful common areas, and convenience of being right in downtown Chicago helped make the stay worthwhile. I enjoyed my visit and would consider staying here again, particularly because of the fantastic location.

reviews.author: Walk 11
reviews.title: Great conference stay and convenient location
reviews.body: Really liked this location. It was clean and the staff were excellent. Could not be more satisfied.

reviews.author: Chicagone
reviews.title: Arriving in Chicago
reviews.body: Excellent location! However, noise cancelling thru windows could be better.

reviews.author: Jay John
reviews.title: Prefect Location
reviews.body: Excellent location, professional and knowledgeable staff. Eager to make recommendations for diner and how-to navigate the area

reviews.author: Emily S
reviews.title: Still waiting for info about a charge, but otherwise a lovely place.
reviews.body: I  had a great time here and followed the instructions for what was covered by the daily destination fee, but incurred a small extra charge anyway.  I've asked about it but it's really hard to get in touch with a person. Waiting for a reply.

reviews.author: Molly C
reviews.title: First time Chicago Stay
reviews.body: This was a wonderful place to stay for the first time visiting downtown Chicago!

reviews.author: KDM1103
reviews.title: Disappointed elite member
reviews.body: Very poor service, messy/dirty hotel, small outdated rooms, rude staff and extremely overpriced.

reviews.author: Tina C
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.body: Amazing hotel with great staff. Location was perfect!

reviews.author: RJ27
reviews.title: Gross, musty rooms
reviews.body: Musty rooms that have unreliable A/C. Very terribly disappointed at the quality of this hotel. I booked because of a work conference being held there, wherein there was a room-block discount. I have been to older hotel that have very dated design and carpeting but they were still clean and did not smell like someone tried to cut corners and just air dry carpets that have significant moisture damage. I would avoid this place if I had allergic rhinitis, asthma or other chronic respiratory condition. I booked a different hotel after the first night because the Renaissance Chicago Downtown was just intolerable.

reviews.author: Manuel
reviews.title: Fantastic location
reviews.body:
The location was fantastic, with an incredible view from our room; it was ideal for exploring the city and right by the river. The staff were very attentive and friendly.

The rooms were a good size and very clean. All the staff were very friendly. The pool area was okay...
It is in need of some renovation.

reviews.author: Checck23
reviews.title: Minimally Acceptable
reviews.body:
The room was ok.  Beautiful view of rooftops of immediately adjacent buildings.  Very small room. 
As always, my travel router would not connect to Marriott’s unencrypted, security issue laden Wi-Fi - had to use our data plan. 
The room had NO desk!  No place to work!  Even the lowest end properties have a desk or table. Our room had neither. 
Next time we will stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: KelseaMT
reviews.title: Great, downtown RiverWalk area stay
reviews.body: We had a wonderful long weekend here. The hotel was in a great area. It is near the loop (train) and our room was quite noisy. I mentioned it (didn't ask to move) but was shown another room that was much quieter and we ended up switching. We didn't want to be a pest and ask but we were so grateful they (Aidan!) took the initiative to help us and it was so nice. The barman was surprisingly unfriendly and the prices were crazy high (think Vegas) so be aware of that if it eat there. The hotel location so great though that you can find a lot of great restaurants nearby. There is also a Starbucks if you go do the stairs to the breezeway. Overall we loved our stay and would choose this hotel again.

reviews.author: Memi63
reviews.title: Eccellente Stay
reviews.body: Good position Good Service

reviews.author: SFtransplant
reviews.title: old and dated
reviews.body: rooms are heavily dated and needs proper refresh.

reviews.author: K2008
reviews.title: Mother Daughter Bday Weekend
reviews.body: We checked in and the front t desk helped us with tickets that needed to get printed off before a show. It was my birthday and they went the extra mile to make it feel special! The room was clean and comfortable. And the pool was great! Although a little chilly…but it was a humid day so it was pretty refreshing!

reviews.author: Titanium Elite member
reviews.title: Great mix of business and leisure weekend.
reviews.body: Quick three-day weekend.  Service, location and property worked perfectly.  Front desk and lobby bar staff could not have been friendlier.  Added bonus to be VERY close to the Chicago Riverwalk area.

reviews.author: Caroline
reviews.title: Don't Stay
reviews.body: Don't waste your night and stay here. The lounge is closed on the weekends and no accomodation or replacement is offered. The resort fee is a joke and not honored automatically. You have to go out of your way to try to use it. The bar staff at the bar are slow and rude. They will only come to you if you tip them. The food at the kitchen is good, but takes forever to get brought out if dining in the seating area. If there is any function in the hotel expect everything to be shut down. The 'rooftop' on the third floor was closed during our stay. There is no appreciation for being a status member. I was told we were upgraded but were in the same room I booked, no upgrade was given. Our room still had trash in it on arrival and food in the fridge. The bathroom is old and not kept up.

reviews.author: WorkTraveller42
reviews.title: Disappointing lodging at a very high price
reviews.body: While the location of this hotel is excellent, and the lobby gives a wonderful first impression, the room was dated, unclean in some ways, impractical for work, and not especially comfortable. The sound of slamming doors was also an issue on my floor. For the price my employer paid, I was disappointed in my experience. I will likely choose alternate lodging next time.

reviews.author: Benderson
reviews.title: Publishing details
reviews.body:
I liked that the food was great. I had a nice stay. The room was great. It was clean. The elevators were clean. I had great service.  
It's very close to the Clark and Lake train station, which is good. You can walk to Michigan avenue. That is good too. You can see the river if you're on the far side of the hotel. You can walk to the picasso statue. You can walk to Stan's Donuts. The smiling fountains are right around the corner, near the bean.

reviews.author: Roy III
reviews.title: Great visit to Chicago
reviews.body: Outstanding room and great location.  Staff were very helpful and professional

reviews.author: JRS1
reviews.title: Weekend Vacation
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location with a nice lobby and bar area, as well as third floor roof bar. The staff were very friendly and generally the service was very good. However, the hotel rooms and corridors were tired. dated and dirty with old outdated furnishings and dark, musty smelling rooms. I would definitely look for a hotel with more modern rooms.

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.title: Great location but poor value and rundown. Breakfast benefit is sub-par
reviews.body:
I paid an average of more than $600 per night for a 3 night stay at this hotel and I would not stay again. The location is great, the gym is decent and the staff are very friendly but that's where the positives end.

The rooms are dated and have a mouldy/humid smell. There is breakfast in the lounge on weekdays but the food quality and selection was worse than many courtyards I've stayed at - worse still they pack it all up at 9am. There was only enough seating for half of the guests that were actually there trying to eat. If you stay over the weekend when the lounge is closed then you're given vouchers for a "continental breakfast" which you pick up from Staytion Market - it was ok but not enough food. We ended up paying for breakfast at the restaurant which was significantly better but they charge $6 for not so great coffee. The final insult is the daily $30 destination fee, of which the only real value is a $15 food and beverage credit. The rest of the inclusions are nonsense designed to try and justify the destination fee which is straight up profit for the hotel. They do not have to pay commission, Bonvoy points or Marriott qualified spend on these fees.

reviews.author: CT718
reviews.title: Fine hotel but nothing special
reviews.body: This hotel appears to have a great view but unless you ask for a river view room you will be looking at the CTA out back. The rooms aren't anything special and I wouldn't make a point of coming to the Staytion restaurant if I wasn't staying here.

reviews.author: Chicago Trip
reviews.title: Chicago travel
reviews.body: Room was not clean...The floor needed to be mopped.

reviews.author: Mz H
reviews.title: Mz H
reviews.body: Hitel very clean, comfortable except fir broken television and blackout curtains in room would not close entirely allowing neon signs from across the street allowing disturbing lights in room during night.

reviews.author: Happy guest
reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.body: We love the LaSalle. The team and rooms are amazing.

reviews.author: A leisure traveler
reviews.title: Did not meet expectations
reviews.body: Really nicely finished and furnished. The bed comfort was disappointing and had quite a bit of noise from other rooms. Very few outlets in the room, in particular none within range of the desk.

reviews.author: VA to Chi Town
reviews.title: Not 5 Star Service
reviews.body: Two out of three nights the housekeeping cabinet was stationed at my door, dirty used cups were placed back in the beverage area as if they were new, the toliet made a loud noise after ever flush (housekeeping must not had cleaned the area bc it was not fixed), (room 1831) I had two rooms, two reservations, two seperate credit cards at check in but one credit card charged both rooms and although hotel was contacted no one has been able to resolve the issue.

reviews.author: John P
reviews.title: Very Rude Service
reviews.body: Very rude staff. Will not be staying here again.

reviews.author: review
reviews.title: wonderful stay
reviews.body: would recommend to all my friends and family.  top class

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.title: Beautiful, Clean, Quiet, Attentive
reviews.body: The rooms are beautiful, clean and peaceful. A lovely space to return from the day. In-Room Dining from Grille on 21 is consistently fabulous. The hotel's staff is extremely professional, attentive and genuinely kind. I'm looking forward to my next stay here! I Love Chicago.

reviews.author: Melissa M
reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing — Not Worth the Premium Price
reviews.body:
We stayed in a Corner Executive Suite and, unfortunately, the experience was nowhere near what you would expect from an “Executive Suite” or from a hotel charging this level of pricing.

The room was visibly worn, dirty, and stained in multiple areas. The pull-out sofa bed, which we needed for our stay, was not clean and did not appear to have been properly prepared for a guest. At this price point, basic cleanliness should never be something a guest has to question.

The room also could not maintain a consistent temperature, which made it uncomfortable throughout our stay. Between the stained and tired condition of the room, cleanliness concerns, and temperature issues, this certainly did not feel like a premium accommodation.

What made the situation worse was the customer service. Rather than feeling that our concerns were taken seriously and that someone wanted to make the situation right, the service was dismissive and disappointing. When a hotel charges a premium rate, the expectation is not perfection—but guests should absolutely expect a clean room, functioning amenities, and responsive customer service when there is a problem.

We paid a significant amount for a Corner Executive Suite and received a room that looked worn, stained, and poorly maintained, along with service that did little to improve the experience.

The value simply was not there. Calling this an Executive Suite creates an expectation of an elevated experience, and our stay was anything but that. Based on the condition of the room, lack of cleanliness, inability to maintain a comfortable temperature, and poor customer service, I would not recommend paying the premium for this room category.

Management should seriously evaluate both the condition of these rooms and how guest concerns are being handled. For the amount we paid, this experience was unacceptable.

reviews.author: Emma
reviews.title: Generator Noise Issues
reviews.body: Most of the rooms on the 19th floor have generator have noise issues. Some of them even have trains pass through. If you are sensitive to noise, I'd suggest book another hotel. The neighborhood safety is also a concern, I think. Maybe north river would be safer.

reviews.author: LynnA
reviews.title: My favorite hotel
reviews.body: This is a gorgeous hotel. The food and drinks at Grill 21 are sublime.

reviews.author: CL111
reviews.title: Not worth the pricing
reviews.body: So many options in Chicago. Don’t overpay for a hotel where you don’t feel wanted

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Adult objects found in drawer
reviews.body: Everything was great, however on day two of our stay I opened a drawer to stow some items, upon opening I found used adult products.

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.title: Average Hotel - Not 5 Star
reviews.body: For the price, I would not place in the 5 Star category. Room was missing key amenities, hallways were not kept clean from room service items for days, and the age of building was heard through every pipe in the rooms.

reviews.author: M1460ky
reviews.title: Stanley was the best!
reviews.body: Outstanding employee of the hotel was so helpful, kind and inviting!

reviews.author: LCooke
reviews.title: New Favorite Chicago Hotel
reviews.body: Small hotel with all rooms on high floors. Beautiful decor. Excellent bathroom. Very clean and fun lobby bar.

reviews.author: Roy 1
reviews.title: Chicago visit
reviews.body: Concierge service was very helpful with dining options and experiences for first time visitors. Robert went above and beyond in this area of his expertise.

reviews.author: Nashville Native
reviews.title: Excellent Stay - high qualify hotel with excellent service
reviews.body: I come into town for work and recently discovered this hotel. I was so impressed and it will be my new "spot". The bar and restaurant are beautiful with great service. My hotel was on the 19th floor with a nice view, clean, and well stocked (amazing that I didn't have to call down for a steamer because there was already one in the room). The turndown service pulled my curtains, left fresh water bottles and chocolate - the room ready for sleep upon my return from a long conference day. This was one of the few times that I was on a higher floor and still got great shower pressure and didn't have to wait forever for hot water - it was immediate. I loved the decor of the hotel - it felt very high end but also so warm and inviting.

reviews.author: Couple from Charlotte
reviews.title: Not a luxury experience
reviews.body: No luggage carrots, no bellman(and we had large , heavy bags) poor welcome, luxury linens promised were average at best , even had a king pillow in a queen case, rough towels that smelled unpleasant, a slow drain that we had to request to be fixed, very little storage and no luggage racks . Not a luxury experience.

reviews.author: Hibida
reviews.title: Great stay in Chicago
reviews.body: We had a wonderful overnight stay at the LaSalle. Wish we had stayed longer. Rooms were very comfortable, a great shower and bathroom. Staff was friendly and helpful. Hotel is beautiful. We also had an amazing breakfast in Grill 21. Definitely my new favorite to stay in Chicago.

reviews.author: Titanium Elite
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.body: Standard rooms are very small with no exterior view. No upgrade was offered or given for Titanium Elite. Cell service was very spotty in room and not adequate for working. No executive lounge, standard breakfast credit was small and for one guest only.

reviews.author: Hector
reviews.title: Beautiful Experience
reviews.body: Did not expect to receive this level of service in this beautiful hotel. I look forward to the opportunity to return!

reviews.author: Love Chicago
reviews.title: Relaxing low/key stay
reviews.body: Outstanding stay my go to place in Chicago

reviews.author: Britt J
reviews.title: My stay at the Lasalle
reviews.body:
Overall, we had a great stay. The hotel was clean, beautiful, and had a great aesthetic. The staff was friendly, welcoming, and made us feel well taken care of. We also appreciated the complimentary room upgrade—it made our stay even more enjoyable.

The only disappointment was that our minibar was not stocked, even though there was a list of available items in the room. It would also be nice if the hotel offered birthday celebration packages or special birthday amenities for guests celebrating a special occasion.

I also noticed that the complimentary car service is no longer available, which was a nice perk in the past. Despite those minor issues, we had a wonderful experience and would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: ba123
reviews.title: Birthday Stay
reviews.body: Great Service, Delicious Food, loved the stay!

reviews.author: EnS IL
reviews.title: Three Wonderful Days We’ll Never Forget—Thank You, Garren!
reviews.body:
My husband and I just spent three wonderful days here, and we left wishing we could have stayed even longer. Everything about our visit made us feel relaxed and welcomed. The hotel was beautiful, comfortable, and spotless, and we loved starting our mornings in the workout room before enjoying the rest of our day.

The food was absolutely delicious, and every drink we had was fantastic. But what truly made our stay so special was the incredible service we received from Garren. He wasn't just an amazing bartender—he became one of the highlights of our trip. Garren has such a warm, genuine personality that makes everyone feel at home. He remembered us, took the time to chat with us, made wonderful recommendations, and always had a smile on his face. It's rare to meet someone who loves what they do as much as he clearly does, and it made a lasting impression on both of us.

We also had the pleasure of being served by Becca, who was so sweet, friendly, and welcoming. She was wonderful, and we truly appreciated her kindness.

To everyone at the hotel, thank you for making our getaway so memorable. We came for a relaxing vacation and left with great memories and already talking about when we can come back. And to Garren—thank you for making our evenings so much fun. You are a true asset to this hotel!

reviews.author: Cassandra Berry
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body:
I've made it my mission to find my favorite hotel in Chicago since I visit at least twice a year, and after this stay, LaSalle has definitely earned a spot near the top of my list.

I've stayed at several of Chicago's luxury hotels, many through American Express Fine Hotels + Resorts, so I've experienced some incredible properties. While no hotel stay is ever perfect, what truly sets LaSalle apart is its customer service.

I stayed in the Corner Suite, and for me, that's the room to book. It was spacious, comfortable, and made the stay feel much more luxurious.

I did have a few concerns during my visit, but what impressed me most was how quickly and genuinely the staff addressed every issue. They listened, cared, and made sure I left satisfied. Out of all the luxury hotels I've stayed at in Chicago, LaSalle has provided the best customer service I've experienced.

Another highlight was the upstairs Bar, Lounge & Grill. My family and I spent a lot of time there, and there were about 15 of us, including babies and young children. The food was delicious, the drinks were excellent, and the atmosphere was perfect for our group.

I especially want to recognize the bartender/server who took care of us. I didn't catch his name, but he was a tall Black gentleman who appeared to be in his 30s. He was outstanding. Managing a large family with little ones isn't easy, but he handled everything with incredible patience, professionalism, and a smile. Whether it was babies crying, kids changing their minds, or adults placing multiple orders, he never seemed frustrated or rushed. He made every one of us feel welcome and taken care of.

Great hotels have beautiful rooms, but exceptional people create unforgettable experiences. The staff at LaSalle did exactly that.

I'm still searching for my forever Chicago hotel, so the jury is still out, but one thing is certain: LaSalle has set the standard for customer service. I'll absolutely be back, and I hope management recognizes the team members who made our stay so memorable.

reviews.author: Second time Chicago
reviews.title: La Salle has the bones of a strong Autograph property, but it feels like it has been sanded down.
reviews.body:
La Salle is a very comfortable hotel with good bones: calm rooms, a strong Loop/financial district location, and enough historic Chicago character to feel like it could be a really distinctive property.

The service was professional and the stay itself was easy. The rooms are polished, quiet, and business-friendly, and the building has real potential as an Autograph Collection hotel.

Where it falls a little short is personality. Autograph properties should feel memorable and locally rooted, not just well-finished. The Grill was the biggest example. On a previous visit, it felt genuinely special — foie gras, escargot, demi Champagne by the glass, and a proper old-school Chicago indulgence to it. This time, it felt much flatter and safer: more salad, burger, eggs, and generic hotel-restaurant basics. Nothing was necessarily bad, but it had lost some of the charm and appetite that made it stand out.

Overall, La Salle is a good hotel and I would stay again, especially for the location and rooms. But it feels like a more interesting version of the property has been softened. With a stronger food and beverage identity, a sharper bar/restaurant concept, and more local texture, it could be excellent rather than just solid.

reviews.author: Isabella43
reviews.title: Romantic Extended Weekend
reviews.body: The property and all the accommodations were gorgeous, but the staff made the stay with how kind and accommodating everyone was. It was clearly a very busy weekend, but everyone still took time to answer questions and help with anything we needed. I let the front desk know that the shower drain was very slow and I had a light burnt out in my room and it was all fixed when we got back a few hours later! I booked completely with Marriott points which only allowed me to choose the most basic room but I was upgraded at check in. While I don’t typically stay in luxury hotels so I can’t compare to many other places but I would recommend this site from my experience. It was worth the splurge. And the robes were so soft, I wish I could buy one.

reviews.author: Vintage traveler
reviews.title: Vintage hotel, unautographed
reviews.body: Autograph hotel vintage translates to Old and obsolete no matter how much you renovate your bathroom. There are dusts so clean the room means clean the room, not refill the towels only. And displaying beverages at mile high prices tells your customers 'don't touch them, they are not for  you". Come on.

reviews.author: ML from East Coast
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel Once You Arrive on the 21st Floor But Ground Floor/Lobby Staff Were Decidedly Underwhelming
reviews.body:
A beautiful hotel once you arrive on the 21st floor for check-in, but the level of service in other areas fell short of the mark.  Frankly, it was shocking.  First, when I arrived, I arrived with my sister and niece - and we each had 2 bags of luggage (one small and one large), plus I had my daughter's luggage and her tote bag - who was graduating from Northwestern University this weekend.  There were no valets in sight when we alighted from our Uber.  We managed to struggle to roll our luggage to the front entrance, despite the weight of it all. While looking for a valet through the glass front, I could see a valet at the valet stand who immediately disappeared behind a door and so was of no assistance to us.  There were no other persons in the lobby or outside the hotel with luggage requiring assistance other than me and my guests.  After awkwardly managing to get all of our bags through the revolving door, we noticed a desk at the far end of the lobby at which sat a gentleman who greeted us, in a rather friendly manner, only AFTER we approached him to inquire about the location of check in.  It was as if he did not see or notice us until we were practically upon him.  He offered to have someone bring our luggage to our room - but by that point, we were fairly irritated and had already done the hard work.   When we made our way to the elevators, we had no idea how the elevators worked - so he directed us to the proper one, pressed the correct button, made sure we were in the elevator and explained that it would take us to the 21st floor.  I am sure that much of our experience was captured on your hotel's lobby cameras on June 13 (~5:30 - 5:45 p.m.). Check-in on the 21st floor was cordial and flawless, and the front desk staff apologized for our experience in the lobby.  The young woman advised that she would be notifying management of what had occurred, which was done, as I did receive an email from a manager inquiring about my experience, to which I responded but received no reply in return.

Trying to manage heavy luggage on our own from curbside, through heavy revolving doors (that were not automatic) was not without consequence.  My sister broke her nail and both of us, being near and over sixty, experienced back discomfort and soreness that made sleeping in an otherwise delightful room difficult on our first night.  You should also be aware that, after we checked into our hotel and headed out for dinner, we noticed the same gentleman who first greeted us in the lobby, seemingly asleep behind the desk at which he sat - chin to chest.  I believe that the hotel could use a few extra bellmen/valets to be a truly 5 star experience.  Guests should not have to break out into a sweat, suffer damaged fingernails or strain their backs just to check into a hotel.  I have just never had such an experience before from an establishment that is described as being a near 5 star property.

Aside from the above, the only other glitch I encountered was breakfast on the second morning of our stay.  My niece and I ordered entrees and I specifically asked for eggs over medium and emphasized that I did not like my eggs runny.  I received runny eggs with my entree that were cold upon arrival.   My niece waited 15 minutes for the toast that was supposed to arrive with her over-easy eggs and by the time it arrived, her eggs were cold.  When we complained about this, an apology of sorts was offered - with our waiter explaining that we had arrived near the close of breakfast and that staff were focused on cleaning up and not preparing food.  In other words, the quality of our breakfast was due to the time we chose to eat and were seated by your staff for breakfast.  In the future, however, if your guests cannot expect to receive a meal that is served hot and as requested, solely because it is too close to the end of the breakfast hour, then perhaps you should not seat any guests for breakfast who arrive less than 30 minutes from the close of breakfast?  The waiter offered to comp my order to address the food quality issue, but did nothing about the toast that was served late to my niece, as she was reluctant to offer a complaint about her entree, given her age.

Beyond what is described above, however, the hotel is a lovely property (rooms and 21st floor common areas), and the staff are friendly and welcoming.  Our room was quiet, the beds were comfortable and everything was spotlessly clean.

reviews.author: Darlene D
reviews.title: What a Treat
reviews.body: Beautiful and classy  hotel from the lobby to the reception floor to rooms. We were treated so graciously by all of the staff from the front desk to the restaurant and bar and everyone in between. Can not wait to come back as this will be my new must stay location when in Chicago.

reviews.author: Leanne
reviews.title: Yay for the Westin!
reviews.body: Loved this hotel. Exceeded expectations. Location is SO central and very close to the CTA train to the airport. Staff are all super friendly. Felt very safe in this hotel solo. Also very happy with level of cleanliness

reviews.author: DanF
reviews.title: DanF
reviews.body: Excellent Service and Cleanliness, Great Casual atmosphere

reviews.author: Paula
reviews.title: Average stay
reviews.body: Rooms were spacious but bathroom’s faucet leaked and dripped and room service food was just average.

reviews.author: Karenl
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Wonderful stay as usual. Within footsteps of our daughter’s condo on Wacker. Always look forward to our stay there

reviews.author: Virginiakim
reviews.title: Exceptional Stay with Elegant Service
reviews.body: I had a truly wonderful stay at The Westin Chicago River North. The comfortable accommodations and elegant, highly professional service were very impressive. I would happily stay here again on my next visit.

reviews.author: K Snow
reviews.title: Location Location Location
reviews.body: Walking distance to everything.  Helpful staff clean rooms with the best bedding in the hotel industry.

reviews.author: NF Bailey
reviews.title: Great hotel for touring Chicago
reviews.body: The Westin is a great choice for downtown Chicago. It’s close to so many sites, and easy to navigate Ubers, trains and buses right outside the door. Spacious inviting lobby restaurant and bar, clean rooms and wonderful service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: S Tucker
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.body: Poor check-in service and cleaning service

reviews.author: Evan
reviews.title: Watch for poorly timed construction on the resort.
reviews.body: Excellent location, getting the river view rooms is a must!  On the plus side, the staff was remarkable. Charles the doorman was tremendous, this guy puts the W in Westin.  The front desk staff were super friendly as well, Destiny made us feel very welcomed.         On the negative side, why oh why would you be doing construction on your amazing outdoor waterfront patio area during the peak busy season! And then compound that by closing your gym for remodeling. Such poor planning.

reviews.author: BABS in NOLA
reviews.title: BABS in NOLA
reviews.body: This hotel has a fantastic location.  We could walk anywhere we wanted to go, and we felt safe.  I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone!!!

reviews.author: UK Visitor
reviews.title: Fine stay for a business conference until the bathroom door cut my finger open
reviews.body:
In short - stay was fine, food and service was good, inline with other Marriott locations I've been to. 

The bathroom fitting around the door handle cut open my finger on my last day. I was surprised how deep the cut was. Lots of bleeding which was unnerving.

Staff gave me a bandaid and an antiseptic wipe. 4 days since, it's healing fine and didn't require any medical attention but the fitting needs to be revised..I stayed in room 1510.

reviews.author: mslamb
reviews.title: Location was excellent!
reviews.body: The Westin River North was a perfect spot to explore downtown Chicago. The staff was helpful. The room was well appointed and the bed was outstanding. We will come back again!

reviews.author: Elise
reviews.title: Very relaxing stay
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful stay at this hotel! The room was exceptionally clean, well-kept, and comfortable, and the bed was incredibly comfortable. We also had a beautiful view of the river, which made the stay even more enjoyable.

I especially appreciated the thoughtful complimentary touches, including the lavender essential oil roller and the robe. The lavender roller was such a relaxing touch, and I loved being able to use the robe during my stay. It’s those little details that made the experience feel extra special.

reviews.author: Visiting from Buffalo NY
reviews.title: Great location!!
reviews.body: Perfect location. No ride share needed. Walked to architectural boat rides and many wonderful restaurants. Came in late and they brought us up a microwave! Beautiful rooms. VERY COMFORTABLE BED. Very reasonable rates.

reviews.author: Friendly
reviews.title: Friendliest employee ever
reviews.body: Just amazing . The management is doig a great job of training and hiring the right people

reviews.author: Ms S
reviews.title: My Relaxation Retreat
reviews.body: I was very comfortable. I had absolutely no issues with anything when I did ask for any help or questions.

reviews.author: Lazae
reviews.title: Hotel
reviews.body: Excellent hotel, on a very good location, river is near, Tha Mart is near , metro is near and Michigan avenue was only 15 min of walk

reviews.author: T Bench
reviews.title: Wedding weekend
reviews.body: Stayed here for Grandson’s wedding and everything was excellent

reviews.author: ORTIZ
reviews.title: Best option to stay in Chicago Downtown
reviews.body: Great location next to the river with excellent views and restaurants around the hotel. One of the best options to stay in Chicago downtown

reviews.author: ChicagoMOG
reviews.title: Wonderful stay at the Westin
reviews.body: We had a wonderful stay at the Westin River North.  They could not be any more accommodating to us, even when we inadvertently booked the wrong Westin.  They helped us remedy the situation with ease and allowed us to enjoy our wedding weekend thoroughly!  Special Shout out to front desk associate, Medede.  He is the best!! This will be my go to hotel on return visits to Chicago!

reviews.author: K Haruta
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: It’s the people that work at The Westin River North that make the stay comfortable. In my opinion attitude is everything and everyone I met had a great attitude. The hotel is clean and is in a great location.

reviews.author: PConk
reviews.title: Great stay in Chicago
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay here at the Westin. It was easy to get to, clean, welcoming, and had everything we needed from a hotel. I especially liked that all the staff were so incredibly welcoming, but my favorite part was the bed. It was by far the best bed I have ever slept on in a hotel. I felt comfortable and well rested for our days of touring the city.

reviews.author: TSmith
reviews.title: Perfect place
reviews.body: The staff was friendly. The room was impeccable. The bed is super comfortable, and the location is just right for enjoying Chicago. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Molly W
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.body: We will be staying here annually! Great location, spacious, phenomenal views, incredible staff (thank you Glinda (front desk) and bellman Keith (so awesome) and James (great help!). We loved everything about our stay!

reviews.author: The traveler
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.body: Coming to a different state can be confusing and scary and frustrating but the Westin at Chicago river north made sure my stay was smooth sailing from beginning to end they accommodate me with everything. They made sure that I was put in a system as a late arrival upon arrival they were very friendly and outgoing very welcoming compared to other places I have stayed prices was very reasonable. Room was very clean room service was outstanding. If I’m going to stay at this place and spend my money, this will be a top-tier for me. Thank you to the West End Chicago River North, and all the manager and staff that accommodated me and my family.

reviews.author: Robert C
reviews.title: Great stay but dated.
reviews.body: Lived up to expectation for a Westin but rooms are somewhat dated. Glass shelves in bathroom had dust on them.

reviews.author: ACROC
reviews.title: Westin River North
reviews.body: Excellent except for a bit too much fragrance in the air

reviews.author: Unhappy wedding guest
reviews.title: Ask how often they clean before you stay
reviews.body: Room was not completely cleaned when we fist arrived. Room was not cleaned the next day either.

reviews.author: LynnMB
reviews.title: Great service and facilities.
reviews.body: All around great stay. Helpful and friendly staff.

reviews.author: July wedding event
reviews.title: Westin Chicago River North
reviews.body: Great location, near the river.  Resort fee is a rip off.  $15 credit, not even valid for the Marketplace.  Good for room service and the restaurant in the lobby.  The fee also included visits to sites that are honestly not interesting.

reviews.author: Janet
reviews.title: Okay, but for the price not really!
reviews.body: It's okay, but maybe will not consider staying there anymore

reviews.author: Madi
reviews.title: Great weekend getaway
reviews.body: The entire staff made me feel welcome and provided many of the Marriott status perks such as free wifi and extra water without being asked. Rooms were very clean, comfortable, and cold (a must for summertime)!

reviews.title: Review
reviews.body: Staff friendly, great location, clean

reviews.author: Platinum Traveler
reviews.title: Cumplaints about the curtains
reviews.body: "Human Enthusiam" on the curtains. Additionally, thin and ratty towels and sheets, peeling wallpaper, cracking tiles, empty soap containers and a filthy shower rod. I have the pictures to prove it. The staff was polite. Lousy for the price.

reviews.author: Meg D
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel in downtown
reviews.body: My stay at the Hotel Chicago Downtown Autograph Collection was awesome! The location is great and it’s close to tons of restaurants and shops. It’s also within walking distance to train stations and bus stops. Linda and Ed were wonderful during my stay and made everything more enjoyable.

reviews.author: teamMajors
reviews.title: Friendly, welcoming staff... A1
reviews.body: The staff was very welcoming and accommodated us during our stay. I was traveling with an elderly parent and they made sure our stay was comfortable.

reviews.author: AmberM
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.body: If you are new to Chicago and want to stay somewhere near the River Walk and do many other shops, restaurants, etc, this is the place to book.

reviews.author: Lauri Stamps
reviews.title: Best Stay Ever
reviews.body: The place was fantastic. The art on the wall was beautiful. The staff was amazing. The Doorman deserves a raise. Overall, it’s a place that I will come back to for sure.

reviews.author: KAREN FROM HOUSTON
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.body: The hotel was professional, accommodating and attentive.  Great location and I would recommend to everyone looking for lodging in Chicago. We will be back!!!

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Great place for a small conference downtown
reviews.body: Was here for two days for a work conference. The meeting spaces were bright and tech-friendly. The hotel itself is a nice ode to when it was originally built, but it was modern and clean. The rooms are clean and comfortable, as well. Good beds and pillows. Great location. Good food. Very good service from all of the employees I came across. Overall, it was a great stay, and I'd absolutely stay here again. My one rub with it was that there was a valet parking stand in front of the hotel, but no valet employees staffing it. Nor is there any communication that it's not staffed. So, I sat out front in my car for 10 minutes waiting for a valet parker that didn't exist. (I know, first world problems.) I finally went in to the front desk and left my car sitting there. The woman who checked me in took my key, gave me a receipt, and had someone come get my car. So, all was well that ended well, but a little better communication would have avoided my confusion.

reviews.author: Too expensive
reviews.title: Expect extra charges and high cost for simple bar items.
reviews.body: Nickeled and dined to death.

reviews.author: Follow through
reviews.title: Follow through
reviews.body: Asking for a Bonvoy member 2p checkout when I checked in, I was told “yes.”  Returned to room on checkout day with two kids who had to pee and we were locked out at 1245. Staff unapologetic and unhelpful in the moment. Lack of follow through left final poor impression.

reviews.author: Businesstraveler
reviews.title: Old building in a good location
reviews.body: Walked into my room at 9pm. It was pitch black. Curtains drawn, tv off, and the light switch by the door was just a cover. No switch. I used my phone flashlight to find the tiny little switches on each lamp. Very annoying after a long day of travel. Went into the bathroom with my toiletry bag to find a pedestal sink. It’s cute. Quaint. But not functional at all. Then the shower curtain rod was too large of a diameter for the shower curtain hooks so it didn’t slide properly. Bed was fine, nightstand was small with a 2 outlet power strip and a rj45 telephone jack.  Fitness center was TERRIBLE. Small, one bench, 6 treadmills/ellipticals, and  a cable machine. So small 2 or 3 people felt like max. Not to mention it’s downstairs in the dungeon. Hotel location was great though!

reviews.author: LauraS
reviews.title: Hotel Chicago hits the Mark
reviews.body: We recently had a one night stay at The Hotel Chicago and were pleasantly surprised at the great service and lovely room.  Sammi at check-in was so nice and made sure we got a room with a wonderful view of the river.  She explained the amenities and gave us a coupon for drinks at the bar. I’ve seen people complain about the $25 destination fee but honestly it’s downtown Chicago! We were able to use it to get a cocktail at the bar and there were tix for a museum and ping pong which we couldn’t use but would make the fee a bargain if we were tourists. We had a great staycation, and the location is right next door to the house of blues, where we were seeing a concert so super convenient!  I highly recommend this hotel in the heart of Chicago!  Staff was very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: GPGP
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.body: I had an exceptional stay at this location. I was there for 2 nights for meetings. The location is great, breakfast at Yolk and dinner at Tortoise Supper Club were fantastic, and the staff were incredibly nice. It’s the perfect location for people with allergies, since the whole hotel is pet-free and feather-free. I will definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago.

reviews.author: AW04
reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.body: We came to Chicago specifically for a House of Blues show and it couldn’t have been more convenient to the venue. But it was conveniently located to so much else - we walked to river walk/water taxis, walked to Navi pier and mag Mile and lots of dining options nearby. Upscale retreat in the heart of the city.

reviews.author: Nan072426
reviews.title: Sad
reviews.body: Sad will not recommend as room was never cool and unmade from one day to next

reviews.author: MB2221615
reviews.title: Great Location for a Chicago Vacation
reviews.body: This was our first visit to Chicago. The hotel was conveniently located near train stops, the river, Miracle Mile, Millennium Park and lots of great restaurants. The room was quiet and comfortable with a large bathroom.

reviews.author: Hudson WI Visitor
reviews.title: Great location and staff.
reviews.body: Walking distance to many upscale restaurants, the river walk and public transportation. Staff including front desk, bell man and bartender professional, friendly and informative.

reviews.author: Hazel2026
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body: My family and I enjoyed our stay; the staff, and accommodations.

reviews.author: Dre1906
reviews.title: Could've been better
reviews.body: The location was great. Ms. Linda at the front desk provided excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Sazzad
reviews.title: Sazzad
reviews.body:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had an excellent stay at Hotel Chicago! The staff was warm, professional, and always willing to help. The room was spotless, spacious, and very comfortable, with great amenities and an amazing view. The location was perfect, making it easy to explore the city. Every part of my stay exceeded my expectations, from the smooth check-in to the outstanding customer service. I highly recommend Hotel Chicago to anyone visiting the city and will definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: TC 77
reviews.title: Business stay
reviews.body: Overall quality was mid. Initial reservation was messed up received an upgrade upgraded room had non-functioning USB’s and only one of the two TVs worked bed was not set on the pullout couch showerhead great pressure but was unmarked for hot cold. Lots of small issues trash collection, complementary water is not being replenished USB charge ports broken one TV not working no microwave in room.

reviews.author: Nicolette
reviews.title: Excellent choice for downtown Chicago
reviews.body: Great location, beautiful view of Chicago’s waterway. Staff was amazing and went above and beyond. Perfect location to walk to most of downtown attractions, easy access to redline and metro. Great dining at hotel and also within same block. Very reasonable price for high quality accommodation.

reviews.author: RachH
reviews.title: Highly recommend on all counts
reviews.body: We loved our stay here. The room and all public spaces were kept clean. The staff were all excellent. The location is super convenient. The daily reimbursements for the tourism fee were excellent and added a little extra fun to our trip. We will absolutely be staying here again next time we’re in Chicago!

reviews.author: thing23
reviews.title: Modern Gem
reviews.body: Hotel was centrally located. Close to River North bars and restaurants.  Red line was three blocks away.  Would stay here again!  The lounge for premium members is nice.

reviews.author: Dedra
reviews.title: Disappointed stay!
reviews.body: I was overly charged! Room wasn’t very comfortable or clean.

reviews.author: hrubino
reviews.title: A building and location with promise - but work needed.
reviews.body:
We stayed at this hotel over a very busy Chicago weekend. When we arrived, we were placed in the wrong room for what we had booked. Which, worked for our family, and would have been fine, had it been acknowledged and had we been compensated for the price difference between the room type we booked and the room type that we were placed in. The elevators were very noisy right on the other side of where we were sleeping, which made it very hard to sleep. Putting some sound proofing along that wall would be super beneficial, because otherwise the room was beautiful. 

We had a pullout couch and were told that the bedding would be in the room. When bed time came around, there was no bedding. And, it took over an hour for it to be delivered to our room. That is unacceptable on a first night when folks are really tired and trying to get to bed and can't. 

The building is super old feeling, which is a really nice, grand feeling. The room was older, but in a nice, clean, grand feeling way. I really enjoyed the overall hotel, if the kinks were worked out.

reviews.author: Ohiotraveler1055
reviews.title: Best stay ever in downtown Chicago
reviews.body:
We have stayed at many downtown hotels and they all delivered positive experiences. Hotel Chicago is by far the best experience we have ever had. 

Location is perfect and has all the amenities you need to feel comfortable. Speaking of comfort my wife and I like stiff mattresses and our mattress helped us sleep like a dream.

reviews.author: midwesttraveler09
reviews.title: Great location but all else fails...
reviews.body: When I made the reservation for two nights, it stated that it would have a city view.  Upon check-in, we settled into our room and found ourselves staring at two parking garages, and when I went back down to see if there was a room with a view, as our reservation detailed, the front desk staff said that indeed parking garages were part of the "city view."  Eventually, she offered to move me to another room that "may have a glimpse of the river" but it had a king bed, and I was traveling with a friend, and we wanted our two queen beds.  The room should not have "city view" as a descriptor.  Also, I ran out of body wash in the midst of my first shower, and there was one pump of lotion remaining.  Additionally, there was only one robe in the closet even though we booked for two guests.  When I notified the staff as we were heading out for the day, there was no apology/sorry for the inconvenience, just a we'll let the staff know. Additionally, we were not told about the $25/day destination fee until we checked in and were told we could use it toward room service and/or at the bar.  We stayed two nights and ordered two bagels the first morning for $12.  The bill, with delivery fee of $11, a 24% service fee, a tip that was already placed on our bill and a tip of our own (not knowing a tip would already be charged) brought the $12 bagels to $33!! While I appreciate someone having to prep and deliver, paying almost three times the cost of what was printed on the menu is excessive.  Our booking for $230/night, with all the additional property fees, destination fees and outrageous room service fees brought our bill to $725, which is well over a third night's stay.  I would much rather pay a higher cost upfront, knowing that everything is included rather than have all these extras added on upon our arrival.  While the location is great, I would not recommend this hotel to others based on the all the extra fees and the inaccurate room description.

reviews.author: MJ0W
reviews.title: Reception Ross was great, but house keeping was not good
reviews.body: Reception Ross was great, but the next night, I requested for sheets change and it took 2.5 hours wait, it was poor comms, no follow up calls or calls to update about ETA, I had to follow up with reception 4 times during the 2.5 hours, and to wait for house keeping to change the sheets with shoes in the bed, didn’t take off shoes nor wear shoe cover). Hotel also says it will do full clean on 3rd or 4th day but I can tell the sheets were the same, which was slightly disappointing.

reviews.author: Kim3
reviews.title: Great place for a solo traveler
reviews.body: This was a great place to stay as a solo traveler.  Close to the trains, variety of restaurants around, next to the river walk and walkable to multiple tourist spots. Felt safe and the hotel was clean in all areas.  Loved the patio area outside.  The staff was always helpful and nice.  I’d stay there again.

reviews.author: Disappointed guest
reviews.title: IT'S GREAT IF YOU LIKE SLEEPING ON A ROCK AND ARE NOT CLAUSTERPHOBIC
reviews.body: The staff was very nice. The end.  The rooms are ABSURDLY SMALL with barely any counter space for personal items; no drawers for clothing--you are forced to live out of your suitcase; no in room iron or board, you have to use a community iron room and the iron on my floor had brown singe marks that, had I not looked, may have tranferred to my clothing; they leave two 6 oz bottles of water, but no cups to get tap water; noise from the street; and the WORST THING--BEDS ARE HARD AS ROCKS.

reviews.author: Dr Jim
reviews.title: 2nd best hotel ever
reviews.body: The friendly staff and managers that my family and I spoke to went out of their way to assist us

reviews.author: 303Titanium
reviews.title: Great location and amazing value, but prepare for tiny rooms and frustrating parking
reviews.body:
Location & Vibe

The hotel is in a fantastic, central spot in Downtown Chicago—super walkable to everything you need. The reception staff was warm, welcoming, and very helpful throughout the stay. The lobby area stands out: it’s bright, spacious, and filled with plenty of eclectic seating options, making it a great spot to relax or work.

Food & Drink

The food and beverage offerings exceeded expectations. Breakfast was healthy and delicious, paired with high-quality coffee. The bar also has a great selection if you want a drink in the evening.

The Rooms & Space

The price is exceptionally low for central Chicago, but there is a clear trade-off: the rooms are tiny.

Layout: The XL king bed takes up the entire width of the room against the window, meaning there is no room to walk around it—you have to climb in from the end.

Bathroom: The commode and shower share the same compact pod space.

Amenities: I booked a "Superior" room, which included a small desk and chair; note that standard rooms do not have a desk. There are also no in-room irons, but a shared ironing setup is available down the hall.

Parking & Logistics Warning

Parking here is terrible. The hotel doesn't have an on-site garage, so you have to use an off-site deck about a block away, and the entry/exit procedures are completely inscrutable and frustrating to navigate.

Verdict

An amazing option for solo travelers or short trips if you're traveling light, using public transit/rideshares, and planning to spend your time exploring or in the lobby. If you need spacious quarters or are driving into the city, be prepared for the parking and layout trade-offs.

reviews.author: CitizenMFanz
reviews.title: Excellent Location and comfortable spaces
reviews.body: Citizen M is not for everyone. Slept well at this hotel. Room becomes dark and bed is comfortable. Loved the covered balcony space along Michigan Ave. to people watch. Street noise can get loud at times- not unexpected in a big city. The most excellent location to the River Walk, shopping, and the Bean, and public transportation.

reviews.author: citizenX
reviews.title: Excellent Experience!
reviews.body: Very friendly staff, impeccably clean rooms, and very modern feel in an excellent location downtown Chicago. I will definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: J2k4
reviews.title: Inferior design leading to 80 degree nights
reviews.body:
Multiple maintenance requests lead to no HVAC fix, and the staff could only supply a box fan. When delivering the fan the staff audibly gasped when they felt the heat in my room at 11 PM. The hallways and lobby were cool, so this is not an environmental issue, which was the excuse of the front desk. 

I resorted to propping open my door, sacrificing security and privacy for comfort. Unfortunately I couldn’t sleep with the door open, so I just didn’t sleep much due to the heat.

reviews.author: Km95
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: So grateful to stay here! They were very accommodating and personable! I never came across anyone that worked there where I couldn’t ask for help.  The bartenders were great very friendly and did their best to accommodate my needs whenever I ask for something. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Rico
reviews.title: Perfect Stay in Chicago
reviews.body: Citizen M!! Loved it! I was in town visiting family and lucked out finding it... Modern with all the right amenities, breakfast and coffee were the highlight, lots of choices and great coffee, living room feel with cubby holes everywhere to sit, work and or eat were great!! Gym was also top notch... all the equipment you would need in a hotel gym and more. Best of all was the friendliness of the staff, they were great!!! Will be back.

reviews.author: Torri
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.body: Staff Horrible was rude my husband and I were asking important question about parking the young lady act like she was mad just RUDE!!!

reviews.author: lenabugtay
reviews.title: If you're looking for a decent option
reviews.body: Hotel was a solid 6 all around. But rooms are extremely small, no amenities besides a gym, but good service. great location

reviews.author: SSSept2026
reviews.title: Staff and Location Good but I cannot recommend this hotel
reviews.body: The only redeeming factor about this hotel and trip was the staff.  In very challenging circumstances, they kept their cool and did their best to manage expectations.  On the hotel front, we had a non-functional air-conditioner on the hottest week of the year in Chicago and I found it ludicrous that I had to call downstairs to ask what the temperature was in the room every hour because there is no visible thermostat in the room or IPAD.  We weren't moved to a new functioning room until we reached 75+ and two fans with no relief.  Thankfully after we moved rooms our last two nights (out of a 5-night stay) were more comfortable.  Additionally, the cable was also out, so channels were garbled and not visible for two days in our first room.  The IPAD experience, while modern was SO slow, it took minutes not seconds to see a response from any function in both rooms.  For our trouble, the staff did give us a free breakfast for one day, which was generally good and fresh.  In general however, I would not recommend this hotel for anything other than wonderful team members and location.  Comfortable beds, amenities, climate comfort...all 0 stars.

reviews.author: Benny
reviews.title: Perfect location and for couples
reviews.body: Can't go wrong with this brand. 2nd location I've stayed at (other being Seattle) and they're exact same in terms of setup and comfort. Perfect location, not a far walk from anywhere... great staff!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: The team made everything about our meeting and time in Chicago perfect!
reviews.body: The team made everything about our meeting and our time in Chicago absolutely seamless. From accommodating all of our meeting-space needs and ensuring we had coffee each morning to jumping in to help with the small, unexpected things that came up throughout the week, they consistently went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly. We also really appreciated seeing how the team rotated through different sections of the hotel and everyone we interacted with was incredibly warm, welcoming, attentive, and genuinely committed to making our experience a great one. A real camaraderie amongst them! Their hospitality and willingness to help at every turn made a real difference, and we’re incredibly grateful for the care they put into making our stay and meeting so successful.

reviews.author: Jojo
reviews.title: Everything excellent
reviews.body: Excellent service and pretty hotel

reviews.author: Arie
reviews.title: My fave hotel in the Chi!
reviews.body: I always try to book at this property when I’m in town. It’s just the right amount of space, the staff is amazing & the atmosphere and common areas are amazing! Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Toddpay
reviews.title: Super cool hotel in a great location!
reviews.body: The citizenM hotel is in a great location in downtown Chicago. The staff is fantastic! The rooms are good for an individual, on the smaller side, but very neat, modern and well appointed. Overall, the hotel has a great vibe and has very cool spaces.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Mother/Daughter Trip
reviews.body: This was my very first time staying at this hotel I would absolutely stay here again. Everything was excellent from the aesthetic all the way to a smart room and excellent lounge area on the patio .

reviews.author: Lindsey
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: I enjoyed my 4-day stay. I was traveling for work by myself. The check-in process with simple, the room was excellent. I only ate one meal here. I grabbed a bite at the bar one evening; dumplings and fries were meh.

reviews.author: T Wright
reviews.title: A Pleasant Surprise in the Heart of Chicago!
reviews.body:
I’ll be honest..I was a little apprehensive at first because citizenM is definitely a different kind of hotel experience than what I’m used to. But from the moment I stepped off the elevator, everything was exceptional!

From the cute little daily “this or that” questions and the beautiful terrace overlooking Michigan Avenue, to the clean, comfortable rooms and the overall atmosphere, I truly enjoyed my stay. But what really stood out was the staff. Everyone was welcoming, helpful, and attentive, with a special shout-out to Julian, who went above and beyond to make our experience even better!

I would absolutely recommend citizenM to anyone visiting Chicago. It was such a fun, unique, and enjoyable experience, and I will definitely be back the next time we’re in Chicago!

reviews.author: GeoC
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.body: This hotel is a great place close to everything

reviews.author: Review xhi
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Excellent location , very friendly staff and super comfortable bed. This is my 2nd citizen m property stay and loved both definitely recommend

reviews.author: Anthony tris
reviews.title: Smell
reviews.body: Hallways up until our room smelt like vomit! Extremely uncomfortable smell when wanting peace and a nice get away!

reviews.author: Bisay Vindas
reviews.title: Review before check in
reviews.body: Dont stay in rooms close from the street. Ask for a change. Also, the food of breakfast its really bad

reviews.author: Megan and Dustin
reviews.title: My favorite hotel
reviews.body: By far my favorite hotel in the city. The windows are absolutely perfect!

reviews.author: Sam D
reviews.title: Good Value
reviews.body: Good hotel, but no real mini fridge in the suites. Just a poorly performing dometic cooler. Just sub standard for what you would expect from a 4 star hotel, just seems cheap.

reviews.author: steven j
reviews.title: Would stay again
reviews.body: Service was great, room was clean, gym had more equipment than I anticipated, and the terrace area was a plus.

reviews.author: Balmond
reviews.title: Downtown Chicago Vacay Highlight
reviews.body: This was my second time staying with citizenM in downtown Chicago. The location is amazing, the guest service is sublime, and the room is to die for! I will always stay with CitizenM when visiting Chicago!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Did not enjoy my birthday
reviews.body: I got my wallet stolen I don’t know if it was by staff or the clean up maids but wouldn’t let me go back up to the room

reviews.author: Week of happiness
reviews.title: Week of happiness in Chicago
reviews.body: very nice, breakfast was great and the location was great and close to everything

reviews.author: Superbus Vir
reviews.title: Not a good experience
reviews.body:
This was one of the most upsetting hotel experiences I have had, and the condition of the room and the lack of meaningful assistance fell well below the standards reasonably expected of a Marriott property.
Upon arrival, I found the room to be unacceptably dirty. The carpet was visibly old and in such poor condition that I did not feel comfortable removing my shoes in the room. This alone materially diminished the value of the accommodation for which I had paid a premium rate.
Compounding the problem, I was unable to connect to the hotel’s internet service. When I called the front desk for help, no one was able to resolve the issue. After considerable difficulty, I was ultimately told to write down a telephone number and contact the outside wireless company directly because hotel management did not know how to make its own guest internet service work. It is unreasonable to expect a guest—particularly one paying approximately $800 for a single night—to troubleshoot the property’s essential services with a third-party vendor.
A front-desk associate apologized and advised that I would receive a $150 adjustment. Not only was that amount inadequate in light of the circumstances, but I have not received the promised $150 credit. I also requested to speak with a manager. He later called while I was on business calls, and when we were eventually able to connect, he was willing to assist despite preparing to leave for the evening. I appreciate his effort; however, by that point the experience had already been seriously mishandled.
Given the unsanitary room conditions, the failure of an essential amenity, the inability of on-site staff to provide assistance, and the unfulfilled promise of a partial credit.

reviews.author: SloanTraveler
reviews.title: Great location, but check-in and elevator issues
reviews.body: As a frequent Marriott guest, I've stayed at many properties over the years. The room and hotel location were both very nice, but a couple of issues made this stay disappointing. Check-in took much longer than expected. We arrived at 3:30 PM, half an hour after our selected check-in time, and the room still wasn't ready. Staff said we'd get a message once it was ready, but by 4:45 PM, ahead of a 5:00 PM appointment, we still hadn't heard anything. We were told it was due to a busy day with a wedding on-site, but that isn't something guests should have to absorb. Separately, the elevators were down for most of the weekend, and we spent a significant part of our stay just waiting for them.

reviews.author: Tab C
reviews.title: Pleasant stay in Downtown Chicago
reviews.body: I was on a mother/daughter vacation. This was my second stay in Chicago and my first stay at this Springhill Suites. I am glad I chose this property. It is conveniently located. It's within walking distance to restaurants, shopping and attractions. The hotel staff was very friendly. Jacob at the front desk was very helpful with the check in process and answering questions. We had a corner room, and it was quiet. There was some city noise which is to be expected in a large city.  The room was clean and we received housekeeping services each day of my stay. With so many restaurants nearby I didn't intend to have the free hotel breakfast, but I had it a few w days and I was pleasantly surprised. It was quite good. The only negative about this hotel was there were only two of the three elevators working and sometimes there would be a wait in the morning.  We really enjoyed my stay and will probably choose to stay here again.

reviews.author: SFamily
reviews.title: All good all around
reviews.body: Staff was super friendly, helpful and welcoming from the front desk to the restaurant. Rooms were clean, beds comfy, location great.

reviews.author: Lifelong learning
reviews.title: There is no place like come; but, it comes close.
reviews.body: Great stay. Comforts of home, shopping, museums, entertainment, and nourishment before you set off for adventures in the city or your next destination.

reviews.author: Chic3
reviews.title: A great place to stay!
reviews.body: Immaculate facilities, helpful and friendly staff, great location, excellent breakfast.   Loved our short visit!

reviews.author: Beachgirl18
reviews.title: Family Chicago trip
reviews.body:
This was our first time staying at Spring Hills Suites Chicago. It was a family trip and we shared 2 rooms next to each other. Even though my grandchildren were in the next room and can be noisy, we didn’t hear a thing!! What a bonus!! The rooms are spacious and clean. 
Great location to all downtown. The staff was very pleasant.
My husband was a big fan of the attached parking garage to the hotel. Making getting luggage so manageable.
The breakfast also was very nice and had a good amount of choices.

reviews.author: Flipper15
reviews.title: Wonderful stay in the heart of downtown Chicago!
reviews.body: Terrific location, friendly and helpful staff, breakfast buffet that is second to none and very comfortable and spacious rooms. Will definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Gail B
reviews.title: Great location but not always comfortable
reviews.body: Upon arrival, be prepared to take an elevator to the next floor up to check in.  Very pleasant staff, but not a lot of them. Elevators are always busy. Facility is shared with Residence Inn which has a coffee machine all day and quicker elevators. Very good breakfast.

reviews.author: Feltch
reviews.title: Welcoming & very comfortable
reviews.body:
From the minute I walked into Springhill Suites, I felt welcome. Front desk staff very helpful & made sure I had everything I needed. I wish my stay was longer since my room was so comfortable, clean & well appointed arrangement of the room w/ an area like a mini living room & kitchen with everything I could need. 
A bit noisy at night with traffic on the weekend, but Sunday night was quieter. I would definitely recommend & will book a room again the next time I visit Chicago.

reviews.author: Julia T 618
reviews.title: So good
reviews.body: Welcome stuff, good breakfast, clean room, perfect service. Parking stuff really working for you. Every time I stay here, I feel happy.

reviews.author: Celeste
reviews.title: Golden Birthday
reviews.body: I have stayed here a few times because the location is so close to EVERYTHING. We had dinner reservations on the riverwalk, did the boat tour, quick walks to any store or entertainment. I loved how accommodating they were, we got there super early around 9am and although we couldn't check in that early they were able to text us when the room was ready - which was literally not even an hour later. The staff is so kind. I highly recommend coming here, no matter your Mariott status, you always feel like a platinum or titanium member.

reviews.author: LCK64
reviews.title: Front Lobby Representatives
reviews.body: The hotel was very nice, however the Front Lobby representatives did a poor job of representing the Marriott brand.  They were very rude and short with guests.  They made us feel as if we were bothering them.  They are not representatives of the Marriott brand and need to be moved to another position if they don't desire to interact with the guests.

reviews.author: Uday Vemuri
reviews.title: Excellent hotel to stay
reviews.body: Excellent hotel to stay. Walkable distance to most of the attractions. Hotel staff is so nice.

reviews.author: Jesikah
reviews.title: Chicago River Springhill
reviews.body: It was perfect location close to everything Excellent

reviews.author: Good place to sleep
reviews.title: Safe and clean, but breakfast had very few choices
reviews.body: I felt very safe staying here. The carpets are really clean. The rooms are clean and the linen is good, but I did not like the breakfast at all. Very few choices. Kids ended up eating no breakfast.

reviews.author: MS08
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.body: It’s new and clean hotel.

reviews.author: Robyn23
reviews.title: Great location, rooms outdated and dirty.
reviews.body: This is the first time Marriott has let me down. The rooms look much more updated and refreshed online, but in person it was dated and dirty. Breakfast wasn't even worth waking up for and the line was insane! The location can't be beat and everyone who worked there was friendly and helpful, but I won't be staying at this hotel again.

reviews.author: Carol
reviews.title: Springhill Suites
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel, room and view amazing and great location

reviews.author: VA683528
reviews.title: Unprofessional and disappointing
reviews.body: Ultimately the room was small, the elevators slow and inefficient, and unauthorized charges were made and the staff was less than helpful.

reviews.author: Fa22571
reviews.title: Was almost great
reviews.body: Front desk associates should be trained better,  or a manager should be around for issues that they can't handle. I also feel a quality check on the rooms before guest arrive.

reviews.title: Overall positive stay
reviews.body: The only issue I had was it took 20 minutes on Saturday morning to get an elevator from the 23rd floor. Then you have to transfer to the lobby to another elevator. That was frustrating. Other guests were complaining about this same issue.

reviews.author: Mayflower
reviews.title: Wonderful stay!!
reviews.body:
We had a great time in Chicago the main reason is that we chose SpringHills suites by Marriott river north to stay at. The location is amazing, all attractions are minutes away by foot, breakfast is included, house keeping clean the room every day, and a very welcoming and helpful staff.
I will definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: JMY23
reviews.title: Great week in Chicago!  Felt like family.
reviews.body: The place is tucked in on an unassuming block across from Harry Carey's Restaurant and perfect location  for Cubs fans to hit a quick trip on the Redline to Wrigley.

reviews.author: cwws07042026
reviews.title: Only Book If You're Looking for Loud and Inefficient
reviews.body: I would not recommend this hotel due to the noise and poor elevator service. When checking in, we specifically requested a quiet room, and the receptionist promised to place us far from the elevators. Instead, we were given a room right next to them and could hear everything. On top of that, the three elevators near us were incredibly slow, causing frustrating lines to form during busy times. Definitely look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Katerina GR
reviews.title: Not a great experience - Be prepared for elevators traffic jams!
