reviews.body: Smelly carpet in the room, not trash bin in the toilet, hot dishes at breakfast were actually cold. Staff was polite, but didn't respond directly to my questions. Horrible traffic jams at the elevators - especially in the morning.

reviews.author: Happy Senior traveler
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Excellent service, friendly staff that were smiling and responsive to my needs ( many issues with ordering Ubers, checking train schedules, etc. A senior trying to be "tecky").

reviews.author: Stacy
reviews.title: Very peaceful quiet stay
reviews.body: Perfect hotel, but beware if you are allergic to dogs.

reviews.author: Jerome
reviews.title: Best Stay In Chicago
reviews.body: Great hotel in a happening part of the city. Will def stay here again.

reviews.author: NR23
reviews.title: Conference Stay
reviews.body: Overall great staff, the elevators need some work in order to accommodate guests.

reviews.author: Chicago weekend
reviews.title: Weekend stay in Chicago
reviews.body: Nice hotel just be wary of the comped parking.

reviews.author: AJIOhio
reviews.title: The Place to Be
reviews.body: Everyone we encountered wanted to help and was pleasant. The room was spacious and had everything you would need. Was near a ton of restaurants and a 5 minute Uber ride to The Pier

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: One of the most amazing hotel stay my family has experienced.
reviews.body: This was my family's first time visiting Chicago, and the staff at Residence Inn River North made it the most memorable. Aaliyah Whitehorn was the person at the desk that checked us in and she literally set the precedence for the remainder of the trip. She was professional and polite, and asked us what brought us to Chicago. We informed her that it was an early birthday present for our 10-year-old son, to which she responded with a “happy birthday” in excitement and put us on the 24th floor with an amazing view, just for him. She also gave him a treat, on her, from the Marketplace. The staff at Residence Inn River North was incredible--from Glenda Malon, providing us with information that altered our itinerary positively, to Jermaine Wallace calling a cab for us at checkout. The hospitality received at Residence Inn River North was nothing short of amazing!

reviews.author: Tiffani
reviews.title: Excellent check in experience
reviews.body: We checked in on 9/4 during a very busy time. Aaliyah was extremely quick and efficient during  check. She offered amazing options for dining and clubs in the area.

reviews.title: Group
reviews.body:
Nice stay good view. 
Only thing sofa is very poor to sleep on. Need a upgrade

reviews.author: Miimii Veal
reviews.title: The views
reviews.body: Love 💕 my views and it was a great stay, love the breakfast. It was good. Guest service was  amazing .

reviews.author: Jazzy Jaz
reviews.title: Conveniently located to all activities in Chicago Loop
reviews.body: Clean, friendly staff, excellent room.

reviews.author: St Louis Travelers
reviews.title: Getaway Trip
reviews.body: Absolutely loved our location, great City View from our room! Extremely walkable and the staff was so very nice. Will definitely stay there next time we are in Chicago

reviews.author: Ishraq
reviews.title: Bad experience @Residence Inn Chicago Downtown River north.
reviews.body: Bad hospitality. Rude front desk staff with bad service.

reviews.author: inchicagoforlolla
reviews.title: Staff was great and responded quickly
reviews.body: The room was very clean, and the staff was very accommodating with check-in plans. I had an issue where the laundry machine ate all my money, and the staff sent up someone quickly to get it started for me. We did unfortunatley have some issues trying to get our parking validated and the hotel was trying to charge us more than it cost to pay for parking in the garge which did cause some delays and issues for us leaving.

reviews.author: BuckeyeJT91
reviews.title: Springhill Suites better than Residence Inn at this property
reviews.body: Third time I've stayed at this property, second time on the Residence Inn side. Spring Hill side was nicer last summer. Like the first time a few years ago the room was super warm the day we checked in and took a long time to cool down because the sun coming in that side of the hotel. Thermostat needed to be set at 64 the first night to make it even tolerable by bedtime. Mentioned this to front desk and a few years ago they gave me some points back to make up for the uncomfortable first night, this time just seemed to brush it off with an apology. I also let them know that the toilet handle would get stuck and that the door to the room would not lock when you left and really needed to be slammed to shut it. Said they would pass that along but not sure it ever got looked at. Also the one day house keeping came in they turned thermostat back up which made it uncomfortable again when we returned for the last night from our daytime baseball game. I let them know at desk at checkout and said they would pass along to management but not sure that ever happened. Seems like they just need to do a better job of making sure the room is at a comfortable temperature before a guest arrives and definitely not mess with the thermostat when they clean the room especially in the middle of the summer.

reviews.author: Traveling Family
reviews.title: Would Stay Again
reviews.body: Friendly staff, breakfast options varied each morning with various offerings each day, room was clean. Even though the hotel was busy (Lollapalooza and based on how many people were at breakfast) we never had noise issues, never even heard anyone else near our floor. Perfect for a tired toddler to get a good nights rest.

reviews.author: RandomGuy
reviews.title: It’s fine
reviews.body: Had some hiccups with my rooms. Tv didn’t work in the first one. Lock didn’t work I. The second one but that’s gonna happen anywhere. It gets extremely crowded and sometimes you have to wait like 15 minutes for the elevator to be available. Food is nothing special.

reviews.author: JsnakeFL
reviews.title: Great hotel for quick business meetings
reviews.body: Excellent hotel in a good location.  Clean and staff was very friendly.

reviews.author: Jim B
reviews.title: Needs some upgrades!
reviews.body:
Rooms and hallways are tired and the breakfast area chaotic and poorly run. Slow elevators.
On the positive side, location is wonderful and front dest staff great.

reviews.author: Js45
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.body: Our stay was great and so was the staff

reviews.author: Clemens
reviews.title: Great location, spacious rooms, friendly staff
reviews.body: We had a great stay at the Residence Inn in Chicago downtown. Special shoutout to the bellmen who were super friendly and helpful, especially Jermaine, who helped us out in a very tricky situation.

reviews.author: Anthony Jesse
reviews.title: First time visit to Chicago
reviews.body: Don't sleep on Chicago. There was so much to do in the little time we were there. Festivals and free events were happening all over Chicago.

reviews.author: Stuck on Elevator
reviews.title: Elevators will stop working while you in it!!!!
reviews.body: My son was stuck on the elevator between floors and had to climb out.  The management was extremely nonchalant about the situation.  I'm thinking if this happen and maintenance has to come, the elevators would be out of order until a proper inspection. Nope, 20 minutes later the elevator was operating again.

reviews.author: Travelbea12
reviews.title: Poor/Bad experience
reviews.body: It’s miserable if you book 11 days and know that it’s just not good Day 1.

reviews.author: Anas Godil
reviews.title: Family trip to Chicago
reviews.body: Good location. Suite was perfect size for a family of 4. Great staff and housekeeping. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Gina
reviews.title: Perfect place for workation
reviews.body: While I wanted to spend my holiday in Chicago, I also had to work a bit during the day. Supermarkets are nearby and good restaurants are in the vicinity so my family spent a wonderful time while in there. We were also able to watch football games with the food that we cooked. The River Walk is so close, so you can take a short walk with kids. Staff members are kind and professional. I especially recommend this place if you plan to travel with kids.

reviews.author: Janet
reviews.title: Excellent location, wonderful staff, great parking option
reviews.body: Ben who helped with my check in was excellent.  The staff at breakfast was very attentive.  We parked our car at the parking garage which is connected to the hotel.  We like this very much.  We didn’t drive at all during our 3 night stay.  We walked, took the train or subway.  The only issue I encountered was they forgot to top up the conditioner bottle.  It ran out after one use.

reviews.author: John v
reviews.title: Great family hotel not pleasant for a couple with no kids
reviews.body: Great for kids dogs families not suited for couples

reviews.author: Damian Barczewski
reviews.title: Bad Experience from the get-go! Rude & unprofessional FD staff.
reviews.body:
My partner and I originally had a reservation at the property from June 28 through July 5 under confirmation number 83128150. Prior to our arrival, I contacted the hotel directly and advised the staff that although the reservation began on June 28, we would be arriving on a red-eye flight and would not reach the property until June 29. To ensure there would be no issues, I also contacted Marriott Bonvoy Member Services, and a representative kindly added a note to the reservation documenting this information.
Unfortunately, upon arrival, we were informed that the reservation had been marked as a guest no-show and had been completely canceled by the hotel. This was extremely frustrating, as I had taken multiple steps to notify both the property and Marriott of our delayed arrival and was assured that everything had been properly documented and would be handled accordingly.
What was equally disappointing was the manner in which the situation was handled at the property. There was no sincere apology, little acknowledgment of the inconvenience caused, and the staff’s response felt dismissive. The manager’s demeanor came across as unprofessional and indifferent to the situation. The only compensation offered was a single complimentary drink voucher per person for one evening, which did not feel commensurate with the significant inconvenience and stress caused by the hotel’s error.

As a result, I was forced to spend additional time on the phone recreating the reservation and redeeming my Bonvoy points again. The new reservation number was 73245496.

Unfortunately, the overall experience left such a negative impression that my partner and I decided to depart the property early. We checked out on July 3 and did not stay for the remaining nights of the reservation through July 5. The combination of the canceled reservation, poor service recovery, lack of professionalism, and overall customer service experience fell far below the standards I have come to expect from Marriott and was particularly disappointing as a Platinum Elite member.

reviews.author: Getaway
reviews.title: Smell in Room.
reviews.body: Location is great,  Staff is Wonderful however my room had a terrible odor in it.  Housekeeping came to spray but it came back the next day.

reviews.author: Ganesh
reviews.title: Home Away from Home
reviews.body: Highly Recommended for Long Stays

reviews.author: Wonderful Wanderlusts
reviews.title: Cityscapes
reviews.body: I wholeheartedly would book more hotel accommodations on my next visit. The property is well maintained, boasts great views of the city, great lighting with superb cleanliness. The staff was very friendly and helpful. I would score 10/10 and I definitely would recommend you to book your stay.

reviews.author: Amelia
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.body: Fantastic location. Great service and rooms.

reviews.author: Lynn
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.body:
Friendly staff, comfortable beds, great location.
Hotel is not fancy, but it checks all the important boxes.

reviews.author: ChicagoFan
reviews.title: Nice hotel but overcharged
reviews.body: Was charged for room even though I booked with points.  Front desk said I would be refunded but still hasn't happened yet.

reviews.author: no
reviews.title: overpriced for the absolute bare minimum
reviews.body: title says it all. they charge you through the nose and give you as little as possible in your room

reviews.author: Marcell
reviews.title: Been to much better Marriott's...even in Chicago.
reviews.body: Worst Marriott in Chicago that I have stayed at.  Lobby is small and workers don't know the system so it takes a long time to check in and check out.  Meanwhile all the people waiting are commandeering the lobby so no other guests can use the sitting area.  No breakfast at all offered.  Terrible Chinese restaurant that no one uses taking up purposeful space that could have breakfast for it's customers.

reviews.author: Cris
reviews.title: Stay here!
reviews.body: Great location and accommodating staff!

reviews.author: Henry
reviews.title: Better options available
reviews.body: The hotel was alright. We got upgraded to a suite which was fully renovated from top to bottom and it had a living room and a bigger bedroom/closet. The bed was comfortable but the pillows were not and they seemed old and flattened. The bathroom had a big vent with air coming out and it made it difficult to shower the first day, until we closed it altogether and finally the bathroom remained warm while showering. But the worst part was that it LOUD while we were trying to sleep. We could hear the construction outside, trucks, sirens, and overall city noises. You would think that in 2026, the insulation on these windows would be much improved. It’s not 1970 after all! The service was very plain, they had two people max at the front desk, as well as one or two security staff cleaning windows and floors and other odd jobs.

reviews.author: Long time Bonvoy mbr
reviews.title: Room was  not avalible at stated check in time
reviews.body: Room was  not avalible at stated check in time

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Destination Wedding
reviews.body: Excellent location and friendly staff.

reviews.author: Andres
reviews.title: Maybe only worth it if it is like 30% of the current price
reviews.body: Not worth it, try another Marriot hotel instead

reviews.author: Wedding Guest
reviews.title: Hotel is subpar and only one employee cares
reviews.body:
Impossibly noisy room, including a situation on Sunday night/Monday early morning that required us to call 911. (A sound machine and earplugs don't compensate, sorry.) Drawers that can't open because they are blocked by the legs of the desk (and can't move because a wall is in the way). Ridiculously noisy A/C. No shower pressure and not addressed by engineer. Hot water available on "cold" position in shower which is unsafe. Nothing done beyond offering to move us on our 3rd day (another nuisance) and a promise of bonus points which have yet to show up in our account. 

With that said, shout-out to DANNY who was the only person we interacted with who really cared and tried to make us feel better though there was really nothing much he could do to make up for stupid design and really poor execution.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: Wonderful stay at Courtyard River North!
reviews.body: It was a wonderful stay at Courtyard Marriott River North! The location is great, there's a restaurant right downstairs and convenient valet parking (it's expensive though). The room was cool and clean. They provided ear plugs because since it's downtown it does stay loud at night. The beds were comfortable, everything was lovely! Would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: Kae
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.body: Stayed here for a business trip with other colleagues and the room was amazing and clean.

reviews.author: Laycee
reviews.title: First time in Chicago
reviews.body: The location is great. It was also pretty affordable. Walkable to a lot of businesses and everyone was friendly. I only wish that the full body mirror was bigger and in a different part of the room. I didn’t find it until my 2nd day there

reviews.author: Detroits Finest
reviews.title: Comfortable Enough, But Far Below Expectations
reviews.body:
While the room itself was decent overall, there were several disappointing aspects of my stay that would make me hesitant to return.

The hotel's amenities were lacking. Dining options were extremely limited, and there was no bar on-site, which made it difficult to relax or grab a drink without leaving the property.

One of the biggest disappointments was the fitness center. The photos advertised online are misleading and do not accurately represent the actual facility. The gym was dirty and poorly maintained, and the route to access it was even more concerning. The entire area leading to the fitness center was under construction, creating an environment that felt unsafe, inconvenient, and difficult to navigate.

The room was acceptable, but housekeeping could have been much better. Finding hair on the shower walls is never something guests should encounter, and it immediately raises concerns about cleanliness. The bathroom was also missing a vanity mirror, which was an inconvenience when getting ready.

Another frustration was the climate control system. The thermostat on the wall indicated that it controlled the room temperature, but it didn't function as advertised. I had to adjust the temperature directly on the HVAC unit, making the wall thermostat essentially useless. Unless the room was below 66 degrees it was extremely humid which made curling my hair a complete waste of time.

Overall, the room was fine, but the combination of cleanliness issues, misleading fitness center advertising, lack of amenities, and maintenance concerns made this stay fall short of expectations.

reviews.author: Cooper
reviews.title: VERY NOISY
reviews.body:
Our room overlooked State Street. Noise from sirens, horns, people screaming, all in the wee hours of the morning, made it impossible to sleep. When I mentioned this to people at front desk, they indicated that this was normal. 
Four sleepless nights made our stay unpleasant, to say the least.

reviews.author: EP
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.body: Delesa helped us out tremendously and accommodated us from the moment we arrived. Our room wasn’t ready so she found us a different one, which was not what we originally booked. She gave us hotel credits in return and made sure we were taken care of

reviews.author: Sonia W
reviews.title: Great location and price point
reviews.body: We really enjoyed our stay. The front desk was super helpful and accommodating from the moment we checked in to the moment we checked out. The double queen room size was very comfortable for 3 people. I would definitely consider staying here again on another Chicago visit.

reviews.author: Gates
reviews.title: First visit to Chicago!
reviews.body: Being first time visiting Chicago and worried about where to stay, I had been searching for hotel stay to accommodate my visit with location and pricing. I must say this was the perfect pick! Walking distance to everything I needed along with great dining. Restaurant that is in hotel is Asian cuisine and it was great! I would stay here again just because of this. Hotel was clean and comfortable sleeping. No loud noises or disturbances during my stay.

reviews.author: Rich C
reviews.title: Everything promised was delivered!!
reviews.body: Great location was expected, but the cleanliness of the rooms and the overall vibe from the staff was excellent. We will be back.

reviews.author: Chuck B
reviews.title: Great place to stay in downtown Chicago!
reviews.body: This hotel, on Hubbard near State Street, is steps away from all that downtown Chicago has to offer.

reviews.author: Spencer
reviews.title: Rooms may smell like marijuana. Shared stairwell means staff can’t address the problem.
reviews.body: I had probably the worst night at a Marriott at this hotel. At check in and at about 2 AM we had heavy marijuana smoke smell coming into the room. Gap on the bottom of the door was probably at least 3/4 inch, and a shared stairwell to a parking garage meant that people smoking in stairwell pushed smoke into room. Staff had not put an air purifiers out after calling 3 times in one day, and they couldn’t stop those who were smoking.

reviews.author: cabcro
reviews.title: Excellent location, clean and comfortable room, friendly staff
reviews.body: The location of this Courtyard met all of our needs on a recent baseball trip. Friendly greeting, valet available, easy check in, baggage services, clean common area and room, comfortable beds, quiet. There is a restaurant on premises for convenience. We have stayed here in he past and would not hesitate to again in the future.

reviews.author: Marilyn P
reviews.title: Nicest Staff!
reviews.body:
We had a delightful five-night stay at this hotel. Our room was spacious and comfortable, and we thoroughly enjoyed our time there. The front desk staff was exceptional; they were incredibly friendly and accommodating, making our stay even more enjoyable.

The noise outside was quite loud, and there was a firehouse just two blocks away. I had specifically requested a room that wasn’t connected to another, but unfortunately, I was given a room with a connecting door to another room, which meant we could hear the guests next door. Despite this inconvenience, we were still able to sleep in a very comfortable bed.

The water pressure in the shower could have been improved, but it wasn’t a dealbreaker. The bathroom was pleasant, and I actually enjoyed having the sink outside the toilet and shower. Overall, our stay was positive, and we would still recommend it.

reviews.author: C Lee
reviews.title: Thank you Rodney (Staff)
reviews.body: The staff, room and amenities were great. I loved that this location was nestled in a neighborhood that was close to go to restaurants, shopping and the river. Everything was in walking distance for me and I really enjoyed my stay at this location. Once again, Thank You to Rodney who listened, took action, kept me updated and had taken action to assist me! I am appreciative of his assistance.

reviews.author: AHK
reviews.title: Just what I needed!
reviews.body: Room, lobby, staff, and location met my every expectation!

reviews.author: T Knab
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Wonderful staff and great location. Busy weekend but the staff never made us feel like a number always a pleasure to interact with.

reviews.author: No
reviews.title: None
reviews.body: The server was not wow Service the cleaning was OK but the Employee did not really greet you or notify you a good morning. How acknowledge you

reviews.author: Sarah R
reviews.title: Chicago VNL Visit
reviews.body: My teenage daughters and I traveled to Chicago from S Florida for a US Mens Volleyball VNL game and college visit. The hotel was clean and our room was spacious. All the staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. The location was prefect for all the things we wanted to do and see. Close to CTA stops but also close enough to most attractions to walk, if we wanted. My only suggestion for the hotel is put larger refrigerators in the suites. We would have loved to have more fridge space for groceries and takeout. Overall, we had a great stay and would definitely recommend the hotel to others.

reviews.author: Southern Gal
reviews.title: Great location and staff
reviews.body: The location is convenient to many restaurants and local events/shops. Very friendly and accommodating staff. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lori
reviews.title: Friendly, helpful service
reviews.body: Be prepared for a very soft mattress.  Nice room and bathroom, decor could be more cohesive.

reviews.author: Chris D
reviews.title: Friendly Service
reviews.body: We were very pleased with the help and support on all issues that arose. The staff are extremely friendly. When we arrived from the airport several hours prior to check in they were able to secure a room, at no cost for our group, to store our bags until the the rest of group could check in. We were truly happy to be treated so kindly during our entire visit to Chicago for a family wedding.

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.body: The views are of a brick wall. There is no preferential treatment for gold members. The rooms are small. The lighting is horrible. They must use 40wt bulbs. I wont stay here again. There are nicer, cheaper hotels than this.

reviews.author: JayCee
reviews.title: Locked out of my room, noisy, not a true Marriott stay, except Javier and Fannie
reviews.body:
I booked this hotel on the Marriott Bonvoy site for a business trip Sept 13–16 thinking it was a Marriott property. It is a privately run Fairfield franchise. That was not obvious when I booked.
On the second day I returned to find I had been checked out by mistake. I could not access my room or my belongings, and there had been no housekeeping. I had to “extend” the stay just to get back in. That is not a smooth or stress-free stay.
The room had paper-thin walls. Hallway noise came straight in. A constant high-pitched mechanical/turbine sound from outside was clearly audible on the 14th floor and was migraine-inducing. I only slept because I had noise-cancelling headphones. The room also did not smell right when I first walked in; I opened the window to air it out.
Breakfast was paper plates and flimsy individually wrapped plastic forks. Not what I expect at this rate.
Javier and Fannie in the breakfast room were fantastic — warm, professional, and the only reason anyone should consider this hotel. They were the one part of the stay that felt like real hospitality.
For about $500 a night I expected reliable access to my room and a quiet place to rest. I did not get that. I would not book this property again

reviews.author: Debra Juchemich
reviews.title: Top Quality
reviews.body:
Everything about this hotel is quality.
From the minute,you walk in the door, the staff is extremely helpful and friendly. The hotel is very clean. We very much enjoyed the breakfast buffet.
When you combine this with the great location, it is very recommended.

reviews.author: J White
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay With Cleanliness, Noise and Billing Issues
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, I was disappointed with my stay at the Fairfield Inn & Suites Chicago Downtown/River North.

The bathroom floor was grossly sticky. It was so bad that my slippers actually made suction noises as I walked across it, which made me question how thoroughly the floor had been cleaned.

The bathroom lighting was also terrible. The only lighting was a very soft, warm glow that might be fine for ambiance, but it was completely inadequate for getting ready and applying makeup.

Another thing to be aware of is the location next to a fire station. I understand that this is outside the hotel’s control, but prospective guests should know to expect sirens during the night. I was awakened by them one or more times each night.

Finally, I was charged for high-speed internet despite being a Lifetime Platinum Elite member. Getting the charge corrected required multiple calls, which was frustrating and should not have been necessary.

Between the cleanliness issue, poor bathroom lighting, nighttime noise and the billing problem, this stay did not meet the standard I expected from a Marriott property.

reviews.author: Beth
reviews.title: Central location, clean
reviews.body: Central location for transportation options and walkability. No views. Breakfast was almost identical for three consecutive mornings - no variation in pastries, for example.

reviews.author: Z Gon
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.body: Excellent place to stay. Clean and well located. Breakfast service was amazing.

reviews.author: Dave R
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body:
Location is great - convenient to restaurants, bars, shopping, and river walk.
Staff were all very friendly and helpful.
Fannie at breakfast was fantastic! Helpful, friendly, remembered me each day, went above and beyond by helping us with some food to go ( we were there for Triathlon and needed something we could take along as we didn’t have time to eat there that day). 
She is a gem!

reviews.author: Are Paris
reviews.title: Friendly staff, clean hotel. Great location!
reviews.body: Friendly staff, clean hotel. Great location! I’d stay here again.

reviews.author: Nancy
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.body: My friends are very satisfied with the service, prompt service, clean rooms friendly staff. Will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Kayleen
reviews.title: Perfect Stay + Location!
reviews.body: The staff here were amazing! Everyone was so kind and attentive, and professional. The hotel was very clean, and in a great location to be able to explore the city. We would definitely stay here again! I was impressed.

reviews.author: Ksmsu
reviews.title: Friendliest staff
reviews.body:
This hotel was beautiful and clean. The staff at the valet parking and front desk were phenomenal.
The staff working the breakfast were the friendliest I have ever encountered at a hotel breakfast

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Average Quality-Great Location
reviews.body: The location is great and the price was acceptable. The shower drain was clogged and the shower handle broken. The breakfast was subpar with little variety or quality. The beds were comfortable and the room was acceptable in terms of cleanliness.  Overall, an okay property for the price compared to surrounding hotels. Everything is within walking distance.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.body: I was more than happy and satisfied with my stay at this Fairfield Marriott hotel. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. My room was spacious, clean and comfortable. The hotel is located within walking distance to all major tourist restaurants and attractions and a short ride share ride to all major Chicago entertainment attractions. I will definitely make this hotel my hotel of choice when traveling to Chicago in the future. Thank you for being hospitable and welcoming with me on my first visit to Chicago.

reviews.author: Rajesh
reviews.title: Great location and service
reviews.body: I visited with my family for 3 day trip and I loved the stay with super city view !! Great location and around 1 mile away to all the major attractions!! The front desk is very helpful!

reviews.author: Challis
reviews.title: Exceptional service
reviews.body: The staff were extremely friendly. Very nice rooms with great views.

reviews.author: Nschoonover
reviews.title: Perfect hotel for our family in Chicago
reviews.body: We love this hotel this was our 3rd stay. Everything was perfect for us. We really like the King Studio, location, and value of this hotel! Javier and Fanny take it up a notch at breakfast!

reviews.author: Selena Pug
reviews.title: Thank you for a wonderful stay! Will stay here again!
reviews.body: Whole experience was great! Easy and great customer service! Facility was clean and well kept. Thank you! We would stay here again!

reviews.title: Chicago weekend
reviews.body: Hotel staff were courtesy and friendly. Rooms were clean and comfortable. Breakfast was a good way to start the day. The staff within the breakfast area offered advice on what to see and do.

reviews.author: Harmony
reviews.title: Girls Trip Success
reviews.body: Went for a 4 night stay with friends.  Close to everything and great restaurants just outside the door.  The beds were very comfortable and appreciated the daily room service for fresh towels. Only miss was a fan in the bathroom, but room was comfortable and staff were friendly.   Would defiantly stay again.

reviews.author: LAS
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: We had a great stay!  The staff was very friendly and helpful!!

reviews.author: J Lang
reviews.title: Chicago
reviews.body: Excellent location and friendly staff.  Clean and easy to navigate.

reviews.author: New experience
reviews.title: Unexpected experience.
reviews.body: Didn’t expect this kind of service from a hotel that belongs to Marriott chain .

reviews.author: Ricky S
reviews.title: The little things
reviews.body: Everyone on staff was beyond kind and seemed genuinely happy to be at work. We were greeted so kindly when we arrived and from that moment every staff member we encountered always asked about our stay. This hotel was in a great spot, the only downside is they're directly across the street from a fire station, but even that was thought of with ear plugs in the room. Should I return to Chicago for an overnight stay, I will return to this hotel.

reviews.author: CparkFleisch
reviews.title: Loud, dark and mediocre stay
reviews.body: Room was dark even with all lights on.  Ice machine broken, no usb ports.  Hotel is across from the fire department .  While it’s not the fault of the hotel, the sirens are very loud and constant.  It was impossible to sleep.  Parking cost was excessive.  Much better options at or below this price point.

reviews.author: FZ
reviews.title: happy with our stay
reviews.body:
Great location for reaching all the main points of interest. The room was comfortable and clean. The reception staff were very kind and always available to help with any request.

The breakfast was good and more than enough to start the day.

A special thank you to Javier and Fannie for welcoming us every morning with a smile and for always being so helpful, especially since we were traveling with our 15-month-old child. They were always patient and ready to assist us with anything we needed.

Overall, we were extremely satisfied with our stay and will definitely return to this hotel!

reviews.author: Go Cubs
reviews.title: Javier FTW
reviews.body: I really enjoy the location of the hotel and the proximity to a parking garage and also the Red Line. Also easy walks to a bus stop to go to Navy Pier, or also within easy walking distance of Michigan Ave. Also close to Walgreens and a Target location. Javier and the folks in the kitchen / breakfast area make this location though.

reviews.author: Lisa Thomas
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: We had a great stay at this hotel! The staff were amazing, from check in to breakfast!  It’s also conveniently located to everything!  The rooms were cleaned. The kids loved eating breakfast and watching the action at the fire station. The staff at breakfast kept everything stocked and cleaned! We can’t wait to go back.

reviews.author: Pam and Bud
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.body: Wonderful staff.  The front desk was always there to help from the moment we arrived (getting my husband a wheelchair) to the moment we left (helping to get a cab and us in it). The breakfast staff notably, Javier and Fannie, were exceptional.  Although we were initially super nervous going to breakfast with the wheelchair, their welcoming manner and help changed all that.  We are forever grateful!

reviews.author: Sa
reviews.title: Problems with checkin and checkout
reviews.body: Wrong billing of parking on checkout.  Could not checkin 1 hour earlier unless we pay extra.

reviews.author: AG
reviews.title: Excellent location; nicely decorated hotel
reviews.body:
There is a unique charm to this hotel with how it is decorated and kept with. The location is excellent - you can use Muni transport right opposite also close to many locations such as Japantown (amazing food options) and various SF locations. 

Food options inside hotel are limited to none- hotel is adjacent (share walls) to a restaurant and there are many options nearby.

reviews.author: MM
reviews.title: Business trip A+
reviews.body: This hotel was very convenient to nice restaurants, coffee, shops, and shopping. I was there for business and it was easy to work in the lobby, business center, and then unwind enjoying San Francisco.

reviews.author: Appreciated guest
reviews.title: Medical
reviews.body: Convenient location quality hotel

reviews.author: Amelia
reviews.title: Great location to go to a concert at the Filmore!
reviews.body: Love the location! Would definitely stay again.

reviews.author: Lady Nadie
reviews.title: Parking is Terrible
reviews.body:
Let me start by saying that the hotel itself - once you are inside - is beautiful.  The rooms, while a little small, are very nice, well decorated, clean, well supplied, and have lovely bathrooms/showers.  However, the outside is where everything falls apart.

Upon our arrival, we were told that we could not park in the hotel's parking lot because we did not have a room number, in spite of the fact that we had a confirmation number for our reservation.  We were told that we needed to find outside parking on the street and then come in to the front desk.  For those unfamiliar with downtown San Francisco, there is pretty much zero outside parking and the process of navigating the city through it's various alleyways and streets upon which you cannot turn left or right makes finding the way back to the hotel to look for parking a stress-inducing experience.

After finally finding a parking space and checking in with the front desk we were informed that the hotel's parking lot was full and that we would have to use the public parking garage across the street.  What they don't tell you is that once you leave the elevator from that parking garage, you are in the lobby of another building, in front of an interior movie theater, and at least 100 to 200 feet from the building's entrance/exit.  So even after you exit the parking garage, you have to parade your luggage in front of the movie theater, through the building's lobby, and out into the streets of downtown San Francisco as you cross the street to the hotel.

I do want to reiterate that the hotel itself is lovely and beautiful and were in practically in any other location, I would be delighted to stay there again.  However, for someone unprepared for the situation in downtown San Francisco, the parking situation alone is enough to ensure that if I were to ever return it would not be to this Marriot location.

reviews.author: Karen
reviews.title: Compassion at the Courtyard
reviews.body: I stayed at this beautiful hotel for 10 nights while my husband underwent Quadruple Bypass Surgery at UCSF.  The compassion showed by the Manager David was unbelievable.  He made sure that all my visiting family were able to get rooms even though it was the weekend of a huge music event at Golden Gate Park.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Rude staff!
reviews.body:
From the time I arrived the staff were rude and treated us as if we were a nuisance.  The hotel room was noisy from an a/c unit outside the window and the carpet was dirty.  
There were drug addicts outside the hotel shooting up.  Worst experience I have ever had.  I left the hotel and went to another one and didn't stay.

reviews.author: JGLUX
reviews.title: Beautiful and Unique Hotel Experience
reviews.body: This Marriott has a beautiful and unique design that charmed me. I got a room upgrade to a king bed on the 4th floor overlooking the streets of San Francisco. It felt very cozy but not cramped and i loved the style of the bathroom. The shower was terrific! I loved getting to gaze out the window. The staff were warm and professional and even offered to hold my luggage before my checkout to go explore the city. While parking may be a bit cramped, the hotel is secure and offers a wonderful lobby and business area to relax and work if you like to get out your room. I hope to return again when I am not working to see more of San Francisco and stay in this wonderful Marriott! I love how I can always depend on Marriott for its quality.

reviews.author: Brynn
reviews.title: Great property
reviews.body: The hotel was very clean, and Montel, who checked us in, was so kind and helpful. He made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived and made check-in super easy. The restaurant attached was nice for a quick bite to eat.

reviews.author: Gw
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.body: Beautiful building, great staff and rooms

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.body: Loved the hotel decor and hospitality, would definitely recommend this hotel for a couple, it was a small room for more than 2 and the area the hotel was located wasn’t the best area in town. We felt safe with all the hotel security but the outside area was very homeless.

reviews.author: Johnson
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Great location. Sabitha at checkin was very accommodating and friendly

reviews.author: Kevin L
reviews.title: Marisella in front desk was awesome!!
reviews.body: Marisella from front desk was amazing and made the experience perfect.  Thank you!!

reviews.author: Sonia
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.body:
Horrible experience!!
Never will book again!!!

reviews.author: Good value
reviews.title: Good value
reviews.body: Good location near union Square and nice Marriott hotel

reviews.author: DN Thomas
reviews.title: Clean, convenient place to stay in SF!
reviews.body: I stay at Courtyard Marriott on Van Ness due to it's central proximity and location to the Golden Gate Transit bus stop directly out front and to many music venues in the vicinity. I come down from Santa Rosa for music and other events and it's an affordable, clean option. Staff is always polite and helpful.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Just What the Doctor Ordered
reviews.body: Comfortable and welcoming place to stay while being close to family hospitalized at CPMC.

reviews.author: Lou
reviews.title: Excellent stay with courteous and hospitable staff!
reviews.body: Thank you for making our stay wonderful. Your staff was hospitable and kind!

reviews.author: californiamom
reviews.title: Very disappointed. Do not stay here!!
reviews.body: When we arrived. The parking lot was full. We could not park our car near the hotel. We had to park on the street. We had to search for parking for over 45 mins. The area is not the best. It was very dirty, homeless, and drug addicts everywhere. If you have a family do not bring them there. The reservation clerk was not friendly. She was irritated with the gentleman before us. The room was tiny. One of the smallest hotel rooms we have ever stayed in.

reviews.author: SS
reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.body: Every employee at this property is amazing and the property is very cute, well maintained, clean and the overall feeling is that every person who works there is empowered to do anything possible make your stay perfect.

reviews.author: MoniH
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel with a lovely modern design. Room was wonderful and modern as well. And had best bedding ever! It was incredibly comfortable! Slept like a baby!

reviews.author: CF
reviews.title: Small, but well done!
reviews.body: We stayed for 2 nights for our daughter’s wedding at City Hall. The hotel is comfortable, quiet and welcoming. The rooms are very small, but I was surprised how comfortable I felt in the space. I would recommend!

reviews.author: Aleks JH
reviews.title: One of the best places to stay in San Francisco
reviews.body: This hotel is so wonderful. It has so much character and charm. It is very clean and safe, the front desk and all staff is very welcoming and professional. The location is truly perfect, right by the theaters (ballet, opera, symphony), walking distance to Hayes Valley with so many amazing restaurants, and Japan Town. There is a new movie theater building right next to it.  I love this hotel.

reviews.author: SF101
reviews.title: Great Location and Service
reviews.body: The location is great for access to the bus, Uber, and Lyft.  Two major one-way streets (East and West directions) are very close to the hotel.  A Starbucks is also nearby.  My room was on the third floor and faced Van Ness but was very quiet.  The only noise I heard came from the neighboring room when the occupant returned late one night.  Parking is easily accessed and my friend was able to use the lot to drop me off.

reviews.author: Mark F
reviews.title: Disappointment on Venice Street in San Francisco.
reviews.body: A Marriott has a certain panache, and this did not. As a goal elite member normally you are greeted and offered a small upgrade for some type of refreshment. There was no coffee there was no cream for the coffee. There were no Keurig machines there was nothing to single out this hotel as a Marriott property. Also, there were no down/feather pillows just the very thick foam uncomfortable ones.

reviews.author: JO Reno
reviews.title: Quick Trip to downtown SF
reviews.body: I am a former San Francisco resident and needed a hotel for a very early appt nearby the following morning.  The Van Ness Marriott was a perfect location and the front desk staff was excellent.

reviews.author: J R
reviews.title: My stay in San Francisco
reviews.body: Parking is a bit tight so careful if you have a big car...room was small and if you need ice please get it before you retire for the evening.

reviews.author: Jill W
reviews.title: Fun in SF!!
reviews.body: Great location, fun, friendly and great vibe!  Definitely would stay again!!

reviews.author: Saf3
reviews.title: Fun hotel
reviews.body: Hotel and staff was awesome. Mattresses were very uncomfortable after 10 days.

reviews.author: Ecast
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: The staff demonstrated exceptional courtesy and provided valuable assistance, exhibiting comprehensive knowledge of the local area and available amenities. The accommodations were impeccably clean and remarkably well-appointed. I would unequivocally choose to stay here again.

reviews.author: Max
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Nicely furnished, slow wifi under construction. Not in union square only a few blocks away though

reviews.author: Robert I
reviews.title: Better luck next time
reviews.body:
I would not recommend this hotel to my worst friends. 
I was told when making my reservation that breakfast was included/complementary. It was not
The coffee bar was not refreshed.
The bottled water was not restocked
Bed was not made, only pulled back up. 
The towels were placed on the bed instead of placing them back in the restroom.
Overall very poor for the price.

reviews.author: Hill
reviews.title: Weekend Stay
reviews.body: My experience was not the best.

reviews.author: Alessandro
reviews.title: Good option, decent price
reviews.body: This is a good option if you are planning a visit in SF, excellent position, well maintained room. Only the shower was not up to quality of the rest of the experience

reviews.author: J
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: Staff was great and everything ran smoothly

reviews.author: Fernando
reviews.title: Great Hotel Stay
reviews.body: Clean rooms, great service & friendly staff.

reviews.author: Petersen stay
reviews.title: Union Square Marriott
reviews.body: Not worth the money, considering what’s avalable

reviews.author: Unhappy customer
reviews.title: Dissapointing Service for a Special Occasion
reviews.body:
I stayed at this hotel to celebrate my 30th birthday and, as a Marriott Bonvoy member with status, I expected a much better level of communication and professionalism.

Prior to arriving, I called the hotel specifically to confirm early check-in and also received confirmation through the Marriott app. Despite this, when I arrived, the interaction with the front desk was unnecessarily frustrating. Rather than acknowledging the prior confirmation and helping resolve the situation, the staff became argumentative and confrontational, repeatedly emphasizing that I had a « place in line » which increased in number when I called again. 

I understand that early check-in can sometimes depend on room availability. My frustration was not simply that the room wasn’t immediately ready. it was how the situation was handled. There was very little effort to communicate clearly, provide an estimated timeframe, or make the interaction feel welcoming. I also felt that the tone was belittling as well as rude frankly.

I was also told I would be notified when the room was ready, but I never received direct communication from the staff. I ultimately saw the room-ready notification through the Marriott app and returned based on that.

For a stay that was meant to celebrate a milestone birthday, the experience was disappointing. A hospitality issue can usually be resolved with good communication and courteous service, but unfortunately that was missing here. I expected a much more professional and guest-focused experience from a Marriott property.

reviews.author: Keith
reviews.title: Family stay
reviews.body: Everything was amazing. Staff was very helpful.

reviews.author: NK
reviews.title: Amazing staff, terrible location, cramped bathroom.
reviews.body:
Stayed 6 nights. Very friendly and helpful staff. However, the hotel’s location is not ideal, although there is not much that can be done about that. As long as you stay on the street where the hotel is located, you’re fine, but we didn’t feel comfortable walking farther away. We ended up taking an Uber to find a safe restaurant nearby.

The bathroom was extremely cramped and smelled like mold. It could use some updates, such as replacing the shower curtains with walk-in showers or glass doors. Overall, the friendly staff was definitely a plus, but the bathroom could use some improvement.

reviews.author: Julianne D
reviews.title: Extremely Helpful Staff
reviews.body: Thank you for such a clean, easy, and pleasant experience. The room and service were wonderful! A special thank you to the valet services for accommodating my oversized vehicle and putting my mind at ease from any safety concerns. Edmond and Eugene did amazing at accommodating us!

reviews.author: Close to Amtrak
reviews.title: Exceptional Customer Service
reviews.body: Fabulous stay. Hotel was very clean,  convenient location and a Five Star Customer Service. The staff was amazing from check in to check out. We had a couple in our group that had been unexpectedly gifted a very late cruise ship cabin upgrade which called for immediate change of documents. The staff happily printed off their new boarding passes and luggage tags. I will most certainly style here next time in San Francisco.

reviews.author: JT Weekend Travelers
reviews.title: A Solid Stay with Standard Service
reviews.body: Overall, a good stay and I would absolutely stay here again. Everything was comfortable and met expectations, though our experience was fairly standard—nothing spectacular, but certainly nothing negative either. The standout was the doorman team, who consistently went above and beyond to keep an eye out for our Ubers and transportation and made coming and going incredibly easy. Great service from them!

reviews.author: Elina
reviews.title: Better options available
reviews.body: I wouldn’t recommend, there are better options available for the price point.

reviews.author: Omar Iglesias
reviews.title: Staff Friendliness is N/A and cleanliness of Room
reviews.body:
Staff isn’t friendly when asking questions and also combative with responsive/ ugly. 
 
Cafe was closed on a Monday 12pm time. 

Bathroom was also dirty once we were checked in

reviews.author: Bmw78
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Very comfortable room, small but bed was comfortable. Nice to have a fridge in the room as well. Marilyn at the front desk was very helpful even offered a late checkout when we checked in. Area around hotel does have quite a few homeless people but no one bothers you. Good restaurants and bars close by as well as a Trader Joe’s. Would definitely stay again

reviews.author: TG26
reviews.title: Courtyard Union Square
reviews.body: The hotel itself is clean, but dated.  Its location is on the edge of a rough neighborhood.  The restaurant/bar is under staffed (only 1 employee acting as bartender cook and waiter). Everyone on staff was friendly and kind.

reviews.author: Lady
reviews.title: Best Hotel Stay
reviews.body: Location was great lots of walking distance food options! View from our room was nice, staff is friendly and relatable! Definitely will stay again for future visits.

reviews.author: Sid
reviews.title: Enjoyed the stay
reviews.body: Excellent location, clean rooms and common space, complimentary water and coffee, courteous staff – especially Chris (the one with the orange hat) – who was extremely helpful and friendly. Got early check-in at 1 PM and extended check-out to 1 PM. Worth the money spent.

reviews.author: EB and KP
reviews.title: Not at the Marriott level.
reviews.body: This Hotel fell far below expectations in location, parking , restaurant.

reviews.author: Ann Carmel
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Great staff, the valet, the front desk, and everyone were so helpful and accommodating. We had a great stay.

reviews.author: 4URWealth com
reviews.title: Excellent Staff
reviews.body:
I was very satisfied with my stay, I needed something to make my stay more comfortable and it was supplied almost immediately. The room was on the small side and might have been a bit tight if I had a 2nd person or if I  needed more counter space in the bathroom (my wife would have had an issue) but I was very comfortable & the staff was really superlative. 

I'm a frequent business traveler & I appreciate that the room had a safe, closets, a desk and a bureau & an Iron w/ board which I  needed-- my suit and shirts needed a refresh before my meetings also I appreciated the room lighting (sounds like a small thing) but the room had natural light (no weird blue light LED's)  --as a frequent traveler I run into the blue light a lot & it actually makes traveling much more stressful.  I know it's a small thing to mention here but, to me, the small touches matter & show that they care. To that point I want to mention that the management puts out homemade cookies, in the lobby, every night-- Nice touch!!!  I've been to San Fran many times and this was a first. Next I want to mention this comment, in general, for folks who haven't t been to this city before:  the hotel was great but in any hotel in this city please make sure you get yourself a good paper map and orient yourself correctly. A wrong turn could, in a few blocks, put you in "the Tenderloin" area of the city - in my opinion you don't want to subject your family to that part of the city -- I'm sure the hotel staff will happily help you get properly oriented.

reviews.author: MJ
reviews.title: The Friendliest Staff
reviews.body: The staff here are the kindest and friendliest in The City!

reviews.author: Yunni17
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.body: The hotel is in good condition, within walking distance of Powell Street. The room is comfortable and clean. The customer service of the team was warm and welcoming.

reviews.author: Shopping
reviews.title: Shopping
reviews.body: Perfect location and enjoyable stay

reviews.author: JW
reviews.title: Fantastic staff but sketchy locale
reviews.body: Despite arriving near midnight and a full lobby, staff welcomed me warmly. The elevator had an alarming shake near the top floors and the bathroom wasn't spotless. Otherwise, the hotel, amenities, and staff were great! The only reason that I would not choose this location again is the surroundings. I did not feel safe on the street.

reviews.author: AndrewInSanFran
reviews.title: Excellent customer service, excellent stay
reviews.body: Edmon in the man!! Would consider staying here again solely because of him. Very helpful and friendly. Clean room, centralized location.

reviews.author: Yuliia
reviews.title: Fair value for money.
reviews.body: My daughter and I came to San Francisco on business. We stayed at this hotel for 4 days. We made the right choice. Polite staff, good service. The only disappointment was that breakfast was not included in the stay. If I come to this city again, I will stay here again.

reviews.author: Mel
reviews.title: Great for Nob Hill Union Square location.
reviews.body: I was in town visiting my daughter. This was a great location to come and go throughout the day and be in a fun San Francisco area without too much noise. I was able to walk to the hotel from the BART, also easily accessible for bus and ride share. Room was the great size for me. The bathroom counter space is very limited, which is common for hotels in that area, but the wall mirror solved the issue.

reviews.author: Ray Ray
reviews.title: A magical stay
reviews.body: Our time here was absolute Kudos-worthy. From the seamless check-in logistics to the pristine, aesthetic room setup, every single detail was brilliantly managed. The entire vibe felt like a premium upgrade from the daily hustle. Massive appreciation to the incredible team for their flawless coordination and hospitality—this experience truly deserved a spot on the Peacock track of our itinerary. We cannot wait to colour our future travel plans with a return visit!

reviews.author: Axel
reviews.title: Hands Down..SF Best Boutique Hotel!
reviews.body: I had a wonderful experience at Hotel Adagio San Francisco. From the moment I arrived, the hotel had a welcoming atmosphere and a unique charm that made my stay feel special. The stylish design and character of the property really stood out, while the staff were friendly, professional, and attentive throughout my visit. My room was comfortable, clean, and provided a relaxing place to unwind after exploring the city. I also enjoyed the overall location and convenience of being close to many of San Francisco’s attractions. The combination of great service, comfortable accommodations, and distinctive atmosphere made this a memorable stay.

reviews.author: Janet from Sac
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel near Union Square
reviews.body: Had a short but amazing visit to Hotel Adagio.  Bar and restaurant were spot on!  Near Union Square. Rooms were well equipped, clean and quiet.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Amazing Properrty
reviews.body: Wonderful hotel in a great area of San Francisco. I come to San Francisco 6 times a year for business and this is the only hotel I choose.  Amazing staff, so friendly and outgoing.  Great food at the bar.  Spacious rooms and very clean along with well appointment common areas.  10 out of 10 stars!

reviews.author: vtxrider
reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.body: My second time staying here. This hotel is an older building but updated in sort of a rough neighbourhood afterhours but its closeness to the business district of downtown and overall accommodations and service offered, I will likely chose the Adagio for all of my future stays.

reviews.author: pat b
reviews.title: Beautiful property, outstanding staff
reviews.body: Hotel Adagio is my SF home. The staff is absolutely phenomenal. Elliot’s, Mortimer, the front desk, flawless. Seeing them is a highlight whenever I’m in SF

reviews.author: Ben B
reviews.title: Avoid this Property
reviews.body: Had stayed at Hotel Adagio once prior and enjoyed it. This was a business stay, and my husband tagged along. It was an extremely unpleasant stay. There were a number of issues we experienced, and we'd asked to be contacted by management but have not heard anything. As an Ambassador Elite, I'll be sure to avoid this property moving forward. At best, this is a 3-star property. For the price, you'd be far better off at the Courtyard.

reviews.author: Benson
reviews.title: First Time in San Francisco
reviews.body: From the moment we arrived until we checked out the staff at the Adagio was superb. The desk staff, the Bellman (Tuan), the bartender at Mortimers (Kinga) and the wait staff in Elliott's were all the best I have encountered in a hotel. I would not hesitate to recommend the Hotel Adagio to a friend or business associate.

reviews.author: AR Mull
reviews.title: Great hotel and staff
reviews.body: Hotel was nice and staff were excellent.

reviews.author: Dylan
reviews.title: Very accommodating staff.
reviews.body: My wife and I stayed here for a convention and had booked the wrong dates, the staff were very accommodating and gorlt us into the last room available and allowed us to check in early. As Titanium Elite members we frequent Marriotts often and this has been one of our most pleasant experiences.

reviews.author: Monica S
reviews.title: Great stay at Adagio!
reviews.body: This is fully modernized and renovated hotel which was built is 1929. It is warm, beautiful, and close to transit, shopping, food. The accommodations were comfortable and clean. What made our visit so special was the staff. We were warmly greeted by Gabe who checked us in, explained everything we needed to know and acknowledged our status. He kept our luggage until we check in when our room was ready. Tuan, the bellman, greeted us with two glasses of champagne, and said hello every time we came into the hotel. He was outstanding, professional, and made our stay! Chris, front desk, greeted us and assisted us getting settled. He made us laugh and was efficient and personable. Our waitress at breakfast, Ailia, served us with utmost kindness and kept our coffee mugs full! The food was top notch. Kinga, our Mortimer bartender, served the perfect gin martini and was engaging, sweet, and took very good care of us. We spoke with the manager, Diego, was was available and approachabe, to compliment on his staff. He welcomed our feedback and wanted to ensure we enjoyed our stay. It is the top level of service that made our stay at the Adagio one of the best places in SF. Thank you to all!!!

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Not up to Marriott standards
reviews.body: The staff was amazing but in terms of standards this hotel did not live up to it. It is quite old and definitely not renovated or majorly maintained for a while. I stay in the Marriott chain all around the world and I was quite surprised with the standard here. Wanted to surprise my husband with a great start to our holiday but that really wasn’t that. The staff and the location was the only thing that I can give really 5 stars to otherwise a definite fail. Also the price for parking (79 USD per night) is atrocious taking everything else into account.

reviews.author: YosemiteMom
reviews.title: Small town family went the big city
reviews.body:
If you’re from a small town the location of hotel in SF, is going to be a lot. If you’re from a large metro area the activity around the hotel probably won’t bother you. 
Inside the hotel was nice, I wish we would’ve been able to try the food or drinks. 
We live in a place with more trees than humans, so it was a lot more than we were prepared for.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Giants Game Weekend
reviews.body: Saw the Hotel Adagio was within walking distance of the Giants game/ Oracle Park and other San Francisco attractions. Fun  unique hotel, great staff, very fair price.

reviews.author: Libby R
reviews.title: Ready to be dazzled
reviews.body: Our stay was an unexpected delight! From staff to room to restaurant everything on point

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Ed Lambert
reviews.body: The Adagio is our favorite place to stay when in San Francisco. Traditional Marriot top-tier levels of service in a beautiful setting with a great location.

reviews.author: MoniLove TX
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.body: Beds were super comfortable. Probably one of the best ever experiences. Room was quiet, clean and cozy. Cute lodging and friendly staff.

reviews.author: KGB1108
reviews.title: Great experience and friendly staff
reviews.body: Amazing 🤩 experience overall. Great location. Linen fresh and silky, felt like home. Staff friendly always.

reviews.author: Solo traveler
reviews.title: Flor runs the show
reviews.body: The single individual Flor exceeded my expectations.  She is Director of Operations.  Extremely valuable I to this hotel.

reviews.author: Jurga
reviews.title: Excellent hotel! Clean, comfortable, and in a great location.
reviews.body: Excellent hotel! Clean, comfortable, and in a great location. There were several convenient parking options nearby. It's a shame we could only stay for one night due to our flight being canceled. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Molly
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!
reviews.body: Great stay from start to finish! The hotel was clean, comfortable, and the staff was friendly and welcoming. One of the highlights was the bar—the Street Car cocktail was fantastic and definitely worth trying. It was a relaxing place to unwind after a day of exploring. I'd happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Phoenix traveller
reviews.title: Outstanding hotel and staff
reviews.body: Tony, Francisco, Thanks and Angela provided outstanding customer service and always went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and assist us with everything we needed!

reviews.author: Matt Giordano
reviews.title: A perfect place to call home while in San Fran
reviews.body: I've stayed at Hotel Adagio twice now and have been beyond happy with the accommodations and service provided by this hotel.  I feel very secure in parking my vehicle with the valet in the lot next door to the hotel.  That provides a good peace of mind.  The hotel rooms are immaculate and front desk attendants are very helpful with information, the complimentary glass of champagne or in our case, granting a little later checkout time.  I'd highly recommend this property as a place to call home while you're in San Francisco.

reviews.author: Nikhil
reviews.title: Good location & service
reviews.body: The hotel made me feel good being a Marriott platinum elite member unlike some of the courtyards. The location was also great to add to that.

reviews.author: JohnH
reviews.title: Need to do better
reviews.body: Disappointed in customer service for a bill issue I had. The pricing on the mini bar is much cheaper than what the hotel will charge you. I feel as though that is deceptive pricing. I called the hotel once I reviewed my bill. I spoke to two individuals that said they’d fix the issue and never did. That’s disappointing customer service, thus the reason for my poor review. I expect better service, especially as a titanium member.

reviews.author: chris
reviews.title: last weekends stay
reviews.body: I have stayed here 2 times this year. I like the hotel and the bar and restaurant are good. I don't like waiting for a reserved room.

reviews.author: KimS
reviews.title: Nice location and great service
reviews.body: Our family if 4 enjoyed our stay during a recent trip to San Francisco. We were close to and within walking distance to several attractions. The neighborhood felt safe and the service at the hotel was excellent.

reviews.author: heyitsthatgirlANNA
reviews.title: Hidden gem in the heart of San Francisco's Union Square district
reviews.body: Cute, boutique style hotel located in the heart of San Francisco's Union Square district is a little treat of a hotel. It sits close to public transportation, eateries, and attractions - like San Francisco's Union Square. Service was top notch, every day we stayed. Rooms were nice and very clean. Elevators were in working order and the food/drinks at the bar/lounge was fresh and quench our thirst.

reviews.author: B1K2
reviews.title: Visit to San Fran
reviews.body: The staff was one of the best I have ever experienced. Definitely a 10 star hotel rating on how they welcomed you and made sure everything was fine. Offered a glass of champagne at checkin. Rooms and Hotel are very clean and the hotel is close to everything downtown.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Unclean
reviews.body: Very unclean, dirty pillows and a pubic hair was on my pillow after the room was supposed to be cleaned. And they charged me for a coke I bought in the airport.

reviews.author: HotelAdagioFreshAir
reviews.title: Excellent stay, great hotel, great staff
reviews.body: My wife and I wanted to stay centrally to downtown SFO but not in a mega-hotel, so we chose the Adagio. The staff was outstanding, food was excellent, and it has a great bar looking out on street traffic nearby. The room was comfortable and welcoming too.

reviews.author: Mathieu
reviews.title: Great location, solid value for money
reviews.body: Very happy with my stay at citizenM in San Francisco. Location was excellent, the room was clean and efficient, regularly cleaned. Recommend it as a landing point to go and explore the city!

reviews.author: Zady
reviews.title: Friendly Staff
reviews.body: Great location near Union Square for conferences in the city. Very friendly staff (Kitty and Oscar M) always there to help and accommodate.

reviews.author: enif
reviews.title: Smart, Stylish Value, and Just as Good as Taipei
reviews.body: Having stayed at citizenM in Taipei, I knew roughly what to expect, and the San Francisco location delivered the same excellent value. The rooms are compact but thoughtfully designed, with small touches everywhere that make the stay feel effortless and stylish. The quick self check-in and the lively, well-curated lobby lounge add to the experience. For a city as pricey as San Francisco, it's one of the smartest choices for comfort and design without overspending.

reviews.author: djane
reviews.title: Awesome stay
reviews.body: From the easy check in to easy check out, this place is great. Beds are extremely comfortable. This was our second time staying here. Bartender was very friendly as well. The Living Room is a great space~ we ordered dinner in and had a drink and played board games. Will be back again.

reviews.author: cbubs
reviews.title: Quietest urban hotel
reviews.body: This is the quietest urban hotel I've ever stayed in! I was VERY impressed and am now a huge fan of citizenM.

reviews.author: ABC123
reviews.title: Bugs in Bed + Cramped room
reviews.body: Stay was fine but bugs in the bed on our first night - had to change rooms at 2AM. Room was very cramped - not worth the price point.

reviews.author: kcarb020
reviews.title: Highly Recommended for Recreational visit TO SF
reviews.body: This was my first time in SF and I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone going there on vacation. Pretty conveniently located, you will still need to uber or take public transit ofc but the area is still walkable. The staff at this CitizenM specifically were so nice and helpful and the room was very clean.

reviews.author: mejys
reviews.title: Nice place, but not worth the price
reviews.body:
This is overall an okay place to stay for solo travelers. The rooms are small, but if you're alone it's fine. The ipad controls for the lights, curtains, and room temp are great. The water pressure in the shower is very poor, I did not like that at all. The security for the building is good, and the location close to the Powell Bart station is great. I would not suggest paying extra for breakfast; the food offered is very limited and there are plenty of cafes and bakeries around that offer more choices. 

The biggest problem with this hotel is the price point. They don't offer the standard hotel amenities, but charge standard hotel prices. The rooms are half as small as a regular hotel. There is no daily housekeeping, only an option for "light" housekeeping which is basically replacing towels and emptying trash and no cleaning. The canteen is mostly just pre-packaged snacks you can buy at a grocery store. Yet the price per night is the same or even higher than other 4-star hotels in the area that offer more traditional services. Why would I want to pay traditional hotel prices when staying at what reminds me more of a hostel than a hotel? 

If the price were reasonable for what few services they actually provide, I would recommend this place for bare bones solo travelers. However, at this current price point, I would recommend anyone considering staying here just get a room at the Westin a few blocks away. Similar price per night, but with all the traditional hotel services and amenities.

reviews.author: Annette
reviews.title: Camper Van Accommodations
reviews.body: This hotel is quite modern, and at first glance, it all seems pretty good. Until the staff literally tells you at check-in, "when you get up to your room, please don't call down and ask for a larger room, they are all the same size in this hotel". So we go upstairs to our room...150 square feet. The bed is shoved against the wall, therefore, the bedding just lays on top, no way to tuck it in on both sides. It has the open space equivalent to a small camper van. Two people really cannot be standing at the same time. You will need to shimmy past each other if one of you needs to get up to use the sink (in the common area), and one of you needs to use the toilet (in the same enclosure as the shower). The layout feels like your camping. There isn't even enough space for an ironing board in the room, so they mark the floors where you can find an ironing board (there were two floors for this out of at least 12 floors). This room was close in price to the W, which was about $15 more per night, but would have at least given two sides of a bed to access! I would not have to climb over my husband to use the loo in the middle of the night. Did I mention there are no outlets or charging ports on the window side of the bed at all? This hotel is a no for me.

reviews.author: hie72m
reviews.title: Why are there no water glasses in the rooms?
reviews.body: It's ridiculous that you have to go downstairs to the bar to ask for the most basic amenity of a glass. I don't understand why these aren't already in the room. There were glass bottles of water in the room, but it wasn't clear if these were complementary or charged for.

reviews.author: George718
reviews.title: We won't stay anywhere else!
reviews.body:
LOVE this place! Our second time here and we won't stay anywhere else! Rooms are modern and fun, but it's the AMAZING staff that counts! Every staff memeber we encountered aren't just exceptional hosts, they're exceptional people! If you like a futuristic room where everything is run by an iPad--- lighting, blinds, TV---this is your place. Makes us sad we have to leave our friends at Citizen M. Hope to return soon! 

Show less

reviews.author: Party of One
reviews.title: Great location and amenities!
reviews.body: I had a great day at the citizenM union Square. This is the second citizenM property that I’ve stayed at, and it did not disappoint. It is conveniently located in the downtown area where you’ll find lots of different restaurants and activities to do.  Staff was friendly and welcoming, and the rooms are cozy. Highly recommend if you are traveling on a business trip or solo.

reviews.author: Fran88
reviews.title: Very good place
reviews.body: I liked to stay in Citizen, the room was clean, the personnel prepared and very supportive, place close to the subway. Excellent place

reviews.author: TimFerg
reviews.title: The 'must place to stay' in San Francisco
reviews.body:
If a good rate (I know, that can be a loaded statement in San Fran), great location, cool (not trying to hard) vibe and just what you need in a room is what you need for your next trip...this is your place!!!!

While you cannot beat the location, I always prefer the Union Square location over other neighborhoods, its the overall vibe and the staff (Ambassadors) excellence that sets this hotel apart from others in the area.  

This property 100% fulfills on the CitizenM promise with a warm, hip and welcoming central 'living room' for check in/out stuff, hanging out and meetings.

The room delivers on efficiency and cleanliness while offering everything you need for a comfortable stay with a minimalist mindset.

Finally, the experience starts from the moment you step out of the car.  The safety/security team takes an active interest in welcoming you to your home away for home.  I understand they serve a functional need, but their delivery clearly demonstrates they are part of the extended CitizenM family and not just an afterthought/necessity!

reviews.author: FabMo
reviews.title: Perfect spot for solo trip.
reviews.body: A five-star stay for a solo traveler who loves modern tech and a central location. Just plan to grab your morning coffee downstairs!

reviews.author: Davinci
reviews.title: Afffordable hotel in great location
reviews.body: Citizen M provides a clean affordable room with everything you need in it.

reviews.author: Alyssa G
reviews.title: Modern and Chic
reviews.body:
We stayed at the citizenM San Francisco Union Square during our trip, and it ended up being one of my favorite hotels we've stayed in.

The only tricky part was finding it. We actually walked right past it the first time because it's tucked into the building with just a small sign above the entrance. Once we found it, though, check-in was a breeze. Everything is self-service, so you check yourself in and even make your own room keys. The staff was nearby if you needed help, and everyone we interacted with was incredibly friendly.

One thing that really impressed us was that they let us check in around 11 a.m. at no extra charge, even though official check-in wasn't until later that afternoon. After an early flight, being able to drop off our bags and freshen up before exploring the city made such a difference.

The room itself is definitely compact. It reminded me of a tiny home or one of those beautifully designed camper vans where every inch of space is used efficiently. The bed takes up most of one side of the room, and while there wasn't much floor space for opening our suitcases, it worked perfectly for just the two of us. If you're traveling with several large bags, just know you'll be a little tight on space.

One of the coolest features was the iPad in the room. It controlled just about everything--the lights, curtains, room temperature, TV, and even housekeeping requests. You could even play relaxing white noise through the television, which was a nice touch after a busy day of sightseeing.

The lobby was another highlight. It has a fun, modern vibe with plenty of comfortable places to sit, and the staff even had a Polaroid camera they offered to use to take photos of guests. We left with one of our favorite souvenirs from the trip--a fun Polaroid of the two of us.

The hotel also has a rooftop area with great views of the city. A staff member lets you up, so just ask at the front desk if you'd like to check it out.

Location-wise, it couldn't have been much better. We were just a short walk from the cable car turnaround and several public transportation options, so we never needed to call an Uber during our stay. Even better, there was a Trader Joe's just around the corner where we stocked up on breakfast items, snacks, and drinks. It saved us a lot of money instead of eating out for every meal.

Although we didn't purchase breakfast at the hotel, it smelled amazing every morning and looked like a great option if you wanted the convenience.

There were a couple of minor downsides. The bed was much firmer than I prefer, and each person is only given one pillow. We probably could have asked for extras, but we didn't.
