Since the bed is really the only place to sit in the room, having a second pillow to prop yourself up while watching TV or relaxing would have made it much more comfortable. There was also construction taking place outside the hotel during our stay. It didn't bother us for most of the trip since we were out exploring, but on our last morning--the one day we had planned to sleep in--they started drilling fairly early, so that wasn't ideal.

Even with those small drawbacks, we absolutely loved our stay. The unique design, amazing location, friendly staff, and thoughtful touches made this one of our favorite hotels. We'd definitely stay here again the next time we're in San Francisco.

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.title: The perfect budget hotel
reviews.body: Intelligently designed for comfort and efficiency. Well managed, friendly, clean.

reviews.author: Liz71
reviews.title: Great stay in the city
reviews.body: The people who worked for the hotel were very friendly and helpful, the room was clean, small but very modern, and had everything I needed. It’s in the financial district and I had to go to the visa center just a block away and I could walk. Felt safe as a female traveling alone. Had a fun, friendly vibe

reviews.author: Brianfizzy
reviews.title: Hipster Hotel in SF Homeless Hotspot.
reviews.body:
Nice clean & comfy ultra modern small room, in a very dicey part of SF. Sad situation with many loud and aggressive homeless lurking in places outside the Hotel. There is security 24 hours out front who do a great job keeping the Hotel safe.
Citizen M is located near museums, movie theaters and the BART transit system, making it easy to get around the city. Also 1 mile walking distance to Oracle Park, The Ferry Building & Embarcadero.

reviews.author: Tamar
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Great staff. Sleek and clean rooms.

reviews.author: Sharonpdx
reviews.title: Great for Solo Travel
reviews.body: This place was recommended to me from my co worker. Cute quirky hotel in a convenient location. Staff was friendly with both check in and check out.

reviews.author: Donald T
reviews.title: Do yourself a solid and stay here
reviews.body:
This was my first stay at this brand, and I was impressed. I stayed here the last night of my work trip to Palo Alto so I would be closer to the airport and be able to take in as much of the tourist sights before flying out in the morning.

First impressions upon arrival: The hotel is located in the thick of downtown with paid parking immediately next door. Having lived in Wyoming for the last few years, the downtown spectacle is a bit awe-inspiring, like the scene in Gladiator where Juba first sees the coliseum when arriving in Rome. Security was always alert and present outside the entrance.

Self check-in was conducted in the third-floor lobby and went smoothly once I discovered the trick to scanning my ID. The lobby also contains the restaurant/bar and the community room. The vibe of the hotel feels more like a posh nightclub than a hotel.

The rooms were perfect for my aesthetic, having stayed at several micro-style brands. The bed was large and comfortable with a wall-to-wall window that provided a nice view of the city. Lighting can be set to any color in the spectrum and, along with the blinds and TV, is controlled by the room's mini-iPad. There are presets for studying, sleeping, etc. Shower water pressure and temp were good.

This is a micro-style brand, and if you have never stayed at one before, do your research on what that means. There isn't much space for storage, no microwave, and no coffee pot. The room is for sleeping, showering, and private work sessions, and it excels in that role. Great ambiance throughout the hotel.

My one nitpick, and it only applies to a few people, was that the internet speeds were acceptable but closer to 30 Mbps and not the 100 Mbps I was expecting. I do not believe the hotel advertises this speed, but when searching for a place to stay, some other review sites had mentioned this, and it was one of the criteria that influenced where I stayed.

The hotel's location is perfect to allow a traveler to see and do a lot in a short amount of time. I arrived later than planned, as I don't seem to be able to keep myself from working half a day on my day off, but was still able to walk from the hotel (you don't want to have to drive unless you are going a long distance) through downtown, through the tunnel into Chinatown, and finally ending up at the wharf (roughly 1.5 miles). Grabbed some nice sunset shots of Alcatraz, had a robot make me a latte, and took pictures of the harbor seals. Had a nice dinner with a great elevated view of the sunset, went through a plethora of places, and made notes of all the places I want to visit next trip. There are tons of them within walking distance of the hotel, including the steak place across the street from the hotel entrance that smelled amazing.

Typical tourist, I took a Waymo from the wharf back to the hotel, which cost about $25, and wait time was less than 10 minutes even in a high-use time period. I ended the evening with a dirty chai latte in the hotel bar, which was delicious and reasonably priced. All staff appear to be cross-trained in the restaurant/bar area. In the morning, I was able to drive to Marshall Beach on the way to the airport (virtually no traffic before the sun comes up), get several low-angle photos of the Golden Gate Bridge, and arrive at the airport in plenty of time to catch my flight.

Overall verdict: This hotel is perfect to allow a workaholic the ability to feel like a normal tourist on vacation for an evening while also providing the 'hip' vibes of a John Wick movie.

Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: aman m
reviews.title: good stay
reviews.body: my partner and I had a great time in the new tech room. super clean and fun. would definitely recommmend.

reviews.author: DieHardFan4Life
reviews.title: Returning for life!
reviews.body: Love CitizenM hotels so much that I am a Marriott member. This is our second stay and the service in Union Station is even better than the WashingtonDC location. The staff were extremely helpful and went out of their way to help when we forgot toothbrushes and other toiletries. The security guards are very helpful and remembered us and always opened the doors. The buffet and drinks are top, with Salmon Lox and thick cut bacon. It was great we got to watch the FIFA games in the common areas beside in our room. My daughter lives the modern ipad controls. Honestly, the secind we stepped in the hotel, it felt like coming home since we had such a good experience with our first stay in DC. I am a forever fan!!

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.title: Cool hotel with good overall connections
reviews.body:
I arrived to the hotel walking down Market Street from the Ferry Building and it does feel a bit... interesting as area. The hotel has a really relaxed and friendly vibe. Because this is San Francisco, I suppose, everything needs to be done through a tablet, from your check-in and check-out. There's staff on hand though and they are very helpful. And there's a nice bar and a lounge with sofas and (I loved this) actual books one could read. 
My room was compact but efficient, the bed very comfy, some nice light effects in the bathroom and all the toiletries I needed. 
The hotel is very well connected, I took the bus a few times, the train, it's also walking distance from Union Square and some nice coffee places.
I'm overall satisfied with my choice and I'd definitely come again.

reviews.author: Holly
reviews.title: Modern, clean, cool, centrally located hotel
reviews.body: We went into San Francisco for a quick 2-day trip (we are a retired couple).  We found CitizenM online and the reviews were great, so we booked it. We had a terrific experience as well.  Although the hotel is a bit of a different and modern concept (no traditional hotel desk entry, etc.), we knew what to expect from the reviews and the hotel website.  Most everything is done by iPad, but there was an attentive, courteous and helpful staff member there as we arrived to walk us through the procedures.  Our room was really tiny (think "cruise ship"), but extremely clean, efficient and well thought-out, kind of remarkably so.  We were impressed at how well the two of us could function in that room! The coffee in the lobby in the morning was excellent quality (and we always appreciate self-serve coffee at a hotel). The location is ideal; it's a few blocks to SF MOMA, and about a 15 minute walk to the Embarcadero, The Ferry Building, etc. We will definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: Oldergent73
reviews.title: Nice modern facility, but not my cup of tea.
reviews.body:
The facility was clean and well maintained. Most of the staff were friendly, helpful and attentive. The security people at the entrance were especially nice. I'm an older individual who is not terribly techy, but not totally ignorant. 
I found the check in procedure annoying, the ambassador on duty had to do it for me and I was not the only one. A front desk where I could present my ID and payment and then receive my room key would have been really nice. 
It would have been nice to have a bathroom door that could be closed to provide some privacy. The sliding glass door was not that. Light switches and rheostats would be an improvement over going to the Ipad to change lighting. Separate lighting in the bathroom would have been nice. A luggage stand would have been greatly appreciated, drawers even more. Living out of a suitcase on the floor for a week kinda sucks.
Overall, not a bad stay, but I won't be back. Older Gent 73

reviews.author: YLondon 1
reviews.title: Not for adults 😒
reviews.body: Glorified box with a great bed. That's all the quality you get and l guess, central location

reviews.author: ZeRo
reviews.title: Excellent location of small room in good condition
reviews.body: Great location with very small but good condition rooms. No coffee machine, kettle and glasses in the room, no hotel private parking. The staff is very friendly.

reviews.author: DrBBL51
reviews.title: Recent stay
reviews.body: I felt this JW Marriott does not fit the profile of what JW really means. An underwhelming hotel experience. The hotel seemed empty and the service was lackluster. The restaurant experience was extremely poor

reviews.author: MM4Life
reviews.title: JW San Francisco
reviews.body: Great hotel great staff. Highly recommend in Union Square.

reviews.author: haneul ham
reviews.title: A Truly Memorable Stay Thanks to the Wonderful Staff
reviews.body:
I would like to express my deepest gratitude to the concierge staff who greeted me so warmly every morning.

In particular, I would like to thank the staff member who remembered my appearance and the way I dressed, as well as the two staff members who kindly provided me with water. I may not remember their names, but I believe they will know who they are. Their warm and friendly greetings every morning always made my day start on a pleasant note.

I would also like to give my sincere thanks to Tan, who was incredibly kind and attentive whenever I ordered food. Even when I had very specific and demanding requests, Tan always handled them with patience and sincerity. I was genuinely touched by the level of care and service.

Although some of the hotel facilities felt somewhat dated, everything was very well maintained. I was also extremely impressed by the chefs. They prepared the food with great care and attention to detail, and I was never disappointed even once during my stay. Every meal was satisfying and delicious.

I would also like to thank the front desk staff member who patiently answered all of my questions and explained everything to me in such detail. He appeared to be in a very senior position, and thanks to his guidance, I was able to travel without getting lost or feeling confused.

Above all, I am truly grateful to all of the hotel staff who made my trip such a memorable and enjoyable experience. Your kindness and professionalism made a lasting impression on me, and I sincerely appreciate everything you did during my stay.

reviews.author: Freddy
reviews.title: Name of JW Marriott
reviews.body: Expected upscale and luxurious, but it doesn't fit with value of the name. Just minimum amenities and remained some of bananas in a trash can...

reviews.author: Gabe
reviews.title: Luxury Prices Without a Luxury Experience
reviews.body:
Very disappointing for a JW Marriott property. Although the prices reflect a luxury hotel, the experience did not.

The restaurant closes from 11:00 a.m. until 5:00 p.m., which created a major problem while I was traveling for business. On both days, I was unable to have a proper meal at the hotel. The only alternative was a tiny convenience store selling poor-quality, overpriced sandwiches. That is unacceptable for a property positioned as a luxury hotel.

I also was not offered an upgrade, despite the hotel appearing lightly occupied. More importantly, the restaurant’s limited hours prevented me from using my American Express property credit, so I lost part of the benefit that influenced my decision to stay here. A hotel participating in The Hotel Collection should make it reasonably possible for guests to use the associated credits.

The staff was very kind and the service was good, but the overall experience fell well below the standard I expected. It felt like an ordinary business hotel charging luxury prices. Unfortunately, I would not stay here again under these circumstances.

reviews.author: aria
reviews.title: Jose
reviews.body: restaurant was bad services and confuse

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Come and Experience
reviews.body: Comfortable bed and didn't get rush, excellent services, staff were incredible amazing, clean and neat room.

reviews.author: Cyn T
reviews.title: Expected more
reviews.body: We expected more out of a JW. They are off union square so walking to dinner could take you to the Tenderloin walking through feces in the street. Inside was nice but parking was outrageously priced with an option 1/3 the cost right across the street. Breakfast wasn’t included as we expected. Overall the room was clean and nice, not very spacious but ok for what we needed for a night away.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Room service
reviews.body: Ordered a chicken sandwhich fries and a Diet Coke.  Chicken was undercooked and I became very ill.  Complained to staff and no one responded.

reviews.author: Gwakitu
reviews.title: First Timers at San Francisco location
reviews.body: I would like to rate my overall experience as 9/10. Everything was awesome but I wished the hotel offered lunch.

reviews.author: Gio DeSouza
reviews.title: Best night's sleep ever — highly recommended
reviews.body:
We loved this hotel! The room was one of the darkest we have ever stayed in, which made for an amazing night's sleep. The cleaning, staff, and location were all great.
The only letdowns were the food, which didn't match the hotel's standard, and the price for a long stay. Instead of the $20 voucher, I would have appreciated a daily parking discount.

reviews.author: I heart Marriott
reviews.title: Great Three-Day Weekend
reviews.body: Came to SF for a three-day weekend to see a concert and a new movie. I decided to stay at the JW Marriott and was not disappointed. Titanium elite here and decided to book trip through Amex Hotel Collection. Was able to check in early and check out late. Received free breakfast plus $100 food credit for the stay and $20 daily food credit from the destination charge, so decided to use it all and eat all meals at their restaurant. Food was delicious. Had a nice room on the 17th floor with a good view. Bed was comfortable and slept like a baby. Really appreciated the blackout curtains. I come to SF a lot and have stayed at most Marriott properties and am on a mission to stay at all of them at least once. JW was great and looking forward to a return next year.

reviews.author: NickT
reviews.title: Great area
reviews.body: Great hotel and place to stay.

reviews.author: Steve Long Island NY
reviews.title: JW San Fran
reviews.body: Overall fine - yet somewhat dated and I expect overall better experience at all JW Marriott's

reviews.author: MBFJUL26
reviews.title: Martha's JW Marriott SFO Experience
reviews.body: Please copy the review I typed on Page One. Thank you.

reviews.author: Chicago 53
reviews.title: Grand Marriott Experience
reviews.body:
Attempting to reach this location, I experienced all the negativity  of every modern downtown metropolis. Traffic congestion, a labyrinth of confusing one way streets, construction, detours, sirens, and all the rest .
  Once entering the lobby, you are transferred to Shaingrala .  Polished stone work, art , plants, refined open spaces, and a sense of serenity .
The absolute far end of the Hotel spectrum .
Plus, most of the major city highlights are not far .

A trip worth every penny.

reviews.author: Robbie1
reviews.title: Great location and high quality accomodation
reviews.body: I really enjoyed my stay at the JW Union Square. The location was great, room very nice and comfortable and staff were friendly. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Anonymous123
reviews.title: Lackluster, non-luxurious, basic, cheap-feeling Dump
reviews.body: What a disappointment this hotel was.  Rooms were mid, no store or rooftop bar like advertised, ONE teeny tiny bar that serves like 3 dishes that were all disgusting.   Some of the staff was nice, most seemed more interested in their phones or personal conversations to ever say Hello or a kind word to a guest.   Very very poor quality in service and amenities.

reviews.author: Mr G
reviews.title: Thank you, Enrique
reviews.body: My stay at the JW Marriott was unfortunately short, so I did not experience all the amenities. However, staff was very professional. The facilities were very clean.

reviews.author: A and C Millis
reviews.title: 35th Wedding Anniversary
reviews.body: Excellent accommodations and good time had by all

reviews.author: Resmy S
reviews.title: Resmy S
reviews.body: Great place always , and the best customer service

reviews.author: Elle Jay
reviews.title: Worth the Stay
reviews.body: One of my favorite hotels I've stayed at in San Francisco. Comfortable bed, great service, and an excellent location within walking distance of shopping, restaurants, and the cable cars. I'd happily stay here again.

reviews.author: Loyal Member
reviews.title: Very Disappointed Loyal Member
reviews.body: Level 3 restaurant needs a complete overhaul with training and food safety. I watched a server buss a table while placing clean dishes on the table and polishing the silverware with the dirty towel. The service is very slow as none of the staff work with team service. Tables needed to be bussed but so many walked past the tables and did nothing while there is a line of people waiting for over 30 minutes. They are in shambles.

reviews.author: Jspines
reviews.title: Could have been a great hotel during its prime
reviews.body:
I was excited for the stay since all the  JW Marriotts I’ve stayed in Asia was definitely 5 star. Even the older ones. 

This however is probably the worst JWM property I’ve ever stayed in. Aesthetic wise they wanted to make the cool window look as per the hotel listing. Definitely looked pretty and nice but truly it was inconvenient for the guest. The blinds are mini or short blinds that doesn’t pull through to cover the window and do its job. To make things worst the building across had its lights turned on the whole night. I was unable to sleep well since it was a glaring bright light shining into my room the whole night. 

The TV was dated and really lagged. When I click on a channel it takes a minute to load. Even worst when trying to connect to Netflix. After 15 minutes spent I gave up. 

The backdrop of the bed was a window and the window was definitely old and the grosses part was the mirror was spotty. The kind of spots that comes from windows so dated as if it hadn’t been cleaned in ages. 

The toilet does a double flush (waste of water) and is so loud while it tries to refill the reservoir. 

Way beyond shocked and couldn’t wait to leave this property. Will not recommend or come back.

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body:
Very nice property in Union Square.  The central location made getting around easy.  There’s a restaurant and small convenience center in the lobby along with a large bar and lounge area.  The room was spacious and comfortable.  Large TV has streaming service options.  
A microwave would have been nice but that about the only improvement I would suggest.

reviews.author: Frank
reviews.title: Woefully Understaffed
reviews.body: This is a nice hotel, but they only had 1 front desk person and that caused long waits.  And there was a 15 minute wait for brunch even though there were dozens of open tables.  The problem is that thee were not enough servers or kitchen staff, so they only seat 1/2 the tables.

reviews.author: Alexandre H
reviews.title: Terribly below the level of a JW Marriott
reviews.body: I booked this JW Marriott for myself and a high-level guest for a conference, expecting a certain of level of service that was not absolutely met. While the location is ideal, and the rooms spacious and clean, the overall experience is terrible considering the JW status. I travel 200 days a year and this is the single worst hotel I have stayed at. Had I known what to expect, I either would have booked a much more expensive hotel, or a much less expensive one, as this one fails to deliver its promise and sits in a 3* range of service. By all means, should you travel to SF and need a clean room to sleep in, this hotel is fine - though there sure must be others that are just as fine and not as pricey. The breakfast was an absolute insult. Take my cue and skip it and grab a bite in any diner in the street, as they are far better and far less expensive. The staff was not helpful in any way, not that I asked for the Moon. I am a loyal guest of the Marriott group and this is enough to make me reconsider my future stays.

reviews.author: vandy
reviews.title: The worst JW ever!
reviews.body: Dont waste your money on this JW - I would suggest to go to a fairfield inn instead of this

reviews.author: Nisha B
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.body: I would like to thank the front desk representative, Rick, for making my stay memorable. He's definitely one of the reasons that I would return. I will also like to thank the male bartender, for the great drinks and hospitality.

reviews.author: Marriott Guy
reviews.title: STAY AWAY FROM THIS LOCATION
reviews.body:
One of the worst experiences I’ve had at a JW Marriott property. I specifically chose JW Marriott because of the brand reputation, but this hotel did not feel like a JW at all.

First, I do want to mention that the front desk staff were excellent — especially Ms. Bianca. She was professional and helpful throughout my stay. Unfortunately, the rest of the experience was very disappointing.

The overall facility felt outdated, dark, and even smelled unpleasant in certain areas. Honestly, I felt like I walked in Sheraton.

The room itself was also below expectations. I was supposedly upgraded to a king room with a city view, but there was barely any view at all. The light switches were difficult to use and felt worn out, and the TV kept turning on and off randomly during my stay.

The biggest issue in the room was the air conditioning — there was a noticeable moldy smell coming from the AC, which made the room uncomfortable.

The Level 3 dining experience was probably the worst part. I received a complimentary continental breakfast, but it was honestly one of the worst hotel breakfasts I’ve had. you got to choose only two menu from continental breakfast and the options were horrible. you have options to choose two. all options were terrible. You could get a better breakfast at a Fairfield Inn or Courtyard.

I also ordered the avocado toast from the discounted menu for around $28 (they said the original price was even higher). It absolutely worthless and was extremely disappointing. WORST SPEND $28. 

What shocked me most was that when I asked for a refill of apple juice, I was told drinks were only included one time. For a JW Marriott property, that felt ridiculous. So after the first day, I decided not going back to the restaurant. 

Lastly, parking was nearly $98 per night, which made the experience even harder to justify considering the overall quality of the stay.

Very disappointing experience overall, especially for a hotel carrying the JW Marriott name. I suggest you to change your hotel name to something else- you DO NOT MEET JW marriott name. people will get confused

reviews.author: DDVigil

reviews.body: The Westin is so lovely. We have stayed in the new tower and the older rooms. Both are comfortable but we think we prefer the original rooms. It smells nice and the coffee cafe is great for that morning cup. The staff is friendly and available.

reviews.author: ReneeA
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.body:
I have stayed at the Westin St. Francis several times in the past and genuinely enjoyed my stays, which is why I chose to return. Unfortunately, after this experience, I believe this will be my last stay.
Our assigned room was initially great and even included an outdoor seating area. However, when we went to use it, we found that the chairs were deeply dipped inward, there were no cushions, and the entire area had a significant amount of bird droppings. Needless to say, we did not use the outdoor space.

The most concerning issue, however, was the water and the way our concerns were handled by the hotel staff.

Before leaving for an evening concert, I brushed my teeth using the bathroom sink. I immediately noticed that the water did not taste right. I filled a glass from the sink and noticed that the water had a yellow tint. When my daughter flushed the toilet, the water appeared golden-orange.

We notified the staff before leaving for the concert and were asked, “Did you run the water for a while?” We explained that we had not, as we try to be mindful about not wasting water. We were told, in essence, to see what the situation was like when we returned.

Unfortunately, the problem had not resolved itself. When we returned from the concert, the sink water was still yellowish, the toilet water was golden-orange, and the water in the shower/tub was also discolored.

At that point, we contacted the front desk again. The response we received was dismissive and accompanied by what felt like a very poor attitude. We were told that an engineer would come to our room to investigate. After waiting several minutes, I called the front desk again to ask when someone would be arriving and was met with more attitude.

Thankfully, the engineer who came to our room was courteous, professional, and took our concerns seriously. He immediately validated what we had observed with the water. He opened several valves and ran the water. While the shower water eventually came out clear, the sink and toilet water remained slightly discolored. He told us that he would speak with the manager on duty and explain what was happening. He also said the manager would contact me to discuss whether we wanted to change rooms or determine what could be done.

By this point, it was around 12:30 a.m.

No manager ever contacted us that night—or the following day.

I ended up spending the night with a stomach ache and diarrhea, although I cannot say with certainty that this was caused by the water. Given the circumstances, however, it was understandably concerning. We used bottled water to brush our teeth for the remainder of our stay and checked out the following morning to head home.

What is most disappointing is that I had previously had positive experiences at the Westin St. Francis, which is why I returned. I understand that unexpected maintenance or plumbing issues can happen at any hotel. What matters is how those issues are handled. In this case, the discolored water was concerning, and the lack of urgency, follow-up, and empathy from the front desk and management made the experience significantly worse.

The engineer who assisted us was the one bright spot in an otherwise very disappointing stay. Unfortunately, based on this experience, I will not be returning.

reviews.author: OneLuckyFamily
reviews.title: The Westin St. Francis is Entering a New Golden Age
reviews.body:
I have just returned from a six-night stay at the Westin St. Francis. The St. Francis is one of my favorite hotels in San Francisco, and I have enjoyed its hospitality for a fair amount of time, including through COVID and work protest impacting years.  On every occasion, my experience has been exceptional.

This time, I felt what can only be described as a discernable overall "vibe". The staff went out of their way to engage - the housekeeping, Westin lounge, front desk, lobby and the concierge desk teams, each in their own way, made me feel particularly welcome and cared for. It was extraordinary.

Perhaps the completion of the beautiful Bourbon lounge and restaurant and the Eighth Rule speakeasy have brought the hotel to full speed operation, I'm not sure, but the ambience was wonderful.

I also must mention that I finally took the free Saturday morning hotel tour. It was terrific! If you are at all interested in the history of the St. Francis, this tour delivers.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Disfunctional experience for a wedding party.
reviews.body: The staff were not friendly. They over billed our room. There was no help for those who booked through our room block. They charged our room rates in a way that it was flagged for fraud. They were very rude and then suddenly expected high marks upon check out.

reviews.author: Jay Buenaobra
reviews.title: Great Stay - would stay here again
reviews.body: The location of this hotel is its main selling point, but I will say the staff here is incredible. It’s an older property and I believe they honor its legacy. Would stay again !

reviews.author: AdrianV
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.body: We had a wonderful stay at The Westin St. Francis last week. The hotel is exceptionally clean, and the staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. The location is unbeatable - Union Square is right across the street, and it's within walking distance to so many great spots, including Chinatown. We also thoroughly enjoyed the hotel restaurant; it's charming and quaint, with very accommodating team. Highly recommend for a comfortable, convenient stay in San Francisco!

reviews.author: Excellent
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Great location. Staff was great. Got lots of personal help from Luis. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.author: Craig
reviews.title: Parking fee is outrageous
reviews.body: For the price of the room I would have expected better bathroom amenities and better quality towels. The bedding and pillows were very comfortable and luxurious. We only had time to eat in the Cafe which had a pleasant atmosphere and good food. The problem was when we picked up our car, the fee was $100.00 to park. I think this is outrageous and should have already been included in the price to stay. It made a nice hotel feel cheap.

reviews.author: Mnguyen925
reviews.title: Title: Severe Valet Safety & Service Breakdown for Platinum Elites
reviews.body:
As a Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite member, I expect basic hospitality, security, and common-sense problem-solving
—none of which were delivered by the valet team at The Westin St. Francis.
My family arrived around 5:45 PM for an overnight stay. I took my daughter and the bags to check in while my wife looked for the key.  

Because our physical Tesla key card was accidentally left behind, my wife explained to the valet staff that the vehicle could easily be operated using Remote Start via the official Tesla app—a routine, seamless procedure at any modern luxury hotel.  It’s happened before at another Marriott property.

Instead of offering a solution or assisting my family, the valet team flatly refused service and instructed my wife to navigate unfamiliar downtown San Francisco traffic and go figure out public self-parking late in the day on her own.
Turning away high-tier loyalty members and forcing a woman to find off-site parking at dusk is a massive safety hazard and an absolute failure of Westin service standards.
I took my wife and daughter up to our room, went straight back downstairs, and demanded to speak with a manager. I insisted on signing a liability waiver so they could accept the vehicle overnight using Remote Start. Given some rude remarks by staff to move my car because it was in the way… Remarkably, the moment management was called and a waiver was requested, the situation was resolved instantly and the car was accepted.
The fact that it required me escalating the issue in person to force a resolution proves this was never a policy restriction—it was pure staff laziness. Forcing guests to fight for a basic, reasonable accommodation to ensure their safety is unacceptable. Future guests—especially Bonvoy Elites and EV drivers—should be extremely cautious relying on this front drive.

reviews.author: Nette
reviews.title: Hotel of charm
reviews.body: We loved the history of the hotel. It felt like the staff enjoyed serving us. The location is great. If I had to choose a stand out, it would be the concierge. There were 3 on different days but all made us feel welcomed and were spot on with recommendations.

reviews.author: SF in Sept
reviews.title: SF in Sept
reviews.body:
Loved the hotel- my 4th stay there- the new bar is stunning! All the hotel workers go out of their way to be helpful and friendly!
I enjoyed the gym there as well

reviews.author: a Marriott fan
reviews.title: Feels like you've stepped into a bygone era of old world charm and hospitality
reviews.body: This hotel has 2 sides - a historical side with original rooms, some facing Union Square, and a tall high rise side built somewhere around the 1980's, with a glass elevator and views of the city, golden gate bridge, and Grace cathedral. The hotel architecture is gorgeous, and dripping with elegant old world charm, and you can book a tour of hotel history and museum. The hotel is amply staffed and they are all so gracious. There is a wine tasting room, full bar/restaurant, and a lobby cafe with ala cart salads and sandwiches. In walking distance to the Moscone convention center, shopping, restaurants, and a huge Trader Joe's. The membership lounge is the best I've visited...with delicious breakfast and dinner M-Th, and breakfast Fri-Sun. Please remember to tip the hard working staff of this lounge if you visit, they are amazing. The decor is marble tables with wood paneling and original wall murals of the Ludwig Bedelmans (the French Madeline books).

reviews.author: ViziWard
reviews.title: Excellent Stay for business
reviews.body: Overall the experience was top-notch with the staff, the room, the cleanliness, and the location. Having filtered water stations throughout was an absolute plus.

The room was clean.
Staff at front desk was good and friendly. 

Room Service was good. Only feedback is please check and make sure the shower gels are refilled.
My shower gel was not refilled for the two days I Stayed.

reviews.author: James
reviews.title: Phenomenal Experience
reviews.body:
Jenevieve and the entire team at The Westin St. Francis delivered an unforgettable rehearsal dinner experience from start to finish.
​Working with Jenevieve was an absolute dream. Her attention to detail, proactive communication, and flawless coordination made the entire planning process effortless and stress-free. She ensured every element of the evening flowed seamlessly, allowing us to simply relax and celebrate with our loved ones.
​The entire staff at The Westin St. Francis went above and beyond:
​Impeccable Service: Every team member—from the banquet staff to the front desk—was warm, attentive, and consistently went out of their way to make our guests feel welcome.
​Flawless Execution: The setup, food, and timing throughout the night were executed with incredible care and professionalism.
​We cannot thank Jenevieve and the Westin team enough for making such a special milestone so memorable. We will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: Iriszone5
reviews.title: Overall good hotel with good location but...
reviews.body:
The Westin St. Francis is overall a very good hotel. I stayed in the tower side which is supposed to have larger rooms and more contemporary which I found to be true. My king room was very spacious with bay windows that made for a great room experience. The room was also in very good repair and very clean; Kudos to housekeeping. 

What the St. Francis does lack are nice plush seating areas in the lobby for conversations. There is the Rito open area cafe with plenty of seating but the furnishings are more like a mid to low-end diner. The look does not match a high-end hotel. They chose easy to clean faux leatherette and functionality over aesthetics, ambiance, customer comfort and good customer experience. The food is also way over priced even for the convenience in a hotel and not worth it when you are sitting in less than wonderful low-end diner-like surroundings. 

As for the fine dining Bourbon Steak Restaurant and lounge by a James Beard Award-winning chef but it misses the mark in flavor. I was looking forward to a great meal but instead was served an extremely salty and too many bones left in not fresh but fishy tasting branzino accompanied by equally over salted spinach. Normally, I would mention the poor taste and over seasoned entree but the extreme noise level from a constant barrage of pulsating music prevented me from being heard by the waiter.

In Summary, the Westin has very spacious rooms and is in a great location right on the Powell Cable Car Line but I would seek other dinning options and cross the street to Union Square for a soothing open air experience and enjoy the cool San Francisco weather.

reviews.author: LA to SF traveler
reviews.title: Super expensive with extra charges But Bonus of Amazing Hotel
reviews.body: Incredible location. Rooms are super quiet and large. Very comfortable. Def landmark side more beautiful decor. Staff incredible. Bring own pillow for comfort. Resort fee on top of charges and Marriot Points still expensive - could not imagine parking on top of all other charges. Bummer. But once and a while worth the splurge. Sticker shock and incredible interaction almost a win win....but VERY expensive for the room decor and point system. Again, once a year maybe. Take Advantage of entire hotel bonuses or might find other options.

reviews.author: 123 fix the AC system
reviews.title: Marriott watch your credit card charges
reviews.body:
The hotel was very nice. Staff was great. Very clean. Two problems. Some of  the group I was with experienced the first problem.
The room would either get too cold or too hot. You would turn the AC down as low as it could go to get the room to feel cool then in the middle of the night, it would be hot. You  Could never find a happy cool spot.
Second problem went to the view lounge one night. Received two charges on my credit card for two different dates of service at the view lounge. I  Called  the hotel, and asked for restaurant management. I left a message for restaurant management and over a week later have not heard from anyone.

reviews.author: JennyB
reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.body: Perfect for your trip to San Fran! Friendly staff and walking distance to ball park and great restaurants

reviews.author: Reel Country Travel
reviews.title: Accommodation are not for the weekend
reviews.body: The hotel staff is non-existant, I did receive fresh towels in my room until the 2nd day, even after messaging the front desk. The lounge access is a joke, it closed all weekend,  so you can notget coffee or any beverage during the day. The Breakfast is cheap ingredients and sub-par. This Marriott staff doesn't respond to the messaging app.

reviews.author: sandysf
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay Despite a Great Downtown Location
reviews.body: Disappointing stay overall, especially as a Marriott Bonvoy Titanium member. No room upgrade, no room service, no water in the room, and the breakfast was quite poor. I would recommend guests check carefully what is included with their stay. The location is excellent, which is the main reason I’m giving it 7/10. Otherwise, I expected much better from a Marriott Marquis property.

reviews.author: Kimedward
reviews.title: Destination fee
reviews.body:
We have been charged for destination fee which is new and we were not aware of it at all. We charged for wifi and gym although we have never used it and it should be free. 
Parking was full for the hotel residents. We spend few hours to find a nearby parking!

reviews.author: Giuseppe
reviews.title: Very Nice hotel with awesome view and outstanding gym that contributes you to feel home
reviews.body: Very Nice hotel with awesome view and outstanding gym

reviews.author: Momoko
reviews.title: Disappointing experience with extremely chaotic billing
reviews.body:
Disappointing experience with extremely chaotic billing
I am giving a 1-star rating due to a very frustrating experience with the hotel's billing process at checkout. My room rate explicitly included complimentary breakfast for two guests. However, the hotel restaurant charged me between $100 and $200 for breakfast every single day, with pricing that seemed completely random and inconsistent. Upon checkout, I was presented with an unexpected bill of around $800.
Although the front desk eventually removed the extra $600+ in charges after I disputed it, the fact that this happened in the first place shows how chaotic their management is. Guests shouldn't have to audit their own bills just to get the amenities they already paid for. I will not be returning.

reviews.author: Convention goer 70
reviews.title: 9 night stay
reviews.body: Convention goer who was on an advance committee

reviews.author: Frustrated traveler
reviews.title: Expensive not worth it
reviews.body: Food and drinks very expensive at restaurant and pantry. For example a 12 ounce can sprite $5 at pantry. $26 for wedges and chicken tenders they put in the microwave before serving them. Etc.etc.etc.

reviews.author: Traveler From Texas
reviews.title: View Bar early closure
reviews.body: No cocktails for you.  View Bar closed early.

reviews.author: Great Stay
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Enjoyed the hotels location lots to do in the downtown area.

reviews.author: Niki T
reviews.title: First time in San Francisco
reviews.body: Great room, great location, and great staff.

reviews.author: Will elite member
reviews.title: Not Taking care of elite members
reviews.body: Front desk did not even take time to acknowledge the elite member and did nothing to rewards the members with the upgrade they deserved

reviews.author: SLB603
reviews.title: Accessible to ALL
reviews.body: The Marriot is in a great location with access to great food, activities and affordable options for anything you might need.  Example Target and Trader Joes directly across the street.

reviews.author: Muffintop007
reviews.title: FRONT DESK STAFFING
reviews.body: The check-in time was horrible.  I was line over 17 minutes waiting to check-in.  There was one person working the Mobile desk (far left) that was only checking in flight staff, one working the Help desk (far right) that was assisting guest with issues, one male clerk in the middle dealing with the check-in line, 3 clerks standing next to him talking and one person at the head of the line apologizing for the delay and thanking us for the being patient.  There were 2-3 stations not being manned.  The 3 clerks walked off leaving a line of guest trying to check in.  If this location gets tested/shopped for efficiency and wait times on the front counter-line, you will fail.  Also, having a microwave in the room should be available to guest upon their request.

reviews.author: Boss Lady
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!
reviews.body: The stay was great! The employees were great! Thanks for attending to my room daily! 10/10

reviews.author: DVS001
reviews.title: Some things good be better
reviews.body: I stayed at this hotel for a convention.  I was there for 8 days and my main complaint was that the food offered to us was always the same and cold.  I didn't spend much time in my room but when I was there, it smelled of smoke.  Some of the front dest staff and bellhop staff were kind of unfriendly.

reviews.author: BL1961
reviews.title: customer services on all levels, other than the cleanliness of our room
reviews.body: We had great service at the convention meals and all  restaurants except B52(?).  The server seemed a bit bothered by our presence.  finding the top sheet made with the tag at the head of the bed.  when we remade it, we found what looked like fresh makeup on the sheets, and unfortunately not necessarily not a small amount.  Also we found that the fridge in the room had items still in it from the previous guest.  It did make us wonder what else might have not been done or clean.  Not necessarily what I want to be thinking of while at a convention, staying with my wife, and meeting with friends and family.

reviews.author: Valwin
reviews.title: Worst experience at a Marriot Hotel
reviews.body: Marriot is normally my hotel of choice. This stay was the worst. I was with a group. We were on different floors throughout the hotel. During the stay there was a fire drill. I was on the 5th floor. We heard the fire drill on the 5th floor, therefor we evacuated the building. When I looked for other members of our group it was noticed they did not evacuate. I called them and they did not get the fire drill. Thankfully the issue was not as serious as it could have been. The entrance to me room had maintenance issues. A pipe was laying from the floor along with dirt and water. I had to walk through a puddle of water on several days. My shoes got wet. I had to listen to a wet dry vac cleaning up the water daily.

reviews.author: KenB
reviews.title: A gem in central San Francisco
reviews.body: The Marriott Marquis was one of the finest hotel experiences I have had.  The rooms were well appointed.  the bedding and comfort were superb.  The staff was exceptional.

reviews.author: Joe from Florida
reviews.title: Above and beyond
reviews.body: My experience was outstanding, everything was on point. The staff was stellar and far exceeded expectation.

reviews.author: ROBIN FROM LA
reviews.title: room and prople were just fine.  Excess charges were overdone,
reviews.body: Great location.  Nice room  Look at your bill carefully!

reviews.author: Isaac T
reviews.title: Everything perfect, but…
reviews.body:
Everything were perfect.
The room, the cleanliness, the service, the location.. everything! But…
The tv in my room did not work to stream a single thing. The YouTube app did no have a sound and the Netflix app could not stream a single thing.
My stay were like in a room without a tv. 
I’m used to watch a show or a movie after a long day out, or simple to turn the tv to hear something I like during I prepare for sleep. But I could not do that because the tvs are old. It barely pick up signal for regular channels.

reviews.author: Peterpiper313
reviews.title: Horrible Marriott Experience! Deceptive Fees & Poor Management
reviews.body:
Horrible Marriott Experience — Deceptive Fees & Poor Management

This was an extremely disappointing Marriott experience. The hotel charges a mandatory $38 daily destination fee, which supposedly includes a daily credit and other benefits, yet this fee and how to actually use the benefits were never properly disclosed or explained at check-in.

When I questioned the manager, Magda, about why this wasn’t communicated, her response was that there are “flyers everywhere.” Seriously? Guests should not have to search for flyers around a hotel to understand a mandatory daily fee they are being charged. These charges and included benefits should be clearly explained at check-in.

The cleanliness was also unacceptable. The bathroom shower was full of hair, with visible dirt and grime on the walls. Someone was sent to clean the shower after I complained, but while the hair was removed, the dirt and grime remained. I ultimately ended up cleaning the shower myself because I did not want the additional hassle of packing up and changing rooms.

Then there was valet parking—$62 per day plus approximately $8 in taxes, bringing the cost to around $70 PER DAY, which is already outrageous. To make matters worse, I was overcharged for valet parking on top of that.

What made the entire experience worse was the nonchalant attitude of management. There was very little concern about resolving these issues or providing the level of hospitality I expect from Marriott.

Between the poorly disclosed mandatory destination fee, dirty room, valet overcharge, excessive parking costs, and dismissive management, this stay fell far below Marriott standards. Guests should carefully review every charge on their bill before leaving this property.

reviews.author: Jon Z
reviews.title: Excellent Stay at San Francisco Marriott Union Square
reviews.body: I've stayed at this hotel twice in the last 4 weeks and it is one of my favorites.  The rooms are nice and the staff is incredible.  I ate at the restaurant and the food was very good but the service from the staff was amazing.  Excellent Old Fashion at the bar.

reviews.author: JP Mac
reviews.title: Family Stay
reviews.body: Family stay in San Francisco

reviews.author: D and L
reviews.title: Not what we were expecting
reviews.body: I booked a king Junior Suite, asked for high floor. We checked in around 4:30 given our keys and went to our room. Upon arrival our room/Suite was a handicap suite, wasn't what we where expecting and even though I set it up for two, the supplies such as coffee was for one. We were put on the 17th floor yet there were 28. I called the front desk upon arrival explaining that we were not happy with room and if there was something else available, I would've even upgraded but was told nothing available. The view was nice and I did love the black out curtains. The hotel was clean but our room could have been cleaner, ther was a hanger left in shower from previous guest. I only went down to the breakfast to get coffee, but didn't eat there. Bathrooms down stair are locked,  not good.

reviews.author: Zhang1
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.body: Nice hotel, perfect location, excellent service

reviews.author: Dom London UK
reviews.title: San Francisco Business Trip - Work and ACDC Concert
reviews.body: Arrived late in the evening and check in was so quick. Great rooms and perfect location.  The highlight for me is that all the staff are really cheerful, positive and seem like they want to help you! Thanks!

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.title: Not the best marriot I've been
reviews.body: This is a well hotel to stay for a couple of days.  Rooms are nice and bed, only if you like extremely soft pillows/mattress. Staff in the entrance and breakfast is very friendly. Breakfast options are good for a overprized fee. If you need to have packages sent to you during you're stay be aware of another fee and have evidence of arrival with you because they might get lost.

reviews.author: California Traveler
reviews.title: Location, location, location
reviews.body:
The location near Union Square was one of the only impressive parts of our stay. 
The beds were small and uncomfortable, definitely time to swap out the mattresses. 
Check in was a little confusing. We arrived a little early. My husband went to the restroom while I went to check in. The lady at the counter said to come back after the 4pm arrival time. I went to use the restroom also. In the meantime, my husband came back and spoke with a different team member who was able to get us into a room. It seemed like the first team member just couldn’t be bothered. 
The walls and ceilings lack any kind of sound barriers. It sounded like a track meet was going on in the hallway and above us.

reviews.author: PapaJohn
reviews.title: Comfy Bed
reviews.body: The bed was heavenly and I'm considering buying a Marriott Bed

reviews.author: Nat289
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay
reviews.body: Perfect location. Rooms are large and comfortable and we enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Big Mike
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.body: Perfect, Staff is so nice

reviews.author: B from Boston
reviews.title: Very Very Good, but Nearby Westin is Far Better Choice
reviews.body:
Context: 
Business Traveler. Titanium status. 

Review:
Overall, a strong Marriott. Had a super comfy bed and a great view. Some of the furniture is worn. The lobby flow is... dark. odd. not super welcoming. The elevator banks are also dark and gloomy. 

If the nearby Westin is available for around the same price (or even $50 more a night), I would stay there first, here second.

reviews.author: Jo Fia
reviews.title: Great stay at Union Square
reviews.body: Great location and the service was wonderful. Very friendly and helpful staff. The room and beds in double room should be larger, especially for a room booked for two adults and two children.

reviews.author: Sungjin Choi
reviews.title: Hotel is very old.
reviews.body: They need to do renovations very soon.

reviews.author: BallFam
reviews.title: Superior Hotel at Union Square
reviews.body: This hotel is completely top notch. We reserved our room with club lounge access. The people working there are amazing. The rooms were super clean. We were very happy with our stay and would highly recommend this to anyone.

reviews.author: Happy Traveller
reviews.title: Marriott Bonvoy
reviews.body: Stayed 4 nights in July initial check in went smoothly although the first room offered wasn't the one we booked but that was rectified quickly had a high floor overlooking cable cars going up Powell and beyond to Fisherman's wharf, if I was to be real picky the external of the window are very dirty but we found that at most properties we stayed at across the country other than that everything was fine.

reviews.author: Kittens that travel 12
reviews.title: Great Location and View
reviews.body: Amazing staff clean hotel with great access to china town and a short walk to fishermen’s warf.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: Great location to use as a base to explore the city. Staff was friendly and helpful. The $30 per day F&B credits plus the cable car tickets were a nice touch.

reviews.author: Jennifer from Tennessee
reviews.title: Fantastic Place to stay!
reviews.body: We loved our recent stay at the Marriott Union Square.  Every single person we encountered went above and beyond to help us.  The location was perfect, the beds were comfortable, the showers were top notch.  Everything was clean - we couldn't have asked for a better experience.  If we're ever back in SF, we'll definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: No Receipt received, room floor is dirty
reviews.body: I still have not received my hotel receipt after 5 days but there is a credit card charges without no explaination. When checked out the only lady there told me I will be emailed with the receipt, then said bye. The floor in the room was not properly cleaned, still had kids food left next to one of the bed when we walked in. There were many options for breafast on the hot food side.

reviews.author: PJEPDX
reviews.title: Great accommodations experience
reviews.body: The location is accessible to everything, the rooms are clean and well-appointed, and the service throughout the hotel was excellent.  The only disappointing aspect is that this survey does not provide an area for suggestions because more vegan options would be nice.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.title: BEST STAY
reviews.body: GOOD GOOD GOOD GOOD GOOD GOOD GOOD GOOD GOOD GOOD GOOD GOOD

reviews.author: Valkyries Fan
reviews.title: Won't stay at this hotel
reviews.body: Dissatisfied with this hotel! The check-in clerk wasn't friendly and didn't make us aware of the $30 daily food/beverage credit so we lost out on that for the first night. The room was stinky and the carpet was dingy. The doors slam very loud, creating quite a disturbance. The only positive thing about his hotel is the location, near Union Square.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Hidden costs!
reviews.body: Experienced hidden costs from the hotel that were not disclosed.  Furthermore, the bartender charged me a random fee on my bill.  Not cool.

reviews.author: RR1965
reviews.title: Excellent Location and service
reviews.body:
This hotel is conveniently located a block from the Union Square transit station which connects to BART and MUNI (including SFO, OAK and SJC). You can easily walk to several of the area's prime attractions, restaurants and parks. Most rooms have a good view of the neighborhood. 

Your choice for restaurants is extensive from McDonalds to the highest standards available in the city. The front desk staff is excellent and they go the extra mile. Rooms are "Union Square" size so don't expect super large rooms but they're comfortable and clean. 

There is a restaurant on site with limited hours and menu but still convenient. 

Compared to the nearby hotels, we found the value here for the room rate to be excellent.

reviews.author: Omcav
reviews.title: San fran stay
reviews.body: Had a wonderful stay at the San Francisco Marriott Union Square! The hotel was very clean, the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, and they were even able to get us checked in early, which made our trip start off great. Everyone we interacted with was amazing, and we had no complaints at all. Overall, it was a lovely experience and I'd definitely stay here again!"

reviews.author: conference guest
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.body: The hotel is wonderful and the staff is very accomodating

reviews.author: Frequent SF visitor
reviews.title: Nice, Easy and well located.
reviews.body: Great place to stay when visiting SF.  It is within walking distance to many SF sights and sounds.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Service From Another World
reviews.body: Absolutely blown away by my stay at the St. Regis San Francisco. I've stayed at some wonderful hotels, but service on this level is rare. Every single person I came into contact with, from the valet and doorman to the concierge, front of house, room service, restaurant staff and the spa team, was impeccable. It's all the little touches you just don't get elsewhere. A special mention to the head of the spa, who was amazing, and the massage was superb. The rooms are spacious and beautiful. The whole experience was phenomenal. You've got a new fan. I'll be staying here every time I'm in San Francisco, and seeking out St. Regis properties around the world wherever it makes sense.

reviews.author: April
reviews.title: Best hotel in San Francisco
reviews.body: My husband and I had an amazing trip to celebrate his birthday! The staff were very friendly with great attention to details. They truly went above and beyond for us to make the celebration special by decorating our room and leaving surprises throughout the trip. We were greeted with drinks and escorted to our room. The views from our butler suite were phenomenal. It was extremely quiet at night and clean, and handwritten notes were placed in the room by request. The room had blackout curtains for a good night's sleep. Concierge services included discounts on food and free tickets to the Art Museum next door. They even offered a free car service if we had dinner within a 2 mile radius of the hotel. We had dinner in the restaurant at the hotel and the service was great, with fresh flavorful ingredients. They also served us a free dessert for his birthday! The 24/7 gym and pool were well stocked, and the pool was kept warm. We also felt very safe with a key card only elevator that only works for the floor you're staying on and shared spaces. This place was hands down the best hotel we've been to and worth every penny spent. It was actually cheaper than other options in the city with less amenities.

reviews.author: Rowie
reviews.title: Romantic getaway
reviews.body: We chose the St Regis to celebrate my husband’s 40th birthday. We were not disappointed. From bubbly at valet, a surprise birthday song from our bellman, the excellent cocktails at the bar, there was just no detail overlooked. Our only regret is not staying longer. Thank you to the staff for making our weekend so special.

reviews.author: Frank
reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.body: Everyone was great. Food average at the Astra. Valet was on point as were the door people. Fitness center too small. I would stay again.

reviews.title: Started at the door, always opened for me
reviews.body: The staff, friendly and always attentive were also present. I did a lot of back and forth and felt like I returned home every time. Actually better than home. I wasn’t even expecting the mood change when I came back to my room in the evenings. Relaxing was made easy after a long day of walking and standing. I enjoyed every minute, I didn’t feel like a visitor, I definitely felt like a guest.

reviews.author: LeivyZ
reviews.title: Beautiful Surprise stay
reviews.body: My stay at the St Regis SF was anything but dull. The staff was amazing and catered to our every needs and he room service was excellent as well as the quality of food. Overall a 10/10 stay and would recommend anyone  posting SF to stay a night or 2. Not only that, but its location is so convenient and literally all the shops are walkable distances.

reviews.author: Jennifer P
reviews.title: Exceptional Service from Start to Finish
reviews.body: Our stay at The St. Regis San Francisco was exceptional from start to finish. We were celebrating our fifth wedding anniversary, and the team went above and beyond at every turn. The pre-arrival experience alone set the tone: Moneir Aziz and May Maglanoc Lee were thoughtful and thorough in noting our preferences, and when the spa happened to be closed during our dates, Felipe Lee handled it with genuine grace — arranging a suite upgrade and SFMOMA tickets as a lovely goodwill gesture. In the end we were upgraded to the Metropolitan Suite, which was absolutely stunning. Special thanks also to Robert Buen-Drews at the concierge desk, who pivoted quickly when our first dining choice fell through and secured us a wonderful table at Bar Crudo. The service throughout was warm, polished, and anticipatory — exactly what you hope for from St. Regis. We left feeling genuinely celebrated and will absolutely return for future special occasions.

reviews.author: VinBA
reviews.title: The very best San Francisco has to offer
reviews.body:
We came for family for a Giants game and were treated like absolute royalty the moment we arrived.  

The location is central to all things San Francisco.  In one weekend we watched a game at the Giant's stadium, the Exploritorium and Fisherman's Wharf.  

Our room had every detail executed- slippers, lavender essential oils, premium bedding and a bathroom fit for royalty.  The architecture and design feel like staying in a modern penthouse.  

The bar had 5star service and drinks.  The presentation and mix of my New Fashioned I had in the bar was a new core memory for me.  

The pool was quiet and secluded from city life.  The service throughout was like none other.

reviews.author: Bill K
reviews.title: If you want to spoil yourself
reviews.body: Just an incredible hotel.  A beautiful lap pool which I wished I had used, to the best bedding I’ve slept on in years.  In fact, trying to find out who their manufacturer is of the pillows, mattress and bed sheets.   Total luxury and feel like you’re living in style.  It is a hit on the pricey side but definitely felt I got what I paid for.

reviews.author: NF72
reviews.title: First Visit at St Regis San Francisco
reviews.body: Great service, elegance and detail oriented will warrant a return visit for leisure or business.

reviews.author: Moosh
reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.body: We were a group of 7 and stayed in 3 rooms for 5 nights. Although I requested to be on the same floor with my parents in advance which was confirmed on a phone and also at the time of check in, my parents were assigned to a room on 10 floors above us when they arrived later that day. Our room was not cleaned daily and this also happened to my parents’ room. We asked a concierge to notify us once the room was cleaned so we could rest a little before going out for dinner. However, after waiting in a lobby for 2 hours, nobody came to  talk to us. We just went up to our room to get changed and found out by ourselves that housekeeping service was already done. We were truly disappointed.

reviews.author: The best
reviews.title: The best visit ever
reviews.body: We had a blast, they made my birthday spectacular. Davis at the concierge and Robert the bellman were the best.  💯 we will return

reviews.author: AMC83
reviews.title: Excellent Family Stay
reviews.body:
We had an excellent family stay at The St. Regis San Francisco. The hotel is beautiful, comfortable, and very well located for exploring the city. The staff was consistently warm, attentive, and welcoming to both the adults and our children, which made the experience feel especially easy and relaxing.

Our room was spacious, quiet, and extremely comfortable, and the service throughout the hotel was outstanding. It felt luxurious without being stuffy, and the location made it convenient to get to many of San Francisco’s main attractions.

We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to families looking for a comfortable, upscale home base in the city.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Pure excellence
reviews.body: From check in to check out everything was perfect. Will absolutely be back. We found our hotel in San Francisco

reviews.author: Birthday Traveler
reviews.title: Good and Bad
reviews.body:
This is a good/bad story---
Bad: We were traveling through the city and I wanted to stay at the st. Regis very specifically for the pool and spa, mostly the sauna. I called BEFORE I booked to be sure it was working and the front desk said Yes, of course. Now I don't know for sure that the front desk knew at that time about the scheduled closure, but it seems likely they did. Okay, so I check in and say "Can't wait to get in the sauna!" and I was informed it was closed. I had already berated myself for being willing to pay $800+ for a sauna, so this was a slap in the face
Good: the front desk upgraded my room to a beautiful corner overlooking Yerba Buena Gardens which was awesome and because I mentioned it was my husband's birthday they also delivered a small box of chocolates and a handwritten card which was very sweet and appreciated. Really a thoughtful and kind effort.
Bad again: I went to the pool three times and each time it was occupied by screaming children and their parents, one set even blasting music! Really? At the St. Regis? What part of quiet elegance is that?
Anyway, I ended up taking a bath which was lovely and the view really was amazing, but I did come away feeling they could have told me the truth about what was working when I called, particularly because I love the Palace hotel around the corner that's $200 cheaper, has a pool and a hot tub, always working.

reviews.author: Raya84
reviews.title: Amazing Service!
reviews.body: We had a fantastic time at the St Regis I’m San Fran! Felipe and his team took care of us from the moment we stepped in! We traveled with our two young kids who the staff made feel so special!

reviews.author: Fabian L
reviews.title: Great Location with Excellent Service.
reviews.body: We were there for one night and the level of service and class did not disappoint. A Big  Thank You to the Front Desk Staff, Ms. Mya Lee and Mr. Jeremy. Very cordial and personal. Made the three of us (wife, son and myself) feel special. The location is pretty good and a very safe neighborhood. Just a Great Hotel all around. We were in room 1904. They accommodated our needs and recognized our Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status. Enough said.

reviews.author: MisledDad
reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.body:
My family (wife and two young kids) decided to have a staycation at the St Regis SF for my wife's birthday this past weekend. We were between the St Regis and Palace Hotel, both offering different pros/cons. The St Regis was considerably more expensive at ~800 per night after taxes and fees where the Palace Hotel was closer to 475/night. What ultimately swayed us were:

* this review that kept popping up during google searches - https://worldtraveladventurers.com/where-to-stay-in-san-francisco-with-kids-st-regis-san-francisco-review/ (which unfortunately was very misleading)
* online mentions of how family friendly the St Regis can be
* similarly, how much you hear about their legendary "Butler" service in online reviews.

Overall I thought our stay was good but not worth the price and/or price difference against the Palace Hotel. Here is what we liked and didn't like about our stay:

Stuff we liked:
* I found the hotel location to be just right. Close to Yerba Buena gardens/Moscone area for things you could walk to, and not near Market St. where there was too much street/pedestrian traffic
* Room cleaning service and staff were amazing.
* Pool was great and open 24/7. Great for night swims to end the day.
* We used our breakfast and property credit to have breakfast on both mornings we were there. The food was EXCELLENT.
* The room was immaculate. Spacious, gorgeous design, nice view.

Stuff we didn't like:
* Concierge was useless
* Front desk was not friendly. Forget any upgrades or any early check-in/late check-out.
* If you're booking through Edit, unless you're booking a suite (you're likely not), you're not getting the Butler service. Feels a bit misleading.
* The hotel gives free museum and cable car tickets to "regular" guests b/c their reservation included a $45/night destination fee. This same courtesy was not extended to us. Feels VERY nickle and dimey.

I really wanted to like the hotel, especially given how friendly most of the staff was (except probably the ones that should have been the most friendly), but unfortunately at this price point, I can't justify staying here nor recommending it to anyone else.

reviews.author: RAS3
reviews.title: Broken Promises and Discrepant Charge
reviews.body:
This was not a single miscommunication but a repeated pattern across multiple channels, all pointing to promises the hotel did not intend to keep, followed by an explanation from management that does not hold up against the hotel's own written communications and Family Traditions program designed to create memorable experiences for guests traveling with children. 

Upon check out, we received a copy of our invoice which showed and itemized breakdown of the credits applied and a balance of $0. 

I was checking my credit card and was surprised to find a charge from the St Regis. I called St Regis and was told it was a food and beverage charge. I offered to provide proof of the invoice that they had been emailed to me with the specific line item credit for the exact amount they charged me that should have been $0. This is yet another issue even after the conclusion of my stay.

reviews.author: Nicolas W
reviews.title: Very comfortable beds and a well maintained property, but not quite up to the 5-star standard
reviews.body: The beds are great. So, so, comfy. The food is okay, the drinks at the bar are excellent (try the basil martini). Water pressure should be better, as should the food. A 5-star property in SF really needs to shine and the food here was just good. Nice location for business or pleasure, and for public transit or taking a car.

reviews.author: Sherwin B
reviews.title: Our Favorite Hotel in SF
reviews.body:
The excellent service started as soon as we pulled up. We were greeted and brought up to the check-in desk. As Platinum members, we were upgraded to a higher floor. However, I was very surprised that the charge for a roll-away bed is $100 per night. We declined. The room was a good size. We are used to the corner suite, which is what we are usually upgraded to. The room was clean and well-appointed. There was a card and a chocolate plate wishing someone else a Happy 27th Birthday. The front desk apologized for the mistake and immediately came to retrieve the card. They let us keep and enjoy the chocolate plate. The bed was very comfortable, and we enjoyed a restful night's sleep. I feel the $85 per night valet fee for a regular-sized car is a little too much.

The hotel lobby and bar are beautiful. The location is excellent. We were able to walk to Yerba Buena Gardens and Union Square to catch the Big Bus tour. Food and drink were very good. We had dinner and drinks and breakfast in the lobby bar. We wished there was a little better selection for dinner.

reviews.author: Bob and Mel 78
reviews.title: Not worth the price.
reviews.body: Hotel is nice but I’m not sure what makes it a 5 star hotel. Room was clean but not overly fancy. The hot water faucet on the sink leaked very badly. At the lobby bar, the bar tenders were rude.

reviews.author: Andrea W
reviews.title: Great rooms, good location
reviews.body: The staff were wonderful, the rooms were spacious, clean, and in good order. Breakfast was more good than fantastic but overall a lovely time.

reviews.author: RaeInFL
reviews.title: Exceptional Luxury, Warm Hospitality
reviews.body:
I had an exceptional stay at The St. Regis San Francisco. The service was warm, personable, and genuinely attentive from the moment I arrived. Every staff member I interacted with went out of their way to make me feel welcome.

My room was beautiful with an incredible view, and the recommendations I received throughout my stay were outstanding. It wasn’t just the concierge who was knowledgeable—everyone I spoke with offered thoughtful suggestions that enhanced my visit.

The St. Regis delivers true luxury while maintaining a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. It’s elegant without feeling stuffy, and the attention to detail was evident in every interaction. I would gladly stay here again and highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Exquisite by Patty
reviews.title: Beautiful ambience
reviews.body: Down to earth people and beautiful art!!

reviews.author: Jeng
reviews.title: A restful stay
reviews.body:
I stayed at the St. Regis San Francisco for one night last week and had a great experience. The location is excellent, right in the heart of downtown San Francisco, making it very convenient to get around the city. The hotel has a modern, elegant design, and everything was clean and well maintained.

One thing that really stood out was the excellent soundproofing. Unlike many hotels these days, I couldn’t hear my neighbors walking around, running water, toilets flushing, the elevator, or people in the hallway. It made for a very quiet and restful stay.

The staff was friendly and professional throughout my visit. My only minor complaint is that almost everything comes with an additional charge, so be prepared for extra costs.

Overall, it’s a beautiful hotel in a fantastic location with outstanding soundproofing and great service. I would definitely consider staying here again.

reviews.author: JJ123
reviews.title: Another Stay at St. Regis
reviews.body: upon arrival to departure they make you feel appreciated.  Love the Boutique style of a stay and the attention to detail.  We will be back again. Our go to place. Thank you St. Regis staff

reviews.author: Steve G
reviews.title: Perfect Place to Hang Your Hat in San Francisco
reviews.body: Amazing location within walking distance to downtown, the wharf, Chinatown and Little Italy. Rare tub inside the room with a view of the city to die for. Top notch service, great bar, and staff that offers excellent attentive service.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Perfect experience
reviews.body: For superb service and a beautiful room I highly recommend this property.

reviews.author: AuuBab1837181
reviews.title: Amazing SPA, Great Doormen, Everything else was shockingly terrible
reviews.body:
The repeated broken commitments, lack of follow-through, lack of consideration for the basics, and complete lack of attention to detail is astonishing. I am beyond shocked by the complete lack of customer service and lack of any basic follow-through, accountability and respect.

I was in a room in which the shower was unusable for 2 nights and my laundry was lost for 2 days without any update or anyone being able to tell me where it was and then was returned smelling terrible.

reviews.author: amarachel
reviews.title: Always Amazing
reviews.body: I absolutely love the W San Francisco. I’ve had the pleasure of staying here multiple times for work over the past few years, and it never disappoints. From the friendly, attentive staff to the spotless rooms and vibrant lobby bar, everything about this property makes work travel very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Jesse
reviews.title: Excellent in every way.
reviews.body: Property newly renovated so facilities clean/nice.  Above all staff service/attitude/support excellent.  Definitely one of the better W Hotel’s I’ve stayed at and amongst the best of Marriott properties in city.

reviews.author: Sandi
reviews.title: No the best W location
reviews.body: I've loved W hotels, but this location definitely isn't one of the good ones.

reviews.author: C McM
reviews.title: Comfortable stay in a great location.
reviews.body: We came to the city to see the Matisse exhibition at SF MOMA next door, so the location was perfect. Also easy walking to several restaurants . Our upgraded corner room was very comfortable. The staff was very friendly and helpful- especially the servers in the Trace breakfast restaurant. The breakfast buffet, omlets , and pasteries were delicious . I did not realize that the room’s minibar was not refridgerated, and had to discard some food. The front desk was able to send a minifridge to the room, however. Parking in MOMA’s garage cost 1/3 of  the hotel garage.

reviews.author: San Francisco W
reviews.title: Excellent hotel, despite construction
reviews.body: Everything at this hotel is amazing despite there construction unfortunately during the construction, there was no restaurant or food services available. However, everything else was amazing. The staff was friendly. The hotel was clean and safe. All the other amenities that were offered were working perfectly, and there was no broken damaged anything and the staff was extremely helpful in finding places we could go eat that were good. I’m sure after the  and the staff was extremely helpful in finding places we could go eat that we’re good. I’m sure after the construction is over and the restaurant services return it will be five star.

reviews.author: Henry
reviews.title: Best Weekend
reviews.body: I expected my trip to San Francisco to be out of the hotel, but I was already thinking what time I'd be coming back to our room. It was so comfortable and very organized.
