The service was professional but they had fun with us. Talked to us more than being just another customer to them. I'm already thinking about coming back again to see more of San Francisco since it's conveniently in the middle of everything I wanted to see.

reviews.author: lambchop807
reviews.title: 5 Star Customer Service Hotel
reviews.body: Prior to my arrival I receive an email asking for information that I need during my upcoming stay.  When I check in I am welcomed by name as well as my friend.  The W Hotel feels like my second home.  I choose this hotel over others even though it may cost a little more because I feel so welcome and appreciated.

reviews.author: Jay L
reviews.title: Great view and location
reviews.body: The front entrance was renovating so it was difficult to locate the hotel. There was also no vanity provided despite a nice hotel (toothbrush, comb). I don't use it but most of the nicer hotel I used had these necessities.

reviews.author: Always Flying Somewhere
reviews.title: Great Vibe in SF
reviews.body:
I visit San Francisco at least once per quarter and this is my favorite property. I love that it's away from Union Square. The hotel's public areas are currently undergoing renovation, but the hotel has done a fabulous job of minimizing impact by moving Reception and F&B  to the third floor. 

The temporary "Living Room" currently resides inside a conference room and they've even retained the DJ. Breakfast consists of a buffet, including an omelet station, that is accessible to Bonvoy Elite (Platinum+) members.

We cashed in some Nightly Upgrade Awards and received an upgrade to the Penthouse Suite on the 31st floor. While it could use some renovating, we enjoyed our stay (and the spectacular view). 

We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Family of 4
reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.body: We appreciated the staff accommodating our family situation.  Parking at $95+ and you have to move your luggage during construction feels like a very broken experience

reviews.author: Geoff
reviews.title: W for the Win
reviews.body: This is always a destination for my dance troupe Mabuhay Folkloric Society and I. Josh was extremely hospitable. He has assisted in our check ins the last few years and he always accommodates us for our annual celebration of the Pistahan Festival that embraces the Filipino hospitality and culture. We are extremely grateful for his kindness, respect, and care that he graciously provides. Our stay was practically perfect for the most part as it usually is at the W. Our only concern was the Key Cards being demagnetized repeatedly for our Suite causing us to be locked out. Thankfully throughout the weekend Josh and everyone at the lobby were happy to assist us whenever this inconvenience would occur whether it be coming back from our performances throughout the day, gym sessions in the morning, or evening outings. We love it here and cannot wait to come back.

reviews.author: Nestor Popowych
reviews.title: Mr.
reviews.body: Excellent hotel with great service!

reviews.author: Happy Elite
reviews.title: Well worth the stay
reviews.body: Great experience at the W, and far superior to the way the JW Marriott in in SF treated me as an elite member immediately before my stay at the W.

reviews.author: Wayne
reviews.title: No Storage No View
reviews.body: 1408 is billed as a high floor, corner room with a view.  I guess, if you consider the museum wall right outside your window view worthy.  Room design is kitchy, 80's cool but not functional.  No drawer space, no shelf space in the bathroom.  Staff are great, location convenient, but overall, a disappointing stay.

reviews.author: Turnbizzle
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.body: This was a our first stay at the W in San Francisco and it didn't disappoint.  The staff (starting with the valet) were extremely friendly and welcoming.  The room was gorgeous.  Location was centrally located so it was easy to walk to Oracle Stadium and restaurants nearby.  We had breakfast in the Living Room which was great for your above average hotel breakfast - made to order omelets were delicious.  We also needed to contact the security staff after our stay due to a very sentimental item being left behind in the in room safe.  Even the security staff was accommodating, friendly, and went above and beyond.  Cannot say enough positive things.  We will be back.  Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: Handal
reviews.title: W San Francisco
reviews.body: It was okay. The rooms are small and not the cleanest. The beds are full size beds. I probably wouldn't stay there again if I had the choice.  The service was great and everyone was friendly.

reviews.author: N V C
reviews.title: The staff is amazing; they go above and beyond.
reviews.body: The W San Francisco hotel staff is great

reviews.author: Sims
reviews.title: Construction
reviews.body: We had a good time at the W San Francisco. It was a great location. The construction on the lobby and restaurant were very intrusive. Wait until it is over to visit. Supposedly done by sept 2026.

reviews.author: Kay10
reviews.title: First time at the W
reviews.body: The location was excellent and very convenient. Unfortunately, the guests in the room above ours were making excessive noise until approximately 1:00 a.m., which made it difficult to get a good night’s sleep. Additionally, both beds were extremely uncomfortable. The mattresses were lumpy and overly soft, making it difficult to find a comfortable sleeping position. A comfortable bed should be one of the highlights of a hotel stay, but instead, we spent the night tossing and turning trying to get comfortable. On a positive note, the staff were courteous, friendly, and provided excellent customer service throughout our stay.

reviews.author: Lucy1994
reviews.title: Excellent service for family
reviews.body: The staff have been super nice to my two children. My kids had a great stay in the hotel.

reviews.author: Schera
reviews.title: Great Stay in the Bay!
reviews.body: I had a wonderful vacation in San Francisco and the W Hotel was a big part of the reason why. It was a perfect home away from home with a friendly, happy, and helpful staff! The room was lovely and my view was excellent. I will choose the W again for my next visit to San Francisco!

reviews.author: Yba1
reviews.title: An extraordinary Stay
reviews.body:
Our family travels frequently and stays at many well-known hotel brands, but the team at W San Francisco truly exceeded every expectation.

From the front desk, bell staff, breakfast team, chefs, and housekeeping, every interaction was warm, genuine, and attentive. The little details made all the difference—from the head chef personally preparing a special meal for our daughter with dietary restrictions, to Beto’s exceptional service at breakfast, my wife’s perfectly made oat milk espresso every morning, and the thoughtful extra Nespresso pods left in our room.

These are the kinds of touches that are surprisingly rare, even at luxury hotels. Whatever the General Manager is doing to inspire this team is clearly working.

Thank you for giving our family one of the best Fourth of July weekends we’ve ever had. We can’t wait to stay at more W Hotels and will absolutely be back to W San Francisco

reviews.author: Wwhat
reviews.title: Needs new management and attention.
reviews.body: The W is complete chaos and not in an artsy good way.  The staff was friendly and tried very hard, but it was obvious they had poor management.  The hotel common areas are dirty and run down.  This was my first stay at a W brand hotel and will likely be my last.  They should tear this place down and start all over.

reviews.author: PermaFrost
reviews.title: Mislead and very disappointed
reviews.body: We had a very strange experience during our visit. First of all, we were not informed that ALL of the hotel's public areas are under renovation until maybe a day before our trip. The room was nice, but getting to it through two elevators and a construction zone - not so much. The breakfast was absolutely atrocious, boderline inedible. I cannot understand how you can charge $40 for powder scramble eggs and tepid water for tea. We addressed this issue with the hotel manager, she promissed she would review and respond the same day, but never did.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: A rare failure of the W brand by marriot
reviews.body: The stay was mediocre at best considering the cost. Firstly the renovations meant lots of facilities not being available. While checking in - no one helped with the bags. Being a Gold elite member - they didnt even check if there was a complimentary room upgrade available, no appreciation. Breakfast quality was good but a 25 USD voucher for breakfast having paid almost 450usd a night for a room in a 5 star hotel?? Felt like i was living in a budget 3 star hotel. Dental kits were also not present in the bathrooms. I am a long term W fan and Marriot member but this was such a bad experience that I might not ever choose W again atleaat in the US

reviews.author: 123321ABC
reviews.title: Fine, but lacked important information regarding fees
reviews.body: The stay was fine and employees were friendly. However, the front desk did not explain the destination fee properly, nor did they explain what the "incidentals" charges included. Be prepared for the insanely priced valet if you're planning to bring a vehicle and for a $30 per night destination fee. They do offer deals with the destination fee, but the website to redeem some deals did not appear to be up-to-date. Overall, the value for money spent was not worth it.

reviews.author: June2025ConferenceGuest
reviews.title: Great Location, Mediocre Service, In the middle of a renovation.
reviews.body:
I've stayed at this W on more than one occasion when in San Fran for conferences. This was my worst experience with the hotel by far. I called ahead because my flight was delayed, that information was not relayed to the staff working the desk, so my 3:30AM check-in turned into a much longer ordeal than necessary. 

The current construction detracts from the normal feel, and you have to navigate a maze to find the check-in desk. 
Rooms are starting to show their age.

reviews.author: Sam2026
reviews.title: Expensive hotel with sub par service and food and room
reviews.body:
This hotel is in a convenient location next to the Moscone Center, making it a good choice for business travelers attending events nearby. Unfortunately, that was the main positive aspect of my stay.

The hotel is quite expensive, but the overall experience did not justify the price. The room was below expectations, service was inconsistent, and the food quality was disappointing. There was ongoing construction during my stay, resulting in significant dust and noise that made the environment uncomfortable.

The ambiance of the property was also lacking. The lobby felt dark and uninviting, which created a poor first impression. Food and beverages at the bar were excessively overpriced. For example, an almond croissant cost $16 and was stale.

Given the high room rates, I expected a much better level of service, cleanliness, atmosphere, and dining quality. While the location is excellent, I would not stay here again unless significant improvements are made.

reviews.author: Nancy C
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Enjoyed our stay for a weekend get away. Great service, excellent food, great value for the price.

reviews.author: Heath
reviews.title: Housekeeping and Security teams
reviews.body: I left items in my room safe. When I called, the Security team had all of my items and helped with arranging their return in a prompt manner.

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.title: Convenience of downtown
reviews.body: Easy and convenient. Staff does not do housekeeping until close to 5pm. Vanity kits run low on stock sometimes.

reviews.author: Fish
reviews.title: Great hotel, bad location
reviews.body: Great hotel. Reasonable price. Everything is new. But awful location. So many homeless and drug addicts right outside the hotel. Honestly a scary walk back to the convention center. Poor food options around it.

reviews.author: KICKIT
reviews.title: Good but no early check-in
reviews.body: I really enjoyed my stay.  The location was great- however I do wish they offered the option of early check in.  I flew in at 6am and was hoping to check in to rest before my event.  I had called Marriot CS to confirm and they gave me the run around.  After bouncing from rep to rep, the final rep said they put in the request but cannot guarantee and would have to go in person. I did and I learned that they DO NOT offer early check in at all.  I wish I new this ahead of time. Instead, I had to wait in the lobby until 10a to head to my event. Other than this, the hotel was clean, had an awesome vibe, the staff was incredibly nice.

reviews.title: Great spot Downtown LA
reviews.body: I had no expectations and was completely blown away! Firstly self check-in was easy. Parking was right across the street (not included in room rate but v. Easy) Room was utterly fantastic. So clean … now these rooms are small but efficient. All of the amenities are superb … everything from lighting to shades to media run by an iPad! I hung out in the lobby and made calls … very comfortable. Breakfast buffet rocked … I’d stay here again! Thanks for the hospitality!

reviews.author: Felixo
reviews.title: Citizen M
reviews.body: I would highly recommend this place to everyone! The staff is amazing and I always feel safe when I stay here

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Not a v good experience
reviews.body: Room size is too small , like a student lodge. Not for family couples

reviews.author: Larissa
reviews.title: 10 Nights at CitizenM
reviews.body: This was my first time staying at CitizenM DTLA and I will definitely be staying here again. This was the first time I booked a smaller room and I had no issues as a solo traveller. The bed was comfortable, room was tidy and the staff helpful and friendly. I felt safe staying here by myself and would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Crys N
reviews.title: Customer Service needs improvement
reviews.body: I enjoy Citizen M properties. I've stayed in SF, DC and Seattle. The amenities were great and it's extremely clean however customer service was lacking and the staff was not thorough which affected how I felt overall about my experience.

reviews.author: Fmedina104
reviews.title: Excellence in Service !!
reviews.body: Modern and Close to Everything

reviews.author: AitanK
reviews.title: A Comfortable Stay with Great Service
reviews.body: I had a great stay at CitizenM Hotel last week. The room was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a relaxing stay. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the overall atmosphere was welcoming. I really enjoyed my time there and would happily recommend the hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable place to stay. I’d definitely consider coming back

reviews.author: Duck
reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.body: This hotel is advertise very deceptively. I believe it’s quite. expensive for what it’s giving. When you walk in, it’s not a normal Concierge check-in. I guess they are trying to be ahead of the trend of technology. It’s a little table with a few kiosk where you check yourself in there may or may not be someone there to help you. When I was having some issues, figuring it out the gentleman was a little rude and belittling as if I were supposed to know what to do. It’s not giving hospitality. Then you go into the room and it is literally a shotgun room a box as if you are in a dorm room. I would say that this room is for a bachelor. That is just staying for business and leaving right away. Me and my boyfriend had to climb over each other just to go to the bathroom. Because the bed doesn’t have an entrance in a Ulta on both sides.  I would say that this room is for a bachelor. That is just staying for business and leaving right away. Me and my boyfriend had to climb over each other just to go to the bathroom. Because the bed doesn’t have an entrance in an out on both sides. The bathroom is small, no privacy. They gave only ones set of towel again. I guess they were hoping for a bachelor. When I called to see if we could get cups because they didn’t have none in the room as well as extra set of towel towels I was given an attitude and said that I should come down and get them. That they do not have anyone for that. Then my itinerary came with free breakfast, which I paid extra for. My boyfriend had went down first and the bartender that was in charge of the breakfast argued with him saying that he needed to pay for breakfast. When I came down, I said no it’s included with our stay. So he said well let’s check with the front desk. There was a gentleman that was standing there that was fiddling with his suit and he asked him. Can you help me with my suit? The bartender begin to go in the back of him while I’m standing there, ignoring me and what we were coming to the front floor to help him with his suit. It was not a quick fix. He walked away to grab scissors. He came back. I’m just standing there and discuss and I said excuse me. I’m still waiting. I’m bout to go get my breakfast. He told me hold on and continued to cut his tags of the managers suit. The manager did not even ask me what was going on what was I waiting for? They were very dismissive. Finally, I found my itinerary and I shoved it in his face and said see. I have free breakfast. That was five minutes later and he said oh ok go  ahead, help yourself. I guess he heard me cussing at my boyfriend and so then his tone and demeanor changed once I yelled that I was going to be making a bad review.. he then asked if we wanted anything to drink that he could make and to take as much food as we wanted as they were gonna be shutting down soon. However, that is how they should have greeted me in the first place. As a guest staying, we had our bags and the keys to our room. We should not have been treated like that. It was terrible. I do not recommend this at hotel at all. Yes also the parking around there is terrible that you gotta find and pay for.

reviews.author: Naeee
reviews.title: Best stay of my life
reviews.body: I’ve spent my birthday here and it was ABSOLUTELY AMAZING and worth every DIME

reviews.author: Much Better
reviews.title: Much Better
reviews.body: This location change my mind on how I felt about CitizenM Hotel.  I didn't have a good experience at the first one I stayed in downtown Miami BUT DTLA came in and change my mind... from when I step into for the first time, till my last day when I left...Hey Matt lol....I want to thank the staff for making me feel comfortable and wanted...being nice does go along way and now I'm looking forward to staying at the Chicago downtown location...

reviews.author: Ana98
reviews.title: Very good hotel option
reviews.body: I loved this hotel. The staff is very nice and overall its very clean and has a lot of places that you can go nearby.

reviews.author: business
reviews.title: good
reviews.body: good value for money, location, service, cleaning and amenities.

reviews.author: DJ Morris
reviews.title: Book for an individual experience worth a million words
reviews.body: Traveled to many CitizenM around the United States and Europe and LA location is by far my favorite one due to the staff. Thank you to Hector for always helping me with my stay. He goes above and beyond and truly understands the value of hospitality. CitizenM is unique and oozes innovation but also can be the invaluable reminder to most other hotel brands who has seem to forget the sole purpose of hotel experience which is hospitality. Thank you!

reviews.author: Peaches
reviews.title: My Experience
reviews.body: I enjoyed my stay here, I made the best of the experience with my love …I wouldn’t recommend this hotel for couples because of the small room size there is no microwave in the room, no iron or ironing board inside the rooms … 1 thing I can say is that it’s literally an upscale dorm room with beautiful ranges of color lights inside the room.. you can control everything inside the room with the iPad which is pretty cool it’s little to no room to walk around …most of the room I seen is in the lobby area downstairs lol 😂 the room was clean ..room service cleaned every day so it was great coming back to a clean room and new sheets and towels every day .. I’m not sure why they only give one washcloth but when I asked for more it was no problem but 2 washcloths should be the minimum or really 4 especially because some people use one for their face and the other for the rest of their body. My tv stopped working the second day but maintenance maybe took 15-20 min and helped me to get the remote to turn the tv back on so it was fast service when it came to the things I needed. The best other thing is this hotel does not require a 100 day deposit like the others so it was a great choice for the weekend and it’s super close walking distance to downtown to get out and walk around & the grand central market that had so many good food and shopping choices !! I would rate it a 7/10 because of the room size..no microwave ..and no ironing board otherwise it was a pretty okay experience.

reviews.author: Nesha B
reviews.title: If you’re traveling alone
reviews.body: Excellent from check in to check out, beautiful hotel, comfortable beds, great location, love the iPad, definitely safe for a solo traveler, staff were very nice

reviews.author: Greg the photographer
reviews.title: Great spot to stay on a business trip.
reviews.body: 10 out of 10, would recommend.

reviews.author: Great Location
reviews.title: Comfortable stay
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location. It is clean, near and secure. Easy access to many amenities. However, i soon realized that it is dangerous to go out in the evening after dark. There are a number of homeless people on either side of the road. Some of them looked too rough and i felt really uncomfortable walking down the street. Apparently this hotel is on the boarderline on where rough sleepers hang out. No issues with the hotel thought but the surrounding areas doesn't look that great.

reviews.author: Sm1955
reviews.title: Hidden treasure
reviews.body: This is one of the best stays I can remember having in a hotel. The staff were so personal and accommodating and happy and friendly. The artistic design of the hotel in the rooms is beautiful, quirky artistic modern clean with a lot of open space. The downtown LA area it's in is a bit sketchy but you quickly learn which directions are good to walk in and which ones to avoid. Impeccably clean, e-z-going but completely professional and contemporary. 10 + +

reviews.author: Ti83
reviews.title: Nice place!
reviews.body: Recommended if you don't mind the surrounding streets

reviews.author: DoubleL
reviews.title: BEST HOTEL IN LA
reviews.body: If I could give you 10 stars I would

reviews.author: Hisayo
reviews.title: A Comfortable Trip to Los Angeles
reviews.body: The location offered easy access to popular tourist spots and to the Los Angeles Dodgers game, which was the main purpose of the trip.

reviews.author: Anneisha
reviews.title: Obssesed
reviews.body: Definitely gonna stay here next time I'm in Los Angeles.

reviews.author: GWilliams
reviews.title: Great hotel for an independent traveler
reviews.body: The hotel was perfect for me. Modern look, clean with easy access... nothing too fussy. It was also in a great location. Could easily grab a bite at the market around the corner. Could also walk a block and hop on the train.

reviews.author: UrbanGuest0817
reviews.title: A Thoughtfully Social Take on the Downtown Hotel Stay
reviews.body:
citizenM LA Downtown is designed to draw guests into its shared spaces: the lobby, co-working areas, living room, and bar. The rooms are minimalist, but not lacking; they have everything needed for a comfortable stay. They simply are not meant for lingering in the way the common areas are.

I appreciated how different this felt from the more isolating experience of many hotels. The emphasis on social, welcoming spaces was thoughtfully conceived and well executed.

reviews.author: Travelers420
reviews.title: Tiny rooms.
reviews.body: The room was tiny, roughly 7 feet by 25 feet, including the bathroom.  There was nowhere to legally stop to load and unload luggage.  The staff was friendly and helpful.  We were disappointed that we could not use our amenity credit for breakfast.

reviews.author: Laurence
reviews.title: This hotel is fabulous!
reviews.body: CitizenM Downtown is  an hotel you will want to come back and make your second home in Los Angeles! The team is prodigious : always here to say hello, helping you for anything or making for you a delicious cocktail. We really feel they love there job and it’s make the ambiance of the hotel totally unique. The rooms are very comfortable, beautiful design and a tablet to personalize the ambiance, clim and everything. Checking and checkout are done in 2 minutes. Wifi very fast and a delicious breakfast (buffet). I recommend it and can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Anthony
reviews.title: LA Citizen M
reviews.body: The rooms are clean, quiet, and perfect for business travel. The air conditioning is surprisingly quiet, the beds are comfortable, and the rooms are well designed for a good night’s sleep. It’s a great place to stay when you’re traveling for work or don’t plan to spend much time in your room. The lobby is also a great space to relax or hang out.

reviews.author: Tracy Urias
reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.body: Five stars for the incredible customer service! I ran into a stressful issue with my reservation upon arrival, but the management team stepped in immediately and handled it with absolute grace and professionalism. To make things right, they even upgraded me to a beautiful complimentary room. Turning a negative situation into such a positive experience shows true hospitality. I will absolutely be staying here again!

reviews.author: LA for the night
reviews.title: No bad dogs
reviews.body: Would have been a great stay except for the two big dogs that growled and barked all the time in the room next door.

reviews.author: PSColorado2026
reviews.title: Returning to LA after 10 years
reviews.body: The customer service was excellent -with the front desk staff very kind and welcoming and made my check-in very quick and smooth. The valet staff were also very kind and quick with my vehicle requests (they kindly opened the door for the two of us- passenger and driver, daily). The lobby level restaraunt staff was also very hospitable and provided great service during breakfast. The hotel was clean and grand (i.e., shopping, dining, rooftop pool. and the gym) and I loved the different towers layout. I did not walk to any nearby attractions, but the location was convenient and easy to get to in the downtown area. The room itself was very spacious and clean with a comfortable bed and comforter. The only down side was that I couldn't find an iron and ironing board, unless this was located elsewhere or upon request? I will definitely stay here again when I return to Los Angeles, CA.

reviews.author: proctor1981
reviews.title: Old and Poorly Staffed
reviews.body: This property is extremely dated. The rooms and public areas are just old. You can tell hasn’t been renovated in a long time. And the food and beverage department is extremely understaffed. Stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: Charles F
reviews.title: Amazing hotel experience
reviews.body: Very much enjoyed staying at the Bonaventure

reviews.author: SC62
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Great hotel and excellent stay.LOVED it.

reviews.author: Mrkmrf
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: I will be staying again. Absolutely beautiful hotel, large rooms, super clean. Central location. The only thing is the parking is expensive and there is no street parking.

reviews.author: Asmaa
reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.body: Very convenient location,

reviews.author: James C
reviews.title: Stay with family
reviews.body:
Location in good area next to shops and restaurants. Beds are full size not queen if you book 2 beds. Lobby and lounge area are very nice. Valet parking staff is very helpful. 
I would stay again at this hotel.

reviews.author: MAHALO
reviews.title: 2泊しました
reviews.body:
風呂の流れが悪く、足首まですぐに溜まってしまい、清潔では無かった。
高級ホテルなのに残念だった。
風呂の時間が不快でした。日本ではとても良いホテルなのに。

reviews.author: Cortez
reviews.title: Great view
reviews.body: Loved the view, location, comfort, @ staff

reviews.author: Rebecca G
reviews.title: Elegant, safe and clean city view hotel.
reviews.body: I absolutely love this hotel. It has the most amazing city views set up in an elegant style in downtown LA. I came into town several time in the past few months for chemotherapy and always stayed here because they always spoil me. The perfect home away from home with posh and style. You can dress up for a classy dinner at LA Prime or relax in the soft pillow top bed. I love this place. Its in a safe area of LA and convenient to everything. The waterfalls in the lobby are just amazing. The glass elevator is so cool. The city view from the room is beautiful.

reviews.author: Daisy
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing stay!
reviews.body: It’s such a beautiful place, offers so much in if, staff is attentive.

reviews.author: Castro1
reviews.title: 10 out of 10 in every aspect.
reviews.body: Every employee was very courteous and helpful, and the property was clean and well taken care of.

reviews.author: Raj92
reviews.title: 5 star service
reviews.body:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I had such a wonderful experience at the Westin! The staff was incredibly kind and helpful throughout my entire stay. They always had an EV charger available for me every night, which I really appreciated.

I wish I could remember everyone’s name who helped me! A special thank you to Ruben, Mauricio, Gerald aka “G Money” 😂, Ron, Josue, and the wonderful lady who checked me in whose name I believe started with a Y. I tried to remember as many names as I could because everyone was truly so nice and welcoming. I know I maybe leaving some names out and I am so sorry. 

My room was extremely clean and comfortable. I’ve stayed here multiple times and have never been disappointed! The amazing service is exactly why I’m always happy to tip the people who go out of their way to make my stay easier and more enjoyable.

I love this place and will definitely continue coming back! ❤️

reviews.author: kaip
reviews.title: tv stopped working
reviews.body: Some one came to room twice and harassed me

reviews.author: D Ortiz 1
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Great place to stay and close to everything.  Clean hotel.

reviews.author: BrotherTwaan
reviews.title: 5 Star experience
reviews.body: It was a lovely stay. I was here for my jobs national convention for the Apwu. Hotel was beautiful, clean, smells amazing. Their white tea scent is top notch. Smell it as soon as you walk into the hotel. I’d recommend a stay like this to anyone. I’ve already been telling family and friends. Thank you Westin!

reviews.author: Persephanie
reviews.title: Best Hotel in LA
reviews.body:
Westin Bonaventure Hotel rates 5.0 
The Best Hotel in LA

reviews.author: Lori
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: Hotel was nice, clean. Staff was professional. Housekeeping did a great job

reviews.author: TERESA
reviews.title: GREAT HOTEL
reviews.body: THE HOTEL WAS LOCATED IN A VERY NICE AREA WHERE YOU COULD VISIT PRIME ATTRACTIONS. IT WAS NICE & CLEAN WITH VERY FRIENDLY STAFF. THE BEDS ARE VERY COMFORTABLE.

reviews.author: Anneg
reviews.title: Good hotel
reviews.body: Clean ,good food , housekeeping staff outstanding

reviews.author: UrenaE
reviews.title: Honest Review- Room for Improvement
reviews.body:
My stay at the Westin Bonaventure was okay overall, but unfortunately it did not meet the expectations I had for a hotel of this caliber.

When we arrived, the hotel was extremely busy. It took approximately 40 minutes just to reach the front desk for check-in. The representative assisting us appeared overwhelmed and frustrated, while another younger employee seemed to primarily be calling the next guest in the Premier line rather than helping with the growing number of guests waiting. The overall check-in experience felt disorganized and understaffed.

The hotel also felt unusually warm throughout our stay. Los Angeles has been experiencing extremely hot weather, so I understand that may have contributed, but the heat was noticeable throughout the property. The valet waiting area was particularly uncomfortable. This was also one of my biggest frustrations with the stay. I understand the convenience of valet parking, but requiring guests to valet essentially every vehicle becomes extremely expensive. Once city taxes and additional fees are added, the cost comes close to $100 per day, which I find excessive. Having a self-parking option would make a significant difference.

Our room was adequate, but it felt smaller than the description led me to expect. The bathroom was especially tight, and the sink had very low water pressure. I was also surprised by how much outside noise we could hear from the 25th floor. We could hear significant street and transient noise even at that elevation.

The elevators were another issue. There was no noticeable air conditioning inside them, and because they are exposed to the outside and direct sunlight, they became extremely hot. With multiple stops and additional passengers getting on and off, the temperature inside the elevator could become very uncomfortable.

We also had problems with the ice machines. The machines were dispensing partially melted ice, and the surrounding floor was wet. We had to keep returning to try different machines to find usable ice. These may seem like small issues individually, but together they contributed to the feeling that several areas of the hotel simply needed more attention and maintenance.

To be fair, my stay wasn’t terrible, but it also wasn’t the experience I expected from a Westin. The property seemed understaffed, and there were several areas where better maintenance, staffing, and guest attention could make a significant difference.

I hope management takes this feedback seriously because the hotel has a lot of potential. Unfortunately, during my stay, too many things felt like they were falling through the cracks.

reviews.author: Patrick
reviews.title: Where was the food?
reviews.body: The hotel is nice but after the pandemic food options have practically all but disappeared.

reviews.author: Derek
reviews.title: Fantastic Convocation facility
reviews.body:
Attended a week long church Convocation at the Bonaventure. It is a great place with interesting and unique style that has many different spaces and rooms for hosting a big event.
Nice outdoor pool and patio area and indoor fitness area.
Good location for DTLA needs.
All the staff were friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Carol SH
reviews.title: Wonderful stay at the Bonaventure for over 10 years
reviews.body: I have been staying at the Westinghouse Bonaventure during the SRF Convocation for over 10 years. It has been a great hotel. The only drawback this year was a significant decrease in the number of available restaurants within the hotel.

reviews.author: Lil7
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Overall excellent experience with stay and food.

reviews.author: Ramki A
reviews.title: Always great place to stay
reviews.body: World class beyond comparison.

reviews.author: Aaron
reviews.title: We discovered a new LA Gem.
reviews.body:
We only stayed one night at the Bonaventure, but it was wonderful.

The hotel itself is an amazing place. Exploring the central lobby is an adventure. We could see the remains of the old mall, and it was fascinating to imagine all those interior floors filled with people and businesses back in the 1980s. The building itself is a work of art—Brutalism taken to another level. Even though the hotel was built in the 1970s it feels like you are stepping into the future.

The staff were a big part of the experience: 
helpful, friendly, and welcoming. And definitely go for the breakfast buffet, it was delicious!

It is hard to summarize all the things we liked about our stay there. It wasn’t just about having a comfortable place to sleep; the hotel itself became a big part of our adventure and our enjoyment of exploring Downtown LA.

I lived in Los Angeles for 12 years and now live about four hours north in Morro Bay, so I know the places worth visiting in LA. The Bonaventure was a wonderful surprise that I'll be adding it to my list of LA gems.

Thanks to you and your staff for a wonderful stay!
We loved it.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: LA holidays
reviews.body:
My husband and I really enjoyed our stay at the Bonaventure Hotel overall, but there are a few areas that definitely need improvement.

First, the food and dining options were disappointing. Many of the places to eat inside the hotel were closed, which made dinner difficult. We did not feel comfortable going outside the hotel at night because the surrounding area did not feel very safe. The main restaurant was often very crowded, and it was difficult to find a table. Even when we found a table, the service was very slow. One evening, I ordered chicken wings and they arrived burnt, very dry, and hard. For the dining experience, I would give the hotel about 5/10.

The second issue was housekeeping. Unfortunately, the room cleaning service was very inconsistent. On several occasions, it was already around 7:00 p.m. and our room still had not been cleaned. I actually had to go and find someone and ask them to clean it. This happened approximately five days during our 10-day stay. They also did not always replace the bottles of water in the room.

After spending the whole day out, it is very frustrating to come back to your hotel room in the evening and find that it has still not been cleaned.

Overall, we really liked the hotel, but improving the dining options, restaurant service, and especially the housekeeping would make the experience much better.

reviews.author: MDM Delonghi
reviews.title: A secreat place on Olive & Seventh
reviews.body: All you need to know is that I will return and was a wonderful stay.

reviews.author: review1
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.body: Our stay was extremely disappointing. The first room had major pluming issues. The bathroom was leaking and the sink won't drain. The second room had AC issues and our AC won't turn on periodically. The staff at Cafe Ora was extremely rude. The front desk is condescending and there were unexplained charges on my bill and hidden fees that they are not upfront about. Extremely limited room service. Overall very disappointing stay.

reviews.author: LAReet123
reviews.title: Hotel Per La
reviews.body: Hotel Per La is an excellent place to stay while in downtown LA. The Hotel is beautiful and well maintained. The preservation of the beautiful Italian style architecture is amazing! The room decor was complimentary to the style of the Hotel. All the food we had in the restaurants was outstanding !! My husband and I highly recommend recommend staying at this Hotel.

reviews.author: ShelbyR
reviews.title: Poor guest issues handling / not solution oriented staff
reviews.body: I had a business trip and stayed for 2 nights. First night, A/C stopped working and considering it is a hot summer season, I reported it twice and nothing was done. I had to go downstairs at 3am and speak directly with the front desk and I was told nothing could be done until 6:30am when the first person from Engineering started his shift. I couldn't sleep nor rest for my upcoming busy work day. After 2 more calls at 7am, a new guest services agent offered me to change the room and sent a key. I had a very poor performance and work day due to this incident and lack of efficiency in solving a guest maintenance issue.

reviews.author: C Wheeler
reviews.title: Another Excellent Stay
reviews.body: This is an outstanding hotel. Very comfortable, clean and quiet. We will return again in the near future.

reviews.author: Fan of PerLA
reviews.title: Top Notch hotel in DTLA
reviews.body: From the valet to the check in to the restaurants and the bars this place delivers an upscale personalized service like no other in  DTLA!

reviews.author: Emelita
reviews.title: Beware of double charges from the bar
reviews.body: I have never given a bad review previously but the front desk person was irritated that I was disputing the duplicate charges . Not helpful at all

reviews.author: YankeeGirlChris
reviews.title: A unique experience
reviews.body: Seeing this hotel online does not do it justice. It is a piece of art… Everywhere you look, the rooms were gorgeous. Bathroom was perfect beautiful Tile Work beds super comfortable! That’s always important. The restaurant service was a little slow. I think they were understaffed but the food was phenomenal and they should tell everyone to go and check out the restrooms downstairs in the vault because it is an experience not to be missed we will absolutely stay there again when we’re in the area, maybe get a bigger room. We only stayed for one night so we took a small room, but it was still wonderful.

reviews.author: LRJ85
reviews.title: Ask of they're filming before you book
reviews.body: I chose this hotel over two others. I got an email a couple of days before check-in stating that their first floor eateries would be closed for filming. Because of this, their rooftop space, Bar Clara would take charge. They were very much giving hands-off pool bar. It was not a great or enjoyable experience

reviews.author: Subzero
reviews.title: Poor Service, Poor Hygiene  and Limited Amenities
reviews.body: Had mold growing in restroom which is common in this hotel bc of wooden flooring and staff was non chalant about this major hygiene issue.  My a/c wasn’t working in the room and couldn’t even sleep 1st night.  hotel did give me an upgrade begrudgingly but staff was rigid and not customer service oriented.  limited to no amenities were available during stay because of a movie shooting that the GM just informed about the day prior or else I would have booked another place.  As a result, restaurant and other amenities were closed.  This place has limited amenities any way and try getting a sprite or Coke something to drink and it is impossible - was told to get an uber to get a simple snack and room service wasn’t available along with any engineering to look at my a/c issue.  Terrible, limiting experience comparative to a 2.5 star motel.  Internal decor is nice but not great when you can’t even use those amenities but are still charged a $35 destination fee per day of stay.

reviews.author: Small Rooms
reviews.title: Small Room
reviews.body: The place is nice, old-fashioned, but the rooms are smaller than any other hotel

reviews.author: PlueysWorld
reviews.title: The coolest little piece of art in LA a.k.a. hotel
reviews.body: If you’re looking for a fun different hotel with an RC feel close to everything and look no further this hotel has everything you need from great dining an amazing café, friendly staff and the coolest atmosphere. The view from the top deck with the pool is absolutely amazing. Everything about this hotel is so unique and the best part is it’s close to everything within walking distance so if you’re looking for a really cool time in a cool hotel no further.

reviews.author: Sonia O
reviews.title: Birthday stay
reviews.body: The hotel was beautiful. The Claire Suite was really nice size. Pool was warm and enjoyed the convenience of the bar so close.

reviews.author: CJ2026
reviews.title: Make sure they aren't filming when you're there. And bring lots of backup battery packs.
reviews.body: Beautiful place, terrible follow-through. Holes in in-room towels; no real veg-friendly meal options if only the upstairs bar is open (which seems to happen anytime they film). Maintenance doesn't communicate whether or not they repair anything, and nothing gets fixed, so one can only assume they just don't bother to fix anything. They advertise food menus that aren't even available to order from (when filming). The upstairs pool is no where the size it looks to be and apparently anyone can buy wristbands to hang out up there. The upstairs bar itself is tiny, focused mainly on outdoor seating, so if you have no access to the lobby, you will just end up burning your skin outside if you need to sit anywhere up there. The one time I was able to order room service, they messed up my order, but by then I was fed up and didn't bother complaining. It wouldn't help anyway. Finally, the staff will try to make up for it and offer you food credit or Bonvoy points, but they may not always actually put that on your account after saying they will. So keep that in mind as well. They also charge 25 cents per printed page should you need anything printed, because that's what boutique, luxe hotels are supposed to do, right? Oh, and after one person (a native Angeleno and DTLA resident) at the front desk assured me it was safe to walk around there, even though most restaurants and cafes were closed before 10. She refuted my claim that it might be dangerous to walk around at night, even though local friends warned me AND someone apparently was murdered just nearby a day prior in the middle of the day.

reviews.author: El Aye
reviews.title: Check it out for yourself
reviews.body: Rooftop bar has a cute view. The lead female bartender is the best and deserves a raise. They need to update their pool chairs and furniture. Cute hotel fun ambiance overall

reviews.author: Vianey
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel with Amazing Vibes
reviews.body: We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Per La. The hotel is beautiful, comfortable, and has an amazing atmosphere. The unique design made the experience feel special, and everything was relaxing and welcoming. I would definitely recommend this hotel and would love to stay here again.

reviews.author: From SD to LA
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.body: We were very surprised by the ambiance of the hotel. Very stylish with an old school feel, it gives off "important". The rooms were spacious and there was a selection of places to eat. The pool was very nice as well, though crowded but it was hot. The only issues are the televisions are outdated and the food selection, while wonderful, was sparse. The $35 resort fee for locals gives one pause as well. However, they have valet parking which is a plus in DTLA. If I am back in the area I would definitely chose Hotel Per La.

reviews.author: Margot
reviews.title: Charming Hotel
reviews.body: Stayed here for two nights and I couldnt stop looking at all the details that went into creating this hotel.  From the furniture, the fabrics on the wall, to the converted bank vault downstairs, to the beautiful roof top pool.  Breakfast was amazing and the rooms were comfortable and service fantastic.

reviews.author: Dodger fan BB
reviews.title: Stay at Hotel Per La for Dodgers games
reviews.body: The Hotel is definitely unique in both the interior design and the building itself.  It is only 2-3 blocks from the 7th street metro (if you use the Hope street exit).  They give you a food and beverage credit of $18/day but it can't be applied to tip or tax.  This wasn't mentioned on check in.  Also, they told me several times (3) that you could use the credit on the day you check out if you didn't use it on the day you check in.  This didn't happen so you should just be aware of this.

reviews.author: PerezP
reviews.title: A must stay
reviews.body: A must stay if you are in the downtown area. The staff was super friendly. The hotel location is convenient to restaurants and shopping. I would definitely recommend it to my family and friends.

reviews.title: Hotel Per La Delivered On All Ends
reviews.body: Staff was so kind and patient—even during peak hours on a Saturday afternoon. The hotel checked all the boxes: great staff, great amenities (nice pool area, gym, etc.), great food, and affordable (for LA standards) parking options.

reviews.author: Izzy
reviews.title: Birthday Retreat
reviews.body: From the second we sat down to check in our experience was exceptional. Robert at check in was super friendly and accommodating. The room we were given exceeded our expectation. One of our days we spent it upstairs on the roof. The pool was delightful, our pool server Garland was amazing, really went above and beyond and was super friendly and attentive. The food was delicious and the drinks were worth every penny! We loooved the guest service and all the amenities!

reviews.author: Stay123
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.body: Great place to stay. Super clean, nice pool and staff was amazing!!

reviews.author: FWW2
reviews.title: The good the bad and the ugly
reviews.body: Overall the hotel is very pleasant with old world charm. The roof top and lobby bars are open and comfortable. The rooms are well appointed and spacious despite the size with great light from the central courtyard. All said the hotel is pleasant to stay at. The biggest miss is the $79 per night parking which is not disclosed before you arrive. If you plan to have a car, there are other hotels in the area that do not gauge travelers with surprise expenses.

reviews.author: Chrufon
reviews.title: Our preferred destination for LA Stays
reviews.body: From valet to check out, our stay at Per LA was so amazing. You walk in through the mirror hallway and feel like a celebrity. Check in is a sit down affair and super easy. The decor on every level is high quality and unique. Comfortable rooms and beds, good quality toiletries and super clean! This will be our place to stay whenever we are in the LA area!

reviews.author: TH TH
reviews.title: PerLa
reviews.body: Charming Hotel, great rooms and bar.  I am glad it is located near many restaurants as the food is not good and there are not many options on the menu.

reviews.author: Kelly Proctor
reviews.title: Thank you for a wonderful stay!
reviews.body: I can not say enough about my experience at Hotel Per La!  The staff was absolutely wonderful as well as the accommodations.

reviews.author: User1064026
reviews.title: Best Hotel in LA
reviews.body: I travel frequently to LA for work. This location is excellent, the area is safe & the staff are top notch. The rooms are remodeled but still have the original charm of the building. There is an old bank vault in the basement that is so cool to see. Great hotel for business travelers in LA plus $18 a day breakfast voucher for my titanium status. I received a great room upgrade last time I stayed here. I can’t say enough excellent things about this hotel.

reviews.author: Fabian
reviews.title: Largely Inaccessible
reviews.body: Sadly, large parts of the hotel were inaccessible during my stay. No access to the lobby/lounge, no access to the restaurant, no access to the cafe. No compensation was provided. At the same time, the TVs are so old that no streaming services run on them, no Netflix, no YouTube. And that's in the city of Los Angeles where entertainment is at the heart.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Brown bag lunch?
reviews.body: Hotel Per La, Autograph Collection advertised a chic coffee lounge that was closed due to filming without prior disclosure, and its overpriced “room service” arrived in a brown paper bag with takeout containers and plastic silverware, making the experience feel far removed from the boutique luxury stay that was marketed.

reviews.title: Wasn’t worth it
reviews.body: I had paid my room ahead of time got to the location they charged me my room plus $200 said I would get my money back after 3-5 business days and only get back $30 so they kept a total of $1,023 for a basic room for one night which I had booked two weeks in advance.

reviews.author: LAVisitors
reviews.title: Overpriced compared to other properties
reviews.body: Exorbitant valet and destination charge coupled with a coffin sized shower make this property one of our least favorites. The secure elevator system, possibly a legacy of the pandemic, was initially difficult to use and not all terminals worked. The room was decent in size however the streaming services offered, TV size and only two bath towels showed the lack of concern for giving us value for our choice to stay.

reviews.author: LionKing
reviews.title: Hotel needs upkeep
reviews.body: Concerning issues with elevator and room ac unit

reviews.author: Dino
reviews.title: My stay
reviews.body: The only complaint is I think they should bring your car up to you from the valet to the front of hotel and the 70 dollar charge for over night parking. Also our ice machine was broken. Had to go to the next floor. Other than that, the stay was awesome.

reviews.author: Jim LA trip
reviews.title: Jim LA trip
reviews.body: Great hotel, very clean. Located close to the office.

reviews.author: Harry
reviews.title: Worst service/staff/stay
reviews.body:
Zero stars if I could. Worst hotel service I've ever experienced.

The corridors smelled, the room was dirty and carpets were stinking and the bed and linens were filthy. When I complained, the staff handed me fresh linens and told me to change the bed myself. Is that what Marriott calls service? I'm a Bonvoy member, and I got no apology, no resolution, nothing.

It didn't stop there. I asked for a microwave, and the staff member who brought it was openly rude, dumped it on the table, and walked off without even plugging it in. Even getting tea and coffee replenished felt like I was asking for a huge favor.

When I asked to speak to the manager, I was refused. No one was willing to take responsibility or even listen. That says everything about how this hotel treats its guests.

This place is a complete waste of money and points. Save yourself the frustration and stay anywhere else. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.author: Business Trip
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: great location, great accommodations, fitness center,

reviews.author: Kathy529
reviews.title: Excellence @ the Sheraton Grand
reviews.body: I stayed @ the Sheraton Grand from Aug. 24/27 for a convention. The setting was perfect, from the cleanliness of the hotel, to the friendly and very helpful hotel staff, to the convention location. The hotel is right in downtown LA, and there are many restaurants, stores and pharmacies available in the neighborhood. I would highly recommend staying @ the Sheraton Grand Los Angeles Hotel, it was a great experience!

reviews.author: Jun2026Tokyo
reviews.title: The best Hotel in downtown
reviews.body: Check-in was incredibly smooth, and every member of the staff was friendly, attentive, and genuinely helpful. Everything about our stay was perfect. It was truly an ideal hotel, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting the area.

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Best hotel to stay in while visiting LA
reviews.body: Great Stay - hotel is beautiful. Staff are very friendly and responsive. Great food and location.

reviews.author: Gloria 35
reviews.title: Unsatisfied
reviews.body: Managerial Staff could have been more accommodating especially since my handicap room was given to another guest due to overlooking.

reviews.author: JAM1585
reviews.title: JAM Conventioneer
reviews.body: Beautiful clean hotel, close to Convention Center.

reviews.author: R Byrne CO
reviews.title: A Great Place to Stay
reviews.body: I stayed at this location for a full week and couldn't have asked for anything more.  The food at the restaurant was great and I regularly finished the evening on the deck on the 3rd floor.  The staff was great, keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.title: Great place to stay for a Dodgers game!
reviews.body: Stayed here multiple times for close access of Dodgers stadium.

reviews.author: CindySoCal
reviews.title: Memories to last a life time
reviews.body:
In one word, exquisite! We were in DTLA for a concert and decided a one night stay would be a convenient way to end the night as this is within easy walking distance of LA Live. I am so thankful we did. Everything, and I mean everything, was perfect! This trip was meant to be a surprise for my husband and the Sheraton staff went above and beyond to make it happen. A big thank you to Lin from the bell desk and David from Valet, who once they learned it was a surprise, got to work on making sure it stayed that way until I was ready.

The room itself was beautiful, clean, spacious and very comfortable. The city view was an added bonus! Thank you for an amazing stay and wonderful memories!

reviews.author: MCJJ
reviews.title: Disappointing First Sheraton Experience – Not Worth the Price
reviews.body: This was my first stay at a Sheraton, and unfortunately it did not leave a positive impression. For a room costing over $400 per night, I expected a much higher standard. The room was dark, outdated, and not very clean. The bathroom fixtures were inconvenient to use, the hot water was difficult to regulate, the bathtub looked worn, and the TV was unusable during our stay. We were also assigned a connecting room, which was quite noisy, and even the lobby directory screens were slow and unresponsive. Overall, the experience did not justify the price or meet the expectations of a Sheraton Grand property.

reviews.author: StillAlive
reviews.title: Entirely Overpriced
reviews.body: Our room didn't have body soap in the shower, only shampoo. The shower didn't have a safety bar and the bathroom didn't have a fan. We asked for an additional pillow and never got it. There was like 12 sockets in the room and only 2 worked. Some of the lights did not work. The mattress felt old and was very uncomfortable. Every time we went to the front desk, they were training a new employee and everything took twice as long.

reviews.author: Cris
reviews.title: Excellent service and convenience
reviews.body: I chose the Sheraton Grannd Los Angeles because of its Anime Expo hotel connection, proximity, convenience and the shuttle service. I received high quality service from friendly and timely valet service, reliable bellman service, guest service providing my family and I a microwave upon request, a great fitness center with top of the line equipment and easy check-in and checkout.

reviews.author: Always Marriott
reviews.title: Excellent Lounge Service, with Room to Improve the Final Invoice Process
reviews.body:
I want to give the Sheraton Grand Los Angeles a five-star review because the service during my stay was genuinely excellent, especially from the lounge staff. They were welcoming, attentive, and consistently made the experience feel comfortable and well cared for. Their professionalism and hospitality are the main reasons I continue to appreciate staying at this property.
That said, I do want to mention that the final invoice process continues to be a recurring challenge. There always seem to be issues after checkout, and it becomes frustrating and time-consuming to reconcile the bill after each stay. For example, during my stay last week, I had provided the email from my personal Marriott Ambassador regarding the gift card, and the front desk assured me it would be honored. Unfortunately, that never happened, which made the post-stay billing reconciliation more difficult than it should have been.
Overall, I truly value the service and hospitality at the Sheraton Grand Los Angeles, particularly the outstanding lounge team. I hope the billing and final invoice process can be improved so the experience after checkout matches the excellent service during the stay.

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.title: Mix up
reviews.body: Gave our room to some other guest and had access to the room. Our stuff was already settled in the room. Then over charged our rate of x2 upon checking out. The rate which had previously been established, which was at a much lower rate.

reviews.author: Miserable Experience
reviews.title: terrible experience
reviews.body:
Miserable experience, was told that parking was included by the reservation agent who made the reservation for me.
When I arrived to check in I was told that I was either mistaken or was given bad information, either way I was informed that I had to pay the exorbitant parking fee. Front desk supervisor couldn't have been less accommading to a Titanium Elite member for life.

reviews.author: Around the world travel
reviews.title: Not impressive
reviews.body: Not impressive. Room is not cleaned properly. Dust in many places.

reviews.author: Leslie Long
reviews.title: Phenomenal Experience
reviews.body: We drove in from Vegas for our daughter’s surgery. We stayed 4 nights and from start to finish we were treated like royalty..From our parking experience to meals to cleanliness all 5 stars…would highly recommend.

reviews.author: mckth61
reviews.title: Bravo Sheraton Grand LA
reviews.body: Convenient location, great facilities and amenities, and great staff!

reviews.author: Elisa888
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.body: My husband and I love this hotel! It’s our second year here. I love the ambiance, rooms, VIP lounge, fitness center, very close to where my church conference was. I love that they have a parking garage so I know my car is safe. The staff is excellent! The food is excellent! The servers are excellent! Everyone goes above and beyond to make you feel special and important! Can’t wait to come back! A special thanks to Monica, Manuel, Chris, Lupe and Edgar! They made our stay most enjoyable!

reviews.author: Daniel T
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.body: Would highly recommend staying here. Friendly staff, clean room.

reviews.author: Bfrye
reviews.title: A total relief
reviews.body: This was only my second trip to LA for a church conference. I actually had originally booked at another hotel in the arts district of downtown LA. We stayed one night there and felt very uncomfortable with the street noise, the people walking the streets aimlessly. Even to take a walk to find somewhere to eat was nerve racking. After one night at the other hotel I started looking for an alternative and found Sheraton Grand. They were able to book us two nights right then. This hotel was only 5 mins from our first one but the difference was like night and day. There is so much security around the Sheraton, at the doors, at back on the Bloc, we immediately felt relief. The rooms were clean, beds were comfy, staff was so kind acknowledging us everytime we walked through. It was a huge relief and it enabled us to enjoy our next 2 nights in LA. It's also close to a ton of restaurants and the Whole Foods market. So thankful they were able to accommodate our move.

reviews.author: Patrícia Lembi
reviews.title: Excelent hotel with a ridiculously small shower stall.
reviews.body: Hotel with comfortable rooms and a varied continental breakfast. Large rooms and clean, comfortable bed linens. But the shower stall is ridiculously small and the bath towels too, which do not match the hotel's upscale standards.

reviews.author: Tony T
reviews.title: Great overall stay!
reviews.body: A very nice and luxurious hotel. There is unfortunately some airplane noise if you stay in the upper floors as its not soundproofed. Overall the staff and facilities are excellent

reviews.author: Babane
reviews.title: Good hotel. Great people!
reviews.body: Great location, nice and friendly staff.

reviews.author: I Love LA
reviews.title: I Love L A
reviews.body: I loved my stay but they should include breakfast at the Courtyard as well.

reviews.author: PATRICIA
reviews.title: FRIDGE
reviews.body: THE PROBLEM I ACTUALLY HAD WAS THE FRIDGE.  IT WAS ON A TIME LINE.  YOU HAVE TO CHOOSE 6 OR EITHER 2 0R 4 HOURS.  THAT IS REDICULOUS BECAUSE IF YOUR IN A MEETING YOU ARE NORMALLY THERE FOR 6 OR 8 HOURS.  IF THEY HAVE THAT AT THE NEXT MEETING, I WILL BE CHOOSING ANOTHER HOTEL

reviews.author: UNION2286
reviews.title: Union Delegate
reviews.body: Prime location for access to the convention. Good food & entertainment in the immediate area.

reviews.author: MS1010
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body:
Very clean and friendly.
Easy access to all the attractions in downtown LA. 
Lovely staff.

reviews.author: Ashley T
reviews.title: Great hotel and close to crypto arena!/;;;;;;;;;;;;
reviews.body: Great stay! Right across the street from Crypto arena. Rooms were very large and clean. No noise, no issues. Everyone was very friendly and helpful; would stay again.

reviews.author: Guest in 1115
reviews.title: Review of courtyard, Marriott
reviews.body: The stay was very good staff very polite however, one thing I didn't understand was the difference between courtyard, Marriott and residence Inn Marriott. Both available in the same hotel. It seems that the residence Inn for $10 more a night were able to be provided a breakfast. I just didn't understand the difference. My friends did have a mini kitchen in their residence room, which I really didn't need, but I would've liked to have breakfast every day. Maybe that could be explained to guest on check-in.

reviews.author: Golden Dome
reviews.title: Mid-Summer Convention
reviews.body:
The property was in excellent condition. It is centrally located in the Downtown LA Live area.
We felt safe and all times in and out in the surrounding area of the LA Live complex.
The staff was very polite and sensitive to the needs of my disabilities.
The staff was very busy as there were multiple events taking place at once: Concert, Basketball Tournament & a Major Convention. But the staff still meet the needs of all the guest.

reviews.author: kayebee
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.body: Very clean, excellent customer service, the bed and linens were great. I was able to get a lot of rest and part of it was due to the bed being extremely comfortable. There was ample seating in the lobby area for guests. I had a wonderful view and the amenities were great.

reviews.author: Conference Attendee
reviews.title: Not worth the $$
reviews.body:
I really wanted to like this hotel, but it missed the mark in several areas, especially for the price.

The biggest surprise was the large security deposit, along with a daily hotel service fee that didn't seem to provide any noticeable value, you have to provide room total + $150 per night upon check-in. 

The rooftop pool was advertised as a highlight, but it was NOT a rooftop pool, just an outdoor pool on level three. No view, nothing extravagant. Thankfully the temp was good, there also is no hot tub or sauna, and there were never enough towels available.

The rooms were tiny and noticeably dusty, and the TV channel selection was extremely limited. Requiring a key card to access the elevators added security, but it also became an inconvenience when your hands are rarely free. No microwave and weird mini fridge that freezes everything. Food and drinks throughout the hotel were also incredibly expensive.

That said, there were a few bright spots. Daily housekeeping did a great job, the bed was very comfortable, and the coffee and breakfast burrito from the bar were genuinely made well.

That said as Marriott member, I definitely expected better. Unless the location is your top priority, I'd probably look at other options for your stay.

reviews.author: Cornell C
reviews.title: Great place to stay with a ton of activities to explore in the area
reviews.body: The Courtyard L.A LIVE was a great property to stay. The rooms and the facilities were clean and the staff was very friendly.

reviews.author: FAMILY LOVE
reviews.title: Family  is everything
reviews.body: They stay only thing staff shouldn't  record us when we our doing nothing and enjoying our  personal time

reviews.author: Craig W
reviews.title: Extremely welcoming and friendly
reviews.body: The food/bar area and desk clerks were all very friendly and helpful.  And, a special thanks to Nathalie - for giving me wonderful tips on riding the rail.

reviews.author: moontecker
reviews.title: Great Hotel but there are two issues
reviews.body: One of issues that I had was the AC kept on blewing on my side and my friend while on bed. I tried changed the directions where wind are blewing but still it did not change. Another issue was the checkout time has to be 11 a.m. while I am Gold Elite Membership status. I suppose to have 2 p.m. checkout time.

reviews.author: GGAtl
reviews.title: First visit
reviews.body: Arrived very early in the morning. Keith was able to get me checked in quickly so I could get some sleep before my early morning agenda. The bed was very comfortable and the workspace in the room was perfect for getting stuff done. If I'm in the area again, this will be my hotel of choice. This location is highly recommended!

reviews.author: Family trip
reviews.title: Family Trip
reviews.body: More Parking options for hotel

reviews.author: Mislead customer
reviews.title: Parking misleading
reviews.body: They should be upfront with the parking situation.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Another Wonderful Marriott Experience!
reviews.body: Beautiful and clean hotel in central downtown LA! Wonderful hotel staff and spacious rooms.

reviews.author: Looking for value in LA
reviews.title: A rip in LA
reviews.body: At nearly $400/night, this is a good place to avoid.

reviews.author: Austin
reviews.title: good place for a quick stay
reviews.body: nice place, holds up to marriot standards. the traffic is a little busy and hard to get into the busy valet tiny drive way for the hotel. if you can park outside on your own.

reviews.author: Niruchi123
reviews.title: Amazing stay @ LA
reviews.body: Had a fantastic experience at courtyard LA Live last week stay. Very well located, neat and clean environment, courteous and supportive staff made our stay extra special. Thank you Team Marriott !

reviews.author: MELISSA C
reviews.title: Family Approved
reviews.body:
Super close to the arena with plenty of food options nearby. The rooms were spacious and clean, and we loved that our room connected to our children’s room. The A/C worked perfectly and kept the room very comfortable. My kids were especially happy with the Wi-Fi — it worked great, and they were able to stream Netflix without any issues.
Valet parking was very convenient, and we appreciated the in-and-out privileges. We were also grateful for the opportunity to check in early and extend our stay. We would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Terry
reviews.title: Courtyard la live
reviews.body: Everything except the food available was excellent. The sandwiches were cold and unappetizing

reviews.author: HB73
reviews.title: Superb location for Kings game
reviews.body: My husband & I came for an LA Kings game and the hotel was an excellent choice due to the location, not to mention the staff was extremely friendly and knowledgeable about the area.  The room was clean and quiet for a downtown hotel. We will definitely stay there again!

reviews.author: BigskyTCT
reviews.title: Nice hotel - convenient location - a few issues
reviews.body: Nice and clean - convenient to LA Live.  Room could be a bit noisy.  Stayed for Grammys - perfect for that.  Vale fees high ($59/day) and extra facilities charge ($30/day) not appreciated.

reviews.author: Abby
reviews.title: Stay Here!
reviews.body: This is the place to stay if you are going to be in DTLA. It was a nice location-the hotel was clean, the staff was friendly, the rooms were spacious and clean, the gym was fantastic, overall, it was a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: 2026Year3
reviews.title: LA LA
reviews.body: Cold weather to warm sunny weather!!!

reviews.author: Eb80
reviews.title: Friendly staff, clean room
reviews.body: Very friendly staff and room is very clean

reviews.author: Tiela
reviews.title: Great property with clean and comfortable rooms
reviews.body: We had a short stay here, but it was a great stay. The location is great and the option to self park independently is helpful. Agents at the desk were friendly, patient, and professional. I believe her name was Bria, but im not sure. She answered all my questions and explained the property features. I was bummed out that the restaurant stops serving food at 9:30pm, so we had to order takeout. But it came fast due to location. The room was so spacious it was hard to believe it was a standard double. I definitely loved that feature. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Naska
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.body:
I would recommend the hotel.
My son and I had a great time there.

reviews.author: Gina
reviews.title: This is the place to stay!!
reviews.body: The staff here are so welcoming and kind and lovely!!  Andrea checked us in and she was so friendly.  She made sure we had everything we needed.  The hotel is beautiful, great location, very clean and well kept!  The rooms are luxurious and the beds were like heaven!  We will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: A2012J
reviews.title: Extraordinary.
reviews.body: Excellent, I give 5 stars

reviews.author: Ben1
reviews.title: Front desk staff
reviews.body:
The front desk staff were very professional and ready to help at anytime of the day or night. 
I got a couple of very helpful tips on my morning running exercise routine.
Unfortunately, I did not take down the name of the particular staff who helped me.
Generally, the hotel was very clean and smelled really good.
Not to forget the valet guys!
They were amazing, making sure my car was ready for me at all times.
Thank you!

reviews.author: Jake Nattly
reviews.title: More expensive parking than Ritz across street no EV charging even though advertised
reviews.body: The parking here is more expensive than the Ritz across street and advertises EV charging but doesn’t have it. My room was not cleaned thoroughly black hair was left on the bath / shower.

reviews.author: Jennie L
reviews.title: Good hotel to stay in LA downtown
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay very much. The room was spacious and clean and the staff were very friendly and welcoming.

reviews.author: Roberto
reviews.title: Dirtbag, valet parkers
reviews.body: The dirtbag valet parers at this hotel, stole my watch from inside my vehicle

reviews.author: LA Local
reviews.title: Stay somewhere else!
reviews.body: When we got back to the room to go to bed, it became apparent that the AC wasn’t working properly on a day when it was 100+ degrees F outside. We had been out all evening, so we didn’t notice it earlier. It was miserable & uncomfortable, and we did not sleep well at all. Additionally, valet is a JOKE!!! It takes forever because there is nowhere for cars to pull in/out; otherwise your car gets trapped for 10-15 minutes before you can even attempt to leave. I was 15 minutes late for my daughter’s wedding dress appointment of which I allotted more than 40 min for travel (it was only 7 miles away)…but waiting for my car in valet took 25 minutes…and it is RIDICULOUSLY expensive!!! I’m so disappointed that I used one of my nightly upgrades on such a terrible stay. There are plenty of other Marriott brand hotels nearby.

reviews.author: Stan S
reviews.title: Terrible Service & Unprofessional Staff – Not Up to Marriott Standards
reviews.body:
While the property itself is nice and in a solid location, the service here is easily the worst I’ve experienced at any Marriott property.

Our problems started at check-in when we arrived at 11:36 PM. The front doors were locked with no instructions on how to enter. Three staff members inside made eye contact with us knocking on the glass and completely ignored us. A returning guest finally let us in five minutes later. When we got to the desk, we weren't even greeted.

The room issues continued that night:

The bedroom smoke detector flashed a bright white light every few seconds all night (I have video of this), ruining our sleep.

In the morning, the shower's body soap dispenser was completely empty, forcing me to use shampoo.

There was a loose paper towel roll left on top of the toilet, showing a clear lack of attention from housekeeping (photo documented).

The final straw occurred when we took our service dog out in the morning. I asked the valet attendant (wearing a black polo and has missing teeth) which direction was safer to walk. He literally laughed in our faces and said, "Nowhere is safe," forcing us to navigate the streets around Francisco St. and W Olympic Blvd on our own to avoid an unsafe situation.

When I reported all of this to the front desk at checkout, the staff member showed zero empathy or concern, offering a dismissive "thanks for the feedback."

Save your money and stay at a Marriott property that actually values safety, basic cleanliness, and hospitality.

reviews.author: Val hoya
reviews.title: The place to be
reviews.body:
Whether solo or with family,  Residence Inn LA LIVE is the place to be. It is modern,  spacious and comfortable.  It is located close to restaurants, Ralph's supermarket,  shopping,  and concerts. If you're going to the convention center - which we did, it is about a 3 min walk.
If you're heading over to Hollywood BlVD, for a show at the Pantages, or to LA LA Land Souvenir shop, just call an uber from this hotel and you are good to go.  If you don't want to go to a restaurant,  there are food trucks 1 min from the hotel.
I really like the pool, the breakfast and the staff . I appreciate the work you do

reviews.author: Mori
reviews.title: Private family trip
reviews.body: No making up our room in the weekend

reviews.author: A Houstonian
reviews.title: Better than the rest
reviews.body: Several fellow and sister delegates were housed at various L.A. hotels.  The Host hotel across the street was selected by many of my home delegation, but their rooms, while very nice, did not offer the space and seating that was standard in ours.  It was clean, comfortable, and remarkably, the whole hotel from the lobby to the room halls, to the room itself was beyond clean, it smelled fresh.  I would choose this for my next L.A. convention stay.

reviews.author: Ibsmyln
reviews.title: Disappointed with overall stay.
reviews.body: Was so disappointed in overall stay. Marriott really dropped the ball on this one. Waited 2 hours delay to check into room with total lack of communication. Bed short sheeted. Notified desk received next day 5 towels/ 3 sheets . I guess I was supposed to make up the bed? Fitness room was down a treadmill, not enough equipment available for amount of guests. Sketchy street area after dark. Rooms decent sized. Breakfast was only redeeming value. Had option of staying several different places, won't recommend this site. Sorry.

reviews.author: Alicia
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience at Residence Inn Los Angeles L.A. LIVE
reviews.body:
The check-in process was easy and efficient, but unfortunately, several aspects of my stay were disappointing.

I was not given any information about the included breakfast or food and beverage credit, which made it difficult to take advantage of the amenities that came with my stay.
