The biggest issue was valet parking. I was told the rate was $72 per night, but Saturday’s charge was significantly higher, and I was never informed that the rate would increase. I would have expected the communicated rate to be honored or, at minimum, for the change to be disclosed in advance.

Checkout was also frustrating. I was told to expect a 30–45 minute wait for my vehicle, so I called ahead to give the valet plenty of time. Despite that, I waited over an hour. When my vehicle was finally brought up, it had been left on the curb, and no one notified me that it was ready. I happened to notice it myself.

I understand that busy weekends can be challenging, but the unexpected parking charge and poor valet experience were not what I expected from a Marriott property. Hopefully, management will review the valet procedures and communication with guests so others don't have a similar experience.

Overall, there were some positives, but the valet experience significantly impacted my stay.

reviews.author: Nalcfan23
reviews.title: Clean rooms, subpar food choices/wifi did not work
reviews.body: Overall the rooms were clean and great. The bed was very comfy. The breakfast options were the exact same every day with a change in meat choice. My friends stayed for 5 days, I stayed for 2. They had trouble connecting to the Wi-Fi. When I arrived I also had trouble and it would not connect on the TV. The pool area was clean and comfy.

reviews.author: Stephanie J
reviews.title: Definitely as good as a dream!
reviews.body:
I stayed at the Residence Inn Los Angeles L.A. LIVE from July 19-23, and I can honestly say this was one of the best hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

From the moment I walked through the doors, I felt welcomed. The woman who checked me in was absolutely incredible. After everything it took just to get to Los Angeles, I was exhausted and overwhelmed. I needed to change my reservation to a two-bedroom suite, and she handled everything so quickly and effortlessly that I jokingly told her, “I could kiss you right now!” She laughed, and in that moment, she completely turned my day around.

As a Marriott Bonvoy member, I was upgraded, and the entire check-in process was seamless. Looking back on it now honestly makes me emotional because of how much kindness and professionalism she showed me. She probably has no idea how much that interaction meant, but she made me feel cared for, and I’ll never forget it. If management can identify who was working the front desk during check-in on July 19, please recognize her. She is a true asset to your team.

The hotel itself was immaculate. The room was beautiful, the views were incredible, the décor was modern and inviting, the beds were exceptionally comfortable, and the shower pressure was perfect. The hallways were spotless, the elevators were fast, and every member of the valet team was friendly, professional, and eager to help.

There is truly nothing I would change about my stay. Every detail was top-notch, and every staff member I encountered contributed to such a wonderful experience.

Thank you for making my trip so special. If I ever return to Los Angeles, there is no question where I’ll be staying. You have earned a loyal guest.

reviews.author: Miranda
reviews.title: Best Stay EVER
reviews.body: My husband and I stay in A LOT of motels/hotels for travel and this was the best one that we have EVER had the pleasure of staying in!! We could not be happier! It was absolutely beautiful, incredibly clean, the staff was so friendly and the water pressure...AMAZING!! The room was absolutely perfect!!

reviews.author: Thesimms
reviews.title: Not the ritz
reviews.body: Love the kitchen and space provided for a family.

reviews.author: TD2454
reviews.title: Solid option for DTLA
reviews.body: I stayed at the Residence Inn with my family. Our room was spacious and had a pull out couch. The bed was comfortable and the AC worked great, which was very nice because it was HOT outside. The TV didn't always work correctly, but we were gone a lot so that wasn't a huge issue. Location is terrific if you're going to a Dodgers game or doing anything downtown. Service was excellent. The one (minor) complaint I have is the selection of food at the breakfast buffet. I get that it's complimentary, but there was literally no fruit and not many healthy options. At least there was coffee, but I definitely wanted a better selection of healthy food. For the price it is a good hotel. I would stay there again.

reviews.author: Reviewer 650
reviews.title: Horrible staff
reviews.body: Room was great, kitchen was perfect but staff was what killed our whole trip. When i arrived i was greeted by a rude vale parking staff. I could see that there was already a line for the elevator, which was horrible, 4 elevators and i only ever saw 2 open or close. Parking informed me i had only 10 minutes to check in, unload my car and move it. Which made no sense due to check in wsa also packed. I explained im a disable vet and needed a moment, i was told no and get on it. I dont understand how you hire someone like that.

reviews.author: Sher
reviews.title: Amazing hotel and service
reviews.body: The team here is consistent and always friendly in reliving the Marriott brand for excellent customer service . I always enjoy my stay here and applaud the management team for supporting their team and staying consistent and friendly and welcoming.

reviews.author: EWC90
reviews.title: Frustrated with the TV service downtime
reviews.body: We had planned to watch the World Cup in our room, but the TV service had apparently gone out for our floor. We had called the front desk multiple times but the issue was not resolved for two days.

reviews.author: TourGuy
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.body: Very clean. Great staff! I would definitely recommend. Thank you

reviews.author: JH Kim
reviews.title: Thank You to the Safe & Security Team
reviews.body:
During my stay, I accidentally left my Dyson hair dryer in the room. Thanks to the help of the Safe and Security team, I was able to get it back safely, and I truly appreciate their assistance.

What stood out most was how friendly and helpful every staff member was. No matter where I encountered them in the hotel, they were always kind and willing to help. Their positive attitude made my stay even more enjoyable and comfortable.

Thank you to the entire team for the excellent service. I would be happy to stay here again and highly recommend this hotel to others.

reviews.author: Happy Guest
reviews.title: Clean, Friendly, & Convenient Hotel
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful extended stay at this Marriott property. The hotel is exceptionally clean, well-maintained, and the staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, making me feel at home from the moment I arrived.

One of my favorite features was the extra space. The room feels more like an apartment than a traditional hotel room, with a fully equipped kitchen that includes a stove, microwave, and refrigerator. Having a separate living room area was also a huge plus, providing a comfortable space to relax and watch TV after a long day.

The shower was another highlight—the water pressure was amazing and made for a very refreshing experience. I also really enjoyed the complimentary breakfast each morning. There was a great selection of food, and everything was fresh and delicious, making it a great way to start the day.

As a pet owner, I appreciated that this is a dog-friendly hotel. I was able to bring my dog for the duration of my stay, and the pet fee was well worth it. I especially loved that the hotel offers a dedicated pet relief area on the third floor, which is much more convenient than having to take pets out to the street.

Overall, this hotel exceeded my expectations with its cleanliness, spacious accommodations, excellent breakfast, thoughtful pet-friendly amenities, and outstanding customer service. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable extended-stay experience.

reviews.author: KK23
reviews.title: If  your a Marriott Member
reviews.body: I'm a platinum marriott reward member but was not offered any of the rewards because I was under a convention rate.  I should have been given bottled water or a drink. Especially for the price of the room I paid

reviews.author: uscso2026
reviews.title: We absolutely enjoyed our stay at Residence Inn by Marriott Los Angeles L.A. LIVE
reviews.body: The hotel location is convenient and the room was very spacious and clean.  It was recently renovated so it looked close to brand new.  They provide a full kitchen and all sorts of supplies which we enjoyed a lot.  The service was excellent too.  We loved the free hot breakfast every morning.  Would definitely recommend to friends and families if they come to visit LA.

reviews.author: Family trip
reviews.title: Best hotel
reviews.body: Hotel stay downtown suite

reviews.author: MBrown
reviews.title: Conference
reviews.body: The Residence Inn was an excellent choice for our conference.   Walking distance from conference center.  Excellent breakfast, clean room, and welcoming staff.

reviews.author: Soliman
reviews.title: Average experience
reviews.body:
Poor value for money, breakfast is poor 
Staff can be trained to be more friendly

reviews.author: JG405
reviews.title: Thunder Struck
reviews.body: We were in town for the NBA playoff game, and I have not felt more welcomed at a hotel in such a long time. It was refreshing to feel like the employees appreciated all their guests from the initial hello to the final goodbye. On top of that, the room was clean, comfortable, and all the features felt brand new.

reviews.author: Opinionated Customer 66
reviews.title: I wish
reviews.body: Although my stay at the residence, Inn Marriott Los Angeles, LA live was a nice experience and the staff was pleasant and accommodating, I feel like at the corporate level and the local level, those individuals should be more hands-on and involved in the inner workings of their Hotel chain

reviews.author: Keri
reviews.title: Perfect Accommodations
reviews.body: We had a delightful stay. The cuisine was excellent, and the staff were welcoming and attentive. The location is ideal, situated near popular local attractions.

reviews.author: MM2025
reviews.title: Celebrated our engagement at the Ritz!
reviews.body: Our stay at the Los Angeles Ritz Carlton Hotel was everything I wanted it to be. We just recently got engaged and decided to spend a few days in Los Angeles so we chose this hotel. I’d already experienced the incredible service in San Francisco so I had hoped to have a similar experience in L.A. The staff did not disappoint. They were very kind and helpful and their service is unmatched. Upon knowing that we were there to celebrate our engagement, we received a complimentary service of chocolate dipped strawberries and a bottle of their house champagne. It was super unexpected but also something you’d come to expect from the staff as they are always going above and beyond for their guests.

reviews.author: Raymond
reviews.title: Stay at Ritz Carlton (LA Live)
reviews.body: The staff were personable, amicable and very accommodating. From the front desk to the valet the staff made sure to prioritize my needs anytime. Very welcoming environment and beautiful rooms. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Great stay
reviews.title: Great place to stay.. would stay again.
reviews.body: Everything was amazing. The room was very clean and comfortable. Staff were courteous and helpful housekeeping always had everything stocked did not have to ask for anything. Location is amazing close to everything.

reviews.author: Sharma6263
reviews.title: An Unforgettable Anniversary Stay at The Ritz-Carlton, Los Angeles
reviews.body:
My wife and I had an incredible stay at The Ritz-Carlton, Los Angeles while celebrating our first wedding anniversary. From the moment we arrived, the front desk team, valet, concierge, in-room dining, and every staff member we interacted with made us feel truly special.

A huge shoutout to Tyler at the front desk, who went above and beyond to make our anniversary memorable. I shared with him that we were married at a Ritz-Carlton and hope to celebrate each anniversary at a different Ritz-Carlton property because each one feels so special and unique. He genuinely listened and made sure our stay felt personal and meaningful.

Every interaction throughout our visit made it feel like the team was celebrating alongside us. The valet was fantastic, in-room dining was excellent, and the level of service from the entire staff was outstanding. This was the best hotel stay my wife and I have ever had, and we highly recommend The Ritz-Carlton, Los Angeles.

reviews.author: Vickey Bains
reviews.title: Excellent Concierge
reviews.body: We felt well looked anfter throughout our stay by staff at Ritz Carlton LA.  Irene & Patricia at Concierge were exceptional to our family. They both went above & beyond to help during our stay. Truly appreciated them. Staff at reception were extremely pleasant & helpful. Thankyou

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Had a wonderful time staying here for a concert next door. It was so convenient and the guest service was amazing. I felt taken care of and safe especially in a busy downtown area. We were celebrating my birthday also, and the front desk person made sure to have a birthday surprise delivered to my room with a personalized message which made my day, and my stay at the hotel very special.

reviews.author: Margaret H
reviews.title: great experience overall
reviews.body: I visit LA often.  First time at the Ritz - great in comparison to other properties.  No complains EXCEPT - we wanted to order food/drinks at the pool.  The bar staff said to take a seat and someone would be around.  It took a long time for menu's and an even longer time for someone to take the order.  It wasn't crowded.  The pool staff was more interested in chatting with one another than attending to guest.  If it wasn't for the pool experience, it would be a 10/10 review.

reviews.author: Hasan 53
reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing Stay and Service Experience at The Ritz-Carlton, Istanbul
reviews.body:
I have rarely experienced such poor service and such a disappointing stay at a Ritz-Carlton. As an Elite Ambassador, this was a truly dreadful experience and fell far below the standards I expect from a luxury hotel and from the Ritz-Carlton brand.

From the moment I arrived, there was no welcome, no recognition, and no sense of hospitality. I even had to carry my own luggage to my room, which is simply unacceptable for a hotel of this caliber. The breakfast buffet was equally disappointing and well below the standard one would expect from a luxury property.

What was most concerning was the quality of the staff. Throughout my stay, I encountered employees who appeared poorly trained and lacked the professionalism, attentiveness, and service mindset that should define the guest experience at Ritz-Carlton. In my view, this reflects a failure of management rather than individual employees. Such consistently poor service is usually the result of inadequate leadership, training, and operational oversight.

If the management in Los Angeles would like to understand what genuine hospitality, exceptional service, and world-class hotel leadership look like, they should send their team for an internship at the The Ritz-Carlton, Istanbul. That property exemplifies the standards, attention to detail, and guest care that the Ritz-Carlton brand is known for and should strive to deliver consistently across all locations.

Overall, this was one of the most disappointing stays I have ever had at a Ritz-Carlton. The contrast with the Ritz-Carlton Istanbul, where service excellence and genuine hospitality are clearly embedded in the culture, could not be more striking.

reviews.author: Rob F
reviews.title: So worth it.
reviews.body: The hotel is beautiful. It is very quiet and the service was outstanding. There are many excellent restaurants within a 2 minute walk. When I left the hotel, there were three valets to see me on my way. One to open the driver door, one to open the passenger door and one to place our luggage in the back!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Ladies and Gentlemen Serving Ladies and Gentlemen
reviews.body: Merlyn at the Front Desk goes Above and beyond her service, class, Loyalty, integrity and accountability of our needs and expectations. Five Star, Five Diamond! Thank you so much Merlyn!

reviews.author: Jkost565
reviews.title: Best experience
reviews.body: We have stayed at the Ritz Carlton in Los Angeles several times over the last decade. We come for events or basketball games and stay on the executive lounge floor. Nathan, the concierge, and everyone else has gone out of their way every time to make our Experience special. For instance, this time it was our son-in-law‘s graduation with a doctorate from USC and they made his Experience special. This is just an example as every time we’ve been there. Nathan and the team have done the same thing for us. The people who staff the executive lounge are extraordinary. They have recognized us even if we’ve been gone a year. The LA Ritz Carlton is really our refuge in LA. Thank you.

reviews.author: Arlene Rdz
reviews.title: Exceptional Luxurious
reviews.body: The staff went above and beyond, making us feel truly valued. Our room was immaculate and offered a stunning view of Los Angeles Downtown Skylines.A truly luxurious experience from start to finish.  The Club ambiance and amenities were world-class. If you want to feel pampered, this is the place to stay.

reviews.author: Lexjf86
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.body:
After deciding last minute to book a bonus night on our mini-trip to LA, we are kicking ourselves for not staying here the entire time!

From the moment we came in, Harrison at the Front desk gave us a full rundown of the hotel and its amenities, and offered us a late checkout so we could have a leisurely morning. His professional but very friendly demeanor made the start of this stay great. 

Below is a breakdown of the stay:

-Room: We were surprised with a delightful suite that had great views of the city! Literally felt like it should be a residence with so many areas to relax, work, and entertain. Immaculately clean. Oversized bathroom that felt like a spa. 

-Pool/Gym: Well-equipped gym with plenty of space/cardio machines. Both Peloton bikes had a few connectivity issues, but beyond that... Perfect working order for everything else. The pool was immaculately clean, the service was great when ordering food for delivery, premium sunscreen was offered complimentary, and the seating was very soft for relaxing in the Southern California sun. The pool was the perfect temperature for swimming or just paddling around.

Room Service: Prompt, delicious, and reasonable for a luxury property. Kudos to the whole staff for making the multiple trips with chicken tenders LOL.

-Club Lounge: W O W! Out of the 10 RC club lounges, this had to be one of the best. Harrison was introduced to Lukas (club manager), who graciously offered his services should we have any questions. Everyone at the club was great, and here are some highlights:

Megan: The way we chatted her ear off about our multiple days at Universal and the disappointment my husband did not get on his favorite ride(Mario Kart), we headed to dinner and came back to such a fun surprise(Photo on the post.) She had put together such a cute dessert with a card full of Mario puns. It was so funny/sweet that she would put something so thoughtful together. Kudos for taking a moment of sadness(we are kids at heart, haha) into a memorable experience.

Josh: So friendly! Always made sure to check in, be friendly, and offer assistance with whatever we needed.

Cynthia: On our first day meeting her, she was so sweet to open a new bottle of Champagne. After leaving for the day, she sent us a warm email welcoming us to the property. Such a nice touch!

And what was supposed to be one night turned into two, thanks to having such a great time(Megan’s gesture really hit it out of the park!) 

From the amazing service, cleanliness, and overall hotel experience, we cannot wait to come back on our next LA visit.

reviews.author: ATJK
reviews.title: Best Hotel for a Downtown LA Stay
reviews.body: Ritz Carlton DTLA is one of the best hotels in the city. The best rooms and amenities right next to LA Live. Great options for dining and entertainment.

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.title: Amazing accommodations for our weekend
reviews.body: We stayed at the Ritz Carlton Los Angeles for an extended weekend and the staff made it nothing short of amazing. Everyone went above and beyond to make the stay special and memorable.

reviews.author: Misa
reviews.title: Fantastic care and luxury
reviews.body: The Ritz-Carlton was absolutely amazing. We visited when I was recovering from an injury and the staff made sure I was well taken care of!

reviews.author: Eden
reviews.title: One night day
reviews.body:
Stayed here for one night since we had dinner reservations at the Agave Library. Upon arrival, valet greeted us promptly, which was a great first impression. At check-in, Christine at the front desk was helpful and attempted to secure a room upgrade for us, though unfortunately nothing was available at the time.

When we got to our room, it hadn’t been cleaned—the bed was unmade and the space was still dirty. We went back downstairs and informed Christine, who quickly arranged another room for us just across the hall. The new room was acceptable, but not particularly impressive. We also noticed a strong odor as soon as you step off the elevator on the 22nd floor, which made the overall experience less pleasant.

Dinner at the Agave Library was just okay. The food didn’t quite live up to the price, although Jonathan, our waiter, provided excellent service and was very kind throughout the evening. We did run into an issue trying to use our Amex card—the transaction wouldn’t go through, even after confirming with Amex that there were no declines on their end. Because of this, we had to charge the bill to our room and ended up missing out on the $100 Amex dining credit, which was disappointing.

Overall, there were a few bright spots in service, but the experience didn’t fully meet expectations.

reviews.author: MT17
reviews.title: Fist class service
reviews.body: I love staying at the Ritz. The service, attention, and care is always first class.

reviews.author: Catherine G
reviews.title: Excellence 🥰💃
reviews.body: Exceptional.. Jhoanne and her team made our stay tremendously awesome and perfect.

reviews.author: Lee2
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.body:
I cannot recommend this dtla Ritz-Carlton enough! From the moment we arrived, every detail of our stay exceeded expectations. The lounge was a true highlight, offering a relaxing and elegant atmosphere that perfectly complemented our quick staycation. The location couldn't be better, and the pool area was serene and impeccably maintained. Every department we interacted with, even in passing, took the time to ensure we had everything we needed — a level of service that is rare to find.
A special mention must go to Mr. Harrison Skinner at check-in, who was absolutely phenomenal. His professionalism, compassion, and attentiveness set a new standard for hospitality. I never felt so genuinely welcomed; he anticipated our needs in ways I didn’t even know were possible and made us feel completely cared for.
This stay was especially meaningful as I was traveling with my mother, and we’ve recently been through some challenging experiences. The care and attention from the team at the Ritz-Carlton truly made this trip restorative. On top of that, I was able to handle some business meetings efficiently, which made the stay both relaxing and productive.
In short, the Ritz-Carlton, Los Angeles delivered an unforgettable experience. I am beyond grateful to Mr. Harrison Skinner and the entire team for their exceptional service — we can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Leon
reviews.title: The Ritz Carlton LA Live Club
reviews.body: The Ritz Carlton has an outstanding staff. Cynthia, Nathan, Darius, Cameron, and the entire crew were accommodating and extremely attentive. I was at the hotel for 8 days and the Club hosts and hostesses were the best.

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.title: Better than Average/Good stay in Downtown LA
reviews.body: This hotel is in the same building as the JW Marriot, so they share a few things.  Andres and Tyler at the front desk were very accommodating and kind to us.  We thought the Ritz staff was very nice, but they sub out some third parties for valet and servers for breakfast, who do not represent the brand and do not bring the same professionalism that would be expected.  There is a large displaced persons tent "city" about 1/2 a mile from the hotel, as we drove through it to get there.  As with any downtown next to a few theatres and stadiums, it is very traffic heavy and a bit chaotic.  Our room was amazing and clean; we loved it.  We only ate at Lena one night, the food was good and the server, Kelly, was fantastic.  She really made us feel special.  Our disappointment came when some unsavory guests were at the pool.  We stayed in March, but it was 80-90 degrees so the pool was wonderful to have.  Unfortunately, there was someone vaping (clearly says No Vaping allowed) and three unsupervised adolescents jumping off the pool railing.  When we alerted security, they came up, looked around and then left.  So, its hard to feel comfortable in a place that doesn't enforce rules.  Otherwise, I never saw a security guard anywhere.  Breakfast was a little bit of a let-down as the server was not representative of the brand and the options for the buffet were basic; you also share breakfast with JW Marriot (I think, it wasn't explained) and we were put on a waitlist because they were "anticipating groups."  I do know there was a large convention at the Marriot when we were there.  I honestly think I was expecting more out of the Ritz brand, and obviously they can't control what guests that they have and the chaos that surrounds the hotel because they are in downtown, but I that's why the security guard and the third-party subs feels cheap because this is something they could control.

reviews.author: Italia S
reviews.title: Exactly What Our Family Needed
reviews.body:
My children and I stayed at The Ritz-Carlton, Los Angeles during a time when we truly needed a peaceful escape. It had been a difficult day for us, and from the moment we arrived, the atmosphere immediately brought a sense of calm and comfort.

When we walked into the room, I saw an instant shift in my two teenagers. Their expressions softened, their stress melted away, and for the first time that day, they were able to truly relax. That moment meant more to me than I can express.

The room was stunning, comfortable, and felt like a true retreat. Christine, Tylor, and Nicolas were incredibly friendly and welcoming — always smiling, attentive, and genuinely kind. Their warmth and professionalism made us feel cared for throughout our stay.

Our experience gave us exactly what we needed: a beautiful space to reset, reconnect, and find peace again. We left feeling refreshed and deeply grateful.

reviews.author: Randall B
reviews.title: A must stay
reviews.body: The staff treated us as if we were frequent stayers. Conceirge dud a great job arranging a tour for us.

reviews.author: Kristie
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.body: I absolutely loved my stay and everything about i!!!

reviews.author: Karla S
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay
reviews.body:
I was disappointed that we were denied an upgrade through our American Express Platinum Card perks although there were available rooms for upgrade. We were also denied club access. 
Furthermore, I left my watch in the room and was told they did not find it. I am sure I left it there. I expected way more from the Ritz-Carlton.

reviews.author: Ransito
reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.body: This hotel is definitely not a good representation of the Ritz Carlton brand. Booked 1 night before our cruise and after this experience went ahead and canceled the post cruise 2 nights. If you need to stay in the downtown area its better to book the JW Marriott itself

reviews.author: Esther S
reviews.title: Outstanding!
reviews.body: Outstanding!  Our trip was fabulous and we can’t wait to return.  Nikko went out of his way to ensure we had a memorable birthday trip.

reviews.author: byMiha
reviews.title: It was ok
reviews.body:
I had a good stay but the rooms are not the best Ritz cam have. 

I had to change the room because they set me to a room that had a tub for deseabled people. Just because I was by myself you don’t give me the room with the americes that are actually convenient for disabled people but really an uncomfortable for a normal petit person. 
It did feel like a downgrade to me… even though people with special needs should have better rooms than that. 

It was an ok stay.

reviews.author: Lama
reviews.title: Best choice!
reviews.body: Picked the hotel due to being close to crypto arena.. and it was the perfect choice. Staff and establishment was perfect. Very peaceful.

reviews.author: ViesRoy
reviews.title: My weekend getaway
reviews.body: This was a staycation for me. I only live 7 miles away from the Marriott location, but I was treated to a wonderful weekend and I will hopefully return very soon.

reviews.author: Dana D
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: Would recommend and will stay again!

reviews.author: Out of towner
reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.body: The bill included items that should have been credited with the $25.00/ day credit alliance.

reviews.author: Nance
reviews.title: Great first time stay at JW Marriott!
reviews.body: We stayed for 3 days to attend the Emmys as our son was a nominee. Meals in the hotel restaurants were excellent, grab & go food was great; front desk staff, servers, valet, bellmen  and concierge went above and beyond it help us with our personal handicapped needs, car service and tuxedo return.

reviews.author: Roberto
reviews.title: Valet
reviews.body:
My stay was great; my ONLY suggestion ~ when we checked out on Sunday morning, we went out front to wait for our car (I had not stayed at this particular Marriott before). We waited for a few minutes when we were finally approached by a valet who asked if we were waiting for a ride. We advised him that we were waiting for our car and he directed us to the downstairs parking garage.
Not a huge deal, but the nice lady who completed the checkout could have directed us to the garage and saved us some time.

reviews.author: Dn123
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience
reviews.body:
Very disappointing experience for a JW Marriott. We ate at Corteza at Sendero after our waitress raved about the food, but the crab dish was basically soup, the ahi tuna was awful, and the fried items were made with seed oils. She asked about allergies and dietary concerns, but there seemed to be little ability to accommodate them, which made me wonder why they even ask. The restaurant felt more pretentious than focused on serving genuinely good food.

Our room also had maintenance issues. We couldn’t properly turn the shower handle, only one bathroom light fixture worked, and the bathroom felt dated. We had to call maintenance during our stay.

I also needed a quiet place for an important Zoom meeting and was told the only workspace available was a FedEx computer area in the hallway next to the restrooms, with people constantly coming and going and doors banging.

For the price and the JW Marriott name, I expected a much higher standard of food, room maintenance, and guest amenities. Unfortunately, this stay did not live up to the brand. I will post this on google review as well.

reviews.author: Supply Chain Professional
reviews.title: great hotel
reviews.body: great hotel with excellent service & food

reviews.author: JD22
reviews.title: Stay here you won't be disspointed
reviews.body: We have no complaints and that's saying a lot. Super nice big room with soft bedding. Quite room

reviews.author: Lostgal
reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.body: See my previous statement

reviews.author: Flyer
reviews.title: Did not live up to what it was selling
reviews.body: For the luxury and spa-like environment that was being promoted and the cost, I did not feel comfortable here at all. I did not get the type of room I requested (I even booked direct), and the room just felt old - dated and scuffed furniture, rocks in the matted rug, non functioning bath. I was just too busy or tired to get it dealt with or change rooms. The positives were that the lounge/restaurant and housekeeping staff were great, and there were amenities (pool, restaurant, cafe) around. However, I'll stick with my boutique hotels next time.

reviews.author: Solo traveler2026
reviews.title: The best hotel stay in LA
reviews.body: If you want delicious dining options, convenient location, accommodating staff, and overall comfortable room, this is a great hotel. It will meet all your needs.

reviews.author: Isa D
reviews.title: Perfect Stay!
reviews.body: I stayed here for 14 nights and everything was perfect! The service was amazing and the location couldn’t be beat!

reviews.author: PSHEN69
reviews.title: NOT WORTH THE MONEY
reviews.body: Sadly to report that this property is not worth the money.  Great staff and friendly service but thats about yet.  the proptery feel like FOUR POINTS and the amenities are just OK.  Pool side service was greaet but the chairs were falling apart.  Pool style is old fashion and nothing to brag about. NOT IG worthy!  Rooms are old with torn furniture. Carpet is so dirty that deep cleaning will not even help.  Just replace it.  Forsure, NEVER stay here again!

reviews.author: Von Krum
reviews.title: My stay that turned buisness into pleasure
reviews.body: I had a convention to attend. Normal business but, my stay at JW Marriot made it more like a vacation. Everything was right there, food, drink, entertainment. You honestly didn't have to leave the hotel. It's placement made it easy to have many choices of places to eat hang out or just walk around.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Really Good. Used to be Better.
reviews.body: This is a good hotel. It was even better when they gave the breakfast at the hotel restaurant, but it’s close to Crypto and LA Live. Nice hotel.

reviews.author: Pam T
reviews.title: Room with a view
reviews.body: The front desk was welcoming.  My stay went smoothly.

reviews.author: Stephylou
reviews.title: Ohkay
reviews.body: My room was dirty. The first day I took a shower, there was a contact in the shower. I don’t wear contacts. I call down to the front desk and they said that someone from housekeeping would deep clean my room. When I come back to my room it was the next day early morning. There was a dead leaf under the white night stand table. I didn’t say anything to the front desk about it. I just wondered where would you find a leaf at around this area. There were barely any trees. The next day I tried to watch Netflix. It wasn’t working. The next day I told the front desk about Netflix not working and they sent a technician to work on it but they had to request an outside technician. Front desk asked me it I want to change my room, I told them no because I lie that I could see the Hollywood sign from my room plus I had already put my stuff up in the room. The last day I noticed there was fake eye lashes between the bed and the other white night stand with the bible in it. I was disappointed in the cleanliness of the hotel room. I didn’t watch tv my entire stay either.

reviews.author: Kemal Kaya
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.body:
During our stay, our room keys were suddenly deactivated and we were unable to enter our room. We were eventually told that this was related to an issue with the parking charge/account.

What is completely unacceptable is that nobody called me, texted me, emailed me, or gave us any warning whatsoever before blocking our access to our own room.

My pregnant wife and our 6-year-old child were left waiting outside the room for more than 30 minutes, while all of our personal belongings were locked inside. Security was called, but even they could not initially open the door. We were then told there was an “account problem.”

We had an appointment and our entire family was late because of this incident.

I had absolutely no objection to paying the parking fee. I understood that parking and other incidental charges would be settled with the hotel account/check-out. If there was any issue requiring immediate payment, a luxury hotel should simply call or message the guest and ask them to come to the front desk.

Instead, JW Marriott chose to disable our room access without any prior communication and left a pregnant woman and a six-year-old child standing in the hallway.

This is not the level of guest service, professionalism, or basic consideration I would expect from a JW Marriott property.

I have documented the messages and the incident and will be formally escalating this complaint to Marriott International and Booking.com.

I expect hotel management to provide a clear explanation as to who authorized our room access to be disabled, why we were not contacted beforehand, and what they intend to do to compensate us for the disruption and distress caused to my family.

reviews.author: TeeWils
reviews.title: Enjoy JW Marriott at LA LIVE
reviews.body: Excellent and personal staff were the touch point for an enjoyable stay. Clean and personable environment. Beautiful clean rooms that are quiet. Concierge lounge is a nice touch but they need more variety in their food servings. And the location of this hotel (smack dab in the middle of crypto arena, restaurants and LA LIVE is superb!

reviews.author: APWU member
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.body: Very professional and great atmosphere. Took care of all my needs.

reviews.author: Vickie A
reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.body: Excellent location, great service, friendly staff, great food and drink options.

reviews.author: Good
reviews.title: First time stay at JW
reviews.body: Is very good service is very good

reviews.author: Famous
reviews.title: LA LIVE!
reviews.body: I previously stayed at another luxury hotel in Westlake Village before my arrival to the JW Marriott LA Live, and  I was hoping to continue the same luxury experience upon my arrival. The JW service staff, onsite accommodations, and esthetics did not disappoint. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay, and would recommend this location to my circle.

reviews.author: Mailman
reviews.title: NALC Convention
reviews.body: Great staff, great service, great atmosphere.

reviews.author: L bourn
reviews.title: Misinformation and unorganized
reviews.body: Terrible valet situation and front desk rep gave us wrong info several times.

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.title: JW Marriott
reviews.body: This hotel was very close to the convention center so was an easy walk for the 5 days we were there for the nalc convention. Also the valets were excellent

reviews.author: Aamaka
reviews.title: Great stay! We loved our trip!
reviews.body: We had such a great time from the moment that we got to the hotel. We were greeted with smiles. Everything was nice and clean when we got to our room it was beautiful. Our view was beautiful daily. The housekeeping did an amazing job cleaning and restocking everything. Overall it was a wonderful trip.

reviews.author: Michelle T
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.body: The staff were consistently friendly and helpful.  I kept coming back to the Mixing Room for the flat bread.  Cortez at Sendero had great food and great views.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: I really enjoyed my stay1 Everything was great and I was surprised they were doing construction and it was still nice and quiet and there was no disturbance because of the construction.

reviews.author: Mrs Lewis
reviews.title: I don't have no complaints
reviews.body: Valet staff was perfect greeters, and the was patient.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great location for short stay in LA
reviews.body: Cannot fault the staff and service excellent however a bit of clean and freshen up might make this a much better experience.

reviews.author: No
reviews.title: Excellent hotel,  gorgeous!
reviews.body: I have a  mixed relationship with the Marriott.  I feel underrated 😪

reviews.author: DR2
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: Great stay. Clean facilities and friendly staff.

reviews.author: Carla
reviews.title: Safety
reviews.body: Uncertain of the non hotel guests that are able to come in and out of the building. No toiletries provided. Layout of shower and toilet lacks privacy

reviews.author: NA
reviews.title: Top location for a conference; Dirty
reviews.body:
Amazing location for a conference at the convention center. Beautiful hotel, well equipped room.
Dirty room. Stained sheets, crumbled paper on the floor, crusty something in the toilet seat. And this is just what I could see.

reviews.author: Jennifer B
reviews.title: Stay at the courtyard around the corner instead!!!!
reviews.body: This hotel does not feel like a marriott! The staff is lacking and impossible to reach. We did not enjoy the stay. The courtyard/residence inn around the corner is 10x better.

reviews.author: Dan313
reviews.title: AC marriot review
reviews.body: I stayed for 6 nights, at the superior room, the views were amazing overlooking way over the freeway and the Hollywood sign,and crypto arena within stones throw.The room was nice tidy and amenities like soap available.Room keeping was immaculate and Eveready,fast internet connection as well as smart tv.Temperature was nice and cool right making the hot night bearable.Overall facility was well maintained and guests seemed happy to be there

reviews.author: Anonymous Guest
reviews.title: Comfortable Room, but Service Could Improve
reviews.body:
The bedding was very comfortable and plush, but service was often slow. Requested items sometimes took 30 minutes or longer and occasionally required more than one follow-up call.

I also would have appreciated on-site laundry, more consistent housekeeping, larger trash cans, and better bathroom privacy when sharing the room with others.

Overall, the room was comfortable, but a few improvements would have made the stay much more enjoyable.

reviews.author: fish6800
reviews.title: Not kid friendly
reviews.body: The hotel should be marketed/advertised as adults only.

reviews.author: Irlanda
reviews.title: Best hotel DTLA
reviews.body: Great hotel, the team very friendly and professional Mac Sarah and Jon were great , valet team was amazing

reviews.author: DJ
reviews.title: Nice and clean
reviews.body: The hotel offers a variety of entertainment options. The rooms are not the most family friendly,  because of the frosted shower and restroom stalls and no restroom walls, but the accommodations could work for couples

reviews.author: Crystal 07
reviews.body: Bartender was amazing, super friendly and welcoming, and on top of everything, Lemon Drop martinis were fantastic.

reviews.author: CloverRover
reviews.title: Consistent and Great Location
reviews.body: We have stayed here a couple times. The rooms are spacious and clean. Great location and easy for events or USC visits. Would be nice if there was room service or restaurant delivery within the hotel.

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.title: Bed was not comfortable and the price of a night stay was too high
reviews.body: Breakfast was too expensive even with the hotel credit

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Ac Marriott/ LACC
reviews.body: Right across from LACC. Nice rooms with good views. Staff was great. One block from the metro. Would stay again.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.body: Overall we enjoyed our stay. Staff and service were excellent. As an out of owner, I would’ve expected the valet pick up area wouldn’t been much cleaner, but everything else was excellent.

reviews.author: T Roy
reviews.title: not terrible
reviews.body: Closest hotel to convention center.l. Very clean and nice. Pool closed a lot. Not sure if just coincidence but ask before you book if you plan on swimming. Great housekeeping all week.  Food at hotel restaurant upstairs with outside patio very very expensive. Service was not good and the waiter didn’t care because they built in 20% tip. I wouldn’t have tipped nearly that much. Soured me on eating at hotel at all.

reviews.author: Frequent traveler
reviews.title: Frequent visitor
reviews.body: I’ve stayed at the AC multiple times in the last year. Great location for being downtown and where I need to work. Plenty of food options within hotel and around the area. Room is always comfy and clean. Can’t beat the views from this hotel either.

reviews.author: MG
reviews.title: Great stay in Downtown LA
reviews.body: The room is comfortable and efficient. Great views of the city. The hall into the room seemed like wasted space and it would have been nice to have a full length mirror there. I liked that the toilet and shower were separate. It’s a little weird going to the top floor and then down to your room and having to switch elevators to exit the hotel but great being on a high floor. The rooftop is nice and I would have loved to spend more time there but it was so hot during my visit. Good stay overall and I’d definitely stay again.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: nice rooms!!!
reviews.body: Very nice and confortable room and the most important is the cleanness of the rooms are top 10!

reviews.author: KT
reviews.title: Lovely hotel, most amazing staff
reviews.body: The staff at the AC were incredibly helpful and friendly. The views for the hotel are incredible and the overall feel of the hotel is amazing, my room could have been a tiny bit cleaner but overall a wonderful stay

reviews.author: Carlton B
reviews.title: Modern, Stylish, and Exceptionally Well‑Executed
reviews.body:
AC Hotel Downtown Los Angeles delivers a refined, European‑inspired experience that feels intentional from the moment you arrive. The design is clean, modern, and beautifully cohesive — exactly what the AC brand promises. Every space, from the lobby to the lounge, reflects a thoughtful balance of simplicity and sophistication, creating an atmosphere that’s both calming and elevated.

The hotel’s focus on European‑style minimalism comes through clearly: muted tones, sleek lines, and a layout that prioritizes comfort without clutter. It’s the kind of environment where you can unwind, work, or meet with ease. The AC Lounge is a standout, offering well‑crafted cocktails, curated bites, and a social setting that feels polished without being loud or overwhelming.

Service is consistently warm and efficient, aligning with the brand’s promise of providing “precisely what you need.” Rooms follow the same design philosophy — modern, clean, and thoughtfully arranged — though compact, which is typical for AC Hotels. What they lack in size, they make up for in style and functionality.

Overall, AC Hotel Downtown Los Angeles delivers a stay that feels smooth, modern, and well‑executed. It’s a strong choice for travelers who appreciate intentional design, elevated simplicity, and a hotel experience that stays true to its European‑inspired roots.

reviews.author: Baltazar
reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.body:
had a great stay at the AC Hotel Downtown LA.
The staff were friendly and professional, including Kevin from the engineering department, who helped me navigate the building and pointed me to some great spots nearby. The room was spotless and stylish, the bed was super comfortable, and I loved the modern vibe and the bar. Convenient location too. I'd definitely stay here again!!!

reviews.author: Ally
reviews.title: Great time at AC hotel
reviews.body: AC Hotel is a fantastic location to stay overnight when planning to watch an event at Crypto Arena. We had a great room! We enjoyed the sunset view!

reviews.author: MC
reviews.title: Awesome stay for business travel.
reviews.body: This was an awesome stay for business travel. I enjoyed the daily house keeping. The rooftop was beautiful. And I had a pretty nice view.

reviews.author: Pat S
reviews.title: A upscale feel & clean hotel
reviews.body:
Honestly cannot praise the AC more, this feels like a more upscale hotel than it positions itself. It’s got a great style & atmosphere to it with amazing views. You feel disconnected from Downtown LA because you’re so high up. 

The cleanliness of this place is also top notch. Lobby, bathrooms, sheets, general everything is clean & maintained.

reviews.author: Rebecg2
reviews.title: Nice hotel, friendly staff
reviews.body: The hotel was clean and the rooms were nice. The location is great.

reviews.author: Nikki
reviews.title: Breezy
reviews.body: Good stay. Rooms are smaller but comfortable for 2 people. Rooftop Pool and bar were fun

reviews.author: Jovic
reviews.title: Olivia day
reviews.body: It’s a perfect spot for a concert venue. Valley parking is a perk!

reviews.author: Do not Go
reviews.title: Go Elsewhere
reviews.body:
Rooms were designed for Hobbits
Lobby design should result in the architect being fired
And no hot water for my morning shower. Plenty in the late afternoon which leads me to believe that the system cannot handle large numbers of people showering at the same time
Would be nice to have an exhaust fan in the toilet area.

reviews.author: Road Warrior 2112
reviews.title: Worst Marriott property I have ever stayed at.
reviews.body:
Maintenance and housekeeping in the room was terrible. Caked dust on the shower head (Although I am somewhat surprised given the leak in the shower head that sprays water into the room) was one of the most notable deficiencies.

There is no bathroom in the room. The toilet and shower "compartments" open directly into the room, and the sink is actually in the room just inside the door.

The side board on the sink is only large enough to (barely) accommodate a shaving kit, leaving nowhere else to set anything.

The bedside table was too small to accommodate both the phone and a book without it hanging over the edge.

I couldn't read the book anyway since the bedside lights are not adjustable and only project light onto the floor.

The "desk" is so small I had to set my laptop on it at an angle in order to find four square inches to use my mouse.

The hangers are mounted on the wall since there is no closet, and they are so low that any shirt placed on them drags the ground and gets the tails of the shirt dirty.

The only overhead light in the room did not produce the light of a single candle.

Apparently, when you turn off the master light switch (the only way to shut off the light above the sink), it also turns off the power to the outlets which you discover in the morning when you realize your phone didn't charge overnight.

I was able to have a drink at the Moxy Bar in the lobby, although I could not have lunch there since the kitchen does not open until 5. So much for the "all day cafe" advertised......

I would have loved to have experienced a nice meal in one of the restaurants, but they were only open Thursday, Friday and Saturday nights, and since I was in town on business, this schedule did not fit well with my activities. I was able to have a couple of drinks at the rooftop bar on Thursday night, but the best I could get for food was a burger.

Multiple requests at the front desk for additional coffee pods for the coffee maker went unfulfilled.

Quite frankly, if I have occasion to return to L.A. in the course of my travels, I would be better served to get a room at a Motel 6 in Compton than to return to this hotel which has all the ambiance of a New York tenement building circa 1905, to say nothing of the ridiculous alien motif.....  To say I was disappointed at spending $1,600 for such sparse and underwhelming accommodations would be a dramatic understatement.

reviews.author: JS
reviews.title: Amazing view  17th September 2026
reviews.body: Amazing view from 24th floor!

reviews.author: Stay at ac hotel
reviews.title: Only stay here if youre by yourself
reviews.body:
This was a hard stay.
The hotel had MANY restaurants to eat at but only a handful would let me use my $100 credit and among those few, only one was open during my stay. I had a very difficult time using the credit and many staff members had no idea where I could use it. Every day of my four days there, I would run around looking to see where I could use it. By thursday night, I finally found a place to use it but that was after going and actually placing orders at two other places only to find out they dont take the credit. I dont even know if I got the credit because I see so many charges from the hotel over random stuff. Im not even sure what the charges were for since it was so difficult to find a place. Front desk was also very unhelpful with any benefits I was hoping to use. They would have me running back and forth from moxy to ac hotel just trying to find a soft drink to purchase (with the $18 credit)
I also did not appreciate the room. The bathroom layout was horrible. My daughter could see me in the bathroom and I could see her WHILE in the bathroom. The doors were horrible. And the sink outside was very inconvenient. This would make sense in a king room but not in a shared double. Please revisit that choice of doors. 
Also, please have staff check their cleaning. There was a strand of blonde hair (me and my daughter dont have anything near blonde hair) stuck on the remote and also on the stand. Stand was also weird because it was made to be used in place of a closet. It blocked the view we were “upgraded” to. Room was really small esp with it being a double. Only space to sit was on the bed so we would be eating on our beds which I really do not like. 
Positive side was view was nice and it was very close to the convention center which was the main purpose of this trip. I just wish we had a better experience since I used my amex plat credit on this stay.

reviews.author: Anakin66
reviews.title: Cool looking hotel
reviews.body: Check in took forever, and elevators take forever! The building maintenance team was great, our room was super hot and the AC was not working right, they came and fixed it ASAP and got the room comfortable for us.

reviews.author: JT805
reviews.title: The amazing stay
reviews.body: What's not to love about my stay here... The atmosphere and the staff are always eager to be at service. Everyone if you haven't stayed here you should it's beautiful all around. Thank you Moxy for another awesome 😎 time and great memories.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: A Gem in the City
reviews.body: I recently stayed at the Moxy LA Downtown, and it is an absolute vibe! The location is unbeatable—right in the heart of Downtown LA and incredibly convenient. The service was fantastic, and the entire property has a fun, energetic ambiance.True to the Moxy brand, the rooms are very small, but they are efficiently designed if you are mostly using the room to sleep. The best part of the stay is the brilliant dual-branded setup. Because it is colocated with the AC Hotel, you get access to an incredible ecosystem of shared amenities. The third-party restaurants, bars, and clubs on-site are spectacular.The absolute highlight of the trip was hanging out at the La Lo La Rooftop and the pool area—perfect spots to relax and grab a drink. Also, as someone who travels constantly, I have to highlight the fitness center. It is easily one of the best hotel gyms I have ever encountered in all my years of travel.If you don't mind micro-sized rooms and want incredible amenities right at your fingertips, this place is a home run!

reviews.author: iynah
reviews.title: Vibin’
reviews.body: Loved our stay at the Moxy DTLA! Loved the pool and the rooftop patio that’s open most hours so we hung out here in the morning sipping our coffee from Bluestone Lane coffee from downstairs. Perfect time after gym to wind down and get some sunshine. Also an awesome spot for sunset and the golden hour lighting. The parking/ valet fee is a bit steep for $70 a day but you get to go in and out of the facility and it worked for us as we were busy going back and forth forth throughout the day. What we love: gym has all the equipment u can think of — for cardio/ strength training/ mats. They even have an outdoor green patch if you prefer to be outdoors doing your stretches. $30 consumables for food and drinks-this covers our coffee. The pool is lovely - small but decent size with floaties and colorful and tropical cabanas to lounge and take pics! We stayed here half of the morning after our BTS concert and it’s a perfect place to just chill and wind down. Rooms are small which is how Moxy rooms are but with a lot of under bed storage. We knew this coming in so no big deal for us. We loved our stay overall. This is our 2nd time staying at Moxy, the first being in NYC! Both are a vibe!

reviews.author: AngCrawf
reviews.title: Amazing and Beautiful Sun Set
reviews.body:
My stay at the Moxy Downtown Los Angeles was absolutely AMAZING! From the atmosphere to the location and overall experience, I truly enjoyed everything about this hotel.

But the highlight of my entire stay was THE VIEW! Watching the sun go down over Los Angeles from the hotel was honestly one of the most beautiful and breathtaking experiences I’ve ever had. 🌇✨ The colors across the sky, the city views, and the entire ambiance created a moment I will never forget. Pictures simply cannot capture how beautiful it was in person!

The Moxy has such a fun, stylish, modern vibe that makes you feel like you’re experiencing Los Angeles in a special way. I would absolutely recommend this hotel to my family, friends, and anyone visiting Downtown LA.

10 out of 10  I would definitely stay here again! 🏨❤️🌆 The sunset alone was worth the stay, but the entire experience made it even better. Moxy Downtown Los Angeles, you definitely left an impression on me!

reviews.author: ZavalaH
reviews.title: Best stay
reviews.body: My stay at moxy was amazing the staff are friendly the room was super clean the view was amazing and the bed so comfy I would definitely go back next time am in LA

reviews.author: Jorge
reviews.title: Cool
reviews.body: It’s good. Decent view of downtown

reviews.author: Debra89015
reviews.title: Nice, clean rooms but not for those who don't like heights!
reviews.body: I stayed here because I went to a concert at Crypto.com Center. The hotel was just a block away, so I didn't have to worry about parking at the venue, only to fight traffic and drive back to a hotel.  The rooms were clean, the staff was friendly, and the lobby area was very nice. My biggest issues were that everything was on higher floors, and I'm afraid of heights--even just thinking about being up on a high floor makes my knees shake! I was on the 10th floor, but at least the sheer curtains were closed, so I couldn't see directly out the window. I was hungry after the concert, but everything in the hotel was closed--and I refused to go up to the 33rd (or whatever) floor for the 24/7 market---why is it way up there?? It would have been nice to have some vending area in the lobby.  Door Dash was going to take too long, so I just got my car from valet and drove to get myself some food. If I went back, I would probably try to go on a day when the other bars and restaurants (Level 8?) were open later.

reviews.author: Kat
reviews.title: Stylish Hotel, but Not Ideal for Business Travelers
reviews.body:
The room itself was very nice, but unfortunately the overall experience wasn’t a good fit for me, particularly as a business traveler.

I had emailed ahead to explain that I would be arriving after an international flight and asked whether an early check-in might be possible. I completely understood that it couldn’t be guaranteed, and they said they would do their best. I arrived only about an hour before check-in, but it turned into an unnecessarily frustrating discussion at the front desk and I really had to push to get into a room. They offered me a downgraded room that was ready, but I would still have been charged the higher rate for the corner room I had booked. Eventually they were able to get me into my room, which I appreciated, but it wasn’t a pleasant way to arrive after a long international flight.

The hotel also charges an additional nightly “entertainment” or destination fee of around $35, yet several of the restaurants and the rooftop bar weren’t open during my Tuesday stay. There’s no room service, and I found the bar quite expensive as well.

The hotel is stylish and clearly designed with a fun, Instagram-ready atmosphere in mind, but for me it felt like the emphasis was more on the scene than on convenience and service. My room was lovely once I finally got settled, but overall it was too expensive and a little too kitschy for a business trip. I wouldn’t choose to stay again.

reviews.author: ERaney
reviews.title: Tiny room.
reviews.body: Smallest hotel room ever with no in room amenities. Basically very minimalistic. Hangers on the wall count as a closet. You have to go get your own ice bucket, and no where to keep it or drinks. Limited counter space. Doors are see through. Convenient location

reviews.author: TCB
reviews.title: Location Great, But Just Say No
reviews.body:
The location was great as far as convenience for our event, but super disappointing for a Marriott property. 
Cleanliness hovers between poor to fair.

reviews.author: ai slop hotel
reviews.title: Worst hotel experience of my life. Ai slop reception.
reviews.body: Dirty, loud, can't talk to a human.

reviews.author: TheSmartTina
reviews.title: Quick and easy stay
reviews.body:
If you're looking for a hotel that's across the street from the convention center and the crypto Arena then this was a great place.
If you want a luxury stay this is probably not what you want since the rooms are like the bare minimum. Yes the rooms are nice but you get what you paid for.
I did not really use the hotel amenities since I was there for a convention and concert across the street but the bartenders are really nice and check in process was pretty easy to do.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: There was no bathroom, space or privacy in the room.
reviews.body: The room is so small there's no separate bathroom, closet or space to put your baggage down. There were hooks along the wall of the room to hang towels or your things. I've never been in such a small hotel room.

reviews.author: Linds
reviews.title: The best hotel for KCON LA!
reviews.body: This hotel is right across the street from the LA Convention Center and the Crypto Arena which is perfect for when KCON LA is in town. The proximity is super convenient to be able to go back to drop off freebies or take a nap before the concert. The city view rooms overlook the convention area which is so cool to look at. The room itself was modern, clean, and comfy. Highly recommend this hotel for KCON LA weekend!

reviews.author: BrittanyC
reviews.title: Went for Kcon!
reviews.body: The location was great for kcon since the convention center and Crypto Arena were right across the street. Staff was friendly and the hotel was clean. There's no mini fridge which is odd and weird to work around. The WiFi also barely worked so we ended up using our phone's hotspot. The $18 food credit you get with your destination fee can only be used at 1 of the 13 restaurants. The room IS small, but if you plan on spending most of your day outside it's totally fine. I'd stay again.

reviews.author: BCAP
reviews.title: Great staycation
reviews.body: Came here for a night and day time fun at the pool - fun and perfect for a staycation; great location in DTLA

reviews.author: Rkav
reviews.title: Awful experience. 0/10.
reviews.body: Loud music all evening and night and a ‘private event’ in our pool with little to no prior notice of this.

reviews.author: Ashli
reviews.title: Convenient to staples center
reviews.body: Booked a stay for the Megan Moroney concert. The line at 4pm to check in took over 30 mins. The girl who helped us at check in was amazing, best part of our stay. We payed for a corner view but were given a downgrade with no reimbursement.  Valet staff were incredibly rude. Everytime we needed to use the elevator it took about 10-15 mins. Food was a bit overpriced. For a hamburger, Caesar salad and a small pasta it was $140.00 not including tip.

reviews.author: AshMoco
reviews.title: Customer service/upkeep
reviews.body:
When I arrived to the hotel I was informed there was not a room ready. Which was fine I arrived at 11am and provided my number. I never received a call that a room was ready. I returned back to the hotel around 4pm to find a coworker that arrived after me received a room at 2pm. The front desk informed me the only room that was available was a handicap accessible room. 
The room I was in the tile was not clean, windows were not clean, and house keeping continued to turn the AC off and turn the heat on in its place. The AC was not working that well either. The amenities were not accessible as expected and we were not made aware of cut off times. 
The hotel is convenient and house keeping did keep fresh towels/bedding.

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.title: Upscale visit at the Moxy
reviews.body: A good choice for our overnighter which included visits to Manhattan Beach, Beverly Hills and Ed Sheeran at the SoFi. Upscale accommodations . Clean facilities and attentive staff. Valet hets pricey and some hidden fees (restaurant imposed a 20% service fee) which added to the cost. Still would rec - just visit the ATM prior!

reviews.author: Mrs Travel ATL
reviews.title: Mrs Travel
reviews.body: Can’t wait to come back next time I’ll do a Mother and Daughter trip. We had so much fun husband and I.

reviews.author: Rhonda
reviews.title: THE MOXY, Hmmmm??
reviews.body: This location wasn't for me

reviews.author: Brack Lee
reviews.title: Would be nicer if the property allowed guests to use guest facilities.
reviews.body:
Moxy DTLA is a nice property in a great location for LA related business and events. However, during our stay the pool area was closed to guests the majority of the time for private events that weren’t published at the time of booking. (Around 20 days in advance.)

That was a big disappointment as the pool area was one of the primary reasons the property was chosen for this trip.

reviews.author: Tans Birthday Trip
reviews.title: TANGS BIRTHDAY
reviews.body: Excellent I enjoyed my stay, it was pricey but it was my bithday.  I love the pool and rooftop and all the ethicses of the place.  I love it more than one bar in Moxy love the fact my parking was inculded. Good job and I love a rooftop view

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Suprise fees
reviews.body: Surprise fees at the end, look at the bill

reviews.author: Tom E
reviews.title: Best Conference Hotel Experience Ever
reviews.body: I have been attending conferences for more than 30 years now and I've never had an experience that can come close to this. The food was exceptional, the staff at all levels were friendly and helpful, the room was spacious and comfortable, and the location was great.

reviews.author: Devin Brown
reviews.title: A premium experience
reviews.body: My wife and I enjoyed our stay at the US Grant hotel. We were in town for my birthday weekend. the staff called this out when we checked in and everyone we interacted with--from the valet to the receptionist to the concierge to the staff at the restaurant--were extremely attentive to detail, helpful, and friendly. The location is prime.We were able to walk comfortably to several of our weekend destinations. When we did hire a car, it was always quick to get to or from the hotel.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with the best to offer
reviews.body: Not only is the hotel beautiful but the staff were knowledgeable, helpful, and friendly. The food was excellent and the bedding was so luxurious I had the best night's sleep I have had all year. I typically don't sleep well when I am away from home. Bell staff came to my room and provided ice and additional water without being called. This was gratefully appreciated as San Diego was experiencing a very unusual heat wave.

reviews.author: Sean O
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.body: The entire team at the US Grant was service focused and professional. We enjoyed our stay in a great location and a beautiful room.

reviews.author: JCS II
reviews.title: Best Hotel in the Gaslamp Area
reviews.body: Great, food great place great service

reviews.author: Alejandra
reviews.title: Premium service
reviews.body: Excellent place to stay if you need to work or explore San Diego. It has private parking and is close to prime locations for enjoying San Diego. 10 minutes from Padres Stadium, one block from the gaslamp on 5th Avenue. Across the street from the San Diego Civic Theater.

reviews.author: Traveller
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay — Not the Luxury Experience We Expected
reviews.body:
We had a disappointing stay at Luxury Grand Hotel in San Diego. Check-in was smooth, and we appreciated the room upgrade, but several issues made the experience far from luxurious.

The biggest concern was security. While our child was sleeping, someone knocked on our door, entered our room and we yelled and then they left. Someone entered again later. This was extremely disturbing and made us feel unsafe.

We were also told we could only receive one Amex time $100 credit per stay despite the benefit terms stating otherwise. The website advertised $20 self-parking, but we were told valet was the only option at $70. Two elevators were closed, the building felt dated, and the dining options were limited.

The Gaslamp location is convenient, but the surrounding neighborhood did not feel family-friendly or comfortable for walking.

Overall, this was not the luxury experience we expected. The hotel needs to improve its security, transparency, and facilities.

reviews.author: Roko
reviews.title: Great hotel in amazing location
reviews.body: Rooms feel new but with historic charm.   Beautiful hotel with impeccable attention to cleanliness and small details.

reviews.author: Laurie
reviews.title: Our place to stay in San Diego
reviews.body: Excellent service, personnel,  accommodations and location

reviews.author: MJacobs
reviews.title: A Treat To Stay Here
reviews.body: Beautiful property and a delight to be able to stay here!

reviews.author: Pcastro
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: Been to many luxury hotels, this one is definitely up there!

reviews.author: Folsom65
reviews.title: You will not regret staying at the US Grant
reviews.body: On a recent trip to San Diego our son who lives  there helped us find the US Grant hotel to stay at during our recent visit. My first impression of the hotel was the elegant entrance and the number of staff members waiting to check you in. The whole staff was very welcoming and  very helpful every time I interacted with them. When we got to our room I was again impressed with the amenities and the ample room in the restroom . I was especially pleased with the shower for my husband who uses a walker. The following day we ordered room service which was promptly delivered to our room and the presentation of the food was first class.  Both of our meals were 5 star. The location of the hotel to be able to access restaurants and other locations in the San Diego area only added to the appeal. Our son is stationed in San Diego and I am sure we will be returning to the area again and I am certain I will be returning to the US Grant for our accomodations.

reviews.author: Amber
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay at a Beautiful Luxury Collection Property
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, our stay at The US Grant fell well below what we expected from a Marriott Luxury Collection property.

Our room was uncomfortably hot, and we were told the A/C requires movement in the room to operate. When we asked for a fan, we were told the hotel had none. We were also surprised to learn there is a $25/day charge for a refrigerator, something we did not see disclosed when booking.

Getting ice was unnecessarily frustrating. We were given conflicting information about which floors had ice machines, searched multiple floors, and ultimately learned that guests actually have to call to have ice delivered.

The biggest disappointment was breakfast. Our reservation included a $75 daily breakfast allowance. At 10 a.m., we were told the restaurant had a 90-minute wait even though breakfast ended at 11. Staff suggested ordering room service instead, but after returning to our room, we called and let the phone ring for approximately five minutes with no answer. We ultimately had to leave the hotel for breakfast and lost the $75 benefit included with our reservation.

There were also only two working elevators during our stay, adding to the inconvenience.

I do want to recognize Jose, who provided exceptional service on Saturday. He was attentive, professional, and genuinely welcoming. If our entire stay had reflected Jose’s level of service, this would have been a very different review. He is a tremendous asset to the hotel.

For a Luxury Collection property, we expected much better consistency, communication, and service. Unfortunately, the accumulation of issues made this a disappointing stay.

reviews.author: Ary C
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.body: My wife and I had an excellent stay. The rooms were clean. The staff were super helpful. The building was gorgeous very well located. It was worth the money.

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: A True Luxury Brand
reviews.body: The US Grant Hotel actually operates like a luxury hotel. I could not have been happier with my stay. Being Marriott Platinum, I feel like I rarely get room upgrades, or I am told it’s a very good upgrade and then I find it’s the same room with just maybe a better view. The US Grant actually upgraded me to a larger room which was greatly appreciated. They were also impeccable about nightly turn down service. The room was spacious, very clean, and had great amenities. We had breakfast at the hotel each day, which was quite good. This is a great hotel and next time I am in San Diego, I will be returning. Thank you for making my stay wonderful!

reviews.author: Travel nurse AN
reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.body: Grant hotel delivered in many ways that the hospitality industry has fallen short in recent years. The dining was amazing, the welcome set up on arrival was extensive. I was displaced from prior accommodations due to a/c failure, grant hotel almost convinced me to pay the higher cost for the duration of my stay. Whether business or leisure, the amenities are amazing. I work night shift, so the black out curtains, maximum AC output and plus bedding allowed for max recovery on my day off! I slept 12 hours and was oblivious to the world around me in my new found sanctuary.

reviews.author: Jen1
reviews.title: Another amazing stay at the US Grant!
reviews.body: This is my second time staying at the US Grant and we were extremely satisfied with the accommodations and service that the team provided! We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: JASON T
reviews.title: Great hotel and staff!
reviews.body: The US Grant is a historic treasure with a staff that provides exceptional service.

reviews.author: RJ 2026
reviews.title: Beautiful Landmark in San Diego
reviews.body: This hotel has a unique story and continues to deliver a luxury experience

reviews.author: Sunnycitytravels
reviews.title: Luxury, Comfort, and Top-Tier Dining in San Diego
reviews.body: I had a wonderful stay at The US Grant in San Diego and would highly recommend it. From the moment we arrived, the staff was amazing and incredibly attentive. Our room was perfect—beautifully appointed and very comfortable. We also thoroughly enjoyed the food and drinks at both the lounge and the restaurant; everything was top-tier. A truly fantastic experience from start to finish.

reviews.author: Family123
reviews.title: Worth the Stay
reviews.body: Great family suite with our 10 year old. She was scared but as parents we laughed and indulged in the amenities

reviews.author: D Bone
reviews.title: Heaven for Hell’s Kitchen
reviews.body: Our stay at the US Grant was nothing short of amazing. From location to service and the hotel itself, all expectations were exceeded. If you are attending a play at the Civic Theater, there is not a better option. No need to look or investigate any further. Direct any questions about what to do, or where to eat at Brook from the concierge desk. The man should be considered a legend.

reviews.author: Alfred O
reviews.title: Honest review
reviews.body: I enjoyed my stay at the historic THE US GRANT in San Diego, though I wish it offered more amenities, such as a swimming pool or indoor spa. The paid parking was also disappointing; considering the price of the stay, I feel it should have been complimentary. Aside from those issues, everything else about my experience was pleasant.

reviews.author: Abel
reviews.title: Amazing Service, but the Room Needed More Attention
reviews.body:
Customer service was amazing from the moment we arrived, and the hotel itself is beautiful with a lot of history and character. We really enjoyed the location and overall atmosphere of The US Grant.

Unfortunately, after settling into Room ###, we noticed a few issues. The bathroom door was not closing correctly and felt like it would get jammed if we tried to force it closed. We also noticed the AC was not really cooling the room. It was set to 65 degrees, but the room definitely didn’t feel that way.

We didn’t complain during our stay because we had already settled in, and moving everything to another room felt like more of an inconvenience. Obviously, we could have said something and switching rooms may have solved the problem, but I feel these are things that should be checked before a guest arrives.

We stayed for 4 nights and spent over $#### so I don’t think it’s too much to expect the room to be fully functional and comfortable from the beginning. These were small inconveniences and they didn’t ruin our trip, but they did take away from the luxury experience we were expecting.

Overall, the customer service was amazing and the staff deserves recognition. I just wish the room itself had received the same level of attention before we checked in.

reviews.author: RMR Sr
reviews.title: Stay in History
reviews.body: Very Nice Stay in a historic hotel.

reviews.author: Tom D
reviews.title: Great hotel, horrific downtown
reviews.body:
Top hotel, excellent room, responsive staff.   
Downtown San San Diego is a war zone due to homeless population  with screaming mentally challenged and urine spell everything.  Walked blocks in fear.  Beautiful downtown destroyed

reviews.author: Karim
reviews.title: Not a Fine Hotel to stay at withno special servcies
