reviews.body: I stayed with family on a birthday trip that also included a work event for 4 nights. The hotel is in a nice historic building but that is all what is there about luxury. The room was basic despite the American platinum upgrade ( no extra space or view) there is no spa or other services at the hotel to use your extra platinum credit at except the restaurant; the latter is a classic restaurant and food was average to say the least. The staff are nice but there was nothing about feeling special- coming on a birthday trip and Gold bonvoy member there was nothing special mentioned or provided- the American express credit could only be used for more food which again was not impressive to spend your breakfast and other meals there- the valet double charged my room and i had to call several times to get that corrected. The billing service kept struggling to get me a detailed bill to see how my A Ex credit was used. Overall this was mostly a 4 star hotel and there are way better spots to stay at in SD!

reviews.author: NS55
reviews.title: Historic elegance meets exceptional service.
reviews.body: spectacular historic hotel that seamlessly blends classic elegance with modern luxury Friendly, professional staff  and incredibly comfortable beds, making for a truly relaxing stay.. I highly recommend this hotel and cannot wait to return

reviews.author: Deb9
reviews.title: Beautiful historical hotel - but
reviews.body: Unfortunately the property although beautiful suffers from mold.

reviews.author: Michelle Ngo
reviews.title: Nice hotel with some excellent staffs, servicing the stay.
reviews.body:
I'd like to acknowledge and appreciation to the old gentlman at the conceirge (i'm so sorry i forgot your name) but he was there early at 8 am on July 14 to help us w some information about our Seaworld & Legoland reservation. He went above & beyond to obtain the information to provide to us. it doesn't take a lot of time, but the fact that he care, remember & got the information to us while we were at breakfast show the amt of care & the integrity he take in his work. and that is something you don't see a lot in servicing industry anymore. I appreciated that a lot! Oh, I saw the video that was playing in the lobby & by the elevator, he was in it...so he must be some model hotel employee or celebrity in his own right!
What was bothering me, was the fact that the hotel charged $40 daily to use the refigerator, daily, that was not explain to us. For being a 5 star hotel, requesting a small fridge, to me is not an outrageous request, and it should be granted freely & readily by the hotel without the fee. Trying to make extra money for something so frivilous as this charge put a sour taste on me coming back to this hotel. I'm writing this, so you can review & reconsider'

reviews.author: Melissa G
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, but not in a good part of town
reviews.body:
This hotel is very lovely, and the staff were fantastic. The bed was very comfortable, and the bathroom is very spacious and well light out.
It was the outdoor environment that really killed it for me. I know they can’t control it, but the city managers can. As I was walking toward the convention center to attend my classes, I felt bad for all the small businesses that were closed up probably because of being overrun with homeless and drug addicts all over the sidewalks, especially at night. It was unsafe for me to be outside of my hotel after five, which limited me to exploring and spending some tourism dollars.

reviews.author: Jj85
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.body: We loved this property from the moment  we arrived.   The front desk staff were super nice and knowledgeable.  We got extra benefits  due to our Expedia rank, some hotels never offer anything, however Alma went above and beyond.  Our room was beautiful, clean and had great views.  The rooftop pool and bar was gorgeous.  There was an issue with the pizza oven and our food took a bit long, however  the staff offered us free chips and guacamole for the wait.  We would absolutely  stay here again in the future!

reviews.author: Thom
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: The location was not the best. The comfortable room and wonderful staff made for it.

reviews.author: Dylan
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Overall fantastic experience. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: SS0326
reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here.
reviews.body:
Our stay at The Alma was absolutely unacceptable, especially for a trip celebrating our child’s first birthday.

Every single time we walked outside the hotel, there were people openly smoking what appeared to be crack and meth within approximately three feet of the entrance. We are both in law enforcement and are very familiar with high-crime areas, and the immediate surroundings of this hotel felt comparable to areas like Skid Row in Los Angeles or the Tenderloin in San Francisco. We did not feel safe bringing our family in and out of the hotel.

The location was also extremely misleading based on how the hotel was presented when we booked.We were under the impression that we would be staying near the Gaslamp Quarter and Little Italy, and the reality of the immediate neighborhood was nothing like what we expected.

To make matters worse, our room had a sewage issue on our very first night, adding another completely unacceptable problem to an already awful experience.

This was supposed to be a special trip for our child’s first birthday, and instead we spent the stay feeling uncomfortable and unsafe.I would absolutely not recommend this hotel to families traveling with children, and I strongly believe the location and surrounding conditions need to be represented much more accurately to prospective guests.

reviews.author: RENE
reviews.title: Amazing hospitality
reviews.body: The staff were polite, professional and always ready to help. Lena and Grace were awesome.

reviews.author: Shann
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Friendly staff. Room was clean. Enjoyed my stay.

reviews.author: Work trvl
reviews.title: Three day stay
reviews.body: Overall, the experience was good, with the room's condition being fair, considering that for most of the stay there was no hot water. To get somewhat warm water, you had to leave the shower on for over 10 minutes (no exaggeration), and there were multiple issues with the room, such as lights and light switches not working.

reviews.author: Happy guest
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.body: Loved my stay. The staff were extremely helpful and nice from the receptionist to the parking valet, they were going above and beyond to be as welcoming as possible. Room was clean, spacious, and had a nice view. Location is great too.

reviews.author: Steph
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Excellent  stay. Very accommodating

reviews.author: Evan
reviews.title: Very Disappointing Stay
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, my recent stay was a very disappointing experience. The room was not clean. There were visible stains in the shower and bathtub, streaks on the mirror, and the refrigerator was covered in stains and had a rotten smell coming from it.

I did not report these issues to the staff during my stay because I was only there for one night and was barely in the room. I was dealing with a personal matter and spent most of the night at the hospital with a dear friend, so addressing the condition of the room simply wasn’t my priority at the time.

Unfortunately, when I returned to the hotel early in the morning, I accidentally fell asleep without setting an alarm. I woke up around 11:30 AM to the room phone ringing. I assumed it was the front desk, but when I answered, there was no response. That’s when I realized I had overslept past checkout.

I immediately rushed to pack and leave and was completely out of the room before noon. Despite making every effort to leave as quickly as possible once I realized the time, I received a message from the on-duty manager as I was leaving stating that I would be charged a late fee.

I understand that hotels have checkout policies, and I take responsibility for accidentally oversleeping. However, given the circumstances and the fact that I was already out of the room before noon, I found the handling of the situation particularly disappointing—especially considering the condition of the room itself.

Overall, the cleanliness of the room and the response regarding the late checkout left a very poor impression. I would expect significantly better cleanliness and customer service from a hotel stay.

reviews.author: Romanreviewer
reviews.title: Friendly staff
reviews.body: The location is the selling point for this hotel.  Walking distance to gaslamp quarter. A lot of bums in the area , but that's not the hotels fault . Staff was friendly and took care of my room needs. The room had stains on the bathroom floor, some looked like mold.  Comforter had mold in it, you can tell by shinning light to it.  Other than that, it was a comfortable stay.

reviews.author: 49zion
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Wonderful stay in the hotel

reviews.author: AS16
reviews.title: Not Recommended.
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, this was an extremely disappointing stay and well below the standard I expected from a Marriott Tribute Portfolio property. Within the first hour of arriving, I discovered blood on the bed sheets. We then experienced ongoing issues with the air conditioning and significant difficulty getting hot water in the shower, even after maintenance was called to address the issue. We were told the hotel’s occupancy level was contributing to the hot-water problem. Additionally, a feather pillow came apart during our stay, leaving feathers throughout the room.

These were not minor or isolated inconveniences. Basic expectations of a hotel stay—clean bedding, a comfortably air-conditioned room, reliable hot water, and properly maintained bedding—were repeatedly not met. This was particularly disappointing given the cost of the stay and approximately $70/night parking.

I have contacted hotel management separately with the complete details and requested appropriate compensation. I hope management reviews the circumstances of our stay and provides a meaningful resolution.

reviews.author: SDSU Parent
reviews.title: SDSU move in
reviews.body:
Hotel is convenient to everything,  valet team was great car ready every time in less than 10 minutes. 
Hotel staff is great Rooster the bartender was awesome.
Rooms are very nice.

reviews.author: Amie AK
reviews.title: A little piece of HEAVEN in Downtown SD!
reviews.body:
Staying in Downtown San Diego may not be for everyone in summer - BUT we had an absolutely lovely time at the Alma Marriott property in August of 2026. An easy 2 block walk to the fun & energizing Gaslamp quarter but, honestly, once we got to Alma - there was very little reason to leave! While we waited (very short time) for our room to be ready we ordered ham & cheese croissant sandwiches from the lobby bar. To our delight the bartender asked if we wanted eggs added to those sandwiches! They were delicious! We chose to eat breakfast there another morning of our stay and the sourdough toast was unmatched! Delicious! 

Our room on 20th floor was perfect! A view of water AND directly into Petco Park! Very quiet - we never heard one other hotel guest on our floor! 

The room was great - only complaints would be the low lighting in the bathroom and ONLY a rain shower head in ceiling - no tub or wall mounted head options… other than that the room was perfect with plenty of space and every amenity you could want! 

The pool did NOT disappoint! Plenty of room to hang out up there. You could have a party up there! I loved relaxing in my lounger and the staff came by regularly to check and see if I needed anything. Poolside drinks and snacks?!!! Who doesn’t love that? We did not get a chance to try the pizza up there, but we will definitely do that next time when we come back. All in all - glowing review from these 2 Bostonians. Fantastic helpful staff and a VERY cool vibe. Looking to stay downtown?!?! You’ll love it!

reviews.author: Chaz P
reviews.title: Nice hotel with excellent service
reviews.body: The Alma is consistently great at providing a warm and accommodating environment. The food and drinks are excellent and the staff are attentive and welcoming. The area, as with the rest of downtown, can be a little sketchy, but if you need a hotel in that area and/or are getting around by car, it’s as good as you’ll find.

reviews.author: CJ56
reviews.title: Very nice, comfortable & welcoming
reviews.body: Spent three days in this hotel while attending a convention. Although the neighborhood was a little rundown, hotel, staff are welcoming, security, conscious, and friendly. The hotel is .7 miles from the convention center. Uber is readily available if you don’t want to walk. The bed was the most comfortable I’ve ever slept in. And there was a marvelous rain shower in the room. Decor is recently updated and the whole facility is in good repair. Portions in the café are large, and the weight staff is friendly. Check-in is simple and well organized.  All in all, a very good experience.

reviews.author: Míriam
reviews.title: Girls birthday celebration
reviews.body: We arrived and the valet was prompt and courteous. Front desk attendant was knowledgeable on the area and explained all of the hotels perks. Bartender Rooster was the Apex bartender with the skills.

reviews.author: Dee T
reviews.title: Excellent stay for my work conference
reviews.body: Everything from check-in to check-out was smooth.  The room and overall hotel were very clean.  Rooftop pool was nice, as was the lobby restaurant.  Enjoyed the complimentary morning coffee/tea bar, and the friendly staff.  Super close to the night life of Gaslamp made it easy to experience.

reviews.author: 3for4
reviews.title: More pluses than minuses
reviews.body: I was a guest for four days and four nights. My highlight was the free use of a bicycle to tour around and ride to an Italian dinner in Little Italy. My bed was very comfortable, the high ceilings spacious with plenty of room for my needs. I enjoyed the open spacious shower and marble tiled walls and sink. The towels were generous and absorbent. The doors are solid. The downside was awakening to the loud sound of doors closing in the hallway at 4:30 AM as guests were leaving for the airport.

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Not up to standards
reviews.body: Staff was unfriendly.  Room was not ready until 6pm.  The room amenities were not comfortable or relaxing.

reviews.author: Leonard
reviews.title: Decent stay with some drawbacks
reviews.body: The hotel atmosphere is sophisticated and chill. The "desk" in my room was woefully small though.  Also, was not thrilled about the $35 fee that covered $20 in daily food.  Seems like a cash grab.  However, the food in the hotel was slightly above avg in quality, though was a bit overpriced.  Also, my Hawaiian pizza was covered in enough onions to make me sick when I never asked for onions.  Finally, what's the deal with bums all over the hotel front area?

reviews.author: Livingwatersam
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: I’m a bit of a hotel knob and I highly recommend staying here. Great location in the gaslamp corner is super walkable to the trolley and downtown. The hotel is clean, aesthetically pleasing, and has great amenities. The staff is wonderful and the customer service is excellent.

reviews.author: ChrisW0011
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: The hotel was clean and well kept. The staff was amazing. Overall great experience.

reviews.author: Tiara
reviews.title: So close to high quality
reviews.body: The hotel is beautiful and the staff was friendly. My complaints are that the pool is not heated. It was 87° and the pool umbrellas were zip tied shut so there was no shade. The café food is overpriced and bland $24 for an unseasoned breakfast burrito or sandwich is insane. The staff is not knowledgeable when it comes to food, allergies. I booked a spa suite specifically the room had an additional half bath, but there was no towel towels or towel rack. The sofa was stained, and there were layers of dirt underneath the balcony was dirty, and the trolley sounds kept us awake. and there were no makeup wipes in the bathroom and there was no tea in the room at the coffee bar experiment. I also found a very difficult to book the specific room because they appear to have 39 different room types and I specifically wanted a room with a tub..

reviews.author: Llittenb
reviews.title: Best Hotel stay in San Diego!
reviews.body: The room was spacious, beds were super plush and comfortable, and most importantly the staff was extraordinarily friendly and accommodating! My new go to for San Diego!

reviews.author: Goodfriend99
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body: Room was bare bones, aging, and in disrepair. Staff was nice and restaurant was decent, but the room combined the extremely expensive parking when added to the room rate and resort fee killed the value proposition for me.

reviews.author: D Ram
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: All staff was great, room/building was clean and comfortable. Great location.

reviews.author: Hugh
reviews.title: Great location of Alma San Diego Downtown
reviews.body: Alma San Diego Downtown is conveniently located near many of the city's top attractions, including museums, the convention center, and other popular destinations. In addition, the spacious and luxurious bathroom is very impressive.

reviews.author: LBJ
reviews.title: Perfect Place & Perfect Location
reviews.body: I'm so happy I selected this hotel. The Courtyard did not disappoint. From the moment I called before my arrival, they handled me with white gloves. The hotel is a national registry and deserves the honor. It is well-kept, clean, and beautiful. The staff is amazing, especially Daniel. His smile is contagious and he is so friendly and helpful. Even when a mistake was made, he was quick to take ownership and make sure things were corrected. The area is amazing. Nightly is a vibe! Plenty of restaurants and bars.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body:
Loved the location of the property and its architecture. 
There were a few things that I did not like about the property. First and foremost the attitude of the lady at the reception was not at all welcoming. Not at all what one would expect from Marriot reception. We had made a booking through booking.com for 5 people. However, the room allocated did not had the capacity to sleep 5 people as there were only two twin beds with no room for an additional bed. Upon raising this issue to to the front desk I was simply told with a dismissive attitude that this was the only room available and I had to manage

reviews.author: Renee W
reviews.title: Beautiful historic hotel
reviews.body: Perfect location that was close to a public parking garage.  Nice views of the city.  Beautiful lobby and comfy rooms.  Great bar with friendly bartender who provided recommendations of local places to eat and see.  The front desk was also helpful and knowledgeable.  It's exactly what you'd expect of the "old" style of Marriott hospitality!  It was refreshing to experience again!

reviews.author: Applesque
reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.body: I think the valet needs to be more accommodating to people who need to load or unload while checking in or out. It seems like such a hassle. For a hotel that doesn't have any parking whatsoever it's the least you guys could do. Other than that, my stay every time is very nice.

reviews.author: KS
reviews.title: A pleasant stay
reviews.body: The hotel is beautiful and the staff is so nice and attentive at all times.

reviews.author: gb business traveler
reviews.title: Good location. OK room.  The rest is below average
reviews.body: Good location. OK room.  The rest is below average.  WIFI was OK.  Fitness center OK.  Restaurant, bar, coffee and vibe in the lobby area were less than OK.  Parking is excessively expensive.

reviews.author: read first
reviews.title: Great hotel, not so great area
reviews.body: Hotel was very clean, lavish and well kept. Area around hotel not great. No pool was only complaint

reviews.author: JLNYC
reviews.title: Very nice hotel in ok neighborhood
reviews.body: The hotel in an old bank is very comfortable and has a lot of interesting art deco details. The room was very large, very clean and very quiet. But be aware that the hotel is a bit of a walk from the Santa Fe Depot and the water. It is very close to the Gas Lamp District and its restaurants.

reviews.author: KRoberts
reviews.title: Not Satisfied
reviews.body: I had a terrible experience at this Marriott. I chose this hotel to relax after moving my kids into SDSU, but it turned into a huge disappointment. The lobby restaurant was completely unsanitary—gnats and bugs were flying around the entire time, and I even found a bug in my drink that the waiter had to take away. After eating there, I ended up with severe stomach issues that lasted well beyond my stay. I was especially disappointed in Marriott given the expected quality of food and standards, which were clearly not met. To make matters worse, my “non-smoking” room reeked of smoke. This was unacceptable from start to finish. I would not recommend staying here.

reviews.author: 3mil1a
reviews.title: A place to QUICKLY rest ur head
reviews.body: This place looks cute but our view sucked. The bed wasn’t comfortable and there was only one mirror in the bathroom.

reviews.author: AW
reviews.title: Lack of Service, Dark, and Dingy.
reviews.body: Valet was not helpful with luggage.  No bell service.  Hotel was dark and dingy.  Room was clean.

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.title: Marriott
reviews.body: Room was nice but it had a smell. Very strong smell.

reviews.author: Annie
reviews.title: Would not return
reviews.body: I stayed here with my son for one night in August 2026. I would not recommend, the area is extremely unsafe, from the moment you step outside. Staff was not friendly and I did not feel valued as a gold member. The bar staff in the evening was not friendly. I travel very very often and stay at mariott and other chains alot.

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.title: Understaffed and poor handling of guest satisfaction
reviews.body: Family of 5, stayed in a 2 queen. My husband and I woke to the sound of constant dripping and the children were beginning to stir as well. We called the front desk to inform them what was going on. They told us they were sending up security to check on us. A few minutes passed and he arrived with a bucket. He stated that there was no current facilities manager on site and will have to stay in our current room until morning because all other rooms have been booked but that our night will be comped for the inconvenience. He left and said he would be back with another bucket because there were two locations that the AC was leaking from. At that moment we were unsure what to do, there was no way we were all going to get a good nights rest. Almost 20 minutes passed with no one coming with another bucket, so we called the front desk again. They informed us that they were trying to move us to another room but that it had smaller accommodations with just 1 king and a pull out. We asked if it could fit a pull out bed in the room as well but said there were no more available. Since we had one in our original room we asked if we can take this one there and they agreed. So we ended up waking our children and moved all our belongings to the new room and did not get situated until past 2 am because the children were shaken up by what was going on. We had to wait for more sheets because the pull out didn’t have any. By now we were beyond exhausted so naturally we had a very late start to the next day, which was our scheduled day at Legoland. Our main reason for coming to San Diego was to take the children to Legoland and it was cut short because of what happened. They weren’t tickets that can be adjusted to a different day, they were prepurchased tickets that had to be used the day we selected. This incident ended up snowballing into a huge inconvenience. It was incredibly uncomfortable in the new room, drains were slow, no where to place anything because the beds were cramped together and hearing the elevator every time someone went in or out. My husband and I ended up deciding it would be best to just go home. Staying another night would just be too stressful on both us and our children. The next morning we checked out and were told that we could not get the charge of that night removed because the manager was not on site to override. 3 days still no response and after receiving my statement, charged my card the rollaway they forgot to include when we checked out.

reviews.author: Angel
reviews.title: Beautiful but lacking
reviews.body: No luggage carts, no roll away beds, not an ideal night.

reviews.author: Jazz
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.body: Everyone was nice and polite and very knowledgeable of the area

reviews.author: Bobby
reviews.title: Must stay
reviews.body: A stay in a historic unique building with a great service and a awesome staff every member of the staff I interacted with was extremely friendly, helpful, and courteous couldnt ask for a better place to call home for 5 days

reviews.author: Dissapointed
reviews.title: Disrepair promises not kept
reviews.body: Tweekers and homeless everywhere room in disrepair the dresser drawer kept rolling out my wife bruised her leg on it we had to prop something against it to keep it safe,The phones wouldn't work they were broken if we needed anything we had to go down to lobby to request extra towels ,I was told being an executive elite to expect big upgrades that never happened when I asked they made me feel like I was begging even though I had recieved an email stating to expect an upgrade when we arrivso disappointed I'll never stay there again I Expected much better from Marriot.

reviews.author: trickeedickee
reviews.title: I recommend!
reviews.body: Great place. Great location. Good food. Better bar!

reviews.author: Rob
reviews.title: Leaking ceiling
reviews.body: Upon arrival i was givem a room. After i asked about a roll away bed, Olivia at reception helped me by switching me to another room that would accommodate that bed. I had an issue with the ceiling leaking in my bathroom. Not the most pleasant thing to come back to. Esme at reception was very nice and changed me to another room.

reviews.author: Bajan traveller
reviews.title: A great comfortable stay
reviews.body: I was in SD for a convention, and had a pleasant and comfortable stay. The room was surprisingly spacious with large windows offering great city views, and the location put plenty of dining options right within easy walking distance.

reviews.author: Texas visitors
reviews.title: Historical Marriott
reviews.body: Excellent Marriott in historical building. Excellent staff and clean rooms.

reviews.author: mnc
reviews.title: Great stay, clean room
reviews.body: Very happy with my recent stay for a concert. Room was clean, really cool historical place. Air conditioning worked great. Bed was on the firm side and not the most comfy for us but we are used to our soft, fluffy bed. We ordered extra pillows and made it work.

reviews.author: ALCO14
reviews.title: The nicest Courtyard on the Planet
reviews.body: The building is from 1928 and is Gorgeous the rooms are bid and have lovely windows in them.  Such a find!

reviews.author: Great Hotel
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: My wife and I stayed at this Marriott on our visit to San Diego. The hotel is in an old bank and is very interesting. We stayed in a 2 room suite which was very roomy and laid out very well. The hotel was spotless and in a good location for touring the city. There is a restaurant/bar on site offering a limited food menu. The head of housekeeping a woman named Lisa is unbelievable and goes out of her way to make guest happy. There are also numerous restaurants and convenience stores within walking distance. I would recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Underwhelmed
reviews.title: Nice hotel, stuffy feel, little customer service
reviews.body: Hotel looks beautiful and rooms are nice but customer service is lacking. I would say 25% of staff gave the experience you would expect in a hotel like this.

reviews.author: JPL
reviews.title: Marriott - please help make San Diego better
reviews.body: The hotel and staff were great.  The location is perfect.  But until local businesses force the city leaders of San Diego to handle the homeless problem, we'll never stay in this hotel again.  I did not appreciate violent homeless people accosting my wife.

reviews.author: Miss Smith
reviews.title: A Beautifully Updated Classic Hotel
reviews.body: This is in the higher end of the Courtyard hotels I've stayed at.  I'm in to architecture and this location has it all.  The rooms were fresh and tastefully decorated.  The service was great. It has a nice restaurant and bar area though we did not get a chance to dine there.  The only downside is the $70 valet parking fee.

reviews.author: AV Network Guy
reviews.title: AMAZING service, but rooms from the past
reviews.body: I will be back in Downtown San Diego, but will try another hotel due to the lighting conditions in the room and bathroom. For the price, I could've gotten a much better room. I paid more for this location and got less, but the staff was AMAZING!

reviews.author: GuyWhoLovesHotels
reviews.title: This place is awesome!
reviews.body: This hotel is fabulous. It looks fancy enough that stepping inside for the first time (and also subsequent times, I promise the magic lingers) provides an almost cinematic experience. The staff at the front were all such amazing human beings and their loveliness only enhanced the magical day I was already having. The room I stayed in was so nice and tidy and had a fantastic view. My room also happened to be right across from a vending machine so, as an avid Mountain Dew drinker, I didn't need to leave the building or even the floor I was on to get my daily Dew! The location of the hotel is wonderful as it's not only on the same block as a fantastic concert venue but it's adjacent to so many quick and easy food options. In summary, this is an exquisite place that I would highly recommend staying at.

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: Best team on west coast!!!!

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.title: Excellent hideaway in the middle of the city
reviews.body: This property seems hidden in the middle of the city tucked in the old Horton. The separation makes it more relaxing. It is very well maintained and clean. The staff was very friendly and accommodating.

reviews.author: Anon 2026
reviews.title: Excellent stay in San Diego
reviews.body: Top quality hotel with fabulous and friendly staff

reviews.author: Not good 956
reviews.title: Don’t communicate
reviews.body: Clean hotel but do not communicate well, they don’t explain what they are charging you for. I feel scammed.

reviews.author: Abc123
reviews.title: Happy day
reviews.body: Hotels really nice just the room is a little small clean enough to us after a big concert

reviews.author: Natasha
reviews.title: My stay before taking flight
reviews.body:
Had a great stay at the Westin Gaslamp! First, shoutout to Maddy at the front desk, who was absolutely amazing. She was friendly, informative, attentive, and made sure I had everything I needed. Give Maddy a raise because customer service like that is becoming an endangered species. 😂

The room was clean, the bed was super cozy, and overall the hotel was comfortable and well maintained.

The $30 resort fee actually comes with some nice perks, including activities like kayaking, yoga, harbor cruise tickets, plus two drink tickets for house wine or beer. So at least when they take your $30, they soften the blow with alcohol and activities. I respect it. 😂

Valet service was good, but here’s my warning: once you valet that car, consider it emotionally unavailable for the remainder of your stay. If you plan on going back and forth around San Diego, Uber or Lyft will probably become your new best friend.

Overall, I really enjoyed my stay. Great location, comfortable rooms, excellent service, and enough resort-fee perks to make me complain slightly less about paying a resort fee. 😂

Would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: Vince915
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.body: Clean and nice stay the place is all you can ask for

reviews.author: Hunter
reviews.title: My Stay at the San Diego Westin Gasslamp Quarters
reviews.body: I had the pleasue of spending 8 days and 7 nights at the Westin. The sercie I got from staff members was amazing! I even remember the names of the staff. That's unusual for me! The information and the knowledge of the concierge was amazing and made my experience wonderful. I definitely will consider staying at the Weston again for future visits to San Diego!

reviews.author: Larry
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: FIVE-STAR HOTEL. i LOVE THE BEDS THEY WERE SOFT AND breakfast buffet was great

reviews.author: Amy R
reviews.title: Excellent Stay in San Diego
reviews.body:
The hotel is polished and clean and is in a prime location walkable to lots of restaurants in the Gaslamp. As someone who travels a lot for work, I always appreciate a warm welcome from staff and check-in accommodations. Getting into my room early made a huge difference for my ability to be comfortable as I started a day of meetings and events. The only thing missing to knock this out of the park is a Club Lounge.

Valet is pricey but there is a public parking lot 1/2 a block away with an overnight parking option for $40.

While there is a resort fee, there are nice amenities that come with it - from drink vouchers for the bar, and a modest food/beverage credit that I used to pick up some snacks. You can also get boat tour tickets and more at concierge.

reviews.author: Kim R
reviews.title: Disappointed deeply
reviews.body: First time staying at a Westin and last. Vallet staff was not ready upon arrival. No bell boy helped with our luggage. Front desk seemed scrambled. Unfortunately the concierge was also severely unkoledganle about toom amenities when called such as not knowing what face wipes were. The room was not stocked adequately with robes towels nor.slippers. usually you can atleast count as enough for two guests. Very sad

reviews.author: Harithra N
reviews.title: A Pleasant and Well-Arranged Stay
reviews.body:
The stay was very pleasant and nicely arranged. The room had everything needed for a comfortable stay. I really appreciated the complimentary water bottles and the lavender sleep balm, which was a thoughtful touch.

The room was clean and neat, and the lighting was very nice. The staff were friendly and helpful throughout the stay. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Laurenator
reviews.title: If you need a good rest, the Westin is best!
reviews.body: I am from San Diego, and have stayed in many hotels around the city. This was my first time staying at the Westin Gaslamp and I have to say, I was so pleasantly surprised that I will definitely choose to stay here again. Every aspect was fantastic. Check in was so easy and the person helping us was genuinely kind and efficient. The room had a fantastic view of the city and was impeccably clean. There is a daily fee that includes basic amenities like use of the fitness center, internet, etc. However, the Westin goes a step beyond and includes a complimentary activity for each night you stay. The options were great: free drinks at the bar, bicycle rentals, a harbor boat tour, and (our choice) kayak or paddle board rentals for two. All that being said, I think the best part of our stay was how amazingly comfortable the bed was. I have chronic back pain, and have never been as comfortable as I was during this stay. I slept through the night and had zero aches in the morning. Whatever mattress is used in this hotel is 100/10. Thank you for a great, restful recharge. I only wish I had stayed more than one night!!

reviews.title: 샌디에고 다운타운에서의 좋은 기억
reviews.body: 직원분들이 모두 친절 했으며, 특히 bar 에서의 친근한 응대는 기억에 남습니다. 룸 컨디션도 깨끗해서 부족함이 없었습니다.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body: GM MR FORD is a credit to your company, YNWA

reviews.author: Meeka Seymore
reviews.title: Exceptional!
reviews.body: The best hotel I ever visited!

reviews.author: Carolina
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Perfect location, beautiful place, great service

reviews.author: Susan C
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay – Amazing Room and Birthday Surprise!
reviews.body:
We had a wonderful stay at The Westin San Diego Gaslamp Quarter on August 1–2. Room 1622 was awesome—very spacious with a beautiful vaulted ceiling, and we were really happy with our choice to upgrade.

A special thank you to Rose at the front desk, who was an absolute delight and made us feel so welcome. Also, thank you to Kayl at the concierge for arranging the wonderful birthday surprise for my husband—champagne, snacks, and balloons waiting in the room! It was such a nice surprise and made his birthday extra special. Thank you also to Sabrina, the manager, who helped me with the guaranteed suite upgrade. It ended up being a great choice!

My only disappointment was that the paid suite upgrade was added as a room charge (including additional tax), but I did not receive Titanium/Bonvoy points for that amount. Since I paid the hotel directly for the upgrade and it was part of my room charges, I really feel that spending should count toward my Bonvoy points/benefits. That was frustrating, especially as a Titanium member.

Otherwise, everything was great. They also accommodated us with a rollaway bed, the location was perfect for walking around the Gaslamp, and breakfast was excellent—so much food! All of the staff we interacted with were friendly and helpful.

Overall, a wonderful stay and a great birthday weekend. Thank you to Rose, Kayl, Sabrina, and the entire Westin Gaslamp team for making it special!

reviews.author: Pulkit
reviews.title: Brilliant Westin
reviews.body:
It is a brilliant property ! Great location atmosphere service comfort .
Perhaps better than most Westin Europe properties !!

reviews.author: octraveler
reviews.title: Needs improvement
reviews.body: we have been staying at this location over the years regularly as we visit family often. We are usually very satisfied with the value cleanliness and service but this time we were disappointed in our particular room. The restroom was in terrible shape. The wallpaper was dirty. There was great damage to the drywall where the toilet paper holder was, there were black areas on the grout on the floor and in the shower. We used Hotwire service to book this time around and I wonder if that had something to do with the room we were assigned. Overall, it was disappointing.

reviews.author: AcceleRise2026 attendee
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: I attended a conference in August of 2026 and it was a great experience. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jose
reviews.title: Golf weekend
reviews.body: Stayed here with a bunch of friends for a golf weekend, place was very accommodating and the staff was exceptional!

reviews.author: Giants Fan
reviews.title: Giants game
reviews.body: We went to the Giants game which was a 15-20 walk to Petco park

reviews.author: Natasha
reviews.title: Great Staff!
reviews.body: Was really impressed with the staff here, especially the front desk. We were staying during Comic Con weekend and thought they would be overwhelmed but they couldn't be more helpful and accommodating! Enrique at the front desk even heated up our left overs really late at night which made my heart melt! Rooms were fine and clean but service was top notch!

reviews.author: AlfonsoM
reviews.title: Always a great stay, we love it here
reviews.body: this is the 2nd time we've stayed at the Westin. we love it. we always try to get our hotel stay here during Comic-Con. The rooms are large, always clean when we arrive. The staff is always friendly, the food at the bronze bird is always good.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Don’t upgrade your room!
reviews.body:
Be cautious when accepting room upgrades. The pricing was not explained clearly, and what was verbally communicated did not match the final charges. Even after asking for confirmation of the cost, the actual amount ended up being significantly higher than expected because it was charged on a different basis than what was understood.

Although the details may have been included in the paperwork, they were never clearly explained during the conversation. Pricing should be communicated openly and transparently, not left to fine print. A clear explanation upfront would have prevented a very disappointing experience.

reviews.author: Ryan
reviews.title: Nice, but...
reviews.body:
The Westin Gaslamp Quarter in San Diego is a nice property that has seen tasteful updates throughout. Unfortunately, there were two items that fell far short of what one would expect from a Westin property; motion activated A/C and the valet service.

The first and larger of the two issues, was that the west facing rooms become unbearably warm throughout the heat of the day due to motion-activated A/C. Only making it back to the room an hour before going to bed means that a comfortable sleeping temperature cannot be achieved in that short amount of time. Front desk attempted to change it to VIP mode but the resolution did not seem to commit in their system and I was unable to sleep more than a couple restless hours each night because of the heat. 

Valet service was the other issue; at a cost of $60/day they politely declined retrieving my car when I needed to get some items from it, instead insisting that they would rather get it themselves. Valet is mandatory for this property in a private garage and therefore access to your vehicle during your stay is off-limits unless valet brings it up from the garage which they weren't keen on doing for me. 

The property itself is beautiful, well kept, and in a great location that is walkable to most all you could want to do in San Diego. Ultimately, I will not be returning to or recommend this property because of the aforementioned items.

reviews.author: Suzy
reviews.title: Perfect place to stay in San Diego
reviews.body: Everything perfect, prefect for couples

reviews.author: Kesha
reviews.title: Best Birthday Getaway
reviews.body:
We had such an amazing experience at The Westin San Diego Gaslamp Quarter! From the moment we arrived, the staff went above and beyond to make our stay special.

We were also celebrating my husband’s birthday, and the hotel surprised us with champagne and the cutest little Happy Birthday sign waiting for us in our room. It was such a thoughtful touch and truly made our celebration even more special. 

The hospitality, attention to detail, and kindness of the staff really stood out. This was our first time visiting San Diego, and we couldn’t have asked for a better hotel experience. We will absolutely be back and highly recommend The Westin San Diego Gaslamp Quarter!

reviews.author: Denise and Genevieve
reviews.title: Moxy Made Our Pierce the Veil Trip Unforgettable!
reviews.body:
From the moment we walked into Moxy in the Gaslamp district downtown San Diego until the moment we departed, we experienced WORLD-CLASS SERVICE!

We stayed at Moxy for a Pierce the Veil concert, and the hotel was the perfect home base for our trip. The location was fantastic, the hotel has such a fun and modern vibe, and the atmosphere was lively and welcoming without feeling overwhelming.

A very special shout-out to Tori, who truly went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. She was kind, attentive, and genuinely interested in getting to know us. She even remembered details about my daughter and me and asked about plans we had during our stay. The fact that she remembered those little details while accommodating so many guests really says something about how genuinely she cares about the people staying there.

What really made Moxy special was the people. Everyone we encountered was warm, welcoming, and helpful, but Tori especially made us feel like more than just guests.

We absolutely loved our stay and would 100% stay at Moxy San Diego Downtown again! Thank you to Tori, Leon and the entire Moxy team for making our Pierce the Veil weekend so wonderful and memorable! ❤️

reviews.author: 805local
reviews.title: Great choice for couples/solo travelers!
reviews.body: The staff was beyond welcoming and friendly; we felt like we were talking to a long time friend and we had only just met! Staff like this is what makes us want to come back! The room was the perfect size, it is straight to the point and the bathroom has very nice lighting and vanity. We had attended a concert at Petco Park (within a 15 minute walking distance) and upon returning, we had refreshing drinks at the bar and were able to order food which was a major plus! We hope to return soon!

reviews.author: A Bass
reviews.title: This place is a for sure for the future!
reviews.body:
Absolutely amazing on every single level. The atmosphere at the bar in the lobby, the liveliness of it, the feeling of being welcomed by the bartenders, the open windows for a fun view of the street, the live music; it all makes for a fun experience. 
The rooms are cute, clean and simple with a large bathroom; perfect for our stay. 
This will definitely be where we book when staying in San Diego from now on; the location is so ideal and everything they had offer made our time there amazing (including their speakeasy!) 
Check this place, you won't regret it.

reviews.author: Suleen
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.body: This location is in the heart of downtown San Diego. You can walk to everywhere. The hotel itself had a fun vibe with lots of board games, shuffle board and DJ on the weekend. You’ll never be bored here. They also had an amazing speakeasy bar called room 56, very cozy atmosphere and amazing drinks. The room itself was super clean, spacious for 2 people and the bed was very comfortable.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Great stay and vibes
reviews.body: I’ve been to other Moxy locations which were great but the San Diego location was phenomenal.

reviews.author: Seesoto
reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.body: One of the best experiences at a moxy to date. There are things that can’t be quantified. The level of hospitality exceeded my expectation and the ability to anticipate what I needed. Late check out, easy check in, empathy for a situation the team had no fault in. The bar tenders were so helpful… the entire staff was. You need to show them this review and let them know they made a huge impact on my stay and turned and sour trip back to being fun.

reviews.author: SDFHDLF
reviews.title: Staff were immensely rude
reviews.body: I had so many issues with this hotel. The valet was impossible to figure out. The email did not include any instructions about where to park for valet and when we arrived, there was still no clear information. We ended up using public parking a few blocks down instead. When we went to check in, it took very long for a staff member to get to us and when they did, they were extremely rude. I was expected to have a Marriott Bonvoy account, which I did not have and the staff were also acting like I was not allowed to even stay in the hotel because I was under 21. I am 19 and my boyfriend is 21 and I called ahead to ensure there would be no problems. The staff were baffled that I was under 21 and very sternly told us that they were "not going to kick us out" but we couldn't be downstairs near the bar which we were not planning on anyway. The room was extremely small and we were surprised to not see a fridge or even a small desk/table. In the morning, I called down to notify staff of our check out and the staff member on the phone said "....uh okay? you can just come down and drop the keys off." and they proceeded to hang up on me before I asked further questions. When I went to drop the keys off, the same staff member from the phone helped us and he told me that he thought it was funny that I called down and mocked me. Would not recommend staying here in the slightest.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.title: Fun trip
reviews.body: Very cute hotel close to everything

reviews.author: Chris Hollingworth
reviews.title: Beyond our expectations!
reviews.body: We had an amazing stay! Tori went above and beyond to make sure our birthday trip was a memorable one, including birthday treats in the room, custom room keys with our picture, and even a wand for my wife! She is an incredible manager, and we can't give her high enough praise!

reviews.author: Unhappy Member
