reviews.body:
Bad service rooms small
No hand soap in bathroom 
Bartender rude 
Takes to long for valet to get car 

Bright point is the speakeasy

reviews.author: Snoots
reviews.title: Check your bill
reviews.body: Check your bill before you leave. I have multiple mistakes on mine and it is very difficult to talk to anyone at the hotel to get it fixed.

reviews.author: Vibes and all
reviews.title: Best location and vibes
reviews.body:
I had a great stay at the Moxy San Diego! The location in the Gaslamp Quarter was perfect I could easily walk to restaurants, nightlife, and everything I wanted to explore. My room was beautifully decorated, stylish, and had everything I needed for my stay. I also loved the fun, energetic vibe of the hotel.

And the hidden speakeasy, Room 56, was such a cute surprise and definitely added to the experience! 🍸

Great location, great vibe, and a perfect home base for exploring San Diego. I would absolutely stay here again!

reviews.author: Eddie
reviews.title: Stay at the Moxy
reviews.body: Don't recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Mike Bonvoy
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Gaslamp
reviews.body: Clean, fun, and modern.  I’ll come back for sure.

reviews.author: Charles
reviews.title: Great location. Fun place
reviews.body:
Efficient rooms are fairly small but very adequate for my needs, beautifully decorated with a really cool speakeasy. The bar and lounge are just outstanding, with cool games and shuffleboard, a great bartender (Joey), and a great vibe. Smack in the middle of the Gaslamp District, where all of the energy of the city resonates. - Walks to:
- Great dining options
- Bars
- Beach
- Train

reviews.author: CRajah2
reviews.title: Esri UC 2026 July
reviews.body: Great location for the event and for socializing in the evenings.  Staff were great, food was great. Had a great experience overall

reviews.author: Yasmeen
reviews.title: Such a cool vibe!
reviews.body: I’ve always wanted to stay at the Moxy and it did not disappoint! Super friendly staff, loved the vibes, was very clean with comfortable beds, and I worked comfortably (and watched World Cup games) in the lobby. It’s not really a place for families, but was a fantastic place to stay for solo travelers, especially if you want to make friends. They create ample opportunity to connect with others in right in the lobby (like table soccer!). I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Katiethegoose
reviews.title: exceptional experience
reviews.body: The staff were super fun, the welcome drink was a perfect touch, the food was good- I especially enjoyed the "my girlfriend isn't that hungry" option on the menu. Trivia night was a great option and the fact that the staff went above and beyond to make sure I was having a good stay- the chef even made a chicken caesar salad for me after she already closed down the kitchen! I love staying Marriott because I know what I can expect- but this particular hotel and staff were next level with the service and kindness.

reviews.author: TJ
reviews.title: Can't Wait To Return
reviews.body: We had a blast at the Moxy! There were so many games to play and had an delicious drinks at Room 56. The staff was so friendly, we told all our friends to go there.

reviews.author: Delilah K
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel in a great location
reviews.body: The Moxy is perfectly situated in the heart of the city.  The staff from the valet, front desk staff and guest services staff were all pleasant and welcoming!

reviews.author: Owen9608
reviews.title: 1st Time In San Diego
reviews.body:
Pros: This is a good location if you want to do things in downtown San Diego. Very walkable. Cool hipster concept with good aesthetics. 

Con: Parking was expensive or hard to find. Rooms were small with no microwave or refrigerator. I don’t really think it was worth the cost. 

Overall: Stayed here for a family vacation. Good hotel but I would not suggest this location to those visiting with family. I would stay here again but under different circumstances.

reviews.author: Alejandro
reviews.title: Fun times
reviews.body: I would definitely recommend this place

reviews.author: ConferenceGuest
reviews.title: Party Hotel, Not Work Hotel
reviews.body: Social atmosphere, booming music. Small, dark rooms are not equipped for a business stay.

reviews.author: Marc E
reviews.title: My stay during marathon
reviews.body: Aces in my book, very cool vibe

reviews.author: SV
reviews.title: Cheap, But Cheap Finishes and No Amenities
reviews.body: The price is very reasonable for the area, but the finishes are so cheap. Flat sink and shower don't drain. No hand lotion or room safe. No closet, just hooks and a couple hangers over the TV. No desk to work at. The A/C is great, but loud. It clicks on and wakes you up. The rooms aren't very well cleaned or maintained. It's basically a small step up from a hostel. I would pay more for some nicer amenities.

reviews.author: Just Passing Thru
reviews.title: You get what you pay for
reviews.body:
The hotel is very vibey.. great music.  Valet staff was amazingly attentive and professional. Unfortunately, cannot say the same thing about rest of the staff.  Checking in, the staff member who attended me was very dismissive & at first treated me as if he was bothered or having a bad day. Eventually, his demeanor changed and acted a bit more courteous.  That night, I had called and asked for a late checkout, to which the staff member was very accommodating. Unfortunately, at 11 am the housekeeping staff member was pounding on my door.  I tried to explain to her that I had called and asked for a late check out. Instead of saying "oh okay let me double check, thank you for letting me know", instead she gave me attitude and told me that my room number was not flagged for a late check out adhd I needed to pack by stuff and get out.  Immediately I said No,  you need to chicle check with the front desk.  Again, unprofessional and rude she told me, "You are not on the list, so please get out". I was not about to go back and forth with her, especially if she was being so rude. I told her, please just double check.  She interrupted me and said "we'll see about that" and walked away.  
I ended up calling downstairs and advised them of what had happened. They apologized and confirmed my late check out. I will never understand why someone who chooses to work in service by their own free will, feels like they can be disgustingly rude to a guest, simply because they either hate their job or are having a bad day.  Its not the guest's fault that they are unhappy with their life choices & circumstances.

reviews.author: WorldTraveler336699
reviews.title: Hi hopes, but fell short.
reviews.body: Unfortunately we were given a room with lots of maintenance  issues, which put a huge damper on our stay. The shower leaked and we had to use all the towels to stop it from going to the hallway. The toilet seat was broken. When we tried to report the issues and ask for more towels to take a shower, the phone was broken, so we had to walk all the way down to the front desk. There was also a rubber chew toy left under the bed that I stubbed my toe on. Not the best time to say the least on our first visit to the Moxy.

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.title: Great Vibes
reviews.body: This hotel has it all.  Great bar, barista to make your fave latte, speak easy, jenga, video games fun music and great staff!  Wendy is awesome!

reviews.author: Panchito V JR
reviews.title: Staff is Superb!
reviews.body:
I was blown away by the staff at The Moxy. They got me in my room early; they got me lotion when I needed it; they filled my water bottle with soda water and lemon wedges every time I asked; they let me print some documents I needed for my conference presentation for free, and they literally did it with a smile on every face! 

And the bonus was karaoke night while I was there! I crushed it with my go-to song!

Highly recommend going to The Moxy especially if you are a solo business traveler!

reviews.author: Dee
reviews.title: Not recommended for business trip/conference
reviews.body:
Location - downtown San Diego, surrounded by homeless people, tents and odorous air. 
Amenities - Rusted pipes in the restroom. No bottled water, desk/table in the room. Extremely tiny space. 
Cleanness -  Stains on iron board. Sticky thing on window inside.

reviews.author: Miss Jones
reviews.title: Small Rooms
reviews.body: The stay was ok but everything else was off the rooms are small parking is to expensive and the breakfast was low budget and the loud music all night and morning

reviews.author: Nadia Osmani
reviews.title: Average
reviews.body: Average hotel, outdated no restaurant

reviews.author: Old Pete
reviews.title: one safety concern
reviews.body: shower was extremely slippery need safety strips or rubber mat dangerous for seniors or person with balance difficulties

reviews.author: Marriott App
reviews.title: Great stay, professional. warstaff
reviews.body: Great stay, polite, warm, and welcoming staff.

reviews.author: C
reviews.title: Unkept and unwilling to help
reviews.body: Our toilet didn’t work the entire stay when we informed them the first night they said somebody would be able to take a look that took about an hour. He brought a plunger that he claimed was for the entire floor. He plunged the toilet for about 20 minutes and it still wasn’t flushing he left the plunger with us. We had to use this every time we went to the bathroom then for breakfast the next morning there was a foul smell of a sewage and flies everywhere. We went to sit down those pet hair on the dining chairs. When we informed them on our check out they didn’t seem bad about an eye, but tell us that they would take a look before the next guest.

reviews.author: Houston2Crew
reviews.title: Small room, and loud as can be
reviews.body:
If you want an uncomfortable bed, incredibly small room, right above the club, with a rude staff, stay here. This was not a cheap hotel
Night, but we stayed here after a baseball
Game. And we couldn’t believe the rudeness of the staff, the room was incredibly small- like just enough room to walk around the bed, and the noise felt like we were at the club. It was so loud, even with the white noise machine provided by the hotel, it was still so loud. The bed was awful, sleep was terrible. We couldn’t wait to leave.

reviews.author: IvebeenBinvoyed
reviews.title: Poor Service at AC Hitel Gaslamp
reviews.body: Indifferent staff, dirty room, no attempt to make up for service deficiencies

reviews.author: Saturday night stay
reviews.title: Cool stay
reviews.body: The stay was cool but there was a lot of homeless people outside the hotel so be careful

reviews.author: Ray
reviews.title: I will come back to gaslamp just to stay here
reviews.body: Overall, this was an amazing hotel location distance from restaurants and entertainment venues. it was definitely a great visit. I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Traveling Hygienist
reviews.title: Padres stay
reviews.body: Right in the heart of gaslamp! Loved that. Great location for restaurants everywhere walking distance in downtown. We ubered to outer areas. We walked to the Padres game, can stop at a bar along the walk. Open front lobby is so nice to sit in and see the outdoors. Room clean, beds comfy. AC controller was tricky to use when changing the temp setting. Housekeeping sets it too cold for me. But it was nice to walk into a cool room after a long hot August day in San Diego. No room view for us other than the building side but we didn't care. Hotel is up to date and nice. Didn't use parking because we flew in and  walked or Ubered as needed. Ubers are easy to get. We would stay again. For quick eat, try the taco place just at the corner from hotel.

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.title: Late checkout process is counterintuitive
reviews.body: Most hotel policies ask that you request a late checkout the day/night before checkout. Not here, you have to wake up and call at 8am the morning of to ask if you can push your checkout time back. If you’d like to sleep in and get some extra rest before travel, DO NOT STAY HERE

reviews.author: DR C
reviews.title: Exceptional Service!
reviews.body: Exceptional Service From The Front Desk Bobby and Chris They Made Me and My Husband Feel Valued A Priority and We Mattered Everyday. You Don't See This Caliber Of Customer Service To Often Anymore. It's What Seperates The Hotel Industry Since They All Sell Rooms.  Thank You  Bobby and Chris

reviews.author: SteveG
reviews.title: Enjoyable, but....
reviews.body:
We went for an easy vacation and liked being in the heart of the Gaslamp Quarter.
All went well and we had no issues, BUT the exorbitant price for parking was obscene.
During SDCC I stayed at a hotel closer to the Convention Center that charged half what the AC did for parking.

reviews.author: Phil
reviews.title: Overall Nice
reviews.body:
Overall Nice Stay, But Valet Service Was Terrible

Overall, our stay at the AC Hotel San Diego Gaslamp was nice. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Unfortunately, the valet service was a completely different experience and really took away from the stay.

When we arrived, there was no valet attendant available. The front desk had to cover for him and told us he was probably out getting a car. We later discovered that he was actually sleeping around the corner in the lobby.

Once he woke up, he couldn’t locate our car keys, which resulted in a long wait. After finally finding the keys, he took an unnecessarily long time to bring the car around. He didn’t assist with loading our luggage, didn’t open the doors, and provided very little customer service throughout the entire process.

For $70, I would expect professional, attentive valet service. Unfortunately, the service we received was far below what you would expect from a hotel of this caliber. The hotel itself was great, but the valet experience was extremely disappointing and needs significant improvement.

reviews.author: Monique
reviews.title: Wasn’t what we expected
reviews.body: I gave my review in the original statement. Wasn’t too happy with the experience.

reviews.author: Do not stay here
reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.body: This place does not care about your safety. The employees don’t take security serious and violate individuals privacy rights by releasing personal identifying information to the public.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: This hotel was very clean and close to all the bars and restaurants.

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.title: Excellence
reviews.body: Had a lovely stay at the AC Hotel in the Gaslamp district. The staff was attentive and friendly. The facilities very modern and clean. The rooftop pool and bar was lovely.  This is a noisy neighborhood and attention was also paid to keeping noise levels down with a white noise machine on the room.

reviews.author: YSERRANO
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel in the center of all the action.

reviews.author: D Smith
reviews.title: Not worth it for the price
reviews.body: Small/dark room. Pool is 3ft deep and was green by noon. Tv didn’t work - despite requests for assistance to be fixed, no one showed up. $70/night for valet, but they left our truck parked right out front all night (if you know the area you know why you wouldn’t want your car parked there). Female bartender on roof complained about “never being able to go home” when a large group showed up to order drinks. Overpriced breakfast option downstairs. The only upside here are the gentlemen working the front desk.

reviews.author: Would Not Recommend
reviews.title: Would Not Recommend
reviews.body:
We arrived around noon and asked if an early check-in was possible. We were told they would hold our bags and call us as soon as our room was ready. After not hearing anything, I called around 2:30 p.m., and Bobby at the front desk told me that we were not even on the early check-in list. He said he would make sure a room was ready by the time we arrived back at the hotel.

When we returned to check in Instead of taking responsibility, Bobby made several excuses and blamed the situation on another employee, saying it was only her fourth day on the job. That is not an acceptable excuse. Guests should not have to deal with poor communication and disorganization because of internal staffing or training issues. 

The entire experience was frustrating and left a very negative impression. I expected much better customer service and accountability. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this property to anyone based on the way we were treated.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.title: Gaslamp perfect spot
reviews.body:
Excellent on all counts.   Location perfect walking distance my favorite Seaport
And rooftop bars within walking distance
Neighborhood Friendly vibe bars and shops too support local business well

reviews.author: KB
reviews.title: Lacking Marriott Value
reviews.body: Front desk staff very unorganized.   Status was not recognized.  Not friendly.  Pool bar and restaurant not open till 4:00, no other options for lunch at hotel. Would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Brittney B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: Right in the middle of everything. Beautiful pool area. So great!

reviews.author: K Williams
reviews.title: Great hospitality
reviews.body: Bobby at the front desk provided us with the upmost hospitality as soon as we arrived for our stay. Our stay was pleasant, room was clean, amenities were nice as well.

reviews.author: Lost Sleep
reviews.title: AC Hotel on 5th Street in Gaslamp district subject to nightly noise
reviews.body: While the AC hotel in the San Diego Gaslamp district is physically a nicely renovated property itself, the Marriott Corporation does a disservice when booking by not mentioning that this hotel is in the heart of the most active nightclub block in the whole Gaslamp District. Loud pedestrian and nightclub noise lasts until 3am every Friday and Saturday night even high up on the 7th floor.  If you're hoping for even an "average" night's sleep, this property should be avoided on the weekends.

reviews.author: Bobbi
reviews.title: Worth the Trip
reviews.body: My friends and I had only a 24hour stay in San Diego and this hotel and the staff made it a memorable adventure. All of my friends and I are East Coasters, so we were surprised by how genuinely friendly everyone was.

reviews.author: I will be back
reviews.title: I will be back
reviews.body: I comfortably stayed at this hotel.  The staffs were very friendly and standout of cleanliness.  I’ll definitely return to AC hotel and recommending to everyone.

reviews.author: Victory
reviews.title: First Time at an AC Hotel! Excellent even if our view was a wall.
reviews.body:
We had an excellent time, room was clean and staff was friendly.
Our view was not the best but everything else made up for it.

reviews.author: Richard H
reviews.title: Visit from Hotlanta, Ga
reviews.body: Thanks! We had a great time and the weather was amazing

reviews.author: Travis L
reviews.title: House keeping
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful stay at The Westin San Diego Bayview, and one of the highlights was the excellent housekeeping service provided by Norma. She was incredibly attentive and always made an effort to make sure we had everything we needed. Whenever we left for the day, she would check in to see if we needed anything and made sure our room was clean, comfortable, and ready for us when we returned.

Norma’s attention to detail, kindness, and dedication to making sure we were taken care of really stood out. Her excellent service made our stay much more enjoyable, and we truly appreciated all of her hard work. She is a great example of outstanding hospitality, and we hope she knows how much her efforts were appreciated!

reviews.author: Stephanie K
reviews.title: Comfortable beds, but that’s about it
reviews.body: This location is not up to Westin standards.  The hotel is a construction zone and there is also a train that is very loud at night.  No food options for late night.  I would not recommend.  I should have listened to the other reviews.

reviews.author: Kat78
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.body: Highly recommend this hotel if ever in downtown San Diego. Its close to so many things and the space was incredible.

reviews.author: Disgruntled guest
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.body: The hotel was under major construction, which made the check-in process terrible and frankly the whole experience terrible. I can’t believe they charged people full price for that experience. Shame on them.

reviews.author: Jeff1951
reviews.title: Bad stay at the Westin
reviews.body: No hot water and inedible food.

reviews.author: DisappointedBonvoyMember
reviews.title: Disappointing Westin Experience
reviews.body: Our stay at The Westin San Diego Bayview was unfortunately disappointing. As longtime Bonvoy members, we expected the reliable service we’re used to. Front desk communication was difficult, with long hold times and unclear responses. Billing was also confusing, with an unexplained incidental charge not reflected on the folio. While we appreciated the birthday gesture for bringing up a celebration cake to our room, the overall experience fell short of the Westin standard we’ve always trusted.

reviews.author: Anthony
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.body: I had a bad experience staying at this hotel. When i asked a staff member for extra pillows, comforters, and blankets they quickly assumed that someone else was staying in the room. I lost a package thanks to these people. I ordered a case of water and one of the managers told me that one of the bottles was stolen by a guests and that there's nothing they could of done but with my other package they said security was supposed to hold it. I got no apology just a smirk by that manager when he was explaining to me how one of the water bottles was stolen. Incredibly rude staff and very unreliable. I had to call three times for maintenance to come and unclog the toilet that was already clogged before we even used it. This hotel is a disgrace to many other Westins, the rooms are outdated and dim. I'll never stay in this hotel. STAY AWAY from this hotel with their horrible rude staff an ugly rooms.

reviews.author: Elsa
reviews.title: Good location. Slightly loud.
reviews.body: Friendly service here. Nice walkable location. Beds were comfy. Pillows were NOT and very quickly went totally flat. It was also noisy - right near a train station that had trains honking their horns multiple times a night.

reviews.author: Phillypham2026
reviews.title: The maintenance staff entered our room without agreement
reviews.body: Very disappointed and uncomfortable. The maintenance staff entered our room for a so called routine check. It interrupted my wife’s nap. When we questioned this occurrence, he spent over 10 minutes to justify that behavior, which to us made the whole thing even worse.

reviews.author: Mel B
reviews.title: Great place to stay.
reviews.body: The Westin Bayview was an excellent place to stay and celebrate my wife’s and my 46th wedding anniversary. We were close to the marina and the hop on/hop off trolley which we utilized, was within walking distance. The facilities and the staff were excellent. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will utilize this facility the next time we come to San Diego.

reviews.author: Milton
reviews.title: Westin
reviews.body: Great and comfy! No issue close by all locations I wanted to visit!

reviews.author: Vicky and Rob from Alaska
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: Came for a couple nights to attend baseball game.  Hotel was great--location, super helpful staff, nice amenities.

reviews.author: v90488003
reviews.title: Broken Glass in Hotel Pool and Disappointing Response
reviews.body:
We had a very disappointing and concerning experience during our stay.

On August 14 at around 5 PM, my husband and I went to the hotel pool, where he was injured by a piece of broken glass in the water. We immediately brought the piece of glass to the front desk and explained what had happened. The staff member took down our room number.

What was most disappointing was the hotel’s response. While the gentleman at the front desk was courteous, there seemed to be very little concern that a guest had just been injured by broken glass in the hotel pool. We received no apology, no offer of assistance, and no resolution to the incident.

For a safety issue this serious, I expected a much more thoughtful and proactive response from the hotel. Accidents can happen, but how a hotel responds when a guest is injured matters. Unfortunately, the way this situation was handled, along with the lack of any meaningful resolution, left us feeling that our safety and experience were not taken seriously.

reviews.author: 35th Wedding Anniversary
reviews.title: Great Time
reviews.body:
The Hotel was fantastic ,Staff was very polite & considerate. If we had a question they helped us.
Clean, great wine & snacks, 
I have nothing negative about the experience we had.

reviews.author: Business Trip
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: The Westin San Diego Bay was an excellent hotel with great amenities.

reviews.author: KJ891
reviews.title: Fine but not the Westin you’re expecting
reviews.body:
Westin is supposed to be a premium Marriott hotel option and I would not say this Westin fits that bill. Overall, the hotel is dingy, dim and outdated. It’s clear where they cut corners whenever they last renovated. Thankfully the staff was great and location was good for exploring but you’re going to encounter lots of vagrants in the area. 

I walked over to the Westin Gaslamp for breakfast and would recommend that location if you’re looking for the standard Westin quality.

reviews.author: Happy ADA Guest
reviews.title: Great ADA room
reviews.body: They found us a room with a great roll in shower. It worked beautiful and had a view of the bay as well very close to lots of great restaurants and you see the ocean in just a few  blocks.

reviews.author: Hindu04
reviews.title: T
reviews.body: Amenities and service did not meet my expectations

reviews.author: ParentsofTwins
reviews.title: Quality yet not High Quality
reviews.body: Westin used to be great and I would say this location is very good. Also inconsistent as far as bartenders, servers, or food. Some are great and some not. Location is phenomenal and it is still a great value for a quality stay. We are repeat at this location and will return.

reviews.author: LAS 59
reviews.title: Remembering my Uncle at Westin
reviews.body:
It was birthday on August 9 and chose to spend my day in San Diego at Westin. I’ve always had a soft spot for the Westin Plaza because my late Uncle worked there, and staying at the hotel brings back memories of him. However, this recent stay didn’t meet my expectations.

We were placed in a corner room, and it was my first time experiencing that layout. Unfortunately, I didn’t like it. The space felt tight, and the drop ceiling made the room feel even smaller—almost claustrophobic. The water pressure was very weak, and the temperature was extremely hot with no option to adjust it to a normal level. For the price I paid—$305 for an overnight stay—I don’t feel it was worth it.

On-site parking is over $60, which I chose not to take. The towels also seemed worn and cheap, which added to the disappointment. Overall, the stay didn’t match the value of the price, and I’m sorry to say it fell short of my expectations.

reviews.author: NanHo
reviews.title: I would stay again!
reviews.body: The Westin is in a nice location. It is clean, and the staff is helpful. They offer a variety of food throughout the day/night. Most importantly to us was that the bed was so comfortable! Our room was spacious and inviting. We would stay here again.

reviews.author: Shima Sheikhzadeh
reviews.title: Mixed Experience: Great Location but Disappointing Service
reviews.body: Mixed Experience: Great Location but Disappointing Service

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: One day stay at Bayview
reviews.body: Had a comfortable stay. Staffs were kind and the amenities are acceptable. The location itself gives convenient access to downtown and port village. However. it wouldve been great if the parking allowed in and out pass.

reviews.author: Bernie
reviews.title: Chill getaway
reviews.body:
My friends and I stayed here for a chill weekend getaway. There was no available connecting rooms when we arrived, but the front desk tried their best to find neighbor rooms and showed us their location on the map. We had a good time at happy hour - service was great. We loved the mini corn dogs :D
We stayed here on a weekend so the rates were pretty high, and the parking & destination fees pushed it to a higher level.

reviews.author: Random
reviews.title: Nice hotel with some issues.
reviews.body: Thin walls make for a loud evening if you have neighbors. Ants are present in the room but it could be a summer issue.

reviews.author: 5mtn
reviews.title: Good not great experiences
reviews.body: This hotel has a great location.  Close to train station, port/marine tourist visitor interests, main bus route access thru the city.  We used the train station for travel to Disneyland, Legoland. Spacious room but not quiet.  Guest has to ask for room upkeep.  Our 2cd room, for family members, had failed AC.  They had to ask repeatedly for a new room.  Breakfast costs $25/person.  Free breakfast is not included in hotel stay. Hotel parking $65/day which uses parking lot across street at$31/day. Front desk staff not familiar with downtown area.  Airport transport MUST be scheduled in advance.  Nice pool for 'family' use.  Social hour is okay, not great. Wine, no beer, snackies.  Close to Torrey Pines State Preserve for beautiful ocean access.

reviews.author: AMG90
reviews.title: The view! The location!
reviews.body: Everything was incredible! Will definitely come back. Just wished the ac would get the room cooler than 73 and wished the sink would work.

reviews.author: Paresh Ag
reviews.title: Extremely rude staff
reviews.body: Reception staff is extremely rude. We were made to wait 1 hr for check in. Even after the alloted 3pm and more than that the staff seemed to not know got to talk nicely to people

reviews.author: Candice
reviews.title: Older Hotel and not the Westin Heavenly Standards
reviews.body: The Westin standard has changed.  You can tell the hotel is older and needs some new updates.  The staff and location were great.  The food was just fair, nothing to be desired.  I would try a different hotel the next time.

reviews.author: Boston fam
reviews.title: Visiting from Boston
reviews.body: We had an amazing stay and my kids loved the pool. Plus the staff were very helpful.

reviews.author: PONY3385
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.body: Again outstanding staff performance.

reviews.author: Duck5B81
reviews.title: Sincere Appreciation for Outstanding Service – Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity Inc. (Beta Chapter, Howard University) 45th Reunion
reviews.body:
I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for the outstanding service and quality accommodations your team provided during our recent Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. Beta Chapter 45th Reunion.

Organizing an event for a milestone like this comes with high expectations, and your property exceeded them in every way.

From the coordination phase through the arrival of our fraternity brothers, the hospitality was exceptional. The comfortable accommodations provided our group with the perfect backdrop for relaxation and reconnection.

What truly set this experience apart, however, was the dedicated support of your staff.

I want to commend Cory, Heather, and Syria for their excellent care and professionalism:

Cory went above and beyond by providing consistent, accurate room status reports upon request over the weeks leading up to the event. This level of communication was crucial to our planning and made our group coordination seamless.

Heather was absolutely invaluable at the Front Desk. She provided our group with outstanding insights and recommendations regarding local restaurants, tours, sightseeing, and transportation, which significantly enhanced our itinerary and overall experience in San Diego.

Syria was warm, gracious, and consistently delivered outstanding service.

It is rare to find a hotel where every team member is aligned in delivering top tier guest service.  

Please pass along our heartfelt thanks to yourself, Cory, Heather, Syria, and the rest of the staff; they played a major role in making our 45th reunion an unforgettable success.

reviews.author: Mtjj5356
reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.body: Heather and Syria were amazing. We were there for a funeral and they helped us with luggage getting us water, helping with ice.

reviews.author: blondie mckay
reviews.title: Marriott is best place to stay. All of them are always located where need to be.
reviews.body: Will stay there again as it was perfect placed for all things wanted to do and to visit relatives living a few blocks away--convenient for walking if able it not taxi or uber who were there in 6 minutes and under.

reviews.author: Jill
reviews.title: Perfect location. Clean and friendly
reviews.body: The front desk staff were extremely helpful and made me feel welcome the second I walked in . The room was very clean and lovely and it was set up to be very convenient for everything I needed if I needed to warm up a little meal.  The breakfast in the morning was beautiful and it was so excellent. The lady who presented it , took great pride in her job.

reviews.author: Momandtoddlervacationcrew
reviews.title: A good hotel for larger families and long stays
reviews.body:
Our stay at Townplace Suites was as uneventful as a short hotel stay should be. The staff was incredibly friendly and the hotel was clean and the full kitchen in the room was awesome. The only downsides from our stay was that we were traveling without a car, walking from the train station. The hotel is about 2 blocks away from the apex of Cortez Hill, so please keep that in mind if you're walking! The other downside was the bed was fairly uncomfortable and both I and my toddler struggled to fall asleep.

The breakfast options were great! One of the reasons we stayed here was because of the breakfast offering before we headed to the zoo for the day, and the spread did not disappoint!

If you are staying for longer than one night and want a cost effective option for a longer stay in San Diego, I cannot recommend Townplace Suites enough. For just one night, I might have stayed down the street at the Courtyard by Marriott because there are fewer hills between there and the train station. That said, we were absolutely satisfied with the stay.

reviews.author: Ryan1
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: 10/10 great service and accommodation

reviews.author: Joe P
reviews.title: Amazing Staff.
reviews.body: Incredibly friendly, professional, and helpful staff. But the parking garage is a nightmare.

reviews.author: JO0813
reviews.title: Family Getaway
reviews.body: Dissatisfied due to room service, bad odor coming from the bathroom sink

reviews.author: Mumma Bear
reviews.title: Comfortable stay, friendly staff but exhaust fan was broken in our room
reviews.body: Our stay at this hotel was comfortable, however, the exhaust fan in our bathroom was broken which lead to moist air trapped in the washroom. This problem was more noticeable as the room service was every other day.

reviews.author: Arthur
reviews.title: Staff was as good as I’ve experience at any accomidstion
reviews.body: The quality of the staff - front desk, house keeping, food service, and maintenance, when I say all I mean ALL, of them, were beyond polite, helpful, and courteous. There’s not a single staff member that wouldn’t greet you, say hello, and actually seem sincere about it… like the kind of hello that invokes a “let us know if you need anything” hello.

reviews.author: LarryC
reviews.title: The stay was great.
reviews.body: The stay was great besides we found laundry from a prior guest under/behind the curtain in our room. They were a couple of pairs of socks.

reviews.author: Kam50
reviews.title: I will not come back
reviews.body: We reserved 2 rooms as we were traveling with Kids. I called ahead and asked to give us rooms right next to each other. While checking in, when I asked if rooms are together, the front desk lady told me that she doesn’t know. That was surprising answer since who will know then? We stayed there for 7 nights and even checking the box for housekeeping on alternate days, no one showed up for 3 days. Then we requested it by ourselves. They did not do any rooms or bathrooms cleaning during our whole stay of 7 days. Once our commode got clogged. The maintenance guy came to our room and asked us if we want to unclog it by ourselves. Their next door parking is very tight and if you have a van or bigger SUV, you will find it difficult to park in that parking area. I will definitely not recommend this place to any one.

reviews.author: Fatboy
reviews.title: Rest before the wedding
reviews.body: Staff was great. And about 5 to 10 mim walk from everything

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Poor
reviews.body: Poor service room’s not being ready when check-in time came in we didn’t get to our into our room until 5:45 PM

reviews.author: Davis S
reviews.title: Heather was amazing. Great asset to your company
reviews.body: Heather was amazing. We were stuck after a family vacation due to flight cancelation.   Heather was very accommodating and made a bad situation a lot more enjoyable.   She was very helpful.

reviews.author: whatsthepointinbeingloyal
reviews.title: No recognition of loyalty and promotes unneeded waste
reviews.body:
It appears this Marriott doesn't care that your loyal even being a Titanium member. Check in staff didn't acknowledge nor ask what welcome gift I wanted. After checking out I noticed they automatically selected points. Per the T&C's of the program, I guess I should have asked to speak to a manager since if not given a choice, compensation should have been given, automatically selecting points does not meet that criteria of offering a welcome gift. 

In general breakfast offerings really need to be upgraded. I had to stay at another competitors hotel for work prior to this trip and their breakfast was made to order. While not feasible for Towneplace Suites, the hot food quality could be drastically upgraded to where I'm choosing to only eat the fruit. 

The one part that made no sense at all was the water dispenser saying not to use your own reusable water bottle and instead promoting using small plastic cups is just an incredible amount of unneeded waste. If the reason is for hygiene, people were using the same plastic cup for multiple trips while eating breakfast and then throwing it away just to waste another cup the following day when a reusable cup would have cut down on all waste.

reviews.author: Monty
reviews.title: Family Visit
reviews.body: Overall, okay place to stay. Needs updating. The parking associated with the hotel was mediocre, tight, and too expensive!  Would not return.

reviews.author: travel
reviews.title: Lacking in Most Ways
reviews.body: First, the hotel says it has a bar, but that was closed because the bartender quit. The breakfast each morning was not good. They had sandwiches in a steam pan so they were all stuck together and soggy. The light in the bathroom was so dim you could barely see your face, and there was no fan so the shower fogged up the whole bathroom. There was no luggage rack. The dishwasher was basically nonfunctional. The closet had nowhere to hang anything long like pants or dresses.

reviews.author: CaliVisittor
reviews.title: It was ok.
reviews.body: Upon arrival I asked about getting the food and snack versus the points. I was told I could get a water, but nothing else making it seem misleading. The room is incredibly small to be considered a "suite." The sink in the bathroom would not drain properly and the water in the shower did not get hot. It barely got lukewarm. The toilet seat had a stain on it as well as the floor of the shower wasn't clean. I used my personal Lysol wipes to clean both the toilet seat and the shower floor.

reviews.author: WongS
reviews.title: Tiny room for 2  and bags NOT more
reviews.body:
Reception staff excellent. 

Rooms are not for more than 2 adults plus luggage … it will still be a squeeze.

Obstacles to safely unload your family and luggage include … Bike lane in front of hotel … temporary street parking to unload vehicle  … small (airport style) luggage carts … constantly locked hotel entry doors

Overnight Parking is in structure next to hotel

reviews.author: Latindawg
reviews.title: Great Short Term Stay
reviews.body: The property is very nice in the heart of San Diego.  A lot to do within walking distance. The staff, Charles in particular, was awesome

reviews.author: Chief Confusion
reviews.title: Check your bill
reviews.body: After checkout found that was charged for food and beverage that I never authorized.  Never once got anything from small little snack area but was somehow charged for it. Parking garage is rather tight, so be aware.

reviews.author: CSEAV445566
reviews.title: Pricey for the average stay
reviews.body: We love staying at marriott branded hotels when we travel as a family. The room was comfortable, bed, pillows, and it was clean. Wish we had the crib we requested in the room upon arrival but needed to call twice on two occasions for the crib then the bedding/sheets for it. Parking is tricky with a larger truck or vehicle but we made do. The location is walkable but the homeless in the area made unappealing to walk around. Breakfast can be significantly improved to have some healthier food choices like fresh fruit, cheese, berries, etc. Overall, it worked for our family weekend away.

reviews.author: Martin A
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Great place .  It’s clean and in a great location.

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.title: Great hotel, forgotten room cleaning
reviews.body: Nicely maintained hotel in a good location, great creative breakfast (coffee could be better), helpful staff. One thing that's not acceptable for me though, they didn't clean our room at all. We arrived with two little kids so trash cans were loaded with diapers. When we found out the next day, it was already late. Hope this was just an incident, not a standard for a Marriott hotel.

reviews.author: Group guest
reviews.title: Wedding guest accommodations
reviews.body: Hotel was clean and staff was helpful and friendly, but reservations for wedding was not good.  We went 1 day early and they would not give us the same rate for wedding guests.  So reservations had to be made twice, once for the Wednesday and another for Thursday- Sunday.  Then we had to link the rooms so we wouldn’t have to move for each reservation.  I was on phone for almost 90 minutes trying to link the rooms for 3 families.  I was transferred between reservations and hotel front desk to get this done.  Don’t understand why it couldn’t be same reservations with different prices.  Should have been ble to get the group rate for the additional early night.  It was only less than $20 difference.  It would saved us a lot of hassle.  The billing of the rooms were also handled weirdly.  Some of us were charged daily rather than one one bill.

reviews.author: TroyinAZ
reviews.title: Great place.
reviews.body: Great location for quick Uber rides to the zoo  or the aquarium.

reviews.author: Toni Kenny
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.body:
This was the first time staying at this location, and I disappointed with my experience.  Upon checking into my room I was not able to access the internet on the TV. I called down and and informed the front desk clerk... Erick of the issue. Erick assured me that they were aware of the problem and the service provider has been notified and it would be resolved. Unfortunately the issue never got resolved, and I wasn't able to use internet on the tv to access Netflix, prime, etc. During my stay,  which is part of an amenity that I paid for.
The  next morning prior to checking out i was showering and found strands of women's hairs on the shower wall. This was disgusting and unsanitary. Seeing as how the housekeeper Marisol signed her name that she cleaned the room,it was not a thorough job. I was not happy with my stay here and I regret spending the 201.00 for the one night I stayed. As a Bonvoy member I was dissatisfied with the accommodations I experienced.

reviews.author: Vaibhav
reviews.title: Good Service, Average Breakfast, Excellent Location
reviews.body:
Overall, we had an okay experience during our stay. The receptionist at check-in made us feel very welcome. I had mentioned that we were celebrating my wife’s birthday, and along with my Marriott Gold status, they kindly waived the parking charges — which was a thoughtful gesture and much appreciated.

The staff was quite responsive through the Marriott app whenever we had requests, which made things convenient. Housekeeping was done daily, and that was a plus.

The breakfast was average — it was hot and had decent options, but nothing particularly memorable. One thing that could be improved was the cleanliness of the dishes in the room; they didn’t seem fully cleaned, possibly due to the dishwasher.

The location, however, was great — very convenient for exploring downtown San Diego.

Overall, a comfortable stay with good service, but with a few areas that could use improvement.

reviews.author: Ryan
reviews.title: Hotel Republic Stay
reviews.body: The staff was wonderfully courteous and accommodating.   It made my stay feel very personalized and warm.  I would definitely stay there again!

reviews.author: Sandman
reviews.title: Air conditioning out
reviews.body: Not good for a whole week stay

reviews.author: NMM 130
reviews.title: Does not meet Marriott standard
reviews.body:
This hotel does not meet Marriott Autograph standards.
Conceierge is terrible food is hardly edible.
40 Dollar resort fee and 75 Dollar parking is an absolute joke!!!
As a titanium member I feel Marriot is being let down by this hotel.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: A mediocre at best experience
reviews.body: The room smelled faintly of air conditioning and mold, and the $40 daily resort fee gets you access to…a gym (which is the bare minimum for a hotel) and some rental bikes. It’s an embarrassment to the hotel. The food was genuinely awful.

reviews.author: Trigger Segler
reviews.title: Bianca
reviews.body: Bianca serve us breakfast each morning in the lobby breakfast bar and she made our trip amazing she was happy, light and bright and cheerful.  She paid special attention to every guest and made us feel warm and welcome each morning.

reviews.author: Sando4552
reviews.title: Great, first day at this hotel
reviews.body: We arrived earlier than our check in time from the airport and staff made it possible to check in early. Since it was me and my daughter staff offered up an extra bed in a king room as an accommodation. The extra bed was brought up within 30 minutes and set up by staff. She thanked me for my status as a Bonvoy/Marriott member and explained the restaurant/pool/bar/gym availability at the hotel. Room was perfectly clean with no complaints at all. We took an uber from the airport so we did not use the parking that was offered. We also did not use the restaurant. Overall I’d stay here again on future travel to the area.

reviews.author: jim s
reviews.title: A home away from home
reviews.body:
This is the second consecutive year I've stayed at the Republic for San Diego Comic-con and I can't say enough positive things about it. The vibe of the entire place is welcoming. 

I'll start with the staff. From the time I walked in, I felt like the staff actually wanted me to be there. Throughout my stay, they were very attentive to my needs without being overbearing or without me having to chase them down. They had a very laid back but still here to help vibe. Especially  Ally, Daniel, Emma, Nick, Jenn and Jackie. 

The look and cleanliness of the hotel were all great. Nothing looked beat up or out of place. The decor contributed to the breezy vibe. It was pleasant to come back to at the end of a long day. And everything was shown care by the staff. 

The food and drinks, mainly from Trade but also Topside Terrace  were both a great way to start the day with excellent breakfast choices. Or a great way to end the day with cool dinner and drink options. Patrick is a standout bartender. It was just what I needed when I needed it.

The location is close enough to everything without being in the middle of everything. You can experience what you want and then come back to a quiet place to relax which is perfect for me. 

Overall, I can't say enough about how I enjoyed my time here. I hope to stay again.

reviews.author: Spanky
reviews.title: Not the 4star hotel I thought I was getting
reviews.body: Bathroom needed lots of work and shower leaked all over the floor.  The restaurant steak tips were small and over priced.  Lastly, parking is $75

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Nice Hotel and Great Location
reviews.body: Overall a very nice hotel. No lounge access to BonVoy members on the weekends which was a bummer. No complimentary coffee in lobby for guests ($7 charge for a small cup).

reviews.author: Gold Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Hold your breath
reviews.body: Room was great. Lobby and bar smelled very strongly of perfume. So much so that we literally held our breath from the entrance doors to the elevators. If you are sensitive to strong perfume smells avoid this hotel, as we will. We will not return.

reviews.author: Victor
reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.body: Poor overall experience. Executive suite was extremely underwhelming, felt like they just named a regular room that so they can charge more. Bathroom had no privacy just completely open concept with a curtain hanging from the ceiling for the shower. Random additional fees made this way more expensive than necessary and an additional $40 fee in which they justify it by giving us a “$20 food voucher” but they have no snacks available and only meals that the voucher can barely even cover.. would not recommend staying for the price.

reviews.author: SALEM A K
reviews.title: KRISTIAN, ANDRES & JOCELY, HORRIBLE UNPROFESSIONAL DISRESPECTFUL STAFF !!!! VERY UNSAFE
reviews.body:
This is my worst ever experience i have had on a property.  During the last day of my stay, someone tried to open my door on 4 different occasions without even knocking the door while i had the "Do Not Disturb" sign on. On the 5th time, i opened the door while he was just trying to do so. There was a guy wearing colored shirts and bunch of chains at the door asking who i was and what was i doing in the room which was very shocking. Then i asked who he was and he claimed he was the " Director of House Keeping" and he his name is Jesus. I asked him what's with all the questions and he was the rudest, most aggressive, impolite staff ever. I asked him if he had any business card, he never responded and walked away 

I ended up walking downstairs to the reception to get a better understanding, i talked to Jocelyn and she said that they dont know anything about what happened, and i should check who was it since it wasnt a staff member or a house keeping staff

I went up packed one of my bags and ended up leaving the property as i was scared someone might walk on me during the night, while i was waiting for my ride. I requested the information of the General Manager but Jocelyn wouldnt give it me claiming that they are not allowed to disclose such information backed up from Kristian Torres, Director of the Front Office, very rude unprofessional disrespectful staff. I have mentioned the incident and he kept going in circles instead if owning up to the issues or apologizing for the incident happened. He didnt even assure that such things should not happen, didnt even assure that i dont need to worry about my safety 

Literally very very very bad, shouldnt be in the hospitality industry if dont have the basics of manners or communication skills, ended up leaving the property while i have paid for something i didnt even use due to people trying to open my door and getting harrassed 

On Monday June 29th, the day of my check out, i asked Kristian to speak to Nelson Barrios, Director of Rooms but never got any communication, call or email

Such a nasty service, unsafe disrespectful staff, bad management especially when they dont care to address the guests issues

STAY AWAY

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: Reliable stay
reviews.body: The stay here is always reliable and pretty good. The food at this hotel is consistently good, and the rooms are always clean. The staff service is always fine, not exceedingly great but never rude or anything. It would have been nice to be upgraded because of my status.

reviews.author: Hayden
reviews.title: Did Not Feel Like An Autograph Hotel
reviews.body: Really disappointed staying at this location. I did not get my moneys worth and really it was one issue after another from service, room issues, and raised costs for the World Cup. I am hoping this was a one off for the location. However for my next trip I will think twice before booking here and spending the extra money.

reviews.author: GauchoMark
reviews.title: A very nice place to stay near Little Italy and Seaport Village.
reviews.body: We enjoyed the stay. Bed was comfortable and the bathroom was nice, not too cramped. These are our priorities in lodging. Staff was very nice to deal with. Polite, professional and informative.

reviews.title: Hotel republic june 2026
reviews.body: Was not impressed by the food at the restos, i couldn't eat the boiled eggs (so bad), hotel room is clean and service is good, veranda lounge is bad since they just offered salty chips and m&ms for my entire 2 night stay bcs they dont offer breakfast on weekends.

reviews.author: JOlson
reviews.title: A great stay!

reviews.author: Q Brown
reviews.title: Great hotel and fabulous location.
reviews.body: Hotel Republic is a nice hotel with a fabulous staff. I enjoyed my stay, and it's in a great location, not far from the pier.

reviews.author: Ryan D
reviews.title: Expensive parking and resort fee
reviews.body: This hotel was surprisingly expensive, especially when you factored in the destination fee, which totals nearly $50 with tax and parking, which is nearly $100 with tax and a tip for the valet. The rooms are small and basic. The coffee in the room was horrific. They don’t give you real half-and-half, rather some chemical concoction masquerading as creamer. The restaurant has increased their prices $3 per item! The resort fee, which they call destination fee has also increased 60% in the last few months. It was $25 previously, and had a $25 food and beverage credit. It is now $40, which is $46 with tax and they decreased the food credit to $20–A real lose-lose scenario.

reviews.author: Christian
reviews.title: Dirty Room and Rude Staff
reviews.body:
When we showed up, the room was dirty. Bottle caps and crumbs on the floor. Hair in the sink and bath tub. We were in a two double (family of 4) the hotel’s solution was tk move us to a king room, which wouldn’t work. I was told to go to the front desk in the morning and they would send someone to clean the room for us.

When we went to the lobby, the staff was very rude insinuating that we wanted credit (which we never asked for) all we asked for was a clean room!!!

reviews.title: This hotel is Below standard
reviews.body: Hidden charges and high valet rates. Would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Great location for value
reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.body: This hotel was super convenient and clean. We had a great experience and their gym was awesome! Great variety of food and service.

reviews.author: LV702

reviews.body: Would not order food here and if you have to park, prepare for the exorbitant costs. Service and amenities are great! Staff is friendly. Property is nice.

reviews.author: FamilyAffair
reviews.title: Great location , and aesthetically beautiful  however hotel needs some upgrades to be  Autograph / Luxury quality
reviews.body: Hotel is aesthetically, beautiful, and the location was amazing. It is walking distance to the gaslamp area, little Italy, the port, and they also have bikes to rent. The bikes were  old, and I think this is representative of some of the functionality that the Hotel offers. For example, our room was very beautiful however, the shower-head sprayed out wonky and leaked all over our bathroom constantly. Our air-conditioning unit defaults to 78 and  heat whenever someone is not moving in the room. When we talk to the front desk about this, they said it’s motion sensor and there was nothing they could do. 78 in May when you were sleeping was very hot and uncomfortable. we also we’re unable to use Netflix or HBO Max the entire time we were there. The Internet TV was very glitchy and slow and there is no way to cast it The TV. This is a little disappointing when you pay $40 resort fee for high-speed Internet and amenities. They upgraded us to have Club access because we are gold members; however  their club is not the usual club set up. There’s only a very very light continental breakfast Monday through Friday. There is no happy hour or lunch services like most clubs where you can get wine or beer during the day. Outside of breakfast the door is wide open the entire time and the club is unmonitored. The snacks were very basic like water, soda, M&Ms, and pretzels. Our check in staff was very nice. The ladies we interacted with were great however, when we called about a few of these issues, some of the staff we encounter were not very pleasant or friendly. We tried to use the food credit from the resort fee at topside but every time we were instructed it would be open or the times that it was open we would go and the restaurant would be closed.I would overall stay again, but I don’t think it’s worth paying $300 a night for their most basic room when you add in the taxes and resort fee.

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.title: A Step Above The Rest

reviews.author: Philip K

We booked a night at the JW, as soon as we arrived we were greeting by very friendly valet guys, we mentioned our anniversary at check in and we were upgraded to a room with a city view and some chocolates! Kids!

reviews.body: The hotel is very nice looking, I had a corner room with huge windows, but there was no view. There was also no refrigerator to store your food or drinks. The AC seems to be old and was extremely loud.

reviews.author: Joshua Crocker
reviews.title: Unacceptable Cleanliness for a Luxury Hotel
reviews.body:
My family’s stay at the JW Marriott Miami was extremely disappointing. After my mother had already slept in the bed, she discovered a visible wine stain on the sheets. This made it appear that the bedding had not been changed before our arrival.

The situation was upsetting and made us question whether the room had been properly cleaned or inspected. No guest should have to discover that they may have slept in used or unclean bedding, especially at a hotel that presents itself as a luxury property.

Although the hotel is in a convenient location, the cleanliness issue greatly affected our stay and made the room feel neither comfortable nor luxurious. Based on this experience, the hotel did not provide good value for the price, and I would be hesitant to recommend it to others.

reviews.author: Frequent traveler
reviews.title: A staff that it there to make your stay memorable
reviews.body: Excellent from check in to departure. Could not have asked for more.

reviews.body: A very nice hotel, quiet. Staff is very kind. I had a room upgrade: new, nice view and very quiet. Room was very clean.

reviews.title: Good hotel and great location
reviews.body: This is a good hotel for business, good location at Brickell and the people really kind

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.title: Beautiful Property, Excellent Staff, But Two Disappointing Decisions
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at the JW Marriott Miami, and overall I had a very enjoyable experience. The hotel is beautiful, the staff was consistently friendly and professional, and my room was absolutely exquisite. Had it not been for two issues, this easily would have been a 5-star, 10/10 stay.

My biggest disappointment was the pool being closed. I completely understand that maintenance and renovations are necessary, but closing the pool during the hottest and busiest part of the summer—especially during the FIFA Club World Cup when Miami is packed with visitors—seems like poor planning. Why not schedule major work for late September or October, after the summer rush but before peak winter travel?

Even more frustrating was that the closure wasn't clearly communicated before booking. The app mentioned possible construction noise, but that's very different from saying one of the hotel's primary amenities would be unavailable. While I appreciated that access to other pools was offered, asking guests to walk several blocks in 95°+ Miami heat isn't exactly convenient. A complimentary shuttle would have gone a long way toward making up for the inconvenience.

My second complaint involved breakfast. As a Marriott Ambassador Elite member, I appreciated the complimentary breakfast buffet. Since the buffet didn't include pancakes, I asked if I could order a small side of them. I had no problem paying a reasonable upcharge—but I was shocked when I was billed over $20 for three pancakes.

I'm sorry, but that's simply excessive. I spend well over $100k a year with Marriott properties, and while I understand premium pricing at luxury hotels, charging that much for what amounts to a few pancakes feels unreasonable. I would have happily paid $7–10, but $20+ for a side order leaves a bad impression.

Aside from those two issues, everything else was excellent. The staff genuinely cared about providing great service, the hotel is beautiful, and the room was outstanding.

My hope is that management takes feedback like this seriously. Small decisions—like better communication about amenity closures and more reasonable à la carte pricing—can make a huge difference in how loyal guests perceive an otherwise outstanding property.

reviews.author: BPARCHITECT
reviews.title: JW Marriott Miami scored GOOOAL
reviews.body: Front desk staff (both gentlemen) made late check-in seamless. Superb service throughout from front desk to valet.  Pablo in concierge lounge a great server.  Coming and going always greeted with smiles. Room was clean and view was great.  We would stay again.  We will make sure friends and family know what JW Marriott Miami experience feels like in Miami (Brickell). Although, thousands were in Miami for World Cup  JW Marriott Miami provided great service.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: The original room I booked online was worst the motel 6
reviews.body:
I’m writing to share a disappointing experience at the Marriott at 1109 Brickell Avenue, Miami, FL 33131 (Bonvoy #248244754).

As a business owner and loyal Marriott member, I expect a certain standard, and this stay fell far short. Check-in was smooth, but that’s where it ended. Room 1708 had a musty, wet odor — more Motel 6 than Marriott. I was also never told in advance that the pool was closed for repairs, only handed a letter about “access to other pools” after I’d already checked in. For what we paid, this should have been disclosed on the booking site before arrival, not sprung on us at check-in.

I went to the front desk to request a refund and leave, but was offered a room upgrade instead. I accepted it, but the odor issue and lack of upfront disclosure still stand — first impressions matter, and my guest almost didn’t want to stay the night. I’ll also add that, as a Black guest, I couldn’t help but wonder if that played a role in which room we were given — I hope that wasn’t the case, but the experience left that impression.

For comparison, I stayed at The Marriott Collection at 112 West 25th Street, New York, NY 10001 just last weekend for a Jay-Z concert, and it was a far better experience across the board — which is part of why I sought out another Marriott property in Miami in the first place.

I’m requesting a partial refund or compensation for this stay, and I’d appreciate the company looking into how rooms are assigned at this property.

reviews.author: Isi Sahman
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel, Excellent Service
reviews.body:
I absolutely love staying at this hotel! One of the biggest reasons I keep coming back is the exceptional hospitality from the manager, Alexis Lopez.

Every time I visit, Alexis makes a point of coming out to greet me, shake my hand, and personally thank me for my business. Those small gestures speak volumes and make me feel like a valued guest, not just another reservation.

He genuinely cares about his guests and consistently goes above and beyond to make sure every stay is comfortable and enjoyable. His professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to outstanding customer service truly set this hotel apart.

If you’re looking for a hotel where you’ll be treated with genuine hospitality and appreciation, I highly recommend staying here. Thank you, Alexis, for always making each visit such a great experience!

reviews.author: Junel J
reviews.title: A Step Above
reviews.body:
I happened upon the Brickell Arch when making a last-minute trip to Miami for a funeral. Anna in reception received me extremely well and welcomed me in a way that made me feel like I had been a customer for years. My room was well put together with everything needed to relax in a quiet, classy space. Additionally, the bedding was also quite comfortable.  

I ate three superb meals in the hotel. Mayling and her staff went out of their way to make sure that my food and overall experience was enjoyable. Alejandro, Luis, Caesar, and Anjelica were awesome! I definitely recommend Brickell Arch as a relaxing escape. From the fantastic views to the pristine service, Brickell Arch is now my preferred hotel whenever I'm in Miami.

reviews.title: Great Pre-cruise stay

After arriving late at night, exhausted from our travels, the staff's kindness and patience were a welcome relief. They even offered us a refreshing bottle of water and some snacks, which was a lovely touch after a long and stressful day of traveling. The next day, the staff helped us plan our day, recommending the best local attractions to explore in Miami. The beds were incredibly comfortable, ensuring a great night's sleep both nights. Plus, the hotel is situated in a safe area, making it an ideal choice for a pre-cruise stay in Miami. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: J2J Pax
reviews.title: Where Luxury Meets Genuine Hospitality
reviews.body:
From the moment we arrived until the day we checked out, our experience at Brickell Arch, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami was simply outstanding.
Every member of the team made us feel genuinely welcomed. The valet parking staff greeted us with professionalism and warmth, the front desk team made check-in seamless, and throughout our stay every interaction reflected exceptional customer service.
Our room was beautiful, spotless, and meticulously maintained every day. The housekeeping staff did an incredible job, paying attention to every detail and making us feel completely at home.
The restaurant staff provided excellent service, and the bartenders were fantastic—friendly, knowledgeable, and always ready with a great recommendation and a smile. They truly added to the experience!
The amenities are first-class. The pool area is relaxing, beautifully maintained, and the staff there were attentive and welcoming. One thing that impressed us most was the hotel's versatility. Whether you're looking for a relaxing vacation, cheering for your favorite team as we were during Colombia's soccer weekend, or even needing a quiet and elegant place to work remotely, this hotel has it all. The comfortable workspaces with breathtaking views make it easy to stay productive while enjoying a luxury atmosphere.
The location is another major highlight. Being in the heart of Brickell, everything is within easy reach, with incredible views of Miami that make every moment even more memorable.
Thank you to everyone at Brickell Arch, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami, for making our stay unforgettable. Your professionalism, kindness, and attention to detail did not go unnoticed. We are truly grateful and cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: Tylash
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body:
Our stay at Brickell Arch, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Miami was absolutely exceptional! From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel genuinely welcome with their warm hospitality and attention to every detail.

The hotel is beautifully designed, with elegant rooms that were spacious, spotless, and incredibly comfortable. The views of the Miami skyline were breathtaking, and the location in the heart of Brickell made it easy to explore amazing restaurants, shopping, and attractions.

Every aspect of our stay exceeded our expectations. The amenities were top-notch, the atmosphere was luxurious yet relaxing, and the service was consistently outstanding. Every team member we encountered went above and beyond to ensure we had a memorable experience.

If you're looking for a sophisticated, upscale hotel in Miami that combines luxury, comfort, and impeccable customer service, I highly recommend Brickell Arch, a Luxury Collection Hotel. We can't wait to return for another amazing stay!

reviews.title: We will be back again!! Dua Miami you have our heart!
reviews.body:
My stay at the Dua Miami was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we arrived, the staff truly went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Every interaction felt genuine, and they were happy to help us! 

The location is another huge highlight. Located in the heart of Brickell, the hotel is near everything, especially since we didn't have a car. Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Shopping is steps away! 

Our room was beautiful, clean, and the bed was our favorite! Amazing mattress! You can tell a lot of thought went into every detail, from the modern decorations to the relaxing atmosphere. We never wanted to leave! 

And finally the food, it was absolutely top notch! The restaurants at the hotel were so delicious, we ended up cancelling our reservation for another restaurant to eat at AHU MAR again! Can't forget the vibes on the rooftop with the pool and gorgeous views! 

I can go on and on... there are a lot of hotels to choose from in Brickell, but if you are on the fence, don't be, just book it!! You won't regret it!

reviews.author: Mackenzie C
reviews.title: Best Stay for a Business Trip
reviews.body:
honestly didn’t expect to love DUA Miami as much as I did, but it ended up being one of those stays you don’t stop talking about, especially if you’re in Brickell for work.

From the moment I arrived, the front of house team were so incredibly kind. Warm, easy, and genuinely attentive. They remembered my name throughout the stay which made everything feel seamless, especially when you’re in and out for meetings.

The location is ideal. Right in Brickell so everything is close, whether it’s meetings, coffee, or quick lunches, but it still feels like a bit of an escape when you’re back at the hotel.

The room was beautiful, but the standout for me was the balcony. Properly spacious, not one of those tiny step out situations. It’s perfect for a quiet coffee in the morning or a drink at the end of the day to switch off.

The pool situation is also so well done. There are two pools and a pool bar, so you can actually relax without it feeling chaotic. It’s such a nice reset after a full day of work.

The gym was another highlight. Floor to ceiling windows looking out over the city and ocean, which makes it a lot easier to get yourself there. And the 24 hour steam room is such an underrated luxury, especially if you’re trying to stay on top of your routine while travelling.

But honestly, what makes this place is the team. Everyone just feels aligned and like they genuinely care about the experience they’re creating. It’s polished but still has personality, which is rare.

I’ve stayed in a lot of places in Miami, and for a business trip in Brickell, this is easily my favourite. It just gets the balance right between work, wellness, and actually enjoying where you are. Would absolutely stay again.

reviews.author: Cyrus C
reviews.title: VIP service
reviews.body:
This stay was one of the most memorable stays I have had in my over 1000 nights with Marriott, all thanks to Valeria. She was our “ Guardian Angel” for our stay, and made my family and myself feel like VIPs on our one night stay.

We had booked this room for a 1 night stay, prior to embarking on a cruise. After a long day of traveling, and before we had checked into the hotel, I got a very warm email from Valeria, indicating that Valeria had been selected to be our “guardian angel” for our stay. 

As soon as we checked in, Valeria introduced herself to us and said if we needed anything, she would be there for us and offered us reservations at their restaurant, which we happily accepted. 

Upon reaching the room, we had a neat gift box waiting for us that had some cool Dua swag in it. Valeria met us for dinner to make sure our dinning experience was perfect and memorable. The food was excellent and the chef even special ordered chicken tenders for my kids. The hand breaded chicken tenders were the highlight of the meal and everything from the pizza to the steak was delicious. My son wanted to give his compliments to the chef, and Valeria made it happen, which made my son’s day. 

We had a few small issues with our breakfast at the hotel, but Valeria, who made it a point to meet us before we checked out, immediately rectified it. 

Overall our stay was magical, and if you are selected to have Valeria as your “guardian angel” you will be in for an amazing stay. 

We highly recommend this hotel and we will be back the next time we are in Miami.

All the amenities were beautifully upkept and we LOVED the cold plunge. I’ve never been to a hotel with such an interactive stay. The staff was incredible they even knew me by my name by the end of our trip! At that point we felt like we were vacationing in the hotel alone. Miami has a lot to offer, and Dua is one of them! We will definitely be revisiting!

reviews.author: HappyTraveler26
reviews.title: Perfect Comfort After a Long Travel Day
reviews.body:
I stayed at citizenM Miami Brickell for one night after an unexpected flight cancellation, and it honestly ended up being exactly what I needed after a long and exhausting travel day.

I had stayed at a citizenM before, so I already knew I liked the concept, but this stay reminded me why. It is especially perfect for a solo traveler. The room was incredibly comfortable, the bed was amazing, and I loved being able to easily control the temperature, lighting, and entertainment in the room. After traveling all day, it felt like having my own little mini spa night. I could freshen up, put on a face mask, relax in bed, watch TV, and finally decompress.

I was also so grateful that food was still available downstairs later in the night. Being able to have a late dinner at the hotel before going to sleep made everything so much easier. The team member working at the bar was extremely friendly and welcoming, which meant a lot after such a rough day of travel.

The hotel was easy to get to and easy to leave from the following day. I also really appreciate the citizenM setup because you can be completely independent when you want to be, while still having friendly staff available if you need assistance.

Overall, this was such a comfortable and stress-free stay at exactly the right moment. If you are traveling solo or simply want a clean, modern, comfortable place where you can eat, recharge, get a great night's sleep, and feel taken care of without any fuss, I highly recommend it. I would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.title: Rooms are tiny!
reviews.body:
We were a family traveling and asked if we could be all on the same floor considering we booked these hotel rooms a month in advance the person on the desk said no, that they had nothing left. I asked how was that possible considering I’d actually emailed a request to have adjoining rooms as we were a family and he said citizen M never received your request. I showed him the email where citizen M responded that they would work on my request and then he said there was nothing you could do. 


The reason we booked at this hotel was because I’d heard it was known for his cleanliness. I can confirm the room was very clean however, I did not appreciate how tiny it was going to be. You literally have to climb over each other just to try and get into bed. There’s nowhere to put suitcases. There’s nowhere to put anything. Basically we were in this tiny little room with a shower and a toilet and we had to share a face cloth and hand towel. Also, the towels in general are really poor quality.! I’m also saving the planet the paying $800+ dollars for this is not worth it.
