reviews.author: Dee1Grateful
reviews.title: Highly Recommend Aloft by Marriott Miami - Brickell
reviews.body: Stayed at the Aloft by Marriott Miami - Brickell.  We were greeted with a warm welcome and smile by the front desk staff.   All of the staff members provided excellent customer service.  We had an opportunity to speak with the General Manager about recommendations for beaches and restaurant.  She was very thourough and pleasant.  She also asked us upon our return how our visit was to the beach and restaurants.  The creativity and artistry in the different sitting and recreation areas is phenomenal.  I loved the vibe and the variety of games to acommodate all ages.  We will definitely plan to stay at this hotel again in the future and highly recommend that you consider staying here.

reviews.author: Miami Moments
reviews.title: Great stay overall
reviews.body:
I was hesitant to stay here at first because there were no microwaves in the room and the price point felt higher than I had planned to spend. 

However, I booked it and the microwave in the lobby proved adequate for my needs and the location more than made up for my hesitation on the price. 

It was so convenient in terms of jumping on the Metrorail, Miami mover, trolley and getting to other spots including getting to Brickell City Center and other key locations - from the airport to Vizcaya. 

The staff were beyond excellent in terms of efficiency, professionalism and overall helpfulness. As well as just being really pleasant! 

I slept well (although I would have enjoyed thicker pillows), there were quite a few sirens one day but I have had that at many other hotels in dense urban areas. It didn’t bother me. 

I got a good size tub and water pressure was great and water was hot. 

The pool was really pleasant and I loved that it has its own restroom and that the lounge chairs were comfortable. although in the midst of buildings it felt like a calm oasis. 

The gym was well equipped and comfortable. 

The lobby has a pool table and other board games and numerous spots to hang out and chill, including the bar. 

There was always coffee and tea available, and (although a little pricey) had a number of quick grab items available from snacks to yoghurt). It is only a block away from a supermarket anyway for more choice, a wine/liquor store across the road and some decent food options. 

I honestly had no complaints and would stay there again.

reviews.title: Overall great stay.
reviews.body: Our Family had a great time here. Lunch was great, kids enjoyed the pool and the beds were extremely comfortable. Our only main complaint was breakfast has a stopage at 10am and we arrived  5-10 mins before the close. The staff literally started removing pitchers and other items before 10am and it seemed as if they were threatened to have everything cleared away or else! reviews.author: Alex2k26
reviews.title: Another amazing stay at Element MIAMI BRICKELL
reviews.body: Another amazing stay at the Element Miami Brickell. Everything from check-in to check out was smooth. The staff goes above and beyond to accommodate their guests and makes sure you are content throughout your entire stay. The entire hotel staff from the lobby to other hotel team members throughout the grounds are extremely welcoming, professional, and cordial. I would like to specifically praise Melissa for being professional, attentive, and for going above and beyond to make sure my family was happy throughout the entire stay. I would also like to commend and give special praise to hotel team members Fernanda, Adolfo, and Ricky on the AC side who were all very professional, welcoming, and helpful to my family and I. This is the type of professionalism and service that goes a long way and makes any trip seem that much better. These team members and their sincere gestures make you feel valued as a guest. reviews.author: Ex Marriot loyalty member
reviews.title: Worst Marriot experience
reviews.body:
I have been a Marriot member for 7-8 years and this was by far my worst experience. First i used the app to let the team know my checkin time (10:30). For context this was my girls birthday and we were making a day trip out of the situation. We get to the hotel and concierge says the room won’t be ready until 4… (granted this is my first year losing gold status). Then when i walk back up to the desk she mistakes me for another black man that was on the waiting list for a room. Now im just over the situation so me and my girl go occupy ourselves until 4. There’s no street parking so i use the valet. 3 hours later i go to grab the car as we are going out for the night. They charge me the overnight fee because im a resident at the hotel and the guest fee is for short term visitors. (I would have to pay again when i got back so this made no sense) basically they were telling me i needed to pay 70 dollars to park 3 hours (overnight rate and the visitor rate was cheaper). The plates in the room were dirty, the remote to one of the TVs didn’t work. 

By far my worst Marriot experience.

reviews.title: Perfect location | Great staff | Outstanding outdoor pool area | Clean
reviews.body: The next time I visit, the AC Hotel in Brickell will be my first choice without a doubt. The staff was excellent and very hospitable. My room was impeccably clean—just as it should be—and both the lobby and pool area were perfect. The ambiance was exceptional. After having to leave another hotel abruptly due to unkempt rooms, we found this Marriott at the last minute, and I wasn't sure what to expect since the pricing seemed almost too good to be true. However, the room exceeded our expectations, and my entire family agreed that this was the ideal place to stay. The location is super convenient, especially for families visiting their college students, as it's close to the Metro-Rail. I highly recommend the pool; the outdoor area is simply stunning.

reviews.author: Happy Julio
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with a wonderful staff!
reviews.body: I had an absolutely wonderful stay at the hotel and I want to give special recognition to two exceptional employees, Fernanda and Rickey Paredes .Rickey was incredibly kind and thoughtful. I needed to do laundry, but the machines did not accept credit cards and I didn’t have cash.Rickey went out of his way to personally help me by providing the money I needed to do my laundry. That gesture meant so much to me, and it showed how genuinely caring and compassionate he is towards his guest. It was far beyond what I expected, and I will never forget his kindness. Fernanda was also amazing. She made sure that my stay went smoothly and that I had everything I needed. She was always helpful, welcoming and attentive, and she made me feel comfortable and well taken care of throughout my stay. I will definitely be returning and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a hotel with a wonderful staff .Thank you Fernanda and Rickey for making my stay such a positive experience!

reviews.author: Rio 1
reviews.title: Good Location, Hidden Fees and Poor Service
reviews.body:
I had much higher expectations, especially as a Marriott Bonvoy Elite Member, but this stay was disappointing from start to finish.

When I arrived, both check-in lines were busy, and the Elite Members line wasn't being enforced—anyone could use it. I was also surprised to be told about an additional $35 per day "location fee," even though I had prepaid my reservation, including taxes and fees. This felt misleading and is something I have never experienced in all my years as a Bonvoy Elite Member.

Unfortunately, there was no recognition or meaningful benefit for Elite Members during my stay.

The service throughout the hotel was below expectations. Breakfast was very limited, with no eggs or even hot milk available. The coffee was consistently cold, and basic items were frequently out of stock. The staff often seemed tired and uninterested in helping guests.

In my room, I called the front desk twice. Both times, I was placed on hold indefinitely until the call disconnected, so I never actually reached anyone.

Another major disappointment was the lack of transparency regarding additional charges. Besides the daily "location fee," every bar bill included a 20% "operational charge." When I asked the server whether this was a gratuity, I was told it was not and was then encouraged to leave an additional tip. If it's not a gratuity, it should simply be reflected in the menu prices. If it is, it should be clearly identified as such. Either way, the pricing feels misleading.

Speaking of prices, they are excessive. $20 for a mediocre glass of wine and $55 per night for parking are difficult to justify, especially considering the overall level of service.

The hotel itself is attractive, and the location is excellent. Unfortunately, those positives are overshadowed by hidden fees, poor service, and a general lack of value. I've stayed at many Marriott properties around the world, and this was one of the most disappointing experiences I've had. I would not choose to stay here again.

reviews.author: From Boca Raton Florida
reviews.title: Dirty linens

reviews.author: FriendsTrip
reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — A Modern, Stylish Escape in the Heart of Brickell
reviews.body:
My stay at the AC Hotel in Brickell Miami was exceptional from start to finish. The moment I walked in, I was greeted with the hotel’s signature blend of modern European-inspired design and Miami’s vibrant energy. The lobby is sleek, airy, and beautifully curated — instantly setting the tone for a relaxing and upscale experience.

The rooms are spotless, spacious, and thoughtfully designed. I loved the minimalist aesthetic, the comfortable bedding, and the floor‑to‑ceiling windows that brought in so much natural light. Everything felt fresh, clean, and intentionally arranged. The bathroom was equally impressive with its walk‑in shower, premium toiletries, and crisp, modern finishes.

One of the highlights was the rooftop pool — a true oasis above the city. The views of Brickell’s skyline are stunning, and the atmosphere is calm and sophisticated. It’s the perfect place to unwind after exploring Miami or to start your morning with a peaceful swim.

The location couldn’t be better. You’re steps away from Brickell City Centre, incredible restaurants, cafés, and nightlife. Whether you’re in town for business or leisure, the convenience is unbeatable.

The staff deserves a special mention. Everyone I interacted with was warm, professional, and genuinely committed to making my stay memorable. From check‑in to checkout, the service was seamless.

Overall, the AC Hotel Brickell delivers a perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. I would absolutely stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a refined, modern hotel experience in Miami’s most dynamic neighborhood.

This hotel is in walking distance to great shopping and dining!! We will be back!

reviews.author: Discerning Traveler
reviews.title: Who’s idea was this?
reviews.body: This hotel is in an extremely busy part of town. The traffic is horrible. When you park in the valet only garage, no one helps or guides you to where to check in. Common sense tells you the lobby is on ground level, right? But that’s not the case here… it’s on the 6th floor, where there’s a split between 2 hotels in the same building…. WHY?  It’s overpriced for the accommodations, and they don’t deliver on their promises. I would not recommend this hotel. It is however, within walking distance to everything you might want to see/do in Brickell, but so are many other hotels in the area. Will choose differently next time. Parking is extremely expensive as well, and there isn’t another option.

reviews.body: I was at the AC Hotel for business. reviews.body:
My room wasn’t adequately cleaned. We stayed here due to proximity to the port and knew this wasn’t a highly rated hotel but figured at least the basics could have been better. 

Further the elevator situation was annoying as one was out of service.

reviews.author: LESDAI
reviews.title: An Unforgettable Experience at W Miami
reviews.body:
My husband and I had the opportunity to enjoy a wonderful stay at W Miami, and we can honestly say it was a truly special experience. From the moment we arrived, we loved the service, the atmosphere, and the unique energy that makes the hotel feel so distinctive.
Everything was beautifully maintained, and the cleanliness, service, and attention to detail made our stay very enjoyable. The pool was definitely one of our favorite experiences. The views of the bay were spectacular, and although there were some areas under construction, it did not prevent us from enjoying the beauty of the property.
We also absolutely loved the views from our balcony. Being able to take in Miami, feel the energy of the city, and share those moments together made our stay even more memorable. ❤️
W Miami gave us the combination of luxury, fun, unique design, and a different kind of experience that we were hoping for. We left very happy and grateful for the memories we created together, and we truly hope to return in the future. ✨
A wonderful experience that we highly recommend and will remember fondly. 10/10. ❤️

reviews.author: LEJ69
reviews.title: Do Not Stay at W-Miami
reviews.body:
This is an old, tired hotel that is clearly in need of a major renovation and overhaul. The condition of the property does not come close to reflecting the experience or standards that guests expect from the W brand.

The rooms were dirty and poorly maintained, with peeling wallpaper, stained and filthy carpets, and visible water stains around the air vents. The overall condition of the hotel was extremely disappointing and, frankly, felt more like a cheap roadside motel than a W Hotel. To make matters worse, I found the staff unaccommodating when concerns were raised.

As a frequent guest, I know what to expect from the W and Marriott brands, and this property fell far below those expectations. I will not stay at this location again. Marriott should also be more transparent with guests about the condition of this property before they book.

Given the poor condition of the hotel and the overall experience, I believe Marriott should provide me with an appropriate credit or refund for this stay. This was simply not an experience that should be associated with the W brand.

reviews.author: Crimson Red
reviews.title: Check In!
reviews.body: The gentleman at front desk made my gf feel like I paid way more than I did. Thank you.

reviews.author: CC18
reviews.title: Not what I was expecting
reviews.body: The hotel is in a prime location. Very walkable and in a great area. However, I was less than thrilled with my stay. The sheets were dirty upon arrival and upon notifying the front desk, they gave me sheets to change the bed myself. The on property restaurant closes early and when the restaurant closes, room service ends. At a luxury hotel, I would expect to be able to order in room service until at least midnight. Lastly, the room itself was nice and the hotel itself was clean, but the phone in the room to call the front desk or room service did not work and I ended up using my personal phone to call down for needed items. They did warn us about the construction which did not bother me. It would have been nice if the pool was open during the week.

reviews.author: celine
reviews.title: stay anywhere else but here
reviews.body: the hotel itself was lacking the usual quirkiness that the W brand offers. I didn't feel like the room was special, it didn't include anything unique. there was construction as well, so i couldn't use the pool. they didn't offer anything to compensate for this. there are other hotels that are in the downtown core that offer a bed and shower. i felt like i paid the W premium price but got the experience of any other 3 star hotel.

reviews.author: JuanJ
reviews.title: My Stay at W hotel Miami.
reviews.body: Everything was good. I enjoyed the stay. The pool was amazing.

reviews.author: not ready
reviews.title: Too much construction forget about sleeping in
reviews.body: The construction starts every day at 8 AM so if you’re looking to sleep in past that you’ll be woken by  jackhammers nail hammers. Parking is a disaster overnight $60 limited amenities for the amount of money spent each room night it’s worth it to go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Disappointed this Trip
reviews.title: Hotel Under External Renovations and Overrun by Influencers
reviews.body:
Hotel was under external renovation.  Water views were not available so the traffic noise was awful throughout the night.  On top of that, the hotel was overtaken by influencers that were video recording everything. They were also coming in at all hours of the night and seemed to think they were the only guests in the hotel!  Not the least bit concerned about making noise.

The bar/restaurant was taken over by a private party Saturday night so the ability to get a drink with the $30 “Resort” credit per day, we’ll forget about that!  The receptionist should have let us know that the bar would be closed to hotel guests that evening!

reviews.author: Cobejack1
reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.body: I expected a true 5-star experience, but this stay felt more like a 3-star hotel. The bathroom didn’t appear clean upon arrival, and the valet service felt unprofessional and somewhat sketchy. The level of service was disappointing—they didn’t assist with our luggage, offer a luggage cart, or escort us to our room. Overall, the hospitality and attention to detail fell well below expectations. I wouldn’t choose to stay here again based on this experience.

reviews.author: King26
reviews.title: Be careful! Unknown charges on my card
reviews.body: I checked in June 26. They charged my card $1,408.50 when they were supposed to charge my card $1,106.27. Check out was June 28th. I ended up leaving June 27 around 5pm. and told front desk. Then next morning I check my bank account and see an additional charge of $711.00 . I immediately called and front desk only could see charges of $1,106.27. I had to wait till the next morning when the manager came in and they said the same thing. They said they can only see when I swiped my card and that they don’t know about any additional charges. They said to give it a few days and to call back. It’s now June 30th. and I have gotten my money back. But getting charged an extra $1,013.23 was ridiculous. Especially in the economy we are in and everyone I called had no answers. I will not be back to that hotel again, they are not trusted with your money.

reviews.author: Tom1
reviews.title: Really gone downhill
reviews.body:
Waiting for an hour to bring up a coffee cup in the morning is so far away from a 5* experience.  WiFi was terrible, couldn’t fix it during my 5night stay.
Staff were great and Tulum restaurant was nice still.

reviews.author: DLM7
reviews.title: Hotel under construction and they don’t tell you
reviews.body: Extremely disappointed at my recent stay here. The pool is only open on Saturday and Sundays but closes and reopens during that time. Is completely closed during the week due to the renovations and they don’t even tell you when checking in ! Don’t waste your money on this hotel right now. Maybe when renovations are done but currently don’t bother save your money

reviews.author: Claudio
reviews.title: Not at the level expected
reviews.body: Works on the building and restaurant poor

reviews.author: James761
reviews.title: Nice hotel but amazed no room service after lunch!
reviews.body:
The W Miami delivers on almost every front. Staff are warm and attentive, the rooms are stylish and well-appointed, and the views are genuinely impressive. Breakfast is excellent, and the service throughout feels polished without being stiff. Self-parking is available in the car park directly across the street, which is a convenient option if you prefer not to use the valet.

One glaring omission, however, threatens to overshadow all of that: room service stops after lunch. No evening menu, no late-night option, nothing. For a hotel at this level and price point, that is a remarkable gap and one that is hard to overlook when you are paying W rates and simply want dinner sent to your room after a long day. It is the kind of policy that belongs in a budget roadside inn, not a flagship lifestyle brand.

That aside, the stay was genuinely enjoyable. The surrounding area has no shortage of dining options, so hunger is easily solved if you are willing to head out. Just do not book expecting the full-service hotel experience you would reasonably assume comes with the name.

reviews.author: Happy Cruiser
reviews.title: Great looking hotel
reviews.body: Gorgeous hotel, room suite was fantastic. Very close to cruise terminal for our cruise. Only downfall is $55 valet parking and tv in bedroom flickered. Couldn’t relax by watching tv. Restaurant food was very good!!

reviews.author: Kevin07
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Good experience—recommended.

reviews.author: HH83
reviews.body: The hotel does not live up to its name.

reviews.author: ToLa
reviews.title: Construction issues but also poor service
reviews.body: For such a beautiful room, this is one of the worst states I’ve ever had. Simply pulling up to the hotel, we were not greeted by anybody and to be honest, wasn’t sure which door was for the hotel. After figuring out how to park our own car with the valet, getting our own luggage out and finally finding the reception desk, the host was very unhelpful. They were dismissive of upgrades and uninterested in any aspects of improving our stay. When asked to help us stay an extra night as our flight had issues, they told us to go online and do it ourselves. The construction made accessibility to the pool, restaurants, workout facilities, and spa services impossible. And yet we were charged full price. We also had construction workers outside of our window peeing in at all times a day and even in the evening. Both weekends and during the week. I would like to think the construction made these issues come up, but it does appear it is simply the culture and design of this hotel.

reviews.author: Disappointed Guest
reviews.title: Pure Disappointment
reviews.body:
I am writing to formally express my dissatisfaction with my recent stay at your Brickell property.
We had just returned from a vacation in Dominica and intentionally chose to spend one additional night in Miami, expecting your hotel to be the “cherry on top” of an otherwise excellent getaway. Unfortunately, the experience at your property was anything but that. It was a frustrating and disappointing way to end our trip.

To begin, the condition and preparation of the room were unacceptable. There were no clothes hangers available, which is a basic amenity in any hotel, especially one positioned as upscale. Additionally, the toilet had extremely low water pressure and clogged easily, creating an ongoing inconvenience. These are not minor oversights. They point to a lack of proper inspection and attention to detail.

Equally disappointing was discovering that the pool was unavailable due to renovations, something that was not disclosed prior to booking. In a destination like Miami, a pool is a key amenity, not an afterthought. Had this been communicated in advance, I would have booked elsewhere, such as EPIC or EAST Hotel which are comparable properties in the area offering similar pricing with full amenities available.

The service experience only compounded these issues. We arrived around 7:00 PM for a one-night stay and asked about the possibility of a late checkout the following day. We were instructed to call in the morning to make the request. When we did so at approximately 9:50 AM, we were told it was “too late” to request a late checkout due to the 11:00 AM checkout time and there was “nothing that can be done”. This response was both unreasonable and inconsistent with my previous experiences at your brand, where late checkout requests have been accommodated even closer to the deadline.

What made matters worse was the lack of leadership available to address the situation…no manager was on hand. The handling of this simple request felt disorganized and unprofessional, and the overall level of service lacked flexibility, accountability, and any sense of guest care.

From start to finish, this stay reflected poor communication, substandard room readiness, and a disappointing service experience. I chose your property expecting an elevated stay consistent with the W brand, but instead left frustrated and disappointed

reviews.author: LM12
reviews.title: Not great
reviews.body: It was not a great experience and would not recommend. The staff was not very helpful and I felt the rooms were a bit dirty. Was also very disappointed the pool was closed and staff was not helpful at giving me other options (e.g., other properties to go to, other activity recommendation etc,). They also forgot my requests (e.g. extra silverware).

reviews.author: Greg S
reviews.title: Not up to W standards
reviews.body: Rooftop bar and restaurant closed.  No room service after 4:00 pm.  No food or bar after 7:00 pm.  If you call the front desk or the emergency number from your room, no one answers.

reviews.author: Rasean C
reviews.title: 2 dirty rooms
reviews.body: No one should be given a dirty room 2x after making a 14hr trip away from home at the W in Miami.  (Stains on pillow, matttress, coffee in sink, water on bathroom floor, stains on chair, hair & stains on towels)

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.title: Alarm went off all night - absolutely horrible
reviews.body: The alarm went off from 1 am to 5 am .. maybe 3 different times. On the loud speaker, it instructed everyone that it was a fire drill and to evacuate - but there was no fire - the system was just broken. It was my birthday so it completely ruined my sleep, my night, and the next day because I was so exhausted. The staff was not apologetic or accommodating which was the worst part. The staff continued to roll their eyes at us, dismiss us, and be very difficult to work with throughout the stay. I will absolutely never ever stay in this hotel again.

reviews.author: TitaniumElite 123
reviews.title: Night manager doesn’t know English or how to do his job
reviews.body: The night manager won’t be able to help you bc of the language barrier and because he doesn’t know what to do when checking someone in. If you don’t have to check in in the late evening, it’s a great experience.

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.title: Avoid the W at all costs
reviews.body: Shockingly poor food - over an hour to get a salad

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.title: Staff was nice enough, but this is not a 5 Star Stay
reviews.body: My husband and I stayed here Monday and Tuesday of a holiday weekend and were informed when we arrived that the pool is not open during the week. The location of this hotel is the best thing about it, but the dining options and amenities in the hotel itself are extremely limited, so you will need to venture out for every meal and activity. Also make sure to request a floor high up - if you are staying on the street side you will hear noise and honking all day and night.

reviews.author: Jesus Gamarra
reviews.title: A weekend in Brickell, Miami
reviews.body: W Miami in Brickell delivered a solid 8/10 stay. The staff was flawless (10/10) and service was excellent (9/10), making us feel truly welcome. Food options scored only 7/10, and we really missed a proper dinner service at the stunning TULUM rooftop in the evenings. Still highly recommended for the perfect Brickell location and vibe!

reviews.author: Gmk97
reviews.title: Not ready to serve
reviews.body: Room was not ready when I arrived at 3:30pm despite my status nor was I offered a place to store my bags. I was told I would be texted when the room was ready but I was not. The room had one bath towel and street noise was loud.

reviews.author: Never Again
reviews.title: Request for Resolution Following Recent Stay Experience at W Miami
reviews.body:
Dear Ms. Maneckji, General Manager -

I am writing to you as a Lifetime Platinum Elite member who stays exclusively within the Marriott portfolio for both business and personal travel. I have always trusted Marriott to deliver a consistent, professional experience, which is why what occurred during my recent visit to W Miami was both shocking and extremely disappointing.

Due to a last minute airline change, my travel into Miami was adjusted and I was unable to modify my reservation from two nights to one prior to arrival. When I arrived at the hotel to check in, I was informed that I had already been charged for the first night and that my reservation had been cancelled. I attempted to calmly explain the situation to the front desk staff and asked for assistance, but the interaction was dismissive and, frankly, borderline rude.

After significant back and forth, the associate stated that she could locate a room, but would only proceed if my wife called the hotel because the Bonvoy account is technically under her name, despite the fact that I am the one who travels and checks in regularly without issue at Marriott properties across the country. This has never once been required in my many years of loyalty to Marriott. I even offered to call my wife myself and have her speak with the associate directly, but I was told the only acceptable option was for her to independently call the hotel and request to speak with a manager.

At 8:00 PM, my wife was at home managing our four children and putting them to bed. It was unreasonable to expect her to stop everything to resolve a situation that should have been handled professionally at the property level. At that point, frustrated and feeling completely unsupported, I instructed the staff to cancel the stay entirely. Despite not occupying a room, the hotel would not budge on charging me for the night.

Unfortunately, the experience did not end there. After spending approximately ten minutes inside the property attempting to resolve this matter, I exited to retrieve my vehicle and was told by valet that my car would not be released unless I paid $16 for parking. The valet directed me back to the front desk, and the front desk directed me back to valet, with neither willing to assist or take ownership. I ultimately had no choice but to pay simply to leave the property.

This was, without question, the worst experience I have ever had at a Marriott property. I have already shared this situation with my father in law, who is a Lifetime Ambassador Elite member, and he was equally disturbed by how this was handled.

I am asking that you personally review this matter and make the situation right. At a minimum, I am requesting a full refund of the charged room night as well as reimbursement of the valet fee, given the complete inconvenience and lack of hospitality extended that evening, not to mention the time required to document this experience.

I remain a loyal Marriott customer and sincerely hope this was an isolated breakdown rather than a reflection of the standards at W Miami. I would appreciate your prompt attention and resolution.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

reviews.author: Disappointed in the W
reviews.title: Disappointed in Miami
reviews.body: This W is connected to an apartment building that I walked into first by mistake. This is what I expected aesthetically. I was excited to be there.  When I was redirected next-door to the W, I was disappointed from the very beginning. It was rundown and basic- nothing seemed luxurious about it at all. The elevators and hallways are reminiscent of an art deco south beach hotel- no luxury. No warmth. Just old. Getting off the elevator and seeing a stark white paint with shiny black decals and a flourescent flamingo was disappointing. The beat up and dirty furniture and carpet in the room actually broke my heart. I blew my points on a dump that looks like a Howard Johnson’s from the past. It is not worth the money or your points.

reviews.author: Miss N
reviews.title: Pleasant but slightly disappointed stay
reviews.body: I had a pleasant stay at the hotel and overall enjoyed the experience. However, I was disappointed to see that the hotel credit I was assured would be applied to my bill never appeared. Despite being told it was added, it wasn’t reflected anywhere on my final invoice. This left me feeling that the credit was not actually applied, which is frustrating after an otherwise nice visit.

reviews.author: Thomas room 2503
reviews.title: Not the amazing experience
reviews.body: Very disappointed , on entire stay room service, NO Points were redeemed as intended service was not acceptable

reviews.author: Anthony C
reviews.title: JW Marriott Miami amazing
reviews.body: I’ve been staining this Marriott for eight months at least three nights a month and everything is on point

reviews.author: inqans
reviews.title: Stay at JW Marriott Marquis Miami
reviews.body: We got a sea facing room. It was awesome.  Cleanliness and in room dining was amazing.  The staff was very helpful and courteous. The gym and play area was well maintained and very clean and there are lot of options like bowling, air hockey. There is additional space on second floor to conduct meetings in a quite area. Overall we had a great experience.

reviews.author: Tanya T
reviews.title: Somewhere To Stay, Regular Hotel Experience
reviews.body: Staying at the JW Marriott Marquis was a big deal for me because I was celebrating my honeymoon with my husband. The experience was not perfect because I couldn’t sleep the night before but the manager (Jonathan) did try to put a smile on my face and I thank him wholeheartedly for that.

reviews.author: ZeroStarrss
reviews.title: VERY POOR SERVICE AND THEFT
reviews.body: Literally the worst experience I’ve ever gone through dealing with a Miami hotel, especially a Marriott. The room had hair in the sheets of the bed hair chunk in the shower. They just put me in a room that was not properly serviced. The mini bar was not fully stocked, and they attempted to charge me knowing they have sensors in the mini bar and nothing nothing was touched by me. They also failed To reserve my third night stay and issued an apology because the receptionist was new. They did nothing to resolve that and instead they tried to charge me extra for late checkout the day before I was supposed to leave. The manager doesn’t even know how to speak, concise English, she’s very hard to understand. This location is dirty and disgusting this JW zero stars.

reviews.author: Phil C
reviews.title: Great Stay at the JW Marriott Marquis Miami
reviews.body:
I stayed at the JW Marriott Marquis Miami last week. I was able to check in at 1000 and Isabella at the front desk was helpful.
The room was large, clean and quiet. I got a massage at the spa and that was definitely worth it. The executive lounge had a good buffet breakfast. The weight room was probably the best I have seen at a hotel. There was plenty of both free weights, machines and cardio equipment. 
There was a Whole Foods next door and plenty of restaurants and shops within walking distance. The nearby river walk allowed for a nice morning run.
I would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: EA3696
reviews.title: HORRIBLE SERVICE
reviews.body: Literally the worst experience I’ve ever gone through dealing with a Miami hotel, especially a Marriott. The room had hair in the sheets of the bed hair chunk in the shower. They just put me in a room that was not properly serviced. The mini bar was not fully stocked, and they attempted to charge me knowing they have sensors in the mini bar and nothing nothing was touched by me. They also failed To reserve my third night stay and issued an apology because the receptionist was new. They did nothing to resolve that and instead they tried to charge me extra for late checkout the day before I was supposed to leave. The manager doesn’t even know how to speak, concise English, she’s very hard to understand. This location is dirty and disgusting this JW zero stars.

reviews.author: Char
reviews.title: The best of the best
reviews.body: My husband and I had a great stay.  Customer service was top notch. We will be back

reviews.author: Visting all 30
reviews.title: Great place to stay for visiting Loan Depot Park to see the Red Sox play the Miami Marlins
reviews.body: The hotel is only a short Uber Ride away from the Ballpark. Food was excellent in all 3 restaurants. Nice clean and quiet hotel. Excellent value for the money. Friendly staff.

reviews.author: Jason H
reviews.title: One of the best JWs in the world.
reviews.body: Perfect hotel. I stay in JW hotels throughout the year and have stayed at the other Miami JW locations.  The Marquis is hands down the best!

reviews.author: Timothy
reviews.title: High expectations with low results
reviews.body: Apart from bell boys opening the door and over priced valet parking the technology offered is very outdated. Rooms are large but the bathing is very uncomfortable. Pillows are very old and uncomfortable. There is nothing offered to you that makes you feel the dollar is well spent. When the AC is turned of you can smell mold within the building. I would never recommend this location to anyone

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Check in delayed, didn’t have my room rate correct
reviews.body: Check in was delayed and we missed going out with friends on time.  Didn’t have the correct room rate I paid for, had to talk to the manager to get it corrected or would have lost hundreds of dollars.  Very disappointed in the experience.  Hotel is otherwise great

reviews.author: Kathryn Wharton
reviews.title: Poor service and false advertising
reviews.body: Marriott marquis falsely advertising that we could return an enterprise rental car at their location.  Once on site they would not let us do this after we drove 4 hours across the state.  They flippantly told us to take to another Marriott location or said we could park it here for 79$ night.

reviews.author: Andrea M
reviews.title: See Mr. Andre for your stay!
reviews.body: My stay was exceptional.  Mr.  Andre is more than happy to help you with all of your needs.  He made sure that my stay was perfect!

reviews.author: Rmassy
reviews.title: Overall stay
reviews.body: I had a lovely stay at the hotel. The room was clean and comfortable, and the staff were friendly and helpful. Overall, I enjoyed my stay and would happily recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Dakota Titanium Elite
reviews.title: 5 Star experience
reviews.body: Clean, strong attention to detail, and amazingly helpful staff. Highly recommend this hotel for your next stay in Miami. Location is excellent and the hotel has every amenity you’d need.

reviews.author: Mallory G
reviews.title: Excellent Treatment for this Titanium Member
reviews.body: I’ve been a Marriott client since 1984 when my profession at that time required my living in cities for lengthy periods of time because of the business consulting that I was involved in.  My first Marriott was in Orlando on Sand Lake Rd, which is no longer a Marriott, but I lived there for almost one year.  This was pre Marriott Bonvoy days but they did have a stay program where one earned points.  Those points eventually paid for many vacations with my wife, which was certainly appreciated.  Years later I continued with the Marriott Bonvoy program where I’ve been a Gold, Platinum and Titanium member for  decades.  In another year I’ll reach permanent Platinum status.  The point of my telling you this, is I’m well aware of the fact that Marriott hotels are franchises and can run their hotels any way they like with respect to the MB member benefits that one supposedly has at their particular membership level.  I of course, at the Platinum or Titanium level is supposed to have the benefit of hotel upgrades to a suite if it’s “available.”  Unfortunately, most hotels rarely if ever provide me with a suite upgrade. In fact, over the decades that I’ve been a beneficiary of that benefit on paper, I’ve had perhaps a half dozen occasions where a hotel provided me with a suite upgrade, and yours was one of those half a dozen hotels over the course of decades as a top tier member.  We both know you don’t have to do this and could do what most hotels do, and refuse to provide a suite upgrade because they think they’ll rent it, even in the same day that I check in.  I’ve even been at many hotels where this occurs and after checking in I’ll call the hotel to ask if they have any suites available that night and I’ve never had any hotel tell me that they didn’t have suites available.  The long/short is I wanted to thank you for making my and my wife’s stay with much more enjoyable with your kindness shown with the upgrade.

reviews.author: JimmyG
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.body:
Wow this hotel goes way beyond.  
 They made me feel like a VIP the entire time I was there.

reviews.author: DS333
reviews.title: Follow through delays
reviews.body: Billing Problem not resolved and takes numerous calls to get addressed

reviews.author: Miami123
reviews.title: Nice Hotel but Poorly Managed
reviews.body: The hotel was beautiful and staff was nice BUT the entire hotel was poorly managed.  The front desk staff never had a straight answer to our questions, they gave our room to another couple and they walked in on me, the pool never had enough towels, the food service at the pool was incredible slow and the bartenders at the wedding couldn't make a simple drink or the "signature" drink.

reviews.author: Vanessa Leon
reviews.title: Fantastic Hospitality!
reviews.body: The team that works at this hotel is truly incredible! attentive, kind, hospitable and charming! From the check-in/ check-out experience, the lounge in the second floor, the coffee shop and the game /pool floor area. We had an exceptional stay. 10/10

reviews.author: Aj010
reviews.title: A Little More Recognition for Elite Members
reviews.body:
Overall, we had a very pleasant stay and enjoyed the hotel. The room was comfortable, the service was good, and the location was convenient.

My only disappointment was the lack of recognition for my Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status. I understand that room upgrades are subject to availability, so I did not expect a guaranteed upgrade. However, I would have appreciated even a small gesture of recognition, especially given the level of the hotel.

Overall, it was a great stay, but better recognition of elite members would have made the experience even better.

reviews.author: Ryan T
reviews.title: Excellent stay in the heart of Miami.
reviews.body: Great sizable and clean room.  Amenities - gym, spa, sauna, locker space are all well maintained and clean.  Lounge staffs are friendly and breakfast selections are decent.

reviews.author: John D
reviews.title: Worst stay
reviews.body: Facilities worn down, rude staff. Telephones in the rooms are not working. Poor telephone services. Overall worst hotel experience

reviews.author: Melindagirls
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.body: Jonathan and the staff were excellent! Will stay there every time I am in Miami and will recommend to friends and family!

reviews.author: Darius
reviews.title: Exactly what I was looking for in a stay
reviews.body: The room was clean and aesthetically pleasing. When you think about a stay in Miami this is exactly what you want.

reviews.author: CW33
reviews.title: Sweet Stay
reviews.body: Will certainly come back. Thank you to the front desk, housekeeping and spa teams!

reviews.author: PerfectPreCruiseStay
reviews.title: Exceptional Pre-Cruise Sanctuary & Top-Notch Bonvoy Treatment!
reviews.body:
The JW Marriott Marquis Miami exceeded every expectation! Arriving exhausted from an early bird flight at 9:30 AM before our cruise, we were blown away that our room was already ready—hours before standard check-in.

As Bonvoy members, the service and recognition were outstanding. We enjoyed a delicious breakfast at the restaurant and then spent a relaxing morning decompressing by the gorgeous pool area on the incredibly comfortable lounge beds. Once we got to our room, the bed was so plush and comfortable that we peacefully slept the rest of the day away until dinner.

The combination of serene luxury, immaculate amenities, and world-class hospitality made this the ultimate start to our vacation. We highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Miami or preparing for a cruise!

reviews.author: ReeseK
reviews.title: Beautiful luxurious hotel
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay at this hotel.   It exceeded our expectations.  We were welcomed by staff. The room was beautiful and very clean. I especially loved the roof top pool. The food was really tasty. Make sure you get the burger.  It was amazing. We are planning our next stay at this hotel.

reviews.author: Dannyg
reviews.title: I was expecting more
reviews.body: I absolutely loved the hotel, and the room was beautifully decorated—spacious and luxurious. However, there are a couple of areas where the resort could improve. The automated AI phone service was a bit of a hassle; reaching the front desk felt like a mission. Even when I finally got through, my request didn’t make it to the room. I ended up using the app to chat and resubmit my request, and it was finally delivered hours later. To top it off, the AC stopped cooling in the middle of the night. I was already tired and frustrated, so I decided to just deal with it rather than go through the hassle of calling the front desk and waiting for a technician. Despite these minor issues, I really love the hotel, and for the price, I think these details could be improved.

reviews.author: FN825
reviews.title: One Night Stay at Hotel Beaux Arts, Autograph Miami
reviews.body: Overall guest stay was excellent, with view of Bay and Port from high-level floor.  The overall service and recognition as a Bonvoy Platinum Member were excellent.  My room was very well appointed, modern and with amenities, features, and furnishing I normally find in luxury hotels (separate walk-in shower, soaking tub, commode and two sink vanity.  Though I had a minor issue with in-room dining items, overall, I had a great experience with this hotel.

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.title: A Fine Stay at Hotel Beaux Arts
reviews.body: We had the pleasure of staying at Hotel Beaux Arts for a one night stay. Overall, the accommodations were good. The room was clean, service was great, and the amenities gave plenty to do. It’s also in a great location and walkable to many restaurants & stores! With that being said, the room is a bit dated in style and the hotel itself has a bit of wear & tear.

reviews.author: Stefan
reviews.title: Good hotel
reviews.body: Good hotel, slow answering reception, Not helpful unfortunately. Nice suite, breakfast was OK.

reviews.author: Stephen J
reviews.title: Amazing Stay and Super Friendly Staff
reviews.body:
This was my third consecutive stay with my wife and son,  From Big Smiles And Warmth Welcome From Tiffany, Stefany & Mary, These are the lovely ladies who welcome you at reception. 

The house keeping ladies do a marvelous job and most importantly they are very honest and trustworthy. I left all of my electronics in the room and came back and met everything there. The rooms are very spacious and bed is huge for a family of three to sleep on.

Downstairs on Floor 2 the concierge breakfast team is the best, Excellent service from Perez, Noah, The Guy in the Pink Shirt who was there every morning and also Camila, Nick the manager also check in on us, Warmth Greeted smiles and they ensure you are properly well taken of. The breakfast team keep up the excellent job. My wife says a special thank you for the Cheese Toast and the lovely service. 

The valet parking guys also do an amazing job always there to give you that assistance when leaving or coming back to the hotel.

 If you are looking for a family oriented or even romantic stay let here be the only option. 

The pool area very clean and gym area also. The most clean, safe and welcoming environment, that sweet aroma from the lobby and amazing staff around the hotel. I highly recommend. 

Also much thanks to the 2 beautiful managers who ensures your stay is the best while there -  Ms. Eugenia and Ms. Loida continue  the amazing job in Empowering your team and providing great memories for your guests.

 I look forward in coming back soon.

Stay Safe 
Stephen J.

reviews.author: Five stars
reviews.title: The best experience
reviews.body: Highly recommend. Was perfect in every way.

reviews.author: Sunny
reviews.title: Remember The brush for your thumb 26 Yes No
reviews.body: Outstanding staff and a super property

reviews.author: numbers and letters only
reviews.title: Crazy expensive Valet was non-responsive
reviews.body: Day one used the room phone to retrieve my vehicle, not there 15 minutes later, "We don't answer that message line, you have to text the number on your tag" Day two used the tablet provided in the room to retrieve my vehicle, not there 15 minutes later, "We don't know where those messages go, text us for best service" Day three texted the number on my tag, not there 25 minutes later! three guys standing around and no cars around. "He's getting your car" and showed up 10 minutes later. 35 minute wait for my vehicle using their suggested method and the best service was the worst of three days!!! $225 for AWFUL VALET SERVICES!!!

reviews.author: 99FreqTrav
reviews.title: Disappointed in the System of Marriott
reviews.body: Marriott’s Hotel Beaux Arts, Autograph Collection did not deliver what was Confirmed to me in writing.

reviews.author: ReasonableYesterday
reviews.title: Fantastic Location and Character
reviews.body: Beaux Arts is a wonderful hotel on the upper floors of the JW Marriott. It is in a prime location in downtown Miami close to transit. It has a distinct character with pleasant art and architectural design. Service is top-notch. Glad we stayed.

reviews.author: DanFromChicago
reviews.title: Surprise jewel in the heart of downtown Miami.
reviews.body: We were looking for a hotel in Miami for a weekend wedding at Viscaya.  I found Hotel Beaux Arts during a search of the Bonvoy app for close properties.  We were pleasantly surprised.  Hotel Beaux Arts is a hotel in a hotel, located on the top 3 floors of the JW Marriott Marquis, and feels exclusive beginning from checkin (private checkin on 39th floor).  It is in downtown Miami, near the convention center, 15 minutes from MIA, and walking distance to Miami's downtown riverwalk.  The location has residential urban feel (with Whole Foods down the block) Because it is downtown, it's not a beach  resort.  But there is plenty to do: riverwalk, pool, golf simulator, bowling lanes, indoor tennis court, ping pong and pool table, spa, etc.  Guests also have access to JW Marriott facilities, including health club, and Executive Lounge.  We would stay here again if we had business in/near downtown Miami or Coconut Grove.

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.title: Customer service horrible
reviews.body:
I have a Marriott gift card. I was not able to bring it up on my phone when checking in. It’s a $400 gift card that i got for being a Marriott member with a Marriott credit card. 
I was checked into the wrong room but moved rooms on day 2. 
I got home and called to have my gift card applied to my stay and was told by hotel staff that I could only use the gift card in person. I’m not happy!

reviews.author: Love to read and travel
reviews.title: Excellent hotel with amazing amenities and staff!
reviews.body: This hotel is wonderful!  The rooms and amenities are top notch.   The food is excellent - but the staff is the true gem!  They make you feel so special and deliver top service!

reviews.author: Greenie3843
reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.body: I had high hopes for my first trip to Miami in over a decade. I wanted to stay in a good location in a beautiful setting. Being an art lover, Beaux Arts seemed to fit the bill. I tried to reach the staff at the hotel before my arrival on three separate occasions  to alter my reservation- but no luck. I got an email asking about my favorite artist and was excited to see why they asked; but nothing ever came of it. Once I arrived, I had some questions and the person who checked me in did not answer questions at all. I felt very disengaged from the experience of being in a luxury environment. Once we got our room, we immediately noticed there weren't enough towels (even for two people). We asked for more and eventually got them. We asked to have our room cleaned multiple times and it never happened. I was so disappointed because had really high hopes. I don't recommend and would advise people to stay at any of the other hotels in the area.

reviews.author: Misleading
reviews.title: Not an Autograph Hotel
reviews.body: Very disappointing.  Not a unique Autograph property but three floors in tired Marriott.  Pretty much have to wait for an elevator to go 40 floors back to lobby levels for any form of service.  Very misleading and deceptive advertising by Bonvoy.

reviews.author: MILES81
reviews.title: No worth it
reviews.body: This place is not as good as the JW property so don’t expect anything special. I’m an ambassador elite and was treated like a silver member.

reviews.author: Bjode1
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: It was excellent all the way there’s hotels and there’s this hotel the best

reviews.author: ClayC
reviews.title: Worth considering for a downtown stay
reviews.body:
The good: I was impressed with the staff, the amenities of the Marquis are outstanding, unlike other Marriott properties, they are not rationing housekeeping here.  By amazing coincidence, this was the cleanest Marriott room I have seen in years!

The bad: With all of the various emails I received to prepare me for my stay, not a single one pointed out that I needed assistance from the Marquis staff in order to reach check-in on the 39th floor.  As a result, my first impression of Hotel Beaux was a frustrating experience going nowhere in the elevator.  The bathroom was seemingly designed by AI...a total triumph of form over function.  Just because every hotel in south Florida charges an "amenity fee" doesn't mean that your expensive downtown hotel has to charge one too.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great place and people.
reviews.body: Hotel was very clean, people very helpful, and cared for us being one of their guests.

reviews.author: DavidY
reviews.title: 5 Star Stay
reviews.body: The ability to use the concierge club is an added plus.  The chef, David and Erwin at the club were amazing and their desire to meet everyone’s needs is to be commended. Mary at the check in desk on the 39th floor went over and above with her service .  All the staff treated us with kindness and attempted to be very helpful.

reviews.author: Angie
reviews.title: Great stay and location
reviews.body: Second time staying at this hotel and they do not disappoint.  The room is amazing,  staff gave great customer service.  Awesome amenities,  close to Bayside Marketplace.  This will be my regular location to stay at when I come to Miami for my cruises

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Walls too thin.... music blasting next door preventing virtually any sleep
reviews.body: see above - hotel location is great, but music next door sounded like a concert and complaints to front-desk did not resolve issue.   Music was playing loudly until 5 5:30am

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.title: An Unforgettable Stay at Hotel Beaux Arts Miami
reviews.body:
My stay at Hotel Beaux Arts was absolutely beautiful. The hotel itself is stunning — elegant, clean, and welcoming from the moment you walk in.

Melody was truly amazing! She went above and beyond to make my birthday extra special by surprising me with an incredible fruit and chocolate tray, a thoughtful handwritten card, and complimentary water. It was such a kind and personal touch that made me feel genuinely appreciated as a guest.

The customer service throughout the hotel was top tier — every interaction was warm, professional, and attentive. I can’t recommend this hotel enough and will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: TDL
reviews.title: Not on Autograph brand standard
reviews.body: if you are looking for the unique feature and story of an Autograph Brand then choose wisely. It is just 3 floors in a JW which is fine but not differentiated. In fact all of the amenities are in the JW areas. Not rating Dining and Amenities as a result.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Felt like a queen
reviews.body: In highly recommend this hotel. From the moment I arrived I was treated like a queen. They even upgraded my room to the biggest suite. Outstanding views and outstanding service. I didn’t want to leave.

reviews.author: Henry G
reviews.title: Excellent hotel.
reviews.body: Our experience at the Beaux Arts, Autograph Collection Hotel was far better than we expected. We were amazed by the style and quality of service. We were assigned a corner suite with a wonderful view from the 40th floor. The room was like a beautifully decorated apartment. A spectacular touch was the jacuzzi and the spacious bathroom. Breakfast was very good. It truly is a hidden gem in the heart of Downtown Miami, with an excellent location.

reviews.author: STEPHEN J
reviews.title: EXCEPTIONAL EXPERIENCE
reviews.body:
This is the second consecutive year I stayed at Hotel Beaux Arts Miami. The staff here really treats you like family. They go above an beyond to ensure all guests are comfortable and satisfied.

Thank You Moodley who checked us in and give us that family welcome and also Gabriella & Loida. The staff and management is very hard working and they Will go to moon and stars to ensure your stay is satisfying.

The pleasant smiles from both the young lady in the Arabic wear and the managers and the breakfast buffet. Around my stay I bump into the managers in the elevator and they as well was very pleasant to ask how are you and if you are enjoying your stay.

Valet Parking is 100% effective and efficent. The guys who help you with your luggage also cool and friendly.

House Keeping Ladies are a gem, they do an marvelous job in cleaning your suite and also they are trustworthy, i left all of my electronic devices; laptop camera go pro etc on the table and they did not even moved it. Thank You House keeping for your trust and honesty....

I WANT TO SAY THANK YOU. And Please keep up the great and wonderful job you guys are doing. See you next year again.

Stephen ❤️.

reviews.author: Excellent
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Excellent service and staff.   I love  this property as it is in a good location.  It is good for business or pleasure.  I enjoy being near to  the city center

reviews.author: J A Svengali
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel!
reviews.body: Bathroom was top tier, best bed I slept on in any hotel! Service was perfect! Lovely hotel!

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Nothing Special about the Beaux Arts
reviews.body: If you are experiencing a first class experience you won’t get it, just a few nice pictures on the walls.  Service was terrible and just another way to charge more for nothing.

reviews.author: James
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: This hotel was great. Good location, staff was very accommodating and friendly, the suite was a lot of space for the value, and the room was very clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: Myriam
reviews.title: Don’t hesitate
reviews.body: Great place to stay, people are so kind. We took our kids and they had a great time. Food was excellent

reviews.author: J Dahl
reviews.title: Good Place for Stopover
reviews.body: Stayed there before leaving on our cruise. It was very convenient

reviews.author: Linda Bostick
reviews.title: Great area
reviews.body: The hotel is in very localized spot. The shops close to hotel. CVS, whole foods,Aldis, everything in walking distance. If you are cruising or just want a cool place to stay. I recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: No
reviews.title: Family Stay
reviews.body: Great location between MIA Airport & Cruise Port with shuttles.

reviews.author: Daniel Young
reviews.title: Great Place To Stay
reviews.body: Great place to stay. Conveinent to cruise port. Great location!

reviews.author: Chunter92026
reviews.title: Extremely unhappy with this unsafe hotel
reviews.body: I do not recommend you staying here if you're coming with family or children. It's an unsafe, dirty environment with the lack of security and I would never stay here ever again.  The hotel smelt like marijuana the staff ignored me ignored my requests. The elevator was broken. There were dead rats in the stairwell. And I was literally frightened during my stay.

reviews.author: Lpena
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.body: The wait for check-in is crazy— I’ve never waited so long to be checked in. The bistro closes way too early, so it adds another inconvenience. The staff does really intervene when people walk in from out of the street that are on drugs or alcoholics, so you have random folks coming into the lobby that make it unsafe. I would never recommend this Marriott or stay there again.

reviews.author: Cruisers
reviews.title: Fine Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel is clean and friendly, but VERY loud at night. The nightlife and cars honking are extremely loud and makes it very hard to sleep.

reviews.author: Cruising 2026
reviews.title: Comfy bed
reviews.body: The bed was super comfy. The pool was out of service but a pool at a neighboring hotel could be used. Please note that gratuity is already included when you purchase food and drinks in the hotel restaurant

reviews.author: Eboni B
reviews.title: Pre-Cruise Stay
reviews.body: We stayed at this hotel for 2 nights with a family of 22. Mostly everything was good until it was miscommunication with the pool. One staff member told us it closes at 7, another staff member said it was under renovations, so we were a bit confused. The third party cruise shuttle that we used were unprofessional. They loaded some of my family on a shuttle, then told us to get off and get on another shuttle because they wanted to fill it out with another family, when I looked to see if it was enough seats on the other shuttle it wasn’t. My family had to wait another hour to get another shuttle very inconvenient.

reviews.author: not a good stay
reviews.title: business trip but no real way to relax after work
reviews.body: was not told in advance that the pool would be closed in the middle of August...even though beaches are less than 5 miles away the drive to get there could take upwards of a half hour or more...would have been nice to have the pool to cool off in after a hard days work

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Okay One-night Stay
reviews.body:
We stayed one night before our cruise out of Miami and one night after returning from the cruise.  The bistro was par at best.

The staff was very nice and helpful.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Excellent Service & Accommodations
reviews.body:
Marriott is always my first choice for a stay away from home. We stayed at the Marriott with a group of 13 people across four rooms, and I want to especially recognize Vondra, who assisted us with check-in.

Managing a group that size can come with a few challenges, but Vondra was incredibly accommodating. When she noticed an issue, she didn’t simply point it out—she specifically asked, “How can I help?” She listened, came up with solutions, and actually followed through and implemented them.

Her kindness, professionalism, and willingness to problem-solve made a real difference. She helped make what could have been a stressful check-in experience smooth and comfortable for our entire group.

Vondra is an excellent example of what great hospitality looks like, and she truly helped make our stay at the Marriott a comfortable and enjoyable one. Thank you, Vondra!

reviews.author: Rocky
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: everyone was polite when we first arrived we needed to switch rooms they helped us with no problem and they also found both rooms on the same floor for us. then they gave us complimentary drinks for my sons birthday they were really nice

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.title: Very clean and convenient to port
reviews.body: Very nice and clean hotel. Staff was friendly and welcoming. It was close to the port.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.title: Courtyard by Marriott Miami
reviews.body: The hotel was in great location to bayside and easy to get to port of Miami, the hotel was clean, and staff helpful , however the pool was shutdown which was a big disappointment cuz we checked in early to use it.

reviews.author: C2J
reviews.title: Check before you book a room
reviews.body: The entrance was difficult to find and on a very busy street.  Pool closed. No restaurant - just a bar to order at a counter.

reviews.author: Steve G
reviews.title: Always a great choice!
reviews.body: The Courtyard Marriott is always my go-to hotel when I am in Miami.  The staff is friendly and accommodating, and the rooms are always in excellent condition.  I   Never give it a second thought when I need to plan a stay!

reviews.author: Dbbermuda
reviews.title: Stay before cruise. 8/2026
reviews.body: Good stay, great location. Front desk associate, Tawanda (not sure if the spelling is correct) she was awesome

reviews.author: From NYC
reviews.title: A one star motel in a five star coat.
reviews.body:
Don’t book here. It’s bad. 
The rooms are very small. The bathroom is oddly laid out. And the views are only parking garages and highways. The over all hotel feels old and dilapidated. Go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Stinky
reviews.title: Downtown Get Around
reviews.body: Close to a variety of eats and attractions. Easy walking distance to venues and restaurants. Onsite restaurant was excellent for our breakfast meals. Get plenty busy either cruise traffic.

reviews.author: Jamie V
reviews.title: Clean, comfortable, enjoyable experience, beds are overly firm though
reviews.body: We had a lovely stay. Things were clean and staff was polite and very helpful. The bed was very overly firm though so sleep the first night was very rough. We had to request a couple extra soft pillows to lay down and sleep on top of to protect our back and hips. Would be nice if they had plush mattress toppers you could request.

reviews.author: Kathleen Galicia
reviews.title: Marriott - Miami
reviews.body:
Amazing hotel and service. Shuttle to port was a nice instead of requesting an uber.
Registration desk representative was very informative and friendly. The room, breakfast area and lounge area are very clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: CR
reviews.title: Stay at your own risk
reviews.body: My original reservation for no card on file but yet told me to pay at the hotel. The lady at the desk was nice and helped get my family a room however it smelled spoiled and like mildew. But at 1 am I'm not fighting over a room. The AC did a loud knocking noise all night. So annoying we were out bright and early. Never again

reviews.author: Family guests
reviews.title: Check the mattresses in suites
reviews.body: Mattresses in suites were filthy dirty and way too small

reviews.author: Blossom
reviews.title: Shay was the best
reviews.body: Shay made my crisis a lot better and did her best to accommodate myself and my 2 sons.

reviews.author: Attics
reviews.title: King room does not sleep 4 as advertised
reviews.body: I would not book here again.

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.title: Poor customer service not friendly staff
reviews.body: Staff acted like it was my fault they gave me keys to someone else’s room

reviews.author: HQ
reviews.title: Great for a cruise departure stay
reviews.body: Short ride to the port with hotel provided shuttle, friendly staff, clean rooms and common areas. If glam and pretty immediate surrounding aren't high on your list, stay here because it's a good value, comfortable, and convenient.

reviews.author: Sheila B
reviews.title: Would not go back
reviews.body: Poor service, shower was leaking on to the floor and shower wand was broken. No one wanted to help and fix the problem.

reviews.author: Olga2026Miami
reviews.title: Amazing stay!!
reviews.body: Everything was truly perfect. Room was good for one person, might be a bit on a small side for two. Perfect location - close to everything. CVS 24h is right around the corner.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Couple getaway
reviews.body: We went only us two as a couple and we loved everything. Definitely will be coming back. A perfect place to have fun because everything is near and to relax.

reviews.author: Sonia
reviews.title: Third citizenM Stay, and I’m Still a Fan!
reviews.body:
This was my third stay at a citizenM property, and the brand continues to be one of my favorites. I love the modern design, laid-back atmosphere, smart-room technology, and the overall vibe that makes citizenM feel different from a traditional hotel.

The Miami Worldcenter location was perfect for our trip. It’s conveniently located near Bayside Marketplace, restaurants, entertainment, and several Miami attractions, and it’s also a great option if you’re cruising out of the Port of Miami. We found it easy to get around and loved having so much nearby.

If you’ve never stayed at a citizenM, the rooms are compact but thoughtfully designed, and the overall experience makes great use of the space. For travelers who appreciate modern hotels, technology, convenience, and a lively atmosphere, this location is definitely worth considering.

Three citizenM stays later, I’m still a fan and would happily book another!

reviews.author: HappyGuest
reviews.title: The best hotel experience in Miami!⁠
reviews.body: Amazing pool and safe location!

reviews.author: Erika A
reviews.title: Great place to stay before a cruise.
reviews.body: This place was convenient to the cruise port. A great Marriott find. Reasonably priced, good food, coffee and very clean room.

reviews.author: Hallyboy580
reviews.title: Decent hotel near the waterfront
reviews.body: It's a nice hotel, close to the bayfront and transportation. Shower leaked and refrigerator wasn't cold. Pool and rooftop bar were nice.

reviews.author: Jen 26
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Miami
reviews.body:
My adult daughter and I stayed for one night ahead of a cruise from the port of Miami.
It is a great place. Lots of comfortable seating for the hanging around involved in waiting to board ship, great staff and food and facilities

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: BETTER PLACE EVER
reviews.body: THE STAFF WAS GREAT. I LOVE EVERYTHING

reviews.author: April Love
reviews.title: Wonderful stay for solo travelers
reviews.body: This was the perfect day for people traveling by themselves! The rooms were cozy, but efficient, and the location of the hotel was perfect because it’s easily accessible to a lot of the main transit lines in Miami.

reviews.author: Anecia
reviews.title: perfect
reviews.body: Perfect in every possible way

reviews.author: Tod from Va
reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay
reviews.body: Highly recommended. Rooms were very comfortable and clean

reviews.author: Shime
reviews.title: CitizenM for Magnificent!
reviews.body:
The place is immaculate, and every staff member that I came in contact with was extremely friendly and knowledgeable of the hotel and the surrounding area. 
The manager of the hotel Jorge, was wonderful as he was very helpful and informative and just an all around nice person. 
The staff was also amazing as they gave off such a friendly vibe and it made us feel so welcomed. The bartenders were very knowledgeable about the drinks and were also extremely helpful to us about the area.

reviews.author: Ramos
reviews.title: Love it here
reviews.body: Amazing hotel and location

reviews.author: Sarah E
reviews.title: Not Ideal
reviews.body: Hotel is clean and cleverly decorated but that is where the novelty ends.  There are no ice machines, no room service and in my experience- NO HOT WATER.  The motorized blinds took a million button pushes and 17 minutes (literally!) to go down.  After it rained, about an hour later we tried to use the pool and we were told it was too slippery and not available.  Too slippery?  It's a pool! We weren't trying to run around it, we were trying to swim IN it.  The people at the front desk, when told about these issues, basically just shrugged it off.  I will not be back nor would I recommend this hotel to others.

reviews.author: Nicolas
reviews.title: Good location
reviews.body: Very friendly staff, good quality breakfast buffet

reviews.author: Daly Destinations
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: I love this hotel. GREAT vibe. clean. unique rooms. love the rooftop bar and pool area.

reviews.author: HMS1234
reviews.title: Just dirty
reviews.body: I really have enjoyed my stays in other locations, but the Miami location is very dirty. I also paid for a Premium view and it was literally a view of the parking lot next door.

reviews.author: MaeBee
reviews.title: Mae's stay
reviews.body: Awesome staff and amenities! Super clean and comfortable.  I will definitely be back soon!!

reviews.author: Paulette
reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.body: The staff was friendly. The hotel was in a beautiful, location; so close to the cruise terminal. Very tech forward. Had everything we needed.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Perfect! Thank you :)
reviews.body: Great hotel with a perfect location. The room was clean and comfortable, and the staff were very friendly and helpful. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Kalet
reviews.title: Worst hotel stay away!!!!!!
reviews.body: This was the worst stay ever…..actually I left I lost what I paid because I didn’t even stay the night the room is small the shower is small the toilet is practically in the shower the bed is uncomfortable and the ac didn’t cool the room was an oven. The staff is unhelpful and don’t care this was the worst decision ever I preferred to lose what I paid for. Went for a concert and after wards preferred to drive back home 2 and a half hours at midnight then stay in this hotel………STAY AWAY ITS NOT GOOD

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Great at EVERYTHING. Service, Room, View, Location, Amenities, all of it is GREAT.

reviews.author: Terrance
reviews.title: Vacation 2026
reviews.body: It was ok I traveled with family

reviews.author: Ma23
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: My time at citizen M was lovely. I loved the rooftop bar and pool. Only downside was that our AC was not working, we however did get a fan sent to our room to help with the heat.

reviews.author: CyndiR
reviews.title: Great hotel, but customer service could improve
reviews.body: The hotel is modern, clean, and very well located. I really enjoyed the room, the facilities, and the overall concept. However, the customer service could be improved. As an international guest whose first language is Spanish, I sometimes found it difficult to communicate with the staff and did not always feel they were patient or welcoming when I needed assistance. I understand that English is the main language, but in a city like Miami, a little more support and friendliness toward international guests would make a big difference. Overall, I enjoyed my stay, but better customer service would have made the experience excellent.

reviews.author: James C
reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.body: Love this place. Room and staff was amazing. Energy and vibe was great. Room was an efficiency but was so nice and all that I needed. Will use them again

reviews.author: Cruise Vacationer
reviews.title: Exceptional Staff at an Excellent hotel and location
reviews.body: JoJo was an amazing host. He made us feel welcome as we waited for our room to become available. He has the most positive outlook and he was so friendly. He truly cared and he was so knowledgeable about the area. He made our one night stay memorable. Along with JoJo, LuLu helped to make our dining experience fulfilling and so pleasant. All the staff were so friendly and helpful,  but a few stood out. We look forward to staying here on our next visit and I've already recommended this hotel to others. Keep up the great service.

reviews.author: Chenere01
reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ An Amazing Stay at citizenM Miami Worldcenter
reviews.body:
I would definitely rate my stay 5/5! From the moment I arrived, I loved everything about this hotel.

The room was clean, comfortable, and the perfect size for a solo traveler. The staff were all kind, welcoming, and friendly, which made the experience even better.

I have to give a special shoutout to Alejandro! He was incredibly kind and sweet and honestly made my stay so much better. He went above and beyond to make me feel welcomed and even recommended a few places for me to visit during my stay. I really appreciated his kindness and helpfulness. I was actually sad that he wasn’t there on the day I checked out because I didn’t get the chance to say goodbye!

The location was also great and very central to so many things to do, which made getting around really convenient.

The breakfast was delicious! My only suggestion would be to have a little more variety and different options on different days, since the menu was mostly the same during my stay.

The only thing I didn’t particularly like was the key card. I found myself misplacing it a few times, so I think something like a wristband or another hands-free option would be much more convenient for guests.

Overall, I loved my stay and had such a great experience. I would absolutely recommend citizenM Miami Worldcenter, and I will definitely be back soon! ❤️

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.body:
This hotel is truly beautiful and the staff is very helpful and friendly. Overall, my stay there was great and the location is also very convenient. 

My only negatives are;

-mini fridge is fully stocked with items you have to pay for, leaving zero room to store anything (a bottle of water, or medication). 
-I was charged for mini bar food/items when I touched absolutely nothing from that area. Contacting someone to help me with this is now going on a week, with absolutely no one helping or rectifying. Make sure you check your bill thoroughly.

Room and housekeeping very very poor 
Will never stay there again. Wasted money
