reviews.title: 2 star Hotel
reviews.body: Wonderful food, very bad services, dirty areas around pool, no service in our suite, dirty jacuzzi in the suite. I will not recommend the Hotel, is a lot better and cleaner Hotels 3 start with a lot better services

reviews.author: Eddie Rob
reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Unforgettable Birthday Stay at Hotel Beauden
reviews.body:
We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Hotel Beauden, Autograph Collection while celebrating my wife Claudia’s birthday. From the moment we arrived, the staff went above and beyond to make our stay feel special.

We were incredibly surprised and grateful to be upgraded to a beautiful King Suite with a Jacuzzi. The room was amazing and immediately made what was already a special occasion even more memorable.

Dinner at Libra, the hotel’s signature restaurant, was another highlight of our stay.  The staff had our table beautifully decorated for Claudia’s birthday, and the attention to detail meant so much to us. Everything about the evening—the atmosphere, the service, the restaurant, and the way the staff helped us celebrate—made her birthday feel truly special.

We honestly could not have asked for a more memorable evening or a better stay. Hotel Beauden helped turn Claudia’s birthday into an experience we will always remember.

Thank you to everyone at Hotel Beauden and Libra for making us feel so welcome and for making Claudia’s birthday so special. We will absolutely be staying here again!

I’d give the hotel and our experience 5 stars without hesitation.

reviews.author: New York Riley
reviews.title: New Name, Even Better Experience
reviews.body: It took some adjusting to see the Grand Bohemian leave but welcome to the next generation of Hotel Beauden. Even more impressive and far more personal than ever.

reviews.author: Christy
reviews.title: Family event
reviews.body: So appreciated working with the catering staff who helped with menu selections and they were flexible regarding the changes to the prescribed menu.

reviews.author: Carol Lyn
reviews.title: Beautiful Property - but disappointed!!!
reviews.body:
The property is absolutely stunning. The main lobby bar had excellent drink and quality service. I checked in around 1pm because my marriott bonvoy app said our room was ready at 10 am. Upon checking in I was advised there would be a $50 early check in fee-- when the room was already ready?! Later, I received a texted thanking us for checking in from Manager Mohammed. I expressed back via text the dissatisfaction of learning of a early check in fee when the room was already ready and received a response back saying it would be waived. I checked out the following morning following up with this waiver of fee- and the front desk clerk has no record of it. She then spoke to Manager Mohammed - who reviewed my text also having no idea about it (clearly an AI generated text) and couldnt be bother with it stating to the front desk clerk " I guess remove it" No apology , nothing from either employee. How does staff- including a manager whom a text was supposedly sent from not now about this service they have? If I didnt inquire about it - i would have been charged!

Prior to checking out we completed a valet service via the app - advising we were checking and requesting out car be retrieved. 30 minutes later out car was brought out after asking multiple times and was told each time "someone is getting it" Only to finally ask again and THEN the same individual who told us someone was getting it actually pulled our keys. and we paid $42 for this service.

While I love this property and I know they are re branding soon- I will NOT be back. This is not the Marriott way.

reviews.title: Lux Comfort
reviews.body: Extremely friendly and helpful staff. Super clean rooms. Comfy beds. Great Food. What more could you ask for?

reviews.author: Honcho
reviews.title: Grandson getaway
reviews.body: We went to Orlando to see our new grandson and experienced mixed reviews for the hotel. While the staff was super nice and friendly and helpful we had many small issues pop up during our stay. We did experience some homeless people in the area too which can be concerning at times.

We went out to dinner and came back for a bit before heading out to walk the town. When I woke up in the morning and flipped the pillow to get the cooler side I noticed blood on the pillowcase. I checked everywhere on myself and my wife and there were no signs of blood. Needless to say that really bothered us. Besides that we had an amazing time.

reviews.title: Laquisha McNair

reviews.author: Miriam

I knew the facilities would be great but the team was even better than the facility. Whoever is in leadership is doing an excellent job of building a culture of first class hospitality.

reviews.author: Wanderlust
reviews.title: Grand time at the Grand Bohemian
reviews.body:
From the Champaign service at check in to the friendly bartender writing down their favorite spots we should visit, the Grand Bohemian delivers on all aspects of hospitality.
 Beautifully designed property  with over sized rooms and a great mini bar. There is a solid fitness center that boasts 8 pieces of cardio and two racks of dumbells. and a Starbucks is located off the lobby as well.
 The pool and pool bar were very cozy and comfortable with loungers and many spots to get comfortable. Impressive drink list and friendly bartenders.
  The Bohem restaurant has a wonderful menu and its lounge is swank and sophisticated.
 We will return

reviews.author: Paul B

reviews.author: DisappointedTraveler2026
reviews.title: Beautiful property, Terrible service
reviews.body:
We stayed at your hotel because it was the designated hotel for my cousin’s wedding block. The property itself is beautiful, but unfortunately our experience with the staff overshadowed everything else.

As a busy mom preparing for a family wedding, I was grateful the hotel offered same-day dry cleaning. At check-in, I specifically asked how the service worked and was told that if we dropped our clothing at the front desk before 6:00 a.m., it would be returned the same day. We followed those instructions exactly.

When I asked about our clothing Friday evening, I was told it had already been sent out for cleaning and would be returned by 7:00 a.m. Saturday. The next morning, I learned that wasn’t true. The hotel’s regular dry cleaner was closed on weekends, our clothing had never been picked up, and staff had only begun calling around Saturday morning to find another cleaner.

The mistake itself wasn’t what upset me most. It was the lack of honesty. Had someone simply told us Friday evening that there was a problem, we would have picked up our clothing ourselves and made other arrangements. Instead, we lost that opportunity because we were repeatedly told everything was on track. We ultimately had to coordinate directly with the dry cleaner and drive to pick up our clothing ourselves to make it to the wedding on time. When we got our clothing back, my dress was missing its corset lace and my husband’s suit jacket was missing a button.

At checkout, I explained everything that had happened. The response I received was, “Oh, you drove to get your dry cleaning? We’ll refund one night of parking.” While I appreciated the gesture, it completely missed the point. The issue was never the parking fee—it was the lack of communication and accountability.

Our room also overlooked the pool, and there was very little privacy. Guests at the pool could clearly see into our room—we even had someone wave at us—so we kept our curtains closed for all of our stay.

I also wanted to mention that I had already taken the time to send a detailed email after our stay explaining this experience. I never received any acknowledgment or response. I wasn’t looking for compensation; I simply hoped someone would recognize that the situation had been handled poorly. The lack of any response only reinforced the impression that guest concerns are not taken seriously.

Your hotel is beautiful, but a beautiful property can only go so far. The guest experience is defined by the people, and I hope this feedback encourages a greater focus on honest communication, accountability, and customer care.

reviews.author: Orlando
reviews.title: Orlando

reviews.author: Britt

reviews.body: Stayed here after a family loss, and the hotel staff went above and beyond to be kind, compassionate and supportive.

reviews.author: Ronni
reviews.title: Excellent stay at the Grand Bohemian, Orlando
reviews.body:
My daughter and I recently planned a long weekend getaway to Orlando to celebrate her 35th birthday. Since she absolutely loves Universal Studios, it seemed like the perfect way to mark this special milestone.

From the moment we arrived at the hotel, our experience was exceptional. Although we checked in late, we were warmly welcomed by one of the most friendly, engaging, and genuinely hospitable associates I have ever encountered—Madison Burgess.

Madison immediately made us feel like valued guests. As she checked us in, she asked about our plans for the weekend. When we mentioned Universal Studios, she enthusiastically pulled out a binder filled with resources she had personally created. She provided park maps, handwritten notes highlighting the best attractions in Orlando, recommendations for local restaurants, insider tips for navigating the parks, and her personal list of must-do rides. Her passion for helping us was evident in her enthusiasm.

When I mentioned that my daughter was celebrating her birthday, Madison went above and beyond by offering to help us celebrate with champagne and birthday cake. What made this gesture even more remarkable was that all of this happened before I ever mentioned that I am a Marriott employee and serve as a Creative Director for Marriott's in-house advertising agency, RiottHaus, in New York City. It's apparent Madison's exceptional service was simply who she is—not because of who we were.

I told Madison that she would make an outstanding Concierge based on the incredible knowledge, care, and enthusiasm she shared with us. She explained that becoming a Concierge is her ultimate career goal because she truly enjoys helping guests discover a new city and creating memorable experiences during their stay. It was inspiring to hear how much personal joy she derives from making guests feel welcome.

Throughout our three-day stay, Madison went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed and cared for. She regularly checked in to ensure everything was exceeding our expectations and thoughtfully followed through on her promise to help celebrate my daughter's birthday. During dinner at The Boheme on our second evening, we were delighted to receive champagne and a beautiful birthday cake—a surprise that made the celebration truly magical. Her generosity, attention to detail, and heartfelt hospitality transformed a wonderful trip into an unforgettable experience that we will treasure forever.

Before checking out, I asked to speak with the Manager, Nabil Hawari, because I wanted to personally share how impressed we were with Madison's exceptional service and to recommend that she be promoted to Concierge. Nabil was equally gracious and impressive, taking the time to listen attentively to our feedback and enthusiastically acknowledging Madison's extraordinary dedication, infectious enthusiasm, and genuine passion for guest service. He spoke highly of her many contributions to the hotel, making it clear that her efforts and commitment are both recognized and appreciated. It was wonderful to see such strong leadership and support for a truly outstanding team member.

Our stay at the Grand Bohemian was absolutely wonderful—far too short, in fact. The beautiful property, outstanding dining, and exceptional hospitality made this birthday celebration unforgettable. Most of all, Madison's warmth, professionalism, and genuine commitment to guest service elevated our experience from great to truly extraordinary.

We cannot wait to return and will most definitely be back!

The property was nice and clean but not as nice as other Autograph and Grand Bohemian hotels I have stayed at.

Very nice and comfy room w excellent service at the front desk.

The room was very clean but the noise from the highway was very loud especially at night . They provide earplugs.

reviews.title: Celebrated My Birthday with AC Hotels
reviews.body: I enjoyed this Hotel for my birthday celebration. Everything was very modern and fresh. The rooms were clean and well stocked with soap, rags, towels. The view is breathtaking and the Sky Bar was a treat during my stay. I overall enjoyed this hotel and I would go back.

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.title: No other hotel beats the AC Hotel
reviews.body: My stay turned out better than I ever expected. The staff were amazing, the hotel was clean, and the food was good. No pool but that was okay.

reviews.author: Brad W
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Work trip. Convenient location. Great room. Friendly staff. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.author: Benjamin
reviews.title: Service doesn’t reflect high priced rooms
reviews.body: Service was not up to par with the high priced room we paid for, no new towels had to reuse them since the start of the trip, no new sheets, valet wasn’t always available so had to ask the security and sometimes security wasn’t even there to ask, valet workers kept reving my corvette c8 and kept stepping on it when taking it inside the parking garage, food not even included in high priced room would’ve been better off going with the cheaper hotels

reviews.author: Ethan
reviews.title: Incredible staff
reviews.body: The staff here went above and beyond to create a memorable weekend for me and my fiancé!

reviews.author: Newly Retired
reviews.title: Best Experience
reviews.body: I tend to not expect much especially traveling and staying at a new hotel in a city that I’m a little unfamiliar with but I must say that AC Hotel has made it so that I now expect every experience to be equally impressive. From the time I checked in (early at that) I requested a room at the highest floor available and the staff made it happen without any pushback or negative comments. I was treated with the utmost respect and given consideration which was above and beyond. I will define give the highest recommendations for this hotel and its amenities exceed all expectations.

reviews.author: Jennifer Fitanzo
reviews.title: Amazing customer service

Now when that hotel fills the building with employees who are genuinely friendly nice and have excellent customer service that is what makes the difference above all again a big thank you to Jorge and the team at check-in they helped me significantly, especially Jorge prior week leading up to my arrival.

reviews.author: Dennis

Parking was easy to navigate, check in was smooth and the SkyBar was fantastic! We enjoyed a few apps prior to the show and came back after to enjoy late night creme brulee! The room was updated and clean, and there were complimentary ear plugs to compensate for any street noise. We walked to the venue and the road was well lit and felt safe! Will absolutely stay again!

reviews.author: JX
reviews.title: Great Hotel in Orlando!

reviews.body: Great stay. The hotel is clean, quiet, and in a great location. The lobby smelled fantastic. I had a wonderful gin and tonic at the hotel bar. Highly recommend if you are attending an event at the Kia Center.

reviews.author: MM
reviews.title: Dirty room
reviews.body: I paid almost $300 for just one night when we got to the property there is someone sitting outside but he's not helpful unless you ask him about question. It's our first time at that hotel so we didn't know how parking worked so we asked him and he said valet is $30 and self park is close to $28 and also check in is on the 18th floor which is a bit inconvenient if you have bags and luggage so we did self parking which is in the hotel. We found parking on the 3rd floor so we left our belongings in the car to check in on the 18th floor. Front desk were friendly but just gave a key and no other information like WiFi or menu or food places near by. We asked for a cart for our luggage and were told they had none on that floor which is the check in floor so that was not ok. Now we had to got all the way to the first floor to get a cart which still none were in sight and no one to help, I had to ask some security man and he went to get it for us or rather find one. Now we have the cart and now we have to go back to the 3rd floor for our belongings then go up to the 21st floor to our room. When we get to our room we barely have service so we looking around for instructions for WiFi and room service just anything and there was nothing so we figured it out on our own. Then we noticed our room not being cleaned like the floor and hair in the shower. Also if you want better WiFi they charge you $6 and breakfast is $21 a person and let's not forget the almost $30 parking fee! So now I'm just upset because I paid almost $300 for one night and my room is dirty! I didn't have time to go complain because we were getting reading for our concert but I did start a chat with the property which took hrs to get back to me. Their response was to come clean our room while I'm in the room and that’s not ok!!!

The drinks were so good and the staff was so friendly. I would definitely go back. Shoutout to Kyle for preplanning my special accommodations and Alex for your incredibly hospitality during dinner and drinks.

reviews.author: Texas guy
reviews.title: Orlando stay

The hotel was very clean, shiek, and close proximity to downtown where I was working. 

My room was quiet, clean, modern and the shower was nice.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.title: Greatness

reviews.author: Night Owl Traveler
reviews.title: Bizarre check-in process
reviews.body:
I am a Marriott Bonvoy credit card holder and stayed at the AC Hotel Orlando Downtown from June 29th to July 2nd under my name. 

Due to travel timing, I arrived and checked in after 12:00 AM on June 30th. The reservation was booked using my credit card, though the loyalty account number tied to the booking belongs to my wife. My goal was simply to ensure the points from this paid stay were credited.
Instead of a standard check-in, I was met with a complete lack of hospitality and a bizarre escalation by the front desk agent. Without explaining her actions to me, she abruptly called my wife—waking her up in the middle of the night—to ask "permission" to attach the points.
Worse still, the agent informed me that hotel policy dictated she cancel my entire reservation because the Bonvoy name didn't match mine. She claimed her boss would insist on cancellation and told me she was "doing me a favor" by letting me stay.
While I understand Marriott has strict security policies regarding loyalty accounts, threatening to cancel a guaranteed reservation for a guest standing at the desk with matching ID and credit card is entirely unacceptable. If a loyalty name doesn't match, the standard procedure is to remove the loyalty number, not deny lodging to a guest after midnight. To frame housing a confirmed guest as "doing a favor" is a severe failure in basic customer service.
I am sharing this feedback because I want to ensure future guests are not subjected to this stressful and unprofessional treatment.

reviews.author: Mika

reviews.author: RDB

reviews.body: Location makes it very loud limited food and beverage is a big negative. No coffee station in the lobby. Room was very nice though clean large size had a corner room.

reviews.author: MMJM
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.body: We stayed at the aloft in Orlando to see a concert at the Dr. Philips Center.  The location was adjacent to the theater and was walkable and safe.  The hotel itself is beautiful.  Our room was not the typical bed in a room with a bathroom.  As you walk in there is a table and chairs with a chaise lounge and a television above the table.  The next section is where the lavatory is, which has the sink outside of the shower area separated by a door.  The next section is where the bed is located with a television atop the drawer chest.  The television is on a turntable so that it can be watched from the bed or the next section, which has two chairs and a large, square ottoman/table.  This section is backed by a large window view of the city.  The room was clean and spacious and an exceptional value!

reviews.author: Tpark
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: Just blocks from the park. Starbucks close by. Good sleep, good service, comfortable room.

reviews.author: Ricardo
reviews.title: Great stay in downtown Orlando
reviews.body: If you are in downtown orlando and want a nice hotel experience this is your first option.

reviews.author: Hotel makes me smile
reviews.title: Best staff
reviews.body: I’ve stayed in a lot of Marriott properties over the years… it’s hard to beat the staff at the Orlando Marriott. Always welcoming and smiling - and hotel with a puppy to greet me??? Ivy and the gang at the desk - could not be kinder or more accommodating.  The Bar is always a fun place to relax - I wish they had more food options, but not something that would stop me from visiting the aloft over other properties. Bartenders always mixing and joking around. Also - have been there for some of their events - salsa (the dance not the food) night was particularly fun to sit adjacent to!

reviews.author: Meg F
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel within walking distance to the Kia Centre
reviews.body: If you’re going to a concert at the Kia Center, the Aloft in downtown Orlando is the place to be. The desk service was exceptional. The easy access from the highway was amazing and the walk to the Kia center was short and safe! The room was also beautiful.

reviews.author: Kind review
reviews.title: Loved the orlando aloft hotel stay
reviews.body: I loved every part of our stay at aloft last week. It was a phenomenal hotel and staff and I will stay again.

reviews.author: Alan
reviews.title: Aloft Hotel Orlando
reviews.body:
Great location downtown, massive rooms, so great value for the price. 
The staff at reception were so friendly and helpful especially 
to Angel and Ivy who were great representatives for Marriot. 
I really enjoyed my stay whilst in Orlando to watch the England v Costa Rica football match. 
I understand Marriot are official partners to the World Cup 2026, they certainly made me and other footie fans welcome.
I shall go there again on my next trip to Orlando.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Pretty bad.
reviews.body: Bad service. Bad staff. Dirty room.

reviews.author: Dave from Florida
reviews.title: great accomodations for the Roberto Carlos concert
reviews.body: superior hotel both building wise and staff/service. One of the best I have been in within the last 5 years

reviews.author: Yes
reviews.title: Aloft is Awesome
reviews.body: Had an excellent experience at my stay at aloft downtown Orlando, Florida. My room was exquisite. For the moment, I stopped to check my current of valet to check in till the time I got to my room was awesome. I even slipped in a quick cocktail on my way up to my room via the lobby bar. I had accidentally left behind some expensive earphones, which when I called, they promptly retrieved and kept them downstairs with the front desk, clerks, and I was able to retrieve them with no problem the next day. Overall top-notch experience.

reviews.author: Nena
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.body: Excellent service . Needs to include parking.

reviews.author: RRG4635
reviews.title: Great business class stay, but breakfast not included
reviews.body: Comfortable, quiet, located perfectly for my business trip. The staff was excellent. Showers and included shampoo/conditioner/shower gel are roomy and good quality. Bed and overall room experience was nice.  Though, the temp on the shower varied. Nice TV. The lobby coffee is undrinkable and breakfast options are sparse and expensive.

reviews.author: ras
reviews.title: Awesome place to stay when attending Orlando Conference
reviews.body: Short easy walk to convention and absolutely lovely hotel.

reviews.author: Blake
reviews.title: Worth the stay!
reviews.body: Great customer service and very friendly!

reviews.author: JeffW
reviews.title: Excellent choice
reviews.body: Upon arrival we were greeted with valet parking. The hotel was well maintained and very clean. Our room was very spacious, clean and better than expected. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Katia from Chicago
reviews.title: Great hotel that far exceeded expectations.
reviews.body: I don't usually write reviews, but this hotel far exceeded expectations, primarily because of the friendly and helpful staff. The rooms were clean, and the bed was very comfortable. I would stay here again.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Bar Service
reviews.body: Definitely won’t use the bar again!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great Stay for Business and Leisure
reviews.body: My stay at the Aloft started out rough with some issues with the parking situation as well as issues with my booking and payment. However, Kadeem at the front desk was able to assist with all of these issues and also made some accommodations to my stay. I really felt Kadeem really cared that my stay was pleasant despite it being a business trip. One thing that really impressed me and made me feel special was when he called my room to make sure everything was prepared. I really enjoyed my stay at the Aloft and will be coming back in the future. Also want to shout out Ivy who assisted me in checking out and made sure all transactions were finalized accordingly.

reviews.author: Jess B
reviews.title: 2nd Stay, will stay again
reviews.body: 2nd time staying here, great spot, nice rooms, staff is always so nice.

reviews.author: Troy Ramage
reviews.title: Excellent front desk service
reviews.body: I was only there for one night for a concert at the Phillips Center and I was running late. They checked me in immediately, anticipated I wanted a late check out the next day and got me out to my room and out the door in minutes. I recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Bryson
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Good energy, very clean, super attentive staff.

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.body:
Pros: 
Great Location (walking distance to everything downtown Orlando)
Clean 
Big Room (stayed in a suite)
Friendly Service
Good Bar (open late)

Cons:
No storage in the room (no closet, dresser, anything like that)
No microwave and a tiny fridge.
Valet can get backed up (order your car early and be prepared to wait during busy times. even tho they are really nice)

I’d definitely stay again, it was a really nice place. The cons I listed are minor in comparison to the pros.

reviews.author: Vegas Girl
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.body: Aloft was great! It’s sort of a boutique hotel, but still had some great amenities. Valet was convenient!

reviews.author: Gresh
reviews.title: Great Place to stay in Downtown Orlando as a Wedding Vendor
reviews.body: Clean rooms, elegant furniture, and kind staff. Super helpful and beautiful common areas to work in.

reviews.author: Cathy
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.body: Great service, impeccable /modern accommodations, pet friendly facilities and amazing entertainment. Superb from check in to check out!

reviews.author: JRCTraveler
reviews.title: Disappointing and Insensitive Experience During a Medical Emergency
reviews.body:
I was very disappointed with my recent stay at Marriott. While the room itself was fine, our experience with breakfast was extremely upsetting. We were never informed that breakfast was not included with our room.

My cousin, who has diabetes, experienced hypoglycemia and took a cup of juice and some fruit. A staff member took the juice and fruit away from him in front of everyone, stating that our room did not include breakfast. Regardless of the breakfast policy, I found the way this situation was handled embarrassing, insensitive, and lacking basic compassion—especially given that he was experiencing a medical issue and does not speak English.

I have traveled extensively throughout the United States, and unfortunately, this was one of the worst and most disappointing hotel experiences I have had. I expected much better hospitality and professionalism from Marriott.

reviews.author: Travelling for work
reviews.title: Advertisement Photos Misleading
reviews.body: The staff is wonderful at this location. No issues or complaints with the people. However, if you require a nice bathroom with walk-in showers this may not be the hotel for you. Overall the hotel could use an update in general.

reviews.author: KendallM
reviews.title: Come for the beds and stay for the friendly staff
reviews.body: Stayed at hotel for an event at the Kia Center, was only a 10 to 15 minute walk away.  Beds are super comfortable.  Staff are some of the friendliest I’ve ever worked with hospitality.

reviews.author: Proud Aunt
reviews.title: Nice Location Convenient to Downtown Orlando
reviews.body: We stayed 2 nights to celebrate our nephew's graduation, so the room worked.  A callout to housekeeping for a spotless room, to Cav the valet when we arrived and the valets working the afternoon of Sept 1st.  Everyone we encountered was wonderful and we appreciated the customer service.  The location was great and close to the restaurant we were celebrating at.  One negative is that it is close to the highway and train tracks.  There was a loud train whistle around 1:30 am on Sunday and any loud exhaust on a car/motorcycle/truck was heard in the room.  Maybe because we were on the 9th Floor.  Except for the train, we did not hear noise once we were asleep, so didn’t wear ear plugs.  Others may find it frustrating.   There were many restaurants and lounges in the area.  We enjoyed the hotel bar and had one lunch in the Marriott.  We ate salads and chicken fingers, which were done well.  Nothing creative, but everything was fresh.  Bre was a great bartender and had great suggestions.  The pool area was nice and the furniture looked comfortable, but we never got to use due to rain.  We are titanium, so we appreciated the executive room.  In our room, there was only a pullout chair, so one of us had to sit on the bed.  With the rainy weather, it was nice to have a comfortable lounge to relax in between outings.  There is a refrigerator in the room, no microwave.  I would say if you are traveling for work or a longer period of time with 2 using the room, I would consider another hotel.  There is only room for one suitcase on the bench, which is challenging with 2 people. The vanity was small and the lighting was poor.  With such a small vanity top, you would think there would have been more hooks, but only one.  Again, not ideal for 2 people.  I was told some rooms have walk-in showers, but we had an old tub setup.  The water pressure was low, but the hot water was fast.    Sometimes while working, I do use the desk in the room.  With no rolling desk chair, which is comfortable and easier, I would not want to stay here when working in the room.

reviews.author: Will
reviews.title: Great stay and hospitality!
reviews.body: Excellent all around, looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: JLGC frequent traveler
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.body: I have stayed here multiple times for business and pleasure and find ALWAYS a very professional and caring staff, top-notch cleanliness, great facilities, superb management, and great location. Love this hotel!

reviews.author: Biz123
reviews.title: Best Ever
reviews.body: This Marriott location is true to the Marriott brand. Exceptional service, wonderful staff, great food, outstanding location!

reviews.author: A Short
reviews.title: Nice stay but had a few hiccups
reviews.body: The room was nice and clean and the front desk staff was very friendly! At about 10 am the cleaning staff did enter our room without knocking which was a little off putting. Also the parking situation was a little odd, i’ve never been to a hotel where the parking has not been included in the stay.  The only options are 20 dollar overnight parking or 38 dollar valet.

reviews.author: Andrew H
reviews.title: Wonderful staff Marriott Staff, needs some updating
reviews.body: The Marriott employees/staff were amazing, felt like I was at a 4 star resort. The rooms and common areas are nice, but the rooms could use some maintenance. Keep in mind they were very clean and comfortable. The valet staff could use some training and/or notes from the hotel staff

reviews.author: Krem
reviews.title: Went for Melanie Martinez concert
reviews.body: Truly wonderful and accommodating stay! Was so comfortable and beautiful!

reviews.author: LJ6258
reviews.title: An Orlando Experience
reviews.body: I stayed at this hotel for a conference, and can’t think of a better experience. The hotel was clean, beautiful, well-maintained. The staff was friendly, helpful and available. Absolutely planning to have our business here again.

reviews.author: Jenn T
reviews.title: Superior Service at an Affordable Price
reviews.body: The Marriott Orlando Downtown was the perfect place to stay on our recent trip to the area. It checked all of the boxes and more. The hotel is clean, convenient and has great amenities. What really sets this particular Marriott apart is the friendly staff. They went above and beyond to make sure everyone was well taken care of. Whether you’re in town for a concert, a convention or to see the mouse, this hotel is the perfect place to stay.

reviews.author: Jenny1005
reviews.title: Safety Concern
reviews.body: PLEASE be very careful ordering any sort of food delivery from any service.  Even if you ask for no contact delivery from both the vendor and the hotel they do not care to listen.  The front desk gave our room number to the man delivering our door dash. How do I know this to be true? We were headed down to pick up or order and the man came off the elevator and stated our room number. "Room 427?" Completely caught me off guard because I NEVER give our room number or even floor number to ANYONE delivering anything to us when we are traveling. This is very dangerous and I am LIVID they would put us in danger like this.

reviews.author: Garrett
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
reviews.body: This Marriott Orlando Downtown does more than provide customer service. They utilize the platinum rule, do unto others as they would have done onto them. As a result, they put their customers first and provide the world clsss customer service experience. David is phenomenal and made the entire trip even pre magical for our son.

reviews.author: SWhite
reviews.title: A great place to stay for a business conference loxatiob
reviews.body: This hotel was exactly what the brand stands for clean, friendly, reasonable, without taking away from the quality of excellence in their service and dedication to Marriott reward members

reviews.author: Satisfied Customer
reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.body: The staff members were professional and friendly. The food was delicious and the facility is spacious. I will visit this location again.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.body: The hotel and staff are great!

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Awesome for Kia Center
reviews.body: Great location for Kia center, Staff was excellent, remarkable checking and out. Club lounge breakfast a bit too cheap; lack quality.

reviews.author: Hardygirl
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: I stayed at this hotel for a conference at the Kia center. I chose it because it was walking distance to the event location. The staff were very nice. The room was very nice and clean and the food was excellent. I will be staying here again next year. One con for me was that there are not microwaves in the room, but there is one that can be used downstairs in the bodega.

reviews.author: Drew64
reviews.title: My stay at Marriott Downtown Orlando
reviews.body: I had a great stay in downtown Orlando. Most of the activities I participated in were in walking distance of my hotel. Usually when I stay in Orlando, I go to International Dr. This time I wanted to explore another part of the city. Thanks once again for the great experience.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Great Staff, updated rooms, immaculate hotel
reviews.body:
Staff was helpful and friendly!
Rooms were comfortable and immaculate

reviews.author: Dan2788
reviews.title: False accusations
reviews.body: This stay would’ve been nicer and rated higher had they not taken $400 from my bank over a false mattress damage accusation. I am getting my refund, thankfully. But it should’ve never happened in the first place and they even tried to double down and tell ME what was in a room that I fully checked before leaving. Also no free breakfast…

reviews.author: Review
reviews.title: Orlando
reviews.body: Should be prepared for local events

reviews.author: Tmartin
reviews.title: Quiet Stay
reviews.body: I was pleasantly surprised on how quiet the hotel was since we’re in Orlando (Disney). I expected children but to my surprise I didn’t hear or see many children.  It was a great couples weekend

reviews.author: Orekelewa Lawal
reviews.title: N/a
reviews.body: The front desk treated me poorly. Because of this I’m not sure if I would stay here again

reviews.author: PDOrlando
reviews.title: This hotel should not carry the Marriott name!
reviews.body: Stayed here for work travel as a group. Hotel itself was dated, but I was fine with that as it was a short trip. Bartender in lobby bar struggled to service our group of 6 and had issues with overcharging a credit card multiple times. When we contacted the hotel after the stay to resolve, they were extremely unhelpful and just told us to contact our bank. Wow, absolutely horrible service!!

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Change your late check out policy
reviews.body: Accommodations were clean and comfortable. However, I could not get into my room until 515. We stayed here for a concert and wanted to rest and shower before the event and we were unable to do so. The manager said it was due to Marriott’s late check out policy and influx of event attendees.

reviews.author: jphil1990
reviews.title: Don't Believe the Check In Time
reviews.body: We arrived to check in almost 2 hours past the advertised check in time, only to find that our room was still not available.  Even after checking in online the day before.  We were not alone.  We watched guest after guest after guest be told the same thing.  As a result, dozens of people trying to get ready to attend a Kia Center Event strewn all over the rest rooms and lobby

reviews.title: Superb Service
reviews.body: Lovely Hotel. Great location. Unbelievable Service. Will, most definitely, return to MARRIOTT Orlando Downtown on our next visit to Orlando...

reviews.author: Emilie
reviews.title: Modern, clean and welcoming
reviews.body:
From the moment I made the reservation, Kayla the hotel assistant reached out to me to welcome us and see if we had any special requests, I felt very
 Special and I appreciated that gesture, staff was all very professional and friendly, the hotel was modern, clean and well kept, our rooms were clean and nice, we had a quiet and league night. Thanks to the entire team for making our stay pleasant.

reviews.author: MarcfromNYC
reviews.title: Clean & Convenient
reviews.body: Very nice property with friendly, helpful staff.  Clean and well maintained.  Rooms are comfy and spacious.

reviews.author: Frequent guests
reviews.title: Our favorite getaway
reviews.body:
Thanks to Nathalia, Eden and Desiree for making our recent stay a nice quiet escape. 

Wonderful service,  personalized by being remembered and recognized upon arrival and throughout stay.

reviews.author: Anna M
reviews.title: Decent hotel
reviews.body: The hotel was ideally located, the staff was helpful and friendly. Stayed in 2 rooms 611 and 621. 611 there was hair all over the bath room .  The furniture in the living area of 621 needed to be cleaned.

reviews.author: Alci
reviews.title: People are what makes Marriot
reviews.body: The  hotel staff was amazing. Starting by Eden at the front desk , she was pleasant and made check in a pleasant experience. Natalia was also helpful and kind providing water bottles at arrival to all guests. Jaci was  very kind , professional and made sure missing basic items were supplied in the room.The employee whom I would like to highlight is Margarete. Her kindness,cheerful demeanor, problem solving attitude were much appreciated. She was always there for guests at breakfast. She went above and beyond.Her social personal skills made everyone feel special. Ramom , the manager, does a great job with guests and employees alike who all seem to enjoy working there.

reviews.author: Noemi
reviews.title: Best day ever
reviews.body: If you need a place to stay downtown TownePlace Suites by Marriott Orlando it's the place to go you will feel safe and they have everything nearby that you need lots of restaurants to choose from

reviews.author: Citrinia
reviews.title: Great location from Kia Center
reviews.body: We really enjoyed the convenience of staying so close to the Kia Center.  The ac needs to be upgraded in the room it was very noisy and disruptive. The stairwell carpet needs to be vacuumed.

reviews.author: Strong Guest
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.body: I frequently stay at TownePlace Suites when I travel and so I chose this familiar brand when I traveled to Orlando and stayed at the Downtown location. From the moment I stepped in the lobby and encountered the on-duty desk clerk, I was impressed! This particular location did not seem like your typical TownePlace Suites—it had an elevated appearance and the tropical theme was fun and welcoming. The desk clerk was extremely professional, but very friendly and seemingly remembered guests by name, remembering key pieces about their stay, and he called everyone,  “my friend!” The dining facility was unexpectedly comfortable with a resort-like feel, but most surprisingly the bar food was excellent! And of course, the rooms were very clean, and every staff member that I encountered, including the cleaning staff were warm and friendly. This will be my go-to place whenever I am in Orlando!

reviews.author: Lola
reviews.title: Amazing! Clear, bright, airy and wonderful staff.
reviews.body:
Amazing! Clear, bright, airy and wonderful staff. 
For the price especially this was excellent. Not much of a few. Though, if you’re there for the hospital, you are right across the street. And this is conveniently located close to downtown. 

Will at the front desk was wonderful and we had a great stay!

reviews.author: Mommax4
reviews.title: Downtown Orlando: Hospital Proximity & Comfort!
reviews.body: What a blessing to have stayed here. We were able to park in handicap parking, walk to ORMC hospital on foot, and the room was clean, comfortable, and secure. Breakfast was delicious - eggs, quiche, waffles, milks, yogurts, fresh fruit and endless coffee. Staff was phenomenal and helped with a quick door lock hiccup (Ramon GM for this location was awesome). Laundry facility, pool, and small restaurant/bar inviting and food delicious. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: BK Baxter
reviews.title: All Around Excellence
reviews.body: This was our 5th or 6th stay! Thanks, Francesca, for help in adding a day on the front-end of our stay, when no availability evident on Marriott site. You will be missed. Thanks, Eden, for help in searching online for a car rental company when the A/C died in our vehicle. Your smile is infectious. Thanks, Natalia, for your help at the front desk and the bar. Your patience and knowledge was appreciated. Thank you, Carla, for your caring attitude and attention to our well-being during our 3 night stay. We enjoyed meeting you. Thank you to Manager Ramon and the entire staff. Every member of the team we encountered was pleasant, cheerful, and a great representative of the location. If you haven't tried this hotel, please do so. The photos don't do it justice. Clean, quiet, safe and secure, comfortable, great staff, good value for downtown Orlando. We even got a great 4th of July fireworks show from Lake Eola, all from the living room of our suite!

reviews.author: DaniMarques
reviews.title: Above and Beyond
reviews.body: It was the best room I ever experienced in Orlando area!

reviews.author: 50 Legs in 50 Days
reviews.title: TownPlace is a life saver!
reviews.body: Conveniently located for local healthcare facilities. Within 2 miles there’s various shopping and personal care stores available. The staff at TownPlace begins to feel like family, they’re so friendly fly and accommodating. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: acarr
reviews.title: Another great stay!
reviews.body: Staying at the TownePlace Suites is always a good experience. They have great front desk and easy access to the hotel. It’s perfect being close to the hospital, but quiet.

reviews.author: Joyce
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.body: This hotel was absolutely beautiful! The staff was a 10+, each and everyone of them went above and beyond to make my stay perfect. Super clean, the room was clean and quiet. I highly recommend you stay here.  Thank you TownePlace Suites by Marriott Orlando Downtown

reviews.author: DSoji
reviews.title: Wonderful place!
reviews.body: Very nice place ,comfortable and  super clean

reviews.author: Anne and the Judges
reviews.title: An excellent stay, not the first or the last
reviews.body: At a loss to find a negative comment. Desiree at the front desk was wonderful. Some people in my party mentionned this had been #1 amongst all the hotels we stayed at (five in 3 weeks!)

reviews.author: Hospital visit
reviews.title: Hospital stay
reviews.body: My husband was having surgery in the orphedic hospital which is directly across the street. The hotel was very clean the staff were helpful thecfood was good.

reviews.author: JaneVV
reviews.title: To the Rescue
reviews.body:
The staff at TownePlace Suites by Marriott Orlando Downtown are exceptional.  I had a medical emergency during our spring break vacation. I was hospitalized and my husband needed a hotel room, with an unknown checkout date.  

The reception desk staff were very helpful and kind as they assisted my husband with extending his stay day-by-day.  

I chose TownSuites because of its close proximity to the hospital. In the future, I would choose this hotel specifically because of the staff.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Dawn oh Dawn
reviews.body: Dawn since the beginning of our work trips at this property has been absolutely exceptional. She has been so welcoming & hospitable. She always has a smile on her face & truly goes above & beyond. Getting to see Dawn each stay during our work trips makes us feel at home!

reviews.author: Happy older couple
reviews.title: Your out of town family
reviews.body: Front desk & housekeeping staff are the best in town

reviews.author: Maurice
reviews.title: Excellent rooms and service.
reviews.body: Great experience. Excellent rooms for a large group. The 2 bedroom suites are amazing.

reviews.author: Keliana
reviews.title: A wonderful vacation
reviews.body: It’s my first time staying at one of these hotels nd I have to say I fell in love. The staff was nice and helpful. The rooms were spacious and clean. The had everything you could need. The hotel itself was pristine.

reviews.author: Frankie
reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.body: Conveniently located to grocery, etc. stores and a highly functional kitchen, just feels like home.  Also, a laundry facility, so I don't have to pack so many clothes!

reviews.author: Jwals
reviews.title: Wonderful visit to downtown Orlando
reviews.body: Town Place Suites was a convenient and affordable solution to our Orlando visit. It provided more space and amenities than other locations and was in walking distance of everything we wanted to do. The staff was thoughtful and accommodating to our requests, and friendly in all of our encounters.

reviews.author: Unhappy guests 2026
reviews.title: Disappointed in the room we were given
reviews.body: I would stay here ever again, they had bugs in the shower, mold in the sink and the refrigerator had an awful smell. The hotel was overbooked to get another room and was told to contact customer service 🙄

reviews.author: Je93
reviews.title: The TownePlace Suites is Amazing!!
reviews.body: This is our 4th visit to the TownePlace Suites Orlando Downtown, and we would never consider staying anywhere else! From management to the front desk to housekeeping, everyone is wonderful at what they do. The customer service and hospitality make the TownePlace feel like home, and it continues to be the cleanest hotel we've ever stayed in. The TownePlace Suites is the best place to stay in Orlando, no matter your reason for coming.

reviews.author: acarr
reviews.title: Great stay near hospital
reviews.body: This hotel is clean and in an easy location close to the hospital. The team is always so nice upon check-in.

reviews.author: William G
reviews.title: Top Notch Hotel
reviews.body: Every aspect of our stay was extremely pleasant. The hotel staff is simply the best!

reviews.author: Sara Tibbitts
reviews.title: Never a disappointment!
reviews.body: TownPlace is conveniently located near a medical facility (POA) that we travel from Wisconsin to because my daughter is an amputee.  In addition, there are SO many restaurants, grocery stores and drug stores en route to the facility, we never have to go out of our way to take care of our day to day needs. The staff at TownPlace from the desk clerk to the cleaners is amazing and always both prompt and able to help with whatever we need.  I cannot say enough good things about this establishment.

reviews.author: Thankful
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.body: Staff was amazing. Very clean.

reviews.author: Sept2027
reviews.title: Nice place, amazing staff!
reviews.body: We stayed for one night as we were in town for a medical issue.  The suite was great and roomy - downtown parking in Orlando is a challenge, but there is parking at the hotel.  Gabby helped us tremendously with our stay and requests, making it a really pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Kaydee
reviews.title: Hidden Fees
reviews.body: Room was nice, but we were hit with extra fees upon arrival we were not aware of. There's a $150 non refundable pet fee, and nowhere to comfortably walk the dog or let them roam despite being pet friendly. On top of that, the informational email said parking would be $22/night, and upon arrival turned into $25 a night. Had we been aware of these extra fees we would have looked elsewhere. Also the lobby smelled weird, like sunscreen and old sweat.

reviews.author: Katya
reviews.title: Good location and spacious room
reviews.body:
The room is spacious and has everything you need for a long stay like in an apartment. Very close to the court so I save time and money for parking. Location is great. 
Drowbacks:
- the pool had lots of debris on the bottom and some alive ants floating on the surface
- parking costs 25$ which is upsetting
- the breakfast is not tasty. For 200$ per room it could be a little better, we had better meals in cheaper hotels.
The rest is great, highly recommend this place if you travel with a family.

reviews.author: LI NY traveler
reviews.title: Residence inn in decline
reviews.body: no longer consistent expectations from Marriott brands

reviews.author: Honey
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: We stayed in Orlando for one night. Hotel was clean and the staff was friendly. Will return in the future.

reviews.author: Anon
reviews.title: Parking
reviews.body: I wont go back to this location because the parking situation. They do not tell you about the parking until you get there.  Its 25 a day. To use their garage. You do not have another choice and you wont find out until you get there because they dont tell you.  There's 0 other parking options.

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.title: Summer Vacation
reviews.body: Awesome stay, love the location and would stay again for sure

reviews.author: Mandi 2026
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.body: My family and I came down to Orlando for an event. Upon arrival of the hotel, it was beautiful. From check in, to our room to check out, it was a great stay! Very quiet and peaceful. Only 6 miles from our event we attended. Would definitely stay again when back in the area.

reviews.author: Patrice R
reviews.title: Second time staying
reviews.body: This was our second stay at the Residence Inn by Marriott Orlando in two months. Gabi at the front desk was very helpful and efficient at check in and check out. Our room was spacious and clean. The complimentary breakfast with gluten free options hit the spot in the morning and got our day off to a relaxing start. We enjoyed some time at the indoor pool as well. Our room on the seventh floor gave us a spectacular view of the city. The dressing area with a mirror, plus the large bathroom made it comfortable to get ready for the day without feeling cramped. The kitchen allowed us to keep a few snacks and leftovers from restaurants in our room. The bed was comfortable and roomy. We'll be back.

reviews.author: T John
reviews.title: Family Trip
reviews.body: Good Value for the money, friendly staff, they just needed the rooms to be ready at the check in times.  Other guests rooms weren’t ready as well.  We just traveled 3 hours and the kids needed to get out of the car. The food was decent, the pool was nice, and the hotel was in a good location downtown.

reviews.author: Yaser k
reviews.title: Great hotel & nice location
reviews.body:
We had a great stay at this hotel. We really liked the modern design and how clean and updated everything felt. The parking was very convenient and easy to access, which made our stay even more comfortable.

The location was also excellent, with many stores and restaurants nearby. Even though it was only a one night stop for us, we truly enjoyed staying in the 2 bedroom suite. It was very spacious and perfect for me and my family to relax and enjoy our time together. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: TM33
reviews.title: Exceptional!
reviews.body: I was very impressed from start to finish! Great check-in, staff (💜 Karen) , cleanliness, friendliness and I loved the breakfast. I even got help making fresh waffles from an exceptional staff member 😋. I came back in the middle of day and someone was cleaning the elevator 🥰. I love cleanliness. Overall I felt like they had great people focused on all the important things that make a stay magical 🌟. I will definitely be back and I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nikki
reviews.title: Superb customer service at Residence Marriott
reviews.body: The customer service is 5/5 stars. Highly recommend staying here for short or extended stays. You can count on everything being easier and better, especially if you are working locally and here for work/business.

reviews.author: Elaine P
reviews.title: Convenient location and friendly staff
reviews.body: This was my second stay.  Greeted with a personal, hand written note welcoming me to the hotel.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.  Room was big, location convenient and safe.  Will stay again.

reviews.author: Ginsberg
reviews.title: Best Place in Downtown Orlando
reviews.body: Love Love Love the hotel but if you need quiet be sure to ask for a room that is not facing the street. The traffic is loud 24/7. There is a restaurant called “NY Deli” across the street that has been there since 1976. The food (gyros) is incredible. The hotel staff is so friendly and welcoming. They have an indoor pool, a gym and laundry room. The free breakfast is great and the nightly free cookies and complimentary coffee/tea on the patio with a fireplace is a must! I would gladly give this hotel 100/10.

reviews.author: CCPat
reviews.title: Last minute surprise stay will now be our first choice...
reviews.body: My husband booked us at another property that was substandard (nasty!!) so we left and were without a place to stay for the weekend. A travel site suggested Residence Inn by Marriott Downtown Orlando. We hurried over as there were only a few rooms available that evening. The clerk at the front desk helped us to reserve a room and get checked in. Our room was spacious and clean. The bathroom was a good size which allowed for showering and getting dressed without feeling cramped. The breakfast each morning featured many options which helped us to relax and plan our day at a leisurely pace. Kudos to the breakfast staff for keeping everything stocked and clean. Thanks for the gluten free options at breakfast. The swimming pool looked tempting but we didn't have time to swim. Maybe next time! We will definitely be back for another stay.

reviews.author: parkingrefundpls
reviews.title: Overcharged, Underimpressed
reviews.body: I purposely purchased at a rate that gave me access to late checkout and half priced parking. Tell me why I was charged TWICE for parking tax and FULL PRICE for parking. Along with this, our TV didn't work upon arrival and it took two separate people to come fix it. The shower floor in our room was disgusting and peeling. Overall just a mess.

reviews.author: Brit
reviews.title: Miscommunication ruined experience
reviews.body:
Overall, our stay had some positives, but there were a few key issues that significantly impacted our experience.

The main reason we chose this hotel was for the included breakfast. We specifically confirmed the hours with the front desk, and Kayla let us know it ended at 11:00 AM. We planned our morning around that and even set an alarm to make sure we didn’t miss it. Unfortunately, when we arrived at 10:20 AM, all of the food was already gone. That was very disappointing, especially since this was a major factor in our booking decision.

On a positive note, the bed was very comfortable, and we did appreciate having food options available downstairs late at night.

We also found navigating the hotel—especially getting to the parking garage—to be confusing. The elevator buttons (such as 2 vs. 2R) are not clearly labeled, and there isn’t clear signage indicating where the parking garage is. We ended up walking around quite a bit trying to find it. When we returned to the front desk for help, we had to wait as there was only one associate available, and the directions were still a bit unclear.

I believe clearer communication and better signage would greatly improve the guest experience. Ensuring accurate information is provided and adding clear directional signage would make a big difference.

reviews.author: Cem1903
reviews.title: 5-star stay
reviews.body:
Residence Inn Orlando is a stellar 5-star stay. The property stands out for its cleanliness, newness, helpful staff, central location, and convenient parking availability. Everything feels fresh, well maintained, and thoughtfully run.

We stayed in a one-bedroom king suite, which was incredible—almost on par with a room in a 5-star hotel. The suite was large and spotless, featuring an open kitchen with stools, a full-size refrigerator, stove, microwave, and complete kitchenware. The bed was truly fit for a “king,” extremely comfortable and perfect for a restful night. The bathroom was also very large, clean, and highly functional—almost like a well-designed home bathroom.

Breakfast was included in the price, which makes the value even more impressive. The only small caveat is that breakfast ends at 9 a.m., which can feel a bit early for those who prefer a more relaxed morning.

What made the experience even more remarkable was the price, which was unbelievably good for the quality offered. If you’re visiting Orlando, don’t hesitate to stay at Residence Inn—you definitely won’t regret it. A well-deserved 5/5 experience.

reviews.author: Vonna
reviews.title: My go-to hotel in Orlando
reviews.body: The plan was to spend one night as I toured potential schools to attend in the area. After sleeping right through the night (8 hours) and had a lovely breakfast, I decided to spend a second night. The breakfast, by the way, is from 6a-9a. Don't go at 9:05a. I didn’t mind the strict hours. That's discipline. The staff was professional, pleasant, and patient -- just the way customer service should be. I even went to see the Magic play at the Kia Center, which was an easy 20-minute walk from the hotel. I was concerned about walking back to the hotel by myself but there were a lot of people on the street walking home or to their vehicles. I even saw people who were also staying at the hotel. I like that the hotel has a garage. I parked there; it's safe as your key card is needed for access.

reviews.author: SqueezeF16
reviews.title: Uncomfortable, Unclean, Unsatisfactory
reviews.body: This hotel fell well below the Marriott standard. We never saw housekeeping, even over a 3 day stay. The bedding was dirty and had to call for replacements - they were dropped off, but no one bothered to clean up the room or make the bed while they were in there? Pillows were shot and the mattress was even worse. Both are badly in need of replacement. Worst of all - the road noise is beyond belief - and that's coming from a guy who's lived on airbases for decades. The windows are as cheap as you can get. May as well have them open as they aren't doing a thing to suppress the noise from a very busy city street. Recommend stay elsewhere, but if you do stay here, get a room on the opposite side from the traffic. And should a manager chose to respond to my post - please spare me the auto-response "thank you's." If any of you had cared you would have checked in with a lifetime titanium at some point during my stay when you could have actually have made a difference.

reviews.author: JoyK
reviews.title: Nice location and helpful staff
reviews.body: I live in Orlando and had a plumbing emergency that required me to leave my apt. It was really nice to be able to move into a studio room with the kitchen and desk. I felt very well taken care of and appreciated the peace and quiet.

reviews.author: Julicious
reviews.title: Your Orlando home away from home
reviews.body: From the clean spacious room, to the friendly and helpful staff, to the safe and convenient location, you can't find a better hotel. Check in was smooth and parking was reasonable. Dishes and cookware were provided and the cute breakfast bar with high stools was a nice feature. The only possible drawback was the noise from the traffic from our room facing Colonial Street. Fortunately for us, we had a room on a high floor and both of us are heavy sleepers.  We will definitely return for a future Orlando trip!

reviews.author: John03
reviews.title: Noisy downtown cars racing
reviews.body: Hotel and amenities were great, but the noise downtown from the cars and motorcycles racing was really annoying. Recommending you find an alternate property if you want a quite night.

reviews.author: James C
reviews.title: Was lied to
reviews.body: Told one thing but that didn’t happen. Really disappointed in the whole situation.

reviews.author: Winter getaway 123
reviews.title: Noisy location downtown.
reviews.body: Location downtown was very noisy all hours of night. Weekends louder than weekdays.

reviews.author: Maureen O
reviews.title: Highly Recommend!!
reviews.body: I highly recommend this hotel! The staff were kind and hospitable, the room was very clean and had everything we needed, and the parking was safe and accessible. My sisters and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and plan to come back in the future!

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.title: Average
reviews.body: With so many options to stay in Orlando, I would not stay here with my family again. The overall hotel decor and style is outdated. We booked a two bedroom and while it was spacious, the cleanliness lacked attention to detail. The extra costs (parking, m pet fee) are not worth the stay. The staff were polite but there was nothing memorable. I was charge twice for the pet fee something I tried to avoid. Their were lots of breakfast options which were delicious and included with our stay. We did not use the indoor pool because it was so cold, but we would have, had it been heated. It was uncommonly cold in Orlando this week. We brought our dog and for the inflated $150 fee, walking the dog is not easily done. The area doesn't seem the safest and there are not many grassy areas. The residents and guest in the area do not seem pick up after their animals, it disgusting to be honest.

reviews.author: Dan and Mai
reviews.title: got what was promised
reviews.body: rooms were well laid out, and included a kitchen

reviews.author: Art
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: The hotel surpassed all my expectations! The location was perfect for sightseeing, and the hotel staff made us feel at home. Rooms were clean, spacious, and had all the amenities we needed. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Sami
reviews.title: Had A Great Stay!
reviews.body: Impressed by the amenities and condition of the hotel!

reviews.author: Indy Traveler
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: Attractive property that is very conveniently located. Front Desk Team is very helpful and specifically helped me with directions and gave me suggestions when I asked. The Food Service Team could not have been better.  The food quality was excellent and the service was top notch.

reviews.author: Drin
reviews.title: Great place to stay in downtown Orlando
reviews.body: I stayed at the courtyard by Marriott downtown Orlando for five days. The rooms were great, the staff were very attentive, and the facilities and gym were in great shape. The bistro was also excellent. I would not hesitate to stay here again.

reviews.author: Frequent traveler
reviews.title: Accommodations
reviews.body: The room we selected was chosen because it indicated that a sofa bed was available.  The sofa bed was in terrible condition, we could not sleep on it.  We requested a crib and it never arrived.  We checked out early and were denied a refund.  We were informed a manager would contact us, no one called.

reviews.author: Zaer Barkat
reviews.title: Good for what it is.
reviews.body: This is my 3rd time staying at the hotel and 1st time I had some issues. Firstly and most minor I had asked for a high floor with a balcony but only got a room on the 4th floor, with no balcony. Secondly the shower floor got super slippery when wet and I almost slipped twice. The little foot ledge on the wall has seen better days. I saw it cracking from the wall when I put my foot on it gently. And lastly the AC in the room made a lot of noise whenever it turned on. Aside from these, my stay wasn't so bad.

reviews.author: Claire
reviews.title: August 2026
reviews.body: Thank you to the staff especially Devin for your cheerful manner and wonderful service, helping us to check in and have great stay during our impromptu staycation at the hotel (due to neighbors fumigation for termites).

reviews.author: JB 2026
reviews.title: Room to grow
reviews.body: I will keep this short and not a fan of public admonishments.  This particular hotel has some room to grow with regard to overall service especially with our check in experience and pre-stay confirmation and changes.  I know that this is one instance and we are one set of guests but as Marriott members we have had quite a different experience at many other establishments.  Again, this is solicitate and not motivated on our end to take away from all of those who go above and beyond every day.

reviews.author: Lisa and Carlos
reviews.title: Totally enjoyable experience
reviews.body: Friendly, homely, clean and the staff across the board were exceptional.  Ellis is a stand out for. Sure, but everyone made our stay easy and catered to.  Will definitely return

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.title: Great location. Very clean
reviews.body: The staff is very friendly. I wish they didn't charge for parking though. The walls are thin and you hear your neighbors. It is very clean and has a great location. They need to put microwaves in all of the rooms.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Trip with Granddaughters❤️
reviews.body: PERFECT IN ALL WAYS🥰. Will definitely stay again!

reviews.author: GIGIS4X1955
reviews.title: MANTLE 2026 Attendee
reviews.body: The shuttle service to the Kia Center was invaluable.

reviews.author: Hope inhumanity
reviews.title: Hotel stay
reviews.body: Everything was good. Veron the person checking me in was nice and provided excellent customer service. I just needed housekeeping without needing to call the front desk to see if they were coming after leaving and coming back to my room not being cleaned. It was never told to me my room only got housekeeping every other day but when that day came still not housekeeping, had to call to get clean towels.

reviews.author: Good place
reviews.title: Clean, friendly staff, good location downtown
reviews.body: Good value! Much thanks for the stay

reviews.author: Erica K
reviews.title: Such a Positive Experience
reviews.body: It was such a pleasure to stay at this hotel for my birthday weekend. Hannah at the front desk made this trip unforgettable! She was extremely accommodating, so personable and kind. She went above and beyond to make this stay one for the books! The staff were all extremely helpful and very pleasant, from housekeeping and even the staff at the Bistro! Thank you for such great service! I would 1000% recommend anyone to stay here and would absolutely come back again!

reviews.author: Emory
reviews.title: Good
reviews.body: Very nice and convenient close to Kia center

reviews.author: Picasso
reviews.title: Orlando Trip
reviews.body: The hotel location is excellent, nice neighborhood. The Property itself is well maintained, rooms are clean and excellent staff.

reviews.author: FrequentTraveler67
reviews.title: Clean, Comfortable, convenient
reviews.body: I like this hotel. The bed is comfortable and the location is decent.

reviews.author: J Smith
reviews.title: Great place to stay, but note no microwave.
reviews.body: The hotel is convenient to where I work when I come to town, it is clean, roomie, nice selection of the bistro, staff are very nice, etc. The only downside is no microwave in the room.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Excellent Staff and stay, start to finish!
reviews.body: I had to go in for surgery at Lake Baldwin VA Clinic, Miss Dominque helped me get my room, on semi short notice, and she got me an excellent rate.  Met her with my wife, she hugged and was very helpful and sweet, the entire staff, I interacted with were great and did a job well done.

reviews.author: Happy customer
reviews.title: Great stay and help.
reviews.body:
Front desk was extremely helpful. 
Had a need for local transportation and had not used uber in 20 yrs and did not know how to get re registered with them. The young lady at the front desk helped me through the process and made it possible for me to make my dinner reservation. 
Very grateful for her kind help and attention as I was unable to navigate it my self.

reviews.author: BWYC
reviews.title: No Hot Water
reviews.body: No hot water during my stay.  When I complained, I was told management would be in contact with me.  I NEVER heard from them

reviews.author: Rbless84
reviews.title: Good location, nice rooms, some small inconsistencies
reviews.body: Nice staff and solid stay overall, but the room safe had a low battery and could not be used when I arrived. That should be checked before guest check-in. Also, balconies are marked non-smoking, which may matter to some guests.

reviews.author: Will recommend
reviews.title: Will recommend
reviews.body: Checking in was a breeze. Our room was clean, neat and tidy. We had fresh sheets, pillows and wonderful absorbing towels. We had pool view. Our my original reservation was for king size bed. I called the day of our reservation and requested two queen size beds and without an issue, our request was granted. This was our second stay at the Couttside Marriott we will be staying again and we definitely recommend.

reviews.author: stwm68
reviews.title: Great hotel.
reviews.body: Clean, friendly and up to date.

reviews.author: AnnieT
reviews.title: Will only stay here when in the Orlando area!  Excellent Stay!
reviews.body: Will only stay here when in the Orlando area!  Excellent Stay!

reviews.author: Satisfied
reviews.title: The Best Stay Ever
reviews.body: Best Stay Ever, Everything was above expectations and wish I could have extended my stay.

reviews.author: Lorenzo l
reviews.title: Great convenient clean and friendly hotel
reviews.body: Stayed for a night for bossiness conference absolutely recommend this hotel for any of your Orlando stays

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.title: Fantastic place to stay
reviews.body: Cheryl, Katie and the staff are so welcoming and provide exceptional service. Only place to stay in Orlando for my family

reviews.author: James J
reviews.title: The place to stay in Orlando
reviews.body: The staff at this downtown location are wonderful, and professional.  From check in to check out, the staff are extremely friendly and helpful.  The food at the bistro is great as is the bistro staff.  The whole facility is nice and well maintained.  The shuttle service is great, full of local knowledge, and quick.  I will definitely stay here the next time I'm in Orlando!

reviews.author: Nico
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Downtown
reviews.body: Very clean, well maintained hotel with easy parking and EV charger!

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: God Stay as usual
reviews.body: Conveniently located and well maintained. I usually stay here when traveling to Orlando

reviews.author: MillieN
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: I spent two nights at the hotel with my husband and daughter. The room was very clean, and the beds were very comfortable. The staff was very cordial and kept asking us if everything was ok and if there was anything they could do for us. They all provided great customer service.

reviews.author: Dioshy
reviews.title: Outstanding everything!!!
reviews.body: Lovely staff, great service, good breakfast, good gym, terrific beds, great location, all clean. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: G
reviews.title: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE
reviews.body: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE WITH NO FOLLOW THROUGH

reviews.author: AshiYVR
reviews.title: Friendly Staff. New Property.
reviews.body: Still a few quirks to iron out on this New Property. The Staff are lovely.

reviews.author: Seasoned Traveler
reviews.title: Best hotel in the area
reviews.body: This was my second time staying at this hotel. Very clean, staff are amazing. Great value as prices are not extreme. Great location with plenty of food options. Way better value than staying on international drive. Highly recommend

reviews.author: SCMC
reviews.title: Great staff, great service
reviews.body: The front desk staff, I mean ALL of them go above and beyond. They take the time to get to know you and go out of their way to make your stay pleasant as possible.  Housekeeping staff are wonderful,  very helpful, and always take care of your needs. All in all I would recommend this place 1000%.

reviews.author: KEH
reviews.title: 100% recommended
reviews.body: This was an awesome stay! Everybody was kind and friendly. I appreciated the fact that I needed help with my shopping bags and Steve, the manager on duty at night, helped me with those :-). Breakfasts were delicious and there was variety of food. Both ladies working there were very kind. Hotel was clean and room too.

reviews.author: Jennika Harris
reviews.title: 10:00am
reviews.body: Everything was great I will be back

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: This hotel doesn’t meet Marriott standards…
reviews.body:
Filthy rooms, undergoing construction repairs not mentioned while booking, poor housekeeping, breakfast selection was poor, all juices where totally watered down… pathetic.
Cannot believe Marriott stands for this.

reviews.author: Nikki
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.body: Our stay at the fairfield was exceptional. Yeah, the staff was extremely pleasant and helpful.The rooms were clean and bougie.As my eight year old says and the pool was great.Breakfast could use a little variety, but other than that.Our state was fantastic would recommend

reviews.author: Keirrena
reviews.title: Conference trip
reviews.body: The staff were amazing and extremely accommodating.

reviews.author: JC 88
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: My stay was outstanding. I appreciated the complimentary bottles of water provided. The breakfast was enjoyable, and the staff demonstrated professionalism and friendliness. The room was clean and well-maintained. The hotel’s convenient location near shopping centers and various activities was very beneficial.

reviews.author: Joji2026
reviews.title: check the lights and fans in rooms before renting them out.
reviews.body: Front desk staff was nice but I believe gave us the wrong breakfast time. Staff running the breakfast was extremely rude and unprofessional. Most of the lights and fans in our room (427) did not work.

reviews.author: Ce
reviews.title: Great spot beautiful location
reviews.body: Perfect location not too far from theme parks are attractions was able to catch Waymo from location if you want a good shopping area I suggest googling crabbers seafood restaurant from that hotel and to me that shopping center was the best shopping center by that hotel

reviews.author: Wayde C
reviews.title: Good Hotel (Minor Issue)
reviews.body: My stay here was very nice. The staff was helpful during check-in and check out. The complimentary breakfast and parking made this hotel my top choice and those two things didn't disappoint. The only concern I had was that on my floor, parts of the wall decor was ripped out, as if there was incomplete work. No exposed wires or anything like that, but it was very noticeable.

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.title: Very nice staff
reviews.body: Everything was awesome no complaints

reviews.author: Business trip
reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.body: I prepaid this location several days before, I told them 3 times I was coming late cause we were going to Disney, even called the same day around 6pm to remind them and they told me they everything was ready and perfect when we arrived at 11pm with 2 babies we were extremely tiered and soaked because of the storm and with our food ready to be eaten in our room, the lady told me they had an issue with the system and also that the hotel oversold the rooms and they didn't had the one I paid for, I was really mad but so tired that I didnt say much, they made my kids wait 45 minutes!!!!!!! Before we got to the room, our food was ruined and cold!!!! The room that was not available, mysteriously appeared?¿?? The hotel has serios water damage everywhere!!!!! All the carpets and paperwall is coming apart in all halls the 5 floors, there was only 2 employees available (really 1 lol this was a joke!!!) 1 in the front trying her best but not efficient at all!!!
