And 1 thats was no where to be found so I had to go to the 5 floors myself to find the only cart the hotel has to get my luggage 🤣🤣🤣🤣 another joke!!!!! I am a Marriott Bonvoy member with a very high tier and after this im considering never going back... Super disappointed and very sad how they treated my kids 2 and 5 yrs old, crying and wet🤬🤬🤬 almost at midnight!!!! Shame on Marriott

reviews.author: cn76
reviews.title: Fair stay at Fairfield
reviews.body: Room for improvement with breakfast. Noticeable Maintenance items in the halls but the rooms are Very clean, very quiet. Friendly, attentive staff.

reviews.author: The Traveling Family
reviews.title: Best Fairfield Yet
reviews.body: I’m a Marriott reward member and stay at a lot of Marriott hotels and this one is at the top of our list for the area.  Customer service was top-notch. The hotel was very clean. The bed was comfortable. It was in a good location with stores within walking distance. Breakfast was good and plentiful. We will definitely stay here again. We only stayed 1 night because we stayed at a resort in Orlando for the rest of the week.

reviews.title: Great place.
reviews.body: Location is suitable for my business. Enjoyed the stay as always.

reviews.author: DD
reviews.title: Not impressed. Ok to stay if you are desperate.
reviews.body:
Front desk not at all friendly. Was not recognized as a Gold Elite member during check in. Usually a good hotel front desk staff will tell you the breakfast hours, where the gym is and where the elevators are. Front desk here didn't bother. During the day the front desk two people working, they don't look up just staring at their screens. Horrible customer service. Breakfast was horrible the first day. Turkey sausage was hard as a rock. The muffin and egg sandwich was tasteless. Second day the scrambled eggs were much better as well as the sausage.

Breakfast lady on first day was very friendly and helpful. The coffee was empty and she apologized and quickly made a new batch. She even got me a fresh cup of coffee from the kitchen. Second day breakfast lady was not as nice. Very nonchalant and seemed unhappy doing her job.

Rooms were clean and modern. AC worked well and was not very noisy. Shower pressure was a bit low. Felt like a drip rain, could not adjust to make it faster.

reviews.author: Qulonda Mobley
reviews.title: Recent Stay
reviews.body:
I recently booked several rooms at Fairfield Marriott for my wedding guests, and overall, we had a wonderful experience. The hotel was clean, well-maintained, and provided a comfortable stay for everyone.

The staff was incredibly polite, welcoming, and accommodating throughout our time there. They truly made us feel valued and went above and beyond to ensure our guests were taken care of.

There was one minor issue involving my cousin’s room. She had paid for a late check-in, and upon arrival there was some confusion regarding her reservation, which initially made the process a little challenging. However, once the situation was explained, the staff quickly resolved the issue and everything worked out smoothly.

Overall, our experience was very positive. The hospitality, professionalism, and cleanliness of the hotel made a great impression on us and our guests. I would definitely recommend Fairfield Marriott to anyone looking for a comfortable and welcoming place to stay.

reviews.author: Hailey
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Would Recommend
reviews.body: This hotel is clean, comfortable, and in a great location. You cannot go wrong staying here.

reviews.author: Bobby V
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: A four star for me!  Convenient, gas station, car wash next door. The mall and shops close by.

reviews.author: Rhenry
reviews.title: Always a great stay
reviews.body: My go to for Orlando trips. Always a great stay!!!!

reviews.author: Great stay
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: The room was great but the shower was the best ever!

reviews.author: ChelleyO
reviews.title: Quick Stay to Disney’s World
reviews.body: The stat was nice. The rooms were clean and breakfast was good.

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Awesome stay before heading to our cruise . Clean, and walking distance to needed shops.

reviews.author: FQ
reviews.title: 2 Day Stay
reviews.body: Breakfast needs improvement

reviews.author: Janine
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: This Springhill Suites did not disappoint. The entie staff was amazing, the rooms were clean and spacious and the location was excellent. Plenty of food stores and a wonderful selection of restaurants in the ares.

reviews.author: Kathy Y
reviews.title: A wonderful place for any type of stay.
reviews.body: The overall facility was clean, welcoming and we'll service. The staff went above and beyond. My go to place in Orlando!

reviews.author: JB007
reviews.title: August 2026
reviews.body: Great accommodations with a welcoming staff and exceptional rooms.  Breakfast is better than most morning breakfasts serviced by others.

reviews.author: Ree1
reviews.title: Failed to Deliver on my Reservation Request
reviews.body: Called the property directly to reserve 2 rooms and requested adjoining rooms at time of reservation.  Upon check in was told no more adjoining rooms left.  How could that be?  Reservation was made months in advance of our stay.  Front desk staff did not seem to care.  Finally offered to waive the parking fee, but still did not make up for the fact that we did not get adjoining rooms. We resorted to leaving the doors ajar with trash cans so the kids could go back and forth between the 2 rooms.

reviews.author: SCC
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Staff ill informed. Not attentive. Didn’t know how the computer worked. Couldn’t give me an invoice on departure. Couldn’t tell me anything..

reviews.author: Greener1008
reviews.title: Great stay in Winter Park
reviews.body: Great hotel will meet all of your needs.

reviews.author: Travelbug
reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.body:
Excellent service from all staff I encountered. Very clean and quiet. Used the gym and that was very clean as well. A good amount of equipment for all users.

Parking was a bit limited or across the street and you have to pay in addition, that is the only complaint I can contribute. So not enough to lower my rating.

reviews.author: JoJo
reviews.title: Excellent Experience!  Highly recommend
reviews.body: Room was clean and spacious.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  Breakfast was delicious

reviews.author: WP Res
reviews.title: Awesome except parking
reviews.body: I’ve stayed here and sent friends here maybe 50 times. It’s great. Only beef is the parking situation, which is awful. And they charge for it, which is insane. Otherwise good property.

reviews.author: Tracer888
reviews.title: Decent location could use more staff
reviews.body: Relatively decent location, though it could use a lot more staff in the morning for the breakfast time considering how close it is to Disney the rooms themselves are decent enough though dated. The air-conditioning units are loud.

reviews.author: Uncle Mikey
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.body: Although they charge for parking, I had a great stay. Front desk was awesome 👌 Breakfast buffet was tasty...especially the gravy.  Yum!

reviews.author: Javier
reviews.title: Cozy place in Winter Park
reviews.body:
Upon my arrival the lady at the front desk was very kind. She delivered a very good service by asking if I need parking, and water. Then my surprise was the room. Very well distributed and cozy place. You can work, and rest well.
Very pleasant stay.

reviews.author: CPFamily
reviews.title: SpringHill Suites: Exceptional!! Thank you!!
reviews.body: I was recently traveling with a large family group. I was blessed to be able to reserve 3 rooms with my points. From the moment I arrived at the desk I was treated as if my Elite Status mattered to her. At check in she was professional and courteous, making sure all my needs were met. I went to my room feeling like a celebrity!!   The hotel was clean. Everything was exactly as I expected. In the morning, the breakfast was over and above. There was so much variety and the food was delicious. My entire family was so pleased with the food and friendly service. I specifically booked a SpringHill Suites for my return trip home. It will be in a different city so I sure hope my experience will be as excellent. Looking forward to it!!

reviews.author: EA
reviews.title: Super impressed!
reviews.body: We had a perfect experience here. Our room was spacious and clean. Service was excellent. complimentary breakfast was impressive. Perfect location

reviews.author: Yes
reviews.title: Tourism
reviews.body: Overall Excellent service, vast and clean rooms

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: This hotel was amazing.
reviews.body:
It felt new and modern. It was clean. I was surprised the free breakfast was delicious. They had mini quiches and cinnamon waffles. 
Everything was perfect.

reviews.author: Ananya Das
reviews.title: Very comfortable and excellent staff services
reviews.body: I really enjoyed my stay at springhills. The room was spacious. Staffs were great and buffet breakfast was delicious. Overall my stay was extremely comfortable..

reviews.author: Miriam F
reviews.title: Really bad on the basics.
reviews.body: The beds were hard as a rock, the door to the bathroom was very hard to open, and there was no hot water for a shower. Just a terrible experience on the basics.

reviews.author: SouthernGirl
reviews.title: Biscuits and Gravy were epic!
reviews.body: On the Saturday morning that we stayed the breakfast had really great southern biscuits and gravy.  What is more than that is that the gravy was done right!  My husband was so happy!  Beautiful location and easily accessible as well.

reviews.author: Missfroggy1028
reviews.title: Modern, spacious, loved the trundle sofa option!
reviews.body: Clean, spacious, several restaurants within walking distance. I loved the trundle sofa option!

reviews.author: CM
reviews.title: Consistently great stay
reviews.body: Every time I stay here, the rooms are very clean and the staff is very welcoming and helpful.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Elena
reviews.title: 5 Years of Awesome!
reviews.body: We have enjoyed your hotel for 5 years: from our first visit when our son was accepted to college and visited to make his final decision, all the way through his graduation this last weekend, we have visited dozens of times. The rooms are perfect for us. The hotel’s location is convenient to the college campus and local shopping. And the staff are all outstanding!

reviews.author: Alessandra
reviews.title: Grateful for Marriott's consistency
reviews.body: I love Marriott because its consistency. No matter which hotel I have stayed at, I have had warm welcomes, clean rooms, yummy breakfast and great service overall. Ive been in hospitality for 10+ years, I know high-end service, I have much experience in that space. This is home away from home. Thank You Marriott, for everything.

reviews.author: GP55
reviews.title: Great comfortable place to stay
reviews.body: Only negative issue was the $15 a day parking charge for an open air parking either outside hotel ( always full) or N lot (up the block! )

reviews.author: Mori
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Lovely hotel with great staff. Everyone was friendly and helpful, gave us a late check out!

reviews.author: CarrMac
reviews.title: Great property and good location
reviews.body: This location is in a great area with tons of walkable food and shopping. Clean property and great front desk staff.

reviews.author: Jambone
reviews.title: Springhill suites Winter Park.
reviews.body: A little too expensive for my expectations they are hidden cost associated with the price.

reviews.author: Kimberly M
reviews.title: A Great Stay from Start to Finish
reviews.body: I had a wonderful stay at SpringHill Suites by Marriott Winter Park. The hotel was very clean and well maintained, which made the stay comfortable and relaxing. The Guest Services team truly stood out—they were friendly, attentive, and went above and beyond to be helpful. I would absolutely recommend this property to anyone visiting the area, and I look forward to returning on my next trip!

reviews.author: Laura C
reviews.title: Quick weekend stay
reviews.body: Very surprised of the amenities in the room and hotel.  Loved the terrace and the coffee was very good.

reviews.author: Mrs T
reviews.title: Excellent staff & service! The hotel is impeccably clean !!!!
reviews.body: The only hotel we will stay in in Winter Park. The staff, service and cleanliness of property is impeccable. Hotel is conveniently located to several great restaurants, shopping and Park Ave!

reviews.author: 28th birthday trip
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.body: Excellent hotel. Located near Universal, Millenia Mall and convenient to downtown Orlando.

reviews.author: Workerbee1
reviews.title: 3 day stay at Marriott residence in at millenia
reviews.body: The lobby, the pool, the look of the place, the gym, the bar on-site, the secure parking…. were all excellent. When I checked in I would’ve liked to be offered a choice on how many keys. I was given only 1 and every time I went back to get more, the front desk was slammed. I also received a shipment from my company while there and it was never communicated to me. Lastly, my room smelled like mold & the beds are very uncomfortable, which is 100% common across mid-level marriotts e.g. residence inn, town place suites, Fairfield suites, etc

reviews.author: Aslyn
reviews.title: A great place to stay with family
reviews.body: Great location great for families. Proximity close to parks and shopping

reviews.author: JSB1968
reviews.title: If you like your room below 72 degrees then do NOT stay here
reviews.body:
As a Platinum elite/Titanium elite traveler within the Marriott brand I was pretty shocked at the treatment I received at this property. 

Check in was great and there is a gentleman by the name of Jose that runs the food and beverage in the mornings - he was awesome 15 out of 10!

They put me on the top floor  - the 6th. It was very hot in the room and I asked to be moved To a lower floor. They gave me a very hard time and moved me to the same floor two rooms over claiming that the Air conditioning would work. 

I told them I wanted to be moved to a lower floor. They said try this room out And we could look at moving me later. I had multiple business meetings and did not have time to argue with them so trusted that the room would cool down. 

It did not so I requested a fan. I also asked again to be moved to a lower floor. They told me that even though there were other rooms available the fan would work. After waiting for 20 minutes I finally walked out in the hallway when I heard a radio going off. 

The guy outside did not speak any English but managed to give me a very hard time about The fact that I had requested the fan. We waited in the hall for two to three minutes while he called down to the front desk and they confirmed that I needed the fan. Even with the fan the room never got below 72 degrees.

If you are an elite business traveler I would not stay at this property as they do not care that you are loyal to the brand. Seventy five to 80% of the people that were staying there were vacationers and tourists.  I guess this type of treatment is normal for that demographic???? I would think that anyone would complain - unless you like to sleep in a very warm room sweating during zoom meetings in the room.

Pity becasue it's located in a great spot.

reviews.author: KEND21774
reviews.title: Unhappy
reviews.body: The staff was very frustrating and not helpful during a fire alarm

reviews.author: BJC80
reviews.title: Like your room temperature above 72? This is your place
reviews.body: Heat wave in FL but thermostat unable to get temperature in room below 72 degrees.  Make for very uncomfortable nights sleeping in 74 degree room.  Bathroom was dirty with hair on the shower floor and walls.  Gym had two machines broken but nice they had lots of free weights. Pool area really nice, good size to relax.  Centrally located so getting to Universal or Epic was only 10 min drive.

reviews.author: Bew vacation 2026
reviews.title: Bew Vacation
reviews.body: Needs better bedding new carpet and toilet bigger

reviews.author: OrlandoVisitor
reviews.title: Needs cleanliness and upgrades
reviews.body:
The location is decent with ~20 min drive to Universal. The breakfast is decent  - however tends to over-crowd on long weekends as it is a common breakfast bar between Spring Hill and Residence Inn. Staff is friendly and helpful.
Room carpets are filthy and need deep cleaning.
Room furniture is old and torn. Our desk chair had holes in it. The stove light did not work.

reviews.author: Quicktrip2family
reviews.title: Very nice hotel and great location
reviews.body: We were very pleased overall with our stay and will stay there again.  It's very nice and a great location within walking distance of the Millenia Mall.  Lots of great outdoor space to enjoy other than the pool.

reviews.author: Lauren C
reviews.title: Good Experience Overall - Elite Member status not appreciated
reviews.body: I felt the room and rate that was given was great. I only disliked that when I needed 30 more minutes to check out due to some issues with my special needs child and 6 month old that I was told I would be charged a fee even though I am an elite member.

reviews.author: Susan M
reviews.title: Combo hotel not a great idea.
reviews.body: Never have I paid for parking. Did have to buy can of room spray. Staff and location great. Breakfast sub par. Needs renovation.

reviews.author: Michaem
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: Love this hotel! So clean and the rooms are spacious

reviews.author: Juan Luis
reviews.title: My trip
reviews.body: The facilities, staff service, and overall amenities are very good. The only point to note is the parking fee, which I do not consider appropriate.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.body: This hotel offers great value for the cost.  It’s clean and well maintained.

reviews.author: CE33
reviews.title: First and last time we will stay at this location
reviews.body: The rooms are not in great shape in the queen suites. Chairs with multiple holes. Uncomfortable chair and sleeper couch. The carpet was so dirty. Every time we showered our feet or socks would be black with 5 min. The air in the room could never get to the temperature set. My discount was removed that we were originally quoted when we booked the rooms. It went up an additional 200 plus dollars. It made the trip miserable, not sleeping well from Uncomfortable beds and couches and the temperature in the room all 4 days. I literally had to go buy a box fan that we left after the stay. No room to bring it home,  but we should have never had to buy one. My family is a loyal customer but we will never stay there again. Worst vacation we have had.

reviews.author: Clync619
reviews.title: Coming home
reviews.body: Where we stayed coming home

reviews.author: Jane and Jerry
reviews.title: Convenient and comfortable stay
reviews.body: We chose the Marriott Residence Inn for an overnight stay prior to an early morning medical appointment in Orlando. It was so homelike and comfortable and helped ease the stress before the medical appointment the next day. We would definitely stay at a Marriott Residence Inn again. It was clean, quiet, private and very reasonably priced, with such a nice, well-equipped kitchenette.

reviews.author: Timothy123
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway
reviews.body: Loved the location you visit downtown Orlando, but still nice and quiet. Tons of dining options nearby and close to International Drive and Universal Orlando.

reviews.author: Great Stay
reviews.title: Great location and value
reviews.body: We booked last minute for a family trip to universal studios. Hotel was excellent in all aspects. Great spacious rooms, excellent breakfast, great location. Found our new go to hotel in Orlando.

reviews.author: Andrea R
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Very convenient for a family trip - the rooms are clean and amenities are well kept

reviews.author: Residence Inn
reviews.title: Ron - Residence Inn at Millenia
reviews.body: Excellent.  Highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.title: Hotel smelled and was dirty and smelled of pets
reviews.body: 2 out of 10 for cleanliness and smell. Room was changed but inconvenient as we had to move all of our luggage again.

reviews.author: Prwons
reviews.title: Great mini vacation
reviews.body: Was out there for work at the KBIS show. Decided to make a mini vacation after the show. Spent the weekend visiting Disney locations. The hotel is perfectly located for any park. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.author: mmroddy
reviews.title: It was YES from the amazing smell
reviews.body:
We had a wonderful stay at Residence Inn by Marriott Orlando at Millenia from February 5–9 while attending a family wedding, and everything exceeded our expectations!

From the moment we arrived, the hotel was welcoming, clean, and beautifully maintained. One thing that truly stood out (and I have to mention it!) is how amazing the hotel smells. Every time I stepped into the common areas, I found myself saying how incredible it smelled. It’s such a small detail, but it made the entire experience feel fresh, elevated, and relaxing.

The atmosphere was perfect for our family gathering — comfortable suites, great common spaces, and a warm, inviting environment. It made celebrating such a special occasion even more enjoyable.

We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the Orlando area!

reviews.author: Jeanete
reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.body: I took a shopping trip to Orlando and stayed at the Residence Inn. It was so close to the Mall, Ikea and Nordstrom Rack that I had plenty of time to shop. The hotel is very pretty, super clean and has a lovely staff. As an elderly widow alone, safety was my priority and this hotel was definitely secure and a perfect location

reviews.author: Kathleen
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel Stay
reviews.body: This hotel was absolutely perfect! The staff was amazing! The room was nice and big and clean which made me happy because I'm a jerm-a-phobe. The lobby area had tons of room and extended out to a huge area for seating including a small bar. The free breakfast had tons of food to choose from and again alot of seating for everyone. The front of the hotel had an outside section with tables and chairs and was open and clean with plenty of space for gathering. It was beautiful!!

reviews.author: Tyrone and Sareka
reviews.title: Birthday getaway for my husband
reviews.body: My husband and I stayed at this property for two nights. We really enjoyed ourselves. The hotel was clean and the staff was great. I would without a doubt stay there again.

reviews.author: Tiffany J
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: My family stayed for a week during our vacation to visit Universal. The hotel was clean, the pool was warm, breakfast was hot and the beds were comfortable.

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.title: Stay overall is good
reviews.body: We are in this hotel for 2 days and family trip everything is good.

reviews.author: Lifetime Platinum
reviews.title: Family Disney Stay
reviews.body: See previous summary.  Overall we were very satisfied with the hotel location, amenities and staff.

reviews.author: Toni
reviews.title: Relaxing with family in Orlando
reviews.body: Love coming to this hotel when I visit family.  The pool is perfect for kids and adults, the reception service was 10/10 so attentive.  I forgot the gentleman's name who helped us but he was new and outstanding and so was his supervisor.  Will always book this hotel when I come to visit my family

reviews.author: MB555
reviews.title: Don’t expect to get sleep
reviews.body: The AC unit runs all night long and is deafening. Perhaps maintenance is a good idea at this location.

reviews.author: Tina
reviews.title: Excellent Stay, Just Skip the Parking
reviews.body:
Springhill Suites in Orlando Millennia delivered on everything that matters. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed with how clean and well-maintained the facility is. The rooms are comfortable and inviting, and the bathroom was spotless and thoughtfully designed. The food is genuinely great, which makes a real difference during a stay.
Overall, my experience was fantastic and I’d absolutely stay here again. The staff and amenities made this a really solid choice. My only complaint is the parking situation. The cost adds up quickly and felt like an unnecessary charge for what should be included.
Despite the parking fee, I’d still recommend this property. It’s a great choice for anyone visiting Orlando.

reviews.author: Chana
reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.body: Confort cleaning good service good breakfast good location

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.title: Room
reviews.body: The room was updated and modern. Great layout with a couch and desk. Walk-in closet was a bonus and appreciated.

reviews.author: Jeff O
reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Exceptional Stay from Start to Finish!
reviews.body:
Our stay at SpringHill Suites Orlando at Millenia was absolutely stellar. From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations. The hotel was exceptionally clean and well maintained, our suite was spacious and comfortable, and the entire property felt fresh, welcoming, and thoughtfully cared for.

What really stood out, though, was the hospitality. Every team member we encountered was warm, friendly, professional, and genuinely seemed to care about making our stay enjoyable. That kind of service makes such a difference and is becoming increasingly hard to find.

The location is also fantastic—convenient to everything we needed while still providing a comfortable place to relax and recharge at the end of the day.

It's rare to leave a hotel without being able to think of a single thing that could have been better, but that was truly our experience here. From the accommodations and cleanliness to the service and hospitality, they got it right.

We will absolutely stay here again whenever we're in Orlando. Highly recommended and a very well-deserved five stars!

reviews.author: KV0605
reviews.title: Stay at millenia
reviews.body: Breakfast was great & front staff was friendly.

reviews.author: Kmm119
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.body: Fantastic stay from start to finish. The entire hotel delivered exactly what I hoped for — and more. The staff were warm, welcoming, and genuinely helpful throughout my visit. The pool area was absolutely beautiful, spotless, and perfect for relaxing. Breakfast was another highlight: fresh, well‑prepared, and far better than the typical hotel spread.

reviews.author: crazy8theory1975
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Very clean and service is awesome

reviews.author: Peaches MIA
reviews.title: Excellent Pick!
reviews.body: Excellent overall. Great location. Mall across the street. Cleanliness and attractiveness. Friendly staff. Buffet breakfast is one of the best. Very busy location due to all of this excellence.

reviews.author: Fatima
reviews.title: Wonderful stayed 2026
reviews.body: We have a wonderful time staying at the hotel my son loved the pool and enjoyed every day. So comfortable and I loved the secure surroundings.

reviews.author: Frequent Traveler
reviews.title: Great location and well appointed for business travel
reviews.body: This location is perfect for business travelers looking for accommodations away from the theme park crowd.  There is a noce bar in the lobby and the rooms are quiet.

reviews.author: Orlando
reviews.title: First time at Springhill suites
reviews.body: That first stay that which gonna win our hearts

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.title: Weekend trip
reviews.body: The hotel was in a safe location near the mall. Parking was not an issue. There was parking on both sides of the hotel. Springhill and Residence in share hotels with the front desk separating their sides and they share the hotel amenities. The rooms were very comfortable and clean. Breakfast was always busy, crowded and tight. No cheese for the eggs and the waffle station always had a line of over 7 folks. Besides that it was a great stay.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.title: Great Find!
reviews.body: This Hotel came as a recommendation and we are so pleased that we booked in. We had three nights here and were impressed by how peaceful it was despite knowing the Hotel was quite busy. Reception and Ball staff all very friendly. We didn’t make the included breakfast facility nor did we may use of the restaurant facilities. The Pool area was clean and a nice place to spend time in, as was the outside relaxation area. If you’re looking for somewhere close to Universal Studios then this place comes highly recommended. It’s also just over the road from the Millenia Mall.

reviews.author: J Stand
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: This hotel is close to food shops and is amazingly clean not to mention the staff was super friendly

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.title: Quick
reviews.body: As always this hotel will keep my corporate stay

reviews.author: D Squared
reviews.title: Millenia/Universal visit
reviews.body: I’m so glad I booked our rooms here as it wasn’t full of people going to the parks, but people attending cheerleading camps and things and was right in front of a mall that had excellent food court and was a 15 minute ride on side roads to Universal…

reviews.author: E Medina
reviews.title: Family trip to the parks
reviews.body: SpringHill Suites by Marriott Orlando at Millenia was a great choice for our weekend trip to Orlando. Just a few minutes from universal studios, we enjoyed the convenience and ease of getting around. From the parking to the breakfast, everything was accessible and had many options. The hotel was clean and organized and the staff were very friendly. Will definitely return and recommend for family trips!

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.title: Excellent stay for Universal
reviews.body: We stayed here for Fathers Day Weekend. We are Annual pass holders for Universal and frequently get hotels in the area. This was the best selection for a simple quick weekend getaway. The rooms are excellent. The property is beautifully done with a great outdoor area, BBQ and very nice and clean (and large) pool for the kids. The location is great, it was a low cost Uber to the park and excellent location next to a mall for shopping and food. The staff has the Marriott customer service down pat and we were very pleased. We never seem to live the food at these brands of hotel but we got alone with a decent pizza for the kids and a salad that had pretty good flavors. Overall we really appreciated this property and will be back!!  The constant aroma spray in the air is a major plus I loved it!!

reviews.author: David H
reviews.title: Great for Business Travel
reviews.body: The SpringHill @ Millenia property is an excellent property for business travelers.  The rooms are spacious and clean.  Everything was modern, and is centrally located near restaurants, groceries stores and other shopping.  I would stay at the property again on my next trip to Orlando.

reviews.author: Scotty
reviews.title: Nice but pricey and overcharged
reviews.body: They won’t respond to why they charged me a restraint fee when I never used the restaurant.

reviews.author: NakitaG
reviews.title: Best Kept Secret
reviews.body: The hotel is truly a gem. The location is prime. Minutes away from all of the attractions, however, not too crowded. The staff is amazing. We came to enjoy the parks and were are large family of 12. We stayed in 3 rooms. I enjoyed the daily housekeeping and the property as a whole was very nice and clean. The signature scent was wonderful. We had food and drinks on night from the bar in the lobby and the wings were a treat. Our kids enjoyed the pool nightly, and the towels at the pool were extremely convenient. On our check out day, one of our cars ran hot and needed tot be taken to the local dealership. The front desk staff were very kind and they extended our check out time to help us get the car situated. I can’t say enough good things about this hotel. We have stayed here many times and plan to stay many more times in the future. Well done.

reviews.author: Vacationer
reviews.title: Orlando Vacation
reviews.body: Top rated for location and access to Universal.  Breakfast options are abundant with the breakfast staff being the absolute highlight of the stay.  The breakfast attendants go out of the way to make the morning comfortable and enjoyable.  Always smiling and positive with absolutely delicious coffee.  Common areas were clean and tidy, but room was showing some wear (slow drains, toilet not always working properly).  Minor concerns, but nothing that hindered our stay.  This property is always a fan favorite when we vacation in Orlando.

reviews.author: Plight
reviews.title: Spacious and convenient.
reviews.body:
The location was so convenient to the Millennial Mall. We were able to cross the walking bridge and walk into the mall food court to eat or shop.  It was so nice to get a quick lunch or just a late snack. The beds were comfortable and the room was spacious. I especially liked the walk-in closet that I used as a dressing room because my grandson was in the room with us. The bathroom was modern and roomy. The pool was nice with an area for children and the outdoor areas had grills for us to use and tables for eating. This hotel had the best breakfast area and selection of foods. I mean, cage free scrambled eggs. The only issue with the room was that towels were not replaced without us initiating the exchange or notifying the front desk except for one time in a four night stay. 
I was also surprised that parking was a bit pricy

reviews.author: Suly
reviews.title: Great price for excellent stay
reviews.body: Excellent and comfortable place to be very convenient area close to everything I needed

reviews.author: Frequent Bonvoy
reviews.title: Great place for a staycation
reviews.body:
We wanted to get out of the house for the weekend. We drove to Orlando and really enjoyed ourselves. We went to the local supermarket grab some food and came and turned on the grill. Enjoyed the pool area and the staff was great. The rooms were very clean housekeeping was on top of everything and the fragrance throughout the hotel was great seeing as though pets were allowed.

Only room for improvement I can see would be during the breakfast timeframe maybe more staff to ensure the tables were being cleaned as people were leaving but other than that, everything was great.

reviews.author: Amanda F
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.body: My stay at SpringHill Suites by Marriott Orlando at Millenia was amazing! The hotel was spotless, modern, and incredibly comfortable. The staff was welcoming, professional, and went above and beyond to make my stay enjoyable. The location is perfect — close to shopping, restaurants, and attractions while still feeling peaceful and safe. One of the best hotel experiences I’ve had in Orlando, and I would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dikla
reviews.title: Good
reviews.body: Great location great hotel

reviews.author: Stephan12
reviews.title: Best Stay Ever!!
reviews.body: Excellent hotel for a stay, whether with family or for work. The staff is incredibly friendly, the hotel is spotless and smells wonderful, the breakfast is spectacular, and the pool area is the perfect place to relax. If you're visiting the parks, its location is convenient. Honestly, one of the best hotels I've ever stayed in.

reviews.author: Martin
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.body: El personal siempre atento amable y a disposición de los huéspedes.

reviews.author: Patty
reviews.title: Mixed Experience at Residence Inn Universal
reviews.body: The location near Universal parks and outlets, the shuttle service, and the included breakfast align well with the residential concept. However, management and room maintenance fell short. We had an unaddressed dishwasher breakdown and were moved to a room with failing AC and a heavy cigarette smell that left us with sore throats and coughing. Great concept and location, but execution in service and maintenance needs work.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great location and service, but two comfort issues affected our sleep
reviews.body:
We stayed at the Residence Inn by Marriott Near Universal Orlando and had a mixed experience. On the plus side, the staff were consistently friendly and helpful throughout our stay, the free shuttle service to the parks was a huge convenience, and the continental breakfast was solid every morning.

Unfortunately, two things kept this from being a great stay. An extractor fan near our window cycled on and off constantly throughout the night, making it very difficult to get quality sleep. The sofa bed was also quite uncomfortable, which was a letdown for anyone in our group who used it. On a smaller note, the water dispenser for filling the fridge pitcher was awkward to use and could use a redesign.

reviews.author: Christina K
reviews.title: Didn’t want to leave!
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay so much that we didn’t want to leave! We were so close to the theme parks we were visiting, overall great location! The room and the bathroom was very spacious!

reviews.author: R Zeigler
reviews.title: Residence Inn near Universal Studios Orlando
reviews.body:
Upon arrival the hotel and grounds were impressive because they were clean and well maintained by the staff.
The staff was genial, considerate, and helpful.  Our room, a one bedroom suite, was clean and well appointed and became my family's home for 3 nights.
The hotel was perfect for a Universal Studios Orlando vacation because of proximity to the park, onsite Universal concierge, and Universal shuttle which picked up and dropped off in front of the hotel.
The hotel provided an excellent breakfast experience which has hot and plentiful and free, just like the parking.
Overall, I have to say that our vacation was outstanding due to making the decision to stay at the Marriott Residence Inn near Universal and the high quality of the hotel and staff.

reviews.author: Michael from New Jersey
reviews.title: Don't go to the free breakfast and you'll have a wonderful time at this Residence Inn
reviews.body: Clean and comfortable hotel. Helpful front desk.  The hotel does not provide daily room cleaning, though you can easily  pick up extra towels from the front. Solid sound insulation. Good water pressure. Good HVAC and rooms are free of humidity or mustiness despite the humid weather.  Breakfasts are simple, and put out by staff that demonstrate eagerness for the guest to leave so that they can clean-up.  As a Titanium member, this was the first time seeing kitchen staff frowning and pushing children away from getting food because the clock has just hit 10am.  The look of disdain on these staffs' faces were horrific.

reviews.author: M W
reviews.title: Poor Communication and Follow-Through
reviews.body:
I was disappointed with how my stay was handled. Earlier in the day, I was informed that due to a system issue, the room I originally reserved with two beds was unavailable. I agreed to accept a one-bedroom room with a rollaway bed and was told the rollaway would be provided.

We arrived late at night expecting everything to be ready, but the rollaway bed had not been set up. After contacting the front desk, we waited more than an hour for it to arrive. When it finally did, it would not properly fit in the room. We ended up having to move furniture ourselves just to make it work so we could finally get some sleep.

The front desk apologized and told me the $30 parking charge would be waived because of the inconvenience. At checkout the next morning, however, the associate could not find any record of that and attempted to charge me for parking anyway.

I understand that room changes and mistakes can happen. What was frustrating was the lack of communication and follow-through at multiple points. After a late arrival, this created unnecessary stress when we simply wanted to get settled and rest. Unfortunately, based on this experience, I would not choose to stay at this property again.

reviews.author: Disgruntled Patron
reviews.title: Billing Error and Poor Customer Service Experience
reviews.body:
I attempted to make a reservation through the Marriott Bonvoy app but encountered technical issues during the process. Because I wasn’t confident the reservation had gone through, my girlfriend booked the same stay using the HotelTonight app instead.
Despite the original Bonvoy reservation not appearing to complete, I was later billed for it. I submitted a complaint through customer service but never received any response.
I then called the hotel directly to resolve the issue. Unfortunately, the manager I spoke with was extremely unhelpful and came across as dismissive and inattentive. The phone connection was poor—it sounded like I was on speakerphone—and it seemed as though she was distracted and not fully listening. She simply stated there was nothing they could do, without offering any meaningful assistance.
Due to this experience, both with the billing issue and the lack of customer support, I have since stopped using Marriott properties for both personal and business travel.
I would appreciate this matter being reviewed and a proper resolution provided.

reviews.author: Fefed
reviews.title: FIFA Fans No Fun
reviews.body:
Our stay was significantly impacted by the large number of Colombian soccer fans in town to support their team during the FIFA tournament against Portugal. The atmosphere was certainly exciting, but it created major challenges for hotel guests. Numerous streets surrounding the hotel were closed or blocked by police, making access extremely difficult. We ultimately had to call the hotel for directions on which streets remained open.

It would have been very helpful if the hotel had proactively emailed guests before arrival with information about the event, road closures, recommended routes, and what to expect. That communication would have allowed guests to better plan their arrival or even adjust or cancel their reservations if they preferred to avoid the crowds.

Because of the event, it took us an additional 20 minutes just to reach the hotel, another 15 minutes to complete check-in, and then we waited approximately 15 minutes for an elevator that never arrived. With an infant, young children, and a puppy, we ultimately carried everything up nine flights of stairs in a non-air-conditioned stairwell. Looking back, I wish we had requested a room on a lower floor once it became clear the elevators were overwhelmed.

Checking out the following day was equally chaotic. We waited approximately 20 minutes in the Florida heat for our vehicle while the surrounding streets remained congested.

Despite these circumstances, the hotel staff did an outstanding job with the situation they could control. Everyone we interacted with was friendly, professional, and genuinely helpful. The valet team worked hard under difficult conditions and remained courteous throughout our stay. The manager, in particular, demonstrated exceptional professionalism, empathy, and customer service. He took the time to listen to our concerns, showed genuine care, and provided meaningful compensation for the inconvenience, which we greatly appreciated.

While I understand the excitement surrounding an international sporting event, I do wish some of the Colombian fans had been more mindful of other hotel guests. Many were extremely loud and disruptive, making it difficult for families seeking a relaxing stay. On a positive note, the police did an outstanding job maintaining order, managing traffic, and ensuring everyone's safety throughout the event.

Overall, the hotel itself and its staff deserve high marks for their professionalism during an unusually challenging weekend. Better advance communication regarding major events affecting hotel operations would have made a significant difference in the guest experience.

Our stay was impacted by multiple issues with the hotel itself, including cleanliness concerns, lack of responsiveness from staff, and overall poor communication. Given the rate we paid and the expectations set for a tournament stay, the experience fell well short.

I’ve already shared detailed feedback directly with hotel management, but I believe it’s important for others to be aware. We were hoping for a comfortable and convenient stay during a busy tournament weekend, and sadly that wasn’t the case.

reviews.author: Colanst
reviews.title: Clean and comfortable
reviews.body: We stayed at the Element ed roof before taking a cruise. The room was clean and comfortable. We tried going to their well advertised roof bar but the music playing was deafening. We couldn't hear each other talk even though we were basically yelling. We ate at the lobby bar and had one of the best Margarita pizzas we ever tasted. The bartenders were awesomrryoe as well. At 4:00 AM the fire alarm went off and an announcement came on instructing everyone to evacuate due to a fire emergency. We got up and quickly dressed tevo leave the room. After going down 9 flights of stairs (as we were told not to use the elevators), the alarm stopped, but no announcem came on stating the emergency was over. We ended up going back to the room but obviously could not go back to sleep due to the commotion. When zi checked out I told the clerk I expected some kind of compensation for the inconvenience. He told me he would discuss it with his manager and I should expect the  call. That never happened.

reviews.author: LP
reviews.title: The element Fort Lauderdale downtown.
reviews.body: Overall an excellent location. The room was clean, the food was good and I like that they will store your luggage. Housekeeping is poor in that there was not enough utensils for four people other than four knives there were two spoons and three forks (we realized after ordering dinner in). The bathroom only had two bath towels for four people which I realized too late in the morning and had to use a wet used towel though my reservation was for four people. The dishes in the kitchen were dirty with dried food I could ship away with my fingernail and had to be washed with the bowl still having chip crumbs in it put away in the cupboard. So the issue is housekeeping. Overall a nice place to stay as long as you address the housekeeping issue before going to eat and having a shower.

reviews.author: Stakingontheworld
reviews.title: Awesome service and offerings! Highly recommend this hotel in the city!
reviews.body: My family and I stayed at the Element hotel for one night in prep of jumping on our very first family cruise!  We were not nearly as prepared for the cruise and I realized that thanks to the Elements staff who provided some wonderful guidance!  After 8+ hours of flying (and early morning start) we arrived at the hotel greeted by the staff with all smiles!  They immediately welcomed us with cookies, champagne & snacks (we arrived during a weekday afternoon.) They inquired what the reason of our stay and as soon as I educated them on our first Cruise, they asked if we were ready and already had out luggage tags printed. I had no idea I needed to print anything!  They offered to print labels and help with whatever we needed!  The restaurant on site was delicious!  Although the food is pricey (let's be honest, every restaurant in Fort Lauderdale is pricey), my two teens, husband and I enjoyed the steak, chicken and burgers!  We ate every bite and the service was icing on the cake!  Room had all the needed utensils, frig, burners and all.  This was definitely an A+ experience in all way!

reviews.author: ALEONDC
reviews.title: My Go to Hotel in Fort Lauderdale
reviews.body: Delmar is an awesome location located near all of the downtown restaurants to include Las Olas and Flagler Village. The rooms are clean, spacious, and luxurious with an awesome view. It’s my go to hotel when I’m in South Florida. The staff is great to include valet, front desk, and the restaurants as well as the cleaning staff. Well, the outside put deck could use some tender, loving care, the pool and the view are awesome options as alternatives to going to the beach. If you desire to go to the beach, there is an awesome shuttle and complementary beach chairs adjacent to the Ritz Carlton on the beach.

reviews.author: David W
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.body: Outstanding experience beginning to end. Fantastic customer service with every interaction. Room was incredible. Facilities were immaculate and memorable. All around amazing experience.

reviews.author: RobLisa 140
reviews.title: July 31st Stay
reviews.body: Spent time at the pool and had dinner/drinks in restaurant, just all around wonderful service

reviews.author: SloLove
reviews.title: Home Sweet Home
reviews.body:
My two-night stay at The Dalmar was absolutely exceptional. I planned this as a special staycation with someone very important to me, and the experience exceeded every expectation. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel genuinely welcomed and valued.

The hotel is beautiful, modern, and impeccably maintained. Our room was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a relaxing getaway. One of the highlights of our stay was when the team graciously fulfilled my request by gifting me a hotel robe. It was such a thoughtful surprise and a gesture that truly made the experience feel personal and memorable.

Every staff member we encountered was friendly, professional, and dedicated to providing outstanding hospitality. The amenities, atmosphere, and location made for the perfect staycation in Fort Lauderdale.

Thank you to everyone at The Dalmar for making our visit so special. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and will gladly recommend The Dalmar to my friends, family, and colleagues. A well-deserved 10 out of 10!

reviews.author: Kward317
reviews.body:
The Dalmar was a great home base for our time in Fort Lauderdale. The mid-century modern design gives it a lot of personality — it doesn't feel like a generic hotel lobby, and the rooftop views are a nice touch at golden hour.
Check-in is what really made the stay, though. Kelsey at the front desk was amazing — warm, efficient, and made the whole arrival process feel effortless. That kind of first impression sets the tone for the entire visit, and she nailed it. Easily a 10/10 start to the trip.
Location is walkable to Las Olas and the Riverwalk, which made evenings easy without needing a car. Would happily stay here again.

reviews.author: TheDalmarBust
reviews.title: The Dalmar Bust
reviews.body: The room was dank.  The A/C worked but it was unknown why the room was so humid, sticky really.  I am an attorney and was in town several days for business.  My wife was with me, but in Ft. Lauderdale to instead relax.  The Front Desk staff was apathetic at best and rude at times to my wife.  My wife asked about the hotel room associated museum access and was told vague information, never given specific venue information, and that basically my wife could figure it out on her own.  My wife asked about the transport to the beach and if there was restroom access at the beach and was told it was possible the Ritz maybe would permit her to use their facilities, but that was not a certainty.  Consequently, my wife, a licensed professional in her own right, was stuck in the hotel room for days while I was away conducting business.  I came back to the hotel room after a long day at work to find my wife frustrated and upset.   Its like The Dalmar staff went out of its way to make my wife's stay miserable.  At the end of our stay I collected some food related garbage my wife had accumulated from being stuck in the room for days and I took it to the 6th Floor front desk seeking to dispose of the trash.  After waiting for the front desk clerk to finish on the phone and actually acknowledge me, he then asked me to carry the refuse to a different part of the hotel and to ask for their help instead.  For the money, the hotel was not at all impressive.  Further, given the substandard and unprofessional service, we definitely won't be back.  I told the hosting law firm in Ft. Lauderdale the bad news about The Dalmar and suggested they form a new relationship with a different local hotel.  Two thumbs down for The Dalmar.

reviews.author: Happy campers
reviews.title: Great location to stay in Fort Lauderdale
reviews.body: Tanisha the director of first impressions was a gem... she couldn't of been more helpful!!!!

reviews.author: South Florida Weekender
reviews.title: Fabulous weekend stay at the Dalmar.
reviews.body: We chose the Dalmar for its proximity to the airport and the venue we were going to for a bridal shower.  We arrived late as our flight was delayed.  The hotel staff were very accommodating and provided us with a room upgrade which was very welcome as we were all exhausted.  The next morning Lorena Portillo of housekeeping asked if we needed anything and brought us what we needed.  The next morning there was some confusion as to our breakfast and what was included with our stay, but our server was extremely helpful in sorting it all out and made every effort to ensure that we were completely satisfied.  We could not have asked for better service from everyone involved with our stay.  I highly recommend the Dalmar.

reviews.author: Blessed2
reviews.title: Exceeded my expectations
reviews.body: The Dalmar, Fort Lauderdale, exceeded our expectations. We loved the area which was convenient to everything which made our stay even more enjoyable!

reviews.author: Traveler Review
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Chaotic Arrival and No Communication About Our Lost Luggage
reviews.body:
Our stay at the Dalmar began under very challenging circumstances. When we arrived around 9:45 p.m. on June 26, the hotel was surrounded by thousands of Colombian soccer fans celebrating the World Cup. The celebration itself was not the issue—we understand that large events happen and can create an exciting atmosphere.

The problem was the hotel's management of the situation. Because of the overwhelming crowds and heavy security presence, it took us approximately 45 minutes just to gain access to a single elevator so we could check in. After a long day of travel, this was extremely frustrating. The individuals controlling access to the elevators even told us they did not work for the hotel, which left us questioning who was responsible for ensuring hotel guests could access the property safely and efficiently.

Once we finally reached the front desk, our experience improved. The hotel itself is beautiful, and the front desk employee who assisted us was friendly, welcoming, and professional.

Unfortunately, we encountered another issue when we tried to have dinner. The restaurant was so packed that there was no opportunity to sit down and eat. However, I do want to recognize the restaurant manager, who went above and beyond by taking our order and personally arranging for it to be delivered to our room after 10:30 p.m. We truly appreciated that effort, especially so late at night after a long day of traveling.

The most disappointing part of our experience came after our stay. We accidentally left a piece of luggage behind when we checked out. The suitcase was clearly labeled with my name and contact information, yet no one from the hotel attempted to call or email us to let us know it had been found. We only learned the luggage was at the hotel after I emailed the property three days later to ask if it had been turned in. Had the hotel contacted us when it was discovered, we could have attempted to retrieve it before boarding our nine-day cruise. Instead, we spent our entire vacation without our clothing and other personal belongings.

Overall, the property is beautiful, and several employees provided excellent customer service once we were able to interact with them. However, the hotel's handling of guest access during a major event and the lack of communication after locating our lost luggage significantly impacted what should have been the start of a wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: Captain
reviews.title: No focus on the guest
reviews.body: No one seemed to care that our entire stay was a debacle despite asking for a manger twice. Just was one bad thing after the other. 2 hours before checkout we found our bed stripped and our drinks gone after we specifically asked not to touch our room. Had no choice but to checkout before our stay was over. Manager offered free food at the bar and discounted our stay but it should have been comped once we could not take a nap because the maid stripped the bed and threw our drinks out. The place has no communication and is very disconnected between the staff and throughout the hotel. I’m still waiting for my adjustment to my bill. I’ll probably have to physically go there and fight to fix it.

reviews.author: Shannon Aaron
reviews.title: Thank you Robert Greening!!!
reviews.body: Incredible service!!!  I was behind schedule about 2 hours and Robert Greening was AMAZING!!!  Thank you for your genuine care and service!!!  Gratefully, Shannon Aaron

reviews.author: Jasmine
reviews.title: Awesome.
reviews.body: Love the hotel and the staff!

reviews.author: Samantha
reviews.title: Exceptional Service, Beautiful Junior Suite, and a Great South Florida Stay
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at The Dalmar in Fort Lauderdale and had an excellent overall experience.

The service was outstanding from start to finish. I booked through American Express Travel, and the hotel honored a complimentary upgrade from a standard room to a spacious Junior Suite. I also received an $18 hotel credit, which I believe is offered to all guests. The property feels modern and well-maintained, with smart elevators that are impressively fast and convenient.

Upon entering the suite, I was immediately struck by how spacious it was and appreciated the beautiful city views. The hotel went above and beyond with several thoughtful touches, including a personalized welcome card, a pre-made mojito with complimentary Bacardí, and a pre-filled ice bucket waiting in the room.

The suite itself was exceptionally well-appointed, featuring two televisions, two separate toilet areas, a refrigerator, a cocktail mixing station, large windows that filled the space with natural light, and an enormous glass-enclosed shower. The king bed was plush, comfortable, and made for a very relaxing stay.

My only significant issue was with room 1020. There was a low humming noise coming from above the bedroom that intermittently woke me during the night. Unfortunately, even earplugs did little to block it out, and it affected my sleep on two of the three nights I stayed. This is something I hope management investigates, as it was the only notable drawback of an otherwise excellent room.

If I had one minor suggestion, it would be to add a bit more artwork or décor to the living area, particularly above the sofa. The space is beautiful but feels slightly sparse in that section.

The sixth-floor restaurant, bar, and pool area were highlights of the property. The staff was attentive and professional, and the bartenders made excellent cocktails. The infinity pool offers great city views, and enjoying an Aperol Spritz while watching the sunset was one of the highlights of my stay. The fitness center was clean and reasonably equipped, although somewhat small. Each morning I grabbed coffee and a light breakfast from Rose's Coffee Bar, which was both convenient and enjoyable.

While there were several amenities and dining venues I didn't have time to explore, the overall aesthetic, atmosphere, and level of service throughout the hotel were exceptional. Finding a truly standout hotel in South Florida can sometimes be a challenge, but The Dalmar exceeded my expectations. I would absolutely stay here again and would rank it among my top choices in the Fort Lauderdale area.

reviews.author: jkendall
reviews.title: Great meeting venue
reviews.body: From top to bottom the stay was excellent

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body:
As someone who travels often and stays in many hotels, I can confidently say The Dalmar stands out.

My room was spotless, well-designed, and the hotel itself was beautifully maintained. What truly made the stay exceptional, though, was the staff. The restaurant (6th floor) wait staff were  warm and welcoming each morning, and the front desk staff were consistently friendly and helpful.

Breakfast was delicious and something I looked forward to daily.

As a Platinum Marriott Bonvoy member, I appreciate the details that make a stay memorable, and The Dalmar delivered. Highly recommend and would gladly stay again.

reviews.author: Andrew 2215
reviews.title: Cockroaches
reviews.body:
We check in May 20 2026, after 2 nights we found cockroaches in our room so we had to move our whole family to another room at 11pm at night . We have young kids and it was an extreme inconvenience. Hotel did not show any signs of good faith. Did not even take that night off the invoice. On top of all that we got home and found cockroaches in our son’s hockey bag that we had with us in the hotel room. We threw all his equipment out when we got home after seeing that. 
Hope nobody else has this experience!

reviews.author: Missy
reviews.title: Best hotel ever
reviews.body: I absolutely loved my stay. The staff made sure I reaped the benefits of a Bonvoy member with a room upgrade, and the excellent customer service of the staff was fabulous. The location is great and the shuttle service is an extra perk. The rooms were cleaned everyday and the pool the the nearby bar was the icing on the cake.

reviews.author: Andy Desir
reviews.title: Service
reviews.body: Exceptional hospitality in the City of Fort Lauderdale with an abundance of Hotels in the area. Delmar is the place I would stay over and over again!

reviews.author: tommi215
reviews.title: Horrible Service
reviews.body:
The hotel looked nice at first, but my stay quickly turned into an extremely frustrating and disappointing experience. The toilet in my room became clogged, so I immediately called the front desk and was told someone would come up shortly. After waiting 40 minutes to an hour with no update and no one arriving, I called again hoping for some kind of assistance or explanation. Instead, the front desk staff couldn’t even provide an estimate for when someone would show up and simply told me to “keep waiting,” which I found completely unacceptable and dismissive.

What made the situation even more upsetting was the lack of communication or effort to resolve the issue. A simple response like, “Let me check on that for you and call you back,” would have shown at least some level of professionalism or concern. Instead, I was left sitting in a room with a unusable toilet for over 90 minutes feeling ignored and inconvenienced.

After an hour and a half of waiting, someone finally arrived — only to hand me a plunger. While I understand things happen, making a guest wait that long just to be handed a plunger felt unreasonable and honestly insulting. For a hotel that appears nice on the surface, the customer service and handling of basic maintenance issues were incredibly disappointing.

reviews.author: Florida
reviews.title: Hospitality
reviews.body:
I want to Thank the staff of the Dalmar hotel for their kindness and going above and beyond to help my family.  During our stay my daughter suffered a fall at the beach and had emergency surgery.  When we returned to the hotel, the valet guys were so kind to help us get her off the vehicle and up to our room.  The front desk, and housekeeping assisted us through the whole process making sure my daughter was comfortable.  The security guy was very kind and facilitated our exit process smoothly.   The staff at the Roses bar were so friendly to my son when he dined there, the food was great!  Our shuttle guy was very nice and gave us all the information for the beach.  I attended for a conference, and everything was good.  I truly appreciate everyone at The Dalmar they made a scary situation for us less painful.  
Thank you-Vejar family.

reviews.author: adam
reviews.title: Stunning Corner View and Great Overall Stay
reviews.body: The Dalmar was a great stay overall. The pool area was beautiful, and the corner room with a balcony had incredible, seemingly endless views. The only downside was the rooftop bar noise. I enjoy music and don’t mind a lively atmosphere, but on Sunday night it felt more like a full-on DJ club, with heavy bass thumping late into the night.

reviews.author: Suitcase
reviews.title: Hotel chooses profits from loud parties and live music over the comfort of their guests.
reviews.body: it is impossible to stay at this hotel.  There is no sleeping at night.

reviews.author: LCruz83
reviews.title: Absolutely Stunning Hotel
reviews.body:
I had the most AMAZING stay at this Courtyard Marriott! Top notch customer service, friendly staff, clean premises and rooms, absolutely STUNNING rooftop pool and bar, I stayed for one day and didn't want to leave! My bartender, Kat, was just the cutest and nicest, and the front desk rep Monique is just FABULOUS! I cant say enough great things about my stay. My room was clean, cozy, spacious, and comfy! Oh, and the best part is I had a MICROWAVE AND MINI FRIDGE!!! What place does that anymore!?? I pray you guys NEVER take that away! The restaurant was just PERFECTION! I will come back and stay there or the W on Ft Lauderdale Beach EVERY TIME I VISIT!!!! Nowhere else!

Marriott is constantly updating their locations to stay on top of hospitality trends and modern developments! The premises are clean, spacious, practical yet modern and fresh! There is fresh water in the lobby, the hotel smells amazing, and the designs are beautiful! I can't wait to return!

reviews.author: C Dinerstein
reviews.title: Awesome location
reviews.body: We had an overall great experience. The location was perfect. It was close to many restaurants and walking distance to everything they had valet service that was very convenient because the parking is not great.

reviews.author: BonvoyMember
reviews.title: Beautiful property but staff needs training
reviews.body: I would not stay at this property again, nor recommend it if customer service matters. The property is beautiful and the room was very nice and clean. I was greeted by Alejandro who was apparently asleep when I arrived to check in. He had zero interest in helping me with my check in. He was very rude and short. He never mentioned my Bonvoy membership, and said nothing about the property or amenities. I reported this situation to the Front desk manager the next morning who simply tried to justify the behavior of his team member with no apology. I won’t stay there again.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Barnet Jones
reviews.body: Amazing front desk staff and amazing F&B staff

reviews.author: Barnet
reviews.title: Food and beverage service
reviews.body: F&B service staff is amazing Kat, V and Rick were awesome with suggesting current and potential new menu items that were great. Their service was 10/10

reviews.author: Waited Longtime
reviews.title: It’s ok
reviews.body: Ok, waiting 5 hours to check in.

reviews.author: MM
reviews.title: Solid Service
reviews.body: After renovations, this Courtyard gives the impression of a higher class hotel. It is clean and very well appointed with good water pressure that allows for a better experience when taking a shower. The staff was also very accommodating in changing us to a different room given the people in our original next room were noisy and they were coming loud and clear through the connecting room door

reviews.author: TLH
reviews.title: 5 Star Stay
reviews.body: This hotel is warm, inviting, clean and quiet. Decor and art are stunning; not what you typically envision in a Courtyard. Welcoming, inviting spaces to gather, top of the line amenities and top notch service. As someone who travels for a living and is a Marriott member, this is one of the nicest hotels I have ever stayed at. It’s a don’t miss if traveling to Fort Lauderdale.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: undefined
reviews.body:
My stay at the Courtyard by Marriott was such a pleasant experience. The room was comfortable, the balcony offered a beautiful view, and the pool was definitely one of my favorite parts of the stay. 🌴✨

The room was nice and cool — and when I say the AC was on BURRRR, I mean I slept like a baby! 😂🥶

Overall, it was a relaxing and enjoyable stay, and I appreciated having a comfortable space to unwind and enjoy some much-needed time away. I would definitely stay again. ❤️

reviews.author: Happy customer
reviews.title: Best stay ever
reviews.body: Can’t hear from my husband‘s 45th birthday and it was phenomenal. We had an amazing room, room 701. We had a balcony room. Which what I booked and  the corner balcony was perfect ! Will visit again

reviews.author: Z
reviews.title: Great stay.
reviews.body: I enjoyed my stay very much. The property is in an excellent location, close to restaurants and other stores right across the street. My room was specious and clean. The highlight of my stay it was definitely rooftop pool and the bar. Staff at the front desk was excellent, so the bartenders at the bar. Overall, I enjoyed everything that was there to offer.

reviews.author: G
reviews.title: Needs to be cleaned up should I ever stay again. But won’t.
reviews.body: The staff are lovely but the place is not clean. The pool rooftop needs standards. Like cleaned couches and couples prevented from being so despicable they have sex out in public. The surrounding area is very good. The gym needs some upgrades.

reviews.author: DVR
reviews.title: Great Stay and Staff.  Stay Away From Guest Washing Machines
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, I had to use the Guest Laundry washing machine  during my stay.   So this wasnt my own personal washer I decided to wipe out between the rubber creases of the washer.  The amount of dirt and hair and I dont know what else came out of those creases was nothing short of disgusting!  I had to use the gym towels to continue cleaning out the machine.  It was so gross.

I expected a much cleaner washing machine Marriott has for their Guests to use.  That was unbelievable.  Simple Solution:  Start having a Houseman wipe out the machines, the creases.  Run a clean cycle.  But something need to be done.

reviews.author: Horror
reviews.title: DMV mentality at the front desk.
reviews.body:
Aside from getting physically ill from the food at the restaurant and asking for a refund upon checkout and not receiving it, the overnight girl’s name was Jasmine was an absolute nightmare. After spending 45 years staying at Marriott hotels worldwide this was the worst experience of my life. I even had to speak to Security like I was some cat burglar or some sort of felon. I will never go back to that property. I simply wanted a late  checkout which I have the right to as a longtime member… And she treated me like a child. When I called downstairs to extend the stay for an extra day, she scolded me and then called Security when I came to the front desk. I’ve never been so mortified… And physically ill from staying at a hotel. Run don’t walk away from this hotel. I’m going to give Marriott a two-year respite from using their hotels and my Marriott credit card just as a show of distain for their new lack of service and training.
See you mid 2028 possibly.

reviews.author: Kameron
reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.body:
The absolute worst customer service i have ran into in a hotel.
There was a party going on loud enough it sounded like it was the next room over. At 1130pm when I called front desk I was told "it happens, we are known as a party hotel" this morning when I went down the lady informed me "its the first I have heard about it. Nothing I can do anyways but my manager will be in at noon" mind you check out is earlier than that. 
Waking up at 7am to shower I had a five minute shower, as I opened the bathroom door my smoke alarm instantly started to go off due to lack of bathroom ventilation and the steam. 
Room looked nice, bed was very uncomfortable and the smart TV was glitched/frozen almost half the time. So thankfully it atleast looked nice as we were kept awake by a party and couldn't watch tv..
0/10 recommended

reviews.author: July 18th
reviews.title: Saturday july 18th stay
reviews.body: Not able to use the pool due to roof top party, bathroom disgusting, front desk lady did not let us know about elevator card

reviews.author: Elite member
reviews.title: Completely less than satisfied
reviews.body: Would not recommend this location !!

reviews.author: Nellie
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: Staff was amazing especially the front desk clerks Monique. Very clean space

reviews.author: O Sol
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.body: I would recommend this place to anyone! I will be back! This was my first time in Florida and I am truly happy.

reviews.author: Deborah R
reviews.title: Went for a concert
reviews.body: Enjoy my relax time in the pool. The laundry room was an added bonus

reviews.author: BLaQuoya
reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.body: The stay was amazing. Nice space and well kept. Staff was very helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: SD
reviews.title: Amenities Not Available as Advertised
reviews.body:
We stayed one night with our family of four and specifically chose this hotel because we planned to spend the afternoon at the pool before our flight the next day.

Upon arrival, we were told the pool was hosting a Flock Fest party. While technically open to guests, it was clearly an adult-only environment and not appropriate for children. Since the pool was a primary reason we booked, this was very disappointing and should have been disclosed before booking.

The first room was hot (around 78 degrees) and had a strong musty odor. We tried lower A/C and leaving for a bit hoping for improvement but there was none. When I called to request a new room, they quickly moved us, which was much better, although it was missing a toilet seat that maintenance quickly fixed.

The staff responded well to every issue, but the facilities were the problem. Later that evening, after the event ended, we tried the pool again and found the water visibly dirty and unappealing. I wouldn’t even let a dog swim it.

Overall, the staff was helpful, but between the unusable pool, room issues, and poor pool condition, the stay did not meet expectations.

reviews.author: Grif
reviews.title: Guest Stay Feedback and Opportunities for Improvements
reviews.body:
Good Morning,

I recently stayed at your hotel and wanted to take a moment to share some feedback regarding my experience. My intention is not simply to point out concerns, but to provide observations that I believe could significantly improve guest satisfaction scores and overall guest experience.

First, I would like to highlight several positive aspects of my stay. Your hotel is located in an excellent and convenient area, making it an attractive choice for travelers. The valet team was exceptional throughout my visit—attentive, professional, friendly, and genuinely helpful. Additionally, Ashley at the front desk provided one of the warmest and most welcoming guest experiences I’ve encountered in quite some time. She made us feel valued, demonstrated true hospitality, and was a major contributor to the positive aspects of our stay.

That said, there were several operational concerns that I feel deserve attention.

One of the first issues I encountered was learning that breakfast charges from the hotel’s restaurant could not be billed directly to the guest room. As someone with over 20 years of hospitality experience, I found this surprising and inconvenient, particularly for a hotel operating under the Marriott brand.

The rooftop pool area, which is clearly the property’s signature amenity and primary attraction, presented several concerns. If the pool is scheduled to open at 7:00 AM, it should be fully serviced and guest-ready prior to opening. During my stay, I observed housekeeping staff beginning rooftop cleaning well after the pool had opened, around 8:30–9:00 AM. Guests arriving when the amenity opens should not be greeted by trash, empty bottles, debris, and remnants from the previous evening’s activities.

Additionally, I witnessed pool water testing being conducted while guests were actively using the pool. From a guest perspective, this creates unnecessary concern. Pool testing should ideally be completed before the facility opens so that guests can feel confident that the water has already been verified as safe. Seeing testing occur while people are swimming raises questions that guests should never have to consider.

While using the pool, I also noticed a significant amount of debris beneath and around the cabanas, including balloons, toys, food containers, and other remnants from previous gatherings. This was highly visible from the pool itself and detracted from what should have been a premium guest experience.

reviews.author: FamTime
reviews.title: Worth the price
reviews.body: Great stay. Very clean. I always “clean” when I get to a hotel, but it was actually clean. My only issue was the design of the shower in the accessibility room. Despite our best efforts, the  water got everywhere. It was a huge room/suite but the water from the shower required cleanup after each of us showered

reviews.author: LegalEagle75
reviews.title: Long Stay
reviews.body: I ended up staying at this property longer than expected. About 9 nights. The staff was incredibly accommodating at all times.  They helped me navigate doing laundry onsite as well as sending clothes out for Dry Cleaning with same day service. The food in restaurant is good and the service was friendly and efficient. The property is relatively new and in an emerging location in Ft. Lauderdale with many bars and restaurants within walking distance of the property. The hotel is clean and modern. Would recommend as a clean and comfortable place to stay.

reviews.author: Mrs Thomas
reviews.title: Fun stay
reviews.body: Great stat and customer service was outstanding! Will stay again

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Courtyard blessings
reviews.body: Great staff & good experience definitely will be back soon thanks for having me

reviews.author: Stevo
reviews.title: Great all-in-one location
reviews.body: My family and I heard about this hotel from a friend and they did not disappoint. Enjoyed the hotel and its amenities greatly! The evening entertainment without having to hire a ride share made the whole experience even better.

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.title: Its ok
reviews.body: The pool/bar would be great if guests were allowed to attend and not just have to hear in their room. Staff at the bars would probably attend better if they didn’t automatically get tips

reviews.author: Eulalio
