reviews.title: My whole experience was great.
reviews.body:
We had a wonderful experience at this hotel from beginning to end. The service was excellent, the hotel was beautiful, clean, and very well maintained, and we felt genuinely welcomed throughout our stay.

What impressed us most was the kindness and professionalism of the staff. Everyone was attentive, helpful, and made an effort to ensure that we were comfortable and had everything we needed. Those little details and the way guests are treated truly make a difference.

Our stay was relaxing and enjoyable, and everything exceeded our expectations. It is always special to find a hotel where excellent service and genuine hospitality come together.

We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable and memorable experience.

Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so enjoyable!

reviews.author: Cathy
reviews.title: Very nice facility.
reviews.body: Very nice rooms. Staff friendly and very helpful.

reviews.author: Travelers
reviews.title: Nice hotel near the airport and port
reviews.body: Overall, a great spot with friendly staff, good food, and an excellent location. I would definitely stay here again! Rooms are big and nice. Love the colors in the rooms.

reviews.author: ArGa
reviews.title: Great Service and Very Clean Hotel
reviews.body:
I had a very pleasant stay at the Four Points by Sheraton Fort Lauderdale Airport/Cruise Port. One thing that really stood out was how clean the hotel and my room were. The housekeeping team clearly does a great job keeping the property clean.

A special thank you to Felipe, the shuttle driver, who was friendly, helpful, and made transportation easy and convenient. I also had the opportunity to interact with Lucia, the General Manager, and you can tell she genuinely cares about the guests and the service her team provides.

The hotel could benefit from updates and exterior repairs, especially around the windows, which would improve the property's overall appearance and condition. However, this did not take away from the excellent service or cleanliness during my stay.

Overall, the staff, cleanliness, and hospitality made my experience very positive, and I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Dequan
reviews.title: The worst Stay ever
reviews.body: Very unprofessional, employees stealing your DoorDash food service, manager lack of customer service. I will never recommend this to anyone ever the worst experience of my life.

reviews.author: ChelseaZ
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.body:
I would like to provide very honest feedback on the one-night stay. The overall experience was pretty bad:
1. The room and hotel were not clean. There was dust on the carpet in the elevators. The faucet in the restroom had some sticky dots on the velvet. Especially the air quality was so bad. My husband was having breathing difficulties. He had to step out as much as possible. Though we asked the receptionist to check if anything wrong with the air quality and to circulate the air in the room, it didnt help. The pillows were so humid.

2. We booked the 8am shuttle bus to airport. However, the ride was late for almost half an hour. If our flight were a bit earlier, we would have missed the flight.

3. We escalated the issues above, but no practical supports were in place. 

The experience was not positive, hence, I will not recommend it to others. I hope the hotel can improve its service and bring good experience for guests.

reviews.author: KKaun11
reviews.title: Not a clean hotel
reviews.body: Rooms were not clean properly. The tub had shampoo/conditioner on the back of the tub.

reviews.author: Christina
reviews.title: Just what we needed
reviews.body: Very clean, and welcoming. Close to the port. The staff was so kind and welcoming. We'll be back.

reviews.author: TS Wright
reviews.title: Solid hotel choice for being close to the port
reviews.body: The hotel is dated, so don’t expect otherwise; however the staff members are helpful and friendly and the hotel and rooms are super clean despite needing to be brought up to date at some point in the near future.

reviews.author: JeanC
reviews.title: Great choice near cruise port
reviews.body: Excellent service starting with the free shuttle from FLL, courteous and helpful reception ,bar,and dining room  staff.  Tasty options for breakfast and dinner and glad they had a non-alcoholic beer option.  Room was clean and comfy.  Good options in the fitness center.  Shuttle to/from cruise ship ($35 rt) was helpful.  Highly recommend and would stay here again.

reviews.author: Patty
reviews.title: Hotel stay
reviews.body: This was are first time at this hotel and it was excellent as well as the staff

reviews.author: JCSHP
reviews.title: Just one night.
reviews.body: If you are staying just one night and don’t want any service just a bed. This is the hotel for you. Great location for sure but service and mantainance are not priority on this property.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.body: After a cancelled flight, this hotel came in clutch with an airline partnership, free stay and ground transportation to the hotel, and good location near good food and a pharmacy. I just wish the shuttle to the airport was easier to book.

reviews.author: MDL
reviews.title: I’ll stay here again!
reviews.body: From the time I checked in I felt like the staff wanted to help to assure I had an enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Eulalia Rivera
reviews.body: As mentioned before our whole staying was a very good experience.  For sure we would like to come back to get relaxed and having a great time.

reviews.author: Julie
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.body: Great atmosphere friendly staff hostel is clean and very convenient I totally recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Traveling lover
reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.body: The hotel exceeded our expectations with its exceptional customer service. Their staff were not only vigilant but also incredibly nice and respectful. To make things even better, they offered my family and me a fantastic rate, considering our family member was hospitalized at the time. Nathaniel is the star . At the front desk

reviews.author: Business traveler
reviews.title: Great hotel near the airport
reviews.body: Great hotel near the airport with a convenient complimentary shuttle. The staff was friendly, the restaurant was very good, and I recommend trying the local beer. I was in town for business, but it was a nice bonus that they had the FIFA games on, which made it easy to relax and keep up with the matches after a long day. Overall, a very comfortable and convenient stay. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: 2nd stay
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.body: It was a nice place to stay and was convenient to where, we needed to be. Felt like it was a little over priced and had issues with room keys constantly deactivating.  Easy access to many restaurants and stores.

reviews.author: Mr Kevins visits
reviews.title: Excellent Front Desk
reviews.body: I have many choices but they always remember me when I walk into the lobby.

reviews.author: Outofluckwithrefund
reviews.title: BEWARE OF NON-CANCELLATION POLICY
reviews.body: Awful reservation system!

reviews.author: ArGa
reviews.title: Exceptional Service, Clean Rooms, and a Great Stay
reviews.body:
I had an excellent stay at the Four Points by Sheraton Fort Lauderdale Airport/Cruise Port. The hotel delivered a comfortable and relaxing experience from the moment I arrived. The front desk team was friendly, welcoming, and efficient, making check-in and check-out seamless.

A special thank you to Felipe, the shuttle driver, for his outstanding service. He was professional, punctual, and made transportation to and from the airport stress-free.

My room was spotless, comfortable, and well-maintained, which made it easy to relax and enjoy my stay. The combination of exceptional customer service, clean accommodations, and convenient amenities exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend this hotel and look forward to staying here again.

reviews.author: Family Cruise
reviews.title: Never Again - NOT FAMILY FRIENDLY
reviews.body:
Before even reaching the hotel, we had issues, we contacted the hotel's shuttle service 3 times over a 2-hour period after landing at FLL airport which is a 10-minute drive from the hotel, we later found out that the person who provided us directions on where the shuttle service was going to pick us up from where incorrect directions.
 Upon arriving at the hotel when checking in were told that our room was not ready yet (which was understandable as we were early), however, our reservation was originally set for 2 rooms, we were being told that there was only 1 room available, with a family of 5 traveling we were told that the hotel did not have a room that was big enough for hold all of us and that we would need 2 rooms... (which is what was originally booked). After some back and forth and "checking the system" we were finally given 2 rooms on separate floors. This makes traveling with families bigger than 4 people very difficult to keep them together. This Hotel is not family friendly at all. Also, most "business level" hotels will offer a FREE continental breakfast and have an option for a paid buffet, paying 20 dollars per person for a family with kids who may or may not eat more than a couple bites is ridiculous.
 This resort is very run down (though it is currently going through renovations), the fridge in one of our rooms did not work, and the TV in the other room did not work. As well as one of the rooms had a single towel in it, someone also tried entering our room at 6:30am while we were sleeping, had I not had the swing bar lock engaged someone would have been able to enter our room, this is very unsettling. I will not be recommending this hotel to family that will be traveling down in the future, I will actually be telling them to avoid it at all costs.
Also, the pool area did not appear to be maintained, though the water was clear, the furniture and pool deck were covered in feces (which I can assume are from lizards and birds), the chairs and tables we also had to wipe/shake off before use.

reviews.author: Couple on a cruise
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Location was perfect. Close to airport, cruise port, restaurants, and shopping. Shuttle service was convenient.

reviews.author: Kmac
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.body: Super nice facility and friendly staff made our stay here a joy.

reviews.author: UKWildcatz
reviews.title: Won’t stay here again.
reviews.body: We stayed here on 5/28 and then again on 6/6 going to a cruise and coming back from one.  Shortly after leaving the hotel I broke out in a rash that covered parts of my arms, face, neck, and legs.  I was miserable and itched for the first two days on the cruise non stop until I was able to get some steroid cream while on the ship.  I didn’t think much of it until after checking out on 6/7 from your hotel my wife and oldest daughter got the same rash in the same spots.  I’m not sure why or what caused it but my wife has been so miserable with itching that yesterday she went and got a steroid shot to help it go away.  One person is a fluke but three people same hotel and same places is not.  We will not be staying at this hotel again.

reviews.author: Flowrjap
reviews.title: AC was Sub-Par!
reviews.body: If you like a cold air condition, plenty of pool towels, a warm pool, and free parking, DO NOT select this for your stay. Value is just not there.

reviews.author: Nicki
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Rooms need an update as the light fixtures, carpet and bathroom appeared to be dirty and worn out. Got charged for breakfast even though I just sat at the table with my husband.

reviews.author: R p
reviews.title: Expensive but you can get better either way this pay somewhere else
reviews.body: Expensive but you can get better other option  with  this amount somewhere else

reviews.author: No
reviews.title: Great location. Great people.  Minalmist phacilities. ⁰
reviews.body: Same as title. Great location. Great people.  Minalmist phacilities. Rooms need refreshing.  Pool could use a hot tub.

reviews.author: Satisfied Customer
reviews.title: Great choice of hotel
reviews.body: Very clean. Comfortable beds. Very professional staff. Super close to Port Everglades

reviews.author: Simon A
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body:
I had a really enjoyable stay at the Renaissance Fort Lauderdale Marina Hotel. The hotel has a great atmosphere, feels modern and welcoming, and the location is excellent, especially if you’re cruising out of Port Everglades or spending time around Fort Lauderdale.
The staff were friendly, professional and helpful throughout my stay, which really made a difference. The first room I was given did have a noticeable damp, moldy smell, so I called the front desk straight away. Without any hesitation or questioning, they apologized and immediately relocated me to another room. I really appreciated how quickly and professionally they handled the situation.
The new room was clean, comfortable and well maintained, and I really enjoyed the overall feel of the property. I also ate at the hotel restaurant and the food was delicious. The portions were huge, which was a pleasant surprise, and everything I had was really enjoyable.
The marina setting gives the hotel a relaxed South Florida vibe while still being close to restaurants, shops and everything you might need.
Overall, I was very happy with my stay. Issues can happen at any hotel, but what stood out to me was how well the team responded and resolved it. I would definitely stay here again and would happily recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, convenient and enjoyable hotel in Fort Lauderdale.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Extremely happy
reviews.body: Great location. Rooms are spacious.  Staff extremely nice.

reviews.author: Paris G
reviews.title: Quick getaway
reviews.body: This hotel checked all the boxes for me. Clean, comfortable, and very professional staff.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: A Nice Hotel
reviews.body: They offer more than a bed and shower, which is literally all I need. It's a nice hotel, and very friendly people work there!

reviews.author: TracieA
reviews.title: Not Clean
reviews.body:
Poor cleaning/housekeeping. When I checked in, the floor in my room was sticky. I went to the front desk and asked that it be cleaned and then I left for a couple hours to have lunch and go to the pool. When I came back, it hadn’t been cleaned. I made a second request to have it cleaned. This was very inconvenient because at that point, I needed to shower and get ready for my conference evening activities. Since I didn’t want to be in the shower when housekeeping came by, I went downstairs and sat in the lobby for 45 minutes. This was very inconvenient as my room should have been clean in the first place without me making 2 requests and needing to sit around in the lobby. 

The good things about the stay were convenience to the Omni convention center, water bottles in the room, and Pluto TV.

reviews.author: REW909
reviews.title: Friendly & Courteous
reviews.body: The Staff was very professional, courteous and very friendly

reviews.author: Manuel Benegas
reviews.title: Avoid Until Updated
reviews.body: While the bar and restaurant staff provided excellent, attentive service, the room itself fell completely short of acceptable standards. The accommodations were badly neglected, featuring old beds with ripped linens full of holes, a TV with a completely dead line of pixels, and no drawers to unpack clothing. To make matters worse, the bathroom air extractor made an incredibly loud, awful noise every time it was turned on. The dining experience was the only positive highlight of an otherwise highly uncomfortable and disappointing stay.

reviews.author: John Bersch
reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.body: Terrible service,, not hospitable not clean. I have nothing good to say about this hotel or staff. No name tags,, elevator and key issues

reviews.author: BRANDI
reviews.title: The furniture was outdated, it was not the typical Marriott experience
reviews.body: I am extremely disappointed with my recent stay at this hotel. From the moment I arrived, the experience fell far below expectations. The room was not properly cleaned, with noticeable dust, and a bathroom that appeared to have been only superficially maintained.

reviews.author: AG2026
reviews.title: Don't Waste your Money
reviews.body: We paid way too much for a one night stay for what we received. The pool was okay, but looked nothing like the pictures on the website. There were no working treadmills in the workout facility and the ice machine on our floor was missing. I purchased a black coffee for $6 and it was horrible as well. I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: RLPon
reviews.title: Time for a Renovation
reviews.body:
I'm a Marriott Bonvoy member because I can usually rely on a certain level of quality at each property,  but the Renaissance Fort Lauderdale Marina Hotel was an exception. The property is tired and is in need of renovations. 

My room bathroom had several issues. The shower curtain smelled mildewy. The ceiling above the shower had some visible black mildew spots. The bathroom sink faucet was loose and felt like it could dislodge at any minute. 

Every time I turned the shower on,  it was so loud and produced a high-pitched noise. 

I was on the 7th floor and waited forever for the elevator to head down to the ground floor until another guest came along and told me the button to go down wasn't working and the hack was to select the button going up... again,  this is to go down. So that seemed to do the trick,  but how ridiculous is it to have to go up to unnecessary floors before I could head down EVERY TIME I needed to leave?!

Never again!

reviews.author: Gigi
reviews.title: Stay before cruise
reviews.body: Overall a decent hotel.  The bathroom needs some updating especially the lightning, it was terrible. Had a corner room and the windows were so filthy you could hardly see out of them. The pool area looks so big on line not so much in person.

reviews.author: OCOOP
reviews.title: Not up tp the Marriott standard
reviews.body: Stay across the street at the Omni if money isnt a issue.

reviews.author: Brit
reviews.title: Bathrooms need serious renovations
reviews.body: The tub stoppers didn’t work in either of the rooms we stayed in. The tub tiles were yellowing and grout clearly hasn’t been cleaned in awhile. Paint was peeling off doors in the hallway.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Worst Marriot property I have EVER stayed at - avoid!
reviews.body: This is hands down the worst Marriott property I have ever stayed at - I would never stay here again. From start to finish the mark was not met, in every sense of the word. For reference, I am Ambassador status, and have spent thousands of nights in hundreds of different properties. My ambassador sent a note to the hotel making a request for a high floor, side of hotel furthest from the road. This request is also in my preference notes, and lastly, I messaged the hotel this request - so, three different attempts to align the room. I was placed on floor 3 in the closest room to the road - no big deal, I suppose ... I politely asked that the accommodation be met and was instantly moved (which tells me the room was available all along) however, I am still very close to the road. I just accept that and ask for a fan - I am assured one will be there in a few minutes. I waited about and hour and made the request again, still nothing. I make the request a third time, finally, three attempts and three hours after my ask, a fan is delivered. Later in the afternoon I realize that the bed has no bed pillows, just small slim couch pillows on it. Around 7PM I make the ask for the pillows ... crickets. I follow up again at 8PM and 9PM. Eventually I just go to sleep. Around 6AM I receive a message, which was clearly not automated, asking if I needed anymore assistance - mind you, this came after the request was never met, had been ignored multiple times, for 12ish hours. I say yes, there is something I need help with, the original request. I am assured one will be sent right up. Two hours later, still nothing ... I follow up a fourth time, more than 15 hours after my original request, and finally, some bed pillows arrive ... a day late and a dollar short. I head down to the "Fitness Center". 2 of the 3 treadmills do not work at all, the one that did "work" made a horrid screeching noise because the belt was ripped and the treadmill bowed/dipped in the middle. Only 1 of the 2 elipticals worked. Breakfast was incredibly lack luster, dull, bland, limited options. I was at the property less than 36 hours total, or horrendous experience. I would stay at a one-star non-Marriot before I would ever stay here again. Avoid!

reviews.author: Dana
reviews.title: Hotel in serious need of maintenance and renovation !
reviews.body: We stayed here prior to a Disney cruise and found the rooms to be so misty smelling that we could not sleep. The staff was very accommodating, but unfortunately there wasn’t much they could do as the problem seems to be throughout much of the hotel’s rooms. So, while the location was very convenient, we would suggest staying elsewhere.

reviews.author: Kcs306
reviews.title: Convenient and very clean
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location.  The service is great.  The rooms are clean and spacious.

reviews.author: mlb2007atla
reviews.title: Hotel Needs Update!
reviews.body: The hotel is very dated, bathroom drainage is noisy that makes it impossible to rest, the staff was very helpful.

reviews.author: Dissapointed
reviews.title: Not for business travelers
reviews.body: The hotel is outdated, loud, in poor repair and the night staff are uncaring at best. This is probably fine for a night before a cruise, but if you are used to Renaissance hotels, this is a big let down. The location is good, and there are good restaurants around, but the hotel appears to be untouched since 1980. If you are a frequent traveler, I would look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Time for an upgrade
reviews.title: Time for Uogrades
reviews.body: Hotel is a great location to stay for a next day cruise. Very close to terminal.

reviews.author: Amy H
reviews.title: Safety Concerns
reviews.body: While staying for a conference, 2 guests had personal items stolen. In addition, my room & a co-worker's room were entered even though we had a DND tag on the door. Management said they looked into it and no one used a key to enter the room. I'd like to know how my tv was turned on (I turned it off 2 days ago when I arrived and never turned it back on) and my co-worker's closet door was wide open when never used the closet. Both rooms were entered after we left in the morning and before we returned during our lunch break. Hotel cleaning staff were on the floor when we left our rooms. In addition, the towels felt like sandpaper. Clearly, we will not stay at this hotel again.

reviews.author: TR Williams
reviews.title: Great pre-cruise location but over priced and in need of some TLC.
reviews.body: We enjoyed our one night stay before doing a cruise.  However, It was over priced for this class of hotel.  The food options and decor in the hotel were fair.  Fortunately, there are some great dining options within a short walk of the hotel.  The breakfast items and cost are a joke.   The really laughable  item was our room was advertised as having a microwave in it.  And it did.  Unfortunately it wasn’t plugged in and there was no outlet available to plug it in. So why bother with the microwave? The hotel  needs  minor facelift upgrades.  With a few tweaks, I definitely would recommend staying here and would stay here again.

reviews.author: Henlee
reviews.title: No Perks
reviews.body:
I’ve stayed at the renaissance Fort Lauderdale Marina in the past and this hotel is not maintained like in has the past. Needs a lot of TLC. 

No perks for lifetime titanium members. No room upgrade, no problem. No lounge, no problem. They only provided a small cold continental breakfast. No hot food and a very small selection. I had to pay $50+ for my breakfast. Breakfast is a big Bonvoy perk and I always take the breakfast in lieu of points, especially if no lounge. But I was not given that option

reviews.author: Steve M
reviews.title: Nice hotel, lots of unneccessary charges.
reviews.body: If you're going to use this as a port hotel, know that there is a $25 per night plus a $98 charge for transportation to the port. It starts at 10am, which is an appropriate time. Boarding for most ships is 10:30-11:00. I would recommend just parking at the port yourself. It's $25 per day, and a lot more convenient.

reviews.author: ford2026
reviews.title: Uncomfortable Mattress
reviews.body: Mattress not comfortable . Coffee shop was closed for a Monday morning .  Had to purchase coffee from restaurant for $17 for a thermos of coffee.   Very disappointing

reviews.author: Family Traveler
reviews.title: Not Awesome
reviews.body: I should have read reviews prior to staying here. No way this location is a 4-star…

reviews.author: BON VOYAGE 2026
reviews.title: The RFLMH in Lort Lauderdale.
reviews.body: Great hotel and location.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.body: Clean, friendly and so easy for access to the port a cruise. Transportation to port for a nominal fee. Perfect stay much better than anticipated and breakfast included with our rate.

reviews.author: Sam10
reviews.title: Great location with amazing staff
reviews.body: Enjoyed the stay and loved the location of the Renaissance hotel. Great staff that are very helpful! However, as someone who likes to excercise, the gym was very small and the temp was hot.

reviews.author: Ali
reviews.title: Marriott Oceanside Hotel
reviews.body: Too many hidden high costs.

reviews.author: SKJ
reviews.title: Quick unplug
reviews.body: Fort Lauderdale/Hollywood Florida never disappoints. We enjoyed our stay at the courtyard. Appreciated the warm, welcome, and the complementary Waters, great food, comfy beds, and great views of the ocean.

reviews.author: JCF85
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.body: The view from the room was amazing!

reviews.author: Laticia Arrone
reviews.title: Inconvenienced.
reviews.body: The air in my room didn’t work. I notified staff at 7pm. They stated they’d be up to check it. I left my room to meet with a friend at 10pm and never heard from them. When I returned at 2am I inquired again about the air and never got a response. The next morning during checkout I let them know for a third time about the air and they offered me two more fr tickets rum punches (the welcome drinks). I declined and they said there’s nothing they can do. I asked for the managers contact info. I called right in front of them and it was just the front desk number to the hotel. I left a message and emailed. They never followed up with me. Marriott personally gave me 5000 pts for being inconvenienced but the hotel did not care AT ALL.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Trip
reviews.body: Oceanside definitely became one of my husband and I favorite hotels. Staff was very attentive and wonderful. Hotel was always clean and updated. We did the sangria and beach package. Everything was included in our package that was promoted when we checked in staff did a wonderful job at explaining where we could go and places we could visit And how to use our package would recommend this hotel to anyone and will be visiting again

reviews.author: Canada
reviews.title: 16 nights
reviews.body: Was a long stay, got upgraded to a room with a living room which was very nice for such a long stay. Everything I needed was on location. Staff was friendly and service was great.

reviews.author: Teresa
reviews.title: Ok
reviews.body: A lot of taxes and extra fees. Breakfast is not free. 13.00 day for taxes. No late check out if plane has accident. Double charges on my room and credit card.

reviews.author: JacKac
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: This hotel was excellent, from the service to the food. On the beach and walking distance to entertainment.

reviews.author: Warren
reviews.title: Weekend stay after a work week in Miami
reviews.body: I really enjoyed the hotel. It started off kind of rough because I was given a different room than I booked, but it was quickly rectified. The food for lunch and breakfast was great. I can't remember the bartender's name at the restaurant but she said he made the best lemon drop martini she's had in a long time.

reviews.author: bluensleepy
reviews.title: great hotel for beach and proximity to airport and cruise terminal
reviews.body: great location with lots of stores and restaurants walking distance of hotel. Best part of hotel was the beach directly across the street with hotel pool towels and beach chairs. extra bonus was the showers available for rinsing before returning to the room.

reviews.author: Good hotel location
reviews.title: Good location
reviews.body: Hotel is in a great location. Food is not anything to talk about and too expensive. Almost $20 for 7 wings is ridiculous. The beds need to be changed they are too hard and uncomfortable

reviews.author: Jim Rathbun
reviews.title: Nice renovated hotel
reviews.body: Great Courtyard on Ft. Lauderdale beach.  Newly renovated.  Clean, comfortable rooms.  Great service and nice amenities .

reviews.author: Nick F
reviews.title: Extra Fees
reviews.body: Hotel is in great location.  Fitness room is undersized.  Resort fee charges daily and MANDATORY Valet fee are both charges that aren’t appreciated

reviews.author: T Johnson
reviews.title: Empty nester vacay
reviews.body: Love the area and realize that construction must go on but the view from my room was the construction.

reviews.author: Regretted Stay
reviews.title: Extremely disappointed
reviews.body:
The check-in experience was extremely disappointing. The young gentleman at the front desk who checked us in appeared to be new and needed assistance throughout the process, which I understand. However, the other staff member assisting him, a Hispanic woman, displayed very poor customer service skills and was rude and unwelcoming. Overall, the check-in experience was a 0/10.

Unfortunately, the issues continued at the end of our stay. I was owed a credit for one day of my reservation (August 17, 2026). Before leaving, I received a printed and emailed receipt showing the credit/refund that was owed to me. The gentleman at the front desk specifically advised me that the refund would be returned directly to the card I used to book the reservation and that it would take 3–5 business days to appear in my account.

It has now been well beyond that timeframe, and I still have not received my refund. I have a receipt showing that a refund was issued, but there is no corresponding credit in my bank account.

I contacted Courtyard by Marriott customer service, and the representative initially seemed dismissive and did not appear interested in assisting me. I had to escalate the issue before he ultimately agreed to file a case. I was then told that I would need to wait an additional 3–5 days just to receive a response.

This entire experience has been incredibly frustrating and unacceptable. I should not have to repeatedly follow up to receive money that is rightfully owed to me, especially when I have documentation showing the refund.

Marriott, you can do better. I am requesting that this matter be investigated and resolved promptly. I want the refund that I am owed returned to my original form of payment.

I am awaiting a resolution and expect this matter to be addressed promptly.

reviews.author: IA Pickers LLC
reviews.title: A Week-Long Escape That Saved Our Vacation: Courtyard Oceanside Fort Lauderdale!
reviews.body:
​My partner and I (both 37) started our week-long getaway in a waterfront condo down in Miami Beach, but the overwhelming amount of seaweed washing ashore ruined our beach days. Desperate for pristine sand and clear water, we left early and drove up to the Courtyard by Marriott Oceanside Fort Lauderdale Beach. We couldn’t be happier that we did—it completely saved our vacation!
​This hotel is an amazing place to stay with an unbeatable, prime location. You are just a 1-minute walk to the beautifully maintained sands of Las Olas Beach, completely bypassing the chaos of the main strip while keeping you right in the middle of the action.
​They offer a great variety of room types, from standard Harbor View rooms to 1-Bedroom Suites and an incredible Oceanfront Penthouse. We opted for a Harbor View King, going to sleep with an amazing night view and waking up to the goregeous boats in the harbor was phenomenal.
​The hotel itself is perfectly set up for beachgoers, featuring an elevated pool deck, on-site dining, and no resort fees. We also loved that we didn't have to drive anywhere. It’s a short stroll to amazing surrounding businesses like Coconuts for waterfront seafood, Bo's Beach, and Lona Cocina for upscale Mexican food. Plus, world-class shopping on Las Olas Boulevard is right around the corner.
​If you want a stress-free getaway where the ocean is your front yard and fantastic restaurants are in your backyard, this is it. We’re already planning our next trip back! I could tell you all the amazing reasons this is THE PRIME DESTINATION FOR A FUN GETAWAY! We have traveled all over Florida, literally having stayed in hundreds of places and This place is in the top 20 places we would suggest on the Atlantic Side of Florida.

reviews.author: NSAUG2026
reviews.title: Convenient location with a beach access
reviews.body: Good location hotel, a lot of walking by the beach and restaurants. Room is good size. Food is good at the restaurant for breakfast.

reviews.author: Rich C
reviews.title: Relaxing family stay
reviews.body: Traveled with the kids for some time to relax. The beach right across the street was amazing. Staff on the beach helping us with chairs and umbrellas made it so easy. The pool had a minor issue our first night there. The staff worked on it non stop and by the morning it was refilled cleaned and open. The outdoor bar dining area was great to relax and watch the sunset. Overall amazing time

reviews.author: JudyR
reviews.title: Nice visit
reviews.body: Hotel is very nice.  But, parking is $67.00 a day which you don't hear about until you get there and there is another $100+ in resort fees.  Our one night stay was about $400 with parking and fees and we did not have an ocean view room.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Good Value
reviews.body: Nice facility, good staff, good location, but the rooms need some shelving and drawers for clothes.

reviews.author: MartyMcFly2026
reviews.title: Fort Lauderdale stay - 4th to 6th August 2026
reviews.body: A great location for a hotel - but let down by its current set up. Valet parking was extortionate for what it was and the independent payment system it used, had no way of  accepting bank card PIN codes - requiring us to find $135 in cash on the spot, for two nights (for parking which was 10 yards away). Pool was also out of action for most of our stay due to “maintenance” for which the manager was unsympathetic (would not even offer Marriott points to compensate - which we would have been happy with - and have received for lesser problems in other Marriott hotels). Staff were also confused about the policy as to where we were allowed to use our $17 daily credit - saying we could not use this in the gift shop (when in fact, we could). Also, three of us stayed, yet we were only offered two rum punch welcome drinks - surely our teenage daughter could have been offered a soft drink!? These issues are probably not difficult to fix for the rate the hotel charges.

reviews.author: Mr Figueroa
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation
reviews.body: Beautiful and nice pool and outside patio with the bar

reviews.author: M
reviews.title: Not for me
reviews.body: Over priced and too many hidden charges

reviews.author: Keyla F
reviews.title: Ok hotel not wow
reviews.body: Hotel ok not wow factor but is u are looking to be in front of the beach is ok

reviews.author: Taken advantage of
reviews.title: $67.00 A DAY TO PARK YOUR CAR!
reviews.body: Over 200.00 dollars to park my car for a 3 night stay is ridiculous

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.title: Unavailable Pool
reviews.body: UnClean Unsafe Pool Conditions

reviews.author: TEAM MOM
reviews.title: Great Sales & Catering Teams!
reviews.body:
We used this hotel for our team stay, reserving about 40 rooms in total. The sales team, led by Melody, was excellent throughout the process, and catering (Phil) and The Mast restaurant followed through on every promise for our team dinner (everyone enjoyed and had plenty of food!). The gift shop staff were sweet and helpful as well. The front desk staff was pleasant despite the chaos we brought with nearly 90 athletes plus family members, and check-in was smooth, with only minor issues that were resolved promptly. Housekeeping was polite and efficient, and the rooms were great! Loved the shower and was so thankful for cool/crisp AC at the end of long hot days!
The only concern was a customer service issue at the poolside bar that was unrelated to our event. We had two great bartenders, but one decided her bad day was going to be ours and failed to listen when I alerted her to a problem with a missed food order. The hotel addressed the situation by refunding the missed food order (which we never ate) and the drinks (which we did consume and were excellent). I’d give the whole experience a 99.9% thanks to the sales team and their attention to our comfort and happiness!

reviews.author: Dom
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: Clean, comfortable, modern, friendly staff

reviews.author: Erika S
reviews.title: Good Hotel/ Horrible Parking
reviews.body: The hotel I have no complaints about except the price of parking 75 a day. How ridiculous!!

reviews.author: Frances Donison
reviews.title: Excellent service always!
reviews.body: When you begin with excellent front desk service, are greeted by alll staff and treated with respect it makes for a great vacation

reviews.author: Sheresse
reviews.title: I will definitely return, that is a promise!
reviews.body: We really enjoyed our stay at Aloft Fort Lauderdale. The rooftop was so relaxing, and the bartenders made excellent drinks. Every staff member we encountered was friendly and welcoming, and the entire hotel was impressively clean. Valet parking was a great bonus, and the location was perfect - close to everything we wanted to do. I definitely found my new go-to hotel whenever I'm in Fort Lauderdale!

reviews.author: 804loso
reviews.title: Ok stay.
reviews.body: The check in process was not good. Took nearly half an hour but only due to short staffing. Management should provide two people at all times. Rooms are clean and modern.  Food was not good and over priced.  Shuttle service was great driver was top notch. Overall just good stay.

reviews.author: Love to cruise
reviews.title: Aloft by Marriott is tops
reviews.body: This is the 2nd time we have stayed at this location before a Cruise. Aloft has the nicest people working here. The employees at the check-in desk are very efficient when checking you in.  I had a question regarding my card being charged and when I went to double check the charge in the am the employee behind the desk already knew about the issue because the previous employee informed her about it.  The Bartender during the days we were there Thursday and Friday Sept 4 & 5 (I believe her name was Grace but could be wrong) was awesome.  Very Friendly and waited on you right away, she was always aware of people coming up to the bar to order. I have to say all in all I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Disney Cruisers
reviews.title: Great hotel for the FLL area and cruise ship terminal.  Lots of great bars and restaurants close by, and the beaches aren’t far away.
reviews.body: Title says it all… we love staying at Aloft properties.

reviews.author: Dawn H
reviews.title: short stay
reviews.body: The hotel is nice and clean but if you have a lengthy stay this is not the place. The room has no closet or no Iron. The dining room was suggested to us by the staff. We get there they were out of wings, Fish, Pizza. After waiting over an hour, we were given burgers and they did not have the right ingredients for drinks we ordered.

reviews.author: HappyCruisersForLife
reviews.title: Excellent Stay Before Our Cruise
reviews.body:
From the moment we arrived at Aloft by Marriott Fort Lauderdale Airport, we had a wonderful experience. We were warmly greeted by the valet and front desk staff, and everyone we encountered throughout our stay was friendly, welcoming, and helpful.

Our room was very clean, comfortable, and perfect for relaxing before our cruise. We also enjoyed spending time at the bar, where the bartender provided friendly and welcoming service. The hotel had a fun and relaxed atmosphere, and the location was very convenient for our travel plans.

We were very pleased with our stay and would definitely choose Aloft Fort Lauderdale Airport again before our next cruise. I would also happily recommend this hotel to friends and family looking for a comfortable and welcoming place to stay in the Fort Lauderdale area.

reviews.author: Lynn
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.body: Stayed one night before a cruise. The location was very convenient to the airport and to the Port Everglades cruise terminals. The room was very clean and the bed was very comfortable. The rooftop bar and pool was fun and had great views.

reviews.author: Schaferj
reviews.title: Less than average
reviews.body: Food was ok. Location ok. Cleanliness poor. Service ok

reviews.author: family with infant
reviews.title: Not a quiet stay
reviews.body: We needed a place to stay because of an overnight layover at FLL. Complimentary airport shuttle was prompt and quick. Front desk was quick with checkin and helpful with late night food options. Room sucked because car traffic noise (obnoxious reving engines) and AC unit was really loud. We only had 9 hours to get some sleep in a real bed between flights, so we did not ask to change rooms, but wow it's not a quiet hotel room.

reviews.author: Miniman8
reviews.title: Great stay but change shuttle driver
reviews.body: Was a fantastic stay. The bartender was a supreme mixologist. I has to stay due to missed plane. Everything was fantastic until the morning with the shuttle driver. He was rude, distracted  and those were the good qualities.

reviews.author: Horrible place
reviews.title: Never stay here
reviews.body: Disgusting place disgusting staff

reviews.author: Willy K
reviews.title: Needs Updating
reviews.body: Pool was being remodeled but nothing was stated when making the reservation on the website.

reviews.author: Kelly M
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel is very appealing and the rooms are spacious and modern and nicely decorated.  Close to airport, shopping, restaurants and the cruise port.

reviews.author: Shara
reviews.title: Highly Disappointed
reviews.body: Highly disappointed that the pool was closest during my staff and there was no notification prior to arrival

reviews.author: RoyalScotts
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body:
Wish I could give it a better review than a 5/10. While the place was very convenient to place we needed to be, this hotel did not provide my usual Aloft expectations. Prior to check in or during booking, I was not warned that the hotel pool was not available due to construction. Would've been helpful to have some sort of warning while booking so I could’ve booked another Marriott nearby. It was disappointing for my kids to realize it was closed when we were checking in while it was 95 degrees in Florida and no hotel pool for them to enjoy and we were there for 4 days. Also, the bathroom in the main lobby was dirty. It did not have any toilet paper in any of the stalls. Looked like it has not been cleaned for a few days. Our floor leading up to our room had a utility cart that was just sitting in the middle of the hallway for 3 days out of 4 that we noticed. It was moved on the 4th day we were there. It was just oddly sitting there without any purpose. It was unsightly for us to constantly walk by it. 
Being an Aloft, we had expectations as we’ve stayed in other Aloft hotels before. While it was a modern/updated hotel, it was disappointing on others that mattered the most.

reviews.author: Valerie Overton
reviews.title: Awful stay
reviews.body: My sister and I stayed to rest before we returned home from a cruise. When I booked the hotel pics looked great I was excited to arrive early and get in the pool. That didn’t happen it was closed ???? Really !!!! sheets had oil spots on them food tasted like it was cooked in rancid grease the shuttle bus attendant was the only pleasant person there desk staff was kinda rude and uncaring he was the only one who. asked how our stay was. Very disappointed on how much I paid and the service delivered

reviews.author: AJ from ATL
reviews.title: You’re-cruise stay
reviews.body: highly recommend for a pre-cruise stay in Ft. Lauderdale

reviews.author: A McIntosh
reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.body: Great place to stay! Definitely would come back.

reviews.author: Peter Hologram Man
reviews.title: A-Loft(y) Experience 😀
reviews.body:
In fort Lauderdale for several days and needed a place near the hotel but also accessible to downtown. Had never heard of Aloft but wanted to use Marriott Bonvoy points. This looked interesting and it certainly did not disappoint! 

Quite directly, this was the single best hotel experience I've had in the US in more than a decade. It's a vertical format with valet at the bottom and then one floor up to the lobby so very little walking. The lobby is open and airy, high ceilings and with interesting techie decor and the front desk just steps from the elevator. Unique podium style front desk layout caught my attention, with bright smiling faces to greet. Multiple employees interacted spontaneously. The vibe was helpful and friendly. I request today high floor and they accommodated. Directly next to the desk is a refreshment area that had some lovely freebies and purchased goodies including a delicious fresh fruit cup :-) The lobby is spacious, with various sitting and work areas and a nicely appointed bar. 

Entering the room, I immediately noticed that it was filled with light! The beds faced multiple large picture windows looking out to fort Lauderdale City in the distance. All the appointments one would need, including an ample refrigerator, USB ports, plugs, numerous lighting options, and a small interestingly shaped sitting area for desk or dining. Open layout behind the kind of translucent glass wall to the sink and shower with a separated bathroom stall, all well thought out in both layout and lighting. Besides the standard hair dryer, instead of an iron they included a small steamer, brilliant! :-) The room was simply but nicely decorated, though for me the standout feature was the huge windows that allowed me to feel private yet with a view to the world! I noticed there are corner rooms as well that must be also interesting with Windows in two sides, I'll try for one of those next stay :-) 

They were able to accommodate a later checkout (ymmv), and held my bags while I walked to the city, returning them quickly when needed. 

15 minutes from the downtown Beach and 7 minutes to the airport, hourly free shuttle was available.

Rooftop pool and bar!

Well thought out, well laid out, well-trained staff, accommodating, unique, new feeling. Overall it was far different and better than most places I've stayed in quite a while. Enough so that I actually considered extending my trip just to have another night there :-)

KUDOS 💯👍✨

reviews.author: AD2026
reviews.title: Will not return
reviews.body: I have always stayed at Marriot's hotels. I will not be returning to this one. The staff was indifferent and unfriendly. The hotel room was dirty with mold, an unflushed toilet, and mold and dirt spots throughout the room. The AC unit had layers of dust and there was a smell. Overall, a very disappointing stay.

reviews.author: Not the best stay
reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.body: Staff that I encountered was not very friendly and rather rude. It was later do to a long work day. Room was okay but not the best.

reviews.author: JZ
reviews.title: I enjoyed my stay!
reviews.body: This hotel met everything that I needed and more minus the food options. I would stay there again for the same amount of time that I stayed, which was three days. Luckily DoorDash can get you anything else you want.

reviews.author: Willie Abreu
reviews.title: Clean Hotel near FLL and Cruise Ships
reviews.body: We truly enjoy staying at this hotel, and its location is perfect for our work. Jeffrey at the front desk has always been exceptional—he is consistently welcoming, professional, and always greets us with a smile. He is one of the reasons we have continued to return. I would also like to recognize the housekeeping staff, who always do an outstanding job and make every stay comfortable.

reviews.author: The Southern
reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.body: Hotel met expectations and more. The staff were nice, hotel was nice and clean & very cozy. Rooms were nice & cozy as well. Only a few minutes from cruise port, beach, & food

reviews.author: JPD
reviews.title: Great location but that's about it.
reviews.body: As a lifetime platinum member, I've lived at many hotels across the world. This one had one of the worst breakfast options I've ever experienced. The hotel rooms were okay. The toilet flush did not work, and continued to not be operational even after maintenance came and "fixed" it. We had to manually pull the flush pin after each use.

reviews.author: Angel
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.body: Excellent stay, beautiful hotel. Staff is wonderful. Would highly recommend and will definitely be back.

reviews.author: LOCAL
reviews.title: They deliver on cleanliness and creative rooms
reviews.body: Wonderful stay. I would highly recommend

reviews.author: Doug
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: When booking a hotel from across the country, its always a little worrisome trying to decide which hotel to stay at. Fortunately,  we chose the Aloft and we were not disappointed.

reviews.author: Layla Abed
reviews.title: Not up to Marriott’s standards
reviews.body: As mentioned earlier, room was not as booked, room was not clean, the bathroom was smelly and the towels and bed linen were dated , valet parking was absolutely unnecessary, you could have added the $35+ tax per night to the room rate.

reviews.author: Traveler R
reviews.title: Do better
reviews.body: This was by far one of the worst experiences I have ever had at a hotel and during a vacation. From the moment that I checked in, it was complete disaster and the overall disregard and eye rolling by the staff only added fuel to the fire. I’m a long time Marriott customer and truly, I will be avoiding trying any new locations after this. Shame.

reviews.author: Great stay
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: Overall great stay! Hotel is very clean. The breakfast was very good. Staff was friendly. Only issue was lack of restaurant in hotel for lunch when it rains. The rooftop bar closed and had no where to eat in the hotel. Would stay again! Location is great as well!

reviews.author: SamW
reviews.title: Check in was horrible
reviews.body: It was great besides check in

reviews.author: SB
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: Entire staff was courteous and Professional!

reviews.author: Tab
reviews.title: Very pleasant
reviews.body:
I really enjoyed my stay! The room was clean and comfortable, and check-in was quick and seamless. The front desk agent was very friendly and upgraded my room in recognition of my Marriott Gold Elite status.

I especially appreciated that the hotel proactively honored the room upgrade benefit without me having to ask. That small gesture made me feel valued as a loyal Marriott member and was a great way to start my stay. Overall, a very pleasant experience, and I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Diane K
reviews.title: Nice Stay at the AC
reviews.body: Rooms, staff and location are a good value for the money. For some reason, I can never get an upgrade there even if requested in advance. Since I’ve been a Gold member for years, it would be nice to actually get one. Food is just okay. Save your money and eat elsewhere.

reviews.author: TravelingCouple
reviews.title: We cant wait to visit again
reviews.body: Everyone was amazing! Staff, service and location. I couldn’t have asked for anything more!

reviews.author: David P
reviews.title: Great place to stay for a meeting
reviews.body: Nice hotel with good prices nice food and very nice atmosphere.

reviews.author: Jasmine R
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but staff lacks basic customer service
reviews.body: The oceanfront rooms are beautiful! I enjoyed the free bikes available and the roof top pool. My only suggestion would be customer service training for the staff. The staff lacked basic customer service skills at every interaction.

reviews.author: Anonymously
reviews.title: Rude staff, poor communication
reviews.body: i’m the beginning from check-in. The customer service was rude. The whole front desk were rude. They didn’t communicate very well. They even told me that my scheduled 4 PM check-in time is not guaranteed because the elite members have late checkout and I understand that membership, but what did that have to do with my 4 PM check-in it doesn’t make any sense. They said they couldn’t get any early check-in even though we call multiple times they said we have to be physically present there to get early check-in , which i’ve never heard of, so we came early and they still told us we could not receive it in that the housekeeper did not clean our room yet. They were extremely rude. They didn’t do anything to accommodate us while we were there, we paid for another room under another reservation and though we got to stay in the same room, there was a man that opened our door with another key so I’m just confused on how he even got access to that key working for our door, even though he made a mistake and he was at the wrong door. Another customer’s key shouldn’t have worked. Luckily, I had the bolt lock turned on. The room sink was clogged. It needed Drano just overall. The experience at this hotel was a zero out of 10. I wish I can give it a zero.

reviews.author: Jennifer Ray
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.body:
The property itself is lovely, and I especially want to recognize the housekeeping team. Every housekeeping employee I encountered was warm, friendly, and helpful. Unfortunately, the overall service experience did not match the property or price point.

I am a Marriott Titanium Elite member and understand that upgrades and special requests are based on availability. I requested a balcony room if available. At check-in, my status wasn't acknowledged, and when I asked if my room had a balcony, I was simply told, “You didn't book a balcony,” handed my key, and the interaction was over. I wasn't upset about not receiving a balcony; I was disappointed by the dismissive response. “Unfortunately, none are available” would have been perfectly acceptable.

There was also no explanation of the property's amenities. I wasn't offered water at check-in, later found it in my room refrigerator, and actually checked the Marriott app to make sure it was complimentary.

Both mornings, I waited while a front desk employee made her own coffee at the lobby station without acknowledging me. More frustratingly, I didn't learn until the evening of night two that there was a 24-hour self-service coffee/espresso station elsewhere in the lobby. When I asked a bartender for coffee, she said there was espresso, told me it was “back there,” and walked away. Another guest ultimately explained to me where the station was.

Night three was better, including a different bartender. However, throughout the stay, my colleagues were proactively offered second drinks while I was repeatedly overlooked—even though I was the person paying the bill.

None of these issues individually is significant. Collectively, they reflect a lack of basic guest acknowledgment, communication, and hospitality.

I booked two rooms for this business trip, and my three-night room bill alone approached $1,000. I don't expect guaranteed upgrades or preferential treatment because of my Titanium status. I do expect courteous interactions and basic information about the property.

I've experienced warmer, more attentive service at Courtyard properties at significantly lower price points. The hotel is beautiful and the housekeeping staff were wonderful, but unfortunately the overall hospitality experience did not meet my expectations for an AC Hotel or Marriott.

reviews.author: Jimmy
reviews.title: Enjoyed my stay
reviews.body: Highly recommended hotel with all of the amenities you need while away from home

reviews.author: WI Pilot
reviews.title: Great hotel, lots of construction noise, frequent visitor.
reviews.body: Hotel is amazing. Lots of construction noise longer than posted hours. Front desk staff seemed to have an attitude.

reviews.author: Hang Vu
reviews.title: Concern About Significant Noise During my Stay
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at the AC Hotel Fort Lauderdale on Alhambra Street, and I would like to share a concern about my stay room 510

During both mornings of my stay, I was repeatedly disturbed by very loud noise coming from the area above my room. The noise was loud enough to wake me up and made it very difficult to relax and enjoy my stay. Since this happened on both mornings, I believe it was more than just an isolated incident.

I understand that some noise can occasionally happen in a hotel, but the repeated and significant noise early in the morning was very disruptive. I was especially disappointed because I chose your hotel expecting a comfortable and relaxing stay.

I would appreciate it if you could look into what may have been causing the noise and review my stay with your management team.

Given the inconvenience and the impact it had on my stay, I would also appreciate consideration for an appropriate goodwill gesture or compensation.

I have stayed at hotels expecting a certain level of comfort and service, and I hope you will take my concern seriously. I look forward to hearing from you and understanding how this matter can be addressed.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Avoided at  any cost
reviews.body: Dirty grimy mattresses. Ongoing renovations. Dishonest lying, and deceiving staff .

reviews.author: Vf
reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.body: Great stay at a great price

reviews.author: Francesca A
reviews.title: Lovely Experience
reviews.body: The staff were extremely welcoming. The hotel had a beautiful beach view. There were plenty of delicious restaurants nearby and it was a quick walk to the beach.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Best Stay Ever, 10/10!
reviews.body: This was my second time visiting, AC Fort Lauderdale after a wonderful stay the first time. At check in, I was greeted by Albert and Anitra, both who were so kind and lovely! They were so hospitable from check in to every day when we saw them at the lobby during the day. At night, Paula was so kind to ask if we wanted to change our towels to new ones, before we even asked! Ashley and Robert at the bar were so friendly, the churro ice-cream combo is to die for! Overall, my stay exceeded my expectations, and I was happy to rebook at AC. The staff at AC Fort Lauderdale went above and beyond to make sure we were welcomed and taken care of, and it was because of them that made my vacation more enjoyable. Vacations are better when you meet people that make it better, that is what the staff did!

reviews.author: Anthony with BSMD
reviews.title: My AC Fort Lauderdale Stay !
reviews.body: I had an excellent stay at the AC Hotel Fort Lauderdale Beach. The staff truly rocked — friendly, attentive, and always making sure I had everything I needed. The room was clean, modern, and comfortable, and the overall experience was smooth and enjoyable. I wanted for nothing during my stay. Highly recommend this hotel and its amazing team.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: July 2026
reviews.body: The overall hotel is beautiful. The check in process was great with the help of the supervisor/ manager. Housekeeping is somewhat aggressive on your check out day. Also entering our room with our "do not disturb" sign hanging to bring bedding we did not request. While most of the staff was friendly and helpful there is one that can use some training on how to treat ALL guest. My overall stay was great with a few hiccups. The location is in a quiet part of the beach which was appreciated since we were celebrating our anniversary. The bar staff and food service was also great. The pool was closed. Even though we were able to use a neighboring hotels pool; we weren't notified before we booked.

reviews.author: Morgan  and Mitchell
reviews.title: Dumps
reviews.body: Very unsatisfied. We definitely will not be booking here again!!!

reviews.author: RR
reviews.title: Family Stay
reviews.body: The AC accommodations are always as expected.  Great rooms and service.  The hotel is a tiny walk to the beach, and chairs/umbrellas are provided by the sister's hotel Westin which is about a 3 minute walk north.  The balcony room is amazing with great views all around.  Quiet and clean.  Unfortunately, the pool was closed for the month due to renovations, which limited the food options within the hotel itself.

reviews.author: Dissatisfied
reviews.title: Nickel and dimed and misrepresented
reviews.body: I’ve taken my time to respond to the survey to gather my thoughts. The hotel itself is nice however, we were not notified that we would not have access to the pool on-site and while we were told the other hotel pool we had access to was next door, as well as, access to the beach chairs they were actually two full blocks away, which was difficult for my elderly mother with mobility issues. On top of that, only one elevator was sometimes working and, considering the capacity of the hotel guests and workers, all of whom had to share the one elevator, I had to use the stairwell multiple times from the 8th floor. My husband on the way up the stairwell was advised by a worker that he should join a gym. The hotel is clearly still under renovations and we were nearly run over in the hallways as well by workers. While my sister and my father respectively were given compensation for the inconveniences, when I went to the front desk to express that I was disappointed and not satisfied with the accommodations I was dismissed with a sorry. Parking at $60 a day, breakfast at $30pp, and $30 a beach umbrella felt like we were being nickel and dimed for an already expensive hotel stay in a room advertised as ocean view from which we had to stick our heads out the balcony felt like a scam through and through. For charging like a luxury hotel, it was not a luxury experience.

reviews.author: Duavic
reviews.title: Beautiful view from my bed.
reviews.body: I loved my room; it was just as I expected, with a beautiful view of the sea right from my bed. The entire hotel was clean and lovely. The pool is very small, and the restaurant is only open for breakfast. However, there is a restaurant with good food right next door, and plenty of other options nearby. I would definitely book this hotel again.

reviews.author: DH
reviews.title: Staff makes the difference, despite some bad dings I have read
reviews.body:
Pleasantly surprised - after I saw some knit-picky reviews - which were what I thought unfair I decided to stay. You staff - all of them - are your largest assets. 

When I arrived at check in there was an extremely obnoxious guest trying to check in at 10 am - who refused to even consider an early check in fee. (I was going to try to do the same, but understand, that, being a beach location, rooms and early check ins are premium and I don't mind a fee) - Nevertheless, this gentleman who checked in before me (Friday 7/10) was extremely rude and disrespectful to the point where I almost stepped forward to pay his early check in fee for him - since the line at the front desk had grown considerably due to this man-child - Nevertheless, your front desk agent handled herself beautifully. I am sure management had to speak with this gentleman anyway - 

Next - I had a check out and check back in a day later - and again your staff handled this wonderfully. 

Lastly - Upon re-arrival on Sunday 7/12, There was an extremely loud party going on in the room down the hall. Your staff, and security people handled it great - I was able to relocate (albeit at midnight) but that was my choice. 

Thank you for doing your best.

reviews.author: garthphilpot
reviews.title: not bad, but could do better.
reviews.body: like the title says, it was clean and tidy, id say had a refresh perhaps 2 or more years ago, the food was a let down, hours to arrive when it did, and the breakfast was not great at all.

reviews.author: Alh487
reviews.title: Rude and unprofessional staff
reviews.body: Worst Marriott I have stayed at, the staff ruined the experience for us and the property was filthy. There were fluids all over walls, hairs all over bathrooms. Don’t recommend.

reviews.author: Roaming Rakane
reviews.title: Where the views never get old
reviews.body:
Views Worth the Stay

We absolutely love staying at the AC Hotel Fort Lauderdale. This was our second visit, and once again, it exceeded our expectations.

Although our room wasn’t ready right at the 4:00 p.m. check-in time, the manager went above and beyond by treating us to complimentary drinks while we waited. That level of hospitality made the delay much easier and left a great first impression.

This time we booked the wraparound suite, and it was worth every penny. The panoramic city views paired with the partial ocean view were absolutely stunning and easily one of the highlights of our stay.

Our visit also happened to coincide with FIFA festivities, so the streets below were packed with energy and excitement. From our suite, we had the perfect vantage point—we could safely enjoy all the action from above without being caught in the crowds. It was a unique and unforgettable experience.

Our first stay at this property was during the Florida Panthers’ Stanley Cup celebration parade, which made such a lasting impression that we knew we’d be back. This boutique-style hotel feels like a hidden gem, offering an excellent location, outstanding service, and incredible views.

We’ll definitely be returning again next year. This property continues to be one of our favorite places to stay in Fort Lauderdale.

reviews.author: Tee
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Disappointed won’t be staying at this location anymore

reviews.author: CWeathersby
reviews.title: Very nice and convenient
reviews.body: Highly recommend staying, proximity to the cruise port was great, as well as across the street from the beach. Walkable area for shopping and eating.

reviews.author: Summer 2026
reviews.title: Summer 2026
reviews.body:
Arrived late due to flight being delayed was told our reservation wasn’t in the computer, the correct day.  I had a confirmation email, but they still told me they couldn’t honor it cause it wasn’t in their computer. It was a complete disaster. Had to cancel and wait for a refund from company they told me they could give me a room at the rate they had that evening, which was dramatically higher.
Terrible customer service and when we did get to the room, the room was dirty.

reviews.author: MDSM
reviews.title: AAA CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.body: OUR STAY AT THE RITZ-CARLTON FT LAUDERDALE WAS EXCELLENT, AAA CUSTOMER SERVICE FROM THE TIME YOU PULL UP TO THE FRONT DOOR TO CHECK-IN TO CHECK-OUT.

reviews.author: Marcos
reviews.title: Titanium Elite Member
reviews.body: This hotel doesn’t respect a titanium elite member and charges to access the lounge

reviews.author: Pjs233
reviews.title: Poor management
reviews.body: Service staff and food are excellent.anagnt is extremely lacking.

reviews.author: Semy
reviews.title: An Exceptional Experience at The Ritz-Carlton
reviews.body:
Absolutely the best hotel experience my family and I have ever had. The service was exceptional from beginning to end, and every staff member made us feel truly welcomed and well cared for.

The rooms were spotless, comfortable, and beautifully maintained, with amazing views. The food was excellent, and the attention to detail throughout the hotel was outstanding.

We felt relaxed, appreciated, and completely taken care of during our entire stay. Everything exceeded our expectations. Without a doubt, one of the best hotels we have ever visited. Highly recommended, and we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Ray and Wendy
reviews.title: Extended weeken getaway
reviews.body: From our initial arrival to our departure the people at the Ritz were friendly, engaging and accomodating. everywhere you went , pool, bar, restaurant, check in and Spa they would great you with a smile and address any concerns or needs you had or simply said hello, The  inquired about our stay and even make suggestions of places to go and things to do.

reviews.author: MrsWare229
reviews.title: Excellent Stay and Team
reviews.body: I absolutely LOVE this location!! We have not been to Ft. Lauderdale in over 20 years! First of all, I love that the staff are family. My experience started with KP when our ride shared dropped us off. [KP THANKS SOOOOO MUCH for your kindness. We didn't make it back to the property to share our appreciation]. Kadar (sp?) and José at the B. Coast bar are great. My absolute favorite person was Scottie at the pool bar [next time I will know to start there and work my way down]. Finally, I have to commend Jaime. I love a working manager. I think we will be back very soon. We met sooo many vacationing regulars, we might as well be one too.

reviews.author: Patricia A
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Wonder place to get away for a few days. Truly enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: PhillyFrequentflier
reviews.title: Caring and suprised
reviews.body: The staff found out it was our anniversary and left champagne and chocolate covered strawberries while we were out! How amazing

reviews.author: Gina
reviews.title: Great as usual
reviews.body: Always have a great stay at the Ritz Carlton!  Looking forward to my return very soon!  Service and hotel  go above and beyond!

reviews.author: H2024
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.body: Everyone was so nice and so helpful.. I will say only one negative thing. They need to upgrade their pillows. They flatten out really quickly. Overall I will stay there every time I’m in Fort Lauderdale

reviews.author: Regretting my stay
reviews.title: I was racially profiled at this hotel
reviews.body: I was racially profiled at this hotel. I expressed my concerns to them. They did nothing.

reviews.author: Bn review
reviews.title: Ritz at Fort lauderdale
reviews.body: Excellent service all around. Throughly enjoyed our stay and food .

reviews.author: RandD
reviews.title: No Longer Ritz Quality
reviews.body: After 4 or 5 stays in last few years we thought a big anniversary visit  would be nice. Room nice - upgraded? - but $100 credit went to breakfast (no rolls or croissants, not fresh OJ, luke-warm coffee), 4 "suits" in the gym discussing what's needed next, #70 charge to use sauna, etc. Not the Ritz we'd grown to love.

reviews.author: Liz A
reviews.title: Liz A - Business Meetings
reviews.body: The Ritz-Carlton Fort Lauderdale is a hidden gem for Business Meetings and Groups!  The Events & Banquets Team is AMAZING!  Delette Legrand and Christopher Lozano are such an asset to RCFLL and the reason why we keep hosting meetings their for over a decade!!

reviews.author: C Newman
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: It was a great experience from the beginning to the end they made sure we were well taken care of

reviews.author: Nick C
reviews.title: First Class Accommodations!
reviews.body: One of the finest and classiest stays on the beach.  The staff is terrific; the location is perfect!

reviews.author: MyGoProAndMe
reviews.title: Ocean View is stunning! But there's No BIDET!!
reviews.body:
The service is A LOT different from other locations! 😳 NO BIDET?! REALLY?! 
🤯😂


I had to PAY for honey! There’s no fridge big enough to keep our water cold, and I don’t trust ice from commercial ice machines! 😩
🙄
The coffee machine definitely needs to be upgraded to a Nespresso Vertuo! Asking for extra capsules and clean cups just to make two 8-oz coffees takes an ETERNITY to arrive! 
☕️
And the mattress? Definitely NOT up to standard!
🪨🧗‍♀️
I was told over the phone there’s no gift shop, and the concierge said they don’t offer complimentary shoe shining—REALLY?! Every other location does! 🤦🏻‍♀️ So I had to call Guest Services to double-check. 😂

Apparently, the “standard” here is VERY different! 
🧐😝
The impressive points: They gave us a nice room and a late check-out, and the valet and bellhop service were definitely par excellence! 👏👏👏
⛵️
The Dining 3238 team was also very polite and was the ONLY team that consistently addressed us by name whenever we called—well, aside from the waiter at Burlock. At other locations, being greeted and addressed by name when you call seems to be the norm, but not here. That personal touch definitely stood out! ❤️

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Not up to Ritz-Carlton Standards
reviews.body: My wife are Platinum marriott members and have stayed at various mariottts, including Rize-Carlton, around the world.  Our experience at the Ft. Lauderdale Ritz Carlton was disappointing.  In a nutshell, the level of service varied considerably from "very nice" to "do I start a class action over this?".  The net was that it provided net level services more akin to a JW Marriott.  This is, of course, not terrible in itself by any means by it is far from the level of a Ritz, all at prices of a Ritz.  Specifically, things that happened that should not happen at a Ritz included the only walkway from the hotel to the beach being out of commission for one or more days, the "beach elevator" being unbelievably slow, the valet app not working and never fixed despite my inquiring, the key would suddenly not work but the straw that broke the camel's back was that, and I kid you not, the $400+ massage treatment included what appeared to be a mandatory management direective of upselling the customer as they were there in the massage room, trying to relax, wasting a good 10 minutes of the customer's time which was subtracted from the published time period for the massage.  This "used car sales" management directive I have experienced, and then only rarely, at places like Massage Envy and similar.  My wife was conned into adding at $65 add on while I was offered (and declined) $110 add on treatments.  I do not blame this on the massage technician who was actually pretty good but rather know it is a managemnt level directive no doubt making their employees as uncomfortable as their customers.  For this reason alone, I will strongly recommend not to go to the Ft. Lauderdale Ritz.  (BTW, the room itself was really great and the club was more than adequate  but those Ritz level services did not outweigh the aforementioned below standard services mostly because, based on my decades of senior level management experience, when so many little things go wrong and there is also a management directive to try to squeeze as much as you can from your customer, something is dramatically wrong (usually financially) and it is best to stay away.). Anyway, those are my thoughts for whatever they may be worth.

reviews.author: DLaurent28
reviews.title: An Unforgettable Wedding Anniversary at the Ritz-Carlton Fort Lauderdale
reviews.body:
Celebrating our wedding anniversary at the Ritz-Carlton Fort Lauderdale was truly an unforgettable experience. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with genuine warmth and exceptional hospitality. Every member of the staff went above and beyond to make our celebration feel special.

The hotel is beautifully maintained, the oceanfront views are breathtaking, and the atmosphere is both elegant and relaxing. Our room was immaculate, comfortable, and offered stunning views that made our stay even more memorable.

The dining experience was outstanding, with delicious food and impeccable service. Every detail reflected the high standards that the Ritz-Carlton is known for, making us feel valued and cared for throughout our stay.

Thank you to the entire team for helping us celebrate such an important milestone. We left with wonderful memories and are already looking forward to returning. If you're looking for the perfect place to celebrate a special occasion, I highly recommend the Ritz-Carlton Fort Lauderdale. Five stars!

reviews.author: Manuel
reviews.title: One night stay
reviews.body: As usual the ritz Carlton is a wonderful place to stay. I was upgraded to a suite and was very happy. Although the bathroom was in a bit of disrepair. I was disappointed to learn that the late night menu that they had on the room service option was not available

reviews.author: Kim s
reviews.title: Nice but not wow
reviews.body: Fine for the money. I would have been disappointed if I paid full price for the room. Got a FL resident discount on an ocean view room.

reviews.author: Fina2343
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.body: I love staying at the Ritz-Carlton. The Fort Lauderdale location is no exception. The staff was kind and helpful

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Would love to come again
reviews.body: My stay at The Ritz-Carlton was wonderful. I absolutely loved the beautiful décor throughout the hotel—it felt elegant, modern, and welcoming. The ocean views were breathtaking and made the experience even more relaxing. The staff was friendly, professional, and always willing to help, which made me feel truly valued as a guest. Overall, I had an enjoyable stay, especially appreciating the good service and strong shower, but I was slightly disappointed by a lower-floor room and a leaking bathroom issue given the high price. it was a good stay, and I would definitely return for another visit as long as a few issues can be solved.

reviews.author: Lindsey
reviews.title: Phenomenal service and staff
reviews.body: The Ritz Carlton Fort Lauderdale far exceeded my expectations. All of the staff was so kind and accommodating to me and my two children. It blows my mind that there are any negative reviews. I think people are being pretty nitpicky. Staff was wonderful. The food was excellent and I cannot wait to come back.

reviews.author: The Wilsons
reviews.title: Amazing Property
reviews.body:
