We had an amazing time staying at The Ritz-Carlton, Fort Lauderdale! From the greeting by the valet staff and reception staff upon arrival, to excellent food and service in the restaurant and some of the best massages we've ever had in the spa, this was truly one of the most enjoyable visits. 

Every single valet staff was so helpful and accommodating. I would list them all by name, but I would have to list everyone. Every person in the restaurant was helpful, congenial and made our meals memorable from the host staff to the servers. The concierge staff was incredible in helping us book dinners at other local restaurants. 

Our room was spacious and well maintained and the daily staff kept it clean and tidy for us during out stay.

We travel a lot and this was truly one of the most enjoyable hotel stays we have had!

reviews.author: Warren
reviews.title: Anniversary stay with family
reviews.body: Our expectations in comfort, quality, and staff were exceeded at ever turn.

reviews.author: Weekend Getaway Mom
reviews.title: A Relaxing and Memorable Fourth of July Stay
reviews.body:
We had a wonderful Fourth of July stay at The Ritz-Carlton, Fort Lauderdale. We booked a Club Level room overlooking the pool, and it was perfect for our family of four. The room was spacious, spotless, and incredibly comfortable.

The Club Lounge was one of the highlights of our stay. The food was consistently delicious, the service was exceptional, and we always felt genuinely welcomed. We especially enjoyed spending time there throughout the day. The pool was also fantastic and very well managed, even with the holiday crowds. There were always plenty of chairs available, and the staff did a great job keeping everything organized.

One of our favorite memories was watching the Fourth of July drone show and fireworks from our balcony. It was such a fun way to celebrate as a family.

We would have loved to see a few more festive touches throughout the resort and in the Club Lounge for the holiday weekend, but that certainly didn't take away from what was an excellent stay.

Overall, the hospitality throughout the resort was outstanding, and we left feeling relaxed, well cared for, and already looking forward to another visit later this year. We wouldn't hesitate to recommend this property to anyone looking for a relaxing beachfront getaway with exceptional service.

reviews.author: Nawlins9
reviews.title: Never again for a special event
reviews.body: The hotel was nice and certain staff members were wonderful. However I had stuff missing from luggage after it was brought up hours late, and the birthday surprise for my wife that I prepared days in advance was not there upon arrival and when they finally brought lit up it was not done correctly.

reviews.author: Clarki
reviews.title: Missing The Ritz Carlton Touch of Prior to Covid.
reviews.body: Dreaming About The Old Days

reviews.author: Linas
reviews.title: Hotel stay
reviews.body: Excellent front desk staff

reviews.author: Family2
reviews.title: Very much enjoyed the stay staff was wonderful only thing the bathrooms don't give you any privacy
reviews.body: Had a very pleasant stay everyone from the restaurant to the pool to walking the door were exceptional and friendly the only drawback would be the bathrooms they were not private don't understand why anybody would have designed a bathroom like that

reviews.author: Johnny B
reviews.title: Great stay from check-in to check-out
reviews.body: The W Ft. Lauderdale exceeded my expectations from the moment I arrived until the moment I departed. Check-in was friendly and my Bonvoy status was immediately recognized with a room upgrade and breakfast credit. All of the staff were friendly and accommodative. The room was clean and spacious. Spent a weekend there so had the fortune of using the pool both days. The pool vibe was good. The DJ's each day were awesome. Great music without being obnoxious. Even received a surprise bottle of champagne in my room to celebrate our anniversary. I was in Florida to consider buying a place but after this weekend I think I found a home without all the hassle of owning one! Will be back soon.

reviews.author: ilianna
reviews.title: Amazing hotel stay
reviews.body: Amazing service and best room, beach abad pool

reviews.author: JeffJ
reviews.title: The worst hotel experience I’ve ever had.
reviews.body: Upon check in, zero towels in room. Went to bed, bloodstains streaked 4-5 feet down the side of the bottom sheet. Next day, different room, huge clump of black public hair on floor of shower.

reviews.author: Kam C
reviews.title: Horrible aray
reviews.body: Let start with the extra fees I was charged when arriving. Oh and the 20 minutes it took for the elevator plus two of the three weren’t working. Oh yea and waiting 15 minutes to get in our room because our brand new activated key didn’t work. No hot water for an hour. Water pressure was let’s say next to none. Pool closed at 5 for a private event would have been nice to know about that at check in. Bar is closed until like 4pm. Restaurant was rude and food was cold they didn’t even call to tell us it was ready for pick up. And for almost $1700 for three nights I’m disgusted to say the least. Some staff were wonderful mostly the cleaning ladies and valet everyone else was poor quality.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Watch out for the minibar charges on your final invoice!
reviews.body: Initially i was impressed by pleasant service and clean rooms though I didn't like the long wait for elevators and 7pm closing time for the pool. But the worst part was putting charges on my final bills for minibar items that I never consumed. I requested to verify and correct the charges at the check-out time with the reception manager. She did it at that time but the next morning I received email with another version of invoice that included even more minibar items. What especially looked fraudulent was that my signature was electronically copied to this new invoice. So basically, they made me to sign one (correct) invoice but on the next day re-used my signature for a new invoice with additional charges. They told me that "this is how the system works". Wow!! so they do this trick "systematically"! I can only guess how many customers they defrauded with this "system".  Finally they agreed to reimbursed the minibar fees but it cost me an hour of arguing over phone and bitter aftertaste.

reviews.author: Ym03
reviews.title: I was charged twice for 5 days stay
reviews.body: I was charged twice for my 5 day stay and they didn’t try to put my money back on my card .I was told it would be when I checked out but no it’s was few days later.So my birthday trip was messed up

reviews.author: W Fort Lauderdale Fan
reviews.title: The best hotel in Fort Lauderdale, beach
reviews.body: The W Hotel in Fort Lauderdale never disappoints. It's an absolutely amazing property. The staff, the amenities, and the location are absolutely perfect and ideal for any getaway, whether it be a vacation, a staycation, or just a quick jaunt or even a longer stay. Absolutely recommend it above all hotels in Fort Lauderdale Beach.

reviews.author: Neveragain
reviews.title: Do not stay here
reviews.body: This is a tired old hotel which is in desperate need of a refit. Every room has something broken in it. They dont even have a toothbrush available when you need one. Bottled water is only in your room the first day, not subsequently. On top of all that they have the audacity to charge a $62 daily resort fee (money grab) for what is a regular hotel.

reviews.author: Kymmee MD
reviews.title: The Elevator is a HUGE issue!
reviews.body: Well, it’s a nice hotel but the elevator is a big problem. We literally had to wait 20 - 30 mins every single time, then it was packed, people didn’t want to move for you to gain access, if you were lucky to get on, it stopped at every single floor and one elevator was down. You have a very rude waiter (female - Cuban) in the pool area. She was very rude and ignored me. I reported her to management. Lastly, parking is $63.00 a day and they looked for a tip coming and going. Honestly, I would not recommend this location.

reviews.author: Matt G
reviews.title: Exceptional experience
reviews.body: It’s rare these days to have an experience where you can tell that someone truly cares about making it special for you. I have a feeling this is going to be one of those vacations our little family talks about for a very long time, and the staff made this trip! We arrived and were checked in right away…. And even upgraded. The amenities are great at this property. We will without question be back (hopefully sooner than later).

reviews.author: Charlesws6
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.body:
The W Fort Lauderdale delivers well on the design and overall atmosphere, but unfortunately, the level of service did not live up to the luxury experience I expected. The property is beautiful and has the stylish, energetic feel that I associate with the W brand. However, the service issues I experienced particularly with room service and communication were disappointing.

For a luxury hotel, I expected a much higher level of attention to detail and follow-through. Waiting over an hour for a menu after being told someone would bring one to my room significantly took away from the overall experience. While one front-desk employee ultimately went above and beyond to help me, the situation should never have reached that point.

Overall, the hotel has the potential to deliver an exceptional W experience, but the service needs to be more consistent with the luxury standards the brand promises.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: The W Florida
reviews.body: This place is excellent! Staff is wonderful, food is delicious, although I was very disappointed to learn El Vez closed.

reviews.author: Johnny Bravo
reviews.title: Beachfront pool resort that closes main beach pool for private event
reviews.body: Stayed 3 nights. Paying hotel guests asked to leave main beachfront pool…for private reserved event. NO advance notice given. Astonished as the pool is the main attraction at hotel. Even more astonished by lackluster response of hotel when issue raised. Rooms are worn and need TLC.

reviews.author: jessie
reviews.title: If you like hot water, quick elevators and temperature cool rooms - stay somewhere else
reviews.body:
This was a business trip, so I did not have much time to stop and complain in the moment because I was constantly trying to get out the door and get to work.

The biggest issue was the elevators. On multiple occasions, we waited more than 20 minutes. Three people I was with had their Ubers leave, one person ended up walking down 10 flights of stairs, and on one day six members of my team were late because we could not get downstairs. That is more than an inconvenience, especially for business travelers. I could write a book on all the issues I had with these elevators. Please fix your elevators!!

I also did not have reliably hot water for more than half of my stay. Sometimes it took 20 to 30 minutes to warm up, and more often - it never did. The water had a green tint and noticeable odor, there was visible mold in the shower, and the shower itself was coming off its hinge. The AC barely worked, especially at night, and after walking barefoot across the room for maybe 30 seconds, the bottoms of my feet were black. Gross.

These were not isolated issues. One coworker’s AC went out in the middle of the night, and another also had no hot water.

I also ordered food to go from the downstairs bar when it was nearly empty. It took over an hour and was overcooked and extremely salty.

I do want to say that everyone I interacted with was genuinely very nice. My frustration is not with the staff. It is with the condition and operation of the hotel.

Honestly, it was really disappointing to see. I have made content for W in the past and have always associated the brand with a much higher standard of quality, service, and attention to detail. I understand that things go wrong, but this was not one isolated issue. It was a series of problems that affected most of my stay and several people on my team.

I would really appreciate someone from management reaching out and considering a meaningful service recovery. I would genuinely like the opportunity to come back and have the experience I know W is capable of delivering

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Dirty
reviews.body:
Upon check-in, I went to use the bathroom in my room and found blood all over the toilet seat. I immediately notified the front desk. Four hours later, the blood was still there and the bathroom had not been cleaned. Only after I followed up again did someone finally come to clean it.
I then went to use the shower and found it covered in someone else’s hair. Once again, I had to report the issue and wait for it to be cleaned.
While I appreciate the apologies and that the bathroom was eventually cleaned, this room was clearly not properly cleaned or inspected before I was given the keys. Finding another guest’s blood on the toilet seat is not just unpleasant—it is a serious sanitation concern. Combined with the hair throughout the shower and the fact that it took four hours to address the initial complaint, the condition of the room was completely unacceptable.

reviews.author: Vero
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.body:
I can’t say enough wonderful things about our stay at the W Fort Lauderdale. From the moment we arrived, the entire experience felt personal, welcoming, and exceptional. The valet team was fantastic, and we were so surprised to find a personalized note and charcuterie board waiting in our room for my husband’s birthday. It was such a thoughtful touch and immediately made our stay feel special.
A huge shoutout to Raul, who truly went above and beyond for us. He helped us find fun places to visit nearby and was always so friendly and helpful whenever we needed anything. When we realized our refrigerator wasn’t working, he quickly arranged for someone to come take care of it.
We also had an issue with our shower taking about 20 minutes to get hot. When I mentioned it to Raul, he immediately offered to move us to another room. We were already unpacked and it wasn’t enough of an inconvenience for us to want to move, but I really appreciated how quickly he offered a solution and genuinely wanted to make sure we were comfortable.
Even with those two minor room issues, our experience was exceptional because of the level of service we received. Raul and the entire W team made us feel like our stay mattered and that every need was being personally taken care of.
We will absolutely be back! The W Fort Lauderdale knows how to make a special occasion feel even more special. Thank you, Raul and the entire team, for making my husband’s birthday weekend one we’ll remember!

reviews.author: CheSL
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body:
My husband and I planned a one-night “staycation” since our parents were in town to spend time with our baby. Upon arrival, we received the great news that our room had been upgraded. However, once we entered the room, we immediately noticed that the toilet wasn’t working, there was hair on the sofa, the area rug had multiple stains, and the bathroom floor appeared to have old vomit on it.

We called the front desk and were told to notify them when we left the room so it could be properly cleaned. We were also told that we would receive four drink vouchers as compensation. We notified them as instructed when we left; however, when we returned to our room several hours later, it still had not been cleaned.

At this point, it was the middle of the day, and we wanted to enjoy our room and take a nap. Instead, we were grossed out and uncomfortable touching anything while waiting for a new room. We were extremely disappointed, especially because this was a rare opportunity for us to enjoy some alone time after becoming new parents.

The new room was clean, but it did not have the ocean view that I had originally paid for. At that point, we were too tired and disappointed to complain further, so we simply accepted the room and tried to make the best of the remainder of our stay.

reviews.author: Bonnie Ftl61
reviews.title: Great place to go for a FUN weekend or even just a day pass!
reviews.body: We had a beautiful room with an ocean view!  The pool was fun with great music and included lots of classy young people and families!  Drinks and food from the bar was great!

reviews.author: felicia
reviews.title: W Fort Lauderdale
reviews.body: Great stay at a great hotel perfectly located on the beach serving up great drinks, great vibes and great music! Staff not very friendly, my only complaint!

reviews.author: Marc
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: It was a great experience for my family.

reviews.author: Sarah941
reviews.title: Better Hotels in Fort Lauderdale
reviews.body: I would recommend the Harbor Marriott hotel if you want to stay and have a lovely time on the beach. This hotel is old and not clean to my standards for a $430 a night.

reviews.author: World traveler
reviews.title: Excellent choice!!
reviews.body: Booked two bedroom suite for the weekend with my family. Excellent experience with five star service breakfast was amazing dinner restaurant on first floor was fresh very tasteful great ambience bar pool area, fun and welcoming.

reviews.author: JVC333
reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.body: Our stay was from Friday to Tuesday. When I booked, I stated it was our anniversary and we were attending a wedding. Friday, our flight got delayed, and we got in later than we were supposed to be. After a long day, I wanted to shower and eat. I go to shower and no hot water. I’m thinking it has to warm up. So we keep the shower ON and go downstairs to order food to go. The restaurant menu was totally different from what was in the room. They stated we have to order those items to our room at the front desk or our room, but the front desk can help. Go to the front desk, and with no hesitation, he tells us to order from our room. We go back upstairs and order. The food was $92 for a salad and a meal with chicken breast plus asparagus. The salad dressing has hair in it. While all of this is taking place, I’m still waiting for the shower. I go check, and it’s STILL COLD. Now I’m upset because the food is nasty and the water is cold, plus we are tired. They tell me they can send maintenance up….who maintenance going in and out the room that late? I ASKED can we switch rooms, it wasn’t offered. He states they only had residential options and lower-level options with no ocean view. We were on the 21st floor and PAID for ocean view. Most people know that the rooms are based on the VIEW and balcony! If we switched, I wouldn’t have gotten my money’s worth. I’m thinking he is going to offer something for the inconvenience while we are staying there. Mind you, there was no note in regards to our anniversary. They had champagne next to all the other amenities we had to pay for it opened. He offered points I couldn’t use in that moment or no time soon and to remake the food. Please note—I had no choice at this point to let maintenance up, which took 20 min in and out. Every night after that, we came in to cold water. I was over it….and because we were there for a wedding, we didn’t want to keep moving rooms with all of our items. Before the last day, someone called and stated something about a refund. I’m thinking it will be at least a night OR TWO coming off. Nope…they only took off the resort fee of $160, which doesn’t even total one night’s stay at this hotel. I wouldn’t recommend it! Now I’m upset because the food is nasty and the water is cold, plus we are tired. They tell me they can send maintenance up….who is maintenance going in and out the room that late? I ASKED if we could switch rooms, but it wasn’t offered. He states they only had residential options and lower-level options with no ocean view. We were on the 21st floor and PAID for ocean view. Most people know that the rooms are based on the VIEW and balcony! If we switched, I wouldn’t have gotten my money’s worth. I’m thinking he is going to offer something for the inconvenience while we are staying there. Mind you, there was no note in regards to our anniversary. They had champagne next to all the other amenities we had to pay for it opened. He offered points I couldn’t use in that moment or no time soon and to remake the food. Please note—I had no choice at this point to let maintenance up, which took 20 min in and out. Every night after that, we came in to cold water. I was over it….and because we were there for a wedding, we didn’t want to keep moving rooms with all of our items. Before the last day, someone called and stated something about a refund. I’m thinking it will be at least a night OR TWO coming off. Nope…they only took off the resort fee of $160, which doesn’t even total one night’s stay at this hotel. I wouldn’t recommend it!

reviews.author: Pedersenj
reviews.title: Eat but don’t stay
reviews.body: This is absolutely a great Marriott to have something to eat at as the food really was outstanding, but I would honestly stay somewhere else. The room we had was dated and had mold. There were other items in the room that could have easily been fixed, but we’re left unkept. Definitely the worst luxury Marriott we have stayed at to date and we are lifetime platinum, currently Titanium. The staff was really attentive and the service in all areas was excellent. Not a fan of the room.

reviews.author: NashGuy
reviews.title: Fantastic stay again!
reviews.body: They welcomed us back with open arms, and the staff took amazing care of us!  We had a fantastic time, and we hope to come back again this year!

reviews.author: Aleisha
reviews.title: Family Birthday Trip
reviews.body:
We attended from out of country to celebrate our daughter’s birthday. The Insider Team members, Amaya and Nickolas were incredible and went above and beyond to offer their services. 

We communicated with them, including Petal & Passion, prior to arrival to curate a memorable experience.  This team, including other members we interacted with were courteous and pleasant.

The W Fort Lauderdale has breathtaking views, steps to the beach, plenty amenities, and a welcoming environment.  It is inclusive to many demographics which was pleasant to see. 

Will definitely return!

reviews.author: Horrible
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.body:
I am writing about a very disappointing experience during my recent stay at the W Fort Lauderdale, for which I paid approximately $1,400 after upgrading my accommodations.

On the morning of my departure, despite having a confirmed 2:00 PM checkout, I began receiving repeated communications around 8:00 AM regarding a remaining $340 balance. I was contacted by phone, text message, email, and a written note—approximately six hours before my scheduled checkout.

To be clear, I had absolutely no issue paying the remaining balance. My concern is the excessive and intrusive manner in which payment was pursued while I was still an active guest with several hours remaining in my stay.

I brought this concern directly to hotel management and requested a reasonable service recovery. I was then informed that the higher-level manager had personally initiated the 8:00 AM contacts and declined to provide any credit or adjustment whatsoever.

What was perhaps most disappointing was management’s complete unwillingness to offer any form of remediation. I specifically upgraded my accommodations and spent approximately $1,400 because I expected the elevated level of hospitality associated with the W brand. Even a reasonable gesture acknowledging the disruption would have demonstrated that my experience mattered. Instead, my concerns were dismissed entirely, which ultimately left a much more negative impression than the original incident itself.

After spending approximately $1,400 at a luxury Marriott property, I do not believe being repeatedly pursued for a $340 balance at 8:00 AM—and then having management dismiss my concerns—reflects the level of hospitality associated with either the W or Marriott brands.

I am asking Marriott Corporate to review this experience independently of the property and provide an appropriate service recovery. Because property management is directly involved in my complaint, I would appreciate a response from someone with the authority to address this matter rather than simply referring it back to the same management team.

Please confirm receipt of this complaint and provide me with a case number for follow-up.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to Marriott’s response.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay, Hidden Fees, and Poor Customer Service
reviews.body:
My stay at this hotel was extremely disappointing. There was no Spanish-speaking assistance available to provide clear information, and the additional costs and fees were never explained properly.

At check-in, I was told that everything was included, but at check-out I was unexpectedly charged additional fees that had never been clearly disclosed. When I raised concerns, I did not feel that the staff made any real effort to provide a solution.

The pool was also dirty and uncomfortable, which made the experience even worse. Overall, I was very dissatisfied with the lack of communication, transparency, customer service, and cleanliness.

reviews.author: rafael
reviews.title: nice hotel and location
reviews.body: the hotel is nice, good location,  confortable room and nice bie if you stay in front beach view. service is good, i was just expecting a buffet breakfats but they do not have only a la carta with limited options and a little expensive

reviews.author: Holly
reviews.title: Decent stay in Key West
reviews.body: The hotel is a bit dated but mostly decently kept. Breakfast was disappointing. Pool is nice. Staff was very friendly.

reviews.author: Paola L
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: We loved this place even though they were doing renovations . The hotel was cleaned and the pool was a big plus .

reviews.author: R Wright
reviews.title: This Hotel is need of major updates.
reviews.body: If you’re looking for a hotel that was built in the 80’s with no modern amenities this is the place to stay. But if you wanna charge a cell phone or watch and a computer, good luck.

reviews.author: JDel
reviews.title: Might have been ok if you are deaf, and don't want to eat breakfast.
reviews.body: With other hotel groups, when a property is under renovation it states that on the website.  Fairfield did not bother to list that.  The breakfast area was closed and we were forced to eat microwavable sandwiches outdoors while listening to the two different loud music stations blaring noise.  On top of that, both days there was construction equipment like diggers, chain saws, chippers, and gas powered blowers making noise during all daylight hours--woke us up too.  We complained and barely got a "I'm sorry" out of the front desk.

reviews.author: A concerned guest
reviews.title: The room was fine but.
reviews.body: Please be warned that the poolside bar is all boarded up. They claim drinks were available elsewhere but no poolside bar is available. The breakfast room is also closed and boarded up. They had a temporary room set up for breakfast but it was terrible as well as the food choices. Way below the Marriott standard for there free breakfasts.

reviews.author: gary
reviews.title: horrible place
reviews.body: worst hotel and breakfast

reviews.author: WLM
reviews.title: Unannounced construction
reviews.body: While the room was comfortable, the hotel’s breakfast room and tiki bar were under construction and not available to use. The breakfast was served in a very dark temporary room. Packaged breakfast sandwich. Not worthy of a Marriott property also was charged $12 per day for parking but I didn’t have a car. The charge was removed at my request but I shouldn’t have had to ask. I told them at check in I didn’t have a car

reviews.author: J n M
reviews.title: Not for us
reviews.body: Some might find this hotel, some might find this hotel quaint and charming, but we did not like the fact that the doors opened to an outdoor hallway that anyone could access. Made us feel unsafe. Upon opening the door, we were met with blasting AC with a heavy smell of mold, that was the decision-maker. Other Fairfield Inns are quite nice, but this one was not for us.

reviews.author: C Siegel
reviews.title: Less than pleasurable experience.
reviews.body: All hotels under construction should list such construction on their website if a customer is booking during said construction time. The rooms were less than acceptable for a Marriott property and I stay over 100 night a year with 95% of all stays at Marriott properties. Outdoor pools should be cleaned every day by hotel staff.

reviews.author: Rob70
reviews.title: Thank you for giving Me and My family Great service!t
reviews.body: Great Stay at the Fairfield Key West!

reviews.author: dont go here
reviews.title: don't go here
reviews.body: skip this place not worthy of the Marriott name

reviews.author: August Traveler
reviews.title: It’s got a great pool, but nothing else was great
reviews.body: The pool area was nice. The room and hotel need updating. Bath towels were stained. No a/c in the elevator so they are stifling hot. Shuttle to downtown was nice.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: This was a motel, not a hotel
reviews.body: This was not the standard that Marriott or Fairfield usually has.  It was a motel that was converted.

reviews.author: Antonio B
reviews.title: Disappointed, Fairfield Key West
reviews.body:
Booked a double and specified 3 adults,  received what appears to be a full with pull out sofa. No linen for sofa bed. Small, compact very tight space. For price paid, not worth it. Very disappointed. 
Had not been to Key West in approximately 20 years and was looking forward to a relaxing weekend.

reviews.author: Worst Marriott ever
reviews.title: The worst Marriott ever
reviews.body: See the point in the feedback comments

reviews.author: BV
reviews.title: Weekend in Keywest
reviews.body: The check-in process was quick, smooth, and the staff was friendly. We also enjoyed the complimentary buy-one-get-one drink offer at check-in. The hotel is currently undergoing renovations, so the food and beverage area was temporarily set up between two rooms. Because of this, the breakfast selection was somewhat limited, and it didn’t meet our expectations. On a positive note, the pool was clean and well maintained throughout our stay. The guest rooms were comfortable but felt a bit dated and could benefit from some renovations. Overall, the hotel has potential, and we hope the ongoing updates will enhance the guest experience.

reviews.author: Expressing concern
reviews.title: Expressing concern
reviews.body:
Overall, my stay was okay, but there are a few maintenance issues that I believe should be addressed.

The biggest issue was the air conditioning in my room. I called the front desk as soon as I checked in, and a maintenance technician came by. He advised me to wait about 30 minutes for the room to cool down, but unfortunately the issue was never resolved, and the room remained uncomfortable.

The pool area also needs attention. Several of the pavers surrounding the pool are lifting, creating a potential trip hazard. In my opinion, this should be a top priority, as someone could easily trip and get injured. Additionally, the cabana cushions had multiple noticeable stains, which took away from the overall appearance and cleanliness of the pool area.

I hope management addresses these issues, as the property has great potential and these improvements would significantly enhance the guest experience.

reviews.author: Fred from Florida
reviews.title: The Keys trip
reviews.body: The hotel is dated. Construction work ongoing without being informed. The location and complimentary shuttle service is good.

reviews.author: Suz
reviews.title: Please refund resort fees
reviews.body: The hotel is dated and the amenities were subpar. The room was not cleaned very well. The "complimentary breakfast" was very lackluster. The food looked old and not fresh. The "Tiki Bar" was ridiculous. $12 for a drink in a small cup, no menu, and just a guessing game. Many things were not accessible. The pool was not clean. The resort fee should be refunded to all guests because this hotel is not a resort and the amenities and services were non-existent.

reviews.author: Solid for the Price
reviews.title: Solid spot in the keys
reviews.body:
Staff is very friendly, location is solid. 

Shuttle was super clutch.

Bar was being renovated. Pool needed someone to check the filters and needed a skim but the fountains helped.

reviews.author: Keys visitor
reviews.title: Little Gem
reviews.body: This hotel offers all you need for a Keys visit. The downtown shuttle is a very nice and convenient feature. We were hesitant on booking something outside of downtown, but this was well worth it.

reviews.author: Unhappyfamily
reviews.title: The worst stay ever
reviews.body: At no point during booking or at check-in, were we told that the hotel was under construction. I've been going to this hotel 2x a year for 4 years, I brag about it to everyone. It's always been a beautiful stay and experience, but this time was awful and disgusting. The tiki bar, breakfast area, poolside bathrooms were closed for construction. They had a "bar" setup in an unused room, but only had about 5 drink options. The breakfast area was also set up in an unused room. It would have been maybe ok for guests who've never visited this hotel before, but when you e been going for years you have an expectation, and this was far far far below that. The pool deck pavers were so uneven, you had to be looking down at the ground to watch your step your you'd trip. The pool was very dirty, we asked for someone to come scoop some of the debris out, the man took one scoop and left. So my kids and I were picking dead bugs, leaves, flowers, hair, earrings, and everything else out so we could swim. The pool towels were a nasty nasty dingy white. The mildew/mold on the outside on the second floor was nasty and disturbing to see. As well as the pillars on the ground floor, they were all crumbling apart. The dresser drawers in the rooms wouldn't stay closed, the floors were sticky like something had been spilled and not properly cleaned. When things were mentioned to staff, they simply shrug their shoulders and said they are under construction.

reviews.author: Kayg19
reviews.title: Not a great stay
reviews.body: Very old property, towels were scratchy and grey. Sheets were pilled. Room smelled of mildew.

reviews.author: Tony Guadagnino
reviews.title: Not worth money
reviews.body: First room the A/C did not work.  Second room was cooler but air ran for 2 days straight and the temperature never went down. The hotel was under construction. Bar and breakfast area were set up in a room on tables. Staff was super nice but the experience was not good at all.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: review
reviews.body:
Hotel had a nice layout with parking underneath as well as on the exterior of the hotel. Some parts were under construction, so I did not get to utilize the gym or the breakfast or bar area. the room was simple but adequate. didn't have any foul odors and was pretty clean. The shower had a bit of mold around the corners but nothing that was greatly visible with the naked eye.

The pool area had adequate amounts of towels and the jug of spf was a nice touch. I did wish it would've had at least a small hot tub. 

overall, I would visit this location again.

reviews.author: H Noboa
reviews.title: Repairs/under construction not advertised
reviews.body: Tiki bar and gym closed.  Makeshift bar in a room.  Dirty towels, gap under door which can allow pest to enter the room. Small rooms and pool area is not as big as advertised on website picture.  Checked in and within 45 mins I was checking out.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Very disappointed and I have been a Marriott member for 15 years
reviews.body: I’m just disappointed in the accommodations. The staff. The service  what’s the point of being a Marriott member paying extra for your card if you’re not felt special there  the food was gross not as described in the description, which was one of the reasons we booked that hotel so we didn’t have to eat out for breakfast  and we booked a certain room that came with a discount to Sunset water sports and nobody knew what that was about and did not seem very eager to help me

reviews.author: Morrison
reviews.title: Well below expectations
reviews.body: I should have read the other reviews before booking!  The room was cramped.  You could hardly get around the bed to get into the bathroom.  The room was poorly lit.  The linens were dingy and needs replaced.  The door to the room was visibly dirty.  The overall property has many areas is disrepair.  Was disappointed that Marriott had its name attached to this property.

reviews.author: New to marriotts but
reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.body: Hotel will soon go thru a renovation we heard and its much needed.  But the worse part of the stay was the uncleanliness of our room and towels, and then staff friendliness.  Not everyone was unfriendly…but how hard is it to smile or even say hello.   It gave me the feeling they were not happy with their jobs.   Exception was the workers at the pool bar in the afternoons.

reviews.author: Trip to Keywest
reviews.title: No good experience.
reviews.body: Finding lobby is hard , poor parking, dirty pool, horrible food.

reviews.author: Jeremy L
reviews.title: Room for Improvement in Most Aspects
reviews.body: See initial comments for full review.

reviews.author: Ricardo
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Everyone else interested staff is very friendly

reviews.author: NP
reviews.title: Moldy building “C”
reviews.body: Building reeked of mold, card keys had to be reprogrammed multiple times.  Beach area smelled foul.

reviews.author: Christine
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: this hotel was everything advertised, very clean, and very helpful and accommodating staff. The pool was perfect.

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.title: Staff here are aweful
reviews.body:
Some of the rooms are old and dated while
Some have been. Updated.  The hotel sits on a very busy main road intersection.   Request not stating in rooms directly on the street, they are noisy and you hear traffic all night and day.

reviews.author: GA88
reviews.title: TV did not work.  Beach not accessible due to crocodiles.  That was main reason I booked here & couldn’t even go in the water.
reviews.body: TV did not work.  Parts needed to be ordered.  They did not offer to change rooms with a working TV and just said they have been having issues with that TV.  I was given voucher for 1 breakfast, which I don’t think was reasonable for broken TV my entire 4-night stay.  Beach not accessible due to crocodiles.  That was main reason I booked here & couldn’t even go in the water.  Wish I would have known prior to booking, then I could have booked Fairfield where they at least have full kitchenette and free breakfast.  Supposedly recently renovated but bathroom were dirty and rust stains.  AC was noisy & didn’t sleep well.  I would have hoped they would have done better to amend these misgivings for a Marriott Bonvoy member.  I expect more from Marriott.

reviews.author: Unhappycamper
reviews.title: Worst Key West Stay
reviews.body: The hotel needs attention. The rooms are dingy and smell moldy. The hallways carpets were black from use. There were issues with the bathroom sink, which didn’t drain. Housekeeping failed to service our room. They opened the room door where my 12 year old was inside sleeping without confirming anyone’s identity, which seems like a nice thing to do but is a complete safety hazard. There were people playing profane music on a speaker they brought to the pool and no one addressed the situation. As a Titanium member, we were not offer a welcome drink or bottled waters. The experience was what I expect from a Marriott brand hotel.

reviews.author: Boch61
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Key West!
reviews.body:
Great hotel with an outstanding staff! This was my 10+ stay and I am always impressed by a professional, friendly and welcoming staff!
Large comfortable guest rooms, welcoming lobby with early morning complimentary coffee (before our charter fishing trips) and plenty of seating on the deck overlooking the water!
As always it is great to see Ken and Jeff serving drinks at the Tiki Bar! Great guys and always fun to hang with locals and guests at the bar!

reviews.author: Jenn W
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.body: Everything about this place was great.

reviews.author: Ximikeix209
reviews.title: Bed bugs
reviews.body: Pretty simple. Dont want bed bugs

reviews.author: Very disappointed
reviews.title: Not for me
reviews.body: Hard to believe this is a Marriott, it doesn’t meet the standards I am used to from the other Marriotts I have stayed in the past. There are no elevators, the doors to the halls are not locked/secured at any point of the day. Dirty carpets, smelly hallways. The only food available is served from 11am-2pm and you have to go to the bar at the pool to order it.

reviews.author: AMB
reviews.title: Extra charges on my credit card statement
reviews.body: There are extra charges on my credit card statement that is not on the hotel receipt. This is my 2nd email with copies of my credit card statement. I still haven’t heard back from the manager.

reviews.author: Poor follow up
reviews.title: Poor follow up
reviews.body: No response to my voice mail message and concerns for incorrect billing

reviews.author: NC 2026
reviews.title: Awesome Staff But OWNERSHIP Needs to Address Several Issues
reviews.body:
Ownership needs to start spending money on badly needed repairs and upgrades.  The renovation of 2019-2020 that was never finished and needs to be completed or redone.  While the older motor lodge section of the hotel was completed and is now pretty well up to date, the main building (400) was never finished and it shows.  Covid is over and is 5+ years in the rear view mirror.  Building 400 has the most expensive and spacious rooms in the place.  They are all suites  but furnishings are from the 1990's or worse, drawers on dressers don't stay closed, doors on cabinets do not line up and pop open from time to time,  curtains and shears do not close completely and don't line up.  TV remotes are not paired correctly and batteries are never checked and replaced till the customer takes it to the front desk to switch out.  There are water conserving fixtures in the bathroom sink (barely a dribble) however the sink in the kitchenette area have regular full pressure faucets, so what's the point.  Some showers still have tubs and a few have more modern walk in stalls.  The carpets are dark and dirty and lighting in these rooms are just as 1990ish and need upgrades.  They charge upwards of $300 to $450+ most times of the year and in this condition the price paid is absolutely not worth the price asked.  Marriott needs to force the owner to complete renovations or do a totally new renovation on this building or put them on probation and force the issue.  The boardwalk on the gulf has several loose planks, some with splinters sticking out.  My wife tripped on a loose, uneven plank, nearly fell and stubbled her toe (no injury, just a bad situation that was totally preventable).  The rail going into the pool in the shallow end as you go down the steps into the water or coming out gets very hot in the sun and needs to be wrapped in some kind of safety fabric that will prevent hand burns like happened to me twice during this stay.  Again, no injury, but a preventable incident that needs to be addressed.  Total overkill in the parking lot with 5 or 6 electric only vehicle charging stations.  We live up north and I have never seen that many charging stations in one businesses parking lot.  To have this many in a hotel with 70 or so guest rooms is total overkill and just shows how lucrative the government tax credits must have been when they were installed.  Rebates that benefitted the hotel ownership.  

Again let me say, great staff.  Ownership needs to spend some money.

reviews.author: ML
reviews.title: Stay at another hotel
reviews.body: The hotel room need some serious updating. Sofa is poor condition, remove the popcorn ceilings and please get a real headboard instead of pillows.

reviews.author: Susie Q
reviews.title: Not what I expected for Marriott
reviews.body: This hotel does not define the Marriott brand in my opinion. The hotel is outdated, rooms are mediocre. Hotel is far from the common bar/restaurant areas that Key West has to offer. There’s no shuttle service so plan to Uber quite a bit or be prepared to walk a lot. The description Hotel gives is deceiving. The “beach/oceanfront” area was small and water was dark and murky. No one was able to enjoy that area. The positive I give this hotel is that it has some charging stations available for those that have electric vehicles. Also, the hotel is close to a Publix shopping plaza.

reviews.author: Family trip
reviews.title: Annual family trip
reviews.body: Hotel is otherwise clean but pool and pool area need lot more attention.

reviews.author: Ared317
reviews.title: Great stay on main highway!
reviews.body: The location of the hotel was outside of downtown Key West, but was very close to the marina and several stores/restaurants. We enjoyed the pool and hot tub. Jeff at the bar was very attentive and easy going! The hotel staff also did a great job of helping me celebrate a milestone birthday. Very nice stay!

reviews.author: L Atkinson
reviews.title: This is a great place to stay in Key West!
reviews.body: I recommend this hotel highly! The rooms are spacious and clean. The breakfast is good with Starbucks in the lobby. There is a nice tiki hut bar by the pool. There are chargers for your electric car. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: CJ
reviews.title: Family trip experience
reviews.body: The property has beautiful garden and a deckwalk as well as a small beach area. The hall way has a strong smell of cleaning product, and the smell is less strong in the room. The AC unit in the room makes loud noises. The breakfast has a good selection of starbucks-like menu.

reviews.author: Shanon
reviews.title: Disappointed in front desk staff
reviews.body:
The overall property is visually pleasing and well taken care of. The support staff-cleaning -bar tender etc were competent and friendly. 
The big disappointment was the front desk staff who were borderline  incompetent and not well trained for “ Marriott hospitality “

reviews.author: Couple
reviews.title: Comfortable, but lacking
reviews.body:
Bed was comfortable, mobility accessible room was tight for maneuvering to restroom. 

Grandchildren visited and the youngest one found a prescription pill near edge of bed. Please have your housekeepers look underneath the beds to be sure that there is nothing there. He recently just stopped picking things up and putting in his mouth.

reviews.author: L Harper
reviews.title: 40th Wedding Anniversary
reviews.body: We were very impressed at check in.  Everything was great and we were very pleased.

reviews.author: My birthday weekend
reviews.title: My birthday weekend!!!
reviews.body: I really enjoyed my self at the Marriott. Ken the bartender really made my birthday happy hour a blast. He recommended places Key West had to offer. The staff took the time to decorate my room for my birthday. I loved the champagne and the snacks. The pillow with HAPPY BIRTHDAY was very special to me. Thank you all for making my stay a weekend to remember. I was disappointed that the jacuzzi was out of order for the time I was there.

reviews.author: Noah
reviews.title: Rooster
reviews.body: Rooster at 4am made it impossible to sleep.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.title: Lovely view from the room!
reviews.body: Beautiful sunset view with palm trees and boat on the water! Great room, terrific shower! Just lovely. Only drawback for me personally (knees and feet) is the fact that there are no elevators. Will book next time with a ground floor.

reviews.author: Beach Bum
reviews.title: Key West get away
reviews.body: Excellent stay. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Rosana
reviews.title: Comfortable, nice pool
reviews.body: Traveling with family member from out of town. Nice facility with a great pool area.

reviews.author: GAF  Training
reviews.title: Island Lodging Key West
reviews.body:
It was a quick trip. The room was pleasant. All tile floor (probably necessary in the Keys). 
The room lighting was very dim. The main light was about as bright as two night lights. 
This time of year, there was a significant rainstorm prior to the visit and the termites were swarming all over. Many congregated in the bathroom.
The back door access to the pool was nice and the poolside bar was also nice to have.
The furniture was awkward. There were no 90* corners and I felt like I had vertigo. It took me all day to be able to learn to ignore the OCD kicking in.
When checking in the desk appeared to have been training new employees, it took them quite a long time to recognize my presence.

I realize that at this price point there will be imperfections. The overall experience exceeded my expectations. My comments are succinct for your ability to make light of whatever you feel is necessary. 
The boardwalk and beach area has lots of potential for improvements and at the same time it has that eclectic feel of Old Key West

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Always comfortable, clean & feel safe

reviews.author: Liz A
reviews.title: Amazing hotel in all aspects!
reviews.body: We were completely blown away by the level of service we received by every single person we encountered at La Concha from the moment we walked in the door. We barely checked into our room when we received a call to make sure everything was to our liking. Every single request we made was answered promptly and delivered with a smile.  The quality of food and beverage in the bar and restaurant was top notch.  We particularly enjoyed chatting with Emma at the Mojito Bar as she worked quickly filling the orders of every customer with a bright and sunny attitude.  She made excellent food and drink suggestions and this quickly became one of my favorite meals while in Key West.  I wish I would have written down more names to acknowledge, but every single employee we encountered delievered amazing service from the front desk, to housekeeping, even maintenance and the bellman.  The property was centrally located and within walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go.  I don't think I will ever stay anywhere else when we come back to Key West.  I have been a travel agent for over 20 years and will recommend this property to all my clients.

reviews.author: Beware
reviews.title: Save the money
reviews.body: This is a very dated property…just know that going in. Small pool, small rooms and limited staff to help you.

reviews.author: CDJardine
reviews.title: La Concha Key West
reviews.body: La Concha Hotel .. the star of Duval Ateeet⭐️💫

reviews.author: James V 424
reviews.title: Review
reviews.body: Everything was spot on with one exception. Please look into the person who checked my the night of 9/3. She was so rude and disrespectful. Adding insult to injury she didn’t even realize it which also made her clueless. I run a business I’m sharing based on how important the right people are for the work. I expect better than that from Bonvoy. Train her and cut bait.

reviews.author: Roxie
reviews.title: Perfect Location
reviews.body: Great location on Duval Street. Great view from out room on the 7th floor.

reviews.author: Great location
reviews.title: Staff  very confused with every problem
reviews.body: Every effort to get things right by Charles (who was terrific) but somehow the rest of staff just didn’t come thru. Jennifer (I think is her name ) also tried to help but message light never turned off. Housekeeping not great!

reviews.author: RP21084
reviews.title: Hotel has a lot of potential, perfect location
reviews.body: This could be an excellent hotel if it was better maintained, consistent cleaning and front desk staff to answer phones.  The hotel is beautiful and staff is very friendly, however no one answered at the front desk when calling, some areas need painting and room floor had not been moped prior to stay and one day our room not "cleaned" until after 4pm and we showered using pool towels. The complimentary rum punch and mojitos daily were definitely appreciated as well as an on-site concierge.

reviews.author: TGC702
reviews.title: Another Excellence Experience @ La Concha, Key West
reviews.body: This was our 10 year in a row staying at La Concha, Key West! The hotel and the service at this hotel has continued to improve and exceeds all expectations!

reviews.author: MM17
reviews.title: A stay to remember !
reviews.body: From the moment we arrived , we felt welcomed and special by all staff members. Britney & Jenn in particular, provided a 5 Star guest experience my family. I would never stay anywhere else while in Key West 🌴

reviews.author: Frustrating stay
reviews.title: Overpriced and underserviced.
reviews.body: For $400/night, we expect better

reviews.author: RecentGuest
reviews.title: Quality location and hotel
reviews.body: Excellent location, staff, and hotel.  If you are a smoker, be warned:  There is no smoking on the property, which is not uncommon.  What is uncommon, is the unacceptable smoking area.  It is a small empty area next to the parking lot tucked behind a building, next to a bike parking area with 3 mismatched chairs that look like they came from the trash.  As a woman, I would never go to this dark and isolated area.  My husband and I couldn't believe what area we were expected to use. Hotels around the world provide a smoking area convenient for smokers, while not bothering others.  I specifically called prior to booking and was told there was a smoking area.  Say there is no smoking area instead of giving us that unacceptable area.  Do better.

reviews.author: Jamkam
reviews.title: Stylish and Beautiful Hotel that gives Little Havana Vibes
reviews.body: This is a gorgeous little hotel located in the heart of Key West.  It is both stylish, quaint, light, bright, and airy without seeming like a cliche.  The hotel is centrally located on Duval Street.  I had a 1-bedroom suite with a large patio overlooking Duval Street.  The rooms were very clean.  The bathrooms were great.  It is an older building, but it does not feel older.  It feels cozy and warm yet still large and bright.  My only downer was the food.  Great options, but the food quality in the mojito bar and for breakfast in Perla was inconsistent.  The coffee shop had great coffee and pastry options.  Definitely grab rum punch in the lobby in the afternoons AND a free mojito.  The pool was small but relaxing and the service by the pool was very good.

reviews.author: Stay Here
reviews.title: Great spot and lots of fun
reviews.body: Staff were great!  Hotel clean!  Great location to walk all over the downtown are!

reviews.author: KC26
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.body: We loved everything about La Concha! The location is right in the middle of all of the action yet very quiet! The pool and bar were great too! The staff were friendly and accommodating but our Concierge Jennifer made our trip to Key West unforgettable!!

reviews.author: Needs updating
reviews.title: Elevator neegs help
reviews.body: The elevator is ridiculous old and wore out guests have to ride with hotel maid carts that's after waiting for long time one elevator for too many people not what you would except from a autograph hotel or from Bonvoy hotel and as usual as a platinum member no upgrade available

reviews.author: Hon3y617
reviews.title: Key West Getaway
reviews.body: We had an amazing time at La Conch in Key West. Location is the best right on Duval close to everything. The staff are super nice, rooms are clean and spacious, excellent experience.

reviews.author: Sean
reviews.title: La Concha last minutes trip
reviews.body: 3 nights in the recently remodeled hotel. Lobby looks great.  Staff is top notch and location is near impossible to beat.

reviews.author: Bobby
reviews.title: Room with temporary ac unit! Told to keep blinds closed-pulled on balcony room.
reviews.body: Checked in to a 2nd floor balcony room facing Duval with a temporary ac unit. Was told to keep blinds pulled to keep room cool. It never got comfortable! Unacceptable service at bar and over unit.

reviews.author: A repeat quest
reviews.title: Best place
reviews.body: This place is outstanding, and the staff is amazing.

reviews.author: Papa wanabees
reviews.title: Old Key West
reviews.body: Great accommodation right on Duval. This is Old Florida building with roots and history close to everything yet quiet and cool. It has everything you need from a Pool to bars and restaurants all done well.

reviews.author: Kare466
reviews.title: Absolutely fantastic stay
reviews.body: My husband and I stayed at La Concha Key West with my 20 year old daughter.  The hotel is right on Duval street which was fantastic for us bringing our daughter down there for the first time.  We walked the street as well as to Hemingway House and Mallory Square.  The staff was so friendly and the hotel is super clean.  We will be back!!!!

reviews.author: DelawareNorm1
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Laconia is very clean, nice big rooms.  Outstanding staff.  Everyone was friendly and professional.  Special thanks to Jennifer and her staff!!

reviews.author: Mohit
reviews.title: Visit was excellent and was nice property , enjoyed our stay
reviews.body: Amazing trip we’ve been a few times to key west but this was a memorable trip

reviews.author: Angela Mitchell
reviews.title: The Heart of La Concha? Its Amazing Staff!
reviews.body:
My stay at La Concha Hotel was absolutely wonderful. The hotel has so much character, a fantastic location, and a welcoming atmosphere that made my visit truly memorable. What stood out most, however, was the exceptional staff. Every employee I encountered was friendly, professional, and genuinely committed to making guests feel at home.

One of the highlights of my stay was meeting Jennifer Robino, who has been with the hotel for an incredible 24 years. Jennifer's warmth, knowledge, and passion for La Concha are a true reflection of the outstanding hospitality the hotel provides. It was a pleasure getting to know her, and her dedication made my experience even more special.

If you're looking for a hotel with charm, outstanding service, and a team that truly cares about its guests, I highly recommend La Concha Hotel. I look forward to returning!

reviews.author: Traveler1
reviews.title: What a disappointment
reviews.body: This is not worth your money. Small rooms, bland food, untrained staff.

reviews.author: HARVEY
reviews.title: Great Stay in a Great location.
reviews.body: 2nd time at LaConcha and even better this time.    Loved the staff and the ambience.

reviews.author: DB26
reviews.title: LaConcha Simply the Best
reviews.body: My wife and I stayed three nights at LaConcha to celebrate our 52nd anniversary. We were not disappointed! From the moment we walked in were met with friendly staff who made our stay truly memorable. Waiting in our room was an anniversary welcoming basket. The display was above and beyond our expectations. The hotel is perfectly located on Duval St close to everything Key West. Staying at LaConcha was simply the Best!

reviews.author: Anon
reviews.title: Honest Feedback
reviews.body:
Overall, the property was beautiful, cozy, and a wonderful place to stay.

The only downside was our experience with the front desk. At a 4-star hotel, I expected the staff to be warm, welcoming, and genuinely helpful.

During our stay on July 7, we had a few simple questions about Key West. The front desk associate with dreadlocks wasn’t very accommodating and kept insisting that we wait for the travel and tours concierge instead of helping us. We also asked whether we could use the bikes, and his response came with an odd look that made us feel like we were bothering him just for asking questions. As first-time visitors, we were simply trying to learn more about the town, so the interaction felt unnecessarily dismissive.

When we checked out, Maria was also speaking so quickly that I could barely understand her. I had to ask twice, “Sorry, could you repeat that?” While she may have been busy, slowing down a bit would have made for a much friendlier checkout experience.

On the bright side, the General Manager completely turned things around. He was incredibly approachable, professional, and genuinely helpful. He even shared a great tip on the best beach to visit during seaweed season, which we really appreciated. His hospitality was exemplary and reflected the level of service we had hoped to experience throughout our stay!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: The hotel is at center of activity on island perfect place to stay and first class
reviews.body: All employees are there to make your stay perfect

reviews.author: Cadesca24
reviews.title: EXCELLENCE
reviews.body: Cleanliness, friendliness, LOCATION are all excellent.

reviews.author: Jax5056
reviews.title: Great Key West feel but room was very dark
reviews.body: Excellent location - great Key West vibe and staff was absolutely excellent….but lighting in our room was so poor we would probably try another place next time.  It felt like we were in a cave.

reviews.author: Birthday trip
reviews.title: Great hotel to be in the middle of the action but have a private space
reviews.body: We loved the hotel, cozy clean and good spot to be at close to the action.

reviews.author: Marriott Platinum
reviews.title: Terrible treatment by staff especially hotel manager, Abrahsm
reviews.body:
Don’t stay at The Saint Hotwl in Key West. 
The hotel manager is an abusive bully and dishonest. 
He raised my room rate and other costs by double when I extended it another day after nearly 2 weeks there.  And lied and said he didn’t. And I should have known it. And banged on my door and yelled at my by my room and at he front desk. I have serious health issues and had chest pains and other complications because of his abusive treatment.

reviews.author: Robert W
reviews.title: Review for The Saint Hotel – Key West
reviews.body:
The Saint Hotel has become our absolute favorite place to stay in Key West — and while the beautiful rooms, the perfectly cooled pool, the lively rooftop bar with great music, and the incredible brunch all play a part, the real reason is the people.

Everything starts with Abraham Cox, who is truly a gem. He embodies the spirit of service in a way that sets the tone for the entire hotel. His warmth, professionalism, and genuine care make every stay feel personal. He is the heart and soul of The Saint.

And he’s surrounded by an equally wonderful team. Latoya, Juan, Gustavo, Maria, and Aeryc all bring their own energy, kindness, and attention to detail that make each visit memorable. Whether it’s a friendly greeting, thoughtful help, or simply making you feel at home, they deliver service that goes far beyond expectations.

We look forward to many more stays and deeply appreciate the amazing hospitality this team provides. The Saint isn’t just a great hotel — it’s a place filled with great people, and that’s what keeps us coming back.

reviews.author: MPW Charleston
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body:
The Saint Hotel was such a pleasure! The vibe is truly unique—welcoming, fun, and classy all at the same time. The service was impeccable, the food and drinks were outstanding, and the entire property was beautifully maintained and exceptionally clean.

And the location is amazing! We were able to walk everywhere, which made exploring Key West so easy. We also loved the rooftop and the live music—it was the perfect addition to an already wonderful stay.

We will absolutely be back and look forward to another chance to “Sleep Saintly!”

reviews.author: Jro21722
reviews.title: The Saint-Key West Oasis
reviews.body: My husband and I have been coming to Key West every summer for 10 years.  The Saint is our hotel of choice for a kid-free break.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rumcake1
reviews.title: Great Key West Stay
reviews.body: Don't pass up the opportunity to stay at The Saint Hotel Key West.  Professional staff, ideal location, fun vide, and great food and drinks.  Don't miss the Sunday Brunch.

reviews.author: Underwhelming in paradise
reviews.title: Underwhelming
reviews.body: The staff, pool & location is amazing. The rooms were disappointing! The first room smelled like mildew so we moved to a different room. Both rooms had a dehumidifier that had to be dumped a couple of times a day.

reviews.author: AFSki
reviews.title: The Saint
reviews.body: All the staff was very nice and helpful.  The common areas had a cool hip vibe.  The signature drinks and food were delicious. The room was a bit small but adequate. The only downside was the bathroom. The handle on the shower was very loose as was the one towel rack.  The shower door wouldn't close all the way because the upper hinge was dislodging. The bottom of the bathroom door was a bit chewed up and in need of paint.

reviews.author: Stadlers
reviews.title: Quiet in the Heart of Key West
reviews.body: Lovely, boutique hotel just off Duval. Craziness outside the property, but peace and quiet inside.

reviews.author: McCoy
reviews.title: Memorial Day get Away
reviews.body: The hotel is located in a wonderful spot. Abraham, Luisa, and their staff were very good and accommodating. Our stay was great; however, I would have been able to rate it wonderful had we not had the reservation issue. Our reservation was cancelled without notifying us, even after I personally worked with management to make it. They were able to accommodate us; however, not in the room type we had reserved. I recommend that if you use Marriott Bonvoy and need to make a change to your reservation, you call to confirm it hasn’t been cancelled.

reviews.author: Cliff
reviews.title: The Saint
reviews.body: Great place!!  Will come back!

reviews.author: Joe Q
reviews.title: High Expectations, Underwhelmed, Nothing Negative
reviews.body:
The The Saint Hotel Key West, Autograph Collection was an overall 4 out of 5 experience for us. Nothing was necessarily bad, but the stay just felt a bit underwhelming considering the price point and the expectations that come with the Marriott Autograph Collection brand.

The service was okay — not great, but not bad either. The food and beverage staff clearly worked hard and did the best they could despite seeming understaffed during our stay. Housekeeping, however, was excellent, and the cleaning staff kept the rooms very clean throughout the visit.

The biggest downside was probably the room design. While clean and well maintained, the layout and overall functionality felt poorly thought out and awkward compared to other hotels in this category.

The location is definitely one of the hotel’s strongest features. Being close to everything in Key West made getting around easy and enjoyable.

Overall, the stay was just kind of “blah” — difficult to point to any major negatives, but also nothing that really stood out or justified the premium pricing. For a similar price, we would personally choose Marriott’s Key West-La Concha next door, next time for a much better overall experience. We moved to the La Concha to finish our trip. 

Lots of Marriott BonVoy services, apps, and experiences are not served at this property.

reviews.author: Repeat visitor to KW
reviews.title: Nice location on Key West
reviews.body: Amenities were average.   Nothing spectacular about the property.   Compared to other nearby hotels and guest houses, this property was way overpriced in my opinion.

reviews.author: Kpg59
reviews.title: Do not get a room under the Rooftop Bar..
reviews.body: Place is great, but the location of my room (216) underneath part of the rooftop bar was not...  sounded like furniture being dragged across the floor and live music with base vibrations started at 8pm and went for hours.. I ended up putting on noise cancelling headphones to get to sleep..  Everything else was fine..  Too much noise for $300 plus per Tuesday night..

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.title: Our Stay in Kerry West
reviews.body: Excellent location right in the center of the action.

reviews.author: Cap215
reviews.title: Very Cool Vibe!
reviews.body: We really enjoyed our stay at The Saint Hotel. Overall the staff were super friendly. We were able to check in earlier than expected and we were greeted with a glass a champagne! All of these details added to to one great experience as far as hospitality goes. The hotel itself is super clean. They have a hotel bar on premises that was a huge plus. But above all, the decor with cool red uplighting in the bar and funky blue in our hallway and room gave it a very cool modern vibe. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Vince G
reviews.title: Nice place, dull staff
reviews.body: Nice room with great toiletries. Great location off Duval St.  Nice rooftop bar, though don’t order the Crispy Brussel sprouts appetizer (horrible!!!). Nice pool area; just be prepared for loud talking guests. Turndown service is laughable. Came back to room Monday at 3:40pm after sightseeing to find the room not yet serviced. Requested ironing board on Tuesday for delivery by Wed am; nothing. HVAC directed freezing cold air directly onto bed. Nice hotel overall; little personality/warmth by staff though (except for Neo, the server in the restaurant). The best thing was the amount of Bonvoy points received.

reviews.author: Platinum Travel Blogger
reviews.title: Poor showing for the Autograph Collection
reviews.body: I have stayed at many Autograph properties. This one was truly not up to standard. The tubs were filthy and this is one of the few times a bath would not be an option at an Autograph property. If you have the option to stay elsewhere then even as a loyal Marriott member I would recommend finding alternatives.

reviews.author: Catherine
reviews.title: Key West must-stay
reviews.body:
You can’t visit Key West and stay anywhere else. The location is unbeatable, but it’s the property itself and the people who make it truly exceptional. The team consistently goes above and beyond, creating such a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The hotel has a one-of-a-kind charm, and you genuinely feel immersed in the heart of all the energy, from the lively lobby bar and restaurant to the rooftop with live music every night.

A special thank you to the incredible front desk team, including Latoya and Neo, as well as managers Abraham and Luiza, for making the experience so memorable. If you want to fully experience Key West, The Saint Hotel Key West is the only place to stay!!!

reviews.author: CathyM64
reviews.title: A slice of paradise
reviews.body: The Saint is a lovely boutique hotel in the middle of Key West walkable to so many attractions. The staff are amazing and the food was exceptional.

reviews.author: Bruce Wayne
reviews.title: Anniversary Weekend
reviews.body: The Saint Hotel is an amazing and unique property with an amazing staff and great location.  We will be back!

reviews.author: Mel N
reviews.title: First Time Visit
reviews.body: The state is a beautiful little boutique hotel. Great location off of Duvall Street. The staff is excellent and very helpful. The Sunday brunch was amazing, and the cocktails accompanied were the perfect addition to our meal!  Rooms are tad bit small but overall great experience!!

reviews.author: Brian J
reviews.title: Great Property and People
reviews.body:
We have stayed at The Saint twice in the pst year.  Both stays exceeded expectations.
Amazing location, really cool funky property, excellent service. Beautiful pool, amazing and well executed menu. Generous happy hour(s)  Live music upstairs at night. What's not to love?

reviews.author: DJEWestChester
reviews.title: Adult Only Hideaway in Key West
reviews.body: This boutique hotel is close to everything but hidden off the main streets. The pool is always quiet and the service is excellent. Just make sure you like live music, as the singer-songwriters at the rooftop bar will have you tapping your toes each night.

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.title: Front desk lacking
reviews.body: Hotel had a lot to be desired

reviews.author: Heap
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.body: The property is exquisite and the food is phenomenal.  The bartenders could use an attitude check. The worst thing is the rooftop bar which allows the general public to wander about the property stumbling drunk to search for the bathroom which is 3 floors down and across the entire property. Really puts a damper on paying the $1,000/night - as we expected a bit more exclusivity for that rate.

reviews.author: Chip and Dawn
reviews.title: The Best of Key West!
reviews.body: We had a magical stay!  Great food and wonderful staff!

reviews.author: Moniepeni
reviews.title: Not worth the hype or price
reviews.body: From our so so check in, to the aging room, this hotel is not worth it . I’ve stayed at many places in the Keys and have had better experiences at the Courtyard .

reviews.author: Minnesota Guest
reviews.title: Not worth the cost
reviews.body: Small rooms, not enough hanging spots for damp clothes, loud, uncomfortable beds, floors not clean.

reviews.author: 2026rg
reviews.title: Good hotel
reviews.body: A lovely quiet hotel with friendly staff. Clean and spacious rooms. A large pleasant swimming pool.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Excellent stay; quality and friendliness.
reviews.body: Excellent accommodation—super comfortable and clean, with spacious, well-equipped rooms. The friendliness of the entire staff makes you feel at ease; the food is delicious, the pool bar is fantastic, and the free shuttle service to Old Town is incredible. Everything was perfect for a stay in Key West.

reviews.author: Jp
reviews.title: Business
reviews.body: Excellent overall,  staff very friendly,  property very beautiful

reviews.author: CTCT4
reviews.title: Nice Stay
reviews.body: Very spacious and clean room.  We were only there as a quick place to stay before leaving early morning.  They require a destination fee of $24.95 plus tax, which I feel is a ripoff.  Yes, it includes shuttle service, etc, all of which we would not use.  If anything, make the rate $25 higher and include these things so we see one price.  Less painful perception.

reviews.author: Fanely Maurette
reviews.title: Excellent remodeled hotel to stay
reviews.body: This hotel was beautifully remodeled. Rooms are clean and quiet. Hot breakfast and well attended. Totally recommended!

reviews.author: Danny
reviews.title: Bed bugs in room 164
reviews.body: There was bed bug in our room, my whole family got bitten, complain email was sent to the Guest Service Agent of Fairfield Inn and Suites by Marriott Key West Florida, but no response.

reviews.author: Anita
reviews.title: No complaints at all—would definitely stay again!
reviews.body: We had a great experience at this hotel! The rooms were clean and comfortable, and the pool was great. The drinks were also very good. The front desk staff were extremely patient, friendly, and helpful. We traveled with our two kids, ages 18 and 14, and my husband, and we all had a wonderful stay. We really enjoyed our time here and have no complaints. We would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: MBG
reviews.title: Clean rooms, nice property, friendly staff, abundant breakfast
reviews.body: We stay here routinely and find it to be predictably clean with large comfy rooms, great breakfast options with a wide variety and pleasant staff, big cold pool, parking, bikes, easy access to all kinds of stuff and free shuttle into town.

reviews.author: H And G Fun
reviews.title: Key West Fun
reviews.body:
Great place to stay!!!!  Great staff!
Great rooms!

reviews.author: My weekend escape
reviews.title: Great getaway
reviews.body: It’s been a while since I took a break the atmosphere was very relaxed

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.body:
From checkin until checkout everything was great. 
Friendly polite reception staff. 
Extremely clean room. Great shower. 
Lovely breakfast with lots of choice. Lovely pool area. 
Shuffle service was a great bonus.

reviews.author: Sant1972
reviews.title: Great place to recharge
reviews.body: Away from the buzz, but great to recharge for next day. Breakfast basics not there,  ham, cheese, fried eggs, but enough to keep you going through the day. Pool nice to relax.

reviews.author: German V
reviews.title: Weekday getaway
reviews.body: Rooms needs updating,  air conditioner not working properly. Low quality breakfast selection

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: An amazing Hotel
reviews.body:
I would
Like to express my deepest gratitude to front desk Onela who is marvelous; Luciano and Kelly !!! You guys ROCK !!

reviews.author: Mctowgirl
reviews.title: Great Stay in the Keys
reviews.body: This was a bucket list trip! We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Great staff, clean and well maintained property, prompt service from all the staff, safe place to park cars or motorcycles. The shuttle service to downtown was nice and always easy to access. Breakfast was great everyday, busy but well taken care of. Wonderful visit!

reviews.author: Fredzski
reviews.title: Good stay, confused about additional fees.
reviews.body: Best perk was having free transportation to the downtown busy area of Key West. Room was supposed to have a king size bed but from the look of the bed it was only a queen. Bathrooms were a good size and the staff kept the room clean and neat/organized during the room turnover.

reviews.author: Dago
reviews.title: Dago
reviews.body: I arrived at the hotel with my family on the wrong reservation date. The staff went above and beyond to help change the reservation without any penalties. The room was spacious, spotless, and had remarkably comfortable beds. The hotel's convenient location near major landmarks and the excellent breakfast buffet made our stay truly enjoyable. We had an amazing time from check-in to check-out. Special thanks to the front desk team for making us feel so welcome. The food was fresh, the property was well-maintained, and the overall service exceeded our expectations.

reviews.author: Andrew R
reviews.title: Lovely old school Caribbean vibe
reviews.body: The room was lovely and clean with a powerful shower and great view of the pool area. Staff were polite, friendly and very helpful. The pool was clean and not too deep for the children, and the towels were fresh. Breakfast was adequate but lacks a restaurant and bar. Free parking was also a bonus.
