Overall very happy with our single night stay in Key West.

reviews.author: Bhagwan Wadhwani
reviews.title: Bhagwan
reviews.body: Hotel fairly good ac was makin sound because it was old style

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.body: I recently stayed here with my granddaughter (13) when we were in Key West for a few days.  It was conveniently located just over the last bridge away and they provided a shuttle service to and from the downtown area.  Free beverage each day of our stay and free laundry facility which was convenient.  Pool was clean and refreshing and breakfast was good as well.  Great accommodations at an affordable price!

reviews.author: Cgdkelly
reviews.title: Totally pleased and satisfied
reviews.body: We have come back again. We were totally pleased before and we are again. We stay numerous days. And we will be back again. The hotel and grounds are very clean and well maintained. The staff throughout are very nice and helpful. The front desk and housekeeping took very good care of us. The breakfast buffet is excellent and we looked forward to it each morning. We highly recommend this hotel! 😁

reviews.author: Dissappointed Guest
reviews.title: Multiple Room Issues and Poor Customer Service
reviews.body:
Booked two rooms, both with significant issues. One smelled strongly of marijuana and had dirty linens. The other had a bathtub that repeatedly backed up to ankle level while showering and initially had no hot water. Although the sink was fixed, the bathtub problem was worse the second night.

Breakfast was disappointing, with limited vegetarian/vegan options and eggs that appeared undercooked. The lobby had a constant fishy odor and overflowing garbage receptacles. Staff were not particularly friendly or responsive to our concerns.

Overall, the cleanliness, maintenance, breakfast, and customer service were well below expectations. Unfortunately, I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: no
reviews.title: Recommendation
reviews.body: I recommend this location.

reviews.author: Jean
reviews.title: Decent Stay, but Below Fairfield Expectations
reviews.body:
My stay at Fairfield by Marriott Inn & Suites Key West at The Keys Collection was decent overall, but it didn't meet the standard I typically expect from the Fairfield brand. The property had more of a dated, motel-like feel than I anticipated.

The room had several maintenance and cleanliness issues. The entry door didn't automatically close and lock unless I pulled it shut, the bathroom had visible rust, the towels looked worn and were no longer bright white, and the lighting was insufficient. Although it was the middle of summer and extremely hot outside, the air conditioning couldn't be set below 72 degrees, making it difficult to keep the room comfortably cool.

That said, the hotel offered several amenities that made the stay more enjoyable. The complimentary breakfast was a nice perk, and I especially appreciated the free EV charging stations. It would be helpful if the hotel added signs reminding non-electric vehicles not to park in the designated charging spaces so EV guests can easily access the chargers.

We also enjoyed the pool, which was a great way to cool off after spending time in the heat. The pool bar was excellent, and having a DJ one evening created a fun, lively atmosphere. Another standout amenity was the complimentary shuttle to Old Key West. We used it frequently, and it saved us the hassle and expense of paying for parking, which can be quite costly in Key West.

Most of the staff members were pleasant and courteous throughout our stay, which contributed to a positive experience. Overall, the hotel offers several great amenities and friendly service, but the condition of the room and the lack of attention to maintenance prevented it from meeting my expectations for a Fairfield property.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.body: Nothing special for a Marriott hotel resort expected more received a motel .

reviews.author: Kenny M
reviews.title: 3-Day Key West Birthday Celebration
reviews.body: We had such a fantastic three-day adventure in Key West to celebrate my birthday, staying at the lovely Fairfield Inn by Marriott. The hotel offered a tasty breakfast with eggs, waffles, cereal, sausage, toast, oatmeal, and more, making our mornings feel extra special. Each day, we enjoyed a complimentary drink, which was such a nice touch. Our room was absolutely charming, with super comfy beds, and I was really impressed that even the floors were perfectly spotless—no need to wipe my feet after walking around, which made everything so much easier. Although some people mentioned the roosters in the mornings, it wasn't a problem for us; I only heard one, and it was barely noticeable. Luciano kindly sent a thoughtful message to check how our stay was going and if we needed anything. The staff was incredibly warm and friendly throughout our visit. Overall, I wholeheartedly recommend this hotel and would be happy to stay here again!

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.body: Sheets were dirty- full of hair. Guests and employees are loud. Pool was dirty/cloudy. Shower had hair- eww. The shuttle only takes you to ONE place- drop off and pick up so you have to uber everywhere else. There are no resort fees and yet they charge 25 a day destination fee. If you don’t like animal noises well…the chickens and roosters do their thing bright and early. Breakfast was same as you get at any continental breakfast.   Don’t worry each room is stocked with ear plugs which should have been my first indication that it was going to be loud. Drug deals going on behind the hotel where guests park so it did not feel very safe.

reviews.author: Johnnie B
reviews.title: Nice and relaxing place. Excellent Services
reviews.body: I travel a lot to EYW for business purpose, and this hotel both location and service are 1A.

reviews.author: Lisa Galella
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay with family.
reviews.body: Had a great time. We got wristbands and went to The Blue Famingo . Great to entertain the kids while adults sat back with food and beverages from the bar.

reviews.author: Tracey
reviews.title: AMAZING i wish I would’ve stayed another night!
reviews.body: Amazing food at breakfast and a very comfortable stay! Very clean- i thought it was a little pricey- I had points on my travel credit card that covered the room for the night. I would have loved to do another night but paying over $200 was not in my budget for just a bed for me to sleep in. It would be nice to have Lower prices for the average middle class income or the people just going there to sleep, not hangout there all day. I understand Key West is a popular tourist destination and it’s not cheap. In my opinion pricing can be better for a regular room and solo traveler. But everything else was 10/10. I was very happy with my stay

reviews.author: StephenB
reviews.title: Perfect vacation hotel to chill in the Keys!
reviews.body: I was really unsure if this would be a good vacation spot but it turned out to be perfect. The hotel and grounds are beautiful, two pools and wonderful amenities. Worth the cost and associated resort fee.

reviews.author: Isla
reviews.title: Horrible check your bill days later
reviews.body: Check your credit card statement a few days later

reviews.author: Sedaves
reviews.title: Great location and very nice resort
reviews.body: Great amenities, 2 pools, fitness center, restaurants.  Nice central location halfway between Islamorada and Key West making it easy to visit a lot of places.  Large rooms with balconies and plenty of parking on site.

reviews.author: THD123
reviews.title: Marathon property never dissapoints
reviews.body:
I've been to this property many times over the years, including around its grand opening. It never dissapoints. I love the location in the middle keys near 7 mile bridge in the sound side. The sunsets can be breathtaking. It is part of the Faro Blanco property. The front desk staff are always welcoming. Most of the rooms feature balconies or decks and many have water views. The property features 2 pools and a hot tub and other amenities. It seems they've added more cabanas for rent, which I don't love, as guest chairs fill up. The pool near the sound has a nice outdoor bar. The cocktail list changes sometimes but the service generally varies from good to fabulous - this year it was good. I didn't eat the food this time as there are so many better nearby options but it is usually passable at the pool bar and standard courtyard overpriced breakfast in the lobby. 

I've seen reviews that complain about the wear and tear on the property, but the reality is it is challenging to maintain any ocean property. I think the hotel and grounds have held up well, and the cleaning staff inside do a great job (and are friendly). I do wish the grounds / pool staff would be more proactive about cleaning up the iguana poop, especially when it is precariously close to pool or hot tub. 

I took a yoga class this time and really enjoyed it! It was free for guests. As there was lightning nearby, we moved it from the "beach" (think typical Keys beach not east coast sandy endless beach) to a sheltered area but the class was great. I also like that if you reserve a private boat tour, there is a dock at the hotel where they can pick you up.  

I really enjoyed this property for an easy getaway in the quiet area between Miami and Key West. Parking is $20/day. (Just don't speed in the Keys as police are aggressive.) The hotel is fine for low maintenance couples and very family friendly. I look forward to my next visit.

reviews.author: Vicki
reviews.title: Great Sunset Views from Infinity Pool
reviews.body: We really enjoyed our stay especially the infinity pool with Tiki bar. The drinks were really great and the service was fantastic. Loved the walkout area to the ocean with fabulous sunset views.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.body: We stayed 5 nights the experience was great.  The location is easy and convenient.  The pool is 24/7 and the views are good.  They offer several different activities and also chairs and cooler for the beach.  Everything was nice.

reviews.author: Melissa and Wandy
reviews.title: The experience was amazing
reviews.body: The hotel, the service, the staff, the food , everything was excellent . I will recommended

reviews.author: key452
reviews.title: Favorite place!
reviews.body: The Faro Blanco resort is amazing and I never want to leave! It’s a true resort feel with amenities and service to match. Not only is the pricing fair, but the resort is up to standards. The food is great, the pools are lovely, the entire resort layout is nice. You can even use the Nextdoor resorts amenities, and their food is also great. Nearby the resort there are plenty of fun things to do. But just relaxing at the pool is good too. The room is always very clean, and daily housekeeping keeps it pristine. The front desk staff are kind and helpful. This place has everything you need for an amazing getaway.

reviews.author: Kimberly
reviews.title: Great location and views
reviews.body: Loved our stay. The bartender was not what I would expect. He lacked any personality and was rude. The female, Patricia and the other female at night were great. Watch your resort credit is applied. We did have an issue with that

reviews.author: Joanna
reviews.title: A slice of paradise
reviews.body: The only place we’ll come back to time and time again. Beautiful property. Cabanas have been added to the main pool. Food and drinks are great. Service is exemplary. Shoutout to Delwin and Elissa for their excellent service and hospitality. Rooms were clean. Movie night every night.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Relaxing Stay
reviews.body: Staff was great. Room was roomy and very comfortable

reviews.author: DeeH
reviews.title: Great family spot!
reviews.body: We loved this hotel.  My daughters and I visited in August.  We loved the well maintained, beautiful property.  The pools were great, and the bar at the infinity pool was awesome.  We took advantage of the restaurants on site as well as the resort fee which entitled us to rent beach chairs, umbrellas and a cooler.  The staff were lovely and helpful.  Highly recommend and would return again.

reviews.author: Vicki N
reviews.title: Just perfect!
reviews.body:
Amazing location
Amazing facilities
Amazing staff
Wonderful food 
Wonderful sunsets and sunrises.
Just perfect and hope to revisit sometime.

reviews.author: Mike K
reviews.title: Amazing hotel!
reviews.body: My family and I had an amazing time at this hotel. The staff and atmosphere was awesome.  Everything was clean and well kept and the views of the ocean were stunning. We are looking forward to staying here again!

reviews.author: Chef11
reviews.title: Check your statement well.
reviews.body: We had a $140 charge for food on our bill that someone had charged to our room. We only had a $15 drink and so it was an error for sure. Glad we caught it and could handle it in person.

reviews.author: Island Diver
reviews.title: It’s got it all
reviews.body: From walking into the lobby for the first time to checking out, our stay at Faro Blanco was incredible! The property is clean, updated and rooms offer a lot of space. We loved having the patio as well. The views from the infinity pool and beach area to watch the sunset were spectacular! It’s centrally located and you can even walk to the Turtle Hospital (highly recommend!) beds are comfortable and food is good. We loved being able to get bikes to explore and ride down the 7 mile bridge. We would definitely come back. Staff was friendly and helpful too.

reviews.author: Kris20
reviews.title: Needs Maintenance
reviews.body: My room was very spacious and clean but the resort needs maintenance and upkeep. Furniture in the common areas pealing, third floor AC Brocken or not on at all. Room  air conditioner temperature is definitely controlled because it was warm. Pool tiles broken, pool needs a good scrub down and re grouted as between the tiles it was moldy and dirty. Pavers lifting up. More staff for outdoor area. One person can not attend the bar and outdoor restaurant. Despite the wait she was very nice. However, no clean towels outside. Did not see any watersports. Overall expensive for quality of resort.

reviews.author: Dr Weaver
reviews.title: Truly Disapppinted
reviews.body: We will not return or recommend. Room was ready at 5:50, checkin is at 4pm. HOT hallways. Room had no working frig, cheap old furniture, dirty walls, old carpet, and a clogged tub. The a/c in the room was LOUD and cycled on/off in strange patters. HIGHLY disappointed.

reviews.author: Matthew
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Amazing staff, great location with Amazing veiw.

reviews.author: Frequent traveler
reviews.title: Weekday stay
reviews.body: Nice but didn't have all the amenities they said they have.. like the welcome drink.  They said they replaced it with the water at the door. And it's a laundry was free, and it cost money to wash and dry also, had to call three times for them to fill up the towels outside for the pool

reviews.author: EH
reviews.title: Quiet, Clean, Affordable
reviews.body: The hotel was relatively quiet we didn't hear any noise from other guests rooms at all during out stay. Property, common areas, and rooms were all clean and neat. Price was reflective of the area. Had to drive an hour to get into Key West but the cost was much more affordable and the drive to and from was beautiful. Only downside is that even though there are 2 pools they aren't "large" and when people start brining in floats for kids the pools get smaller. The showers are great though! Very good water pressure! Wish the restaurant/bar was open later than 9p.m.

reviews.author: FarroBlancoreviewer
reviews.title: Too many fees- choose a different Marriott
reviews.body: While the hotel was decent and just like most other courtyards, it was not a resort by any means. Do not eat at the restaurant- the food was horrible and overpriced.

reviews.author: BedBugsBites
reviews.title: Horrible bed bugs !!!
reviews.body:
I really wanted to love my stay at the Courtyard by Marriott Faro Blanco Resort in Marathon (Islamorada area), but unfortunately I won't be returning.

The resort itself is beautiful, but one thing I wish they would improve is the operating hours. Everything on the property and in the surrounding area seems to close very early, so there isn't much to do in the evenings.

The biggest issue, however, was my room. I woke up covered in what appear to be bed bug bites all along the left side of my body—the side I slept on. It was absolutely disgusting and completely ruined my stay. Management needs to thoroughly inspect, fumigate, and replace the bed in Room 331 if necessary so this doesn't happen to another guest.

I left extremely disappointed. A hotel can recover from minor inconveniences, but cleanliness and guest safety should never be compromised. Unfortunately, because of this experience, I will never return.

reviews.author: SVBonvoyfan
reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.body: We enjoyed the stay.  Rooms were clean and well kept.  Room service staff was very good. Front desk was helpful.  The atmosphere is a good. The pool was great in the early morning but would get crowded by afternoon.

reviews.author: Lazaro O
reviews.title: Stay at Marathon
reviews.body: We have stayed here in the past, yet our family was very impressed by the upgrades in the hotel.  Our room was very spacious and clean. Everything we ordered from the restaurant was delicious!  Staff made you feel welcomed... Not to mention the new additions and breathtaking views outdoors.  We are already planning and anticipating our next visit!

reviews.author: Salty
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body: Our room, while spacious, was in disrepair. The pools were extremely overcrowded and water was hot. Pool towels were scarce and not available for most of our time there. None of the doors were locked, allowing anyone, guests or not, to flow in and out of every space (pools included).  Outside staff, especially bartenders, were un attending and bothered. Bar food choices were not great. We watched many people who were visiting or fishing park in the parking lot we paid a daily fee for. Super disappointed we chose this hotel.

reviews.author: Gpete324
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body:
The negative. Room need updating. Old carpet buckling. Leaking shower/tub shower curtain 2 inches above top of tub. . Tiolet looks like it belongs in a kindergarten school. TV is small. No complementary water bottles. Blackout curtains are dried and cracking holes sunlight coming thru.  Door doesn't automatically close. Have to slam it shut.  
The Positive.  The grounds and pool are well kept. The poolside restaurant and bar were nice and good. The room was clean. And the beds were comfortable. Would not stay there for that kind of money $350.00 a night until updates were made.

reviews.author: Jf02
reviews.title: Fantastic place to vacation!!
reviews.body: Everything at the faro blanco Marriott was great. Francisco at the pool bar stood out the most, made us feel like family. Housekeeping was excellent. Just all around outstanding vacation been there before and will return again soon.

reviews.author: Dena K
reviews.title: Gorgeous property and so much to do!
reviews.body: This hotel is truly a gem! The property was gorgeous and my group of 7 on a girls trip had a lovely stay. We really enjoyed the yoga by the water in the morning and we also took the complimentary bikes out for a spin along the bridge before heading next door to the turtle hospital. We could have stayed forever in the eternity pool or the chairs along the water. The rooms were nice and large and had a great ocean view. Overall a really lovely place that I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: MC
reviews.title: Tropical oasis
reviews.body:
We love staying at the courtyard by Marriott Faro Blanco Resort.
It is a beautiful location and every staff member is so friendly. They truly make your stay special.

reviews.author: Karen G
reviews.title: A little slice of paradise in paradise
reviews.body: The hotel was perfect for our weekend getaway. Well located in Marathon. The pool area was tropically landscaped, the room was clean with comfortable bedding and a great air conditioner to escape the south Florida heat

reviews.author: Ed Z
reviews.title: Great place to unwind
reviews.body: Nice large rooms and view of the bay

reviews.author: Michelle Wells
reviews.title: A wonderful experience!
reviews.body: Wonderful stay with excellent service. My husband and I enjoyed our quick getaway.

reviews.author: Charlie
reviews.title: Great stay for the price
reviews.body: I really liked the room and the balcony. However, there was a ticking noise that drove my husband and I nuts. Also, the ceiling is peeling- not sure if there's water damage there. My child loved the sofa bed, but honestly that mattress has seen better days.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Bitten by bed bugs and poor staff communication
reviews.body: Will not return after being bit by bed bugs and not being informed about the water being turned off after checking in.

reviews.author: Travelguide
reviews.title: Stinky rooms and AC do not work
reviews.body:
Check in process of painful, we have reached bit late around 11.45 PM and no one at the counter to open the doors, as doors are
Locked as it late night. No one  responding to door bell. 
Charges 20$ for the parking I felt its bit costly.
Room was stinking and AC not working and only Fan was running. My kids sweating all the night. And do not have patience go go out at the mid of the night and report about the issues. 
Breakfast is fresh and good. But the space where they keep its tiny, it will be crowded if couple of ppl standing to toast the bagels and for waffles.
This is not as per the marriot standards. I will not come here again.

reviews.author: ERIK C
reviews.title: OUR VERY FAVORITE HOTEL!
reviews.body: GREAT HOTEL!  GREAT LOCATIONGREAT STAFF!  GREAT FOOD! GREAT EVERYTHING!  WE LOVE THIS HOTEL!  WE CAN'T WAIT TO COME BACK TO STAY FOR ANOTHER WEEK AS SOON AS POSSIBLE!

reviews.author: Just average
reviews.title: Just average
reviews.body: Not real clean. Very pricey.

reviews.author: Marathon fisherwomen
reviews.title: Nice stay in marathon
reviews.body: Very clean and comfortable rooms!!!

reviews.author: Hyatt 1
reviews.title: AWESOME HOTEL AND SERVICE
reviews.body: Would recommend this Hotel to everyone.  The experience and customer service are beyond great.

reviews.author: Florida girl
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: We stayed overnight.  The location was great.   The restaurant out back friendly with good food and great water views.  The pool though a bit shallow was pleasant with great views with plentiful seating around it. The room was clean.  Beds comfy.  And overall staff was friendly and helpful.  We will return on our next Florida key getaway.

reviews.title: Amazing resort like hotel.
reviews.body: I had a wonderful time here. Very clean and the housekeeping was on schedule. Breakfast was nice and I love the views walking around the grounds.

reviews.author: Mike R
reviews.title: Keys vacation
reviews.body: My daughter and I enjoyed staying here, engaging with the staff and taking advantage of the complementary breakfast each day. The proximity to every thing we had on our itinerary was nice too. Will definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Guy Dotan Zilberberg
reviews.title: Unfortunately, will not stay there again
reviews.body: The pool was nice beside that. It’s a good location one hour away from Key West. The food quality was terrible and they didn’t had gluten-free food in the morning, and the breakfast is very poor

reviews.author: Rubens
reviews.title: Amenities
reviews.body: Top amenities. Breakfast included.

reviews.author: Unhappy
reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.body: Prior to our arrival the hot water heater went down in our unit. The front desk failed to mention that there was no Hot water. After our adventure in Hot FL full of sand and sea water I could not enjoy a nice Hot water shower. I confronted the front desk and was told sorry the water heater part will not arrive for 2 more days.  There was no compensation, no remorse, just deal with it.  They even admitted to being aware of the issue before our arrive and choose to do nothing about it. Poor customer service

reviews.author: Jen M
reviews.title: Perfect vacation at the Fairfield in Marathon, Florida Keys
reviews.body: My husband, sister-in-law and I stayed at the Fairfield in Marathon, FL. It was like staying at a resort, with free breakfast, clean pools, on-site restaurant, rentals (kayaks, etc.) and close to local attractions. The people were pleasant and knowledgable about the area. Centrally located in the Keys, it was easy to get to Key West to visit more attractions.

reviews.author: JP
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: Great staff and facilities were well maintained. Not a fan of pay to park.

reviews.author: JH
reviews.title: Great hotel in Marathon key
reviews.body: The Fairfield Inn on Marathon key is a great hotel. It is easily accessible with plenty of parking. Check-in was simple and pricing was fair. The room was clean and spacious. Breakfast was free in the morning and there is an on-site restaurant which is excellent. I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Florida Native
reviews.title: Great Location and Property!! Bring your own pillows
reviews.body: Overall great stay with family friendly accommodations. Only drawback was the beds were very low to the ground and not super comfortable. Also, the pillows were terrible.

reviews.author: Couples retreat
reviews.title: Couples vacation
reviews.body:
Nice time being there
 Pretty friendly staff

reviews.author: Jersey Girl EP
reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.body: This hotel is beautiful and perfect spot for the keys. Just an hour drive to Key West. Close to Sombero beach and a State Park with a beach. On-site restaurant was delicious. The suite we stayed in was away from the hotel and was private. Perfect view of the bay with its own pool. Very relaxing. I’m not a breakfast person but it’s your usual free breakfast.

reviews.author: Yes
reviews.title: Keys trip
reviews.body: Had a nice stay, enjoyed the room, comfortable bed, always enjoy the walk in shower.

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.body: Beautiful, clean room, friendly staff.

reviews.author: Abraham
reviews.title: World Cup Vacation
reviews.body: We went over to Miami for the World Cup, had a few days in between and decided to hit up the keys. With our young, children, we always have to look for specific hotels. And this one definitely went above beyond. Only bad side was, we wish we had more time.

reviews.author: Consuelo
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.body: Breakfast could have longer hours, more options and variety and parking should be free like before

reviews.author: Just me
reviews.title: Nice place to stay in Marathon for sure
reviews.body: Hotel is excellent! Pool deck needs improvement you can't walk on it in a sunny day.

reviews.author: Jose
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Everything you want and need is located here. Perfect place to stay.  Book it.

reviews.author: The H Family
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: My family stayed one night on our way down to Key West. Wish we would have stayed here the whole time on our trip to the keys.

reviews.author: CJ
reviews.title: It could have been perfect, it was ok
reviews.body: The first night the a/c wasn’t working, the team that night did everything they could to help, they accommodated with a strong fan that made the night bearable, in fairness, the next day they installed a new a/c very quickly and the rest of the stay was excellent. I thank the team over the weekend (4th of July) very very much. They did great.

reviews.author: Williams
reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.body: They made my wedding awesome! Heather is amazing!!

reviews.author: Grimm
reviews.title: Warm and Welcoming
reviews.body: Staff was incredible. Welcoming and attentive to every need. Went out of way to ensure we had everything we needed. Will stay again for both business and pleasure.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.title: Disappointed with price and room
reviews.body:
I booked through the Bonvoy app and found that it would have been almost a third of the price if I had booked other ways.  

They do not have in room coffee, you are supposed to get a complimentary coffee as a Bonvoy member but only if you go to a specific place to order it at specific times of the day that did not fit my travel schedule.

They have a giant valet cost despite not even having electric chargers for their guests.

The room itself had a terrible layout, you could not see the TV from the bed.  The curtains were sheer and opened to the outside and since I was on the second floor corner I didn’t feel like I could even change in the room without flashing the surrounding area.  A neighboring business played loud music all day and night that could be heard from the room at all hours.

Overall a very high amenities fee for zero amenities, no in room coffee, lack of privacy.

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.title: Very close to excellent
reviews.body: The location is in a nice downtown spot that is very walkable and close to restaurants and coffee shops. First impression of the hotel is how lovely the granite and wooden doors look coupled with the trendy yet timeless furniture.  Unfortunately our room smelled musty and was very humid from the second we stepped into it. The food and service we had at the hotel restaurant Sal Rosa was great.

reviews.author: Wilson
reviews.title: It's Mimosa Time!
reviews.body: We loved the experience at this hotel. Pleased with the staff and their willingness to assist us with all of our needs. I would definitely stay here again and recommend to others.

reviews.author: R Goings
reviews.title: leMerdian
reviews.body: Overall excellent experience. Only issue: parking at the hotel is expensive when you add in the rental rate. I used Uber instead.

reviews.author: KHALIF 144
reviews.title: Surprised
reviews.body: Excellent service knowledgeable staff that goes the extra mile

reviews.author: Will
reviews.title: Best value for money amongst the downtown Tampa hotels.
reviews.body: There are several hotel options to choose in downtown Tampa. This one is by far the best value for money and the best overall staff..

reviews.author: Ron A
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.body: Wonderful place to stay. Great service and wonderful  hospitality

reviews.author: Sigma 61st Boucle stay
reviews.title: A Great Stay
reviews.body: Excellent service I would love  to stay again.

reviews.author: Sabrina
reviews.title: Great hotel; be mindful of valet fee
reviews.body: The hotel was very nice.  The history was a great story.  At checkin our associate was amazing.  Be mindful of the valet fee.  We were told at checkin the fee was $40.  My bill stated $45.  Upon checkout when I explained this, the feedback was “the fee is listed on website “.   The courtyard around the corner which is a Marriott hotel is $40.  There is no reason to charge more.  The room was nice size. We were a bit challenged with a humming noise coming from the fridge.  Other than this, the property was nice.

reviews.author: Business Tripper
reviews.title: Overpriced and underdelivers
reviews.body: Historically this hotel is a neat feature as a renovated court house.  Room was clean and comfortable.  No coffee pot in the room and no coffee in the lobby.  Valet only parking was overpriced for the area.  Convenient to downtown if that is where your travel focus is.  Great cell service and wifi .  Marble floors made the hallways noisy when you were in the room.  You heard everyone walking by, talking, etc.  I travel with a noise maker to help me sleep and that worked well.  A/C was incredible!!

reviews.author: Andrea Helfrich
reviews.title: Marriott elite members treated very well
reviews.body: An amazing property for a Marriott elite member. No request was too big and everything was handled quickly efficiently.

reviews.author: Macks850
reviews.title: Top tier location
reviews.body: The staff was extremely helpful very pleasant interact with the hotel was immaculate. The location was great.

reviews.author: Liggumz
reviews.title: Such a neat, historic hotel
reviews.body: We loved the design, from the beautiful stone hallway floors, to the HEAVY wood doors and the repurposed witness stand in the restaurant. The staff were friendly and on their game all the time! The surrounding area is nice, safe and walkable.

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.title: Le MERIDIEN is  l'excellence
reviews.body: This charming restored 1900s federal courthouse has all the modern charm and amenities to make your downtown Tampa stay excellent no matter the occasion.  I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Couple city escape
reviews.title: Excellent couple city escape retreat
reviews.body: Did the city life escape with culture and history that gave us 10k+ steps a day walking. Being handed a Mimosas upon checking and and having tickets to the museum of arts was spectacular. We walked to 6 different restaurants and bars and took ride-share to Ybor one night. It was a weekend to remember.

reviews.author: Kettly L
reviews.title: Bad time at the meridian court house hoyel
reviews.body: For such a high ends place it was the worst hotel experience in our life.THe bed are sinking but ordinary room not even a cup of coffee was available upon arriving just water but they have a big vending machine area ,the breakfast in the café is absolutely inedible and the eggs tasted like powder and I throw up from the smell.

reviews.author: Kirkman class of 81
reviews.title: My stay at the Marriott in Tampa
reviews.body: A+ this is a must stay two blocks from the Riverwalk

reviews.author: DrRichard
reviews.title: The best hotel in Tampa
reviews.body: We have stayed in hotels around the world and the Meridian is in the top tier of all of them!

reviews.author: Disappointed 1
reviews.title: Too Much for too Little
reviews.body: Price is way more that the value. I have stayed in nicer places for $125. Avoid this place if you can.

reviews.author: Courthouse1967
reviews.title: A Night To Remember
reviews.body: My 1 st job out of high school was here 2 nd floor , Hillsborough County School System as a clerk , you made my Stay with the artifacts , incredible Transformation to a beautiful Hotel ! Thanks  so much !

reviews.author: PositivelyKatelynn
reviews.title: Quick anniversary staycation
reviews.body: My husband and I made a quick last minute trip to Tampa for our anniversary. We planned on going to a concert and wanted a place to stay for the evening.  I was so pleased that I decided to book a room at the Le Meridien. We were greeted with a welcome drink, a beautiful front desk associate who kindly explained everything and reminded us we had passes to the Tampa museum of art (which we used) inckuded in our stay, and coasters that she wrote the date and happy anniversary on.  Our room was beautiful, tall cielings, comfortable bed, and a great feeling.  We had breakfast at the restaurant in the morning and our server was great, she was very personable and on top of everything.  We will definitely go back when we have another staycation!!

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.title: Beware: Valet scratched my car
reviews.body: I paid for valet and received a scratched door and two $45 parking tickets.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Missing the Mark !
reviews.body:
When an Bold building steeped in American History tries to be a European boutique you get a confused design, equally confused amenities and lack of autheticity. 
Rather than magnificent it was blah. 
Identity crisis across the board. 
The fitness center was equal to a Junior high gym from the 8o's. Its 2026, people crave health and fitness especially Tampa guests. 
In fairness I build and renovate hotels, however I do so because I love great hospitality and architecture. 
Le Meridien lacked intitial thought and planning, and it shows in the culture. 
Marriott owns the Liberty Hotel Boston that type of inspiration is needed here.

reviews.author: Florida native
reviews.title: Historic charm
reviews.body: A piece of history where you can imagine what transpired there. Elegant hotel with high quality service, friendly staff and comfortable rooms. Surprisingly quiet for downtown; but very convenient to restaurants, activities and views

reviews.author: Joan
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: Staff was wonderful! Went above and beyond!

reviews.author: Steff
reviews.title: Gorgeous Hotel
reviews.body:
We had our wedding here in May 2026. 

Heather, the coordinator for the hotel was absolutely amazing and we could not have completed it without her. 

Our guest also loved the hotel for its interior and rich history. Definitely worth staying at! We will be returning to Le Méridien.

reviews.author: Hope
reviews.title: Wine Spectator
reviews.body: Excellent facility. Great staff. Loved the large table in general gathering space.

reviews.author: NOCOFFEE
reviews.title: No Coffee
reviews.body: It's a cool and well maintained building.  The beds were a bit soft for my taste.  There was only one chair in the room, and it was bar stool height.  No in room coffee maker, Motel6 can manage it, for a $400+ night  stay it doesn't seem like too much of an ask.

reviews.author: Diana Madrigal
reviews.title: Beautiful experience
reviews.body: Everyone was so welcoming. It felt like family.

reviews.author: Where to next
reviews.title: Quiet Convenience
reviews.body: Marriott Springhill Suites in Tampa doesn't disappoint.

reviews.author: J Reed
reviews.title: Zac Brown Band Concert
reviews.body: This hotel is great !!! The Lighthouse Grill food was great !!! We will be staying here again when we attend a concert at Benchmark Arena !!

reviews.author: Lisa GB
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: We booked this very last minute while traveling and don’t regret it. The hotel was in a great location. The staff was very friendly and the rooms were spacious. The pool was really nice and wasn’t busy at all. I would stay here again

reviews.author: Good
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.body: Rooms were disgusting, dirty full of mold very very unacceptable

reviews.author: Amy K Forish
reviews.title: Impeccable Service
reviews.body: Impeccable staff service from everyone I interacted with.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel in Tampa!
reviews.body: The property and everyone working there was phenomenal! They were so kind and made me feel very valued as a guest. The rooftop bar/restaurant was also my favorite! The rooms also get very cold, which I appreciate and the room was a perfect size and layout (TV placement is a little weird but I didn't even use it so not an issue at all for me) When I'm in Tampa again I will absolutely be staying here again!

reviews.author: Donna
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.body: The staff was wonderful and extremely helpful. I was not from the area, and they went out of their way to help me find different things to do. They greeted me every time I walked in.

reviews.author: CC
reviews.title: Great Stay at SpringHill Suites Tampa!
reviews.body: Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely stay here again. I highly recommend SpringHill Suites Tampa Downtown to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and welcoming place to stay in Tampa!

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: No
reviews.body: Friendly staff however room did not have ventilation.  No fan/exhaust in bathroom. Mold around ceiling. Shower door did not close completely. Tiles in corner of shower broken or sealant old and full of dirt or mold. Coffee creamer in caraf old.

reviews.author: L Jones
reviews.title: Week in Tampa
reviews.body: The hotel staff was friendly and clean, just need better food selections

reviews.author: Drea
reviews.title: Tampa Florida
reviews.body: Great Trip!! We all had a ball and enjoyed the location of the hotel.

reviews.author: D Heald
reviews.title: Downtown Fun
reviews.body: Was the best time we had while in Tampa. After all the sites and when it came down to settle in for the night. The pool experience on the roof and ease of food were a great treat as well as their snacks from the lounge. Only off putting would of been the trash near the entrance to the hotel from the garage.

reviews.author: Tara
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.body: The room was perfect.  Very spacious.  Breakfast was good. Staff was great.

reviews.author: Weekend in Tampa
reviews.title: Weekend away
reviews.body: Great weekend away with the family, great hotel. Great location. Front desk gentleman (marques) is awesome.

reviews.author: Myers
reviews.title: Great place to stay with breakfast and amazing hotel staff
reviews.body:
Great place to stay with breakfast and amazing hotel staff. 

If you stay at this hotel ask for Marques and John they were very helpful and knowledgeable about the city

reviews.author: Traveling1922
reviews.title: Friendly, Clean and Comfortable
reviews.body: Stayed 5 day for Conference and found the staff to be professional and friendly. Rooms were nicely decorated and clean. Had a nice amount of space in room to not feel cramped.  Would  recommend again.

reviews.author: Unsatisfied Guest
reviews.title: Unsatisfied Guest. I would not recommend this hotel.
reviews.body: I would not recommend this hotel; my room 708 smelled like mildew. I had my necklace taken from this room, which I had never worn. When I inquired about it, of course no one has seen it. The hotel is understaffed. I am not use to staying at a hotel where I have to ask for my room to be cleaned daily. One of the employees got in the elevator with me smelling like weed; upon me noticing the smell, she came back and sprayed air freshener in the elevator.

reviews.author: Alli Hill
reviews.title: Mother/Daughter Fun!
reviews.body: My daughter and I were going wedding dress shopping in the city so we booked an overnight and had a lovely evening, eating and relaxing by the pool then watching the sun set. We watched movies later then went to bed, had a good breakfast and worked out in the fitness center before check out. Very comfortable accommodations and we will be back!

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.body: I stayed 4 nights while in town for a sorority conference and I have to say, the hotel exceeded my expectations! I had a double queen room and there was more than enough space for the two of us. The room was cleanly (though it was a little disappointing that housekeeping only came every other day). I truly appreciated the free breakfast (that's hard to find these days). The rooftop restaurant was perfect for quick bites and drinks in between our events. The staff at the rooftop bar and front desk were all lovely. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Randall
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.body: This hotel does an excellent job across the board. The rooms were spotless, the staff was fantastic, and the rooftop pool, gym, and The Lighthouse restaurant/bar were all highlights. Highly recommend staying here!

reviews.author: Miguel
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: Location was perfect right in the middle of downtown Tampa. The hotel was updated and very clean. The staff was very ey nice and the amenities were awesome. Bar on the first floor and restaurant, gym, and pool on the roof. I will say the the food at the restaurant wasn’t worth it. So much food around I’d go ANYWHERE else next time.

reviews.author: Texas Shriner
reviews.title: Shriners International convention
reviews.body: Friendly and courteous staff. Especially Marques at front desk and Ciara at the lobby bar.

reviews.author: Last Minute Booking
reviews.title: Last Minute Booking
reviews.body: Amenities not worth the price.

reviews.author: OliviaV
reviews.title: Unavailable amenities
reviews.body: I booked this hotel for forth of July weekend for the rooftop pool and lounge area. The pool was closed the entire weekend and I was not alerted until I arrived in the lobby at 6pm. We also paid for parking as expected, but there were no parking spots and we were told to park across the street which was a $37 lot. There were also no spaces there and we were told to wait until 10pm when staff left and then we could park, we waited in the car for 45 minutes waiting for a spot at 10pm and one finally opened up.

reviews.author: Mnm
reviews.title: Pleasant hotel but No swimming for kiddos
reviews.body: The hotel was clean and felt fairly new. Wish that the rooftop pool was functioning properly. The kids were saddened that they could not swim, especially 1st time at this hotel and it being a rooftop.

reviews.author: Bummed out
reviews.title: They don't get it
reviews.body: When the feature of the hotel, the rooftop and pool area, is malfunctioning and then closed, people would like to know that WHEN THEY GO TO CHECK IN. Not after you take their money and act like nothings wrong until they find out by accident at 9pm. They were not very concerned, didn't do anything to make up for it, and pretended I was the problem and seemed relieved  I was leaving at 9pm. My sister and I were so excited go go there for the fireworks. Luckily there are hotels with better guest relations in the area and we did ok, but what a fail. I work hard and each small vacay is a big deal. I won't waste my money at this hotel. It wasn't that there was an equipment issue that allegedly couldn't be fixed, it was that we were not told when we checked in and they knew there was a problem early afternoon.

reviews.author: Leslie
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.body: The Hotel was really nice and clean and also upscale and I will plan another trip there.

reviews.author: Jess
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: Beautiful, hotel! Very clean, modern and  soothing atmosphere. The rooftop pool was amazing and you could see the entire city. We could walk to diner with many places to choose from. Walked to the riverwalk too and saw dolphins. Amazing!

reviews.author: LTaylor
reviews.title: Five Star Stay
reviews.body: Springhill Suites -Tampa was a delight.  Easy to find, friendly and personable staff; helpful with directions, too.  Clean rooms (immaculate, actually), super comfy beds, and it was quiet.  Very attractive and logical design to the room.  I would recommend to anyone to stay here, and I would certainly do so myself if I'm ever in Tampa Bay again.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Playwright82
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: My friend and I were there for a convention being held at the convention center. It was within walking distance so it was great. There were also great restaurants and cafes around to get food.

reviews.author: James Fin
reviews.title: College Drop off
reviews.body: The staff is excellent.  The building could use some maintenance.   The rates should not be adjusted due to college events.

reviews.author: Jody P
reviews.title: Always good!
reviews.body: Great staff, always willing to help with any request!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: VirginiaTraveler
reviews.title: Outstanding Accommodation
reviews.body: Very comfortable,  clean and welcoming

reviews.author: Willig
reviews.title: Best stay ever
reviews.body: I’m in a wheelchair and every member the staff make sure that I was comfortable and then make sure there was nothing that I needed the whole five days I come out my room. They check on me and I truly appreciated that. I will stay here every time I’m in the city.

reviews.author: Michael Leggs
reviews.title: My Stay
reviews.body: If I were to return to Tampa, I would not come back!

reviews.author: JR7012
reviews.title: Comfortable stay
reviews.body: Great location. Comfortable stay.

reviews.author: fabs
reviews.title: the hotel needs to be more clean and improve it looks old
reviews.body: it needs to be more updated and clean.

reviews.author: SD99very satisfied
reviews.title: Enjoyable Stay
reviews.body:
We were at Tampa for appointments at Tampa General. The staff made our stressful visit extremely easy and less stressful. 
The rooms were clean and the beds were very comfortable. Everything was very accommodating and I cannot say enough about the staff.

reviews.author: Mag03
reviews.title: One night stay
reviews.body: Stay was good.  A pity I had to get up twice been 23:00 - 02:00 to ask front desk to quiet down the noise from a party of other guest outside my window.

reviews.author: OK STAY
reviews.title: OK STAY
reviews.body: We checked in to start a vacation prior to getting on our cruise, because nothing was open we decided to leave to hotel to get dinner.

reviews.author: Frank
reviews.title: USF visit
reviews.body: Location great but hotel was run down and old. Staff was great though. Hotel needs work for sure

reviews.author: Surely Kee
reviews.title: Immaculate expectations
reviews.body: Overall I did like courtyard I enjoyed my stay. It was very cozy for the most part. I would like a clean room. That’s really it

reviews.author: Guest26
reviews.title: Comfy bed!
reviews.body: The hotel is easy to get to, valet was super nice and helped me with my bags, check in was great!

reviews.author: Wonderful Stay
reviews.title: Enjoy My Stay
reviews.body: Relaxing, downtown everything was walking distance

reviews.author: Frequent traveler
reviews.title: Not professional at all.
reviews.body: I’ve stayed at dozens of courtyards and I never had a problem, but the one downtown Tampa is terrible. The staff is very bad. They are not professional at all.

reviews.author: Mamma B
reviews.title: Great for the night before your Cruise!
reviews.body:
The location is great with many amenities within walking distance. The hotel is a bit out dated and the rooms were muggy and stuffy. The air conditioning would not cool down which made it hard to sleep…..the hallway was cooler than the room. 
Very close to the cruise ship port - so really good for one night before your cruise.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: Tampa Courtyard missed the mark
reviews.body: I usually enjoy my stays with marriott's.  I have stayed at different properties all around the US.  this one missed the mark. moldy english muffins, stale coffee, and musty smell, carpet stained room.

reviews.author: Vacationer
reviews.title: Disappointed and worse Marriott ever stayed
reviews.body: The worse Marriott I ever stayed.  It’s like Holiday Day Inn express or Motel6.  The carpet filled with dust and hairs.  AC loud and not cold.  The hotel didn’t offer extra points for going green on not replacing towels daily.  Staff doesn’t even know about the program.

reviews.author: aly21var
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.body: I always choose Marriott for my hotel needs. This was the most disappointing stay I ever had. My room. Was not clean, mildew from mini fridge leak that they were just masking. Pubic hair in my shower, sheets felt slimy and gross, stains on carpet, marks all over the walls. Sludge on sink faucets. I will never stay here again.

reviews.author: 2026 Stay
reviews.title: 2026 Stay
reviews.body: Overall my stay was decent. The first room assigned, air conditioning wasn’t cooling the room. Changed rooms and problem was fixed. Just disliked the fact I had to go downstairs the upstairs gather all belongings to then change rooms tugging everything.

reviews.author: Shelia Cook
reviews.title: Great service for Special Event
reviews.body: Excellent service, staff, and quality. Very impressed with service!  Valet was extremely attentive, the Bistro staff was amazing, and the hotel staff was so polite. Will definitely stay here on my trips to Tampa.

reviews.author: Lima 1
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.body: They don’t provide water and they didn’t change my bed sheets and also didn’t change my towels

reviews.author: Tf22
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.body: Room had some ants in it. Cabinets had water damage. Shower handle did not work well

reviews.author: Terrible conditions
reviews.title: Would not recommend
reviews.body: Place was run down and in terrible condition

reviews.author: LifetimePlatinumMember
reviews.title: Terrible Facility
reviews.body: Room wasn't clean, large tear in the bedsheet wasn't replaced after the first night stay and was given a new sheet the next evening by the front desk person to replace myself, my dog's bed at home is cleaner than the sofa bed, the dining amenity is misrepresented in the hotel description. A very pleasant woman serves what is basically a coffee shop selling Starbucks and yogurt. Not menu dining like most Courtyards

reviews.author: Beatrice
reviews.title: Beware
reviews.body: Great location but rooms need a major revamp and deep cleaning. Grime around sink and shower, carpets disgusting, stained sheets, beds don’t have headboards, no complimentary breakfast, lobby/rooms poorly lit. Would not recommend nor return.

reviews.author: Michigan Traveler
reviews.title: Central Located, Needs a Bath and Updates
reviews.body: While centrally located in Tampa, near downtown and the stadium, the hotel needs some updating. My room was ok, but the stained carpet, battered shower, and moldings show that care is overlooked.

reviews.author: A Bummed Marriott Patron
reviews.title: The location is nice - but don't expect to sleep
reviews.body: Arrived and there was a nearby event, had hoped to have a decent nights sleep but was up all night listen to constant foot traffic and noise from the street.  no consideration was given whatsoever to those who wish to actually sleep in their hotel room.  If you are there to party all night this may be a great hotel but if you are looking to rest, you may want to stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: JV53
reviews.title: Property Updating
reviews.body: Property needs a total redo

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Hiding behind the garb of renovation:
reviews.body: Do not visit, under jack hammer loud renovation, gym is non functional, air ducts are wide open. Good for employees, worst for travelers.

reviews.author: HealthcareTraveler
reviews.title: Worst Extended Stay Ever – Loud, Obnoxious, and Unsafe
reviews.body: I am incredibly disappointed with my recent 53-day extended stay at this property. I was staying here for work at the nearby hospital and desperately needed proper rest so I could safely take care of my patients.Before checking in, I specifically requested a quiet room on the pool side, away from the road. Instead, I was placed in what had to be the loudest room in the entire hotel: a ground-floor corner room situated right at a busy intersection with a red light. It sounded like a drag race outside my window all night long, making it completely impossible to sleep.To make matters worse, the property is undergoing renovations. The daytime construction noise was loud and obnoxious, offering absolutely no peace or downtime when I needed to sleep between shifts.Beyond the relentless noise, I felt a serious lack of security. There was a large presence of homeless individuals right outside the hotel doors, making it feel unsafe to leave or enter the building—especially during odd hours for hospital shifts. For a hospitality brand catering to extended-stay guests, ignoring a guest's explicit wellness and safety needs for nearly two months is unacceptable. I cannot recommend this property to traveling professionals.

reviews.author: Unhappy1
reviews.title: Discussing! Mold!
reviews.body: I unfortunately couldn’t find another room in town. This room was unfit for human beings!

reviews.author: PP Williams
reviews.title: Rough Stay at the Residence Inn Downtown Tampa
reviews.body: I am use to staying in Residence Inn properties because of the space and amenities that make you feel like your home. This stay however, was full of faulty amenities such as stopped up toilets, slow draining showers and heavy construction which resulted in unexpected water shut offs. I think had I been informed at the booking process that the hotel was going through the renovation process I would have 100% booked elsewhere.

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.title: 🎶🎵🎧 Club next door
reviews.body: Loud base until 3am! Other than that great hotel.

reviews.author: Vince S
reviews.title: Thanks for ruining our vacation
reviews.body: Staff was disrespectful and no help. Elevator hardly ever worked. Toilet hardly flushed and water in the shower would not completely shut off, causing a co stand drip sound. They were remodeling the room directly above us, using jack hammer and drills, making very loud noise, stopped by 6pm, then started back up by 8am the next morning. Mentioned to staff a d they said sorry for that, we are having construction done. I will never stay there again and advise others not to. Thanks for ruining our trip.

reviews.author: UNDER CONSTRUCTION
reviews.title: UNDER CONSTRUCTION!!!!
reviews.body: I came down for business for one week.  I looked online to find a good hotel down the street so I could walk. When I saw the Residence had ok rates, I booked with them.  No where on the website did they say they were under construction.  It wasn't pleasant to stay there.  The staff were amazing.  Every time I left for work or when I would come back they spoke and made me feel welcomed. That was the only good thing about my stay.  The room was dirty, the carpet and sofa smelled. There was spots on the floor. The light under the microwave did not work. The vents were dirty and blew dirt across the ceiling. The bathroom smelled bad and there was some black stuff under the soap holders. I felt very uncomfortable and will never stay there again.

reviews.author: Lady c
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.body: The location and staff is great so is the breakfast the serve. But the rooms need a serious cleaning and makeover

reviews.author: Disappointed Veteran
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: This hotel was under renovation during my stay. There were several issues with my room, such as a soaked carpet near the toilet. The hotel never offered to move my room or discount my rate. Also, a week before my stay, I received an email telling me water would be turned off during certain hours each day of my stay due to the renovations. Again, no offer to discount the rate.

reviews.author: JP1011
reviews.title: Water would have been nice
reviews.body:
The hotel had a note in the elevator from the previous week stating water would be off that week from 10am to 6pm. I asked the front desk about it and they assured me it was just for last week and water would be on during my stay. 
On Sunday we received a note from hotel management stating water would be shut off Monday-Friday from 11am till 4pm for their renovation. So much for their promise that water would not be shut off during our stay. The next note we received from the hotel management stated water would be off Thursday and Friday from 10am till 5pm, Saturday from 11am till 5pm and the following Monday-Wednesday from 10am till 5pm.
Be truthful when people ask if something essential like water will be available during your stay. 
Had they told me water was going to be off I would not have stayed there.

reviews.author: Chris S
reviews.title: Above and beyond service!!
reviews.body: Great service, my daughter left something there and at first they could not find it. The next day they called me as they did find it, you made my daughter’s day. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Baaskcman
reviews.title: Glad you are doing renovations! Much needed
reviews.body: We have stayed at this hotel twice in back two years ago and it needed repairs and upgrades then.  We booked the double room suite and it was really in bad shape.  Nothing done to it in two years and it needed it then and was told it would be renovated.  It was not and we had to switch to two single rooms.

reviews.author: J Moylan
reviews.title: Our stay was perfect in every way
reviews.body: Although the property is about to undergo a renovation, the service is top notch. We enjoyed every moment of our stay.

reviews.author: Lina
reviews.title: Good Experience Overall — Hoping They Address the Pest Problem
reviews.body:
We stayed for two days over Memorial Day weekend in Room 405. The room was clean, check‑in was easy, and the front desk staff were very helpful. The breakfast buffet was excellent, and the location near the Tampa Museum of Art is perfect.

However, on the second night we saw a large cockroach in the kitchenette, and the next morning a small one in the bathroom sink. During a check out we mentioned it to the lady at the front desk — she made a note, and I truly hope they address it, because I really like this place and would love to return.

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.title: Your team members are amazing
reviews.body:
Its a nice hotel. I've stayed here a few times. Today during check inn there was an unfortunate accident where my credit card dropped through a tiny slot in the main desk, for wires, and into the void. Christian, who was helping me was very polite and friendly. He wasted no time removing the bottom drawer from the desk and crawling in with his phone light. Sade' soon joined in to help look and add a little humor to the situation. She helped look and suggested my card might be stuck under the upper drawer. At this point Myka' who was working over near the elevator at the time stepped in to assist and removed the top drawer. Sade' quickly found me card once the drawer was out.
Mistakes happen its how you handle the situation that matters. The entire team was polite and professional. They kept the situation light hearted and worked effortlessly in helping each other help me.
They turned a simple mistake into a positive memory and only increased the hotels reputation. 10 stars

reviews.author: JSAJ212
reviews.title: Disappointed stay
reviews.body: Hotel is about to undergo renovations but no where did it mentions that. Bathroom was horrible. I was scared to bath my toddlers. Don’t stay here if you have little kids. It very noisy at night with the cars driving by. The lamp shades were broken. No notification of the condition of the rooms. Then you mention it to the staff and they say “oh yeah we know the rooms are horrible”. It was not worth the money I paid. I asked to be relocated to another room but it wasn’t any better. Apparently no one can do anything either. Not even refund the parking. I plan on returning to Tampa but I won’t stay here.

reviews.author: Soggycustomer4x
reviews.title: 4 floods and hours without water.
reviews.body:
Absolutely unacceptable experience at the Residence Inn Tampa Downtown. A water main break flooded my entire floor, leaving the hallways and surrounding areas smelling strongly of water damage and mildew for the remainder of my stay. Industrial drying machines and remediation equipment ran constantly, creating loud noise day and night that made it nearly impossible to relax or sleep.

As if that wasn’t bad enough, the hotel then shut off the water for approximately six hours to repair the damage not once but twice. Along with two other leaks that requires the water to be shut off yet again for hours at a time. Guests were left unable to properly shower, use sinks, or comfortably use their rooms. 

The combination of flooding, odor, nonstop machine noise, and extended water outage completely ruined the experience. This stay felt more like staying in an active disaster cleanup site than a hotel. 

Very disappointed with the condition of the property and the lack of meaningful accommodation for the disruption. I would strongly recommend future guests avoid this property until these issues are fully resolved.

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.title: Hotel review
reviews.body: The hotel wasn't as clean as expected. Bathroom looked..like something from resident evil . Price too high for the condition of room. Totally different experience from last year

reviews.author: Brooke
reviews.title: We will stay here again
reviews.body: Very friendly staff and great area

reviews.author: Indy500
reviews.title: Indy 500 in my room
reviews.body: Bring your ear plugs because you will hear every car as you try and sleep!!

reviews.author: Michelle R
reviews.title: Very convenient and lovely staff
reviews.body:
Great size room, lots of ‘little extras’ - washing up liquid / sponge / kitchen towel /dishwasher powder, and also individually wrapped make up remover wipes. All the little things you are likely to forget!!! There are a few items for sale in the reception area, again for convenience.
The staff were all really helpful and so friendly.
The hotel was tired but it was explained at check-in that there were small issues but the hotel is about to have a refurbishment- this was a helpful touch as it made any imperfections tolerable. 
I would definitely stay there again ☺️

reviews.author: MrsDill
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.body:
The staff at this location is UNMATCHED! Everyone was amazing. Extremely helpful and friendly, ready to be of service whenever we needed something, it was great. We felt
welcome and comfortable staying here. Also, the rooms were clean, comfortable, and everything we needed. Even the breakfast was pretty good!

reviews.author: BC712
reviews.title: Great service and good location, in need of updates
reviews.body: Room was nicely designed and provided all needed items, but was lacking in upkeep and maintanence.

reviews.title: Normally, excellent, but this time....
reviews.body: Residence Inns are my favorite Marriott brand!  This Tampa hotel is in a great location and the room was fine.  However, the elevators were very shaky and 1 day, one of the elevators got stuck and the fire department had to come and get it moving again.  From that point on, we took the stairs everyday.  Breakfast was good, except they often ran out of coffee.  We also had no room cleanings despite multiple requests.  For our 4 night stay, we should have had at least 1 room cleaning.

reviews.author: NCAA
reviews.title: NCAA trip
reviews.body: We were there with a high school thespian group.  They were loud and completely took over the breakfast area leaving no seats for other guests.  Staff did nothing to help.   They said there was nothing they could do and there were no other seating options.  Felt we were completely ignored.

reviews.author: DEREAK
reviews.title: EXCELLENT STAYS
reviews.body: THE LADY AT THE FRONT DESK WAS WONDERFUL,  WAS THE SAME LADY HAD SPOKEN TO ON PHONE DAYS EARLIER TO CONFERM MY RESERVATION, ( DAR SKIN-LADY WITH  CURLY HAIR )  SHE WAS A POLITE AS A PERSON CAN BE, GOT US OUR ROOM QUICKLY, EVEN THOUGH I WAS EARLY, WHILE ALSO HELPING ANOTHER LADY AT FRONT DESK , ( ASSUMING SHE WAS NEWER ) TO GET OTHERS CHECKED IN AS WELL.   THEN WHEN GOT UP THE NEXT MORNING SHE WAS BACK AT WORK AGAIN, WITH THE SAME SMILE ON HER FACE.   CANNOT SAY ENOUGH ABOUT THIS PERTICULAR HOTEL.    THE FIRST TIME STAYED THERE THE HOTEL HAD BEEN  FULLU BOOKED, SO THE NEW MANAGER GOT OUR ROOM READY HIS SELF, INSTEAD OF WAITING ON OTHERS TO DO IT, SAW HIM DO MANY OTERS ROOMS AS WELL.   SO THEY WORK TOGETHER,  AS A PLACE OF BUSINESS SHOULD BE.

reviews.author: George
reviews.title: Tampa stay
reviews.body: Very dated appearance with very small bedooms.

reviews.author: Couple from Brooklyn
reviews.title: A very good option for Downtown Tampa
reviews.body: Overall a good experience. Convenient location, friendly staff, good size rooms. Biggest drawback is sharing the pool with the adjacent "Courtyard by Marriott" - pool too small for TWO hotels

reviews.author: Family from Jamaica
reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.body: It had the elements of a home and not intrusion of space was experienced. The staff especially Katina was the life of the front desk.  The location was so ideal for us as we stepped outside we were in the vehicular zone but somewhat it was not a busy and crowdy zone. My kids and I loved it there!

reviews.author: Shay J
reviews.title: Value over quality
reviews.body: This hotel is positioned in a great location for a budget friendly price but the rooms lack in quality. The bathrooms are disgusting; old, rusted, and dated. The space of the room itself is ideal for a family but not for a quality stay.

reviews.author: Tracy
reviews.title: Great location Tampa
reviews.body: We have stayed at the Tampa Aloft twice so far. Love the hotel decor and the amazing staff. Hotel is in a perfect location for events at the arena.

reviews.author: Ashley P
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay in Tampa!
reviews.body: My stay at the Aloft was great! My room was great and I loved that it was refreshed every day. I forgot how much I enjoy getting fresh towels and having my trash emptied each day. When you are there for almost a week, these are the simple luxuries! The staff was also very attentive and friendly, everyone I encountered was great. Requests were answered quickly and almost always accommodated. Thank you to the entire staff!

reviews.author: Happy Traveler
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: Couldn’t have had a better visit.  Everything was perfect

reviews.author: Tamara W
reviews.title: OUTSTANDING Service
reviews.body: Puma & Tiana at the front desk and Hooney in Valet were AWESOME! They clearly love their jobs as all 3 were super friendly and welcoming. They fulfilled all of our special requests like extra towels and a fan to make our stay most memorable!

reviews.author: MMG
reviews.title: August 2026
reviews.body: We stayed at the aloft while our daughter was moving in for her freshman year at the University of Tampa. The hotel was clean, the workout room was great, staff was polite and professional, and helpful.

reviews.author: UT mom
reviews.title: Tampa
reviews.body: Shenaaz at the front desk was absolutely amazing!!!  She went above and beyond to make me comfortable after a very long travel day!!     Great staff, excellent location!!

reviews.author: Marianna
reviews.title: Our experience was 1 out of 10
reviews.body: Very disappointed in this hotel! The first thing was the smell when we walked into our room. Second, our bedding was not clean at all! The mattress cover and top cover had stains, and the pillowcases didn’t smell fresh at all! In the bathroom, there were seven sheets of tissue paper in the tissue box. I will never come back to this hotel again.

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.title: Excellent downtown Tampa hotel
reviews.body: Great experience all around. Staff is exceptional in attending to the needs of the guests and very friendly. Location very convenient in downtown Tampa

reviews.author: RA
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: The bartenders at the hotel bar, Joseph and Camila were the best!

reviews.author: NB
reviews.body: Overall great! Biggest gripe is not getting river view and one bartender was kind of smug. Otherwise, clean, friendly, cool decor, great pool, convenient location.

reviews.author: AP
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body:
This ALOFT has a great pool deck overlooking the Riverwalk. The rooms are up to the usual standard. The bar is low key and spacious.
Breakfast service ( albeit a limited menu) was excellent

reviews.author: Sc
reviews.title: Very subpar
reviews.body: Location was great, employees and staff were kind and very helpful (special shoutout to Puma and Shenaz). However, the rooms were subpar. Upon arrival, the floors were dusty and dirty. The toilet paper roll was falling off the wall, water leaked from the shower anytime you used it, surfaces were dusty, upkeep was not done. Carpets were dirty. Not enough towels given. Hallways were humid, everything is a bit dated.

reviews.author: DG Golden
reviews.title: Royal Treatment
reviews.body: The ALoft Downtown Tampa staff are second to none. From my arrival to my departure they catered to my every need and desires. Special thanks to Shenaaz, Ana, Wim, Tiana and Marcus. They are definitely an asset to your company and embody the essence of your mission.

reviews.author: TAW
reviews.title: Don't get what promised
reviews.body: Bed linens had big stains on sheets and mud in the bed. Have to get extra towels and wash clothes every day, because housekeeping will only leave you 1 of each. Was told my parking fee was going to be comped, but was charged $198 for parking at checkout.

reviews.author: Great place to stay
reviews.title: Ana is the best!!
reviews.body: My wife booked for Saturday night for a wedding. Then we decided to book Friday night as well. I booked for Friday but when we went to check in we found I booked at the wrong Aloft. Ana at the desk worked with us and got us a room for Friday, she is wonderful!

reviews.author: Rich
reviews.title: Staff not supported by management.
reviews.body: Pay the extra money and stay at fully staffed hotel.

reviews.author: Ky Phan
reviews.title: Awesome service, location & views of the river!
reviews.body: Awesome location, views, service.  Ana at the front desk was super helpful & made the experience memorable.  She even offered to get me pool towels when I was soaking wet & I forgot to get my towels & coming in from the pool.  We had a great experience & will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Aloft review
reviews.title: Aloft survey
reviews.body: We had food under our sheets upon our arrival and the ice machine on our floor (5) didn't work the entire time we were there. The pool is in the shade :(

reviews.author: Extremely poor staff
reviews.title: Poor Service and inattentive staff.
reviews.body: Very poor valet service . Refused to help. Didn’t care about their job. Lying front desk personnel. Very unprofessional eating and picking their teeth when talking. The front desk supervisor Carl advised that he would take care of my complaint. I was very happy that he said that, but it was only words as he did not follow through which I discovered on checkout. The checkout clerk Ana was very rude ( eating at the desk and picking food out of her teeth . She lied that she did not have the authority to handle the situation and that no manager or supervisor was available . She said somebody would call me which obviously they didn’t. I had to call. In fairness I did receive a call back from the manager Puma and she resolved the situation . She did award me some points, but haven’t received to date. Overall the staff spoiled my stay.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay, went to Tampa for a wedding.
reviews.body: The location and price were on point. Short Uber from airport. Check in staff was exceptional by being friendly, knowledgeable about the area and recommended excellent restaurants, (First Watch was great, ask for Randy, excellent server) The Oxford Exchange will change your life for the better!) Never would have known without the Staff's recommendation. The pool was refreshing, and rooms clean. Located on the water so great views of the water and boats. Overall, great stay. Have dinner at Boulon Brasserie, food was exceptional!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Clean Rooms
reviews.body: Hotel and rooms were very clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: Jiovanni
reviews.title: Clean rooms and Excellent Service!
reviews.body:
I stayed at the Aloft for 3 days and 2 nights over Fourth of July weekend in a King River View room, and overall, I had a very positive experience.
From the moment I walked in, the staff was polite, cheerful, and welcoming. Anna at the front desk was especially great and went above and beyond to make me feel welcomed. Another front desk employee, whose name I unfortunately did not catch, also made my stay extra special with a small unexpected gift, which was a really nice surprise.
The hotel was very clean and well maintained. The lobby, elevators, hallways, and my room were all spotless. Housekeeping was also impressive. I went downstairs for breakfast one morning, and within about 20 minutes, they had already cleaned my room, replaced the towels, and made the bed. I never even saw them, but they were clearly on top of everything.
The pool area was enjoyable, and having the bar right inside the doors was very convenient. Gabi, the bartender, was upbeat, skilled, friendly, and always smiling. Side note: I gave her my number and she still has not called me, but she still deserves credit for her outstanding service. 😉
The location is also a huge plus. The hotel is very close to the Riverwalk and downtown, making it easy to walk to places like The Hub, The Gin Joint, Gen X Tavern, the Riverwalk, and CVS, which is only a couple short blocks away.
The only negatives were minor. My “river view” was technically from the bathroom window, which made me laugh more than anything. The bar did not open until noon, which felt a little late for a Saturday on a holiday weekend. The pool area also had no music or entertainment, but luckily I brought a Bluetooth speaker and we got some tunes going.
The room itself was clean, comfortable, and efficient, although smaller than expected. The walls were completely bare, which made the room echo a bit. Also, there was no real bathroom door or separate toilet privacy door, which may be awkward if two people are sharing the room.
Lastly, while the location is very convenient, there were quite a few homeless individuals and some activity downtown that may make some guests uncomfortable late at night. There was also a strong police presence, though that may have been because of Fourth of July weekend.
Overall, the positives definitely outweighed the negatives. The staff, cleanliness, housekeeping, pool bar, and location made my stay welcoming, comfortable, and memorable.

reviews.author: Marriott Veteran
reviews.title: Not up to Marriott standards
reviews.body:
Very noisy.
Marriott preferences not considered.
Room very tiny-no drawers for clothing.

reviews.author: Mini Getaway Trip
reviews.title: Last minuit booking was not dissappointed
reviews.body: We make the last minuit booking online and they did not fail us.

reviews.author: Mike R
reviews.title: A great week stay at the Aloft downtown
reviews.body: We had a great stay at the ALOFT downtown from the moment checked in to the moment we checked out upon checking in we were able to have her bags put away so we can enjoy eating our lunch that we brought with us since our room wasn’t available. Every member of the service team said hello to us access is there anything they can do to make our stay more enjoyable and we really appreciated that the amenities of the hotel were very nice got to use the gym the pool the bar area in the lobby as well. The only pickup was a little bit in the room cleaning schedule, but the HOTEL made it right with our request to have it done or items brought to the road at the later point the people is what made our stay that much better. We had a great time, but it was because of great people working at the Aloft.

reviews.author: MAG2026
reviews.title: Aloft Tampa Downtown
reviews.body: We chose the Aloft Tampa Downtown due to its proximity to UTampa. We loved having the River Walk right outside. The common areas and outdoor areas were pleasant. The room itself was dark and sterile, but clean. We were only there for one night so the location and very accommodating staff made up for the room. The front desk staff Ana and Puma were helpful.
