We also enjoyed a fresh very hot breakfast sandwich from the chef in the breakfast area. For a one night stay, it fit the bill.

reviews.author: Doc
reviews.title: Lacking common courtesy
reviews.body:
The hotel sent me an email inviting us to their pool party from 2-8. We go out there and get in the pool. Slowly realized there was something else going on. It was some kind of LGBTQ party…guys in fishnets, thongs etc. We got out and left. Why would you invite a family to that with kids?

Drinks at the bar cost us 50 bucks for two margaritas. That's nearly double what they generally cost.

They force us to do valet saying there's no other options which wasn't advertised, I went down to the front desk because I needed something out of my car. The lady at the front desk said I’d have to go to the valet and he’d bring my car to me. I told her I wasn’t going anywhere, I just needed to get the kids iPads. She then proceeds to tell me that my car may not be on site because sometimes they park them off site. I said, you’re telling me that my car might not even be at this hotel?! You can't just take peoples cars off site without disclosing that ahead of time.

I get down to the valet and tell him I need something out of the car. He starts to walk to the parking garage and I asked him if I needed to follow him, he says no, it floods in there. I ended up getting to go down  there but my first thought was that they parked my car in flood waters. This is unacceptable. I about told him to pull the car back up and we were leaving.

reviews.author: Guests Beware
reviews.title: Avoid the Bar
reviews.body:
Recently stayed at Aloft for 2 days. I need to break this down into 4 parts.

Front desk-Ana, Tiana, and Puma were great. Never had to ask for anything, they just knew and they get a 9.5.

Valet- I was not able to get their names but everyone in valet was great and went above and beyond. 9.7

WXYZ Bar onsite-the bartender Joe has no business in any customer service job. He is a smart aleck and a condescending person that I came so close to telling off multiple times. It's a shame because it's a cool spot to hang out onsite. He get a 1.5. Please find a new job Joe.

The room- this is where things fall apart completely! The room is small for what we pay but we did want the balcony to have our own private outside area. This balcony has zero privacy. In the remodel they put dividers between each floor's balcony that everybody can just stand there and look right over and it is completely opened with no privacy. This needs to be changed. You should not be able to see and step right over to other balconies. The bathroom situation is a complete cluster. The sink is in one area and then the toilet. A shower is in a separate area with a door, but both areas are controlled by only one light switch. So if someone is an early riser and someone is not, that person cannot go into the bathroom and turn on the light because the light at the sink will come on and wake up the person sleeping. I have never ran into this before in my life in any hotel I've ever traveled in and this needs to be fixed because it is completely inconvenient and just makes no sense. And then the straw that broke the camel's back. Is the door going to the balcony. It did not shut completely. They took the lock off and you can literally look out a hole to the outside. So the door does not latch. It is only held by a chain in the bar so therefore there is no seal formed and every bit of noise from the very busy Tampa streets. Down below you hear all night. I was lucky to get 1 hour of sleep each night and I am so glad to be home now because I am exhausted. I don't know who signed off on that remodel or acknowledge that that room was ready for guests but it was not. That door needs to be fixed as soon as possible before it is rented to another guest and they have to suffer like me and listen to all of the cars and all of the police and all the noise from the busy downtown. Needless to say I won't be back. The room get to zero. It is the worst I've ever stayed in and the loudest.

reviews.author: Meggie
reviews.title: Stellar customer service
reviews.body: This hotel is clean and quirky with comfortable accommodations. The customer service went above and beyond. Arriving after midnight due to flight problems, and not having been here before, Kevin took excellent care of me. The next day, the manager called to check on me and see if I needed anything. I have never felt so taken care of.

reviews.author: Dpou
reviews.title: Couple's Getaway
reviews.body: A hotel with an excellent location and amenities—perfect for a romantic getaway to Tampa, for exploring the city, and for taking walks.

reviews.author: Margie H
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel 5 Star
reviews.body: My sister and I cannot stop talking about how great of a time we had during our stay at Edition.  We typically stay at Marriott on WaterStreet.  I am so happy we decided to change it up because Edition owes us absolutely nothing!!  Starting with Zoe- she made the initial smile before we got to Tampa and provided a generous charcuterie board; followed by chocolate covered strawberries and if that was not enough - VIP HOST Daria walks in with beautiful flowers and balloons!!  My sister was blown away.  I know you probably know all of this already but I have to share  the Food Service Team to bring up two beautiful desserts that were scrumptious!!!  I really could go on and on about how Anthony took special care of our luggage and shared with us the local cuisines, Carmen was a delight as I asked her 50 questions regarding breakfast and she was gracious enough to answer each one!   It was nice to see Frank, Manager (i believe) on arrival and departure who greeted us with a smile.  The Entire Edition Team was awesome.  I cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: Jen G
reviews.title: Slightly different
reviews.body:
This was not a
Typical
Stay. I normally have absolutely no complaints and this is the only hotel
I ever stay at.. the staff is amazing.. this stay had some
Issues.. room
Was either freezing or I had to shut off the a/c altogether and sweat in the middle of the
Night. 

It’s very expensive to be uncomfortable. Nothing was offered to me
At all which is disappointing for sure.

reviews.author: Rtaustin
reviews.title: Amazing stay - will definitely be back
reviews.body:
The EDITION was everything I imagined it would be and more. Most certainly the nicest hotel in Tampa, and maybe in FL - and that’s despite having some amenities temporarily unavailable due to construction. 
The food and service were both 10/10 and I couldn’t have felt more of a personal experience.

reviews.author: nweirich
reviews.title: Felt very special on our anniversary
reviews.body:
I would give 6 • if I could.
We stayed here for 15 year anniversary - belated date due to our children's activities, but it was a nice getaway with my wife.
Many years have gone by and we've always stayed somewhere nice for our anniversary and you usually tell the people when you book your reservation it is your anniversary usually not much is made of it. Maybe a free dessert at best.
The Edition went above and beyond my greatest expectations. We were upgraded without having to ask, we were greeted in the lobby by Daria who escorted us to our room. There was a wonderful welcome gift and wine. They even printed a picture from our wedding and framed it for us (see pic).
We were so surprised and happy. We will 100% be back. What wonderful service! It reminded me of how service used to be many years ago.

reviews.author: Chris Lee
reviews.title: Top notch service
reviews.body: Great location with exceptional service and amenities. Attentive and caring staff.

reviews.author: Mike w
reviews.title: Next level service
reviews.body: This place provides next level service!

reviews.author: Tara
reviews.title: Perfect Anniversary Weekend
reviews.body: The Tampa Edition exceeded our expectations for our 1st wedding anniversary. What was already a special occasion was made memorable by the warm staff and the details they included in their service. Every part of the experience was world class from making our reservation to the personalized service of concierge. We would 10 out of 10 recommend this location for any celebration or anyone looking for curated hospitality. Thank you Tampa Edition. You have made a lasting impression.

reviews.author: Elijah Morgan
reviews.title: A Perfect 10/10 Experience
reviews.body:
We booked our stay through Chase Travel, and the entire process was very easy. Upon arrival, we received a room upgrade and late checkout, which made the experience even better.

We were celebrating our eighth anniversary, and the hotel surprised us with rose petals and chocolate-covered strawberries in our room. It was an incredibly thoughtful touch that made the occasion feel very special.

The hotel was beautiful, classy, and luxurious. Breakfast at The Market was delicious, and we really enjoyed the music, atmosphere, and drinks at Arts Club in the evening.

Overall, it was an amazing experience and easily a 10/10 stay. We look forward to returning.

reviews.author: KaylaZM
reviews.title: Amazing stay!!!
reviews.body:
We had an incredible stay at The Edition Tampa for a little babymoon getaway last Thursday and Friday. From the moment we arrived, Anthony went above and beyond — he helped us with our bags at check-in and checked in on us throughout the entire stay. He also pointed us to The Arts Club for dinner on Thursday night, where we had amazing sushi and noodles — such a great recommendation!

We booked through Chase, so we got to enjoy the complimentary breakfast each morning, which was delicious, along with really great coffee. We were also excited to receive a room upgrade during our stay.

The one thing we didn’t get to experience was the pool and rooftop, though we appreciated being able to use the JW Marriott’s pool in the meantime. Overall, it was a wonderful stay and we can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Johnny
reviews.title: Best hotel in Tampa
reviews.body: If you are looking for an amazing hotel, with an incredible staff, cool bars and restaurants, and a great location The Tampa EDITION is for you!

reviews.author: George
reviews.title: Call to clarify what is available
reviews.body: I feel I was not informed properly what facilities would not be available during my stay and would have appreciated clarification on what was closed as in your rooftop restaurant and lounge areas

reviews.author: MS6840
reviews.title: Don’t go while everything is closed
reviews.body: Don’t go unless All outlets are open inside.

reviews.author: Marie
reviews.title: Disappointed in the quality
reviews.body: The hotel did not meet a 5 Star quality. The rooms have thin walls so I was able to hear people talking and snoring in the room next to me. The rug and floors look old, dirty and worn out. There  room wasn’t dusted. The outside windows very dirty and can tell they haven’t been cleaned for a while. The desk chair was a very cheap plastic wobbly chair that I would not expect for a luxury hotel. I was disappointed also with the quality of food. Overall it was not relaxing stay

reviews.author: Carolina W
reviews.title: Always incredible
reviews.body: The Tampa Edition is an outstanding hotel. Staff is professional and friendly, rooms are fantastic and sophisticated and they provide a great experience overall. Food at Market was so good too!

reviews.author: Devin Washington
reviews.title: A Stay That Reminded Us Why The EDITION Feels So Special
reviews.body:
Our stay at The Tampa EDITION was truly exceptional and reminded us exactly why The EDITION brand stands apart. From the moment we arrived, the experience felt thoughtful, personal, and effortlessly refined.

The property itself is beautiful, but what made the stay so memorable was the people. Every interaction felt intentional, warm, and genuine. Our VIP host helped make the visit feel especially seamless. Jess at The Market, Mia and Carly as hosts, Andre at the Lobby Bar, Cassidy at the pool, Anthony and Dylan with the bell team, and everyone we encountered in between all contributed to an experience that felt both elevated and deeply welcoming.

The EDITION promises a level of hospitality that is stylish, personal, and memorable — and this stay delivered on that promise in every way. It felt special being back, and it only confirmed that this is a place we look forward to returning to again soon.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: FANTASTIC SPOT
reviews.body: This Hotel is well worth every penny. The entire staff was exceptional. Paige and Jessica at market are awesome. Alisandro at the pool was amazing fantastic energy. Ryan our server at Lilac one of the best waiters we have ever had. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Wedding excellence 61326
reviews.title: Event completed with precision
reviews.body: Every interaction with the staff was authentic and accommodating.

reviews.author: Rogers2018
reviews.title: Luxury in Name Only: Ignored Anniversary, Incorrect Charges, and Poor Service at The Tampa EDITION
reviews.body: Our stay at The Tampa EDITION was beyond disappointing, especially for what is supposed to be a luxury Marriott property. Prior to arrival, the hotel reached out multiple times asking if we were celebrating a special occasion. Each time, I clearly responded that we were celebrating our 8th Wedding Anniversary. The ONLY acknowledgment we received was an email trying to sell us a PAID room upgrade. We declined, expecting at the very least some genuine hospitality or recognition upon arrival. Instead, absolutely NOTHING. No “Happy Anniversary.” No complimentary upgrade. No small gesture. No welcome amenity. Nothing at all. To make matters worse, my husband is a Lifetime Platinum Marriott Bonvoy Member, and we booked through American Express Stays, which typically comes with elevated service expectations. Yet none of that seemed to matter. And the disappointment didn’t stop there. After we had already checked out and left the property, the hotel charged my card for breakfast — even though breakfast was INCLUDED with our booking. Before checkout, we specifically asked the front desk why the breakfast benefit was not showing properly on the bill because we wanted to avoid this exact situation. Normally, the charge appears with an offsetting credit. We were reassured, yet they still incorrectly charged us after departure. I’m glad I carefully reviewed the emailed receipt because otherwise we would have been improperly billed. I then had to take time out of my day to call the hotel myself to get the charges reversed and credited back. At this point, it honestly feels like either the staff is lazy, or they simply do not care about guest experience. If you are going to repeatedly ask guests whether they are celebrating something special, then why ask at all if you have zero intention of acknowledging it? Luxury hospitality is about attention to detail, professionalism, and making guests feel valued. The Tampa EDITION completely failed at all three. Honestly, There are other hotels in the area that are just as luxurious and a better value for the money. This hotel is nothing special as we thought. We will never stay here or recommend this place again. AGAIN, EITHER THEY ARE TO LAZY OR JUST DON'T CARE

reviews.author: Linds
reviews.title: Best hotel experience ever
reviews.body: If you're not staying at the Tampa Edition while in Tampa, you're staying at the wrong place. This place is beautiful, friendly, has amazing food, is accommodating and you want for nothing!

reviews.author: Mahmud Y
reviews.title: Anniversary Staycation!
reviews.body: We had a wonderful anniversary staycation at The Tampa EDITION. The hotel was beautiful, stylish, and relaxing, and the overall experience made our celebration feel special. Everything felt smooth from arrival to departure, and we appreciated the comfortable room, inviting atmosphere, and thoughtful service. It was a memorable stay, and we would happily return for another special occasion.

reviews.author: Mcflyguy
reviews.title: Don’t stay here unless you are an influencer
reviews.body: Great hotel but over run with influencers. If you go out for dinner in the evening you have to get past the door security to get in

reviews.author: Millie
reviews.title: A whirlwind weekend experience!
reviews.body: This hotel Edition was top notch in every aspect. It and the staff delivered. From valeting the car to being greeted at the front door, to getting a welcome drink at check in, all before seeing our beautiful room. The staff went above and beyond to make our stay as enjoyable and comfortable as possible. The Greek Cuisine was delicious and the staff at the wedding we attended couldn't be nicer and accommodating.  Overall I give the Edition a 10! Spent my last day at the roof top pool and spa, with no rush to go back home. It was an amazing experience from beginning to end. I would go back in a heartbeat! Go check it out. It's worth the stay!

reviews.author: Shant
reviews.title: Another great stay at the Edition!
reviews.body: Really beautiful property and great staff - always attentive, friendly, and welcoming.  The lobby and Market Restaurant are a pleasure to be in.  The rooms are clean, comfortable, and nice.  The rooftop pool is a great way to spend the day.  Great location in Tampa.  I love this hotel and will continue to return!

reviews.author: May 2026
reviews.title: Stay/Event Gone Wrong
reviews.body: Service was terrible. Staff knew nothing. For the caliber of the hotel, it is not worth it.

reviews.author: She travels
reviews.title: Highly recommended 5 star luxury
reviews.body: This is the only true 5 star luxury hotel in Tampa. I stay here often and the staff consistently provide outstanding service and ensure our stay is top tier. The deluxe king and one bedroom suite are our favorites. The food is amazing at the Market place and pool side. We also order room service which is great too. The food is always amazing.

reviews.author: Michelle G
reviews.title: Awesome Stay!
reviews.body:
We had such a wonderful stay at The Tampa EDITION. From the moment we arrived, the experience felt special. The team surprised us with a thoughtful upgrade and a lovely treat to celebrate our anniversary, which truly made the trip unforgettable.
The hotel itself is absolutely stunning—elegant, beautifully designed, and incredibly picturesque at every turn. There are several great dining options on-site, each offering its own unique atmosphere and delicious food, which made it easy to relax and enjoy without ever needing to leave.
What stood out most was the kindness and attentiveness of the staff. Every interaction was warm, genuine, and helpful, making us feel truly welcomed throughout our stay.
We couldn’t have asked for a better place to celebrate such a special occasion and are already looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Stephen K
reviews.title: The best Bonvoy property in Tampa
reviews.body: Great stay, this was our third vist to this property. The location is great right off of Water St and across the street from the arena. The property is well appointed, the restaurants are excellent and the service is fabulous

reviews.author: Courtney R
reviews.title: Wedding anniversary
reviews.body: The edition is by far the best hotel we’ve ever stayed at the hospitality and kindness from every single person is amazing. You truly feel special

reviews.author: HockeyDad
reviews.title: Spring Breakaway
reviews.body: Our stay at the Tampa Edition was nothing less than spectacular. The Edition Hotel was amazing from walking in to checking out. The entire staff made my daughter and I feel like VIPs. Beautiful Hotel, great area of town and steps from Benchmark International Arena where we took in a NHL game. The staff were amazing, the amenities were great, and the rooms were large and immaculate. Would stay again and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Mike H
reviews.title: My Weekend at the Edition
reviews.body: Fabulous place to stay.  Service could not have been better.

reviews.author: AJLeary
reviews.title: Tampa
reviews.body: The JW Marriot is BIG with no personality. Not a great value and no cell service in your room without purchasing internet.

reviews.author: BJB Naples
reviews.title: Marriot at its best
reviews.body: From the moment we pulled into hotel, the staff was excellent.   Ramandeep and Riley, who checked us in were the best. They had great personalities and were informative and professional. The concierge, Junie, was great in arranging for a nice bottle of wine in our room to celebrate my wife’s birthday prior to arrival. Amanda in Anchor restaurant was terrific and surprised my wife with a birthday dessert at lunch.  You can stay at a 5 star hotel but if the staff isn’t great , it can ruin the trip. The entire staff made this particular hotel a 10.

reviews.author: C3PO
reviews.title: Excellent Facility and Staff
reviews.body: From the front desk staff to housekeeping the staff were welcoming and attentive.  The facility was quiet and clean.  Highly recommend this property when visiting Tampa. Having spent many years in hotels in my career, this ranks as one of the best.

reviews.author: Kevin C
reviews.title: Amazing hotel at a great location
reviews.body: I absolutely love this hotel and had a great stay. Everyone was nice and polite. Amenities were great. The gym was fantastic. Definitely one of the better JW Marriotts I’ve stayed at. The only improvement I would suggest is do your carpet cleaning a little later or check with the room under you. Or even post a sign! When you’re tired from the night before and get woken up with constant scraping noise from upstairs cleaning the carpets, you’ll get very irritated.

reviews.author: Michele Lacy
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.body:
This is the second time we’ve stayed at the Marriott Riverwalk and it’s a perfect location. It’s within walking distance of a lot of restaurants and sites, but really you don’t even have to leave the hotel.

Everything about it is first class.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.title: Outstanding all around experience
reviews.body: Highly recommend the JW Marriott Tampa for your travels whether business or personal.  The facility is beautifully well kept and offers a number of amenities and I received exceptional service from hotel staff members during my stay!

reviews.author: Vandal 6
reviews.title: The JW Marriott is without a doubt, BEST IN CLASS
reviews.body:
From the moment we arrived, the JW Marriott Tampa Water Street made us feel genuinely special. What stands out most about every stay are the exceptional team members who consistently go above and beyond.
Vinny and Marissa at the pool bar are simply the best—their service and hospitality elevate every visit. The entire pool staff, front desk team, and housekeeping team are equally outstanding. I also want to recognize the wonderful bartender who took such great care of us over Labor Day weekend and crafted truly excellent martinis (I apologize for not catching her name—it won’t happen again). Honorable mention goes to Gerry at Driftlight, whose service was excellent as well.
We also want to acknowledge Sean and Jerry from the Marriott Pool Bar. We frequently enjoy their hospitality when our grandchildren stay with us, and they are truly top-shelf professionals who consistently exceed expectations.
The JW Marriott Tampa Water Street excels in every way. It is a truly outstanding place to stay while visiting downtown Tampa and Water Street, and we look forward to returning soon. Thank you for making our stays so memorable.

reviews.author: Jayson
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.body:
We had a really good stay this time. Everybody was very friendly from the front staff to the restaurant to the spa. Shout out to Jake.  

The room service the room everything was really good.

reviews.author: BostonBonvoyMember
reviews.title: Comfortable Stay, But Check-In and Arrival Experience Could Be Improved
reviews.body:
Overall, we had a pleasant stay at the JW Marriott, but there were a couple of areas where the experience could be improved. After a long day of travel and arriving well after the posted check-in time, our room was unfortunately not yet ready. Since we were traveling with several bags, the additional wait was a bit frustrating when all we wanted to do was settle in and relax.

We also found the valet and loading area somewhat challenging to navigate. It wasn't always easy to quickly pull up and unload or retrieve items from our vehicle, which added a little extra hassle during our stay.

The staff was courteous, and the property itself is beautiful, but a smoother check-in process and more convenient access for guests with luggage would make the experience even better.

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.body: My husband and I use Marriott as often as possible thankfully, we have yet to be disappointed the JW Marriott Tampa, Water Street hotel was bright, clean, and was exceptionally staffed with wonderful people. On a sidenote, this hotel is just under 2 miles from the cruise port terminal so if you need to use a rideshare to jump on a cruise ship, I would 100% recommend this location safe travels and hope this helps someone.

reviews.author: Tom P
reviews.title: Perfect hotel
reviews.body: This Hoyle will not disappoint , yes it's beautiful but the staff really sets this apart from other hotels . We will certainly be back !

reviews.author: Scott T
reviews.title: 5 Star Hotel
reviews.body: Great Hotel!!! If I had 1 complaint it would be no coffee available until 6:00am when the coffee shop opens, should have complimentary coffee in the lobby for people that get up before 6:00am. Otherwise AWESOME Hotel!

reviews.author: MarriottLifer
reviews.title: Birthday Getaway
reviews.body:
Amazing weekend.   I got to talk with the concierge on setting up the weekend to celebrate my wife's birthday.   She helped me get amenities for the room that included ballons, flow pedals, a delicate cake and chocolate covered strawberries.    She ensured our reservation at the roof top would be along the glass to see the sunset.  It was stellar.    She really went out of her way to make sure our stay was stunning.  I love the attention to details.  Even at check-in the young lady helping us didn't bring up the surprise or tip her hand the room had been setup as a Happy Birthday welcome.  I love attention to detail, and this JW excelled at it. 

The food was very good, I could say the bruschetta was a little over-thought with the ingredients but I'm a food snob have been through culinary training.   The croquettes were pretty good, and the baked oysters were quite tasty.   The drinks were very good and tasted just like they were described.   The Service was exemplary at the Roof Top.  Our waitress and the hostess were more than accommodating and helpful.  Even checking to make sure my wife was ok with the wind and not chilled. 

The overall service was great, even did the little detailed turn-down service while we were at dinner.  The room was clean, amazing view and I can't say enough about how much we enjoyed the visit.

reviews.author: Bob j
reviews.title: Such a beautiful hotel, just poorly managed
reviews.body:
I attended a large convention we had at this hotel that our company put on. We had approximately 180 people at attendance. The hotel is beautiful. It’s spotless. Amenities are gorgeous but it’s very poorly run access to the rooftop lounge is managed like standing in line in a New York nightclub instead of taking care of your clients that are staying at the hotel. The valet service was horrible. They took in way too many cars having to anticipate that it was gonna be impossible for them to retrieve them in a timely basis. The line to get our car was 2 1/2 hours long. Some people waited up to three hours for their car. The valet service was terrible. They didn’t care the attitude was tough. You don’t have a choice just put up with it. They would not let us retrieve our own car. They said it was a safe.
They said it was a safety issue when I know that’s not true. They could’ve easily escorted us to get our vehicle so we could’ve left instead of standing there in the parking lot for 2 1/2 hours


I missed a dinner engagement that I had arranged two months in advance because of the total incompetence of the valet service in the hotel management

When I went to the manager of the hotel, he looked at me like oh there’s nothing I could really do I could really Care less you’re just gonna have to put up with it. I can tell you I’ll never put up with it again because I’ll never go to this hotel ever again. I’ve been a loyal exclusive Marriott client for years and years. I stay at hotels all over the country. I always choose Marriott properties. I would never set Foot on this property again.

reviews.author: Brooks
reviews.title: Amazing retreat in downtown Tampa
reviews.body: Our stay was perfect from arrival to departure and we can't wait to return. Cole, the pool attendant, was very personable and saw to it that we felt at home. Amelia, our server for breakfast at Driftlight, was very friendly and her warm personality started our day with joy. Amazing staff in all areas we encountered though and the facilities were modern, clean, and beautiful. See you all again soon!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: A wonderful experience overall!
reviews.body: We had a wonderful anniversary weekend enjoying Mumford and Sons at Benchmark.  The amenities and overall experience was fabulous.  Thank you!!

reviews.author: Michelle D
reviews.title: 10/10 Review: Seamless Luxury & Exceptional Service
reviews.body: Though I only stayed for one night on business, the exceptional service makes me eager to return for a personal vacation. The 10/10 experience began the moment we pulled up to valet. We were immediately greeted, and our luggage was seamlessly taken care of. Front desk staff accommodated my early check-in and recognized my Platinum Elite status. The young man who checked me in went completely above and beyond. He provided a helpful overview of the property, great dining recommendations, and a tip to check out the hotel’s rooftop bar when it opened at 5:00 PM.The service didn't stop there. The luggage concierge escorted us up, unloaded our bags, and proactively offered to bring extra water and ice to the room. Both the room and all public areas were absolutely immaculate. During the stay, we utilized the gym, enjoyed the pool, and dined on-site—every single amenity exceeded expectations; additionally we had access to the executive lounge which had a variety of quality options for breakfast and great healthy snack options to hold us over between meetings and meals. I cannot wait to come back for a longer leisure stay.

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: 2nd Trip this year @JW Marriott Tampa Water Street
reviews.body: My wife and I decided to go back to the JW Marriott Tampa Water Street for the second time this year. We enjoyed our stay the first time around and this second visit didn't disappoint. As a Titanium Elite member they were nice to get us on a high floor with a very nice view. Very clean hotel and the staff all across the board are attentive to their guests thriving in providing good customer service. The hotel has all the amenities including coffee shops, bars, and restaurants with nice views. You have to try the buffet breakfast at the Driftlight Steakhouse there. This hotel is also conveniently located in the city center making it really easy to just walk everywhere. We'll be back!

reviews.author: Melanie and Alex
reviews.title: To feel SEEN
reviews.body: Eli with front desk. Donna and Lito with JW Spa, Lilet the host at Driftlight, Juan the bartender in the lobby, and all of the staff at JW..I am forever grateful for your hand in delivering a truly unforgettable birthday experience for my husband. You have no idea how much doing something like this for him meant to me. You will hold a special place in my heart for a long time. We have 5 children and don’t often get time to ourselves, so this experience was everything we needed to refuel and keep going. Thank you. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.title: One of our favorite places to stay.
reviews.body: Hotel is top-notch. Staff and customer service are excellent. Enjoy the Beacon Lounge and pool. Frequently visit to just to stay at the hotel and relax in the area.

reviews.author: AC 1973
reviews.title: Didn’t meet expectations
reviews.body: I originally was booked at the JW Marriott for two days for a business meeting and then my wife and I spent three more days that we booked on our own. Upon arriving, our room was not clean in the hallways have not been vacuumed or at least been vacuumed that day we arrived around 4:30 PM. Always stayed in that shape for the entirety of our trip with a plastic wrapper, etc. out on the floor in the hallway. Our room upon arrival there were many hairs in the shower as well as dried soap from another user. Our bedsheets potentially had been changed, but upon inspection, we were not convinced that they had been changed out. Also, the mirrors in the room were all dusty and magnification mirror had hair on it as well as an eyelash. Some of the furniture had definitely not been dusted in sometime totally not what we would expect from the Marriott especially the JW Marriott. At that price point, you would expect the room to truly be in perfect condition for incoming guest.

reviews.author: Anna from Tropical Tampa
reviews.title: Luxury without being pretentious
reviews.body: I am a Tampa local, but stayed at the JW Marriott for work. From the second you pull up, to the moment you leave, you feel welcomed. It has a professional vibe with quiet luxury. The staff is warm and friendly and anticipate your needs. The food at Driftlight and Beacon - delightful. Every day I returned to my room from long work meetings, housekeeping restocked my coffee (noting how many I used the day before, and giving me a little extra). Perfect fitness facility to get a solid workout in - and close to enjoyable running/walking around Tampa bay and the riverwalk. I'd come back for a staycation!

reviews.author: Unsatisfied Customer
reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.body: Although the front desk confirmed the multi-night visit was credited to my Bonvoy account, I have not received the points for the stay (3 weeks post visit). In addition, the rooftop lounge staff were not accommodating when it came to multiple people within our party splitting the check.

reviews.author: Clive
reviews.title: Great location and perfect rooms
reviews.body: Hotel has all one could want . Great rooms, views, amenities and location

reviews.author: Terry55555
reviews.title: Our place to stay when we are in Tampa
reviews.body: The hotel is wonderfully located next to the bay.  Service is top notch, rooms were clean and quiet and my kids and I loved the pool.  We are repeat visitors and will continue to make JW Marriott Tampa as our place to stay when we visit family.

reviews.author: Texas Traveler
reviews.title: Perfect for a relaxing weekend getaway
reviews.body: Quiet rooms, great views, excellent pool/lounge area

reviews.author: RJV743
reviews.title: Tampa's Finest
reviews.body:
We just returned from our trip to Tampa and our stay at the JW.  What a wonderful experience!!!

My wife and I had adjoining rooms with our daughter and our only grandbaby.  We came to Tampa for two primary reasons -- Wrexham game and to take grandbaby to visit her great Grandmother for the first time.  Very successful trip!  A big reason -- the beautiful JW, our room comfort, wonderful dining, very gracious, friendly, and professional front desk staffing.  

1.  Front desk / reception - from the check-in, to in between requests to check out.  Excellent personnel who seemed empowered, well trained, friendly, and professional.  The best I have seen in the US.
2.  Room comfort - rooms were well maintained, stocked with nice sundries, towels were fresh, and housekeeping excellent.  When we arrived, we were greeted with chocolate covered strawberries in the fridge in celebration of our wedding anniversary.  
3.  We dined each morning at breakfast.  The staff was always friendly and took great care of us, and in particular our granddaughter.  Food and omelettes were outstanding, from the variety and freshness.  Expensive, but great quality is worth the price.

Thank you JW Marriott Tampa for your leadership in making this such a wonderful place to stay!  Keep up the great work in empowering your teams to make customer experiences so positive.

reviews.author: Fred in Tampa
reviews.title: Tampa Disappointment
reviews.body: Beautiful rooms and views of Tampa. However, our Wedding Event was unfortunately during a motorcycle (Buffalo Soldiers) convention. I think they spent all their time idling their bikes form 0400-0900 each day. No rest possible. The staff is young, foreign, and inexperienced. Simple requests like getting gift bags to our out-of-town guests was met with objections. Half of the bags were delivered after repeated calls. Also, the phone system is a problem to reach a guest room when calling from outside the hotel. The Wi-Fi is unreliable. The on-site fees are ridiculous too.

reviews.author: Andres R
reviews.title: Not a real JW
reviews.body: The rooftop does not care for hotel guests. It is managed like a nighclub.

reviews.author: Dennis
reviews.title: Happy Return Customer
reviews.body: This hotel, located in the heart of downtown, provides excellent service and accommodations. From the moment you walk in the experience is simply outstanding. Everything from reception to room to available services is so great. Recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a truly unique get away experience.

reviews.author: Calypso
reviews.title: Restaurants are amazing, but I would sleep elsewhere.
reviews.body: The restaurants within the hotel are definitely worth coming back for. Unfortunately the quality of the bed, sheets & pillows were WAY BELOW high end expectations.

reviews.author: ARON
reviews.title: Everything great except the late night bar service
reviews.body: Everything about our stay was exceptional, except for our experience at the late night bar the service was painfully slow and without urgency for the customer.  It was disappointing, but after going to the Zac Brown concert, no food service was available at the bar.  The salad that we got from the office was good, but we wanted to hang at the bar and have snacks.

reviews.author: Kenny A
reviews.title: Tiki Bar Tour
reviews.body: Marriott does an excellent job

reviews.author: Zed 26
reviews.title: Best Pool in Tampa!
reviews.body: Not another like it in town!

reviews.author: C Barton
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.body: Excellent location, service. Breakfast buffet is excellent. Front desk help is always on point. We love the waterfront view

reviews.author: Wendy M
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.body: We loved our visit to this Marriott. Super clean, easy to check in, and tons of options for food right in the lobby area. Lona was a slam dunk, personally!

reviews.author: kmccain
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but not for overnight
reviews.body: The food at Lorna was fantastic and the hotel is well maintained, very pretty and close to the water. Unfortunately, the bed was hard as a rock and we did not get any sleep so I can’t recommend. This is a nice place to get drinks and dinner, but don’t stay!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Ms. Rhonda L Burgess
reviews.body: Excellent service from all

reviews.author: Business travel
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel in Tampa
reviews.body: Great hotel right next to convention center.  The amenities in the hotel were wonderful. The hotel was clean and staff was friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Mother and daughter trip
reviews.title: Clean, Friendly and Convenient
reviews.body:
We loved our stay. Anchor and Brine food and setting were delicious. Perk was convenient for coffee and quick grab stuff. The lobby was welcoming and decorated nicely. Nice place to sit with coffee or tea.  Staff was friendly and accommodating. The  2Q water front with balcony room was clean and comfy, and the view of river was beautiful.  Location was great for vising the U of 
Tampa and access to restaurants. Walking path on the river was great as well right out front of hotel.

reviews.author: MeMi Mohammed
reviews.title: Great Location & Friendly Staff, But Cleanliness Needs Attention
reviews.body:
Overall, my stay was decent, and the hotel is in a great location, especially for families. I was traveling with my children, and there were plenty of fun things to do nearby.

The room itself was decent, but there were some noticeable stains on the bedding and on the toilet seat. They didn’t necessarily appear dirty, but the staining was noticeable. In those cases, I would expect the bedding and toilet seat to be replaced or refreshed. The bathtub floor also didn’t feel as clean as it should have. It may have been sanitized, but it didn’t appear to have been thoroughly scrubbed.

There were also noticeable stains on the carpet in the hallway leading to our suite, which took away from the overall appearance and cleanliness of the hotel.

On a positive note, the front desk receptionist was very kind and helpful, and the valet team was great as well.

Overall, it was a decent stay with a convenient location and friendly staff, but I do think more attention to cleanliness and upkeep throughout the property would improve the guest experience.

reviews.author: Notchingit
reviews.title: Outstanding service
reviews.body: From the time of arrival to the hour of checking out of the Mariott, the service, food, cleanilness and staff were phenomenal.  I will definitely return and stay at this establishment.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Definitely will stay again
reviews.body: The hotel and amenities are excellent.  Location is within walking distance to all downtown venues and an assortment of great places to dine. The Riverwalk Terrace breakfast buffet (AYCE) at the hotel is top notch.  The service, staff and food selection were perfect.

reviews.body: Front desk doesn't pass information to the cleaning staff well

reviews.title: Hotel beautiful!  Food Price ABSURD!
reviews.body: FORGOT - BOTTLE OF WATER IN YOUR ROOM WAS $7.00!!!!

reviews.body: I will have to give it a poor review because of the number of infractions that I found on my stay.

reviews.title: First and Final stay at this location!
reviews.body: Substandard customer service….

reviews.author: Jeffnew
reviews.title: A nice resort in the middle of a dirty city
reviews.body:
Upon arrival ask them to explain what the ammenities are there and the water taxi and what the 35.00 a day charge covers.
If you don't bring a car check your bill upon check out to make sure they didn't charge you 59.00 per day for parking. 
The Anchor and Brine restaurant has excellent food and a beautiful view of the water way. Don't order a martini at this hotel they don't know how to make one. The 6th floor pool is nice at the JW accross the street. The Driftlight Steak house is good but they have no dress code which I find distrepectful to the people that make the effort to dressup. The 45day aged Ribeye was great and the carrot cake was off the chart.

reviews.author: Mauricio A
reviews.title: Great stay for. vacation in beautiful Tampa
reviews.body: Great hotel stay with incredible restaurants - great views of Tampa

reviews.author: Our Tampa Florida 2026
reviews.title: Perfect Tampa get away.
reviews.body: We have stayed in A few Marriotts. The Tampa location is Our favorite. This Marriott feels like a resort it’s in the heart of beautiful Tampa walking distance since everything around including the option to use the trolley. The restaurants on site are excellent. This was our first experience with wanting to stay longer the furnishing in the lobby are inviting and the vibe is perfect.

reviews.author: Michael L
reviews.title: Marriott Tampa Water Street
reviews.body: I can't say enough about this Marriott.  Our stay was outstanding from arrival to departure. Their staff is outstanding.  Smiles everywhere.  We were staying here the night before our cruise out of the Tampa Cruise Port and the property is across the street from a free public trolley that takes you directly there.  It could not be more convenient.  Highly recommend.  5+ stars.

reviews.author: Lanese A
reviews.title: Friendly Staff, Unmet Requests & Billing Questions
reviews.body:
I want to start by giving major praise to the staff—every single team member I encountered during my stay was fantastic and genuinely went above and beyond. Unfortunately, the room quality and overall administrative support did not match the level of service provided by the employees.
During my stay, I ran into several frustrating room issues:
 In-Room Amenities & Maintenance: Both the air-conditioning and the television in my room malfunctioned and ultimately couldn't be fixed. Eventually, I simply didn't have the energy to keep calling front desk support. The room also lacked basic amenities like facial tissues, and the pillows were far too thin. I had requested extra pillows at check-in, but they were never delivered.
 Elite Member Recognition: After my conference wrapped up, my return flights were significantly delayed. Given that the event was over and the hotel was quiet, I asked if I could extend my stay by just one hour. As an Elite status member, I was disappointed to be told there was zero flexibility unless I paid an extra $100 to $200.
 Billing Discrepancies: I currently have an unexplained extra charge remaining on my account that no one on-site has been able to identify or explain.
The staff’s hospitality was a bright spot, but between broken amenities, unfulfilled requests, strict late checkout fees for loyal members, and unresolved billing charges, the experience fell well short of expectations. I hope management can resolve the billing issue and address these maintenance gaps.

reviews.author: Peter T Burdge
reviews.title: JW Marriot Bonvoy 510 Water Street, Tampa
reviews.body: Excellent hotel, hotel room, hotel employees, hotel restaurants, 1 pool, rooftop lounge.

reviews.body: What a view! This is a great hotel.

reviews.body: Our national convention was held at this hotel and it was pretty decent. Some of the amenities such as the pool was not open due to renovations. The food options were limited also  so that was a hindrance late night.

reviews.author: Pleased customer
reviews.title: SGRHO Conference
reviews.body: From the time we stepped in the door the staff and atmosphere was beyond 10.

reviews.title: Marriott
reviews.body: Great place to stay if you are going to a show or anywhere downtown. Friendly staff and excellent location.

reviews.author: PK23
reviews.title: We Chose This Hotel for the Pool—Unfortunately, It Was Unavailable
reviews.body:
Marriott Tampa Water Street Stay Review

Our recent stay at the Marriott Tampa Water Street was disappointing, especially because this was a very special trip for us. We were having a girls’ getaway to celebrate turning 60 together, and our friends flew in from Chicago for the celebration.

My friends had stayed at the Marriott Tampa Water Street before and had bragged about what a great hotel it was and how awesome the pool was. Based on their recommendations, we chose this hotel instead of the JW Marriott, specifically because we were looking forward to enjoying the pool and spending time together during our celebration.

Unfortunately, upon arrival, we were informed that the pool was completely under construction and unavailable. This was extremely disappointing because spending time by the pool was one of the things we had specifically looked forward to as part of our birthday celebration. Had we known the pool would be unavailable, we would have made a different hotel choice.

We were offered a few points for the inconvenience, and while we appreciate the gesture, points were not what we wanted. We would much rather have had the experience we came to the hotel for—relaxing by the pool, enjoying cocktails, and celebrating our 60th birthdays together with our girlfriends.

Unfortunately, the pool closure was not the only service issue during our stay. When we arrived, we waited approximately 20 minutes for valet to receive our car, followed by another five minutes waiting for a luggage cart that never came. We ultimately had to struggle with our luggage ourselves.

Check-in also had a long line. Once we reached the front desk, we had a short wait for our room, which fortunately was not too long.

We were also disappointed to learn that the concierge lounge was unavailable, which was particularly frustrating as Marriott Platinum members. The lounge is one of the benefits we specifically look forward to when staying at Marriott properties.

There was also an issue with a simple room request. We called room service twice to request champagne glasses, and both times, wine glasses were sent instead. Having to make the same request twice and still not receive what we asked for was frustrating.

Overall, while the hotel may be a beautiful property, our experience did not live up to the reputation we had heard about or the expectations we had as Marriott Platinum members. More importantly, this was a once-in-a-special-moment birthday celebration with longtime girlfriends, and the unavailable pool took away from an experience we had been genuinely excited about.

We appreciate that the hotel acknowledged the inconvenience by offering points, but points cannot replace the experience we planned and came to the hotel expecting to enjoy. We strongly recommend that guests be clearly informed about major amenity closures—especially something as significant as the pool—before booking or upon making their reservation.

reviews.author: Chris1993
reviews.title: Great Meeting Location
reviews.body: Despite the fact, the hotel is going under serious renovations, we held a training there and it was fantastic. The hotel staff was very accommodating and friendly. They were alternate accommodations provided as the pool and fitness center were closed, that we took advantage of. I can’t wait to see what it looks like when everything is updated. The food was also very good.

reviews.title: UT VISIT
reviews.body: Great location, good time

reviews.body: Quiet hotel room in downtown Tampa

reviews.author: Erika
reviews.title: Peaceful and enjoyable stay
reviews.body: Got early check in, room was very nice and showed the water. The area surrounding was great and very walkable. Hotel is undergoing some renovations but I never heard any construction noise from my room.

reviews.body: The lack of hot water in our room due to construction/renovation issues was unacceptable

reviews.author: JenFL
reviews.title: Convenient Location and Beautiful Rooms
reviews.body: We were in town for a concert and stayed for 1 night. This is our second time staying at the Westin and the rooms have been beautifully updated since our last visit. The view is great, the location can’t be beat, and the staff is attentive.

reviews.author: F2Write
reviews.title: Conveniently located hotel with friendly staff!
reviews.body: Loved our stay at the Westin. Was so close to everything we wanted to do. Friendly staff. Rooms were spacious and beds were comfortable. Requeted extra towels that were delivered within minutes.

reviews.author: Josh V
reviews.title: Westin Tampa Waterside - Remodeled and Friendly
reviews.body: Westin Tampa WatersideLoved our stay at the Westin Tampa Waterside! The hotel has clearly seen some updates recently—our room felt fresh, modern, and beautifully remodeled. True to Westin’s reputation, the bed was exceptionally comfortable, making it easy to get a great night’s sleep.The standout feature, however, was the service. Every staff member we interacted with was remarkably friendly and welcoming. While the pool and fitness center were currently closed for renovation during our visit, the front desk team went above and beyond by proactively informing us upfront and providing nearby alternative options so we wouldn't miss a beat.Great service, great rooms, and a fantastic waterfront location. We’ll definitely be back once the new amenities are complete!

reviews.author: 1goodstay
reviews.title: Very accommodating and comfortable visit with a reasonable rate
reviews.body: Excellent stay reasonable rates and excellent staff

reviews.author: Todd M
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Very clean and nice. I really liked staying here

reviews.author: Not a happy camper
reviews.title: Avoid while under construction
reviews.body:
The extent of construction was not communicated -
No a/c in hallways, make shift gym and restaurants, construction hammering starting before 8am (but, eat plugs provided on your night stand…lol). Avoid until renovations are complete.

reviews.author: ConnectMeetingPlanner
reviews.title: Great Stay...Even With Renovations Going On
reviews.body: Westin Delivers on Guest Experience

reviews.author: fitz1229
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay and Outstanding Staff
reviews.body:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ **Wonderful Stay and Outstanding Staff**

My wife and I stayed at the Westin Tampa Downtown Waterside while dropping our son off for his first year at the University of Tampa. It was an emotional and exciting weekend for our family, and we couldn’t have been happier with our experience at the hotel.

The hotel itself was great—comfortable, clean, and a perfect location—but what really stood out was the staff. Everyone we encountered was friendly, welcoming, and helpful.

Two people in particular deserve special recognition. **Kim, who checked us in, was fantastic** and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. **Matt at the valet desk was equally impressive**—friendly, attentive, and always willing to help. Those little interactions really make a difference, especially during such an important weekend for our family.

Thank you to Kim, Matt, and the entire Westin team for making our stay such a positive one. With our son now attending the University of Tampa, I’m sure we’ll be making plenty of trips back to Tampa, and we would absolutely stay here again.

Highly recommend!

reviews.author: T A Hill
reviews.title: Stay during the 2026 AEAONMS & DOI Imperial Session
reviews.body: We had a great day during the convention. The room was one of the newly renovated rooms, and the amenities were very nice. I always enjoy staying at the Westin and the team at this location made sure that we had a great stay.

reviews.author: ARHB26
reviews.title: Great Location Downtown Tampa Bay
reviews.body: The Westin is a great hotel option in downtown Tampa Bay. It is in a convenient location, just across the bay, from the convention center. It is walkable to downtown restaurants.

reviews.author: Gus2026
reviews.title: Be aware of hotel Under Construction.  If you are looking to nice facilities Bar/Restaurant I do NOT recommend this property.
reviews.body: "My experience at this property was utterly unacceptable. My intention was to enjoy a relaxing lunch at the bar, but I was instead hosted in a windowless, temporary setup in a meeting room lacking proper food and beverage infrastructure. To offer such a compromised, sterile environment without prior notice demonstrates a severe lack of attention to guest comfort and standards. I expected a refined dining experience and left thoroughly unimpressed."

reviews.author: Guiseppe 1
reviews.title: Nice hotel great location
reviews.body: Weston is located on Water Street in the heart of shopping close to the trolley restaurants right on the water and also some water excursions available just over the bridge

reviews.author: Scoobdoo49
reviews.title: Enjoyed the Stay
reviews.body: Great property, friendly and helpful staff. Enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: No transportation
reviews.title: No means of transportation to the convention center
reviews.body: We had someone ,that really couldn't  take that walk. No transportation to and from Amtrak.  Called about situatio, was no help. It's  hard when traveling in a group and there's  no kind of transportation to the hotel.

reviews.author: Danni6424
reviews.title: Westin-Tampa Wsterside
reviews.body: This hotel is just how I expected. The only way it could be better is to add a microwave in the rooms. Otherwise, the hotel is clean and the  staff is extremely nice. We had a clogged sink and maintenance fixed it immediately. Also the hotel is in walking distance to the convention center and restaurants. If I ever come back to Tampa I will definitely stay at the Westin water side.

reviews.author: MGivens
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
reviews.body: Ms. Juddikay provided excellent customer service with a smile. Checked in on me when she noticed I selected no daily maid service. It was a great check in, as I needed towels. The towels were sent to my room within 10 minutes. Received a room upgrade as part of my Gold membership without requesting. I usually have to remind the front desk staff that I qualify and to check on availability. Requested late check out and was granted late check out without hesitation. Once again, it was always service with a smile.

reviews.author: TBBishop26
reviews.title: Great stay in Tampa Bay!
reviews.body: The Westin Tampa Waterside is a great location to stay and the remodeled rooms are really nice. All the staff was extremely nice and accommodating. Look forward to staying again soon!

reviews.author: DoDIIS
reviews.title: Not up to Par
reviews.body:
My stay at the Westin was unfortunately not up to the standard I have come to expect from the Westin brand. The hotel was undergoing significant construction and renovation during my visit, which negatively affected the overall experience.

My primary concern is that I was not made aware of the ongoing renovations prior to my arrival or at the time of booking. Had I known the extent of the construction beforehand, I would have elected to stay at another nearby hotel.

I understand that renovations are sometimes necessary to improve a property, but guests should be clearly informed in advance when the work may impact their stay. As a guest who selected the Westin based on the level of quality and experience I normally associate with the brand, this stay fell well below my expectations.

I hope the hotel will improve how it communicates renovation activity to future guests so they can make an informed decision before booking.

reviews.author: DemAtMarriott
reviews.title: Latest Stay
reviews.body: This is a property I regularly stay at when I am Downtown Tampa near Harbour Island. Great location. This property is currently under renovations. They have setup alternate dining and gym facilities which are OK. Marketplace is decent. No Bonvoy lounge or benefit I was made aware during my stay.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Renovation
reviews.body: Due to renovation, under the circumstances you guys were very grateful and supporting the restaurant and bar accommodation

reviews.author: Nym69
reviews.title: Disappointed & Overpriced
reviews.body: The only people I could imagine having a good time here are people who have more money than god and can spend excessive amounts of it on mandatory $50 nightly valet and all the restaurants you’ll have to frequent or else hunt down the one unicorn of a microwave in the entire hotel. I will never stay at this hotel again, and I hope that the convention I went to stops using them for their hotel block rates because it’s honestly embarrassing to travel for such a good event and have my lodging be this disappointing.

reviews.author: Satisfied Customer
reviews.title: Incredible Staff
reviews.body: I stayed at the Westin during a family emergency and I had issues with my third party booking website.  Kate at the front desk was incredibly helpful and compassionate and went above and beyond to help and show empathy and help me resolve the issues at hand.  People like that

reviews.author: Atlantan
reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.body:
OK. But did not live up to its name. I have had 10 times better experience dollar per dollar.
Not worth the price

reviews.author: Grad SGRHO
reviews.title: Very Underwhelming & Disappointing
reviews.body: This hotel cannot hide behind being under renovations as an excuse for poor service.  My roommate & I were very disappointed.  Our room was only cleaned once during our 5 days.  Neither the bathroom sinks nor bathroom tub had proper drainage. Found bugs crawling on the floor by the fridge & the iron was broken. When I asked to speak to management, they were non-present.  We were told late check out wasn't available until we reminded the staff of our room issues.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Worst Stay I’ve had
reviews.body: The hotel is under construction. During our time, we heard drills and banging starting at 7am (hotel said 10-5 noise). The AC was out in the entire hotel when we checked in, and we were not informed. Our TV didn’t work, and our room wasn’t cleaned for 3 days. All of this in a very expensive property. Go to the two hotels across the street and skip this one.

reviews.author: A pleased visitor
reviews.title: An excellent spot to start and end a dinner at Burns steak house
reviews.body: Perfectly located that compliments a dinner evening at Burns steak house

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.title: 100 star hotel for us
reviews.body: Darren worked with us and I am so appreciative! Front desk people 100 star, valet people 100 star, young lady  that cleaned our room 100 star… so all stars!!

reviews.author: Ali T
reviews.title: "A must stay"
reviews.body: My husband and I stayed here for his birthday and we couldn't have been more pleased with the overall experience. The front desk staff is unmatched when it comes to friendliness and service. We had cocktails at Edge, the rooftop bar and the bar staff was super helpful with info about local places- great drinks too! We loved the overall decor and vibe of the hotel and our room. Highly recommend staying here!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Exceptional Hotel/Service
reviews.body:
Really enjoyed my stay at the Epicurean Hotel. The hotel has a great atmosphere, feels upscale without being overly formal, and the staff was friendly and attentive throughout my visit.
The rooms were comfortable and well kept, and I really liked the character of the property. The location is also a big plus with plenty of great restaurants and things to do nearby.

Overall, it was a very enjoyable stay and definitely a place I would return to when I’m back in Tampa. Highly recommend if you’re looking for something a little more unique than the typical hotel experience.

reviews.author: Lulu
reviews.title: Perfect Location + Fantastic Food
reviews.body:
When looking for a unique and ideally located hotel experience Epicurean delivers. 
If you could get food overnight, I would consider the epicurean its own little world. My friends were OBSESSED with ChillBros. One had a pregnancy massage at the spa which she said was the best bday gift ever. 
Breakfast at Elevagé is amazing. Edge is super cool and fun and you can even order food from Elevagé at Edge. Epicurean is a tiny little paradise that I would love to live in. 
The service was excellent! When you first arrive valet is incredibly bright and friendly. The folks at the front desk are nice and helpful. 
Housekeeping was a bit of a hit or miss but the beds are amazingly comfortable and room service is fast and just as good as at the restaurant downstairs, wished it was 24/7!

Luckily Epicurean is located central to sooooo many great restaurants in SoHo like Berns and Bella's.
Definitely worth a visit if you are in town and great location + good eats are your priorities.

reviews.author: Joel Mott
reviews.title: Hotel should permit dogs.
reviews.body: Hotel does not accept dogs other than service dogs.  We have a 3pd. poodle and stay at the ritz Carlton another Marriott property when we travel with her. We saw several dogs at the Epicurean that I am sure were not service dogs.  Their conduct was not a problem and we think you should amend the policy.

reviews.author: Armando
reviews.title: Short stay for the family
reviews.body: Nice short stay to drop daughter off to college.  It was about a 25min drive to USF

reviews.author: Plant panther grad
reviews.title: Back on Bayshore
reviews.body: The Epicurean offers the finest in service, food and accommodations. Just a quick walk to Tampa's premier walking, running and biking Bayshore Blvd. To see the sun rise over Hillsborough Bay is amazing, as amazing as The Epicurean itself. And don't forget a evening at Bern's.

reviews.author: SMay
reviews.title: Stayvacation
reviews.body: Just love the Epicurean!!Great atmosphere!!The staff was very friendly!!Nice room!!Excellent food!!Easy 5 stars

reviews.author: Richard Katz
reviews.title: Epicurean Tampa is uniquely great place to stay
reviews.body:
Epicurean Tampa is first class in every respect.  You won't find a better appointed pool, for example.  Let me just tell you that you must stay at Epicurean Tamps at least once so you'll have a chance to carefully inspect and appreciate the artworks and accoutrements in the lobby area and around the Elevage dining area.  Not to be missed.  Not at all.
BTW Epicurean Tampa is across the street from Bern's Steakhouse.  I didn't know that until I got there, and I knew where Beren's is.

reviews.author: ASus
reviews.title: Great location - focus to detail needed
reviews.body: I have stayed at the Epicurean many times.  The staff is great - very attentive.  Focus on room details have slipped, specifically the bathrooms.  The mini refrigerator barely gets cold.  There are no laundry bags for service.  No robes - you have to request what should already be included in your room.  The food at the restaurants is always great.  The service is excellent.  As far as parking - valet should NOT be mandatory.  You should have the option to self-park.  If you are a UTampa parent visiting your college student - the hotel is a good location.

reviews.author: Scott C
reviews.title: Awesome Property and Service
reviews.body: We came down to Tampa for a long weekend and wanted a place to stay that was near downtown but quaint and quiet.  We couldn't ask for anything more!  The accommodations were top notch and the food / area around the property were second to none.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: JLM2026
reviews.title: Nice historic apartments
reviews.body: Nice facility with a good location

reviews.author: Cin676
reviews.title: Truly a class act…….
reviews.body: We were extremely pleased with staff service from front desk reception to the valet attendants.  Truly first class hotel ….!!

reviews.author: Elise
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Room was ready early. Nice pool and outdoor patio.

reviews.author: kjw222
reviews.title: Epicurean is epic
reviews.body: I've stayed at a lot of hotels in the course of my lifetime, but this one absolutely tops the list.  Being greeted with a glass of wine upon arrival was a special touch we greatly appreciated after a long drive. From its prime location in Tampa to its attention to detail/accommodating guests' comfort, my only complaint was not being able to stay longer than we did to enjoy the rest of what this hotel had to offer.  That being said, we will be making a special trip to return again soon!

reviews.author: Saucy
reviews.title: Foodie adventure
reviews.body: The food shattered my expectation!

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.title: Great hotel, but...
reviews.body: The spa overcharged me. That ended my trust.

reviews.author: Proud Bonvoy Member
reviews.title: Couples anniversary trip
reviews.body: We had an amazing stay for our recent anniversary. Customer service was top notch. The hotel was spotless. The balcony suite was amazing along with the hotel amenities. If you have a night out planned, which includes Berns restaurant- the hotel is conveniently located right across the street!

reviews.author: SFCook
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Everything was great! Room and staff. Little glitches and push back with breakfast delivery. Restaurant was reasonably priced and food was good.

reviews.author: Samantha W
reviews.title: So Unique
reviews.body: Such a fun experience. Very spacious room. Breakfast smelled amazing on our way out. We have to come back for a wine tasting.

reviews.author: Triay 50th
reviews.title: 50th Wedding Anniversary Stay
reviews.body:
We have enjoyed many hotels in the Bonvoy system. The Epicurean ranks among the best for three reasons:

1) The friendliness of the staff was exceptional.

2) The gift that we received in recognition of our 50th wedding anniversary was outstanding. 

3) The staff was able to answer all our questions. Our only request is to make the free eggs on the voucher better for breakfast. They tasted like powdered eggs. Everything else was very good.

We hope to return to this property very soon.

reviews.author: HappyazzaClam
reviews.title: FANTASTIC AS USUAL..!!!
reviews.body: Staff, Amenities, Decor appointments, Cleanliness, Food and Drink, close to BERN'S,  ... ALL AMAZING...! THANK YOU..!!

reviews.author: Jodie
reviews.title: Amazing experience.
reviews.body: The hotel was very clean with friendly and polite staff.

reviews.author: Ray Combs
reviews.title: Love this spot
reviews.body: The staff is incredible and the location is next to so many spots! Very vibrant

reviews.author: NDixon
reviews.title: Great place to stay in the heart of it all
reviews.body: This was a great stay for our anniversary.  The staff was amazing and went out of their way to make sure our stay was special.

reviews.author: Tammie
reviews.title: A Wonderful Delight
reviews.body: As a travel professional,  we have experienced hotels across the globe and this property, from check-in to accommodations and hotel restaurant, is one of the best!

reviews.author: Andrew Workman
reviews.title: The Upmost Hospitality
reviews.body: The staff was amazing, the hotel was clean and well thought out. The epicurean theater was a WOW moment and a night to remember. Thank you for a memorable night :)

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.body: Great place to stay, clean rooms, nice restaurants, friendly staff.

reviews.author: YeliR
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.body: The hotel was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The staff was very friendly and provided excellent service throughout our stay. We had a very pleasant experience and would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Wrights date night
reviews.title: Was not happy with the aloft
reviews.body: I paid for aloft they have me a room my food spoiled in the cool box. My drinks stayed hot the whole weekend I'll never stay there again for the money I paid we was not happy

reviews.author: Solo wedding travels
reviews.title: Tampa
reviews.body: Excellent hotel for the price point. Excellent location as rion for great restaurants

reviews.author: Freshman Drop Off
reviews.title: Freshman drop off
reviews.body: Great location, beware of room style if traveling with teenager. Some rooms the shower is not closed off so if you're in the main area no privacy. Other rooms at this location the shower and toilet are closed off by a door.

reviews.author: DaniM
reviews.title: Because hotel
reviews.body: This a beautiful hotel, great pic, very clean and nice staff!!

reviews.author: Go Bucs 4
reviews.title: Aloft was wonderful
reviews.body: Very nice view was amazing on the roof top pool

reviews.author: AwesomeHuman
reviews.title: Hotel great, parking options not so much
reviews.body: Everything was pleasant during my stay and the hotel is situated in a nice walkable small scale area. I could not give this a 10 or excellent rating due to the cost of the only option for parking which was valet. $50 a day was excessive considering its other venues located  on a river front or water front with much more city options charge the same amount. I expect that in a downtown location not this small scale area.

reviews.author: Beans W
reviews.title: Very the same vibe as mid-town
reviews.body: Very outdated and felt dirty.

reviews.author: BamaQueen
reviews.title: Do better about your breakfast situation.
reviews.body: I paid to have breakfast. Your hotel has two sides, so how am I supposed to know that “the breakfast is for the OTHER side”? I went down to grab a couple muffins, yogurt, and OJ. I didn’t have enough hands so I took it upstairs with plans to come down to get water. Well, when I went back down, the door was pulled closed to the “OTHER” side with a sign stating that breakfast was for them. I asked the attendant, who was friendly, but told me OUR breakfast is per pay on the ALOFT side. I told him I’d paid for breakfast as part of my stay and was told we had to order ours and that the continental style was for those staying with the Element. The attendant at ALOFT told me that if I paid, I can eat breakfast at either. The point is, we are in adjoining hotels and it shouldn’t matter! A person shouldn’t feel “less than” because of the side of the hotel they stayed at. Also, put hand soap dispensers in the rooms.

reviews.author: MattD
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.body: Amazing service - I will be back

reviews.author: Nita
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
reviews.body: The staff at Aloft Midtown Tampa were so kind and accommodating. Steve checked us in and was super helpful for any questions or requests we had. All of the staff was eager to help in any way that they could. The rooftop restaurant/bar and pool were amazing! The location was perfect! Many shops and restaurants/bar in the same area.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: John
reviews.body: Everything was fantastic all the way from the pool to the rooftop bar rules are beautiful only issue was the parking $52 a park

reviews.author: Tina D
reviews.title: Unique hideaway conveniently located to EVERYWHERE
reviews.body: Best hotel we have stayed at, with exception of Renaissance in Orlando.  Very quiet, very quaint, and staff is over the top accommodating.

reviews.author: Jess
reviews.title: Night stay
reviews.body: The hotel was nice and clean but o am very unhappy about the wrong information I was given I booked a room here to watch the fire works and then when that time came they told me I can’t go to the patio to watch the fire works after they made me wait till nine now at 9:30 I was told forget it they change thier mind due that they was over the event that was happening there and they where all rude about it

reviews.author: Hiway
reviews.title: Bad Room
reviews.body: They put me in a bad room. Outside the windows were the air condition compressors. The HVAC system in the room did not work properly. It would never stabilize and alternate between heat and air-conditioning. Also, the fan speed would turn on high and then entire unit would rattle very loudly. Did not allow me to have a good night sleep.  You would think a gold level member would be assigned a better room.

reviews.author: Tampa
reviews.title: Tampa trip
reviews.body: It’s a very nice area and venue but there was issues staying there

reviews.author: J545
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: Me and my cousins came to Tampa for a girls trip and when I say this hotel did not disappoint! From the front desk clerk and soo many amenities it literally was the best Girls trip EVER also it was very clean

reviews.author: Juan
reviews.title: Charged the incorrect credit card on a corporate account
reviews.body: Charged incorrect credit card and now I'm struggling to get reimbursed when I traveled for a company meeting.

reviews.author: CoCo
reviews.title: Aloft Tampa Midtown is an excellent hotel with great amenities and staff.
reviews.body: David and the entire staff went out of their way to make our stay memorable. We really appreciated the effort they put in. Location is great and made attending spring training games a breeze. Plenty to do at the hotel and in the area, highly recommend.

reviews.author: Paul F
reviews.title: A fun environment for a conference or a family vacation
reviews.body: This is an awesome venue for a conference in area that provides for so much more when you are finished in meetings!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: perfectly fine.
reviews.body: This is a pretty nice hotel. The breakfast is average and the valet parking people are not very helpful but the gym is very good.

reviews.author: physwiz69
reviews.title: Awesome Hotel
reviews.body: Great place to stay in Tampa midtown.

reviews.author: TravelDOC
reviews.title: Good location
reviews.body: Great location at midtown center with multiple restaurants within walking distance. Typical Aloft brand layout of rooms and amenities. Valet was quick

reviews.author: Rennie96
reviews.title: Easy Hotel
reviews.body: Practical and convenient hotel accommodation and services. Great gym facilities, self service laundry and self service F&B areas.  The only disappointment I had during my stay was the service and quality of the cocktails at the roof top bar. Badly made cocktails and sloppy service.  I will definitely go back to this hotel in the future but don’t think I will consider visiting the hotel rooftop bar and restaurant again. All other areas of the hotel were superb.

reviews.author: Ursula
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: The location was great, there are a lot of options for food and some shopping near by. The stay would have been perfect if the room was a bit cleaner. I was a little grossed out by the random stains on the walls.

reviews.author: Cat
reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.body: Double charged for stay. Told the second charge had been reversed. Eight days later still no correction. Also avoid the wxyz bar. Terrible service. Rooftop bar and food was great.

reviews.author: Noname
reviews.title: Beware of the Valet Department
reviews.body:
Upon arrival I asked if there was a parking garage that I can use without having to use their Valet Services.  I was misinformed by the valet attendants that there was not and that my only option was to Valet Park my car at a cost of $45./night.  I reluctantly acquiesced and paid to park my car overnight.  Upon further investigating I discovered that the parking garage across the street was free to the general public and that vehicles were allowed to park there overnight.  Prior to checking out of the hotel I asked for a copy of my parking folio only to receive an e-mail from the 3rd party Valet Vendor stating that I had been charged $496.00 for one night's parking.  After several unsuccessful attempts to contact someone at the Valet Management Firm I decided to drive to the hotel to speak directly with manangement.  Upon arriving at the location I parked my car downstairs in the short term parking zone (15 min or less) and as I got out of my car was informed by the Valet attendant that my spot was for Valet only.  I informed them that the signage read that hotel guests were allowed a 15 min grace period and that I was heading up tp speak with management regarding my bill.
