Upon returning to my vehicle 9 min and 38 seconds later I discover that the Valet attendants had called the public parking meter attendant who was in the process of writing me a ticket, 
The lies and deception carried out by this Valet Parking Services are costly and certainly are something to consider before you book your next stay at this location.

reviews.author: Kutch
reviews.title: Nice Place to Stay
reviews.body: Location, location, location. In the center of fun restaurants and shopping. Rooms were sporty and comfortable. Lobby fun and approachable. Staff, present and helpful. All and all, nice place to stay.

reviews.author: ShayB
reviews.title: One awesome night
reviews.body: The Aloft was what you can always expect. A step above. I love this art deco hotel. My last stay was in Austin. They're the same all over....A1

reviews.author: 1 solo trip
reviews.title: A solo trip
reviews.body:
My hotel stay was absolutely the best I've ever experienced. From check-in to check-out, the hotel staff were highly attentive, friendly, and professional. They promptly answered all my questions, providing detailed and helpful responses. The complimentary breakfast was exceptional, featuring a variety of fresh fruit, freshly baked pastries, and rich, freshly brewed coffee, all of which were absolutely delicious. 

I would recommend this hotel to everyone who's visiting Tampa

reviews.author: VG
reviews.title: Nice getaway
reviews.body: We come in for the lightning games with locals and we enjoy staying at the loft

reviews.author: Aniyaher
reviews.title: A&N Stay at Element Tampa
reviews.body: We had another amazing stay at Element celebrating my boyfriend’s birthday! This was our 5th time visiting and staying here, and somehow they never disappoint.

reviews.author: Cj Brooklyn
reviews.title: The Hotel is Great. Parking a disappointment!!!
reviews.body: The hotel itself is very nice, however the parking situation is unfortunate. It's enough that you're being charged for less than 24 hrs a day in a room (ie. check in 4pm - check out 11am) and charging people for a later check out, in addition to force people to valet park @ $40 a night. People barely scraping money together for a vacation and then to be nickeled and dime'd is sad.

reviews.author: ttommytutu
reviews.title: HIghly recommend
reviews.body: HIghly recommend! The staff was very friendly and thoughtful about my stay. The location is within walking distance to many restaurants and shopping.

reviews.author: Gordon
reviews.title: Great Location, Friendly Staff, Fun Place to Stay
reviews.body: Would recommend this to anyone visiting Tampa

reviews.author: Gui F
reviews.title: Amazing Stay at the Element in Midtown Tampa
reviews.body:
Amazing staff
Great breakfast and food 
Large rooms 
Very clean 
Wonderful location smack dap in Midtown
Sam Chambers is an amazing Director of Operations

reviews.author: Trung
reviews.title: Consistent Quality
reviews.body:
I have stayed at a number Element Hotel and this like many of the others have been great! Customer service is fantastic. Rooms are spacious and reliable. Breakfast is offered. Didn’t use the gym but it was accessible. Water pressure in the shower was fantastic!

It was weird needing to take the elevators to the 6th floor and the doors opening on the opposite side to get to the front desk but I figured it out fine.

reviews.author: jjtracy
reviews.title: Fine hotel but be careful! The valet parking is a ripoff
reviews.body: The hotel is clean, updated, and in a good location at the Tampa Midtown shopping/dining/office complex. But, the only parking option they promote is valet parking and it is $50 per night! If you are willing to walk a block or so, you can park for free on the second level or above at the Midtown parking garages.

reviews.author: Bonvoyage
reviews.title: Nightmare hotel
reviews.body: Our stay was awful. The first room we checked into was filthy. There was hair everywhere. The toilet was never cleaned. It was disgusting. The AC wasn’t working at all. We had a baby with us so we had to lug all of our belongings back to the front desk, there was only one elevator working and the elevator goes to upper floors before lower floors no matter if you push the lower floor button before another person. We got to the front desk so they could change our room and the second room we went into was also dirty and smelled terrible. We didn’t want to lug our stuff all the way back downstairs again, especially because they put us in a room that took us forever to walk to after we got out of the elevators mind you while carrying a baby and our luggage. We went to take a shower and the soap was completely missing. This was after being inside the shower and had to get out without getting washed. We called down to the front desk to see if someone could bring it up and after an hour we had to call back again to see if somebody was on their way or not, and then another 15 minutes, went by and somebody showed up at the door with a small bar of soap. Terrible terrible experience. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. Also, I had a charge on my credit card and I tried to call the hotel to see what this charge was for and nobody ever answers the phone. I’ve tried calling for four days now and somebody instantly puts you on hold as soon as they pick up the phone and that’s even if they decide to pick up the phone.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Element Midtown Tampa
reviews.body: Great little hotel in a great location with lots of food options

reviews.author: Disappointed traveler
reviews.title: You may not get the room that you reserve!!!!
reviews.body: I was given a lower class room and told my level of room was not available, although it was currently available on line for new bookings.

reviews.author: Neil P
reviews.title: Great hotel with a great location
reviews.body: Everything was fine. Parking is a problem. Only offered Valet parking. Not ok. Cost over $150 just to park at a shopping mall location in a suburban neighborhood. As a Marriott Bonvoy Member maybe offer free or discounted parking.

reviews.author: M Davis
reviews.title: Element Midtown Review
reviews.body:
Great hotel in a great location with so much within walking distance. Front desk staff was friendly, though no recognition of being a Bonvoy Elite member at check-in. 

My only negative feedback is the lack of service on the housekeeping side. While we didn't want/request full service during our stay, we did request both extra towels and toilet paper (the extra roll left in the room had been exposed to water and was unusable). When neither ever showed up at the room, we were forced to hunt down a housekeeper and grab them for ourselves.  Based on past experiences, we expect more from Marriott. 

Otherwise, a good stay overall and a special shout out to the bartender at Sal Y Mar. Fantastic service and incredibly friendly. Keep up the good work.

reviews.author: Crissie
reviews.title: Very Clean!
reviews.body: Everything was very clean. The fitness center and the pool were top tier. The breakfast was lacking though

reviews.author: Jan Marie
reviews.title: My Go-To hotel
reviews.body: We love the Element brand. The hotels are modern, classy and the staff is always kind, professional and helpful.

reviews.author: Ella70
reviews.title: Impossible to rest
reviews.body:
- No noise protection. I had Room 220 and the gym classes woke me up at 7 and 6 am every morning. Thought I'd catch a nap before my event, and there was ANOTHER class at 3 PM. Unbelievable. It was incredibly loud and clear, I could hear the instructions. I was exhausted. Outrageous rates for no rest. 
-No railing in the shower, just glass and wall. Dangerous when the floor gets slippery from soap. 
-Pillows were thin and flat, not what I've experienced in other Marriotts. 
-Mobile key doesn't work all the time. Will take several tries in elevator and in front of door. Not the safest. 
-No hotel store for forgotten essentials like charging cables, sunscreen, etc. 
-Valet prices are scammy. They tell you there is surge pricing in effect which apparently means they can charge whatever they like, on TOP of a surprise $15 "service fee", without informing you. The parking garage is right there and could EASILY be used by hotel guests. It's just another opportunity to rip off patrons. 
-I will not be back.

reviews.author: Laura P
reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.body: I reserved a suite and was given a basic room, i was told they had oversold the suites for a wedding and there was nothing they could do. I was only told this after i checked in and discovered the room was not a suite so i had no ability to make other arrangements. My husband and children all had to share a single bed. We were also in a hearing impaired room directly next to the elevator and heard drunk people coming in all night. No one slept. I was not given any refund or compensation for this mistake and inconvenience. A terrible experience overall.

reviews.author: JKM07620
reviews.title: Wonderful Staff and Facilities
reviews.body: The tone was set by the most courteous and friendly gentleman in reception.  Hotel is very clean and comfortable.  Minutes from the airport and universities as well as Riverwalk and other sights.  Definitely a hotel I will return to in the future.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Tampa
reviews.body: Great location. Nice rooms. Nice people

reviews.author: C Archer
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: Love the location. Near everything.

reviews.author: Lindsay
reviews.title: Very attentive and helpful staff
reviews.body: When we unexpectedly had to stay in Tampa due to an airline breakdown in the transportation of both us and (arriving days later) our luggage, the staff was considerate and helpful throughout.  Everything was clean, worked well and there were no issues.  The location was excellent and what was a difficult situation was made far better thanks to the people here.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Do Not Stay at this hotel
reviews.body: As a long time Marriott customer and Platinum Elite level member, this was by far the worst hotel I have ever experienced.

reviews.author: Juan
reviews.title: Evening at Berns with Family
reviews.body: Great place to stay!! Clean,Beautiful, Spacious, unique!

reviews.author: lauraCT
reviews.title: Great stay for daughters Soccer Tournament
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel, and very accommodating staff.  Hotel location is amazing surrounded by different restaurants, and fun to walk around different retail spots.  Room was very clean and quite, and breakfast was enjoyable every morning.

reviews.author: Chef Boyr E
reviews.title: Great visit
reviews.body: Great hotel, visit, excellent location and great people.  Upscale neighborhood and great shopping walking distance. There is even a WholeFoods.

reviews.author: Burkrad
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay in Midtown
reviews.body: The Element is ideally located in midtown and within walking distance to good restaurants.  The rooms are nice and clean.  There is a very nice rooftop bar.  Morning breakfast is excellent.

reviews.author: Robert Baker
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.body: Everyone and everything was great.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.title: Business Travel
reviews.body: Great atmosphere at the roof bar, great and friendly service

reviews.author: Indira B
reviews.title: Simply delighted!
reviews.body:
I had an incredible stay at the Element Marriott in Midtown Tampa! The front desk service was exceptional — John and Cinthya went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect from the moment I arrived plus they found a charger for my phone that was dead!!!

The breakfast area was just as impressive. Janela, Isel, and Silvia took such great care of me each morning and truly brightened my day with their kindness and attention. The food was great, but their service made it even better.

Highly recommend this hotel for outstanding hospitality and a genuinely welcoming experience!

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Comfortable stay
reviews.body: I enjoyed my stay at this hotel. The staff is always friendly and welcoming. The rooms are very nice and clean. I make it a point to stay here when I visit the area.

reviews.author: BRN
reviews.title: An average stay in an expensive area
reviews.body: As a longtime area resident, returning home for a visit, I chose a Marriott property because as a Bonvoy member, I usually enjoy the stay. This property is fair-to-average, with sometimes unclear navigation, a mediocre included breakfast, and a horribly expensive valet-only parking area. In the city, valet-only might be expected. But in this midtown area, which is still relatively isolated, it’s unreal. The lobby is on the sixth floor, for some reason, which seems like a minor thing until you realize how often you hit the wrong button when trying to get there from your floor. Checking in with the mobile app is normally simple, but this property seems to struggle, and the instructions on using the valet were unclear. Requested maid service didn’t arrive. They may have come by before we made it out of the room that morning, but that would have been relatively early. Overall not a terrible stay, value for the price was fair, but if you are driving, I’d find a property with parking.

reviews.author: Nakia Foots
reviews.title: Good but 2 flaws
reviews.body: Such a beautiful new property if u want peace in vegas this is it. Very clean spacious hotel

reviews.author: DessertGirl
reviews.title: Beautiful Property and Wonderful Staff
reviews.body:
I wasn’t sure about staying at the Element and only stayed 1 night to give it a test. I was beyond amazed that this property was beautiful, smelled good, clean and had a wonderful staff. Shout out to Lauren, Bri and Jordan they answered all of my questions and were very helpful. Give them a bonus!

I stayed in room 4113 which is an 1 bedroom suite and when I say suite that is was and it was beautiful. 

I travelled with friends but we stayed in our own rooms and we felt safe in the hotel and area.

We were disappointed that we were changing hotels and wanted to stay , but we decided we will be back with our families.

We walked to Fremont Street which was only about 10 minutes and we felt safe. 

Overall I recommend going this location if you want to be downtown Vegas without the noise and foolishness but close enough to enjoy.

We also walked to the Outlet mall which took less than 10 minutes. 

Yup that’s his is my new downtown Vegas location.

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.title: Very new and clean
reviews.body: All staff are nice !  The room is very clean and comfortable ! Parking lot is security

reviews.author: Holly L
reviews.title: Newer hotel in the heart of a homeless encampment
reviews.body: Hotel is right next to a homeless encampment with lots of transients roaming around. Walking around the outside of the hotel or to Fremont Street (0.5 miles) was unsafe and no shuttle service or security was provided.  Only the front / main entrance is accessable, no other exterior doors/entrances are accessible even with a key card, making transporting luggage thru drive lanes difficult.

reviews.author: Vanguard Family
reviews.title: Elegance meets Affordability
reviews.body: This is a premium property with dynamite service and exceptional pricing.

reviews.author: Susie
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: The hotel is not near the Las Vegas Strip; however, free shuttle to Freemont Street was great.  The food service was excellent in breakfast area and at restaurant and Starbucks.  Staff was friendly; however, I was a little disappointed that I did not receive my $25 slot play and Free drink tickets on arrival.  I received upon check out and was allowed to use the slot play, but missed out on the free drinks.  Overall, I would highly recommend this hotel.  Also, was accessible to outlet mall across the street for some excellent shopping.

reviews.author: A Marriot regular
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.body: Poor service and lot of mistakes. disappointing.

reviews.author: Jonathan Oliver
reviews.title: The NEW AC/Element at Symphony Park; a “hidden” gem
reviews.body: The new AC/Element by Marriott at Symphony Park in Las Vegas, is a clean and nice (and affordable) Marriott product that has me keep coming back. I’ve stayed at dozens of different properties on and off Strip over the last 20+ years, and having this quiet, clean and new Marriott product as an option, is a very welcome alternative that I find myself booking time and time again.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.title: Recommend staying here
reviews.body: Room was very clean, bed was amazing and the free breakfast was delicious but above all the staff were very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: If you’re looking for a quiet, non-Vegas style stay, this is it! Great location across from the World Market Center and near the outlet mall. Pool and fitness center were clean and a great addition to the stay. Michael at the front desk was amazing! Breakfast and food at the restaurant were all top notch!

reviews.author: Happy traveler
reviews.title: Happy traveler
reviews.body: Entire was excellent! Service, food, pool, amenities were all excellent.

reviews.author: Carmen
reviews.title: Loved it for the most part
reviews.body: My only review is that i dont think they cleaned my room every day, wasnt sure if this was on purpose or what. but overall experience was excellent!

reviews.author: Tm6798
reviews.title: Worst hotel ever
reviews.body: My room was filthy hair everywhere and the ac did not work

reviews.author: Blank
reviews.title: Pre Anniversary
reviews.body: The staff was great and made you feel like a valued guest .From Annie and Angie at the front desk to Mateo , Sandra and Mayra at the breakfast area.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Excelent price x.benefit
reviews.body: I ll come back to this hotel!

reviews.author: SummerVacation
reviews.title: We love Marriott
reviews.body: We were looking for a clean, comfortable, and safe place to stay in Vegas for our family vacation. Element by Marriott turned out to be an excellent choice, exceeded everything we had in mind.

reviews.author: No Doubt 45
reviews.title: It was good, could have been better.
reviews.body: The hotel was beautiful and clean. The air-conditioning needs to be adjusted. It is on a timer and a sensor so it turns off after no movement which when you’re sleeping at night in your bed then the air conditioner completely turns off and the room starts to heat up. We had to wake up every two hours to turn the air-conditioning back on which definitely affected our sleep cycle.

reviews.author: JMc1111
reviews.title: Beware ! There are rooms behind the billboard in front.
reviews.body: Some rooms are claustrophobic

reviews.author: Mariana
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.body: Loved the hotel. The decor is tastefully modern, the room was comfortable and quiet, the staff very nice and the location great. I'd definitely come back.

reviews.author: Gypsyflys
reviews.title: Wish more hotels treated and offered guests this experience
reviews.body: From my arrival and a friendly greeting with the offer of complementary wines and cheese to my departure of a complementary breakfast with healthy choices, and a front desk with a smile and an invite to come back. The property was well appointed very clean, well maintained and just felt so comfortable. If you’re in Vegas, I highly recommend the element. It was also nice to be off the strip, but have the strip within easy distance.

reviews.author: Morgan04
reviews.title: Enjoyed my stay!
reviews.body: Upon checking in, Thomas, was extremely friendly, professional and knowledgeable. I was there for an event at the World Market Center which is across the street. The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. Gym is large with a lot of options. The pool is small, so if that is important to you, perhaps seek alternate hotel. The continental breakfast was fresh and delicious. Starbucks is located in the hotel for an afternoon pick me up! The restaurant had a small menu. What I ordered was so good though, I had it two nights in a row. My only complaint is that the restaurant staff is not exactly eager to serve. Waited quite a while, even sitting at the bar, for service. I was able to walk to Freemont Street for some 'Vegas' excitement. The area is newer and a lot of development appears to be in the works. I recommend and look forward to returning!

reviews.author: Alaska traveler
reviews.title: No distinguish signage like Resort World for wings to rooms
reviews.body: Walls are thun not Ideal if you have business to attend.  Request not near elevator.  Right next to elevator.  Restaurants breakfast was good.

reviews.author: Geoff
reviews.title: Great Location, But Not Great Hotel
reviews.body: I was working a convention across the street at the World Market Center. The location to the space can't be beat, which was great. However, for a brand-new hotel, there was room to be desired. The WiFi was inconsistent, only one elevator was working, and in my 5-day stay, my room was cleaned once. Additionally, being there for work means I needed a desk area with outlets etc. The desk in the room was really not comfortable, and not conducive to a work area that I needed. For the price, I really expected more.

reviews.author: KN1977
reviews.title: Avoid if you can.
reviews.body: Poor service, Housekeeping issues (even if its every 3rd day), careless staff

reviews.author: Becca
reviews.title: Cleanliness
reviews.body: Unsatisfied with the bathroom cleanliness when I got there it hasn’t been cleaned. They tried to get someone to clean it again but still not all the way clean. Hair in shower and used soap and towels.

reviews.author: JG1984
reviews.title: Missed the mark
reviews.body:
Super pretty, clean and new hotel. Room was really nice, very spacious, no complaints. 

Only issues were A. We asked for an extra blanket for our daughters bed, was told they’re really busy (zero people in the lobby when we checked in late) and the blanket never arrived. We ended up giving her our blankets off the bed and sleeping with a sheet. Not a huge deal but super annoying when you’re paying $300 a night for a room. 

And B. We went down for breakfast a little before 10am on a Saturday and they wouldn’t let us get anything because they said it was closed. Website says 7-10 on weekdays and 7-11 on weekends. Even with multiple people still getting food, they denied us stating it was over. I doubled checked Google and the website which I posted below and asked Nathalia at concierge and she very quickly dismissed my question and said “it’s 10am on weekends, sorry”.

Parking is also $35 a night, so there’s that.

reviews.author: Tena
reviews.title: New hotel, excellent service
reviews.body: Check in, check out were fast. Room were clean and spacious. Complimentary breakfast was delicious, I really love the omelette and waffles station. The hotel is about 15 minutes walk from the north premium outlet.

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.title: Nice quiet place to stay near downtown, but not too close.
reviews.body: The property is beautiful and the rooms were large and quite comfortable. We stayed in the Element half of the hotel, which I believe has better amenities than the AC half. The complementary breakfast was quite good. My only real disappointment was that the pool is much smaller than it appears in photos. Just one or two families there and all serenity is lost. I had hoped to spend more time there, but there were just too many people, and I'm only talking about like a dozen people and that was just too many.

reviews.author: Sastisfied
reviews.title: We Were Pleasantly Surprised!
reviews.body: We were not expecting a new, modern and clean hotel, with most amenities which were satisfactory!

reviews.author: Rosh C
reviews.title: Superb stay at arms length from the craziness of the strip
reviews.body: Spacious, new, well maintained rooms. Large beds, good water pressure in the shower, and kitchenette facilities in the room. Staff are super friendly. Location is close to the North Outlet mall - 10 mins away from the strip so close enough to action but far enough away to get a good night’s sleep. Breakfast is simple but super filling!

reviews.author: Glenn
reviews.title: Calm and relaxing vibes
reviews.body: Very calm and relaxing while staying here for couple of days.

reviews.author: JustG
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Great hotel that is reasonable in price, and gives you the highest quality in professionalism and hospitality. 5 stars!!!

reviews.author: Titanium in Texas
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.body:
The service was poor except in the bar.

I was  very annoyed with being an upper elite member with Marriott and not being provided at the Element  in the lobby. Would cost you all nothing to offer that to Titanium and above since you were willing to allow me to use it for $20 per person. In addition you provide no other breakfast option on the AC side. I went and spoke to the front desk but they didn’t care nor tried to provide a solution. I was just told no.

I had a problem with my bill and no one at the hotel has been response in attempting to assist me even reaching out to several members of Management including the GM.

I would not stay there again nor recommend the hotel to anyone if you care about service.

reviews.author: Truth74
reviews.title: Fun time
reviews.body: Great place to stay and relax

reviews.author: Sd44
reviews.title: Poor service stay
reviews.body: I was placed in a room that was absolutely filthy with bloody shades and had several issues get with my room keys working having them have to be re-keyed. The overall state was very inconvenient. I will not go back.

reviews.author: Happy
reviews.title: So Convenient!
reviews.body: Amazing hotel and right across the street from World Market Centre which is fantastic!

reviews.author: Nancy
reviews.title: Nancy
reviews.body: Nice new hotel with amazing staff! loved that the brooms are not comforted, and are very spacious and comfortable. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rahimova
reviews.title: Exceptional Stay
reviews.body: AC Hotel Las Vegas Symphony Park delivers exceptionally well on this promise. The hotel has a beautiful, modern European-inspired atmosphere that feels sophisticated yet comfortable. The food and beverage experience was one of the highlights of our stay—the restaurant food was flavorful, beautifully prepared, and genuinely impressive, while the cocktails were creative, well-crafted, and just as good as those I’ve had at some of the more famous casinos in Las Vegas. The staff and entire team were exceptionally pleasant, welcoming, and helpful. The hotel is also exceptionally clean, peaceful, and smoke- and casino-free, creating a much more relaxing experience. Overall, it truly delivers a refined European-style hotel experience, and I would highly recommend it to others and would love to stay here again on my next visit to Las Vegas.

reviews.author: AH2395
reviews.title: Business Stay
reviews.body: If hotels charge us full amount and then they charge us "Resort Fee" but they do not want to clean your room daily. How greedy can these hotels get ? We litterly had to beg them to clean our room daily as they would only clean once in 3 days. Can we pay Resort fee for 1 out of 3 days?

reviews.author: glenndgov
reviews.title: Relaxing atmosphere
reviews.body: Convenient and comfortable stay

reviews.author: MG1969
reviews.body: It was an overall great experience, great location for what i was looking for.

reviews.author: Tom S
reviews.title: Tom S
reviews.body: Food service previously..this time disappointed..Breakfast at Element not a value at $25 ...sat at bar for 10 minutes with no service requested menu never received got up and left....Brittany Barris resturant supervisor went above and beyond to take care of getting food to me.  She saved the day

reviews.author: BenV
reviews.title: Undisclosed destination fee
reviews.body: Got charged a destination fee without being informed or published anywhere. Also got food and beverage credit from status that was not applied.

reviews.author: Abdul July 13 to 17th
reviews.title: Great experience at AC Hotel Las Vegas Symphony park
reviews.body: Very nice location. The front desk, resturant, and Bar and banquet team are very nice. Over great service! Thank you to Ash, Britany, Alessandra from restaurant & Tiffany from banquet.

reviews.author: Wendell S
reviews.title: Vegas if you don’t drink and gamble
reviews.body: AC hotel is a comfortable hotel with excellent dining and a great, relaxing pool. The hotel is excellent and exudes class and style. There is a free shuttle a half block away that drops you off at Fremont Street, the Las Vegas Premium Outlet Mall, and the Mob Museum. Starbucks is in the lobby for morning coffee. Walgreens is less than a mile away. I had the Vegas experience, talked to locals, took pictures of street artists, and ate way off diet (but the D.U.I. dog was worth it). My family and I visited the casinos and returned to AC for peace, and a full recharge, then did it again in Downtown Vegas.

reviews.author: WaltonS
reviews.title: Ready yourself for multiple charges pending
reviews.body: Stay here often but this time was not good as it relates to staff and charges. Not to mention I used points. I was charged three different days for $150 plus the $320 when checking in. Did I say I used points for this stay?! Unbelievable. Oh..and I received 2 different invoices..2 different amounts after checking out! We lodged here 7 full days and I had to call 3 of those 7 days.

reviews.author: Dominique Bullard
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: We stayed off the strip to avoid chaos but when attempting to enter our room Saturday a naked man lay outside our door unresponsive his genitalia fully exposed. My husband attempted to wake him and couldn’t so we rushed downstairs to the front desk to advise staff to seek emergency assistance we were met with no sense of urgency and had to repeat the concern multiple times. I also think it’s disappointing and an attempt to price gauge guests to charge $35 for parking when there is no other options but I suppose that’s why it’s done. I also want to understand why I was charge a ridiculous amount of taxes and fees for a stay I redeemed points for???!!!

reviews.author: Marty
reviews.title: A hidden gem
reviews.body: Just a 20-minute drive from all the popular attractions in Las Vegas, this hidden gem offers a captivating aesthetic, a trendy atmosphere, friendly staff, and a well maintained property. It’s an ideal location to stay and immerse yourself in the city’s vibrant energy without any hassle.

reviews.author: Taurus96
reviews.title: Serene
reviews.body: A solo getaway that reminded me how important it is to recharge, reflect, and simply breathe.

reviews.author: Jessy143
reviews.title: Hidden Fees Bad Breakfast
reviews.body: I was only suppose to be charged 35.00 for parking and I ended up with a 65.00 bill I paid for everything but parking in advance. Too many hidden fees then I wasn’t told about the 150.00 hold I had to ask and I had to ask about the disgusting breakfast and show proof that I paid for it so I felt like I was accused of being a liar in a sense. Breakfast was a waste of money hair in my food limit choices bad layout

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.title: Excellent Stay and Excellent Service
reviews.body: The rooms were great, the pool was clean, and the staff was amazing...Brian in particular was top notch.  Make that guy a manager.  I stayed here when work offered a more expensive hotel to see if I'd enjoy staying here in August on a personal trip.  Special shout out to the Starbucks crew as well.   I'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: D1L34T
reviews.title: AC Hotel is Fabulous
reviews.body: When I arrived, I was greeted by the concierge who had an amazing smile and was ready to assist me. Upon entering the hotel the design was unlike any other hotel I’d been to before, I seriously underestimated this stay. The pool area was beautiful,the band hall was great and the rooms were so clean and the bathrooms were beautiful with such beautiful lighting. I slept very well and the view from morning to night was amazing. Glad I was also able to go the the gym the next morning for a nice workout. It was my first time using the rowing machine, which was great! Thank you AC for this experience!!

reviews.author: Family Road Trip
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.body: Great place to stay. Close to downtown and other places.

reviews.author: Mike56
reviews.title: Staff was very unattentive
reviews.body: The breaker was tripped to our room that controlled the a/c and lights.  It took the staff an hour and a half to come reset the breaker that we didn't have access to.

reviews.author: Locals
reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.body: I recently booked this hotel for a staycation, and I was overly pleased with the cleanliness and hospitality of the staff.

reviews.author: Claire
reviews.title: Great stay at AC Hotel Las Vegas
reviews.body: Our stay at AC Hotel was pleasant. Geeeted with a smile at check in, everything went smooth. When we got to our room we did not have a luggage rack in our room. We called the concierge and they sent one up for us immediately. The pool was nice to relax at and we loved having a Starbucks there to get our morning coffee. Parking was close and convenient. The only issue we had is that we are not accustomed to not having our room tidied up every day. We did not realize this until too late in the day when we returned and saw no one had come. On our next trip we will request housekeeping for everyday upon check in. We have found our hotel for all stays in Vegas. Thank you for a great experience.

reviews.author: eyeTravel
reviews.title: Professional and clean. Immaculate!
reviews.body: From the first second walking in, to the last second walking out.. every detail and every staff member was exquisite. I felt safe in every part of the building including the parking garage. The food in the restaurant was flavorful and was made with quality ingredients. The cocktail menu was varied and classy, with great explanations (and tasted great!). I will definitely be staying here again.

reviews.author: CAK1
reviews.title: Overall good stay
reviews.body: Great location; easy access to strip/stadium. Friendly staff. Rooms could be cleaner. Also if a light sleeper beware you can hear neighbors very easily.

reviews.author: Jonathan
reviews.title: Vegas baby
reviews.body: A good place to stay—close to everything and with good service.

reviews.author: Platinum elite
reviews.title: Higher expectation
reviews.body:
The hotel is new and beautiful. I expected better information at check in. I wasn’t told where the pool was, fitness center, hours of operation for food service….
I expected the rooms to be very clean. The hotel is beautiful, but I feel that is more because it is brand new. The leadership needs to visually and physically be checking everything and guiding the staff on performance and expectations.

reviews.author: RevolorioBibis
reviews.title: Clean and good service place
reviews.body: The place in general is a good looking place, clean and friendly service. But It is a shame that rooms don’t have a coffee maker, or a microwave. Also the pool was not all clean, lots of planta and flowers in it and dirt at the bottom of it.

reviews.author: William J
reviews.title: First time, and will always be back
reviews.body: I can’t recommend this hotel enough. Off strip and off Fremont yet close to both. The property is in the Arts District and is adults only. The restaurant onsite is a fantastic destination for breakfast lunch and dinner. You are walking distance to many restaurants and bars. I will definitely be staying here again.

reviews.author: BenFromSeattle
reviews.title: Nice Quite Las Vegas Hotel
reviews.body: I arrived at ~2a on Saturday 8/22/2026 -- my jetBlue flight from BOS was three hours late. Argh. I got a good nights sleep, headed out about 0900, stopped at Bungalow for coffee/snack, then walked to The Strat, went up on the first elevator, enjoyed the views, and back down and walked to the MGM Grand. Over five miles in 97F-105F heat. Gatorade a lifesaver! I got a late checkout for Wednesday (1p, thank you!), had a few meetings, then got back in time to grab my bags and head to AUS. I appreciated the out-of-the-way location and the quiet. Thank you.

reviews.author: JTaylor
reviews.title: Good in Concept only!
reviews.body: Hotel needs work. Great Staff but I am not a fan of the bathroom design (extremely bad Design for the shower). Not even a iron or iron board was provided. The restaurant located on the property was okay, but it opens in the afternoon, No Cooked Breakfast available. Way, way overpriced menu.

reviews.author: Ethan
reviews.title: Great spot, great place
reviews.body: This is a great hotel in a fantastic Location. Staff is awesome. Hotel is great clean nice.

reviews.author: Travelers from UT
reviews.title: Good
reviews.body: Clean and friendly. Might checkout other hotels in area. Stay was fine.

reviews.author: JLD2026
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.body: This is a great boutique hotel in the arts district that is quiet, clean, comfortable and in a great location with walkable restaurants, cafes and shops.  It does have a casino which is our preferred style of a hotel.  Parking is easy and free.  Close to Arts districts restaurants, World Market Center and Outlet mall.  Rooms are comfortable and clean.

reviews.author: Beach All Day Guy
reviews.title: LVAD over the Strip
reviews.body:
Our stay at the hotel was fantastic. The front desk staff, Royce and Jorge, were incredibly gracious and welcoming from the moment we arrived. We also met the general manager, Steve Dennis, who was friendly, engaging, and clearly leads a great team. Fantastic job to all the staff!
The rooms were spotless, and we loved having a beautiful view of the pool from our window. The pool area itself is excellent, featuring great amenities like soft lounge chairs, umbrellas, and a clean towel station. As a major bonus, there are no resort fees and parking is completely free. Staying off the Strip at LVAD beats the Strip any day!

reviews.author: Sky2
reviews.title: It's not bad, but it's not up to Marriott standards
reviews.body: This hotel has a nice building, and is located near some excellent bars and restaurants, but it did not meet my expectations of Marriott properties, nor other Tribute Portfolio properties. This feels more like a good deal found on booking.com. The breakfast was the worst I've seen in years, and was entirely misleading to be told it was breakfast when I checked in. Its a snack bar comprised of nothing but sugary snacks from Costco, spread out on the lobby entry table. The rooms were off as well. Furniture that just didn't quite fit the room, and surprisingly difficult to find electrical outlets as most are already used by the rooms lamps, speakers, phones, and other electronics. Again, this is not a bad hotel, and some may like it, but coming from 10+ years of Marriott all over the globe, it did not meet my expectations. The potential is there for sure, but it needs structural changes.

reviews.author: J 76
reviews.title: Peaceful getaway
reviews.body: I truly enjoyed my stay at The English Hotel. The staff, lobby, pool, snacks and rooms are welcoming the minute you walk in the front door. It's walking distance from an amazing speakeasy and cigar lounge. Its a calm peaceful adult only hotel that I will definitely book when I need a getaway in Vegas.

reviews.author: Jenilee S
reviews.title: Overnight stay for work
reviews.body: My experience was great and will definitely stay again when in town for work. Customer service was fantastic, cleanliness was great and the breakfast and coffee bar were perfect.

reviews.author: Happy to have visited
reviews.title: An amazing weekend
reviews.body: Cannot wait to come back.  Location, staff, room comfort - it was all more than expected and for the price a true treat.

reviews.author: Erica
reviews.title: Wonderful boutique hotel in the Las Vegas arts district
reviews.body: If you want a lovely hotel away from the bustle of the strip with great staff and a fun vibe, this is your place. We will definitely come back

reviews.author: It had potential
reviews.title: Lack service and customer experience.
reviews.body: The hotter priced at over $400 a night was rustic, poorly served and lacks amenities.

reviews.author: Dana
reviews.title: very nice
reviews.body: love the easy check in, unlike a big hotel

reviews.author: Brian B
reviews.title: Trendy, boutique hotel for a more fun stay in Las Vegas
reviews.body: I stayed here to experience the Arts District to get away from the usual casino/resort experience. I will stay here over and over for future visits to Las Vegas. Even when I have a work conference on the strip, I will choose The English Hotel. It's convenient to resorts on the strip, but even more convenient to excellent dining and drinking options of the Arts District of midtown/downtown.

reviews.author: Clear and Happy 2026
reviews.title: I recommend staying here.
reviews.body: The hotel was everything they said it was. From the staff to how clean the hotel was. Very nice place to stay off the strip but close.  Also what they say the price is without hidden fees.

reviews.author: Drica Mello
reviews.title: Ok experience
reviews.body: Fantastic location in the hear of the Arts District and away from the Strip. Boutique hotel vibes, but no vibrancy in the details. The amenities feel a bit cheap. Comfortable bed and quiet rooms!

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.title: Love this hotel
reviews.body: EXCELLENT! Great staff, exceptional front desk service. Clean and extraordinary rooms that elevate your stay in vegas.

reviews.author: Clickedy
reviews.title: English hotel is a must stop when in vegas
reviews.body: Can't say more. Nothing to complain about

reviews.author: Lawrence
reviews.title: A great place to stay in the Arts District
reviews.body:
If you're looking for a comfortable and well-appointed place to stay in the Arts District, look no further than The English. Everything in the area is easily walkable and it's a short walk to Fremont as well. Keep in mind that the hotel is in the middle of the action during First Friday, but we found it quiet enough, even overlooking Main St.

Also, the hotel is lacking a gym.

reviews.author: Cody
reviews.title: Unique and Welcoming Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel was great. Unique layout, clean, and welcoming. I loved the welcome bag, and the comfort of the room. Parking is limited so be prepared.

reviews.author: brian
reviews.title: Great Place in Vegas just off the Strip
reviews.body: The hotel is located in a nice recently revived area.  It is a very clean and well designed boutique style location with an exceptionally polite and friendly staff.

reviews.author: Cap
reviews.title: Recommended stay off the strip
reviews.body: The English Hotel offers an interesting stay off the Strip for a night.  Room rates are reasonable.  In the Arts District with a quick drive to Downtown LV which is a must-see for 1st timers.  There is an incredible Sushi Brew Pub across the street, and plenty more interesting bars / restaurants in a short walk.  I wish the restaurant / bar at the hotel was open. Seems like it was under renovation.  Rooms were nice and clean.  Lobby seemed a bit beaten-up relatively.  The set-up for breakfast / snacks in the AM through noon was an enjoyable and differentiated addition.

reviews.author: Upset Elite Member
reviews.title: Big promises underperformance  and lack of communication
reviews.body: When Travelling for business you attempt to make it as pleasant as possible. To arrive and find that ZERO food and beverage is available for your stay and to be told that is not their problem - we only provide accommodation! No help was given to re accommodate me - as - City is very busy you know!

reviews.author: TComton
reviews.title: First time visitor
reviews.body: A very nice hotel! Parking is free! No entrance from parkinglot into hotel without walking around to the entrances. Front doormen are wonderfully friendly! As are the front desk staff! The hotel is smaller than I'd pictured,  same with the King Poolview room (recommend this), though VERY comfortable and clean! Love the ease of control for my room temp! Overall,  will stay there again,  when on short trips, less than 2weeks!😉

reviews.author: Platinum since 2001
reviews.title: The new English hotel is a great addition / 5 star hit - beautiful plants all around too :)
reviews.body: Great location / great hotel design - friendly staff - beautiful plants all around, what a great artistic touch - come stay and enjoy this one Marriott family ...

reviews.author: Lee Gold Member
reviews.title: Consulate General
reviews.body: Excellent location and Staff with a priceless bonus of being a adult only property, go cat ladies

reviews.author: Caz W
reviews.title: Business weekend in Vegas
reviews.body: Great hotel, comfortable bed, great shower, friendly staff, great neighbourhood.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.body: The hotel itself was very nice. The staff were friendly, the rooms were great and we appreciated the added security outside the doors. However downtown Las Vegas felt a bit sketchy, with quite a few homeless individuals in the area and not many people walking around like you’d expect in most big city downtowns. The hotel was also a bit pricey considering the neighborhood.

reviews.author: Dissatisfied
reviews.title: Marriott Las Vegas Springhill Suites
reviews.body: The Check-in Process was atrociously bad as there is no room at the entrance to accommodate multiple cars at once.

reviews.author: Vortex
reviews.title: Parking skam
reviews.body: Everything was good except for the parking scam.  Rooms were clean and comfortable and quiet. The view was also good.

reviews.author: No
reviews.title: Fairfield comfort
reviews.body: Found hotel an uncomfortable.  Entryway was extremely small making you park and pay for your parking .  Elevator for parking was at a different entrance from hotel.

reviews.author: ARod
reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service
reviews.body: Hotel charges us illegally for my sons service dog, random service charges and for smoking when we no one in our room or family smokes or vapes (we have two small children and I’m pregnant). What made matters worse is front desk manager Maddie was no help and said verbatim there was nothing they could do about charges and that there was no other manager (both lies) until I pushed and then said she would have the the general manager Ira call me back and low and behold even after sending messages and a formal complaint no response.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Nice Hotel avoiding Casino Pricing
reviews.body: This hotel is reasonably priced and good sized rooms that are furnished well.  The room I stayed in had a microwave,  coffee maker, and small refrigerator.  Bathroom is separated between toilet and shower which was nice.  It is located toward end of the strip and off the main road about 2 blocks but easy enough to walk to the monorail if you desire.  Would recommend this is you want to avoid staying in a casino and the prices.

reviews.author: Claude
reviews.title: A week in Las Vegas
reviews.body:
Despite some of the reviews we read before travelling to the US, I have to be honest I done understand the reason for people dissatisfaction.

We've been welcomed, looked after with promptitude and wirh a smile. The room was made daily despite the fact that we were trying to minimise the impact on the team. We had a nice view from our room and been able to enjoy our stay with no issues. 

Breakfast was good, and the staff managing the area werenvery attentive. 

We had to move for an extra night to another hotel next tot LV convention center. Smaller room, noisier from the road and guests, breakfast was a nightmare as we had to ask the staff from utensils and plates to coffee to be made available. So yeah, a shame we could not stay an extra night at SpringHill. 

The luggage also was stored while we were at a competition and free of charge. We will come back if we have the chance to attend the same competition in Las Vegas.

reviews.author: Steph
reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.body:
The rooms were mostly clean. We stayed in the King with a trundle bed. The trundle bed was VERY dusty. I don’t think it’s been wiped down or vaccuumed. Also we found blood on the king bedding. Another room our friends were in had menstrual blood all over their bed. Honestly looks like they don’t change their bedding between customers which is disgusting. In hindsight we should have asked insisted on new bedding. The room included a microwave, small fridge, a desk, extra blanket for the trundle bed, one TV, and a toilet separate from the shower. That was pretty convenient. The shower light went out, so it was super dark in there on Day 2-3.

The customer service here is confusing. Some are kind & some are not. I booked my room several months before our stay. We didn’t know how many days we needed to stay since they don’t release the tournament schedules until the week before our stay. I didn’t make our reservation for enough days, so I had to make a second reservation. I called the Springhill months ago & told them what happened. They reassured me that I would not be checked out between reservations and that they would note that on my reservation. Instead, during my stay they checked me out midday while I was busy with my activities. We got locked out of our room with all of our stuff still inside. When I went to the front desk to fix the issue. I asked for them to reactivate my card key. Instead of being kind & patient, the front desk rep decided to argue with me about how I was wrong, they never promised me they wouldn’t check me out, and berated me in front of other customers. I was being super nice until she started blaming & arguing with me. Then I raised my voice out of frustration. I didn’t need a lecture on what I should or shouldn’t have done. And I didn’t need to be shamed for not knowing that I couldn’t trust your online customer service representatives. What I needed was for your reps to just check me back in & give me my room keys. What was a pretty decent stay turned completely sour by one of your front desk reps.

reviews.author: SherAL
reviews.title: No better place for attending LVCC!
reviews.body: Perfect stay if attending events at the convention center.  Easy walk to and from. Comfortable, clean, spacious rooms. Good burgers at their restaurant and free hot breakfast. Would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Satisfied
reviews.title: Very nice an comfortable
reviews.body: Friendly staff, clean rooms, nice breakfast bar a good place to stay

reviews.author: ASD Convention 2026
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: Great location. Close to the convention center. However, after flight delays and over 20hrs traveling arrived to the hotel and have to wait close to 30 minutes for the front desk clerk. Security guy tried to find someone inside the building in order to assist me. It was around 1:30am when suddenly a lady shows from the parking and ask to assist me. That was my first impression arriving.

reviews.author: KerriEscapolog
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.body:
Would stay here again....
Clean and friendly hotel.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Never coming back
reviews.body: Because of one person working at the front desk ruined all of my business trip and loosing a big customer like us.

reviews.author: Arthur
reviews.title: Poor management and head Maid service
reviews.body: On Thursday, while napping and with the “Do not disturb sign on the door“  I got a knock on my door by the head maid telling me that I should not be in the room that the room shows vacant for cleaning. I told her I’m staying here till Tuesday. I advised her to talk to the front desk. She snapped back at me and said I need to talk to the front desk and that I need to leave the room. I told her that she needed to talk to the front desk. Needless to say the exchange was not pretty.  After she left, a maintenance man came knocking on my door asking me if I had ordered a remote control for the TV. I told him that I did not order a remote control. Anyway, I complained to the manager the next day and she provided excuses for them. She did not apologize to me at all. She didn’t even offer to provide any points for the inconvenience.   Needless to say, Thursday was not a good day for me.  If it weren’t for the breakfast, staff, I would have given a 1 rather than a 3.

reviews.author: JB
reviews.title: Avoid this Hotel
reviews.body:
Room smelled like cat urine / litter box. 
Shampoo was watered down, conditioner was empty. Only 3 towels and 2 facecloths provided for 5 guests.
Food was taken back to kitchen before end of breakfast hours and right from underneath me as I reached for the tray. No sheets, blanket or pillows provided in room for the sofa bed/ trundle.

reviews.author: Flavie Moldowan
reviews.title: Again the tall light skinned front desk lady made our experience so good! Just her.
reviews.body: Excellent place to stay. There is nothing more to say.

reviews.author: Happily Anonymous
reviews.title: Thank you, Mattie Thomas
reviews.body: I had to file an incident report due to a flat tire from construction in your parking lot. Mattie was very helpful with communication and getting reimbursed for the cost. Thank you, Mattie.

reviews.author: Business goer
reviews.title: Short Business stay
reviews.body: Room was comfortable and located across from Westgate, which is where conference was. Very convenient.

reviews.author: NM
reviews.title: Nice option off the strip
reviews.body: This is our second time staying at this Marriott. It is a nice option off the strip but close to it. The breakfast is good and our room was clean. I wish the bathroom had fans and the parking was free. The person checking us in was rude because my husband wasn't present with me when I checked in with my kids. I think a spouse should be able to check in a family if their spouse who's name is on the reservation is unavailable (such as in meetings).

reviews.author: Diana pleat
reviews.title: Family friendly
reviews.body: We came for a event at South hall.  We were able to cut through Central so it kept the walk short and nicely air conditioned.  The hotel itself has great air conditioning, comfortable beds, and most importantly it's clean.  Friendly service at that front desk and those doing breakfast service.  I'm a light sleeper and never heard outside noise or hallway noise.

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: I’ve always enjoyed staying at this particular location due to its easy access to the convention center and the strip

reviews.author: Si
reviews.title: Nice workers
reviews.body: Every workers very nice on customer service specially  breakfast  helpers

reviews.author: Valb
reviews.title: Valb review
reviews.body: Wasn’t thrilled with room or upkeep of room

reviews.author: Sunny
reviews.title: Very bad service
reviews.body: When we checked into the hotel on the night of July 13th, the receptionist's behavior was very bad. Her attitude was completely wrong; she didn't offer any greeting. Not coming back here . Thank you

reviews.author: Mari
reviews.title: Do not book at this place.
reviews.body: Very bad experience  , the receptionist lied in front of my face to the manager, the room smelled like mold, and cigarettes, the hallway smelled like marijuana .the toilet water kept running 24/7 the shower had rust. The pool is so small only a family of 5 can literally be in there.and it is only 4 ft deep. The breakfast was okay but not worth the stay .never again. The Bar lady was very rude. Like she hates being  there.

reviews.author: AAU
reviews.title: Springhill Suites
reviews.body: Excellent location if you have events at the convention center.

reviews.author: Amber Lee
reviews.title: Great Saty!
reviews.body: highly recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Booked for location
reviews.title: Close to Sunrise Hospital
reviews.body: Easy to book, quiet clean rooms. Having breakfast ready at 6:30 really helped out and saved money. Parking was about $25 a day.

reviews.author: JustineR
reviews.title: Great overnight stay for 4th of July
reviews.body:
We arrived 5pm on the 4th of July, checkin was quick and lady at the front desk was nice and efficient.

There were five of us in the room (two queen one trundle) and it was indeed spacious. Just wish they also gave us five towels at one time (there were only three) and free water. 

Rooms are clean well appointed and well kept. Was very happy w our choice.

reviews.author: Robert G
reviews.title: Clean and Comfortable Hotel in a quiet area
reviews.body: When I go back to Las Vegas I will stay here.  Clean and excellent price

reviews.author: COSUNDOG
reviews.title: Great staff and location - below average rooms
reviews.body: Staff is fantastic!  Hotel itself is inviting and rooms have great views.  Room I had in poor condition and needs a refresher.  Rooftop Pool deck is awesome but offers zero shade.  Breakfast is the standard Marriott offering.  Decent value, just an older property.

reviews.author: Ken M
reviews.title: Great for Convention Center access.
reviews.body: Great location, BagelMania is across the street for great food. Convention center is right across the street. Free charging for my Tesla. Staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Rooms are very nice and up to date.

reviews.author: Suzette
reviews.title: Average
reviews.body: I was promised a call if a room became available at an earlier time, I never received that call and some other guests in our group arrived way later than I did and they got a room before. I was killing time around that area in case they were to call. Once I finally got the room, the staff never emptied the refrigerator from previous guest. I had to clean it myself to put my belongings in it.

reviews.author: Romeo D
reviews.title: My new IBJJF World Masters hotel.
reviews.body: Great room, food and location.

reviews.author: Bulldog
reviews.title: Mariott discriminates
reviews.body: Booked my room 4-6 weeks in advance. On arrival (3:30PM)I  was given the worst possible room in the entire hotel 2nd floor facing a parking structure . I asked to be moved and all they had was handicapped rooms. This is the second time in a row where this particular mariott has done this to me.

reviews.author: TareeC
reviews.title: Not quite the Marriott experience I expected
reviews.body:
My stay was just okay. I’ve had a wonderful experience with Marriott in the past, particularly during a recent stay in Arizona, so unfortunately this location did not feel comparable.

Our room was not ready at the expected check-in time, and once we were checked in, we weren’t given any information about the hotel’s amenities or breakfast options. Those small touches and communication really make a difference, especially when you’re staying somewhere for the first time.

We also requested a late checkout but were told it wasn’t available. I completely understand that late checkout can’t always be accommodated, but combined with the delayed check-in and lack of information upon arrival, it was disappointing. We ultimately decided to leave early the following morning rather than stay through the regular checkout time.

The stay wasn’t terrible, but it definitely didn’t provide the level of service or hospitality I’ve experienced at other Marriott properties. I expected a more welcoming and informative experience.

reviews.author: EGPotl
reviews.title: Great pick
reviews.body: Our granddaughters were in a Ju Jitsu tournament at the convention center and we stayed here which made it perfect! If you want quiet, no smoke and a restaurant, this is the place. We walked to the strip to meet family for dinner and walked across the street for their tournaments. Staff was amazing! Great view of the sphere the entire stay.

reviews.author: youyouxue
reviews.title: Good value in a fair location
reviews.body: I had an overall good stay at this hotel. The room was clean and had a nice view. However, the check-in staff member who assisted me tried to tell me that the type of room I wanted was not available to upgrade into, when in fact it was available. I wish I did not get the runaround. The grab and go area in the front had dozens of items but no price tags or price list. This was so frustrating and seemed like a way to discourage people from properly using their $10 food and beverage credit.

reviews.author: Lharris
reviews.title: Great Spot in Vegas
reviews.body: Wonderful hotel, clean, great location, and wonderful restaurant.

reviews.author: TN09
reviews.title: Las Vegas Marriott
reviews.body: Excellent place to stay, great staff..breakfast was great.

reviews.author: Chef
reviews.title: Off the strip
reviews.body: A very nice, clean, updated hotel with great staff

reviews.author: Tom G
reviews.title: Great location for business visits
reviews.body: Will be staying again!  Very nice property

reviews.author: Larry
reviews.title: Las Vegas Marriott and had an outstanding experience from beginning to end.
reviews.body:
recently stayed at the Las Vegas Marriott and had an outstanding experience from beginning to end. What truly made the stay exceptional was the staff. Everyone I encountered was professional, welcoming, courteous, and genuinely committed to making guests feel valued.
The level of customer service was outstanding. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the staff consistently went above and beyond to make my stay enjoyable.
A sincere thank you to the entire Las Vegas Marriott team for your hospitality and professionalism. You represented the Marriott brand exceptionally well and made my visit to Las Vegas even more memorable.
I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend the Las Vegas Marriott to anyone visiting the area. Five stars all the way!

reviews.author: RayP
reviews.title: First of two stays.
reviews.body: Most of the staff was outstanding during my visit. The room was nicely furnished and very clean. My only disappointment was the Sagebrush restaurant. Our waiter was nit as attentive as I would have hoped for. We had three adults at the table. He took longer than expected to take our orders, did not supply napkins or silverware and failed to ask if we wanted to split the check. When informed that we did, he took a long time to return to the table with the checks. The food was cooked properly and very good.

reviews.author: You will love this hotel
reviews.title: Excellent Hospitality!
reviews.body: Great staff and restaurant!   Breakfast buffet was wonderful!

reviews.author: Mauricio G
reviews.title: A perfect fully renovated hotel, away from the distractions of Las Vegas
reviews.body: I don't mind taking an Uber or the Monorail to this hotel from the Strip. I don't mind it not being in the actual Strip. This is the only hotel in many years traveling to Las Vegas where I truly feel at home. I don't see myself staying anywhere else. The fitness center is one of the best, competing with the big brands in Las Vegas. The restaurant is a perfect place to start or end your day. Also, check out the bar for any of their unique concoctions. And maybe finish the day at the pool.

reviews.author: Curious Traveler H
reviews.title: Easy, convenient, quiet stay
reviews.body: I thoroughly enjoyed staying here for a few nights. Easy parking, in and out from a quiet street, no traffic ever. No casino, no crowds, no resort fee. Has a newly renovated gym and a pool. It’s very consistent with other Marriott experiences, if you don’t mind less luxury and slightly businessy feel, this is a great place to stay and value for your bucks.

reviews.author: ErinCincy
reviews.title: Vegas business trip
reviews.body: Great of raw experience came in late after a long day of travel and business meetings was greeted with a friendly face. The reception desk lady even provided me a few extra water bottles to take up to the room for me. The next morning I came down for breakfast at the little restaurant and it was perfect with great service.

reviews.author: Beyond Pleased
reviews.title: Best Marriott I’ve stayed at that I can remember.
reviews.body: I typically do not leave reviews, but in this case I have to. I am a titanium elite member and I only stay at Marriott when I travel for work or personally, which is quite a lot. When I booked this hotel, I was a little, unsure being that it was basically next-door to the convention center where I was working all week. A week ago I stayed at a different Marriott in another city, which was not the best. after a long day, I went to check in and when I got to my room, I was beyond happy at how clean it was and looked brand new. I dropped my stuff and I went to check out the gym. There was a woman in there cleaning and mopping the floor, and the gym also looked immaculate. And it had everything you need. It was larger than most of the Marriott gyms I’ve stayed at. And there is a water station on every single floor that actually worked normally unlike so many other ones I have experience. The next morning I woke up early, went to the gym, and then I went to have breakfast. I am not exaggerating when I tell you that this was probably the best Marriott breakfast buffets that I have had or at least that I can remember in the past few years. And I think I’ve stayed at over 200 nights in the past two years alone. there was oatmeal with grape add-ins, fresh fruit that didn’t look like it was sitting out for a year, eggs that looked great, and tasted great, two different types of sausages, and not the thin crumpled ones that look like they were microwaved, but large sized pieces, lox, literally thick pieces of bread and not the thin pieces you normally get. I think I either had sourdough or whole wheat, but regardless there were options. And there was serial options muffins, and so many other things, but it was great. if I had to give a knock on something, I love my morning coffee and the coffee was just OK. However, I got up and there was a Starbucks right by the front desk with full service. I got an iced coffee with a shot of espresso. The line to Starbucks in the convention center takes a good half hour and there was nobody at the one in the hotel. I really can’t say anything bad about this. I guess I would also say it was perfect for traveling for business. I don’t know if I would stay here with my family being that it is far from the excitement of Las Vegas and not next to so many restaurants. The strip seems to be far. I did walk right to resort world for dinner which has some options. My days of partying in Las Vegas are over so this had everything I needed to relax and the most important thing was that it was so clean and that’s what I need when I’m staying somewhere.

reviews.author: Yaya
reviews.title: Always great...
reviews.body: AH-Mazing always and always great place to stay when in Vegas-all around great staff and service.

reviews.author: jen810
reviews.title: Great staff, location, and clean spacious rooms.
reviews.body: The staff was super friendly and helpful-the room was spacious and clean. It was a quiet atmosphere and met all of our needs.

reviews.author: Ali Haider
reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.body: Hotel is conveniently located near the Vegas Strip

reviews.author: Meeting planner 22
reviews.title: Pick this hotel!
reviews.body: Amazing staff, clean rooms, delicious food. Convenient location. What more could you ask for? 10/10 stars!

reviews.author: Jtrib
reviews.title: Vice President of Sales
reviews.body: Hotel is very clean, very nice, and it looks like it has been recently renovated. I'm not mistaken. I think the breakfast was outstanding. The staff at the breakfast was outstanding. The people at the front desk were nice, although sometimes the lines get a little backed up at the front desk. It's still not that bad. I wish you did not have to pay for parking, especially when you're an elite member like I am, but great overall value.

reviews.author: Rodney
reviews.title: Great property
reviews.body: Services and staff was great! Comfortable rooms and beds were great!

reviews.author: Traveler 1
reviews.title: Great spot
reviews.body: Excellent team to make you feel welcomed.

reviews.author: EMC415
reviews.title: Great hotel for NBA Summer League
reviews.body: This Marriott location, staff, gym and dining is great.

reviews.author: Mei Mei
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body: Excellent view on Sphere from our room

reviews.author: TinyHagrid
reviews.title: I enjoy staying here
reviews.body: The only nitpick I have is in the cosmetics of the minimalist modern style. Everything else was up to the standards that the Marriot has previously set.

reviews.author: Evo2026
reviews.title: Staying here every evo
reviews.body: Far and away the best evo hotel. Great room, great service , and close

reviews.author: Robb from Kentucky 1
reviews.title: Couples Getaway
reviews.body: This hotel has been renovated and sure shows it.  Rooms are extremely comfortable, clean and accommodating.  The staff and I mean everyone, is so nice, so helpful and they just make your stay relaxing.  We picked this hotel because how close it was to the Sphere.   We were so glad we did.  We enjoyed the small but private pool, the non hectic atmosphere and it was right besides Piero’s Italian restaurant.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Outstanding staff
reviews.body: Love the place, great room and great staff

reviews.author: SEPT 2026
reviews.title: Family friendly and home like stay
reviews.body: Thank you for the lovely stay in the hotel room. However, the parking situation was not that great. It would have been easier to park near our room but that particular parking spot is for Marriott. We had quite a ways to walk to get to our room, we had two elders with us. Overall. It was a good stay just the distance was not that great.

reviews.author: perfect100
reviews.title: Most comfortable and everything needed was in the room
reviews.body: Great room to use kitchen and the bed was super comfortable.  I can't say enough how clean the room was.  Very comfortable to be in the room and have family in to eat.

reviews.author: Neal
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay
reviews.body: Fast friendly service, near convention center

reviews.author: Nekko S
reviews.title: Diamond in the Ruff
reviews.body: Great Service, Great Location, Great Stay and Family Friendly.

reviews.author: Leslie
reviews.title: Friendly staff, nice rooms & free breakfast
reviews.body: This has become our favorite place to stay in Vegas.   It’s always clean, quiet, rooms are nice size and they serve a great free breakfast! And the staff is incredibly friendly like they really enjoy their job.

reviews.author: johnston22722
reviews.title: Our go to place tonstay
reviews.body: This is our go to place to stay when in Vegas for BJJ tournaments!

reviews.author: Jlnon30
reviews.title: Perfect for couples getaway
reviews.body: Excellent property for Vegas getaway. Convenient location near Strip.  Monorail across the street, several restaurants( Siegals Bagelmania, Taco el Gordo) a short walk away. Breakfast was excellent each day. Beds very comfortable.  Rooms clean with everything we needed. Area felt safe. Property was clean and well maintained.  Small houses with 4 residences in each. Staff was amazing from the breakfast staff to maintenance who changed batteries in thermostat within minutes to Igor and Aliyah at the front office. Perfect in every way for an excellent adventure in Vegas and surrounding areas. Highly recommend this property.

reviews.author: August2026
reviews.title: Excellent Place to Stay
reviews.body: We have stayed at this property several times since 2018.  It is always clean, well-maintained, comfortable, easy to get to. Staff are friendly & many have been there several years. Nice breakfast. Laundry facility. Fitness Center.  Pool & hot tub are well-maintained & pH is always perfect. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Gary Monterey
reviews.title: Excellent Front Desk Staff, Facilities Need to be Remodeled and Upgraded
reviews.body: The front desk staff was excellent.  The breakfast was good and about you what you would expect at a Residence Inn.  The facility itself badly needs a remodel and renovation.  It seems to be declining rapidly.  I have stayed at this location a few times in the last few years and stay in hotels frequently and in another Marriott in another state the same week.  This hotel does not meet Marriott usual high standards.

reviews.author: 563linda
reviews.title: Monorail across the street
reviews.body: Easy and safe location. Walked home at 11pm. No worries. Clean location. Great breakfast

reviews.author: Nicole Warren
reviews.title: Fantastic Location for access to LVCC West Hall
reviews.body:
This location is absolutely perfect if you’re attending an event at the Las Vegas Convention Center "LVCC" West Hall. 

One of the best perks is the shortcut gate that lets you walk out near the other Marriott property, directly across the street from the LVCC. It turns what could be a longer walk into an incredibly convenient 0.01 mile stroll to the convention center.  A huge plus when you are at 20,000+ steps each day of your conference! 

Having a kitchen in the room is a lifesaver, especially with the rising cost of meals in Las Vegas. The kitchen is stocked with the basic cookware, dishes, and utensils you would need to prepare a meal. Would recommend guests bring their own Ziploc bags (food storage) and aluminum foil (no cooking spray/oil provided) for easier cleanup. Dish soap, kitchen towels, and a sponge are provided by the hotel. 1 pod for the dishwasher is provided.

The free breakfast is another fantastic perk. 
My only suggestion would be to extend the breakfast hours beyond 6-9 a.m. While those hours work well for conference attendees who are up and out early, they’re a little limiting if you’re hoping to sleep in or enjoy a more leisurely morning. (But you can also cook breakfast in your room if you want to sleep in!)

The rooms are spacious and comfortable. The beds are very comfortable after a long day; just note that if you get the King Suite with the loft, those units are only upstairs, so you will have about 20 steps to get to your suite. (which can be hard with large or heavy luggage) 

This hotel exceeded my expectations and those of the 4 others traveling with me. The combination of the incredible location, spacious accommodations, in-room kitchen, comfortable beds, and complimentary breakfast makes this an excellent choice, especially for anyone attending an event at the LVCC. As soon as next year's conference dates are available, I will book this hotel again for next year.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Las Vegas summer market 2026
reviews.body: Living room very uncomfortable sofa.

reviews.author: Wendipooh13
reviews.title: Great family stay in Vegas
reviews.body: This location was perfect for us. We weren’t looking to be near the strip, and wanted a quieter location. It worked great for our family to have two rooms and 2 bathrooms and a kitchen. This location was great. The staff was so kind and friendly. The pool was great for swimming and cooling off. The breakfast had lots of options and space to eat at in the morning. The gym also had everything I needed.

reviews.author: Song
reviews.title: Will comeback in future
reviews.body: For sure i will comeback in future. the perfect location which is just across the street from LV convention center. Plus my good experience this time.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.title: Quick Road Trip from SLC To Las Vegas.
reviews.body: The Residence Inn in Las Vegas was a great, inexpensive 2 night stay for us when taking a impulsive road trip.   It located near everything.   Most important, it gave us some where to "hide" from that 120 deg heat.

reviews.author: Lu123
reviews.title: Does not meet Marriott hotels standards
reviews.body: The photos online definitely looked outdated and deceiving. I was disappointed upon arrival as the carpet was disgusting, there was a strong odor that did not go away. The drawers and bathroom were dirty.

reviews.author: Gilby
reviews.title: Birthday Trip
reviews.body: There of course are always a few things that can't be perfect but the location and price does help the deciding.However the beds are a bit harder than I would like.But overall it is quite , security does keep the rif raff at bay and extra space is nice when your gone for more than a few days.

reviews.author: KDG1971
reviews.title: Was there for business.
reviews.body: We enjoyed staying here and we'll be back. Although was hoping they'd have biscuits and gravy and there was no ice in the freezer in the room loike it said. All the information ya need is mainly on the tv in the amenities area once ya click on it. Wish they had lotion.

reviews.author: With our baby Yorkie
reviews.title: Homey place
reviews.body: Feels like home away from home when you are in Residence Inn by Marriott

reviews.author: Emma S
reviews.title: No green areas for our pets
reviews.body: No green area for our pets

reviews.author: Marissa Maka
reviews.title: Convention Center
reviews.body: I stayed here for the Be+Well Convention and was pleasantly surprised at how easy it was to walk over to the event. I also brought my family and it was close enough to the strip to allow them to stay entertained while I was at the convetnion. Location is perfect and the cleanliness was great!

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.title: Decent place but worst service.
reviews.body: We have to travel far from car to two flight of stairs to the very back. No elevator, exposed to the sun 110 degree heat, and no staff helping us with our heavy luggage. Room was decent and AC was great but never booking and recommending this place again.

reviews.author: MrTraveler20
reviews.title: A Comfortable Stay That Delivers
reviews.body:
I had a really great stay at the Residence Inn by Marriott Las Vegas Convention Center. The location is super convenient, especially if you’re in town for an event at the convention center or just want easy access to the Strip without being right in the middle of the chaos.
The service really stood out, everyone was friendly, helpful, and made the experience feel welcoming from start to finish. The room was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed to relax after a long day.
One thing I really appreciated was the breakfast, it was actually really good, and it’s nice to see a hotel still offering a solid complimentary option since not many places do that anymore.
Overall, it definitely lived up to expectations. I’d absolutely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone visiting Vegas, whether for work or leisure.

reviews.author: Philip
reviews.title: A good business hotel next to the Convention Center
