reviews.body: The hotel is well located for anybody looking to attend an event at the LV Convention Center. The staff was very helpful and kind. The property is well maintained and good for stay with family as well.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: My stay in Vegas
reviews.body: It could be a great hotel when they will finish all the work in the area and finish renovation of pool.

reviews.author: Jeremy
reviews.title: Magiccon with the boys
reviews.body: Had a great time.  More toilet paper next time.

reviews.author: Libby
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Off the strip and easily walkable to the LV convention center. Great stay and service will stay here again!

reviews.author: SoCal traveler
reviews.title: Clean, convenient off strip Hotel
reviews.body: Room was clean, front desk very responsive and helpful.  Morning continental breakfast was convenient and tasty, pretty much what you come to expect at a Residence Inn.  My main complaint is that Marriott has decided to charge for parking, just another source of Revenue to make tourists pay for.

reviews.author: Zandra
reviews.title: Great rooms/ staff/location
reviews.body: Amazing rooms! Felt like we had our own apartment! Staff was the friendliest, and I have stayed at many, many hotels! Breakfast was good, would have enjoyed it to be opened later than 9, also would have loved to see more food options available. Cold brew option was fantastic !

reviews.author: VladN
reviews.title: Excellent Stay and Great Location
reviews.body: We had an excellent stay at Courtyard by Marriott Las Vegas Convention Center. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and very conveniently located. The staff was friendly, welcoming, and professional throughout our stay. We truly enjoyed our visit and would gladly stay here again.

reviews.author: Josh from Missouri
reviews.title: All great except bed/mattress
reviews.body: Overall very good, just didn't sleep well due to mattress too hard.

reviews.author: Cece
reviews.title: Nice Hotel Within Walking Distance to the Convention Center
reviews.body: Nice room.  Very accommodating staff.  Good Food and Beverage options

reviews.author: Adam L
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay at Courtyard
reviews.body: Walking through the door Adolfo greeted us and started our stay on a positive note. He got us checked in quickly, made conversation with us while processing our information and every time I saw him afterwards, he'd ask us how things are going and was always smiling. Lisa and Eve in the Cafe / Bar area were a treat. Even though my coworker and I were in Las Vegas, I went to the bar area almost nightly. Those ladies really care for what they do and made us feel welcomed every night. On the last night of my stay, I made sure to tell them how much I appreciated them taking care of me and making me feel like I was at home even though I was 2200 miles away from it. Kenya was also very attentive. I watched as she'd interact with guests in the lobby, quickly answer phones and answered tons of questions from new arriving guests. The staff was the real gem of the hotel and hopefully my next work conference takes me there again.

reviews.author: Jezza
reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.body: As someone that is a Bonvoy Member and travels for work monthly, I paid for this room with points and was treated like a second class citizen.

reviews.author: Charly
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Great place to stay off the strip. Quiet at night. Guest were pretty quiet too. Right across the street from the convention center and monorail. They have a cafe with great drinks as well.

reviews.author: Bash
reviews.title: Clean, modern and safe near convention center.
reviews.body: Good location for easy on and off major arteries. Great location, even better when there is t anything going on at convention center.

reviews.author: Robin B
reviews.title: Comfortable stay and inviting staff
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful stay at the Marriott Courtyard. The staff was exceptionally friendly, kind, and welcoming throughout my visit. Every team member I encountered greeted me with a smile and went out of their way to make sure I was comfortable and had everything I needed.
Their level of professionalism and genuine hospitality is a real tribute to the management team and the positive culture they have created. The staff was always accommodating, attentive, and eager to help, making my experience truly enjoyable.
I highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for outstanding customer service and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Thank you to the entire team for making my stay such a pleasant one!

reviews.author: BizTravelerCL
reviews.title: Great stay for work
reviews.body: Clean efficient hotel.  Offered steel cut oatmeal (paid) for breakfast and small but clean gym.  Room was clean and quiet.  Balconies are a nice touch.

reviews.author: Suzie
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Courtyard Marriott Convention Center was a great place to stay. The entire staff were very courteous and accommodating. I would stay here again!

reviews.author: Convenience
reviews.title: Convenience
reviews.body: Cleanliness and convenience

reviews.author: J Clay
reviews.title: Great stay in Vegas, not far from the strip
reviews.body: No complaints, the staff was great and the service was as well. Nice cold air conditioning, clean room. The entrance is a little tricky because it's under construction so rideshare can be challenging. Other than that, all was great.

reviews.author: Long dana 2026
reviews.title: Love staying at this hotel
reviews.body: Excellent customer service and very clean rooms with great amenities. Love the Starbucks coffee in the lobby.   Great location. This hotel is very comfortable and undergoing a remodel, cant wait to see the finished remodel.

reviews.author: Rudi
reviews.title: Convenient Location to Convention Center, Good Room, Disappointing Construction and Food Options
reviews.body: The location was great as it is only a short walk from the convention center. The interior of the property is in good repair, well kept and clean as was the room. The construction was a disappointing surprise and made it less convenient and less pleasant to stay. The staff was overall quite good in terms of service. The Bistro food options were quite limited and a disappointment when compared to other Marriotts I've stayed at. For someone with dietary limitations there were few options and non were palatable. Even though I had a $15 credit as a Bonvoy member I chose to skip breakfast on my final day as I didn't care for what they served at any price. I did get tea which was fine.

reviews.author: TCBJ living the life
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas fantastic staff
reviews.body: I will be back we went through 4 states and this was by far the best place we stayed.  I am so happy they are a part of the Choice brand.  I highly recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Perfect spot to stay off the strip!!
reviews.body: We absolutely loved our time here—it truly felt like a little piece of home. One of our favorite parts of each day was unwinding by the fire pit in the courtyard, such a relaxing way to end the evening. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and everyone we encountered was so lovely. We would highly recommend staying here!

reviews.author: The Diplomat
reviews.title: Undisclosed Renovations Significantly Impacted Our Stay
reviews.body:
I booked directly through the Bonvoy app, and at no point was it disclosed that the hotel would be undergoing major renovations during our stay. This came as an unpleasant surprise to my wife and daughter and, frankly, left me feeling embarrassed about my choice of hotel.

The visible construction, scaffolding, and overall atmosphere significantly detracted from the experience, regardless of the hours during which work was being carried out. While I raised this with the front desk, the concern was largely dismissed, with the explanation that work only takes place during the day. This overlooks the fact that the impact on the guest experience is constant, not limited to noise alone.

I have come to expect a higher level of transparency and guest consideration from Marriott properties, particularly when booking directly through official channels. This experience fell short of those expectations.

reviews.author: SJoy116
reviews.title: Thoroughly satisfied
reviews.body: From check in to check out, our stay was delightful. All staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. The room was quite comfortable, clean, and tastefully decorated. Proximity to the convention center monorail station and the Sphere were a pleasant surprise and primary factors in our choice to stay here on subsequent trips to Las Vegas.

reviews.author: Dean681
reviews.title: No rest for the weary
reviews.body: Staff were great that we dealt with during our short stay.   However the sounds from the building/mechanicals/roadways around the hotel were terrible.   The construction and/or materials used on this hotel were obviously not designed for the busy roads directly next to the hotel. I would not stay here again due to the complete lack of  noise reduction resulting in a terrible sleeping environment.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Quiet Room!
reviews.body: We had a quiet stay and appreciated the blackout curtains. The towels were very rough and scratchy. There was hair on the sink and inside the bathroom rug towel.

reviews.author: Lova
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.body: A great find. Affordable, great service, clean, and amazing staff!

reviews.author: Debiasf
reviews.title: Stay at Marriott Courtyard Convention Center Las Vegas
reviews.body: Enjoyed our stay.  Loved staying off the strip but close to the Monorail.  Front desk staff was friendly and helpful.  Room was clean.

reviews.author: Work traveler
reviews.title: Good place to stay if you want to be close
reviews.body:
This particular Marriott is a nice place to stay if you want to be close to the tram, or the convention center. The strip is a little bit of a walk, but it’s not out of reason.
If you expect a nice smiley face at breakfast (you have to pay for breakfast) then this hotel is not the one for you, as the morning breakfast staff is apparently too busy to turn around and look you in the face and ask you what you want, and their back is always to you. But if you’re there to sleep, be close to what you need to do and expect everybody else to be happy and appreciate that you’re there, this place is for you.
The front of the building was going through construction or maintenance when I arrived, but the inconvenience was very minor, and the hotel staff made up for it was clean room rooms, a happy face and pretty much what I needed.

reviews.author: Tom K
reviews.title: Worst hotel in recent memory.
reviews.body: Only good thing about this hotel is it's close to Convention Center.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Marriott Guest Experience - Awesome
reviews.body: They say people are the brand.  For this hotel, everyone was incredibly friendly and helpful no matter what the ask was. Sandra was my guest experience expert. She was great from the minute I called from the airport to check out.

reviews.author: C Law
reviews.title: Courtyard by Marriott Las Vegas Convention Center - Hidden Gem
reviews.body: Excellent hotel in a great location.

reviews.author: dieforHim1
reviews.title: Our Las Vegas Go-To
reviews.body: Came into town for The Eagles Concert and Wizard of Oz at The Sphere. The front desk lady was so inviting and sweet. Our rooms were very clean and spacious. Bed wasn't very comfortable; too hard. When ironing my husband's shirt, there were scorch marks on the iron plate and it ruined my husband's shirt. I called housekeeping and they immediately brought down another iron and apologized profusely. A few minutes later, the front desk called apologizing and gave us a $30 credit at the restaurant. The hotel is walking distance to The Sphere, Convention Center and some restaurants. We've decided that when we come to Vegas from now on, we will definitely stay here and refer our family and friends here.

reviews.author: Alex G
reviews.title: Excellent stay at this hotel!
reviews.body: The staff here are very friendly and the built in Starbucks was a lifesaver for a good morning coffee.

reviews.author: DLuke
reviews.title: 2 week stay
reviews.body: It was a great trip, and the staff was very friendly

reviews.author: John2
reviews.title: The best staff ever!
reviews.body: The staff was courteous, friendly and helpful. The Bistro staff made excellent meals and cappuccinos. Would come back just for that.

reviews.author: Ana S
reviews.title: Worst customer service ever experienced
reviews.body:
I loved the restaurant and the staff there. But to be woken up from the cleaning lady cleaning the room right across from my room at 11:00pm felt completely unacceptable. She continued to clean 940,  the room right next to mine and slammed the mop and was so loud I first called the number and they said on the phone they’d ask her to stop. 15 m later I walked down to the reception and they said they’d ask her manager if she could stop cleaning, another 15 min passed and I had to do and tell her myself since no one even in my message on the app did anything, so me as a guest did not feel welcomed at all. I find it absolutely ridiculous and unacceptable to clean in the middle of the night when I was going up at 6 - she also came back at 5:50am starting again and since I barely got sleep I was trying to sleep longer which was impossible once again with someone cleaning!! The midnight guy in the  reception did not know what customer service is.

Great breakfast and morning restaurant staff. Great dinner And service

reviews.author: Upset Guest
reviews.title: UNJUST FINES
reviews.body: Policy sucks that they steal from guests without recourse

reviews.author: Sar4
reviews.title: Needs a good clean
reviews.body:
After checking into our room we discovered that the sink in the bathroom was filthy, we called front desk and were offered another room. After moving we once again found the bathroom to be quite dirty, the shower and toilet both needed a good clean and again the sink was dirty - although not as bad as the previous room. It looks like housekeeping pour dirty water (maybe from a mop bucket) down the sink and do not rinse it after. 
Due to the late hour (1am because of a delayed flight) we decided to just stay in the room and get some sleep, we had been travelling for 27 hours at this point and were all exhausted.

reviews.author: CF26
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: Great hotel away from the crowds

reviews.author: Nyrei9
reviews.title: Nice, Convenient Hotel, Just Needs A Little TLC
reviews.body: The room was nice, I booked a suite. The carpets in the livingroom area were very dirty and overdue for a deep cleaning. I killed at least 5 crickets in the room and noticed them in the pool area as well. They definitely need an exterminator. The staff was friendly and otherwise my stay was very good.

reviews.author: Anita
reviews.title: A Perfect Vegas Home
reviews.body: Wonderful staff who made us feel welcome and valued.  We were close enough to the action on the strip without having slot machine noise greet you first thing in the morning.

reviews.author: JMoSue
reviews.title: Wonderful Suprise
reviews.body: This hotel was away from the Strip choas ans noise but still close enough to venues. The staff was knowledgable, graceful and an all

reviews.author: Marriott Platinum Member
reviews.title: Lack communication with Marriott Member
reviews.body: This is the worst stay I have been as the Marriott platinum member. I booked one double beds room for one night stay ( I with my family, total 3 guests, I believe the system should have the record about 3 guests stay). When I checked in at the lobby, no any awareness is to me the room changed to a king size bed in a small room ( No upgrade).  No body asked me to choose either provide a welcome gift for platinum member or give me 1000 points. (Normally, I choose the welcome gift). I required to change back to a double beds room, they tried to convert me to add a rollaway in this small room. Eventually, they changed one double beds room to me with my compliance which the hotel should comply with what I booked before. I felt very upset this service to a Marriott platinum member. Also, in the bathroom, the shower gel pump doesn't work, etc.... I don't desire to stay this hotel and recommend it to my friends.

reviews.author: Ella1
reviews.title: Great rooms
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay here the place was clean and the staff was friendly

reviews.author: Fill C
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Highly recommend this hotel. I was there for our 5th year in a row, staying at the convention center for our conference, and we will be back again next year.

reviews.author: G DOGG
reviews.title: no hot water
reviews.body: I was staying  3 days and on the first morning had no hot water for a shower-- NOT HAPPY

reviews.author: Andres Zea
reviews.title: Charged Twice for a Smoking Violation I Dispute
reviews.body:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience. I was initially charged $566.90 for an alleged smoking violation, even though neither my girlfriend nor I smoke and absolutely no smoking took place in our room. I contacted the hotel and disputed the charge, but I was told it was based on their smoke detection system.

In addition, I was charged $34.01 as a separate destination fee. Then, after I had already contacted the hotel regarding these charges, I was charged AGAIN for $600.91.

This is extremely concerning. I strongly dispute the smoking violation, and I do not understand why another $600.91 charge was processed afterward. I am now having to dispute these charges with American Express.

I expected much better treatment and transparency from a Marriott property. This situation has caused me unnecessary stress and completely ruined my experience. I would like Marriott management to investigate both the original smoking charge and the additional $600.91 charge and provide me with a clear explanation and resolution.

reviews.author: Number 1
reviews.title: Excelent
reviews.body: The food it was much better 2025..small portions but delicious .

reviews.author: Sammi JD
reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas!
reviews.body: Stay here. You won’t be disappointed. Skip the noisy casinos & Smokey lobbies. This place is charming, and has everything you need: Great pool/jacuzzi. Great bar & restaurant. Delicious food. And every single staff member from front desk to bartenders & housekeeping were attentive, welcoming, and went out of their way to make us feel like VIPs! Can’t say enough about it! Just stay here! You’ll see!

reviews.author: Karen from Scottsdale
reviews.title: Very Enjoyable Stay
reviews.body: The Renaissance was a great stay for a "girls reunion".  The location is perfect and I prefer a Las Vegas property off the strip, without large crowds and noisy lobbies.  Convenient to the Sphere, Convention Center and a quick rideshare to anywhere.  I was most impressed by the customer service of all staff.  The bar and Zio's (restaurant) were welcoming and fun to enjoy!  This will be my "go to" place to stay in Las Vegas!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Feedback
reviews.body:
First of all I was in this hotel in 2024 and was so good but this time I had seriously aweful experience. I have called housekeeping several times but no one there to pick up the call, No one came to clean the room.  2nd day as well and no one picked up the calls. I called front desk to inform housekeeping to send plate. 3rd day also same, no one picked up calls from housekeeping department. 
I called front desk and asked to give a simple nail cutter but they replied with NO (they don't have). 
First morning I went to have my breakfast and ZIO's receptionist informed me that it's will take to get table at least 10 minutes, is it okay for me!! whereas some tables were empty. 
I went to have couple of Bears in BAR and took one Corona seated on the table instead of bar chairs. One lady came and asked me, how is everything! Then straightway she printed the bill and put on my table, asked me to pay whenever I am ready! But never asked whether I need one more bear or not, even my class also not even half empty. Means she wanted me to pay and leave the Bar.

reviews.author: ImMr2You
reviews.title: Hotel wasn’t 100% clean
reviews.body:
I arrived after the normal check-in time, so I was disappointed that I still had to wait in the lobby for more than 45 minutes for my room to be ready. What made it more frustrating was seeing other guests arrive after me, receive their room keys, and head straight to their rooms while I was still waiting.

My biggest issue, however, was the cleanliness of the bathroom. I have pictures showing that there were several long pieces of hair left in the shower, as well as hair around the bathtub drain. Finding someone else’s hair in a hotel bathroom is a huge no for me and made me question how thoroughly the room had been cleaned before I arrived. I normally clean and wipe down hotel bathrooms myself anyway, but I still expect the room to be properly cleaned before check-in.

I didn’t complain or ask for another room because, after already waiting more than 45 minutes, I honestly didn’t want to risk waiting even longer to be moved.

reviews.author: CoachKCP
reviews.title: A quiet gem within walking distance to the convention center
reviews.body: Every question, every request, every interaction was exceptional. This is a great place to stay

reviews.author: Berylene
reviews.title: Dead cockroach in room and receptionist is being insensitive
reviews.body: We found a dead cockroach right in front of us as soon as we open the hotel door. We were tired but had no choice to walk downstairs and seek for assistance. The receptionist just switch us to another room with no apologies and acknowledgment of the issue. They still continue to charge us all kind of resort fee.. this is rediciously disappointing

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.title: Club Lounge
reviews.body: Don’t advertise a club lounge if it is closed during the weekends.

reviews.author: Mary W
reviews.title: Repeat customer and will continue choosing this hotel in Vegas
reviews.body: My third stay at Renaissance Las Vegas and it continues to impress! As a Titanium member, I was made to feel truly VIP, with an amazing suite upgrade and exceptional service. The restaurant staff and front desk were outstanding, with top-notch customer service. I’ll definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Jac M
reviews.title: Mediocre
reviews.body: If you’re staying for a night it’ll be fine but stayed for a week and it got worse every day.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Comfy and Friendly but Older
reviews.body: Beautiful lobby, friendly staff and a comfy room. My only note appropriate to mention here is that it’s older than how it looked online (shallow 70s style bathtub and blackout curtain was detached from rod).

reviews.author: Geva64
reviews.title: Business in LV
reviews.body: Excellent hotel a bit off the strip but very close. Business trip but this hotel allowed me to enjoy its own setting without braving the intense heat. Thankful to work and return to my room and enjoy a great restaurant.  Very nice, beautifully decorated and clean straightforward room. Will return.

reviews.author: The Golden Spott
reviews.title: Our go-to "near strip" hotel
reviews.body: This hotel is kept up very well, and the staff went out of their way to make my wife feel special for her birthday. Property is clean, staff is friendly, and restaurant employees are very professional and well trained. The pool and pool area made me wish I had brought my swim suit. We will 100% stay at this property every trip to Vegas!

reviews.author: Rjm111
reviews.title: Great bar!
reviews.body: The shower leaked and housekeeping didn’t actually change the sheets or vacuum, but otherwise it was fabulous. The lounge food is amazing, the whiskey selection was excellent and the front desk and bar staff were wonderful.

reviews.author: Faye
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.body: Hotel was very beautiful, the staff was very nice and professional

reviews.author: Vegas Visit
reviews.title: Poor Maintenance in Room
reviews.body: The toilet didn’t flush and or flush properly. The cabinet door where the refrigerator is, was broken. Toilet paper is like sandpaper. Coffee maker and area is outdated, they want you to spend more money to get coffee in the lobby. Parking is not for hotel guest only, they allow outsiders to pay for parking to go to the convention center and leaving minimum parking for paying hotel guest.

reviews.author: Ramon B
reviews.title: Property is Legit
reviews.body: This is a beautiful property. Amazing staff, especially Suzanne and Mario. Awesome food and an outstanding pool area. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Felicia
reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.body: Perfect home-away-from-home location!  We love to experience Vegas without being in the middle of the hustle and bustle 24-7.  The view of the strip, Sphere, and luscious green golf course is mesmerizing!  Our curtains remained open 24x7.  When we choose to explore the strip, Fremont Street, and other surrounding attractions, it was a simple drive or leisurely walk to the nearby metro station for a comfortable, safe ride.  And let’s not forget Zio’s for their amazing meals!  Looking forward to my next visit soon!

reviews.author: RAYO
reviews.title: September stay 2026
reviews.body: I will be definitely recommending this location to family and friends.  Conveniently close to strip. Staff is friendly and welcoming. Complimentary breakfast was surprisingly good with a variety of choices

reviews.author: Arkansas Traveler
reviews.title: A Vegas Winner
reviews.body: For the price you can’t beat it. Close enough but far enough from the strip to enjoy the area without excessive noise. Easy and adequate parking. Rooms and common area clean and maintained. Shout out to Shannon and all the friendly front desk staff for making checkin & check out a breeze and helping with any questions and concerns. The Breakfast lady was friendly and kept buffet well supplied. Would definitely stay here again if returning to Vegas.

reviews.author: Cherry Rhedd
reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.body:
Almost Perfect

* Our room smells clean so with the beddings, comforters, pillows and blankets.
* Carpets, refrigerator, coffee set were all clean.
* Only our bathroom sink was draining too slow, maybe there was debris in it.

reviews.author: D Stamper
reviews.title: Friendly Staff / Shuttle Problems
reviews.body: Friendly staff, but issues with the return shuttle made our stay quite stressful and greatly reduced our limited time for sleep. Property needs a remodel.

reviews.author: Ramon B
reviews.title: High Level
reviews.body: Meesha from the front desk was extraordinary. She knew everything we needed before I even asked. I’ve been to a lot of Marriott’s and she is one of the best. Above and beyond! Everything about our stay was perfect, thanks to her. We really appreciate you having employees like her!

reviews.author: Ana
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Beds are very comfy better than other hotels i stayed at. Only thing is it needs more lights in the bathroom and room it was too dark. But other than that good. Also I had to find house cleaning because they didn't clean and add toilet paper

reviews.author: Becks
reviews.title: Perfect stay in Vegas
reviews.body: Wonderful hotel - away from the main strip so you get a welcome break from the madness of Vegas. Staff were wonderful, room was excellent - exactly what we needed!

reviews.author: Five Dog
reviews.title: Wonderful & relaxing.
reviews.body:
Everything was handled professionally & with warmth.   Special shout out to Holly Locantore & Kae Martinez who made me feel like a Marriott Bonvoy member is special.  

Certainly would return in the future.

reviews.author: Ricardo
reviews.title: Show
reviews.body: Amazing service and clean!

reviews.author: DadbodT800
reviews.title: A pleasant stay in Las Vegas
reviews.body: The Fairfield Inn is a convenient and comfy spot off strip. The rooms are clean and well kept, the gym is well equipped and well maintained, the breakfast is surprisingly good with a good selection, and the staff are all very pleasant and friendly.

reviews.author: GSTL
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body:
This Fairfield by Marriott didn’t live up to my expectations. Parking was awkward, my closet-like room was small and dark, with a view of a vast construction junkyard, just outside my window! 
The bed was comfortable. The bathroom was dark and small. I was only there for one night, but it felt like two or three!
I was given a 2pm checkout time, but apparently no one told the housekeeping staff, who ignored the “Do Not Disturb” sign and knocked on my door just after 12 noon!
Departing was the highlight of my stay!

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.body: Excellent off strip n close to airport

reviews.author: Patricia Larreal
reviews.title: Great choice
reviews.body: Great location, nice rooms, very clean, we enjoyed nice breakfasts. We attended a concert at the sphere and was easy to travel between airport, hotel, venue and other places

reviews.author: Happy Traveler
reviews.title: Nice place with helpful staff
reviews.body: Everyone was helpful. Room was clean and they have security in the parking lot watching the cars overnight. I felt safe getting in and out of the car at night time. Entrance is close to Parking lot.

reviews.author: Sharon
reviews.title: Overall, good value and good experience
reviews.body: The motel was very clean and comfortable. Food was decent at breakfast, and the staff was very kind and helpful. The only complaints I have are that the water pressure in the shower was awful, and there isn't a powered exhaust fan, apparently. (I mentioned that the fan in the bathroom didn't turn on to take out the steam from the shower and was told "oh, they don't do that").

reviews.author: Mnotstayinghereagain
reviews.title: Beware of Car Towing and Management
reviews.body:
My car was towed from the hotel parking lot without warning or due diligence by hotel staff.

I was given a parking pass on the first day and was told "to put the pass in my car later". When I went to look for my car later, it was gone and the front desk employee and manager on duty did not know what happened to the car. It was only after calling a tow service was that I found out that the hotel had called to tow my car due to me not displaying the parking pass.

Hotel guests travel long days, work long hours, and endure hot vegas days. If an exhausted guest falls asleep immediately entering their hotel room, it is unrealistic to tow their vehicle. It is also unrealistic to tow hotel guests vehicles when the parking lot does not have proper signage about towing vehicles. 

Every other hotel that I have stayed at has asked what type of vehicle I have parked in the lot, to avoid situations like this and to create exceptionally unhappy guests.

reviews.author: STEPHANIE
reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.body: Super clean parking lot and rooms. I liked that there was security in the parking lot. Nice to have a **place** near the Sphere!

reviews.author: J Hay
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: The staff were extremely friendly and helpful!

reviews.author: Persian R
reviews.title: Location & WiFi is HORRIBLE!
reviews.body:
I originally booked a four-night stay because this trip was a combination of business and leisure. Unfortunately, I ended up checking out early and moving to another hotel.

One of the biggest issues was the Wi-Fi. If you’re planning to work remotely, attend Zoom meetings, or conduct business from your room, I would strongly recommend staying elsewhere. The Wi-Fi was consistently slow, unreliable, and frequently disconnected throughout my stay. For a property charging premium rates, dependable internet should be a given.

The hotel’s location was another disappointment. The surrounding area felt distressed and did not align with the upscale experience I expected. Between the unreliable Wi-Fi and the location, this property simply wasn’t a good fit for either my business needs or my vacation.

I rarely cut trips short, but this experience left me with no choice. I checked out early and relocated to another hotel, which was ultimately the right decision.

reviews.author: ArielKay33
reviews.title: Convenient and Affordable
reviews.body: My husband and I stayed here to attend Illenium at the Sphere on the 4th of July. This hotel is .5 miles away (walking distance) from the Sphere so it was very convenient. I also liked that this hotel was clean, spacious, and very affordable.

reviews.author: Cherry Rhedd
reviews.title: I am satisfied 👌
reviews.body:
Almost perfect.  But just maintain the cleanliness of the room from bedsheets, bed covers, pillows and all the towels.  It needs to smell washed and laundered.

For breakfast needs to have variety of food for everyday breakfast meals.

But the food server were great.

reviews.author: Will4fel
reviews.title: Close enough
reviews.body: We didn't want to stay on the strip but wanted to be able to walk to the sphere for a concert. This hotel is in a good location for that. The walk was not bad. The only negative we had was we had ants in the room and we're told that they couldn't do anything about them until we left.

reviews.author: John D
reviews.title: Very good short stay hotel.
reviews.body: Good location for our visit to the Sphere. Walking distance. Food nearby. Nice staff and good room. Not fancy but not pricey either.

reviews.author: LJ
reviews.title: undefined
reviews.body: Very conveniently located near the convention center. I stayed here a couple years ago and have to say they haven't changed. Very relaxing stay.

reviews.author: Bridget
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.body: Everything was amazing! The staff was incredible. Thank you!

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Bad Reception upon arrival
reviews.body:
Bad Reception from Dijon. 
I did not feel welcome upon entering the lobby. When I got to the counter, I attempted to check in but Dijon
said we are not checking in until 1:00. It was 12:40. He confirmed that we were in the right location and I could wait 20- 30 minutes in the lobby. So, I went to the car to call my husband and get my bags.
When we returned, my husband asked to use the restroom because the door was locked and required a code. Dijon responded by saying that the restrooms were for guests only. I was stunned by the response. I said that we are guests. He had just seen my confirmation on the Bonvoy app.  He contested, “You aren’t registered yet.” At this time , I was sitting in a lobby chair with my luggage. 
I responded in disbelief, “I have never been treated like this when I arrived at Marriott.” He said, “Like what.” 
I made eye contact with a woman seated  in the lobby area waiting to get a room assignment like me. She said that she was treated that way, too. I said that it was unacceptable. 
He finally opened the door to let my husband use the restroom.
I responded, “I hope that it gets better from this point forward.”
Was it too much to expect to use the restroom after a 4 hour drive? 
Shortly after I noticed that 2 other “non-registered guests” entered the lobby and asked to use the restroom and they were immediately escorted and let into the restroom. I was so upset by this behavior from management but tried to check in as calmly as possible. Dijon must have realized his faux pas and offered to comp. the $15 parking fee for what he called a “misunderstanding.” I thanked him but it’s kind of hard to erase a bad first impression. Thank goodness that I had a reservation for just one night. I left early the next morning.

reviews.author: Peraza
reviews.title: Average stay
reviews.body: It was an average day AC didn’t really work that well until 2 to 3 hours. The room was 81° when we got there the most it went down to 176 to 78 or you’re still OK but not worth staying there again. The food was decent for breakfast but felt like the eggs wasn’t cooked all the way well the sausage and bacon were really overcooked and the orange juice machine was out of order again would not stay here again and probably not recommend family and friends this hotel

reviews.author: John Mac
reviews.title: Average Room; Excellent Service
reviews.body: The room left a little to be desired. And I'm still amazed that any hotel these days still has fully carpeted rooms. But the staff was nothing but friendly and helpful!

reviews.author: Sue K
reviews.title: "Fair" grade for a Fairfield
reviews.body: Room was adequate but certainly not the quality level that we have experienced at other Fairfield properties.  Cost was also astronomincal for this 2-star level hotel property which clearly presents as a previous lower end hotel that has had some "renovations" to try to make it into a Fairfield but not to the level that Marriott Bonvoy customers have come to expect.  I would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Not happy
reviews.title: Power Outage
reviews.body: The hotel didn’t inform my husband at checkout that they were / would be experiencing a temporary power outage due to maintenance. My husband is a diabetic and his insulin was ruined because of the extended outage. Definitely a horrible experience!

reviews.author: Chicago fight fan
reviews.title: Better then expected
reviews.body: Great stay at decent price ,off the strip but close enough, rooms were clean and the bathroom too

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.title: Awesome hotel
reviews.body: Very friendly staff, clean beautiful hotel.

reviews.author: JKru
reviews.title: Recent Stay
reviews.body: Convenient location and great environment. This location appears to have recently been remodeled and is in great condition.

reviews.author: AnaT
reviews.title: Extremely good
reviews.body: Thank you very much to the hotel and all its staff for their dedicated work. It was only one night, but it was formidable to arrive at the hotel after driving 5 hours and finding a ready, clean and comfortable room.

reviews.author: Jetlagged visitor
reviews.title: Rooms are becoming a little tired
reviews.body: The staff are great, the location is great, but having been coming here for the last 4 years, I've noticed the rooms (especially bathrooms) are becoming a little tired.

reviews.author: Louie C
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Overall a great experience. Though, the few times I did try the provided breakfast. I do say that it needs a bit of an improvement, consistent in what they offer but not much variety overall.

reviews.author: Absh
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Excellent place to stay  with kids…away from the loud busy casinos…easily reachable to all the places like sphere, Venetian gondola,Caesar’s palace…enough to place to park ..

reviews.author: Frequent flyer
reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.body: I booked a room for my son online who was headed to boot camp after the second leg of his flight was cancelled.  It took endless hold with Marriott Bonvoy, multiple calls directly to the hotel, being completely lied to by the front desk agent and over 1.5 hours before my son finally got checked into a room.  I have booked rooms online at several Marriotts in the past when my sons have traveled for school or sports and never have I had the problem of them refusing to add my sons to the reservation and check them in.  And I certainly have never been lied to like that.

reviews.author: Rocio De Dios
reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.body: Awesome place! It a great place to enjoy Las Vegas. Excelente service and customer service

reviews.author: Maira h

reviews.body: Buena ubicación, buen precio con desayuno incluido

reviews.author: Diane 6
reviews.title: Too much noise
reviews.body: Was not able to get a good nights sleep.  Had someone from the next room banging on the door trying to get in the room.  We were woken up and had a hard time falling back to sleep.

reviews.author: ZamoraT
reviews.title: Clean Hotel
reviews.body: Very clean hotel rooms, breakfast area, lobby and very friendly staff great location. I would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: Sage
reviews.title: Home Away from Home
reviews.body: Very nice accommodations.

reviews.author: Joavnni16
reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.body: Stayed at the Marriott for a concert that I was attending so I wanted a stay to be comfortable but not too loud or noisy. The place was absolutely amazing. The room was spotless when we arrived and the desk attendant was super nice & courteous. Check in was extremely easy & all the amenities in the room were amazing. We will definitely book here again.

reviews.author: Scott B
reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.body: The only issue during my stay was the testing of the fire alarm system at 9:00am Wednesday morning. I had a late night, and had no meetings until later in the day, and was abruptly awakened with sirens and voice commands.

reviews.author: JCast
reviews.title: First choice
reviews.body: Fantastic hotel, great staff, and a number of great food options within walking distance.

reviews.author: 1st time visitor

reviews.author: WilJ357
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: All was well. Everything was clean, nothing was missing,  Everything worked well. The service was friendly.

reviews.author: Dboone
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Nice sized rooms with solid amenities. Clean and the staff are professional, helpful and kind.

reviews.author: DefCon Favorite
reviews.title: Prime location
reviews.body: This property is strategically located near great eateries and close to major arteries like the LV Conversion Center and the Sphere.

reviews.author: DS114
reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.body: Residence Inn by Marriott LVHC was a wonderful place to stay. The hotel was clean, easy to locate, friendly staff with a nice size room. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Sum W
reviews.title: Good for What We Needed, but Not up to Marriott Standards
reviews.body: The space in the room and location were great. I appreciated the staff for being kind, helpful and letting us check in early. But, this place needs a remodel first of all. The rooms are very dated and the furniture is starting to wear out. To be completely honest, the breakfast is truly awful. Plan to eat elsewhere. The biggest issues we had were the WiFi and the TV. The WiFi (that we paid extra for) was slower than the terrible cell service so we missed valuable calls and messages from our kids at home. The cable was out the entire time we were there and we were unable to watch anything on TV.

reviews.author: CORINA
reviews.title: AMAZING STAY
reviews.body: What a perfect spot to stay at near the strip but not in the middle of the chaos. Food and amenities were great, and our two bedroom suite was perfect for our family.

reviews.author: Cheri B
reviews.title: disgusting
reviews.body:
I was extremely dissatisfied with our stay at the Marriott Residence Inn Hughes Center in Las Vegas.
My daughter and I chose this hotel because of its convenient location near the Sphere for a Backstreet Boys concert. We arrived late, quickly dropped off our bags, and headed to the concert, so we didn't have time to really look over the room.
When we returned around midnight, we were disgusted. The room smelled moldy, and when I shined my phone's flashlight into the air vent, it was covered in black buildup. The chairs were torn and badly worn and should have been replaced long ago. Worst of all, there was pubic hair on the towels, which is completely unacceptable.
I do want to say that the staff, (Reema, Celeste )including the manager, Dan were wonderful. They were warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind. It's unfortunate that such a caring team is representing a property that is in such poor condition.
The Backstreet Boys were unforgettable. Sadly, so was this room, but for all the wrong reasons.
I would never stay here again.

reviews.author: TournamentTraveler
reviews.title: Great Location, Disappointing Rooms
reviews.body:
I stayed here for one night while attending an event at the Las Vegas Convention Center. The location was excellent—close to the convention center—and the exterior and lobby were clean and well maintained.

Unfortunately, the room was a major disappointment. I booked a two-bedroom suite, and it felt old, worn, and not as clean as I expect from a Marriott property. The peeling dining chairs, stains on the walls, dirty refrigerator, stained dish rag, and bathrooms that needed a much deeper cleaning made the suite feel unsanitary and overdue for renovation.

I’m a loyal Marriott guest, which made this stay especially disappointing. The location is great, but the cleanliness and condition of the room did not meet the standards I’ve come to expect from Marriott.

reviews.author: lm stay
reviews.title: best hotel
reviews.body:
Positive Review – Marriott Hotel Stay

I recently spent a wonderful weekend at the Marriott Downtown City Center and couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the moment I arrived, the staff made me feel welcome and valued. The check‑in process was swift, and I was greeted with a complimentary bottle of water and a warm smile.

Room
The King Deluxe room was spacious, impeccably clean, and featured a stunning city view. The plush bedding ensured a restful night’s sleep, and the high‑speed Wi‑Fi made it easy to stay connected for work.

Amenities & Services

Fitness Center: Modern equipment and a spacious layout allowed for a great workout.
Pool & Lounge: The heated indoor pool was a perfect spot to unwind after a long day.
Dining: Breakfast at the on‑site restaurant was delightful—fresh fruit, made‑to‑order omelets, and excellent coffee. The evening dinner at the rooftop bar offered breathtaking skyline views and a menu of delicious, locally‑sourced dishes.
Housekeeping: Daily housekeeping was attentive without being intrusive; the room was always refreshed with fresh towels and a tidy environment.
Customer Service
Every interaction with the Marriott team was exemplary. The concierge provided fantastic local recommendations, and when I requested extra pillows, they were delivered within minutes. The staff consistently went above and beyond to ensure my stay was comfortable.

Overall Experience
I left feeling relaxed, well‑cared for, and eager to return. The combination of elegant accommodations, top‑notch amenities, and genuinely friendly staff makes Marriott a standout choice for both business and leisure travelers.

Rating: ★★★★★ (5/5)

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable, upscale hotel experience.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.body: We always have a great time whenever we stay in this hotel. Especially Bianca and the hotel staff are the best. Everyone is very friendly and welcoming.

reviews.author: Ryan
reviews.title: Not to Marriott Standard
reviews.body: The hotel rooms need a lot of renovations. We had two rooms with a similar feel. Ended up booking elsewhere. For the price there are much better options. The room quality wasn't there for the Marriott standard. Bathroom doors didn't lock. Tub plug missing. Bathtub needs to be replaced. Old smell. It's a 1980 feel.

reviews.body: My room was dirty, not restocked, the kitchen did not have a garbage disposal and the dishwasher was not secured to the counter, so it would fall forward. The windows had gaps in the frames, so you could hear the wind whistling through. I’m not booking this one again.

The staff in general were friendly and helpful. Location was good.  Even though its a non smoking property, I could smell smoke in my room, wasn't terrible and minor compared to the overall condition of the room. I'd say, this Westin is just worn out..  I consider myself well traveled and this is the first time, I've sat down to actually commennt on a property.

reviews.author: jisang
reviews.title: The Worst Hotel Experience — 3–4 Hour Wait and Broken Promises
reviews.body:
This was by far one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

We were exhausted and desperately needed to rest, but there was no cleaned room available. We were made to wait for three to four hours before we could finally get a room. After such a long and exhausting wait, the hotel gave us a voucher for a dessert, but by the time we were able to use it, it had already expired, so we didn’t even get to enjoy it.

To make matters worse, we were also told that we would receive points as compensation, but those points were never credited to our account.

The entire experience was extremely frustrating and disappointing. After such poor service and multiple broken promises, I cannot recommend this hotel.
