reviews.title: Our hidden gem!
reviews.body: The Westin Hotel just off the strip was everything we could have hoped for. They provided a peaceful setting when the noise of Las Vegas was just too much.  Everything was wonderful, from the restaurant to the front desk staff.  Our every request was granted with a smile and a “what else can we do for you”?  We highly recommend The Westin to anyone looking for a reliable, high class, family friendly hotel.  The Westin is an incredible value!  Book now for your next trip!

reviews.author: Kai W
reviews.title: Unfortunately not that expected
reviews.body: We stayed in the westin for a conference, at checkin all seemed settled, at checkout everything went sideways, not clear how to bill, promising it will ge all good, putting stuff on bill that was not used, I will not come back!

reviews.author: JK 00001
reviews.title: I recently stayed at The Westin Las Vegas Hotel & Spa and it completely exceeded ALL expectations
reviews.body:
If you’re looking for a comfortable, well-located, and genuinely welcoming place that still puts you right in the heart of the action without the overwhelming chaos of a mega-casino resort, this is it.

Location is outstanding. The hotel sits just off the Strip on East Flamingo Road — an easy 5–10 minute walk to the main action, including the Flamingo, LINQ, and High Roller. What really sealed it for me was the proximity to the Las Vegas Monorail. The Flamingo/Caesar's Palace station is only a short walk away (literally a few minutes), making it incredibly convenient to hop on and reach other parts of the Strip, the Convention Center, or further destinations without dealing with traffic or expensive ride-shares every time.

The staff were exceptional from start to finish. Everyone — from the front desk team to housekeeping and the restaurant servers — was warm, professional, and genuinely helpful. They made the whole stay feel personal rather than transactional. Special shout-out to the team at the restaurant who remembered preferences and went out of their way to make every meal enjoyable.

The Good Plate was a real highlight. This contemporary on-site restaurant serves solid American fare for breakfast, lunch, and dinner in a bright, airy setting. Breakfast was particularly excellent: fresh, well-prepared options, generous portions, and outstanding service that set a positive tone for the entire day. It’s the kind of reliable, high-quality hotel restaurant you actually look forward to returning to.

The rooms delivered classic Westin comfort with the signature Heavenly Bed (which lived up to the hype), and the overall atmosphere felt calmer and more relaxed than many of the bigger Strip properties. Loved the Sphere views! Having the spa, fitness center, and outdoor pool on-site added nice extras without feeling like the hotel was trying to be everything to everyone.

All in all, The Westin Las Vegas struck the perfect balance: convenient location next to the monorail and Strip, outstanding staff, and a solid restaurant in The Good Plate. I’ll definitely be staying here again on future trips to Vegas.

reviews.author: Thinh
reviews.title: Exceptional staff, service and spectacular views from my room.
reviews.body: The Westin staff was friendly, and exceptionally polite. They made the whole stay at Westin worth it. I definitely will comeback.

reviews.author: Flygirl
reviews.title: First time guest
reviews.body: Great location and great room. I slept so good in the king size bed

reviews.author: Kev1n
reviews.title: BSB alright
reviews.body: Shout out to Toie at the front desk. She was amazing.

reviews.author: J and C Love
reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.body: Highly recommend ! Great location and walking distance to other attractions . Perfect view of sphere !

reviews.author: Dilip
reviews.title: Cold welcome and bad room
reviews.body: Cold welcome and bad room

reviews.author: AHamner
reviews.title: Disappointed - not what I anticipate from Westin or Marriott
reviews.body:
Some staff was lovely - others were (a
I'll be polite and say...less than). Room was not clean upon arrival and was not addressed even after reporting it to management.

reviews.author: C10161718
reviews.title: Great management obviously
reviews.body: Making a team of people work within the same high standards is difficult, they got it done!! The Westin Las Vegas is a clean great break from much of what you know Vegas as.

reviews.author: Gz gz
reviews.title: Food service was really bad room was not clean
reviews.body: Food service was really bad room was not clean

reviews.author: Kea88
reviews.title: One of the best, quiet and convenient hotels in Las Vegas
reviews.body: Love the location, walking distance to everything including the Rail/Train

reviews.author: JTWJR
reviews.title: Really great hotel
reviews.body: I would stay here again just for the convenient parking!

reviews.author: Rugger33
reviews.title: Desert Oasis
reviews.body: Close to the sphere, a calm property to relax before and after hitting the strip.  Staff are insanely welcoming!

reviews.author: Charlie
reviews.title: Nice stay but breakfast needs huge improvement
reviews.body:
Very nice stay, reception staff very friendly, felt very safe in area and great location to see everything, also close to metro. 
Breakfast however left a lot to be desired. The menu is very limited, and what I did order was very poor quality given the price. There are some excellent local cafes that provided a much better offering only minutes from the hotel.

reviews.author: HP
reviews.title: Rude staff, bad service.
reviews.body: My room wasn’t ready until 4pm. Front desk was very rude. I had already checked in on the phone very early but the front desk rudely said “why can’t you wait” this spoiled all my plans.

reviews.author: Soraya
reviews.title: Room was very dirty
reviews.body: Room was dirty: hairs on the bed and on the bathroom floor. Curtains were torn up. Shower was dirty and had hair on the floor. Stains on the towel. Would not stay again!

reviews.author: Lola
reviews.title: A wonderful stay to see Our Nation's Capital .
reviews.body: The location to the National Mall in DC was great.

reviews.author: Teddy P
reviews.title: Good stay, great location,  but in need of additional amenities.
reviews.body: The location is great, very walkable to different stores and restaurants.  However the room is smaller and missing basic amenities. I wasn't aware of insite cleaning and ironing servi e until the end of my stay since you have to request an iron and board via the front desk. Overall it's a good spot, just missing out on amenities.  Also, two elevators aren't enough for the level of foot traffic during my stay.

reviews.author: Clayton
reviews.title: Not a great breakfast for $60.00
reviews.body: No warning of a costly average breakfast

reviews.author: Nat
reviews.title: Three night stay double queen
reviews.body: Clean, basic hotel.  Small,  a bit crowded.  No closet no iron, small fridge no freezer.   No plastic cups provided.   No drawers or cabinets.  Coffee maker didn’t work with supplies provided, brewed coffee prices in lobby changed day to day, no cash or card accepted everything must be charged to the room, no parking included.  $49 for valet or $32 for self parking off site.   No hot tub no pool.    Exercise room was 24 hours and clean.   Hotel is quiet,  walking distance to lots of food options.   Staff were friendly.

reviews.author: Singing Mama
reviews.title: Nice Hotel by Dupont Circle
reviews.body:
Courtyard by Marriott was a pleasant stay.  The location is excellent, within walking distance of restaurants (try Pizza Paradiso and Amparo Fondita), the Mansion on O Street, a great used bookstore, and the handy bar/restaurant next door.  The DuPont Circle Farmers Market on Sundays is worth a visit. 

The beds were comfortable, the room and bathroom were clean, there was copious hot water and nice towels.  We liked it and would stay there again.

reviews.author: no
reviews.title: This was a Ok stay.
reviews.body: The hotel stay was average and met my basic expectations, but nothing stood out or impressed me.

reviews.author: Horrible shower
reviews.title: Horrible shower
reviews.body: Shower was a trickle at best could not even wash my hair. After long day of hot sightseeing all you want is a shower so disappointed.

reviews.author: Tan
reviews.title: Travel for work
reviews.body: Professional staff and clean rooms. Walking distance to many restaurants and few minutes walk to DuPont circle Metro Red Line

reviews.author: Joi W
reviews.title: Beware-dangerous area & awful rooms
reviews.body: I booked this location because I’ve had good experiences with Marriott in the past and this location also had good reviews. They were a lie. The king room is very small. I received an awful view of rats playing in a parking lot directly adjacent to the back of the hotel twice. Yes I asked to move rooms based on the view and I received a room with the exact same view. I should’ve paid for the severely over priced parking because my car window was smashed out when I checked out of my room Sunday morning. I thought this was a relatively safe area of DC but apparently not. I would not recommend this location nor will I return to any Marriott any time soon unfortunately.

reviews.author: Alan D
reviews.title: Great hotel and convenient location
reviews.body: Great hotel and convenient location

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Beautiful Marriott that just missed the mark!
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at the Marriott in Washington, DC, beginning on July 17. My experience was a mix of exceptional customer service and disappointing incidents.

Upon arrival, we were greeted by a receptionist who was incredibly warm, welcoming, and professional. She made us feel valued from the moment we checked in, and her kindness made a wonderful first impression.

Unfortunately, early in our stay, I requested an iron, and the one sent to our room was in unacceptable condition. It was so dirty that it stained my clothing, and despite multiple attempts, I have been unable to remove the stain. This was frustrating and could have been prevented with a simple quality check.

The following evening, on July 18, we witnessed a physical altercation directly outside the hotel involving a Marriott employee and another individual. This was alarming to witness and far below the standards I expect from a Marriott property. It immediately made us question our safety and detracted from what should have been an enjoyable stay.

While I truly appreciated the professionalism and hospitality of the front desk staff, the issues with the maintenance equipment and the disturbing incident outside the hotel significantly impacted our overall experience. I hope Marriott addresses these concerns to ensure future guests have a safer and more enjoyable stay.As a Marriott member this was just below the standard

reviews.author: Tia
reviews.title: Cute place to stay!
reviews.body: Stay here for just a night to celebrate my daughter’s birthday. Location was perfect. I would stay here again when I come to the area.

reviews.author: DC frequent flyer
reviews.title: Boutique feel
reviews.body: Great location, small hotel feel, with large hotel style and accommodations.

reviews.author: Llpp
reviews.title: Hotel stay
reviews.body: The bathtub was blocked n we had had to inform the front desk at 11 at night.  But it was fixed the next day..  overall we loved our stay at the hotel

reviews.author: EsqMom
reviews.title: Very accommodating on a busy, holiday weekend!
reviews.body: Between making my reservations and my arrival, I fractured my knee. When we got to DC, I was alternating between a wheelchair and crutches. The staff was able to change the room from one bed to two, so my husband and I could sleep more comfortably, and they were able to give us a room on the second floor, across from the elevator, which was a tremendous help.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great job Indie!
reviews.body: Good job Marriott DC Dupont

reviews.author: MattM
reviews.title: Great location and comfortable rooms
reviews.body: First time staying at the Courtyard DuPont location. Excellent location and comfortable rooms. No frills hotel but excellent value.

reviews.author: Kelsey
reviews.title: Hotel does not live up to Marriott brand .
reviews.body: Sadly would not recommend this place. Staff were not professional, rooms looked out at overflowing dumpsters, and breakfast situation is shambolic. The gym was good; large size with multiple machines and clean.

reviews.author: Freedom250vistors
reviews.title: Ehhh it was enough
reviews.body:
We paid $500 a night - It wasn’t so bad where we wanted to leave that moment and the bed was okay, the amenities were sad. 
No true personality to the hotel. Most the staff were nice but some were not very friendly. This hotel was just ehhh okay. 
No one came to our room for cleaning for five days and no clean towels. I had to call down and ask for towels and the garbage to be removed, the television didn’t have good picture. The little pantry store they offer inside the hotel was absolutely insane on their prices- $9 for a cup of yogurt and some fruit. The only thing they had was cold ice water in the lobby and it was always empty. 
The biggest thing that upset us was the fact we had to use our towels multiple days until we called and said please ! Give us fresh towels and toilet paper and remove the trash. No one should have to beg for simple things like that. The younger staff members were very friendly and even knew us by name but sadly the older clerks were so unfriendly. They don’t offer any complimentary coffee, they have these awful little machines in the room that look like they have been sitting there for years. This hotel was a huge disappointment. We will never go back. This hotel was over priced and had bad amenities and no thought of the trash in the room. Don’t waste your money and keep looking for somewhere else. The only thing they have are kind young ladies who are trying to be friendly to their guest. Older staff are rude and unfriendly. So disappointing! 
A big fat disappointment.

reviews.author: Emily B
reviews.title: Visit to DC
reviews.body: We came for a two day stay, and used this hotel for our overnight stay. Everything was great, and the staff were especially friendly and welcoming-I would come back for sure.

reviews.author: Andrea K
reviews.title: In a pinch!
reviews.body: Everything was great for my last minute trip. Only issue was my bathroom floor was a little sticky, needed to be mopped and I found a hair strand in my bed.

reviews.author: Deborah
reviews.title: Attending DAR Continental Congress
reviews.body: This hotel is located conveniently for attending all events. The front desk team is attentive and professional. Rooms are clean and comfortable. No closets, but wall hangers hold clothing (including gowns) in hangers.

reviews.author: SG
reviews.title: Enjoyed my stay.
reviews.body: I had a wonderful stay. From check-in, the staff was professional, welcoming, and genuinely friendly. I was greeted by name, offered a cookie and bottled water, and made to feel valued as a guest. The next day, the front desk associate was equally kind and engaging—it was refreshing to feel truly seen rather than just passing through. The hotel was clean, my room was spotless, and the location was convenient in a great neighborhood. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: JT
reviews.title: Cozy hotel in DC
reviews.body: Great little hotel with charming area around.

reviews.author: LMT
reviews.title: Got charged for services I did not use.
reviews.body: Bad experience... bad costumer service

reviews.author: Linmal
reviews.title: Loved the location and staff but a few misses.
reviews.body:
My husband, myself and 2 of our grown children stayed for 3 nights in a 2 queen bed room. The beds seemed more like doubles than queens. Very tight. The room was very nice but we paid extra to be in a high level room which had no view. Might as well have been lower. 
The staff was excellent and very helpful since we had to keep having towels sent up as they only provided 3 of each one for 4 people. The room is minimalist style which looks nice but is really very inconvenient for 4 people. We had our luggage laying all over the floor. Only a few hangers placed on a hook on the wall. No dressers, no closet. It was very hard to move about the room easily. 
Oh also only 3 pillows on each bed which was also odd for 4 people. 
The bar doesn’t seem to get much traffic so they just close up if no one is around. We tried to get a drink and watch the Knicks game but no bartender. We wound up bringing our own drinks in and watching. The bar area is very nice however.

reviews.author: bobnob
reviews.title: Disappointing stay and non existing room service
reviews.body:
No room service during the entire three night stay and got Tinea Pedis.
I really need to know if they ever vacuum or clean the carpet at all. Already an extremely disappointing stay and now with a health problem I have never had before after coming back after a week. This is utter unacceptable.

reviews.author: Charles0428
reviews.title: Basic hotel for your visit to D.C.
reviews.body: The room temperature could not be lowered to the desired temperature and the restaurant ambiance looks like a cafeteria.  Service in good however, throughout the hotel.  If you like your breakfast to be a packaged bacon, egg, & Cheese sandwich you have come to the right spot.

reviews.author: dpf27
reviews.title: Visit Washington D C 250th
reviews.body:
Our stay with at the Le Meridien , The Madison , was a central location for our chosen events. The hotel staff very friendly and 
accomadating, the Lady Madison Staff were fun and smiling, Abdule never miss a beat in his busy times , enjoyed his company!

reviews.author: Sunny05
reviews.title: Our new go to hotel in DC
reviews.body:
We come to DC for a weekend trip at least once a month, we've stayed in a variety of places including competitive luxury properties. Le Meridien is hands down the best bang for your buck. Its in a pristine location. Its a elevated hotel that rivals experiences and staff at $600 a night places near by. The valet team, front desk, and bar were incredible. Everyone was so nice and passionate about making your experience great. Will be staying here again. 

The area that could elevate them more is the breakfast food. Everything else was 10/10, fresher breakfast would really propel to the next level. There are some great breakfast options down the street as its in a prime location.

reviews.author: September 2026
reviews.title: Great location, average to below average service
reviews.body:
Geat location. 
No fridge or coffee in room. A fridge was offered but not delivered. 
No assistance from reception desk in arranging for early morning ( 3;00. AM ) taxi or transfer .to airport .

reviews.author: Keith
reviews.title: Long way to go
reviews.body:
Re-do the lobby to make it classic, comfortable and truly European.

Turn off the the bad loud music. If you must pipe in sound — low and classical.


Lower prices and provide fast, friendly service in the snack bar.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Will be back
reviews.body:
I did enjoy my stay and the services were just great. 

The workers there were friendly and professional which made me felt at home.

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.title: Great property
reviews.body: Great property minutes away from the metro and other attractions. Staff is friendly. Property is clean. Would stay again!

reviews.author: Arvind
reviews.title: Stay at Meridian was ok compared to other marriott properties
reviews.body: Property was clean. rooms were good. Staff were professional / friendly and room service was prompt. But maintenance was lacking. Had to request refills for water and coffee everyday. Microwave and minifridge were not provided and had to be requested.

reviews.author: Diane1239
reviews.title: A beautiful hotel!
reviews.body: Everyone who works here is top-notch and makes you feel like a King/Queen.  It is well located.  The beds and bedding are top-notch.  Housekeeping is impeccable, as is maintenance - we had a dead battery in our thermostat, and he was there in 5 minutes to repair.  We used room service and it was AMAZING!  Wow, how often can you say that?  Oh, and quite reasonable, we thought!  This was a birthday/40th anniversary trip, and I'd like to thank everyone there for making it so great.  Cheers to the front desk.  So classy and NICE!

reviews.author: Violet
reviews.title: Freedom 250 Grand Prix Weekend in DC
reviews.body: Excellent accommodations, helpful staff, clean hotel, nice decor and convenient in house restaurant & bar.

reviews.author: Nina S
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body:
From the valet, front desk staff to even housekeeping each individual made my stay great. Friendliness & respect every step of the way. The valet was attentive, received my car within 8 minutes each time, front desk staff acknowledged me every time I walked in & housekeeping greeted me when they saw me. 

Rooms were also clean, smelled great & renovated.

In a perfect area, plenty of food options!!

reviews.author: Grateful
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.body: Wonderful staff that always helped with a smile.

reviews.author: Hunter
reviews.title: The Perfect Place to Stay for Your DC Trip
reviews.body: The Madison is a beautiful hotel with a superb staff, clean facilities, & plenty dining options on site. It also feels like the perfect location. There are numerous restaurants/bars in walking distance plus it's a short trip to anything you would want to do in the city. Hard to consider any other hotel when planning a DC trip.

reviews.author: Eddie
reviews.title: Excellence
reviews.body: The Le Meridien Washington has some amazing staff. The housekeeping is top notch. The staff at the market place especially Francisco is friendly and takes care in providing excellent service.

reviews.author: Denis 1525
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Exceeded all expectations!! We love this hotel

reviews.author: Jaa2026
reviews.title: The Meridien DC - Room Experience Good / Billing Experience Poor
reviews.body: We reserved the Park and Dine package (includes room, parking, breakfast).  The room was clean and comfortable, no refrigerator. The valet team - excellent.  We had to request the breakfast tickets and upon checkout the parking was charged.  The staff member immediately adjusted the amount and provided a new statement.  The charges posted immediately, the credit has yet to post.  The billing department is nonresponsive and can only be reached by leaving a voicemail.

reviews.author: LLin
reviews.title: Attentive service at this hotel
reviews.body: From the valet team, to the front desk and the staff in Lady Madison, everyone was attentive.

reviews.author: LoyalGuestFromWisco
reviews.title: Comfortable Rooms, Great Service, Solid DC Stay
reviews.body: The Madison always delivers on service and comfortable rooms. The staff stood out from check-in to checkout. The front desk team was efficient and friendly, recognizing me as a returning guest. (I didn't need it this time, but when I've asked for a late checkout, they've accommodated it without hassle.) Location worked well for getting around the city. Walking distance to several good restaurants, and a short car ride to the main sights when needed. Overall, a solid choice for a business or leisure stay in DC. All reasons I book here again and again.

reviews.author: Eva71526
reviews.title: My Thoughts on Le Meridien
reviews.body: While the hotel was nice, it lacked amenities in the rooms. No fridge, microwave or coffee maker. I payed for coffee in marketplace even though they had complimentary coffee. No one told me.

reviews.author: Fefe
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: My stay was perfect for my business trip

reviews.author: RMov118
reviews.title: Coupon book on check in
reviews.body: I overall just felt very nickel-and-dimed at this hotel. All of the added amentities felt like they had an asterisk next to them and were over complicated by design to make them harder to use the full value of. The Le Meridien Columbus did a much better job at making me feel valued as both a guest and as a member

reviews.author: Kevin B
reviews.title: Le Meridien -- Superlative Service Across the Board!
reviews.body: From parking to guest welcome, to the restaurant to the desk agents EVERYONE was fabulous.  Special mention to the parking/valet team, Shewa at the market, Solomon the bellhop and concierge, Abdul and David in the restaurant, and Charles & John at the front desk. The entire team is a spectacular example of why Marriott continues to be a hotel of choice, and why I enjoy my stays at these properties.

reviews.author: PN88
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay Due to Missing Amenities and Poor Service
reviews.body:
I expected a much better experience from a Le Méridien property, but unfortunately my stay was disappointing.

The biggest issue was that my room did not have a refrigerator, even though the Marriott app indicated that one was included. During my stay, Washington, D.C. was experiencing temperatures above 100°F every day, making a refrigerator much more than a convenience. It was extremely frustrating not being able to keep bottled water or drinks cold.

As a Marriott Platinum Elite member, I was also surprised that none of my elite benefits were explained at check-in. The front desk staff, particularly the male associates I interacted with, seemed rushed and rather unfriendly, making the arrival experience feel far from welcoming.

In addition, the room was not properly prepared. The body wash and shampoo dispensers were not fully refilled when I checked in, and I had to contact housekeeping to have them replenished.

Overall, the room did not match the amenities advertised at the time of booking, and the service fell well below the standard I expect from a premium Marriott hotel. I hope management reviews these issues and considers appropriate compensation while taking steps to improve the guest experience.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Mr. Chestnut’s review
reviews.body: This place is excellent, the staff was very attentive really worked hard to meet my

reviews.author: Elite1
reviews.title: Le Meridian- DC
reviews.body: Great property overall but the staff really sets it apart!  From check in at front desk to the club everyone was friendly and welcoming.

reviews.author: Cherryl
reviews.title: July 4 weekend
reviews.body: Wonderful weekend ! The staff is kind, hotel immaculate and food and drinks amazing!

reviews.author: Great Lication
reviews.title: Awesome Stay!
reviews.body: Everyone was friendly and helpful.  Staff always had a smile and no request was denied.

reviews.author: Tee2025
reviews.title: 4th of July Stay
reviews.body: Everything was great ! The cleanliness of the room and share areas, like the restaurant and bar were always well kept. the room service was quick and very yummy!  & While checking out Micah was very patient and helpful while helping me use my gift card. Only thing is, i didn’t get the complimentary upgrade but I’m sure it was because of how busy they were due to it being 4th of July! But I will definitely be back ! 10/10!

reviews.author: Patrick
reviews.title: Downtown Washington
reviews.body: A terrific hotel with great staff at a great location

reviews.author: mightycat99
reviews.title: R. Martello
reviews.body:
We stayed at Le Meridien for the July 4th. 250 celebrations. The fireworks were fabulous and so was our stay at this hotel.
It is a stylish hotel with a superb staff. I highly recommend staying here!

reviews.author: PattyCooks
reviews.title: A Beautiful Experience
reviews.body: My time at The Mayflower was delightful. The staff throughout the facility were all friendly and accommodating. The facility is stunning and I recommend any guest take the time to walk around and peek into conference rooms, etc. to find hidden historical treasures. My room was spacious, beautifully decorated, and spotless.

reviews.author: Julie H Dallas
reviews.title: Historic downstairs, Dated, Dingy & Drab upstairs
reviews.body: Hotel was fine. It's beautiful and historic downstairs. Front desk was personable and provided us with complimentary waters and was helpful. However, the rest of the hotel from the hallway to our suite was dim and drab. The lighting is low and unflattering, windows didn't provide much natural light unless perhaps you are on an upper floor. Room pictures online were either taken years ago or photoshopped. Room was very large, but several furniture pieces were missing. Bed was comfortable, showerhead was great, but no separate tub and shower available as advertised. Curtains, carpet and furniture a bit dated and drab. Guest services attempt to switch our room for a tub room as requested, but after about 45 mins of back and forth and moving rooms and moving back, we were told the bathroom pictured online for the King Suite was actually the Presidential suite on hotels.com. If you are traveling for business, the hotel is fine, if you are looking for a romantic or special experience, stay somewhere else and visit the hotel lobby and bar.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Mayflower
reviews.body: Poor Valet and Front desk service. Both very rude!

reviews.author: Jason M
reviews.title: Unfriendly front desk/phone etiquette and dingy looking rooms
reviews.body: The staff at the Front Desk were aloof and at times unfriendly especially on the phone. Also, the rooms were very clean, but very dated and dingy looking. Make sure to bring your own charging cords and converters because the room installed charging ports do not work.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.body:
We loved our stay at The Mayflower. The hotel has such a wonderful historic feel and so much character. I had read a few reviews describing the rooms as dated, but I didn’t feel that way at all. I found the traditional style charming and fitting for a hotel with so much history. Our room was also surprisingly large and very comfortable.

The location was excellent, within walking distance of many of Washington, D.C.’s landmarks, restaurants, and attractions, which made it very easy to get around and enjoy the city.

The staff throughout the hotel was wonderful, friendly, welcoming, and helpful. We also really enjoyed the bar and restaurant. Both had a warm, comfortable atmosphere that made it easy to relax and enjoy being there.

If you appreciate historic hotels with character rather than a modern, cookie-cutter feel, The Mayflower is a special place. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely return.

reviews.author: Not Pleased
reviews.title: Lack of customer focused service
reviews.body: Employees failed to provide service meeting base line Marriott standards

reviews.author: Heidi
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: I loved my stay. Close to Metro and not a far walk to trolly.

reviews.author: First timer
reviews.title: A weekend to remember
reviews.body: We visited for a work event but the hotel atmosphere made us feel as though we were only there for a romantic getaway.

reviews.author: Truffle TM
reviews.title: Beautiful Lobby... Dated rooms
reviews.body: The rooms are quite dated and the air condition made extremely loud noises and failed to cool the room to an appropriate temperature. It was so uncomfortably hot in the room that sleeping was impossible. The room has no natural sunlight and was quite dark.

reviews.author: Increase water pressure
reviews.title: Poor water pressure!!!!
reviews.body: All good x water pressure

reviews.author: George 2025
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body:
Terrific historical Hotel.
Huge selection of eateries , including at the Hotel.
Great service great concierge’s guest service leader best.
Check in easy. The major are really friendly and respectful and helpful.

I was always a great value as well.

reviews.author: Green Luxxe
reviews.title: Great Stay at the Mayflower
reviews.body:
Here is a revised, concise option incorporating all your perks:

> **5/5 Stars**
> Fantastic stay in a prime D.C. location! The Mayflower combines grand history with complete modern comfort. Upon check-in, we were warmly welcomed with wonderful gifts, including meal credits, an Uber voucher, and Old Town Trolley Tour tickets, which made exploring the city effortless. Attentive service and comfortable rooms throughout—highly recommended!

reviews.author: Susan B
reviews.title: 10/10 would stay again
reviews.body: The staff was accommodating for an early check-in. The bed is comfortable, more soft than firm, but definitely holds its shape.

reviews.author: Not great
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.body: Everything was clean most of the staff was helpful and kind. The person that checked us in was not. The mattress was horrible, the air conditioning had a mind of its own. I appreciate the history and everything was very clean. I won’t stay there again

reviews.author: MIJO
reviews.title: Great Common Area/Lobby, really outdated below average Room and worst service at Front Desk
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at The Mayflower Hotel for a week while attending the ASU Executive MBA Washington residency. The hotel's lobby and common areas are beautiful and have the classic charm you'd expect from a historic property.

Unfortunately, my guest room was a major disappointment. It was extremely small, cramped, and honestly felt more like a motel room than what I expected from a Marriott Autograph Collection hotel.

What was even more disappointing was my experience with the front desk. I simply wanted to confirm that I had been assigned the correct room under our ASU EMBA group block reservation, but my question was met with a rude and dismissive attitude. As someone who has consistently had great experiences at Marriott properties, this was very unexpected. I hope this was an isolated issue with the staff at this hotel rather than a reflection of Marriott's usual customer service standards.

Overall, the property itself has character and an impressive atmosphere, but the room quality and customer service fell well short of expectations.

reviews.author: VPATL
reviews.title: Great Staff; Cleanliness Could Be Better
reviews.body: Issues with the sheets being dirty when I checked in (yellow stains) and hair in the shower. The A/C in the room was very loud and the room smelled not very pleasant. Other than that, the staff are very nice.

reviews.author: Read
reviews.title: Mayflower stay
reviews.body: Great hotel food at the weekend was limited and no room service. But everything else was excellent..

reviews.author: JShiner
reviews.title: Mayflower is the beautiful historic property it holds itself out to be.
reviews.body: This was a lovely hotel. About a 35-40 minute walk to the National Mall but worth the stay. Every single staff member was absolutely pleasant. Beds were great, more than enough pillows, low noise. Great for couples and families alike.

reviews.author: A1985
reviews.title: Worst Marriott Experience
reviews.body: The staff was extremely rude and unwilling to help. The rooms are very small and you get one queen bed. The fire alarm went off at 4am. Water not draining properly in the bathroom. This place was a nightmare.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Not bad, not great
reviews.body: Nice hotel, but nothing extraordinary. Check-in and billing was a mess.

reviews.author: NHK2005
reviews.title: Service and Cleanliness Concerns
reviews.body:
I’m writing to share my disappointment with a recent three-night stay at The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection, from July 9-12. As a Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite member, I expect a certain standard of service, and unfortunately this stay fell well short of that, especially for a property positioned as a 4-star hotel at this rate.

Our issues began at check-in. We arrived late at night with our children already asleep, and a bellhop helped load our bags onto a cart. Shortly after, I found that cart sitting unattended in the middle of the lobby with all of our belongings on it. When I asked, I was told staff had gotten busy and would get to it eventually. I ended up retrieving our electronics myself and bringing them to the room, out of concern they would be left unattended indefinitely.

When we reached our room, the toilet had not been flushed and still had toilet paper in it. There was no Do Not Disturb sign in the room, and the bathroom had no conditioner or body wash. When my husband went to the front desk to request these items, the response was simply “okay, so what would you like?” with no acknowledgment of the inconvenience and no apology.

Later in our stay, our children accidentally spilled coffee on the bed. We called the front desk to ask if someone could change the sheets. We were told there was no one available to do this, but that they “could send some sheets.” We understand housekeeping may not be staffed in the evenings, but there was no real attempt to solve the problem. Even a quick sheet change by an available staff member would have gone a long way.

Individually these may seem like small issues, but together they reflect a broader lack of attentiveness and a lack of genuine effort to be helpful, which I did not expect from this property or brand, especially given the rate we paid.

reviews.author: Focused1000
reviews.title: A stay at the Mayflower Marriott in DC
reviews.body: The highest praise I can offer is that I would stay there again

reviews.author: DON L
reviews.title: Tradition continues
reviews.body: The Mayflower is a legacy Washington hotel but has to manage to provide contemporary accommodations while maintaining the tradition.

reviews.author: Cha87
reviews.title: Historoc hotel with a rude personal
reviews.body: The receptionist were rood. The room service was Always knocking at 7 while sleeping. The AC was so strong that It made me come sick. No way

reviews.author: Gluten free required
reviews.title: Allergy protocols not followed
reviews.body: Do not eat conference food at this hotel if you have any dietary restrictions as kitchen staff do not practice allergy protocols and do not understand the harm they are doing to people with celiac disease by serving salads with croutons picked off of them.

reviews.author: E and B
reviews.title: Best Customer Service
reviews.body: Our stay was exceptional! Customer service professionals at every turn really made us feel welcomed. Would highly recommend staying with The Mayflower, we will absolutely stay again.

reviews.author: WiggyThump42
reviews.title: Grand hotel with a few blemishes
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel in a convenient location but needs a few furniture upgrades and attention to hallway carpet. The housekeeping staff was very kind and attentive but the front desk guy when we checked in was not friendly and doesn’t seem to like his job. We booked two suites and while our suite on the eighth floor was very nice (except for the view) the suite on the third floor was much smaller but cost the same price. I booked them at the same time but upon checking in the front desk attendant told me he was having to “find my second suite”and no explanation of why we were put on different floors. No apology and no offer to make it right. He didn’t like me asking to repeat what he said about the Wi-Fi and amenities since it was hard to hear him and said to me “read the card I’m giving you” in a hateful tone. I can honestly say that most front desk attendants usually greet the patrons but this one couldn’t be bothered.

reviews.author: FloridaManTravels
reviews.title: Overrun by Third World Staff!
reviews.body: Charming historical hotel with stunning lobby in the heart of DC. Unfortunately, Marriott has chosen to staff it with third world ESL Muslims who don’t understand American customs, culture or customer service. The so-called concierge was absolutely clueless and when questioned about the neighbor hood would become defensive. So weird. Other Muslim employees didn’t understand basic hotel protocols and couldn’t explain why things were done the way they were. Other guests shared my same opinion and my wife was so disgusted with all of them. So disappointed to see a historic treasure ruined by clueless foreign borne staff.

reviews.author: Regina
reviews.title: Not yiur typical Sutograph collection
reviews.body:
The building is charming and has quite a history. The rooms are small but adequate. They don't invite you to stay in.
Basically a place to rest in bed, take a shower and leave. The staff seems to be
Not as trained and experienced as my experiences with other Autograph Collection hotels that I have visited in the past.
Edgar, the only restaurant and bar in the property, is not open all day. The service is very slow.

reviews.author: First time to DC
reviews.title: Nearly Great
reviews.body: The hotel is awesome and the staff are great, however check the linens and towels, blood and yellow stains is not a great look.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Comedy of Errors
reviews.body: It was terrible. They didn’t have the correct room we had reserved. They didn’t seem to have any understanding of their own room inventory. The AC couldn’t get the room below 75F even though it was only low 80s outside. They brought us a broken box fan to help with the AC issues. They agreed to a 2pm checkout but still locked us out of the room at normal time. It was a horrible experience all around.

reviews.author: 22DE
reviews.title: Super Duper
reviews.body: All the staff is excellent!

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.title: We would stay again!
reviews.body: We were happy with our stay at The Westin for a weekend trip to the city. Staff was polite, room service/clean up was wonderful and the woman was very sweet, food was good, bed was VERY comfortable. The only “cons” (which are minor and/or expected) were the pillows not being as amazing as the bed, and the cost of parking.

reviews.author: Krista
reviews.title: Mostly good some bad
reviews.body: Overall it was fine. AC was broken and not fixed when I reported (fan just ran, someone set the temp at 65 but it only cooled to 71), there was urine on my toilet seat and on floor at the base. Bed had a huge crater from wear. But the room was otherwise clean; the cleaners after the first night did a good job. The room was quiet.

reviews.author: Great to stay

reviews.body: Great people and safe environment. Really would recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Leigh
reviews.title: Perfect location!
reviews.body: My first time staying at this hotel and I was met with excellent customer service by Katie! She checked me in very quickly and efficiently. My room was clean and stocked with useful pleasantries. Bed was comfortable. Shower was hot. They have a 24-7 convenient store that came in handy during the late night hours lol.

reviews.author: salin Ghonchu
reviews.title: Nice place in washington DC
reviews.body: Overall an excellant hotel, clean neat and good people, beautiful lobby. My child was disaapointed as there is no pool.

reviews.author: Clark W
reviews.title: Something Going Right!
reviews.body: Having worked in leadership development when Westin was part of Starwood Hotels, I can usually tell when something is going right with the leadership at a property. At the Westin Washington, DC City Center, each staff member with whom I interacted was friendly, efficient, fun and proactive. These outstanding experiences suggest there is superb leadership at that property. Kudos to all of you for creating a memorable experience that I will surely return to when the opportunity arises!

reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Expensive to have no drums in fridg

reviews.author: Westinstay
reviews.title: Stole my AirPods
reviews.body: My AirPods were stolen from my room. Couldn’t get help from management.

reviews.author: Bdubya
reviews.title: Dated hotel, flying insect issue
reviews.body:
The Westin quality seems to be degrading. Overall the stay was pleasant and the ladies at the bar, Donna specifically, really made us feel welcomed and well taken care of. The front desk could take note. My room didn’t have a shower head, only a handheld wand with low water pressure. The rooms are a bit dated, as is the hotel itself. The public bathroom areas had dead flying insects on the counters and the flying insects were swarming everywhere. Thankfully they were not in the rooms themselves. I wouldn’t return for a stay at this 
hotel, but I would return to the bar cause Donna knows how to take care of her customers.

reviews.author: KAYE
reviews.title: Does Not Live Up to the Brand
reviews.body: The lobby was what you'd  expect from a Westin. Once you got on the elevators  it was a different  story. There's  a permanent  damp smell and the carpet is dirty. In our room the bathroom  floor and baseboards were dirty. Multiple  calls to the front desk went unanswered.  Desk staff were dismissive.  The food service staff and valet were kind and professional. Absolutely  would not stay again.

reviews.author: Zorro
reviews.title: Cigarett smell. Airconditioning not worlking
reviews.body: Room smelled of cigarett. Aircondition did not work

reviews.author: Cristina
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Excellent room and service

reviews.author: ZKincaid
reviews.title: Hotel cares more about saving money on the AC in the room than the guests being comfortable in their sleep
reviews.body: The AC in my room turned off every hour due to it being a motion censored thermostat.  I woke up sopping wet and had to alternate between beds to catch an hour of sleep at a time before the AC turned off again.  I stayed for 8 days and I was dehydrated, sleep deprived.  It this gave me heart palpitations, cramping muscles, and low performance at work due to the lack of sleep for 8 days in a row.  I think a hotel should realize that their customers are paying for the use of an AC in 100 degree weather and 90% humidity.  Worst experience of my life at a hotel

reviews.author: Steve H
reviews.title: Courteous Staff and overall great experiance
reviews.body: The Westin City Center is in a great location. Its people are friendly, helpful and courteous. We were in an interior room and it was nice and quiet. Great for recovery from the events on the Mall.

reviews.author: Mario S
reviews.title: Made to feel at home in DC on a busy busy weekend!
reviews.body:
Our travels brought my whole family to Washington DC over the July 4th celebration.  We knew the area around the Capitol would be packed - the Westin Washington DC City Center went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable and enjoyable.

The hotel was buzzing with people at all hours of the day - but the front desk staff were ALWAYS attentive and helpful.

Our room was a double double-bed set-up with a city view... the room was plenty big for two adults and two kids - and our luggage.

More importantly, the room was SPOTLESS.  It was a delight to be in a room that we didn't have to feel scared to walk around in socks... our socks remained clean on the bottom.  That's the sign of a room that is thoroughly vacuumed and cleaned after every guest.  (I know - your expectation is that every room 'should be'... after 35 years of travel I can tell you that they are not all treated as well as this room/hotel is.)

The next time my meetings take me to DC, I'll book the Westin Washington DC City Center!

reviews.author: Moneys345
reviews.title: Good but overpriced
reviews.body: Decent stay but not all that impressed.

reviews.author: Herrera
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: We took our meals at other locations because we were out and about from early to late

it was a great stay for me and my family,

We were all so happy to have met her. We’re in DC once a year. I think we may have found our new permanent spot.

reviews.author: Vanessa

reviews.body: The staff at Westin not only provides amazing customer service at times it felt as if they read my mind. All servers were well acquainted about wine and food and excelled at assisting patrons in choosing what would make them happy.

reviews.author: 2 Satisfied Guests
reviews.title: Very Satisfied Guest
reviews.body: Hotel staff was accommodating, the premises were clean and impressive, food was delectable and I enjoyed my stay immensely.

reviews.author: 305inDC
reviews.title: Great stay at The Westin DC
reviews.body: Great hotel, central and staff went above and beyond

reviews.author: Vince G
reviews.title: Sub-par Westin
reviews.body:
Comfortable stay, good location, but hotel needs upkeep. The first room I was given had a very damaged bed (totally caved in) with no working AC (the air vent was completely blocked with gunk). Second room was much better. 
Housekeeping knocked on my room incessantly at 8:30 a.m., which woke me up much earlier than planned. Very perplexed as to why this happened. 

Overall, not what I expect from Westin - a brand I generally enjoy very much.

reviews.author: BaltimoreVisitor
reviews.title: Baltimore_Visitor
reviews.body: Everyone was very welcoming and helpful. The rooms were amazing comfortable and we grabbed something to eat at the restaurant. The food was great, but your staff was the best part.

reviews.author: Ellebea
reviews.title: Great place to stay in DC
reviews.body: This was a great hotel for our week in DC. Great location, comfortable, clean and good amenities. The staff were friendly and helpful. The rooms were good size with comfortable beds and nice size kitchenette.

reviews.author: DC Newbie
reviews.title: Perfect place to stay
reviews.body: We were very happy with the week we spent at Residence Inn. We had extremely busy days, so it was nice to come back and have a comfortable place to unwind and relax. Great location for getting nearly anywhere in the city.

reviews.author: Punkin
reviews.title: Chicago to D.C
reviews.body: Traveled with my 11-year-old for a conference and this hotel was perfect. Full kitchenette and walking distance to Trader Joe's let us eat on a budget, and we could walk to all the major DC sites. Great

reviews.author: RP24
reviews.title: An Excellent Choice for Long-Term Stays
reviews.body: Excellent location, exceptional service, and well-equipped rooms. The warm hospitality and comfortable atmosphere made it feel like a true home away from home during my extended stay.

reviews.author: Mr B

reviews.author: Matt

reviews.body: Gets the job done. Smell is weird smells like smoke. Garage and stair well stinks.

reviews.author: Business traveler 1
reviews.title: The Residence Inn Downtown Washington is an excellent choice..
reviews.body: The Residence Inn Downtown Washington on Vermont Avenue is an excellent choice. Good location, clean and has a welcoming staff.

reviews.author: Must stay
reviews.title: Worth staying in Residence Inn by Marriott Washington, DC Downtown
reviews.body: I stayed at the Residence Inn by Marriott Washington, DC Downtown for 6 nights. If you are looking for an ideal hotel to stay neat all iconic Washington DC must see places, choose this hotel. It is walking distance from most iconic places. Wide range of restaurants are also nearby. It is quiet, clean, and well kept. They have complimentary breakfast which is good.

reviews.author: TwoWeekStay
reviews.title: Outstanding quality and service!
reviews.body: Truly the best lodging I've ever had in DC. The staff were fantastic to work with, and the location was within easy walking distance of everything. You could Uber there from the airport, then never need a vehicle again until you Uber back to the airport.

reviews.author: Ike1
reviews.title: Not impressive
reviews.body: Just didn’t live up to a Marriott property. I expected little more.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Very satisfied with the hotel.
reviews.body: I highly recommend the hotel; it is comfortable, has very friendly staff, is in a great location, and is an excellent choice.

reviews.author: RH2026
reviews.title: In town for convention with daughter
reviews.body:
My 11-year-old daughter and I came in town for a youth conference convention and really enjoyed our stay in the room. The room was very clean. It was very spacious. It was nice that it had separate areas to include the little sofa & kitchen, in addition to the bed and the bathroom. We were able to store snacks and drinks bought from the CVS right next door and because it had a full size fridge with a microwave, we were able to bring leftovers back from restaurant visits to reheat for later. It was nice that it was within walking distance to the convention center, even if it was a little over a half mile each way. It was also nice that it was a straight shot to the silver line Metro which allowed us easy access to and from the airport.  It was a nice start in the morning, especially with the breakfast offered each morning with eggs and meat and waffles and yogurt and fruit and whatever you desired. I made sure that each of us grabbed a piece of fruit that we could take to the convention center as late snack. The people who worked the counter were always very friendly and helpful, to include the house cleaners when we saw them as they would prep rooms. 

I just wish they had a pool, it would have been nice to be able to cool down and relax after walking 8 mi each day that we walked, but that's beyond their control. We would definitely stay there again, and would definitely recommend especially if you're expecting to stay several days and have kids.

reviews.author: Lisa Mac
reviews.title: Good place to stay especially if you need a bit more room
reviews.body: The Residence Inn is close to the White House and the Washington Monument.  The room is oversized with a regular refrigerator and freezer, stovetop and kitchen sink.  The room was clean and comfy.  There is a couch and desk area. There is one large tv hat swivels for wherever you are sitting. There is overground parking for $60 a night.  CVS is next door, pizza place close, short walk to Whole Foods and Farmers Market on Sunday. I enjoyed my stay here.

reviews.author: Ely k
reviews.title: Poor hotel
reviews.body:
I give this hotel pool

Of lack of communication of letting me know that Garage do the lobby has no elevator and I have to bring my luggage up 50 pounds two stories. There was no one to help me there was no one to bring up my luggage and when I spoke to the manager, she was very rude about it and she refused to help me just handed me a numbers and go call this one and it’s out of my hands. The hotel charged me for parking 500 bucks the first day. I have to park there six days then they will charge me. What kind of rule is this that you deduct 500 bucks from my account I have not even parked their 24 hours.  A staff was poor communication was poor clean. This was poor. Breakfast was very minimal and coffee was not hot at all.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Business Trip
reviews.body: Room was spacious and clean. Food was fresh and hot. The Staff though is what truly made this stay outstanding.

reviews.author: Bussiness trip
reviews.title: Windows
reviews.body: The only thing that I don't like on your hotel is, you cannot open any windows over the room,  all are blocked, the inside room was smelling dump

reviews.author: 2names

reviews.body: Hotel rooms were extremely clean and comfortable. Staff friendly and great location.

reviews.body:
No Valet Parking
Elevators require key even though it is behind you when you get on elevator.   No mirror to see what floor you are on again it is behind you

reviews.author: Izzy from Florida
reviews.title: Children’s hospital surgery for my granddaughter, could have stayed anywhere but stayed at residence inn.
reviews.body: Excellent all around even though difficult time

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.title: Residence Inn
reviews.body: Excellent location, good size rooms, and wide range of choices for breakfast

reviews.author: Dale
reviews.title: Mini trip to DC
reviews.body: Not what I expected.  The parking garage had no elevators and was two levels down.  It was expensive for the quality of the furnishings.  The balcony was large but the furnisher was sprawled all over and dirty.

reviews.author: Jeanette from Buffalo NY
reviews.title: Excellent choice
reviews.body:
Staff was amazing while handling my reservation issues. 
Room was extremely spacious and clean. 
Mattress, pillows, and bedding was +10 for comfort. 
Breakfast area was comfortable, food options were limited, but decent enough to start your day. 
Parking for a fee ($64 daily) but included in and out priviledges. 
Location was a little far for walking to see the monuments, however,  subway station is a short walk. Using the subway was so easy and super efficient. Trains were clean and we felt extremely safe while not seeing security guards. App available.

reviews.author: Over priced under served
reviews.title: Buyer beware of false advertising
reviews.body: Issued wrong room at checkin and an "upgrade " the following day to our correct room which had an ant infestation!!

reviews.author: Janice
reviews.title: Great location, great staff
reviews.body: The hotel is in walking distance to a Metro station and many DC sites like the Smithsonian museums, National mall, White House. Hot breakfast buffet is included. My room was a comfortable suite with full kitchen. The hotel was quiet at night even though I was on a low floor facing the street.

reviews.author: ConcernedTraveler2026
reviews.title: Security and Service Failures - Disappointing Stay Overall
reviews.body: During my stay, my reservation was closed and reopened, causing confusion. Twice, other guests were given access to my room, once late at night, and once while my wife was inside taking a shower. The front desk repeatedly failed to correct billing and loyalty information. These compounded issues led to a stay that was both unsafe and frustrating.

reviews.author: Rjn Miami
reviews.title: RJN-Miami
reviews.body: Hotel location was perfect & quiet.  The breakfast buffet was excellent, however the hot breakfast items didn't change frequently.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body:
I am extremely disappointed with the service we received at the Residence Inn Washington DC Downtown. I booked a hospitality suite weeks in advance, and upon check-in, we were told that the suite was not available. Instead, we were told we had been given “the equivalent,” which was simply not true. The only true equivalent to the hospitality suite I reserved would have been another hospitality suite.

Nothing was proactively offered to address the issue. We had to ask to speak with a manager, and even then, the only remedy offered was points. That did not come close to making up for the disruption. We booked that specific room for the space and layout it provided, and our plans had to be changed at the last minute because Marriott did not honor the reservation.

As a Marriott Bonvoy member and customer who planned ahead and booked a specific room type, this experience was extremely disappointing. I understand that issues can arise, but the lack of proactive service, meaningful accommodation, or real effort to make the situation right was unacceptable.

reviews.author: Average Joe
reviews.title: Family Wedding
reviews.body: Attended wedding; friendly & efficient staff; solid food; fitness area underwhelming but expected; lots of mosquitoes in the Lobby and they love me so eaten alive

reviews.author: Darby
reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.body: We stayed at the St. Regis which is a block from the Hay-Adams where we were attending a wedding. It was delightful in every way. My only criticism is all the offers of bottled water when we were waiting to check in. A nice chilled pitcher with ice and glassware would be nicer and way better for the planet.

reviews.author: Gator99
reviews.title: Old hotel
reviews.body: Room was old, very poor construction, overspray on baseboards, crack in joints in bathrooms that have been patched. Bathroom was small, room was small. Lobby had mold smell, room had mold smell, Maid service missed  twice, tile hallways were loud

reviews.author: DDF platinum
reviews.title: Good stay. Some items missed
reviews.body: The staff is very professional and helpful. The miss for me was the quality of the food at Alhambra. I tried two dishes for breakfast and each was below average. The platinum breakfast in particular is not what I typically see even at regular Marriott properties. The rooms run on the small size, and there are a limited number of suites that they will offer to upsell you to at a pretty high rate.

reviews.author: MAC and RANYA
reviews.title: Best Service Ever!!
reviews.body: I will never stay at another place in D.C. again - St. Regis earned its top spot!!

reviews.author: Dave Austin 904
reviews.title: St Regis Washington DC. Experience exceeded our expectations!
reviews.body: Fabulous hotel which feels like an old world European hotel in every way. Staff is outstanding.

reviews.author: Filippo Viale
reviews.title: August 2026, never again.
reviews.body: Never again. Terribile. Hotel very old.

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.title: More than a luxury hotel
reviews.body: Service from the staff of the St Regis was outstanding. They strive to go beyond and make the stay special. From check in reception to concierge, Doormen, valet, restaurant and bar staff. Everyone was super nice and welcoming. It’s a opulent hotel but the staff are what make it even more outstanding

reviews.author: Maya
reviews.title: Where True Luxury Is in the Details
reviews.body:
An exceptional example of St. Regis hospitality.

What distinguished this stay was the team’s precision, discretion, ownership, and remarkable attention to detail. Their ability to respond thoughtfully, communicate seamlessly, and ensure that every element of the experience ultimately reflected St. Regis standards was deeply appreciated.

Special recognition to:

• Katelyn — Front Office
• Katrina — Senior Executive Butler
• Brian — Chief Concierge
• Catherine — Butler
• Salomon — Butler
• Dona — Butler
• Janet — Butler
• Deric — Front Desk
• Huei — Front Desk
• Moses — Valet & Luggage

I was also very grateful for the beautiful and exceptionally spacious suite. Yet the lasting impression was the people: a team that demonstrated genuine care, professionalism, and exceptional follow-through.

True luxury is ultimately measured in the smallest details, and this team understood that beautifully.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.body:
The staff at the St. Regis DC are friendly and helped with everything they could.
I will stay again.

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.title: Amazing One Night Away
reviews.body: Amazing stay! We always choose the St. Regis for its exceptional service, and the Washington, D.C. location exceeded our expectations. Our suite was immaculate, the dining was outstanding, and every interaction with the staff was warm and attentive. A special thank you to Melissa and Latoya for making our stay truly memorable. We look forward to returning!

reviews.author: Mike Werner
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.body: Thank you for a great experience. Best Marriott experience yet!

reviews.author: Josh W
reviews.title: An Elegant, Courteous Experience from Start to Finish
reviews.body: From arrival to departure, the staff’s attention to detail and the calm, courteous environment created a great escape from the bustle of business. Responsive service was always evident, and the hotel’s spaces and amenities were as expected with no complaints. We utilized the gym, Afternoon Tea, Alhambra, and Valet with good experiences across all.

reviews.author: KML2
reviews.title: Celebrated our wedding anniversary
reviews.body:
We celebrated our wedding anniversary at the hotel. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. It was great from the moment the gentlemen at the door welcomed us in. The lobby was opulent with over the top neoclassical ornaments and Victorian furniture. The reception staff was courteous and eager to meet our needs. They have arranged special gifts for our daughter and a delicious cake for us in the room. 

The room was spacious, luxurious, and clean. The showerhead had the just right amount of water pressure. The bathroom amenities like shampoo and body shampoo were of excellent quality.

We enjoyed the sabering ritual at 6 pm and complementary glasses of champagne. Made the evening much more memorable. The platinum member prefix breakfast menu was amply portioned and of quality ingredients. We were satisfied. 

We would definitely revisit the hotel in the future and consider other St Regis locations thanks to our experience here.

reviews.author: SS85
reviews.title: Mixed Feelings
reviews.body:
Based on this experience, I would be very unlikely to recommend the St. Regis.

The initial issue was the air conditioning in my room. I returned to the hotel at approximately 4:00 a.m. after preparing for trial and found the room unbearably hot. Engineering attempted to address the issue for roughly 35 minutes, and I was not moved to another room until around 5:00 a.m., despite needing to leave by 7:30 a.m. The subsequent room changes were also handled with a noticeably dismissive attitude, including when I requested a room without an adjoining door. Although I later received apologies, they did not reflect the manner in which I was treated during the actual situation.

Despite the significant disruption, loss of sleep, repeated room changes, and the amount of time I spent trying to resolve the issue, I was not offered any meaningful accommodation or gesture of goodwill—not a room credit, dining credit, points, upgraded accommodation, or any other acknowledgment of the severity of the inconvenience. That was particularly disappointing given the level of service associated with the St. Regis brand.

My flights were then canceled, requiring me to extend my stay by one night. What should have been a relatively simple extension required call after call after call. The process was unnecessarily difficult and frustrating, particularly after the problems I had already experienced.

Finally, at checkout, I was told that I had ordered breakfast through the hotel. I did not order breakfast or any other hotel dining during my stay. I deliberately ordered through DoorDash each day because I did not want my American Express to incur no additional hotel charges. I was told that the breakfast charge would be investigated, but as of the end of the day on Tuesday, July 28, I still have not received an explanation or resolution.

This was not the level of service, communication, billing accuracy, or recovery effort I expected from the St. Regis. The repeated inconvenience, dismissive interactions, difficulty extending the reservation, unresolved charge, and lack of any meaningful effort to make the situation right significantly affected my confidence in the hotel.

Nonetheless, their night auditor/manager/receptionist - who was there when I checked in, and during my AC horror, she is the most pleasant, empathic, amazing, person.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: The BEST Hotel We've Ever Experienced!!!
reviews.body: Our recent stay at the St. Regis Hotel in DC was exceptional, excellent, and exceeded all our expectations. They gave us a room upgrade to a suite because our room wasn't ready. The room, the service, and the food was all top notch. We used the car service for dinner... a great perk and a great ride. Our anniversary stay was memorable in every way and we look forward to returning as soon as possible.

reviews.author: MotherDaughter2
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.body: The St Regis DC is beautiful and the service was so extraordinary, it was the perfect combination for a luxury weekend.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and rooms, Butler service lacking, food is average
reviews.body: Astor Suite was remarkable, bed extremely comfortable, Sara at the front desk was exceptional. Room service for desert took 90 minutes, they forgot about the order. Front office made up for it. Coffee delivered cold twice in the morning. Butler service no where near the St. Regis in New York. Location is excellent. Food from the bar was average at best, steak was tasteless. Beautiful hotel, front desk was terrific, overall it's a good hotel. But, be warned the expected St. Regis butler service is lacking. This is not the New York St. Regis, a step below. Enjoyed the stay, would stay again. I'll grade this a B+ for St. Regis standards.

reviews.author: manvol
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Great location, but for the money the property really should have a gym and spa. My room was clean but the front desk check-in area had one hundred dusty power cords under the desk and my thought was "fire hazard!"

reviews.author: Gene
reviews.title: Nice, but not up to St. Regis standards
reviews.body: Stayed for the recent 4th of July weekend.  It was nice enough, but not up to standards and expectations for a St. Regis.  I'm Ambassador and didn't really see any perk or benefit for that (crowded weekend, so I guess I understand). The rooms are a bit tired and could use a remodel, the gym is barely there, and the whole city was struggling with the heat, and our room was no exception where the A/C struggled to keep up.  The afternoon champagne is a nice touch, but overall, and especially considering the price, I don't think I'd stay here again when returning to DC.

reviews.author: Chubbs
reviews.title: Friendly
reviews.body: Smiles everywhere everyday

reviews.author: St Regis
reviews.title: St Regis
reviews.body: Elegant and friendly hotel.

reviews.author: Wilson F
reviews.title: OMG A MUST WHEN IN DC
reviews.body: The experience was one of a kind. I felt welcomed and appreciated. The staff super friendly and helpful. Restaurant was amazing! Every moment spent here was worth it.

reviews.author: JRod
reviews.title: Best hotel in DC
reviews.body: The hotel is perfect , from checking in , to the beautiful rooms. This is our go to hotel in Washington DC

reviews.author: The Daniels
reviews.title: Luxury, History, and Exceptional Service
reviews.body:
Our stay at The St. Regis Washington, D.C. was exceptional from the moment we arrived. The staff was professional, courteous, and attentive throughout our visit. The bellmen and valet team were especially welcoming and provided first-class service every time we came and went.

The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful. The elegant décor, grand chandeliers, and historic charm create a luxurious atmosphere that makes you feel like you've stepped back into a more refined era. The lobby is stunning and showcases the rich history of this iconic hotel, which has been welcoming guests since 1926.

Our room was spotless, comfortable, and well-appointed. The bed was incredibly comfortable, making it easy to relax after a day of sightseeing. The bathroom was impressive, featuring upscale finishes and a heated bidet toilet that added an extra touch of luxury. The room offered the perfect combination of historic elegance and modern comfort.

The location is outstanding, just a short walk from the White House and many of Washington's most popular attractions, making it easy to explore the city.

If you're looking for a luxury hotel with outstanding service, beautiful accommodations, and a truly memorable experience, I highly recommend The St. Regis Washington, D.C. We would gladly stay here again.

reviews.author: TravelingBud
reviews.title: We felt Welcomed
reviews.body: The St Regis atmosphere was great and we felt welcomed from the initial greeting at the entrance and throughout our stay.

reviews.author: Lreal
reviews.title: The St. Regis Washington, D.C. — Beautiful Property, Disappointing Service
reviews.body:
The hotel's classic décor and old-world charm are genuinely stunning, but unfortunately the experience fell far short of what you'd expect from a property at this price point.
The lobby restrooms were visibly unclean and overflowing with trash — not the first impression a luxury hotel should make. The room itself was adequate, but the lack of a standard mini fridge was a frustrating oversight. Bottled water had nowhere to go, and requesting ice from the front desk resulted in a 30+ minute wait. Even more surprising, a basic mini fridge could only be added for an additional $50 fee — an unnecessary nickel-and-dime charge at a five-star rate.
The in-room snack fridge had clearly not been fully restocked from the previous guest, which speaks to a broader lack of attention to detail. Reaching the front desk directly was nearly impossible — calls were consistently routed to butler service instead, making even simple requests feel like an ordeal. Staff interactions throughout the stay felt indifferent rather than welcoming.
As a first-time guest on a special weekend getaway, I had hoped the hotel might go the extra mile — a welcome gesture or complimentary upgrade would have gone a long way. Instead, the visit felt transactional. The bones of a world-class hotel are here, but the service culture needs serious attention.

reviews.author: Gary Cza
reviews.title: Feel like Royalty
reviews.body: The St. Regis will make you feel like a visiting royal from the moment you arrive on property to the moment you leave. Check-In was easy and the wait in the salon was excellent. My room was ready early. The restaurant was 5 star. The room was exquisite for a classic DC hotel and the service was deluxe. Will stay again.

reviews.author: Frank C
reviews.title: Exceptional beyond compare!
reviews.body: The St. Regis made our birthday trip something special. From check in, to the champagne toast at night, to all of the staff experiences in between. We had some of the best interactions, some memories we won't forget, and truly the best location in DC to tour landmarks and visit museums with ease. Would go back any time I am in DC.

reviews.author: GAFOG
reviews.title: Wedding at the St Regis Washington, DC
reviews.body: The staff at the St. Regis Washington, DC delivered an exceptional experience for the wedding weekend.  Every aspect of the event was well planned and they had even the most minute details covered.  The attentive staff were friendly and very helpful. It was an amazing wedding weekend, from the lobby bar, the nightly champagne sabering, to the reception, and then the Brunch with the Newlyweds on Sunday morning.  Truly a memorable event all around.

reviews.author: Hyrox0903
reviews.title: Not a pleasurable experience
reviews.body: I’ve already written the explanation on page 1. Will not repeat

reviews.author: Hannah28
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!
reviews.body: I love staying at the AC properties! The staff was very courteous and helpful. I felt very welcome at the hotel and very confident in my safety.

reviews.author: Pisces8
reviews.title: Goings to DC
reviews.body: Great location to restaurants, retail, bars, clubs and going on runs. Very clean room and friendly/knowledgeable staff!!

reviews.author: Rudy
reviews.title: 2 nights in DC!
reviews.body: We booked our room through Marriott Bonvoy and from arrival we were delighted with our choice. We took advantage of the valet parking since our 2 nights stay would require Uber and driving. The guest services, food, and drinks were amazing! 5 start experience!

reviews.author: Patricia
reviews.title: Great from beginning to end!
reviews.body: Our stay was lovely. We were allowed to drop our bags off before check in time. When we came back to check in the receptionist was very pleasant. Our room was spacious and clean. My only gripe was that the room was so cold; it took awhile for the room to warm up. Aside from that everything was lovely. The location is walkable and clean. Staff was warm from check in to check out. The entire process was seamless. If I’m in DC, I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Cherie
reviews.title: Military Monument Visit
reviews.body: Great hotel with a perfect location.  Only complaint would be the halls are really dark and doors take too long to close. Could be a safety hazard.

reviews.author: Ayeh Bassil
reviews.title: Great Stay with Excellent Customer Service
reviews.body:
I really enjoyed my stay at AC Hotel Washington DC Downtown. The hotel was very clean, comfortable, and had a modern, upscale feel. What impressed me most was the customer service. I forgot my phone charger at home, and the front desk was kind enough to let me charge my phone with them during both days of my stay. It genuinely saved me!

The only thing I wish they offered was complimentary breakfast, as breakfast is available for an additional charge. Aside from that, I had a great experience and felt the hotel was absolutely worth the stay. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others visiting DC.

reviews.author: MissDiva
reviews.title: Fun and Quick Stay
reviews.body: The hotel was nice and clean. The staff was pleasant.

reviews.author: MB
reviews.title: Great hotel, good value and location
reviews.body: We really liked this hotel. The staff was excellent (especially Kai). The room was nice and clean, and the location was convenient.

reviews.author: Not pleased
reviews.title: Unfortunate Experience
reviews.body: My l experience here was unfortunately nowhere close to enjoyable. I was kept up all night by other guests who thought it was funny to run through the halls, bang on the walls between rooms and from the rooms above, smoke weed in the hallways, etc. I was offered the ability to cancel the rest of my stay but this does not make up for the initial experience I had.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel in a great location!
reviews.body: I stay here on every business trip to DC.  Ultra clean and well maintained! Staff is professional and friendly and the food at breakfast, happy hour, or a quick dinner is fresh and delicious.  Highly recommend this Marriott hotel.

reviews.author: Alejandro J
reviews.title: Highly recommended after thorough search of area hotels
reviews.body:
From the moment we arrived, the experience was excellent\. The staff at check\-in were incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the beautiful lobby immediately gave us a great first impression\.

The room was spacious, clean, quiet, and very comfortable\. One of the highlights was the shower—it had plenty of space and an amazing shower head that made it a real standout\.

I also want to give special recognition to the ladies working in the early morning when we checked out\. The system was having issues and wasn’t cooperating, but they were incredibly helpful, patient, and professional\. Most importantly, they followed through on every promise they made regarding the reconciliation of our bill\. Their commitment to making sure everything was taken care of properly truly stood out\.

Overall, a wonderful stay with excellent staff, comfortable accommodations, and great attention to detail\. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: Jade
reviews.title: Event
reviews.body: I love AC Marriott, however this location with parking and valet was unpleasant. The rooms were a bit smaller than anticipate but overall it was still a nice stay apart from valet and parking. Staff was friendly and welcoming upon arrival.

reviews.author: DR
