reviews.title: Nice hotel in great location
reviews.body: The staff here is very nice and the rooms are clean and well maintained

reviews.author: Cheri
reviews.title: DC Review
reviews.body: Overall great stay and staff was amazing

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Convenient location, quiet rooms, excellent staff
reviews.body:
My family of 4 (two adults and two teen boys) stayed at the AC Hotel Washington DC Downtown for six nights in July 2026. We chose the hotel because of its location near the National Mall and also George Washington University, which my son was visiting. The location was basically perfect. I cannot overstate how nice it is to have so many varied restaurants and shops in close proximity, including a Wawa across the street. (Did I mention I have two teenaged boys?) This was a benefit I had not anticipated. We were also within easy walking distance of two subway stations and made great use of the excellent Metro system on a daily basis.

The rooms here are updated, very clean, and surprisingly quiet. (Were we the only guests on our floor of the hotel? It certainly seemed like it, though surely that's unlikely.) The front desk staff was able to accommodate us with adjoining rooms, another huge benefit to our family. They were also incredibly helpful whenever we needed anything: from assistance connecting a video game console to the tv (teenaged boys!) to recommended walking/ Metro directions to storing our luggage on our first and last day in DC so we could take advantage of the most sightseeing time.

All that aside, this isn't necessarily a hotel intended for family vacations, and some of the amenities/ inclusions/ features reflect that. The rooms are quite small, no meals or beverages (or related discounts) are included, no swimming pool, and absurdly expensive valet parking. Luckily we knew all of that ahead of time and planned accordingly. When we didn't feel like walking or taking the Metro, Ubers were easy to find, and even the airport (DCA) is just a short Uber or Metro ride away. And again, so many great and reasonably priced (for DC) restaurants right across the street or around the corner. We are already missing our favorite taco place and coffee shops!

All in all, if my son decides to attend George Washington U, this is the hotel we will probably book whenever we manage to visit him, and I will look forward to staying here again!

reviews.author: Mathew
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body: Excellent staff, location and rooms if you are in DC for work

reviews.author: Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Doesn't meet minimum Marriott standards
reviews.body: The hotel is fine, not much better, worse or or different than a hundred other hotels in DC.  They refused to honor the Marriott bonvoy program promise of a free breakfast for two people for Marriott Bonvoy platinum members, which was an expectation I had when I made the reservation.  So I didn't think the hotel delivered....

reviews.author: Dev
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: My stay was not long but I can truly say I will be back! The staff were kind and attentive. All areas of the hotel were clean and well maintained.

reviews.author: Laz
reviews.title: Excellent and Caring Service
reviews.body: The front desk staff showed true customer service!  Client relations in the industry goes a long way. Thank you!

reviews.author: Stephb
reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.body: Excellent location close enough to Smithsonian National parks and Historical Sites yet not close enough to be considered a tourist spot.  So your stay isn’t hampered by busy tourists and traffic.

reviews.author: KiLo23
reviews.title: Great location and modern design
reviews.body:
The AC Hotel has a modern, stylish design and is in a great location, especially if you’re in DC for work. There are plenty of restaurants within walking distance, and it was convenient to everything I needed.

Unfortunately, the stay itself fell short of what I’ve come to expect from Marriott. We requested a room change due to a marijuana odor, and while the staff accommodated us, the second room had the same issue. The room also felt humid and stuffy, the air from the vents carried a smoky odor, and we both woke up congested and sneezing, which made us question the room’s air quality.

The bed wasn’t particularly comfortable, and the room wasn’t well insulated from hallway noise (conversations, foot traffic, and doors closing were easily heard throughout the stay).

Overall, the location and appearance of the hotel are definite strengths, but improvements to room comfort, air quality, and sound insulation would make for a much better guest experience.

reviews.author: Rob
reviews.title: Great location but room wasnt clean
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location. The room was nicely appointed. However, the floors were filthy in the room and bathroom.

reviews.author: Sally H
reviews.title: Excellent downtown DC hotel
reviews.body: What a great hotel! 20 mins walk and you're on the mall. Great restaurants, coffee shops in immediate vicinity. Large room with very clean linens on the bed. Great friendly front desk staff. Would definitely stay again.

reviews.author: 4th of July
reviews.title: Delightful Experience
reviews.body: We wanted to experience our 250th Birthday and my husband's 80th in DC. We chose the AC Marriott because it was close to activities and we trust Marriott. It didn't disappoint. Food, staff and facilities met our needs and made it very pleasant. Great memories were built here and we will always be grateful!

reviews.author: Robert J Feezor
reviews.title: Perfect hotel in DC
reviews.body: great hotel - clean and decent walk to monuments.  great breakfast and wonderful staff.

reviews.author: Helen C
reviews.title: Another great AC hotel I stayed!
reviews.body: I always stay in an AC hotel because I like their minimalistic character. Their breakfast is excellent!

reviews.author: Cinderellen58
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: The location is perfect: lots of restaurant choices close by, walking distance to many DC attractions, including the White House. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Bar menu was surprisingly good, food was good. Rooms were nice. Reasonable room rate for location. A great place to stay!

reviews.author: Dawn C
reviews.title: Fantastic place to stay in DC
reviews.body: There is absolutely no reason for bar food to be this outstanding!!!!

reviews.author: HowardU
reviews.title: Three Nights in DC
reviews.body: 3 nights at the AC Hotel Downtown DC. The staff was amazing, but we are only able to give this stay a “fair” or “average” rating due to room issues.

reviews.author: J1MM
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Very interesting concept, from books in the room to the art gallery to rooftop deck bar

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Perfect Choice
reviews.body: From the friendly greeting upon arrival, to the cleanliness of the entire hotel, to the nice room with a great city view, to the delicious food and drinks in the restaurant, to the offer to store our luggage on departure day, the VEN was an exceptional hotel! The location was perfect for our time in DC. We will definitely plan to stay again.

reviews.author: NOT GOOD
reviews.title: Not good
reviews.body:
Called to let them know of a late arrival 
Also requested 6 pillows total. 
Also asked for a nice room with a city view, not. Given a room that was a special needs room. 
No communication when Air Conditioning and hot water were shut off, VERY NOT ACCEPTABLE SERVICE.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Don't go for the art gallery
reviews.body: One art gallery room was completely empty and abandoned. The space is not maintained and the art there at the time of this writing is not diverse and exclusively African American art. A lackluster experience for a tribute portfolio collection hotel.

reviews.author: Sara C
reviews.title: Wonderful Staff
reviews.body: The staff and service culture were excellent; the room itself was nice, though a little small. My main issue was that the walls were paper thin, and I could hear absolutely everything happening in the rooms beside my room. I would come back to get dinner/drinks/coffee at Fred & Stilla, but wouldn't stay again given the noise issues.

reviews.author: Luca
reviews.title: Ottima soluzione per Washington dc
reviews.body: Posizione perfetta per visitare la città punto fermata della metropolitana vicinissima ottimi servizi

reviews.author: Okey
reviews.title: One of DC's best
reviews.body:
The Ven at Embassy Row is one of the best hotels I have visited in Washington, D.C. I stayed here for three nights during a carefully planned concert trip, and this property did not disappoint. My Army buddy and I enjoyed everything about our stay.

Our interior room was clean, comfortable, and remarkably quiet, while the hotel’s amenities exceeded our expectations. We especially enjoyed spending time by the water, and The Ven’s rooftop pool and bar blew every other property out of the water. They were easily among the highlights of our visit.

The service was equally impressive. From the front desk managers and bartenders to the housekeepers and maintenance personnel, everyone was exceptionally friendly and accommodating. I had read other reviews praising the staff, and I can now personally attest that those compliments are well deserved.

The Dupont Circle neighborhood also puts practically everything within walking distance, including a wide variety of restaurants and shops. Fantom Comics, an excellent local comic-book store, was another great discovery nearby.

The Ven at Embassy Row represents exactly why I continue to choose Marriott hotels when I travel: the staff's professionalism and the quality of the service are consistently excellent. I have stayed at many other hotels throughout Washington, D.C., over the past 25 years, and The Ven will be the first place I return to—no matter what brings me back to the city.

reviews.author: KURT K
reviews.title: Great Place to Stay in DuPont Circle!
reviews.body: I stayed for 5 nights and was pleased with this property.  The gym was adequate, the rooftop pool deck was nice.  The room was very clean and comfortable. The hotel staff was very accommodating.  I plan on staying here again on my next trip to DC.  No question about it, I'll be at The Ven!

reviews.author: Niraj
reviews.title: Really good location
reviews.body: Excellent location, 5-10 mins walk from Metro station (Dupont Circle)

reviews.author: Swatson
reviews.title: Great staff and nice stay
reviews.body: I stayed at the Ven Embassy for work and my family came with me. I appreciated all of the amenities. My kids enjoyed the game room and played foosball. we also enjoyed the pool. The location was perfect. It was closed to my conference and conveniently located close to restaurants and shops.

reviews.author: TGeorge
reviews.title: Felt like home
reviews.body: everything about this hotel was great the staff, food, the room, all a must stay again

reviews.author: Jugie67
reviews.title: Nice hotel in beautiful DuPont Circle
reviews.body: The Ven is a nice hotel with good amenities in excellent location. Staff was very nice and quickly responded to requests and concerns

reviews.author: Timpe family
reviews.title: Perfect fit for our family
reviews.body: We came to DC for a convention and chose the ven for it's pool and good reviews. Clean, helpful, right on embassy row for beautiful walking views. Jorge made our stay exceptional as well as Jose and we will return to this same hotel as long as they are both still there making us feel at home. Clean rooms short walk to metro will hopefully be back soon!

reviews.author: Merry
reviews.title: Great hotel but pool area needs some attention
reviews.body: Room-wise, this is a great hotel. Super clean, comfortable and beautiful. It's also in a fantastic location. If you are staying here for the rooftop pool, look around.  The hotel only had 6 lounge chairs and the hotel is also part of Resort Pass, so insufficient chairs.  Only one umbrella was available. The other furniture around the pool needs a refresh and the rooftop needs a good cleaning.

reviews.author: Clausholk
reviews.title: Notification of planned disruption to normal services.
reviews.body: Our stay (3 nights) saw no notification given of planned events causing a) rooftop pool to be closed for 8 hours due to private event party and b) noisy construction activities (drilling) on a Sunday afternoon. These two events cause for principle claim, as I would otherwise have chose different hotel had I known of same prior to booking.

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: Highly disappointing stay—not worth the price tag
reviews.body:
Having stayed in Washington, D.C. multiple times, this was by far my least favorite hotel experience. There are significantly better options in the area for a comparable price, as a series of service failures and poor maintenance ruined the entire trip.

We specifically booked The Ven for the rooftop pool, but it ended up being the biggest letdown of all. The photos online show a stylish, inviting space, but the reality was dirty and chaotic. Tables were askew, trash and empty drink buckets were scattered everywhere, and three employees were just sitting around ignoring the mess. The pool water itself was murky, so my friends and I took one look and immediately walked out. It killed the experience right from the start.

The rest of the stay offered a steady stream of minor frustrations. There are stairs immediately upon entering the lobby, which makes hauling luggage annoying, yet no staff ever offered to help at check-in or check-out. The valet situation was equally strange for a service that costs $60 a day. Even after calling ahead to have my car brought around, the valet stand was hidden around the corner inside the garage rather than at the main entrance, forcing me to walk down to collect my keys every single day.

The room itself left a lot to be desired. The bathrooms are shockingly tiny, making it nearly impossible for two adults to get ready at the same time. Housekeeping was erratic as well. We were given no washcloths, requiring us to call the front desk to request some, and when cleaning staff came the next day, they took all of our hand towels and failed to replace them entirely. Worse, a housekeeper walked directly into our room without knocking while my friend was still inside. Even if a room service sign is accidentally set to request service (which was my mistake), staff should always knock first out of basic courtesy and guest security.

To top it off, both the dining and tv options fell flat. One night when we arrived around 9:20 PM, the front desk informed us room service closed at 10:00 PM. Yet when we tried to order on the app at 9:40 PM, it was already shut down, and the front desk unhelpfully suggested we walk downstairs in to see if the restaurant might still take an order. Meanwhile, the in-room TV relied on a finicky Chromecast system that barely functioned. It failed for the first two days, worked briefly after maintenance looked at it, and then stopped working again. Overall, this hotel falls far below expectations for the price point, and I won't be returning.

reviews.author: Susan 3
reviews.title: perfect service
reviews.body: excellent experience  - I cannot find a single thing that woud not deserve the highest rating

reviews.author: Camila
reviews.title: Highly recommend it
reviews.body: This was a last minute booking and it exceeded our expectations. The staff were very nice and helpful. The room was clean and comfortable. I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Dave W
reviews.title: Pool not open to guests
reviews.body:
Be warned that the pool can be closed to private events it was for most of the daytime Saturday and all day Sunday, so we were unable to use it for more than an hour or two and it was still being used by the private event with a loud DJ and most seats and chairs taken.

I was offered Bonvoy points as an apology but they have not showed up in my account 7 days later.

reviews.author: DrMac
reviews.title: Good
reviews.body: Good but we didn't receive free breakfast each day. It was only the first night. We are titanium elite for life.

reviews.author: DrMom
reviews.title: Not worth the hype
reviews.body: Service, food, and unrenovated spaces like elevators are awful. Staff don't seem to care. Worst Marriott experience, ever, and I am a committed patron.

reviews.author: HotinDC
reviews.title: No Pool available with 100 degree heat!!!!
reviews.body: How are you going to close the pool for a private party on the 4th of July with 100 degree weather???  Well they did it, advertising a hotel with a pool and then taking the pool away, without compensation.  Also, want a bite to eat on the 4th?  Sorry, also closed the bar/restauraunt for private party.  Another service taken away.

reviews.author: Stay at Embassy Row
reviews.title: Customer Experience at Embassy Row
reviews.body:
The Ven at Embassy Row, Washington, DC
The following is my experience at Ven at Embassy Row, Washington, DC
First: At check in I asked for a reservation at the Roof Top Bar for July 4th. At that time, they informed me that the Roof Top would not be available for the evening due to a private party. Hotel guest would not be available to use it. I received two early arrival notices from Embassy on June 28th and July 2nd that made no mention that the roof top would be closed to hotel guest. Second, on Saturday when I requested dinner reservation for Saturday evening, I was informed that the main bar and restaurant would be closed to hotel guest. Both areas were reserved for “private” events. This is the first time I’ve stayed at a Marriott on a Holiday weekend where the major facilities would not be made available to guest. Also, being told that there were many other locations we could use within walking distance. This I find not acceptable and never experienced this type of customer support from Marriott in the past.
The following also contributed to my final assessment on my stay at Embassy Row:
1.	I requested adjoining rooms for myself and my son’s. However, the air condition did not work in my son’s room. To correct the problem, they moved my sons to another floor. 
2.	The door to my room was very difficult to open. One had to be somewhat strong to move the handle to the door.
3.	During my visit I was locked out of my room from the inside bolt. 
4.	On arrival I noticed that there were no wash clothes in my room. I requested wash clothes on July 3rd. They arrived on the afternoon of July 4th.
5.	When I made mention to a representative about the bar / restaurant being closed for a private party I felt that I was brushed off. He showed no concern.
6.	When I discussed this with the front desk the person did show concern and asked if there was any way they could compensate us for all the concerns. She said a manager would get back to me. I’m still waiting.
7.	During my check out there was no mention of any of my concerns or apology. 

I brought every one of the concerns immediately to the Front Desk as they happened. There was no follow-up with me on any of the concerns. I did not feel like a Priority Guest. Please note that in the past I always found Marriott to be a Quality Hotel that showed customer awareness and satisfaction. Sorry that Embassy Row had to be my first one.

reviews.author: Mediocrebuthappy1
reviews.title: Mediocre
reviews.body: Ok for quick stay but a little dated and stingy with towels and wash cloths

reviews.author: Bruce
reviews.title: The Ven at Embassy Row is a comfortable,  cozy respite in a very busy DC.
reviews.body: I feel I ve found a hidden treasure in The Ven ar Embassy Row.  The location, just off Dupont Circle, is convenient ti the Metro,  restaurants, and other amenities.  The staff is helpful and friendly,  the restaurant has good food, and the rooms are comfortable and clean. Enjoy!

reviews.author: Ruth
reviews.title: Good location,
reviews.body: Hotel is well situated and convenient for business meetings in downtown area of DC

reviews.author: Stayed 8 Nights
reviews.title: Room Needs Updating
reviews.body: noisy hallways, sink in room chipped and full of black scuff marks

reviews.author: NJ Travelors
reviews.title: Perfect Gem on Embassy Row
reviews.body: This Embassy Row Centerpiece is in a great location for DuPont Circle and offers easy access to transportation at a wonderful value.

reviews.author: CHRIS 696
reviews.title: Very Nice Stay!
reviews.body: The Ven is Very Nice Hotel and the STAFF were VERY GOOD!

reviews.author: Kyra
reviews.title: Great Hotel in Great Area
reviews.body: We had such a wonderful stay in DC. The staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed and at home. And loved the extra special touches of the book club in each room. Would absolutely stay here again! We love this location and feels very central and accessible to many different areas of DC.

reviews.author: Alexander
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body:
I asked high floor suite on a quiet side once made a reservation, but received mid floor street side. We couldn’t sleep well. Receptionist  couldn’t care less. 
Our two bedroom suite was big, but dark and poor maintenance. 
The oven was dirty and there was an oven plate with leftovers of some food. It was really disgusting. The room service take this plate out but they didn’t clean the oven during our three nights stay. 
The room service was done only once and was very brief. 
Last night we sow big bug in the bedroom, but didn’t catch it and pictured it. 
Water pressure in one bathroom was very low but somebody came to check and decided that it is fine. 
Only one elevator was in service. 
The breakfast was very poor variety and quality. 
Staff were mixed, some nice some rude. 
The girl at checkout didn’t even asked how was our stay. 
They charged me about 100 $ more than an invoice I received. Still waiting for the refund. 
The only good thing was a location of hotel. Very nice area and good position to the rest of the city. 
Very disappointing experience.

reviews.author: Jose
reviews.title: Good hotel on Dupont Circle
reviews.body: Residence Inn is a good hotel for pratical purposes: good bed, good location, quiet ambient and good staff

reviews.author: Tooblessedtobestressed250
reviews.title: Above and Beyond an Excellent Stay
reviews.body:
We have stayed in many Marriott hotels all across the U.S., and this hotel far exceeded our expectations. The staff was amazing(and I don't mean one or two of them, I mean every single person from the front desk to the manager and housekeeping staff), the room was clean and comfortable, and you could tell that it is well maintained. The breakfast is the best we've ever had, and they kept everything well stocked. They also offered my wife a gluten free muffin and/or bagel. They even had cold brew coffee, which we have never seen at any Marriott before, and it was excellent! We also had the opportunity to try out the in-house restaurant for Happy Hour and appetizers, and the food and drinks were excellent!

One of the most impressive things I can say about this hotel is that the manager even helped his staff every day during breakfast and made sure all his guests had everything they needed. This is above and beyond, and we will absolutely stay at this hotel again in the future!

reviews.author: JSMN4th
reviews.title: Perfect for Family, Friends & Work
reviews.body: The Residence in by Marriott is in a great location close to the Dupont Circle Metro, so it's easy to get around D.C. The neighborhood is charming. We had a two bedroom, two bathroom, kitchen and living room layout. Every staff member was professional and attentive. The drinks in the bar were fantastic and the bartender was great! We would stay here again.

reviews.author: Great experience in DC
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Very clean hotel, and very accommodating and helpful staff.

reviews.author: Steve 19
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.body: Excellent Service. They always exceed my expectations. Staff is outstanding everyone from front desk, managers, service staff and housekeeping.

reviews.author: Sleepy
reviews.title: Do NOT stay on second floor
reviews.body: The room was spacious and clean with enough amenities.  The breakfast buffet included with the room was very well run.  The location is great near the embassy district and walkable to Georgetown and DuPont subway to reach dc sites, and near many restaurants having a vast variety of cuisines.  There were two downsides, the price was still a bit high (especially adding another $55/day for parking) and staying on the second floor we were directly over a bar that had a dj party until 1AM Saturday night.  Needless to say, that was more than disruptive to sleep.

reviews.author: Alisa B
reviews.title: Drawers don’t fit, no housekeeping, no lunch service for $450 a night
reviews.body: I ave stayed at properties for much less that were in better shape. Most of the drawers don’t close properly, there are no power plugs on the night stands and housekeeping is offered every other night- meaning not at all for a 2 night stay.

reviews.author: SarahJam
reviews.title: Great stay with extremely kind staff
reviews.body: Conveniently located hotel near lots of food and attractions. Very cute neighborhood. The staff went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable. The 2 bedroom suite was a great choice that allowed us to have a place to chill between activities. Recommended!

reviews.author: Petulla
reviews.title: Home Away From Home - Residence Inn
reviews.body: The hotel Staff is very warm and welcoming and rooms gives you a good feel while being away from home like you are at home. the surrounding community of Dupont Circle is vibrant and restaurants and stores are in close proximity.

reviews.author: Frequent DC Visitor
reviews.title: Excellent suite in great location
reviews.body: The Dupont neighborhood is ideal in DC— lively and with plenty of shops and restaurants, but calmer and more congenial than downtown. Immediate access to the metro to get everywhere. My suite was spacious and comfortable, and allowed me to save a good bit of money by having some meals in the room.   The breakfast room staff staff and housekeeping staff were friendly, efficient, and accommodating; same with the front desk staff, especially the young woman who answered several questions for me. I will gladly return.

reviews.author: Life time Marriott Member
reviews.title: Excellent place
reviews.body: The staff is by far one of the top in the Marriott chain I stay at the Ritz JW you name it! If you’re in DC take the service not always the luxury.

reviews.author: Doc1221
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.body: It is not worth the nightly rate.

reviews.author: SWN77
reviews.title: Very nice hotel at the heart of Washington DC
reviews.body: very spacious rooms with kitchenettes, feels like an apartment

reviews.author: Homero Elizondo
reviews.title: Not a good choice to stay
reviews.body: Room are small and not clean ,, noisey room ,, Only good thing is the ubication

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Budget Hotel in DC, that's all
reviews.body: Nothing fancy, slightly disappointing honestly. Expected more, but DC on a budget there wasn't much better for a family of 6 for one room in DC.. Wish we would have lied and went elsewhere.. Very tight place..

reviews.author: Judy
reviews.title: Judy
reviews.body: Residence Inn by Marriott Washington DC/Dupont Circle is an excellent place to stay while visiting our nations capital.   It is very conveniently located to the metro.   The hotel is clean, well maintained,and staff is friendly and accommodating.  I have already reserved my next stay in Dec.

reviews.author: Ted N
reviews.title: Attentive service and great location
reviews.body: For being an urban located Residence Inn, this location offered a superb level of amenities, neighborhood and attentive staff for our family weekend in DC.  And a special shout out to Ronita at the front desk who makes every guest feel like the most important guest at the property.

reviews.author: FenxFire Arizona
reviews.title: The best staff and a restaurant surprise!
reviews.body: This was the most pleasant surprise of any stay, and I travel quite a bit. First, the hotel staff was WONDERFUL; encouraging, helpful, and kind. Second, adding the restaurant to a Residence Inn is brilliant. I have often chosen other Marriott properties specifically because of on-site restaurants. When I travel for business, that does not include a hotel-based seminar, I keep in mind that I do not want to venture out for dinner as a solo female. The selection of this hotel, without knowing about the restaurant, was based on cost. Finally, the restaurant itself was impressive. The staff was engaging, thoughtful, and provided a comfortable atmosphere. I ate there all three nights of my stay that they were open. The food was excellent, and the steak was cooked to perfection! I have never been this completely satisfied with any hotel stay. This hotel will be my hotel of choice on my future visits to DC, even if there is a hotel-based seminar!

reviews.author: Marriott Traveler
reviews.title: Nice Residence Inn location in DC
reviews.body: The hotel is very well located, close to the DUPONT CIRCLE metro station. The staff are friendly and personable. The restaurant bartender was very friendly and would definitely make me come back to the restaurant, and the hotel.

reviews.author: Salsagirlatl
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.body: The absolute best stay ever. We loved every minute of it. The rooms were well apportioned and quiet. Location could not be better - mere blocks from Dupont Circle and walking distance along a trail to Georgetown. Delicious breakfast. Clean. Incredible staff. We absolutely loved our stay!!

reviews.author: Barbara
reviews.title: Amazing Customer Service
reviews.body: Staff when above and beyond to assist us with anything we needed during our stay.

reviews.author: T from the 313
reviews.title: Spacious, clean, and ready to serve
reviews.body: I recently stay at the Residence Inn in Dupont Circle and It did not disappoint.  The staff were nice and welcoming.  The one-bedroom king suite was a perfect size for me and my daughter.  The breakfast was filling.  The on-site restaurant didn't miss.  The chef knows his way around that kitchen. The food was absolutely fabulous.  Everything we ate delivered.  I would go back just to eat to eat there.

reviews.author: Nia6
reviews.title: All staff was great!
reviews.body: All staff were kind, helpful, and went above and beyond to make sure my stay was good!

reviews.author: Grandparents of 5
reviews.title: BEST hotel staff in D.C.!!!
reviews.body: We traveled with our family and the rooms were perfect - our daughter and her family had the 2 BR suite and my husband and I had the 1 BR suite.  This accommodated 9 people nicely! The entire staff were A+, after 4 days they felt like family!!!  10/10 recommend!!!

reviews.author: Courtney
reviews.title: Way beyond expectations
reviews.body: Helpful staff, friendly all around, amazing breakfast. Great experience! We had an issue w the heating they fixed it right away. Will be back

reviews.author: K2025
reviews.title: Better options available
reviews.body: Dreary rooms. Old looking showers with barely any water pressure. Multiple issues with things not working throughout the stay. Tried to use the room phone to call front desk and it didn’t work. Employee called room and had a huge attitude about how she was saying hello and I didn’t say anything (I did-the phone wasn’t working). Netflix option on tv didn’t work the first few nights. Light burnt out in bathroom. Tried to do a load of laundry. Washer took longer than timer said it work and the spin didn’t get any water out. Had to stand over the sink and wring out every item from the puddle they were in. Dryers didn’t work. Had to run the same small load three times in three different dryers. Took three hours to do one load of laundry.

reviews.author: Joan
reviews.title: A lovely experience.
reviews.body: You did a great job of providing a home away from home for the WPI IQP students that were there, as well as making their families comfortable and welcomed when we visited for the holiday.

reviews.author: BusinessTravel
reviews.title: Front Desk Staff Excellent
reviews.body: The Residence Inn at Dupont Circle was great. Staff made all the difference.

reviews.author: Njh
reviews.title: Great DC experience!
reviews.body: The staff is what sets this hotel apart. The breakfast food was wonderfully prepared and the staff was attentive and with a smile this will be my go to hotel in DC!

reviews.author: Terrible Smell
reviews.title: Terrible smell and no follow through
reviews.body: I had to leave the hotel after looking at three different rooms. First one had a loud AC unit and the following two had a nauseating air freshener smell that caused an immediate headache. When I asked the manager to refund my room he said he would but then when I called the next day to confirm I was told they wouldn’t do it. I left the hotel to go to a different the night of check in because I was told I would get a refund.

reviews.author: JHUSMA87
reviews.title: Georgetown Marriott Frequent Guest
reviews.body: The staff at this hotel is amazing. I've stayed here several times and have always been treated as a welcome guest. The staff in the M Club is great. The hotel is not actually in Georgetown, but Georgetown is a close walk. There are several good restaurants within walking distance and this is a safe area. The only knock on this hotel is the mandatory destination fee that provides "free" credits to things that you are actually paying for (they are not free).

reviews.author: Retrac
reviews.title: Great receptionists Aretha
reviews.body:
Dear sir or madam,

We recently stayed at the Georgetown Marriott, we really enjoyed our stay.

I’m writing to say that one of your Reception staff Aretha was excellent and would recommend you give Aretha the recognition she deserves.

Aretha was very helpful, friendly and I would consider excellent at her job. Aretha went above and beyond her role in both helping us and in making us feel welcome.

My wife and I had a really enjoyable stay which in some respects were down to Aretha making us feel welcome and valued customers.

Yours sincerely
John and Beverley Carter

Confirmation ref # 77849639

reviews.author: Andrew A
reviews.title: Excellent Hospitality
reviews.body: Best location, great staff and always clean.

reviews.author: Swinny
reviews.title: Marriott Georgetown- place to stay when in DC
reviews.body: Front desk was so kind helpful and personable upon check-in after a long day of travel and arriving late- had dinner after checking in service, drinks and food were 10 out of 10!

reviews.author: Derek
reviews.title: great stay
reviews.body: Was in DC for business for a week. had my wife come for the weekend for an early birthday celebration and they really did roll out the red carpet for us.

reviews.author: Donnie from NC
reviews.title: Low stress conference.
reviews.body: I recently attended a three day conference held at the Marriott Georgetown. From entering the door after a very long day of flight delays, the check-in staff were so accommodating and provided great customer service. Having not eaten for most of the day staff directed me to order a great beet salad for the evening. Every staff member there displayed focus on making my stay pleasurable. The meeting rooms were comfortable with snacks and the food was very tasty. This was a great future location for personal travel in the future.

reviews.author: James
reviews.title: Leftovers for lifetime gold bonvoy member
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location and I’ve stayed here several times. The lobby area and bar are a great spot. However, upon checkin, I was thanked for being a gold member then given a handicap accessible room with 2 queens and a shower that leaked water all over the bathroom floor. Most others in my large conference group - who are not bonvoy members at all - were given the standard king rooms that I thought we all reserved. For all the money and loyalty I’ve shown to Marriott to obtain lifetime gold status, I am very disappointed to just be given the leftovers.

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.title: Good Location and Price
reviews.body:
The Rooms: Decent in size and relatively clean, but they feel somewhat dated and lack modern flair. The bed was comfortable enough for a night's sleep, but do not expect luxury finishes or high-end electronics.

The Lounge: The lounge is okay, though the spread is quite limited. The evening hors d'oeuvres and breakfast selections were basic, and the seating area felt more like a generic breakfast room than an exclusive retreat.

reviews.author: Bill O
reviews.title: Marriott Georgetown
reviews.body: Excellent staff provided great service for our entire week.  My wife and I truly enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: MojyB
reviews.title: Horrible check in !!
reviews.body: On July 4, I arrived at the Washington Marriott at approximately 1:00 p.m. to check in. I was informed that my room was not yet available. Since Marriott guarantees room availability by 4:00 p.m., I waited until then, but my room was still not ready. By around 5:00 p.m., after waiting for nearly four hours, I became frustrated and called the Marriott Bonvoy customer service line. The representative placed me on hold for about five minutes and was somehow able to make my room available immediately. This raises concerns about why the room could not have been provided earlier without my having to contact customer service. Unfortunately, the problems continued during check-in. The front desk associate failed to activate my key card for Club Lounge access, even though I had paid for Club Level accommodations. I also was not informed about the amenities and benefits included with my seven-night stay or those covered by the resort fee. As a result, I was unaware of services and benefits that I had already paid for. This was, by far, the worst check-in experience I have ever had at a Marriott property. After being a loyal Marriott Bonvoy member, I expected a much higher level of service. Waiting nearly four hours beyond my arrival, having to call customer service to obtain a room, and experiencing additional check-in errors made for a very disappointing start to my stay.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.title: Great location, amazing staff
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay for the July 4th festivities.  Our room was available was very nice, parking was right at the hotel, it is within easy walking distance of major sites.  We did uber as it was very hot and humid.  Loved the lounge-bar area, we met their each evening.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Typical Tired Marriott
reviews.body: Tired hotel with the public areas badly in need of renovation.  Staff though seemed very professional and generally friendly, and food service at the restaurant and Club was pretty decent and reasonably priced. Staff in the Club were exceptional

reviews.author: UCLA Alum Enjoys Stay
reviews.title: Comfort In DC
reviews.body: This was the first time I stayed at the Marriott Georgetown.  I wasn't quite sure what to expect.  One always expects hotel descriptions of its accommodations and amenities to be somewhat inflated.  In this case, the Marriott Georgetown met the descriptions.

reviews.author: Teenie
reviews.title: Excellent Services
reviews.body: Our visit to Marriott Georgetown was excellent!

reviews.author: Crash
reviews.title: I expect more from Marriott
reviews.body: For the location and price, Marriott needs to step up.  Breakfast was poor…just because it’s ‘complimentary’ doesn’t mean we have to settle for a poor product.  We’re downtown in the Nation’s capitol, and expect a better showing.  Front desk staff was great - excellent attendance to our needs.

reviews.author: Heath
reviews.title: We need more money from you
reviews.body: They’re going to charge your card the initial deposit for your nights stay and incidentals but then there’s hidden fees you cannot avoid as well. Then if you charge something to your room they’re going to apply another deposit charge to your card for the remaining nights, incidentals and charges. It’s insane they attempted to charge my card 3 times AFTER my initial check in. I budgeted well for my trip but they just needed more money. As if I traveled to the Nations Capital solely to be entertained by them. One of the worst hotel experiences of my life. No new sheets or towels after asking. Food was awful. The microwave was from 1985 and didn’t even make your food hot. Overpriced snacks as well. $5 for a Gatorade or 20oz Soda. I was flabbergasted.

reviews.author: Nancy J
reviews.title: Hotel OK. Destination Fee Charged is a Rip Off
reviews.body: This is for my stay from June 19-20. The Destination Fee is a rip off. The Big Bus Tour itself is poorly run. No one told me the bus only stops at the hotel once early in the morning, so I had to walk to the White House bus stop. The employee there did not give me the correct information on how long the loop took and that I would have to get off and wait for another bus at the Washington Monument. The employees seem confused about the blue and red bus system. They are mostly trying to get people to buy passes. I was by myself. The Destination Fee gives 2 passes, so one of them was of no use to me. I did not need the uber pass because I didn’t go anywhere away from walking distance. I do not use hotel wifi for security reasons. For the meal discount, I had to go to the front desk to have it taken off. It was not automatically removed.

reviews.author: Bonvoy elite member
reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.body: If you can stay at the Marquis or the Metro. This Marriott is a big disappointment.

reviews.author: Mayne Family Road Trip
reviews.title: After driving 7 hours on I-95
reviews.body:
We checked into the hotel at 1 o’clock in the morning we were bone tired we were treated with such respect and such kindness by Cheryl at the front desk. She was outstanding the next morning. My son went down and worked out in the Hotel gym. He said it was clean and properly appointed with free weights
The mattress was outstanding and the sheets are fantastic. I will be ordering them smooth like butter. I also appreciated the fact that there was visible security around as we were traveling on our own. It was just nice to see that. There was a presence of men and female security guards.
I do wish there was a swimming pool, but overall, it was a wonderful experience in a great location so close to everything!! we rented electric bikes and went all over to all of the monuments and ended up spending a great deal of time at the Native American museum, as well as the African-American museum and the botanical gardens just fantastic!!
Even though the outer structure of the hotel is kind of older, the individual rooms have been updated and they’re very modern and I really appreciated how there is a refrigerator. Also a coffee maker and real separation between the bedroom and the bathroom. It was great. We were in room 425 because I have a bad back. It was a great room to be able to get in and out of the bathtub safely because of all the extra handrails that we’re appointed in the bathroom, I do miss the lotion, mouthwash, toothpaste, and all the little amenities that you get everything now is attached to a wall, which is not my favorite, but I understand it probably cut down on cost overall the staff that we interacted with were professional kind and really seemed to care about our personal experience I love Marriott and I appreciate that these reviews do get red and that the people especially a few names someone they do get acknowledged so thank you thank you to Cheryl to Juan and to Claudia. Great job thank you so very much. !!!

reviews.author: DC Traveler 07
reviews.title: Room with blood and hairball
reviews.body: The room I was first offered had blood on one bed and a nasty hairball in the pillow of the other.  I asked to switch rooms and wasn't even offered anything for the inconvenience.  2nd room wasn't much better.  Way below the standard of which I expect from Marriott properties.

reviews.author: P Buckley
reviews.title: Great location, but needs an update
reviews.body: The Marriott Georgetown is in an ideal location in the West End. The service was excellent and the hotel offers a wide range of amenities. However, the rooms are dated and in need of renovation. The premium price for the location doesn't excuse the condition of the rooms and facilities.

reviews.author: Stoutgrowler
reviews.title: Exceeded Our Expectations
reviews.body: Aside from the great location of this hotel, the staff always made us feel welcomed.  The layout of the reception is warm and inviting with the lounge and restaurant area close by. The club lounge experience is excellent!

reviews.author: Leej2026
reviews.title: Weekend gate away
reviews.body: During our visit service and amenities were excellent, Room were clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: Adepa Ramy
reviews.title: My Stay at Washington Marriott Georgetown
reviews.body: I had a great time, great staff and the place was very clean

reviews.author: Ak2710
reviews.title: Most disappointing Marriott for a long time
reviews.body: Overall I was very disappointed with this hotel. We chose it for the location between downtown and Georgetown and obviously on that point it delivered, However we were upgraded to a corner room with little or no light, one of the TV's didnt work and the service in every interaction with the colleagues was about average, in some cases poor. Also do not use the restaurant , the service was again very poor and the food dreadful

reviews.author: AD with FFFAF
reviews.title: Reunion
reviews.body: Costly but good food. Service on evening shifts were excellent

reviews.author: Joel
reviews.title: Best stay at Marriott since the pandemic
reviews.body:
I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel. Kudos to Juan for making my statement relaxing and memorable from start to finish.

Rooms: Very spacious and designed to enjoy compartmentalizing the room and bathroom. Bathroom nicely designed and easy to maneuver if you have physical limitations. Housekeeping was VERY attentive and timely.

Service: Excellent treatment for guests and visitors. I enjoyed a couple of meals in the bar area and the staff were friendly, knowledgeable and efficient

Location: Perfect for walking around DuPont Circle, riding Metro (10-15 minute easy walk to either Blue or Red line trains), accessible to anywhere in the DMV area and airports using ride share or a rental car

Juan and Team - thank you again for an amazing stay!

reviews.author: Disappointed 1
reviews.title: Worst Hotel Experience Ever
reviews.body: Worst hotel experience ever. Poor management. Hotel overbooked. Didn't get my room until after 10 pm the first night.

reviews.author: BHutch
reviews.title: Georgetown Marriott
reviews.body: Had another great stay at a Marriott property. Wonderful staff and location.

reviews.author: Danielle
reviews.title: Loved it!  We will be back
reviews.body: Amazing!  Safe and comfortable

reviews.author: BusinessTraveler
reviews.title: No hot water.
reviews.body:
Throughout my stay, there was no hot water in my shower. (The hot water in the sink was fine.) When I reported this at checkout, the front desk clerk refused to offer a refund, claiming the computers were down for a systems upgrade and that it was impossible to change any of the charges in my "folio."

That explanation didn't make a whole lot of sense to me, given that I hadn't checked out yet, and in any case had nothing to do with me. I was extremely disappointed.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: City break in Washington DC
reviews.body: Knowing the rules at Moxy hotels, I decided to book a stay, but I didn’t expect the check-in to take place in a club-like atmosphere, where I couldn’t hear a word the receptionist was saying. What’s more, the hotel states that there is a library on the second floor where you can relax in peace and quiet and have a coffee, but nobody mentions that this library is on a mezzanine level just above the bar, where it’s incredibly noisy. To sum up, this hotel is not a place where you can relax after a busy day. The noise is simply everywhere – in the rooftop bar, in the lifts, in the corridors and in the hotel lobby. I would definitely never recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: NS
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: Stay was good, room and the hotel was clean. Staff was friendly and helpful. Even though i stayed on one off the higher floors, there was no noise from Rooftop bar to my room. Even though the rooms are petite sized, they are good for a solo travel/couple and i never felt squeezed. This hotel is built for a certain audience and i advise people to follow that. Location is also good with some good food joints in the neighborhood and Metro stations nearby.

reviews.author: Kaitlin Yankowy
reviews.title: horrible
reviews.body: whole floor smelled like weed, when we nicely complained guy gave us attitude and caused a scene. acting like we were an inconvenience to what he was "going through"

reviews.author: Moxy Experience
reviews.title: Moxy
reviews.body: Overall vibe of Moxy was pretty cool. Rooms were alot smaller then we thought, hard to move about. Bartender downstairs was gross and unprofessional.  Sneezing without covering his face and didn't was hands while making a drink. Staff was very nice, Moxy itself is probably more for younger people or single travelers.  Cool vibes all around.

reviews.author: Carla
reviews.title: Cool vibe
reviews.body: Hopping vibe , dim and loud music in the evening. Just poorly labeled stair well and got locked in for a while before finding an exit in the basement . Also weird bathrooms were a glass box in the room. Bizarre. Wouldn’t recommend if sharing with another couple .

reviews.author: Sof94
reviews.title: Clean and good location but poor service and breakfast
reviews.body:
Fine rooms. Though very loud from the rooftop bar to very late in the night. We hoped to be able to use the rooftop bar for cozy evenings, but there were always loud private parties, making it a bit awkward to  be up there. 
We didn’t get a lot of information at check in and breakfast is not recommended. Either you get something from the fridge or a greasy bagel that apparently takes a long time to make especially if you order at 7 am when they open.. 
There was a rude woman at checkout that didn’t take time to explain things and didn’t let us talk.
Overall it is a cozy place and it could be a 10/10 by improving staff, breakfast and not allowing huge parties from outside in the rooftop bar to prioritize people that are actually paying to stay at the hotel.

reviews.author: DC work traveler
reviews.title: Just okay
reviews.body:
Things I liked: fun environment, library space is cool, shower was great

Things I didn’t like: gym was not good (several machines but only one yoga mat and not a lot of space - online it says peloton available but that’s not true). Bed and linens were pretty bad too. And the rooms are very cramped with no closet so challenging for longer stays.

reviews.author: Makayla
reviews.title: Andre the Great Host
reviews.body: I can not say just how much I enjoyed & appreciate Andre. His personality was so lovely & he makes me want to stay at the Moxy DC everytime I come to DC.

reviews.author: Joe Mama
reviews.title: STAY AWAY FROM THE MOXY
reviews.body:
Where do I start? We'll separate it into categories. Yes I have the time. 

Room: 
 1. The room 602 had zero ventilation. When you showered, the entire room fogged up. 
2. As result of the lack of ventilation the room and air quality was extremely stuffy and it was very hard to breathe. 
3. The staff was accommodating enough to not only upgrade us but allow us to move rooms, however the room we ended up moving to 611, the shower drain doesn't work. The shower was pooling. 

The elevators: 
1. One of the elevators malfunctioned multiple times during our stay. 
2. On numerous occasions when trying to get to our room, there was a line of people trying to get to the rooftop bar and therefore preventing us from going into our room. 
3. The elevators smelled like vomit and cigarettes 

The staircase: 
1. You would think that there would be a plan b for the people staying at the hotel in case the elevators went out, there's not because when you try to take the stairs the doors to get into each floor are locked from the staircase side. 
2. Threat to Life and safety. I work for the fire department, so I can speak on this. In the event, God forbid there is a fire on a floor and you have to escape and go upstairs guess what, you can't because the doors, all of them are locked. And there is only one obvious staircase for the residents in case there is a fire. 

Bathroom in the basement: 
1. During our stay one of the pipes seemed to have burst and caused flooding of the toilet or toilets. There was a disgusting smell followed by fecal matter all over the floor of the basement bathroom. 

Rooftop bar: 
1. You would think that considering there were little children staying at the hotel there would be extreme caution or parental guidance advised during a stay when there is in fact a swim suit competition going on the roof top bar. On top of that there was no warning signs or flyers indicating that any of that was going to take place on a random hour like 6 pm. Unfortunately I ended up going up to the 12th floor where the rooftop was to just have a drink and was met with that competition going down. Just to be clear, this was basically a strip club, considering what the woman were wearing. 
2. My wife and I left because thats not why we went to the moxy in the first place. But ofc while in the lobby, while there were little itty bitty children, the swim suit models were walking in the lobby, im assuming to their changing rooms. Unacceptable.

reviews.author: Ray H
reviews.title: Super fun, super clean
reviews.body: Couldn’t be happier!! The Moxy property and staff was awesome. Close to a lot of stuff, great walk to site see. Rooms were clean and freshened up every day. Super cozy and comfortable rooms. Definitely would stay here again!

reviews.author: kcarrollk23
reviews.title: Location
reviews.body: Great location, safe, clean and very friendly staff

reviews.author: Girl Tripping
reviews.title: Hip and Trendy Hotel
reviews.body: The staff is TOP TIER! We were shocked to see that 2 cocktails was $60 bucks at the rooftop bar but overall, wonderful establishment.

reviews.author: D Talley
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: I love the hotel, staff and aesthetics. I will book again when I visit DC

reviews.author: Vanessa
reviews.title: Loved my stay here
reviews.body: Loved my stay here this was my first time, but my Sister’s second time here. We felt safe, as two women traveling, and the staff were absolutely wonderful. The hotel was clean and also was very conveniently located to various attractions and events.

reviews.author: Kevon
reviews.title: Happy place
reviews.body: Great Hotel, good people, very welcoming, the staff were the best. I definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Flying Solo
reviews.title: Nothing to write home about
reviews.body: My stay at the Moxy was fine. It is close to the convention center, but that was about the only perk for me. The rooms are small with no closet or fridge, but clean and comfortable enough if you are traveling alone. I would recommend asking for a lower floor, as if you are on the top you will hear the rooftop bar all night.

reviews.author: JessicaH
reviews.title: Fun, Friendly, Favorable
reviews.body: My stay at the Moxy was great. The check-in process was smooth and like non-other. The rooms were accommodating, clean and perfect for two people. The complimentary drink each night was an added bonus! 10 out of 10 I would recommend!

reviews.author: Awful
reviews.title: Don’t book the Moxy D.C
reviews.body: No hot water. No morning coffee.  No iron in the room. Inconsistent heating and cooling of the room.

reviews.author: Frequent DC Visitor
reviews.title: Fun but Small Rooms
reviews.body: The hotel was enjoyable, friendly, helpful staff and cool decor, however, the rooms extremely small. For two people, it was uncomfortably claustrophobic. There was no where to place luggage, my husband and I had to shimmy by each other to pass, and there was no bedside table on one side of the bed. I would not stay there again because of the room size. Everything else was fine.

reviews.author: Nunello
reviews.title: Great for overnight stay
reviews.body: Cute upbeat hotel close to museums

reviews.author: AJ
reviews.title: Great for young groups
reviews.body: Great for a group of young or young at heart folks to have a room to themselves and still gather in public spaces.

reviews.author: Chris75
reviews.title: Unusual but a good place to stay
reviews.body: The hotel is unusual. The room is quite small (no desk, no closet). The bed was comfortable and the shower was exceptional (large, good water pressure, great shower head and detachable wand). A folding table hangs from a peg on the wall if you need a table or desk. Clothes also hang on wall pegs (only 3 hangers provided). The bathroom is a nice size but the walls to the bathroom and shower are see-through to the whole room (ok for couples on good terms or for single visitors). The main hotel spaces are lively and social. I worried about noise from the lobby bar or rooftop bar but my 5th floor room was plenty quiet. No through-the-walls noise. I could hear other room doors open and close but didn’t hear talking or other room TVs. The location is excellent—7 minute walk to the metro station and plenty of restaurants on the same block as the hotel. The staff are friendly and helpful. The vibe is fun.

reviews.author: Theresa
reviews.title: I had multiple issues staying here and would not recommend it to anyone
reviews.body: Not a good hotel. I expect for Marriott to reach back out to me

reviews.author: Claire
reviews.title: The club vibe wasn’t for us
reviews.body: The Moxy had a cool vibe on paper and in pictures, but fell short upon arrival. The rooms are extremely small. Would only recommend staying here if you’re a solo traveler or if you want to put your relationship to the test. Be aware you’re going to walk away with bruises all over your shins from running into the corners of the bed. We couldn’t even fit our suitcases under the bed where the designated spot was. While the downstairs looked cool online and seemed like a promising spot to hangout, we quickly realized we were a minority of the individuals staying there. Overall, the Moxy served its purpose of giving us a place to sleep for the night but we will not be returning or recommending it.

reviews.author: S Johnson
reviews.title: Super cute! Super fun! Great place to stay!!
reviews.body: Easy check-in process! Clean rooms and hotel! Food is good! Staff is AWESOME! And I love the free check-in coin for a drink!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Too small
reviews.body: Room was too small and one of the elevators didn't work

reviews.author: Solo Traveler80
reviews.title: Excellent hotel for solo travelers
reviews.body: Stayed at the Moxy DC for birthday celebration. Had an excellent corner room with great views. The entire staff from front desk to housekeeping all provided top notch hospitality. Had an excellent experience and would stay there again.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Excellent place for a staycation with your significant other
reviews.body: Very fun and romantic getaway with a lively atmosphere and a room that sets the tone

reviews.author: Tonnie
reviews.title: Incredible Staff
reviews.body: The staff at this hotel from the time I checked in early, valet service, and in room dining were probably the most friendly and attentive of any hotel I have stayed at.  The General Manager is one of the most positive, friendly people I have ever met and does an incredible job with her staff.

reviews.author: K Cromwell
reviews.title: Love the W Seattle
reviews.body:
I had an excellent stay at W Seattle and would absolutely return. The entire staff was friendly, welcoming, and genuinely helpful, but Africa on the valet team deserves special recognition. Since our very first visit, he has remembered us every time we’ve returned and always takes such wonderful care of us. He is incredibly kind and consistently makes us feel genuinely welcomed and valued.

The front desk, concierge, restaurant, and bar teams also provided excellent service throughout our stay. The people truly make the experience at W Seattle special, and we look forward to coming back!

I almost forgot… it is a short walk to Lumen Field. GO HAWKS!!!

reviews.author: Andy B
reviews.title: Extremely disappointing — nowhere near a 4-star property
reviews.body:
This was by far the worst Marriott property I have ever stayed at. I’m honestly still surprised that this is considered a 4-star hotel and marketed as a luxury/upscale property.

The rooms are extremely dated and, more importantly, dirty. The room also had a noticeable unpleasant smell. The bathroom floor had stains and dirt throughout, and the carpet in the room was covered with stains. The overall condition of the room was so poor that a highway motel would have felt like an upgrade.

Even basic amenities were missing. There was no shower gel in the bathroom, which I had to request. The old and empty minibar no longer works and had a noticeable unpleasant smell. The in-room phone either didn’t work or nobody answered when we tried calling.

Housekeeping was also inconsistent during our stay.

I have stayed at many Marriott properties, and this experience was nowhere close to the standard I expect from the brand. The condition of this hotel does not match its 4-star rating or its upscale/luxury positioning.

Very disappointing stay. I would not stay here again and would not recommend this property.

reviews.author: Heather B
reviews.title: Great from top to bottom!
reviews.body: I spent a few days at this property hosted couple meetings, stayed a little longer for some personal time. From check in to check out, every member of staff was AWESOME! I think I had the most people ever tell me how AMAZING the buffet lunch was that we had at the meeting I hosted. The food every time I ordered anything was great, and let me tell you, I am VERY spoiled and know my good food...I live in Portland..IYKYK

reviews.author: Enjoying Seattle at the W
reviews.title: Great location and front desk staff
reviews.body: Loved the location for Seattle and front desk staff.  Need to improve the service for the restaurant.  The gym is great .  Overall we really enjoyed our time

reviews.author: EliseM
reviews.title: Great service by the staff
reviews.body: Location was incredibly convenient. Staff recognized that I had made two separate adjacent bookings and was able to keep me in the same room without me asking. Great service.

reviews.author: Never again
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.body: I was never notified as promise when room was ready. The food was horrible at the Trace market. We ordered coffee before breakfast and 2 times during our meal. We never received our coffee. My daughter's Acia bowl had no yogurt. I ordered pork sausage and received chicken sausage instead. We never returned for another meal.

reviews.author: CalH
reviews.title: Disappointing service at W Seattle—not up to standard.
reviews.body:
​As a fan of Marriott properties, I was excited for my first weekend stay at W Seattle before boarding a cruise. I booked through Chase Sapphire Edit, which came with perks like an early check-in request and a daily $30/person breakfast credit.
​The stay started off okay. We arrived early, dropped off our bags, and were told they’d notify us when the room was ready. We grabbed lunch nearby, and right on cue, I received a call that our room was ready. However, the negative experiences began right there—the caller hung up on me mid-sentence before I could even say thank you.
​Back at the front desk, we opted to have our bags delivered to the room and were told it would take about 20 minutes. After waiting patiently for an hour, I called down to check. Shockingly, the front desk asked if I had my luggage tag—the very tag I had handed over to the agent when we checked in! Only after that call did they finally send our bags up within 5 minutes.
​The breakfast service at TRACE Market was another major disappointment. Arriving at 8:00 AM, the host station was incredibly disorganized with a long wait just to get on the waitlist. Even though empty tables were sitting open, service moved at a painfully slow pace, from getting drinks to getting basic attention. We tried again the second morning to use our daily credit, but the slow service hadn't improved at all.
​The hotel has great potential, but front desk communication and breakfast management definitely need work.

reviews.author: KimB
reviews.title: Bathroom tile has black mold
reviews.body: Just ick. And want me to tell you more. Isn't the title enough said?

reviews.author: Lauren E
reviews.title: Good experience and good location
reviews.body: Service was good and staff was friendly. Overall the hotel is small and not like the others in large cities. The trash was overflowing in the lobby on many occasions and there isn’t a rooftop or much social activity. Good location to downtown

reviews.author: E from Mpls
reviews.title: Skip it
reviews.body: Truthfully expected quite a bit more. For a Chase recommend property, this property under delivered on just about all fronts.

reviews.author: TheWSeattleIsVeryBad
reviews.title: Maybe Seattle service is a subpar bar?
reviews.body: Horrible service from arrival to checkout. No assistance with bags, car doors, accommodations requested, and it ended up feeling like staying at a budget motel with how haggard the whole property is.

reviews.author: Nice hotel
reviews.title: Nice hotel in heart of downtown
reviews.body: If you want to stay in downtown, this Hotel will be an excellent choice as all the landmarks are nearby. Hotel is very clean, staff is friendly. The only concern I had was the beds, The bed option is only Double beds , Not comfortable for 2 adults.

reviews.author: Max Khmel
reviews.title: Very Disappointing Experience
reviews.body:
I expected much more from a W Hotel, but unfortunately the overall experience was disappointing.

The Deluxe room was surprisingly small, and the beds did not even feel like proper queen-size beds. On top of that, the room was not as clean as I would expect from a hotel in this category. For the price and the W brand, the room simply did not meet the expected standard.

The bar is actually one of the better parts of the hotel. The atmosphere is nice, and the food and drinks were good.

However, the breakfast service was absolutely unacceptable. We had to wait at least 15 minutes just to get through the line, and then around 40 minutes for the actual breakfast order to arrive. That is completely unreasonable, especially for a hotel that positions itself as an upscale/luxury property. Breakfast should not require nearly an hour of your morning just to order and receive a meal.

The biggest issue here is not the food itself, but the service and organization. The hotel needs to seriously improve its breakfast operation and staffing.

Overall, the location and bar are positives, but the room quality, cleanliness, and especially the breakfast service make it difficult for me to recommend this hotel.

Overall rating: 2/5. The breakfast service in particular deserves a 2/5 and needs significant improvement.

reviews.author: Marc from CA
reviews.title: Great room with breakfast that lacked
reviews.body: The breakfast buffet was horrible.  Eggs were cold, buffet was a mess and the glasses and plates were all gone and none available to use for drinks or food.  I had to get a plastic water cup to use.  The hostess was clueless and did not care about service.

reviews.author: Stacy K
reviews.title: Don’t stay here!
reviews.body: Party of 10 staying there, I called ahead of time and advised of early arrival, only 2 rooms ready.  1 couple who made reservations in March didn’t have a room but was upgraded to receive a room immediately.  We reserved in march and was told our room category wasn’t ready but for several hours other people were getting placed into rooms but not us, we weren’t even offered the opportunity to upgrade or change categories.  Not acceptable!

reviews.author: C Kilroy
reviews.title: Incredible staff and a great location
reviews.body: The staff were phenomenal at every turn and made us feel welcomed and special, rooms were immaculate, and the location was great.

reviews.author: Sleepless in seattle
reviews.title: Lack of awareness all around
reviews.body: The hotel is very modern and cool. However, there is a general lack of awareness when it comes to the staff when you go to the bar, the bartender does not acknowledge you. It is completely inefficient and non-hospitable after checking into our room the floor was wet and their solution was to provide us with slippers after spending a night out in Seattle after using the toilet the water ran nonstop throughout the night keeping us up. We got no sleep, and the only resolution the staff would provide was some bonus points with Marriott. They did not resolve the issue and I do not feel like my concerns were not heard.

reviews.author: Brett Fish
reviews.title: Poorly run hotel - issues at every step
reviews.body:
My family went to Seattle for a concert. Arrived at the W around 5:20, after their (already somewhat later) 5pm check-in time.

Right on pulling up - the valet staff was pretty rude and dismissive, saying the parking lot was full, and that I had to move my car because they needed to get cars out. I asked where I should park to unload my family and our items since the W is right on a city block with no pull-in area, and they just shrugged their shoulders. They told me there was a paid parking garage a block away.

I went into the lobby to check-in and it was chaos. A huge line of people waiting to check in - very loud and chaotic. When I finally got to the desk to check-in, they told me that our room wasn't ready AND there was no timetable on when it would be ready. At almost 6pm. I asked if there was another room they could put us in or an upgrade (since I'm Bonvoy Gold and they're supposed to upgrade us if available - more on that in a moment), and they said there were no other rooms.

While I was letting them know that was really disappointing and trying to figure out how we were going to make the concert, all of a sudden she said the room was now clean and issued us our keys. We thought it was "crisis averted", but were wrong.

I went to park the car at the garage a block away and my wife and two kids went to the room. The room was dirty and had not been cleaned. My wife called the front desk to let them know, and they said they would bring her other keys, but 15+ minutes later when I got back to the lobby they had not yet. I went to the desk, and another person helped me and issued me keys to an "upgraded room". I told him that was odd since I had just been told that there were no other/upgraded rooms. He made up some excuse. but was trying to help.

Then there were several times during our stay where we called and requested things that were never provided. We asked for a luggage cart when leaving - never brought or called to let us know it wasn't available. We asked for an extra blanket for our kids and they brought something that was the thickness of a sheet and told it was the only one available. One blanket in the whole hotel?

Overall the word "execution" comes to mind - it was really poor execution at every step. Not a well run hotel. We've stayed at other Ws that were nice experiences - this one was not.

reviews.author: Kali G
reviews.title: Customer service at it's lowest
reviews.body: I travel a lot for work, a titanium member for Marriott and have been loyal to the brand.  Unfortunately, the W Seattle is a hotel that I will not be visiting for work or personal trips again.  I had to valet my car, which was $80 a night (absurd).  They had two people working the front desk with a line just about out the door, after waiting for 20 minutes to check in, one person decided to go on break and leave the long line waiting until he came back 15 minutes later.  I chose to have the breakfast in the morning, the service problems continued.  I spoke with the waitress one time and then waited about 35 minutes after finishing our meal to get the check.  No apologies just tossed it on the table.  Finally, I couldn't get my car keys because something was wrong with my card, I then waited another 35 minutes for that same card to be used no problem.  Unfortunate that such a nice property has terrible service for the cost to stay.

reviews.author: Jbecker
reviews.title: Weekend stay in downtown Seattle at the end of a 10 west coast trip.
reviews.body: Perfect end to our 10 day trip along the west coast. The staff was excellent, the hotel is beautiful in a great location, we enjoyed a wonderful dinner just across the street front the hotel. We really couldn’t have pick a better place to end out west coast trip! Thanks

reviews.author: JoKW
reviews.title: Great location and friendly, helpful staff
reviews.body: I stayed for a week whilst attending a conference. We were able to check in early which was so helpful, the staff were very obliging and always greeted us with a smile. If you are an avid gym goer, the gym may not meet your needs as the equipment is limited and the space confined.

reviews.author: Alan
reviews.title: Great hotel, bad timing
reviews.body: The hotel and suite was all great but there was a massive and crazy loud protest outside against Marriott

reviews.author: Monroy
reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.body:
This hotel was the worst hotel I've ever been to. The room looked like.ot needed a major update. Mini fridge inoperable, pictures in frame falling, no water, dirty rooms. 

Front desk staff was fine. The staff is the market Area different story. Specifically, the older gentleman in the market area very different. He was very rude every encounter with him. In one instance, I had a simple question about the price for the kids at the buffet. I said said excuse me I have a question, he said "what, what do you want?" That was just one encounter with him. The younger girl was very friendly. Otherwise, the rest look like they unhappy, not even the simplest of smiles. 

The walls are so thin you can hear every conversation the person in the rooms next to you and passing in hall way are having. The list goes on. 

This hotel gives the vibe that it's trying to hard. It's like watching the night at the Roxbury. Just bad and weird all around. Overalls, terrible experience and will not be staying here again.

reviews.author: Sapphire Reserve
reviews.title: Money Hungry Hotel
reviews.body: If you’re considering this place for the chase sapphire reserve edit credit usage then maybe think of another place. The welcome gift was not given unless asked for and is no real treat at all. The “perks” that you get such as food money is just enough to get one meal with room service. A deluxe room upgrade with a city view is actually just a view of a parking structure. If you think parking is included after paying the high room rate then you would be wrong. It’s $80/day to park which is the highest around. If all this isn’t enough spread throughout the room are water bottles that say “Stay Hydrated” but then are advertised as $5/each. Every service of this place demands money and is welcoming if you have unlimited money. The only thing I didn’t have to pay extra for was for maintenance to fix my drain, which took until about 11pm.

reviews.author: AJPB
reviews.title: Great Experience in Seattle
reviews.body: W Seattle hots the mark, great team, great location and a great hotel all round. I will be back for sure.

reviews.author: Angry bird flew away
reviews.title: Poor service, good location, not so luxury hotel
reviews.body:
Very mixed feelings with W.

Summary: The front desk service was absolutely downgrading the entire experience. Maybe they were tired, or just don’t care. The location was great (super convenient). The room / facility was not what I expected with cost of ~$500 per night, but more like ~$200 regular hotel. We got a room below 10th floor so the view was not good. There was no room upgrade or late check out. Not a pleasant experience. 

What happened 1: when we wanted to check in at 3:10pm, the front desk said our room was not ready, and saved my phone number, said “will be ready in an hour” and “will text you when room is ready”. Both didn’t happen. We felt like fooled.

What happened 2: there was supposed to be welcome gift, we asked for it when we checked in, the front desk said it will be sent to our room. We waited for two days, it never showed up. We eventually went to front desk again to ask for it, then, a different person said, sure, and gave us a box of cashew. We were a bit disappointed bc we expected better. That’s fine. Then we went back to room and planed to eat it. Before that, I checked the “best before date”. It was two and half months ago. Photos attached. We felt like more than fooled. What is happening in W?

Summary: this message is not for making complaints or getting anyone lost their jobs. I also don’t want any credit because I won’t come back to this hotel again. I am writing all these because I hope these could be addressed by management level involvement. So other people won’t have similar experience.

reviews.author: hpxxhan
reviews.title: The "W" stands for worst
reviews.body: The worst hotel experience i've ever experience in my life.   I understand early check-in is "if" there availability and I'm ok with it but never had i ever had to wait until 5pm to get my room.   The worst part is I checked in at 12pm and put my name in wait list and until almost 5pm, I didn't hear anything from the front desk.  I was sitting in the lobby and I can see people who just checked in well after me getting rooms (similar to what I booked) right away but I was kept waiting.   I feel like my loyalty doesn't mean anything at this establishment.   I chatted with the representative on BonVoy app and addressed my disappointments and noted that I still want to talk to the manager.   I was told they will follow up and manager will get in touch but nothing.   I'm not sure how you folks define good service and how you plan to keep loyal customers happy but this is not it.   And the hotel itself is a worn down mediocre hotel at best and not worthy of the W name.  I expected cleaner, more sophisticated hotel in terms of design and amenities.  Such a disappointment.  Makes me question my loyalty to the brand.

reviews.author: DanD
reviews.title: Great stay at the W Seattle
reviews.body: Great stay, excellent staff, excellent location, enjoyed the robot massage.

reviews.author: Raul B
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body:
I’ve stayed at W hotels around the world, until management can get the Seattle W hotel closer
