To the one in Bellevue I would suggest paying more to stay at a nicer hotel or paying less somewhere else as the W hotel in Seattle is more closer to an oversized motel 6

reviews.author: DisappointedInSeattle
reviews.title: Left Item at Hotel - Left Multiple Messages - No Call Back
reviews.body: My husband left his Apple Watch in our room at checkout and didn’t realize it for two days. He called the hotel and was told to speak with Security - was transferred there and left a message. Called back a few days later and same thing - Security did not answer and he left another message. A few days later he called back AGAIN and left a message for the Security Manager. That was two days ago - and again so return call. We can tell from Apple Find Me that the watch is STILL AT THE HOTEL. At this point it feels like they stole it.

reviews.author: Momi
reviews.title: Completely pleasant
reviews.body: The Renaissance in downtown Seattle sits in a business district with really nice nighttime views of neighborhood skyline city lights. The staff was very helpful and nice, and the hotel is perfectly decent and comfy for a business trip. You can get coffee in the lobby and tend to your business tasks. If you are able, absolutely walk down 5th and turn on Pike for a not-to-hilly walk to the Pike Place Market. It will only take you 10 minutes-ish! You can also walk to fancy stores and Nordstrom. However, the hotel is in a quiet business part of Seattle so night time walking doesn't really get you anywhere with much character. The fun parts of Seattle should be uber-able at night. Absolutely go to Elliot Bay Books (20 minute walk over the very walkable bridge over the 5) and of course the Pike. The hotel itself really needs new carpeting, art, wallpaper, and upholstery to look either modern or charming-- currently it looks very dated. But that doesn't matter if you are exploring Seattle and just need a comfy and quiet spot to rest your head with a sparkly view of neighborhoods at night. I wouldn't walk alone into Freemont at night, but directly around the hotel is fine though there is no nightlife there.

reviews.author: NOLA
reviews.title: Sadly dissatisfied
reviews.body: Poor representation of a Marriott operation.

reviews.author: Btsailor
reviews.title: Bedroom and bathroom were not cleaned when we arrived
reviews.body: Bottle caps on the floor, dirty towels in the bathroom and toilet not cleaned when we arrived in our room. Staff were helpful but really not what we expected after a long journey and made the hotel experience sub par.

reviews.author: DR Beer
reviews.title: Sept 9
reviews.body: My family enjoyed their time we reserved two rooms.

reviews.author: Travelpaloozalady6
reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.body: Easy parking, great lobby, friendly and helpful staff, Food at the 515 was really delicious and great service.

reviews.author: Alaska
reviews.title: Night before Alaska
reviews.body:
Great room. Good breakfast
Nice people

reviews.author: tbolsh
reviews.title: August'26 Internal Docusign team meeting
reviews.body:
Great, as usual
My son was staying with me for one night. He was climbing rocks in vicinity and found a time to stay.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.title: another great stay!
reviews.body: overall, it was a great stay.

reviews.author: JD from SD
reviews.title: Great location, professional staff, amazing lounge
reviews.body: Enjoyed our stay for 2 nights during the week. The lounge had great views and a good vibe, along with enjoyable breakfast and hor dourves. We didn't get a view due to the adjacent office tower but the lounge made up for it.

reviews.author: ladyofthelake
reviews.title: Classic views and a great location
reviews.body: I adore this hotel, I have stayed here often when I am in town. It is walkable (if you have any mobility) and close to the main areas of downtown. Old school charm and the staff is always lovely.

reviews.author: Jj tt
reviews.title: Good luck getting room bill
reviews.body: Wanted room bill after being charged never got it

reviews.author: Bitten in Seattle
reviews.title: Got bedbugs and management didn’t care
reviews.body: Woke up with bedbug bites, asked to speak with management and no response as of yet

reviews.author: EM423
reviews.title: Friendly Staff but Dirty Bathroom
reviews.body: I checked into the hotel on Saturday, August 1 with my daughter. We were staying the night to see Ed Sheeran in concert at Lumen Field. I love Marriott hotels and am a Bonvoy member and have the Marriott credit card as well. The hotel is very nice and the staff were very friendly and helpful when we checked in. Unfortunately, after we got back to the room from the concert, I was standing by the fridge getting ready to take a shower, and I noticed something under the bathroom counter. Upon further inspection, I found it to be a pair of dirty men's underwear. To say I was shocked would be an understatement! At this point it was after midnight and I had to go downstairs to the front desk. The desk clerk was shocked and immediately got a manager who apologized and had someone come up to the room and remove the underwear. I did appreciate the concern that was shown, but for a room that in total cost nearly $700 for one night, I was extremely disappointed. At no point was I offered a reduced rate, a gift card for dining, Marriott points, or any compensation for this situation. From the moment I discovered the dirty underwear I wondered if the sheets had been changed, if the tub had been washed, if the room had been cleaned in general. It really changed the way I felt about the overall cleanliness of the room and the hotel. I contacted customer service through the Bonvoy app but have still never gotten a response.

reviews.author: LA0000
reviews.title: Love This Location!!
reviews.body: This was a great place to stay in Seattle. It's a great location, plenty of restaurants around within walking distance, along with some attractions nearby! The hotel staff was great and very professional! The hotel is very clean and had no maintenance problems! I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Jkirch126
reviews.title: Isolated location. Hills on hills on hills
reviews.body: Nowhere to go!  Everything was far away. Nothing close. Very misleading on expedia.  Airport distance and ballpark way off!

reviews.author: LuluV
reviews.title: Okay but not my Favorite
reviews.body: This hotel is directly off the freeway, so easy to find but we circled several times before we could find a place to park just to my husband could stop long enough to let me and my kids out with the bags. The drop-off of the front of the hotel is horrible. He was able to self-park in the parking garage easily though. The hotel is at the top of a very steep hill so with all the walking we did all day it was tough to end with a climb coming home. Because of these things we would chose a different Marriot in Seattle over this location. We were also surprised when we ordered room service that it came in a paper bag and paper to-go boxes. Expected food on an actual plate.

reviews.author: Do not stay
reviews.title: Not clean, service not the best
reviews.body: Rooms need better cleaning, you can’t see out the windows, very dirty and their hotel needs to be updated. I would suggest staying somewhere else.

reviews.author: Bobesox
reviews.title: Weekend trip for Concert
reviews.body: convenient location.  Staff very helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: Randy
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.body: Staff outstanding hotel very clean

reviews.author: AntoB
reviews.title: I felt at home
reviews.body: My stay was great. Room was always clean. Food delicious. Shoutout to the waiter at The Fig (Asian, thin, ponytail): he was really one of a kind!

reviews.author: Sandro
reviews.title: Noisy air conditioning machine and room with very poor acoustical isolation (facing I-5)
reviews.body:
It was impossible to use the air conditioning machine due to high level of noise, and the room, which faced the I-5, had a poor acoustical isolation, adding to the discomfort at night.
Hotel staff is awesome and very attentive.

reviews.author: Star
reviews.title: Incredible Experience!
reviews.body: This hotel went well above what was expected.  Every individual - from the check-in to the check-out and everything in between was fantastic - I can't wait to stay here again!

reviews.author: Titanium Elite Member
reviews.title: You Can Do Better
reviews.body: Old hotel needing a lot of refreshing and improvements. Staff is not the best, poor communication and poor execution. Valet was awful. I cannot stay here again.

reviews.author: MNAIR
reviews.title: Stay at Renaissance Seattle during July
reviews.body: The stay was pleasant and the interactions with the front desk was great. Walking distance to popular places nearby ..Barnes and Noble, Convention Center etc.

reviews.author: BartMan1421
reviews.title: we stayed for the rooftop bar/it's not open
reviews.body: The private club is open to everyone

reviews.author: 55ss
reviews.title: Great location.
reviews.body: Very nice room and hotel in great location. Came to Seattle by Amtrak

reviews.author: Diana85
reviews.title: Not Worth the Money
reviews.body: This hotel is sub par for a Marriott property; it is noisy, even from the 15th floor. The rooms are not updated and it is way overpriced for the value.

reviews.author: Melaniie
reviews.title: Subpar
reviews.body: Room as subpar with a broken bed and safe but the breakfast service was great!

reviews.author: AvidMarriotBonvoyCustomer
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Overall, our stay was pleasant, with desired destinations within a few minutes walk (took a bit longer getting back since the hotel is located on the top of the hill).

reviews.author: MarriottLover
reviews.title: The Hotel That Made My Seattle Stay Superb!!!!!!
reviews.body: To add to my previous remarks - The location is perfect. Close to all of downtown and the pier access!!!!

reviews.author: Don K
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Courtyard Marriott Pioneer Square was very clean and comfortable. The location was very convenient for all attractions. The staff was very friendly and helpful especially Q she went above and beyond!!

reviews.author: Maggie May
reviews.title: An excellent choice
reviews.body: This hotel was in a perfect location for sightseeing as well as being comfortable with friendly, helpful staff. I wouldnt hesitate to recommend.

reviews.author: Kat
reviews.title: Great location, great staff
reviews.body: Central location yet a little bit away from the craziness that is Pike Place Market, which is nice. Great bars and brunch spots within a 6-7 min walk! Would definitely stay here again. The staff was lovely

reviews.author: JordynW
reviews.title: Good location, nice people
reviews.body: Some friends and I took the train into Seattle for a show at Wamu theater. This hotel was the perfect walking location! Also, I got super cold that night and called down to the front desk requesting another blanket, they brought one to me in less than 5 minutes :)

reviews.author: Matthew
reviews.title: Beware of extremely high parking cost
reviews.body: Great location for going to a Seahawks game. Ridiculous price for valet parking along with the already high room rate.

reviews.author: SM
reviews.title: Not Bad
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay at this hotel. We arrived early after our cruise and they allow us to check into our hotel early which we greatly appreciated and needed a place to unwind. The rooms were clean and spacious. Probably the few annoyance we had was how long it took for the elevator to arrive, the coffee maker in the lobby takes awhile to brew, and there's no hot water when showering.

reviews.author: Go Mariners
reviews.title: Luke warm showers. 👎🏿
reviews.body: The stay was fine.  You can always expect prices to be way overpriced in this location.  Biggest complaint was not being able to take a hot shower.  Water was lukewarm warm at best. Will be finding a new location when we are in Seattle again.

reviews.author: Covina
reviews.title: Nice clean hotel
reviews.body: Hotel is very clean and has large rooms. It’s walking distance to T-Mobile stadium and many good restaurants.

reviews.author: Awesome stay
reviews.title: Great place that’s located in the center of it all!
reviews.body: I would recommend this hotel to anyone that’s looking for a great night’s sleep. During the day, the opportunities are endless with everything that downtown seattle has to offer very close by

reviews.author: Julia Dean
reviews.title: Great front desk staff!
reviews.body: Front desk worked Raul was so great, gave us great recommendations for places to eat and to go! The place was clean and ready before check in.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.title: Courtyard by Marriott Seattle Downtown / Pioneer Square
reviews.body: Hotel needs extensive repair and maintenance.  I will not recommend this to anyone unless they at least change their carpets and get up to date with general maintenance. It is really disappointing

reviews.author: Maci
reviews.title: Kind Staff
reviews.body: Staff made our quick one night stay great! Rooms were clean, valet service was quick and easy to use, and the front desk staff were awesome! They helped me get checked in early, answered all my random questions, and provided suggestions on things to do near the hotel. I plan on returning when I visit Seattle again. The hotel is in a great location for exploring as a first timer to Seattle.

reviews.author: Sleep in Seattle
reviews.title: Great water view and comfortable beds.
reviews.body: Very friendly staff, perfect location to baseball or football games. Water views are fun and comfy beds.

reviews.author: Reluctant Canadians
reviews.title: Short trip to see Mariners but a great stay nonetheless
reviews.body: Staff was amazing right from when we walked thru the doors. They can't hide the fact that they care to treat the guests better than most at other check ins. We love our American neighbours and can't wait for things to get back to where they once were but for now it was a taste of the past which we thoroughly appreciated.

reviews.author: Den travler
reviews.title: Clean. Great location. Big corner rooms
reviews.body: This hotel is in a great location for visiting Pike market, ferry terminal, and both Sports fields. There is an on-site restaurant, but we did not take advantage. My Gold status allow us to get upgraded to a corner room, which was amazing. They’re very large and can easily accommodate a family of four. They are much bigger than the standard rooms. As a corporate traveler who is very picky on hotel rooms, I  would definitely stay here again. If loud city noises bother you, this might not be your hotel as even being up on the 13th floor You could hear the city noises all day and night. For us, It was no concern as it’s to be expected and we live in a city.

reviews.author: Texas Travelers
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body:
the location was why we choose this hotel. We were able to get out of the airport and catch the link train to downtown seattle,a half a block from the hotel!! way better than an expensive uber and a fun way to see the city suburbs!!
Probably would not stay here again as it was not very sound proofed, being such an old building with old windows. lots of street noise that woke us up every time we fell asleep. Also the beds were not very comfortable. 

HOWEVER it was super easy to catch the shuttle to the cruise terminal for 17 bucks per person with a ton of luggage. and the hotel desk clerks and housekeeping were all very friendly. 

SKIP the BISTRO, terrible service. we left!!!

reviews.author: KKKKKade Fan
reviews.title: Mariners Trip
reviews.body: Great location. Easy 10 minute walk to T-Mobile. Easy/inexpensive access from airport via Link Rail System.

reviews.author: Tim W
reviews.title: Great place to stay.  Especially to walk to the Seahawks!
reviews.body: Marriot is always great.  This is an awesome location for walking to the stadium.

reviews.author: CD
reviews.title: Over price for what you get
reviews.body: Valet is extremely expensive. Mattress quality is inferior

reviews.author: Dont Stop Believing
reviews.title: Marriott never disappoints!
reviews.body: The staff was patient, kind and understanding. They were very accommodating and cheerful. The day staff especially.

reviews.author: Arup Dutta
reviews.title: Seattle trip with a Marriott stay
reviews.body: 1-night stay so that we could take the ferry next morning. Good location and worthwhile staying even though it was a short stay

reviews.author: Matthew H
reviews.title: too loud/expensive parking
reviews.body: Had bad experience with loud neighbors on Friday night, changed rooms, and had loud music until 3 am from nearby bar or party on Saturday night.  Parking prices are completely unreasonable.  Would not stay here again.

reviews.author: 2026Stay
reviews.title: Great stay in The Square
reviews.body: Wonderful stay and many choices for our needs and enjoyment of the history of the area.

reviews.author: Deeply Disappointed
reviews.title: Not the Marriott Experience I Expected
reviews.body: I'm a Gold Elite member who has stayed at many Marriott properties for business and have generally had positive experiences, but unfortunately, this location fell well below expectations. The property appears poorly maintained (3 of the 5 ice machines were out of order, and the coffee and water stations were noticeably dirty). I was also extremely disappointed by the parking charges. Guests are advised of a maximum rate of $65 per night, yet I was charged $101 because of a Mariners game. Charging hotel guests a significantly higher rate based on a nearby event feels excessive, particularly when they are already paying to stay at the property. Additionally, a substantial deposit was placed on my account that I was not informed of in advance, and the hold still has not been released. The lack of transparency around both the deposit and parking charges was particularly frustrating. Given the condition of the property, unexpected fees, and overall experience, I would not stay at this location again.

reviews.author: Shelly
reviews.title: Our Condo in the City
reviews.body: As season ticket owners who don’t live in the city, the Courtyard is our home on game nights. Perfect location to stroll to and from the stadium, get a bite, workout, and log-in as needed.

reviews.author: Family trip review
reviews.title: Don’t stay here
reviews.body: Don’t stay here, there are far too many homeless camped out back of the hotel, the 1st to 7th floor with “20s” as last digit are facing a scary looking ally. The rooms are definitely dated and musky.

reviews.author: dzias
reviews.title: Would go with another option
reviews.body: Expected more for the price we paid.  There was an event in the area, which was unrelated to my visit, which increased the parking to $101 per night which is outrageous!  The food was ok and overpriced.  Stayed here for my anniversary and got a beautiful view of a neighboring roof and bed comfort was just ok.  Will defiantly stay at  another hotel my next visit!

reviews.author: Lechuga Corona LLC
reviews.title: Bistro Bar!
reviews.body: Amazing city and this hotel’s location is right in the center of it all. We walked to and from the Space Needle and Pike Market. The hotel was clean, accommodating, and the staff were friendly. The Bistro Bar, an onsite restaurant bar, had the loveliest bartenders who were so welcoming, kind, professional, and attentive. I will come here every time I visit Seattle.

reviews.author: Cmbk
reviews.title: Great location.
reviews.body: While the hotel is in a great location for walking, the parking charges really took us by surprise.   I don't remember seeing in any email confirmations that there would be a surcharge on our parking cost because of an event at Lumen.  The $101/day charge instead of $65 was news to me -- even though we checked in a day prior to this event.  Also, we were told that if we left our car an hour past 1pm, we would be charged $15.  This wasn't true and we ended up paying another $65 for that hour.  It is clean, the staff is really nice, but they definitely overcharge for event weekends.

reviews.author: Business traveler
reviews.title: Elevators out of order
reviews.body: The hotel was down to one elevator in one of their towers for most of my stay. This meant it could take up to 30 min to get down from one’s floor. They eventually got a second elevator working, then it went out of order again. This is out of 4 elevators. This made staying in the hotel very difficult. Rooms and service were otherwise nice. Ice machine on my floor was not operational. Strange brown spatter in the corner ceiling of my friend’s room. Yikes!

reviews.author: Marie
reviews.title: Extremely disappointing stay
reviews.body: This was far and away the worst stay I have had at a Marriot property. Elevators on U ion tower inoperable (only one working) foe about 48 go outs resulting in LINES to get to the room. I have ulcerative colitis and sometimes use the restroom 4 times a day. I was at a conference and stayed at the conference hotel for bathroom privacy but spent 2 days in public bathrooms bc I could not access my room. Finally got moved only to have the blinds not go down so I had to wait 30 mins past my bedtime for them to fix it. Then the last day I was supposed to check out at 2p bc of my Gold status but asked to check out at 6 bc I had a red eye. Sadly even w the privacy sign housekeeping knocked once (before 2) waking me up and AGAIN at 5 waking me up. Really really really disappointed w the stay and would never ever stay there again.

reviews.author: SHINERBOCK74
reviews.title: DZEvil
reviews.body: Great place to stay. Had a amazing view and the Food was excellent. Only issue having was the elevators being out of order.

reviews.author: Tredor
reviews.title: Grand hotel a grand result
reviews.body: 5 star hotel that lived up to its rating

reviews.author: BusinessTraveler
reviews.title: I expect more from the Grand Sheraton
reviews.body: We selected this hotel option primarily for the gym and availability of Peloton bikes (n=2) therein. Sadly, the bikes were out-of-order during our entire 4 days stay--yes, both of them. The reason, the staff, despite being alerted by us multiple times (daily and twice daily on some of the days), could not or would not reset the bikes and log back into their account--this was the only thing wrong with them and it denied usage to guests like us who were expecting to use them. The executive lounge is not a fun experience--they have the same, low-quality snacks there every day and it doesn't even open for coffee until 6:30am--a very late time for most of us who are coming from more easterly time zones--further many business meetings on the west coast start early (as did mine) to accommodate the more easterly time zones, so I was already up and out before the lounge opened. Oh, and our shower head dripped...constantly.

reviews.author: Kim Camus
reviews.title: Perfect place to stay prior to our Cruise to Alaska
reviews.body: We loved our high floor, corner room and wished we could have stayed longer!

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.title: Never Stay Here
reviews.body: Terrible service and treatment by the employees at the "concierge" desk.

reviews.author: Filleheureuse
reviews.title: Fantastic location, great hotel
reviews.body: Wonderful service and a very pleasant stay in a beautiful hotel. Parking is extremely expensive. You can park for half the price just a few feet away across the street, but the concierge and valet service made it worthwhile to park at the hotel. Sheraton Grand is quick to make things right if there is an issue and cares about its guests.

reviews.author: John f
reviews.title: Unbelievable upgrade
reviews.body:
Everything was great
Except for rip off destination charge

reviews.author: Reviewbyjoe
reviews.title: Friend's Anniversary Stay
reviews.body: I bought my friends a few night's stay at the Sheraton Seattle.  They'd never been to a hotel of this caliber before and absolutely loved their stay!  From the comfortable rooms to the friendly staff and everything in between, Sheraton Seattle was able to relieve the stress of travelling so they could focus on their vacation.  I've stayed here many times and am happy I've convinced one more person to join the Marriott family!

reviews.author: MEJ2260
reviews.title: Mixed review
reviews.body: Good location. Nice hotel lovely room. Quality of food varied.

reviews.author: The Aroma in 520
reviews.title: The Smell in 520
reviews.body:
My room, 520, reeked of cigarette smoke. Since there were no other rooms available, a young man was sent up with air freshener. He even acknowledged that he could smell the smoke while standing in the hallway outside the room. Unfortunately, the air freshener did nothing other than make the room smell like a forest fire.

This issue should have been identified and addressed before the room was assigned to a guest. I did not unpack my clothes because I was concerned the smoke odor would transfer to them and that I would smell like cigarettes when meeting with my clients. Unfortunately, that still happened. When my co-worker, who was staying at another hotel, met me for dinner, they immediately asked why I smelled like cigarette smoke.

What makes this especially upsetting is that my company regularly uses the Sheraton whenever we come to Seattle for business. This experience has seriously affected my confidence in choosing your hotel for future stays.

reviews.author: KimPDX
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.body: Accommodations were clean, and comfortable. Staff was friendly, helpful, and quick to respond. And location can't be beat!!

reviews.author: Mac 1
reviews.title: Average hotel
reviews.body: I feel there are better hotel options in the area for a lower price

reviews.author: JenNYC9
reviews.title: Great single night stay
reviews.body: Almost tidy beds (there was tissue stuffed into one of the reading lights and the other light was broken), great view of city, water and snack bars for Envoy member bag upon arrival, quiet halls, considerate guests in dining floor. Overall stay was pleasant.

reviews.author: Abc124
reviews.title: Old fashioned, poor quality sheets and pillows inedible breakfast
reviews.body: This dated hotel needs to do an upgrade. The sheets were quite rough the pillows were very uncomfortable, the lighting terrible and the bathroom old-fashioned. We came in as a group after coming off a cruise and the breakfast was absolutely inedible. The quality was so poor I had to spit out my mouth full of yoghurt and fruit terrible shocking. I am surprised.

reviews.author: Alan2traveler
reviews.title: Excellent location. Excellent staff.
reviews.body:
At this hotel level, service and the little things matter a lot.  Service quality is a good indicator of good management.
The location is great for short walks to Pike Place Market or the monorail.
The room was consistent for a Sheraton Grand.
Elevators in the Pike Tower are very good.
Gym on the top floor was spacious with nice views.

reviews.author: Noliftarrama
reviews.title: Ok but could do better
reviews.body: Poor lift service from the 20th floor only 1 lift  working in a busy hotel, unacceptable

reviews.author: JS and HS
reviews.title: Happy Travelers
reviews.body: So glad we chose the Sheraton for our stay. The location and the Starbucks in the lobby were a big plus.

reviews.author: TWINS1997
reviews.title: SHERATON GRAND HOTEL DOWNTOWN SEATTLE
reviews.body: VERY WELL KEPT, EXTREMELY EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

reviews.author: James M
reviews.title: Central and accommodating
reviews.body:
The hotel was exceptionally clean and well kept and the staff seemed invested in offering their personal touch to their service. You can tell they cared about making your stay better any way they could! 

Highly recommend also checking out the gym on the top floor. You’re probably gonna be doing some walking around town and it’s great to get a stretch in with the view up there.

reviews.author: Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Loved the location. Friendly staff. Had a great stay.

reviews.author: Work
reviews.title: Work
reviews.body:
I've never asked for a new room no matter what the circumstances, as I don't like to complain.
Given my company has paid for for dozen of years to stay here I thought it would have been a better experience.
My first 2 nights. The bathroom fan wouldn't shut off. When I blow dried my hair the lights flickered on and off. The window shuddered every 10 min. After no sleep on the 2nd day and putting a pillow over my head I had to go to the front desk.

They downgraded my room. I went to take a shower on my 3rd day and the faucet got stuck and I couldn't turn the hot water off and my tub started filling up.

My coworker had to come and help. However she couldn't turn it off either. I had to shower in their room. Given this was a company event. I dont think that should have been my only option.

I spoke to the hotel about and they said they couldn't help with, but could give me Marriott points. 

Wow. What will that do.

I also have pictures of the fan was dismantled from the bathroom of the 2nd room they put me in.

So no.  I wont recommend this hotel and have told my company about this stay. Honestly my worst experience ever

reviews.author: Seattle
reviews.title: Seattle
reviews.body: Seattle without Queen sized beds

reviews.author: Guiti R
reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.body: A beautiful hotel with great customer service and friendly staff, a must visit!

reviews.author: Lck2109
reviews.title: Sheraton Grand Seattle – Honest Guest Review
reviews.body:
Here’s a polished, ready‑to‑post review that captures your experience clearly, professionally, and with the right amount of firmness.

---
We recently stayed at the Sheraton Grand Seattle, and there’s a lot to love about this property. The hotel itself is beautiful, the rooms are very nice, and the location is incredibly convenient — right in the heart of downtown with endless dining options just steps away. For comfort and walkability, it absolutely delivers.

However, our stay was significantly impacted by poor planning and questionable management decisions regarding elevator maintenance. On Sunday morning, when a large portion of guests are heading out for cruise departures, the hotel had only one working elevator due to scheduled maintenance. This left us stranded on the 17th floor for nearly an hour, unable to get down to the lobby.

Because of this delay, we missed our scheduled ride and were charged for it — ultimately paying for two Ubers just to get where we needed to go. Learning afterward that this was planned maintenance made the situation even more frustrating. It showed a real lack of foresight and common sense, especially on a day when guest movement is at its peak.

The hotel itself is wonderful, but management’s decision to limit elevator access on a Sunday morning created an avoidable and costly inconvenience. I hope they reconsider how they schedule maintenance moving forward so guests aren’t put in this position

reviews.author: OW88
reviews.title: Not clean
reviews.body: The stay was gross. There were crumbs on the carpet, along with what looked to be chunks of skin. There was also hair all in the tub and a dark orange/yellow stain on the toilet seat. I would only rate this stay a 2 ONLY due to the helpful staff. They were very kind.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Greene
reviews.body: The first night was not good for my wife. Something bite her but the change our room as soon as they found out.

reviews.author: BernardnTony082126
reviews.title: Exceptional Stay in the Heart of Seattle
reviews.body: We had an absolutely wonderful stay at the Sheraton Grand Seattle. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was welcoming, elegant, and comfortable. The hotel was beautifully maintained, our accommodations were excellent, and the staff were consistently friendly, professional, and attentive. The location is also fantastic for enjoying downtown Seattle. Our entire experience exceeded expectations, and we would gladly stay here again. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Indy
reviews.title: Don’t expect service and cleanliness
reviews.body: Disposable cutlery , no tea bag’s , rude phone operator , dirty bath tub that didn’t get cleaned after several calls to housekeeping , constantly kept saying my card didn’t work while I kept getting charged

reviews.author: MosesMan
reviews.title: Micro Rooms with a great location
reviews.body: Great location and view in a well appointed micro room hotel.    Cool lighting and decor in rooms.    Bar area is handy and they have decent food if you need.

reviews.author: GDUBYA
reviews.title: Not a good choice for an elite business traveler
reviews.body: I did not like that there was no valet option and had to park in a separate garage a few blocks away. The room and neat and very trendy. Makes me feel like I'm staying in a room on Japan. But Japanese hotels provides a lot of amenities for their guests like in room coffee makers, tea, and robe. My room did not have that. Also did not have an in room steamer or iron for my clothes. Water pressure in my room was awful. My room rate was over $400/night which I think was totally overpriced for the lack of amenities.

reviews.author: KMakani
reviews.title: Will book again
reviews.body: Great location, close to Lumen and the Waterfront with only short walks. Please note that the rooms are small, though it was not an issue for us (we knew).

reviews.author: Jimmy D
reviews.title: Excellent but not a bargain anymore.
reviews.body: Same great hotel and staff, marriot purchased the hotel and changed nothing but added 1/3 price increase. Great hotel no longer a good value.

reviews.author: Amelia
reviews.title: Great Exerience
reviews.body: My stay was a one-night solo trip. The friendly and accommodating staff were excellent throughout my visit. The hotel was very clean and inviting. The front desk staff made check-in easy. The room was spotless and exactly what I needed for a solo trip. The service was outstanding, and I would stay here again and recommend this location to anyone.

reviews.author: SheWentAnyway
reviews.title: A Love Letter for room 811 ❤️
reviews.body:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Dear citizenM Seattle Pioneer Square, Please Save Room 811 for Me

I came to Seattle on a solo trip and booked citizenM because I wanted somewhere fun, modern, and close to everything. I didn't expect to become emotionally attached to Room 811. 😂

From the moment I walked in, I loved this hotel. The funky artwork, red hallways, beautiful lobby, and mood lighting made the whole place feel playful and completely different from a typical hotel. My room was small but brilliantly designed. Everything had a purpose, and it became the perfect little home base for my Seattle adventure.

And the location? AMAZING.

Every night, after walking approximately 97 miles uphill because apparently Seattle has a personal vendetta against my legs 😂, I came back to Room 811, kicked off my shoes, changed the mood lighting, and decompressed.

But 811 became special for another reason.

This trip was about learning that I could travel alone, navigate a new city, get lost, find my way again, make my own decisions, and genuinely enjoy my own company. Room 811 became my little landing place while I did all of that.

I came to Seattle looking for an adventure.

I left with one of the best experiences of my life and a little more of myself.

So thank you, citizenM. And please take care of Room 811 for me.

I'll be back.

And don't try giving me 812. I know where I belong. 😂❤️

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: alexis
reviews.title: citizenM is a MUST!
reviews.body:
We absolutely loved our stay at citizenM Pioneer Square! The location was amazing and made exploring Seattle so easy, but what really stood out to us was the staff. Everyone was incredibly helpful, welcoming, and genuinely so friendly. They even took the time to help my husband and me plan parts of our itinerary and gave us recommendations, which made our trip that much better.

The entire experience felt easy, comfortable, and welcoming from the moment we arrived. My husband and I had such a great stay and will 100% be back the next time we’re in Seattle. Highly recommend! ❤️

reviews.author: Cory
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: Love staying here especially for sporting events nearby that are just a short walk away. Service is always great, no complaints.

reviews.author: citizenW
reviews.title: citizenA+
reviews.body: A truly special place to stay in Seattle. The service is so remarkably on point and authentic that the word excellent seems entirely inadequate.

reviews.author: AK guest
reviews.title: Unique modern hotel
reviews.body:
I enjoyed my one-night stay here - the rooms were really modern and funky, and small. Not sure that I would’ve enjoyed sharing the cozy room with my husband as we would’ve been constantly bumping into each other. There’s also not much space for luggage. I’d definitely stay again solo for 1-2 nights, but not sure I’d do longer than that!
The self-service style of lobby services doesn’t work super well.  The kiosks function ok for check-in/check-out, but inevitably people have questions and the 1-2 “ambassadors” on duty seemed overwhelmed, although they were polite and helpful (after waiting for their availability). 
As far as dining…I didn’t buy the $20 breakfast, but did have some good (and gratis) coffee from the lobby. The breakfast spread looked ok, but no hot options that I saw. No coffee makers in the rooms, but I never use them anyway.

reviews.author: Lewi
reviews.title: amazing hotel
reviews.body: beautiful and affordable property

reviews.author: 2cruisers
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: We stayed here prior to a cruise.  Walkable to waterfront restaurants and shops.  Free shuttle to Pike Place and Space Needle.

reviews.author: J and J
reviews.title: Unique and Efficient Hotel
reviews.body: Clean, friendly employees. A Happy Feeling place.

reviews.author: Sven
reviews.title: Excellent location and nice staff
reviews.body: This property located in the heart of Seattle and we can walk to most of attractions. Public transportation and parking overnight isn't a problem. The room is right on the coast and offers a great view of the pier from the windows. Breakfast is good value for the price, and the staff are friendly.

reviews.author: Citizen M
reviews.title: Citizen M at Seattle Waterfront
reviews.body: love the hotel's aesthetic! Fabulous location at the beautifully reworked Alaskan Way on the Seattle waterfront.

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Seattle
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location. We arrived at a little past midnight and the security guard on duty let us in. We completed the self-check in without any problems and went straight to our room. The room was on the sixth floor and our window faced a brick wall which was painted with a whimsical mural. We closed our blackout shade using the handy iPad that served as a remote for all things in the room and got the best night's sleep. When I got home, I immediately started looking for a way to purchase the pillows at the Citizen M. The pillows are indeed the best pillow I have ever used! We walked to The Great Wheel, Pike Place and T-mobile baseball park while we were staying at the Citizen M. We used an Uber to visit Discovery Park and go out to eat at Ray's Boathouse. When we needed an Uber, the Uber was literally right outside the hotel just waiting for customers! We ate the buffet breakfast (it costs extra and is not part of the room cost) and it was very good! We loved the white chocolate macadamia nut cookies that were $1.50 at the bar each night! It was a daily treat for us. The room is small but very efficient. The shower has both a handheld shower head and a rainfall shower head. We used every inch of the space, but we never felt cramped! It was a great weekend stay and I hope to stay in more Citizen M hotels in the future!

reviews.author: Laurendp26
reviews.title: Simple, But Great!
reviews.body: A terrific concept for a hotel that is just what we needed. A bed, bathroom, and a small desk. The changeable lighting in the room was very fun and unique. The proximity to the ferry system, light rail, and sports venues was phenomenal!

reviews.author: Traveler1
reviews.title: 10/10 Would rebook in the future
reviews.body: Amazing Staff and hotel is very clean. They hotel is quite small but if you’re 1-2 people i think this hotel would be perfect for u. The area is very safe and close to everything u want to do in seattle.

reviews.author: Unhappy
reviews.title: Living in Pods
reviews.body: Had better accommodations as a Private in the army.  No Parking that is a minim of an extra $40 per day.  Then enjoy your walk past homeless encampment on your way from the parking to your hotel. To find that you have to check yourself in, and then get to a room that can best be described as a dystopian future living pod the size of a walk in closet with a prison toilet and shower in the same room. The bed was literally the back 1/4 of the room.  The positives was it was clean and no bed bugs.

reviews.author: Seattle Weekend
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.body: Great place. Great design. Great location. Really fun for a weekend trip

reviews.author: Kacie R
reviews.title: 10/10 recommend for your stay in Seattle!
reviews.body: This hotel is amazing! It's so clean and the staff are helpful and friendly. I love that they have a water filler station available for guests, as well as lots of spaces for lounging or eating. I would definitely recommend this hotel for a quick stay or if you want to be close to events. We were walking distance from everything we wanted to see and really enjoyed our time there.

reviews.author: Josh1
reviews.title: Lovely Spot
reviews.body: great locastion in Pioneer Square area. Right near waterfront. Good vibey rooms with lots of fun gadgets. Great breakfast. Great common areas for fun and work.

reviews.author: Toaster234
reviews.title: My Seattle Washington Pioneer Square Adventure
reviews.body: citizenM Seattle Pioneer Square was life changing to say the least. It is the best hotel I have stayed because the registration process was smooth and staff cared about their job. I love the people given it was near major areas of Seattle tourist areas. Whenever your traveling by train like I did. Or need a place to get way from things in life this hotel truly shows it's care it has for guests and would highly recommend for a stayed in the area. Over all 10/10 thank you for being who you all are keep showing that spark!

reviews.author: Tammil
reviews.title: Staff is excellent at this hotel
reviews.body: Staff is very helpful. Never have had a bad interaction with anyone who works here.

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.title: Fun but odd
reviews.body: Don’t bring a car, or drink water or plan to iron your clothes. Do enjoy the area and the pod room.

reviews.author: Rayne
reviews.title: Above and beyond!
reviews.body:
I cannot say enough positive things about this location and our stay. The staff was friendly, the check-in process was quick/easy, and the room was very clean and comfortable.

We left some of our picture film rolls in our room after checkout, frantically contacted Marriott to see if they could locate it, and our request was prioritized through the chain and the film was located! We had just gotten engaged and our photos were on that film. SERIOUSLY cannot thank the entire team and crew for their superb communication and all other interactions during our stay. I’m a Marriott customer for life now.

reviews.author: CFischer1527
reviews.title: Nice hotel, rooms were too small.
reviews.body: I like a lot about the hotel. It's just the rooms were way too small for my wife and me. Also, the breakfast was overpriced; $21 for fake eggs, potatoes and bacon is not worth it.

reviews.author: Todd
reviews.title: Great time in Seattle
reviews.body: Deanna manager was great. She helped us out. The staff was really good. Also, Liam and I believe Emily really helped us a lot. They’re really friendly great location. Only one thing I had negative was the beds were really hard.

reviews.author: bsmjerm3
reviews.title: Pioneer Square CitizenM
reviews.body: Hotel is ultra modern, clean and well located.  Our room would have been fine for one person but the bedding, sink location were not practical.  Also, no cups/glasses in the room.  Restaurant is limited by design and that's ok.  Service was fine but food wasn't great.

reviews.author: Cheryl O
reviews.title: Stay close to all the attractions
reviews.body: Easy walk from Link train from airport.  10 stops 30 minutes.  Close to everything.  If you get there early, drop your bags and walk across the street to the Ferry Terminal and take a ride to Bainbridge Island.  Lots of shops, stores, art galleries.   From the hotel you can walk to Pikes Place, the SF Art Museuum and many shops and stores.  Its a great location  Room is small but comfortable.  Only nitpick is no microwave in room but you can heat it up downstairs.  Traveling with another, better be good friends because the room is tiny.  Fine for solo travelers.

reviews.author: Whothehillstocks
reviews.title: First Seattle experience
reviews.body: We have traveled to beautiful islands but traveling to a different stay on land we were mesmerized by the tall buildings and the way The Westin Seattle offers beautiful all around room views with it’s architecture design. The interior of the room feels calm and the bed sheets and bed was so comfortable too. Can’t wait to visit again.

reviews.author: saint2026
reviews.title: The summit was a great success!!! it was great to get together and share ideas and insights
reviews.body: The summit was a great success, gathering all these people (~700), and providing enough classrooms and halls was remarkable

reviews.author: Jariya P
reviews.title: Good Location and Friendly staff
reviews.body: Great location, close to tourist attractions. The reception staff were helpful. Check-in and check-out were quick. Wi-Fi is available. There's a fitness center and a heated pool. Credit is provided during the stay. The rooms are clean, spacious, and the beds are comfortable.

reviews.author: Marco
reviews.title: Not Too Bad
reviews.body: Great location next to the light rail, monorail, and trolley station. Everything was fine except for the small double beds and lack of security staff. The elevators were locked via room card but a suspicious individual made his way into the elevator. Not good.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: A Fantastic Event at Westin Seattle
reviews.body:
We held our annual work conference at The Westin Seattle for the first time, and we couldn’t have been happier with the experience. With approximately 70 people in our group, I didn’t hear a single complaint—which is quite an accomplishment!

A few team members deserve special recognition. Kailey made sure our entire event ran seamlessly, and Ivan did a fantastic job handling our last-minute room and booking changes. Clarence at 1900 Fifth went above and beyond with his customer service, making everyone feel welcome and ensuring no one went long without a cocktail or refreshment.

The lobby staff were consistently helpful and attentive, and the catering crew served delicious food throughout our event. Every team played a part in making our conference a success.

This hotel clearly knows how to take care of a group, and we will definitely be back. Thank you to the entire Westin Seattle team for such a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Stclar2026
reviews.title: One star accommodations at four star prices
reviews.body: My stay was bad. I went up and down for twenty minutes looking for a working ice machine in the north tower because no one would pick up when I called room service. The gym didn’t have any cold water in the coolers either. The woman at the desk was extremely nonchalant when she said “yeah, sometimes the ice machines don’t work.” WHAT? I was moved to South tower and there was no soap in the room. These are crazy lapses for a four star hotel. I also ordered a meal at the barn restaurant and it was bland and overcooked. The one bright spot was the pool.

reviews.author: Seattle Meetings
reviews.title: Hotel stay was nice, but could use some extra TLC
reviews.body:
Stay was was nice, but our room could have used a deep clean. 
Very NICE STAFF.

reviews.author: Stephen
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Excellent  hotel would stay again if I go to Seattle

reviews.author: A Karen
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful, relaxing four day stay at
The Westin Seattle!  The beds were
VERY comfortable.  I loved that a bath robe was available!  The BEST part was the signature Westin scent, the nighttime bar staff and the location!  I would definitely stay there again!

reviews.author: Mariners Fans
reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.body: Overall very good; coffee in Bistro cold, wallpaper in room peeling in a couple places, but overall very good

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Business stay
reviews.body: Comfortable bed, quiet room, outstanding, helpful and efficient check in and staff.

reviews.author: eddie
reviews.title: Overall Stay
reviews.body: Restaurant service was very slow. Waited at least 45 minutes to get service, once we talked with the manager

reviews.author: Gary W
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: We spent $2500 at the Westin over Labor Day for a family trip.  Rooms were nice, location excellent.  The restaurant called relish was understaffed, service poor and food worse.  Very disappointing. Plus they were closed Labor Day weekend with no place to eat.  The kids were tired and hungry and tired from a day in Seattle and had to go back out to eat.  In addition we had two rooms and were provided a $20 a day credit to be use in the hotel.  When we checked out we we told that we had to charge on each room to take advantage of the credit. So I would have to split the  with my grandkids room every time I used the restaurant.  Made no sense.  At check out I had to get the manager “to make an exception to the policy”.  Stupid policy.  Great bartender in the bar though.  We needed him.

reviews.author: Jhin
reviews.title: Super disappointed
reviews.body:
The Westin Seattle did not deliver on its promise of guest comfort and well-being. Reliable hot water and adequate shower pressure are basic hotel necessities, yet our shower repeatedly turned cold before we could finish, and the water pressure was extremely low. We reported the problem, but it was never properly fixed or meaningfully addressed.

Unfortunately, the problems went beyond the room. The food was not good at all, the café staff were unfriendly and had unpleasant attitudes, and I was also charged extra. Instead of making the situation right, the hotel offered only a $30 credit, which felt dismissive and completely inadequate given the number of issues we experienced and the premium price we paid.

These were not minor inconveniences. The lack of hot water, poor water pressure, disappointing food, unacceptable customer service, and additional charge significantly affected our stay. I expected much better service, accountability, and hospitality from the Westin brand. The entire experience was unbelievable, unacceptable, and deeply disappointing.

reviews.author: KW123
reviews.title: Location is pretty much the only good thing.
reviews.body:
Hotel is dated, elevators take an obscenely long time, the wait for food was considerable, the parking situation is ridiculous (plan ahead and park in any other lot downtown), we werent able to get a cart to take our things up to our room (had to be bell hopped, there wasnt another option offered) the rooms are mediocre, dont have enough plugs, and the in-room fridge is stuffed full of things to purchase, there isnt room to put anything you brought. 

We asked for the fridge to be cleared so that we could put breast milk in. They offered to bring up another mini fridge but plugged it into an outlet connected to a light / light switch and did not tell us. When we turned out the light for bed, it turned off the fridge and 3 days worth of breast milk went warm and had to be thrown out.

Frustrated is an understatement.

reviews.author: Sheila
reviews.title: Would not return or recommend
reviews.body: The most disorganized s__t show we've ever been a part of at any hotel.

reviews.author: CTB3
reviews.title: average
reviews.body:
TOWELS -inconsistent in size and thickness. Felt old, some with stains. Not what you want to feel refreshed when travelling. 
AIR CONDITIONING -doesn't really work! Room was barely cool (actually quite hot), even with the A/C all the way up. 
DUSTY -air quality seems poor at the hotel. 
AMBIANCE -so dark everywhere. 
LOBBY BAR -great staff, good drinks. 
STAFF -friendly. 
FEDEX -expensive charges to receive packages at the hotel as a guest. And no notice of this was given when inquiring.

reviews.author: Bryon N
reviews.title: Nice location but will not stay again
reviews.body: The location is great. However, the room is not. The desk chair in my room was falling apart and the air vents above the bed was dirty and the paint was peeling. The wall paper was also starting to peel. You would think the cost of the rooms. These things would not be an issue to upkeep and fix. Also, the person's that delivered our room service was rude to my daughter. At least they could have done was acknowledge the fact that she was trying to thank them and show appreciation for their service. Instead they just placed the food on the floor in front her and walked away.

reviews.author: Mathew X Curry
reviews.title: Needed a Seattle culture outing!
reviews.body: In need of a Seattle cultural "escape" from a busy week focused on my art installation on Bainbridge and two consecutive jazz shows at nearby Jazz Alley was just the ticket...Weston option, perfect!

reviews.author: L101
reviews.title: Seattle Westin stay
reviews.body: I recently stayed at the Westin Seattle. It was a great experience. I highly recommend if you’re looking for a centrally located property and great service.

reviews.author: Elainski
reviews.title: Pleasant stay
reviews.body: The room was comfortable and clean.  We had a pistachio dessert that was great.  Lines were long for coffee in the morning, but they were pretty quick. Staff in the restaurants were really hospitable.  We appreciated the late check out but didn’t appreciate having the housekeeper walk right in around 8 or 9 when we were still in bed.  Would not hesitate to stay again.

reviews.author: Rafael
reviews.title: A great stay in an excellent Seattle location
reviews.body: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay with a big and spacious room, a comfortable bed and feeling of the room and a fantastic location. My stay was very pleasant and met my needs. I would stay here again and recommend to others.

reviews.author: Tony S
reviews.title: My best stay in Seattle.
reviews.body: If you are planning to visit Seattle, you must stay at the Westin Seattle. It is an excellent hotel, perfect location and with an excellent staff. I highly recommend it and when I return to Seattle, I will be staying here again.

reviews.author: Not impressed
reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.body: Told three front desk staff of the disgusting desk chair in our room before it was replaced. Wallpaper seams peeling apart all over the room. Below expectations. I'm  Marriott Titanium Lifetime.  Think I've been in a few Marriott properties ?  This one not impressive.

reviews.author: Chelsy
reviews.title: Run down
reviews.body: Super run down, not what you expect from a typical Westin, the bathroom mirror was basically peeling off. We also had to wait 15 minutes to get our luggage.

reviews.author: CPLMAugust2026
reviews.title: clean comfortable bed to sleep in; if you're looking for good customer service or anything nice keep searching
reviews.body: Really comfortable beds and duvets. I like the rainwater showerhead. The rooms and customer service are very minimal. Reception is polite but keeps it short - not explaining much. For example, we booked the room that included parking but she didn't explain how the parking worked, the hours, etc and billed us incorrectly which I could not resolve until after check-out through an online form.... so I'm still waiting on that... Valet staff were lovely and helpful and gave us more information about check-in, check-out, etc than the actual reception staff did. If you hope to use room service, I suggest booking another hotel. I guess most people order delivery from restaurants these days. All we wanted was tea and coffee in the morning delivered but that had obstacles (like they don't take orders over the phone but the website says one tea takes 45min....). Unfortunately, after a number of small administrative, operational and customer service annoyances that I believe are easily avoidable, I'm not sure if I'd recommend it but it was clean, comfortable and in a good location so maybe these brief experiences aren't really a problem (as long as the billing gets sorted that is).

reviews.author: Staff lack of empowerment
reviews.title: Convenient and consistent
reviews.body: Overall good experience, clean and reasonably updated, however upon checkout I realized my group rate was not applied and the staff stated they could not do anything to correct the situation,  which yielded an additional charge of $100 to my overall bill....so that leaves me with the option of calling the main office and consume time I do not have to attempt to get corrected...or just forget about it and probably look for a hotel chain with local staff who have the ability to correct issues similar to mine with out pointing to a 1-800 number..... we do a fair amount of traveling so I do speak from experience...

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.title: Average
reviews.body: Nice enough hotel.  There are no complimentary anythings.  Anything other than the room is going to cost extra.  The staff was excellent especially the valet staff.

reviews.author: Dee N
reviews.title: Big city hotel with amenities
reviews.body: The Westin downtown Seattle was well situated. We were able to walk to the sights that wewanted to enjoy. The light rail is only a few blocks away. I am still waiting to see if they adjust the bill appropriate to the credit I was supposed to receive, so I reserve judgment on that part of my stay.

reviews.author: Retired and loving life
reviews.title: Seattle Westin; excellent!
reviews.body: We truly enjoyed our experience at the Seattle Westin. It was our first time to Seattle - and the Concierge did a great job of directing us to restaurants close by. I would definitely recommend this hotel if you visit Seattle.

reviews.author: Highly recommend
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.body: We loved the location because we never waited more than one minute for a Lyft or Uber! Great deal on the room and couldn’t believe the inexpensive drinks at the bar! Very friendly staff!

reviews.author: Liz09
reviews.title: Residence Inn by Marriott Seattle Downtown/Convention Center
reviews.body: Amazing stay. Very clean and quiet. Easy check in and check out. Breakfast was great, staff was great.

reviews.author: Battistone13
reviews.title: Honestly, it's great!
reviews.body: This hotel was everything I needed on my trip. The location was great, the the rooms were comfortable and updated, and the amenities (fitness center and breakfast) made my time there more enjoyable. It felt clean and secure. For the price, I thought it was a great value!

reviews.author: Couple get away
reviews.title: Couple get away
reviews.body: Great stay room food security service!

reviews.author: Dwhite1220
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.body: This was a stay for a cruise we had planned the following day. The hotel was clean, spacious and amazing in every way. The staff could not have been better. The restaurant was also exceptional. Highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Gerry
reviews.title: Very Disappointing and Overpriced
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, our stay was very disappointing and did not live up to what we expected from a Residence Inn by Marriott.

We specifically paid for a high-floor room, but upon arrival we were initially given a room that was not on a high floor. We had traveled all day and it was close to midnight, so having to complain at that point just to receive the room we had already paid for was extremely frustrating. We were eventually moved to a high-floor room, but the situation should never have happened in the first place.

The room itself was underwhelming and felt dated. It also did not look like the rooms shown in the hotel's photos. For the price we paid, we expected a much more modern and comfortable room. The overall experience simply did not feel like a good value.

The downstairs restaurant was an even bigger disappointment. The food tasted premade and reheated rather than freshly prepared, and the prices were extremely high for the quality. After eating there, I became very sick and experienced what felt like food poisoning. I cannot say with certainty that the restaurant caused it, but becoming sick afterward made an already poor experience even worse.

The location was convenient, but that was really the main positive for us. Overall, we felt the hotel was overpriced for what it delivered, and based on this experience, we would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Disappointed with the stay
reviews.body: Wrong photos of the room on booking, rude staff, didn’t accommodate, told us to cancel and find another hotel.

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: PAX West
reviews.body: Fantastic service and helpful staff. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Julie E
reviews.title: Nice Stay
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful time at the Residence Inn, from my room to the city view, the rich breakfast, proximity to restaurants, bars, high-end stores, and monumental sites, it was a great stay for me. My check-in and check-out were fast and took less than a minute. I got my cardio in, with walks to Target, Westlake Mall, Pike Place Market, and other centers. 
Special thanks to Nikki at the front desk and all staff who made my stay a memorable one. 
This was a good value for money

reviews.author: Lenwood V Long Sr
reviews.title: Bedbug Hotel
reviews.body: My room was infested with bedbugs, and the staff's response was deplorable.  Equally as bad was the staff saying he did not know what to do.

reviews.author: marydp
reviews.title: Great location, wonderful service
reviews.body: This was a clean, quiet and well-maintained property in a great location. Many of the attractions we visited were within a mile of the hotel in this very walkable area. Public transportation is also close by. The restaurant off the lobby was so convenient with great food and service for dinner. Breakfast was wonderful with so many options. Friendly staff are clearly dedicated to excellent service. Our room was so comfortable and had everything we needed.

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.title: Excellent will return
reviews.body: I have been to a lot of hotels and by far this is one of the top 2.  Another couple went with us and they loved it.

reviews.author: Sd71
reviews.title: Great location and superior value
reviews.body: Hotel is central to Seatttle proper, clean and modern. Everything is within a walk or short uber ride. Staff us very attentive and wastes no time checking in.

reviews.author: MagicRonn
reviews.title: Residence Inn hospitality is excellent
reviews.body:
Marriott Residence Inn is well maintained and run. The morning breakfast is convenient, the rooms are comfortable and even have a slightly unique layout. The in-room kitchen is absolutely great. Networking, TV selections, and open ports on the TV are all a traveler could ask for.

Even if the hotel were not as great, I'd still stay here just because of the excellent staff. From a helpful check-in to a smiling staff person at breakfast who made the start of the day feel great, to someone loaning me their personal charger cord because it was important to me that night, I couldn't have asked for a more obliging and caretaking staff during my stay. I've been staying at this hotel for the past 5 years, every month or so, and it's just been a treasure the whole time.

reviews.author: BJL1
reviews.title: Absolutely Perfect!
reviews.body: The staff were friendly and professional.  Location was perfect.  Easy to walk to everything including the monorail to the Space Needle.   Breakfast buffet was excellent with great options.  Very clean.  The area around the hotel was very clean and I felt safe walking to the various places.  I highly recommend this hotel for visiting Seattle.

reviews.author: Winner family
reviews.title: Unsafe place to stay
reviews.body: Very unsafe hotel to stay

reviews.author: Smrati Thakur
reviews.title: The staff is racist.
reviews.body: Subtle racism noted. A British customer infront of us was given a full run down of city map, tours guidelines etc while we were just checked in with bare minimum stuff and hurried.

reviews.author: Family trip
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.body: Overall excellent except the Wifi issue.

reviews.author: VBSD
reviews.title: Perfect stay with families in a accessible area for downtown
reviews.body:
Excellent stay in heart of downtown and walking distance to Convention centers. Helpful hotel staff and clean rooms. The street outside is safe and walkable even at night.
Breakfast is a struggle with chaotic arrangements and hardly any place to sit given the number of rooms hotel houses. Wouldn’t bank on getting it at the hotel

reviews.author: DG647
reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.body: Rooms are comfortable and clean. Breakfast was very nice. In the evening there is a bar menu with hamburgers. Sandwiches and wings. Front desk staff friendly. Our only issue was the hotel shuttle service to the cruise port.

reviews.author: jerry
reviews.title: Disappointed Stay
reviews.body:
It all started with me checking in , inspite of being a  gold member the front desk outrightly lied saying they didn’t have a higher floor and gave us a room
on third. My friend who checked in right after who was right beside me was given a higher floor and we had the exact room type. It was plain dishonesty . I would have looked past that, however our stay wasn’t that great either, one of the days sometime around 11pm the ac went bad and the thermostat started making noise , we had to turn the thermostat off to get some sleep however were uncomfortable the entire night. The TV wasn’t functioning either through the entire stay, the hotel did not even care to do basic checks before handing off the room. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Deb U
reviews.title: Ok
reviews.body: Convenient location and well stocked kitchen

reviews.author: Summer Vacation from KC
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.body: The stay was here was very nice and centrally located in downtown Seattle. The rooms were clean and the beds were very comfortable. Great place for the money. Marriott provided water bottles upon request at the front desk. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: JazzyT
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay
reviews.body: Excellent place to stay! We had a great time celebrating my first birthday!

reviews.author: MrsLRDub
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Great location in downtown Seattle

reviews.author: Sharon Curtis
reviews.title: Excellent hotel experience!
reviews.body: Very positive experience staying at the Marriott Residence Downtown Seattle. Breakfast was excellent, great variety. You could also eat at the hotel at night.  A market was present on site where you could purchase anything you forgot as well as microwavable meals.

reviews.author: Family from Pittsburgh
reviews.title: What a gem!
reviews.body:
This was our last stop on a two week journey and the place completely exceeded our expectations. Everything looked new, spacious and clean. The suites had enough room for a family of 5. All the staff we encountered were very polite and courteous. Breakfast buffet was busy, but it never ran out of things, they were on top of restocking things. Great gym too! 
This is definitely our hotel of choice when we’re back in Seattle!!

reviews.author: Hasse
reviews.title: Do not forget anything in your room at this hotel! Hotel otherwise OK
reviews.body: Very disappointed with the hotels inability to locate a valuable shirt forgotten (my mistake) in the room closet, even when notified less than 24 hours after check-out. Seems very strange and not right - hotel should know exactly who had access to the room after I left

reviews.author: JS55
reviews.title: BIG GROUP - GREAT STAY
reviews.body:
Our group of 31, in 11 rooms, was greeted cheerfully and guided efficiently through check in.  Kylie and Nikki made it easy and stress free.  Location is convenient to Pike Place and the Space Needle.  The hotel was clean and comfortable for us all.  
Most highly recommended for a city stay or a pre/post cruise stay.

reviews.author: Jean
reviews.title: Overnight stay
reviews.body: It was a good location close to the port just wish the restaurant was open later than it was. The breakfast was good.

reviews.author: Best
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Would defintley stay again! :)

reviews.author: K horserider
reviews.title: The food was horrible
reviews.body: We were so excited to stay at the Marriott. We had a horrible experience with the restaurant we had chowder and became extremely ill. The manager of the restaurant said they would do an investigation and have not heard back from them. My husband and I and some friends were on a cruise the next day and my husband was sick the entire cruise with food board illness. We will never return to this Marriott.

reviews.author: Travelers
reviews.title: Review
reviews.body: Needs better security approached by homeless trying to leave the hotel .

reviews.author: DaveS
reviews.title: Poor service overall
reviews.body: The hotel is poorly managed, but the restaurant was wonderful. The corned beef hash was amazing.

reviews.author: 6935829Astyhg
reviews.title: I highly don’t recommend wasting you’re money
reviews.body: I have stayed here now numerous times as a Bonvoy Member & highly respected local google guide for Wa state! I have been greeted with disrespect & my food orders from room service are never done correctly & arrive cold & soggy no matter what I’ve ordered! The Hook & Plow staff are unfriendly & expect tips!

reviews.author: Swanny68
reviews.title: Seattle Marriott Waterfront Great Choice
reviews.body: Found staff very friendly & able to address all our questions.  We had phoned in a month before our stay for an early checkin, they were able to put the note on our account, for 12PM.  We ended up arriving early (11AM) and they put us on a waiting list for early checkin.  They have a Bell service to store your luggage should that be required, so we were able to head out to the pier for lunch.  Within a hour we got a text that our room was ready and we headed back, cannot say how much we appreciated this as it had been a long day already from our early flight to get there and had a balcony view overlooking Elliot Bay.  We were not able to enjoy the amenities they offer in house due to our schedule and other activities we were doing, hanging out at the Pier, Pike Place Market, a couple of ball games & of course the Space Needle.  One thing we really enjoyed was all our activities were within a 1/2 hour walking distance, which was great for us.  Overall really enjoyed our vacation.

reviews.author: Chrissy A 918
reviews.title: Stay here!
reviews.body: Love this hotel and the view.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Do not book cruise transportation package
reviews.body: We booked a room with a package that included transportation to Pier 91 for the cruise terminal and the staff had no idea that Marriott.com was offering that package deal. They did not understand how to actually coordinate ground transportation because the hotel does not have a shuttle. It ended up being a significant burden with about 30 minutes of back and forth to figure this out.

reviews.author: Sam H
reviews.title: If you are an “It’s just a place to sleep” traveler- this location is perfect
reviews.body: I found this hotel while browsing the Seattle area. We had stayed elsewhere a week prior, and had an incredible stay- so, the expectations were similar. Boy were we in for a treat. The staff were friendly, and helpful- but as soon as we entered our room, we had an unpleasant odor- that had a sour twist to it. The room and hotel as a whole are much more dated than online images would imply. The partial view room was accurate. Our A/C stopped working on our second (and last) night. The overall feel for the hotel is that it’s a great spot if you are embarking on or disembarking from a cruise. Otherwise, I would not recommend this particular location. To be fair, I am unfamiliar with the Marriott brand, and this was the first for me. I hope other locations have more up to date amenities and furnishings. But, time will tell if I keep my status with Marriott.

reviews.author: JCT10
reviews.title: Quick family trip for a concert
reviews.body: I was impressed with this property. I am a Titanium member, we travel a lot. I haven’t felt like properties really honor or make a big deal about our loyalty tier but let me tell you, this property makes you feel special!

reviews.author: Traveler2026
reviews.title: Good Location - Tired Hotel
reviews.body: This hotel is in a good location for seeing the sites of the Seattle waterfront and market area, but it is relying purely on the location.  This shouldn't be a Marriott branded hotel, it feels more like a Courtyard or Fairfield. It's a bit worn, the rooms aren't very nice, and the staff doesn't seem to have the same care that most Marriott properties do.

reviews.author: Dean
reviews.title: Beware of the Seattle Marriott Waterfront
reviews.body: On two different stays, we had to wait well past the 4:00 PM check-in time for rooms to become available.  One of the times involved guests from the previous night still occupying the room and the hotel letting them stay at least five hours past check-out time!  The young lady at the front desk had no empathy for our situation, expressed no apologies or concern for us, and at one point even told one member of our group of six to leave the lobby when he became a bit vocal about our complaints.  The reservations had been made six months in advance with three adjoining (not necessarily connecting) rooms stipulated.  That did not happen, again with no apologies and we ended up with 20 rooms between our assigned rooms.  The restaurant is only open for breakfast and dinner dining occurs in the hotel lobby with one wait person on duty.  The food prices are astronomical, even considering the hotel location.  Overall, the hotel facilities and location are excellent, but the service leaves much to be desired.

reviews.author: Most helpful staff ever
reviews.title: Excellent staff
reviews.body: Very helpful staff they had an answer for all our needs, baggage storage while wait for rooms or while wondering around after check out, shuttle to anywhere, and valet staff that is second to none.

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.title: Stay Away!!!!
reviews.body: We were forced to wait in the bar for over two hours for a dirty room with no glasses to brush our teeth.  The bed felt like sleeping on a bale of hay.  The pilots were like rocks.  The check in receptionist was rude and not helpful.  The valet promised a driver to take us to an important event—no driver.  We asked and were told our Tesla would be charged for us—it did not happen.  I called the hotel (NOT 800 reservation) and spoke to reservation desk requesting early check in.  The cyber check in email from Marriott was worthless.  (We had a timely event at 5:30 and nearly missed it by 9 minutes). No thanks to Marriott.  What a joke for a night at the Marriott for $634.

reviews.author: Doug W
reviews.title: Place not good at allPlace very overrated
reviews.body: Room wasn’t serviced properly. Staff not courteous

reviews.author: The 3 Amigas
reviews.title: Cruising with Friends
reviews.body: This Marriott is a great place to stay if you are leaving on the NCL Alaska cruise from Pier 66.

reviews.author: Pampered Girl
reviews.title: Reasons to choose this hotel for your Waterfront stay!
reviews.body: The location can't be beat! But what made our stay spectacular was the attentive and friendly staff. Valet parker's were all over it! They were fantastic. The front desk staff was attentive and knowledgeable and helped us with a couple issues that we had unrelated to the hotel. The wait staff at the restaurants were great as well. We even got the absolute best directions from the janitorial staff who directed us to Pike's Place Market! We will stay here again!

reviews.author: Joe S
reviews.title: Excellent location minutes away from pikes place waterfront
reviews.body: This hotel is in a great location, the staff were very friendly would recommend

reviews.author: ship1
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: We found the excess into the shower little high for us and the air conditioning unit outside going on and off all night kept waking us.

reviews.author: Ethan S
reviews.title: Great location and friendly staff.
reviews.body: We arrived at 9:30 am and they stored our luggage until check in allowing us to enjoy the pier.

reviews.author: Bill H 545
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: The service & maintenance need to be improved at the Seattle waterfront hotel. If I return to Seattle, I'll opt for a different hotel.

reviews.author: Shelley GD
reviews.title: Mediocre hotel
reviews.body:
Hotel is old and the AC systems in the rooms are very loud to the point we had to turn it off.
The breakfast buffet was very expensive and poor quality.
The Club Lounge was diabolical. Again poor quality food and they even tried to charge for wine and beer!
Needless to say we have no intention of ever staying here again.

reviews.author: Ljp123
reviews.title: Convienient if your on a Norwegian Cruise
reviews.body: The boat is right across the street. Id never stay here otherwise

reviews.author: KR33
reviews.title: Front Row at the Party
reviews.body: The Seattle Marriott is excellently located in the heart of the newly renovated Seattle Waterfront.  So many attractions just footsteps away.  From the Space Needle, to Pike Place Market, to the Great Wheel and then to the professional ball fields, all just moments away from your enjoyment.

reviews.author: KH100
reviews.title: Sleepless in Seattle - Hotel with a loud HUM
reviews.body: Sleepless in Seattle - Hotel with a loud HUM

reviews.author: Tara
reviews.title: Thank you!
reviews.body: I booked this location for a team event, and it was the best in the city. What sets this hotel apart from the others isn't just the location; it’s the staff.
