Estephany, Tyler, Sung, and Ali, to name a few.  This team delivered an excellent experience for my team and me. They understand the details and truly know what great customer service looks like.  I was always a fan of Marriott; now I’m a loyalist.  Thank you for a wonderful experience!  We will be back.

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.title: Outstanding in Seattle
reviews.body: This Seattle Marriott is outstanding all the way around. Great location, beautiful facility, outstanding staff. 5 stars!

reviews.author: NineA5
reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.body: For the price we paid, we expected more and were disappointed in our rooms.

reviews.author: Tom B
reviews.title: Homeless in Seattle
reviews.body: Our room view was a homeless person sleeping outside the room

reviews.author: TheHotelCritic
reviews.title: If you didn't know, cruise ships dock right across the street, so expect to line up and wait... and wait... and wait some more.
reviews.body: This location is convenient if you are going aboard or coming off, but the wait is long for checking in, a seat at the hotel bar or restaurant.  Unfortunately, 2 different cruise lines were there for our 3 day stay.  The entire front desk staff was amazing, very nice, courteous, and helpful.  The room was clean and ready hours before our normal check in time.  This is walking distance to Pike Place if you walk or jog a lot, so we didn't mind.  But, I think next time we will get a place closer.  My family enjoyed the stay there.  It was our first time in Seattle so it was a great experience.  We would be back if our cruise ship docks across the street.

reviews.author: Clay
reviews.title: Great hotel in the middle of all downtown action
reviews.body: Very close to all activities, restaurants and bars. Quick Uber or walking distance.

reviews.author: MK
reviews.title: Average
reviews.body: It was quite good however what I didn’t like was that the sofa bed was not prepared and we had to do it ourselves plus the bottom mattress was super thin. Breakfast was ok for hotel like breakfast but real boiled eggs were not available and only not too real scrambled eggs were there. Parking could be a bit less expensive so we could use it instead of near by parking.

reviews.author: Grant
reviews.title: PAX West 2026 Weekend stay
reviews.body: We booked a room at SpringHill Suites Seattle for PAX this year.  We have stayed at other hotels in the area for PAX, but this was our first stay here.  The hotel is in excellent condition.  Everything was nice and clean.  The room was spacious and comfy.  Complementary Breakfast was excellent.  Fitness center met my needs.  It's only a few blocks from the convention center, so that's a plus.  We had a great stay.

reviews.author: GorTrav26
reviews.title: Great accommodation in downtown Seattle that  priced accordingly.
reviews.body: We chose this hotel for its price, room accommodation Size for our group. It is located in downtown where tourist attractions are walking distance. The breakfast was included in our stay and they served  good warm and cold breakfast to start our day. We were given an early check in so we had time to relax before exploring the area some more. We enjoyed our stay here because it was comfortable and we had more space.

reviews.author: Pre cruise traveler
reviews.title: Seattle Gem
reviews.body: Recommend for leisure travel.  Accommodating staff, clean comfy rooms.  Quiet, too.  Location easily walkable for public transportation.

reviews.author: Cwoods
reviews.title: A comfortable stay that met our needs
reviews.body: This was an okay property. Close to downtown area and no issues with neighborhood. It wasn't very bright lobby, parking and breakfast area felt very confined.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: Nice place good lication
reviews.body: Nice place good location, can walk to most places or Uber. Booked for 2 days stayed extra 3 had to cancel cruise. Not many restaurants but Italian around corner it good.

reviews.author: Rob D
reviews.title: Unhelpful front desk staff, and sketchy surrounding area
reviews.body: We fully paid for our room several months in advance, but when we arrived, the credit card reader at the front desk was broken. That kept the attendant from placing a deposit for incidentals on our card. As such, she was ready to deny us a room, even though the room itself was already FULLY PAID MONTHS IN ADVANCE!!  Thankfully, a different attendant overheard the conversation and ran our deposit through HIS card reader, and it worked just fine. Had it not been for him, we would have been on the sidewalk with the homeless people who panhandle around the hotel.

reviews.author: Ivey Elm
reviews.title: Amazing customer service!
reviews.body: I stayed one night. I walked in and asked about transportation to the pier for my cruise. They looked up my pier, scheduled a third party shuttle for me. Told me all I needed to know. While I sat there I saw them print out walking instructions for other guests. Call cabs and help out in other ways. These people are awesome and when I take my next cruise out of Seattle this is where I want to stay. The place was extremely clean everyone I encountered was smiling and helpful. Loved it!

reviews.author: Tooties travel
reviews.title: 2day Amtrak trip
reviews.body: Excellent hotel and staff and the room and the stay are all awesome

reviews.author: Aquino
reviews.title: No place to park and loud freeway noise
reviews.body: I would not stay here again for fear of not having a place to park.  We got the last parking spot in a private lot next door.  We saw others that didn’t have a place to park.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel near cruise terminal
reviews.body: I stayed the night before our cruise.  The staff were friendly and helpful in getting me transportation to the cruise terminal.  The beds were comfy and the breakfast was great.

reviews.author: In and out
reviews.title: Line dance cruise
reviews.body: Only in Seattle for a cruise, this Hotel was a Poor location to see the tourist locations of the city

reviews.author: JeffJD
reviews.title: Comfortable but noisy.
reviews.body: Decent hotel in a pinch. Off the beaten path a bit. bathroom and room a bit noisy from a malfunctioning fan/light and location of room. Complimentary breakfast was a plus. Staff was accommodating and allowed early check-in after cruise.

reviews.author: Ed
reviews.title: Nice Place to Stay for Cruises
reviews.body:
Free breakfast was very good, although traffic flow needs work and Waffle Station needs better monitoring to keep supplied.
If using the shuttle service to get to port(s), be advised it's a shared service, not just you or just people going to the same port.

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.body:
Hotel room phone didn't work. 
Rooms get hot. 
Room carpet needs changing, nasty. 
Vents caked with dust.
Housekeeping cleans room every other day, that is if they clean your room. 
Always had to ask for the correct amount of towels. 
Front desk guy named Alex could care less and he showed that. 
Front desk guy named Ty was very welcoming and helpful. 
Housekeeping don't clean rooms on the day they are suppose to.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.title: Very Average
reviews.body: Good location and I like the room designs.  But be prepared to care for yourself or wait.  Understaffed for as busy as the hotel is.

reviews.author: Bryan
reviews.title: Great service.
reviews.body: Great service. Would’ve been even better if I wasn’t billed right away and also charged another $183 after my stay.. the location was OK not very pleasant around it

reviews.author: Kendra F
reviews.title: Clean and comfortable
reviews.body: The hotel was clean and comfortable. The free breakfast was good with a variety of food options. The staff were kind and accommodating.

reviews.author: R
reviews.title: Please work on room 201
reviews.body: Room was filthy, very unlike Marriott:(

reviews.author: C Turner
reviews.title: A comfortable stay in Seattle
reviews.body:
I was in town for a two night stay. Enjoyed a ball game, exhibit and a few tourist destinations.
SpringHill offered a good location for access to transit or walking to local attractions. 
Our room was quiet and clean, as was the hotel in general. Breakfast was busy but had plenty of food. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Good value. We'd stay here again!

reviews.author: Seafair Visitor
reviews.title: Overcrowded and poor breakfast buffet.  Will not return.
reviews.body: Overcrowded and poor breakfast buffet with inadequate seating.  Elevators were always full and taking the stairs leads you outside into an alley on the backside of the building.  Poor quality of towels and not enough for 2 people.

reviews.author: Niki
reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.body: System was down both when we checked in and when we checked out. Staff told us it happens fairly regularly due to the old PCs that jam. Bedsheets and pillow cases were not ironed. Not sure if they had been changed at all, actually. Very disappointing.

reviews.author: Becky
reviews.title: Spacious
reviews.body: Our suite was spacious, comfortable and clean. Complementary breakfast was really good. Location was ideal. The weather was great so we were able to walk to the Market and to the Space Needle.

reviews.author: ronster369
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: I was looking for a nice stay near Capital Hill. This place delivered. And they have a great complimentary breakfast to start your day!

reviews.author: Dennis from Ohio
reviews.title: A Good Value
reviews.body: We had a very short stay at this hotel -- arrived 11:00 pm and left 10:00 am to board our cruise ship.  Obviously, the hotel knows that many guests are bound for some ship because they had an arrangement with a shuttle to take guests from the hotel to the cruise terminal.  The $15 cost per person was extremely reasonable, especially comparing that to a $50-$60 Uber ride.  Breakfast was good with the usual fare of scrambled eggs, meats (sausage or bacon), and cereal.  Overall, staying at Springhill Suites was a very good value.

reviews.author: SeattleFamilyVacay2026
reviews.title: Average accommodations in a convenient Seattle location.
reviews.body: Dated accommodations with friendly staff and decent security. Questionable value compared to other nearby hotels.

reviews.author: LC
reviews.title: Stay at Springhill Suites
reviews.body: Horrible Stay at Springhill Suites by Marriitt in Seattle

reviews.author: Zoomlizard
reviews.title: Nice stay in Seattle Center
reviews.body:
Overall really clean and nice place. Breakfast had a good variety of foods. 
Easy to walk are or rent a scooter.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Good Location near downtown. Large rooms.
reviews.body: Excellent location for easy freeway access and close to Downtown area. The rooms are large and comfortable. Mine was quiet even facing the freeway. Room was clean and had a small refrigerator, a big desk, and an old little coffee maker with just a regular "pod". No decaf. Might be nice to upgrade the coffee makers as they are slow and old. Beds were comfortable. Pillows were awful - truly, all flat. For our 1 night it was fine. They have expensive underground parking ($45), but it is convenient. Breakfast included was meh - but I expected that, however the coffee here was good. No eggs, but a lot of other choices. Back-up at front desk with only one clerk when I arrived.

reviews.author: Steve D
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.body:
Great Stay made even better by the excellent service i was fortunate to enjoy from start to finish 
Location was ok  but it was still walking distance to most attractions 

Room was excellent 10 floor with great views room 1010 
Clean and spacious Bathroom 

Staff were welcoming  Helpful and nothing was impossible for them 

Enjoy the fitness centre 

Breakfast was amazing plenty of choices 

Love the Coffee Station at the reception

reviews.author: Summit Legacy Travel
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Nice place, great staff, beautiful setting and wonderful experience overall.

reviews.author: Dana
reviews.title: Excellent all around
reviews.body: The staff always went way out of their way to make us feel special.

reviews.author: Luci J
reviews.title: Great modern hotel stay
reviews.body: We really enjoyed our long weekend here. The rooms are modern and clean(although lacking a little bit of bathroom privacy) and the location is a short walk from public transit, the Capital Hill neighbourhood and plenty of amazing local restaurants.

reviews.author: Lokkie
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.body: I was here for a training with our team and I was impressed on how attentive the associates were. Kobe in the fd was very hospitable . The bartender and breakfast attendants were welcoming and helpful as well.

reviews.author: Seasoned travelers
reviews.title: Comfortable and good locatiin
reviews.body: Hotel is relatively new so venue is quite nice. Nicely located with neighborhood feel.

reviews.author: MJ
reviews.title: Not clean
reviews.body: Room was not clean with dust bunnies and hair all over the floor. Asked for house cleaning to come by to vacuum, and no one showed up. Also short staffing or something, where my husband and I called more than 3 times to see if we could do an early check in and was put on hold over 10min each time where we ended up hanging up and giving up.

reviews.author: RJH
reviews.title: Recent stay AC Marriott Seattle
reviews.body: Overall, I thought the hotel stay was fantastic, we definitely had some trouble upon check-in. We were sent to the wrong room twice, which made it very difficult using a room key to get up to a room that wasn’t assigned to us, and a front desk agent who initially refused to take any responsibility and made us feel like idiots, which started our stay a little rocky thankfully, another agent intervened and helped us with the situation. Our stay was very pleasant after that. Rooms are clean, restaurant for breakfast very good, work out facility very nice, view was back of hotel rooftops not the greatest.

reviews.author: Hidden Charges
reviews.title: Hudden Charged
reviews.body: Beware of hidden charges!  Don’t eat their breakfast buffet.  Staff is like robots. The place is immaculate though!

reviews.author: Joy O
reviews.title: Hotel overlooking the freeway
reviews.body: The hotel is on the newer side but I would not reserve this hotel again because of the location. I requested a room with a view and would have paid more, but they gave me a room overlooking the freeway. It was not the view I hoped for. I was charged $28.00 for breakfast buffet when there were no signs or information posting the price. I would not have used the buffet had I known the price. The saving grace were the comfortable beds! Always something to count on.

reviews.author: Bad experience
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.body: Horrible service desk manager

reviews.author: Joy
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body:
The staff were very kind, accommodating and respectful.
The room was very nice and clean.
I’d stay here again.

reviews.author: 1 Star experience
reviews.title: Not a true reflection of Marriot
reviews.body: Terrible experience at the Seattle location downtown the kitchen was inoperative all week during a very busy work week

reviews.author: LAMA1028
reviews.title: Only go if you can’t find anything else
reviews.body: The rooms are great for comfort. You have to ask for a manager to rectify things but they do extremely well. Food is awful-microwaved and English Muffins frozen. Bar food undercooked. Cruise stopover and the place is a total disaster at breakfast. Only one staff person. No clean up. Looks like a high school food fight

reviews.author: Kay
reviews.title: Horrific Hotel
reviews.body:
Elevator broken for entire stay (3 days), small room, bathroom door doesn't close, unsafe street (drug addicts roaming all around with no security). Bartender took 20 mins to make one drink.

DO NOT STAY HERE.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.body:
I was double-charged for my room at the AC Hotel Seattle. As soon as I noticed two pending charges on my credit card, I called the hotel and was assured the duplicate charge would be corrected. I was also told they would “waive” the cancellation fee—as though they were doing me a favor—when the reservation could already be canceled without penalty up to 24 hours before check-in.

The duplicate charge was never corrected, forcing me to dispute it with my credit card company. I also sent multiple emails to the hotel and received no response.

Billing errors happen, but ignoring the problem after promising to fix it is unacceptable. This was business travel, and I will recommend that my company stop sending employees to this hotel. Based on the poor communication, misleading explanation, and complete lack of follow-through, I would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Ru
reviews.title: Worst Hotel and service
reviews.body: I stayed there for 3 nights, the manager at the hotel doesn't even care, i asked the front desk to ask their manager to reach me as i was very unhappy with the service. The worst part is that i used a face towel and there was a white hair on my face from the towel and i am 26 with jet black hair. I was horrified and had to take a shower and even after saying this i didnot get any call or help. I had marriot platinum elite status and they didnt care so i dont think they would care for any status and the hotel is just worst. for 3 night i paid around 900 with the status i could have taken other marriot but never this one.

reviews.author: JP
reviews.title: Nice simple spot
reviews.body: Good clean hotel just needs a couple more workers and maybe some extended bar hours. No pool, good location walking distance to lots of desirable Seattle spots.

reviews.author: sage1125
reviews.title: Difficult location, nice rooms
reviews.body: Room was modern and clean, view was into other rooms. Difficult location for parking.

reviews.author: AC
reviews.title: It was okay
reviews.body: Nothing special. Worked for what I needed.

reviews.author: D Lam
reviews.title: Exceptional Experience
reviews.body: Stayed here for summer vacation with kids. Centrally located, easy in/out.

reviews.author: HA
reviews.title: An excellent choice when staying in Seattle
reviews.body:
Location location location. This is so close to everything. And very convenient.
Good views. Convenient, excellent dining. Good coffee shop one block away. Uber drivers are super fast we use the shuttle service from the airport and we're happy with them, too.

reviews.author: Unhappy customer
reviews.title: Never go back
reviews.body: I there 7 days only got my room cleaned, several rude employees including a manager. There was only 2 friendly staff members. To many other problems that I'm still dealing with.

reviews.author: Rob
reviews.title: Contradictory service. Bad vagrants all over the place.
reviews.body: Nice hotel but inconsistent service. Lots of homeless camped across the street. Empty tent next door.

reviews.author: GlobalTexan
reviews.title: Clean and quiet but poor chair and toilet design.
reviews.body: Clean and quiet, if somewhat small room for the money.  Desk chair, after 30 years of hotel travel all over the world, is literally the most uncomfortable (and I am a thin person) I have ever used.  Also this has the Asian style circular vs oval toilet bowl so if you are a larger person this is not ideal.  But if those two issues don't bother you I had a good experience at this location and the staff were friendly.

reviews.author: Audry
reviews.title: Stay at the AC Hotel
reviews.body: The breakfast was satisfactory, although it could have been improved. The orange juice was not of the highest quality.

reviews.author: yes
reviews.title: Do not honor titanium or elite status
reviews.body: staff are fantastic . breakfast ran out of food. no eggs for ordering  menu breakfast. Ran out of the main dish prosciutto an hour before ther end of breakfast.

reviews.author: Gen West
reviews.title: Great staff but short on service standards
reviews.body:
Staff was amazing during the whole stay but the property did not meet my expectations of a the Marriott brand. 

Areas to improve; 

Mobile chat - takes 20 minutes to respond
Housekeeping requests were a hit and miss 
Fitness gym needs consistent cleaning and temp

reviews.author: Do better
reviews.title: First time at an AC not impressed.
reviews.body: Hotel finishings are an attempt at high end but low quality.  No issue with staff but maybe picking up the trash on the sidewalk beside your hotel and keeping the boulevard nice would make your 400 a night hotel seem like it is worth that.  The rest of the street looks nice except around your entrance not what I expect of a Marriot quality .  AC did not work properly in my room  1112. Had to ask to be moved.

reviews.author: Friendly and Clean
reviews.title: Comfortable, Clean and Friendly
reviews.body:
My 10 year old daughter and I stayed at the AC Marriott Downtown Seattle for just a fun girls weekend in Seattle.  The hotel was clean, comfortable and the staff was so friendly.  We really were comfortable with our whole stay.  My daughter loved the breakfast area making us tea and bagels and a bowl of fresh fruit for her breakfast.  

She also enjoyed the corn hole and golf put put on the patio outside the bar.  After a long day and not ready to head up to the room, it was nice to have a place to enjoy quiet time on the patio with a beverage.  

The only thing is we were on the edge of downtown. We planned on walking but we walked and used Uber more than we had anticipated.  But the people at the location and the cleanliness made it totally worth the extra effort. Everyone from the front desk, maintenance, the bartender and guests were friendly and helpful.

I highly recommend getting an Orca card about 2.5 weeks before your visit (they arrive to your home address and it takes time to process).  Taking the bus down to Pikes Place Market is only $3 and kids ride free.  This will save some walking and transportation costs.  

We loved the Lime scooters/bikes for a quick jaunt but they do charge by the minute and the minutes add up when your sitting at red lights that seem to be on timers rather than sensors for traffic.  

Our stay at the AC Marriott Downtown Seattle was truly excellent.  I would recommend it.

reviews.author: Russ
reviews.title: Cramped and Dirty
reviews.body: Small king room was not great. The whole place felt cheaper than a capsule hotel. AC did not work and the "smart" tablet was literally cracked/broken and did no not control anything but the tv. Room had a layer of dust.

reviews.author: Remote worker
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Seattle.
reviews.body: Great location. Nice area to walk around. Great staff and facility.

reviews.author: Fair
reviews.title: Good for short stay
reviews.body: Helpful staff, centralized location

reviews.author: Steveg
reviews.title: Great property and staff
reviews.body: We stayed in Sept 2026 before and after an Alaska cruise...Conveniently located and an average 15 min walk to almost anything you want to see...The staff is very helpful, accommodating and friendly.  The property is clean and very modern with some interesting artwork.  The bar is excellent and the food is good...

reviews.author: Irene R
reviews.title: Great for a short stay
reviews.body: My husband and I were here for a football game and upon arrival we arrived before our check in time and our guest service member was able to accommodate us with our room early so we can make the game on time. Our room was extremely clean and loved the features it offered! I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Going for a Gen Z vibe but missing the big picture
reviews.body:
Nice vibe.  Some good small touches (like the single button lighting).  But disliked a few things

#1 - tiny room . felt like i was in a studio room in Tokyo.  comparable marriotts in the area are way bigger
#2 - no coffee in the room
#3 - self-checkin.  I am platinum for a reason, and it isn't so I can mess around with a self checkin like i'm ordering at mcdonald's
#4 - the scrambled Eggs were cube shaped. Unless you have cube shaped chickens, that's a red flag for a $20 breakfast

reviews.author: Hip just not for us
reviews.title: Lotsa tech
reviews.body: We felt out of place, it clearly was designed to be catering to a younger demographic. Breakfast wasn’t bad, we decided overall to eat out. The bedroom was too small for us.

reviews.author: Beds Bites and Beyond
reviews.title: Small Room, Big Comfort—and Breakfast Worth Coming Back For
reviews.body:
At first, I was hesitant about the room’s size and the capsule-style bathroom, but I was pleasantly surprised by how nice the shower was. The room may have been small, but since we only needed a comfortable place to sleep, it was perfect. And those blackout blinds deserve their own five-star review—the room was so dark I’m pretty sure morning simply gave up. CitizenM, if you’d like to reveal the brand, we’re all ears!

Breakfast was far beyond my expectations. Everything was beautifully presented, with a wide variety of options. I enjoyed eggs, sausage, avocado toast, fruit, and vegetables, along with an Americano and refreshing cucumber water. I would definitely stay here again—and honestly, I’d come back just for the food!

reviews.author: Anne
reviews.title: Great location, great team
reviews.body: The hotel is ideal, you can walk everywhere. Spotlessly clean with all the amenities you need, but the staff are genuinely exceptional. Friendly, helpful, thoughtful - they are simply awesome and made our stay fantastic.

reviews.author: Watch for charges
reviews.title: Watch your bill for extra charges
reviews.body: Was charged for two drinks I never ordered. Tried to call and email many times and nobody got back to me

reviews.author: Tarun
reviews.title: 2 night stay.
reviews.body: Good breakfast buffet (even though its not complimentary with the reservation). My only complaint is the flashing light (smoke detector) in the room.

reviews.title: Aesthetic
reviews.body: We ❤️ this place!! The decor is awesome, I especially love the lounge areas. The staff is courteous and helpful. We also appreciate the fact that housekeeping doesn’t intrude unless you request service.

reviews.author: Jane and Paul
reviews.title: Good Value in Downtown Seattle
reviews.body: Great place to stay in downtown Seattle without breaking the bank. Good location, great service, basic but comfortable room. Late night food and bar service a bonus. Enjoyed hanging out in the big comfy lounge area. Would stay again.

reviews.author: darrenM
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.body: A great hotel, great location (to the Amazon office(s) I visited), great team (Gray et al) and breakfast!

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.title: Excellet if you know what you're getting into
reviews.body: This isn't a normal hotel, so be aware of the room sizes. But the rooms are what I like best about CitizenM - they're always clean, modern, and comfortable for solo travel.

reviews.author: Cody
reviews.title: Very kind staff
reviews.body: Staff was very kind and helpful to when we needed to switch rooms to accommodate my wife’s accessibility needs.

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.title: Amazing location
reviews.body: An amazing place to stay when you need to be around Seattle. Super clean. My only issue is the breakfast booking. I was overcharged and can’t seem to get the day I didn’t use off.

reviews.author: Mandeep
reviews.title: Clean & fresh… but pricey!!
reviews.body: Clean & fresh; small room and basic facilities.

reviews.author: Queenroyalty777
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!!!
reviews.body:
My stay at the Citizen M South Lake was amazing from start to finish! I was coming to visit Seattle and attend the Layne Staley Tribute Weekend! 

The area was easy to navigate around once I got the hang of the bus schedules! Walking was also something I did to nearby places, there are plenty of things within walking distance including the Space Needle! 

I loved my room and that I could set things up on the tablet from the lights to curtains! The bathroom was gorgeous and upscale! Breakfast was lovely with so many choices to pick from every morning, I enjoyed it every morning! 

I especially loved the style of the hotel it was very eccentric and minimalist, definitely the most interesting 4 start Hotel I’ve stayed in so far! Staff was very friendly and helpful!

reviews.author: None
reviews.title: Review Seattle South Lake Union
reviews.body:
The rooms are too small for the price. The bed is placed against a wall. One person would need to crawl over the other if getting up at night. It’s also difficult to make the bed.
I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Very chic!
reviews.body: This was my first time at a citizenM hotel, so I didn’t know what to make of it when I booked my stay. From the minute you enter the lobby you know this isn’t your standard hotel. From the self service check in to the multicolored lights that greet you when you enter your room, I was just bowled over. The iPad based room controls took some getting used to, as did the micro sized room. But the coziness factor grew on me and soon I didn’t want to get out of the luxurious king sized bed. I can’t wait to stay in another citizenm!

reviews.author: Name
reviews.title: OK
reviews.body: Nice, clean hotel in good location. Rooms are extra small, but that is kind of brand thing. A bit too pricey for the value.

reviews.author: Nimita1
reviews.title: Modern, cool vibes, friendly staff
reviews.body: I had originally booked a 2 night stay but had to cut it short due to an unexpected family emergency. The front desk staff was kind and understanding and could see the anguish in my face. They refunded my extra night, made an exception and it took so much stress off me. Despite the digital self check-in and check-out process, the friendly faces made the difference for me. I’m definitely coming back for another stay.

reviews.author: rkuzminski
reviews.title: Bad
reviews.body: It felt as though I was being neglected while I was staying there. My hopes were high since it was the second time being there. I even got the highest package there for the second time.

reviews.author: Hb12
reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.body: Not really worth the money for what you are getting especially in the area but nice staff and clean rooms

reviews.author: NickyG
reviews.title: Great Location, nice and modern
reviews.body: The hotel is in a convenient location in downtown Seattle. We were lucky to get a parking spot on the street right outside. The rooms are small but comfortable and have all needed acessorries. The special rooms for mobility reasons are more spacious and worked out fine for our needs. The fridge is a nice goodie and overall we were very satisfied with the modern style hotel.

reviews.author: Shelley G
reviews.title: Seattle stay
reviews.body: It was a fun atmosphere and clean rooms

reviews.author: Gabriella
reviews.title: A one shot
reviews.body:
The hotel lobby is really nice, but my room was not as I expected. It was too tiny, especially considering it's cost. Far too expensive for what it offered. The bed was literally stuck in between 2 walls making it difficult to get off it and without a night table. Uncomfortable.
No courtesy set of any kind has was in the room.
Breakfast was very good, but not included unfortunately. And paying another $25 per person...

reviews.author: Mila
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay!
reviews.body: I loved CitizenM room! The bed was so comfy and the best part was blackout blinds. Breakfast was excellent and very nutritious. Location is super convenient!

reviews.author: jume7
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: I’d 100% book with them again. Super helpful staff and friendly. Great room and privacy. Over all very nice.

reviews.author: S Tavares
reviews.title: Clean and well maintained with friendly staff
reviews.body: Staff throughout the facility were universally professional and helpful and friendly. The room was clean and well appointed. The humidifier in the room was very appreciated.

reviews.author: Antoinette A
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: I stayed here for a conference and was upgraded to a suite, my room was beautiful with a beautiful view, very convenient location, very clean, I didn't find a bar or full service restaurant in the hotel but the grab and go sit down area and the room service was pretty good. The gym was great as well.

reviews.author: WhatA Maze
reviews.title: Hope You Like To Walk Your Keester Off
reviews.body: Derpity derpa derpy derpa derpity derpalicious derp

reviews.author: Jamie
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: Service was great, beds comfortable!

reviews.author: Recent Stay
reviews.title: Poor over All
reviews.body:
Absolutely horrible customer service and an extremely disappointing experience.

We were informed that a party directly near our room would be going on until approximately 4:00 a.m. When we called the front desk and insisted on being moved to a different room so we could actually sleep, the situation somehow got worse. We were threatened with being kicked out and then repeatedly hung up on when we tried to speak with staff about resolving the issue.

Finally, around 2:00 a.m., someone came to our room, knocked on the door, and left us two room keys with a new room number along with a wobbly luggage cart. No staff member offered to assist us with moving our belongings. We then had to move all of our luggage ourselves across the bridge to the new room—which includes multiple sets of stairs—making the luggage cart essentially useless.

After everything we had already dealt with, we then had to fight with management just to receive a refund. The entire situation was handled incredibly poorly and was completely unacceptable from a customer-service standpoint.

The hotel itself is OK at best, but the service and the way we were treated overshadowed anything positive about the property. Based on our experience, I would not recommend staying here.

reviews.title: Beautiful and wonderful stay I enjoy my vacation I was just disappointed that you didn’t provide breakfast that all
reviews.body: I wish too come back and it’s so nice and clean I can’t wait to come back with my family it’s near to airport and transport is easy to exec

reviews.author: none
reviews.title: NA
reviews.body: poor, i encountered uncooperative staff

reviews.author: Amanda M
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body:
We were charged for an upgraded room when our room was not available after paying weeks in advance for guaranteed early check in! Upon checking out we had a surprise 41.63 daily charge for the upgraded room
Revenue- front desk said they were upgrading us we should NOT of been charged for the upgrade when we paid for early check in! On top of $57 a day for parking and $32 a day destination fees this felt like a money grab! The AC in the upgraded executive suite 2173 was awful we had the units in the main seating area on high and the bedroom remained so hot my spouse had to sleep on the couch as we were literally sweating trying to sleep- There is a  small slit in the wall that blows the ac into the bedroom but it’s useless in the summer heat! We kept the blackout shades closed The Whole time trying to keep the temps down in the room- The toilet takes numerous flushes to get all the paper down it seeps back up after flushing! The room was clean the only thing positive about our stay! The pool is beautiful but over crowded so you can’t really relax and enjoy it! Kids were loud and obnoxious also! There should be adult only times for enjoyment! Breakfast buffet was delicious but steep at $29 per person! We won’t be staying here again due to the hidden charges and lack of temperature controls throughout the room! We wanted to love this place but it didn’t live up to our expectations!

reviews.author: JOSEPH
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Excellent staff Excellent location

reviews.author: ADO Reston Va
reviews.title: Sheraton Downtown Denver - great choice
reviews.body: The Sheraton is a lovely hotel with easy access to to all is the shops and restaurants on 16th Street. Easy train ride to and from Denver Airport which is a lot more cost effective than an Uber.

reviews.author: Cobesnation101
reviews.title: If you go here expecting mediocrity look elsewhere
reviews.body: Had an event hosted here, overall I was impressed with the service and catering to the community as well as the amenities offered. One of the best burgers I ever tried.

reviews.title: Tyner downtown

reviews.author: ZAGREEN1228
reviews.title: My First overnight stay in Denver.
reviews.body: Room was excellent, food was good, staff was very friendly and professional.  Will recommend.

reviews.author: T Drager
reviews.title: Great visit
reviews.body: The staff managed to get everything in order for 6000 of us for a conference. The checkin process was smooth and fast.  All issues were quickly dealt with. The staff was fabulous. The rooms were clean and remarkably sound proof.

reviews.author: Happy Camper
reviews.title: Sheraton Delivers
reviews.body: Everything about this hotel exceeded my expectations. Staff were incredibly friendly, front desk manager was an absolute peach. Got to check out late. Pool is VERY nice. Location is perfect. On site food options are really yummy.

reviews.author: Ma88
reviews.title: Unpleasant Experience
reviews.body: This is the second time that this property has attempted to downgrade my room without honesty or explanation. Both times I have been sent to my room after a long day and been forced to treck back to the front desk to get the room I originally reserved, then have to teck back to get my luggage and then to the correct room. Just be open and honest with customers, most people understand the issue and just want choices. This left me feeling they they do not value my time in the least. I am Mariott Gold Elite, I can't imagine how they treat regular bookings. The Sheraton Denver Downtown is a consistently sub par experience in my book.

reviews.author: Aaenzi
reviews.title: roach retreat
reviews.body: Roaches in roon 512 tower. None in 1104.

reviews.author: Galaxyfox25
reviews.title: Room stay problems
reviews.body: Don't stay in the tower section in the hotel. Especially in room 630. I was checked in to this room and I had major issues with the door getting in. The room card reader didn't work. I had a hard time getting the door to unlock. The locking mechanism on the door didn't work at all. Because of this I had to call the matenence guy to fix the door and the top latch where u lock the door was loose. The maintenance guy had to fix that to. Then he told me I had to repack all my stuff out of the room and head down to the lobby to get a different room in the plaza. Then then put me in the plaza section and the room I got I had no problem with it. This has been one lousy and stressful stay for me. Especially when there is a denfur convention being held there.

reviews.author: Lodi
reviews.title: Everything was perfect
reviews.body: Everything was perfect. We had to wait for our room but they have an excellent lobby bar :-). The Club Lounge is a great get away when things get busy.

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.title: Pricey get your wallet about
reviews.body: Get your wallet out. You. Will for sure pay extra in expected fees at this place.

reviews.author: Pauls Review
reviews.title: Pauls Review
reviews.body: Great Hotel but beware of Credit Card hold Charges !!!!!

reviews.author: G H one nighter
reviews.title: Great job Sheraton
reviews.body: I've stayed here before and it's clear that Sheraton is renovating and making upgrades. It's a much nicer hotel.

reviews.author: denver trip 2026
reviews.title: work meeting
reviews.body: good overall , pool is small for the size of event

reviews.author: AARON F
reviews.title: SHERATON HOTEL!
reviews.body: Good place in a good location. So many activities in the surrounding area and good vies. Would recommend and visit again!

reviews.author: G Money
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Rooms were cleaned kinda they didn’t wipe the glass rinds off the small table

reviews.author: Gio67
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Very clean. Great location.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.title: Looks nice - but not great
reviews.body: The hotel is very nice looking & and the staff are nice. Our room was tiny, we basically could walk right into our bed from the doorway. We were next to the pool on the 5th floor, and the hallway stunk. We sat at the bar to eat and while the food was quite good, it took forever to get the bartender to take our order, probably sat there for 15 minutes with her walking right past us like we weren't sitting there.

reviews.author: Traveling
reviews.title: Be aware of additional costs
reviews.body: When we arrived at the hotel, we were greeted by valet, we asked them where we could park for free and they told us the parking garage connected to the hotel so we went and parked there. We ended up getting charged $57 a night for parking. We were also charged $32 a day for city tax on top of additional fees and charges. I tried to dispute at least the parking charges since we were told by staff to park there for free and the hotel did not approve my request. Please be aware of additional charges.

reviews.author: Sofrep37129
reviews.title: AC was hot
reviews.body: The room was hot and the AC could not be adjusted.

reviews.author: DenverTrvlr71
reviews.title: Great Convention Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel was a great convention hotel with nice amenities and helpful staff.   The Sheraton Club was a nice perk that was always well-stocked with helpful staff

reviews.author: Happy guest
reviews.title: Excellent! Clean, great location
reviews.body: Walking distance to many attractions. Will stay again.

reviews.author: disappointing
reviews.title: Promising
reviews.body: Very promising, poor execution

reviews.author: Denise
reviews.title: Food was.the.worse
reviews.body: Food items were not very  limited and prepared in mostly one culture or form with alot of meat and cheese. Coffee and water for tea was always cold. The element in time square had better choices.

reviews.author: Kim and Company
reviews.title: An Oasis at a difficult time.
reviews.body: Thank you, I had everything that I needed for  our lengthy three weeks day.

reviews.author: Eviez97
reviews.title: Everything was wonderful!
reviews.body: We stayed 4 nights at the Element Denver. It was so wonderful. The staff, room and property were perfect. There were a few small details that made our stay so much better than anywhere we have stayed before.  Complimentary breakfast and cocktail hour among the few. It was clean. Staff was friendly. Room was great!

reviews.author: Brad LS
reviews.title: Downtown hotel was great
reviews.body: Had a wonderful time during our stay. Staff was excelent as was the room.

reviews.author: Numbers and Letters Only
reviews.title: They don't empty the wastebaskets
reviews.body: The staff for our entire stay of 8 days never emptied the wastbaskets (which are way too small)   in either the room or the batchroom.

reviews.author: Kmoser
reviews.title: Perfect overnight stay
reviews.body: We were in Colorado for a wedding and had one last night before our early flights.  The Element was the perfect place to stay.  We were able to drop our bags off early, enjoy a Rockies game and enjoyed a peaceful night.  Awesome breakfast!

reviews.author: Jade
reviews.title: Very disappointed and would not recommend!
reviews.body: Not worth the price you pay to stay.

reviews.author: Eric Church Fan
reviews.title: Wry enjoyable hotel
reviews.body: We booked here while we were in town for a show at Red Rocks.  We were very pleased with our decision!

reviews.author: Justin Green
reviews.body: Best Hotel I stayed at with Marriot!

reviews.author: From VA to CO
reviews.title: John was amazing!
reviews.body: My stay was amazing and John is a Keeper. He represents the Marriott brand very well.

reviews.author: A visit to denver
reviews.title: 3 nights stay
reviews.body:
The lobby entrance and dining area was very clean, appealing places to set, they have water available. And coffee enjoyed sleeping in the rooms very comfortable. Beds rooms were not fancy. But nice to stay in the biggest issue was we had nobody come to clean the rooms at all, or do the beds or give us towels. We had to go to the front desk and ask for that as well as breakfast. The first day was excellent. We had a choice of scrambled eggs or an omelet and variety of options. Queen on the tables. But the second day and third day only option was scrambled eggs, and all they had were pork sausages, no chicken or turkey options available

Happy hour was very enjoyable
No pool or jacuzzi

Overall review i would say was very good

reviews.author: DenverGreat StaynotGreat
reviews.title: Element East
reviews.body: Top tier cost. Amenities to kept up during stay. Almost 300$ a night to have room not refreshed.

reviews.author: George
reviews.title: Nice hotel in Denver downtown!
reviews.body: Nice hotel in Denver downtown. Close to the convention centre and everything. Clean and spacey room and nice breakfast! The staff is very friendly and helpful (Jimmy, John, Matt and all others). Definitely will go back there when I am in Denver!

reviews.author: GMAloha
reviews.title: An out of the way gem!
reviews.body: This hotel was a pleasant surprise. We’d stayed in the downtown core before but liked the look of the rooms online and the reviews were good so we gave it a try and we’re glad we did. The room was spotless, the bathroom felt upscale and the bed was comfy. The breakfast was super, and the espresso bar was a nice surprise. We’ll take advantage of happy hour the next time.

reviews.author: family traveler
reviews.title: Leaves something to be desired
reviews.body: Wouldn't recommend this place. For over $300/night for the room and parking, not being able to fully access all of the benefits advertised, and the less than clean towels, I don't think it's worth the money.

reviews.author: Mark Grice
reviews.title: Underwhelming experience, I will examine other options next time.
reviews.body: Unhelpful staff at breakfast, plastic instead of real flatware/dishes, overpriced garage.

reviews.author: Phil
reviews.title: Visit to Denver
reviews.body: Good value, excellence service.

reviews.author: jjz1234
reviews.title: good place to stay
reviews.body: clean place and good service

reviews.author: Baci
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel comfortable and clean. Breakfast is excellent.

reviews.author: McOregon
reviews.title: Helpful Staff, Efficient Rooms, Good Location
reviews.body: Enjoyed our week stay at Elements.  Helpful staff, efficient rooms, and spacious breakfast room with wonderful omelette lady. Great location for visiting art and history museums, easy walking distance to free 16th Street shuttle to go to downtown, walking trails, Union Station, the airport. and Ball Stadium.

reviews.author: Katya
reviews.title: You Get What You Pay For - Sort Of
reviews.body: Pull out couch is super uncomfortable. Had to request sheets and those came torn and stained. Mattress pad for the pull out couch really shouldn’t be called that. Decent breakfast. As a Marriott Titanium Elite member, service was sub standard. Hotel was overall clean and well maintained. No robes or slippers. It just felt like a very basic three star hotel.

reviews.author: Anurag
reviews.title: Perfect for long-term stays in Denver
reviews.body: Great stay in downtown Denver. Clean, spacious, well-maintained rooms, with decent breakfast options and a well-equipped gym. Staff are friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: CMW national traveler
reviews.title: 2.0 out of 5 compared to other Element properties
reviews.body: Over priced and over promised vs other Element locations around the country.  Nice in appearance, clean and bright yet hospitality is not to be found.  Bring your own breakfast and you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Blacktooth volleyball mom
reviews.title: Weekend stay for Colorado Crossroads
reviews.body: I tried to get a hotel that was close to the convention center so my daughter and I could walk instead of driving. The walk was about 10-15 minutes which wasn't bad. I did love the fact that our car was in a locked parking garage with security, especially in downtown Denver. The room was great! Apartment sized fridge, flat top stove and microwave and plenty of room. The beds were comfortable and the pillows weren't thin and flat like most hotels. Only thing that was annoying was that you could feel cold air coming in from the window if you were in the bed by the window. It was about 10* outside so it was very cold, but the window was definitely leaking cold air. The bathroom was plenty big enough for my daughter and I to get ready at the same time. The shower was bigger than you would expect for a hotel, and had shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided in bottles on the wall, not the tiny single use ones. The lights on the bathroom kept turning off on us though... Even when we were in the showering. We couldn't figure out how to keep them on. Overall, I would stay at this hotel again, I'd just be prepared to get coffee elsewhere in the morning.

reviews.author: David from Phoenix
reviews.title: Surprisingly spacious!
reviews.body:
Just discovered this Marriott Brand.  Hotel was immaculate and very spacious at all customer touch points.  Rooms and bathrooms were enormous!  Dis not feel confined at any point in the stay.  Only complaint the upstairs bathroom was above my bed.  Could hear everything.  That part
Not so great. Water running, flushing, footsteps.

reviews.author: HiltonhapyatheMariot
reviews.title: Friendly and Competent
reviews.body: Patrick at the front desk was engaging and friendly.  Matt gave excellent recommendations for dinner, which we loved.  Breakfast had great omelets, as well as other quality options.  The one complaint I have about the hotel (and it's not serious), is that to get to the parking garage one has to stop, get out of the vehicle and swipe one's card on the passenger side.  But Patrick made that easy and he alerted us to the obstacle, so knowing the problem, we were able to solve per his instructions.  Great customer service.

reviews.author: Kelleekolie
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: Element downtown was a great place to stay! Friendly staff, super clean, great breakfast! The studio room had just what we needed for the week. It was conveniently located. They even have a lovely fire pit outside for cold night gatherings on the patio. Very pleased with our stay. Also it was in a safe neighborhood, we walked several places even at night and never had any issues.

reviews.author: Traveling from Fl
reviews.title: Traveling from Fl
reviews.body: Staff went above and beyond. Hotel was clean. Parking was convenient.

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.title: Old Hotel In Need of Repair
reviews.body: I was disappointed that I was unable to get a light bite after arriving significantly late due to plane delays. Then the shower in my room was missing the knob that actually turned the shower head on. When I was moved to a fancy suite, the room was large, but the bathroom door didn't close and the soaking tub needed to be cleaned. The women's room in the conference area actuall had doors falling off the hinges so they couldn't be shut either. The hotel looks neat cosmetically, but it's obviously in poor repair. And if a place is charging the amount they charge I expect to have knobs on the showers and for the bathroom doors to close.

reviews.author: Raul
reviews.title: Worst Autograph property I've ever stayed in - outdated, poorly maintained, and zero customer service
reviews.body:
I expected much more from the Brown Palace, especially given its reputation and its affiliation with the Autograph Collection. Unfortunately, the experience was extremely disappointing.

I requested a call from a manager beginning on the second day of my stay and again at checkout. Despite making multiple requests, no manager ever contacted me—not during my stay and not afterward. That level of disregard was particularly frustrating given the number of issues we experienced.

While the hotel itself is beautiful and has plenty of historic charm, the rooms and facilities are in serious need of updating. Most of the power outlets in our room did not work, and several of the outlets that did work had visibly blackened areas around them, which was concerning and appeared consistent with previous sparking or electrical issues.

The hot water was another major problem. It took approximately 20 minutes—timed—to get hot water from the shower. That is simply unacceptable for a hotel at this price point.

We also had problems with the TV. None of the streaming apps or internet-connected features worked. We called three times before someone finally came to look at it, and that did not happen until the following day. The response from the person who came to the room was particularly disappointing: we were essentially told that it wasn't his problem and that he could only replace the TV if it physically fell off the wall and broke. He had no ability to address the underlying internet/connectivity issue.

The Brown Palace may be beautiful, but the physical condition of the property and, more importantly, the lack of meaningful customer service did not come close to matching the hotel's reputation. The fact that I repeatedly asked to speak with a manager and never received a call is perhaps the most telling part of the experience.

Without question, this was the worst Autograph Collection property I have ever stayed at. The historic character is impressive, but it does not make up for poorly maintained rooms, basic amenities that don't function properly, and management that apparently can't be bothered to follow up with a guest.

reviews.author: Dix88
reviews.title: Brown Palace review
reviews.body: Won't stay again. Wifi was shocking as well. We had online meetings and dropped out frequently.

reviews.author: EAMR
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel - Below Average Service
reviews.body: I love the Brown Palace.   It is beautiful, historical, interesting, and who doesn't love a good ghost story.   This time, however, the service at the front desk, lobby restaurant and Ship's Tavern was indifferent, at best.  Inattentive, not super present, apathetic.  Hoping next time we'll have a better overall experience and that leadership focuses on building better culture.

reviews.author: Lou Danger
reviews.title: Brown Palace
reviews.body: Old and tired. Needs a complete renovation

reviews.author: Spencer S
reviews.title: Nice hotel, but lacks and air-conditioning
reviews.body: Needs new air conditioning since it never cooled below 74°. The room and lobby was nice and had great historical vibes. If you want to be comfortable, I'd look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Chester
reviews.title: Brown palace
reviews.body: All in all a nice stay I was charged for charging meal to the room instead of getting a discount! & the bartender wasn’t very attentive! I’ve stayed here before cheaper with a better room

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.title: Anniversary celebration at the Brown Palace.
reviews.body: Most outstanding! Can’t wait to return

reviews.author: Mgray
reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.body: For such a historic and prestigious hotel, don’t bother. The reception / front desk staff are rude and arrogant and the beds are uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Far From a Luxury Collection Experience
reviews.body:
As a Marriott Bonvoy member, this was one of the most disappointing hotel experiences I've had.

From the moment we arrived, the first impression was poor. The valet and baggage staff were not welcoming or courteous, and the front desk team seemed indifferent and unenthusiastic.

The hotel itself feels very outdated and poorly maintained. The hallways and guest rooms appeared dirty, and it's hard to understand how this property is part of the Luxury Collection, as there was nothing about the experience that felt luxurious.

The biggest issue came the next morning when we had breakfast in the hotel lobby. Both of us became sick almost immediately after eating, which completely overshadowed the rest of our stay.

Overall, this was not the level of service, cleanliness, or quality I expect from a Luxury Collection property or a Marriott brand. I would not recommend the Brown Palace Hotel based on our experience, and I would not choose to stay here again.

reviews.author: Akrier
reviews.title: Rundown and sad - used to be the highlight of Denver
reviews.body: This hotel used to be the highlight of Denver, a great historic place to visit with charm and a lovely tea and spa. All of the rooms are now rundown the mattresses are at least 20 years old. The staff is extremely rude and uninterested in providing any sort of customer service. We stayed in the presidential suite and the toilet paper holder was falling off the wall paneling was broken underneath the windows attention to detail was terrible. It is really sad to see this entire hotel basically crumbling one room at a time.

reviews.author: MeeksRay
reviews.title: Great venue, great service
reviews.body: Celebrated a milestone anniversary with family.  Brown Palace has great ambiance and architecture, complimented by great service and excellent food and drinks

reviews.author: August2026
reviews.title: No parking/ extra "resort" fees
reviews.body: There's no parking unless you pay a lot for it. There's also an added resort fee for staying there.That is not mentioned upon booking.

reviews.author: John and Laura G
reviews.title: A Amazing Downtown Hotel in Denver
reviews.body: The Brown Palace Hotel & Spa is Extraordinary and Amazing in its Old World Charm.  The Architecture and Design is Beautiful, and the Craftsmanship is over the top.  The hotel staff is very friendly and our room was exceptional.  The concierge Mr. Leewood "Is The Man", he helped my wife handle transportation to and from the airport.  He is extremely good at what he does and we hope he is considered a very valuable Team member.  We really enjoyed our stay at The Brown Palace Hotel.  The only negative of our stay was deciding to eat at the Ships Tavern in the hotel.  The server we had was terrible, the shrimp cocktail with "Atomic Sauce" was ketchup, and the Fish & Chips was awful.

reviews.author: Mishy
reviews.title: A blast from the past.
reviews.body: The Brown Palace hotel is a unique hotel experience. An historical building it has several restaurants and a lovely little days pa. It offers an afternoon tea party  that is fun and delicious and live music most nights in its beautiful atrium. It is an older building so be prepared to be patient with it, but overall it’s a great experience.

reviews.author: Solo travel
reviews.title: Unique Stay
reviews.body: It was very fun to stay at the brown palace due to the historical aspect of the hotel

reviews.author: Kansas Couple
reviews.title: Great vacation stay at Palace
reviews.body: My husband & I had an amazing 2 day experience at the Brown Palace. Our food was exceptional. We certainly recommend the Brown Palace tour.   Brown Palace is an icon that needs to be appreciated & enjoyed. Such a Grand Dame!  We’d go back in a heartbeat. Denver is so lucky to be able to enjoy all the special events!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Amazing Historical Hotel waiting to be discovered
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel with history and character.  Arriving can be a hassle if you need to valet or park, (be sure to go down the correct street).  Amazing dining and drink options, and fantastic live music on Friday and Saturday evenings.  The rooms were hot but clean, maintenance checked the HVAC unit but it still would not get below 78.  The amenities service wasn’t great and they need a more efficient valet system.  Fun place, might return in winter or when it cools down.

reviews.author: dlc0826
reviews.title: Beware - this is not a luxury hotel.
reviews.body: Afternoon Tea was excellent. Hostess was excellent.  Valet excellent, but expensive.  The rooms were not even average - no temperature control, no hot water, squeaky, low quality bed frame and malformed mattress.  Not what you would expect from a Marriott Autograph hotel.

reviews.author: Pn123
reviews.title: Dated and Disappointing
reviews.body: Rooms were dated and small, plug points didn’t work, no amenities in the room. Front desk service was slow and not a great attitude.

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Sighed up for an account after checkout
reviews.body: Despite declining several times that I did not want to make a Marriott account I was enrolled after checkout, presumably by staff at this hotel. I was very clear every time I was asked that I do not want an account, so they decided to enroll me after I left so I couldn’t do anything about it. To cancel this account I did not want I have to CALL customer support as there is no way to close the account through their website. Will not be back.

reviews.author: Kris F
reviews.title: Total Let Down
reviews.body: Everything about my stay at the Brown Palace was a letdown. Everything is extremely overpriced for the quality that they’re offering. This might’ve been a nice place 40 years ago but now it just looks rundown and the rooms offer. Absolutely nothing unique compared to a motel six for 1/4 of the price.

reviews.author: The Big Easy
reviews.title: Autograph Collection Brown Palace Hotel & Spa Didn't Disappoint
reviews.body: From the Reagan Presidential Suite upgrade to the daily breakfast ($40 voucher) provided in the lobby atrium the Brown Palace was everything they said it would be. The complimentary history tour was wonderful and the almost 134 year old hotel is a like a museum itself!

reviews.author: Kent
reviews.title: The mistake I made by staying at the brown palace
reviews.body:
I’ve stayed at many hotels including with the Marriott property’s.
This had to be the worse experience I’ve had with the exception of one in Asia about thirty years ago in a backward country.

reviews.author: G Fry
reviews.title: An Excellent Historic Hotel to stay at in Downtown Denver
reviews.body: Great elegant and historic hotel. We'll definitely stay here again in the future. This wonderful hotel is a great place to stay if you enjoy excellent customer service and a feel of elegance one would expect in Manhattan New York.

reviews.author: Jacks
reviews.title: Honeymoon blues
reviews.body: We chose this hotel for its great review. We only asked for basic washcloths clean cups and water to be provided o and to have coffee in the morning. It’s our honeymoon and not having the basic made our day laughable we were struggling all the second day.

reviews.author: Bill B
reviews.title: Classic hotels never die
reviews.body: Great old hotel, lovingly preserved and updated in the heart of the city

reviews.author: Not worth it staff rude
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.body:
Horrible
Service horrible oooooooooooooooooooooo see last page

reviews.author: Grandpa bill
reviews.title: Very disappointing and expensive experience!
reviews.body: nothing was as we were told on the phone when we booked- and it was MUCH more expensive then we expected.  Staff was not nice or welcoming .overall- we didn’t have a very good time and we went for a Father’s day celebration so it was especially upsetting!!  (It was the first date our dog sitter had available)

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Genuine Character
reviews.body: I've stayed here several times and always loved this hotel. It may need a little bit of renovation work given its age, but the history, architecture, and ambiance are unmatched. Denver has a number of trendy hotels, but none have the Brown Palace's class and elegance. I would definitely recommend taking the tour of the hotel from the hotel's in-house historian. It was really excellent. I stayed here with my dog and it was very pet friendly as well.

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.title: avoid this property
reviews.body:
⭐ 1/5 — An astonishing failure of basic hotel operations

My experience at Le Méridien Denver Downtown went well beyond poor service.

I personally handed two boxes to a hotel employee in my room after following the Front Desk's instructions for a scheduled UPS pickup the following day. The hotel accepted custody of both. UPS arrived as scheduled, yet the hotel tendered only one of my two boxes — while somehow giving UPS packages belonging to other people under the pickup I paid for.

The second box remained in the hotel's custody.

Trying to get management to deal with this was even worse. Front Desk Manager Lucas was dismissive, repeatedly failed to follow up when he said he would, and the hotel's position essentially became that it isn't responsible for packages — even when its own employee personally accepts them into the hotel's custody.

Then there was breakfast.

We waited approximately ONE HOUR for breakfast, only to finally receive it cold. The situation was apparently so bad that our own server told us they should have closed the restaurant for breakfast that morning.

Think about that: an employee working the restaurant acknowledged that they weren't in a position to properly serve breakfast, yet guests were still seated and left waiting an hour for cold food.

Hotels have problems. Employees make mistakes. What separates a good hotel from a bad one is how management responds when something goes wrong. Here, the response was dismissiveness, broken promises to follow up, an inability to account for property entrusted directly to hotel employees, and seemingly no urgency whatsoever about fixing it.

For a hotel carrying the Le Méridien/Marriott name and positioning itself as an upscale property, the level of operational dysfunction and management indifference I experienced was remarkable.

The building may say Le Méridien on the outside. The service certainly didn't.

reviews.author: Tania
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: The location was great. Everything was walking distance and there's a fee bus on 16th. Very clean and the staff is very hospitable.

reviews.author: Bookie
reviews.title: Garth weekend
reviews.body: Great place with a European flair!

reviews.author: cindyq
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.body: I stayed at this hotel for one night and decided to extend my stay by an extra day. When I went downstairs to request the extension, I also asked for my room to be cleaned and for fresh towels. I spent about six hours sightseeing around Denver, and when I returned, the room had not been cleaned. I needed to get ready for dinner, so I went back downstairs and was told towels would be sent to my room. It took over 45 minutes to receive them. Overall, I do not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: G Gray
reviews.title: First Class at Its Best!
reviews.body: Every aspect from the doormen when you arrived to the front desk staff and housekeeping was the best I have experience since the pandemic! When visiting Denver this is the place to stay, in the heart of everything!

reviews.author: Arturo
reviews.title: Good hotel and staff, need better room charge verification
reviews.body: Stayed here for work. Can’t really complain too much. Did have to get a new box of tissues for my room because they were moist… gross. They were very apologetic about it and got me a box very quickly. Then checking out had a $218 restaurant charge for my room.. I didn’t eat there, they took it off of course but it was strange that someone was able to get my last name and room number. Unless they didn’t check and just added it to my room.

reviews.author: Whyte wedding
reviews.title: A wedding stay at the Le Meridien
reviews.body: Made the bride and family so special!

reviews.author: Michele
reviews.title: Denver trip
reviews.body: One night stay, excellent location, awesome amenities and delicious food at restaurant.

reviews.author: Bryce F
reviews.title: The hotel that thought of everything
reviews.body: I felt washed over in vibrant energy the moment I entered. Tight lobby, and spacious bar and restaurant area, were my first indications this was my kind of hotel. The room was efficient about space (akin to New York), but had all the right elements. The shower and sink setup felt like they tested different designs until landing on the perfect layout. Always upbeat staff, who seemed to genuinely enjoy providing great service and food. It sounds crazy maybe, but this is honestly how I felt.

reviews.author: 1st trip to Colorado
reviews.title: Glam 1st stay in Colorado
reviews.body: From the minute we stepped out of our car, we were welcomed by the valet and graciously ushered into the hotel where we were greeted by the folks at the front desk. Our luggage was brought up to our room which was impeccably maintained and quite modern charming. The whole venue was beautiful and reflected the colorado style of art and living.  The lobby had a wonderful coffee shop, a beautiful restaurant and an amazing, very hip rooftop bar with great music. Fun people, an excellent bartenders that made delicious drinks!  The location was excellent, the neighborhood was beautiful and very charming!  All in all, I would say, this was one of the most elegant hotels we've stayed at in the United States.

reviews.author: jenrn0707
reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.body: Our stay was excellent from beginning to end. The hotel was clean, modern, and overall fun vibe. The service was top notch throughout the facility.

reviews.author: Lizzie
reviews.title: Above and Beyond!
reviews.body:
The teams at Le MERIDIEN, from Valet to Reception to the Conference and Cleaning Teams, they all went the extra mile for us.  I was impressed from the moment I arrived and that continued throughout the week.  Maria and her Conference Team were exceptional, making sure we had what we needed for our Summit.  The rooms are lovely and clean, with daily refresh and tidying.  Overall, I would highly recommend Le MERIDIEN for both business and personal stays.  
You have to get the Grilled Cheese at Corinne - it's delicious.

reviews.author: BrianW
reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.body: My preferred hotel in Denver, and it never disappoints. The location is great, rooms are spacious and comfortable, staff is excellent, and the food and beverages are high quality.

reviews.author: Teacherconference1
reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.body: The staff was fantastic. The women at the front desk are helpful and cheerful. Housekeeping was great. The rooms are cute and bright with lots of windows. Good coffee in the room. Very close to the convention center and lots of fun restaurants. A 4 o’clock check-in is a little bit late. I’m not sure why that is their policy. I was not going to mention the rooftop bar, but since the post has a picture of it, I will. It is definitely a great view. Go early to avoid the crowds and stay only for the view. The servers are grouchy. The drinks are absolutely terrible. If you have to have a drink, order something very simple like a beer or wine. If you would like a decent drink, go to the bar on the first floor where the quality is much better.

reviews.author: Welltraveledlady
reviews.title: Not Luxury
reviews.body: First bad review ever and had I not been with my Daughter on a Mom and Daughter trip I’d probably not say anything.  It’s just wasn’t worth my time at that time.  We confirmed deluxe Queen in Bonvoy.  When I got to the Hotel the front acted like the Deluxe Queen double bed room was the upgrade.  I knew better.  Just didn’t feel like complaining and setting a weird tone on our beautiful weekend.  We were there only one night.  I’ve held Titanium and currently have Gold status for reference.  I do not recommend the following Le Meridian not Luxury Hotel.  Go somewhere else.  First, if it’s more than one person and you’re not in a Suite be prepared to share one sink and no privacy shower.  There’s not a bathroom exactly.  It’s open a toilet with sliding door.  A shower only just walk in.  A sink right next to shower and no room to move around.  Not for two people.  That’s my bad for not realizing this and not reading enough reviews.  The dirty sheets are not.  Blood stained.  Did not complain we had already moved because we were put in a room with joining door.  We did not see dirty sheets until morning light.  Gross.  Room was in fact dirty.  If you’re on street side, you will hear traffic fyi.  Rooftop bar not anything special and food was not good.  How can you mess up Charcuterie board?  The staff for service was weird.  People on the phones instead of service.  Had to go to the bar and ask for service.  We could not get over how none of this stay felt Luxury.  As a Mom who travels all over the world I was embarrassed.  Corrines restaurant for breakfast was okay.  Nothing Luxury about it.  I would not stay here.  I don’t need apologies or comp rooms.  It’s more important public knows.  Were not going back and I’m not recommending to my frequent fliers.

reviews.author: Mary C
reviews.title: Top Notch!
reviews.body: Everything about my stay was pleasant.  Staff from front desk to housekeeping to kitchen were all so kind and helpful!  Food, cleanliness, decor all were so pleasant and very comfortable.  Thank you

reviews.author: Nlmarks
reviews.title: Terrible Stay! Security and Protocol Issues
reviews.body: Management denied my friend entry to my room when his key card did not work. They claimed to have called the room and spoken with me and I denied him access. It turns out the phones apparently had a system glitch and they spoke with a different guest in another room. They never verified the identity of the person they spoke with and my friend was locked out for hours until management broke into my room while I was asleep to verify I was  “ok”. This is a huge security risk and does not seem like the proper protocol was followed.

reviews.author: Josh S
reviews.title: Awful hotel
reviews.body: This hotel has floors that are falling apart, bad food, and awful service.

reviews.author: The Review
reviews.title: need a mirror
reviews.body: need better closet space and a full length mirror.

reviews.author: rpmcc81
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: I had a great stay at this hotel. The property was clean, modern, and well-maintained, with all the amenities I needed. The staff was friendly, helpful, and took the time to explain everything clearly, making the check-in process smooth and welcoming. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Jen888
reviews.title: It sucked
reviews.body: Need to have friendlier staff

reviews.author: Jcarolyn
reviews.title: Excellent Housekeeper going above standards
reviews.body: Jose Miguel went above standards and organized, cleaned, and put care into making the room welcoming. People like that deserve to get far in life. Thank you Jose for making my stay better.

reviews.author: Lorena
reviews.title: Room accomodations
reviews.body: It would have been nice if there was a microwave. I brought leftovers for dinner and stored them in the refrigerator but had to eat them cold because there was no microwave.

reviews.author: Frank O
reviews.title: Perfect Location and Stellar Service
reviews.body:
We were in town for a show at Red Rocks and had a fantastic stay at Le Meridien. It’s a great hotel in the perfect central location, everything we wanted to do was a short walk or an easy ride away. The rooms were comfortable and the service was excellent, making the whole trip feel effortless.

But honestly, Ryan at Corrine was the absolute star of our stay. We sat at his bar for brunch most mornings, and he made every single one memorable. From the moment we sat down, he was incredibly welcoming, full of spot-on local recommendations, and mixing up some genuinely excellent drinks. Ryan went out of his way to take care of us. His positive energy and attention to detail gave us a great start to each day. 

The rooftop bar was also excellent, with a fantastic view and a relaxed atmosphere.

We are already planning our return.

reviews.author: Philly Traveler70
reviews.title: Amateur Hour
reviews.body: Le Meridien Hotel Downtown is well situated and walkable to restaurants and cafes. If you are an inexperienced traveler and just need a clean bed, this hotel is great. But if you require a cup of coffee in the morning don't be surprised if they tell you they ran out of coffee mugs.

reviews.author: TurisDad
reviews.title: Disappointing by Comparison
reviews.body: This was our first US Le Meridien stay, and we are comparing it to our stay at the Le Meridien in Barcelona.  The staff in Denver was pleasant, and the restaurant was very good (both food and service).  The room was quite disappointing.  the furnishings had a cheap and temporary look--I would describe the "closet" as a stick-figure on wheels.  The small refrigerator was sitting on the floor under one end of the desk with no surround.  The furniture was cheap-looking.  The bathroom was nice, but had a very unusual layout.

reviews.author: Louise
reviews.title: Perfect Denver Vacation
reviews.body: 4 night stay. Very clean and well maintained room with ample space for my husband and me. We liked the open bathroom.  Ideal location. Good restaurants in hotel and beautiful vibe and views at the rooftop bar.

reviews.author: 48hoursindenver
reviews.title: Nothing to come back a 2nd time for
reviews.body:
We had 2 nights in Denver and opted to spend more to stay in the city. We paid extra for a city view room. When we arrived we found that the hotel is surrounded by alot of 1 way streets. We finally found the parking garage we were told is the "self park" at $45 and parked around 1130pm. At 7am we left and were charged $64! We thought "at least this will get us until 1130 tonight" and when we returned we were told there were no in and out privileges. We left and found cheaper parking a few blocks away. I wish the hotel was more transparent about parking. 

The other main issue was the room. We paid extra for a city view and while we were in the city our view was of the rooms in the hotel directly across the street. For a city view room I expected to be on a higher floor with more of a true view of the city not a view of only.the building across the street. The room layout was also awful. If you stand at the sink another person cannot get in or out of the shower at the same time. 

The hotel was clean and the staff was nice but that was the only thing that lived up to the expectations of this premium priced hotel.

reviews.author: Myriam20
reviews.title: Violent rooftop security guard and disturbing rooftop manager
reviews.body: My dad was aggravated by a security guard when he had permission to be there. He. Ecame aggresive because i had a vertical id and went up to take a photo. Thd bartender was confused on whh the guard was acting that way and the public in the rooftop was in utter shock.

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.title: Return to excellence
