reviews.body: Having traveled this country and stayed at some of of the finest establishments and the retired I am thrilled to enjoy to comforts, quality, character and excelwnce you bring to the travel experience.

reviews.author: Ralph Mcnuggets
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: Awesome place. Will definately stay again. My wife loved it here

reviews.author: Mr R
reviews.title: Denver for the Weekend.
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful stay at AC Hotel Denver Downtown. From the moment I arrived, I truly felt welcomed and appreciated. The staff was friendly and attentive, and Sarah at the front desk was exceptional. She was helpful, funny, and resourceful, and really made my stay even more enjoyable.

My room was comfortable, the view was great, and the location was perfect for exploring Denver. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely return. I look forward to staying here again on my next visit to Denver!

reviews.author: Kelly McCabe
reviews.title: AC hotel - Sarah was great at front desk!
reviews.body: I loved my stay at AC hotel in downtown Denver. I had great service and Sarah handled my stress and exhaustion from my trip and gave me and my mom great service! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Libby8
reviews.title: Great Hotel to stay.
reviews.body: Great location, great accommodations, friendly staffs, clean environment, attend to needs.

reviews.author: Pierre2Guest
reviews.title: Lots of Potential
reviews.body: A diamond in the raff. The TV applications were a little confusing and so was accessing WiFi but figured it out eventually.

reviews.author: Noah
reviews.title: Great weekend in Denver
reviews.body: The hotel was great for a quick visit to Denver. I wanted to stay right downtown for easy access to restaurants, bars, and Coors Field, and the hotel was perfect for that.

reviews.author: Mel30
reviews.title: Wouldn’t recommend
reviews.body: Booked a double queen room, called days prior to check in to request low floor-due to dear of elevator and needing to use stairs. At check in they had a room on the 19th floor reserved for me. On third floor they put me in a room with a King bed and was told for second night they’d move me into a double queen room. That never happened. Also at check in- the receptionist that weren’t helping me were making fun of customers as they walked by the front desk. I confirmed that the price of the rooms would be what was quoted when I booked and she said yes. Got my bill and it was more and the nights were charged different rates. It was horrible. Beds were uncomfortable- air conditioner didn’t work and no one came to look at it

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Great location, good room
reviews.body: Location is great, room was great.  Rooftop bar service was missing for 30 mins until we left and told another staff member.  Manager talked to us about it and gave us his card.  Was nice of him to meet with us.

reviews.author: Adam KC
reviews.title: Downtown Oasis
reviews.body: Location, food, fitness center are great. Rooms seemed smaller for party of 4 and no microwave in room. Ideal for couples without children or get another room for space.

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.title: Feedback
reviews.body: The parking was horrible. The lady that checked us in the morning we arrived was unfriendly more than one time. The rest of the staff were great. The staff on the rooftop bar were amazing.

reviews.author: J Danae
reviews.title: My stay in Denver
reviews.body: Amazing stay. I was there for 3 weeks. While at the hotel I was greeted by every staff member that I came in contact with. It was a great atmosphere with amazing customer service. I have a list of staff names I wrote down prior to leaving that I wanted to recognize. Ayantu, Lupita, Dameon, Anai, Josh, Lucas, Braeden, Trevor, Nick, Summer. There were several more staff that I have not listed not because they did not standout I just did not have their names. I did not have one complaint with the service I received.

reviews.author: Convention Stay 2026
reviews.title: Convention stay 2026
reviews.body: This is an excellent location. The staff were very courteous and friendly. The rooms were very clean.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay!
reviews.body: The staff was friendly and the hotel and rooms were attractive and clean. My only complaint would be that there were no drawers for our clothing!

reviews.author: Summer trip
reviews.title: Denver needs help
reviews.body: The staff at the AC hotel downtown Denver was great. Check-in was easy and the staff was very friendly. The lobby seemed nice, but the hallway to our room on the eighth floor was dirty. The deadbolt inside of our room did not work properly. The sheets on our bed had several stains on them. The room could use some updating. We walked two blocks to the CVS to buy soap and there were windows boarded up. The armed guard inside explained to us that the homeless people and criminals have taken over in Denver. He said a man throws a brick through the glass weekly and comes in to take whatever he wants. He then walks out and nothing ever happens to him. We were in Denver for two days with our 11-year-old son. During that time we saw so many homeless people outside of our hotel and throughout the city. We saw human feces on the sidewalk. We saw homeless people sleeping in every nook of the streets. We even witnessed a man shooting up drugs on the sidewalk. It was an eye-opening experience for our son…very sad.

reviews.author: Taylor R
reviews.title: Great staff, disappointing property
reviews.body: Missing shower seal in original room, water flooded into the room. Moved rooms & the A/C didn’t properly cool the space. The room could have also used more sanitary attention & we also received a series of calls back to back at three AM- called the front desk to check if anyone attempted to reach us and they weren’t sure why the phone rang back to back. Subpar experience.

reviews.author: ConferenceTraveler
reviews.title: Great Stay for a Conference!
reviews.body:
I really enjoyed my stay at the AC Hotel Denver Downtown. As a woman in my 30s traveling alone for a conference, I felt safe and comfortable throughout my stay, which was important to me. The location was fantastic—just a short walk to the convention center and several great restaurants, making it easy to get around without needing transportation.

My room was very clean and comfortable, and I loved the views from the fitness center. It was a great place to unwind after a long day of conference sessions.

There were a few minor drawbacks. Some of the hallway carpet looked a little worn, and the hallways could be noisy at times, which occasionally made it difficult to sleep. I was also disappointed that Corinne was reservation-only during my stay, as I had hoped to dine there more easily.

Overall, though, I had a great experience. The convenient location, clean rooms, and feeling of safety made it an excellent choice for my trip, and I would definitely stay here again if I'm back in Denver.

reviews.author: RK Gold Elite
reviews.title: Hotel is Nice but it’s not Quiet
reviews.body: Location is great, hotel has great amenities but the walls are thin and you can hear every noise coming from the street. When I mean every noise, I mean every noise. Hearing sirens all throughout the day and night, every radio turned up, every motorcycle buzzing by and every car engine roaring. It’s across from a pool hall and you can hear its patrons after bar close. Maybe it was just our room and floor but I wouldn’t recommend based on that alone. For what you pay, I would expect peace and quiet when I get into my room after a long day. Also, the have two elevators for 20 floors and we routinely would be waiting 5+ minutes for the elevator as we were going or coming back.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Perfect night in the city
reviews.body: AC was a wonderful experience from beginning to end. The lobby is swanky and fun, the room was excellent and had beautiful views of the city and sunrise, and if we were here longer, the rooftop bar and restaurant looked great as well. I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Leticia1
reviews.title: The front office staff doesn't understand how to properly bill
reviews.body: The room was okay. That is all.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Hotel
reviews.body: The self-parking is the worst thing about this hotel.

reviews.author: Nina Fl
reviews.title: Best hotel in downtown Denver
reviews.body: Top hotel with everything you need

reviews.author: Hopedwc
reviews.title: Not ever again
reviews.body: More like camping with no drawers.   Sheets not very good. Tiny closet with few hangers  no bathtub except if you had one bed

reviews.author: Ahammon
reviews.title: Perfect landing spot
reviews.body: We love this hotel. It’s a great location and we stay here every time we come to Denver. You can walk to endless food options, entertainment, etc.

reviews.author: 907 Business Traveler
reviews.title: Business Trip Stay
reviews.body: Great experience! Room was great, staff was amazing. Food choices weren’t that great.

reviews.author: Jason L
reviews.title: Will see me soon again!
reviews.body: I liked it, I for sure will be going back !

reviews.author: Angela R
reviews.title: Good Choice
reviews.body: Wonderful staff, comfortable, clean, quiet,  convenient

reviews.author: KSY68
reviews.title: Great location but for 1 person
reviews.body: This was a great hotel in a prime downtown location. However, my husband and I didn’t care for the layout of the room/bathroom. It was really meant for 1 person. No privacy for the bathroom.

reviews.author: Domo
reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.body: The staff were extremely kind and nice. However, we experienced plumbing issues, lack of cleanliness in the room and subpar food. I wouldn’t stay here again or recommend.

reviews.author: LVANDME
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel is very accommodating and the customer service is top notch.  I stayed here for a conference and really enjoyed the time spent.  I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Jay S
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful stay at the AC Hotel Denver Downtown. The entire property was spotless, and you can tell the staff takes pride in maintaining a clean and welcoming environment. Every team member I interacted with was friendly, professional, and genuinely helpful.

The amenities were excellent and made my stay even more enjoyable. What really stood out, though, was the exceptional customer service, the staff went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect.

The location is also ideal, with easy access to restaurants, attractions, and everything downtown has to offer. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Denver.

reviews.author: RP
reviews.title: A small clean room and not much more.
reviews.body: If you are looking for clean, bare bones hotel in the middle of downtown Denver for a low price , this is fine.

reviews.author: SB at Aloft
reviews.title: Beware of the AC freezing you out
reviews.body: AC is loud and only operates on high speed. Makes fire sleepless nights

reviews.author: TravelerJay
reviews.title: Needs Soundproofing
reviews.body: Quality atmosphere, poor execution. No free breakfast. Outside noises were loud, and the hotel construction did little to block it.

reviews.author: Gen Bienne
reviews.title: Was a comfortable stay for my family
reviews.body: We had family who lived down the street and recommended the Marriott. It was walking distance which is the main reason why we decided to stay here. The front desk was very accommodating for my family and I to check in early, and they had a crib ready for my baby inside our room. The place was clean and quiet. The room service was great quality of food. The following morning when we dined at the restaurant the food was excellent, but the staff does come off a little cold rather than friendly. They were super helpful when we needed anything.

reviews.author: T Brown
reviews.title: Now my #1 chose
reviews.body: Great location, easy parking, early check in, friendly staff! Rooms were perfect for our needs.

reviews.author: Dan Lord
reviews.title: Exceptional Hospitality and a Great Downtown Stay
reviews.body: The team had an outstanding experience at Aloft Denver Downtown. The welcoming atmosphere, attentive staff, and convenient location made our conference stay especially enjoyable. The service from the entire team was exceptional, and we truly felt valued as guests. More onsite parking or valet availability would be a welcome improvement, but overall, this was a fantastic stay and we would happily return.

reviews.author: Tommo
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: Great location , nice staff and facilities - if you are at convention centre its perfect.

reviews.author: ConfAttendee
reviews.title: Loud and small
reviews.body:
The traffic noise level along with the small size of the room made the stay not enjoyable.  The bed was uncomfortable, the pillows were practically flat, the towels were scratchy.  

Think about trying a different location as this one fell short.

reviews.author: Sasi Bigfoot
reviews.title: Great location and staff was amazing
reviews.body: The Aloft was in a great location and the staff was great.   I the room was small and there was a sewer odor but for the most part, it was a great place to stay.  Also, we tried to eat at the restaurant and the service there was very long even though there was only one other couple and our hamburger took 45 mins to get and when we got it, it was gray so we threw it away.  The server did not seem interested in caring about the length of time it was taking.

reviews.author: Not Impressed
reviews.title: Just no
reviews.body:
The place was trying way too hard to be. Have a modern and that was fine down in the lobby area. But the rooms were super cramped and uncomfortable
 And felt dark and cave like

reviews.author: Dasha
reviews.body:
I had an amazing stay at Aloft Denver Downtown, and a huge part of that was because of the incredible staff.

I want to give my highest compliment to Bernadette. She went above and beyond to make me feel welcome from the moment I arrived. Her professionalism, kindness, and genuine care for guests truly stood out. She made the experience feel personal, and it’s employees like her who turn a good hotel stay into a memorable one. Bernadette is an absolute asset to this hotel, and I hope she receives the recognition she deserves.

I also want to recognize Louis, who worked both the bar and prepared food. He was friendly, attentive, and provided excellent service. Whether he was making drinks or serving food, he always had a positive attitude and made guests feel welcome.

A special thank you as well to Kenya and Joe for their outstanding hospitality. Both were professional, helpful, and contributed to the warm, inviting atmosphere throughout my stay.

The hotel itself was clean, modern, comfortable, and in a perfect downtown location within walking distance of restaurants, entertainment, and attractions. Between the excellent accommodations and the exceptional staff, this was one of the best hotel experiences I’ve had.

I highly recommend Aloft Denver Downtown, and I look forward to staying here again the next time I’m in Denver. Thank you again to Bernadette, Louis, Kenya, and Joe for making my trip so enjoyable!

reviews.author: Xandar
reviews.title: Great stay and hotel
reviews.body: Great location. Staff was extremely helpful. Was within walking distance of plenty of restaurants and shops. If I wanted to get out of the city, Lyfts were relatively inexpensive.

reviews.author: Kris
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Location is great though when I was there yes alot of construction. Felt more like a choice properties hotel then a Marriott group

reviews.author: BW
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.body: Good place to stay if you want to explore downtown Denver.

reviews.author: Steph V
reviews.title: Terrible ac unit but good location
reviews.body: We stayed here for the convention center and it was very close. Also close to great restaurants and bars. But the AC window unit was so comically loud that it woke us up and seemed to not work very efficiently because it would be on the majority of the time.

reviews.author: Crystal
reviews.title: Amazing Stay Thanks to the Incredible Staff
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at Aloft Denver Downtown and had an amazing experience. What really made my stay memorable was the outstanding staff. Luis at the bar took excellent care of us. He was incredibly friendly, made fantastic drinks, and provided exceptional customer service throughout our visit.
The front desk staff were also wonderful. Everyone was welcoming, kind, and made us feel right at home from check-in to check-out. Their warm hospitality truly made a difference.

reviews.author: Displaced smoker
reviews.title: Excellent place if you are not a smoker.
reviews.body: If you are not a smoker then this hotel is excellent!

reviews.author: Theresa Kinard
reviews.title: It was a great experience
reviews.body: Staff was very informative and helpful

reviews.author: dc395u2
reviews.title: Nice Hotel but Odd Room Design Choices
reviews.body:
I enjoyed my stay at the Aloft. It was clean and the staff was very friendly, but friends sharing a room may find the layout strange as well. My 3 biggest complaints all center around the bathroom. The bathroom has a sliding door with no latch or lock so there is no "true" privacy, there is no fan (that I could find) in the bathroom to mask any sounds or smells and sound really does travel, and lastly there is a weird frosted glass window from the room that peers directly into the shower. Why? 

Any other complaints I had were from Denver itself, not the hotel. The hotel is in a great location for night life and has amazing food nearby, but hearing about 16th street I expected there to be some nice stores but it was really disappointing.

reviews.author: J Wheeler
reviews.title: Very nice room.
reviews.body: The room was very nice and quaint. Nothing flashy but exactly what we needed.

reviews.author: K Kilber
reviews.title: nice hotel, you wont sleep tho
reviews.body: This is a nice hotel in a good location from the convention center, however you can hear absolutely everything from the street at night with all the busy establishments that are near the hotel. Going for a fun night out? It would be alright. Going for a business trip? I'd look for somewhere else if you'd like to sleep.

reviews.author: Beware of parking
reviews.title: Beware of Parking
reviews.body: Next time will stay somewhere in Denver with valet to avoid the parking headache here.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Quick but satisfactory stay
reviews.body: Had a great stay! A special shoutout to Bernadette at the front desk, who was incredibly warm, welcoming, and helpful when my friend and I ran into a reservation issue due to an Expedia error. She made a stressful situation so much easier and we really appreciated her kindness and hospitality. The only downside was that many food items were unavailable during our stay, which limited the dining options. Overall, the excellent service made for a positive experience!

reviews.author: J
reviews.title: Bang for the buck and great location to attend conferences at the conventional center
reviews.body: Bang for the buck and great location to attend conferences at the conventional center

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.title: Clean, Great Location But Unkept
reviews.body: The room was clean and the location is great. But the hotel needs a lot of upkeep. Several walls in my room were dirty and patched for paint but not painted. My window had a large crack. The shower had terrible pressure and the sink drain smelled. The room was so noisy - poor sound proofing, outside noise & plumbing noise.

reviews.author: Jacobit
reviews.title: Happy Convention Center Attendee
reviews.body: Loved how close it was to the convention center (just a block away) and close to restaurants, shopping and bars downtown. The staff were very friendly and room was good. Bar seemed a bit too quiet but looked like a nice area to hang out. Glad Aloft has replaced water bottles with a glass carafe. It was nice to have complimentary coffee in lobby.

reviews.author: Happy Customer
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Clean room, friendly and helpful staff.  Good coffee.

reviews.author: Vi
reviews.title: Great stat
reviews.body: Location was central to plenty of restaurants. Hotel was very clean and smelled amazing. The staff was very nice. Would definitely stay again

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Safe, clean, and walkable distance to everything

reviews.author: Byron Bordeaux
reviews.title: I have no complaints everything was perfect
reviews.body: I enjoyed my stay the loft was an excellent place thank you

reviews.author: NC Traveler
reviews.title: Weekend in Denver
reviews.body: Magnolia is a great downtown hotel.  Very convenient to everything in the city.  I recommend you give it a try.

reviews.author: Marriott member
reviews.title: Dilapidated and rundown!
reviews.body: The staff at the Magnolia Hotel Denver were friendly and extremely professional. My positive experience ends there. The room I stayed in was rundown and unkept. The door was missing from the closet, the walls were stained, the tile was cracked and separating from the wall in the shower, the furniture was scratched up, rundown and dirty, the curtain rod holding the curtain was bent, crooked, and separating from the sheet rock, barely hanging on the wall, and the window shade had paint on it. I asked for a room on a higher floor, thinking it would be in better condition. Once I entered the second room I was given, I discovered it was even worse than the first room, so I asked the front desk to just to put me back in the first room I was given because obviously the room selection was getting even worse, not better. In a nutshell, the room itself was insulting. Magnolia Hotel Denver, should be ashamed.

reviews.author: RaNel97
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Amazing location! Clean, vibrant, super friendly staff! The ONLY complaint I have is that the lobby is overpoweringly scented.

reviews.author: Rick R
reviews.title: Nice Hotel, Nice Staff, Not so nice Room
reviews.body: Rooms need help/ TLC.  Rooms need a dresser.  No place to unpack clothing.  Cramped closet w/ horrible access to safe.

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.title: Very Satisfied
reviews.body: Check in was smooth and staff accommodated my needs. I also asked for shower caps and slippers and they responded and brought stuff to mu room quickly. Liked the room design too!

reviews.author: Selena M
reviews.title: Lovely stay in Denver
reviews.body: We had a great time at Magnolia Hotel in Denver! It was very easy to access and very central to all types of activities in Denver.

reviews.author: Troy
reviews.title: Premium stay, outstanding value
reviews.body: I’m very impressed by the value I got out of my stay at the Magnolia in Denver. It wasn’t the cheapest option, but it was a fantastic stay at a premium hotel, downtown in a major city, with fantastic accommodations, at a very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Sara T
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Denver
reviews.body: I stayed at the Magnolia Hotel Denver in September for a trade show. The hotel is within walking distance of the convention center and near many restaurants. The hotel restaurant, Harry's, is excellent. It offers a nice variety of choices, and everything I had was delicious. The staff was helpful and friendly, and my room was perfect. Beds comfortable, good shower and clean. I would stay there again for business or leisure.

reviews.author: Lori G
reviews.title: Very disappointed - was stripped down hoyel
reviews.body: Disappointed - hard to recommend

reviews.author: LCGHNW
reviews.title: Great Denver Experience
reviews.body: We had a great experience at the Magnolia!  Staff was very helpful. Shout out to Brendan in Valet!

reviews.author: Nicole W
reviews.title: Great location and valet staff
reviews.body: I chose Magnolia Hotel because of the location and then as usual plans changed and the hotel doesn’t offer refunds even in rebooking.  Which is highly disappointing.  To arrive at the hotel and be disappointed by the cleanliness. The bathroom in my room did not look clean.  We arrived after checkin time and the hallway was lined with dirty laundry from housekeeping.

reviews.author: Tyler C
reviews.title: Convenience/comfort/deal
reviews.body: Stayed at the Magnolia Denver while in town for a professional organization convention. Stay was comfortable, staff was friendly, the dining experience at the restaurant in the lobby met my needs an expectations. And even though the hotel was a few blocks from the convention center, It was still perfectly convenient for me to get around downtown and experienced Denver, knowing that I had a comfortable stay to come home to every evening.

reviews.author: Traveling retiree
reviews.title: Fair
reviews.body: Our room was never cleaned once in the 5 nights we were thete. We told housekeeping 2x. Had to ask front desk for towels, washcloths, toilet paper. Had to empty our own trash. Left our towels outside our door and still ended up finding the cart ourselves to get rid of them.

reviews.author: riahonfiahh
reviews.title: Quick and Cozy Trip
reviews.body:
I came to Denver for a concert and knew I needed to be somewhere where I could wrap up the work week, but still able to be in the fun of it all. The Magnolia is perfectly located near all the things a vacationer could want... From the store staples to the local food spots on every corner, it was a true Denver trip. Easily walkable to the train station (10 minutes), but a wonderful valet area for easy rideshare pickup. The staff was lovely, the bar area was like a neighborhood pub. 

Remember, it's local vibe. It's not the flashiest, but it is comfortable, historic and full of life.

reviews.author: SopGThe1st
reviews.title: Great location to all the downtown hits!!!
reviews.body: Great hotel in the center of downtown Denver. It was clean, the staff were friendly and the cookies were great!  There were some older thing about the hotel as far as maintenance goes. Minor cosmetic things overall hotel was clean and in good shape.

reviews.author: Reese
reviews.title: CANNOT CHECK IN IF UNDER 21!!!
reviews.body: This place is amazing! but if you did the same as i did and googled places in denver that allow 18 year olds to check in, It’s LYING. you cannot check in at 18 or even 20 you have to be 21. They made an exception for us but this cause us not to be able to have room service which is my favorite part of vacations! Goggle also states they have a pool and hot tub yet i did not see one on site and there was not one mentioned on room papers or by workers.

reviews.author: SBuch
reviews.title: Quality City Stay
reviews.body: Wonderful stay , great staff and brought our dog which worked out great

reviews.author: Britni
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.body: Great hotel option in Denver. We try to stay at a different hotel every time we come down and this has been my favorite so far. My kids loved the milk and cookies at the end of the night.

reviews.author: DLBrown
reviews.title: Magnolia's History
reviews.body: My stay at the Magnolia Hotel Denver perfectly bridged my interests in Denver's rich history and its vibrant future. The hotel is situated right on 17th Street once known as the 'Wall Street of the West' - the hotel sits inside a landmark 1910 structure that captures the city's architectural past. Outside, the historic facade and corner clock are stunning; inside, unique touches like the lobby's vintage safety-deposit boxes remind you of its banking roots. The location is exceptionally convenient, offering access to the 16th Street Mall, Larimer Square, and Union Station, alongside local dining, shopping, and the University of Colorado. By watching Denver's modern expansion while using the convenient RTD lines near this historic gem made for an unforgettable guest experience.

reviews.author: Autumn
reviews.title: Very nice hotel in a good location
reviews.body: This is a very nice hotel in walking distance to downtown amenities.  The lobby and public spaces are inviting and fun.  The rooms are comfortable and the blackout curtains are excellent. The gym has great cardio equipment.  The only drawbacks were the size and condition of attached parking garage.  Very difficult to navigate in a full-sized vehicle and they have a limited amount of valet.  The attached restaurant, Harry's wasn't great either.  We sat for about ten minutes and no one ever even came and took a drink order so we left.  Otherwise, this was a great stay.

reviews.author: Lori
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.body: My daughter and I were in town for a concert and we stayed at Magnolia Hotel for 2 nights. The lovely lady at check in let us check in early. The hotel provided free water bottles which was extremely helpful! Great location with tons of things to do. The breakfast at Harry’s was amazing! We will be back!

reviews.author: Lia C
reviews.title: An amazing weekend in Denver at the Magnolia Hotel Denver, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
reviews.body:
I had an absolutely wonderful stay at the Magnolia Hotel Denver in July. I truly cannot say enough good things about my experience, especially when it comes to the incredible people at the front desk.

There was a concert happening in Denver during my stay, so the city was understandably a little more hectic and chaotic than usual. Even with everything going on, every person I interacted with at the front desk was so warm, welcoming, patient, and genuinely happy to help. Every time I needed assistance, I was greeted with a smile and treated with such kindness. It truly made us feel so welcomed and taken care of throughout our entire stay.

I especially want to recognize the young woman who was training at the front desk during my visit. She was absolutely wonderful. She was incredibly helpful and patient, took the time to answer all of my questions, and made sure I had everything I needed. Even while learning, she was so attentive and pleasant, and her willingness to help really stood out to me. She was such a wonderful representation of the Magnolia, and I truly hope she knows how much of a positive impression she made.

The room itself was also fantastic. It was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the overall hotel was lovely. Despite how busy the city was that weekend, our stay felt comfortable, relaxing, and seamless.

I had such a wonderful experience at the Magnolia Hotel Denver and would absolutely stay here again the next time I’m in Denver. A huge thank-you to everyone at the front desk for making our stay so amazing, you truly made us feel at home!

reviews.author: The Mile High Romantic
reviews.title: Magnolia Hotel Denver Made Our Night!
reviews.body: We booked a king room for a couple’s night in Denver, and Magnolia Hotel made it memorable. The staff went above and beyond—every interaction was warm and helpful. Our room was clean, comfortable, and perfect for a relaxing getaway. Parking wasn’t the easiest, but honestly, the service and atmosphere more than made up for it. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a charming downtown stay.

reviews.author: sthomas32
reviews.title: Great family stay
reviews.body:
The Magnolia hotel in downtown Denver was phenomenal. 
The entire staff were professional and kind. The hotel was beautiful and very clean and the room was amazing. 
The teenager thought the bathroom size was amazing and loved the hot water. 
It was a great stay and I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: You cannot go wrong with the Magnolia
reviews.body: In my reviews, I try to be as honest as I can be and authentic as I can be. I stayed here for my last 3 days in Colorado because I saw many reviews that seemed to point to this being a good hotel and I am a Marriott Bonvoy member so I gave it a shot. It started off rocky, only because our TV wasn't working and I did not realize there was no fridge, and my phone did not work but the staff quickly fixed those things. All staff from the front desk, valet area, the bar, and cleaning staff were all great. The rooms overall were beautiful, spacious and my most important thing, quiet. The location of the hotel is pretty central to everything downtown. I went to a rockies game and I was able to take an E bike to the stadium and walk back. There are a few starbucks in the area and plenty of food options. I only had one gripe with my room and that was the pillows on the bed were a bit like sleeping on bricks. I could have complained but I did not. I just managed, and overall, solid place, a lot of charm, great staff and I feel my money was well spent.

reviews.author: Baseball fan
reviews.title: Rockies weekend getaway
reviews.body: Property was clean and staff very friendly.  We appreciated the front desk always (24hrs) had water bottles available at no cost for the guest.  It was 100 degrees outside. The little details matter.

reviews.author: EMorales
reviews.title: Great view
reviews.body: It is a great hotel. The suite on the 12th floor has an excellent view. It's very close to the free ride and within walking distance of downtown. The gym is spacious.

reviews.author: Helen C
reviews.title: A beautiful hotel!
reviews.body: This hotel experience was exceptional, a beautiful room, lovely amenities, and a wonderful drink at Harry’s bar complemented the whole stay!

reviews.author: Kristi
reviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
reviews.body:
I had a great stay at the Magnolia Hotel Denver during PI Planning. The room was spacious and thoughtfully laid out, with separate living and sleeping areas that made it feel much more comfortable than a standard hotel room. Having the extra space was especially nice after long days of meetings.

The shower had excellent water pressure, which was a welcome bonus, and one of my favorite touches was the nightly cookies and milk. It was such a simple gesture, but it made the hotel feel warm and welcoming, almost like coming home after a busy day.

Another highlight was Harry's Bar. Luke provided exceptional service and genuinely made everyone feel welcome. He was friendly, attentive, and created an atmosphere that felt more like spending time with friends than sitting in a hotel bar. His hospitality added a personal touch that made the stay even more enjoyable.

Overall, the Magnolia Hotel was comfortable, clean, and a wonderful place to unwind after work. Between the spacious accommodations, thoughtful amenities, and outstanding hospitality, I would definitely stay here again on future trips to Denver.

reviews.author: Kiana
reviews.title: Avoid unless you’re titanium status
reviews.body: Unless you have top tier status, you will most likely get a dungeon room that is not in good shape. The room was small, dark, and damp with minimal closet space. I would not choose to stay here again. There for a conference and the food was not very good and there were issues with several of our rooms (leaking showers, clogged sinks, damp rooms, loud rooms). Not what we expected from a Marriott. Right downtown but wouldn’t recommend walking around by yourself as it was not a very safe or clean area.

reviews.author: LJ
reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.body: Great location with easy walking to a a variety of places. The perfect home base for a busy weekend.

reviews.author: Poor
reviews.title: Poor
reviews.body: Poor experience. No response from management

reviews.author: RE4
reviews.title: Great Denver Find
reviews.body:
The Downtown Denver Courtyard is a great place to stay. The staff is welcoming and helpful. The lobby is well appointed with plenty of seating, computer outlets, and a work table.
My room was large and clean.  
The hotel is in a great location near shopping and sites.
I only stayed for one night but if I get back to Denver again, I'll be sure to stay at this Courtyard again.

reviews.author: PG Burnett
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay at Marriott Denver, and we did not want for anything. Marriott met our needs. We enjoyed the central location within walking distance of restaurants and historic locations. We loved that this building found a new use and Marriott keeps the history alive through historic pictures on the walls. Opening our window at night to see the clock tower's animated digital views was amazing.

reviews.author: Frequent guest
reviews.title: RETURN STAY
reviews.body: We have stayed here many times. Hotel is clean and located in a great location for attending concerts, football games. $48.00 parking is over priced, and you must call ahead to get a spot. There is a parking garage catty corner across the street for $22.00. The bathrooms could use better / brighter lighting.  Would stay here again.

reviews.author: BK
reviews.title: Vacation Stay
reviews.body:
Service was great.
Hotel room was awkwardly designed.  Toilet and shower are in a separate room with door, sink area does not have door. Shower room has no place to put clean clothes. 
During the night, we had to evacuate twice. We were told it was faulty wiring. Not a comforting thought.  The second evacuation was so late that we left the hotel in our pjs.  Fire department came both times
I checked out early the next day because I could not have my family in a place where faulty wiring may or may not have been fixed or may not have been the problem for the alarms.
Downtown area is not really walkable at night, few restaurants are open, no outdoor seating. The area the hotel is in is not suitable for families.

reviews.author: Ken S
reviews.title: The best ever
reviews.body:
Everyone was so nice, From greeting us every time we came up to the desk or coming back from our night out the staff always said hello. The room was fantastic and the cleaning staff greeted us with smiles. 
The only thing we would suggest is there is no restaurant or a continental breakfast.

reviews.author: Sahls
reviews.title: Downtown Denver
reviews.body: Fire system needs some work.   Two evacuations in the same night while trying to sleep.   Staff is nice enough and the property was clean.   Get there early if you want on-site parking.

reviews.author: TxAggie89
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: Very nice Courtyard - one of the nicest I have stayed in. Great service by staff.

reviews.author: TB
reviews.title: Downtown Denver stay
reviews.body: See the room temperature review earlier.

reviews.author: Judy B
reviews.title: Fabulous location
reviews.body: Flew in to Denver to meet up with my daughter and families from out of state. Fabulous location for easy/free/inexpensive transportation to area museums, etc. as well as shopping and dining. Walkable to dining and stores for everything we forgot to pack. King  deluxe rooms were spacious and well maintained. Lobby provided great gathering areas

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: A Great and very Comfortable Time
reviews.body:
The hotel and staff cover every base and check every box.  Customer service excellent, comfort excellent, value excellent, aesthetics excellent, staff
excellent. Lastly, it’s clean and very well located too!  You will be very happy you picked this hotel.

reviews.author: Kat
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.body: Young lady at front desk wonderful  and helpful, hotel was clean, our room shower door didn't  close , and sink made a loud noise,  young man at front desk that evening  was very rude and nasty,  hope I never see him again or I will not stay there again, hotel doesn't  have a pool, or breakfast,  would be nice if one of their other hotels near you could go used  there pool. No dining, no nothing

reviews.author: Melmelhb
reviews.title: Rooms not cleaned properly
reviews.body: Room was not cleaned properly. Hair in the bathroom walls, hair on the bed and behind the pillow. Weird bleach smell, musty. My room was not cleaned properly and I checked in so late and had to leave at 0600 in the morning. I had maybe 4-5 hours that I was in the room so I didn’t make a fuss. But it was absolutely gross

reviews.author: Disappointed Ted
reviews.title: Don't leave clothes on your bed
reviews.body: I asked for my room to be cleaned daily during my 3 day stay. It was never cleaned completely once. The one day where the staff did change out my towels, my bed was not made or sheets changed becuase I had left a pair of short on the corner of the bed. A poorly written note was left by housekeeping that said the could not move person items. when I reviewed this with the front desk upon check out, I was told this was industry standard. this response was laughable and clearly indicates Marriot is not serious about providing exceptional customer service.

reviews.author: Lady traveler
reviews.title: I expected a little more.
reviews.body: I wasn’t impressed. Started with construction blocking parking, not completely clean bathroom, a poor room view when I paid extra for it, no “stellar” service, and the lack of a simple beverage in a lobby after being charged for a 90 min early arrival. Overly priced room water and crappy coffee in the room. Again, I just expected more from Marriott.

reviews.author: TS
reviews.title: TS
reviews.body: Excellent stay! Would return

reviews.author: Denver Visitor
reviews.title: Great location, nice staff, a little noisy
reviews.body: We enjoyed the location of this hotel. It was easy to walk to many places including Coor's Field. The staff was very nice and helpful. We encountered a noisy neighbor playing loud music after midnight and it took two attempts to resolved the problem. The staff was very responsive.

reviews.author: J
reviews.title: The Best Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel is great. And you have options in walking distance.

reviews.author: Frequent traveler
reviews.title: Big letdown.
reviews.body: This once beautiful hotel is now a poorly maintained, stodgy place in ill-repair.  A major disappointment.

reviews.author: BM 1959
reviews.title: Great Location , Friendly Staff, Third time around
reviews.body:
Great location on the Promenade. Good food, walking distance to Coors Field .
Free Bus ride too!
Clean rooms, quiet, friendly front desk.

reviews.author: June 2026
reviews.title: Over promise, under deliver
reviews.body: We arrived with no notice of no parking and a parking lot closure. We had to call for additional towels because there were only three in our room. Front desk staff, when asked for local recommendations were lacking knowledge and attention.

reviews.author: Family of 4
reviews.title: Dont stay here.
reviews.body: Find somewhere else to stay. Not clean or kept maintained. Not worth the price per night.

reviews.author: Xomas
reviews.title: Nothing exciting and not worth the money.
reviews.body:
Room needed a good clean, bathroom was in even worse shape. Our view was of a brick wall and the entire room smelt of mold from a constantly running AC and no ventilation from the bathroom shower. TV remote didn't work, no alarm clock, and uncomfortable bed. $7 for a bottle of water that is normally free. Spoty WiFi. 

Good water pressure.

reviews.author: jlamps23
reviews.title: Red Sox Trip
reviews.body: My wife and visited from Rhode Island to attend Rockies/Red Sox game.  Hotel was in good location, walkable to plenty of restaurants and other things to see.  Hotel staff was great.  Rooms, common areas were clean.  We had rental car and had not problem finding a spot in the hotel lot.  Rate for parking was as expected.  I would stay here again.

reviews.author: Rosie Brown
reviews.title: Pay to Park !
reviews.body: No one should be required to pay to park on site with the current rates of hotel rooms!  This makes no sense to me!  Making more money isn't always beneficial to your clientele.  Only to the company!

reviews.author: Love to Travel
reviews.title: Denver Gem
reviews.body: We had a wonderful stay at the Courtyard Denver located downtown. The  hotel was very nice, rooms were clean and beds were comfy. We hung out in the lobby which is very spacious. Staff were very friendly and was focused on our needs. We enjoyed a Rockies game and were able to walk to/from the Park. And enjoyed Sams No.3, Snoozes and Holey Moley restaurants all nearby. And bought souvenirs at nearby stores. Highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: RJC007
reviews.title: Clean your ROOMS!
reviews.body: Somebody’s underwear on the bathroom floor!! Don’t clean the room when requested.  No toilet paper or Kleenex!  Hair on the bathroom floor ……just disgusting

reviews.author: TAPhillips
reviews.title: A nice place to stay downtown
reviews.body: Friendly staff, clean rooms, and good value.

reviews.author: Jan
reviews.title: I highly recommend!
reviews.body: We stayed the weekend as a staycation and were blown away with how amazing this hotel was! It was clean and the decor was awesome! Having access to two restaurants in the building and being on the mall was so awesome! the city few was highly worth it!

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Love the hotel I always stay here when in Denver.

reviews.author: FrequentLeisureTravelers
reviews.title: Excellent Downtown Denver Hotel
reviews.body: The Renaissance is our "go-to" downtown Denver Hotel. It's location is excellent for reaching dining, entertainment and sporting events. Hotel personnel are welcoming, professional and always willing to assist with requests. The hotel has excellent Valet Parking services. The Valets always greet us warmly and we know that our truck will be well taken care of and safe. The Teller Bar is a wonderful place to have a drink.  We prefer to stay in the King bedroom suites. They are spacious and always fresh and clean. We truly enjoy our visits to the Renaissance.

reviews.author: Maddy
reviews.title: Great Location, Shabby for the Price.
reviews.body:
A friend and I stayed 4 nights at the Renaissance Denver hotel. While the location and historic architecture are superb, the hotel is dated, in poor condition, and not worth the cost.

Our window curtains had (moth?) holes, the bathroom grout was a mess, and the TV remote didn’t work. The decorations were dated and took away from the intrinsic beauty of the building. Overall, we had a fine stay but I think you’re better off spending your money elsewhere.

reviews.author: B and A
reviews.title: A great night away in downtown Denver!
reviews.body: We choose to stay at the Renaissance because of the location for concerts and to great restaurants.  The staff are so welcoming.

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.title: We loved our Renaissance Denver experience
reviews.body: We only stayed here one night to attend a Rockies game, but we enjoyed everything about the hotel!  The hotel was lovely, the staff of excellent, the room was very nice and we had one of the best steaks we've ever had when we ordered room service from the Range restaurant.  We come to Denver often and will defintitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Katharina
reviews.title: No recommendation at all
reviews.body:
My stay at the hotel was quite nice, the lounge could be cleaned more often. 
But all in all I cannot recommend. More money was deducted from my credit card than the actual costs. I have been discussing with them since then in person and via mail and nothing has happened. It takes them a lot of time to answer and the answers I receive are ridiculous. 
They mention I am not sharing the right credit card statement as the number apparently doesn’t match the one on the bill. 
If you look at the bill you can see that the last four numbers are the same, the rest in the statement from their side is blanked with ‘X’, on my statement it is not fully blanked with ‘X’ because it is a European card and we do not blank all numbers with ‘X’ but more numbers are visible. As accountant the woman I am discussing with should well be aware instead of sending me emails without “hello” and “bye” and unfriendly and incorrect content. 
This is really ridiculous. 
Don’t stay there.

reviews.author: Shel19
reviews.title: Nice Hotel, Good Location, Terrible Pillows
reviews.body:
I was very happy with the location of this hotel. It was close enough to Coor’s Field that we were able to walk, but far enough away that we didn’t have to deal with all the traffic and people after the game. 
The staff were professional and kind. 
The parking garage next door was super convenient- although it wasn’t very easy to find the parking information for it. 
The food in the cafe was terrible. I got the breakfast sandwich and it was literally just one you get from the freezer section at the store warmed up. The coffee was good though.
The pillows were hands down the worst pillows I’ve ever slept on in my life. 
Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely stay here again! Next time I will probably just bring my own pillow.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.title: Good hotel in a cool building
reviews.body: Overall good business stay on two separate trips this summer. Friendly and helpful staff. Decent executive elite lounge.

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body: Hotel is badly in need of a makeover.  The staff was helpful but public areas were grim. No wake up calls. The parking attendant gave me wrong directions to the airport. Not even close to the standard a Renaissance hotel should be held to.

reviews.author: VailCarolyn
reviews.title: A beautiful, historic hotel that could use some inspiration
reviews.body: I've stayed here often, and this time, the rooms were looking tired. I am Titanium, and I didn't feel any sort of acknowledgement on how much time I spend in Marriott brand hotels. One of my biggest complaints is that the housekeeping staff skipped our room...  no explanation, and a brief apology from the front desk. When I stay in a hotel, I like to be spoiled a bit and it wasn't happening here.

reviews.author: Elk625
reviews.title: Wonderful Downtown Hotel
reviews.body: My wife and I highly recommend the Downtown Renaissance Hotel.  It's central location is within walking distance of great restaurants, evening entertainment and is very handy for games and concerts at both Empower Field and Ball Arena.  Renaissance staff are professional, courteous and always make us feel welcome.  Our room, whether a suite or king is always fresh, clean and inviting.  The lobby is well appointed and a great place for a drink, snack, entertainment and just plain "people watching".  If we ever have questions, the front desk is very responsive and if you have questions on places to dine, simply ask the Valet.  They are more than happy to share information based on what you would enjoy for a meal. The Renaissance is a downtown hotel where you can definitely feel safe.

reviews.author: Jeremy
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.body: Elite experience at the Renaissance in DT Denver. The staff was wonderful, rooms were clean, and you felt a calm over you every time you walked on property. Without a doubt, I will not be staying anywhere else when I visit Denver.

reviews.author: Out of towners
reviews.title: Nice but a little tired
reviews.body:
Hotel and building lovely. Rooms in need of
some serious TLC from the maintenance department.

reviews.author: Larry
reviews.title: Great location & comfortable stay
reviews.body: The Renaissance Hotel proved to be an excellent choice to stay.  Our room was comfortable and clean.  The building lobby reflected its banking origin, providing an attractive and unique experience.  The location was great, as it was walkable to many restaurants, bars, and other attractions.

reviews.author: Colette
reviews.title: STUNNING HOTEL
reviews.body: This hotel is beautiful. Just awesome sitting in the reception area, which has a bar..... have a cocktail and be in awe of the original paintings, ceiling and bank vaults.  The restaurant's food is delicious and priced as "date friendly." Illy coffee in the lobby is also delicious. The room is modern, clean, comfortable bed, silky linens and down pillows.  All of the staff are friendly and eager to help, including the Valet.  The location is just as awesome, walking distance to Union Station, and the 16th St. Mall.  Just a wonderful stay and we can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: DRaj
reviews.title: Staycataion and Concert
reviews.body: Hotel location is in the heart of Downtown.  Experience from beginning to end was perfect and couldn't have been better.  Rooms are spacious and very clean.

reviews.author: RG2020
reviews.title: Beautiful property with amazing staff
reviews.body: This hotel is absolutely beautiful. It is in a great location and the associates are amazing! Tyler and Kylee at the front desk were great.  Michael, Eric, Ruben and Marquis were great in valet.  This is a must see hotel in downtown Denver

reviews.author: MorrClan
reviews.title: Vintage and Modern
reviews.body: This Hotel was very clean and comfortable. The rooms are dark and quiet. The customer service was excellent upon entrance and exit with  helpful information regarding the hotel and events in the area.

reviews.author: Terry and Kathy
reviews.title: Evening in Downtown Denver at the Renaissance Hotel
reviews.body: Probably one of the best experiences we have had in a long time at a Marriott facility.  We are pretty much 100% Marriott and find the product and experience to be very good overall.   Our experience at the Renaissance was exceptional.   At we drove up Eric was incredibly informative and helpful with our questions and parking requirements.  Tyler followed suit with our check-in process.  Before dinner we went to the bar for a beverage and met Katrina and Trey.  Both were very professional and shared their mixology expertise in a very informative and helpful way.   Paul, the restaurant manager was amazing   We met him at dinner at the Range and then again after we got back from the concert.  We were a few minutes late to get desert because of the length of the concert but Paul saw to it that we could order some New York style cheesecake which was outstanding.   Paul and the entire staff went above and beyond to make our short stay a memorable one.   Thanks!

reviews.author: Jeff S
reviews.title: Several Issues - Do Not Recommend Staying
reviews.body:
We were excited to stay at this hotel in downtown Denver due to the promising reviews, but this stay was so uncomfortable that we had to leave early to find another hotel after our first night. Service was up and down- for example, the valet was very nice and gave us waters when we walked into the hotel, but when we checked in, the bellhop placed our luggage on the luggage cart…and never brought it up to our floor. After half an hour, I had to go down myself to bring up the luggage. 

However, the worst part about the stay was the rooms. It felt like they completely gave up on the maintenance of our rooms- there was considerable wear and tear of the fixtures and furniture, a power socket was popping out, black mold appeared to be growing on the vents, and the rooms felt dusty and not well kept. Furthermore, one of our rooms had a loud humming noise that never went away. When we asked for support, the front desk sent maintenance to take a look. The maintenance personnel simply told us that the sound was coming from equipment outside of the room (see photo), and that there was nothing they could do. We brought our concerns to the front desk but were told that because we had connecting rooms, all of them would be subject to the same loud humming noise. We left after the first night and checked into the Hotel Clio (also Marriott) which was a much better experience and stay in terms of the room and service.

Overall, it feels like this property is being neglected and not being kept up to standard, and I would not recommend staying here at all.

reviews.author: exceeded expectations
reviews.title: bank on a comfortable stay
reviews.body: I was truly impressed by the extent that a century-old bank was repurposed into a conference-focused hotel while preserving much of the architecture, original art and character of the bank.  Visionary!

reviews.author: Seth
reviews.title: Super rough bathroom
reviews.body: Bathroom had an old beat up bathtub with a shower curtain. Cracking thick caulk and mold in the tub, sink had huge globs of caulk around the counter. Bathroom door was busted up and filthy. Large liquid stains on was behind toilet. Extremely rough all the way around, would not recommend.

reviews.author: Cap26
reviews.title: Denver
reviews.body: The property was well appointed and the staff friendly and professional.  The housekeeping staff did the minimum necessary each day in the room.  We checked in to find socks next to the bed and dirt on the bathroom floor.  We had to ask to have the room vacuumed at the same dirt was still there on the 4th day of our stay.  The bathroom vent fan never turned off and the vents were covered with dust and dirt.  Someone spilled candy on the carpet between our room and the elevator and it was till there after 3 days when we checked out.

reviews.author: GDog60
reviews.title: Excellent Stay Downtown Denver
reviews.body: Fantastic location with lots to do nearby. Very walkable to both Ball Arena and Mile High Stadium.

reviews.author: Kay M
reviews.title: Poor value for money
reviews.body: The room looked old. The security stopper / door stopper on the room door was hanging by a single screw. The bathroom was poor in condition. The spout in the tub was wobbly. The shower head was not cleaned in ages and so water was coming out from some sprays and not others. The water temperature in the sink and the shower area was either very hot or very cold. None of the other settings worked. Water pressure in the sink was slow.

reviews.author: First time visitor
reviews.title: Nice hotel -- cool that it used to be a bank
reviews.body: This is a nice hotel.  It's clean and the staff are very friendly and helpful.  The fact that it used to be a bank is pretty cool.  They kept the bank's vault and the door to it is open so guests can see how massive it is.  The hotel bar was nice and there was music at times.  The Range restaurant was pretty good but, for the price of the meals, one might expect a little better food (it was good, but not great).  Illy's was fine, as was the on-site breakfast space.

reviews.author: World Traveler
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.body: This was the most amazing stay! The staff were especially kind, especially Avian. He took the time out to explain the rich history of the hotel and the architecture of the building. He also took me on a tour of the hotel, even though it was past midnight when I arrived. The hotel itself is very nice and clean. The location is great and close to everything in downtown Denver. I definitely will stay here again when I return to Denver. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: sssshena2000
reviews.title: Friendly and attentive staff
reviews.body: Staff always welcomed me whenever I walked by.  The room was clean and the breakfast was nice

reviews.author: Jpsden
reviews.title: Fair there are other options in Denver to consider
reviews.body: This hotel tries but doesn’t nail it.

reviews.author: Lantad
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Denver
reviews.body: The staff and facility was on par for hotels of similar brands.  Please consider placing toiletry shampoo, conditions and body wash on a level where all guests can easily access.  The room we stayed in had such items way too high for a 5"3 person to comfortably use.

reviews.author: Tarheel60
reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.body:
I highly recommend this Marriott 
The staff and the room were exceptional ! It is ideally located in a Safe area of downtown Denver With nice restaurants within walking distance .

reviews.author: mcreal82
reviews.title: excellent stay in denver
reviews.body: great room and location in the city center of Denver, nice staff and great gym. Only the room was too noisy maybe due to the refrigerator or air conditioning

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.title: Usually a nice place to stay.
reviews.body: I have stayed here many time without issue. Unfortunately this time there were a few issues. First, the sink in the bathroom had stuff coming up from the bathroom above(I assume). Second, I never asked for service, yet, within my two week stay someone knocked and came in twice. I really did not want to spend the time talking to the front desk as these were minor issues. Not sure what happened this time.

reviews.author: Erik
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Great room and price. Room comes with its own full size fridge and ice maker included just make sure to flip it on.

reviews.author: J L G
reviews.title: great location and good staffing
reviews.body:
clean and comfortable 
Friendly staff

reviews.author: Bill H
reviews.title: Hotel Nice, Breakfast sub-par for Residence Inn
reviews.body: Rooms were unkept well and clean.  Location is not the best in Denver Downtown.  Limited options to walk for dogs, nothing on property.  Best option is courthouse 1/2 block away.  No pool.  Breakfast was sub-par for a Resident Inn.  Heavily carb focused with limited options.  No meats, potatoes for hot selections (Biscuit and Gravy, powdered scrambled eggs and pre-made waffles).  Only one type of yogurts, limited fresh fruit selection.

reviews.author: The Anayas
reviews.title: Honeymoon stay
reviews.body: We stayed 3 nights for our honeymoon. The guest had a nice gift for us when we entered our room. So sweet! Nice, clean rooms with friendly staff. Breakfast was delicious. Walking distance to downtown places. We had a nice spacious room with large windows with a great view. Definitely would stay again!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Run down and a complete waste of my agency’s money
reviews.body: I had a thoroughly bad experience at this location. Upon arrival, an entire floor of rooms had mechanical issues with the AC units. Things happen that’s ok, but they still put me in one of these rooms, knowing it’s the middle of summer and the room was 80 degrees. After I called down, they assigned me to another room. This room was *also* hot with the AC not working. My entire stay this room was hot and stuffy. It would turn off randomly. To make matters worse, I tried to get the front desk/engineering men to understand what was happening and they gaslit me. I know I wasn’t the only one of my group to experience this. As a matter of fact, out of the around 30 or so people to be there, at least half of us experienced this. Besides this, the breakfast was unimpressive, the corridors were poorly maintained with visible wear and tear on the walls and the elevator’s electronic pad to ensure people couldn’t access floors without a card was broken (how safe). As a whole, my agency wasted thousands of dollars to book a block of room at this hotel. I hope to never visit again and would actively discourage anyone from staying at this Residence Inn location.

reviews.author: AsMom
reviews.title: Great Property, room needs a little maintenance
reviews.body: A couple of issues with the room made for a less than stellar stay.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.title: Poor room upkeep
reviews.body: The AC didn’t work, I let the staff know and they didn’t fix the problem.

reviews.author: Weary business traveler
reviews.title: Checked In Early
reviews.body: After traveling for more than nine hours, I wanted to check in early (about four hours earlier than the rules allowed).  The front desk attendant said my room type was not available, but he could upgrade me at no cost.  I was very grateful.  This really set the tone for the entire stay.

reviews.author: Mr G
reviews.title: Very reasonable 👍🏾
reviews.body: Overall, great location and very nice staff. I'll be back forsure. Oh please do better at stocking the market plz and thank you

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Denver Conference
reviews.body: The hotel was well positioned.  It was clean and staff friendly.

reviews.author: Kenzie
reviews.title: Great staff no AC or communication
reviews.body: Staff was very sweet and professional just broken AC in our room

reviews.author: Austin
reviews.title: Don’t stay.
reviews.body: Room was so hot we couldn’t sleep

reviews.author: Denver Traveler
reviews.title: Great location, rooms, gym and breakfast, but internet is not great
reviews.body: Hotel is in a good location, rooms and facilities are nice along with breakfast, but wifi has been spotty on all my visits requiring conversations with Tech support, even after that the wifi works on mobile only for a little and then stops working, and only the laptop wifi works after the call.

reviews.author: PaulaF
reviews.title: AC not working , tub didn’t drain
reviews.body: AC didn’t work at times.  Tub did not drain.  Free breakfast was just ok.   The staff were pleasant and respectful.

reviews.author: RD5150
reviews.title: Clean and well maintained
reviews.body: Great Place! Staff was very nice and welcoming. Residence Inn by Marriot is one of my favorite places to stay.

reviews.author: TJT1999
reviews.title: No A/C
reviews.body: Bad experience. Air Conditioners were not working, went to front desk for new room, they explained “oh yeah our AC units were replaced and basically don’t work now.” This is beyond unacceptable. Eventually got to a room that was not over 90°, and then it was ok at best.

reviews.author: Denver 07182026
reviews.title: Concerned
reviews.body:
We had an attempted entry  at 12:30 AM that management wrote off as the maintenance department looking into a water issue. Maintenance doesn’t know what rooms are occupied? I don’t buy their explanation which goes against all professional protocols. 

The HVAC system wasn’t working properly. Freezing the main room while doing nothing for the bedroom forcing us to open the window to let cooler air in. Mind you it was 77 degrees outside. Listening to downtown Friday night traffic, a never ending alarm and emergency vehicles made sleep nearly impossible. I spoke with the front desk and was told that I would hear from management. I am still waiting.

reviews.author: Double check
reviews.title: No AC
reviews.body:
We stayed in the area for an event. Staff were nice and great location in the city Center. 
We arrived and had to go to event right away. Room was very warm so we thought put AC on to cool room for when we returned. We returned and it was after midnight and room was like a sauna. The AC unit was not working and we were exhausted and it was late, so know from experience no technician is coming at that hour. We should have called down and changed rooms but that was a lot of menuvorvng 3 of us late at night. Extreme heat outside so basically suffered throughout the night with little sleep and cool showers. My husband basically slept in lobby early morning for the coolness.  Kinda put a damper to our mini getaway. Later to find out that the system wasn’t working prior to check in and staff knew about it. Not impressed.

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.body: I enjoyed my time and will be back next year.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Dirty
reviews.body: Wasn’t memorable.  It smelled like weed and wet dog.   Feels like an outdate prison.   Stupid expensive for what it is.   Much better options for that price point on the same street.  Parking is horrendous

reviews.author: Shannon0426
reviews.title: Transplant games of America
reviews.body:
Our stay was amazing. The staff was very accommodating. The food was excellent. The hotel was extremely clean. 

10 out of 10 and would stay there again

reviews.author: Neveragain12345
reviews.title: Fail Visit
reviews.body: This location lacked promises made on all ends. Rooms were old and unclean, lacked modern features. Air conditioning stopped working and was forced to relocate to another room in middle of the night. Breakfast was always lack luster and options were limited. Parking was a nightmare, garage so small you could barely make safe turns without risk of hitting other vehicles. Staff was at times limited on knowledge, forcing me to figure things out on my own and consuming valuable time

reviews.author: Craig
reviews.title: Denver Residence Inn
reviews.body: Good location, good staff, a little worn,lack of housekeeping

reviews.author: MJuls
reviews.title: Quick 3 day Business trip
reviews.body: Great downtown location. Bed was comfortable, quiet and clean. 5 stars!

reviews.author: AnonReviewer
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body:
I wanted to love this hotel because I’ve had consistently good experiences with this hotel line in the past, but unfortunately this stay was really disappointing overall.

The biggest issue was the AC. It repeatedly shut off overnight and the room kept warming back up into the low 70s, which significantly impacted my sleep both nights. I also had a very loud refrigerator in the room and an uncomfortable bed, which made it even harder to rest.

There were also maintenance issues that should probably be addressed. The glass shelf in the bathroom was visibly pulling away from the wall and felt unsafe. The breakfast was mediocre compared to other Residence Inns I’ve stayed at, and parking was extremely expensive — almost double the price of the parking garage next door.

What frustrated me most was the customer service follow-through. I calmly reported these concerns before checkout, and the front desk told me a manager would contact me regarding possible compensation. I never received a call back.

Overall, the location was convenient, but the room quality, sleep disruption, parking cost, and lack of follow-through made this stay feel overpriced and disappointing.

reviews.author: Asher
reviews.title: Great place to stay.
reviews.body: This is a wonderful place to stay in the center of the city. It’s clean, modern and the staff are great!

reviews.author: Carla
reviews.title: Great location & Service
reviews.body: Perfect location for seeing Denver.  Lots of great places to eat and see in the immediate area.  The rooms were clean and spacious.  Staff was friendly and helpful with food suggestions.  Breakfast was good - offerings were fresh and a good variety.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Great place to stay right in down-town Denver
reviews.body: My stay for business/conference purpose was an excellent one with large room, great service and even greater food offerings.

reviews.author: KD9194
reviews.title: Undisclosed parking fees and hotel lobby smell
reviews.body:
The valet parking fee was disclosed as $54.00 per day…hefty but Ok. What was not disclosed is the $32.00 destination fee charge per day in addition to sales and city taxes. Parking for 4 nights was over $400 dollars. I reviewed the bill which was emailed to me in my way to the airport and imagine my surprise after receiving!! A destination fee for what? To move the car from the attached garage to the front. And we only used our car twice over the 4 day period. 

Also the lobby area and elevators have a sewer smell. Definitely not expected especially having stayed at several Westin locations across the US which all have such a wonderful aroma. This location not at all.

reviews.author: MaryC
reviews.title: Great hotel - great location
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location, very walkable to shops and restaurants.  Our room was spacious, wonderful view of the city, clean and great amenities.  The pool and fitness center are wonderful.  The bar is a great place to sit and relax after a day out.  The staff are very friendly and helpful

reviews.author: Leisure travel
reviews.title: Great hotel and room lobby smells bad
reviews.body: I have stayed at this location multiple times.  The staff are great and room clean and updated.  Unfortunately the lobby smelled like sewage wich was difficult to walk through every day.

reviews.author: overcharged
reviews.title: overcharged for room
reviews.body: Was at westin for NARMO conference and was not given the room rate for the conference.

reviews.author: Dominique
reviews.title: Awful experience for my first trip to Denver (Traveling for work)
reviews.body: I had an awful experience with the front desk here. I was double charged for my entire 5 night stay which took 2 days to reverse. The reason this was bad is it was on my company card when I was supposed to take people to dinner.

reviews.author: Dan T
reviews.title: Friendly and clean - just want you want in a hotel
reviews.body: The Westin in Denver was a nice place to stay. Valet was kind and fast, the front desk was eager to help, the housekeeping were good at their jobs. The facility was clean, the rooms were well laid out and the beds were comfortable. The down side, the restaurant was okay, but could have been better. Some items were delicious (French onion soup) but others were subpar (steak flatbread).  The event food was also up and down. Great selection of drinks and snacks during the convention but the networking hors d’oeuvres served during a mixer were flat out bad. I was not impressed. Overall, I would stay there if on vacation or a business trip. If I had to hold an event there, I would think twice before paying for hors d’oeuvres to be served.

reviews.author: Bob from NY
reviews.title: Foul odors and poor service
reviews.body: The lobby stunk of raw sewage for the 3 days we stayed. The service at Vs on Saturday was terrible. Was told by waiter he was too busy to take our food order and we should go to the bar to order. We left and ate out on 16th St. Will not return to this hotel.the bright spot was the asst manager Jackson and the Friday bartender at Vs. They were great.

reviews.author: Alexandra
reviews.title: The Westin Denver Downtown
reviews.body: A must if you’re in the Downtown area, everything about this hotel was great cant wait to go back :)

reviews.author: Bummer
reviews.title: Outside pool guests
reviews.body: This establishments promotes outside guests to pay a fee to use the pool. It is packed with over served guests and no room for paying overnight guests. It was disappointing. If the pool is something that draws you to this location skip it and find a location that provides safety to its guests.

reviews.author: BC Family Traveler
reviews.title: Lovely location and comfortable stay
reviews.body: Great location near Union station and the free bus on 16th. Access to good restaurants and Coors Field. Pool was lovely with a bar but on the days we visited it was 95F and the pool area had no shade or umbrellas so there was no rest from the heat. Rooms were comfortable and had all the amenities you could need.

reviews.author: UnhappyGoldMember
reviews.title: Westin Denver Downtown
reviews.body: Sadly this is one of the worst experiences I’ve had at a Westin. I generally always stay at Marriotts but this site has me rethinking that. I didn’t get a single good nights sleep due to the overriding of the thermostat. They don’t let you control your own thermostat so at night I would wake up sweating. And the loud noise out in the hallway that no one could explain or stop didn’t help either.

reviews.author: Alaska
reviews.title: After the fire
reviews.body: From the front desk greeting to all the services, Westin Downtown was great!

reviews.author: Fearless Counselor
reviews.title: Poor mountain views
reviews.body: For a hotel to over charge for mountain views they should at least attempt to provide a room with views of mountains and not glimpses through skyscrapers.

reviews.author: Biztraveler
reviews.title: Nights in Denver
reviews.body: The staff were quick to welcome me, the room was clean and I loved that it didn’t have carpet!  I didn’t hear noise from nearby rooms and the lavender oil roller was a nice perk before sleeping.

reviews.author: OhioGuest
reviews.title: Amenities didn’t meet price
reviews.body: For the price of the hotel, one would expect the hotel room to have a working bathroom vent, be clean upon arrival, and have Internet and breakfast provided. None of the above was true.

reviews.author: Buckeyeeducator56
reviews.title: Refreshing stay to busy days
reviews.body: Westin Fowntown Denver provided a great place for our Group to caucus in the morning before going over to the Convention Center for our major meetings. All of the staff from room service to maids to restaurant to from desk were very nice and service oriented. They made me want to ret for a vacation visit one day. A thoroughly pleasant stay for an extremely busy conference schedule.I DO wish the hotel had a hot tub but you did provide access to the excellent Colorado Athletic Club.

reviews.author: Britt
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: This was one of the best hotels I’ve stayed at. Great location. Close to everything. Used the fitness center multiple times. The staff was wonderful and friendly.

reviews.author: David and Honey
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.body:
We had a wonderful stay at the Westin! From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations. The staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive, making us feel right at home throughout our visit.

Our room was spotless, comfortable, and well-appointed, and the entire hotel was beautifully maintained. The pool was fantastic and a great place to relax, and we especially enjoyed the bar—our drinks were excellent and expertly made.

The only small suggestion would be to add a few umbrellas around the pool area. It was a very hot day, and having some additional shade would make the experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, this is a top-notch hotel with exceptional service and wonderful amenities. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Denver!

reviews.author: Sid Gun
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.body: I had an amazing stay at the Westin Downtown Denver.

reviews.author: Rhonda H
reviews.title: Amazing Experience at the Westin Downtown Denver
reviews.body: I enjoyed every moment of my stay at the Westin Denver Downtown.  Clean rooms and friendly staff.  Look forward to visiting again.

reviews.author: Overnight 1333
reviews.title: Denver Summer Night visit
reviews.body: Hotel is great location in downtown Denver, a bit older but nice condition and easy stay room was very nice and comfortable bed and accessories

reviews.author: Katie06062020
reviews.title: Great stay at the Westin
reviews.body: wonderful service, would stay there again

reviews.author: denverwestinsucks
reviews.title: an awfully expensive night at a subpar motel 6
reviews.body:
Get ready to be charged for everything but breathing. 15 dollar water in room. 10 dollar wifi daily. You a member? Too bad you paying. You want to know where is a good resturant by the hotel? Dont ask staff they will tell you they cant afford to be in the area amd have no idea. Want to know how much the deposit is? Staff doesnt know that either sayings 100 a day when its 100 flat.  Want to wait forever for your car to be in a valet ? Oh boy do we got the place for you. 


A motel 6 would have been more accommodating.  Fire everyone start over

reviews.author: GDKellogg
reviews.title: Westin Denver Downtown Impresses with Stellar Service and Healthy, Delicious Catering
