reviews.body: Excellent accomodations, professional and courteous staff providing services throughout the hotel, consistently outstanding and healthy food offerings and buffets for the event with continuous access to ice water and other beverages. The rooms were well appointed and quiet and the location was convenient to the buses and trains as well as shorts walks to excellent dining.

reviews.author: Divya Jhawar
reviews.title: Had an excellent stay!
reviews.body: The hotel’s location is absolutely perfect—very convenient and close to everything we needed. The staff was incredibly cordial, welcoming, and always ready to help, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend for a comfortable and hassle-free stay!

reviews.author: Jay H
reviews.title: You have to ask about additional fees at checkin
reviews.body: It was disclosed to me at checkout that on top of my prepaid hotel charged, I was being charged a fee of ‘Other’ for $40 a day. When I asked what this was, it was explained to me that this fee covers use of the health club next door, beer flights, discounts on food, etc. All things I would have used, but never disclosed to me until I was leaving. I just want honest transparent pricing. Not hidden fees that are not disclosed until I check out.

reviews.author: Yomi O
reviews.title: Westin Denver Downtown review
reviews.body: This is my second time staying at this hotel. Hotel lobby and floor hallway smelt of feces/sewage. I though it was a busted pipe (although no one acknowledged or talked about it) but that strong smell was there throughout my 5-day stay. I also asked for a extended check-out to check-out at noon instead of 11am; I was told they will charge me $50 for an extra hour! As a Marriott reward member, I started to question my loyalty to staying at Marriott properties.

reviews.author: BusinessTraveler
reviews.title: Not good for business travelers due to lack of privacy and thin walls
reviews.body: I had a room on the top floor that was conjoined with another.  The walls were paper thin.  I could HEAR everything - every business call the person was making, their alarm that went off at 4:30am, 4:45am, 5am, 5:15am.  I got NO sleep and was drained for my own business meetings that day.  I stay at hotels like Westins frequently for work without any issues, but will not be frequenting this one again unless absolutely necessary.

reviews.author: Anaiz
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: I enjoyed my stay and pleased with the service and great customer service and I’m very pleased I was acknowledged about my silver elite status

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Swampy Hallway Ruins Stay
reviews.body: The hallway flooded from an over flowing toilet and the staff did not care!

reviews.author: Linton
reviews.title: The Ritz in Downtown Denver cares
reviews.body: First class client care throughout. The team members wanted our stay to be special and it truly was. Great property and great staff folks. I will be back again!

reviews.author: jenp
reviews.title: Nothing Special
reviews.body: Unfortunately, this Ritz did not live up to expectations. We did not receive the special service that the Ritz is typically known for. When we checked in after our anticipated arrival time, our beds were still being made. The only recognition of our anniversary and my birthday was a verbal congrats at check in. The Club access we paid so much for was not worth it - food offerings were very small and focused mostly on salad and many of the items that were available ran out quickly. The club attendant didn't know how to make a basic classic drink and had to be told the ingredients. Later, we had our privacy card on the door when someone we assume was from the hotel banged very loudly, yelled something, and rang the phone a minute later. We were unable to answer but it was very disturbing. There is no pool to use here, and there are no joint male and female spa spaces to make use of together as other Ritz locations have. Overall our stay was just average and did not offer the luxury and service that the Ritz is renowned for.

reviews.author: AndieC
reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.body: Great place to stay if downtown . Can walk to few restaurants & stores . Great staff

reviews.author: Tyna
reviews.title: Way Above
reviews.body: Absolutely overwhelmed with the service and kindness.

reviews.author: M Rucker
reviews.title: Best stay ever!
reviews.body: I really enjoyed my stay at The Ritz-Carlton Denver. I felt as if the staff cared about me and my needs. The cleaning staff was phenomenal as well as the turn down staff each night. I felt so comfortable I wasn't ready to leave and that's rare. Thank you, RC staff!!!

reviews.author: CONCERT TRIP
reviews.title: VACAY
reviews.body: NICE HOTEL.. VERY NICE ROOMS AND NICE STAFF

reviews.author: Savannah Cudzilo
reviews.title: 16 Year Old Celebration
reviews.body:
The hotel/staff went above and beyond for my family and my step-son! He turned 16 this year and has always wanted to stay at a really nice hotel and just experience a wonderful (and boujee as he says) Birthday Celebration!
Well they really outdid themselves! To the room-to the club experience- to the DINNER (Excellent by the way! Definitely recommend Elways) - to the personalization of the room so he really felt special for those short days. Again this was incredible and I would love to bring my family back so many more times now!

reviews.author: Boltons
reviews.title: Over the top!
reviews.body: The team went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and spoil my daughter for her birthday! It was a great experience.

reviews.author: RLee
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Not a good experience. We’ll never stay here ever again. Worst Ritz Carlton I’ve ever been to.

reviews.author: Babs456
reviews.title: Exceptional Service
reviews.body:
Our stay at The Ritz-Carlton was exceptional. What truly set this property apart was the outstanding level of service.

Every employee we encountered was warm, welcoming, and genuinely committed to making our stay memorable.

The hotel itself was spotless, comfortable, and beautifully maintained. Combined with the remarkable staff, it made for an outstanding stay.

The team at The Ritz-Carlton exceeded our expectations in every way. We look forward to returning and would highly recommend this hotel to anyone seeking first-class hospitality.

reviews.author: CosM
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.body: All the staff paid attention to the smallest details. Always a pleasure and amazing to see how far they go.

reviews.author: Denning218
reviews.title: Beyond Luxury
reviews.body: I cannot recommend staying at the Ritz-Carlton Denver enough. Thoughtful, courteous and always with “my pleasure”.

reviews.author: Kck1
reviews.title: Fair response
reviews.body: Transportation was unsatisfactory. Club level was good but could use an upgrade.

reviews.author: DryinDenver
reviews.title: Excellent hotel but no pool
reviews.body: It's a great hotel and had a nice stay.    Avoid if you want to use a pool.      We had some free time so assumed they had a pool.     First Ritz we have stayed without a pool so surprised.

reviews.author: BriShae
reviews.title: Birthday Trip made to remember
reviews.body:
My stay at the Ritz Carlton - Denver was phenomenal. I booked the resort for my significant other birthday and was so impressed.

The resort made sure that I was able to provide him with a card and champagne. The hotel also gave him a birthday gift which we were not expecting. 

All around great experience.

reviews.author: Mencimer Family
reviews.title: Exeptional Service
reviews.body: The entire staff from front desk, valet, room service and Charles at Elways made my entire family feel special.  We will always stay at the Ritz when we come to Denver.  Great Job!

reviews.author: Vicki S
reviews.title: Downtown Denver
reviews.body:
Our stay was wonderful. The hotel is centrally located in the heart of Denver. The hotel was able to accommodate our suite night award request which upgraded us to a lovely one-bedroom suite. The room was spacious, quiet, and very well appointed. The staff was extremely friendly, funny but very professional and polished. The bartenders provided excellent service. Jake, Terry, and Monica went out of their way to make us excellent craft cocktails and provided us wonderful local tips for sightseeing and dining. Please give them a special shout out for a job very well done.

From the minute we entered the property, the service was impeccable. The hotel is spotless. The housekeeping staff works tirelessly to make the hotel and the rooms sparkle with probably not as much recognition as they deserve.

Would highly recommend this Ritz Carlton for your next visit to Denver.

reviews.author: jeff
reviews.title: bring a eye mask
reviews.body: overall good, but for the money it should have been better.

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Clean spaces with friendly staff
reviews.body: My 1st stay at the Ritz Denver. I was able to check in early and the staff delivered well on both communication and service. I spent some time at the bar for quick breakfast bite and my pastry was great. Later on, the bar tender gave us great service and also remembered us and our drinks the following day.

reviews.author: Kelia Brieann
reviews.title: 40th Birthday!
reviews.body: Excellent stay! I always love staying downtown at the Ritz. It's luxurious and beautiful and perfectly located. I always feel like a special guest as well!

reviews.author: Steamboater
reviews.title: Cold shower
reviews.body:
I gave this rating because the experience did not reflect the level of service or attention to detail I expect from a Ritz-Carlton property. The shower temperature was inadequate, even after maintenance attempted to address the issue, and returning late in the evening to find the bed made without a bottom sheet was extremely disappointing and inconvenient.

I appreciated that the front desk attendant comped my valet and bar tab the following morning, and they handled the situation professionally. However, the overall stay still fell well below expectations, especially at this price point.

reviews.author: Michele 1111
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: The Ritz Denver delivered with friendliness, clean rooms. Great restaurant on premises. Comfortable stay.

reviews.author: Michelle K
reviews.title: Great service, great stay!
reviews.body: We planned a conference with the team here and they delivered on all fronts. From being communicative, responsive, and providing excellent customer service. We loved our stay here. Everything is maintained very well, it's clean, upgraded and top tier.

reviews.author: California Couple
reviews.title: Good, not Great
reviews.body: The Ritz is a beautiful hotel with lovely common spaces and an excellent FITNESS CENTER. There is no separate morning coffee options and the coffee and breakfast selection is lacking. Several items in our room were in need of repair which you don’t expect at a Ritz-Carlton. Everyone who worked there was wonderful, but the hotel needs to be updated and upgraded a bit.

reviews.author: Platinum Traveler
reviews.title: Not the Ritz-Carlton Experience I Expected
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at The Ritz-Carlton, Denver and, unfortunately, this was one of the least Ritz-Carlton-like experiences I’ve had.

From check-in, there were issues around honoring a guaranteed Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite benefit (4 p.m. late check-out). I was initially told this benefit did not apply, which required unnecessary back-and-forth and escalation to resolve. While the situation was eventually corrected, it took far more time and effort than it should have—especially at a property of this caliber.

The room itself (Room 802) had a great layout, but the condition was far below expectations. Furniture was visibly worn and stained, the bedside table glass was mismatched and improperly sized, and there was dust and debris under glass surfaces. The carpet had stains, and the wallpaper was peeling in places. These are not minor issues and significantly detracted from the overall experience.

There were some positives—several associates provided excellent service and were professional and helpful, and dining at Elway’s was enjoyable. However, these highlights did not outweigh the broader issues with service consistency and room maintenance.

Overall, this stay did not meet the standards typically associated with the Ritz-Carlton brand.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: The Example
reviews.body: Best hotel you will ever stay at. This is the Example that other hotel managers should aspire to this level of performance.

reviews.author: k123
reviews.title: Disappointed in Denver
reviews.body: Disappointed by arriving and having no restaurant / bar to get a quick bite.  Got a room upgrade and while spacious, a bit dated and very dark.

reviews.author: Oana
reviews.title: Excelent experience
reviews.body:
A great experience at The Ritz-Carlton Denver during the Joe Dispenza TTT Training.
The hotel delivered excellent logistics throughout the entire stay- everything was smooth, well-organized and supportive for a focused training environment. The rooms were comfortable, with a beautiful balance between city skyline and mountain views.
The food was consistently very good-fresh, well-prepared and energizing, which made a real difference during long training days.
Overall, a premium experience that supported both comfort and performance. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: RG1965
reviews.title: Best service ever!
reviews.body:
Our stay at the Ritz-Carlton was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we arrived, every detail was handled with care, professionalism, and genuine warmth. The level of service truly went above and beyond—every team member made us feel welcomed, valued, and genuinely special throughout our entire stay.

Dinner at Elway’s was equally outstanding. The food was incredible, the atmosphere was perfect, and the experience felt elevated in every way. What truly set the night apart, though, was the staff—attentive, engaging, and thoughtful without ever being overbearing. They anticipated our needs before we even had to ask.

A special highlight was the Phantom of the Opera–themed dinner experience, which added a unique and memorable touch to an already amazing evening. It felt personal, creative, and truly one-of-a-kind.

The bar staff also deserves recognition—they were top-notch. Friendly, skilled, and attentive, they crafted excellent drinks and created an environment that made us want to stay and enjoy the moment just a little longer.

Overall, this was more than just a stay and a dinner—it was an experience. The Ritz-Carlton and Elway’s delivered above and beyond in every way. We’ll absolutely be back.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.body: Wonderful service, shower pressure and temperature. Air conditioning in my room was fabulous while it was sweltering outside.

reviews.author: Seabiscuit
reviews.title: New York Jets Vs Tenn Titans Weekend, Sept 11th to Sept 14th 2026
reviews.body: Thanks, It was my 2nd time staying at this hotel.  It was a quick ride to and from the airport.  Its also a quick walk to Broadway and all the live music. Was in town for the NY Jets Vs Titans game, which was a rare win for the NY Jets.  Had a few drinks and a meal at the lobby bar/restaurant, food was good and the beer was cold.  The staff was welcoming.  The early check in fees, I had never seen before, $150.00 for real early and $50.00 for ~ noon, I thought it was odd, if the room was ready, I should have been able to check in.  All-in-all a good stay for 3 nights.

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body: Clean rooms and nice restaurant

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.title: Executive lounge was poor
reviews.body: I wouldn’t stay here again 70 dollars to park your car per night , executive lounge was the worst I have stay in with Marriott and I am platinum elite member

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Amazing Staff & Clean Rooms
reviews.body: I was there for four nights and five days. The staff were all amazing. Even the cleaning staff that were primarily Spanish speaking, they tried to help even through the language barrier. That's the one thing I'd ask as far as opportunity for improvement. Supply the Spanish speaking staff interpretation tools. My room was very clean. So, for me, having friendly staff and a clean room were the best.

reviews.author: Pvisg
reviews.title: Highly recommend this  propeetu
reviews.body: Location staff service view of capitol amenities All spot on would stay here again

reviews.author: Nashvegas Visitor
reviews.title: Excellent Class B Option
reviews.body: If you aren't looking for the newest and more fancy hotel, but expect and want a clean comfortable and well equipped hotel, that is very well located, this is it.  Courteous staff.  Well equipped gym (for a hotel).  Our room was surprisingly quiet (20th floor).  Would definitely choose it again.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.body: Not worth it -- better hotels in the area that will feel more inviting.

reviews.author: Davis2026
reviews.title: Management cancelled my reservation that had been pre-paid
reviews.body: The staff at this hotel was by far the worst I've ever experienced, I would recommend finding another option in the area.

reviews.author: Brenda
reviews.title: Quiet, comfortable rooms and friendly Staff
reviews.body: Hotel is in a great location.   Bed is confortable, rooms are quiet (did not hear any noise from the street, I was on 6th floor). During the conference, the catering staff were friendly and helpful, greeting attendees during foodservice.

reviews.author: Bela Rod
reviews.title: Check In was delayed by 5 hours
reviews.body: Arrived at the hotel at 3:25pm on Wednesday, August 26th expecting to be able to check in and did not receive a call until around 8:30pm stating that they would be able to grant me a room key and access to my room. In addition, I requested a late check out due to a late flight and was only granted 1 hour although I could not access my room for 5+ hours on my arrival day. Food ticket was given but only for one evening so I could not even use it.

reviews.author: Nikki L
reviews.title: Helpful staff, nice place to stay
reviews.body: The room was clean and was spacious. It is convenient to downtown and an easy walk to many tourist spots. Attended a conference in this hotel while I stayed. It was very convenient. Helpful hint: If you stay in an upper-level floor, let the water run for a while if you like a hot shower.

reviews.author: Nova
reviews.title: Not a good experience for the price
reviews.body:
“Great staff, but the stay fell short of expectations”
We paid a premium rate for our stay, and unfortunately it didn’t quite live up to the price. There was noticeable road noise, and a group of other guests made for a less peaceful experience — we smelled pot throughout the hotel, including in the hallway, and someone knocked on our door in the middle of the night. It ended up being a disappointing stay for us.
That said, the staff were wonderful throughout, and we truly appreciated the 20,000 points they offered us as a goodwill gesture. We were also charged for a snack we didn’t order, but we chose not to make an issue of it.
Overall, the team was great, but the stay itself didn’t match the premium cost. Given everything, we felt a complimentary adjustment would have been appropriate. We’re not sure we’d choose to stay here again, but we do hope to see improvements in the future.

reviews.author: SB01
reviews.title: BNControl User Group
reviews.body: I stayed at the Sheraton for a business meeting. The room was great. The food was great. The meeting room was great. The service was amazing.

reviews.author: jefro7211
reviews.title: Outstanding memories made at Grand Sheraton!
reviews.body:
I was treated with excellent customer service from all of the staff, every day.  My room was very clean and comfortable. 
I would recommend this hotel for your stay in Nashville!

reviews.author: KAL UK
reviews.title: Does what you need it to do. Staff make it great
reviews.body:
as long as you are mobile this is a great stay. we picked for gig at Nissan stadium and it was literally 20 mins walk.
it was also easy to get to downtown and the bus interchange but away from the noise and hustle & bustle of Broadway.
Staff were the best and most of them really tried to help with all.our queries and issues
Food good and reasonable value for a hotel - limited healthy / small plates but that might just be me
Overall a great stay and would probably consider again

reviews.author: fellowtraveller1
reviews.title: Nice hotel for a conference
reviews.body: The hotel was nice enough for a conference. They did not have a full-length mirror in the room, which was unfortunate, and the iron was difficult to use as well. The shower head got stuck on one setting after the first use and I had to ask for someone to fix it. It was fine for a conference and good enough for a downtown stay.

reviews.author: FOR THE RICH ONLY
reviews.title: Get you wallet out!!
reviews.body: Room is fine its the unknown add on of parking which is not free. They place several items in the fridge and table which are not included in the room price! Extra $100 for aeminities which is not returned right away 3 -7 business days!

reviews.author: Cierra
reviews.title: Best Honeymoon!
reviews.body: The Sheraton grand was Ana amazing place to stay, very clean, staff was very friendly, room was big! The capital view was to die for!! Me and my (now) husband went here for our honeymoon, it was so close to everything we wanted to do so we mostly walked and enjoyed the city, and the breakfast from the library was amazing!

reviews.title: Nashville stay
reviews.body:
Absolutely perfect stay
Top notch

reviews.author: CM2026
reviews.title: 50th birthday celebration
reviews.body: Clean hotel, friendly staff.

reviews.author: concertgoer123
reviews.title: Upscale stay for a great price
reviews.body:
The Sheraton Grand Nashville Downtown was a great place to stay. The service was awesome, the staff was pleasant, friendly, helpful, & hospitable - all the way from the front desk to the maintenance personnel. Their self parking was safe, convenient, & at a good value. The location was convenient for the price, & the design inside was aesthetically pleasing. Would definitely love to stay here again next time I'm in Nashville!

There were only a few things that were off & I wish were different;
I'd like to give the Skye Lounge another try sometime, but I did find the entry & vibe of it a bit awkward - small entry way that includes bathrooms with doors that swing out, & wasn't sure what the vibe was (loud & socialable in some parts, & quiet & intimate in others). Felt the food menu could've had a few more non-sushi items, as I was with someone that didn't care much for sushi - we ended up just getting an appetizer & a drink a piece & leaving. 

The rooms should really just have a mini fridge for guest use in them already - I know we could've called down to the front desk for one, but it was an amenity that should just be there without asking. Felt weird there was one that was only for up-charged bar items. 

We also felt maybe the main hotel bar/restaurant should either be open a bit later (with a limited menu if needed, or only bar items until a later time closer to bar close) - we didn't care for the options at Skye Lounge much, & would've liked to have the option of the main bar/restaurant for late night. Also, didn't love that room service items were both upcharged AND had more fees for delivery/service on top at check out - felt one or the other would've been sufficient, either higher prices on items off the rip, or an additional delivery/service charge added at the end. 

Lastly, maybe we missed it, but the gift/convenience/snack shop should have prices clearly listed on the items/snacks/drinks, on the shelves, or on a menu somewhere - after seeing what prices were for other things & not knowing what they would be - it really deterred us from using that. Maybe that's the point, but transparency on those prices was the only thing keeping us from buying from there because of how self-check out was set up (didn't want to scan something just to be surprised by price & have to possibly get help clearing it off to check prices on something else).

Just some small suggestions/preferences - it was our first time staying at this hotel, so maybe it's just something non-newbies already are used to/have the hang of.

reviews.author: Nashed
reviews.title: Great but broken elevator
reviews.body: The hotel was great and staff was nice. Biggest issue was a broken elevator in the garage. It’s the only elevator which meant having to walk up four stories to get my bags from the car in 90 degree heat. Then having to walk down the garage levels against traffic which is dangerous. This was after paying $60 to park there overnight as a guest. Completely unacceptable.

reviews.author: Kathy O
reviews.title: Getting reacquainted with Sheraton hotels
reviews.body: We had a great stay, great service (with the exception of one middle aged female server in the Library who was rude when she helped the bar tender handle our table on 8/8/26 around 6pm).  Every other member of your staff was excellent!

reviews.author: MAmama1202
reviews.title: Talk about a night-and-day experience!
reviews.body:
We came to the Sheraton after spending just one night at the hotel across the street, and the difference was incredible from the moment we arrived.

The valet guys were so nice and immediately helped us with our bags. The woman at the front desk was also very pleasant, welcoming, and helpful. We needed an empty fridge for the room, and they had one sent up right away.

The room itself was spacious and comfortable. The bed was actually comfortable, there was a full couch, and we had a nice desk and drawer setup with plenty of room for our things. They even provided a robe! The room smelled so nice and clean, and housekeeping came every day to make the bed and take out the trash, which we really appreciated.

The only downsides were that figuring out how to get to the rooftop restaurant was a little confusing, and our room phone didn’t work. Maintenance did come up to try to fix it, but unfortunately, it still wasn’t working afterward.

Overall, though, this was a night-and-day difference from our previous hotel experience. The staff was friendly, the room was comfortable and spacious, and we felt much more welcomed and taken care of. I would definitely choose the Sheraton again!

reviews.author: Family weekend
reviews.title: Fun with family
reviews.body: We were traveling with a 1 year old and family and the staff helped to make having a child much easier.  Thoroughly enjoyed!

reviews.author: Peyton Lewis
reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.body: Stayed for a girls trip. Only concern was that we were not able to use the fridge as there was drinks in it and sensors. Along with the snacks provided.

reviews.author: Kayla
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.body: Staying at the Sheraton Grand Nashville Downtown was excellent. The service was extremely welcoming and helpful. Alongside the beauty of the hotel lobby and amenities, our room was updated and clean. Parking on site was also fairly simple and easy, although the parking garage was very tight. During our stay, we were unfortunately not able to visit the Skye, as it had limited hours of availability. I would definitely recommend the Sheraton Grand Nashville Downtown for your next stay in Nashville, especially if you are going to be visiting Broadway, Printer’s Alley, or other attractions around town.

reviews.author: JBabS
reviews.title: mediocre
reviews.body: MEDIOCRE VENUE WITH GREAT VALET STAFF- VALET LUKE WAS SUPER HELPFUL AND WENT ABOVE AND BEYOND. BATHROOM ROBE WAS RIPPED, THERE WAS HAIR IN THE SHOWER WHEN I ARRIVED, AND A PEE YELLOW STAIN ON SOME OF THE TOWELS. SNACK PACK IS $45 AND IT ONLY CONTAINED A COUPLE CANDY BARS/POP/STALE POPCORN. DEF NOT $45 WORTH

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.title: Sheraton Grand Nashville
reviews.body: The hotel was clean, new, and modern. It was conveniently located near Nissan Stadium, which made getting to and from events very easy. The robe in the room was especially nice and added a luxurious touch to the stay. The staff was welcoming, friendly, and helpful throughout our visit. The parking garage was expensive, but the in-and-out privileges made it convenient and worthwhile.

reviews.author: Jurney99
reviews.title: Great hotel and experience except for front desk
reviews.body: Hotel room and overall respective services were great.  Lounge was great and food quality and service were  great.  Front desk was frustrating and manager of front desk was rude and unacceptable.

reviews.author: Leigh
reviews.title: Just ok for the price tag
reviews.body:
The room is just a regular room with the “club access” for nearly $500. Since I was coming in early and staying for business I stayed at the same hotel the event was held at. I paid extra $80 per day to stay in the same room through the whole trip
Since a lower class room was reserved through the event. We received a $15 credit on food and drinks for the 1st 2 days, however when questioned the 2 and 2 they said it wasn’t included in the room fare for those 2 days. The “club” only has food for specific times and small windows if you’re not available then it’s just water and chips for an extra $50 a day. My key card stopped working for the lounge and my room at least 3 times, digital key was not available for half the stay. Room service was fantastic day 1. Never showed up for 2 hours and was then cancelled day 2. Showed up looking day old, cold and missing items 2 salads and app for $100 on paper plates. day 3. I ordered a bagel and fruit for breakfast one day. The bagel came smashed into a paper soup bowl.

We had a great view of Music City Center. We used the Club Lounge every morning, some evenings and for dessert too! So this was definately a great upgrade! We will for sure book this location next time we are in Nashville!

reviews.author: UnhappyGirl
reviews.title: Stay Anywhere Else
reviews.body: Our room was small, the bathroom and shower was very outdated. Tub/shower didnt work well and falling apart. The mattress was the hardest ive ever laid on. We did get upgraded to a higher floor. The room was slightly better but still not to the level we expect from the reputation has. We had lunch in the restaurant downstairs. All servers were cut by 2 pm and the bartender was god awful. She was rude to us about trying to sit at a table, her bar was a disaster and she couldnt keep up. The destination fee was said it was included in our room rate but it was charged seperate. I did not get either of our $15 daily credit either that was promised to us. All in our this was probably the worst experience overall ive had in my trips. I had such high expectations for you guys and none of them were met. Also the valet smoked weed in my car, and the valet manager basically told us we were lying about it. I will tell everyone I know to avoid you guys at all cost.

reviews.author: Andrew

The food was excellent, the rooms were perfect, the hot was amazing after a lot of walking and a LOT of stairs and the service was great. reviews.author: Keira
reviews.title: My stay 8/13/26 - 8/14/26
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel with beautiful view from the high story building, wonderful lively area, will never use valet again due to my experience here, hindered of dollars with of mechanic tools were stolen from my trunk while in the care of the PMC Parking valet service this hotel employed

reviews.author: Gbama
reviews.title: Renaissance Nvlle
reviews.body: Excellent accommodations. The price for meals was too high eg breakfast buffet was $40+ , a beer was 9 bucks.

reviews.author: Family of 5
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Excellent Location, but Disappointing Front-Desk Service
reviews.body:
Beautiful, well-maintained hotel in an excellent location, but our check-in experience was very disappointing.
We were traveling as a family of FIVE and booked two rooms through American Express. At check-in, I specifically asked about any available room upgrades, but the front-desk associate did not check or provide any information. I also asked if our two rooms were next to each other, and was told they were. They were not, rooms 618 and 613 were quite far apart.
Unfortunately, the lack of attention continued when we checked out. We discovered that the front desk had incorrectly recorded five guests in one room and two in the other, resulting in incorrect extra-person charges. This was particularly frustrating because the associate had clearly seen our group and knew how we were divided between the rooms.
The good news is that the restaurant staff completely changed our impression of the hotel. Everyone we encountered there was wonderful, friendly, warm, professional, and attentive. Daniel, in particular, provided outstanding service at breakfast. He was kind, professional, genuinely welcoming, and a pleasure to deal with. Please recognize him for his exceptional service.
Overall, the hotel itself is beautiful and the location is fantastic. We had a great stay, but the front-desk service and attention to detail at check-in and checkout need improvement. Thankfully, the exceptional restaurant team—especially Daniel—more than made up for that first impression.

reviews.author: PMT138
reviews.title: Stay here!
reviews.body: I recommend this hotel. Easy walking distance to Broadway, shops, food and Museums. During my stay they offered two free admission tickets to the Johnny Cash Museum and the Nashville Barrel Company. If you want A+ service, this is the place.

reviews.author: JAYV
reviews.title: Great Stay in Downtown Nashville!
reviews.body:
Not ever having been to Nashville, I researched the info pretty widely and decided upon The Renaissance Hotel to 
spend the short 3 nights we'd be staying in the city. My husband and I were specifically wanting to be in close 
proximity to Ryman Auditorium as well as within walking distance to other things. We loved that the hotel was 
directly connected to Assembly Hall and that area.  We found that it was definitely also an easy walk to Ryman and The Country Music Hall of Fame 
from there.  We drove to the Opry area instead of Ubering or something and that worked out well because the valet service
was great and the waiting times were short.  We ate some at Little Fib, the onsite restaurant, but (other than breakfast and dessert) there weren't a whole lot of dishes that appealed to us besides the burger which was very good.  The atmosphere in the  restaurant was relaxed but stylish.  This hotel offered all of the amenities but was very welcoming and comfortable at the same time!

reviews.author: PrincessK
reviews.title: Band member was given my room # wo my consent and lingered around it my entire stay.
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at the Renaissance Nashville Hotel and need to bring a serious guest-privacy concern to management’s attention.

Another guest whom I knew gave the front desk my name and asked to be placed on the same floor as me. I later learned that hotel staff disclosed my floor/location to him and accommodated his request without ever contacting me or obtaining my permission. He ultimately knew my room number, was able to wait for me near the elevators on my floor, and on one occasion came directly to my room and knocked.

Fortunately, nothing dangerous occurred. However, that is beside the point.

I had intentionally chosen not to give this person my room number. Whether I knew him, was traveling with him, or whether he appeared perfectly harmless is irrelevant. I should have been the person deciding whether another guest was given information about my location.

I am particularly concerned that providing nothing more than another guest’s name apparently allowed someone to obtain information about where that guest was staying within the hotel.

I would appreciate management investigating exactly what information was disclosed, how my room/floor information became available to this guest, whether this was consistent with hotel policy, and what safeguards are in place to prevent this from happening to another guest.

I otherwise enjoyed my Nashville stay, which makes this particularly disappointing. Guest privacy in a hotel room is something I take very seriously, and I would appreciate a response from management regarding what occurred.

reviews.author: DisappointedGuest
reviews.title: Would not stay again.
reviews.body: Outdated non-working refrigerator, broken ice machine, very loud AC fan that couldn’t be fixed, AC is motion-censored so it turns off at night. Homeless man in the front 24/7

reviews.author: N Carew
reviews.title: Front desk cleark marred my whole stay
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, my interaction with the front desk clerk really marred my overall experience. She was extremely reticent and made me feel unwelcome from the moment I arrived. She barely said  anything to me throughout the entire interaction and was neither personable nor inviting.  I could count the number of words. This was particularly noticeable because the two other employees at the front desk were jovial, warm, and welcoming with guests. The contrast was striking. Since the front desk sets the tone for a hotel stay, the interaction left such a poor first impression that I actually considered leaving and staying at another hotel.

On the positive side, the hotel itself was very clean and smelled great. My room was also clean, but unfortunately it faced directly toward another building, making the room extremely dark with very little natural light even with all the room lights only.

I was also surprised by the lack of basic toiletries. I have never stayed at a hotel that provided virtually none of the standard toiletries you would expect. Strangely, there was eye makeup remover, but very little else.

Overall, the cleanliness of the property was a definite positive, and the other staff members I encountered seemed pleasant. Unfortunately, my initial front desk experience made me feel unwelcome and significantly affected my impression of the stay.

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.title: Wonderful Time
reviews.body: The staff was awesome. The hotel location was great. The building was historic and the rooms were clean.

reviews.author: Scot1955
reviews.title: Great location and comfort
reviews.body: We will return. This Courtyard is well maintained and rooms are very clean. The bed may be the most comfortable of any where but home. Walking distance to Broadway and the Ryman. Perfect.

reviews.author: paulbier13656
reviews.title: Proximity to entertainment
reviews.body: We visited Nashville to enjoy the Broadway entertainment & restaurants. I wanted to stay within a few blocks of Broadway. Since I am a Bonvoy member, I chose The Courtyard-downtown Nashville. I was not disappointed. The walk to Broadway was a few blocks. The caveat is that the most direct walk is down a fairly steep slope down to Broadway and after a long day or night, the walk back is obviously up that steep slope. We did find other routes to Broadway that were a bit longer but a little less hilly.

reviews.author: Queen B
reviews.title: Don’t judge this Courtyard!
reviews.body: I am ambassador so stay at marriotts a lot.  Have to say the meeting booking rooms here made me nervous.  BUT wow!  It was clean, the room got cold even when it was 109 out, a Starbucks on property AND my colleague left her diamond earrings on the nightstand and they were returned by housekeeping!!   Outstanding.  Close to broadway.

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.title: Not accomidating
reviews.body: This may be petty but I didn't get a traditional greeting and recognition of being a Titanium Elite.  That usually comes with a smile, a thank you, and maybe water or a snack bag.  The big issue came when we arrived back to our room for the evening.  The Thermostat was on 68 but the room temp was 74.  Called maitenance they came up and said it's running it will just take a while for it to cool down.  It didn't cool down hardly at all through the night.  Then at 11:30PM - 12:30AM they were doing construction with drilling and hammering.  This is where I got really upset.  I called down to the front desk that night told the front desk that this was going on.  He said that it shouldn't be long they had a water issue they needed to take care of and they should be done before midnight.  It continued after midnight.  I called back down, told them it was going on again.  The comment back to me was "They are working on 10 & 7  I don't know how you can here that".  Why not offer me another room or again apologize.  Don't chastise me with that comment.  Why would I be calling if I couldn't hear it?  Totally wrong and really put a sour taste in my mouth.  Given other options in downtown I will probably choose the Renassiance or the Sheraton when I would like to stay in that area.

reviews.author: Andy and Sally
reviews.title: Stay here!!! Great place near everything!!!
reviews.body: Staff is amazing! They go above and beyond!!!

reviews.author: Tbradyp
reviews.title: Great historic building and a short walk to the Ryman.
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay and the closeness to the Ryman Auditorium was perfect.  Everything we needed and wanted to see within a 2 - 3 block walk.  The history of the original building was amazing.

reviews.author: Chris O
reviews.title: Where to stay in Nashville hands down
reviews.body: Friendly staff and very clean hotel. I have stayed here twice now and will not have to look any further. Thank you to the staff.

reviews.author: Adventures
reviews.title: Sucky parking!
reviews.body: Valet parking was a nightmare!

reviews.author: Cousin Trip

reviews.body: As a Bonvoy member, the front desk did permit early check in and late check out which was very much appreciated! Our double queen room was clean, roomy and comfortable.  We appreciated the secure elevator access. The staff at the attached restaurant/bar were great although we just had drinks.

reviews.author: Family
reviews.title: Would not recommend.Charged extra fees for basic cleaning.
reviews.body: I've never been chard extra for cleaning a room $200 on top of reservation. Very disappointed as a long term bovoy customer.

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.title: Great location, Bad air conditioning.
reviews.body: The hotel staff was friendly, hotel was in a great, walkable location.  The big issue was the AC couldn’t keep up with the heat outside which made sleeping very uncomfortable.  I expect more from a brand name hotel which was definitely not an inexpensive stay.

reviews.author: Wanda
reviews.title: How was our stay!
reviews.body: Overall it was perfect!  Staff was very accommodating and hotel was very clean and in a great location!

reviews.author: Rob
reviews.title: Amazing location
reviews.body: Hotel is in an amazing location.  Convenient to all attractions.   Highly recommend staying here.   Only negative is $5 room charge for a bottle of water.   Just include a bottle of water

reviews.author: Bucket list Traveler
reviews.title: Marriott as always excels
reviews.body: Everything went perfectly the staff and the room

reviews.author: Buckeye Jen
reviews.title: Walking distance from Broadway Fun!
reviews.body: Great location. 3 minute walk to the Ryman, 4 minutes to Morgan Wallen's, and Broadway.  Clean rooms and great staff.  If you want to spend time at a pool, you need to visit another hotel and buy a resort pass (which was pricey).

reviews.author: Scott B
reviews.title: Enjoyed the visit.
reviews.body: We will come back. It was our second visit.

reviews.body: Great location, very nice room, and friendly staff!

reviews.title: concert

reviews.author: Emily P
reviews.title: Best stay in Nashville!
reviews.body: Rooms were clean and staff were friendly! Great location!!

reviews.author: Jamie C
reviews.title: Location, location, location
reviews.body: Great stay for a quick business trip. Within walking distance of great eateries and fun spots.

reviews.author: S Wheeler
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: I stayed just one night for a work event, but the experience was great, the room was nice and clean, the bed was super comfortable. Everyone was very nice from the valet to the desk clerks. Will definitely stay again.

reviews.author: Jeana

reviews.body: Had a great time in Nashville. Stayed at a perfect location at the Marriott courtyard on church and 4th.  Walking distance to all the Broadway street action yet far enough away to avoid the noise when it was time to relax.

reviews.author: SeanD
reviews.title: Great property
reviews.body: This courtyard was clean, comfortable, in a great location and loved that there was a Starbucks!

reviews.author: AW
reviews.title: Great service and location
reviews.body: Great service from the front desk  and bell hop

reviews.author: Ruegsegger1
reviews.title: Not impressive
reviews.body: You pay a hefty price for a bare minimum normal hotel room. Clearly MX outages and not resolved until after being called out. No amenities. No pool, hot tub, or complementary breakfast. Gotta do better to meet expectations

reviews.author: Betty
reviews.title: Wonderful stay for Fourth of July fireworks show
reviews.body: We chose the Marriott for the location to the Riverfront . It was perfect. Very convenient walk to Broadway for food . Staff was friendly and. The valet parking was very expensive but worth it for  the convenience on July 4th.

reviews.author: Dan W
reviews.title: Moxy Rules!
reviews.body: Moxy Nashville is the best!  Closest to Broadway and super clean.  Bar and live music are outstanding.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Way over priced
reviews.body: Room too small only one chair to set in and parking was awful

reviews.author: Marcelo
reviews.title: Always worth it!
reviews.body: The Moxy has been our favorite hotel in Nashville since we started coming. It's an excellent hotel, with a great staff. The location alone is worth it. Look forward to my return trip and stay in Nashville!

reviews.author: Archie
reviews.title: Moxy for a Nashville Broadway stay.
reviews.body:
The Moxy is a great location to Broadway in Nashville.  The staff is friendly, helpful and polite starting with the valet attendants to the bar/front desk persons and especially the 5th floor lounge experience.

I am not sure why the hotel staff does not recommend the 5th floor lounge but they did not mention this location once.  We found it on our own and highly recommend it for an evening of drinks and very good food.

reviews.author: Teri j
reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.body: Great location !!  The staff is wonderful!

reviews.author: Sharper1
reviews.title: Not Our Cup of Tea
reviews.body: Great location within walking distance to areas downtown, but the noise is unbearable. They provide a noise machine and ear plugs, but that does not help with the room and bed vibrating from the base from the bar across the street. Lasted until 130am. You check in at the bar. When we came back from our event, we had to walk through a crowd of drunk people standing in our hotel doorway just to get inside. Rooftop breakfast was delicious and the server was very friendly.

reviews.author: Valerie
reviews.title: Must stay at the Moxy
reviews.body: We loved our stay at Moxy Nashville Downtown\! The location is perfect, with Broadway, restaurants, bars, and live music just steps away\. Being able to walk everywhere made our trip even better\. We had an amazing time and can’t wait to come back\! Highly recommend\!

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: Returning visitor.  Always stay at the Moxy.
reviews.body: I will pick the Moxy time and time again strictly for the location. It might not be the cheapest it might be the loudest but the location can't be beat. Rooms are nice and cute with no frills but it's perfect for a short getaway in Nashville.

reviews.author: Trish Vintson
reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.body: Check in and out was easy, valet service was great, our room was clean and efficient. The hotel is in a great location to everything! Would definitely stay again and highly recommend to anyone going to Nashville.

reviews.author: VZE2
reviews.title: Rude staff, and rooms with no windows even if you paid for one with a window

reviews.body: Check in on Thursday the 23rd around 12 noon so I saw no reason for the staff to come clean my room on Friday nobody came around 12 noon we went out on the town came back around 3 PM ask the lady if she was gonna come clean our room she said yes went to go get something to eat. Came back in the room was still not clean. Went back down to the front desk told him about the situation and they said they’ll bring some new towels up did not bring any new towels up took a nap got ready around 9 PM I had to go down and get my own towels they told me that I would be first on the list for Saturday morning because we had the usher concert. We’re not got some breakfast at 10 AM nobody came came back 12 noon they said someone will be there here shortly but they wouldn’t clean if someone’s in a room so then again we left came back around 4 o’clock for the usher concert that started at seven and the room was still not cleaned that put my group at a real disadvantage that we could not have clean towels or clean room to get ready for this concert had to go down four separate times. The location is amazing it’s right next to Postee right next to all of the action but the bang for your buck no I don’t know if they were short staffed on cleaning staff but for the dollar amount that you pay I deserve to have someone at least come clean my room

reviews.author: WendyT
reviews.title: The Perfect Blend of History and Hospitality
reviews.body:
We had a wonderful stay at this beautifully restored historic train station hotel in downtown Nashville. The location couldn't have been better, right on Broadway and within walking distance of everything the area has to offer. Our room was spacious, with high ceilings and large windows overlooking Broadway. The design perfectly balanced the building's historic character with a warm, comfortable atmosphere, making it feel both elegant and inviting. One of the highlights of our stay was the hotel's self-guided history tour. It was a great way to learn about the building's past and appreciate the restoration work, although a few areas were inaccessible during our visit. The lobby was also a destination in itself, with multiple seating areas and classic games like Scrabble, checkers, and tic-tac-toe that encouraged guests to relax and enjoy the space. The restaurant was excellent, especially brunch. The blueberry pancakes were a standout and some of the best we've had.  We stayed on the sixth floor and often chose the stairs instead of the elevator just to take in the stunning open views of the lobby from each level. The only minor downside was the street noise at night from Broadway traffic. Since our room faced the main strip, we expected some noise, and it certainly wasn't enough to detract from our overall stay.

If you're looking for a hotel with character, history, great amenities, and an unbeatable location in Nashville, this is an excellent choice. We would absolutely stay here again!

reviews.author: itybity00
reviews.title: Beautiful Luxury Stay With a Few Disappointments
reviews.body:
We stayed at the JW Marriott Nashville while in town for the Louisville vs. Ole Miss football game, and overall we had an amazing stay. The hotel is beautiful, clean, luxurious, and in a fantastic location. We really enjoyed the atmosphere and would stay here again.

There were, however, a few disappointments that kept our stay from being rated Excellent. Our room had a stocked refrigerator/minibar, but there was no usable refrigerator space for our own drinks or food. At a luxury hotel, having some space available for guests to refrigerate personal items would be appreciated.

My partner also used the fitness center and found that several pieces of equipment were not working, which was disappointing for a property of this caliber.

The biggest concern was discovering that the door of our truck had been scratched while it was in the care of valet. That was extremely disappointing and unfortunately put a damper on an otherwise wonderful experience.

Despite these issues, we genuinely enjoyed our stay. The JW Marriott Nashville is a beautiful property with an excellent location and upscale atmosphere. With better attention to the fitness center, guest refrigeration needs, and especially vehicle care through valet, this easily could have been an Excellent stay.

reviews.author: B Iozzia
reviews.title: Absolute luxury in the heart of Music City—an unforgettable stay!
reviews.body:
My recent stay at the JW Marriott Nashville was nothing short of phenomenal. From the moment we pulled up, the valet and front desk teams went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, valued, and completely at home.  
The property itself is stunning—modern, impeccably clean, and dripping with high-end style. Our room was spacious, beautifully appointed, and offered breathtaking panoramic views of the Nashville skyline. It was the ultimate retreat after a busy day.  
The location couldn't be better. Situated just a short, easy walk from Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, and the best spots in downtown, it gave us the perfect balance of being right in the middle of the action while still offering a peaceful, upscale sanctuary to return to. We spent downtime enjoying the fantastic pool area, and the on-site dining and drink options were top-tier.  
True five-star hospitality from start to finish. If you are heading to Nashville, do yourself a favor and stay here. We can’t wait to come back!

Half the cardio equipment was not available for use, and there were no mats included in the fitness center.  This hotel felt like an average Marriott.  I have experienced better Marriott locations and other hotel brands.  I mentioned these items during my checkout and was told maintenance would be notified and “thank you for staying”.  A very disappointing stay when expecting luxury.

reviews.author: InternationallyKnown
reviews.title: Management 101
reviews.body:
My recent stay at the JW Marriott Nashville was excellent in many ways\. The hotel is beautiful, the rooms were clean and comfortable, and the staff throughout most of our visit were friendly and attentive\. Unfortunately, one interaction at the pool left a lasting negative impression and overshadowed what had otherwise been a great experience\.

On our second day at the pool, my fiancée and I were relaxing with a small portable speaker playing music at a low volume\. We had done the same thing the previous day without any staff member mentioning that it violated a policy\. We had also been at the pool for several hours that day, had multiple interactions with servers, and again, no one said anything about the speaker\.

Another guest approached me and asked if I could change the music or turn it off\. I politely told him I would change the music and lower the volume\. Instead of continuing the conversation with me, he went to speak with the manager\.

The manager came over and immediately told me the speaker had to be turned off because it was against hotel policy\. I respectfully explained that no one had mentioned this policy the day before or earlier that day, and I simply asked to see the policy since it wasn’t posted anywhere that I could find\. Rather than explaining the rule or showing me where it was documented, the manager walked away, called security, and never returned to speak with me\.

About 20 minutes later, security arrived\. I remained seated the entire time, never raised my voice, and never became confrontational\. During the conversation, the security officer told my fiancée that she needed to “control” me\. That comment was unnecessary, disrespectful, and completely inappropriate\. I responded that you control dogs, not grown adults, but otherwise remained calm and cooperative throughout the interaction\.

If portable speakers aren’t permitted at the pool, that’s completely understandable\. My issue wasn’t with the rule—it was with how it was enforced\. A simple explanation, a polite conversation, or even pointing out the policy would have resolved the situation immediately\. Escalating to security without first attempting to communicate effectively made us feel embarrassed and unfairly treated\.

I hope management reviews how situations like this are handled in the future\. Clear communication and respectful customer service go a long way, especially at a property that otherwise delivers the level of hospitality you’d expect from a JW Marriott.

reviews.author: TheArkansan
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel

Marriot in Nashville was a phenomenal experience for our first time in Nashville. Beautiful, well maintained and organized hotel. Loved the hotel staff that helped us, and any specific needs like a fridge added to the room. The valet service was fantastic and had our vehicle ready for us within 5-10 mins everytime we needed it.

Overall the experience was fantastic, though pool hours were a big confusion during our 3 night stay. Hours listed on website did not match actual pool hours on-site and the slightest rain can close the pool down much earlier for the rest of the evening. Bad luck for us.

I will definitely be recommending the JW Marriot in Nashville to everyone looking to visit Nashville. Very close to the convention center, litterally just across the street and within walking distance to Broadway as well for a night out in the town.

reviews.author: MS H
reviews.title: Holds placed on credit card
reviews.body: wasn’t at the Hotel for long. checked in maybe by 8pm checked out about 330 am the tfe next morning. I was told that a $50 hold would be placed on my credit card. I was staying there on points. I was okaywith the $50 hold. However, when I looked at my credit card a whole for $150 hold was on my credit card plus an additional $70 hold was on my credit card. I’ve already called Marriott to complain, but they’re asking for a review, so I’m giving one.. You’re being told that is just a hold, and that you will  get it back. That’s besides the point. Question is why was it taking in the first place. You have to watch your credit card because they’ll just put holds on there that you did not authorize.

reviews.author: Nashville19104
reviews.title: Great hotel !
reviews.body: The hotel experience was great. I felt at home and comfortable in my space. The breakfast was great and offer a great presentation. The staff was friendly and helpful. The location was only a few blocks from some of the main attractions and transportation. If you are ever in Nashville and you want to feel at home, please consider this hotel.

reviews.author: Tiltt
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.body: Excellent Customer service, and clean room

reviews.author: Thee I luv
reviews.title: JSU
reviews.body:
Great location, very clean 
Helpful staff

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: RAWK!
reviews.body: Five (5) Stars!  If you are a Marriot Bonvoy member and are going to NashVegas stay at Town Place.  DO IT!

reviews.author: Ahil
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Super friendly staff and close to the event we were in town for.

reviews.author: Allison
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: the hotel was fine overall. Main complaint is the noise from the hallways and the restaurant above us. Very noisy.

reviews.author: Dan77
reviews.title: Perfect place for a trip to Music City
reviews.body: We found the hotel to be very nice and comfortable. The bathroom was good, although I’m not a fan of sliding doors reducing privacy, but the shower was great. The gym facility on the 7th floor was more than adequate, with 4 treadmills, 2 elliptical machines and an exercise bike as well as two benches and free weights. Breakfast was very nice and ran through till 9:30. The free water dispenser and coffee facilities were much appreciated. No complaints; we’d highly recommend this for a stay in Nashville, being only a 15 to 20-minute walk to Broadway and less than 5 minutes from the Musicians Hall of Fame and the Farmers’ Market. As with everywhere in Nashville, parking is expensive at $45 per night but Uber, Lyft and Waymo are available.

reviews.author: LibrarianCSMplus2CEOs
reviews.title: Close & Short | Ladies Trip Review
reviews.body: We liked the location it was close to places by walking or a short uber ride. Staff was friendly and helpful. Room was nice size and had nice amenities. The ONLY that surprised us was how close the toilet seat was to the ground. 4 ladies height ranged from 5'4" to 5' 8" and we were all surprised. We would stay here again.

reviews.author: USAF Nashville
reviews.title: Nashville
reviews.body: Not the most appealing location but very close to pretty much everything.  Staff very nice.  Lost the car but other than that...great trip.

reviews.author: Karen
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.body: Perfect location for what we needed, very clean hotel and friendly and accommodating staff!

reviews.author: CGH529
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: Great Price and Great Hotel.  Perfect location to get anywhere you need. Spacious and clean rooms

reviews.author: Jayde
reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.body: The service at this hotel was great from the front desk to the bar service at the rooftop restaurant. Everyone was so nice and helpful. The room was comfortable, clean and quiet. My only complaint was the bathroom floor was always wet like something was leaking in there and when we got up late we got skipped for housekeeping for the day and they came back to clean our room at 6pm. We were out of the room from 11-5 but they came at 6 to clean. I found that inconvenient but overall I would stay again.

reviews.author: TB 2026
reviews.title: 0/10 Don't think I'll come back to this property
reviews.body:
During my stay, two major issues occurred:

Incompetent Billing & Out-of-State Financial Hardship: My reservation was booked using a corporate card intended for room charges and taxes. At check-in, I provided my personal debit card strictly for a $150 incidental hold. Front desk staff mistakenly charged the entire stay to my personal debit card. This direct debit drained personal funds, leaving me unable to properly provide for myself while out of state on travel.

Managerial Misconduct & Contradictory Information: When I approached the Branch Manager for assistance with the situation their error created, I was treated with total disrespect and told, "We don't give out free food." Not only was this response hostile and dismissive given that the property caused the financial tie-up, but it also directly contradicted what I was told at check-in: that guests receive a $10 daily restaurant credit.

While the debit charge was eventually reversed after my stay, being left without access to my funds in a different state and then demeaned by management when seeking help is completely unacceptable for the Marriott brand.

reviews.author: Robyn
reviews.title: Very nice suite
reviews.body: This was a very nice king suite. The view wasn’t spectacular because I was on the 1st floor. I could see the sidewalk and the bail bond building across the street. Check-in was easy and the staff was friendly. Upon entering the room it was warmer than I liked. I am unable to sleep when it’s hot so the first night was uncomfortable. The next morning I asked for a fan and the temperature wasn’t a problem after that. You get a hot breakfast everyday however the meat option was only sausage every day the week I was there. The shower pressure was amazing, the room was quiet, and I felt safe throughout my stay.

reviews.title: Nashville stay
reviews.body: The staff and the facility always meet my expectations.   I have never been disappointed.  I had been delayed leaving to head to Nashville and it was later in the evening when checking in.  When I arrived, the he front desk staff had me checked in and everything was ready.  Wonderful service.

reviews.author: Harry
reviews.title: Not for wheelchair users!
reviews.body: The hotel was nice, the room was clean and spacious, and the kitchenette was useful. But the parking is all the way around the building and the valet service out front doesn’t have a curb cutout for wheelchair access. It was extremely challenging for my family, which includes a wheelchair user,  to get inside with all of our luggage. We were able to manage it because there were 3 of us, but someone traveling solo might have a worse time of it. The coffee shop also has stairs from the lobby. We would have to go outside and around to access the coffee shop.

reviews.author: California tourist
reviews.title: close to everything
reviews.body: walking distance to many attractions, very quiet, lovely coffee bar & breakfast

reviews.author: Diesel Dave
reviews.title: What could’ve been a disaster for me?
reviews.body: The friendliness and knowledgeable staff made my 10 days go by quickly

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: This place was great and in a perfect location. Close to everything downtown! 9/10 hotel, and that is only due to having to pay for parking.

reviews.author: Amanda G
reviews.title: Three Day Conference
reviews.body: Stayed at TownePlace Suites by Marriott Nashville Downtown/Capitol District for a work conference. Everyone we encountered was very respectful and nice.  I will definitely be back for anything work or personal. It is located within walking distance to everything. The rooftop bar/restaurant was a huge bonus.

reviews.author: MannyG
reviews.title: A real find perfect place to stay during CMA Fest
reviews.body: This has been my second stay during CMA Fest and its perfect to get to everything within a reasonable time. The rooms are clean and i haven't had any issues with either of the ones i have stayed in. The reception area is welcoming and the on duty staff are helpful and knowledgeable about the area, i remembered some from last years trip so that`s got to be a good thing.If there was anything i could say to improve was the breakfast , just a couple of warm items the cheese Omlette was nice but adding some bacon and maybe fried eggs and beans or mushrooms would make it a better option for breakfast, although there was plenty of cereal and waffle makers and bread if you wanted an alternative.But all in all it is a well rounded hotel for an enjoyable stay.As long as your not requiring a pool the place is perfect, And if i decide to go to CMA Fest next year i will be looking to stay again.

reviews.author: Greg41
reviews.title: TownePlace Suites by Marriott Nashville Recommendation
reviews.body: TownePlace Suites by Marriott Nashville is well located within easy reach of all the attractions we wanted to see: The Musicians Hall of Fame, The Ryman, The Johnny Cash Museum and of course Music Row.  The valet parking made the surrounding construction a non-issue. The hotel amenities are useful, clean and well maintained. The staff is super friendly, competent and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: travelingfamily
reviews.title: Clean place to stay
reviews.body: Very clean place to stay with excellent breakfast. Not worth what we paid for the weekend... plenty of other hotels that are nice, clean and with a pool versus this hotel. Valet parking is advertised as the only option but they're parking in an open, public lot where we could've paid less and walked the short distance to get our own vehicle (versus the higher cost and longer wait).

reviews.author: Jules
reviews.title: I can’t wait to come back
reviews.body: Beautiful location / Wonderful Staff / safe & clean.

reviews.author: Happy Customer
reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.body: The Towne Place Suites in Nashville Downtown felt like a five star hotel.  The service was exemplary.  I can’t say enough about the location or the people.  Stay here—you won’t be disappointed

reviews.author: May2026
reviews.title: Poor food service
reviews.body: Poor food service and promise of free drinks, not true, only if you drink beer or wine. It was our anniversary and it put a damper on it.

reviews.author: Frequent Bonvoy Traveler
reviews.title: Excellent Choice for Nashville Experience
reviews.body: The Westin Nashville was an overall Excellent choice.  We will visit again in the future.

reviews.author: BKing
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: It was very clean and nice.

reviews.author: Bluth619
reviews.title: Best work trip
reviews.body: I recently stayed there for a Work summit and it was amazing. The staff was so friendly. The accommodations for the event were wonderful. They catered to us with whatever we needed. The food was amazing. The rooms are very spacious and the bathroom. I loved the rain shower in there. The location of the hotel is perfect to town whether you wanna walk or take an Uber. It’s not far. I also like the area itself. It does feel somewhat quiet and safe. I just think that it was a great hotel to stay in. Overall experience was a 10 out of 10 we enjoyed the rooftop pool so much. It gave great views of the city. I would highly recommend this to a friend and I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Hannah D
reviews.title: Best traveler hotel in a busy city
reviews.body: The Westin offered me the ability to keep my at home habits, while I was traveling on the road for work for multiple days. Having such a large comfortable room, truly made the experience so much more enjoyable after a long day of work! I used many resources on-site: restaurant, steakhouse, in-room meals, gym, pool. Everything was top notch and clean! I would recommend this hotel to anyone - traveling for work or pleasure.

reviews.author: Regional Meeting
reviews.title: Corporate Meeting
reviews.body: The Westin is the one stop shop for that luxury feel on a business stay. The rooms are clean, comfortable, and feel 5 star. The meeting rooms have jaw dropping views and offer attentive staff and an array of healthy options to keep you fueled during meetings. The stay overall was 10/10. My company sent a package that we thought was lost, but the GM and the front desk worked hard to track it down. Additionally, the Westin is a stone's throw from all the action on Broadway, a great way to blow off some steam after long days in meetings!

reviews.author: Disappointed Bonvoy Elite
reviews.title: More like a Budget Inn
reviews.body: The service at this hotel is definitely not what is expected at a Westin. A management refresh is called for - from check-in to check-out the service was abysmal. With so many options, look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Rosye
reviews.title: Great location but not for family
reviews.body: Rooms were spacious and lobby was great. However, do not recommend for family. The pool on the 27th floor was dirty, looked cloudy both days we were there and is very small. Pool closes at 6pm on 27th floor. Lots of traffic both nights, lobby and elevators delays and loud. The food was okay, location was great, beds were comfortable and we like the fact that floor was not carpeted.

reviews.author: Welcome to Nashville
reviews.title: Welcome to Nashville
reviews.body:
The city is so clean and pretty with so many different things to offer as far as entertainment is concerned. And the Westin
never disappoints is my favorite hotel under the Marriott umbrella.

reviews.author: Mandy
reviews.title: Comfortable luxury
reviews.body: The decor and design were amazing and modern. Our stay was comfortable and luxurious. Amazing views of downtown. Fridge is pre filled with room service items so plan accordingly.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: We LOVED The Westin Nashville
reviews.body: From the moment we walked into the beautiful lobby to the moment we (sadly) checked out, everything was perfect.  Our room and the entire place were so well cleaned and maintained.  The staff from the front desk to the housekeeping and the valet, were all so nice and accommodating.  Mind you, we never even used the valet service, yet were always asked if there was anything we needed as we waited for our Uber.

reviews.author: Monica B
reviews.title: Wonderful get away
reviews.body: Walking distance from many great venues. The hotel is very clean, smells great and had great service.

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.title: HORRIBLE ROOM SERVICE !!
reviews.body: WORST ROOM SERVICE I HAVE EVER HAD !!

reviews.author: Mverv34567
reviews.title: Average experience
reviews.body: Clean and good location. Staff was mixed. Had several issues with service and being ignored on the rooftop. Had to complain a few times for minor things and that was waste of time.

reviews.author: C Short
reviews.title: The Westin never disappoints!
reviews.body: Loved and enjoyed my stay at the Westin!

reviews.author: Ok enough gal
reviews.title: Slow service. Nice people
reviews.body: Ok enough- conference good had no vegetarian options

reviews.author: Rocky56
reviews.title: A less than expected experience...
reviews.body: Nice quiet, clean, modern room with nice pillows.  Good restaurants yet disappointed with the guest problem-solving abilities of the young front desk.  For example, they seemed confused when on discovering there was no business office that I would request that they print off a couple of pages I needed for my conference presentation.  Instead they fumbled a bit and then sent me over to the JW Marriott. Then again confused as to where I could find a rental car agency.  Nice lobby and water bottle fill up station...

reviews.author: Elite 1957
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.body: Our stay was beyond words, it was just perfect.

reviews.author: Sean m
reviews.title: Nashville trip
reviews.body: Hotel and staff were good. The Pool area was not what anticipated.

reviews.author: Loraine88
reviews.title: Wonderful stay at the Westin
reviews.body:
The Westin was a very nice hotel stay. The hotel staff were very friendly and kind. The hotel was very clean and nice. The food and room service was top notch.
We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: mmcbride
reviews.title: Value for the Points
reviews.body: I stopped in Nashville during a long roadtrip. I stayed for less than 12 hours but the food and ammenities helped me feel fresh.

reviews.author: WestbankNolaGirl 62
reviews.title: Just for Me
reviews.body: When doing my hotel search for my Nashville trip I kept returning to the Westin Web site and I'm glad I did. The Westin did not disappoint. This was truly my home away from home.Comfort, serinity and luxury all in one.

reviews.author: Angela 24
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.body: Excellent stay. Spa was amazing. Great anniversary trip.

reviews.author: Jolinda
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!
reviews.body: We stayed for a business trip and everything was wonderful!

reviews.author: Kentucky Traveler
reviews.title: Beautiful downtown hotel
reviews.body: Excellent facility and staff.  The only downside to this property is the small pool on the rooftop.  If you're looking for a large pool during summer months, you might want to consider another property.  But the fitness area is excellent, my wife enjoyed the spa. and the restaurants were great.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: An Unfortunate Westin Experience
reviews.body:
My stay at The Westin Nashville was, by far, my worst experience at a Westin property, and one of the most disappointing Marriott stays I have had.

I want to acknowledge that there were individual staff members who were kind and helpful, including Takunda at the front desk and Angela and Gillian at the rooftop. I appreciated their hospitality. Unfortunately, those positive interactions could not overcome the larger service issues I experienced throughout my stay.

There was an extreme lack of urgency across the property. As a partner hotel for a major convention, the hotel should have been prepared for the volume of guests. Instead, lines to check in or simply receive assistance from the front desk were frequently lengthy. At one point, I watched another guest spend hours trying to retrieve a package from the mailroom. Basic requests seemed to require repeated follow-up.

My housekeeping experience was particularly unacceptable. I returned to my room multiple times to find that it had not been serviced as expected, and when it was serviced, the attention to detail was severely lacking. Used washcloths were left in the bathroom of what was supposedly a cleaned room. A robe was left on a table in the living area rather than returned to its hanger (let alone the fact it was never there to begin with). These may sound like small details individually, but when they happen alongside repeated service failures, they speak to a much larger issue with standards and quality control. I had minimal time in my room and the time spent, left me to be frustrated.

The most frustrating part was reaching a point where I no longer trusted what I was being told by staff because promises and assurances repeatedly did not match what actually happened. A hotel stay should never reach that point.

I am a Titanium Elite Marriott Bonvoy member, but status really should not matter here. Clean rooms, responsive service and reasonable follow-through are baseline expectations for every guest, particularly at a Westin property.

I could have stayed at the Omni for this trip. I purposefully chose The Westin Nashville because of my loyalty to Marriott and my previous experiences with the Westin brand. Unfortunately, that decision was a grave mistake.

I appreciate the individual employees who did their best to provide good service, but overall, there was far too much left to be desired. This property did not meet the standard I associate with Westin or Marriott, and I would have a very difficult time choosing to stay here again.

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.body: My family and friends absolutely loved our stay and would absolutely return if we go back to Nashville soon.

reviews.author: Khalif
reviews.title: One Bad Apple
reviews.body: The overall service was good. There was one server in the upper deck lounge area that was rude. She was on the younger side and I forgot her name. The other issue was the housekeeping would take my 1 washcloth and never replace it. I had to call everyday for a new washcloth.

reviews.author: Elizabeth
reviews.title: Mediocre, pool isn’t great
reviews.body:
The pool is tiny and only has 6 bounce chairs that are in the shade.  The daybeds are like $300 / day and the pool area in general is just extremely lame and poor service in the L27 bar.  Very low energy scene.

The beds are comfortable and rooms are pretty nice.  

Good location.

reviews.author: Brian Tate
reviews.title: My Stay
reviews.body: Top tier service. It’s always a pleasure.

reviews.author: Jp86
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.body: My wife and I I came for our anniversary. The hotel was taken over by a car club. They were allowed to effectively have the run of the hotel. At one point one of them left their car with its hazards on blocking the entirety of the valet for about half an hour. Nothing was done about it at the time.
