Once we finally made it back to our room something was thrown or dropped by a neighbor or fell off the wall. It shook our room so hard it activated the motion light in the bathroom.

reviews.author: Samthe3
reviews.title: Disappointing stay, especially for a Marriott Titanium member.
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at the SpringHill Suites by Marriott Nashville Downtown/Convention Center, and unfortunately, the level of service was not what I’ve come to expect from Marriott.

The biggest issue was the lack of consistent service. It was surprisingly difficult to get a drink or food, and at one point we had to move from one bar to another in the air-conditioned portion of the hotel just to find service.

The rooms could also use some updating. The biggest problem was the air conditioning. The unit blew cold air directly onto the person sleeping in the bed next to the window. One of the guys in our room was actually shivering, so I switched beds with him. Unfortunately, turning the AC down or off wasn’t really an option because the room quickly became extremely humid.

We also had to call the front desk several times to get fresh towels for our room, and the pool ran out of towels on both days of our stay. Those are basic things I would expect a hotel to be able to handle.

I do want to give credit to the breakfast staff. They were fantastic—friendly, attentive, and working incredibly hard to take care of everyone. They were easily the highlight of our stay.

Overall, I was disappointed. As a loyal Marriott Titanium member, I expected a better experience, particularly given the significant number of Bonvoy points I used for this stay. I don’t expect perfection, but I do expect reliable service, basic amenities, and a comfortable room. Hopefully management takes this feedback seriously, because there is definitely room for improvement.

reviews.author: LTTitanium
reviews.title: Below standard cleanliness in the room, front desk staff doesn't want to be there
reviews.body: FYI - bring water as they don't provide it to Bonvoy members like most places do. They said I could by their expensive water at the marketplace. Coffee was terrible. The rooms need a good deep clean. The front desk does not seem like they like their jobs and are very apathetic.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.body: Amazing stay, the room was clean and close to board way.Breakfast was good and gaby on staff went above and beyond. Also, the night staff at reception was amazing and went above and beyond for us special mention to Kiki.

reviews.author: Larry F
reviews.title: Spring Hill Average
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel friendly staff and close to downtown Broadway and many attractions. Was very disappointed in the breakfast quality as well as the guest seating at the large pool. They have more paid seating that nobody used leaving guests with no place to sit by the pool. Gym was a bit larger than most hotels.

reviews.author: Lisa Massachusetts
reviews.title: We had a great anniversary!
reviews.body: The hotel went above and beyond to make it special - thank you!

reviews.author: Indiana
reviews.title: Family girl’s trip
reviews.body: I absolutely loved the hotel. The only issue I had was that the pool turned very green and cloudy on Sunday so we declined using the pool. It was then closed until further notice on Monday so we couldn’t use it the one day we had planned on spending all day there. When I asked for some money off the room, the manager refused because I was not a Bonvoy member. I was very disappointed that we picked the hotel especially because of the pool then couldn’t use it 2 days of our stay. I feel some compensation should have been given when we were told on Monday at 10:30 that the pool would probably only be down 2 hours.

reviews.author: Ja Wa
reviews.title: Stinky and Dishonest
reviews.body: Place smelled of mildew and dirty mop water, room was super strong, paid for a king got a queen, $60 valet charge without telling me upfront, fridge wasn’t cold, ac sounded like a jet taking off.

reviews.author: Unhappy Visitor
reviews.title: Long Wait
reviews.body: We stood in line for 30 minutes to check in, and the air conditioning in the lobby area was insufficient (it was 90 degrees and humid outside). Nice staff, bad supply chain. And the price of the room was exorbitant.

reviews.author: Corporate Traveler
reviews.title: Poor experience with app and front desk
reviews.body: I arrived really early and figured my room wouldn’t be ready but went to the front desk anyway. I was met with disdain and told the app would notify me. My status was never acknowledged. I was told I could go downstairs and check my bag but chain was 4pm and IF a room was ready before then, I’d be notified on the app. At 4pm I finally Wendy back to the fri t desk to find myself in a line with a dozen others trying to check in, no notification from the app and ONE PERSON working the front desk. Upon checkout I received the same cold greeting and indifference.

reviews.author: Dr VonNostrus
reviews.title: Convenient location….but….
reviews.body:
Staying close to Broadway is a plus, but expect this location to be quite crowded due to convention guests or peak season travelers.  It wasn’t very spacious, elevator queue was frustratingly slow, pool area was overcrowded and bar/food line was always long.

All in all, I’d probably recommend another property that isn’t combined/shared with other properties like this one is.

reviews.author: Anonomous
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Staff is very friendly, located within 2 blocks of Broadway, beds are comfortable, rooms are spacious, good breakfast with basic options, great price, large pool area, and lots of options in the gym. Definitely would recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Long time Marriott guest
reviews.title: Long time Marriott guest
reviews.body: The hotel was clean and spacious. The check in by Jay was wonderful. She is a jewel that you should make sure you keep. However as a platinum elite for life member I expected a little more. Usually have bottled water in the room and sometimes snacks. Nothing here and our name on tv was wrong. Simple things but make you feel welcome. Overall I did not have complaints but disappointed in the welcome.

reviews.author: Ashley M
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel and location
reviews.body: A quick walk to so many things in Nashville. We loved the hotel itself and great pool area!

reviews.author: Pam B
reviews.title: Love SpringHill!
reviews.body: The gym has nice equipment and a great location next to pool with views of outdoor lounge and deck. The front desk made guests feel at ease with a very laid back approach while bar staff was super engaging, creating a fun atmosphere. The breakfast crew are super chill and hospitable also, so overall great staff. We didn't realize that we had to request housekeeping each night so had to try to communicate with the maid for towels hut they were super nice too! The Lyrics Lounge White Russian tasted amazing -top notch and their food menu was really good too! Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Hege
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body:
The Hotel has a very good location and nice rooms. Unfortunately the service was not that good. We booked a room for 3, but had to make the sofa bed ourselves, we also ordered some packages from Amazon which we tried to get out 3 times from the reception! 
We also had to ask for cleaning and new towels after 4 days.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.body: Building itself is very disorganized with check in, etc.  Breakfast was disappointing.  Sausage everyday.  It got sickening.  I guess waffle machine is out only during wkd?

reviews.author: Lester Couple
reviews.title: Great Stay in Nashville
reviews.body: Absolutely will stay here again.  The location is perfect!  The pool area was amazing!  Very clean, nice hotel.

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.body: The hotel was very clean, the staff was nice and the food was surprisingly good!  The pool and hot tub were great also.

reviews.author: TASS
reviews.title: Excellent value
reviews.body:
We did a friends birthday celebration for 3 nights.
Everything was fantastic, the location is @10 mins walk to all the tourist attractions.
The hotel was clean, breakfast was excellent and overall very safe.
We very much enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Rloe
reviews.title: Highly recommend staying here while in Nashville!
reviews.body: Myself and three friends stayed in a double room. There was even a trundle bed, which we did not have to use. the room was spacious, impeccably, clean with comfortable beds. The free breakfast in the morning was delicious and convenient.

reviews.author: Tom1223
reviews.title: Overpriced and Cramped
reviews.body: While the lobby and public spaces give the appearance of a comfortable, upscale hotel, the room and amenities are far from it. The rooms are cramped, uncomfortable and unimpressive. The only nice thing about the hotel is the location. Otherwise, you are smushed into a shoe box while you get overcharged for things like valet parking.

reviews.author: Philip
reviews.title: Unimpressed
reviews.body: Substandard breakfast buffet, no complimentary water and warm tap water, insecure room safe.

reviews.author: MTEE LLC
reviews.title: Recent Stay in Nashville
reviews.body: Its convenient to Broadway and the museums but was disapponted that no water bottles were given on check in nor in the room during the course of my stay. As a lifetime platinum elite member i look forward to being pampered when staying at a Marriott property

reviews.author: Bill O
reviews.title: Service
reviews.body: Outstanding service and support, great team

reviews.author: JHawkJim
reviews.title: Nice Staff and Accomodations but Awkward and Frustrating Logistics
reviews.body: This property is in the heart of downtown Nashville and is central to many of the attractions and the convention center with standard Marriott rooms which are well furnished, clean and comfortable.   However, the logistics of checking in were a little frustrating.    After two attempts to get our room key programmed to work, we eventually had to get maintenance to come up to room and see if it was a lock issue.   Maintenance did get the door to unlock to the dismay of the gentleman who was already occupying the room.   He was extremely upset and very awkward for us.   Staff was nice during this process and finally found a different room.    Their computer system should have known the room was occupied.   Our time at the pool was relaxing until I tried to order a beer from the bar and they could not serve me unless I had a drivers license or ID with birthdate.   How many people bring their ID to the pool?   This required trip back to the room to retrieve my DL this was another frustrating logistic.    I am 66 years old and I had to show an ID to check in.  That should be on the profile of my room number in which I was making the bar charge at pool.     I am a Platinum Bonvoy Member and have never had this happen before.   I hope they get these logistical things worked out so future guests do not have to be as frustrated.

reviews.author: B Liotta
reviews.title: Housekeeping is only by special request; free breakfast worth exactly what it costs.
reviews.body: I found it distasteful that the hotel puts the burden on the guest to phone in requests for even basic housekeeping. In other words, they don't provide any housekeeping services, regardless of the length of stay, unless you phone the front desk and request it. Absurd. The breakfast buffet featured cold eggs and sausage each morning. No thanks.

reviews.author: KandTinTX
reviews.title: Needs work, especially for the price
reviews.body:
I understand the hotel is in a good location of Mashville, but juice we got was not worth the squeeze they charged us for.  No daily
Room cleaning, room smelled foul and musty, lighting was dim and difficult to see, elevators were slow to operate and crowded. Breakfast service was poor, and staff never seemed to be happy to assist.

reviews.author: Tiff S
reviews.title: My New Nashville Home!
reviews.body: This place is GREAT! We did a quick 2 day trip, we last minute chose this place. Very quick walk to Broadway! And places along the walk. Very clean, great staff, even valet. We will always stay here when we come back!

reviews.author: Piper
reviews.title: Weekend stay for Hockey Game
reviews.body: The receptionist that checked me in was rude. Instead of handing me back my card, license, and room key she placed them on the counter. The refrigerator didn’t work. It wasn’t even plugged up. When I called they replaced it in a quick manner though. The microwave plate was the correct plate for that microwave. The bed didn’t even have fitted sheets on the bed. It only had flat sheets in place of fitted sheets and it didn’t cover the whole bed.  Besides that great location to be downtown everything is walking distance. Just very unprofessional

reviews.author: Family of Five
reviews.title: Great Location - Tight for a Family of 5
reviews.body: Location of this hotel is great - walkable to Broadway and a lot of other nearby attractions. We booked a "suite" with a daybed for our family of 5 to stay for 2 nights. We found it to be a very tight fit. The pictures online make the room look a lot more spacious that it is. The biggest complaint was the lack of privacy in the restroom. It had a frosted glass sliding barn door that did not lock. Anytime someone used the restroom at night, the light from the bathroom lit up the entire room. It would be fine for a single or a couple, but was not comfortable for our family.

reviews.author: Laura Slats 33
reviews.title: A Wonderful Stay in Nashville
reviews.body: Great hotel, rooms are nice, beds comfortable, staff friendly and close to downtown.  My favorite is the pool, and rooftop bar! Perfect location to walk to Broadway, and see a football game, along with many other Nashville sights.

reviews.author: Lifetime Elite Member
reviews.title: Fantastic professional staff that understand hospitality…well almost everyone.
reviews.body:
What initially threatened to be a disastrous stay due to unforeseen room issues was entirely salvaged by the staff’s exceptional hospitality. As a Bonvoy Elite member for over a decade, I have experienced the full spectrum of hotel operations, as well as the myriad ways management can choose to handle unpleasant scenarios. 

The front desk team at the AC—particularly Rose—were some of the kindest, most well-trained agents I have had the pleasure of interacting with in my ten years of travel. They deserve immense praise for resolving the issue efficiently and standing by their word.

The only less-than-shining star of the experience was Casey Ann at the pool bar, whose unique approach to hospitality suggests she may be better suited for a career that does not involve interacting with the public. Every encounter was met with a baffling level of attitude and combative conversation. Fortunately, the daytime gentlemen were an absolute delight, and the service at the pool itself was fantastic.

All in all, what could easily have been a 1 out of 10 stay was elevated to a 10 out of 10, purely thanks to the incredible staff. The corner balcony suite was also amazing. Thank you again for making everything right; we truly look forward to returning.

reviews.author: JLK 3321
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body: Hotel location very convenient. Check in and check out process very smooth and in a timely manner. Staff go above and beyond to make sure your state is excellent. All amenities were excellent. Rooftop bar has amazing views. Very clean and well maintained. Price was good for the location. Would definitely recommend staying.

reviews.author: Canadianagal
reviews.title: Pool Closed for Maintenance
reviews.body: When you are taking a special trip somewhere for the first time, you research all of your options and make a decision based on your personal wants and needs. What was most important to us was an outdoor pool. While I can appreciate that all things need maintenance and certain things are unpredictable, nothing could have been more disappointing than the closure of the pool for our entire vacation. Coupled with management’s complete disregard for said disappointment left a sour taste in what was otherwise a great trip in the best city!

reviews.author: Family Traveler
reviews.title: Everything was great but the bartender
reviews.body:
Hello,

I'm not writing this review to be published and shame, I want this to be read by a manager and potentially offer a response.  My wife, son and I stayed at your facility the evening of August 13th on our way back to Chicago from dropping our daughter at college in Fort Lauderdale.  I share as context is important to understand the goals of our trip as this wasn't a party trip with a group of crazy folks looking to let their hair down.  It was a wife and husband trying to enjoy some family time after an important milestone in our lives.  

The evening we arrived, we went out to dinner and walked downtown before returning around 9:30pm so our son could swim before the pool closed.  Around 9:45pm, I came downstairs to meet up with my wife and son and learned that the pool bar was closed.  I went to the lobby bar where there was one person sitting at the bar and one person waiting for their drink.  I patiently waited and when it was my turn, I was told that I needed an ID to order a drink in TN.  I was annoyed but certainly didn't say anything rude to the bartender, Casey Ann.  She said it in such a fashion that I found it to be extremely rude and indignant.  So much, in fact, that I immediately went to the front desk and told the young lady that was working how upset I was at Casey Ann's rude demeanor.  After getting my license in my room, I ended up coming back to the lobby bar to order a drink and the bartender immediately read my frustrated and annoyed look and began be telling me that it was state law and it wasn't her decision.  I told her the issue wasn't getting my license, it was the rude attitude she treated me.  Knowing that arguing could only cause more issue, I kept my mouth shut while she proceeded to lecture me about how she can do whatever she wants and deny me service if she wanted.  And how she wasn't being rude to me and she can't help if I take it personally and don't like it.  I responded by telling her that I wasn't going to debate with her and run the risk of her not serving me. Ultimately, she felt that my attitude wasn't appropriate and she refused service.  

I want to reiterate that I had only a few drinks that evening over the course of a few hours and I certainly wasn't under any influence nor was I belligerent or argumentative.  Ironically, she felt that she didn't like the customers' attitude and decided that I wasn't worthy of her efforts.  I understand that there are times when a bartender has to make those decisions and I didn't argue one bit when she did refuse me service.  I would encourage you to review the video and watch/listen to the conversation to corroborate my story as I understand that her perspective will sound quite different than mine.  I did absolutely nothing wrong and was treated with more disrespect than anyone has shown me in a long time.  

I wouldn't expect this out of a Motel 6, much less a high end hotel that I splurged on with my hard earned money.  We're not some rich family that does this all the time - it was a big deal for us and she ruined my night and the rest of my trip as I was distraught by her behavior.  I'll add that I ended up coming back down a little later in the evening to grab snacks with my son and Stephanie (I believe that's her name) at the front desk was phenomenal in listening to me and even gave us a late checkout so we could explore more the next day.  She was so kind and a great listener.  I would also encourage you to ask her if she remembers me and if so, her interpretation of my state of mind and behavior.  

Ultimately, I'd appreciate a response from hotel management but am certainly not demanding anything.  The timeframe for my visits to the bar would likely be in the 9:50pm - 10:10pm window.  Thank you for taking the time to read.

reviews.author: Jstef
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.body: Great amenities and location! Staff was very friendly and accommodating.

reviews.author: MzV24
reviews.title: Just Do It!
reviews.body: This was our first time in Nashville and at this hotel brand and Neither Owes Us A Thing!! From the moment we walked in I knew I had made the correct decision! This hotel is very upscale, clean, smells amazing and the absolute Perfect location!! I picked this hotel online not knowing it was perfect for us first timers! We literally walked out the door and down a block to Broadway where Everything is happening! If you’re on the fence, Just Do It!! You won’t be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Stacey Woiderski
reviews.title: 25th Anniversary
reviews.body: My husband & I stayed here for 4 nights with a corner balcony room. It was beautiful, clean and the staff was amazing! Had food by the pool in the bar area on night, excellent & fresh.

reviews.author: Buckley
reviews.title: My Pillow Experience
reviews.body: Everything about the hotel was good but there’s only one complaint that I have, those pillows was the worst ever they were as flat as could be the next time I visit your hotel I will bring my own pillows and I advise everyone else to do the same unless you love flat pillows.

reviews.author: FamilyVaca
reviews.title: Must stay hotel in Nashville
reviews.body: Best location! Clean rooms with amazing comfortable beds! Easy walk to Broadway and other great eating places. Parking both in the hotel and across the street. Friendly staff.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Clean hotel, horrible service, horrible food.
reviews.body:
When we checked in the service was impeccable.   My wife and I are frequent travelers and staying in hotel hotels at least 5 to 10 nights a month.    The front desk was really accommodating when we checked in.     The breakfast service was horrible, multiple people that were also in the hotel had to keep getting up and ordering food.  It’s like they didn’t know what they were doing.   Each of us ordered eggs and bacon, and it came out not as we wanted very salty and the bacon was obviously pre-cooked and just thrown out of a pan.    They ran out of coffee and told us we could go to the bar and get it.    Let me remind you that we’re a lot of people just standing around that work there.      
Pool bar staff needs to get a serious attitude adjustment everyone was sharp tongue, very rude.  While waiting in mind for drinks, people felt like they were being held prisoner and that they were going to be demeaned when they got up to the bar.    Very disappointing.    We were happy with the location and we are both Marriott members.    We will not be visiting this hotel again.

reviews.author: jjmarsh1994
reviews.title: Room dirty and bed was like a concrete slab
reviews.body: Staff unfriendly. There was no one in valet to help my husband and I’m in a wheelchair. Will not return.

reviews.author: Welling
reviews.title: Ok stay
reviews.body: The cable TV and wifi lagged so much that they basically did not work. The sliding glass door to the bathroom was difficult to use. No microwave and the fridge was not very cold. The pool is lovely but the room was just ok.

reviews.author: Doug56
reviews.title: AC
reviews.body: High Priced for quality of bedding and noise.

reviews.author: Nick2026
reviews.title: Quality room. Loud AC.
reviews.body: Comfortable bed, good bathroom, pool looked nice. Super loud AC. Had to wear ear plugs because of this. Requested room service but it never came.

reviews.author: Recent Stay
reviews.title: AC Nashville
reviews.body: I was disappointed with housekeeping, I had asked for daily room cleaning between 11-2pm. The room was only cleaned once.

reviews.author: Fun traveling people
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: We really enjoyed staying at this hotel. The location is very convenient to everything and the hotel was very clean and very comfortable. We will stay there again

reviews.author: DB 88
reviews.title: Our stay at the Downtown AC Marriott on our first trip to Nashville
reviews.body: Terrific place to stay if you want to explore Nashville by feet or uber or taxi..,

reviews.author: Azplumber
reviews.title: Nashville stay
reviews.body: Good hotel sorry food choices, bars closed way to early

reviews.author: LinglingZ
reviews.title: Great Downtown Location and Fun Nashville Stay
reviews.body: Great location in downtown Nashville, very convenient for walking to Broadway and enjoying the live music scene. The hotel was clean, modern, and comfortable. We had a fun and pleasant stay. The only minor issue was that the WiFi login process was a little inconvenient.

reviews.author: MWATTS
reviews.title: 7th Floor is not a High Floor
reviews.body:
Front desk staff needs to pay closer attention to details. We booked and paid floor a higher floor room. We did not get a higher floor. Our room was directly above front desk and the patio. We were also placed across from the elevators. 
I would have requested to move rooms but I had already used the room and thought it could not be as bad as it was.  I was trying to give benefit of doubt.

reviews.author: NHR18
reviews.title: Great Stay!!
reviews.body: Perfect location, nice property and great Staff

reviews.author: I was here
reviews.title: A bit disappointed
reviews.body:
There were many things that could have been improved upon with this stay.  I was there for a conference from Sunday-Tuesday, and the hotel knew that all these people would be arriving yet only had one person at the front desk for check in, causing a line of over 20 people to check in which took forever.  I also had issues with my room and a few other items.
It is a beautiful hotel and pretty convenient to everything, but overall, I was not impressed.

reviews.author: Sleepless in Nashville
reviews.title: clean, contemporary hotel with attentive front desk staff but VERY noisy rooms.
reviews.body: The street noise over night from sirens and vehicles blaring loud music is incredibly excessive. It woke us up every night, repeatedly, and we were way up on the 19th floor. The building appears to have ZERO sound proofing.

reviews.author: mjt418
reviews.title: Glass Bathroom Door Shattered After Reported Safety Concern
reviews.body:
We stayed at this Marriott property in Nashville from April 30–May 3 for a wedding, and unfortunately our experience included serious safety and maintenance issues.

When we arrived, the glass bathroom door in our room appeared improperly secured and off its hinges. We reported it to staff right away because we were concerned it could fall. Maintenance later attempted a repair, but on our final night, the door shattered during normal use when my fiancé opened it. He suffered multiple cuts to his feet and was actively bleeding, requiring paramedics to come to the room.

The incident was traumatic and preventable, especially because the hotel had already been notified of the issue. Staff took 30–45 minutes to clean up the broken glass, during which we could not safely leave the room. By the time we were moved to another room, it was nearly 1:00 a.m., causing us to miss the rest of the wedding evening and forcing us to change our 6:00 a.m. flight.

There were also other maintenance concerns during our stay, including water spreading across the bathroom floor from the accessible shower and lighting fixtures that appeared to be held up with tape.

After everything that happened, the hotel offered only 20,000 Bonvoy points, which felt completely inadequate given the injury, emergency response, disruption, and safety concerns. This was not the safe, well-maintained experience we expected from Marriott, especially at a premium rate. We are extremely disappointed and believe the hotel needs to seriously review its maintenance and guest safety practices.

reviews.author: mecollein7
reviews.title: Weekend stay
reviews.body: Disappointed- I stay at Marriott’s frequently and was let down by this experience

reviews.title: Amazing Establishment
reviews.body: The hotel was amazing. Great customer service, decor was beautiful. The food was amazing especially the buffalo chicken wrap. My favorite drink was the strawberry daiquiri, relaxing by the pool. Quiet and pleasant. The area is downtown Nashville and everything was walkable.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.title: Just an “OK” stay
reviews.body: Breakfast is an absolute joke. $18 for a very lacking “buffet” that comes with a very light thing that you order. Also I didn’t receive credit for me stay because the Folio showed “Guest” and not my Marriott number even though I booked under my Marriott number through the app. I then had to submit a missing stay which when you travel weekly, is not the easiest to keep up with. Hotel itself was nice, just really lacked amenities, especially for premium, Titanium in my case, members.

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: No customer service
reviews.body:
Our experience at the Marriott in Nashville was unfortunately disappointing from start to finish.
We arrived early on our first day and understood that our room might not be ready, but the front desk told us they would notify us when it became available. That never happened. We spent time by the pool and ordered a buffalo chicken wrap, which was underwhelming—the chicken was chewy and looked like low-quality cuts you wouldn’t expect to be served.
Check-in was guaranteed at 4 PM, yet when we returned at that time, our room still wasn’t ready. We were told to wait, which we did patiently, checking back multiple times—at 5 PM, 5:30 PM, and again shortly after 6 PM. Each time, we were told we would be contacted, but no one ever reached out. We only found out the room was ready because we kept asking, which added unnecessary stress since we had plans that evening.
Food quality continued to be an issue during our stay. A couple of days later, we ordered wings by the pool, and they were undercooked and rubbery—again falling short of expectations.
The service inconsistencies extended to our checkout experience as well. We requested a late checkout two days in advance and were told to ask again the day before. When we did, we were told to come back the day of. We made a point to ask early that morning to improve our chances, only to be denied without much flexibility or consideration.
Overall, throughout our five-day stay, we never felt valued as Marriott guests. The lack of communication, inconsistent service, and poor food quality made this an experience we wouldn’t choose to repeat.

Might want to consider the Red Roof Inn  over this next time.

reviews.author: Visit From ATL
reviews.title: Great Room and Amenities. Poor Service: Valet and Front Desk
reviews.body: The valet service if you can call it that was 50/50. At check-in the valet had a bad attitude and didn't even offer to put our bags on the luggage cart. The evening valet staff were much more professional. The front desk staff at check-in was unprofessional and difficult. However, the rooms and amenities are great.

reviews.author: Adiós 26
reviews.title: Poor quality, worst service, no food choices.
reviews.body: No employees available for service during 4 days stay. The draperies were broken; bad fragrances in linens; restaurant food quality was not good.

reviews.author: klertz
reviews.title: Perfect place to stay in Nashville
reviews.body: The location is perfect for a short walk to Broadway

reviews.author: Donna B
reviews.title: Nashville and Grand Ole Opry fun!
reviews.body: Excellent customer service and great location for walking to Broadway and most locations.  Breakfast was very good and enjoyed pool and hot tub many times!  Room was very large and very accommodating for our 3 day stay.

reviews.author: Bella
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.body: Came here with my boyfriend, bestfriend and her boyfriend and we had a great stay! Any time we needed more towels or toilet paper we got them so fast, the staff was so friendly and welcoming and the room was in perfect condition! Had no complaints and i would so come back to this location!

reviews.author: CanadianMCrmy
reviews.title: Perfect suite for concert vacation
reviews.body: Travelled from western Canada for a concert and then stay for tourist fun. The suite allowed us to have our own meals when needed. The amenities are fabulous and the staff were always friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Corey Jack
reviews.title: The Residence Inn Stay
reviews.body: If you are coming to Nashville,TN stay at the Residence Inn downtown it’s in the heart of everything. You won’t be disappointed

reviews.author: Briah
reviews.title: Stay here!!!
reviews.body: Fantastic value for being right downtown! Close to everything- save on Ubers and parking. Rooms are SO comfortable, spacious and clean!

reviews.author: Ms84
reviews.title: Concert Stay
reviews.body: I stayed here for a concert at Bridgestone. It was a convenient location to walk to the venue. The room was perfect and spacious. The staff was very friendly.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Vacationing
reviews.body: We went to Nashville for vacation. We chose this location as it was in the heart of the city and I loved that the hotel had everything. We stayed in a king suite

reviews.author: Gabriel
reviews.title: T
reviews.body: Need cheap prices or deals

reviews.author: Grandpa
reviews.title: Took the Grandkids to Nashville
reviews.body: First trip to Nashville with our grandkids and loved the 2 bedroom suite, rather than the connecting rooms offered by other brands.   Room was well furnished.  Staff was great.  Some issues with an understaffed front desk made talking to a real person challenging, but we worked around it.   Grandkids loved the pool.   Entry through the parking garage was a little strange.

reviews.author: Ivebeeneverywhere
reviews.title: Great location without the drama
reviews.body: Great hotel for convention center and without the drama of the typical Nashville visitors

reviews.author: Christian C
reviews.title: Location, Clean, Friendly Staff
reviews.body: Location is in the mix but easy to get in and out of. All staff was helpful and friendly. Breakfast was great. Cesar salad wrap at bar was great. Room was clean.

reviews.author: Ladies Trip Done Right
reviews.title: Would Recommend!
reviews.body: This is the third time I have visited Nashville and the first time I have stayed downtown. The hotel was clean, updated, and in a prime location for everything we wanted to experience on this trip! The pool was incredible, large, and fun! It had a DJ, pool floats, and an overall fun vibe. Our Deluxe King Suite was beautiful, spacious, clean, and updated. I would 100% recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Isabella
reviews.title: Excellent weekend getaway
reviews.body: I stayed at Residence Inn because my friends were staying across the street at Margaritaville for a bachelorette party. I wanted the points, so I stayed here. The room was very spacious and clean. Kitchen was well stocked. The shower could be stronger, but it definitely was not weak. Amenities were great! Pool can get crowded because it serves three hotels. The gym has some nice varieties of machines, weights, and other apparatus. Machines were not too dated. Other useful amenities is a washer and dryer room. There’s a mini store near the front desk that sells basic necessities and the front desk can exchange cash for coins (since the machines use coins only). Another great amenity is the breakfast buffet. It’s well stocked with a wide variety and selection of food and beverages! It can get crowded, but the tables turn often so you can get a seat. The location of this hotel is perfect. It’s far enough from the craziness so it’s quiet. But it’s close enough to Broadway; it’s about a 5-10 minute walk. The only thing I didn’t like about this hotel is that they could use more elevators. There’s only three servicing 21 floors so it can take some time to come. Overall, I would stay here again!

reviews.author: Gigi Godinez
reviews.title: Slow recepcionist
reviews.body: The late-night staff was slow and took like 30 minutes to check in for 2 rooms.

reviews.author: Tenney
reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.body: Hotel not worth the cost. Elevators took forever. Tv didn’t work. Carpet was soaked. Got put in a hearing impaired room next to a service room. Breakfast supposed to end at 11 but ended 10am

reviews.author: AH5687
reviews.title: Unaccommodating and Loyalty is Not Valued
reviews.body: The suite that I purchased months prior to the stay was overbooked and they gave me the wrong rooms several times at check in. Gave me an accessible room which I did not need nor want. Front desk staff did not honor my late checkout privileges given my Silver Elite loyalty status and did not want to accommodate a late check out by more than a mere 30 minutes. Inattentive and unkind front desk staff. Will never purchase a stay here again. There were no complimentary water bottles or no kind gestures to show they value customers. For this price, I will much rather stay at another competing hotel nearby in the city and receive better treatment and satisfaction for the price paid.

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.title: Concert trip
reviews.body: Rooms were great with full kitchen and living area. Very clean and comfy. Staff was super friendly and the valet was awesome

reviews.author: MJpost
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.body: Asked for housekeeping on arrival and two times after.  Received no housekeeping during four night stay. One key was improperly coded and was not fixed after two attempts

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.title: Wonderful Amenities, convenient location
reviews.body: I stayed at Residence Inn by Marriott Nashville Downtown/Convention Center for a conference. I was pleasantly surprised with the amount of amenities included in this type of property. Breakfast was delicious and well maintained. Pool was the perfect way to end long day. Room was clean and spacious.

reviews.author: CH927
reviews.title: Clean and close to Broadway
reviews.body: Had a great stay.  Room was nice, clean and comfortable.  Great for families.  Close to Broadway, Arena and Nissan Stadium.   Breakfast was good.  Will definitely stay again.

reviews.author: Amanda Ford
reviews.title: Its worth it
reviews.body: The location is great.  Walking distance to Broadway is not bad at all.  Area felt safe. Staff is great.

reviews.author: Wesley
reviews.title: Great room but inadequate staffing
reviews.body:
The room was first class.  The staff was quite friendly.  The restaurant food was very good.  The included breakfast was OK - if you want to eat outside be aware that it is difficult to get the door open while holding food.  We noticed most people spilling drinks as they tried to turn the handle and pull the door to get out.  
The front desk staffing was inadequate.  This resulted in long lines and non-answering of my direct phone call when assistance was needed.  Be aware if you are confirmed with a late checkout time, you must have your card re-activated to reflect the late departure time.  They failed to tell us that we need to update the card, thus we were locked out of the room and elevators.

reviews.author: Wee Mosey
reviews.title: Nashville 2026
reviews.body: All great. Great service great staff. Great location.

reviews.author: JJPcheers
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: We stay here often. The location is great to walk to all things downtown. The beds are comfortable and the rooms are always up to date and clean. The rooftop bar is nice as well as Hal’s steakhouse for an upscale meal.

reviews.author: NJ Traveler
reviews.title: Could have been great
reviews.body: Housekeeping did not show up on any day of my stay despite my asks and reminders to do so. Coming back to the room at 4 and 5pm after a long, hot Nashville day to a room that looked the way we left or at 10 am is a concern.

reviews.author: Racheal
reviews.title: Great Hotel minor improvements
reviews.body: Great hotel, needs to improve response time to customer via phone, more staff at front desk, less scent in the lobby and main area. Better breakfast would be great. Overall very clean, great location-and well maintained

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Downtown stay
reviews.body: Second time staying here. Great location, close to everything. Homeless are around outside, asking for change and cigarettes, but it's public space, so....There is security at the pool, although we had two children approach us at the pool asking to buy them food. Overall, a good stay.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.body: Outstanding experience - perfect location - supreme comfort

reviews.author: North Georgia Ramblers
reviews.title: Great Local for Exploring Downtown Nashville
reviews.body:
This was our first at the Joseph, and it was a wonderful local to walk to the Bridgestone, Country Hall of Fame museum, Broadway and many other downtown locals.
Our suite was well appointed and comfortable.
We met many helpful employees, that made our experiences enjoyable. Breakfast everyday morning was excellent, no need to adventure out to find great food and service. The bar, food and pool area at the top was delightful and the view of the area was great.

reviews.author: Mjk259
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.body: The hotel was excellent staff was exceptional pool was very nice my only complaint is there was no refrigerator or microwave in the room

reviews.author: Unhappy Visitoy
reviews.title: Not a Luxury hotel
reviews.body: They advertise this as a luxury hotel but the only thing that makes it that is the price. Our room had a non working phone and hair dryer. The phone was fixed but they claimed they could not give us a working hair dryer. Ridiculous! Save your money and stay someone else that will actually take care of their customers.

reviews.author: anonymous
reviews.title: Needs mature hospitality professionals
reviews.body: All of the staff were 18 year olds; This is not luxury. Hotel is across the street from live music venue that blasts music till 11pm. Changed rooms 3 times before I could sleep. Rooftop restaurant messed up order for several dishes, waited 45 mins+ for car from valet. I would recommend staying at Soho House.

reviews.author: Divot1
reviews.title: Fabulous Stay in Downtown Nashville
reviews.body: The Joseph was exquisite. Helpful and professional staff, beautiful, spaces and very clean rooms. Walking distance to everything!

reviews.author: Dr LTB
reviews.title: The Joseph
reviews.body: Definitely worth staying here!  I had problems with the room temperature.  The thermostat seemed to be preset at 68 degrees and the temperature in the room never changed, even when I changed the setting to 74 and also called guest services and complained.  They said service would come up, but I don't know if they ever did.  The room stayed cold.

reviews.author: Kanawha7619
reviews.title: Great Stay Overall
reviews.body:
We had a great stay overall! Matt at the front desk was wonderful and provided excellent service throughout our visit. Our room was clean, comfortable, and the bed was especially comfortable.

The rooftop pool was a nice amenity, but the chair reservation process could use some improvement. Additional lounge chairs would help, and when cabanas are sitting empty, guests should be allowed to wait in them until they are reserved. The current process also places too much responsibility on guests to discover that a waiting list exists. A clearer and more proactive system would greatly improve the pool experience.

Despite that issue, we enjoyed our stay and would return.

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.body: The Joseph was an excellent hotel option for my girls weekend. We enjoyed the rooftop bar and SpeakEasy. It was very unique and the staff was great. The location is convenient to Broadway Street and all of the activities you might want to do.

reviews.author: Christina D
reviews.title: One of a kind experience
reviews.body:
We had an absolutely amazing experience at The Joseph. From the moment we arrived, we felt incredibly welcomed and well taken care of. The gentleman outside was so friendly, holding the door and making sure we were taken care of from the street. Even when a car broke down outside, the front desk team handled everything so professionally and immediately.
Walking into the hotel, we were blown away by the incredible artwork, the wine tasting in the lobby, and the overall atmosphere. Every detail felt thoughtfully curated, and the artwork throughout the property was truly stunning. The restaurant was beautiful, the pool was absolutely gorgeous, and the entire hotel had such an amazing vibe.

The service, attention to detail, design, and overall experience were truly one of a kind. We honestly didn’t want to leave. The Joseph exceeded every expectation, and we can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Unvalued Guest
reviews.title: Unimpressed
reviews.body: From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, we were unimpressed by our stay. When we first arrived an hour after check in, we were told our room was not ready and they’d call us in 15 minutes. We never received a call and had to wait in the lobby for 40 minutes before we checked back in and the room was ready, but they forgot about us. There was no introduction of the facilities or where to find anything. In room, the facility was nice, but lighting was poor, robes were uncomfortable, and bedding was subpar. The gym had leaking water all over the floor from the water station. The pool area was nice, but service was extremely poor. We asked for menus and waters several times and never received them. At the lounge bar, speakeasy, and pool, we were rarely checked in on and service was very slow when we ordered. Nothing stood out by this stay. Location was two blocks from broadway.

reviews.author: Very dissatisfied guest
reviews.title: Lacking in several areas… not worth the money
reviews.body: Room service was absolutely horrible, three different members of the staff could not give directions to Ryman Auditorium and two different staff members quoted the incorrect amount for car valet. Not worth the money at all.

reviews.author: Ms Jean
reviews.title: AMAZING PLACE TO STAY
reviews.body: The Joseph is a place to stay if you want to feel welcomed from the time you get their to the time you leave!! They know you by name and are ALWAYS their to help with a SMILE!!  Thank you for going over and beyond and I WILL BE BACK!!!

reviews.author: MD1313
reviews.title: Lacking Customer Service
reviews.body: The valet service is the best part about the customer service at this hotel. Once we checked in with the front desk and advised it was our first time, we were given no additional information. After our check in time had passed, we had to approach the front desk to inquire about the delay. We were provided a $100 credit to our room but it wasn't until we approached for the reason of delay. The room was slightly dirty (King corner suite). The ceiling in the bathroom needed some work and the lamp in the dining nook didn't work. There were a few questionable stains on some of the furniture. The room service however was quick and warm.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Great clean close to everything. Will be back

reviews.author: Tarheels
reviews.title: Tarheels
reviews.body: Awesome  location and service, good people.

reviews.author: An 11 out of 10
reviews.title: The Joseph is the best place to stay
reviews.body: Courteous, professional, friendly management and staff.  Even the valet persons.  You want for nothing.  Exceptional hotel

reviews.author: Big fan
reviews.title: A memorable celebration and our second home!
reviews.body: The staff at The Joseph make every effort to accommodate guests with a smile.  The level of detail and dedication to guest satisfaction is outstanding.  If you want luxury with a side of home this is the place for you! Whether it’s business and you need a comfortable place to rest and a nice gym to keep in shape, or a family vacation with smiling staff to support your needs, I can’t say enough about this quaint and beautiful hotel.  I have already booked my 4th stay!

reviews.author: Diane NYC
reviews.title: Wonderful Weekend in Nashville!
reviews.body:
We had a wonderful stay at The Joseph in Nashville! The accommodations were lovely, and the staff was incredibly attentive and accommodating, especially when we requested an early check-in.

The rooftop pool was a perfect way to unwind at the end of the day, and the gym was excellent with great views. The location was ideal for our family of four, with our two daughters in their twenties. It’s close enough to downtown to make exploring easy, but just far enough away from the craziness to feel peaceful and relaxed.

Overall, The Joseph was a perfect choice for our family trip to Nashville. We would definitely recommend it and would happily stay here again!

reviews.author: Tsmith
reviews.title: Wonderful Anniversary Stay
reviews.body: The Joseph was a fantastic stay to celebrate our Anniversary.

reviews.author: Jimmy H
reviews.title: My New Favorite
reviews.body:
Really fantastic stay at a chic and beautiful hotel. The service was amazing. The staff was top notch.  So many things I liked about this stay. I really can't say enough.  

From the moment I walked in I was greeted by Lucy at the front desk.  She made sure I got a great room and explained all the amenities in the hotel. 

Kyle in the speakeasy on the second floor was a fabulous bartender.  Too good perhaps....

The rooftop pool and restaurant offered a great place to relax after a busy day touring Nashville. 

The breakfast coffee bar had the best pastries. 

Even the valet was top notch offering great service and great recommendations. 

Definitely my new favorite hotel.

reviews.author: Santisfied Customer
reviews.title: Every year great experience
reviews.body: consistency and great service is the model pattern to have. Can't say more than that. We've been staying at the Joseph for the last 5 years and every year is a great experience.

reviews.author: Paula
reviews.title: Wedding Event
reviews.body:
Our wedding planner, Joy, was absolutely phenomenal. She took care of every one of my needs and wants, and she handled unexpected weather delays with total professionalism. When our timeline had to shift, she kept everything flowing perfectly—cocktail hour and appetizers first, then the ceremony—without any stress on our end. I brought in flowers and many decorations, and she knew exactly where everything should go and how to bring the bride’s vision to life. I would recommend Joy every single time, 10x over. Truly the best wedding planner.
While Joy was exceptional, we did experience a few issues with the hotel side of the wedding weekend:
The bride and groom’s room was not ready at the promised time. All other guests’ rooms were ready, including mine, but theirs wasn’t. They were told 4:30, and when they arrived, someone was still in the room. With rehearsal at 5, the bride had to get ready in my room, which caused unnecessary stress and delays.
Other guests received a charcuterie board with water, but the bride and mother of the bride did not. The bride missed out on that “wow, they really care about me” moment that everyone else experienced.
The wedding planner manager (unfortunately I didn’t get her name) was rude and dismissive. Any request felt like a burden to her, and she acted irritated by our presence. At the end of the night, while I was struggling to remove decorations, she looked directly at me and said, “You need to get your stuff out of here,” offering no help and clearly ready for us to leave. It felt like, “We got your money—now go.” Not acceptable customer service.
Despite these issues, the hotel staff overall was exceptional, the bartenders were wonderful, and the hotel itself was fantastic. The venue is beautiful, and Joy made the wedding day unforgettable.
If the hotel addresses the customer service concerns with the wedding manager, this would easily be a five‑star experience.

reviews.author: Joe V
reviews.title: Falling short of expectations
reviews.body:
Hotel Review – Marriott The Joseph
My recent stay at The Joseph, a Luxury Collection Hotel, was unfortunately disappointing and did not meet the expectations I had for a luxury Marriott property.
While the hotel itself is beautiful and well-appointed, the overall guest experience was negatively impacted by poor service and a lack of communication. The most significant concerns involved the front desk staff and the pool experience.
Throughout my stay, interactions with the front desk were underwhelming. Staff members often seemed disengaged, requests were not handled proactively, and there was little effort made to deliver the level of hospitality typically associated with a luxury hotel. Simple guest service interactions felt transactional rather than welcoming, leaving me with the impression that customer satisfaction was not a priority.
The pool experience was equally frustrating. To make matters worse, construction was being performed at the pool during the first two days of our stay. This significantly impacted our ability to enjoy one of the hotel's advertised amenities. The noise, disruption, and restricted atmosphere detracted from what should have been a relaxing experience. What was most disappointing was the apparent lack of communication regarding the construction prior to arrival or during check-in.
Additionally, the pool area appeared poorly managed, with limited staff presence and little attention given to guest concerns. Expectations regarding seating, access, and available amenities were not always clear, further adding to the frustration. For a luxury property, I expected a much higher level of attentiveness and guest service.
That said, I want to recognize the valet team, whose service was exceptional throughout our stay. They were consistently professional, friendly, attentive, and eager to assist. Their level of hospitality stood out and reflected the type of service I had expected throughout the property. Unfortunately, the outstanding work of the valet staff was not matched by the service received at the front desk or pool area.
I do appreciate that the hotel acknowledged some of these concerns by providing a modest compensation credit to my stay. While the gesture was appreciated, it did not fully offset the inconvenience, disruption, and disappointment experienced during our visit.
For a hotel that markets itself as a luxury destination and charges premium rates, guests should expect transparency regarding facility impacts and a much higher standard of service. While the property itself is attractive, exceptional hospitality is what justifies a luxury experience, and that was lacking throughout much of our stay.
I hope hotel management takes these concerns seriously and works to improve front desk responsiveness, pool operations, and communication with guests regarding amenity disruptions. Based on this experience, I would be hesitant to return and would have difficulty recommending The Joseph to others seeking the level of service typically associated with a luxury Marriott property.
Overall Rating: 3/10 Stars
Highlights:

Beautiful property and accommodations
Excellent location
Outstanding valet service

Areas for Improvement:

Front desk responsiveness and professionalism
Pool operations and guest service
Communication regarding construction and amenity impacts
Overall consistency in delivering a luxury guest experience

reviews.author: Henrique
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.body:
Well-located, with excellent services and staff.
The best in Nashville.

reviews.author: Doug B in Nashville
reviews.title: The perfect staycation!
reviews.body: The very best! Read my total review.

reviews.author: JNC Farms
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.body: After losing my husband to cancer, I needed a weekend to regroup. The Joseph was just what I needed. The hotel was wonderful and dinner at Yolan was incredible. I will be back.

reviews.author: Nick M
reviews.title: Not worth the cost - better hotels in Nashville. False hotel room Charges unresolved.
reviews.body: On the surface, The Joseph seems great. Rooms are nice, restaurants and bars and lobby all look really nice. But restaurants were poorly managed, long waits, apparent chaos happening behind the scenes. I have room charges that are not mine that i am unable to get resolved or even have someone call to address. The overall vibe is not what you would expect for a higher end hotel in nashville. You are much better off at the Nash, Omni across the street and even other Marriott properties like JW. All cheaper than the Joseph.

reviews.author: Marshall H
reviews.title: Not worth it.
reviews.body: $900 for 1 night.  Hairs in the room. Sharp, broken tile in the shower. Roof bar has no view and no customers on a Friday night. Breakfast underwhelming. Sausage undercooked, potatoes over salted. Coffee bar line was so long we couldn't get anything. No signage about parking entrance. Location was kinda sketchy at night.

reviews.author: Liz C
reviews.title: The Joseph is a triumph!
reviews.body:
My stay at The Joseph was truly a wonderful time. From the moment you arrive you are treated kindly and welcomed warmly. From offering chilled water (so needed in the Nashville heat) to being offered small treats while you check in, you truly are being given a 5 star experience. The rooms themselves are spacious and well designed, the bathrooms are clean and the turn down service at the end of the day is a delight! 
The Espresso Bar has truly well done pastries, as well as fresh and good coffee. The food at Yolan is also wonderful! The snacks pool side are fresh and good, though I will say depending on the business of the pool and bar, can be slow at times. Just be patient and all will be well! 
Overall, it's a stay that truly cannot be beat, especially with staples like Martin's BBQ and the Music City Center right across the street!

reviews.author: Sarah1989
reviews.title: Great weekend
reviews.body: Everything was outstanding!

reviews.author: Dilynn
reviews.title: Courtyard on Jefferson, Memphis
reviews.body:
We stayed here for a birthday weekend. It is convenient to Beal St and having a frig in the room was a must ,(due to insulin)
 The front desk staff was so upbeat, cheerful and helpful
The room was clean & neat, absolutely no wait for the lighting fast elevators. I highly recommend staying here. 
Be aware the parking is a third party contractor,(,they need better staff) parking is $32 a night.

reviews.author: Karen
reviews.title: Stay at Downtown Marriott Courtyard Memphis TN September 2-6 2026
reviews.body: The Marriott Courtyard in downtown Memphis TN went above and beyond when I stayed for the Lions USA/Canada Forum.  I asked for extra towels, extra toothpaste, soap m, saving kit and cream and it was In my room when I arrived.  I went. To the Bistro and wanted coffee before my dinner reservation she made me coffee which I needed.  She made some coffee and during my stay and when I came back from dinner on Friday night I was able to get coffee even though it was only available at breakfast.  The hotel was close to the convention center so I walked since the bus was not available when I needed it. I would definitely stay here again if I come back to Memphis.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.title: Not a good experience
reviews.body: Disappointed with this Marriott and will not go again.

reviews.author: JGo
reviews.title: Great hotel and great location.
reviews.body: Came for weekend getaway and this was the perfect hotel for it. Staff were the nicest. Hotel was clean. Location is great.

reviews.author: Sara Stjepanovic
reviews.title: Best Service Hands Down
reviews.body: Everyone and I mean absolutely EVERYONE was so friendly in that hotel. The staff is hands down the best I have seen so far in a Marriott and I have stayed in over 10 this year alone. They all deserve such a HUGE shout out for their service because they are amazing. They remember every guest and try to make the best experience possible which is exactly what it should be. I do not remember the front desk lady's name but she was AMAZING, I mean her energy was contagious- I had driven 8 hours that day before getting to the hotel and was pretty tired as one would be and as soon as I said hello she perked up and was ready to help. She deserves all the good things coming her way, Marriott is lucky to have her (please find her) and the rest of the staff (valet asking if I needed help, cook asking as well, literally everyone).

reviews.author: MM
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: Great hotel, walking distance to convention center.  Food is great but do not expect a fine dining experience, service is slow and you may need to check on your order.

reviews.author: Travel Tournament
reviews.title: Hotel Nice. Concrete Bed. Valet Wrecked our Truck!
reviews.body:
Hotel staff were all very nice. Hotel was clean.

Room was spacious but the bed was like sleeping on concrete. 

Valet (night shift) lost our keys. Girl was too busy on her phone when we handed them to her to pay attention at the desk. The guy that parked our truck that night, parked it in a lot that it should've never been (it's a 1-ton dually) and he wrecked it. Instead of notifying us, he didn't tell anyone. The next morning, the day we checked out, our truck was brought to us with both finders damaged and the rim scratched. The rest of the Valet staff had been amazing our entire trip. That morning they ALL stated that our truck should've never been in the garage it was parked in due to the size. The valet staff that morning were all helpful and filed the claim for the truck to cover damages.

reviews.author: ANH
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body:
The customer service at this hotel was top notch. Very kind and welcoming staff who were eager to serve. The room was very clean and the staff was attentive.

Unfortunately the mandatory valet service is $30 a night and their service was horrendous. Sometimes I had to wait 30 minutes for my car. When I came back in the evening there wouldn’t be any attendants there and I would have to leave my keys with the hotel staff. The parking situation left me with a high level of anxiety and I do expect more from Marriott.

reviews.author: Takeyah
reviews.title: Could’ve been better
reviews.body: Hot tub didn’t have any water in it, highly disappointing! Everything else was fine

reviews.author: OptimismDidntSaveMe
reviews.title: Worst stay I’ve had
reviews.body:
It’s time to sell!  

Hot tub: was told at check-in that it’s busted/under maintenance…he didn’t know why but said there’s always an issue with it and it was leaking just a few weeks ago too. This was literally the only reason I stayed at this downtown location..

Gym: 2 of the 4 cardio machines don’t turn on at all. 

First room attempt: Phone doesn’t work. Zero lotion in room.  No water bottles in room. Zero body wash in the shower (completely empty). Shower nozzle was stripped/didn’t work - limiting me to a cold shower after twenty minutes trying to get it on. After my shower, the first and second towel I grabbed had multiple spiders on them. Very regrettably stayed my first night in this room..absolutely should’ve cut my losses and asked for a refund/walk to any other hotel

Second room attempt: Phone doesn’t work. Zero lotion in room. No water bottles in room. Refrigerator is putting off incredible heat and making a loud noise, and when I opened it zero cold air/didn’t work at all.

Third room attempt: Phone doesn’t work. Zero lotion in room. No water bottles in room. Forced to settle.

I raised all these to front desk who didn’t offer any solutions whatsoever…I had to be pushy about even trying a new room…I spent a lot of money on my three night stay and if I was the GM I’d be incredibly embarrassed and processing a refund with a heartfelt phone call to apologize.

I was in town for a funeral and unfortunately the plans I had on my last day got changed but when I requested a late checkout after 3 or 4pm (since the front desk staff repeatedly told me they were EMPTY/lots of open rooms) I was outright rejected. Again, zero solutions offered so I asked if they could hold my bags at the front desk while I found somewhere local to walk to since I didn’t need to be at the airport until after 4:30pm. They seemed reluctant but did agree to this.. 

I’ve been staying in SPG/Marriott exclusively for decades..this was so far below the standard I honestly couldn’t  believe it hasn’t been sold off to a lower tier hotel company or developer to gut. 

Good luck with keeping this trash a float

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay
reviews.body: Great location. Clean and the staff is awesome.

reviews.author: Steve H
reviews.title: Not up to Courtyard Standards
reviews.body: see prior comments made in the initial pages of the review.

reviews.author: Hawksbb35
reviews.title: Clean rooms. Nice Staff.!!!!!!!
reviews.body: Rooms were clean.  The service was fast and excellent.  I really enjoyed the valet service.  They were always on time and polite.  An overall A+ stay.

reviews.author: Sure
reviews.title: Marriot lives up to expectations
reviews.body: The room was clean and comfortable. Top notch linens and bath soaps. The staff was friendly and accommodating.

reviews.author: Yes
reviews.title: Best hotel I have had in Memphis TN
reviews.body: The staff was perfect. The rooms were clean. The hotel was clean. Just great service.

reviews.author: J Emmanuel Obi
reviews.title: My new go-to when in Memphis
reviews.body:
My recent stay at Courtyard Memphis Downtown was nothing short of excellent, and it easily exceeded my expectations in several areas.

First and foremost, cleanliness stood out immediately. The entire property, from the lobby to the rooms was well-maintained and spotless. I don’t do shower curtains at all, one my personal highlights of the room was the walk-in shower. That may seem like a small detail, but it made a big difference in terms of my comfort and convenience.

Another pleasant surprise was the affordability. For a downtown location, especially in a city like Memphis, the pricing was more than reasonable.

The staff deserves special recognition. Everyone I encountered was extremely accommodating, professional, and genuinely helpful. Whether it was answering questions or assisting with requests, they made the experience smooth and stress-free. Also, the hotel was impressively quiet. I had absolutely no issues with noise. I honestly had no issues during my stay at all, which speaks volumes. Everything ran efficiently, and the overall experience felt seamless.

If I had one small critique, it would be the lack of dedicated on-site parking. However, the valet system more than made up for it. It was probably the best valet experience I’ve had…fast, organized, and hassle-free.

Outside of The Peabody Memphis, this is the only place I’ll stay when visiting downtown Memphis. Highly recommended for anyone looking for comfort, convenience, and quality service.

reviews.author: EM
reviews.title: A beautiful property, with great service to match
reviews.body: Such a beautiful place to stay, the views were beautiful with the rooms to match. Check in and check out was friendly from start to finish. Located very conveniently downtown, not a bad walk to get to some of the main attractions downtown. Our only issues were the tv being very slow and breakfast being a little confusing in terms of trying to figure out what was included in terms of paying for breakfast ahead of time. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: NBA Fans
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: We had a quick trip in town to watch the Memphis Grizzlies. The hotel was walking distance to the arena. All of the staff we interacted with were kind and friendly. The hotel was clean and nice. Our beds were comfortable. I recommend this place for sure.

reviews.author: Nessa26
reviews.title: Wedding in Memphis!
reviews.body: This location was perfect. It was 10-20 minutes from everything I needed! Check - in and out was easy. They gym was nice and clean. I used the on site laundry. The café was cute. Not a large menu selection but food was good. Did not have a pool but the weather was on the cool side. Will book again.

reviews.author: Rob
reviews.title: Nice but parking expensive
reviews.body: Hotel was nicely appointed and good location downtown Memphis. Although just in town for the night, room was nice, clean and comfortable.  Food was okay for what was available expecially late in the evening service was appreciated.  Parking no self parking available and cost of valet was surprising.  $32 for one night stay was a bit much!  Definately was a suprise to us and would have chosen another property with self parking on site at lesser rate if had know this before arrival.

reviews.author: Angel
reviews.title: Deplorable conditions
reviews.body: Room felt unsafe to be in. Possible mold, broken fridge and shower lever falling off.

reviews.author: J williams
reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.body: All over horrible experience. Parking horrible, food horrible, filthy toilet in room. I will never return.

reviews.author: Recent traveler
reviews.title: Parking is bad here
reviews.body:
We checked into our room about 8pm, and then drove to dinner. When we returned, the valet told us there was no room to park our car, and we would have to go find something on our own. Three Marriott hotels share one valet service, and it was a zoo. Heard other people’s stories.
Also we were awakened in the middle of the night by a woman loudly knocking on a door near us and shouting to whoever was in the room the he stole her car. After about 15 minutes of this, we called security and they eventually came up and things got quieter.

reviews.author: SJ
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.body: From the front desk to the service for breakfast, dinner and drinks at the Bistro, the people are first class. I normally don’t sleep in hotel beds but this hotel is one of the cleanest and most friendliest places I’ve stayed. The bed was extremely comfortable. If you are in Memphis, this is definitely the best place to stay.

reviews.author: Sandi
reviews.title: Making an ice storm tolerable
reviews.body: We came to Memphis for the first time the week after your snowstorm and ice storm, knowing it would be challenging not realizing just exactly how challenging with the ice and snow but everyone we met. We were friendly, helpful, and the people at the courtyard Marriott were exceptional. We chose your location because we have been looking forward to being able to walk around the courtyard and such where you were so we’re gonna have to come back to experience that part of your hotel.

reviews.author: LP
reviews.title: Marriott Courtyard Downtown Memphis
reviews.body: My experience was less than expected from a Marriott and being a rewards member. The bed/mattress was atrocious and the knits at the bar was the employees. However, the paid employees were phenomenal. Felecia, and the other lady was outstanding.

reviews.author: Big Gee
reviews.title: Great location and great service
reviews.body: Marriott has great customer service great security and good location.

reviews.author: 5K
reviews.title: Low Class for the Rates
reviews.body: Extremely limited access to any food outside of vending machine which should not be the case for even a mid class establishment.  Appears to be understaffed for check-in/check-out, food service, and valet parking which cost extra.

reviews.author: BobDad
reviews.title: Kindness, comfort, and quality oh my!
reviews.body: It was a very pleasant experience. The staff was very friendly and the room not only looked clean it smelled good. I loved the balcony and being able to sit out there and enjoy your wonderful city. Thank you for the comfortable stay.  I look forward to coming back again.

reviews.author: HN
reviews.title: Beware of Valet
reviews.body: The Valet lost my car keys and I had to travel back home to Nashville without my car. I was without a car for 3 days. Marriott DID NOT claim any responsibility. They said every reimbursement from this issue must come from the valet company. Beware of this location and Marriott!

reviews.title: Memphis BD @ Moxy
reviews.body: The bed was uncomfortable, poor shower drainage, and mold on the interior and exterior surface. Overall, the atmosphere at the Moxy 100%

reviews.author: George
reviews.title: Average Moxy
reviews.body: The hotel is located in a really good part of town. No frills or extras at this hotel. Lobby was cool spot to play games.

reviews.author: Ashleyk4917
reviews.title: Minimalist and not in a good way
reviews.body: Worst hotel I’ve ever stayed in.  Worse than Motel 6.  Tiny rooms, no fridge, no ice machines, no microwave, see through shower, nowhere to put your clothes, no drawers, closet, and did I mention tiny rooms?  Not even a drawer in the nightstand.  I don’t mind the concept but the price should reflect the accommodations.  Depressing vibe all around.  Never again.

reviews.author: Nice hotel
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.body: Pretty good hotel to stay at the only downside to the hotel is that you do not get a fridge or microwave in your room other than that, it's pretty good.They have free pinball machines in the lobby

reviews.author: Bwalk0415
reviews.title: The best in town !
reviews.body: When staying in Memphis on business or pleasure you will find no location better than the Moxy Memphis Downtown. The rooms are clean the atmosphere is inviting and friendly plus the staff have you covered ! Just steps away from great food down town or stay in the secured lobby and bar. Either way I highly recommend giving this Moxy a few of your nights !

reviews.author: Erin E
reviews.title: Do NOT stay here!
reviews.body: Filthy. Bodily fluids on the wall and orange mold in the shower were the least of our worries. I’ve stayed at countless Moxy hotels before, my husband was a Marriott exec before his passing … he would not have believed this hotel! Checked out two days early and the staff could not have cared less.

reviews.author: Liz
reviews.title: Subpar Rooms
reviews.body: The staff was welcoming and provided great service.  The rooms felt very damp and not clean.  The air conditioner was so loud I had to sleep with ear plugs.  I would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Shocking
reviews.body:
The aesthetic of the place is very neat! I really enjoyed whoever decorated Moxy even though it’s not a typical place I would stay in. 
I was very shocked by the valet and a housekeeper being on their phone. When I drove up, the valet went in the air lock area sat down on floor on her phone — no acknowledgment of can I take your car let me help you with that.
As we were leaving a housekeeper sitting in windowsill by the elevator on her phone. This is the first time I’ve ever seen this and it was very unprofessional.
I will not be staying here again.

reviews.author: Abby W
reviews.title: Quick trip, tons of fun!
reviews.body: We celebrated the 73rd birthday of my father-in-law in Memphis. It was a quick trip but it was so much fun and the Moxy was a great part of our time. The staff was kind and caring from valet through housekeeping! We will definitely return and will plan to book at The Moxy!

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.body: Moxy is a fun social hotel

reviews.author: Underwhelmed
reviews.title: Moxy in Memphis is Meh...
reviews.body: The overall stay was fine, in that the room was cute, clean and I got a good night's sleep. However, I've been to a lot of Moxy hotels in my travels, as it's my preferred go to when traveling solo, and I was very underwhelmed by the overall vibe, but mostly the dryness of the front desk/bar staff. They weren't rude, but it didn't feel like a warm welcome. That, coupled with the extremely limited hot food options and choices for redeeming your drink token was disappointing. Not the vibe I was looking/hoping for.

reviews.author: Ash
reviews.title: My Stay at the Moxy
reviews.body: Valet was extremely slow. One time we waited about 10 minutes before we saw someone. The charge is separate from your stay. Room 302 has no fridge, microwave, nor an iron.

reviews.author: Ben M
reviews.title: MOXY is a MUST-STAY
reviews.body:
From the music and ambiance on each floor to the stellar service and staff, MOXY is miles and miles above the rest. Amazing locale, kinda removed from any major hustle and bustle or bothersome foot traffic, a little hipster paradise in its own corner of Memphis. Can't recommend enough, especially for the price. Next time I hope to check out the fitness center and maybe stay a few extra nights. Hope to snag a few more drink tokens too!

Thanks MOXY!

reviews.author: Business
reviews.title: Not great
reviews.body: The gym lacks a proper exercise bike, the room was tiny with no desk, the bed was uncomfortable, and the AC was extremely loud.

reviews.author: Polly H
reviews.title: Would stay again
reviews.body: The Moxy was perfect.  Good location.  Clean and safe.

reviews.author: TaraLynn
reviews.title: Great Stay at Moxy
reviews.body: Very clean, friendly staff, and cute aesthestic.

reviews.author: T Slessor
reviews.title: Unique stay
reviews.body:
After a long drive, the reception staff were not as friendly or helpful as we had hoped, which was a disappointing first impression.
The valet parking attendant was friendly, quick and efficient. 
The location is excellent. A short walk to the restaurants and clubs on Beale Street. Not very far to drive to the other sights in Memphis.
The hotel itself, however, had fun and quirky vibe. In the communal/ reception area, we enjoyed the pinball machines, games and record player, which gave the property a unique character. The room was also quirky and the bed was very comfortable, which meant a good night's sleep.

Overall, the hotel has plenty of personality and some great features, but a warmer welcome from the reception team would have improved our experience.

reviews.author: TMarie
reviews.title: Everything I Needed
reviews.body: Hotel and staff provided everything that I needed during my stay. The location is also great. I was able to walk to meet friends downtown.

reviews.author: Nightowl180
reviews.title: Not the best experience
reviews.body:
I arrived at the hotel around 11:30 PM to check in and had to wait approximately 15 minutes for valet service. After finally getting checked in, I was given a room that was already occupied. I opened the door and thankfully the safety latch was engaged, otherwise I would have walked directly into someone else’s room. I then had to return to the front desk to be reassigned another room late at night.

The following morning, I noticed the sink area in the room had not been properly cleaned and there was hair left around the counter area. To make matters worse, while taking a shower, I discovered the shower gel dispenser was completely empty.
