This was a very disappointing experience, especially considering the basic expectations of cleanliness, preparation, and guest safety. I wanted to make management aware of these issues and would appreciate a response regarding how this situation will be addressed.

reviews.author: Nero
reviews.title: This hotel has vibes
reviews.body: Former Memphian, living in California for the past 20+ years. I got to come back to my hometown to see my friends and family that still reside in the great 901, and for a special occasion - BBQ Fest. I can tell you, the Moxy did not disappoint when it came to lodging and experience. The location, staff, service, rooms, bar/food area were all great. This place definitely has the vibes. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: D
reviews.title: Great price and location
reviews.body: I was in town for the night and staff was six regular! Gym was functional. Wish I could have stayed longer but I'll look to stay here again next time

reviews.author: Nice hotel
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.body: Such a cool hotel. Great prices. Great place all around. Clean. Very clean.

reviews.author: R 2106
reviews.title: My trip to Memphis
reviews.body: Room was nice though beds were full (small). Bathroom was very tight.

reviews.author: Quick pop in Memphis
reviews.title: Quick pop in Memphis
reviews.body: In and out was easy and all was in order. Was assisted w a booking issue with professionalism.

reviews.author: Hava Rose
reviews.title: Enjoyable and Easeful stay
reviews.body: The Moxy Downtown was a great stay for my business trip and an easy walk to th convention center downtown. I would gladly stay again for future business stays!

reviews.author: Ronda T
reviews.title: Fun place!
reviews.body: Valet, check in, bar, and house keeping staff were all excellent. Very clean. Good food and service. Clean well appointed rooms.

reviews.author: AG
reviews.title: Love The Moxy!
reviews.body: Eric was excellent and so was his staff. Thank you!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Excellent location and Staff Members
reviews.body: I truly enjoyed my stay at the Moxy Hotel because it has an excellent location not far from everything. I was in town for the New Edition/Toni Braxton concert, and I really had a great time. The bartenders on all shifts are amazing!!!!!!!!!! at this hotel and very personable. Also, all of the other staff members are very pleasant and professional. My room was very nice, clean, secure, and cozy. I will most definitely return with my family next time. Thank you all for making my stay at your hotel welcoming and enjoyable.

reviews.author: Tee
reviews.title: Welcoming Vibes
reviews.body: This location was an unexpected surprise. Nice dining right in walking distance.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: Love this place and the staff. Will be back.

reviews.author: Yes
reviews.title: The JJ Watts 26 Anniversary
reviews.body: Everything was exceptional even the back door Trolley ride

reviews.author: Lori T
reviews.title: Nightmare from hell
reviews.body: Arrived at the hotel, states could not find my reservation  presented the clerk with confirmation number, reservation was found.  Checked in room assigned on 5th floor new edition. Can someone come decorate the room for my husband birthday, only for the air to go out.  Moved to 2nd floor handicap room no bells or whistles and was not notified of such.  Went down to the lobby desk again to be informed there were no more rooms.   I advised the gentleman at the desk, I paid for a suite and that is what I wanted.  He went back in the computer and found. Room.  This time the room is on the 5th floor in the older area, this room did not have all the bell and whistles as the suite.  Advised front desk the phone in the room was not working.   They removed the phone and did not bring another. In the event I needed anything I would have to go the lobby desk, big inconvenience.  Only had one washcloth in my room, went down to ask for more and was told they were all dirty and they would have some delivered to my room.  This never happened, my husband and I had to walk two blocks down to dollar general to purchase a pack.  I lost money on the room decorating and the moment I created for my husband 60th birthday was gone.   I have always used this hotel chain and never been disappointed until I visit Memphis.  Total waste, the hotel was not clean, the breakfast food was okay.  Valet service excellent and the guy Terry from facilities was fantastic

reviews.author: TDB
reviews.title: We came for Graceland!
reviews.body: While me and the family came to visit Graceland, we also had a great time in Downtown Memphis! The location of the hotel was great, within walking distance to multiple restaurants and Beale Street! I would definitely recommend staying at Springhill Suites by Marriott Downtown Memphis!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: visitb 8/6-8/9
reviews.body: Not good, valet required parking not good at $32 per day, rip off.

reviews.author: Jax from Yorkshire
reviews.title: Super clean, hotel in great location, friendly staff.
reviews.body: Would recommend this hotel, always a good trustworthy brand. Clean and spacious rooms, great safe location.

reviews.author: Chigirl
reviews.title: Chicago
reviews.body: Room was nice size, cozy and slept well. A short distance to Beal street and Trolley stops in front of hotel. 5th floor had a great view.

reviews.author: KG
reviews.title: Family Reunion Disaster
reviews.body: Go elsewhere the lack of cleanliness and quality of the rooms leave much to be desired

reviews.author: Annamae
reviews.title: GIRLS TRIP!!
reviews.body: Staff was excellent, as well as valet. Great place to stay in down town memphis!!

reviews.author: Jelaine B
reviews.title: Nice Hotel, But Our Stay Was Very Uncomfortable
reviews.body:
Nice Hotel, But Our Stay Was Very Uncomfortable

The hotel itself is nice and conveniently located near everything. Our room was also much larger and more spacious than most hotel rooms we’ve stayed in. We booked the larger room with two queen beds and paid almost $200 per night including valet service. We really enjoyed the valet service, and the breakfast was also a highlight.

Unfortunately, there were some issues that made our stay much less enjoyable.

When we first entered our room, the faucet was running, the door had been left open, and the AC was on but the room felt like it was close to 90°F. We tried adjusting the thermostat and waited, but there was no noticeable difference.

We found a staff member on our floor, a gentleman named Terry, who I believe was his name. He was very kind and did what he could to help. He came back with a long ladder and spent about 15–20 minutes trying to figure out what was wrong with the AC while we were still in the room.

The timing made this especially frustrating. We had driven for three hours with my husband, mother-in-law, and our two toddlers because we wanted to stay overnight and rest before my USCIS appointment the next morning. After a long drive, the last thing we wanted was to arrive at a room that was hotter than it was outside and then spend another 15–20 minutes watching someone try to fix the AC. We decided to just bear with it rather than go through the hassle of moving rooms. A different room was never offered to us.

We went to the pool with the kids, and Terry told us that if the room was still not cooling when we returned, we could speak with the front desk. Unfortunately, when we came back, the AC still wasn’t blowing cold air. It felt more like a fan. It was somewhat cooler outside by then because the sun had gone down, so we decided to stay and hoped the room would cool off overnight.

Unfortunately, it never really did. We were sweating throughout the night. The kids ended up sleeping in just their shirts and diapers, and my husband slept in his underwear because of how hot the room was. It was extremely uncomfortable, especially with two toddlers.

Another disappointment was the pull-out sofa bed. The mattress was extremely thin and offered very little support. Even my 4-year-old sank into it, so I wouldn’t consider it suitable for sleeping comfortably.

reviews.author: KS
reviews.title: Not what we expected
reviews.body:
This hotel didn’t live up to my expectations and what I am used to with the Marriott SpringHill Suites brand.
Room had an odor, there were ants in the room. We stayed 3 nights and housekeeping never cleaned our room. They only came in once and only emptied trash and exchanged towels. The other 2 nights we had to ask for new towels.

All of the staff were very nice but some weren’t very professional. I wouldn’t stay here again for the price of the rooms and the cost of parking. The overall experience isn’t worth the cost

reviews.author: Misu
reviews.title: Memphis
reviews.body: As I stated earlier the staff and breakfast was great. The location and the rooms AC was under par.

reviews.author: Ali
reviews.title: No light, no drains, lackluster customer service
reviews.body:
Never again. Never. 

1. The light when out in the bathroom. I had to keep the door open to see. I took a shower in the dark.
2. Shower drained so slowly that I had to turn the water off while soaping up during my shower. 
3. Sink didn’t drain well either. Filled up while face washing. 
4. Big stains in the carpet in the bathroom and primary room.

I won’t stay here again.

reviews.author: Mr RealDeal
reviews.title: Tell a friend
reviews.body: This hotel sits down town Memphis in walking distance to the famous Beale St

reviews.author: Deb
reviews.title: Very disappointed!
reviews.body:
The good:

Location is spot on with a tram stop directly outside the hotel making it easy to get around.

The hotel is kept fairly clean in most areas.

The bad:

We had problems with the room safe, a slow draining sink and insecure doors onto the balcony which were reported several times and not repaired. (We paid extra to have a balcony room and yet the insecure doors made us feel unsafe through the night).

We had no room makeover - it wasn't explained to us during the check in, that we had to request it, so when we eventually did, we had a basic freshen up and still had to ask for new towels.

We did not receive any complimentary bottles of water in our room, until we asked for them.

The room was reserved for 3 people but we didn't have enough towels and had to request more.

The pool was closed due to maintenance issues, this was not communicated to us at any point prior to check in or during check in, even though it had already been closed for several days. One of the reasons we chose this hotel was location and pool.

The reception manager (Chris?) apologised for the failure of the service we received and the disappointing experience we had and put it down to a new system being used. I was told I would be credited ×1 night and given 10,000 points on my account as a gesture of goodwill.

I have received a credited night but not received the 10,000 points as promised.

Because ×1 night was credited, I have not earned any points for the 3rd night. I continue to be disappointed with the whole experience.

reviews.author: SLC2026
reviews.title: Great location downtown
reviews.body: Location was perfect. Everywhere I wanted to go downtown was either walking or quick Uber/Lyft ride away.  Rooms were clean and comfortable.  Breakfast hot and good.

reviews.author: Famof5
reviews.title: Dirty, poorly maintained and bad room/bathroom layout
reviews.body: Sticky and stained floors throughout the hotel, sofa in room was covered in something, pealing paint on bathtub, awkward bathroom layout

reviews.author: Kenner 504
reviews.title: Great family Vacation, we will return.
reviews.body: My family loved this hotel, the children went from room to room. The rooms were clean, spacious and never felt crowded.

reviews.author: Darren H
reviews.title: I night stay
reviews.body: The hotel was great, my issues was the excessive cost of parking.

reviews.author: Anon
reviews.title: Not good. Service here is not good.
reviews.body:
Service here is far below what you expect from Marriott. 
Expect to have to collect your own bedding, make your own bed and hunt down towels.
The staff do not want to be there and it shows.

reviews.author: Tracy J
reviews.title: Perfect location situated in a great part of downtown
reviews.body: Overall  great place to stay. Conveniently located near Walgreens, Fat Tuesdays, ice cream shops, deli shops and Beale Street in .50 miles.

reviews.author: JLove
reviews.title: Nice, but lighting & valet service is horrible
reviews.body: We were in town for a wedding, and spent 3 nights at the Springhill Suites.  The rooms are very nice & spacious, but the lighting is horrible in the room.  It's not bad during the day when you have natural sunlight, but when it's dark outside, the lighting in the room is so poor, it's hard to see, and almost impossible to see in the closet without a flashlight.  The light over the bathroom mirror and kitchenette mirror isn't good, either.  It's nice to have the sink and mirror separate from the tub/toilet area so that both places can be utilized by different people at the same time.  The breakfast was good, but the dining area is way too small.  There was a long line to get breakfast, and then nowhere to sit once you got it.  VALET - I understand that the valet service is totally separate from the hotel, and is shared between 3 different hotels.  We repeatedly had to wait for our vehicle, even after requesting it through the app before going downstairs.  Oftentimes, they would look at us, and ask us if we were waiting for our car, and what our name was, as if they hadn't even checked the app requests.  We were late for dinner reservations, and well as a wedding because we had to wait for the car, even after requesting it at least 10 minutes before going downstairs.  Then, of course, the app asks you to tip (which I don't mind doing), but then adds a $0.99 fee to each tip.  If valet is required, the service should be better.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Had a great experience staying here for 2 nights with my family. Clean, friendly, and a good safe location.

reviews.author: McClellon Family Reunion
reviews.title: BEST FAMILY REUNION EVER
reviews.body:
It's always a challenge to please a group of people,  but Springhill Suites Memphis succeeded!  Memphis was the host city for my family reunion this year.   WE HAD A BLAST!   The entire hotel staff was amazing!
Macy and the guys in valet were great.  Reggie at the front desk went out his way to ensure that everyone was comfortable. Tanisha in housekeeping kept our room clean and stocked. The remaining staff made sure that we were comfortable in our meeting room.  THANK YOU !

reviews.author: MN26
reviews.title: Great staff but hotel needs work
reviews.body: My daughter, grandson and I spent 3 nights here and while the location is great, so many things didn't work during our stay. The air conditioner in both rooms never worked as it should. It would work for a bit, then stop cooling, then start again. The maintenance person came to my room and changed the filter but it didn't fix the problem. Evidently other guests had the same issue. The drain stopper in the bathroom sink was completely broken, missing the part to open and close the drain, so you either closed it and let the sink fill up with water or leave it open and put a washcloth over the drain to keep your contacts from going missing. The towels were thin and rough; the TV was also hit or miss. The remote was hard to operate and Netflix worked one time in 3 days. Needless to say, there wasn't much else to watch on a very limited menu. The staff was wonderful and really tried but there wasn't much they could do. When I checked out and shared these issues with the hotel, they did adjust my bill so I was very appreciative of that but I really would have rather had a comfortable room with everything working. I wouldn't stay here again because of this experience so I hope the hotel will spend some money on upgrading these things.

reviews.author: Lancye
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Absolutely perfect stay! All the staff was so friendly and helpful!

reviews.author: Krayjrn
reviews.title: Springhill Suites in Memphis a big letdown
reviews.body: The Springhill Suites in downtown Memphis seemed like a good property because its proximity to everything. In fact it was dirty and upkeep has not been down. Amenities were closed and the pool had mold around it. Parking was expensive and it took forever for the valet to get our car. The only bright spot was the breakfast.

reviews.author: Family of 4
reviews.title: Poor experience
reviews.body:
Our party of 5 reserved the mountain view suite with 2 queens and a trundle but wwe were placed in a room with 1 king bed, which was sitting atop a double frame and buckled in the center, and a twin sized trundle. We were told the AC unit went out in the room we reserved and this was the only room available, which left some of our party sleeping on the floor. I suspect our room was given to another party in error, or they overbooked. 
Additionally, the shampoo and conditioner bottles were empty, the extra bedding was covered in dust, we were only provided 2 towels, the valet took forever, and the hallways smelled like burnt rubber and marijuana. The only positive thing, was the welcoming attitude of staff who tried to make things right without success.

reviews.author: Theo
reviews.title: Consistent Door Knocking
reviews.body: Horrible, Unsafe, and poor service

reviews.author: Poor hotel
reviews.title: It was not as we expected for the price. We will to stay elsewhere
reviews.body:
We had to walk a distance from lobby to room. No room
Service was very poor. No one ever came to clean our room. We had to get all our towels, toilet paper, coffee, tissue and walk it back to our room. The hotel needs updating. Reggie was very nice and helpful. The valet was very expensive.  We had my elderly mom with us so it was our only option. The valet was fast and efficient. The breakfast was pretty good for being included. The location was good.

reviews.author: Good Valet Services
reviews.title: Friendly Staff
reviews.body: The staff and the valet were awesome. I would have liked to tip each one.

reviews.author: User04571
reviews.title: 09/20-09/21 stay
reviews.body:
The Marriott Downtown is a nice hotel overall. 

I believe that small things can be fixed to ensure you’re getting your money’s worth. There were things like messed up paint, the rugs they have in the room weren’t the cleanest, the snack area was not fully stocked at all, in rooms with 2 beds they provide a couch that takes up a lot of unnecessary space, the water pressure in the room’s sink area was way too high causing water to get everywhere, and the shower wasn’t squeaky clean as I expected, lastly, I believe I saw mold specks in the shower.  

This could be a great space if those small things were improved. If I'm going to pay 300+ for a room for one day, I expect that everything be up to par.

reviews.author: LCOnTheGo
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay in Downtown Memphis
reviews.body: We really enjoyed our stay at Aloft Memphis Downtown! The front desk and valet staff were welcoming, friendly, and attentive from the moment we arrived. We especially appreciated one of the valet employees recommending a nearby restaurant, which turned out to be an excellent choice. Our room was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The downtown location was convenient for enjoying the city, and the overall experience was relaxed and enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again on our next trip to Memphis!

reviews.author: Miss V
reviews.title: Excellent location!!
reviews.body: Location was great! Beale Street, Peabody Hotel, the sports mecca Pyramid, and other great places within walking distance. I was able to make an emergency 3 min. walk to Walgreen's for sunscreen and over to a liquor and wine store -- for BYOB event. Although aLoft doesn't offer hot breakfast, Biscuits and Jams is right across the street!! A-Mazing breakfast!!

reviews.author: T Marie
reviews.title: A Night of Fun!
reviews.body: Overall, I would definitely stay here again. The location, the staff, cleanliness of the lobby and rooms and the overall vibe will definitely constitute and rebook!!

reviews.author: Jinx
reviews.title: Cozy comfort.
reviews.body: Cozy and very comfortable.  The bed was comfortable.  Roomy.  Quiet.

reviews.author: The McNeals
reviews.title: Aloft of good service
reviews.body: This over all was a great place to visit and stay. Staff was friendly and the room spacious with a great view. We would definitely come again.

reviews.author: ktate1998
reviews.title: Staying at the downtown aloft
reviews.body: Thee hotel and room were very clean, and the staff were very friendly

reviews.author: Tara
reviews.title: Unexpectedly Pleasant Stay
reviews.body: I've visited a few hotels in Memphis, and specifically the downtown locations have disappointed me. The Aloft was different. Exceptionally helpful and pleasant staff, clean and comfortable rooms, and much quieter than the hotels nearer the center of downtown near Beale. Still convenient to all attractions Downtown and in Midtown, but without the chaos.

reviews.author: Kem
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.body: The stay was nice, but too much noise for 8th floor. Bar Good choices were lacking.

reviews.author: JULIUS
reviews.title: Great space
reviews.body: It was a great experience and will be the only hotel I stay at when I come to Memphis

reviews.author: August2026
reviews.title: Proactivity in checking on consumables
reviews.body: Had several instances where the complimentary coffee and the creamers were empty. Had to ask someone to replenish. And we heard others say “this is the third time it’s happened since we’ve been here” so we are not alone.  Also the shower gel pump dispenser in the room was completely empty my first morning there.  It would be beneficial if staff was proactive in checking consumables either in room or at food service areas and replenish before people begin to complains. Would be nice to be comped a couple thousand reward points for the inconvenience

reviews.author: TexasResident102
reviews.title: Great - Would Recommend (Room for Improvements)
reviews.body:
Enjoyed 4 night stay. All staff is friendly. Check in and Check out was a breeze. Lounge bar, pool table is a plus and enjoyable. Fantastic lobby.

If you need WiFi - it's capped at 5 MB/sec (even for members) which does not meet todays demands for any personal non office work, streaming, other connections for family.

Walls are paper thin and can hear neighbor(s) for any small subtle noises (even bathrooms! etc...) - Would recommend asking upon checkin about these concerns - including WiFi & possible room changes.

Other than that, enjoyed the stay and would still highly recommend.

reviews.author: South985
reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE!!
reviews.body: Front desk staff are HORRIBLE and they advertise movie theatre and golf simulator but all of that is an xtra charge. There is a pool table but it was trashed and the pool sticks were broken. I checked out two days early bc of the staff and spaciousness of the rooms. Rooms are VERY small! Don’t waste your money!

reviews.author: The last from STL
reviews.title: My favorite hotel in Memphis
reviews.body: The Aloft Hotel in Memphis is the best place to stay. Very friendly and welcoming staff. The hotel is always clean and the lobby area is a vibe. Very professional and helpful staff.

reviews.author: Nina Simone
reviews.title: Great Family Friendly Stay
reviews.body: I recently returned home from my stay here at the Aloft Downtown Memphis. As a customer my stay was exceptional. As a travel agent my stay was definitely recommendable. The customer service was exceptional, drinks/food were great, the room was clean and serviced well, the views were great and the location was not too far from anything - great for sightseeing.

reviews.author: Thaddeus
reviews.title: July stay while moving
reviews.body: Will most likely not be coming back.

reviews.author: Travelling Okies
reviews.title: Great brand with a catch
reviews.body: Love the Aloft brand and staying at these hotels. Room was perfect and quiet. Parking options are to park on the street at your own risk or pay $35 for valet (cost as of July 2026). This was not visibly disclosed on the reservation site and not discussed until we brought it up, after swiping the card.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Won’t be back
reviews.body:
The person at the front desk upon checking in wasn’t very welcoming or knowledgeable. I also had to fully check in and get keys because the hotel didn’t have any of that information though I had already checked in on the app and requested a mobile key. 
Once entering the room, the toilet paper looked already used with stains on them, and the room didn’t feel super clean. To make things much worse, later in the evening when we turned on the heat, the strong smell of urine came out. We requested a room change immediately. Fortunately we got one, and that room was better, but we still didn’t have a great experience. But Aloft looked like the best hotel in the area.

reviews.author: C
reviews.title: Nice Appearance. Terrible Service.
reviews.body: The aloft is in a semi sketchy area. It looks nice on the inside but the customer service is TERRIBLE.

reviews.author: Susie
reviews.title: Susie
reviews.body: The staff at this hotel is the friendliest, most helpful staff I have experienced in a very long time!!!  I will definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: RECOMMENDED 100
reviews.title: RECOMMENDED
reviews.body: If you’re looking for a nice and clean hotel in downtown, this is your place. Do not look around

reviews.author: Joyce
reviews.title: One night in Memphis
reviews.body: One of the best hotels we stayed in during our long road trip.

reviews.author: Solo Traveler Pete
reviews.title: Comfortable Rooms with Minimalist Approach
reviews.body:
Great location
Comfortably furnished rooms
Ample parking
Fantastic staff
Great food and beverage options

reviews.author: Nawlins Transplant
reviews.title: Wonderful Vibe at This Convenient Downtown Location
reviews.body: My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our five-day four-night stay. The music, several large coffee table books, and World Cup programming in the main area of the bar, seating area, outdoor patio and front desk were great. We enjoyed the breakfast in the mornings and the tapas and drinks in the evening. Everyone was always helpful and smiling - from the front desk personnel to the bar, breakfast area, patio and cleaning staff. The bed was super comfortable and the blackout blinds were great for the one morning we wanted to sleep in. There is a fully stocked and clean workout room. Many places are in walking distance, and in addition to a very friendly and helpful valet, there is plenty of nearby, inexpensive self-parking options. We loved this hotel and will be back.

reviews.author: Sgt Hunt
reviews.title: Great hotel to stay in Memphis, TN
reviews.body: Clean and comfortable beds

reviews.author: Kcav58
reviews.title: Great choice for Downtown Memphis
reviews.body: Just visited for the 3rd time at the Aloft Downtown Memphis. The room was very clean and well equipped with towels, etc. The location is in close walking distance to several restaurants and bars. The hotel bar is nice with a variety of options, but food menu/quality could be improved.

reviews.author: LDB
reviews.title: I had a nice stay!
reviews.body: Even though my overnight stay was short. I did enjoy the ambiance of the room. The aesthetic was very nice.  The front desk associate was nice also. I just didn’t like the parking arrangement. Good thing I’m from Memphis, and had my brother drop me off so he could keep my car at his place. $35 parking off site is absurd.  That’s my only complaint.

reviews.author: Blinding lights
reviews.title: Bright flashing fire alarm inside room
reviews.body: Hotel was ok. My issue was with the bright flashing light coming from the in room fire alarm, this was extremely annoying and woke me up several times. Gotta be a better design.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Gem of Memphis
reviews.body: Kudos to the staff of aloft downtown Memphis. From check-in to check-out nothing but great service. Great bang for your bucks. Great amenities and if u have a sweet tooth the banana pudding is to die for.

reviews.author: Yalunda55
reviews.title: Omega Sundress and Linen event
reviews.body: The hotel was very clean and located in an Awesome spot downtown Memphis. Customer service and Rooms Awesome non-issue or complaints

reviews.author: TMC88
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body:
As a Marriott Bonvoy member, I have stayed in many Marriott hotels, and unfortunately was disappointed in this one. Overall, the hotel just needs to be refreshed and updated. My room had large stains on the carpet, and   A toilet that was always running. 
I was interested in room service, but could not find any information on the offerings. There was no printed information and when I looked on the hotel channel at the TV it simply said it was under maintenance. The breakfast buffet was average at best. I would not recommend staying at this location.

reviews.author: Disappointed2026
reviews.title: Do not recommend staying here
reviews.body: The WiFi never worked right, the rooms are gross with stains and musty smells, constant noise at night, a/c barely works, the furniture in the room is broken, and there isn’t really good walkable stuff near by.

reviews.author: Unhappy experience
reviews.title: Unhappy Experience
reviews.body: I did not feel safe in this hotel. Hotel staff were nice to provide me late check out and i was able to check in early

reviews.author: Jenny
reviews.title: Marriott should be ashamed
reviews.body: Horrible sad hotel in desperate need of renovation. Friends had ants in their bed, others had no AC, and another had to sleep on a cot in a living room. Carpet stained. Elevators broken and creaking. Key card in elevator not working. WIFI unable to connect. TV in disrepair. The staff is making a heroic effort and should not be criticized for the embarrassment Marriott has let happen here.

reviews.author: Gracen
reviews.title: Very Disappointing Stay
reviews.body:
Our check-in process was smooth, but unfortunately, the positives ended there. I had requested extra pillows and a fan for our room ahead of check-in, but neither was provided and we had to ask for them once we arrived.

The room itself felt very dated and was not particularly clean. There were noticeable spots and marks on the walls, ceiling, floors, and door, and there were sparkles scattered all over the bathroom. Our room also had a balcony overlooking the lobby, but the balcony door was broken and would not shut completely. The room was uncomfortably warm throughout our stay despite the thermostat being set to 67°. The shower also had very poor water pressure.

One particularly concerning issue was that housekeeping apparently used our personal charging cords to charge her phone while cleaning the room. I found this inappropriate and invasive, especially when guests’ personal belongings should be left alone.

The fire alarms went off during our stay, and there was little to no guidance provided to guests about what was happening, which was unsettling.

The hotel lobby bathroom was absolutely disgusting. There was hair and trash throughout, along with an unpleasant smell. It was not remotely what I would expect from a hotel of this type.

We also had a disappointing interaction at checkout. We asked to have our bags held while we finished attending the conference, and the front desk employee appeared visibly inconvenienced by the request. After getting the bag tags, he walked back toward us mumbling and talking to himself the entire way. It made an already disappointing stay end on an even worse note.

The hotel also does not provide the river access or views that we expected from the name/location. The only real convenience for us was that the hotel was connected to the conference center, which made attending the conference easy.

Overall, this was a very disappointing experience. Between the cleanliness issues, outdated room, broken balcony door, uncomfortable temperature, poor shower pressure, lack of communication during the fire alarms, inappropriate use of our belongings, and poor customer service, there were simply too many issues to overlook. I would not choose to stay here again.

reviews.author: Anonymous07
reviews.title: Extremely dirty!
reviews.body: Room was very dirty with hair all over the bathroom floor and counters, urine/stool on the floor around the toilet, and stains on the bedding. Food service was fine but the food tasted awful! Air conditioning didn’t work most of the time either.

reviews.author: Tatiana
reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.body: The customer service was excellent from the time we walked in to check in to check out. The rooms were amazing. I had a great view, and the beds are comfortable.

reviews.author: Angie
reviews.title: Worst hotel !
reviews.body: This is the worst marriott property I’ve ever stayed at! Front desk staff terrible customer service, air conditioning did not work consistently throughout hotels some sections had no ac at all. My bathroom ceiling tile fell down and when I arrived to my room after checking in my bathroom had moldy insulation and tile all over the bathroom and in the toilet. I was given another room and when I asked if this was isolated incident was told “unfortunately this happens”! Totally unacceptable! The furniture in room wa beat up, stains on couch and torn leather in desk chair. I could go on and on…. DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL in its current condition!

reviews.author: Eddie from mass
reviews.title: Memphis stay
reviews.body: Hotel was nice and convenient  to convention center, staff was lacking in restaurant for guests that were known to be checked in on Wednesday.

reviews.author: Lion Hope
reviews.title: Staff is excellent
reviews.body: In spite of some A/C issues and power outage the staff at the front desk were patient, quickly responsive, and professional.  That attitude extended to the restaurant, maintenance and housekeeping.

reviews.title: Conference
reviews.body: Would not recommend- should have been compensated duly

reviews.author: Disappointed Traveler
reviews.title: The Worst Hotel Stay in my Life
reviews.body: On my 1st night (Wednesday), the A/C went out...my room temperature was 82 degrees. Maintenance finally arrived at 2:30 am.  He got the A/C cooling to 79 degrees.  However, at 6 am, the A/C temperature rose back to 82 degrees.  As a result, I got very little sleep before my conference. The Hotel then moved me to another room with working A/C.  I checked it out, and yes, the A/C was working fine. However, again, on my 2nd night (Thursday) around 2 a.m., my A/C stopped working... the temperature was at 81 degrees. Again, Maintenance arrived around 2:30 a.m. and repaired it; again, I did not get a good night's sleep for the conference. On my 3rd night (Friday), I was working on my computer, and around 4 pm, the power went out.  The room started to get hot (92 degrees), and the desk clerk said they were working on the electrical issues, but it probably wouldn't be fixed until MIDNIGHT (12). And yes, the power did go on, but my A/C was not working AGAIN... I called Maintenance, and they came and had to reset the compressor. Again, another poor night of sleep. On my 4th night (Saturday), the A/C was working without any problems. So, over the four nights I spent, I only had one night of restful sleep.

reviews.author: Not Happy and Dismissed
reviews.title: The Hotel you should Stay away from
reviews.body:
We were there for a convention for over 7 days ......

The A/C didn't work and we were told ..... its not that hot.

Housekeeping never showed up even we asked and even gave the maid a few dollars by her cart and asked her to noy forget us

They said they just changed hands and everything is a mess still

reviews.author: Betty 123
reviews.title: Hotel reviews
reviews.body: The checking staff was very good

reviews.author: 3musketeers
reviews.title: rundown hotel
reviews.body: if not because of the customer service you have, I won't be going back nor will recommend other to stay in this hotel

reviews.author: Lions
reviews.title: Lights went out
reviews.body: While we were there the electricity went out 4ish  after returning for the night around 10ish it was still not working. We were given the choice to transfer for just the night down the street. Since it was late we decided to stay and sweat it out.  Thankfully the electricity came back on sometime around 11-11:30.

reviews.author: Jene1234
reviews.title: The hotel was unprepared to handle the group.
reviews.body: I thought the Riverline Hotel was awful.

reviews.author: Lion Steve
reviews.title: Not ready for prime time
reviews.body: I stayed there since this was the headquarters hotel for a Lions gathering. The staff was very friendly and helpful, but the facility was understaffed especially with food service. In fact, when we went down for dinner the first night we were told they decided not to open because they didn't expect enough guests to be there. And there are absolutely no full-service restaurants within a comfortable walk of the hotel, especially in hundred degree plus temperatures. Such food as was offered was limited in selection and very overpriced. Two drinks cost almost $70 and took more than an hour because they did not have enough staffing. That said, the room was clean and comfortable, valet parking worked well, and we felt safe in the facility and nearby although there were very few people on the street (the temperatures certainly played a factor in that). Some of the elevators were out of service for part of a day, and another part of the hotel lost electrical power for several hours. If Memphis wants to attract more conventions, this hotel, the city, and the convention center all need to work together to provide the necessary amenities for visitors.

reviews.author: Elijah
reviews.title: After Visit Survey
reviews.body: The lights in room were out for over 4 hours which means the air conditioning system wasn't working. Extremely hot in the room.

reviews.author: Canada 2026
reviews.title: Canada 2026
reviews.body: Would not recommend. Not a great experience. Price vs quality doesn’t really match up.

reviews.author: John Scott
reviews.title: A great space that missed the mark.
reviews.body: When you first drive up you realize that this hotel, that is attached to a convention center, is not prepared for the huge amount of people who show up to use the convention center. The entry drive is crowded with just three cars and under staffed greeting, bell, and valet persons. Once you make it to the front desk, you find there are two people working and a huge crowd of guest that are lined up. Once you make it to the elevators, you figure out that only 3 of the 4 elevators is working and those that are working strand you for minutes between floors or shake and rattle as though they will fall apart. On the south tower there is no air-conditioning in the halls, the room HVAC was set at 67 and never stopped running the entire four day period. Now that you have settled in your room you head down to the bar/restaurant in the late afternoon to find that they are closed until 5pm and will only be open until 10pm. You attempt to get a drink when they do open, the one bartender is smoked by a counter full of people and the one waitress is slowly making her way around the room passing out menus and utensils in the bar area! On Saturday you find out that guests in the north tower are without power until 11pm. On the bright side, the staff that cleaned and straightened the rooms did so every day without asking and were very polite and helpful. Something you don't see anymore since hotels found out they could get away with not doing it during the "scamdemic".

reviews.author: Disappointed in 2026
reviews.title: USA/Canada Convention without Power and Good Restaurants
reviews.body: I hate to give bad reviews...Usually i just do not respond...but the experience was not a good one.   Only one restaurant with fair menu always crowded or not open.   Had to leave the hotel to get food.   Problems with power outrages and staff response to the situation.    Always have a good time at the USA/Canada Forums but this was a very poor choice.

reviews.author: disappointed
reviews.title: Hope for future
reviews.body: Am use to Marriott hospitality. and standards. Did not come close. Bedrooms adequate. TV great. Bath tub peeling. with the entire hotel used by our attendees, staffing was poor. Beverages in bar, was fortunate if they had anything. particularly beer. had to settle. one server in bar and a bar tender. they did the best they could . Resturant, , food , no variety. Electric went out in hotel.

reviews.author: Norbs
reviews.title: Weekend stay
reviews.body: Food & Beverages were good. Rooms were adequate, clean but old (carpet stains & chairs scuffed up). Lost power for about 12 hours and the only update received was when you called the front desk and all they said was it was being worked on. No apology for the inconvenience or giving a discount for one night stay or offering a meal or complementary drinks at the hotel.

reviews.author: Roger
reviews.title: Fun trip
reviews.body:
Good hotel.  Wood give a better
Review except rest was slow due to lack of waiters for full house

reviews.author: Unhappy
reviews.title: Very poor preparation for a large forum
reviews.body: The hotel was greatly understaffed, the facility in in disrepair,  I did not expect this type of experience from  Marriott hotel.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Definitely not Marriott quality
reviews.body: Avoid at all cost in the future

reviews.author: CBE 0309
reviews.title: Not up to par
reviews.body: The stay had its good points but these were outweighed by the downsides.  For this stay, the hotel did not live up to the expectations of the Marriott Bonvoy name and typical level of service.  In addition, the TV never worked, plus the space for the ICE Machine on our floor was empty with no ice, etc.

reviews.author: Jayn M
reviews.title: USA-Canada Forum
reviews.body: Hotel was in poor shape. Infrastructure needs a lot of work. Air conditioning did not work.

reviews.author: Jilldjab
reviews.title: Not at normal Marriott standards AT ALL!
reviews.body: While we were there, yes we arrived early, however I had to wait over 3 hours past typical check in time for our room. Even then I had to ask and was told no but they magically found a room when I asked how long it would be. Then the hotel had major power outages which of course included a/c. Then after it was back on, I called about the tv not working. I was told they would send someone right up. They never did, so no tv for the whole weekend! They were very dismissive as the front hotel staff. This is a Marriott conference center hotel which are normally very nice but this was a far cry from others that I have stayed in! Sad state for the rooms and hallways too.

reviews.author: Shannon Family
reviews.title: Exceptional Stay at Residence Inn by Marriott Memphis Downtown
reviews.body:
My stay at the Residence Inn by Marriott Memphis Downtown was outstanding from start to finish. As soon as we walked through the doors, we were greeted with a warm, welcoming smile by Ira, the evening manager on duty. Ira provided some of the best customer service I've experienced and immediately made us feel valued and at home.

The room was spacious, spotless, and well-maintained, providing everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The hotel's welcoming atmosphere, combined with the exceptional hospitality, truly set this property apart.

A special thank you to Ira for going above and beyond to ensure we had a great experience. If you're looking for excellent service, clean accommodations, and a friendly staff, I highly recommend Residence Inn by Marriott Memphis Downtown. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Elaine
reviews.title: Ole Miss trip to Memphis
reviews.body: We came to Memphis to see our grandson play football for Ole Miss stayed a few extra days to see Memphis loved your hotel our room and Memphis really enjoyed ourselves had no idea we would love the hotel as much as we did

reviews.author: Jim1958
reviews.title: Scenic views and amazing service!
reviews.body: Extremely safe and well protected, downtown (walking distance to dining, etc.) Great staff

reviews.author: Aunt Gertrude
reviews.title: Memphis Residence Inn Downtown is an oasis in the middle of Memphis!
reviews.body:
Traveling to Memphis to attend a conference at the Renasant Convention Center about a half-mile from the hotel, the Marriott Residence Inn Downtown Memphis was a great choice! Conveniently located in the heart of Downtown, it was an easy walk to the convention center for business or to Beale Street for fun and fabulous music. My suite was delightful, quiet, and comfortable. When the hairdryer conked out, Housekeeping brought another within five minutes. Ima is a charming hostess and gave great directions. 
When in Memphis again, I know where my home base will be: right in the heart of Downtown at the Residence Inn on Monroe. Thank you!

reviews.author: Travellers from Oz
reviews.title: Convenient and comfortable
reviews.body: The staff were very helpful, the location felt a little dodgy. The room was comfortable and spacious.

reviews.author: Sherry Young
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.body: This hotel is conviently located in the heart of downtown Memphis. The service from the valet to the check in was superb. Room very nice and clean. Awesome amenities.

reviews.author: Lynn
reviews.title: Best Staff EVER
reviews.body: The staff so courteous, friendly and makes everyone feel like old friends.

reviews.author: CajunCapt
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body: We first arrived at 1 AM. The person at the front desk was completely rude and a bunch of other choice words I cannot post the AC was broken and was 80° in my room we would’ve left, but it was 1 AM when we checked in but they did fix it the following day. Housekeeping only came once for three nights stay.

reviews.author: One night visitor
reviews.title: Value and Service
reviews.body: I find the Residence Inns offer a good value.  My room was clean and tidy and the kitchen was well stocked with paper towels, cups, bowels, silverware, and everything else I might need.  The rooftop offers great views of the surrounding area and has several tables and chairs for guests.  I appreciate that the breakfast staff were friendly and helpful and even advised me to wait for a fresh batch of eggs being brought out in a few minutes.

reviews.author: Brian Kiser
reviews.title: Memphis Residence Inn Downtown
reviews.body: Hotel is nice as a renovation.  City is charming and so are the staff and nearby businesses.

reviews.author: Sindhura Tripuraneni
reviews.title: Happy Home
reviews.body: Feel like Happy Home. People are responsible.

reviews.author: Eagleschick
reviews.title: Great stay in Memphis
reviews.body: Exemplary staff and stay! The location is great and the rooftop area is a BONUS! Will definitely stay here again when in the area!

reviews.author: Greg R
reviews.title: Sketchy Area
reviews.body: While this hotel was great inside the area not so much. Didn’t feel safe even during the day.

reviews.author: conference doc
reviews.title: Good for downtown but could be better.
reviews.body:
Very noisy generators and moved from 4th to 11th floor which helped and kept fan on all the time. 
Step up to bedroom/bath area had poor lighting so had to be careful - poor lighting overall
Clean bathroom and bed a bit to soft for me but adequate
Kitchenette adequate with stainless steel pans rather than the cheap, beaten typical teflon pans in hotels
Breakfast was average and OK but not fantastic
Ima at front desk excellent and staff overall great
Downtown area with little open during the week for eating and no restaurant or cafe in hotel.  Five star restaurant within walking distance. 
Homeless/needy people around hotel. Just a few blocks from the Peabody Hotel and the noted "duck experience". 
Carpet was pretty dirty and needed cleaned.

reviews.author: First time in Memphis
reviews.title: First time at a residence, Inn
reviews.body: We were fortunate to get upgraded to a penthouse suite which was well appointed and very comfortable and quiet

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: I always stay at the Residence Inn by Marriott Memphis Downtown
reviews.body: Everyone is friendly, the rooms are well sized and I am in the middle of DT MEM.

reviews.author: Harley Jae 0210
reviews.title: It was Magic in Memphis at the Marriott Residence Inn
reviews.body: I feel like that the over and beyond experience with the staff friendly. The food was delicious for breakfast cleanliness was 10 out of 10 staff professionalism 10 out of 10. The food the 10 out of 10. I had a wonderful time

reviews.author: A Veli Jr
reviews.title: Residence Inn Downtown
reviews.body: For anyone visiting Memphis, the downtown Residence Inn would be my recommendation as to where to stay. Conveniently located amongst restaurants and shops and staffed by professionals who go out of they’re way to make your stay as pleasant as possible. I thoroughly enjoyed my time at the hotel.

reviews.author: Lily
reviews.title: The best hotel ever
reviews.body:
Wonderful stay 
Clean and quite 
The cleaning ladies are awesome

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: A Pleasant Experience
reviews.body: The staff is professional, helpful and friendly. The facility was clean and welcoming.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Friendly and attentive staff with an experience filled with all of my needs.

reviews.author: DC3Oz
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: Great place to stay (Just watch out for the almost $40 valet parking.

reviews.author: Marriott Traveler
reviews.title: Convenient location only
reviews.body: Although this Marriott was convenient for the travel we completed, the hotel is definitely very dated and the ‘queen-sized’ bedding was way smaller than a standard queen, and too small for 2 grown adults. King beds were not offered at the time of booking. Also, I feel the price per night was a bit much. The staff were extremely cordial and helpful however.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Non-responsive management
reviews.body:
The following relates entirely to my experience and to my personal opinion:

Had multiple issues during my stay, some were addressed, some were not, some were outright ignored by management that was seemingly absentee and non-responsive (Ms. Henninger). 

This place could be a lot better if it were run better. I don't want anyone to lose their job. 

Olga, Ms. Brown, Rick, Edna, and Andrew were/are wonderful. I won't publicly name the other employees who aren't, in my experience and my opinion.

reviews.author: JLWADE
reviews.title: BOYS BASEBALL
reviews.body: THE STAFF AND HOTEL WAS AMAZING AND THE ROOM WAS VERY SPACIOUS WITH EVERYTHING WE NEEDED

reviews.author: Mrs Souza
reviews.title: Overall, a pleasant stay with great service
reviews.body:
The staff was extremely kind and welcoming — truly one of the highlights of our stay.
The rooms were very good, and with the upgrade, we ended up in a spacious, well-equipped apartment with a full kitchen and everything we needed, which made our stay very comfortable.

My overall score is a 7 mainly because housekeeping was not provided daily, which was a bit disappointing. Also, there is no on-site parking. We had to pay for valet service, and the car was parked in a public garage, which didn’t feel very secure — although, luckily, we didn’t have any issues.
Overall, a pleasant stay with great service, but a few areas could be improved.

reviews.author: CHill
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.body: This hotel is in a prime location! Very walkable to local restaurants and shops. Will definitely return

reviews.author: World travelers
reviews.title: Terrific Staff at Residence Inn Downtown Memphis
reviews.body: We have stayed in hotels all over the world, and have had several great experiences.  However, the friendliest staff we have ever experienced was at the Residence Inn Marriott Downtown Memphis!  Every single person including the valet, the front desk, the manager, the cleaning personnel, everyone went out of their way to speak, be extremely courteous, asked how could they help, was there anything we needed and seemed genuinely interested in us and our stay.  My wife and I were both blown away by the level of service and how pleasant the entire staff were.

reviews.author: Pete S
reviews.title: Residence Inn Downtown Memphis
reviews.body: Location and Rooms on Point

reviews.author: Dr Dov
reviews.title: Family and football game!
reviews.body: We had a mini reunion; enjoyed the Southern Heritage Classic football game. The hotel had the perfect location. We had good food and easy access to all events.

reviews.author: DJax
reviews.title: Expected better
reviews.body:
Not up to the standards of The Westin that you’d expect.
Poor customer service, food, and tired rooms.
There are better, lesser, Marriott options in town.

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.title: Unfriendly staff
reviews.body: Unfortunately, the hotel staff were quite unfriendly and not helpful at all. They often seemed impatient and short-tempered whenever we asked for assistance, which made us feel uncomfortable and unwelcome. The level of customer service was disappointing and definitely needs improvement.

reviews.author: Jah2
reviews.title: Very pleased
reviews.body: First time staying in this particular hotel, but definitely won’t be our last. Came to visit our kids and decided to stay downtown. Everyone was extremely nice and helpful from the front desk to the valet staff. The bar attendants inside the bar/restaurant was also equally helpful. Room was very clean, bed was very comfortable, had all we needed. Only hiccup was the tv couldn’t be used the first night due to remote not working. Figured it was the batteries but didn’t want to go down to the desk to ask for them. No big deal. Bathroom was huge and rain shower was amazing.

reviews.author: AA007
reviews.title: Short Business Stay
reviews.body: The hotel was very nice. The rooms were roomy and comfortable. The staff were excellent, very kind and helpful. I would stay here again and recommend the hotel to others.

reviews.author: Kp Reviewed
reviews.title: Best Thing Memphis Has so...I guess so.
reviews.body: The people are friendly and the service is okay. But the basics are lacking for the price. Worn toilet seats, poor shower temperature regulation, dirt caulking that makes it all seem nasty.

reviews.author: Christine N
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Great location to Beale Street and short drive to Midtown - Cooper Young.  It's also right across the street from concert venue. Easy to find, super clean, nice staff, loved the pillows and had snacks/drinks as needed.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Great Location Perfect Buy
reviews.body: I booked this space last minute for a solo trip. I loved the location. I was able to walk and enjoy the food and scene then rest and come back out at night and do it all again. It was perfect. As a solo woman, I also felt safe to walk that distance alone.

reviews.author: Wichita KS
reviews.title: Perfect place to stay for a tourist going to Beale Street! I don’t know
reviews.body: Great place to stay clean all the extras great staff!

reviews.author: Rochelle
reviews.title: The Westin
reviews.body: I went here for a getaway with the family. It was decent the rooms clean. We love the view. The food was mediocre at the restaurant. The front desk staff wasn’t so pleasant. The housekeeping was top-tier. The elevator can use some work. The location was amazing.

reviews.author: A Satisfied Customer
reviews.title: Conference Stay
reviews.body: The Westin on Beal Street was very conveniently located.  The hotel was clean and comfortable and the staff were friendly, helpful, and courteous.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: What An Experience
reviews.body: Great staff, great bar, Ms J was amazing.  Great atmosphere for adults to converse about life.

reviews.author: Jenfried
reviews.title: Restful stay
reviews.body: Location is supreme. Can walk to several dining options. Right next to FedEx center. Huge plus during bb season. Staff was welcoming and helpful.

reviews.author: TLM818
reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.body: Overall, this is a very nice hotel and a good location for downtown Memphis.

reviews.author: RoMaddie 1223
reviews.title: AVOID!  Memphis has far better options!
reviews.body:
The hotel was poorly managed from start to finish, with constant miscommunication, lack of follow-through, and a complete failure to recognize or support loyal Bonvoy members.
Prior to our arrival, the Ambassador Desk proactively contacted us and advised that an Executive Suite had been arranged for our three-night stay. The suite continued to show as available until the very hour we checked in. However, upon arrival, we were informed that the suite had been given away. While our late arrival was due to airline weather delays and therefore outside the hotel's control, it was extremely disappointing and inappropriate that a room that had been discussed and seemingly secured in advance was released without any accommodation or communication.
Instead, we were assigned a very small room that appeared not to have been properly cleaned. To make matters worse, the toilet was not functioning and would not flush. The television remote also did not work. We reported the issues immediately, yet the hotel did not make any meaningful effort to address the toilet problem until the afternoon of the following day. Having a non-functioning toilet for that length of time is simply unacceptable.
At check-in, we were also told that if a suite became available the next day, we could be moved and that the request had been noted in our reservation. However, when we attempted to follow up the next day, we were told all available suites had already been assigned. The front desk employee then advised that no notes or documentation had been left regarding our request despite the assurances we had received. This became a recurring theme throughout our stay—promises made, notes supposedly entered, and then no record of anything when it came time to deliver.
During our stay, I requested assistance finding a suitable location for an important business meeting. I was assured that someone would either call or message me first thing the next morning. As with several other commitments made by the hotel, nobody ever contacted me.
We also received no luggage assistance upon arrival or departure and were never offered assistance at any point during our stay. We saw another elderly couple from Australia having to push their own luggage cart and unload everything.  They too commented on the lack of American hospitality.  
Another frustrating issue was the complete disconnect between the front desk staff and the Bonvoy chat representatives. The front desk personnel seemed unfamiliar with conversations that had taken place through the Bonvoy chat, and information did not appear to be documented or communicated between teams. Nothing felt organized, coordinated, or customer-focused.
As an Ambassador Elite member, I was disappointed that standard elite recognition appeared to be absent. We were not offered breakfast or points, benefits that are commonly extended across Marriott properties. In addition, obtaining a late checkout became a significant challenge despite our Ambassador status, with the explanation repeatedly being that this was a convention hotel. While I understand that convention properties face unique operational demands, elite recognition and basic customer service should not disappear because the hotel is busy.
Throughout the stay, nearly every issue—including room maintenance requests—was met with excuses rather than solutions. To make matters worse, the individuals communicating through the Bonvoy chat seemed more interested in making assumptions and arguing about circumstances than in actually helping resolve the problems we were experiencing.
I have been a Marriott Bonvoy member for well over 15 years and have maintained Platinum status or higher throughout that time. I have held Ambassador status for at least 10 of those years. According to the Bonvoy app, I have stayed 1,256 nights at Marriott properties. With that level of experience and loyalty, I can confidently say that this was the worst Marriott stay I have ever experienced.
The experience was so poor that we shortened our planned three-night stay to just one night and moved to another property for the remainder of our trip.
This stay represented a complete breakdown in communication, service, follow-through, and elite member recognition. Unfortunately, after this experience, we have no intention of returning. Never again.

reviews.author: Melvin
reviews.title: My stay
reviews.body: Enjoyed my stay but sitting area out front at night was crowded with non hotel stayer people from all over was sitting in seats and couldn’t enjoy

reviews.author: Sac Town on the move
reviews.title: Great location. In need of updating
reviews.body: The location of this hotel is awesome. The staff friendly. The rooms were very dated and the showers disgusting. There is no lounge and they do not offer you any breakfast or Starbucks which was disappointing. They did give me a $15 credit which would not have gotten you a full breakfast with tip.

reviews.author: Upset Gold Member
reviews.title: Westin Beale Street Location
reviews.body: This particular Westin location is not the greatest. The staff is nice, but the rooms look extremely old and not as clean as they should be.

reviews.author: Lisa A
reviews.body: Professional-friendly staff.  Room is up-to-date and well maintained.  Ill choose this location everytime.  Rightbonnthe cusp of everything going on on Beale Street. Positioned on the 6th floor and didnt hear any noise from outside.  Absolutely great experience.

reviews.author: Dallasgirl
reviews.title: Okay stay
reviews.body:
Housekeeping never cleaned the room
Valet was slow
Road closures every night was aggravating

reviews.author: Lisa H
reviews.title: Find a quieter place
reviews.body: Noise at 3am and they did nothing until I called 3 times

reviews.author: WHooper
reviews.title: Not the Westin we are accustomed to visiting
reviews.body: The people were friendly. We just didn’t get the same level of service that we get at other Westin properties. No bellhop, no one offered to get us ice, the rooms seemed older and weren’t as nice as other Westin hotels, and the restaurant wasn’t great. However, we still enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: What is a profile number
reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.body:
The toilet room was leaking continuously throughout my stay, I had to place folded bath towels on the floor to avoid getting feet wet.
Informed front desk but nothing was done to address the problem.

reviews.author: GenXtraveler 77
reviews.title: Dated but great service and location.
reviews.body:
Parts were dated in rooms. There’s rust and the shower should be re-grouted.
Other than that things were great!

reviews.author: Kathy54
reviews.title: Good location,poor service
reviews.body: Right near Beale Street so excellent location . Sadly lacking in customer service ; bedroom not cleaned properly or bed made. Court side grill had excellent & helpful staff , good food & drink.

reviews.author: Conf42926
reviews.title: Event Catering
reviews.body: The food was very good, lots of choices. The bar service for the conference was average, the event bar was not stocked very well, couldn’t accept credit/debit/applepay. Bartenders were courteous and helpful though.

reviews.author: Not good
reviews.title: Not good
reviews.body: Not good crime is rampant there the place is old and shows it.

reviews.author: Bgentry422
reviews.title: Great stay in Memphis
reviews.body: Great stay! Spacious rooms and very clean. The hotel was beautiful and we felt very safe. I liked the link up to the parking garage.

reviews.author: Review of a local
reviews.title: Nothing to write home about.
reviews.body: Location to the forum and a quiet room were the only positives.

reviews.author: York
reviews.title: Good choice in Memphis
reviews.body: Hotel was clean and up to date. I would stay again. Staff was friendly but service was not above and beyond. Staff more on the dry side. I had to ask questions about where things were located as they were not explained to me during check in. Restaurant was decent but I would’ve rather door dashed as the service was understaffed and the food was okay. They looked really short handed over all.

reviews.author: KRE2026
reviews.title: The Memphian is a Gem!
reviews.body: The Memphian is truly fantastic and an excellent choice for your visit to Memphis. Walking distance to many great restaurants and shopping, as well as to Overton park for walking and golf, as well as the art museum and zoo...it hits all the high points for a great Memphis trip!

reviews.author: Ambassador Member
reviews.title: The Hotel is good, but the hotel parking security guards are unprofessional and extremely rude to guests
reviews.body: The hotel is good; however, the parking security guards extreme unprofessionalism and attitudes are the reason I will select another hotel when visiting my hometown in the future. Please be aware, if you are a registered guest, that does not guarantee you will have a parking space at the hotel.  The security guards should spend their time ensuring the people parking there are guests instead of harassing and making actual guests uncomfortable and unwelcome.

reviews.author: Seth S
reviews.title: Boutique experience
reviews.body: I had a good time with my friend. The hotel has an eclectic look that is good for any occasion. The breakfast food was great and the staff is very friendly and nice. The rooms are modern and unique. The patterns in the decor were my favorite part.

reviews.author: Theft
reviews.title: THEFT
reviews.body: Premises are not secure.  Housekeeping may enter room and get things that do not belong to them.

reviews.author: CAS64
reviews.title: We love the Memphian!! Miss it already!!
reviews.body: We usually stay at the Peabody but wanted a change because it is so crowded. Peabody-never again. What a great decision. The Memphian was so charming. The staff were friendly, and the restaurant was excellent. The room was spacious and felt luxurious. You are in the theater district and can walk to a play and other restaurants. You can also walk to Overton Park.

reviews.author: Will
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel is always clean, the staff is always helpful, and the food choices are amazing.

reviews.author: FL Davis
reviews.title: Youthful desk staff creates guest issues
reviews.body: Will not be staying again. PS re-train your youthful desk staff. The housekeeping and wait staff are great but the young desk clerks are indifferent and careless. Our booking literally was changed while we were there.

reviews.author: Freeman12
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body: The stay was excellent. The staff was very helpful after we experienced car issues. We will continue to stay here for future visits to Memphis.

reviews.author: JoeyG
reviews.title: Modern option in Memphis
reviews.body: Great property and nice rooms, but lacking a concierge lounge and slow service in the restaurant

reviews.author: Dave S
reviews.title: Refuel and Relax
reviews.body: Terrific stop between TX and KY. Guests are right in the middle of a vibrant action yet could also enjoy quiet and privacy. One of the best overnight we have experienced on years. Staff was incredible.

reviews.author: TamiN
reviews.title: Memphis stay
reviews.body: This hotel is decorated so fun and welcoming. The staff is friendly and there are plenty restaurants in the area.  I’d highly recommend this to anyone traveling to Memphis.

reviews.author: Rosie and Randall
reviews.title: Always an uplifting experience at the Memphian
reviews.body: The Memphian provides a unique, and certainly above average lodging experience.  From the Pilgrim to the Peacock, we enjoy all aspects of this wonderful hotel.  We met here for the first time over 3 years ago, and have returned many times.  The Memphian never disappoints....

reviews.author: Chyna Dolltam
reviews.title: The best of the best!
reviews.body: The Memphian hotel experience truly starts in the lobby. From the beautiful multicolor chandelier to the live music coming from the piano placed in the corner. The Moet vending machine as you board the elevator. The rooftop restaurant, Tiger Peacock, and the ambience that it embodies is immaculate. Complicated Pilgrim in all of the delicious food that is also within the hotel is everything 1 could ask for. I definitely will stay here again and visit the rooftop again.

reviews.author: Rachel t
reviews.title: Cute fun hotel
reviews.body: Upon walking in you can tell this isn’t your normal Marriott. The hotel has fun vibrant prints sprinkled through out. Near the elevator is a champagne machine.

reviews.author: J12345
reviews.title: Boutique hotel conveniently located
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay at The Memphian. Quiet room ( thank you Sean), conveniently located, nice breakfast( thanks Reilly). Areas for improvement: 1) Shower didn’t drain. I lifted the drain cover and discovered housekeeping forgot to clean/ remove hair from drain 2) Minimum hot water on one morning. However, I would stay at the Memohian again

reviews.author: JJohnson87
reviews.title: The perfect stay
reviews.body: The Memphian was the perfect place for my weekend stay in Memphis. The spacious room and friendly staff added to my experience. Parking felt safe and secure. Best cocktail at the rooftop bar, Tiger & Peacock.

reviews.author: My stay at the Memphian
reviews.title: My stay at the Memphian
reviews.body: After staying here, I can kiss the Peabody Hotel goodbye.

reviews.author: TXBaseballMom
reviews.title: Warm & Welcoming
reviews.body: I have stayed at The Memphian on two separate occasions—spending a total of 7 or 8 nights between the two so this review comes from someone who has experienced all the amenities.  My room, for both stays, was spotless, roomy and very comfortable.  The entire hotel was well kept from the ground floor to the rooftop and the food at both restaurants is great.  They have a good walkability score with nice shops & restaurants nearby.  Last note—I have to give a shout out to Angel—my favorite front desk agent whose kindness and helpfulness is greatly appreciated.

reviews.author: DrEW
reviews.title: My go-to place to stay in Memphis
reviews.body:
This continues to be my go-to place to stay whenever I am in Memphis. Every visit is met with warm hospitality, welcoming smiles, comfortable accommodations, and consistently excellent service.

During my most recent stay, I was especially impressed by Santriece St. Valentine. She remembered me immediately from a visit months earlier, and that level of genuine care and attentiveness reinforced exactly why I make it a point to stay here whenever I am in town. Seeing her again truly made my day.

What made the experience even more meaningful is that she was incredibly helpful during my last visit as well, going above and beyond to assist my elderly parents with kindness and patience. That level of service is rare and leaves a lasting impression. It is clear that she genuinely cares about guests and creating a positive experience.

My room was clean, comfortable, and made for a wonderful stay. While the hotel cannot control the activity on the street below, guests staying on a weekend, particularly in a room facing the main street, may want to bring ear plugs if they are light sleepers. That said, the view more than made up for it.

Looking forward to returning in August.

reviews.author: Nat1967
reviews.title: Excellent hotel and remarkable restaurants
reviews.body:
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at The Memphian hotel. I reserved the Champagne room located inside of Tiger and Peacock restaurant. The service was amazing. We enjoyed are rooms. Breakfast was delicious at the Complicated Pilgrim, always book through open table for reservations. 

Thank you for an amazing birthday experience at The Memphian hotel

Natalyn Whittington

reviews.author: Nora
reviews.title: Very nice and classy
reviews.body: I have stayed 3 times and always very clean and the staff is so nice.

reviews.author: Dana JW
reviews.title: The Memphian, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
reviews.body: Highly recommend this hotel, great location and customer service.

reviews.author: Bill from East TN
reviews.title: Memphian - Excellent Stay
reviews.body: Our stay at the Memphian was excellent. The employees were friendly and helpful.  The room was clean and quite nice. The location in Overton Square is convenient to midtown, with lots of nice restaurants nearby.

reviews.author: BHMfamily
reviews.title: Special gem in Midtown Memphis
reviews.body: We stayed at The Memphian for a weekend visit. We loved the hotel, which has a boutique feel. The staff (front desk, housekeeping, dining) were all personable and went out of their way to make our stay great. We will be back!

reviews.author: TomN
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: Very nicely appointed hotel with comfortable rooms and a great location.

reviews.author: PC Palace
reviews.title: A unique hotel experience in Midtown
reviews.body: I was truly impressed with the Memphian Hotel in Midtown Overland Square. I had both breakfast and lunch at the restaurant and the staff were friendly and respectful. I thought it was a restored hotel but found out it was built within the past 5 years. Great touch of classic and modern amenities. I plan to stay at the Memphian anytime I'm in town.

reviews.author: 321 go
reviews.title: Great Location, Staff, and Decor Lacks one thing.
reviews.body: Overall was pleased with the service and Hotel. Tiger and Peacock is a must. Such a unique and cozy rooftop experience. One major problem was the total lack of any microwave. How are you to either reheat a snack, warm water for baby formula, etc? First hotel that I have stayed in that did not have ANY access to a microwave in any public area. Could have easily had one in the hydration station area that they have on every floor. Not having that amenity that almost every hotel in America has seems as an oversight.

reviews.author: Weekenders
reviews.title: Great place to stay in midtown
reviews.body: Highly recommend staying. Also recommend reservations for their roof top bar otherwise you will not be able to get in. Parking can be limited on busy weekends.

reviews.author: Rich W
reviews.title: Fab stay at the Memphian!
reviews.body: Cool, unusual decor, artsy- one of the best Marriott properties I’ve been to in 20 years.

reviews.author: Overton
reviews.title: Last minute
reviews.body: Very accommodating. I arrived very early and didn’t expect a room to be available,but was surprised they found accommodations

reviews.author: Airport hotel
reviews.title: One and Only Stay
reviews.body: The hotel has an 8’ security fence around the property so that should tell you about the location.

reviews.author: Dee from Dayton Oh
reviews.title: Recent stay
reviews.body: Excellent facility except for breakfast options.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Room Quality
reviews.body: Rooms cleanliness was terrible, definitely will not stay again

reviews.author: OhItzNiyah07
reviews.title: Great price , great stay
reviews.body: This trip was booked late , so for there to be no hiccups and a smooth process was great. Rooms were a little smaller than expected but never he less the comfort didn’t lack and me and two other fit fine. The staff were nice and had great energy no matter he time.

reviews.author: Frequent traveler
reviews.title: Things could be done better
reviews.body: Bed and room comfortable.  First room ac leaked, had to move rooms, 1st one was a nicer space, but I guess that was what they had, no one to repair it all weekend. No working ice machine for the customers, had to go to the Bistro to get only an ice bucket filled. Breakfast was good but expensive! Faucets in the room did not have cold water only lukewarm or hot.

reviews.author: TL
reviews.title: Outstanding customer seru
reviews.body: Nice hotel with all the amenities to make for a relaxing stay. What sets this hotel apart os that the employees are truly dedicated to assuring you have a pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Cookie
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: The staff was friendly and helpful. The room was cozy. The breakfast was delicious!

reviews.author: Starr
reviews.title: Great time in Memphis
reviews.body: I just got home from Memphis. It was Elvis week and my daughter and I love going every year if possible.  We stayed at the Marriott Memphis Airport. It was so convenient to all the places we wanted to visit so that was great for us. The hotel was very nice and clean and updated.  The staff greeted us with friendly smiles and nice hellos. Throughout our stay we came and went at all hours but the staff was helpful and nice at all times. We felt safe and comfortable the whole time. Plenty of parking that was a great convenience.  It was just an overall great experience and stay!

reviews.author: CA Traveler
reviews.title: Hotel on highway.  Loud.  No sleep
reviews.body: This hotel is located along the highway and its loud.  Airport pickup is only available if the flight crew that stays hasn't already filled up all the seats, they are the priority.  Some staff is nice, others are surly.  Several in training.

reviews.author: Pedro L
reviews.title: Great place power outage dampened the experience
reviews.body: Everything was great about the actual facility and staff, but, the power going out in the middle night.

reviews.author: NotHappy
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.body:
Unless you like terrible service, constant smells of chemicals-- been under construction the past 18 months. 

Stay at one of the many other options

reviews.author: Toni
reviews.title: Shuttle service should take return calls by name
reviews.body: Rooms were very clean.  Service at desk was great. Shuttle service cost me $35 taxi ride.

reviews.author: J Jones
reviews.title: Unhappy
reviews.body: The power went out and there is no attempt to discuss the issues. Everyone was sweating in the morning, no showers, packed in the dark, no coffee, front desk was not supportive, manager was sympathetic, but GM didn't return the call.

reviews.author: T Trice
reviews.title: Power Outage
reviews.body:
Unpleasant front desk staff. During my stay I also experienced a power outage at 3am and had to pack and get ready for the shuttle in the dark. Since the phones and doors were locked, I missed the shuttle and almost missed my flight. 

Very unpleasant and inconvenient experience.

reviews.author: KAM
