reviews.title: Close to Airport
reviews.body: It was ok for our purpose. Our flight got in around 2am. The we were back to the airport to rent a car. So we weren’t there long. Not a great neighborhood, but close the airport.

reviews.author: CW
reviews.title: Old and run down
reviews.body: The staff here are unwilling to be helpful. The hotel is old and needs updating. Smells stale. None of the ice machines were working. The elevators are a long walk from the front desk. Which is challenging when you have multiple bags. We would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Airport travelers
reviews.title: Poor stay
reviews.body: Terrible experience in a bad part of Memphis. Hard to believe that Marriott allows this facility to be a franchise courtyard. Not well maintained.

reviews.author: Nicole Bautista
reviews.title: Unfortunate experience
reviews.body: This was not a hotel we would return to. We were on the hotel premises for 12 hours. During that time, we had malfunctioning air conditioning during July, a non functioning ice machine, and two days of parking charges for a twelve hour stay.

reviews.author: Peter V
reviews.title: 7 days for an email receipt?
reviews.body: Decent location. Nice facility.  Great staff.  But, breakfast not included?

reviews.author: Letstravel
reviews.title: Flights cancelled, one night at the hotel
reviews.body: Got to the hotel aelhnd 11 pm, trying to sleep and catch a flight next day at 4:30 am. Guests at the pool playing loud music at 11 pm, loud party,

reviews.author: JJ23
reviews.title: Hot and muggy yet helpful and friendly
reviews.body: Staying by the airport to take an early flight was a good idea. The shuttle driver, Jasmine, was incredibly patient with my calls to figure out the maze of getting from the car rental drop off to shuttle pick up. Once in the shuttle, she kindly inquired whether I had eaten and shared her favorite places in Memphis when I inquired. I was a solitary traveler and the only one to be picked up at that time. It was refreshing to be out of the heat and treated with such kind professionalism. The staff at the desk both evening and morning were also friendly and professional. The AC was out in the lobby in the morning, and I felt for the staff who had to work in the discomfort. The hotel and room were clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Review of Recent Stay
reviews.body: Poor. Hotel is in desperate need of a remodel. Water-stained ceilings, non-operational air-conditioner in the lobby, no restaurant/bar in the evening, broken window in the airport shuttle. Won't stay here again.

reviews.author: BH
reviews.title: Damp room and Unfriendly staff
reviews.body: As previously mentioned in the first box.

reviews.author: Parrish party  of 5
reviews.title: Holiday weekend getaway
reviews.body: Nice hotel.   Very accommodating!  Will stay again.

reviews.author: My stay
reviews.title: Cleanliness
reviews.body: This hotel needs a lot of structure and management help, the staff looked lost and don’t seem to interact with the customers, the staff expression on their faces look like they’re being bothered by the customers.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.title: AC problems
reviews.body: AC problems in the lobby, and more importantly in the room, which wasn't adequately addressed.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Do not stay here
reviews.body: I have stayed over 1000 nights at Marriott properties in the last 10 years. Worst courtyard ever. Staff is rude. Hotel layout is poor. Hallways, elevators and staircases a filthly. Property does not feel safe. Bistro staff did not show up on time to open in the morning. Yelled at customers watching the worldcup when they cheered for there team scoring. Odd since Marriott is one of the sponsors. Did not serve complete order. Staff was sitting at a table playing on her phone. When asked where our water was she said "go get it yourself at the front desk"

reviews.author: Kh1040
reviews.title: Subpar
reviews.body: The airport was a little dark upon entering and stayed that way even when people were at the “bar”. The elevators are on the opposite side of the building (no joke). The receptionist said it is down the hall and on the left, but it was literally half a mile walk to the elevators. The rooms were clean and nice though. The airport shuttle during the day = don’t trust it because it will not run every 30 minutes, we waited for over an hour and then called an uber. However, during the evening/early morning times it was on time.

reviews.author: Tenntraveler
reviews.title: What a joke of a place
reviews.body: Marriott is known for its upscale resorts/ hotels. The one in Memphis tn by the airport should just be bulldozed down..

reviews.author: Harnetthounds
reviews.title: Great airport location
reviews.body: Staff went above and beyond. Great spacious room. Timely shuttle

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Decent Stay
reviews.body: Hotel was clean and comfortable with some minor issues with the bathroom and the juice machine not working.  Staff were courteous and helpful.

reviews.author: Nina59
reviews.title: Nina59
reviews.body: Highly recommend this hotel. The rooms are very spacious and beds are comfortable.  Very safe area and easy access to highway.  Just 18 minutes to downtown Memphis.

reviews.author: BJ
reviews.title: Convention
reviews.body: Had a great time. The Hotel was clean and the staff was GREAT!

reviews.author: Cht
reviews.title: Happy I had no problem
reviews.body: I had no problem staying at the hotel for couple of days my room was clean.

reviews.author: MAC
reviews.title: Memphis
reviews.body: Friendly staff, clean comfortable room and good breakfast

reviews.author: Satisfied customer
reviews.title: First time acquaintance with a wonderful experience  !
reviews.body: Very well pleased !!!! Comfortable,  affordable, great location with many places you could choose from walking distance.

reviews.author: PB
reviews.title: Long‑time Marriott Bonvoy member, extremely disappointed.
reviews.body:
As a long‑time Bonvoy member, I have consistently chosen Marriott because of the hospitality, cleanliness, and care that once defined the brand. Unfortunately, my recent stay in Marion, AR fell far below Marriott standards and left my family feeling disregarded during an already painful time.During our stay for my brother’s funeral, we encountered multiple issues that are unacceptable for any hotel, let alone a Marriott‑affiliated property:

Unfriendly and dismissive front desk agents

Bugs found in our bedPoor room cleanliness

Management and staff showing no concern or urgency

This was not simply an inconvenience — it compounded an already difficult moment in our lives. 

What was once a trusted brand now feels inconsistent and indifferent, especially across franchised locations where quality control appears to be slipping.

As a loyal Bonvoy customer, I no longer feel valued. I am requesting that this matter be reviewed at the corporate level, with appropriate follow‑up regarding guest safety, cleanliness standards, and staff training at this location. 

Experiences like this erode trust, and I hope Marriott will take meaningful steps to restore confidence in the brand

reviews.author: Judith34
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.body: Ac didn’t work. Gave me box fan. Couldn’t move rooms because they were full. 82°.  Pillows stunk. Beds were hard. Stay elsewhere. Property manager was rude and offered me 1,000 points as he wouldn’t stand on their 100% guaranteed night stay. Awful service

reviews.author: OHIO Bound
reviews.title: Overnight stay
reviews.body: The stay was great after long day on road of travel. Woke up refreshed the next morning to hit the road again. Prices were a bit steep but overall good.

reviews.author: jl
reviews.title: Damp sheets
reviews.body: Sheets on both beds were damp.

reviews.author: Nice place to stay
reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.body: It was a very nice hotel, clean, quiet and spacious. The only thing that would be better would be to have a way to charge phones directly from USB in the breakfast area.

reviews.author: DLB1
reviews.title: Excellent night's sleep and Breakfast and on my way!
reviews.body: I have stayed here before and I will return again.  Easy on and off of the freeway.  Staff is professional and helpful.  I feel valued as a customer.  Clean and comfortable.  Excellent Breakfast.

reviews.author: traveler63
reviews.title: Pain
reviews.body: It was a painful experience.

reviews.author: GJWMS
reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.body: Location was great, the staff were helpful and friendly. Rooms were clean and comfortable. Will stay again.

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: Excellent staff and stay
reviews.body: Keesha at the front desk is incredibly kind, patient and efficient. Our room was a nice size with everything we needed (plugins on both sides of the bed), very clean, and some of the best shower water pressure I’ve had. Safe and convenient location. Breakfast is perfectly fine - a normal hotel hot bar

reviews.author: WandaD
reviews.title: Excellent Stop & Stay
reviews.body: I like continuity while traveling and this location has made it onto our best stop when traveling to the Mississippi Gulf Coast to visit family. The staff is very friendly. The hotel is always clean (currently under flooring renovations (7/13/2026-7/18/2026) and welcoming. It's in a fantastic location off the interstate just outside of Memphis. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: The Moore
reviews.title: Greatest comforter place to stay. We enjoyed it..
reviews.body: Awesome place to stay! The rooms were clean and the staff were friendly and welcoming!

reviews.author: Faye11
reviews.title: Less Than Standard
reviews.body:
My recent stay was not as enjoyable as previous visits. 

The room didn’t smell fresh or recently cleaned.  It had the scent of stale or old cigarette smoke. 

The overall cleanliness and upkeep was less than standard for this location.

reviews.author: Missouri 2
reviews.title: Convention stay in Memphis
reviews.body: We very much enjoyed our stay.  Looking forward to the next time

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Average Hotel
reviews.body: Front desk staff was very personable and helpful. Food wasn’t very good and the carpet was torn up in multiple places. Nothing spectacular or stands out about this hotel.

reviews.author: JG
reviews.title: Needs renovating
reviews.body: Interior and furnishings needs renovation.  Pool not heated.  Decent breakfast.  Convenient location and parking.  Will probably stay elsewhere next time through the area.  Had a better experience one year ago, but is going downhill.

reviews.author: KWasinger
reviews.title: Very nice hotel
reviews.body:
The front desk personnel were top notch and gave excellent information about the hotel amenities, breakfast, etc.
The room was immaculate, and so new looking and feeling.
The hotel was beautiful, still very new, I believe.

reviews.author: PM
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: No issues at all. Staff was friendly, room was clean, area was safe with multiple dining choices close by.

reviews.author: My email
reviews.title: Alarm bells
reviews.body: Due to fire alarm testing at 9am

reviews.author: O martinez
reviews.title: Clean and friendly
reviews.body: After driving 10 hrs. This location was fantastic Brent was helpful.

reviews.author: J graves
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.body: Unacceptable see comments regarding water, tv, and furniture

reviews.author: Tiljuanna B
reviews.title: Absolutely worth the stay!!!!
reviews.body:
Exceptional hospitality and customer service! 10/10 across the board!! 

And Brent was absolutely amazing!!!

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.title: Comfortable and clean
reviews.body: We enjoyed pir atay. Staff friendly, clean and comfortable

reviews.author: No
reviews.title: Great job
reviews.body: The hotel food was well worth the stay

reviews.author: Roadtrippers
reviews.title: Great quick stay
reviews.body: This was our overnight stay during our 20 hr roadtrip to Alabama. We arrived late and left early. Staff was friendly at checkin. We showered and slept then back on the toad again. We had no issues with the hotel, met our needs for the night.

reviews.author: Seasoned Traveler
reviews.title: You won’t be disappointed if you stay here!
reviews.body: I’ve stayed at many Marriott hotel locations from east to west and this place is a hidden gem! It’s a clean, quiet, well appointed place.  The staff (management, front desk, housekeeping, food service and maintenance ) all go above and beyond to make sure your stay is comfortable.

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.title: Far Below the Usual Fairfield Experience
reviews.body: This is a Fairfield hotel that has passed its life expectancy. Old sagging mattresses, creaking floor, air conditioner that did not remove humidity, located in an area of town that calls for a 10 ft iron fence. The lower pricing does not make it worth it or live up to the Fairfield Marriott reputation.

reviews.author: CLH
reviews.title: Could use some upgrades
reviews.body: The hotel is desperately in need of some upgrades and better attention to cleanliness

reviews.author: Rtraveller
reviews.title: Would have left if we weren’t so tired
reviews.body: Room was clean but shabby.  In need of maintenance. Mattress and sheets were old, door sticky and shower door did not stay closed.  We would have left if we weren’t so tired after being on the road all day

reviews.author: Visitor
reviews.title: Rooms are dirty
reviews.body: The housekeeping does a lane job, dirty sheets and bed spreads, toiletries were out.

reviews.author: Mpilot1
reviews.title: Memphis Fairfield Marriott
reviews.body: The hotel is old, very worn, and in what appeared to be an unsafe part of town. There was a wrought iron fence surrounding the hotel property with a coded gate they used after midnight to enter the parking lot.

reviews.author: Shae S
reviews.title: I'm sure there are some health violations in Rm 208
reviews.body: This hotel is in serious need of repairs. Rm 208 has peeling paint from water damage around the window. The window was dirty and rusted. The tub is rusted. The TV didn't even work. The pool was out of order and the room did not have an iron or hair dryer.  I was booked to stay for 3 days. I was gone in less than 24 hours.  My total cost was 387.87 for 3 days. That room wasn't worth $0.87. A tent under a bridge would have been better. The staff was very helpful and understanding. They know the hotel needs some major work, but they can only do so much.  The owner should be shame and Marriott should consider removing their name from this place until it meets the standard of the Marriott brand.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Overall review
reviews.body: “The stay was disappointing. Unfortunately, the experience did not meet my expectations, and there were several issues that made my stay uncomfortable. I hope management addresses these concerns so future guests have a better experience.”

reviews.author: EK18
reviews.title: Review
reviews.body:
I want to start by saying the workers around the hotel and during breakfast were very pleasant - no issues with them at all.
Although, when searching for hotels to stay in when passing through Memphis, we applied filters to include an outdoor pool. The google search and pictures on the website show an outdoor pool, which they do not happen to have a working pool on site. It is empty out back of the hotel. The pictures of the hotel are misleading and make it look much nicer than it actually is. Room smelled like stale smoke. Dirty walls throughout hallways and stains all over the carpets. Pull out couch is only big enough for one person. Breakfast was ok. Hotel is not in the best part of town. It was ok for one night just to stop and sleep, but we will find another hotel to stay at if we ever pass through again.

reviews.author: James C
reviews.title: Worst hotel ever
reviews.body:
1 Star – Worst Hotel Experience I’ve Ever Had

This was, without a doubt, the worst hotel experience I’ve ever had.

We had to change rooms three different times during our stay.

* First room: The shower had rust throughout it, and the mattress had a large hole in it. My girlfriend actually sank into the bed because it was so damaged.
* Second room: The air conditioning didn’t work at all.
* Third room: There were handprints all over the headboard and bedding, and the room had a terrible odor.

By the time we got to the third room, we were completely exhausted. Since we had a 5:00 AM flight the next morning, we just gave up. We slept fully clothed on top of the sheets because we didn’t feel comfortable sleeping in the bed.

To make matters worse, we were charged $12 for two sodas and one small bag of chips, which is outrageous.

Overall, this stay was unacceptable. The cleanliness, maintenance, and overall condition of the hotel were far below what I expect from a Fairfield by Marriott. I will never stay at this location again and would not recommend it to anyone.

reviews.author: NeverAgain304302
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.body: Bad Rooms Unclean Mold Rooms Smell Of Mold Was Changed To 2 Rooms They Both Were The Same. Payment Issues Rude Staff Disrespectful Been Coming To This Hotel Since 2025 The last Time Was Problem With The Room As Well Will Never Ever Return

reviews.author: M Thomas
reviews.title: Don't stay here
reviews.body: The hotel is run down. It smells bad and the breakfast was so bad that we went to McDonald's instead. I cannot believe that this a Marriott facility

reviews.author: Gio
reviews.title: First Marriott that fell way below standards
reviews.body: Can’t believe this is part of Marriott hotels. Very disappointed

reviews.author: Karen
reviews.title: Extremely poor service and dirty hotel
reviews.body:
1.  Gave away our confirmed reservation. 
2. 5 strands of hair on pillow
3.  Deeply stained chair
4.  Very outdated furnishings 
5.  Cracked window
6.  Breakfast was minimal 
7.  Debris on carpet 
8.  Unsafe neighborhood
This list can go on and on. We checked out after just one night and rebooked somewhere else.

reviews.author: Deceived
reviews.title: Don’t stay here
reviews.body: Poor quality hotel, pictures are deceiving

reviews.author: Eliza Peach
reviews.title: You could not pay me to stay here
reviews.body: I came as a favor to bring someone to this area for work.  After a 9-hour drive (straight, only to stop for gas and restroom break), I was looking forward to a good night rest and return home the next day.  The description in the pictures is not accurate at all.  The room smelled musty and the carpet was not clean.  The microwave needs to be replaced as it was old and rusty, the ice machine had something in it, not intended for human consumption, the ceiling was in poor condition and peeling and the bathroom was barely clean.  They have a security gate at the entrance.  If I had only read the reviews prior to booking as this was a last second reservation, I would not have stayed as I am NOT familiar with Memphis.  I would have driven sleep deprived to find a different place even 100 miles closer to home.

reviews.author: DO NOT STAY HERE
reviews.title: Seedy hotel. Up charge. Rumors of human trafficking
reviews.body: Horrible. Dirty. Rude. Cheated thru up charging. Tried to get us to pay for a whole other room stay. Bad neighborhood. Not on brand for Marriott.  Do not trust the pictures or paid video reviews.  Not safe ppl!

reviews.author: R T
reviews.title: Keep looking, Marriott web site is not correct
reviews.body: On Marriott's web site, there is a View Details button, Clicking it, brings up a popup that shows the hotel as well as a Beautiful Swimming pool. Upon arriving I asked about pool, I was informed it is closed for maintenance, I took pictures, It is missing tiles, very dirty and looks not to have been open for a long time. I was promised some points for inconvenience. Next, I went to my room, opened refrigerator and there is a container of food inside. So even though I had driven over 6 hours and was tired, I gathered my things and went back to front desk. Next morning Manager was there and told me all mention of a pool was taken down. Today, the pool picture is still on that popup. On the check in counter is a sign say Marriott Elite. Well, Due to injury I have not been traveling, but if this is the new Elite. I recommend looking for a different chain of hotels.

reviews.author: Ladyhound
reviews.title: Nasty
reviews.body: Never again the over all stay was nasty was lied to as well etc I already contacted corporate

reviews.author: Benzo
reviews.title: Major Upgrade needed
reviews.body: This hotel has a mildew smell in the hallways and rooms the deadbolt lock didn't work it was rust in the shower and the air conditioner wasn't properly installed

reviews.author: Do not stay here
reviews.title: Never again!
reviews.body: Poor service, unkempt, rude staff, uncomfortable beds.  Very unhappy.

reviews.author: JB
reviews.title: Horrible experience.
reviews.body: See prior comments. Poor check in and room upkeep.

reviews.author: Melissa K
reviews.title: Don't believe the pictures!
reviews.body: This location was not anything like how it presented online. Dirty and stained carpets. Weird stains on the walls. Linen felt less than clean. Towels, same. Pool was not operational.

reviews.author: Us
reviews.title: Worst marriot we have ever stayed in
reviews.body: Would not recommend dirty, rude staff, power outage

reviews.author: Jen W
reviews.title: Outdated and dirty hotel
reviews.body: The hotel on the outside looks run down and has a gate around the perimeter which raised concerns. The area is not nice and is very run down. Inside wasn’t any better. Everything was outdated. The room was very dirty. I wiped the floor with a towel and it was brown. Fingerprints were all over the mirrro, counter, tv, door, etc. the bed was uncomfortable and dirty. The sheets had multiple yellow stains. I felt so gross touching anything.

reviews.author: Sandra C
reviews.title: A nice place to stay for overnight
reviews.body: I stay at a lot of Fairfield Inn hotels, and comparing this to previous ones I have stayed at, it falls a little short. It was adequate for my visit and I would continue to use Fairfield and Marriott.

reviews.author: JL419
reviews.title: Okay for the price, don’t expect much
reviews.body: Employees can ruin it but overall room was decent, clean, and comfy. TV was skipping a lot. Breakfast wasn’t too bad. Location is a bit of a drive away from places but not far enough to deter you.

reviews.author: Colin
reviews.title: Memphis
reviews.body: Stay was average, staff was nice. Shower drain had rust and iron didn't work for my business meetings. Food was average hotel food. Rooms were clean and more modern so that was nice.

reviews.author: Dontstayhere
reviews.title: Don’t stay here
reviews.body: Poorly maintained and managed. Dont expect to have towels or clean room.  Toilet stopped up I was told to come to desk to get plunger.  Room did not have corking outlet

reviews.author: JB
reviews.title: Worse Marriot property Experience.
reviews.body: I booked a double room through Marriott. Although the app told me it was time to check-in via the app, the app would not work to allow that. When I arrived at the hotel there were no double available, because they gave them all out although, I booked via the Marriott website. he offered me a Kin with a pull-out couch. When we got to the room, the pull-out couch had no sheets. There was no shower gel in the room and there were no wash rags. It was the worse experience I have ever had at a Marriott property.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Aloft is better
reviews.body: Booked Aloft and was "upgraded to Element". After a long day of travel I really wanted a nice hot shower.  The water never got above warm.  The Element had breakfast included.  I asked if I could get a Coke or Pepsi with ice and I was told no.  I feel they could have found a way to get soft drinks.  There were eggs but no meat options like bacon or sausage.  There was no grits or oatmeal.  French toast stand was good.  I had to ask for syrup and then they wouldn't let me pour it myself. Next time I will say to keep me in Aloft.

reviews.author: Mb117
reviews.title: Would not recommend
reviews.body: No running water in the mornings. Pressure issues, bad offerings for "breakfast" virtually nothing prepared or ready to eat aside from cold bagels and cold soggy boiled eggs.

reviews.author: RRR1234
reviews.title: Great stay at Element Downtown Austin
reviews.body: This location was excellent. The staff was great. Perfect location and the rooms were clean and well appointed. Highly recommended for a stay in Austin

reviews.author: Lian
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: Everything about this hotel is great. Staff is friendly, great location, and very clean. Margaret at the check in desk was amazing! Very friendly, courteous, and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: DrHunter
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body:
I was very disappointed with my stay. Unfortunately, what was supposed to be a relaxing and restful vacation was anything but.

During the night, I was awakened by a **loud, bubbling toilet**, which continued making noise for quite some time. In addition, at approximately **2:00 a.m. on both nights of my stay**, I was awakened by garbage trucks. After being disturbed for the second consecutive night, I contacted the front desk to report the issue. Needless to say, getting a good night’s sleep was nearly impossible.

The complimentary breakfast was also disappointing. The pastries appeared to be **day-old items from downstairs rather than fresh breakfast offerings**. The toaster took an excessive amount of time to toast the bread, and even then, it only toasted **one side**.

Overall, between the plumbing noise, being awakened by garbage trucks both nights, and the poor breakfast experience, my stay fell far below my expectations. **A hotel stay should provide guests with a clean, comfortable environment where they can rest, and unfortunately, that was not my experience.**

reviews.author: VA35
reviews.title: It was an ok stay
reviews.body: Overall it was ok, but I definitely expected better. Trying to get help from staff was difficult and inconsistent. Upon arrival we checked in, the lady being help next to us was given complimentary water and thanked for being a bonvoy member. My guest and I were simply thanked for being bonvoy members. Also we weren’t made aware that our lobby closed early, so when we returned from our day and needed assistance at the desk there was none. So we had to go to the aloft lobby which was very noisy and very crowded. I  tried getting a hold of valet to get an item from my car, I was told by the guest agent to go back to my room, when valet responded she would let me know yo come down and get the item. After a while I just had them bring the car around to get the item. Also parking was very confusing and inconvenient. I was told self parking was $40 a day vs $65 a day for valet. However when asking where to park I was never given a clear answer then told if I self park I would have to pay every time I came in and out. Which was not what the hotel sight stated. Then we were awakened by them testing the alarm system early Monday morning! Couldn’t wait to get out of there.

reviews.author: Austin Visitor
reviews.title: Could Use Improvement
reviews.body:
The arrival and check-in process was easy. The room we were assigned faced a window with a man standing in front of it, so we had to close the shade which made the room dark and gloomy.  After an evening out, when we were in the shower, there was NO BATH GEL. Quite an inconvenience at midnight.  When we checked out the following morning and I shared what an inconvenience that it was, she merely apologized.  Not exactly the customer service response I expected. She realized I was not happy and said she could give me coffee or breakfast. I said isn't that included with the room. She said it was at Caroline's. How could I do that when we had another couple we invited and they also stayed at the Element. It was not feasible nor what we wanted to do. She said she'd add points to my account. Not even sure what that meant and if it was worth the hassle. 

There was also hari on the bathroom floor, which meant the room was not cleaned well.

reviews.author: Quiet Traveler
reviews.title: Exceptional Service That Made a Real Difference
reviews.body:
From the moment I arrived, I had an excellent experience with the team. Everyone I interacted with was welcoming, professional, and helpful, which made a strong impression throughout my stay.

I especially want to recognize Gabriella at the front desk. After I experienced significant street noise overnight, she followed up with a thoughtful email that demonstrated genuine care and attention to the situation. She acknowledged my concerns, clearly explained the available options, and proactively offered solutions to make the remainder of my stay more comfortable. Her communication was professional, empathetic, and sincere.

What stood out most was the overall commitment to guest service. Gabriella’s follow up, along with the professionalism and helpfulness of the broader team, turned a frustrating situation into a positive experience. I felt heard, valued, and confident that the staff genuinely cared about improving my stay.

Thank you to the entire team for the excellent hospitality, and special recognition to Gabriella for going above and beyond. Her professionalism, empathy, and follow-through truly made a difference and left me with a very positive impression of the hotel.

reviews.author: CraigUK
reviews.title: Fabulous location
reviews.body: A real gem of a hotel. Great location and very efficient staff with very good sized, clean and comfortable rooms. Excellent choice of food and on site restaurant and bar / coffee shop. My only negative thing was the shower in my room did not seem to have a cold setting. Even when the handle was turned to the "cold" setting, the water was scalding hot. I mentioned it to reception every morning of my 7 night stay but it was not rectified. Had to resort to having a shower at a nearby gym.

reviews.author: Titanium member
reviews.title: will come back for sure!
reviews.body: Top-notch staff and service! Super friendly and helpful. I don’t normally leave reviews when something is just good—only when it’s truly excellent, and this definitely qualified.

reviews.author: L CARM
reviews.title: Awful experience - DO NOT RECOMMEND
reviews.body:
The hotel is one of the worst Marriott properties I have every stayed at. The check in desk is so high the woman who tried to check me in couldn't see over it. I had checked in online and just needed a key. She couldn't figure out how to do that, though she kept trying and didn't ask her colleague for help until he offered. By that time I'd been standing at the desk for 10 minutes. It took another 5 minutes to get my key, I was offered a voucher for $10 based on my status, not offered points in lieu of a welcome gift. She didn't acknowledge or apologize for how long the process took.

A bigger disappointment was my room. The door was stuck shut. When I got into the room I could tell it had been recently painted because there was paint on furniture, on the floor, on the mirrors. The furniture was shabby - literally all of the veneer pieces were chipped and scratched, the fabric covering the chair was frayed, and there were just 5 hangers. I called guest services to ask for more, was told I'd be placed on a brief hold, and was left on hold for 10 minutes before I hung up. When I called back and told the person this, she said several guests were ahead of me and put me on hold again. I gave up. The carpet in the room and the hallway was shabby as well.

There are no drawers, just 2 small shelves near the bottom of the closet. There was no pen or paper. No USB-C power. 

There were a couple positives - the staff was very nice and the little kitchen was well-stocked. Other than that the hotel was absolutely awful.

The rate was $208/night. If I had any idea how bad the hotel is I would have stayed someplace else.

reviews.author: Morenos Trip 2026
reviews.title: Great Family Trip to Austin
reviews.body: Highly recommend based on location and ease of access. The staff was excellent. Made us feel welcome and provided great tips for places to see in the area.

reviews.author: C moore
reviews.title: Austin pit stop
reviews.body:
This was a short stay in Austin. Driving in from Houston before heading to Dallas to watch the World Cup soccer. 

Cannot fault anything at the hotel. The staff the room and the building exceeded expectations

reviews.author: Gina from Florida
reviews.title: 10 out of 10
reviews.body: Our visit started off in a very positive way with the help of Maria at the front desk. She was delightful and seemed genuinely excited to share recommendations for our stay in Austin. She took quite some time and hand wrote a thoughtful itinerary for us and it was much appreciated. Then we met Conrad at the valet stand. His genuine enthusiasm and absolutely charming personality was so heartwarming and sweet. If we had a question, he would take out his phone and research to ensure that he was giving us the proper answers even went so far as to get us parking at a sister hotel for a late night trip to a roof top bar. The complementary breakfast we received every morning was more than just adequate. Each morning brought forth a special dish, including breakfast tacos, French toast, and fruit filled pancakes that were made to order. If we ever return to Austin, we would 100% use this property again for the friendly staff, clean and practical rooms and wonderful location.

reviews.author: AVP81
reviews.title: Ok if you are looking for a central location
reviews.body:
Not great if you are in town on the clock.
Also please change your breakfast formula: folks are in rush in the mornings. May be ok for weekends.

reviews.author: Genevie T
reviews.title: Could do better.
reviews.body: At first when we arrived, I could not find an entrance. It was right off the street so there was so many cars trying to also get in valet and get into the hotel. I would literally be sticking out on the road if I waited in that line so after circling the block  two or three times. I finally found. a parking garage nearby then had to bring all our bags and luggage down across the street up into the second floor to check in just to find out that our room wasn’t ready. After waiting a while, I went back to ask if her room was ready, which it was not. She did offer us an accessible room which we accepted because we needed to get ready cause we had a reservation . The room was very dark and stuffy and near an alley full of about 20 dumpsters so in the middle of the night all I heard was beeping and banging for at least 30 minutes. I could not sleep well that night I was hot and cold due to the air turning off and on every 30 minutes. So the next morning I got up to have breakfast which was OK not great so I had a piece of toast and some juice. Then I noticed they had a yogurt bar, which was the best part of the whole breakfast to me. Also, when I reserved the room, I reserved a room for three with a sofa bed. We didn’t get a sofa bed so I feel like I paid for something I didn’t get.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.title: Mediocre
reviews.body: This is an ok but not great property. They ran out of certain breakfast items and didn’t get them in for several days, the rooms were shabby and not well maintained. I was given side—eye for asking for extra towels, the elevators take forever, and somehow my door bar locked behind me.  Gym is nice though.

reviews.author: Atanu L
reviews.title: Great location and service
reviews.body: Great location and service for the price... One of the best in the Austin Downtown

reviews.author: Nicole D
reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.body: Nice stay, some homeless sleeping outside the hotel. Reception was friendly. Breakfast was good but no meat on Monday.

reviews.author: Andy R
reviews.title: Clean rooms, location
reviews.body: Clean rooms, Location, Good Breakfast

reviews.author: Jormunoz
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Austin.
reviews.body: Very clean and the breakfast had a great variety.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Hotel from another planet
reviews.body: Read I wrote a book already do your job

reviews.author: mg83
reviews.title: Great location, good food, clean
reviews.body: The Element Austin Downtown is a good choice for those looking for a good location, a nice breakfast option, a fitness center, and a well kept property.

reviews.author: Clemens 326
reviews.title: Great Location coupled with Great Service
reviews.body: We consider our stay a very pleasant experience with very personal staff, great breakfast, clean and spacious room and great location to either the airport or to many venues.

reviews.author: Katrina Hinze
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Everything was great. The beds were vary comfortable.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Surprise, we don’t have the room you booked
reviews.body:
Wrong room (king + pullout instead of two queens), broken TV, and a shower that ran scalding hot.

Had to sleep on a pullout couch the entire stay — very uncomfortable.

One of the worst Marriott experiences I’ve had.

reviews.author: Faith
reviews.title: World Class at Affordable Prices
reviews.body: The Element staff really creates a world class experience for hotel guests. Everyone is friendly and helpful. The rooms are clean and the location is great!

reviews.author: Kim C
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Quiet, clean and in a great lication for exploring Sixth Street and downtown Austin. Hotel staff is friendly and accommodating. Breakfast was consistently good but hot choices were limited. My one negative was that food service staff were almost never attentive to their station (f omelets, French toast, pancakes - different items each day). We stayed for six days and the two times I wanted something I had to hunt them down.

reviews.author: Mark R
reviews.title: What a surprise!
reviews.body: As a business traveler I am interested in two things- a great nights rest and availability of some decent food.  This place SCORED on both.  It has an unassuming appearance but WOW.  The bed was great, the room was much better than I expected but their breakfast was really beyond all expectations.  It’s central local and easy walking distance to many top restaurants made my stay enjoyable, when I’m often just targeting tolerable on a business trip.  They really outdid themselves

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: First time at Element
reviews.body: The rooms are spacious, the complementary breakfast has a chef fixing pancakes and a lot of upgraded pastries and other items, good fitness equipment and a great location.  No complaints!

reviews.author: Garret
reviews.title: Recommend
reviews.body: Definitely recommend to all friends and family

reviews.author: A Traveler
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Clean with friendly staff - especially Christopher

reviews.author: Nikiklin
reviews.title: Great place to stay for UT parents
reviews.body: We were in town to bring our son to UT for his move in weekend.  Based on reviews, Aloft was the best Marriott hotel we found within a reasonable distance that had availability, as our first choice close to campus was sold out.  Parking at Aloft was with the valets out front for $65. They were very helpful.  Maria at the front desk was also courteous and helpful. The lobby has modern, fresh touches that make it inviting and welcoming.  She gave me the info on the "Boots to Borrow," and I found that a really charming touch!  Our room was a 1 King, with a great view of the city from the 25th floor. We had no issues and liked our room.  It had a rich, minimalist vibe, ample space and a sliding door separating the dressing area from the toilet and shower.  I would stay here again for another visit to Austin.

reviews.author: 1cmd
reviews.title: Great trip to Austin
reviews.body: We had a wonderful stay in Aloft Austin. It's location was perfect to walk to the Capitol, museums, bats, restaurants and great fun to use Waymo/Uber for things that a bit farther.  Loved the wonderful breakfast/ coffee shop and the great restaurant. Staff was super nice and rooms were spacious, had great views and very comfortable.

reviews.author: Fercho S
reviews.title: Great hotel with the best location
reviews.body: Was very happy to walk into a nice lively hotel with amazing vibe, even though we didn't go to the bar, we did walk by and it looked amazing. Nice big room, modern design with comfortable beds.

reviews.author: Hardworking mom
reviews.title: Show Compassion
reviews.body:
As I begin my journey as a parent of a freshman UT student, I chose this hotel because I thought it would be a great fit for my family. Unfortunately, my experience was very disappointing.

When I checked in, Maria assisted me, and she was absolutely lovely, professional, and welcoming. During our conversation, I learned that the hotel did not have a pool, which was surprising because I had booked the property through a third party with the expectation that it did. While Maria was explaining the situation, another employee interrupted our conversation and stated that she had worked at the hotel and that it had never had a pool. I found the way this was handled unnecessary and uncomfortable.

I would also like to address my interaction with the manager, Margaret. I felt that she showed very little compassion or professionalism when addressing my concerns. As a paying guest, I expect to be treated with courtesy and respect, especially when there has been a misunderstanding regarding the amenities advertised at the time of booking.

I want to recognize Maria and Ryan, who were both extremely pleasant, helpful, and kind throughout my experience. They represented the hotel very well, and I truly wish I could have tipped them more for their excellent customer service.

Unfortunately, because of the way my concerns were handled by management, I do not plan to stay at this establishment again. I work hard for my money, and I will not continue to patronize a business where I feel insulted or mistreated.

I will be in Austin for the next four years as my student attends UT, including for home football games, so I will have many opportunities to stay in the area. I sincerely hope management will take this feedback seriously and provide additional customer-service training to ensure future guests are treated with the professionalism and respect they deserve.

Thank you again to Maria and Ryan for being outstanding representatives of the hotel.

reviews.author: Happy Guest
reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.body: The staff was great especially Chris t the lobby

reviews.author: Happy couple
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: This downtown Austin Aloft is unique with its opening into the Caroline restaurant along with its proximity to the downtown/6th street area. The staff are exceptionally friendly. Maria was especially welcoming and gracious with a gift for my wife's birthday. This is our go to location for downtown Austin.

reviews.author: Awilliams
reviews.title: Amazing weekend getaway
reviews.body: Upon arrival we were greeted by Gabby she was very sweet and professional. Very informative as well! The hotel room was amazing and had a great view. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Austin Visitor
reviews.title: Aloft Austin
reviews.body: The Aloft Downtown Austing is located in a very convenient location.  We found most of our interests within walking distance. The hotel itself is very clean and the floor two welcome area with terrace bar is very cute looking over on to Congress Street.  I recommend this hotel for your Austin stay.

reviews.author: Valet
reviews.title: Valet parking
reviews.body: $65 for valet parking per day is ridiculous

reviews.author: Faith
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.body: We had such an amazing time! Our corner room on the 25th floor was fantastic, and we really enjoyed the vibe at Upstairs at Caroline’s. The location couldn't be better. Everything was wonderful—thank you to the team for a memorable stay and especially Maria!

reviews.author: numbers and letters only
reviews.title: Escape to Austin
reviews.body: Ill be back, would stay on aloft again.

reviews.author: Malika
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.body: My significant other and I, as well as our friends who were a couple absolutely loved the hotel.

reviews.author: Sunshine
reviews.title: Wouldn't recommend
reviews.body: As much as we tried to enjoy it, it was truly a let down. Too noisy, bad area & the parking is way too expensive. Not worth it! Will not be coming back!

reviews.author: WheezertheGeezer
reviews.title: Best place to stay in downtown Austin!
reviews.body: We regularly stay at The Aloft when we’re in town and have never had a bad experience.  The rooms are clean and comfortable, and the friendly staff is top-notch.  It’s walking distance from the State Capitol and many major sights.  We highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: Makayla L
reviews.title: AMAZING !
reviews.body: My first time staying here! This was such a nice and clean hotel. Both restaurants located above and below were delicious! Marie made my stay even better, we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Kenn
reviews.title: Kenn’s Stay
reviews.body: Couldn’t ask for a better price! Location is awesome and room is comfortable!

reviews.author: Toya
reviews.title: Couples trip
reviews.body: Wish I could have gave a better review. Really had high hopes for this hotel, especially because of the price. Hotel offers valet for $69 to park in a parking garage across the street where you can park your car yourself for way cheaper. Rooms were really small and not the cleanest. The lighting was not good as I am a makeup artist. Had hanger on the door saying do not disturb and housekeeping. Continued to knock on the door and opened the door even being after told no. Thank you The bar on the rooftop was really nice and the bartenders were great. Had a great ambiance.

reviews.author: Hanging out in Austin
reviews.title: Hanging out in Austin.
reviews.body: I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Aloft was a wonderful Experience!
reviews.body: From check in to check out we loved every minute of our stay. Friendly staff, clean rooms, convenient location.

reviews.author: Conner J
reviews.title: Great stay for those who want to Austin experience!
reviews.body: Great location right behind 6th street. Walked around our whole stay to a concert, comedy club and bars and restaurants. Friendly and helpful staff, nice room with a white noise machine, plus amazing city views. Will definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Dave and Jana
reviews.title: Thank you Ellaine!
reviews.body: View from the 32nd floor was awesome! Great breakfast too.

reviews.author: Biil P
reviews.title: Aloft was ok and staff friendly but not as clean as I expected from Marriott
reviews.body: The hotel was very convenient to the area but it did not live up to what I expected from Marriott. The food options at the restaurant Caroline was not as advertised as the coffee was cold and the tea we ordered came when we almost done dining. There was not a good choice of options as well. The staff was fine and helpful however the room had two issues. The shower leaked into the bathroom floor and there was mold on the showers walls Beside those. Not what I expected from a Marriott property. The situation was repaired and cleaned but it should have been before I was given the room. Also the room was not cleaned till after 3 pm each day. I would have liked it to be done earlier

reviews.author: GritTravel411
reviews.title: Always a Delight!
reviews.body: Aloft never disappoints! 💫 The energy, the service, the rooms—everything just clicks. I always feel like a valued guest, which keeps me coming back every time I’m in Austin. ❤️

reviews.author: Austin Visitor
reviews.title: A safe enjoyable evening in Austin Texas
reviews.body:
I arrived at check in time.
Was kindly greeted by the valet.
The staff at the front desk were personable.
I checked into my room, and came back down to the bar area for a small appetizer and a cold beverage. The bar was busy. There were ample servers. Time was not an issue to receive food or a cocktail.

reviews.author: Jay J
reviews.title: Don’t sleep on Aloft
reviews.body:
I was hesitant to stay hear because I perceived it to be a secondary hotel that was not well maintained.
I couldn’t have been more wrong. The property was very clean and there was an energy about the place.

reviews.author: Mdidina
reviews.title: Would NOT Recommend
reviews.body: I was not happy with having to pay a charge for a super tiny room in order to ensure staying in a quieter section of the hotel. I normally am not charged extra just to switch floors. Furthermore, the room ended up being microscopically small as well as loud. I did not feel that I was supported much value for the amount that I paid for my stay. The hotel was also out of luggage carriers so I had to make several trips to get all of the items out of my car and up to my room. The house hall would not allow me to stay checked in past noon on Sunday, which ended up posing a real inconvenience. The front desk would not hold my luggage and I had to check it in with the valet that is a third-party to the hotel. All in all, I would not recommend.

reviews.author: Rhonda P
reviews.title: Great Hotel—Be Mindful of the Surroundings
reviews.body:
We stayed in a corner room with great views, and the room itself was very clean and well kept. There was quite a bit of street noise, but the hotel provides a sound machine, which actually worked really well and made it easy to sleep.

Our only real issue was the location. When exiting the hotel, there were often multiple homeless individuals asking for money, which felt unsettling. While there was usually security at the entrance and the doors are locked in the evening requiring a hotel key, the surrounding area still felt unsafe and a bit dirty.

That said, the hotel itself was nice—we just chose to spend most of our time away from the immediate area (near 6th Street) and instead explored the other side of the river.

reviews.author: Senior sis
reviews.title: 3 Senior Sisters tour Austin
reviews.body: Excellent stay from check in til check out. We spent 4 fabulous days getting acquainted with the beautiful and friendly Austin. Having a comfortable, convenient hotel gave us the perfect reset each night.

reviews.author: Diego P
reviews.title: Not willing to help out a customer is bad business
reviews.body: I made a mistake (and totally accept that!) and booked the wrong date for my stay for one day later. I asked the staff if I could move my reservation for that day (given that I was already there). They told me it was not possible and that I had to cancel my reservation and make a new one for the day. The new one was double the price than my original one. But what stroke me the most was that they were not willing to refund me. So I ended up paying 3x the amount of my original reservation. I understand there are terms and conditions on reservations, but the attitude from the hotel staff and from Marriott through my digital communications with them just showed a total lack of customer care. I’m not staying on Citizen M or Marriott anymore. I’m done.

reviews.author: Concerned Traveler
reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.body: They purposely restrict the ac to 75+ degrees (consistent with other reviews in here). They are unapologetic and will offer a tiny fan that does not help. Rooms are tiny and missing wash rags and flat sheets. This hotel should disclose that ac will not be fully provided - especially in Austin Texas. This is a hostile at boutique prices.

reviews.author: Feedback
reviews.title: Feedback
reviews.body: I recommend better service and they did not clean our room during our stay

reviews.author: Courntey Clem
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.body: I highly recommend this hotel. Staff was fantastic.

reviews.author: Jellybeann
reviews.title: Safe spot for female traveler
reviews.body: I returned for a solo trip for myself after coming previously with my significant other. I felt the location was safe enough for me stay solo. Check in was a breeze and I was able to do so early. I did note security by the front door in the late evening/night times which is always nice. I didn't run into any issues with my stay and it has a great smoothie spot next door!

reviews.author: Vdavis
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.body: CitizenM was a great spot to stay. Close to several food and entertainment spots. Staff was amazing. Super clean. Rooms are small, but had everything we needed. Would recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to Austin!

reviews.author: Mary G
reviews.title: Aug 2026 Stay for Olivia Dean Concert
reviews.body: Highly recommended! We stayed here for 2 nights - great place to stay for a short stay in Austin. Location is great - a walking distance to the Capitol, 6th St., food places & close to transit stops.

reviews.author: Narali A
reviews.title: Great Views, I had to clean up water from the shower on my husband’s birthday.
reviews.body: I believe this hotel had a beautiful theme, good location, and aesthetic. While the rooms are small they are still cozy, but i had a problem with the shower, as i was showering the water made its way out of the bathroom pod and into the room floor, and soaked my bags, shoes, clothes AND purses. As i called the receptionist they said housekeeping wasn’t available until the morning and sent out 2-3 towels only, i had to PERSONALLY lay all the towels down, wring/squeeze them dry and repeat, mind you this is done with nothing but my hands as i am on my hands and knees near the toilet, i personally PAID to stay in this hotel and was not hired to clean up my room bathroom, nor did I get PAYED to do so. This was all in the early morning of my husband’s BIRTHDAY. As much as i wanted to love this hotel for its amenities and rooftop pool and views, having to clean up the bathroom and having my husband’s and I’s belongings get soaked were not a great experience. I would maybe give this hotel a second try with hopefully a better experience.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway
reviews.body: My review of this hotel is fair. The hotel itself was nice and up to date. Where it wasn’t so great was when we arrived to our room the bed sheets were dirty and stained. Housekeeping staff down the hall quickly assisted with the changing of the sheets. The shower was also still dirty. They also assisted in cleaning the shower. The pool is small but still relaxing if you don’t mind a tight space during busy pool times.

reviews.author: Mia 1
reviews.title: Good area, be cautious of surroundings
reviews.body: Our stay was splended. The view was nice, the hotel was gorgeous. But I did not feel safe. There was an incident at the pool with a male capturing photos of the woman that were there, myself included. I would be cautious. I was very bummed out it caused me to have a panic attack and not want to leave the room.

reviews.author: Perfect Stay
reviews.title: Perfect stay!
reviews.body:
Loved everything about this property and the team. Clean, friendly, welcoming, and cozy. I could write a book about everything I loved.  This was a spur of the moment trip and I had no plans on being in the room much so it was literally perfect. If your looking for something just for you then this is a win. This is not for a family stay so please don’t bash them if you don’t understand the concept. Definitely giving relaxed luxury. 
Will definitely be my new go to spot!

reviews.author: Joe123
reviews.title: Will come back
reviews.body: Very modern and tech infused.  Fun place to stay in great location

reviews.author: SDT1972
reviews.title: American Hostel at Best.
reviews.body: This is an American version of a European Hostel at best. The “icing on the cake” for this property… air conditioning wasn’t working - initially offered a fan, then told they were out of them. When we cancelled the remaining days of our stay, we were informed by their customer service that even if the air-conditioning had been working, it would’ve been pre-set to between 75 and 78°. Just be warned.

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.title: Tiny Rooms
reviews.body: The property is very nice and well-maintained rooftop pool is  nice and the hotel is close to everything downtown. The room was extremely small, smaller than a cruise ship room.

reviews.author: JakeinLA
reviews.title: Disappointing and Uncomfortable Stay
reviews.body: My room was around 80 degrees, and the air conditioning never worked properly, making it extremely difficult to sleep. The kiosk-only check-in felt impersonal, and my Marriott Platinum status was not acknowledged at all. For a Marriott-affiliated hotel, the lack of service and basic room comfort was unacceptable. Unfortunately, I would not stay here again.

reviews.author: Reilly
reviews.title: Do not stay here
reviews.body: This hotel was so terrible that we spent less than 2 minutes in the room before deciding we were going to go get a room at the royal sonesta across the street. First of all, everything is extremely impersonal. You check yourself in and get your own key using an iPad. The blinds and AC and lights in the room are controlled with an iPad. There’s no valet so you have to park across the street and then carry all your bags to the hotel and then your room. And finally the rooms are as small as a closet and you can’t even walk around the bed. It’s set into a corner of the room. Marriott needs to distance itself from such a horrible hotel. I am shocked that it had a 4 star rating.

reviews.author: Sherry2019
reviews.title: Citizen M
reviews.body: This hotel is extremely nice love the new experience very clean and the employees are really friendly the breakfast was phenomenal !!!

reviews.title: Very vibrant hotel
reviews.body: Very nice ,colorful , and friendly staff

reviews.author: Fly Fam
reviews.title: Coolest
reviews.body: Social, hip, fun, cool concept, close to river, restaurants. You want to be in the collective areas. Rooms are small, beds big, bathrooms a bit like a cruise. Staff was fantastic.

reviews.author: Dayaa
reviews.body: Loved staying here the room is so clean and with so much technology loved that everything was controlled by the ipad

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Jail cell
reviews.body: Smallest hotel room I have ever stayed in. I’ve never been to hail but I imagine it’s about the same size. 8 ft wide. The bathroom is equivalent to an RV. Not at all what I expected for nearly $200 a night. Check in was not smooth. There were self kiosks but you still had to wait for someone to check you in. The bartender at the pool bar was not at all friendly. Good location but not what I expected from Marriot. I will never stay there again.

reviews.author: PRgirl68
reviews.title: Good please, bad A/C
reviews.body: The hotel decor, staff and pool is great. Disadvantage the A/C won6work and at night is a nightmare.

reviews.author: Marcus
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.body: Second time staying at this hotel, and must say this will be my go-to from now on. Incredible rooms, welcoming and helpful staff, great views, amazing drinks. The check-in/check-out process is a breeze. Will definitely recommend this hotel to those looking to stay in downtown Austin.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great location, but no cooling
reviews.body: The location is great in downtown austin, however the air conditioning didnt work at all during my stay and was incredibly muggy.

reviews.author: Cheryl C
reviews.title: A bit disappointing
reviews.body: The easy check-in and room lighting options is great.  Unfortunately, I found a few things that made my stay frustrating.  I had to go to a very dimly lit room down the hall to iron my clothes.  I had to go to the resturant/bar to get ice.  The ice was really needed because there is no mini fridge.  The room was hot.  Not just my room, everyone was complaining about the temperature and not being able to cool the rooms down for sleeping.  The pad that controls everything was down for almost a full day and into the next morning.  The space is very small but doable for a single person. No way two people could stay in one room.  For the ironing, ice and cooling issues were the most frustrating.

reviews.author: Summer Stay
reviews.title: Probably would not stay in the summer.
reviews.body: I don't know how the place would be in the winter, but in the summer the climate control did not cool the room down near enough.  It also did not remove the humidity out of the air after showering.  I don't know what type of air conditioning they use (refrigerated air or swamp cooler), but my room only got down to about 76 degrees at night in the summer.  During the day, even with the shades shut, my room was over 80 degrees.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Worst Marriott stay in 10 years.
reviews.body: I checked in with seven rooms and wasn’t told the air conditioning was out in the rooms..it was 102 degrees.

reviews.author: CamV13
reviews.title: The AC was non negotiable in the TEXAS heat.
reviews.body: This was a beautiful hotel. The staff was great! The only problem was they said they were having a heat way and due to that I was not able to cool my room to a comfortable temp. This was a romantic couple weekend. It was miserable due to the heat. I've never heard of this at a hotel. I stayed at 2 other hotels between then and now in Texas and no AC restriction.

reviews.author: Hopefully better
reviews.title: Unfortunate
reviews.body: The A/C didn’t work, the water was cold, the pool was muggy, the food was highly underwhelming (ordered the brisket nachos and it was 2 pinches of brisket on the whole plate) not worth the price, the staff was cool but facilities need some work

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: Hotel is in a great location. Really disappointed by the overall room quality and experience. Felt like I was in a ventilated box. Bed and bedding a little average. Again, this was my experience and experiences differ

reviews.author: Great service
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.body: All the valet guys are helpful and friendly.  Tip them well.  Front desk are quick with service and friendly.  We enjoyed our stay.  Just too bad the pool was temporarily closed when we stayed

reviews.author: Maleeka
reviews.title: Beautiful and Nice environment
reviews.body: I love the way this hotel smells and the service was amazing.

reviews.author: Chief USA
reviews.title: The Eyes of Texas are upon you!
reviews.body:
Exceptional staff, rooms, and breakfast.  My first visit was outstanding!  I was greeted by the most friendliest and professional front desk agent/expert.  L.F. was such a joy to meet and discuss my stay with.  She recommended the best tacos in town.  As for help, she knew everything, about anything!  We will be back periodically, for the next four (4), years!  To add:  Paid parking only.  No pool, or access to a pool.  It would’ve been nice on these triple digit days!  Other than that, ENJOY and make MEMORIES!🫡




Thank you for the memories made!  God Bless! V/r

reviews.author: Alb Tross
reviews.title: check in took 30 minutes
reviews.body: check in took more than 30 minutes. we were told they did not have the room available. We had the booking confirmation but for some reason they did not have the room when we arrived the reason we were given was that they had a busy day and did not have a room available right away.

reviews.author: Jaymac
reviews.title: Residence inn Austin
reviews.body: Nice hotel, the only issue was the construction nearby which is not the hotels fault but detracted from the ambiance and experience around the hotel.  Also, my girlfriend was scared to walk our dog at the nearby park because of all the homeless camped there.  Again not your fault but felt it is worth noting

reviews.author: Lissa
reviews.title: Comfort and fun
reviews.body: Best hotel I’ve ever stayed at and I’m over 50 been to a lot of hotels staff was a 10 out of 10 cleanliness 10 out of 10 hotel location 10 out of 10 rooms 10 out of 10 restaurant and bar 10 out of 10 overall 10 out of 10 room service housekeeping, layout of hotel location all 10 out of 10. I’m making another reservation ASAP.

reviews.author: LMstaysummer2026
reviews.title: excellent stay
reviews.body: Good location. Excellent stay. Good breakfast. Staff were all friendly and courteous. Lobby and valet personnel Offering cold bottled water for the hot weather was a bonus.

reviews.author: laun
reviews.title: Ok to stay
reviews.body: Good, clean hotel and excellent location.

reviews.author: Federal Employee
reviews.title: Best Residence Inn I've stayed in.
reviews.body: The Residence Inn in downtown Austin is the best overall I've stayed in. It's modern and very clean but the service from Valet, to front desk to food and housekeeping was the one from a five-star hotel. The hotel is very stylish, unless most of the rest Residence Inns and the location is unbeatable. I would definitely repeat when I come back to Austin.

reviews.author: Unsatisfied23
reviews.title: the stay was just ok
reviews.body: My stay was okay but I will not stay here again. the dirty room and missing items not to mention some of my things had been thrown away. Thanks for housing my family and I but I will not be returning.

reviews.author: Jeannette Houston TX
reviews.title: Loved our stay at Residence Inn.
reviews.body:
Our stay was wonderful! The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the staff was friendly, attentive, and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. We loved having a kitchen, which made our stay even more convenient.

The complimentary breakfast was excellent, with plenty of great options. The valet service was fast, professional, and very courteous. The location was perfect—close to everything and easy to access.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Hotel as such and personell is fine but need some TLC
reviews.body:
Room is as expected, big and with all facilities. However there is a backdraft or something in the shower making water come up and bring some nasty things with it. The reception took action when pointed out to them but the problem still lingered so most likely a problem not linked to a specific room but the building as such (guessing here!).
Sono blame on the personell as such.

reviews.author: DJadhav
reviews.title: Weekend break at the downtown- excellent stay!
reviews.body: This hotel offers an excellent value for money with several breakfast options and warm hospitality. The location, cleanliness and nearby restaurants and parks makes it more convenient option for family and kids.

reviews.author: Frequent RI Guests
reviews.title: Average
reviews.body: The facility needs some updating and maitenance. However, it is average for a RI and is located in downtown and great for walking and exploring the city.

reviews.author: Byebye
reviews.title: Find a better place for your $$$
reviews.body: Other than the downtown location there is not much to recommend. You might find a better stay and dining option than this one.

reviews.author: Ms Hill
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.body: This hotel surpassed my expectations. The they have everything you would expect from a full service 5 star hotel.  I've never experienced this level of service from a Residence Inn or Courtyard Marriott.

reviews.author: JLSOJOURNER
reviews.title: A great place to stay in downtown Austin
reviews.body: This Resistance Inn property is a great place to stay in downtown Austin. Everything met or exceeded expectations for the brand. The staff were exceptionally excellent!

reviews.author: Great time
reviews.title: The best on price and location
reviews.body: We had everything we needed nearby and at a glance.

reviews.author: Mabesa
reviews.title: Very good.
reviews.body: We had a very pleasant stay in a good hotel.

reviews.author: Dawny4851
reviews.title: I wish I never stayed here.
reviews.body: Paid $500 for a King size bed and room.  I was lied to and they pulled a bait and switch.  They gave away my room and I checked in at 4pm.  I wound up with a queen bed.  I could not sleep all night.  The furniture is old and sunken in.  There were no amenities at all in the room.  I have never paid this amount of money and wished I stayed at a motel.  I actually had to argue with the staff.  They lied to me and treated me bad and thought they were right.  This Marriott is horrible.

reviews.author: Andrew W
reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.body: Great staff, extremely professional and friendly.  Great location with plenty to do within walking distance.  Updated property, very clean.

reviews.author: KM06
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body:
I had a great stay. The hotel was clean, and the staff was friendly. I was even able to check in early, which allowed me to explore the city without worrying about my luggage.

I stayed in a room with a dining space and living area, which was a great added bonus.

reviews.author: Ishmael
reviews.title: Old dirty towels and bed coverings
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location. The towels, bed covers all had an old smell to them. We had to buy our own towels and blankets which should never happen.

reviews.author: Lenny
reviews.title: Great location, excellent staff, but poor sleep quality.
reviews.body: This hotel is in a great location. The staff were fab and so helpful and welcoming. The room was large and spotless. Our main problem was that despite asking for a quiet room, our room was exceptionally noisy. It was located above the external air-conditioning plant, which ran 24/7. The quality of our sleep was very poor. Avoid room 209.

reviews.author: RR4April
reviews.title: Excellent place to gather with small(10-20) crowd
reviews.body: Ground floor game room helped us gather and chat with no additional fees.  This is amazing.  Easy walk to restaurants around and downtown center.

reviews.author: Jen M
reviews.title: Just like home
reviews.body: I recently stayed at this hotel because it was close to a conference I attended. In general I prefer Residence Inns so that I can have a kitchen and more space. The hotel was clean and updated. An easy walk to 6th Street and many restaurants. Parking seemed expensive however I didn’t have a car as Uber was readily available. The breakfast was generous in choices and in how long it was available. I appreciated the healthy, low carb, options and delicious coffee. The Courtyard staff who handled the conference and food were top notch. Strong WiFi and large work desk. Late checkout request was honored. Already booked another stay, this time for fun!

reviews.author: Richard of California
reviews.title: Great Place to Stay in Austin
reviews.body: This perfectly located and built hotel was excellent. Amenities in the lobby market, restaurant and room were outstanding. Virtually instant elevator availability was extraordinary compared to some other hotels where I have had to wait -- but not here. Restaurant food was tasty and the breakfast was outstanding. Special kudos to the hostess who greeted us warmly every time; Carmen is a gem!!

reviews.author: sg1983
reviews.title: Excellent Location! Great Staff!
reviews.body: We stayed here for spring break with family. We are family of 5. the sink was clogged but was fixed immediately after the complaint they even gave was 10$ star bucks gift cards for the inconvenience. BTW there is a star bucks on the premises which was a big hit with the kids. Hotel is walkable and in great location. We forgot our jackets in the room. The staff was very helpful and they have a good system in place to retrieve stuff.

reviews.author: pam 1973
reviews.title: bad bed
reviews.body: the bed was hard and not comfortable. the pillows were feather and I checked the box no feathers I am allergic.

reviews.author: AMSECT
reviews.title: Convention Attendance
reviews.body: Excellent facilities for the conference

reviews.author: Travel Doc
reviews.title: Beware of extra parking fees despite paying for Valet
reviews.body: Very Average Austin hotel  with unusual parking fees despite using the Valet, limited choices in the restaurants menu, housekeeping daily cleaning late in the day,, only positive is location, will not return anytime soon

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.title: Nice room but don't leave anything valuable
reviews.body: It was a comfortable hotel overall but I had something taken from my room when I wasn't there which left me feeling very uncomfortable. Fortunately it didn't happen until the end of my stay and it wasn't a high value item but I would not recommend leaving anything of value in your room.

reviews.author: Spabst
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: Enjoyed our stay. The rooms were very clean and the staff were amazing.

reviews.author: Eris F
reviews.title: Excellent Stay – Clean Hotel and Friendly Staff
reviews.body: I had an excellent stay at The Westin Austin Downtown. The hotel was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The staff was extremely friendly, welcoming, and professional throughout my stay. The location was also very convenient for enjoying downtown Austin. I highly recommend this hotel and would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.title: Highly recommend Westin Austin Downtown
reviews.body: Staff was friendly, welcoming, and helpful literally the second I stepped into the lobby.  Great location - walkable to a lot of shops, restaurants, and bars in the downtown area.  Rooms were clean and updated with great amenities.  I loved the Tea Tree brand soaps and shampoos, they smelled amazing.  Also the nicest, most complete fitness center I can remember at a hotel.  Also has a great view on the 20th floor.

reviews.author: FMH26
reviews.title: Hoity Toity Dream on a Dollar General Reality
reviews.body: Valet was horrible had to wait hours for drop off and pick up. Bar district with lots of loud music and flashing lights all night. Pool present is very small and full of bar patrons. Room was nothing special and even had mold present behind the toilet and shower door though pretty leaked water all over the bathroom floor. Microwaves not present in all rooms and refrigerator is very small. Horrible location for restaurants that don't break the bank. Drunks, transients, and homeless folks present throughout the restaurants and laying on the sidewalk right outside the hotel. Elevator was broken and we got stuck in it until we got dumped out onto a floor that was called to go down to another level- we got off and the other elevators worked with our key card. Our room went into immediate battery dead mode after our initial entry so we had to wait over an hour for maintenance to come fix so we could go do something else because they weren't sure if our keys would work again.

reviews.author: John P
reviews.title: Pleasant stay
reviews.body:
Stayed with my 6 month old daughter and wife. Slight issue at the beginning of the stay. Orlando did wonderful service recovery and the issue was resolved promptly without us having to change rooms. In addition, he gave me tips on places to visit with my daughter while there.

Dining with a baby is always difficult and complicated. Ally our server at Skip Jack made us feel welcome and went out of her way to make it a pleasant experience

reviews.author: Fronapfelanniversary
reviews.title: Fronapfel anniversary
reviews.body: Absolutely amazing stay. The staff made us feel welcome and took care of everything above and beyond.

reviews.author: ElCapitan
reviews.title: Terrible Food
reviews.body: I attended a conference last weekend and they served us food for lunch one day and breakfast another day.  The food was cold and subpar at best.  Cold and really not edible.  Westin should do better, it was ridiculous.  The presenters even ate something different knowing full well the food was horrible!

reviews.author: FormerAustinite
reviews.title: Great for mid-week
reviews.body: If you’re an adult (you know… like a 30-something to a 50-something) wanting to enjoy Austin, stay here mid-week. It’s great! On the weekend, it’s full of the “dirty 6th street” crowd. The rooftop pool was disappointing over the weekend because it seemed to be stacked with Resort Pass visitors and just… folks who were here … for 6th street?

reviews.author: Orlando Coursey
reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.body: Front is not customer friendly

reviews.author: lizrub
reviews.title: Westin Atx
reviews.body:
I've stayed at many hotels, and The Westin Austin Downtown is one I'll gladly return to. The location couldn't be more convenient, from live music to great restaurants and nightlife, is an easy walk away, so there's no need to worry about driving.

One of my favorite discoveries was Skipjack Oyster, just steps from inside the hotel, for outstanding oysters before ending the evening with a cocktail at the rooftop bar overlooking the city. It's the perfect way to experience downtown.

What truly made the stay memorable, though, was the people. Every member of the staff was welcoming, attentive, and genuinely committed to making me and my four legged companion feel at home. Yes, very pet friendly! That level of hospitality is increasingly rare and made all the difference. If you're looking for a hotel that combines an unbeatable location with exceptional service, The Westin Austin Downtown is an easy recommendation.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Hoped for better
reviews.body: Needs Improvement: persistent maintenance issues, parking fees at market peak, and mediocre staff capability.

reviews.author: 122a
reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.body: Worst experience of my life. Your hotel and front desk staff ruined my July 4th. We missed the fireworks because of misinformation from the staff. I had planned this trip for my 85 year old dad and had confirmed if there is terrace and view of fireworks from the terrace prior to booking. My dad cannot stand in park without bathroom access and heat. When I reached the staff couldn't accommodate my request for rollaway bed, I had informed my party size and age before booking. Stuck last minute they slapped me with a 300 usd fees for upgrade. On negotiation brought it down to 250 trapped with no choice for comfort of my family I paid. Then they changed their statement saying view will be blocked from terrace we recommend you take your dad to lake. Google map took me to a section where it was dark and nothing was visible. By the time I could bring my dad back the fireworks were over. I was devastated, it was 250 year celebration. Then they charged me 398 uss instead of 250

reviews.author: Htownmarine
reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.body: This hotel is one of the best I’ve stayed at.

reviews.author: Frank L
reviews.title: Downtown Stay
