reviews.body: Great service, from the valet to check-in, all went well. The restaurant was good too, food and service. I’d would recommend staying here. It is pet friendly which is an added plus and why we chose the hotel.

reviews.author: JessRalf
reviews.title: Fancy Sexy Feel
reviews.body: Fancy hotel sexy feeling while at the pool area and the bar and lounge, just sweet and calm and fun all around

reviews.author: Young
reviews.title: View from window
reviews.body: We stayed in room 701 and we had a view of the alley ways up the street. The amount of drug dealing that we witnessed was unbelievable. My wife brought it to the attention of the desk downstairs and the next day we say an increased police presence after that. But wow!

reviews.author: Happy and Rested Guest
reviews.title: Westin Exceeds Expectations
reviews.body: I am very impressed with this hotel. The room smelled and was very clean. The bed was so wonderfully comfortable. The restaurant was excellent, great service and amazing food.

reviews.author: JKDW
reviews.title: Beautiful and Welcoming
reviews.body: From the moment I pulled up to drop off my books for a conference, the staff were wonderful and helpful. My room was lovely and adored the pool after a full day of giving a keynote and two breakout sessions. A lovely space in the middle of downtown Austin

reviews.author: Exceptional
reviews.title: Great Customer Service and location
reviews.body: I had an exceptional stay and every employee that I interacted with was kind and thoughtful.

reviews.author: Dissatisfied Traveler
reviews.title: Not the Premium Experience We Expected.
reviews.body:
The Westin Austin Downtown did not deliver on this promise during my stay. While the hotel promotes wellness, comfort, and rest, the experience was overshadowed by cleanliness and housekeeping issues that made the stay stressful rather than relaxing.

We had to repeatedly request housekeeping multiple times throughout the day just to have our room cleaned, despite not having the privacy tag on the door. This became frustrating and inconvenient during our stay.

Additionally, the condition of the lobby bathrooms was unacceptable for a Westin property. Trash and paper towels were overflowing onto the floor, and the bathrooms appeared poorly maintained and unsanitary. This level of cleanliness did not align with the standards I expect from the Westin brand.

Overall, the lack of attention to cleanliness and service made it difficult to feel comfortable, rested, or cared for as a guest.

reviews.author: Teni
reviews.title: Exceptional Service!
reviews.body: This has been the most enjoyable customer experience I’ve had. Dominique, Paulo and Bryce went above and beyond to ensure I felt comfortable and safe in the hotel.

reviews.author: OCDE
reviews.title: 5 star hotel
reviews.body: We had the most memorable stay at Westin Downtown. The staff was welcoming, supportive, assured that we had everything and solved all our problems in no time. It was one of my most enjoyable hotel stays

reviews.author: Staycationer
reviews.title: They need to get their act together
reviews.body: OVerall the hotel needs to learn how to handle a crowd.  Valet, check in, pool area, check out and getting car back from valet was a nightmare.  Food was good at Skipjack.

reviews.author: Platinum Elite Member
reviews.title: Very, very good hotel
reviews.body: Everything about my stay exceeded my expectations.  The bed is probably is the most comfortable hotel bed I ever slept in.  The hotel staff was excellent.  The valet service was outstanding.  The room was very clean and surprisingly quiet, given the hotel's location.  The TV offers very nice array of channel and streaming options.  Room service was a little pricey, so I went with a food delivery service.  The towels need an upgrade, but this is minor given all of the other excellent hotel qualities.  I traveled with my pet, which always makes me a little nervous, but the hotel was VERY accommodating.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.title: Disregard and disrespect for Bonvoy members
reviews.body: Absolute atrocious customer service. Did not honor my reservation rate when my wife checked in and charged us a maximum daily rate. Unreasonable to speak with management about the issue and was dismissive

reviews.author: Oscar
reviews.title: Check your final bill
reviews.body: We paid through Expedia and had multiple billing options during check out. $600 charge to my wife's card first night, $350 the second night, we are now home and still not sure about the final charges. Feels strange to me, surely a prepaid hotel stay would be the easiest one to process yet endless charges and fees.

reviews.author: Jenny K Heard
reviews.title: Weekend conference!
reviews.body: I enjoyed the food , the room and the great view from our room ! We got to watch a wedding group do a photo in the crosswalk , that was very cool !

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Austin downtown
reviews.body: The perfect spot to discover the vibes of the city

reviews.author: G from CLE
reviews.title: Great Hotel Great Location
reviews.body: The hotel is clean, workout room is great, pool is relaxing.  The lobby bar is beautiful.   Staff is courteous and friendly.  Very centrally located.  Walking distance to great food and shopping.

reviews.author: DS18
reviews.title: Best of the Best!
reviews.body:
The JW Marriot Austin was simply one of the best hotel experiences I've ever had. From the exceptional service and outstanding amenities to the convenient location surrounded by shops and restaurants, everything exceeded my expectations. 
The property was beautifully maintained; the accommodations were comfortable and well-appointed, and the attention to detail throughout the hotel really stood out. The combination of excellent service, convenience, and overall quality made our stay truly memorable. 
I would absolutely recommend the JW Marriott Austin and look forward to staying here again!

reviews.author: paul
reviews.title: Thank you for making it special
reviews.body: Nice upgrade, perfect treatment, food options superb for a hotel. Thanks to everyone for making our families trip to Austin so good!

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Poor experience
reviews.body: Austin trip problems. restaurant service car service overall experience..

reviews.author: CLBCEB2
reviews.title: Bridal Escape celebration
reviews.body:
We chose the JW Marriott for a special bridal escape celebration and, unfortunately, the overall experience did not live up to what we expected for the price or the JW Marriott brand.

There were several disappointments throughout our stay. Arrangements had been made with the concierge to have our room decorated before our arrival, but that did not happen, which was particularly disappointing given the occasion.

We also paid extra for access to the Executive Lounge, but the food was consistently cold, and the service was surprisingly unwelcoming. Rather than making us feel taken care of, the staff often made us feel as though we were inconveniencing them when we asked for assistance.

Our in-room dining experience was also poor. Our first order arrived incorrect and cold. After calling and explaining the issues, the replacement was much better, hot and fresh, although parts of the order were still incorrect. We also had to follow up because the appropriate adjustment had not initially been made to our bill.

Dinner at Dean’s Steakhouse was another disappointment. We were served undercooked shrimp and experienced a lengthy wait while the issue was addressed. To their credit, one meal was ultimately removed from the bill and dessert was provided.

Any one of these issues might have been understandable, but collectively they made what was supposed to be a special celebratory stay feel very lackluster. At this price point, we expected much better attention to detail, service, food quality, and overall hospitality. Unfortunately, we left feeling that the experience simply was not worth what we spent.

reviews.author: Daniel Aaron
reviews.title: Well Worth The Price
reviews.body: First finding this hotel, I thought it would be another typical "expensive" place by location alone, but was pleasantly surprised by all it had to offer. From the rooms, to the service, to the restaurants it was quite the experience. We went for a race event over at COTA, but found ourself hovering around the JW just from the great amenities and food selection. We also paid for a 25+ floor with a view and definitely got it when they placed us on the top. View of the whole city and the river was amazing, the beds were wonderful (and I don't say that lightly), and the whole time we really felt like we were actually paying for luxury of staying here. Would highly recommend for a nice few nights away and if you want to be close to Down Town.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: JW Austin
reviews.body: Everything was great until we had shower issues

reviews.author: TitaniumTraveler
reviews.title: Not Up to JW Marriott Standards
reviews.body:
I booked the JW Marriott Austin expecting the elevated experience the JW brand is known for, but this stay fell short in several areas.

The property is showing its age. Rooms and public spaces feel tired and worn, and the hotel is overdue for a refresh to bring it in line with what guests expect from a luxury brand.

Service was below the JW standard. Housekeeping and turndown service were inconsistent throughout my stay; some days my room was serviced and some days it wasn't. At this brand tier and price point, that simply shouldn't happen.

Billing was the most frustrating part. I flagged an error during my stay and was assured it would be corrected before checkout. It wasn't, and I had to follow up after I got home to get it resolved. That kind of basic follow-through should be a given at any hotel, let alone a JW.

For comparison, the Marriott Austin Downtown is a much better and newer property. Even though it isn't one of Marriott's luxury brands, it exceeds the JW on service, and the updated facilities make it the better choice overall. Until the JW Marriott Austin invests in a renovation and tightens up its service and billing processes, I'll be booking the Marriott Austin Downtown instead.

reviews.author: Marcus
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body:
This was our fourth stay at this property, and once again, everything was exceptional. One of the main reasons we continue to come back is the consistently outstanding service and the way the staff makes us feel genuinely welcomed.

A special recognition goes to Callie at check-in. She went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of and started our stay on such a positive note. It’s employees like Callie who truly make a difference and keep guests wanting to return. She is definitely someone the hotel should recognize and be proud to have on the team.

Another wonderful stay, and we’re already looking forward to our next visit!

reviews.author: 10 out of 10 I reommend
reviews.title: 10 out of 10 I recommand
reviews.body: I was in Austin for a conference and the stay was top tier. From the comfort of the rooms, the staff, the amenities, the location of the hotel.

reviews.author: Faith
reviews.title: Acknowledgemet of Excelence
reviews.body: My entire experience at the hotel was one I will always appreciate. My room was clean spacious and very comfortable. My interaction with the staff was respectful and accomodating. The conference rooms were spacious and comfortable. My stay was truly a great experience.

reviews.author: CYC Chong
reviews.title: JW does it again
reviews.body: Excellent Stay and Great Customer Service

reviews.author: Kylegolf1985
reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.body: We were on my wife’s birthday and wanted to stay in a nice hotel and the overall experience was great except the room. It was extremely noisy and there wasn’t an option to switch rooms. It sounded like a washing machine running in our room constantly.

reviews.author: Currie
reviews.title: Not up to Par
reviews.body:
I was not pleased with my stay for the first day and a half. There was a very unpleasant odor throughout my room, which made me nauseous it made it very uncomfortable. Maintenance had to be called on the second day to change a filter. I was compensated with a small piece of candy and an apology card, which felt insufficient. In addition, I have knee problems, and the escalator was out of service, making mobility more difficult during my stay. I had to stand in line for the elevator for up to 20 minutes, which caused significant discomfort. 
I could not use the coffee maker because it was not clean.  I complained to the front desk, someone was sent to clean the pot, but I didn't want to use it after seeing it the first day

reviews.author: Business Trip
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay at the JW Marriott Austin
reviews.body:
My recent stay at the JW Marriott Austin was unfortunately not as enjoyable as my previous stays. I have stayed at the property before and have always had a positive experience, so I was disappointed that this visit did not meet the same standard.

During my stay, several of the elevators and escalators were not working, which made getting around the hotel inconvenient. In addition, the air conditioner in my room made a loud noise every time it turned on, which was disruptive and made it difficult to fully relax and enjoy the room.

I also dined at both restaurants during my stay. At the Corner Restaurant, the food was served warm rather than hot. I brought the issue to the manager's attention, and I appreciated that the manager apologized and offered a discount to address the situation.

My experience at Dean's Italian Restaurant was somewhat better. My food was served hot and was enjoyable. However, one person in my party received food that was only warm rather than hot. She sent her food back and, unfortunately, ended up eating nothing while the rest of us were able to enjoy our meals.

Overall, I was disappointed with this stay because I have had much better experiences at the JW Marriott Austin in the past. I hope management will address these maintenance and dining-service issues because the property has the potential to provide the exceptional experience I have come to expect from the JW Marriott brand.

reviews.author: 2026Stay
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body:
JW Marriott Austin you can't move in! I have to say I was completely disappointed with my stay and will try not to stay in one again.  I will share this with family and work.  
This needs to be said you staffing was excellent! But your facility is undesirable.  When you can’t get up to your room on the 19th floor for 40 mis. At the end of the day. There is something wrong. You had two elevators out. You had two escalators out!! When you stay in a hotel and can’t move it is awful.  I was coming back from lunch; my conference next training was at 2pm I waited for the elevator at 1:45 to go from the 19th floor to the 5th floor and I was still 10 mins. Late! This is an ongoing issue at JW Marriott Austin choose not to fix??   I saw a conference coming in on my last day and nothing was fix for them either. You are not a cheap hotel this is unacceptable.

reviews.author: Rose
reviews.title: Quiet among the conference chaos
reviews.body: I stayed at the JW Marriott Austin for a conference, and despite the chaos of any conference, JW Marriott Austin was organized, clean and the staff were always friendly and accommodating.  First rate in every way.

reviews.author: Quality
reviews.title: Good not great
reviews.body: Great personal service. Friendly personal. Poor elevator service. Crazy long wait times

reviews.author: SNG5001
reviews.title: Texas AASC conference
reviews.body: BIG TEXAS HOSPITALITY  .. employees , staff, rooms A1

reviews.title: Conference
reviews.body: With lots people need to work hard to ensure elevators and escalates work properly.

reviews.author: TroyL
reviews.title: Everything was AWESOME!!!
reviews.body: Great service, great staff, great experience!

reviews.author: Traveler095
reviews.title: Just Okay
reviews.body: Overall, I can only say that the JW Marriott Austin fell short of our expectations and is truly an “okay” hotel at best. We recently stayed as part of a large national conference. We were met with difficulty checking in, promises that fell short, and a terrible lack of communication. Once we received our rooms, hotel management reached out to apologize and offer compensation for our troubles. The food options at the hotel were quite expensive and the restaurants ran out of several dishes on their menus. Equipment was broken down and not fixed the entire time we were there, including escalators between floors of the conference. Wait times for elevators was usually quite long unless utilizing them late at night. I appreciate that management reached out and tried to make things right in terms of our check-in experience, but overall there were so many other things that made this hotel a property that I’d likely not return to, especially for large conferences or events.

reviews.author: BluesMan
reviews.title: Good but lacking for the JW Brand
reviews.body: Good amenities, great location, a bit pedestrian for a JW..

reviews.author: Conference attendee
reviews.title: nothing works
reviews.body: multiple elevators broke and esculators broke all wk of our conference making everyone late to get to their conference sessions

reviews.author: Dr T 1956
reviews.title: No call, long elevator wait.
reviews.body: No room upon late arrival.  Did not keep promise to call when a room was available.  Long waits at the elevators and escalators seldom ran in both directions at the same time.

reviews.author: Em04
reviews.title: excellent stay
reviews.body: Came for a work conference and was pleasantly surprised. Everything was pristine and all of the staff was incredibly helpful

reviews.author: VeeCee
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.body: Excellent location and service

reviews.author: Visiting Austin
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: Great location great amenities great staff. Rooms starting to show age, and unfortunately ours smelled of cigarette

reviews.author: neilb
reviews.title: Stay for anniversary
reviews.body: Everything went smoothly.

reviews.author: SYell
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Was on a business trip, and this was the perfect place to stay. This JW Marriott exceeded my expectations in every way—from the gym and rooftop to the room and even the shower! Everything was excellent. I’d gladly come back and stay here again on my next trip to Austin.

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Pay more to stay at another hotel
reviews.body: There were so many shortcomings with this hotel I will not list them all. The worst was the horrific smell of the room. I switched rooms and the second room two floors down smelled equally as bad. Also there was NO fan in the bathroom which then made the smell even worse. The beds were terribly uncomfortable with one bed being so soft , that the middle felt like a hole and the other one being hard as a rock.

reviews.author: Stuart
reviews.title: Not a good location, not comfortable
reviews.body: This Marriot is by the convention center construction sit so the noise is terrible in early morning and though out the day.   The bed was uncomfortable and needed replacing.   This is in a very busy section and the valet parking is limited and not available to us.  They recommended parking on the street which is not possible on the weekend due to crowds.   The restaurant is average at best and usually empty.  Starbucks is on site and convenient

reviews.author: Need Better Valet
reviews.title: Perfect except the valet manager
reviews.body: Stayed on Friday and left Saturday afternoon.  From the time I arrived, the staff made me feel welcome and everything was great.  Breakfast was good and all service from most of the staff was excellent.  The valet manager ruined an otherwise perfect stay.  He was incredibly rude to me but nice to the other guests.  I waited 45 minutes for my vehicle even after texting the valet before checkout.  He went out of his way to ensure poor service to me.  Patrons who came after me got their cars before me.  Make it make it make sense.

reviews.author: Frequent flyer
reviews.title: It’s a bed, but that’s about it
reviews.body: The hotel was clean and staff was friendly, but the room & amenities were not what I expected from a downtown hotel. The pool was closed “for the foreseeable future”, which was my main purpose for booking with them. I also had a king suite with a separate bedroom, and none of the rooms came with trash cans, only a tiny one in the restroom. This made it very uncomfortable to relax and dine in the suite. Overall, it wasn’t worth the money. Lastly, I ordered my car and waited 40 minutes, and had to remind the valet to get it after noticing everyone had gotten their cars.

reviews.author: JayBird
reviews.title: Great location, newer facility, good breakfast, great service
reviews.body:
We stayed at this facility for just one night. Had a very late check-in after moving our daughter to UT (about 5-7 minutes drive). Valet service was very kind. Check in was easy. Always call them, the app isn’t good for communication, the digital key does work!
Facility is modern, clean facilities we weee lucky to get a higher floor (recommended) and larger room for the 4 of us, upon request. 
Staff is kind & courteous. 
Breakfast 6-10 I believe. Getting earlier will help as it can become quite chaotic despite a decent space. Good variety of breakfast including omelette station.
Overall, enjoyed the stay. Thank you Marriott Courtyard, you lived up to our expectations!

reviews.author: mattie
reviews.title: liked it
reviews.body: nice staff and kept very clean didn’t have a problem with my stay, but i will say paying $69 for parking is outrageous.

reviews.author: Nbounphanh
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: I love the rooms. They were really clean and our room was so spacious and even had wine glasses. We had a king size bed, sheets were comfortable and the ac worked well. Only thing I was frustrated about was the valet and how they rushed us to unpack and load our car. I get they need the space but there’s not much we can do about that. I used a parking garage down the street, I liked it more and it was cheaper. It was around 6th street where we went, but we didn’t really have a good time out because of the homeless. It was sad to see them not have a place yet I’m spending 10+ bucks on a single shot. Also one purposely fell in front of me and he was shirtless. If I wasn’t buzzed I would’ve been scared. But that is not the hotels fault. Anywho.

reviews.author: Debra J
reviews.title: Very Nice Hitel
reviews.body: The staff was very friendly and professional.  The hotel was very clean. My room was spacious,  clean, and comfy. There is a microwave and refrigerator available in the room. I would definitely stay here again. I was a little skeptical after reading the older reviews.  I took a chance anyway and was glad I did. They definitely did some upgrades.

reviews.author: Doug C
reviews.title: Loved My Stay—Special Shoutout to Gwen at Champions!
reviews.body: Had a great stay here! If you come, definitely recommend stopping by Champions, the onsite restaurant. Grab a seat at the bar with Gwen, the bartender, and hang out for the nightly specials—Friday night was by far the best in my opinion

reviews.author: Armando
reviews.title: Very pleased with everything
reviews.body: Excellent Location and very clean

reviews.author: Annie J
reviews.title: Weekday Getaway
reviews.body: We traveled to Austin for a quick weekday getaway, Wednesday-Friday. This was such a great location for what we were looking for. We walked to Del Friscos for dinner one night and then to 6th street for some drinks. We also stumbled upon a great Mexican restaurant nearby with a cute outdoor rooftop patio. The staff at this hotel would go above and beyond for us and it was so special! From welcome drinks to directing us to use the pool at the Westin while theirs was under service, to the kind valet guys out front. Also the rooms were so clean and so cold! Perfect for a Texas summer.

reviews.author: Luis
reviews.title: Austin visit
reviews.body: Very rude staff, rooms were very dirty. No hot water

reviews.author: ANUP
reviews.title: DIDNOT MEET EXPECTATIONS
reviews.body: DIDNOT MEET EXPECTATIONS WERE OVERCHARGED EVEN THOUGH AFTER CONFIRMATION FROM THE HOTEL TEAM

reviews.author: DanJ
reviews.title: Delivered a great stay
reviews.body: The Austin Courtyard Downtown/Convention Center is a great hotel. From the moment you arrive you are welcomed and feel like you are taken care of. The hotel common areas and rooms are spotless and the staff is wonderful.

reviews.author: From Dallas
reviews.title: BAD EXPERIENCE
reviews.body: Wrong room no working appliances or phones

reviews.author: Cesar
reviews.title: A Great Stay
reviews.body: Excellent Stay as usual with any Marriot Hotels

reviews.author: Maddie Jade
reviews.title: Very nice and reasonably priced. Parking is pricey.
reviews.body: Thanks. Nice place. Clean. Would stay again

reviews.author: Bet J
reviews.title: Great value for the location
reviews.body: This complex offers great value for downtown Austin. Rooms are comfortable and quiet. I like the package deal with breakfast and parking at the Residence Inn, which shares lobby space with the Courtyard. Convenient breakfast, although I wish there was more variety of pastries (croissants or biscuits). Very friendly and welcoming vibe.

reviews.author: Kassia
reviews.title: Courtyard by Marriott Review
reviews.body: Amazing stay! Staff was very attentive and amazing in answering any questions I had, the room was very cozy and comfortable, the amenities were amazing and overall, Austin, Texas was a lovely place to visit

reviews.author: Hotel Stay
reviews.title: wonderful stay
reviews.body: the hotel was wonderful and the staff was very friendly.

reviews.author: Road Dog
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Excellent location, clean, friendly and helpful staff, and beds are very comfortable too. I just wish they'd have French toast or pancakes daily.

reviews.author: TXTraveler
reviews.title: Just meh...
reviews.body: Water out in hotel and housekeeping not until after 6 PM and multiple requests.

reviews.author: Gonzo
reviews.title: Memorial weekend
reviews.body: It was a great weekend for my family

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: Everyone was helpful, room was spacious clean and nice

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.title: No hot water
reviews.body: There was not any  hot water!

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Great space
reviews.body: Great hotel, great location, parking is an issue.

reviews.author: Austin business trip 2026
reviews.title: Austin work trip
reviews.body: I will stay there again.  The housekeeping and front desk staff were great.

reviews.author: Cat Abrams
reviews.title: Do not stay here!
reviews.body: The hotel is freezing and miserable throughout. There is no hot water for showers. Conference food is bad.

reviews.author: ram1
reviews.title: Well below our expectations!!
reviews.body:
1. I thought parking was included in my booking. Even if there is charge, $55/pay is ridiculous. I ended up paying at nearby garages in 2 nights stay. Argghh...
2. AC didnt work well, even if we increased room temp, it just ignored the setting and kept room so cold. We requested the frontedesk, and they got it fixed.
2. Room was not cleaned up, we had to request additioanl towels, paper cups for the next day - at least change the towels daily!
3. In checking out, the staff made so many stupid errors, she added 2 days of parking charges at first, whereas all I said was I faced many problems in parking for 2 days. argghhh!! Thankfully, my wife checked the bill, and she immediately reissued it.

reviews.title: Not satisfied
reviews.body: Overall experience was dissatisfied.

reviews.author: Teresa
reviews.title: Privacy and safety concern
reviews.body: Stylish hotel with a pleasant stay overall, but housekeeping attempted to enter my occupied room despite my “NOT NOW” sign. The lack of follow-up and an incorrect charge also added to the concerns.

reviews.author: Miffy56
reviews.title: Wanted to love it, couldn’t
reviews.body: I wanted to love our stay at the W Austin — we booked through Amex Fine Hotels & Resorts to celebrate our first staycation as first-time parents, and the disappointment was real. We weren’t checked in until nearly 5pm despite a 3pm check-in, and when I asked for a private space to breastfeed my infant while waiting, I was directed to a public bathroom — truly tone-deaf for a luxury property. Our requested add-ons (a crib and microwave) were mishandled all evening; one staff member told me she thought she’d closed out a ticket for the crib without actually verifying, and when it finally arrived hours later, housekeeping banged on the door and slammed it into the room — waking my sleeping daughter despite my specific request to knock lightly. The microwave never came. At breakfast in Serenade, I was told my order wouldn’t go to the kitchen until I had a final update — but when I returned with changes, I was told it was too late, resulting in an overcharge with zero apology. The only bright spot was Marisa at the front desk, who was genuinely kind and helpful throughout. For a Fine Hotels & Resorts property, this experience fell so far below expectations that I wish we had stayed somewhere.

reviews.author: Trivial Thomas
reviews.title: It's Always the Little Things
reviews.body:
While my stay was fantastic, as a road warrior, I am seeing a lack of attention to details more and more. Things like bottled water not being replenished after the initial (2) or coffee that is not replaced with the same product. If I drank all the regular coffee and didn't touch the decaf, don't replace the missing items with decaf. Same thing with condiments. If all the sweetener is used up in the room and the sugar products are left, replace the sweeteners. 

While these type of items are trivial, it's an unecessary annoyance.

reviews.title: W Hotel is a great place to stay in Austin
reviews.body:
The staff at the hotel was amazing! I had an issue with the lighting controls in my room, and Alex took care of it right away, along with a few other requests I had during my stay.

I decided to extend my stay for one more day, and Alex not only made the process incredibly easy, but also honored the same rate I had booked two months ago.

Outstanding customer service from start to finish. Alex truly went above and beyond to make sure I was taken care of. Thank you, Alex, for the amazing service!

reviews.author: Johnathan
reviews.title: Not Staying Here Again
reviews.body:
My recent stay at the W Austin fell far short of the high standards expected from the brand. While the location remains convenient, several notable lapses in service, maintenance, and noise insulation made for an uncomfortable experience.
The shower door in our room failed to close fully, causing water to spill across the bathroom floor every time it was used. Additionally, the beds were noticeably uncomfortable, making it difficult to get a restful night's sleep.
Despite staying on the top floor, exterior street noise came straight through the windows. The property is in serious need of updated window insulation to block out city noise for high-level rooms.
Housekeeping completely missed our request for extra towels. Restaurant service was also frustratingly slow, adding unnecessary delays to our daily plans.
Between the maintenance oversights, lack of basic soundproofing, and slow service, the experience did not match the price point. I hope management addresses these issues, but until then, I would hesitate to stay here again.

reviews.author: High Travel
reviews.title: Outdated Hotel - Room Service = not working
reviews.body: Stayed here a few times.  Never bad.  Never good.  Location is the only factor.  But they use a telephone system from the 1990’s that doesn’t work.  And if it does work, the people at room service will talk you out of ordering.  If you stay here, you will be on your own and should expect to leave to eat food.

reviews.author: Sooner25
reviews.title: Luxury in the heart of Austin
reviews.body: I was blown away by how nice this property and the rooms were! I greatly enjoyed the modern mid-century vibe of our room along with all of the amenities offered onsite. The staff were attentive and checked in with me throughout our stay. Additionally, the food and beverage offerings, along with the gym, were all top-notch! The property is in an excellent location for enjoying the nightlife in the city.

reviews.author: AdrianCM26
reviews.title: Exceptional Stay at W Austin
reviews.body: I had an exceptional stay at W Austin. The hotel is modern, stylish, and perfectly located, with a vibrant yet luxurious atmosphere. The room was clean, comfortable, and beautifully maintained, and the staff was consistently welcoming, attentive, and professional. The amenities and overall service exceeded my expectations. I would gladly return and highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Badexperience0822
reviews.title: Birthday Trip
reviews.body:
I booked a one-night stay through Amex FHR on August 22. The front desk was completely unfamiliar with the guaranteed 4:00 p.m. late checkout benefit.

They deactivated our room keys without any notice and tried to KICK US OUT at 12:00 p.m., even after I spent time explaining the FHR benefits to them. The most ridiculous part is that their own welcome letter, which they gave me at check-in, clearly stated “guaranteed 4:00 p.m. late checkout.”

After a long back-and-forth, the staff member finally called his manager. She was also unfamiliar with the benefit and treated us like we were unreasonable guests for asking the hotel to honor a benefit that was clearly guaranteed. They eventually reactivated our room keys as if they were doing us some kind of favor.

There was no compensation, no proper explanation, and not even a single apology.

If you do not like the FHR policy, then do not participate in the FHR program. If you choose to participate, train your employees properly and honor the benefits you advertise and agree to provide.

reviews.author: APapa
reviews.title: W Austin is Amazing
reviews.body: W Austin delivered the perfect balance of productivity and play. I was in town for business, and the property provided everything I needed, from comfortable accommodations to exceptional service. At the same time, the hotel's vibrant energy, beautiful design, and lively atmosphere made the trip enjoyable and fun. The staff was friendly, offering genuine hospitality and attention to detail throughout my stay. An outstanding property with an incredible team. Extra shoutout to Blake and Maddie from their sales/marketing team that really went above and beyond for our group.

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Perfect Stay
reviews.body: The best hotel I’ve ever stayed at hands down if you’re in Austin look no further

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.title: Fab couples night!
reviews.body: We had a blast! The pool was just fantastic. Loved the food and drink & the staff was amazing!

reviews.author: SKamal
reviews.title: W Austin Exceeds
reviews.body: Great hotel, with a fantastic staff, great food at serenade breakfast and 2nd roast coffee. Highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Miss P
reviews.title: Great hotel with great location.
reviews.body:
W is a great hotel with perfect location for downtown Austin, especially if you are attending a concert at ACL. 
The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful but if you plan to stay there bring your own bottles water and stay away from rooms near the elevators. It's an engineering tragedy. Very noisy!!

reviews.author: Love2Travel
reviews.title: Fun (hot) trip to Austin for a birthday celebration
reviews.body: The W hotel was amazing. The staff and atmosphere are incredible - the restaurant (Serenade) for breakfast was a great start each day of our visit - Sumit and Jack were great! The pool scene is wonderful - great service there too. And the bar in the lobby is a beautiful place to grab a drink and relax with live music playing at a very reasonable level to allow conversation.

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.title: Overall Great Stay
reviews.body: Great location in the middle of downtown. Hotel was clean, good amenities, nice staff. No complaints.

reviews.author: MFarr
reviews.title: Cool Vibes & Great Service
reviews.body: The W Austin does not disappoint!  The aesthetic is artful and cool as you would expect of a W Hotel.  The staff is great, particularly Suzanne.  The food in Serenade is delicious!

reviews.author: SShaw
reviews.title: Looking forward to another stay
reviews.body:
Had a wonderful stay at the W Austin.  Lovely hotel  (as pictured on website), very comfortable, nice toiletries (don’t remember brand), great location, amazing staff - very friendly, responsive to our needs, extremely helpful - they went above and beyond. Several examples impressed us - UBER service usually very prompt; however, on occasion of wedding we were in town to attend, car was a no-show.  A member of the valet staff, upon sensing that something was wrong, offered and then drove us to the ceremony.  Just incredible! Safe in room was not working due to a faulty battery.  Staff attended to this late one evening and brought a replacement safe.  Housekeeping was always responsive to our requests - iron, kettle, slippers, more hangers.
We hope to return to Austin to enjoy its live music scene, and will certainly welcome another stay at the W!

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.body:
Had a great experience here from the minute I walked in. Valet is great and greets you with a smile everytime, the front desk staff had a smile and literally said hello, how is your stay everytime you pass, the rooms are fantastic. Go enjoy the pool and awesome bartender down there! Also make sure Dimitri makes you a craft cocktail at the bar. What a great staff they have here. The coffee shop was great as well.
Can't wait for my next business trip, I won't stay anywhere else

reviews.author: Aldrin
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.body: Breakfast was delayed. Not a family friendly hotel. All adults partying at the pool. You have to pay a lot of money to have a seat at the pool. A lot of day pass and not a lot of actual guest.

reviews.author: FloridagirlinTexas
reviews.title: Effortless stay
reviews.body: From the minute I checked in until the day I checked out I don’t have a single complaint. From my amazing massage to the perfect cocktail the W Austin was amazing! I’ll never stay anywhere else when back in Austin.

reviews.author: Rich
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.body: I felt heard and seen my entire trip. I am beyond happy and will be back

reviews.author: James
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: This is always a misfit when I visit Austin

reviews.author: Alfred
reviews.title: Almost excellent
reviews.body: The location is the best part of the hotel; it's right in the middle of downtown, and you will have many places to eat and enjoy nearby. The staff gave you a warm welcome, and the DJ at the pool was a lot of fun. My family really enjoyed the food and bar. The only downside of the hotel is maintenance: the air filter in the room AC needs changing, the bathroom door doesn't close properly, and the bed and mattress aren't the best for my liking, but that will depend on the person. I will most likely go to this hotel again in the future.

reviews.author: Karen
reviews.title: Customer service delight
reviews.body: Wonderful customer service. Treated you like a king! Beautifully decorated and updated. A true luxury hotel.

reviews.author: LisAlis26
reviews.title: Fantastic experience like no other.  Definitely will return and recommend.
reviews.body: From start to finish we could have not asked for a better experience

reviews.author: Worldwide Partners
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel for Conference/Summit/Meetings
reviews.body:
We recently hosted our Global Summit at the W Austin for 140 guests, flying in from all over the world.  The whole process from planning to execution was flawless! The hotel is newly renovated into a modern, welcoming space, the staff are attentive to all details and just made the whole process easy and efficient. 

Our attendees loved the space, and were highly complimentary on the location, quality, and most importantly how all the staff made them so very welcome from check in to check out. I highly recommend this property for any conference needs.

reviews.author: ASTER
reviews.title: nice hotel
reviews.body: Hotel was nice.. great location. ac was broken in the room the first night, and you can hear the elevator non stop. also heard bass from somewhere in the building or next door until late.. Suzanne at the front desk is awesome though!

reviews.author: rnapier
reviews.title: An oasis in the middle of a crazy life.
reviews.body: With a work year off the charts, I added an extra day here (post conference) to get a brief reset.  It was more than I could ever imagine. Spa services, yes please--outstanding (and the champagne at the end, chef's kiss).  The "Living Room" bar was fun and relaxing.  Excellent bourbon selection.  Room service--not to miss.  Nothing says luxury like breakfast in bed! Decor is unique, aesthetically pleasing, and yet welcoming. But the real cherry on top is the service of the staff.  Outstanding.  I can't overstate this.  It was the... single... best... service experience I've ever witnessed.

reviews.author: Debbie
reviews.title: Austin
reviews.body: Great staff and location...however no privacy for taking a shower...so only go with a significant other

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.body: This location is in a super location. Located next to the river walk trails and everything downtown. The facilities are very clean. The room views are awesome!

reviews.author: Brittany Lapan
reviews.title: Great weekend away
reviews.body: We were there for a quick trip to Austin and this hotel was perfection. The food, service, amenities were all top notch! My kids loved the pool and we loved the Zanzibar Tiki Bar. We plan to return

reviews.author: review
reviews.title: Inaccurate billing practice
reviews.body:
My hotel room was originally reserved under my company's credit card for the dates of August 22 through August 26. However, upon arrival, I was informed that a credit card authorization form was required. Because it was a weekend, I was unable to obtain the form immediately and had to wait until my supervisor became available. In the meantime, I was required to place the reservation under my personal credit card to secure the room.

On Tuesday, my supervisor submitted the required authorization form to the Marriott, and I was advised that all room charges would be transferred to the company credit card. Unfortunately, this transfer did not occur, and my personal credit card was charged the following amounts:

$370.71
$1,634.52
$1,491.19
$11.91
$64.95
$1.00

After noticing these charges, I contacted the hotel and was transferred to the accounting department. My credit card was subsequently credited in the amounts of:

($370.71)
($1,470.88)

On August 28, I was informed that the $1,634.52 charge would be credited back to my card within two to three business days. As of today, that credit has still not been processed.

I also inquired about the remaining charges and was advised that they were related to in-house food purchases. However, at check-in, I was informed that I would receive a $25 daily credit toward such purchases.

Given the significant inconvenience, the confusion surrounding the billing, and the delays in correcting these charges, I am very disappointed with the handling of this matter. I intend to contact Marriott's corporate office, as I believe this situation reflects poor business practices and an unacceptable level of customer service.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Bare minimum Marriott experience.
reviews.body: Pathetic room amenities; disappointing facility amenities.

reviews.author: Riz Khan
reviews.title: Family visit
reviews.body: Excellent location great service good accommodation

reviews.author: Big Rich
reviews.title: Wedding Trip to Austin
reviews.body: The Hotel was centrally located and the Folks working there couldn’t be any Nicer or any more Professional …A Very Pleasant Stay!!

reviews.author: YAG1216
reviews.title: Austin Downtown Stay
reviews.body: I recently stayed at the Austin Downtown Marriott - I had a Junior Suite and loved every single bit of it - clean, quiet and so roomy!!!! Excited to stay again for my next trip in September

reviews.author: Local Laurie
reviews.title: Quick Refresh
reviews.body: Just wanted to have a getaway from daily life & this was the perfect reset. I was greeted at entrance & made to feel welcome by staff. I had a small issue with the plumbing; however, it was resolved quickly. A member of the Marriott team reached out to make sure that everything was fixed and if I needed anything else. My short getaway was a perfect reset.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Top tier service
reviews.body: From the moment we arrived we were treated like VIP’s.    The entire staff was great.  The location is right in the heart of things and facilities are well kept up.  We loved our stay!

reviews.author: Pittsburgh Review
reviews.title: Margo's Review
reviews.body: The Austin downtown Marriott was beautiful. Great service and the M Club is open on the weekends! This is rare.

reviews.author: Solby
reviews.title: Marriot hotel downtown Austin
reviews.body: The staff friendliness was okay, I didn’t feel the hospitality I usually feel at other Marriot properties. The drinks were all tasting like lime not sure why. But there’s always room for improvement.

reviews.author: Family of Four
reviews.title: Great Amenities, Bad Room
reviews.body: The hotel pool, lobby, restaurant and other amenities were great, but our room was cramped and had several problems. We loved hanging at the pool and ordering drinks and food from the bar. However, the room we paid extra to get on the 31st floor was very disappointing. Some things can be excused like the fact that the in-room sleep sound machine didn't work. Other things cannot be excused like the fact that the refrigerator had a glass door and a very bright blue light inside that lit up the entire room in neon blue at night. Also, the wardrobe was broken and did not close properly which was not be a problem except that it had an automatic light inside that flickered on an off at night. For the price and branding of the hotel, I was surprised our room had these issues.

reviews.author: Jess
reviews.title: Best Location for Downtown Austin
reviews.body: I absolutely loved my stay! We stayed in a corner room on the 29th floor and the view was beautiful, you almost didn't even need to leave! Isaiah helped us with our luggage and he was so nice. He even gave us recommendations on where to eat in downtown! I loved how everything was only about a 5-10 minute walk to anything you want/need in downtown! I would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: KK and AW
reviews.title: Excellent Staycatiin
reviews.body: The bestie and I just needed a weekend get away.  The service was amazing, pool great service and the view was amazing.  Got an upgraded room to a corner king suite with a great view of downtown and town lake!

reviews.author: JordanFam4
reviews.title: Service should extend after stay
reviews.body: Poor service in locating a lost or stolen electronic device. My 11yr daughter accidentally left her iPad in our room. The front desk says nothing was ever returned to lost & found. Obviously someone stole the iPad or misplaced it there at the hotel. However, so desire to keep looking for item. She told me to just file a police report. Uh ok thanks for Not helping.

reviews.author: Erstig78
reviews.title: Great service and food
reviews.body: Quick response to our requests and a wonderful dinner menu at the restaurant

reviews.author: Davie Purves
reviews.title: Marriot Downtown Austin Delivers
reviews.body: Just book, thank me later.

reviews.author: Jonny
reviews.title: Solid stay at Austin Marriott Downtown
reviews.body: Amazing customer service by all staff! Great valet attendants that were very accommodating. The front desk concierge that helped me check in early and showed me around the lobby. Even the employees operating the little store/coffee shop very friendly and welcoming. Will stay again when I return to Austin.

reviews.author: MBG2026
reviews.title: Frustrating booking experience
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel with great location. Bed and pillows were very comfortable and food was excellent. Our group however experienced confusion with our booking and some inconsistencies with the amenities in all the rooms.

reviews.author: Jarrod
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: The rooms were spacious, the food was good and it was close to where I needed to be.

reviews.author: BBQ Eating Engineer
reviews.title: Great location, staff, and facility
reviews.body: I was in town for a conference and enjoyed the great location, helpful staff, and nice facilities at the Marriott. Everything was a short walk away.

reviews.author: TitaniumTraveler2
reviews.title: Could be great, but some concerns
reviews.body:
The Austin Marriott Downtown is a beautiful, modern property in a great location. The hotel itself is fresh, well-maintained, and the service from the staff was consistently friendly and professional throughout my stay. Overall, I enjoyed the property, but there were two significant issues that impacted my experience.

First, my shower flooded the bathroom and extended into the room on three separate occasions during my stay. While I reported the issue each time, it was difficult to get it fully resolved, and at no point was I offered the option to relocate to another room. After multiple incidents, I would have expected a more proactive approach to addressing the situation or moving me to a room without the issue.

Second, the rooftop pool was disappointing. Each day I visited, there was noticeable trash and debris in the water. More concerning, I stepped on a piece of glass in the pool. Fortunately, I was not seriously injured, but this represents a significant guest safety concern and suggests the pool was not being inspected or maintained as frequently as it should have been.

One additional observation is the room layout. While modern and stylish, the bathroom configuration offers very little privacy. The design may work well for solo travelers or couples, but it could be uncomfortable for friends, colleagues, or family members sharing a room.

Overall, this is an attractive hotel with excellent staff and many positive qualities. With better attention to room maintenance and pool cleanliness and safety, it would easily be a five-star experience.

reviews.author: Michelle C
reviews.title: Great Anniversary/4th of July
reviews.body: Our stay was great!  The hotel is beautiful and the staff was amazing.  We'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: CDMATx
reviews.title: Great location but missed the mark
reviews.body: The rooftop restaurant Zanzibar way overbooked and we were not seated until 10 p.m. for our dinner reservation. The burger was barley edible and a big disappointment for $20. The mattress was the worst we've encountered at any hotel/resort/cruise in YEARS. Absolutely not the quality and comfort we've come to expect from Marriott.

reviews.author: Mike G
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.body:
I’m glad to hear you had such a great experience! Here’s a polished, detailed review you could post:

From the moment we arrived, our experience at the Marriott was exceptional, and so much of that was thanks to the outstanding customer service we received. While every staff member we encountered was warm, welcoming, and genuinely committed to making our stay memorable, one person truly stood out—Alena, the manager of Zanzibar and The Rooftop Pool.

Alena went above and beyond in every interaction we had. Her professionalism, kindness, and attention to detail were evident from the start. She made us feel like valued guests, took the time to ensure everything was perfect, and consistently checked in to make sure we were enjoying our experience. It’s rare to come across someone who leads with such genuine hospitality, and it was clear that she takes tremendous pride in creating an exceptional guest experience.

The staff at Zanzibar and the Rooftop Pool reflected Alena’s leadership perfectly. Every team member we interacted with was friendly, attentive, efficient, and always willing to help with a smile. Whether it was offering recommendations, keeping drinks and food coming promptly, or simply making us feel welcome, they exceeded every expectation.

The atmosphere was fantastic, the service was impeccable, and the entire team made our time there one of the highlights of our stay. Experiences like this are what keep guests coming back, and it’s obvious that Alena has built a culture of excellence with her staff.

A heartfelt thank you to Alena and the entire Zanzibar and Rooftop Pool team for making our visit so special. Marriott is fortunate to have such an outstanding leader and such a dedicated group of employees. We can’t wait to return and will absolutely recommend this property to friends and family. Five stars all around!

reviews.author: K8sTravels
reviews.title: Overall Good
reviews.body: The hotel is good overall. For being a busy downtown location the check-in was efficient, the driveway is easy for guests and ubers to enter & exit w/o issue, they have a super convenient snack/necessities store that is open late, and the hotel is pretty and updated. It is also overall pretty clean. I did notice some sort of unsightly stains on our curtain, but to be fair to the hotel I think I only noticed them because I happened to be bending down next to them, and I have extremely high cleanliness standards. The main desk staff, convenience store staff, zanzibar staff, and doormen were all very welcoming and polite. Interestingly we found some of the staff at the premium check-in stand to be a little less warm, but it was just a vibe we got and there wasn't anything overtly rude they said or did so it could be that we just misread them. The first night we requested some extra blankets via phone, and we waited for 30 min w/nothing so we went downstairs to ask the front desk. They told us they'd make sure someone brought them up. We asked if they could just get them right then while we were down in the lobby and they said they were unable to do that. Housekeeping did come up shortly after that, but unfortunately only brought us 1 blanket and we didn't feel like repeating the process so we made do. We also needed some ice packs frozen and while the staff was helpful and accommodating in making that happen, it seems that their freezer wasn't quite cold enough because our packs were not totally frozen when we got them back. Overall these were relatively minor issues that didn't cause us any real problems, I only mention them because they are things I notice at higher end hotels. Another thing to note is that we were informed upon check-in that there is a multi-year construction project next door, and that is the side all of the double bed rooms were located. I heard some construction during daylight hours, but it honestly wasn't bad and it never bothered us at night. There are also white noise machines in those rooms, and the staff offered to move us to a king bed room if that bothered us so I think they handled it well, but just something to keep in mind if you are super sensitive to sound and also require 2 beds as opposed to 1. Overall it fit our needs!

reviews.author: Hayden 2
reviews.title: Great spot downtown!
reviews.body: Great stay! Zanzibar is awesome w amazing, attentive staff! Comfy beds and amazing shower. Location is great for sightseeing and walking to all the best spots.

reviews.author: Screwed over
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.body: Don’t stay here. They don’t help.

reviews.author: HPU2026
reviews.title: Great Stay with Excellent Customer Service
reviews.body: I had a great stay at Austin Marriott Downtown. The employees were friendly, professional, and helpful throughout my visit. The customer service was excellent, and the staff made me feel welcomed and comfortable. Overall, it was a very positive experience, and I truly appreciated the great hospitality.

reviews.author: EducationTraveler
reviews.title: Best In Class
reviews.body: One of the best staff experiences I have ever had at a hotel. Each staff member made it a point to make me feel like a valued guest. And I saw this repeated for every guest that interacted with staff. There was a genuine spirit of care and service that is rare to see! The Mclub is fantastic and there is a wide range of food for most any preference. The pool area is well laid out. Centrally located so easy to get to places!

reviews.author: Not Good
reviews.title: Old/dated accommodates
reviews.body: This location is the worst Renaissance I’ve ever experienced. The rooms were extremely deceptive to what we saw on the website rooms were small in the accommodations were updated specifically the restaurant/bar area was old. The stove/grill was not working when we arrived. they told us no protein was available for any items on the menu. The towels were very thin and rough/hard

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.body: It's just not worth the money

reviews.author: Jacqueline 1982
reviews.title: Beautiful Decor & Excellent CS
reviews.body: I would recommend staying here if you are traveling to Austin, TX. The customer service was excellent. Upon our arrival we were greeted with champagne. Complimentary ice cream available free of charge daily. The decor was hip and beautiful!

reviews.author: Kristen Glimp
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.body: This place deserves all the starts! It was awesome. The food and bar were so great, Richard and Shane took great care of our friend group at the Terrace.

reviews.author: Erik B
reviews.title: If you like flavor this is the place!
reviews.body: Austin in a nutshell. Everything you want  and need is here.

reviews.author: Ebony
reviews.title: Awesome Sauce
reviews.body: The Renaissance is top tier and the fact that they have two restaurants there and the Swim Club you have to go visit when it's hot outside you will not be disappointed they let me do it early check in and did not charge me one dime! When I called and told them that I arrived in Austin at 11:00 they had my room ready for me at 12:00 when check-in is at 3:00. Top tier

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: The Renaissance, “what a beautiful experience!!!”
reviews.body: I cannot say enough of how we felt at home and loved by everyone….. This place is an experience…. It will make you want more… we shall be back . Thank you Paul  the food and beverage director. You need to 10 of him. Marissa at swim club can’t say enough!!!!!Tyler and Maheshwar couldn’t have made our stay better…..AH, Michael, Nickolas , Jackson and Xaverie. I know I mentioned a lot of names but they are well deserved . We stayed for over 2 weeks and would have stayed for 2 more….. We love the Renaissance… The world needs more kindness, so stop by the Renaissance and pick some up!!!!💗💕💗💕💗💕💗

reviews.title: Satified Business Customer
reviews.body: Overall, the facility was sufficient for our purposes.

reviews.author: The Valley Girl
reviews.title: Hotel was Great! Staff needs training
reviews.body: The location of Hotel was great. It was easy to get in and easy to get out.  The parking was great adjacent to the hotel. Room was clean and well stocked.  The staff on the other hand was not so great.  I have never experienced being profiled by where I come from (city).  I was extremely offended , you employee told me he could tell where I was from because I just had that look, vibe and he could pick up on it.  When I asked about the parking his response was " I know where you are from you are     not use to paying for parking, but here you do!!"   Renaissance you need to do better and train your employee on customer service.  You could have received ALL EXCELLENT but this is how I started my check in.

reviews.author: LaciP
reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.body:
I wanted to LOVE the hotel just based on the location and service alone but it was a bit dated and not worth the steep price and parking fee IMO.

Pros:
Clean
We had a corner room queen and it was very spacious on the room part.
Customer service was great
Coffee shop downstairs was perfect
Cute retro decor throughout
Close to the Moody Center
Beds were comfy
was quiet inside we had no noise issues

Cons:
*Parking fee for self park is $50 and the parking garage is so small, like hardly able to turn your vehicle going up and down. There is no direct entrance to the hotel ether was was a little sketch when my daughter and I were arriving back late after a concert, also no employees outside.
* The shower/toilet area is SO small
*the bathrooms are very dark and lighting is weird
*you can tell this is a remodeled older hotel. Getting to our room was down a winding halls with no windows and super low ceiling with a mildewy smell. The rooms were designed to have a "vintage/retro" vibe but honestly just looked old
*elevators made so much creaking noises is was a bit scary

Overall our stay was fine and we only stayed one night, but for the price and the Marriot name, I would expect much better.

reviews.author: JennG
reviews.title: Great hotel!!
reviews.body: Great location and great hotel!!

reviews.author: Karina
reviews.title: Truly One of a Kind
reviews.body: I was so delighted when I walked into my room and saw the retro FUN decor - whoever did the interior design is amazing!! I’m used to just arriving and finding the standard clean place to sleep - this hotel blew me away. I definitely want to come back! It was seriously the best decor I’ve seen.

reviews.author: 100dad
reviews.title: Parking to very expensive
reviews.body: Decent hotel but the parking is way too expensive.

reviews.author: Audrey
reviews.title: Loved my stay
reviews.body: This hotel is so cool! I love the decor! It was different and met the Austin vibe. For example, the pool next to the bar is super cool with the blue tile and atmosphere. The bartender Rick was great as well. I also appreciated Jared at the front desk. He assisted with a strange request (and didn’t make me feel strange for asking), was super professional, and had great food recommendations. Many attractions were in walking distance (capital, 6th street). The attention to detail even down to the items in the rooms was great, such as ear plugs and a white noise channel to drown out the city (though I didn’t need either). The staff was also so quick to attend to guest needs. For example, there was an issue with my room not cooling. I called the front desk and didn’t even have time to use the restroom before the technicians were there to fix the problem. The issue was resolved in no time flat. Thank you Renaissance for a fantastic stay. I’ll definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Texas Orange
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay
reviews.body:
Shame, really.  The Renaissance is usually a great hotel.  This location is really good, but at the prices, let's talk.  The decor is really dated.  The self-parking garage doubles as a homeless shelter based on all the trash in the stairwell, yes, stairwell, no elevator, for $49.  Opt for the valet.
Let's talk room service...hah!  After ordering AND getting hit with a service charge (normal for ROOM service), only then do I get a message that I can waltz myself down to the restaurant and get it my Self-service.  Then, the pool....no hours posted, the door is propped open, then the bartender comes out to yell at us that he had given us extra time but we had to go. Rude.

reviews.author: tyo1234
reviews.title: Nice but lack of security
reviews.body: The hotel itself is very nice and the staff is friendly. However, housekeeping left my room unlocked and unattended for several hours while it was full of my belongings and devices. Anyone could have come by and taken all of it as the door was wide open. I cannot recommend due to this unfortunately even despite the hotel and service being extremely nice.

reviews.author: May H
reviews.title: Great stay. Great value.
reviews.body: The hotel is conveniently located, near WholeFoods, UT, and other restaurants. Easy to get in and out from.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Barbie Dream House
reviews.body: My friends and I celebrate my graduation by visiting Austin and staying in a real life Barbie Dream house hotel. The decor, friendly staff, and amenities were perfectly curated to make this hotel the ultimate dream for any girls’ trip. With a prime location in Austin this hotel provided us with the accessibility and comfort to explore the city. We felt very safe throughout our visit.

reviews.author: Scott Lansing
reviews.title: Incredible Downtown Austin Experience
reviews.body: We had an exceptional stay at the newly transformed Renaissance Austin Downtown Hotel. The property is stylish, modern, exceptionally clean, and full of authentic Austin character. Our room was comfortable and quiet, the location was excellent, and the lobby, bar, coffee shop, pool, and valet experience all stood out. What impressed us most was the service. Every associate we encountered was warm, professional, and welcoming. The hotel’s General Manager even checked on my wife’s breakfast experience each morning, which was a thoughtful touch that made the stay feel especially personal.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great stay !
reviews.body: I came with my 8 year old daughter for a girls weekend. Check in was smooth, breakfast was honesty so good I ended up having the brisket breakfast tacos both days they were so good. The location was perfect for us to get around via uber anywhere. The room was clean and our view was nice.  The hotel is very aesthetically appealing and the staff was honesty all super welcoming and nice.  10/10 I would stay again.

reviews.author: BillyPosey
reviews.title: Great Atmosphere and excellent staff
reviews.body: We loved our stay here. Swim Club was very cool. The staff was super helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: Weekenders
reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.body: Excellent stay! Everything was clean and updated. Plenty of options to not even need to leave the hotel, if we wanted to stay in. Opted for some fun at 6th St and the location was perfect for that.

reviews.author: Dallas family
reviews.title: Weekend in Austin
reviews.body: Very nice older hotel that has been revitalized

reviews.author: Stephhh
reviews.title: Book it!!
reviews.body: Such a vibe! You won’t be bored here. Location was great. Amenities available were awesome. Food was good too!

reviews.author: Jenni Raye
reviews.title: Best Stay in Austin
reviews.body: Beautiful hotel, best costumer service I’ve ever had, quiet area, and perfect closeness to Franklin BBQ.

reviews.author: NG2026
reviews.title: Experience differences
reviews.body:
We changed from our customary hotel across from i35 because of poor service and over priced.  They became complacent. 
And we're glad we did.
Renaissance was clean, well located on the highway and Red River. The actual river can be accessed thru the property, offering an extra way to get to the lake.
The room and other areas were clean, although no safe was offered. Water was free (compared to $5/each, even for your coffee)
The pool area and the pool bar was clean but no staff nor activities were happening despite being summer (felt like a ghost town).
Self parking in Austin Hotels (50.00/night) is not acceptable nor justified.
If you can avoid downtown do so.

reviews.author: Alexandria
reviews.title: Can’t wait to stay again!
reviews.body: From the front desk staff, to the comfiest bed, everything about this stay was 10/10! The food service did take a while that would be my only “complaint” because it didn’t seem busy. But when it did come, it was fantastic!

reviews.author: OU812
reviews.title: Austin off 6th Street
reviews.body: A pleasant, calm property and minutes from 'everything'. Would recommend if you stay in the city.

reviews.author: Mrs C
reviews.title: The Absolute Best
reviews.body: I brought my sister here for her birthday weekend and this hotel made the experience so amazing. From the kindness of the valet and parking team, to the professionalism and attentiveness of the staff ( Ceasar was amazing and funny). This place has it all. Food is great, the coffee at the lobby area was the best. The options of places to eat and the plenty options for cute photos, to the aesthetic of a good time, this place has it all. It's so family and pet friendly. It's very quiet so you can rest at any time of the day (given that you have good neighbors beside your room, but from my experience even the guests were respectful and considerate.)The location was perfect for my sister and I because it was 20min or less from anywhere we waned to go. So many activities and eateries around, and it's very accessible to the access road, but still quiet. I had such a great time I was already planning a trip back with my kids and husband! If you're looking for a place to stay in Austin for a good, fun, exciting time, stop looking. This is the place for it all!

reviews.author: SaMiBuJo
reviews.title: Downright a Great Hotel!
reviews.body: This was our second time staying at this hotel and it’s just getting better and better. We felt the entire staff was working as a team to make everything during our stay enjoyable and first class.

reviews.author: Dissatisfied Customers
reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing Stay
reviews.body:
My experience at this Marriott was unacceptable. The customer service was consistently unhelpful, and despite multiple reports, the air conditioning never worked for the entire stay. The room temperature reached 86 degrees, making it extremely uncomfortable and impossible to relax.

Even with such a significant issue, no compensation or meaningful solution was offered. For a brand that prides itself on hospitality, this was deeply disappointing. I would not recommend this location based on my stay.

reviews.author: Displeased
reviews.title: Stay else where
reviews.body: The hotel is old and musty, no where near what I'm typically use to from a Marriott hotel. The fitness center was barely a closet and whatever was in the center was in horrible condition. Everything was poor.

reviews.author: Alyssa
reviews.title: Would definitely recommend
reviews.body: Everyone in the hotel is super respectful and helpful, the second I got to the hotel the door men helped me unload my car and helped me to my room, the staff is fantastic and the breakfast was always great during my week stay

reviews.author: LawsDog
reviews.title: Residence Downtown Atlanta
reviews.body: If your options is this Marriott location or a park bench…choose the bench!

reviews.author: LisaMac
reviews.title: Great Stay! Great Location!!!
reviews.body: I truly enjoyed my stay. The location was great. The staff was very helpful and knowledgeable!

reviews.author: Davis
reviews.title: Excellent Stay!
reviews.body: This downtown Atlanta location is amazing. You are within walking distance to our capital and to great restaurants and all amazing Atlanta features. The room was very clean and fresh upon my arrival. While I was concerned with the parking since I drive a large truck, it's all valet and they were very accommodating. No issues at all.

reviews.author: The Hairstons
reviews.title: Extremely Pleasant Stay
reviews.body: Our stay at Marriot Residence Inn was a very comfortable and enjoyable stay.  Rashad Sargeant was very helpful, friendly and accommodating to all of our needs. The location was very close to our venue. I would highly recommend staying here if you are looking for comfort, cleanliness, and friendly staff.

reviews.author: ezulem
reviews.title: Great experience - Downtown Atlanta
reviews.body: My husband and I have had a wonderful stay at the Residence Inn by Marriott Atlanta Downtown. The room was very clean and comfortable, with many amenities (a small kitchen); the bathroom was super clean (very important to me). The people who work there are very friendly; the breakfast is simple but good.

reviews.author: Budglenn
reviews.title: overnight stay for a 12 hour trip
reviews.body: the was the least enjoyable stay for Marriott stays this year

reviews.author: Birthday Trip
reviews.title: House Keeping SUCKS
reviews.body:
Our family planned this vacation to celebrate my 50th birthday, and we specifically booked a suite with a pull-out mattress to accommodate our children. I was looking forward to a relaxing getaway, but unfortunately, we encountered several significant cleanliness issues that detracted from our experience.

Upon our arrival, we were greeted by an unpleasant odor in the hotel that resembled a mix of mold and marijuana, which was not the welcoming atmosphere we had hoped for. During check-in, we were assigned to our first room, and upon inspection, I was dismayed to find the pull-out mattress covered in visible pee stains, and what looked like fecal matter. This was incredibly concerning and unacceptable for a family-friendly hotel.

I promptly returned to the front desk to address the issue, and I was grateful that the staff member quickly moved us to a second room. However, when we entered this new room, I discovered that the pull-out mattress had food wrappers and old fries lodged beneath the cushions—definitely not the cleanliness standard one would expect. 

Again, I made my way back to the front desk to explain the situation, emphasizing that we needed a clean space for our family. At this point, the staff member informed me they could not find another room that met our initial booking. To resolve the issue, they graciously offered us two separate rooms. The third room, where the children stayed, was a slight improvement; it had only a Kool-Aid stain on the mattress, which was a relief compared to our previous experiences.

Amidst all these challenges, I would like to highlight Stacey, the cleaning manager. Throughout the process, she was the only person who truly seemed to understand our concerns and responded with empathy. Her level of professionalism and willingness to listen made an otherwise frustrating experience more bearable. I sincerely hope that feedback like this can contribute to improvements in the hotel’s housekeeping standards for future guests.

reviews.author: Mr J
reviews.title: Residence Inn in the Heart of the city
reviews.body:
This is the perfect hotel for travelers used to major cities but also want the advantage of a home stay style hotel room. The subway and streetcar are directly across the street as well as being in a major ride-share area (Uber/Lyft). If arriving at ATL airport you will only step outside long enough to cross a road as the subway is inside ATL and delivers you straight to the hotel. Shopping and luxury shopping are also equally accessible to the train system along with a host of museums and tourist attractions. Wilson (I hope I have that correct) at the front desk is an Atlanta native and happily answers any questions. Valet parking is $50 per day, but that is typical for city parking.

Unfortunately, the valet is only available on the side of the building that requires traversing 3 or 4 step. The handicap accessible side of the hotel is not manned, but accessibility was not front of mind when the building was built in 1929. That said there are interesting features like the pneumatic USPS mail system that though not in use is still present. The only other con I could find is that the breakfast is slightly below mid-tier. It is probably on par with a continental breakfast and since it is free I am probably being hyper critical.

Overall, the location, ease of travel, and price will result in several more bookings.

reviews.author: Sunflower Girl
reviews.title: Kind of a bummer
reviews.body: When we first arrived we had to get another room due to the sofa bed having stains and unclean. The rooms are on the small side would have probably preferred my suite that I reserved. The market inside the hotel was empty it had no drinks there are no vending machines on any floor no pool for families. The overall was good due to location and everything we wanted to do.

reviews.author: Q from Florida
reviews.title: Poor quality in reception employees
reviews.body:
From beginning in checking in start our poor experience, I arrive 4 pm and they said please you need to wait 30 minutes the room get ready so basically we enter to our room after 45 minutes.
Also when we checking out I explained that we had dirty water leaking in the middle of the night also they didn’t care and they told me , you need to call and contact the website or to the company you book from or.
Basically said clearly You don’t book from us and we can not handle your complain.
That way I told him you guys will read some feedback from me every where also in google reviews

reviews.author: Amelia Della Terza
reviews.title: Please inspect your rooms
reviews.body:
We arrived very late and were exhausted, especially since we were traveling with our young child, so we did not call the front desk to request a room change.

The cleanliness of the room was well below the standards we expected. As someone who worked for Marriott for many years, I understand that some properties may have older rooms, and I don’t mind if a room is outdated. However, finding body hair on the bed and in the bathtub was completely unacceptable. It was so unsanitary that I couldn’t even bring myself to bathe my baby in the tub.

This experience was very disappointing and did not meet the level of cleanliness I associate with Marriott.

reviews.author: Unhappy Dad
reviews.title: Hi Parking Cost….No free parking for guest.
reviews.body: When I booked I was not informed of the $50 dollars a night parking

reviews.author: Georgia Peach
reviews.title: Need Improvements
reviews.body: If anyone stays here you understand the need for upgrades and cleaning.

reviews.author: A Traveler
reviews.title: TOP NOTCH ATL - SOUTHER HOSPITALITY & CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.body: Everyone and each team member and department were top notch from check-in to check-out!!!

reviews.author: My Solo Visit1
reviews.title: My Visit
reviews.body: The stay was very enjoyable, and Phil was extremely professional throughout my experience. He was courteous, attentive, and made sure everything went smoothly. I truly appreciated his excellent customer service and would gladly stay again.

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.title: Outstanding!
reviews.body: I was greeted with a pleasant smile, the room was clean, and the customer service was exceptional.

reviews.author: Angel L
reviews.title: Perfect Location but Breakfast Needs Potato's lol
reviews.body:
Loved the location. Walking distance from Centennial Olympic, Coca Cola Factory, Aquarium, Peachtree Street, etc

Breakfast was good but needed potatoes.

reviews.author: Jason m
