reviews.title: Reservation reservations do not matter
reviews.body: I review of this establishment is less than poor. Our reservation was not honored after driving 12 hours.

reviews.author: Dcurtis
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Great experience everyone was extremely helpful and went above and beyond

reviews.author: Solo
reviews.title: Great property
reviews.body: I really enjoyed my stay and will definitely look again in the near future. I would also recommend property

reviews.author: Solo business travel
reviews.title: Not the place to stay until upgrades are made
reviews.body: I can only speak for my room, but there was a musty smell when I walked in. After looking in the bathroom, I could see moisture on the ceiling and what looked to be mold of some kind. Based on the smell, that’s my assumption. I was traveling by myself for business, and will never go back. I certainly would never stay here with my wife and kids.

reviews.author: Marriott Member S
reviews.title: Ok Hotel.
reviews.body:
Based on my recent experience, the hotel only partially delivered on its promise. The location remains a major strength and is very convenient for business travel. In addition, every staff member I interacted with was courteous, professional, and genuinely helpful.
However, the condition and cleanliness of the property fell short of expectations. The room was not cleaned to an acceptable standard, and the presence of mold in the bathroom was particularly disappointing. While the service provided by the staff was excellent, the overall maintenance and upkeep of the hotel did not match the quality that the Residence Inn brand promises.
The people working at the hotel are doing a great job, but improvements in cleanliness, maintenance, and overall property condition are needed for the hotel to fully deliver on its promise.

reviews.author: BostonFam
reviews.title: Good Hotel Excellent service
reviews.body: Definitely and average hotel with a great location and excellent service. Every employee went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and comfortable.

reviews.author: Erica LP
reviews.title: Sooooo disappointed in this Marriott stay!
reviews.body:
I am very disappointed regarding my recent stay at the Residence Inn by Marriott. Unfortunately, my experience did not meet the standards I expected from the Marriott brand.

Upon arrival, I noticed that the bedding had visible yellow stains, which raised concerns about cleanliness and overall room quality. Additionally, the pull-out sofa bed was extremely uncomfortable, as the mattress was worn and the springs could be felt protruding through the surface, making it difficult to sleep.

I was also troubled by the way my service dog was handled by staff. Despite informing the hotel that my dog is a legitimate service animal, I felt that my statements were not taken seriously. As a result, I was charged a $150 pet fee based on the assumption that my service dog was a regular pet. This situation was both frustrating and upsetting, as service animals are not considered pets under applicable disability accommodation guidelines.

Overall, the condition of the room and the handling of the service animal issue significantly impacted my stay. I respectfully request that this matter be reviewed, including the removal and refund of the $150 charge, and that appropriate steps be taken to prevent similar experiences for future guests.

reviews.author: Profile0viewer
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.body: Perfect spot in downtown to get to everything we needed to. Great, kind staff and lovely rooms!

reviews.author: Punit S
reviews.title: Bad Service and Poor BF
reviews.body: Unfriendly Staff and poor BF Service

reviews.author: Dexter
reviews.title: Perfect spot to stay when in atlanta
reviews.body: The downtown residence in. Is located almost perfect.  It's close to just about everything.  It's always been my go to hotel for downtown atlanta.

reviews.author: Cowboy
reviews.title: Super nice staff
reviews.body: The staff was super nice. But everything else fell short for a Marriot location. There is no parking other than valet at 55 a night. Had to wait for a long time for vehicle they are not keep close. Breakfast and coffee don’t even waste your time. Over priced and not worth it. No bar. Location is pretty good. But a lot of homeless around begging for everything.

reviews.author: Ralph
reviews.title: DragonCon Stay
reviews.body: Amazing service. Friendly staff went above and beyond. Room was comfortable and clean. We had amazing stay

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Dragon Con Stay
reviews.body: It was really good. I plan on staying for Dragon Con next year.

reviews.author: DC26
reviews.title: Fine
reviews.body: If you need somewhere to stay but don’t care about luxury, Ellis hotel fits that mark. The rooms are small and cramped and the ceilings were dirty/moldy. However, the staff are polite and attentive and when two things broke in my bathroom they were addressed immediately. I’ve stayed at much nicer places in downtown Atlanta for a similar or cheaper price, but had limited options for this trip and this hotel was at least conveniently located for my travel purposes.

reviews.author: Loyal Visitor
reviews.title: Yearly Tradition
reviews.body: The Ellis is our go-to hotel on our annual visit to Atlanta. The few years that we were unable to get a room there only served to reinforce why we like to stay there. The staff is always wonderful, and the location is perfect for our needs while we are in town.

reviews.author: Leisure Specialist
reviews.title: It Was Fine
reviews.body: It was fine, room was comfortable but nothing to write home about.

reviews.author: Ble2026
reviews.title: Overnight stay in downtown Atlanta
reviews.body: We go to 6-8 Atlanta United matches a year and for the first time decided to make it a 24 hour experience.  We were able to check in early, walked a block for brunch at By George in the historic Candler Hotel.  I grabbed a beer at one of two breweries within 0.3 miles and we hit the Red Phone Booth around the corner, the coolest speak easy with amazing drinks and dinner.  It’s then just a 20 minute walk to the Mercedes Benz stadium for a match, some late night music, and some breakfast at the Metro Diner, also just around the corner.  It’s also great to stay at the Ritz Carlton right across the street, but the Ellis Hotel is a great option (and a little more affordable haha!)

reviews.author: Toby
reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel was comfortable, clean, and in a great location!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: In need of some TLC
reviews.body:
This hotel has definitely seen better days.  The rooms are dated and tired.  More importantly, there were maintenance problems in both of the rooms I was given.  My first room was a handicap king (this was a business trip, and the booking was done through my employer) that seems not to have been used in a while.  The air conditioner had blown a breaker, which a maintenance guy was able to fix after moving the bed and climbing up to do a manual reset in the ceiling.  He was not able to fix the loudly dripping bathtub faucet because that would apparently require shutting down water to the entire building.  Although I had been told that they were sold out and couldn't move me to a different room because of the air conditioning (when it was unclear whether they'd be able to fix it), they magically found a room when instructed by the lead engineer due to the faucet.  My second room was much better--bigger and more recently updated (although still tired).  But it, too, had plumbing problems.  The bathroom sink leaked underneath so that water collected under the vanity and spilled out onto the floor.  The sink and the shower were both really slow to drain.  

There are only two slow elevators, so be prepared to wait during busy periods. 

Overall, this was a disappointing stay for a Marriott property.  There are much better hotels at lower prices in the area.  I wouldn't stay here again.

reviews.author: Oksyheath
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.body: My husband and I enjoyed our stay. The staff very friendly and make you feel welcomed!

reviews.author: VATraveler
reviews.title: Amazing staff in a great hotel
reviews.body: This beautiful hotel was incredibly clean and comfortable. The staff was beyond nice, no matter who you talked to from the breakfast staff to the front desk to the valet, everyone was amazing. put all that together and you have an amazing stay.

reviews.author: Dissapointed
reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.body: The hotel definitely did not resemble pictures or description on website.  Outdated and tired. No restaurant or bar.  Decent location, but that is it.  Staff was friendly.

reviews.author: Bren
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body: Rooms needed to be cleaned and checked better.

reviews.author: Nan K
reviews.title: Only way to experience a concert
reviews.body: Great place to stay for a great concert

reviews.author: Customer 123456
reviews.title: Extremely pleased with stay
reviews.body: First time staying at this property. Staff was extremely nice and helpful. Rooms clean and comfortable. Easy walk to good restaurants.

reviews.author: Cherel
reviews.title: Stay at Ellis
reviews.body: Overall experience was well

reviews.author: Nice bed
reviews.title: Conveniently located
reviews.body: Okay hotel. Could be so much better.

reviews.author: Repeat customer
reviews.title: Great location and will maintain
reviews.body: Staff is responsive, knowledgeable, friendly, and you couldn’t ask for more. The hotel is a lot of history and is more of a traditional hotel something that I liked. I think it’s getting close to time for Refresh, but that’s OK. Time will take care of that. The amenities are limited, which they clearly communicate– there’s one outlet with limited service and at the same time it offers a nice selection of food and drink the gym is sub optimal however they have all the basic equipment room was clean well maintained and comfortable.

reviews.author: Ellis visitor
reviews.title: Ellis hotel
reviews.body: Great staff. Clean hotel. Home warm vibe. Will definitely be going back.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Business Traveler
reviews.body: Excellent location and staff of top tier.

reviews.author: bellgh
reviews.title: Exceptional service!
reviews.body: The service was exceptional, especially Walter at the front desk. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. GB

reviews.author: Cory S
reviews.title: A Hidden Gem in Downtown Atlanta
reviews.body:
I absolutely fell in love with my stay at Ellis Hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff stood out—they were kind, professional, and incredibly helpful, especially for someone unfamiliar with the area. Their guidance and hospitality made the entire experience feel welcoming and stress-free.

The room exceeded my expectations. It was clean, quiet, and surprisingly spacious. I had anticipated something much smaller, like a typical NYC-style room, but instead found a comfortable and relaxing space that made it easy to unwind.

Overall, a fantastic stay—I would absolutely return and highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Atlanta.

reviews.author: Country Travel
reviews.title: Amazing service, very clean hotel!
reviews.body: The hotel team goes above and beyond and was always assisting me with a smile on their face!

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.title: Great Downtown Atlanta Experience
reviews.body: Staff  and Security helped me navigate Atlanta area with food and entertainment as well as walking areas.

reviews.author: Rich AZ
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Atlanta
reviews.body:
We Loved this Hotel…. The staff was Amazing, friendly, would try to help you anyway they could.  Everyday they’d greet you with a smile and address you by name.   The bistro team even remembered your orders from the previous days.   I loved it. 
A BIG THANK YOU to the whole team.

reviews.author: Rob T
reviews.title: Quality Hotel
reviews.body: Well-maintained hotel with quality rooms. Service is excellent and Staff is friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Anya
reviews.title: True Southern Hospitality in the Heart of Atlanta
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful stay at this hotel and would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Atlanta. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel genuinely welcome. Everyone was incredibly nice, helpful, and charming. They truly give you a real taste of Southern hospitality, always going above and beyond to make sure guests feel comfortable and taken care of.
The location is fantastic. You’re right next to great restaurants and bars, with conference halls nearby, and the aquarium is only about a 10-minute walk away. It’s perfectly situated whether you're visiting for business or leisure.
The rooms are spacious, clean, and very comfortable.

reviews.author: Solotraveler1
reviews.title: Nothing to write home about
reviews.body: Nothing really that special, could be updated and th Starbucks does not have the full menu

reviews.author: Snyder
reviews.title: Poultry show
reviews.body: 3 nights. Need some simple verity at the bar. Mic Ultra and Captain morgan maybe? Not everyone likes the fancy stuff.

reviews.author: Morgan Tate
reviews.title: Great staff! Comfortable room!
reviews.body: McKayla on the front desk helped answer questions, hold bags, and print items for me! 10/10 service!  James on Valet was professional and efficient. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience!

reviews.author: Antoine
reviews.title: great stay
reviews.body: Location is great. Was able to walk to the concert, and sky lounge is good for adults to settle after a day or night.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: Ultimately disappointed
reviews.body:
The Glenn Hotel’s location is convenient, but unfortunately the overall experience did not justify the price point. Check-in and valet service were both disappointing, particularly given the challenges of navigating parking in such a busy downtown area. There was no assistance with unloading, getting luggage to the lobby, or bringing it to the room.

The biggest issue was our room, which had a maintenance problem that caused a loud, constant noise throughout the night. Between the lack of service and the room issue, the stay fell well short of expectations for a hotel at this price point. Ultimately, I felt I could have received the same level of service at a Courtyard for considerably less. Based on this experience, I would not return.

reviews.author: Thayne
reviews.title: Awesome.
reviews.body: We had a fantastic stay! Check-in was completely seamless, and the front desk staff was incredibly welcoming and friendly from the moment we walked in. Our room was spotless, comfortable, and nice and cool. Convenient parking right across the street made coming and going a breeze, and the breakfast was truly amazing. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Kimmie
reviews.title: Historic Charm & Boutique Comfort
reviews.body:
Staying at the Glenn Hotel in Atlanta was a truly special experience. I loved the hotel’s historic character and boutique style…it has a unique charm that makes it feel much more personal than a typical hotel.

The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, and throughout my stay I genuinely felt like a special guest rather than just another visitor. The room decor was pleasant and thoughtfully styled, creating a comfortable and inviting atmosphere. The bed was also exceptionally comfortable!! 

Overall, the Glenn Hotel combines historic charm, boutique character, and genuinely warm hospitality. It’s a wonderful choice if you’re looking for a hotel with personality and a more memorable, personal experience in Atlanta.

reviews.author: Jones
reviews.title: The place
reviews.body: This IS the place, I travel for a living and very few places leave a mark on me. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Recommending the amazing deviled eggs. The rooms were very warm and felt quaint. Was a 5 star experience yet a small bed and breakfast feel. It was a great break from the usual flat/hollow hotels I have to stay at. Will be coming back whenever Im in the area.

reviews.author: Girls Trip 2026
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.body: Awesome  stay. Staff were welcoming. Close to everything.

reviews.title: Street Noise NO SLEEP
reviews.body: After the party was over, I go to my room and it was just loud I couldn’t sleep. I didn’t sleep all night was on the third floor and it was so much noise outside and with the loud air condition inside the room you just didn’t get no sleep and I need peace and quiet when I sleep and the windows should’ve been soundproof so I need to change the window windows and get soundproof windows. It was awful. The event I attended was beautiful. It was amazing. The food was excellent. The service was great. The venue was just everything was perfect except for the room where I decided I’m gonna spend the night instead of coming home. I live in Atlanta I said stay there spend the night there cause they played driving in 20 minutes and it was always decision I made.

reviews.author: Concert2
reviews.title: The best hotel in downtown Atlanta
reviews.body: This was my second time staying at the Glenn Hotel in downtown Atlanta. The hotel is a beautifully restored old building with very comfortable rooms that have a unique layout. I love the tall ceilings and tastefully decorated rooms. There is also an excellent restaurant and bar on the first floor. The food is delicious, service excellent and staff very friendly. Can’t wait to stay there again!!

reviews.author: Mary K
reviews.title: Good option for gameday
reviews.body: I stayed here for 3 night for the World Cup.  Good clean location to the stadium and close to the Marta.  Took the Marta straight from the airport. So easy.  No need to buy the Marta card, just tap your phone if you have a cc on your card.  I would stay here again for a sporting event, but not if I wanted to explore Atlanta.  Not much of anything else around the area.  I had a 6:30am outbound flight so I couldn't take Marta, Uber was not taking reservations at the time and was surprised that the front desk could not arrange a taxi for me.  Their only option was to give me someone's number who was going to charge $90 for a one way trip to airport which is a 15 minute ride.

reviews.author: Kelly J
reviews.title: Great World Cup family trip
reviews.body:
My family of 4 stayed here for two night to attend a World Cup game.  Overall we loved the hotel and would stay here again since we could walk to the stadium in 5 minutes.

Things we loved: free welcome cocktail after riding with my kids for 5 hours.  Very clean room with nice crisp sheets. Hotel staff excellent.  Daily housekeeping! Fastest room service breakfast delivery I have every experienced.

Things we didn't like: the room temp was set on 80 when we arrived.  The fourth floor didn't have a great view.

reviews.author: M2848
reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.body: First time to staying here and we were very happy

reviews.author: Kieran
reviews.title: Comfortable and friendly hotel that's well situated for conferences
reviews.body: I was in Atlanta for an event at the Omni. The Glenn made a perfect based and was cheaper ;-) Everyone was very friendly and the room was very comfortable

reviews.author: Bill the traveler
reviews.title: The Last Actual Boutique Hotel
reviews.body:
If you are tired of the same old hotel stays and are looking for something with interesting history and artwork with great service the Glen is the Boutique Hotel your looking for on your next stay.
The Glen is a great location within walking distance to Centennial Park and the Ferris wheel. 

The staff at the front desk and at Glens Kitchen are excellent.  They help you navigate the city if your new to it and I found them very helpful and courteous as well as patient. 

The rooms are a little on the small side so if reserving rooms try to err with the larger room if its in your budget.

reviews.author: devuntae
reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.body: Yes it’s so close to everything and the staff is great . Would reccommend

reviews.author: Carolyn 70
reviews.title: Great place to stay if you are attending functions that are located in the downtown area
reviews.body: Overall, this hotel was a great place to stay! The room was clean. The staff was very friendly. The food in the kitchen was just OK but I would recommend anyone with plans in the downtown area to stay at this hotel. Very quaint and has a home feeling.

reviews.author: Rhene
reviews.title: Beautiful Stay in Midtown Atlanta
reviews.body:
I stayed at the Glenn Hotel for the Atlanta Dream home opener against the Las Vegas Aces and I could not have picked a better property. Aside from being less than a five minute walk from the stadium (I could literally see the State. farm Arena and the Mercedes-Benz Stadium from my room), the property is absolutely beautiful. The staff was fantastic from my arrival to departure. The gentlemen at valet helped me retrieve my bags from the Lyft, the staff at check in was so kind, offered me a welcome beverage, DID NOT tell me my room number out loud which I greatly appreciated, and even helped me carry my bags up the 3-4 steps to the elevator. 
Housekeeping was very thorough, the room was spotless when I arrived and they did an amazing job during my stay.
I dined at the property for lunch upon my arrival and the staff was amazing as well. I ate lunch from there attached restaurant Glenn's Kitchen in their Bar area, The Living Room and it is a great space to have a drink or two, chat with your group or or other staying at the property. 
Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Glenn Hotel, as a long time Marriott Bonvoy customer, I can say  it truly lives up to the Marriott Bonvoy and Autograph Collection Hotel standards in every way.

reviews.author: Dannie
reviews.title: More than a hotel, It's an Atlanta experience.
reviews.body:
My stay at the Glenn Hotel in downtown Atlanta was honestly one of the highlights of my trip. The hotel has a perfect mix of historic charm and modern luxury that immediately makes it feel different from the typical corporate hotel experience. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt warm, stylish, and intentional. 

The staff was incredibly welcoming and attentive throughout the entire stay. Every interaction felt genuine and you could tell they genuinely cared about creating a great experience. The rooms were clean, comfortable (especially if you like a firm mattress), and thoughtfully designed with a boutique feel that still managed to feel upscale and relaxing.

One of the biggest standouts was the rooftop lounge. The skyline views of Atlanta at night were absolutely stunning, and the vibe was unmatched - relaxed, sophisticated, and perfect for winding down after exploring the city. The location itself is also hard to beat. Being within walking distance of the Centennial Olympic Park, Mercedes-Benz Stadium, and several other downtown attractions made everything convenient without constantly needing to Uber around the city.

If you're looking for a hotel in Atlanta that feels elevated without being pretentious, the Glenn Hotel absolutely delivers. I'd stay here again in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Ashley Winther
reviews.title: Beautiful stay
reviews.body: My wife and I stayed at the Glenn Hotel for the Florence and the Machine concert over the weekend. The hotel is so cute and we loved all the eclectic decor. The staff were all so kind and made check in so easy. We were given a delicious cherry gin welcome drink and I was able to draw some bonus points from a bowl. It was so fun and a nice touch. The room was amazing and the bed was very comfortable. We loved the bathroom and we had a great view of state farm arena. We will absolutely be coming back. Thank you all so much!

reviews.author: The Burneys
reviews.title: Perfect night in the city
reviews.body: The hotel is perfectly located for downtown Atlanta. Valet parking on site. Restaurant and bar are both excellent. The rooms are gorgeous and the bed was comfortable. We look look forward to coming back.

reviews.author: Dion
reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.body: We enjoyed the level of professional service

reviews.author: Roxxanne85
reviews.title: My Second Home
reviews.body: From valet...to check in to food service....everything is always top notch

reviews.author: Dubb
reviews.title: Great Location, Great Staff, Great Drinks
reviews.body: Staff was wonderful, especially front desk staff. Drinks were excellent. Room requests (luggage racks, extra towels) were delivered immediately by great staff. They were very helpful. Location is great. We were able to walk to State Farm Arena for event.

reviews.author: Ayah
reviews.title: Privacy issues [Room checks]
reviews.body: Privacy issue. Not safe for women. Male employees "check" rooms. You do not have to consent; refusal to let staff check my bedroom got me removed from the room.  I was in the city for my birthday, with friends trickling in to give me gifts and greetings. Two male employees knocked on my door but I wasn't dressed decently, so I sent my sister. He raised his voice sharp enough for me to hear him through the door. At one point, I heard him say, "Don't talk to him! He's not going to speak to you. You're going to address me." He wanted to do a room check to see how many guests were in my room. The request itself made me feel uncomfortable, but the man who made it made me feel worse. You'd expect someone to be somewhat apologetic about such a request, but he was oddly very adamant and confrontational.  He gave us an ultimatum: either let them come in to look around or be forcibly removed from our rooms. Frankly, he was a horrible bully, and the instant escalation of "or else" raised red flags. I felt extremely accosted. He wasn't asking for permission; he was telling us. No smile, no explanation, and when we questioned it, he said if we didn't like it, we should leave. We absolutely left. I don't pay for men to come into my bedroom. Privacy should not be conditional. It's not real consent to enter if it's coerced under threat of expulsion.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Nice Stay
reviews.body: We visited the area for a volleyball tournament and stayed here. The rooms were a bit small but very clean. Staff helped with all of our questions and concerns.

reviews.author: Scharlene
reviews.title: The Perfect combination of luxury, functionality and comfort
reviews.body:
Stepping into this boutique hotel felt like stepping into intention, elegance, and ease—all at once. 

As a travel professional, I’m always evaluating not just how a place looks, but how it feels… and this one delivered on every level.

From the rich textures and beautifully curated design to the warm, inviting ambiance, every detail was thoughtfully executed. My room offered the perfect blend of luxury and tranquility, while the lounge spaces created an elevated atmosphere ideal for both unwinding and meaningful connection.

What I appreciated most? The seamless balance between productivity and relaxation. Whether you’re traveling for business, leisure, or a little of both—this is the kind of space that supports it all effortlessly.

This is exactly the type of boutique luxury experience I love recommending to my clients. 

If you’re looking for a stay that combines style, comfort, and intention look no further than The Glenn Hotel in downtown Atlanta.

reviews.author: MRD 205
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: I would rate my stay an 8. The smell was terrible, and the cost was high.

reviews.author: KBH65
reviews.title: Great hotel close to the Capitol
reviews.body: My daughter and I enjoyed our stay at the Glenn Hotel! It's very close to the Georgia State Capitol. Easy to drive to or take an Uber. The food was great, and the staff was phenomenal! I highly recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: D Mastin
reviews.title: Needs to be Updated
reviews.body: The hotel is in a great location.  Front desk staff made me feel right at home.  The valet was seamless.  However, a maid walked in on me naked after repeatedly saying not right now.   My room has stains on the wall and wallpaper that was peeling. This is a lack of upkeep.  The hotels character, art work, and aim to bring one into a cultural experience fails at one key point. A lack of upkeep.  I’d love to come back, but I’d never stay in a room that charges 600 dollars for your stay, 120 dollars for ballet, but motel 6 accommodations.  No matter how nice the front desk, the value has to be equal.  Go back to the basics, renew your passions in hospitality, and engulf that work culture to every staff member.  Not just the people you think we’ll see.

reviews.author: Abby
reviews.title: Don’t miss this gem!
reviews.body: The Glenn Hotel is a rare find! The entire staff is professional, courteous, and very helpful. The vibe is old money boutique that draws you in and encourages you to relax and stay awhile. The rooms are cozy and well appointed, from the minibar to the comfy robes. The decor is understated elegance that is calming & inviting. Don’t miss the chance to stay here if you can!

reviews.author: Hygienist84
reviews.title: First stay at the Glenn
reviews.body: This is my first stay at the Glenn Hotel. I was in town for a dental convention.

reviews.author: Visit from Savannah
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.body: Great hotel with a very courteous staff. Comfortable bed, very clean, good food and convenient to restaurants and other Atlanta attractions. Would be happy to visit again.

reviews.author: Andyofct
reviews.title: Awful room but amazing staff
reviews.body:
The staff at Courtyard by Marriott Atlanta Downtown absolutely saved the experience, because the room was a scam. The room was listed at 283sqft, but was actually 192sqft including the bathroom. There was no shower door and the bathroom only had a barn door that did not lock and would gradually slide open, especially while showering.
The “fitness center” was one of the worst hotel gyms I’ve ever seen. There were essentially no other functioning amenities.
The staff was great though. They were friendly and engaging at every point and every hour of the day.

reviews.author: lovelyearth101
reviews.title: Can't Wait for Next Year!
reviews.body: Honestly, with such wonderful staff and the location being perfect, I'm trying to see if I can book this hotel again for next year!

reviews.author: DS
reviews.title: Fantastic staff
reviews.body: While the building may have its quirks due to its historic nature, the staff are always ready and willing to help.

reviews.author: N C
reviews.title: Okay during Crowded Convention
reviews.body: The staff here was very nice, but I did have to pay a pretty high rate during a convention where most of the downtown was booked out. For the rate that it was, I didn’t expect that there would be a lingering sour scent in the room. Beyond that, the bed was comfortable enough and the distance to my destinations was short on foot. I did opt to eat and grab coffee elsewhere once I tried the cafe and found the service downstairs to be slow and offerings subpar. On a visit without the high rate, this would have been a better value, but altogether, not the worst place I’ve stayed.

reviews.author: Stile
reviews.title: One night only
reviews.body: Clean.... quiet... just what we needed

reviews.author: DMS
reviews.title: IWF- had to change hotels this was amazing
reviews.body: I was supposed to be at Marriott Marquis however they didn’t have my room ready even at 12am- I went to courtyard and they were amazing- staff was phenomenal the entire stay.

reviews.author: World Traveler
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.body: Required to move 3 times before getting a room that worked.   Waited an hour for food before being told they were out of the turkey for a turkey sandwich.  Breakfast person for the first two days was wonderful.  The one for the rest of the stay got the order wrong every day.   10,000 points for the room inconvenience was inconsequential for all the mishaps.

reviews.author: Scott603
reviews.title: Great Stay in Atlanta during IWF
reviews.body: Excellent hotel which is a convenient distance from the World Congress Center.  The welcoming , helpful staff at this hotel make all the difference.  Whether finding my way to the trade show, the train station or to one of the many great places to eat in that part of Atlanta, the staff was always ready to help with a smiles and positivity and great information.

reviews.author: Tyler
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: Staff were super friendly and helpful. had great recommendations for local attractions. Room was comfy and the Air Conditioning worked GREAT in the room.

reviews.author: April J
reviews.title: Will be back!
reviews.body: Perfect! Staff, amenities, food, room.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Great hotel in a beautiful building in downtown Atlanta!
reviews.body: The hotel is a beautiful building right in downtown. The rooms were well maintained, clean, quiet. I like these buildings because they were made from sturdy materials and I could not hear people in the adjacent units nor those above me. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. If you're in downtown Atlanta, I would recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Jason Pozarowski
reviews.title: A great hotel and really pleasant stagf
reviews.body: The Hotel was really great people. The staff was beyond welcome in and very nice. We got a corner room so we had three different light sources coming in from the outside, which was quite lovely and quite Rare.. They have a nice small bar downstairs as well and some pretty good food. It was a great trip and we will be back.

reviews.author: Maureen E
reviews.title: Close to the attractions and ball fields
reviews.body: It is a very comfortable place and was close to the Cosm and aquarium. The staff was so friendly. The bartender in the evening, she was phenomenal and fun.

reviews.author: 123XYZ
reviews.title: Missing the southern hospitality
reviews.body: The doorman didn’t offer to assist with our luggage.  The hotel room door was difficult to open without using significant force and often didn’t open on the first attempt.  The room was dimly lit.  Our in-room safe was not functioning.  When  we notified the staff, we informed that none of the in-room safes were functioning.

reviews.author: TKB
reviews.title: Wonderful Corner Room with a wonderful view
reviews.body: No issues! Good place in the middle of downtown!

reviews.author: Birthday anniversary
reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.body: I was really impressed when we walked in I was sweating and the front desk rep gave me a bottle of water.  Also the front desk manager and bistro employee Jocelyn gave me a card, water, and candy bar for my birthday such kind loving people. Jocelyn and he said hi every morning and Jocelyn made sure we had everything we asked for correct for our breakfast each morning. She deserves employee of the month.

reviews.author: Traci
reviews.title: Excellent Staff and Hotel
reviews.body: My stay at Downtown Atlanta was a pleasant one provided by this hotel and its staff. The hotel was clean and the staff are pleasant.

reviews.author: Renee Busby
reviews.title: This location is amazing!
reviews.body: The staff was amazing and the location was excellent.  The hotel was pristine clean!

reviews.author: Will
reviews.title: Make sure you get a regular room
reviews.body: Make sure you aren’t staying in a triangle room, it’s designed so badly you will be turning sideways just to use the the bathroom

reviews.author: D Bryant
reviews.title: Amazing Property
reviews.body: Amazing, property, great front desk

reviews.author: Morgan R
reviews.title: Poor Overall
reviews.body: Do not expect the typical high expectations of Marriott at this location. I did not receive housekeeping as promised. The staff determined restaurant hours despite having clear times posted. One staff in particular had a very poor attitude.

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.title: Best hotel in Atlanta!
reviews.body: This hotel is by far the best I’ve stayed in Atlanta! The room was so spacious and very clean! The bar and Starbucks right downstairs is so convenient! We had a couple drinks before our concert and the bartender was so sweet!! All of the staff were friendly and very helpful! And I must recommend the valet parking! They were quick to bring my car around when I needed it. The area it’s at is very nice too but we didn’t have time to go to the library next door or the pretty fountain across the street but next time we will! My sister and I felt safe staying here and we will come here any time we are in Atlanta!

reviews.author: Armando Santillan
reviews.title: Courtyard Atlanta Downtown
reviews.body: The Courtyard Atlanta Downtown was very nice and exceptionally clean hotel flew in for work and stayed 6 nights

reviews.author: RodJames
reviews.title: Parking nightmare
reviews.body: They don’t have parking, but refer guests to a scam parking lot across the street .

reviews.author: Ann from Louisiana
reviews.title: Courtyard by Marriott Atlanta Downtown
reviews.body: What makes up for the bumps and bruises of travel, nice people! Courtyard has a team of very nice people providing excellent information about your stay in Atlanta.

reviews.author: Brock
reviews.title: Don’t stay here
reviews.body: Our room had fruit flies all over the place, the AC did not work correctly so it was too warm to sleep through out the night. The site listed parking was available but when we pulled up, they only had valet parking for $55. We ended up parking ourselves at a nearby garage costing $25. The garage had several homeless people living there and smelled awful. We told the staff about the issues and they didn’t care to even offer an explanation. They just rolled their eyes and said “OK”. We had a long drive the next day and got very little rest.

reviews.author: Fair at Best
reviews.title: Not the Marriott experience I am used to.
reviews.body: Not the Marriott experience I was expecting.  Will be looking to stay somewhere else next month.

reviews.author: Ms Vee
reviews.title: My last minute bday stay
reviews.body: My plan was to go to Miami. But life be lying had to change plans. I booked this awesome room and chilled downtown Atlanta. It was very clean.THE STAFF WAS GREAT! There was plenty close to do and I enjoyed myself.

reviews.author: jamie
reviews.title: thank you so much
reviews.body: I am so lucky and grateful to have picked this hotel to stay at for Momocon. The front desk was incredibly helpful with check-in and supportive when I was extremely stressed and worried after a terrible trip on the way there. I will look back on the experience fondly! The room was comfortable, clean and quiet and I was able to rest and have a comfortable place to relax after convention fun.

reviews.author: The Agent
reviews.title: Atlanta’s Best!
reviews.body:
The dining was outstanding. Breakfast was fresh and beautifully presented, and the bar was a perfect spot to unwind in the evening with excellent cocktails and attentive service. The lobby itself feels like a destination — elegant, welcoming, and impeccably maintained.

What really sets this property apart is the staff's attentiveness without being intrusive. Every team member we interacted with, from valet to concierge to housekeeping, seemed genuinely invested in making our stay memorable. The concierge desk went above and beyond helping us plan our time around Atlanta, offering great local recommendations we wouldn't have found on our own.

If you're looking for a downtown Atlanta hotel that delivers on luxury, comfort, and service, The Ritz-Carlton is it. We're already planning our next visit.

reviews.author: Carlos
reviews.title: Top tier experience
reviews.body: I return to this hotel over and over again. It is the most consistently elevated hospitality experience of all the places I go. Everything is the highest quality and I feel very tended to at this hotel. And I’ll be back.

reviews.author: Couldvebeenbetter
reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.body: Feels like an older Marriott with front desk staff that’s a bit bothered you’re there

reviews.author: My time at the Ritz 01
reviews.title: My experience at the Ritz in Georgia
reviews.body: Overall the hotel gets good marks except for the cleaning room service. It seems someone made a policy rule where your room never gets cleaned, old towels, garbage disposed and coffee tee ect gets replenished until you check out! Really! So if you book for a week or less expect no room service! You're basically on your own. Front desk does not help!

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Finest hotel I’ve ever stayed at
reviews.body: I’ve never been treated as well as I was at the Atlanta Ritz Carlton just in the Marriott chain. I believe I have over 1000 kn no one has ever come as close to the service that you gave me.

reviews.author: Cheryl
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Atlanta
reviews.body: The Ritz-Carlton Atlanta is our favorite Atlanta hotel. They always go above and beyond for their customers. We stay there every year for several nights when we're visiting the city. The service, the employees, the ambience, and the food are excellent. We will continue staying there every Atlanta trip.

reviews.author: Dragoncon 2026
reviews.title: Welcome Back
reviews.body: I walked into the lobby and within minutes one of the Ritz Carlton team walked up and said, "you were here last year weren't you?  Welcome back."  Are you kidding me?  Thousands of people have been through this property since I was last here and someone just remembered me and welcomed me back?  That is an insane level of attention and professionalism

reviews.author: Misha3131
reviews.title: Best place to stay for Dragon Con
reviews.body: Absolutely excellent experience for the second year in a row. I would highly recommend booking. Between the help with my luggage when in arrived to  recognizing me being over heated and brining me water.

reviews.author: KPUAS
reviews.title: Always a Great Stay
reviews.body: Never disappointed, top shelf experience

reviews.author: VWight
reviews.title: One of a kind experience
reviews.body: I prepaid for my stay here then read some reviews that concerned me. All I can say is that from the time I was dropped off until the time I left, I was wondering what the bad reviews were about. Everything at this hotel is top notch. Especially the staff. The valet, the front desk, the concierge in the Club, housekeeping, anyone I came across was always polite, friendly and accommodating.  You can tell they all genuinely cared about the guests and their stay. I was a first-time visitor to Atlanta in town for a concert and I had questions about transportation, walking and other things and if a staff member didn't know an answer, they found out. I had the most interaction with the concierge staff in the Club and I would highly recommend getting Club access.  The staff there is just amazing. If there is something you need, and it's not right there in the Club, they'll find a way to get it for you. The view of downtown Atlanta from the Club on the 24th floor is stunning. The food, the beverages, the desserts were absolutely delicious. Make sure to get the chicken sausage at breakfast. Thank you so very much to the staff here for making this trip amazing and one I'll never forget. If I ever go back to Atlanta, there is no doubt where I will stay.

reviews.author: Review
reviews.title: Good location
reviews.body: Location was great and staff was kind although felt like lack of amenities as a 5 star luxury hotel would offer.

reviews.author: Derek T
reviews.title: Exceptional Service, Especially When It Mattered Most
reviews.body:
My family and I had an excellent stay at The Ritz-Carlton, Atlanta. The property was beautiful, the food and in-room dining were excellent, and the staff consistently provided the personalized, attentive service you expect from The Ritz-Carlton.

Unfortunately, we did experience an unusual incident when a drinking glass broke while my 13-year-old daughter was drinking from it, causing a small cut at the corner of her lip. Thankfully, she was not seriously injured. What impressed me was the hotel’s response. Loss Prevention responded immediately, checked on my daughter, collected the broken glass, and followed up with us again the following morning. The hotel also continued to check on her after our stay.

Problems can happen anywhere, even at an exceptional hotel. I believe the real measure of service is how a property responds when something goes wrong, and the staff here demonstrated genuine concern, professionalism, and care for my family.

Aside from that incident, we thoroughly enjoyed the room, dining, and overall experience. The staff made us feel genuinely welcomed rather than simply processed as guests. I would absolutely stay at The Ritz-Carlton, Atlanta again.

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.body: What a great experience! The facility was great but the service by the staff was even better!

reviews.author: Brooks3
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.body: My wife and I booked a last-minute stay at the Ritz to enjoy a local concert and were blown away by the service and attention to detail at this hotel. It is a must stay if you are in the downtown Atlanta area.

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.title: No Ritz experience Here
reviews.body: For the money and reputation behind the name this fell way short. I have stayed at many a Ritz and this is not it.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.title: Not great
reviews.body: honestly, save your money and skip. 3.5/5

reviews.author: Jay Rob1
reviews.title: Incredibly disappointed
reviews.body: We should’ve stayed home instead of entrusting this hotel with my wife’s birthday staycation.

reviews.author: Chassidy P
reviews.title: Chassidy P. Experience
reviews.body: The Ritz Carlton Hotel is considered to be a luxury experience but the location in Atlanta in my opinion wouldn’t be labeled luxury. The room had a unique smell that was a little overbearing. The room was basic. The in-room dining was phenomenal and the server was very kind; the food was delicious. The AG restaurant was pretty good and the waiter was very attentive. The Valet Team at night needs improvement. The Valet Team at night allows their friends to hang around which is alarming to guests and can be unsafe. The Valet Team at night wasn’t helpful (specifically the two females) they just stare and be on their phones instead of assisting the customer with their vehicles. The Valet Team at night makes were very helpful but the females weren’t. Mandatory training must be applied for customer care and service.

reviews.author: Rev Harper
reviews.title: A VERY HAPPY 88th BIRTHDAY
reviews.body: We spent three nights at the Ritz Carlton in Atlanta GA to it celebrate my wife 88th birthday. The Ritz and its staff made this an extraordinary experience. The human touch was present in every aspect. They talked to us THEN; they LISTENED to us even though we are over 80 years old!!! Common courtesy is still a valuable business resource.  Thank you, Ritz, we will be back!

reviews.author: AML5961
reviews.title: THERE IS NO PLACE LIKE THE RITZ
reviews.body: My husband and I had the pleasure of staying at the Ritz Carlton Atlanta for 5 days and it has been a long time coming since we received such Wonderful and personalized service!  It truly made our stay so amazing.  From the time we drove up to valet to the time we departed, every minute of our stay was nothing short of A++++++++!  From the comfort of our suite to the top chef food------it doesn't get any better.  I highly Ritz-Carlton Atlanta to anyone ---pleasure or business!! Thank you Ritz for my phenomenal experience!!!!

reviews.author: Kim B
reviews.title: Amazing hotel!
reviews.body: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Ritz Carlton in Atlanta! Everything was perfect from start to finish. Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Faith X
reviews.title: Dropping son off at Georgia Tech
reviews.body: My family was taking my son up to Georgia Tech as a new student.  We decided to stay at the Ritz carlton to make it a special sendoff.  The Steak House at this hotel was divine. Not what you would expect and a hotel but what you would hope for in a fine Steak House they made my son and I feel so welcome..

reviews.author: Disappointing
reviews.title: Somewhat disappointing
reviews.body: For it to be the ritz carlton , the rooms were not luxurious nor grand

reviews.author: The Tuckers 2026
reviews.title: Not upscale for the price
reviews.body: Rooms not the Ritz Charlton effect. Lobby small bathroom in lobby was old not what I expected.

reviews.author: JTHOMAS
reviews.title: Top Tier

reviews.author: Traveling weekly 2
reviews.title: Mkt review
reviews.body: Good central downtown location with acess to some good walking distance dining if not at hotel

reviews.author: LuxuryTraveler
reviews.title: Not the best experience
reviews.body:
Unfortunately, the experience fell well below the standard I have come to expect from the Ritz-Carlton brand.
During my stay, I was moved to a different room after I asked if there were any other rooms with bigger bathrooms available. When the change was explained to me, I was told that the new room would have a larger bathroom, which was presented as an upgrade. After settling into the room, I found that this was not the case. More disappointing than the room itself was the interaction with the front desk associate (younger Caucasian male), whose communication came across as dismissive and condescending when addressing my concerns. Rather than feeling like my concerns were being acknowledged, I left the conversation feeling unheard.
I also purchased access to the Club Lounge based on the expectation that evening food service would begin at 7:00 p.m. (I was told this by the person at the desk). I arrived around 7:30 p.m., only to find that most of the food had already been depleted and was no longer being replenished. As a result, I was unable to enjoy the lounge experience I had paid for. While breakfast the following morning was much better, it was my final morning at the hotel and did not make up for the disappointing dinner experience.
I do want to recognize another member of your front desk team who handled this concern professionally. After I explained my experience in the Club Lounge, they removed the Club Lounge charge from my bill without hesitation, which I appreciated. That interaction reflected the level of customer service I had expected throughout my stay.
Taken together, these experiences left me disappointed. I chose The Ritz-Carlton because of its reputation for exceptional hospitality, thoughtful service, and attention to detail. Unfortunately, my stay did not reflect those standards, and it certainly did not feel commensurate with the premium price of the property.
I am sharing this feedback because I believe Ritz-Carlton values guest experience and continuous improvement. While I appreciate the staff member who resolved the Club Lounge charge, the overall experience has left me reluctant to return to the Atlanta property in the future.
Thank you for taking the time to review my feedback. I hope it is helpful as you continue striving to provide the level of service for which the Ritz-Carlton brand is known.

reviews.author: Please do not post
reviews.title: Surprising
reviews.body: I already stated my challenges.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Limited amenities, exceptional staff
reviews.body:
Our visit to this location was an in-town “staycation,” and consequently I believe we undervalued traditional Ritz amenities like the pool and spa. Nonetheless, the staff was exceptional and both the lounge and restaurant offered great service and selection. If you are planning to spend significant time at the hotel, this might not be the best choice for you, but for meals, drinks, and a well appointed room it is fantastic. 

We ran into an issue with booking where I moved my reservation date through the Bonvoy app and was double charged on a prepaid room, ultimately taking 6 phone calls, 2 emails, and over 4 weeks to resolve. The disconnect from the corporate number’s capabilities, depending on actually making contact with someone in the hotel, was frustrating. Despite that, it was resolved shortly before checking in and the staff on site was so exceptional that the stay was not overshadowed.

reviews.author: June P
reviews.title: Hotel Review
reviews.body:
Do not stay at the Ritz Carlton Hotel on Peachtree Street in Atlanta, Georgia.  It is not like other Ritz Carlton Hotel properties.  To make matters worse, someone decided to place $69.01 of charges on my card for items I did not order, ex. alcoholic beverages, etc.  Just blocks away is a homeless encampment and my family and I did not feel safe at this location.  The room was not clean, shower curtain rod hanging off its holder and they charge $73 per day for guest parking which
is outrageous!  Never again!!

reviews.author: Mama9
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: Wonderful hotel i recommend it

reviews.author: Fellow marriott employee
reviews.title: Cockroaches
reviews.body: If you want to spend 350 a night for cockroaches, be my guest. I could have went to a motel 6 for the service and condition of the rooms. Actually, motel 6 may have been better.

reviews.author: Jame1
reviews.title: Horrible stay at the Westin Peachtree plaza
reviews.body: I stayed here for 1 night of my 2 night stay. After checking in I was offered a single water bottle from reception and told there was more in my room complimentary. I walked over to the elevator where I waited several minutes for the elevator to come down and then several minutes to go up to my floor while we stopped at 10 others along the way. Once I got to my room it was dated and old. The bathroom was tiny and my shower was leaking water constantly. I had a long flight earlier so I decked to get an early nights sleep. At midnight I was woke. Up by the elevator and then the guests getting out of the elevator screaming down the hallway as if it was in my room due to the lack of soundproofing of the door. This continued every hour until 5am when I decided to pack up and leave the hotel 1 day early to go elsewhere. I went down to the lobby where I waited while the one desk staff talked with somebody for 10 minutes before I gave up and handed my key over and left without even having the ability to let them know what my issues were.  If you’re looking for a relaxing stay look elsewhere this is the worst stay I’ve had at any hotel in years. I would not recommend wasting your time or money here. This is a disgrace to Marriott hotels brands.

reviews.author: Business Traveler
reviews.title: Nice hotel...  but not a nice hotel
reviews.body: If you are Platinum Elite +, you always expect an M Club/Lounge.  They do not have one and they do not offer free breakfast.  It cost 38.00 for breakfast making the room that much more.  Overall it was an average condition for a Westin (bathroom and shower were really outdated).  Also can be noisy with the elevators.  Elevators were also very slow, especially at peak times.  I would stay at another Marriott property vs this one.   Location was its best asset.

reviews.author: 1pinktraveler
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.body: The staff is friendly,  great service,  everything is centrally located, beautiful views

reviews.author: JAMES
reviews.title: The Best Sevice
reviews.body: Staff attentive, hotel clean, location great

reviews.author: Great view
reviews.title: Excellent view and staff
reviews.body: I would reccomend.Beautiful room as shown on the pictures. Friendly staff inside.

reviews.author: Council Jones
reviews.title: Trip not as expected
reviews.body: My overall experience was not enjoyable.  We came down to move our daughter into college and my wife has always loved staying at the Westin but this experience was not remotely comparable to the other Westins that we have stayed at.

reviews.author: Javonte
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: I love this hotel new favorite hotel

reviews.author: Aidan
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.body:
Everything at this hotel was perfect. From the service to the cleanliness to the people, I was very satisfied with my stay. Lutfun in the cafe stood out the most during breakfast time. She was always
making sure we had refills and checking up on us.

reviews.author: Tahoe15
reviews.title: Magic in A-Town!
reviews.body: Every detail it thought of! The seemless check-in, amazing rooms with breath taking views, location and wonderful food!

reviews.title: Surprised to be disappointed
reviews.body: Ever since my first time staying at the Westin Peachtree, I have dreamt of the beds and architecture. It is one of my favourite buildings in the world. The service, amenities, and offerings have always been top tier but this year things seem to have fallen apart in some fashion. Staff had no idea how to answer questions about the special event offerings, they did not want to take responsibility for their actions, and overall were neutral at best towards me as a guest. I understand that DragonCon is a big event, but staff need to be properly trained on how to deal with whatever issues may arise when the hotel is booked solid for a full week. Y’all host multiple events in the same month, so I would expect the staff be capable of handling all small and large scale problems that arise during sold-out events. I want to still love and trust the Westin Peachtree but now I am hesitant. I was surprised at the issues I faced, which included water damage in my room, which did not alarm staff at all. This, I was surprised to be disappointed in my stay.

reviews.author: Dragoncon Attendee
reviews.title: Love Staying at the Westin for Dragoncon
reviews.body: The Westin might not be connected to the rest of the hotels but it still very much is part of the con. There are plenty of quality events and considerably less foot traffic. I love the architecture and not to mention the view! It’s wonderful being at a host hotel but not having to deal with some of the inconveniences.

reviews.author: Totally satisfied Guest
reviews.title: Totally satisfied Guest
reviews.body: I am looking forward to my next experience at Westin Peachtree Atlanta

reviews.author: Aaron
reviews.title: Overall Very Good and Would Stay Again
reviews.body: This hotel is very good and extremely clean.  The bed and pillows were quite comfortable and the television worked well.  The room was spacious, but lacked lighting in certain corners.  The bathroom didn't quite match the rest of the room and felt like it hadn't been updated as recently.  Elevator noise was very noticeable in the room.  The wifi was a little clunky to eventually log on to.  The lobby was impressive with multiple places to sit, meet, and relax.  Front desk staff were hard to understand verbally.  Starbucks cashiers seemed like they didn't want to be there.  The pool area was nice and the retractable roof for laying in the sun was awesome.  However, getting to the pool was dark, cramped, and confusing, unlike the rest of the hotel.

reviews.author: Not Worth The High Price
reviews.title: UPGRADE Badly Needed
reviews.body: Not happy with the cost of the rooms and NO UPGRADE in sight.

reviews.author: badiamond01
reviews.title: Westin-Dragon Con Host
reviews.body: The Westin has always treated my family well! We are always excited to stay there. The staff is friendly and accommodating. Elevators are very fast as well.

reviews.author: JHarrisford1
reviews.title: Small changes could make a big difference, but after years why are these still issues?
reviews.body:
The front desk customer service, housekeeping, and if we needed something like more towels brought up, the service was great! 

From a disability accessibility point, the wheelchair accessible entrance and exit was broken the whole trip so an employee had to constantly be opening the door. The hotel apparently only has a handful of wheelchair accessible rooms which I was unable to get (I tried for months) and their solution was to put me as far from the elevator as possible. It’s VERY hard to push a wheelchair on carpet. The doors are so heavy on the standard rooms I can barely get in and out without help. I’m glad there wasn’t an emergency.


The bar/food. The prices are astronomical and the food was mediocre at best. Go ANYWHERE else to eat and drink. You will have better food, better drinks, better service, for a third to half the cost. Even if you wind up eating at another major hotel nearby. The Westin seems to be banking (literally) on the convenience factor. I promise the money you save by going anywhere else is more than the inconvenience of walking there. Since Covid their prices have tripled and the quality has gone downhill. Not a good mix. Their “muffuletta” sandwich ($38) was the same cost as a gorgeous beef entree I had at a 4 star restaurant a few minutes away with SUPERB customer and tableside service.

reviews.author: Jcmoore
reviews.title: Another great stay at the Westin
reviews.body: Everything was perfect, no issues whatsoever.  Staff was extremely friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Daphne
reviews.title: Best host hotel for Dragon con
reviews.body: The staff was courteous. The hotel was clean.  The rooms were quieter than other hotels.

reviews.author: Decent hotel for the area
reviews.title: Decent hotel, needs updating
reviews.body: The rooms were spacious, the bed was comfortable. The staff was excellent. The refrigerator only goes to 51 degrees so you can’t keep drinks cold or keep leftovers from restaurants. From the rust around the toilet and the shower condition, you can tell this is an older hotel. Bathrooms can use an upgrade.

reviews.author: Charity O
reviews.title: The Westin gives their all
reviews.body: The lot attendants were great. They helped me find good, secure parking when their lot was full. Check in was effortless and the front desk staff are friendly and SO helpful. Multiple food options available within the hotel, with MANY others within just a block or two. The rooms are much more spacious than the average hotel room, and included a large desk with chair, a comfortable sitting chair, and a bench that slid under the tv area to be out of the way when not in use. The beds are the most comfortable I've slept in at any hotel in any city. Staff responds quickly and helpfully to any inquiries and requests. I really could not have asked for a better experience.

reviews.author: john t ford
reviews.title: My review
reviews.body: Had a great stay, enjoyed my room and the pool. Would stay again if I’m able to acquire a room for DragonCon again.

reviews.author: Jamie T
reviews.title: Always On Point
reviews.body: The Westin has become our favorite place to stay when in Atlanta. The staff is friendly and very accommodating. Rooms are clean and comfortable.

reviews.author: KeithM
reviews.title: 1600$ to stay in a room with almost no AC, peeling paint, and bad carpet.
reviews.body:
Paid 1200$ to stay at the Westin for 4 nights for Dragon Con

Wildly inflated rates, our room AC barely worked, the carpet was lifting and loose on the floor, paint was peeling in our bathroom.

On top of all that their food rates were wicked high.

The room service was great, we got any towels or linens, bathroom tissue we request and delivered within 10 minutes.

Check in was smooth.

Parking cost me 210$ due to inflated convention rates.

We were there for Dragon Con so high prices are expected but they just keep growing and the hotel rooms do not reflect the prices charged.

reviews.author: lhouston
reviews.title: Pleasant enough
reviews.body: Although the check process could use some tweaking, perhaps better scheduling on the part of the front end staff other than that hotel was clean. Staff was pleasant.

reviews.author: NYSELADY75
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: I really enjoyed my stay at Westin. Be prepared to park off site. We checked in late after the event we attended. There was no on-site parking. There were decks either across the street or next door but nothing on-site. That was my only turn off. After all the walking at the event we attended, we just wanted park our car check in, shower and rest. We spent a significant amount of time driving thru lots that were at full capacity just to fine a parking space. Also be prepared to pay $59+ to park. Other than that the hotel was beautiful, clean, the bed was comfortable and the staff was kind even though it was late when  we got there.

reviews.author: Wilmar A

reviews.body: God bless everyone at the hotel. Wonderful hotel.

reviews.author: Ale77

reviews.body: see notes in the feedback, poor service on a credit card lost at desk, restaurant very expensive for breakfast.

reviews.author: Zman
reviews.title: Great weekend stay for AC/DC
reviews.body: The Westin proved to be a great experience.  it is within walking distance to just about everything downtown and the staff was incredible to work with.

reviews.author: Brione
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.body: Great place to stay and close to everything

reviews.author: Displeased guest
reviews.title: What the public can see matters, behind closed doors, this place is gross.
reviews.body: The hotel looks nice, but the rooms are cramped and generally clean but the small things are not cared about. I have stayed in a lot nicer hotels that are a lot cheaper. This is maybe an $80 a night experience.

reviews.author: JCinTO
reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.body: The staff is wonderful. Everything else is unacceptable. The main thing you need from a hotel is sleep. You won't get that here. The mattress is horrible and feels ancient. Soundproofing is non-existent between neighboring rooms. The tiny window provides no light but a lot of exterior noise. And while the room is mostly clean, mine had a used pillow (visual and sniff test), and there were fingerprints throughout the room and property. Needless to say, I was exhausted after my three-night stay. The operators of this hotel should stay a few nights and experience what they're doing to their customers. I cannot recommend this property to anyone.

reviews.author: MellyMel
reviews.title: Amazing Stay and Location
reviews.body: We had an amazing stay as we traveled for a friend’s 40th birthday. The location was great. The hotel was clean, and the staff and employees were extremely courteous. The gym was great as well.

reviews.author: Kenneth Wise Sr
reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.body: We only stayed one night but we will be back in the near future. I had a problem with my key and the problem was fixed immediately.

reviews.author: MTFarms
reviews.title: A great first time stay
reviews.body: Loved absolutely everything about the hotel other than trying to cool off the room at a lower temperature than what it was set for when we arrived. We will definitely be staying there again!!!

reviews.author: Mr Jones
reviews.title: Great
reviews.body: My overall stay was excellent we were there for the Atlanta food and wine festival, our stay was the best from check-in to check-out was a 10/10 this will be our go to place to stay when we come to Atlanta and the Waffle house being next door is a plus

reviews.author: Vol Fan

reviews.author: Michael

reviews.body: I would not recommend staying here as staff genuinely treats you poorly.

reviews.author: John

reviews.author: TSB47
reviews.title: Stayed before will stay again.

reviews.author: Jason

reviews.body: Exceeded our expectations greatly. Wonderful valet, hospitality and housekeeping staff. Hotel and room was clean and appealing. Special thanks to Ebony, DJ, Jamilia, Travis, Laquarey, Julius - Valet, Deena - Housekeeping, Zach - Mgr. Wonderful folks, would love to visit again. Amazing experience. AC Hotel is A+!

reviews.author: Tim60

reviews.body: Excellent hotel and amenities.  Great location for events downtown.

reviews.author: ACDC
reviews.title: Awesome Staff
reviews.body: Everyone was welcoming and took care of all our needs.

reviews.author: Wonderful stay
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.body: Nice area beautiful hotel wonderful location

reviews.author: The Coley family
reviews.title: Sanders Family Reunion 2026
reviews.body: Enjoyed the AC very much and would love to come back!

reviews.author: L

reviews.body: Everything was nice and clean and quiet. A big plus. Was able to have a great vacation

reviews.author: Robin M
reviews.title: Great Location, Greasy Lobby
reviews.body:
Our was stay at the downtown Atlanta location was pleasant enough. A large crack in the sink needs to repaired or sink replaced. 
The lobby smelled of heavy grease due to the restaurant.

reviews.author: Neese515
reviews.title: Quick impromptu trip
reviews.body: The hotter met our expectations and more. Great location, welcoming service, beautiful rooms

reviews.author: Kara
reviews.title: Best stay in Atlanta!
reviews.body: I booked a room here for a quick solo trip and was pleasantly surprised! The location was perfect and walking distance to exactly where I needed to be. The room was comfortable, clean, and designed very well. All the staff were incredible and hospitable! I'm already planning a trip to return soon with family!

reviews.author: Bria
reviews.title: Good and Clean Hotel
reviews.body: I stayed here for the second time in 2 months. Both times I experienced cleanliness throughout the entire location. The staff was very nice to me both times and offered help and support when asked of them. Checking in and out was also super easy, especially if you have the Marriott Bonvoy app. During busy high traffic times in Atlanta, I would suggest getting your car 10 minutes before to help keep you on time. It is a pretty centrally located hotel and easy to find. The only thing I would say is the area does get fairly busy so a room that is street facing and close to the ground might not be the best idea for anyone that is a light sleeper or needs an abundance of quiet.

reviews.author: R Lew
reviews.title: No complaints
reviews.body: Great location. Updated. Rooms cleaned daily, which is rare these days! Excellent staff, especially the bartender, valet, & front desk. I literally have no complaints!

reviews.author: Terry
reviews.title: My review of the AC Hotel in downtown southeast Atlanta
reviews.body: 9 out of 10. Great location on the budget. Center in the heart of downtown center. Located near everything you need, you can walk to a lot of places if needed. Great pricing, although parking can be almost half the room cost per night.

reviews.author: Lori Black
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.body: We stayed three nights to attend a business event. We have stayed before and each time find the hotel very enjoyable. It is clean and the staff is helpful. They stored our bags for us after checking out till we were ready to pick them up.

reviews.author: She Travels
reviews.title: Ok Hotel
reviews.body: The hotel is cute, and has dome great views. The rooms are very small, the food is very subpar. The upkeep is ok.

reviews.author: Dont go
reviews.title: Don’t stay here
reviews.body: My overall experience at a hotel Atlanta downtown started great ended poorly. The staff was friendly yet scammers they overcharged me for valet parking scammed me and bought me the wrong car. I will never return to this hotel nor will I ever advise anyone else to visit.

reviews.author: A Berrios
reviews.title: Ultra Modern
reviews.body: "A perfectly situated, ultra-modern hotel in the heart of downtown Atlanta, offering unparalleled walking access to a vibrant selection of bars and dining. The property also features excellent amenities, including a stylish on-site bar, a fitness center, and a pool. Would definitely stay again

reviews.author: BowlingDiva2026
reviews.title: GREAT LOCATION
reviews.body: This location is convenient to state farm which is why we stayed here. Its clean , service was great and i would stay again. Plenty of restaurants in the surrounding area as no real restaurant in the hotel more of a bar.

reviews.author: Poor reviewer

reviews.body: Horrible place. Hotel was in a sketch area. I would never recommend. Got charged for a 1 night after leaving 1hr after checkin

reviews.author: Tess
reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.body: Room view was breathtaking. Service all around was great. Stay was quiet and clean.

reviews.author: Kelley Crow
reviews.title: Stay here for the beauty!
reviews.body: Great location and staff is wonderful!

reviews.author: Ciara
reviews.title: If was ok
reviews.body: Stay at a residence inn or a courtyard it’s the same level of service

reviews.author: Randomcostomer24
reviews.title: BOOK IT!!
reviews.body: This was the best hotel I've every stayed at. Kind staff, clean room, AMAZING VIEW. The elevators are very cool! Plus the access to downtown.

reviews.author: Kw01
reviews.title: Dissatisfied and disappointed customer
reviews.body: Dissatisfied and disappointed customer

reviews.author: SJ212
reviews.title: Extremely Loud into the next morning
reviews.body: I’m not sure if this was the hotel’s decision or DragonCon’s but the DJ in the atrium played all night into 5am. At no point was there any quiet in the evenings. I noticed that the other hotels were quiet after some time but not the Marriott. This music was obnoxious enough to send us home one day early.

reviews.author: Isaac
reviews.title: Extremely disappointing and not to standard
reviews.body: Extremely disappointed with the cleanliness of the room and the halls of the hotel. There were literally gummy bears, stuck to the ceiling of my room. Additionally, there was human hair and used wrappers in the bathtub, and it was apparent it had not been thoroughly cleaned.

reviews.author: Jackie
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.body: 5 star for sure enjoy our stay

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.body: Place need to be closed and cleaned. Staff is horrible. Overcharged, bars close early or just won’t let people in. 40 for a small buffet and 65 to park. Not worth even close to that.

reviews.author: Oem3409
reviews.title: Better Alternatives Nearby
reviews.body: Hotel was average. Nothing that screams can’t wait to come back ! The only convenience was accessing the Peachtree Center to at least get food that was edible and so much cheaper. Beds are very hard. Most uncomfortable bed I’ve ever tried to sleep on. 3 nights was way too much. Bring your own pillows as well. These are old and very uncomfortable. Don’t expect a clean hotel. Everywhere you walk, there is dirt and filth. Ice machines only worked one day on the floor we were on. This motel needs some serious cleaning and maintenance !

reviews.author: Kevin D
reviews.title: Place is not what it once was….
reviews.body: Hotel was dirty and dingy.  Room was not clean.  Actual dirty rags and cleaning chemicals left in the room. The check in service was slow and difficult. The concierge lounge was not good and also not clean. I’m a loyal Marriott guy but this place has me reconsidering ….

reviews.author: María 0354
reviews.title: All I wanted in only one place
reviews.body:
100% recommended 
It’s perfect I love the view 
Very clean

reviews.author: Andrea S
reviews.title: ROOM WITH A VIEW(THANKS CARLOS!)
reviews.body: I wanted to treat my best friend/sister to a stay at the Mariott Marquis for her last night as a single woman. We got there close to 5 and the hotel was super busy. We ended up in a room that was nice but I was hoping we would get a great view of the city also. So I called to the front desk and Carlos answered. He was so kind. I asked is there ANYTHING he could do to help make the night amazing for her. He did say it was near capacity but let him see what he could do! A few minutes later Carlos called with a room with a great view of the city and she was so very happy! Thank you Carlos for making us feel special!

reviews.author: Karlsweb zine
reviews.title: After all that work to book the hotel, they rejected me as a legacy member
reviews.body: Trying for months to finally get a reservation for the hotel with the understanding we could have a legacy roll over and pay forward for next year. The rolled there eyes and said no.

reviews.author: BaldGuyFromTN
reviews.title: Dragon Con at the Marriott
reviews.body: This is how a hotel does things.  From greeting me at the door, to responsive room service, daily room cleaning, and overall awesomeness... you could not ask for better.

reviews.author: Karin4000
reviews.title: Hotel Handles DragonCon Well
reviews.body: The intense crowds, more luggage than usual, and all night parties make this week unique for the hotel I imagine.  Considering all those factors, your staff manages everything well.  Sure, there are some minor issues, but they usually get handled quickly.  We had clean towels and everything worked in the room so we were happy.

reviews.author: Daniel00001
reviews.title: Hotel service is amazing. But the room could use upgrades
reviews.body: From check in to check out the service I received from the staff was amazing. The bed was comfortable. And aside from having trouble keeping the room below 70 the climate was good. The bathroom was very nice as well except for the showers water pressure and the heat in the shower. Additionally the furniture had water damage in several areas. However, aside from being cosmetically displeasing the furniture worked as advertised. I would definitely recommend this hotel in the future if anyone asked where in Atlanta they should stay.

reviews.author: Marcus
reviews.title: Not Satisfied At All
reviews.body: Was not given  the room I had previously reserved. I reserved a higher room floor (33rd floor or higher) but got the 1st floor and no view at all. This was a date night for me and my lady and we had came from out of town

reviews.author: Esteban
reviews.title: DragonCon at the Marriott Marquis
reviews.body: The hotel is clean, up to date and THE place to stay for DragonCon.  All of the elevators worked the entire stay, the hotel food and beverage were good.  Much fun was had!

reviews.author: Meek
reviews.title: Falsely Charged
reviews.body: Be careful. I am highly disappointed. I was charged $527 upon check in when I had already paid for my stay in FULL in advance. I told the associate immediately after she charged my card and she assured me it would be refunded immediately. Four days later and I still have not received a refund.

reviews.author: Ks913
reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.body: The keycards gave me trouble and became a hassle when wanting to go to other floors. It only takes you to your floor and the lobby. The food was decent but everything there is super expensive which is not affordable. It makes you want to go other places for food and activities because a water is $5 and up, not even exaggerating. They are clean and staff is nice so that’s good but I also feel like for what it’s worth, they need a hotel garage because when with valet it gets crowded and overwhelming to receive your vehicle. Overall 6.5-7/10.

reviews.author: Ronald Allen
reviews.title: not very relaxing rooms
reviews.body: food was great except room/in room dining and the rooms are very bad. $67/day parking give me a break

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Our Stay During Dragon Con 2026
