reviews.body: Service was a bit lacking in the in hotel restaurants. Elevator availability was difficult at best due to the crowds.

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.title: Honest Review
reviews.body: The parking situation is very complicated. Your only options were (1) valet for $72, which ended up being full anyway so the option was off the table; or (2) park at a garage blocks down for about $25/day. The room was pretty dirty. The body wash, shampoo, and conditioner bottles were practically empty. The shower and sink drains were clogged. The pillows had not pillowcases. It was truly not a nice experience. I never write reviews, but I don’t want someone else having to experience this.

reviews.author: LadyJackson615
reviews.title: I’m Excited to Return!!
reviews.body:
My stay was lovely! Ms. Etta from the front desk checked me in, and her spirit was so exciting and welcoming. She made a wonderful first impression and truly set the tone for my stay.

The hotel itself was beautiful, and breakfast at SEAR was a 10/10! The food was hot, fresh, and there were several options to choose from. Anthony, the host, and chefs Marian and Reggie were all friendly, attentive, and accommodating to my special-request orders. I truly appreciated their hospitality.

I also really enjoyed the pool and High Velocity. My only small complaint is that the alcoholic beverages were a bit more expensive compared to other Marriott hotels I’ve stayed at. However, that didn’t take away from my overall experience.

Overall, I had a wonderful stay and would definitely be excited to return again one day soon!

My only wish is that the hotel would put microwaves in the guest rooms! 😂 I stayed on the 17th floor, so having to go all the way down to the Atrium Level just to warm up food was a little inconvenient. Other than that, I really enjoyed my stay!

reviews.author: Cayce J
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Our time with your facility was a great experience. Room was clean and bed was super comfy.

reviews.author: Keegan
reviews.title: Best place to stay in Atlanta
reviews.body: My favorite hotel. Staff is excellent. Hotel is excellent. No complaints

reviews.author: Callie
reviews.title: Don’t stay here for business
reviews.body: This hotel constantly hosts conventions without disclosing so prior to booking. The hotel is overrun by these groups. Do not book this hotel if you’re traveling for business.

reviews.author: Erikka
reviews.title: Another Exceptional Stay
reviews.body: The Atlanta Marriott Marquis is one of my favorite hotels. The service is excellent and it’s always a lovely stay, and my most recent visit during Dragon Con 2026 was no exception. They made me feel welcome and extended every kindness and courtesy to my family and me. And as a convention attendee, they always help us feel welcome! They celebrate right along with us, and I really love that!

reviews.author: MIL73
reviews.title: Lovely premise, but can use renovation in some areas
reviews.body:
Service level, staff, all above par. Restroom inside hotel room was outdated(caulking) and the mattress was not good.
Valet wrecked my vehicle and tried to get away with it. Marriott doesn’t want to be associated but it encompasses the experience of doing business with this hotel.

reviews.author: D
reviews.title: Last Resort
reviews.body:
Staff was overwhelmed at check in and made a comment in front of me about how crazy it was that everyone was showing up at the actual time they're supposed to. Got checked in, loaded a cart to go to our room and there was a maintance man who we scared upon entrance working on the toliet. We left to go to our event and came back late with a puddle on the floor and had to move rooms at midnight. Our new room was entirely missing the bathroom door handle and one shelf in the mini fridge. The lamp, only good light source in the room, simply didn't work. Not sure if it was broken or the bulb was blown. Neither room had a full roll of toliet paper. Icing on the cake was the elevator that would NOT stop on L2, went straight to L so if you have a lot of bags I hope you're ready. 

When we decided to leave straight after our event they allowed us to "complimentary" get our last reserved night back and truly saved up almost half of the cost. The beds were comfy - but the pillow was yellow with sweat stains under the pillow case. 

Maybe allow this to be a safe last resort?

reviews.author: Disappointed guest
reviews.title: Way less than desired
reviews.body: See initial review on first page

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body: I won't be back. The advertised distance from the event was seriously misleading. The issue with the door was disturbing. Other issues as well.

reviews.author: Jun
reviews.title: Amazingly great
reviews.body:
Every single staff member including house keeper were exceptional. Nightly cost rate so affordable. Hands down awesome stay.
Location was in the center of everything.
Amazing

reviews.author: Doc
reviews.title: Not what I was expecting
reviews.body:
The room looked old, old and dirty carpet

The shower had seen better days. I think for the price of that room in downtown Atlanta I had a lot more options in that price range that I believe would’ve been better quality..

reviews.title: Dated Hotel - with broken air conditioning
reviews.body: We were on the 10th floor: the ice machine on the 10th & 8th floor was not working for the entire stay. The air conditioning in the fitness room was broken the entire stay. The metal grating that goes over the shower drain was removed and standing in the shower upon arrival. There was some sort of leak on the carpet in front of the 10th floor elevators (possibly throw up). The attempt at cleaning up the carpet did not work - the smell was terrible. The trash on the 10th floor ice machine room was not removed for 6 days. The front desk staff were professional.

reviews.author: Random guy
reviews.title: Excellent stay.
reviews.body: Good room.... Good stay. Staff was nice.

reviews.author: TDLB
reviews.title: You should stay anywhere else.
reviews.body:
This hotel is horrible. You should literally stay anywhere else.

Cons:
-No hand soap, just one tiny sliver of bar soap that was never replaced, had to wash our hands with my travel body wash
-WiFi does not work
-No signal on my phone while in the room
-No trash can in or near the bathroom, super inconvenient
-One towel per person for the entire 3 night stay, towels never replaced
-No parking garage
-Limited amount of lot parking for an exorbitant fee and "too bad" if it's full
-No restaurant on site
-No bartender ever present at the bar
-Ice machines did not work the entire weekend
-HIGHLY overpriced (1,600 for 3 night!!!), especially for what you get
-No amenities
-Only small dim lights over the bed, it was extremely dark in the room (even in the daytime as our window simply faced a wall), there were no other lights to turn on. We could not see to do anything.
-The toilet seat in our room desperately needed to be replaced, look at the picture
-Slow sketchy elevators

Pros:

-Walkable location
-Comfortable beds

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.title: Convention Hotel Stay
reviews.body: Our group had multiple rooms in the Aloft for Dragon Con. Everyone reported having a great time, having a great experience, and the facility being in great shape. The cost was good and the location is minutes away from the core of the convention area.

reviews.author: Sqatbdy
reviews.title: Conveniently located.
reviews.body: I was having surgery at Emory, so this was a perfect location for getting back and forth to the hospital.

reviews.author: anna5545
reviews.title: DragonCon 2026
reviews.body: First year at Aloft. No issues other than a light bulb that was out in the water closet/shower area. Fixed promptly. Check-in was easy at 3PM Thursday. Check out was a bit of a line but all we were trying to do was get them to hold our luggage while we had breakfast at Flaky. Staff was upbeat and friendly. They were working with a new software (absolutely worst time to launch and train on new processes) but our stay wasn’t affected by it. Great location to all Con footprint. Would stay again!

reviews.author: Corey I
reviews.title: Great location and Stay was Great
reviews.body: We only had issues with our late check out not being documented and the entire hotel ran out of toilet paper thankfully during our last night.

reviews.author: Danny
reviews.title: Dragon Con 2026 stay
reviews.body: Perfect place. In a great spot, quiet when needed and just the perfect con hotel

reviews.author: Saprina
reviews.title: Totally met my expectations!
reviews.body: Amazing hospitality, great team, clean hotel, well located, everything in close proximity & and pretty cool hotel ambiance.

reviews.author: Vanna08
reviews.title: My Experience at Aloft
reviews.body: My overall stay was good. I ran into a few problems with my original room, but they were resolved. Check-in, none of the staff were friendly. They weren't rude, but they definitely did not greet anyone in our group or the people in front of us. Multiple staff walked up, and no one ever said hello. I'm use to a "welcome to ...., someone will be with you shortly or give me a few minutes, I'll assist shortly. Just something to let the guest know youre willing to help! The parking lot was perfect. The hotel was clean. I read reviews and was kind of nervous about staying, but it wasn't bad at all. The location of the hotel was great! It was quiet, and near a ton of things.

reviews.author: BMBW
reviews.title: Would Expect Better of Marriott's "Choose your own adventure"
reviews.body:
The Aloft is a promise of a swanky home base while out exploring, and it is a short walk from a number of attractions and wonderful places to eat (including other Marriott hotels with full service restaurants). However, the digs can't be considered swanky when there is visible dust hanging from the soffits and along the floorboards or grime around the sink.  It is not swanky to have a toilet that screams at you Everytime you flush it. Adding a serious un-swank to it is if your neighbor also flushed their toilet and the screaming becomes a choir of hellions. Or if the toilet screams in the night, waking you and your partner up, with the sounds of pipes literally shaking in the walls. 
Also, not sure how swanky it is to have a TV from 2010 in the room and the mattress that can easily be pushed off the bed. 
Truly the dustiness in all corners and the screaming bathroom are enough for me to not want to rebook at this location and likely avoid Aloft entirely (if I want a swanky Marriott I'll go with the AC). 
A small set of quibbles as well is just one trash can that was actually hard to find initially. 
The hotels common areas though are clean and nice. I enjoyed both a drink at the bar and the breakfast service though I would suggest Marriott increase staffing at this very "grab and go" location as the cook had to come out and take my and a number of other orders and definitely had to wait a while for that food to then get prepared. 
The fitness center looked nice though I didn't use it.
The concierges/desk staff were great though. Provided helpful recommendations.

reviews.author: T
reviews.title: Find another place to stay if time matters
reviews.body: Room was ok.  Had issues with the toilet being plugged and almost overflowing.  Glad I noticed it otherwise it would had overflowed.  It took several times calling and going to the front desk to get someone with a plunger.  The maintenance person came and no one told him that it was an issue with the toilet being plugged.  It took almost 2 hours to get it resolved.  It messed up our plans with a reservation.  Also barely any toilet paper and no Kleenex.  Also the TV stopped working.

reviews.author: Lavell wineglass
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: Awesome stay. It was wonderful. Will come again

reviews.author: MH
reviews.title: In no way worth the Marriott title
reviews.body:
This hotel should not be able to use the Marriott brand name as it is in no way representative of the quality Marriott strives for. 
Cockroaches by the pool, broken air conditioning units, being charged for milk to go with the "free" breakfast coffee and extortionate parking rates of $32 a day to park in a car park with potholes. Hugely disappointing.

reviews.author: Saunders
reviews.title: College stay
reviews.body: Needs improvement in the room with amenities

reviews.author: T roy
reviews.title: Atlanta family will not stay again
reviews.body: Not up to Marriott standards

reviews.author: LP
reviews.title: Good hotel. Wonderful staff!
reviews.body: Ogwa at the front desk is so friendly and helpful, she elevates the hotel experience. The pool table and fitness center are nice. The room is spacious. No complaints and lots to be happy about!

reviews.author: Hotelcookie
reviews.title: Okay for one night, maybe
reviews.body: This is an okay stay if you just need somewhere for the night. We had a room at the end, and it was okay but not well kept. Our friends had a room closer to the front and it was a completely different experience.

reviews.author: Heyhey23
reviews.title: Wheres the microwave
reviews.body: Can we be honest and not show a microwave in the room if there is no microwave in the room.

reviews.author: Business traveler
reviews.title: An enjoyable experience that provide rest, adventure, and joy
reviews.body: The experience is always pretty consistently meeting my needs in a hotel stay. The staff are always friendly and helpful. The rooms are comfortable, the decor in the rooms and lobby are energetically simple. The hotel patio provides a comfortable atmosphere that allows me to feel at peace and an escape from the hustle and noise of the day like a place of refuse during each stay. That’s why the Aloft Atlanta is my favorite place to stay when visiting for business or to see family and friends.

reviews.author: LO
reviews.title: Poorly kept and not clean
reviews.body: Room where not well kept , lights broken , light bulbs were out. Bathroom was dirty and they failed to clean it even as we were there.

reviews.author: Robbie
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.body: I stay at this location all the time.

reviews.author: Mccrimmon
reviews.title: Excellent location and staff
reviews.body: First time in Atlanta and they made my stay stress free clean cozy friendly staff. Only improvements I request is free breakfast and cable or streaming tvs every thing else excellent

reviews.author: Not a fan
reviews.title: Atlanta weekend
reviews.body: Does not live up to expectations

reviews.author: Ruthlessfashion
reviews.title: came for fashion
reviews.body: aloft is the perfect place to stay for the Markets.

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body:
My mom and I came to Atlanta to see my daughter for Georgia Tech's Parent's weekend.  We booked a stay at the Moxy and I'm so glad we did!  The hotel was very cool- unlike any other I've ever stayed in!  There are lots of cool touches- like checking in at the bar and getting free drinks.  The locker by the elevator with extra towels, etc. was also nice.  The decor was very cool and modern, too.

The best part about the whole visit was the staff- each one was friendly, helpful and fun!  We would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: Jessica B
reviews.title: Stay Here
reviews.body: We loved our stay. Staff was amazing, super helpful, and welcoming. You are literally downtown so everything is walkable. Rooms were so spacious and clean. Will definitely stay at Moxy every time!!!!

reviews.author: Solo Traveler
reviews.title: Nice hotel with a great location
reviews.body: The location as well as staff were/are great.  The Bluetooth within the bathroom mirror was a nice perk/convenience.  The queen bed room size is good for a solo traveler.

reviews.author: CDubs
reviews.title: Fun!... but not for families with small kids.
reviews.body:
While the staff was very helpful and friendly during our stay, this hotel was just not a good fit for my family and I. It was mostly my fault for not reading the reviews online, but when booked through the aquarium package it just shows overall rating. We have three small kids so the vibe was a bit much for them. Really loud music, pretty much everywhere. What really ruined it for us was the rooftop lounge. We were on floor 8 and the music could be heard loud and clear up till closing at 2 am. Ear plugs were advertised but zero were available. I had to Uber to the drug store to pick some up.
The automatic led lights under the bed were super annoying. Every time someone moved they would turn on. 
The faucet in the tub didn't work which made bathing kids super difficult.

reviews.author: Moxy stay
reviews.title: The moxy
reviews.body: The hotel was OK, but I think having a coffee bar in the lobby is important. Having bottled water in your room is important I asked I think having someone come and clean my room, take out the trash and bring fresh towels as expected at any hotel you saying

reviews.author: AshB
reviews.title: Fun place to stay.
reviews.body:
We loved staying here. There was a sound machine in the room which was cool, a free check in drink, really nice bathroom and mattress. We loved the supply cabinet so I was able to grab an extra pillow without having to call anyone. 
The only down side was no fridge in the room.

reviews.author: Ms C
reviews.title: Love Moxy!
reviews.body: We had an amazing stay at the Moxy in Downtown Atlanta. The room and property was very clean and staff friendly.  Our room was very unique, we booked the room with 4-Queen beds, bunk design and we loved the room and the use of space. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Hard Pass
reviews.title: Vibes over Comfort
reviews.body: This hotel cares far more about being trendy and vibey than comfortable. Check in is at a literal bar, so dont show up in the evening unless you want to yell your information over the dj. The rooms are so small and cramped, I didnt even have a nightstand. I could hear the dj in the bar on the 5th floor all night and my room didnt get cleaned 1 of the days.

reviews.author: MikeyG
reviews.title: I Thought I Was Checking Into a Hotel… Then They Handed Me a Whiskey
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at the Moxy in Atlanta while attending a trade show, and honestly, it was one of the coolest hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

The funny part is that it was actually the most affordable hotel available when I was booking my trip.

When my Uber dropped me off from the airport, there had to be close to 100 people standing outside waiting in line for drinks. My first thought was:

“Oh boy… what have I gotten myself into?”

I walked into the hotel looking for the front desk. I kept walking until I found this huge bar in the middle of the space, with music playing and people everywhere.

So I asked the bartender, “Where do I check in?”

He looked at me and said, “Right here.”

I said, “Here? At the bar?”

He said, “Yeah. This is Marriott’s version of a cruise ship on land.”

Then came the next question:

“What can I get you to drink?”

The other bartender noticed my whiskey shirt and said, “He’s got a whiskey shirt on… maybe he prefers whiskey.”

I said, “Sure, I’ll have a whiskey.”

And just like that, I was checked into my hotel.

Honestly, it was one of the coolest check-ins I’ve ever experienced.

And the experience continued from there.

The Moxy may have a completely different vibe than your traditional hotel, but that’s exactly what makes it great. Every Moxy has its own personality and theme, and the Atlanta location absolutely delivers.

What really stood out to me, though, was the staff.

From the valet, to the bartenders, restaurant staff, and housekeeping—everyone was incredibly friendly. It’s rare that you notice that level of hospitality consistently throughout an entire hotel, but I did.

They also have an incredible rooftop bar, and surprisingly, I never heard the music from my room. My guess is there’s a lot of concrete involved in the construction!

And I have to give a special shout-out to the entire crew at Eggslut. Don’t let the name scare you off—the egg sandwiches are incredible. Make sure you try the Dirty Bird.

But what impressed me most was watching that staff work. With the number of people constantly waiting in line, they operated like a machine. Everyone worked together, everyone stayed friendly, and nobody seemed stressed or impatient. They were constantly greeting people with, “How are you this morning?” and “Have a wonderful day.”

That kind of customer experience sticks with you.

Needless to say, I would recommend the Moxy to anyone.

And don’t be afraid of the music or the energy. It’s not your typical hotel—and that’s exactly the point.

I can honestly say I’ll be seeking out Moxy Hotels wherever my travels take me next.

reviews.author: Steph
reviews.title: Fun times 10!
reviews.body: Want a unique and fun place to stay?  It's all here-tasty food, great variety of drinks and rooms that are not typical of a "hotel room",  The rooms all have character and a great view of the city if you choose.  Also a nightclub right on the roof!

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.body: Our stay was incredible from start to finish! Friendly and accommodating staff. Clean hotel/room. Just a great experience. We will definitely be back here during our next stay in Atlanta.

reviews.author: Kaye
reviews.title: Good hotel minor hiccups to improve
reviews.body: The hotel itself was beautiful and definitely gave the Atlanta city-life vibe, with stylish aesthetics and a great overall ambiance. The stay was enjoyable, but the customer service was the main downfall, particularly during check-in. The check-in issue was not met with much warmth, follow-up, or accommodation, which left the experience feeling less personal than expected. Overall, it was still a vibe and a beautiful property, but for the pricing, the customer service should better match the atmosphere and cater to its patrons, especially with the appeal of the Midtown location and the development happening around it.

reviews.author: emdaw26
reviews.title: Perfect for a weekend getaway!
reviews.body: Staff, service and room were excellent! Drinks at the bar were delicious, hotel is such a vibe, the music in the elevator was my favorite! Rooms are on the smaller side compared to other hotels but the space was perfect for my husband and I, plenty of space and very useful space! We will 100% stay at a Moxy again!

reviews.author: ChristinaC
reviews.title: Love this Moxy Hotel!
reviews.body: Such a fun, hip stay! Check-in was quick and easy, and I had a great conversation with Steph at the bar — she made the whole vibe even better. Had a nice dinner at Jagger Suite on-site, and breakfast at Eggslut was delicious (get the Fairfax, you won’t regret it!). Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: WorkHardPlayHard
reviews.title: Not for work or rest
reviews.body: While staff was friendly and helpful, my initial room was dirty (discarded tissue on the bathroom floor, towels and linen on bed in disarray, different hair types inside the bed and the shower, trash in the rug, lipstick smeared in the floor AND the room smelled like urine. I was able to quickly move to another room; however, the experience was beyond disappointing. As a person who regularly travels to Atlanta for work, I would not risk putting myself, my loved ones or my colleagues in that predicament again.

reviews.author: Leito517
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.body:
Overall, we had a very good stay at Moxy Atlanta Downtown, and I would recommend it, especially because of its outstanding location. It’s within walking distance of major attractions like Mercedes-Benz Stadium, State Farm Arena, the Georgia Aquarium, World of Coca-Cola, and other downtown highlights, making it an excellent choice for sightseeing.

The hotel also has a great social atmosphere. If you’re looking for nightlife or a lively place to meet people, Moxy does an excellent job creating that experience. That wasn’t the main purpose of our trip, but it was clear that many guests were enjoying the bars and entertainment.

The staff was consistently friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. They made us feel well taken care of, which definitely added to the experience.

Parking is convenient. While valet parking is available, I would recommend using the self-parking garage nearby. It’s just a short walk from the hotel, costs less, and is very convenient.

The hotel was clean, but there are a couple of areas that could be improved. The rooms can be a bit noisy, and the biggest drawback for us was the bed. It was smaller than expected, and the mattress wasn’t as comfortable or high-quality as we anticipated for the price. As a couple, we felt a bit cramped, especially since I’m 6 feet tall.

Overall, it’s a great hotel with an unbeatable location, a fun atmosphere, and excellent staff. With more comfortable beds and better sound insulation, it would easily deserve a perfect rating.

reviews.author: James H
reviews.title: Birthday Staycation
reviews.body: This was a great way to celebrate my wife’s birthday. We walked to Atlanta attractions and enjoyed the rooftop lounge. The staff was great and the decor was on point for Atlanta culture. The forward thinking of having extra supplies in stash lockers on every floor was great. I hate calling for more towels. Overall great experience and I will recommend and return.

reviews.author: BoBo
reviews.title: Dirty, uncomfortable, and not family friendly
reviews.body: I was very disappointed in this Marriott hotel. Beside the friendly staff, which was the one redeeming quality this hotel is dirty, the  bathroom floor was sticky, the  bathroom sink stopped up and the water would not go down the drain. The bed was extremely uncomfortable with a large valley through the middle of it and sheets that felt like sandpaper. Decor was dark and depressing and the air-conditioning unit did not keep up and it was like an oven. No mini fridge.  And the nightclub thumped  until two in the morning. Not a great night sleep for the day of activities we had planned with our family.  I’ve never given such a poor review of a Marriott property. Extremely disappointed.

reviews.author: Nana
reviews.title: Family weekend
reviews.body: Wonderful place to stay, nicest people and the hospitality was outstanding. Any time you walked downstairs they asked how everything was and if we needed anything!

reviews.author: Magik50
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body: Staff was ok - some great, others very uninterested. Did not get housekeeping at all during our 3 night stay. A bartender is also the front desk. Didn't even tell me that there was a fitness center or where it was located.

reviews.author: Oriia
reviews.title: Beware!!
reviews.body: They have no front desk number. We left something in our room and need it, but there is zero way to contact them to get it back to us. The hotel is just a club that happens to have rooms. Very loud at night, all night.

reviews.author: Sally and Martin
reviews.title: 4 night stay during the World Cup
reviews.body: We had an amazing time at Moxy, loved the hotel and the team were so welcoming and helpful.  The location was perfect, the rooms were lovely and we enjoyed our Eggslut breakfast every morning!

reviews.author: Victor Charlotte NC
reviews.title: Great Vibes and Prime Location!
reviews.body:
If you’re looking for a hotel that skips the stuffy, traditional check-in and dives straight into the fun, Moxy Atlanta Downtown is it.

The Highlights:
The Check-In Experience: Instead of a cold, sterile front desk, you literally walk up to the bar to get your room key. They even hand you a complimentary cocktail (or mocktail) right then and there. It instantly sets a high-energy, party-ready tone for the weekend.

Unbeatable Location: Location-wise, you couldn't ask for a better spot. It is incredibly convenient and within easy walking distance to all the major downtown attractions, restaurants, and spots you'll want to see.

The rooms are sleek and modern, the staff is incredibly welcoming, and the lobby atmosphere makes you want to hang out and socialize rather than just head straight to your room. I'll definitely be staying here again the next time I'm in Atlanta!

reviews.author: Concerned traveler
reviews.title: 1200.00 for 2 nights , outrageous
reviews.body:
Most disappointing hotel experience 
City view Room faced parking lot, no watering room , no coffee or tea, nor was the room ever serviced from arrival to departure, and it was so noisy I was told there was a machine in room to filter sound and earplugs ! And though the manager tried to be helpful the next day no one was reachable

reviews.author: Unhappy Guest
reviews.title: Poor frontdesk service at Moxy Downtown Atlanta
reviews.body: Poor frontdesk staff and service. Not picking up phones, mailbox was full. Did not respond to requests. "Lost" cupcakes sent to frontdesk for a guest of hotel, even though delivery driver sent a photo of them at reception and confirmed they were handed over with clear instructions.

reviews.author: SCmom
reviews.title: Clean, fun hotel downtown
reviews.body: Really cute rooms, extremely comfortable beds, all very clean. There was a fun bar and I loved having Eggslut in the lobby. The valet parking is pricey, but the staff was wonderful and I didn’t worry about my car. Do NOT stay here if you want a traditional, anonymous hotel experience. Come to engage and find something to do at night because everyone else will be out late.

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Terrific
reviews.body: Fresh property perfectly located in the downtown area.

reviews.author: teaspoon65
reviews.title: Phenomenal room and exemplary location.
reviews.body: We loved the roommate style room and the location was prime for all major events downtown ATL.

reviews.author: Hadams
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: The hotel was easy to get to and within walking distance of the Mercedes-Benz Stadium. The atmosphere was electric and everyone was super friendly and upbeat. The room was clean and the view was beautiful. I will definitely be staying at Moxy in the future!!

reviews.author: Readtheamenitiescarefully
reviews.title: Ridiculous
reviews.body: The staff was lovely, and the beds were comfortable. But the hotel itself is ridiculous. They distract you with the not really functional but pretty design from the fact there is no coffee, mini fridge, microwave, or trash cans. Yes you read that right no trash bins. There was a small one in the bathroom without a liner in it and the reasoning for this is because it doesn’t fit the hotels aesthetic. So if you’re going to stay one night, and you have an eating disorder it should work out great for you. Otherwise normal people should probably keep looking for another place to stay. Oh, and another thing… There is no laundry on site. They send it off in the morning and it is something like $12 per shirt and $14 or so for a pair of pants. So if you are traveling for any length of time and need to do laundry, do not expect to find a laundry room in the Atlanta hotel. Instead you will have to drive across town to a laundromat. Hotel staff were incredibly helpful in helping me choose a nice laundromat. They might be the best part about the hotel. Oh, the beds were comfortable though and it was admittedly a fun vibe. Just not practical at all.

reviews.author: Kee32
reviews.title: Good Service, But Disappointing Room Experience
reviews.body: The staff at JW Marriott Atlanta Downtown provided very good customer service, and our room was clean. Unfortunately, the overall comfort of our stay did not meet the standard we expected from a JW Marriott. The guests in the neighboring room were extremely loud, and we were repeatedly woken up in the mornings due to how easily the noise carried between rooms. Our air conditioning also did not work properly. We contacted the hotel and maintenance came to address the issue, but the AC still did not work afterward. In addition, the toilet was very noisy when used and the shower had low water pressure. I appreciate the friendliness of the staff and the cleanliness of the room, but these issues made it difficult to relax and get a comfortable night’s rest. For a JW Marriott, I expected a much more comfortable and peaceful stay.

reviews.author: HOFF22
reviews.title: Exceptional New Luxury Hotel
reviews.body: I had an outstanding experience during my stay. I arrived late at night and received a warm welcome from the the valet attendant who escorted me to the front desk. The front desk agent was extremely friendly and professional. The hotel was exceptionally clean and looked brand new. The room was comfortable, spacious, and equipped with everything I needed for a relaxing stay. The amenities were excellent, and the overall atmosphere made me feel right at home. I truly appreciated the attention to detail and commitment to customer service. I was pleasantly surprised to receive a personalized welcome note from the General Manager in my room. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to the area and will definitely stay here again in the future. Thank you to the entire team for a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: JR80
reviews.title: Great stau
reviews.body: Staff was amazing and helpful!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Absolutely beautiful! Above and beyond expectations!

reviews.author: Surprised Mark
reviews.title: Expecting the unexpected is always amazing at the JW Marriott
reviews.body: The management new my birthday was a couple of days after my stay and sent up to my room a delicious birthday dessert.  It was a very thoughtful and unexpected surprise.  I personally thanked one of the managers that afternoon and the next morning he was back at work while I was checking out and remembered me by name and thanked me for staying at the JW.

reviews.author: Anon
reviews.title: Horrifically overwhelming perfume in rooms & hallways
reviews.body: Rooms are pumped full of some designer scent that not one single staff member knows how to adjust or turn off. If you are at all sensitive to smells, do not stay here. Staff will give up and say “I don’t know” rather than find someone who knows how to solve the problem

reviews.author: C O B Y
reviews.title: 5 star
reviews.body: I highly recommended this 5 star experience

reviews.author: ACampbell
reviews.title: JW Downtown Atlanta
reviews.body: The service was excellent.   The staff were very helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: tcao
reviews.title: Kevin and Nhi wedding
reviews.body: This was such a pleasant day at the Marriott. The location is perfect, and the hotel feels practically brand new. I really enjoyed interacting with the staff—they were kind, polite, and professional. Every question I had was answered thoroughly, and the entire property was very clean and well maintained.

reviews.author: Drewc
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay
reviews.body: Everything about the experience was 10/10. The staff was super helpful and friendly. Rooms were very clean and spacious. Food was great views were great as well!

reviews.author: Lbmiller
reviews.title: The Best Hotel Stay
reviews.body: We had a phenomenal 3-night stay at the JW Downtown Atlanta. It truly exceeded our expectation. We frequent JW Marriotts and this was by far the best! The staff anticipated our needs and was very attentive. We plan to return!

reviews.author: Bethea
reviews.title: Good time
reviews.body: I enjoyed the staff. I enjoy the hospitality the energy I enjoyed the fancy doors. I did not have to touch one door coming in. They were cool for real and I will be back

reviews.author: FG101
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay Due to Poor Communication
reviews.body:
Very disappointing stay. My family booked a rate that included breakfast, but after being told we could use either breakfast option, we were informed in the middle of our buffet breakfast that we were not qualified to dine there. We were later charged for breakfast that should have been included with our reservation.

The overall experience was frustrating due to poor communication between departments, inconsistent service, and unresolved billing issues. I have never left a negative review before, but this stay fell far below the standards I expect from a JW Marriott. I hope the hotel improves its communication, guest experience, and billing process so future guests do not encounter the same issues.

Also, please be aware that the rooftop swimming pool does not have a lifeguard on duty. Guests, especially families with young children, should take extra precautions and supervise children closely while using the pool.

reviews.author: Dubb Russ
reviews.title: Excellent place
reviews.body: We will always choose this place they go above and beyond the customer service is top-tier every single employee that you meet has a smile on their face and they are always willing to help you answer any questions or anyway that they can. This hotel is beautiful and amazing. The pool is absolutely beautiful the atmosphere is wonderful. I just love everything about this place.

reviews.author: My Reviews
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.body: Spacious rooms, friendly staff and great location.

reviews.author: Tiana1130
reviews.title: Amazing experience everyone should visit this place
reviews.body: The hotel ambience was amazing. I would rate it a 10 out of 10. The staff is super friendly and welcoming. If you’re staying in Atlanta, this is definitely the place to stay.

reviews.author: Nurse TK
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.body:
I came to Atlanta for a one night stay to see Summer Walker in concert.
As a Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite member, I stay at Marriott properties frequently, and I wanted to recognize Kadian for providing exceptional customer service. From the moment I arrived, she was professional, welcoming, and genuinely attentive to my needs. She made the check-in process seamless and went above and beyond to ensure I felt valued as a guest.
Kadian’s positive attitude, attention to detail, and commitment to excellent hospitality truly stood out and made my stay even more enjoyable. Employees like her are the reason guests continue to choose Marriott. Thank you, Kadian, for your outstanding service and for representing Marriott so well!

reviews.author: Huntster
reviews.title: One of the Friendliest Places to Stay in Atlanta
reviews.body: I recently stayed at the JW Marriott Hotel in downtown Atlanta, right after it's remodel and name change. While there were a few things that needed attention due to the remodel (my room door was hard to open and close), the hotel was super responsive to every issue and even tried to anticipate the issues. For my room door, I was offered to move rooms and even have them move all of our belongings. We were pretty entrenched, so instead someone came and worked on the door and fixed the problem. The hotel manager, the front desk staff, and ever single hotel employee I encountered had a smile, a courteous response, and asked if they could help in some way. We even met and engaged with the hotel manager on multiple occasions. The room was clean and the beds were comfortable. The hotel was close to a number of eating options and was close to the World Congress Center where our convention was held. I would absolutely stay at the JW Marriott Atlanta Downtown for work or leisure.

reviews.author: J Jones
reviews.title: started bad and ended bad
reviews.body: Most of the staff were nice and tried to address concerns, but when issues kept happening during a ten-day stay, you begin to realize that the organization needs some guidance.

reviews.author: Jeremy O
reviews.title: Leisure activities need fixed
reviews.body:
The pool, located on 16th floor, was extremely cold. I visited the hotel the first week of June. I’d guess the pool was 65 degrees, nearly unsafe for children and could potentially cause health issues for others. It was NOT enjoyable at all. It was, along with the vacant Perch bar, were the primary reasons for my stay at the JW Marriot in Atlanta, Downtown. 

A note on the reservations page would have prevented this stay. 

I’m quite unhappy because my two babes (3 & 5) could not play in the water.

reviews.author: Concerned Educator
reviews.title: Expected greatness, but was let down
reviews.body: Attended SkillsUSA Nationals with 2 other advisors, and 6 students in tow. During the stay, all phones were down, and therefore unable to contact other rooms for the students in my care. The entry and exit into the valet was abysmal during business regular hours. Stair access was limited and inadequate signage was present for directions. Elevator was slow to operate. Pool was virtually unusable due to the cold temperature. Highly priced stay for some very average accommodations and experience. Overall, would stay again if the price were lower, but not at the rate charged during this event.

reviews.author: Jeriman
reviews.title: Valet
reviews.body: Valet manager was very rude at night  when my family arrived

reviews.author: Family Traveler
reviews.title: Good, but avoid the breakfast trap.
reviews.body:
Good rewards stay in a pretty decent location. Close to the attractions in downtown ATL. The property is freshly renovated. All the staff we interacted with were very professional. 

The only negative is the on-site breakfast. $32 per person with a SpringHill Suites level buffet is ludicrous. For $32 per person ($80+ with gratuity), I at least expected some made to order options. Just a really poor experience with breakfast that was our final memory at this property. Will DoorDash breakfast next time if I come back to this property.

reviews.author: JiversonB
reviews.title: Amazing Customer Service
reviews.body: Kaya was exceptional and the night staff made us feel true Marriott Bonvoy Members! I see they are working to upgrade the brand here in Atlanta and stand out from the old branded hotel! The staff was amazing!

reviews.author: DM2026
reviews.title: Hopefully they are ready now!!!
reviews.body:
I reserved two rooms for our stay from May 14, 2026, through May 18, 2026, and housekeeping service was inconsistent throughout our visit. The rooms were not cleaned regularly, which was disappointing given the standards I expected from a JW Marriott property.  Approximately one week before our arrival, I received an email stating that the W Atlanta Downtown had been converted to the JW Marriott Atlanta Downtown. Initially, I was not concerned by the change, as JW Marriott is generally considered an upgrade from the W brand. Based on that understanding, I expected to receive at least the same level of amenities and service that had influenced my original booking decision.

Unfortunately, that was not the experience we had.  Hopefully, the are ready now!!!

reviews.author: Travel
reviews.title: Mini Vacation
reviews.body: We had an amazing mini vacation with an amazing and outstanding staff and wonderful customer service.

reviews.author: EJefferson
reviews.title: Unexpected Expatiations...
reviews.body:
We stayed at the W Atlanta/JW Marriott transition property May 14–17, 2026 for my daughter’s 5-year Spelman reunion, and unfortunately the experience was extremely disappointing. We booked months in advance and even received a letter two days before arrival assuring guests the transition would not affect reservations — yet check-in was chaotic, our reservation could not initially be found, and our card was overcharged for deposits despite multiple confirmations beforehand.

The hotel renovations are beautiful, but the customer service did not match the upgraded appearance. Staff and management seemed unprepared during the transition, bartenders were rude, valet repeatedly lost our tickets, and communication throughout the stay was poor. To make matters worse, our deposit holds still have not been released.

We planned this trip carefully for a very special family occasion, and it was frustrating to have the experience overshadowed by disorganization and lack of customer care. Hoping management takes these concerns seriously and improves the guest experience moving forward.

reviews.author: Dominique
reviews.body: I can’t wait to come back! Everyone made me feel so at home. The room was *chefs kiss*.  I am so happy I was one of the first to experience this hotel . It looks completely different and has a totally different atmosphere. Love, love, love!

reviews.author: JLANDO
reviews.title: Amazing rooms and a modern hotel experience.
reviews.body: Very clean hotel with beautiful, spacious rooms, a central location, and the friendliest staff ever!

reviews.author: DLoRN
reviews.title: Very nice facility with a superb staff
reviews.body: Labor Day weekend in downtown Atlanta is always madness for hotels. Easily 80,000 people descending all at once for football and DragonCon. Couple that with "feels like 106" degree weather and this could've been a much different story. Our stay was not without some technical glitches (I believe some room management software hiccups and a fussy AC unit) but the amazing staff more than made up for it. Special shout-out to Shay and Sandra at the front desk. The whole lobby team was fantastic, but these ladies stepped up all day every day to make sure issues were addressed, communication flowed and guests felt valued. I heard "Oh Miss Shay took care of it" or "Miss Sandra helped me" more than once from my (adult) kids during our stay. We had an issue with our AC unit on day one. I've had similar issues at another brand's hotel in Atlanta during DragonCon and support took multiple calls, visits to the front desk, conversations with a manager and about 48 hours to resolve. The Twelve engineer had it sorted in 30 minutes. Valet parking was a breeze. We walked all over the neighborhood at all hours during our stay and always felt safe. The location is spectacular, with access to all of downtown Atlanta and a nice MARTA station across the street. Couldn't be more convenient. I'm not usually a gushing reviewer, but we just felt especially well cared for during our stay and really appreciated the whole experience. We will absolutely be back.

reviews.author: ConGoer26
reviews.title: Location is best Quality.
reviews.body: The Twelve Downtown’s best quality is its ease of shuttle/walking access to the convention areas downtown. The preparation for one of the biggest weekends of the year in Atlanta was woefully underdone. We arrived at a normal check in time (4:50 at the check in desk itself) and were told our room wasn’t ready. We did not receive a reason why and when I inquired about another topic regarding our room, one of the clerks unprompted told me that “everyone else checked in early” and implied that it was my fault that we did not have a room available. The manager was very nice and did his best to make sure the room was cleaned quickly but the first interaction left a sour taste in our mouths.

reviews.author: 2026ConGoerKris
reviews.title: Best Hotel for Dragon Con
reviews.body: The staff is awesome, friendly, and accommodating!  Hotel is close enough to walk, but far enough to be able decompress from the crowds.  Near the Catholic Church for Mass on Sunday. Close to the Aquarium as well.  Full kitchen to cook your own food too!

reviews.author: Underwhelmed Guest
reviews.title: The Hotel May Have Been Great in the Past
reviews.body: The staff is wonderful and helpful, but the property has challenges, including fewer staff than required for a property that should be part of your Autograph Collection. Things do not work as well as they might: a safe that was not working, needed batteries and a reset, but when reset the lights stayed on all night affecting our sleep; telephone system down for the entire duration of our stay.

reviews.author: KandB
reviews.title: What A Lovely Hotel
reviews.body: The stay here was amazing. The cleanliness, the space, the view. Everything was so perfect. The room had so much character & was so interactive & spacious. It made the trip even more enjoyable for my partner & I. I would definitely stay here again & again!

reviews.author: Emmi
reviews.title: Blood on the Bedroom Wall
reviews.body: The room was spacious and unique, however, there was a significant amount of blood on the wall right next to the bed. There was also notable mold in the shower

reviews.author: Family Traveler
reviews.title: First Class Hotel!
reviews.body: First class hotel and restaurant. Can’t wait to stay again.

reviews.author: Bob in Atlanta
reviews.title: It was cooler in outside Atlanta during the summer than it was inside this hotel.
reviews.body: Hot, hot, hot.  I can see how a hotel may experience its cooling unit being down for a couple of days, but my entire 18 day stay.  Did the staff even try to explain why it was felt like it was 90 degrees indoors all the time?  Have Atlantans just acclimated to the local extreme heat, or are they listening to NY cities mayoral decree to turn the indoor temperature up?

reviews.author: Tracy
reviews.title: THE BEST
reviews.body: I cannot recommend this hotel enough. It is absolutely beautiful and the best I have ever stayed at. Go experience Atlanta and stay here. The hustle and bustle of the city melt away once you walk through the doors.

reviews.author: Scartys432
reviews.title: Lovely hotel, staff, and amenities for price
reviews.body: The staff is welcoming. The rooms are nice and clean. The amenities are excellent, and the hotel location is superb for the price of the hotel. I thought everything was lovely. I would stay again.

reviews.author: AMC5
reviews.title: Horrible!
reviews.body:
They barely cleaned the bathtub, even after we requested housekeeping for the day. The bed sheets were old and heavily worn, with noticeable pilling that made them feel rough and uncomfortable. There was also mold around the bathroom tub faucet. They did not consistently restock basic toiletries, such as toilet paper and bath soap.

While not all of the staff were unfriendly, some were, particularly a woman working the morning shift with dreadlocks. Overall, this was one of the worst hotel stays I've ever experienced.

reviews.author: Stuart
reviews.title: Would not recommend
reviews.body: We had many issues with this property. I would not recommend starting at this property. Seems like the management do not care about the property or guests.

reviews.author: KionaP
reviews.title: Nice stay overall
reviews.body: Nice stay overall. Love the location and atmosphere.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Choose Any Other Hotel in Atlanta!
reviews.body: This is a failure of a hotel.  While the staff is friendly, housekeeping and sanitation are sorely lacking / non-existent in the rooms, restaurant, and bar.  I was there for business and have literally been in a thosand hotels around the world over the years and don't write reviews.  I've taken  rare time to save others from a similar experience with this review, and you would be advised to choose anywhere else for your stay or event.  I'm quite confident that a Motel 6 would have fewer sticky surfaces then this hotel.  Just. Don't.

reviews.author: Misty
reviews.title: Do Not Care About Disabled Guests
reviews.body: Our stay was HORRENDOUS. My son is 22 and has Muscular Dystrophy and is in a power wheelchair, we booked the handicap accessible suite. We arrived and checked in around 4:30 pm. I am a single woman traveling with a handicapped son in a wheelchair and was offered NO ASSISTANCE by valet or anyone else, I was struggling heavily with our things as we have to travel with a portable Hoyer lift to move him in / out of the bed. Needless to say we finally made it to our suite. We were in Atlanta to attend the J-Cole concert, my sons favorite artist.  We got ready to leave and there WAS NO ELEVATOR SERVICE!!!!! HOW CAN WE GET DOWNSTAIRS IN A WHEELCHAIR WITH NO ELEVATOR SERVICE! He cannot use stairs! Clearly!!! This is at 5:30 pm, the concert begins at 7pm , we wanted to grab a bite before going. I call to the front desk and the rude woman who answered stated "I have to get off the phone with you, I am sorry I cannot help you if I'm on the phone with you, we are aware the elevator is not working and we are trying to fix it" then hung up on me. WHAT WERE WE SUPPOSED TO DO???? We waited for someone to tell us something for over an hour and a half. I called back down at 7:00pm extremely upset because we are now going to be late for our show and had also had nothing to eat or drink because                      we were trapped upstairs in our room with NO ELEVATOR SERVICE. The front desk person sent someone up to us to take us through the service elevator which took us downstairs through the kitchen, yes the KITCHEN! My son is in a large power wheelchair and they were having a tough time trying to get the wheelchair past a HOT GRILL surface which was ON, my son scraped his arm going through there and was almost burned. I am appalled at the disregard for his safety. We paid $300 for that room that night and we missed part of our show and were starving because of this incident, I feel I should contact the Human Rights Agency and the ADA. There are measures in place that protect disabled people and I know that having a working elevator is one of them. This hotel is deplorable and I want someone to contact me. I contacted "Max" at 470-836-5610 I think is the manager or owner- he DID NOTHING AT ALL other than off 40% off my next stay which is A SLAP IN THE FACE. This is wrong on so many levels.

reviews.author: Paula C
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.body: The worn-out bed directly affected my health and rest. An elevator was running even though the hotel was full of guests, and the restaurant had only one person on duty.

reviews.author: Chuck
reviews.title: Overhyped
reviews.body: Wouldn’t stay here again.

reviews.author: T Briggs
reviews.title: Great property
reviews.body: Rooms were clean and spacious.

reviews.author: Eli1090
reviews.title: 12 down town stay
reviews.body:
Nice room great view 
Just had minor imperfection like pull out couch was broke in my room 908 and also the bathroom mirror led light was broke

reviews.author: World Cup Guest
reviews.title: Venue is beautiful but that’s where it ends
reviews.body: Starting with check-in, three adults told they would only allow one key. Poor communication. Room was clean but no hand soap. Front desk indicated we should use the shampoo that was affixed to the shower. No towels. We called down and they after several hours brought one towel for multiple guests. No bedding for the pull out. Called down and was told they’d bring it right up. Never arrived. Texts asked about our stay and I asked for a phone call that never came.

reviews.author: Big fan
reviews.title: Unique and pleasurable experience
reviews.body: The design of the hotel lobby and rooms are unlike other accommodations. Care was given to space allowing for normal movement in apartment like style. The staff, including valet were prompt with any requests and kind to answer questions. Always smiling. We felt very welcome and appreciated.

reviews.author: Fqttraveler
reviews.title: Stay away from this property
reviews.body: Service is horrible, dirty, do not stay here

reviews.author: Carlos
reviews.title: Worst experience in a marriott
reviews.body:
By far the worst hotel I've ever been, everywhere smells marihuanas, the room is got smells cigarettes.
when I arrived to the lobby the receptionist was eating on the desk in front of the computer and checking me in at the same time, she gave me zero instructions about anything, I had to ask all the questions regarding my reservation to understand how the hotel works.
The TV was on when we arrived to the room and the remote was not working so we couldn't turn it off and the answer from the front desk was to wait until the next day for the engineer, and they said they have not idea of how I was going to turn it off without a remote.
People smoking into the elevators.
Valet parking staff left my car opened with the keys inside the car.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great for a couples stay
reviews.body: Great stay! Definitely recommend Catch 12 breakfast, great staff.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.body: The location is perfect for experiencing activities downtown.  Friendly staff, food was delicious.  Beautiful, comfortable rooms

reviews.author: Brionna18
reviews.title: Good Room needed some upkeep and lackluster restaurant
reviews.body: I generally enjoyed my room in the space within however the icemaker wasn’t working. The two sinks in bathroom  were draining slow, the light over my bed had a bulb out and despite my request, I never got those things addressed during my four day stay. The food at the catch restaurant was underwhelming. My spring rolls were mushy and bland. There was no bartender on duty.  Otherwise, the staff was very pleasant and helpful.

reviews.author: Vanessa
reviews.title: Used to be BETTER
reviews.body: I would stay at both twelve locations in Atlanta and downtown let me down a little this time. The elevator wasn’t working either for a period of time and I had to go through the kitchen from the service elevator. The showers wasn’t really the cleanest. There were rough spots like no one took time in the corners. The faucet had a leak. Replenishment on things in the room was lacking. Food was not good for room service.

reviews.author: Jrobb519
reviews.title: Clean Convenient option for business in the Summit Building
reviews.body: I called ahead to request a room with washer and dryer as I have had in past when staying and Sandra accommodated me. The stay was great. Clean, comfortable. Elevators went down but staff escorted guests to the freight elevators which was no problem. I was able to thank Sandra personally on the day of check out. She was very kind and hospitable.

reviews.author: MLR86
reviews.title: Great Room, Good Location but, Noisy.
reviews.body: The room size is great for the price. It is very loud due to proximity to the interstate even on the high floors. They messaged me about my stay once I got settled in the room. I told them the light blocking curtains would not close due to track being bent. They said they’d address it in the morning. It was never addressed so the light from the city shined in the room each night. Not ideal for getting restful night of sleep.

reviews.author: Kristen
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.body: Elise and Brian....best hospitality. I cant say enough. Kind, helpful, and just....really freaking amazing people. Thank you for topping of my stay in Savannah!!!

reviews.author: G Baby
reviews.title: The Bohemian Will Be Missed
reviews.body: The stay itself was great. I picked this hotel because it was different because at the time it was The Bohemian not the Hotel Orielle. The Bohemian was exotic from the choice of decorations to the scents that was in the room, to the hotel soaps, hand lotions, etc. The day before we had to checkout we saw that they were removing the soaps and stuff to make room for the new Hotel Orielle soaps. This was the moment where I was like ok I don't like this. Lets start with the name. The Bohemian was a name that matched the decorations. Hotel Orielle, has a religious name behind it which is fine to me but for some they may not like that. The new soaps and hand soap STANK i do not want to smell like lemongrass. I called to have the old stuff returned. I hate to say this but it just seems like they are gentrifying the hotel and it wasn't needed. Idk if I will come back but maybe just once to see what else has changed but I will definitely be bringing my own soaps and lotions.

reviews.author: Bonnie and John M
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Great location, beautiful hotel.  Loved our spacious room and location, 3rd floor with a balcony facing the river.  Only wish there were chairs & small table on balcony.  The staff were all very friendly and helpful.  Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: LA in SC August 2026
reviews.title: Bohemian Hotel Savannah Riverfront, Autograph Collection
reviews.body: The Bohemian Hotel has a beautiful riverfront location, and the staff was wonderful—friendly, welcoming, and helpful. Unfortunately, our stay did not meet our expectations for an Autograph Collection property. Our Romance Package was overlooked at check-in, and we experienced several room issues, including a repeatedly clogged toilet, a burned-out bathroom light, and no refrigerator. We also had concerns about the elevator security. While the staff was excellent, we expected better attention to detail and a more polished experience.

reviews.author: SatisfiedCustomer2026
reviews.title: A nice touch
reviews.body: We had a wonderful time from beginning to end. There were many nice touches.

reviews.author: Mandy C
reviews.title: An Odd Level of Quality for the Price
reviews.body: We were very excited to come stay in Savannah for my husband‘s birthday after a long trip. Upon arriving at the hotel, the valet parking was an absolute nightmare. We pulled up and there was a line of cars backed up to the road because no one was moving their cars along and valet was very behind; we ended up having to unload our car from quite far away and lug our luggage to the front desk without a bell cart. The front desk staff were very kind and lovely to speak to. When we entered our room, we found that the AC wasn’t working and that there were quite a few cockroaches throughout the room. Needless to say, we went back downstairs immediately and got a new room. We had to downgrade from a king room to a double queen room, which was not our first choice, but seemed to be the only one left. The view of the river was gorgeous in the new room, and we immediately went downstairs to the restaurant on the first floor to have dinner. Unfortunately, when we arrived almost an hour before they closed, we were told that the kitchen was already closing so we decided to eat elsewhere. I will say there are a lot of really great dining options within walking distance of this hotel, which is a huge plus. Since the view was so beautiful, we decided to order room service for breakfast the next morning, and that was a decent experience. Again, the staff was wonderful, but the food was subpar. Overall, I don’t think I would pay this price again to stay at this hotel again.

reviews.author: shocked by final price
reviews.title: Overcharged
reviews.body: The hotel I booked for $248 a night on hotels.com almost tripled in price due to extra fees and parking.

reviews.author: Lovely
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: The customer service upon arrival was great. Virgia (likely spelled wrong) was very helpful in ensuring we had a great experience and was quite pleasant. The location (river street) and the amenities were great.

reviews.author: My Stay
reviews.title: My Stay
reviews.body: I always end up staying at this hotel when I come in town some of my days are good and some are OK but this one was definitely different for sure. Some of the staff are really nice and welcoming and others. Don’t keep their promises and end up making you feel stupid but all in all I like this hotel it’s one of the best.

reviews.author: Joe 791
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.body: We were only in town for a sort 24 hours. Tbe staff was friendly hotel was clean and comfortable we had a great time at rocks on tbe roof and a comfortable stay. Can not say enough about all staff we dealt with

reviews.author: Andyman
reviews.title: Check your receipt before you leave
reviews.body: This is my 6th time staying at the hotel. It was nice as always, however I did not get room 501 that i reserved, and I was charged for parking for one day of the 3 days i stayed there. I did not have a vehicle at all. Unfortunately I did not check the receipt before i left so I had to call the hotel thrice. Valet is supposed to reverse the charge, but i should not have to check your receipt and call 3 times.

reviews.author: VA Beach Dave
reviews.title: Very memorable stay!
reviews.body: This is one of those places that we will remember for a long time.  Everything stood out and was excellent!

reviews.author: Titanium Elite Member
reviews.title: No Special Service for Elite Members
reviews.body: The hotel has a great location and  presents itself well.  My experience was the Staff gave no special service to Elite members and appeared to shun people who used the hard earned points for their stay and provided scripted answers to questions.  The restaurant organization with waitresses was disorganized resulting in poor service.

reviews.author: JKW88
reviews.title: Below Expectations
reviews.body: My stay was far below expectations for a Marriott property. The valet service was slow/unavailable, front desk staff processed my needs but were always talking to other staff members, the room had multiple maintenance issues (ie: toilet tank wouldn't fill with water, cracked lamp, dead lightbulbs, broken outlets), and the hallway had a smell.

reviews.author: KirkC
reviews.title: Location, location, location is not the whole story
reviews.body: Don’t come to this hotel, expecting your Bonvoy check-in to be valid. Don’t expect to have a refrigerator in your room. You can’t expect the staff to be extremely welcoming and helpful within the limits given them by the management company we think hotel owner ownership needs to reconsider that relationship.

reviews.author: Agrubbs32
reviews.title: 10 out of 10, highly Recommend
reviews.body: We had a wonderful time at The Bohemian during 4th of July Weekend!  The Kessler Group never disappoints!   Milton with the valet service is brilliant!

reviews.author: KU13579
reviews.title: Be careful of what you see in the pictures and what you are really booking
reviews.body: This is a very eclectic hotel that is beautifully decorated.  Service is impeccable. Unfortunately, we booked a room with a soaking tub and we weren't given one.  This is the only hotel that I could find with one.  We had a great time in Savannah celebrating our 30th wedding anniversary, but would have been better if my wife could relax in the soaking tub.  If you knew what my wife does, you would know the importance of the relaxation that she needs.  When booking, be proactive and contact them directly to make sure you get what your reserved.

reviews.author: Kyle
reviews.title: Many better places to stay in Savannah
reviews.body: I would not recommend staying here. Head to the JW down the street.

reviews.author: Will
reviews.title: Savannah Getaway
reviews.body: This hotel was beautiful, the rooftop bar was great. The staff here was over the top nice.

reviews.author: Savannah Fan
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Great location but falls short - our shower fixture was wrapped with toilet paper to fix a leak. There was a half used mouthwash bottle (with a hair attached-ew!) in the toiletries collection and our breakfast experience at the restaurant was abysmal (not sure if there was a problem with the cook or equipment - we never got an explanation)…all orders that morning were at least 45 minutes late and then arrived cold.

reviews.author: Highly satisfied
reviews.title: Historic Savannah weekend!
reviews.body: Great location on the riverwalk.  Wear comfy walking shoes, not cute heels.

reviews.author: Reggie Pa
reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel Experience
reviews.body: The staff was very accommodating and friendly. The overall experience was excellent. Also a great location.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel unfortunately, the front desk people needs to learn to be more welcoming
reviews.body: Great hotel, valet and doorman are absolutely incredible. Check-in process not very welcoming. The folk at the front desk. Just need to learn to be a little more on the friendly side. It’s almost as if we’re bothering them.

reviews.author: Great stay in Savannah
reviews.title: Great stay in Savannah
reviews.body: Very enjoyable stay. Staff was very professional and helpful. Loved our cover room on the 7th floor. Steven was so helpful in bringing our luggage up when checking in and down with checking out. Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: Wesley
reviews.title: Great time in Savanna
reviews.body: All of my  Family is from the south and it has been 15 years since I have been back to Georgia. Savanna is one of the most beautiful southern town I very been too. The character of the hotel being on the waterfront was spectacular.

reviews.author: FLPaul
reviews.title: Beutifull hotel ambiance
reviews.body: Beutifull decore, gorgeous rooms. Food was excellent both dinner and breakfast

reviews.author: Tom B
reviews.title: Careful on which room you select and pricing!
reviews.body: If the room say Riverview that does not guarantee they have a balcony, even though the pictures show that. Caution required! The rooms are not worth what they are charging you. We had a very unpleasant night at the hotel with a large argument (couple) going on down the hall from us until just before 4 AM. The hotel did respond once we called security, however. The rooms are not worth what they’re charging you. Never again.

reviews.author: larrysr
reviews.title: Nice accomodation
reviews.body: Great stay, convenient, friendly staff, beautiful location on the water situated close to great restaurants and shops

reviews.author: Ms Pretty
reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.body: Phenomenal everything was clean the host were amazing. They made sure that our stay was remarkable

reviews.author: TR TM
reviews.title: Shabby; and Not Shabby Chic.
reviews.body: Lethargic staff, dingy facilites, and rude valet.

reviews.author: Loren
reviews.title: Cool, hotel, exceptional all around
reviews.body: Just exceptional all the way around just like I said in your survey. Great vibe, great feeling great service great rooms and great walking location.

reviews.author: Southern Traveler
reviews.title: Wonderful property and outstanding staff
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay at The Alida. The staff was amazing and the location was very convenient. The only disappointment was the limited hours and menu at The Trade Room which was the only location you could use the $18/daily property resort credit. We never used it during our four day stay.

reviews.author: Frequent Savannah Visitor
reviews.title: The Alida was just slightly above average
reviews.body: Nice hotel at face value, and great location.  The hotel was clean, both common areas and in our room.  Service seems to be hit or miss.  Bar service is fair, nothing exciting.  Room Service was sub-par on speed and quality.  Breakfast at Rhett was average.  The person greeting us was also bussing tables...on Labor Day Weekend.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.title: Great Location and wonderful service.
reviews.body: We enjoyed our 4 night stay and felt very comfortable and loved the location to get to and from wedding and walkable to so much to see in the area.   Service was wonderful!  Room was clean and spacious.   (Suite)

reviews.author: Dwight B
reviews.title: My stay at the Alida
reviews.body:
My stay at The Alida Hotel was extremely disappointing. Check-in was mediocre, and the staff was not particularly friendly or welcoming. The room was much smaller than it appeared online, and the advertised “street view” was actually a view of the side of another building. Both the hallway and my room smelled like mildew.

When I brought the misleading view to the front desk’s attention, my concern was met with a nonchalant response and little effort to help.

The room was also uncomfortable for a taller guest. I’m 6’4” and 265 pounds, and the bed, nightstand, and toilet were all extremely low to the ground. Although this was not an ADA room, the unusually low furnishings made it difficult and uncomfortable for someone of my height and age.

I checked in on August 29 and checked out on August 30 after staying only one night. Unfortunately, the accommodations and lack of attentive customer service made this a horrible experience. Based on my stay, I would not recommend The Alida Hotel.

reviews.author: LTJack
reviews.title: Excellent hotel except the small room
reviews.body: I have mixed feelings about the stay. The staff was excellent, from valet, to servers, to front desk and housekeeping. The hotel is beautiful. My issue is that the room we had is not made for 2 people. It is too small. There is no closet and the space that is meant for hanging clothes is small with the water bottle, glasses and coffee station sharing the same space. The window seat was beautiful but hard. The only chairs were a small chair to go with a small table and a stool. The bed was hard, but front desk was kind enough to have a topper brought up and added. We needed to warm up food and the front desk sent up a microwave. The front desk also offered to move us to a room that would be a slightly bigger. I didn't want to go through the hassle since it was evening and I didn't want to pack up everything to move when we were leaving in 2 days, plus they said "slightly larger". I would only recommend this room for a single person and if they are ok with all of their clothes being in drawers, as well as their luggage being near the door so that it is out of the way. If you don't put it near the door, there is less floor space and makes it difficult to get around the platform bed. My husband hit his leg on the corner of the bed trying to get around the chair/table.

reviews.author: Rita
reviews.title: Very Nice Hotel
reviews.body:
We usually stay at the JW Marriott across the street but wanted to give The Alida a try. It was lovely and all the staff was welcoming, professional and very helpful. The room was spacious and the bed super comfortable. 
We also greatly enjoyed the complimentary bikes and the rooftop bar was fun.

reviews.author: Isobel95
reviews.title: Exceptional Hotel
reviews.body:
The Alida is a beautifully decorated hotel, with every detail thoughtfully put together. It feels really high-end without taking away from the relaxed, welcoming vibe of the hotel. Our room was spotless, and the beds were incredibly comfortable.
The pool was a great facility to have on-site, especially on those hot days when you just want to relax rather than explore. There’s also a rooftop bar, lobby bar, and restaurant on-site, so you really don’t need to leave the hotel if you don’t want to. At the same time, the hotel is within walking distance of everything, making it a great choice for tourists visiting Savannah.
The champagne on arrival and fresh baked cookies are a really nice touch.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend The Alida to anyone visiting Savannah, particularly groups looking for a stylish and relaxing place to stay.

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Great Location, but Pool Access Policy Needs More Transparency
reviews.body:
Overall, we had a great stay at The Alida. The location was excellent, and the hotel was clean, comfortable, and very accommodating. We enjoyed our time there and would definitely consider staying again.

I do want to share some feedback regarding the pool experience. The pool area is relatively small for the size of the hotel, with a limited number of loungers that are first-come, first-served.

During our weekend stay, we encountered a group of outside guests who had purchased day passes to use the pool. The issue was that this was not communicated to us when we checked in, nor was the hotel particularly forthcoming about the fact that outside guests could purchase access to the pool. We only learned about the policy after asking pool staff ourselves.

I completely understand the hotel wanting to generate additional revenue, but the policy can create a significant issue for hotel guests. This particular group occupied approximately 20% of the available loungers, and because they had traveled to the hotel specifically to use the pool, they stayed for a much longer period of time. As a result, we had to wait approximately 45 minutes before a lounger became available.

My concern isn't necessarily with allowing outside guests to use the pool. It's the lack of communication and the impact it can have on guests who are actually staying at and paying for the hotel. When the pool area is relatively small and seating is limited, even one group of day-pass guests can noticeably affect the experience.

I believe hotel guests should be given some level of priority, particularly on busy weekends. At a minimum, I would also suggest being transparent with guests at check-in that day passes are sold and explaining how the hotel manages pool capacity and seating. Perhaps limiting day passes during peak periods or reserving a certain percentage of loungers for registered hotel guests would be a good compromise.

Again, this was an otherwise excellent stay. The hotel, location, cleanliness, and service were all very good, and we enjoyed our visit. I’m sharing this feedback because I think addressing the pool policy and, more importantly, communicating it clearly to hotel guests could make the experience even better.

reviews.author: Badama2015
reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.body: From rude front desk staff, to poorly stocked pool areas towels, to being locked out of your room prior to your requested and approved and verified late check out time. Incredibly poor services for such a beautiful hotel.

reviews.author: Bonnie
reviews.title: Water? Nope. Welcome? Nope. $180 Parking? Absolutely.
reviews.body:
I would not recommend staying at The Alida in Savannah based on our experience.

From the moment we arrived, the customer service was disappointing. The front desk staff barely acknowledged us and seemed more interested in talking among themselves than greeting or assisting guests. For a hotel that markets itself as upscale, the level of professionalism was far below expectations.

We were also surprised that there wasn’t even complimentary bottled water or glasses available for drinking water. These are basic amenities that most hotels provide, especially at this price point.

The biggest issue, however, was the valet parking. We were told parking was $25 per day. We checked in around 4:30 p.m. and checked out the following morning around 11:30 a.m., yet we were charged $180 for parking. That charge is completely unreasonable and unacceptable. We would appreciate a detailed explanation of how this charge was calculated and a prompt refund of any amount that was billed in error.

Overall, this experience fell far short of our expectations. We hope management will review what happened, address the customer service concerns, and correct the parking charge. Until then, we cannot recommend The Alida to others.

reviews.author: Linzeee
reviews.title: Very Cool!
reviews.body: We had a great stay! This Hotel was beautiful & very hip!

reviews.author: JSP24
reviews.title: Classy place to stay in historic savannah
reviews.body: Hotel is well modeled to make you feel a part of historic savannah.   It's an easy walk to just about anywhere you want to go.  Quiet and relaxing

reviews.author: Ron Naradowski
reviews.title: Another perfect birthday stay
reviews.body: We have stayed here the last 4 years for my wife’s birthday. Everyone was thoughtful and praising, the staff even secured a bottle of champagne in our room for arrival

reviews.author: Kristin
