reviews.title: Staycation from Bluffton
reviews.body: We used our Amex platinum credit for this stay and wow we will be doing it again. We received a warm welcome from the front desk. The room was super comfy with a nice bathroom and love the sparkling water faucet on each floor. It was super hot so we spent the day at the pool which had plenty of umbrellas and sun beds if you get there early and the Cabana Club staff were working their tails off. We had breakfast vouchers to Rhett and it was delicious! We’ve stayed at other properties using the credit and usually don’t get much with our voucher but that wasn’t the case here. Also their breakfast potatoes are amazing!!!!!

reviews.author: Nonfiction character
reviews.body: The pool area needs a manager. The staff were good but need hospitality experience.

reviews.author: Woody
reviews.title: One night
reviews.body: Was an amazing view at the top of the roof.

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.body: Just a fantastic experience from start to finish, the front desk staff are very professional and provided outstanding service.

reviews.author: FamilyHolVaz
reviews.title: Good Experience overall
reviews.body: Valet price is crazy expensive on top of all the additional charges the are added at check in. During our stay, we were woken up several times by noisy guests walking through the halls- granted that's not the hotels direct fault- but something should be done to mitigate that problem. Also the shower didn't appear to be thoroughly cleaned- there were hairs on the wall and dirty grout lines.  However, I will probably stay here again in spite of these issues because the hotel overall is very nice and in a great location.  The bartenders at the lobby bar were great and friendly. I think the breakfast at The Rhett was overpriced and probably won't have it again next time.

reviews.author: PGrumbles
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel in the heart of Savannah
reviews.body: Loved our stay at The Alida.  The hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Savannah.  The rooms are immaculate and well designed.  The staff were helpful to lead us to wonderful places for coffee and food.  Lastly, they had a tap water fountain on our floor that was awesome.  Especially on a hot day.  Loved this place and staff.  Book w confidence

reviews.author: Mr Black
reviews.title: Great facility, poor service
reviews.body:
We really wanted to enjoy The Alida, but the customer service was some of the worst we have experienced, particularly the valet. We pulled into the valet stand upon arrival. Both valets were staring at their phones, unaware we had even arrived. They were 4 steps away from us. My wife and I unpacked our car, closed the doors, and locked the vehicle. All while two valets stared at their phones. We walked inside to check in. Eventually, a valet walked inside, and asked if we had parked our car by the stand. I handed him my keys to park the car. 

The desk personnel was not much better. They acknowledged us, but did not welcome us, or deliver any sort of hospitality when greeted. Simply "How can I help you". Savannah is a destination city with a large population of tourists. I've stayed at similar status hotels in the southeast, and typically receive a much warmer greeting. How can we help, so glad you're staying with us, welcome back, etc. This was very transactional. Here are your keys. 

I really wanted to like this hotel. The facilities are quite good. But the lobby bar was the only area where I felt actually welcomed. Check-in, checkout, and every interaction with a valet left me feeling like I was disturbing their day.

reviews.author: FredFlinstone
reviews.title: Worst stay in the last 20 years
reviews.body:
The advertising hides the fact that there is absolutely no parking available other than the rip off valet parking.
Problems with the door lock, tv remote didnt work snd the camera to replace it at 11:30pm and dogs barking inside at midnight.
Valerie driver violated privacy by videoing me, my wife and my daughter amd management didnt seem to care.

reviews.author: Mercer
reviews.title: Romantic stay in Savannah
reviews.body: The Alida Hotel was a terrific experience!  We wanted to get away for a week and it provided a wonderful, relaxing, and exciting home away from home.  The onsite restaurants and bars were excellent, and it was within a short walking distance from everything historic downtown Savannah has to offer!

reviews.author: DISAPPOINTED
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.body: We have stayed at this hotel before and had a great experience however this time because we were unable to access all the hotel had to offer because of areas being closed due to being rented out. If you are going to restrict access to prime areas of the property you owe it to your guests to let them know in advance.

reviews.author: Luv27
reviews.title: Vacations at Alida
reviews.body: Love Alida it’s very relaxing after walking River Street

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: A Gem in the heart of Savanah
reviews.body: Excellent Property with attentive staff and fantastic food. A great place to stay in the heart of the river district.

reviews.author: Pscal
reviews.title: Clean our rooms open bar space for those who pay for stays
reviews.body:
Our stay at The Alida Hotel in Savannah was extremely disappointing from beginning to end.

First, we were charged a $50 early check-in fee even though the rooms were already ready and available. That immediately left a bad impression.

The biggest issue throughout our stay was housekeeping. Every single day we had to call and request maid service for our rooms. Meanwhile, the housekeeping carts sat outside my door constantly, with broom handles and supplies blocking the hallway, yet nobody actually came in to clean unless we repeatedly called.

The second night, we requested both of our rooms be cleaned, and only one was done. The third day, we had to call again. At one point, we know housekeeping entered one of the rooms because someone in our group saw the maid go inside, only for her to walk right back out without cleaning anything. It made absolutely no sense and became incredibly frustrating to have to chase down basic housekeeping service every single day.

Another huge disappointment was the bar situation. Nearly every time we wanted to enjoy one of the hotel bars, they were closed for private events. During most of our stay, we were told to just sit in the restaurant if we wanted a drink. We were only able to use the rooftop bar one night. When you’re paying to stay at a hotel like this, guests should still have access to at least one proper bar/lounge area instead of constantly being pushed aside for private parties.

To make matters worse, there was no convenient little store or snack area to grab basics like water, soda, juice, or simple snacks. The only things available downstairs were minimal items like chips and cookies unless you wanted to order room service.

Overall, this was one of the most frustrating hotel stays we’ve had. Between the extra fees, lack of housekeeping, blocked hallways, inaccessible bars, and lack of basic convenience items, I would absolutely choose another hotel next time I visit Savannah.

reviews.author: Kayla W
reviews.title: FAVE HOTEL IN SAV!
reviews.body: The Alida is by far our favorite place to stay in Savannah & we've been many times. From the superior vibes to the amazing hospitality, yummy food & fabulous drinks...it truly can't be beat! Already planning our next trip :)

reviews.author: Candice
reviews.title: So So So Hot and Less than Friendly Staff
reviews.body: At 3 am, my entire party (including my three year old) woke up because we simply couldn’t stand to sleep in the excruciatingly hot room any longer. We went to check out because it was so uncomfortable. We then (though we used the app correctly) waited 45 + minutes for our car to be brought to us by the valet. While waiting for our car we witnessed a member of the staff be incredibly rude to 3 groups of guest simply because the FRONT door was locked and we needed to use the side door (though NO signs stated this inside the building). Overall a pretty awful experience in a beautiful hotel. Really disappointed the service and comfort don’t live up to how pretty the hotel itself was.

reviews.author: A New Traveling Bee
reviews.title: I've left my Heart in Savannah, Savannah!!
reviews.body:
This was my first time staying at the The Alida, Savannah Hotel and it was an Absolute Joyful experience.
The Location, the Amenities, The Lounge, The Bar, The Pool and what can I say about Alida's Amazing Staff.
Everything was More than what I expected.
Thank You Alida, Savannah!

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: Original decor, comfortable room, disappointing food in and near hotel
reviews.body:
We enjoyed the quirky art and the minerals and fossils. The rooftop pool was nice. The room was comfortable. The bathroom was decent, but didn't have great water pressure. Our lights were missing some crystals and the large mirror was broken.
All the staff we interacted with, even in passing, was pleasant.
As a vegetarian, the lack of food options was a significant disappointment. I know the south isn't known for vegetarian food, but in 2026 at an international chain, I expected better.

reviews.author: Bonvoy Ambassador
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.body: Staff is very nice, especially the front desk management.  They were highly accommodating.

reviews.author: DTrain
reviews.title: Quick getaway
reviews.body: My wife and I stayed here for a quick anniversary getaway. It was very nice and up to date. We were close to everything. The staff were incredible. We will most definitely be staying again.

reviews.author: Family visit 1
reviews.title: Poor value for the money
reviews.body:
Rooms are just the same as homewood stays. I was suppose to get a refund for the hold but never did. I have to follow up. The welcome is casual. 
Breakfast was never delivered as they had told us the night we checked in
Valet parking was a one time fee yet I was charged $60 twice. 
Not worth that much money.

reviews.author: kca6703
reviews.title: Excellent Sevice
reviews.body: Every employee we came across was very polite and helpful. And genuinely seem to care about their jobs.

reviews.author: DanaM
reviews.title: Resort Feel
reviews.body: The lobby of this hotel is breathtaking. So much to see and so well presented. Our room was very large and had a lot of designer touches. We had a great experience, checking in where we were greeted with a drink and ample gift cards towards on site amenities and food. Everyone was very friendly. The location was great and we had a view of the river. The only complaint that we had was that the shower was never very warm and the pressure was not very high. We just missed having a good hot shower. It just seems like this would be something that would come with a caliber of hotel and price point. It wasn’t cold so we didn’t say anything. Either way we would still highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: BeeKay4
reviews.title: A beautiful stay
reviews.body:
Highly recommend this hotel for views, food and relaxation. When you're here you immediately feel like you can breathe easier and switch to vacation mode. The buildings are beautiful and each themed differently. The main building is a museum like display and decorated. Absolutely wonderful for individual and/or family browsing. The property is huge and has a lot to offer, make sure you save some time to take advantage of it.

The room service is great as well, I recommend placing your order as early as possible to get your ticket into the kitchen and the food into your room quicker. Housekeeping was amazing as well. This trip we went as a family, which means more stuff and toys. They were so sweet to setup the stuffed animals on the beds and straighten out luggages and shoes to maximize space.

In the event you need a dental kit, call the front desk and if you are on a time crunch, let them know or you will be waiting over an hour to get it.

reviews.author: Nadia
reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.body: Above and beyond to make us comfortable!

reviews.author: AnniversaryCouple
reviews.title: The staff is special!
reviews.body: Every individual employee to a person was friendly and dedicated to our needs.

reviews.author: RC1960
reviews.title: EXTREMLY NICE
reviews.body: We enjoyed our stay. It was perfection. A fantastic staff.

reviews.author: TB2026
reviews.title: Wouldn’t stay here again
reviews.body: This was one of the most disappointing hotel stays my husband and I have had, especially when the price and tier of hotel are considered. We had to wait for service almost every time we  were at the front desk, sometimes they were truly busy with other people which is completely understandable, but about half the time it was because no one was actually at the front desk. When we did interact with anyone at the front desk it was a miracle if we received accurate information. Prior to our stay I had paid for a “room upgrade” which was just a happy anniversary cake as that was part of the reason for our stay. I had scheduled a time upon booking it, but at check in I had asked if there was a way to move it up or not just so we could plan out our evening- the first response was they’ll check with the kitchen, but it shouldn’t be a problem and they’ll let us know. We got our bags and some time passed without hearing anything so on our way out we checked  with our hotel's front desk who said she’ll follow up and let us know, even taking down my number to personally call. We heard no update for hours and on our way out of the hotel again we again checked with the front desk for an update to which she told us it was on its way to our room at that time but we didn’t need to be present. We came back from dinner and there was no cake, but it finally arrived at its originally scheduled time which would’ve been perfectly fine had any of our three attempts for an update actually confirmed that. The day before we checked out we had asked the front desk about a $100 credit we were notified of at check in, specifically to see if it had been applied to anything from our stay so far. She explained and told us no, and printed out our receipt so far. While walking back to our room at the Three Muses I was looking at our receipt with what very much looked like a $100 credit had been applied, so we checked with our front desk and he told us it was in fact used and applied. I’m glad we verified before going out of our way to spend $100 with no purpose other than to try and utilize a credit. Our experience with the valet was just as bad, if not worse, because out of our entire stay we only ever received our car once without issue. I understand being understaffed and on a busy holiday weekend but there was no communication to advise taking that into account and waiting over 40 minutes for your vehicle is simply unacceptable when you’re being charged $55-60 a day and ultimately need to ask to retrieve your own car on multiple occasions. I understand it taking longer on weekends and during rush times, but there were multiple times during non peak hours, like at 6am when we were trying to check out, where they informed us they couldn’t locate our car and that’s what took so long. This was after speaking to one of the valets the night before, who was incredibly nice, who put a message in their group chat to be able to plan for it in the morning, and after we texted the valet retrieval number the morning of because we felt the need to take all measures possible to try to ensure a smooth checkout- which didn’t happen anyway. We actually received a message that our car was delivered when it actually wasn’t. We also asked the night before if we could take a luggage cart to our room overnight to pack our bags and have it for the early morning check out, to which we were told no. So after carrying our bags ourselves down to the lobby to find that our car couldn’t be located most definitely ended the trip on an even worse note. In addition to our front desk and valet issues, our room had several deficiencies upon arrival. One of the beside chargers was broken in addition to the shower head, and the AC would intermittently shut off which was not ideal for this time of year. As previous Savannah residents, we always wanted to stay at the JW and finally had the opportunity to while we were visiting for a wedding and to also celebrate our anniversary. Needless to say we will not be staying again if we ever have the opportunity to visit Savannah again, and I wouldn’t recommend the JW to any of our friends and family because what we experienced was certainly not worth what we paid or the hassle the entire stay ended up being.

reviews.author: Boy Mom
reviews.title: See the dunks but skip the stay
reviews.body: Not worth what you’re going to pay to stay here. In summary, the staff was inconvenienced by us and severely understaffed. Facility is nice and new but spaces like the pool are starting to show significant wear plus we kept smelling diesel on and off in our room of the three muses.

reviews.author: Ahard
reviews.title: Spa total bust
reviews.body: It is what it is no one could help w spa nightmare

reviews.author: Beautiful Views
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.body: We had a beautiful view. Enjoy the extra features like chocolate on the pillow. The accessible room was wonderful.

reviews.author: CW26
reviews.title: Nice Hotel, No Hot Water
reviews.body: The hotel was very nice as well as the bars and restaurants. However I didn’t have any hot water in my room 3345. I checked in Tuesday and let the front desk know Wednesday morning who advised they would send someone to come fix it. I took a shower Wednesday afternoon and I still didn’t have hot water. I let the front desk know Wednesday evening and they said someone would be sent again to fix it. I took another shower Wednesday night and still no hot water. I checked out Thursday and let the front desk know throughout my whole stay I had to shower in cool water. If not for this big inconvenience I would have given the hotel a 10. For the rooms to be $300-400 a night I thought that this issue would have been fixed immediately.

reviews.author: DeannaH
reviews.title: JW Marriott Savannah Plant Riverside District is an experience not to be missed
reviews.body: The **JW Marriott Savannah Plant Riverside District** was a wonderful place to stay. The staff was exceptionally warm, friendly, and helpful throughout our visit. We especially enjoyed the **Baobab Lounge—the atmosphere, drinks, and food were wonderful**. Because I’m unable to tolerate seed oils, I wasn’t able to eat at some of the other restaurants and bars within the complex, but that certainly didn’t take away from our overall experience. It’s a beautiful, unique property in a fantastic location, and I would **highly recommend it**.

reviews.author: Lindsey
reviews.title: Good stay, disappointing checkout
reviews.body: Hotel was very nice and staff was friendly. Only negatives during stay was that the gym had no air conditioning and one night that we submitted our dining voucher for room service the voucher amount was not actually taken off the bill. Didn’t know until I got my itemized receipt from checkout and reviewed once home. Also, was charged nightly destination fee despite it already being included through my booking with delta vacations. Called to dispute and the staff member refused to refund the money. Truthfully wouldn’t stay here again just because of that.

reviews.author: Alabama
reviews.title: My favorite Marriott
reviews.body: Beautiful art / decor / unique

reviews.author: Fabulous stay
reviews.title: Great getaway
reviews.body: Great stay ay our favourite place

reviews.author: Rob R
reviews.title: Great Vemue
reviews.body: Outstanding Property with great bars, food, and location.

reviews.author: Patti VS
reviews.title: Best place ever
reviews.body: We stay here every time we are in Savannah!  Best service and atmosphere!!

reviews.author: NYCfamily2026
reviews.title: Enjoyable stay
reviews.body: We went for a quick trip to Savannah we enjoyed the hotel. The hotel pool was great for the kids on a hot August afternoon. The hotel has nice rooms and we liked our balcony with the river view.

reviews.author: White Review
reviews.title: Kristi and Terry Savannah Trip
reviews.body: Wonderful experience! Will be returning

reviews.author: Char
reviews.title: An Amazing Experience
reviews.body: The JW Marriott Savannah Plant Hotel is an amazing hotel. It is absolutely beautiful and breath taking. The staff is just as amazing. Professional and sincerely want to provide you with great customer service. There is so many great restaurants to choose from. It was a great experience and I will certainly be going back.

reviews.author: Webber
reviews.title: Fabulous Place
reviews.body: This was a fabulous place to stay.  The staff was always smiling and willing to help even if it was just to decide on close areas to explore.  The restaurants were fabulous with lots of different foods to choose from.

reviews.author: PlatinumEric
reviews.title: Great hotel, but some gaps.
reviews.body: Nice hotel located right on the water - providing great views of the passing ocean freighters.  Hotel lobby is 10+ stars - simply gorgeous.  Lots of artwork work, fossils, rocks etc to look at.  Check in was a breeze - upgraded to a 1 King river view room (from city view).  Food at Turbine Market was very good, but service was lacking.  Hotel fitness center and pool were both very nice - clean and never busy.  The premium WiFi for Bonvoy elite members was not good.  Very slow (<10Mbps up/down).  That’s very subpar and leads to a poor guest experience.  Plenty to do outside nearby the hotel - morning run along the river and into town, walk to dinner, shopping, etc.  Fix the WiFi and the bad service at Turbine and this becomes an ‘excellent’ rating.

reviews.author: Happy Traveler
reviews.title: Wonderful surprise stay at JW Marriott
reviews.body: Can't wait to return for another soul quenching visit to one of my favorite hotels.

reviews.author: One Eye Willie
reviews.title: Savannah Sunshine
reviews.body: The JW Marriott Savannah Plant Riverside District is an experience in itself.  The whole area is filled with wonderful shops, restaurants, coffee spots, places to hang out and take in the moment.  It’s also right in the middle of the Riverside experience off of the premise…. Overall great location and fantastic place to stay.  If you can, get a room on the river side and enjoy the ships and people going by.

reviews.author: ASuzee82026
reviews.title: 10 out of 10, highly recommend
reviews.body:
I had a wonderful stay at the JW Marriott Savannah Plant Riverside District. The hotel is absolutely beautiful, with a unique atmosphere, gorgeous décor, and an amazing location right along the river. There is so much to see and do within walking distance, which made exploring Savannah very convenient.

My room was comfortable and well maintained, and I really enjoyed the variety of restaurants, shops, and entertainment available right at the property. The rooftop views and overall ambiance were definitely highlights of my stay.

The staff was welcoming and helpful, and the hotel felt upscale while still being relaxing and enjoyable. I would definitely recommend the JW Marriott Plant Riverside District to anyone visiting Savannah. I look forward to staying here again!

reviews.author: Echo
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: This place is beautiful with everything at your fingertips

reviews.author: JG2289
reviews.title: Excellent hotel with amazing front desk staff!
reviews.body: The Westin has the best front desk staff team I have ever interacted with at any hotel. They were so genuinely kind and helpful and seemed legitimately happy to be present and be of assistance. The room was clean, the spa was nice, the overall experience was great. The convenience to the conference center is unmatched!

reviews.title: Our stay at the Westin
reviews.body: From the moment we arrived from the valet service to front desk we were treated extremely well

reviews.author: Roman
reviews.title: A good hotel but not great.
reviews.body:
Two nights stay generally good but it is clear the hotel has seen better days. Lacklustre reception on arrival followed by poor hose keeping service. I should not take two visits to reception and two wait for fresh towels to be delivered. A real shame as the location of the hotel is very good.
One of the more expensive hotels we stayed at on our trip but certainly not the best.

reviews.author: Kiki
reviews.title: Should be better for the Westin Name
reviews.body: The hotel was nice and clean. There were some hiccups at check in. Pool restaurant bar closed too early for food options. Food choices were limited in all areas.

reviews.author: Savannah Birthday Weekend
reviews.title: Savannah Birthday
reviews.body: Great Location.  Family Favorite.  Suites are always lovely.  Governor's Suite did not Disappoimt

reviews.author: Serge A
reviews.title: Crown Jewels
reviews.body:
One of the best resorts I have ever stayed at. Well located away from the hustle of downtown Savannah. Has plenty of amenities worth your time. 
The pool and jacuzzi were very nice. Didn’t get the chance to try the gold or tennis but i really had a Good time.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.title: Great view of Savannah riverfront.
reviews.body: Excellent location even for being across the river from the Savannah downtown area. Water shuttle to downtown was extremely convenient. Hotel is dated. Needs an update badly. Bathroom is dark and tub/shower is too worn for this type of a room. Expect this in a room 1/4 of the price. Carpet is bad shape. Grounds were pretty clean and staff was nice.

reviews.author: Customer DisService
reviews.title: Westin Customer DISservice
reviews.body: The front desk staff at the Westin Savannah Harbor Golf Resort and Spa treated me rudely and disrespectfully. I have never been treated so rudely in my life by hotel staff. I charged my very expensive dinner from the Aqua Star Restaurant to my room, where I had my debit card on file. When they ran my card for the charge, my bank flagged the transaction as fraudulent and sent me a text to confirm the charge. The problem was, the hotel did not run my card until the middle of the night, and I did not see the text because I was asleep. Instead of sending me a message through the app or calling my cell number, the front desk called my room and woke me up. The lady then demanded I come to the front desk immediately to put another card on file. I was still half asleep when they called the room, and I was very confused. I asked her to repeat what she said, and she yelled and me and told me I had to come to the front desk immediately to put another card on file. I finally realized what she was saying and looked at my cell phone. I was able to confirm the charge with my bank through their app, and told the lady it was taken care of, and to run my card again. She told me no, I was required to come to the front desk immediately. I explained that she had woken me up from sleep and that everything should be fine now, and to run the card again. She told me no again, and said her manager told her I HAD to come to the front desk immediately. I told her I was not. She could either run the card again, or I could come by in the morning, but I would NOT be coming to the front desk in the middle of the night, after I had already been asleep for a few hours. She told me she had already run my card twice, and it was declined, so she didn't need to run it again. I told her that was fine, but I was not coming down to the front desk. She then agreed to run the card a third time, and this time, the charge was approved. She said to me, "it went through" and then she hung up on me. She did NOT apologize. I have NEVER had an experience like that in my life!

reviews.author: Sologal1
reviews.title: Conference Stay
reviews.body: The room was quiet, clean and well stocked with amenities, pillows, blankets and towels.

reviews.author: Krishna
reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.body: Waste of money and time. Disrespectful and very poorly managed.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.title: Review
reviews.body: Excellent customer service, the food was delicious, and my entire stay was amazing. Thanks so much.

reviews.author: RR4651
reviews.title: Relax at Marriott Savannah Westin
reviews.body: The most relaxing time and you will enjoy yourself

reviews.author: DCLC81926
reviews.title: Our Honeymoon!
reviews.body: Great Stay!! We will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: Weary Traveler
reviews.title: A Place to Rest
reviews.body: Upon my arrival, the staff greeted me, offered recommendations, and provided excellent customer care. Likewise throughout my staff, it was nice to see the river views and just simply rest.

reviews.author: Sam000
reviews.title: Wedding Guest
reviews.body: Great area! Really a fabulous experience.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel ad very relaxing
reviews.body: We were welcomed by a very friendly staff, accommodated us by allowing an early check in, gave us a free room upgrade and allowed us a late checkout.   Super relaxing atmosphere. Definitely would stay again.

reviews.author: Tone
reviews.title: Really lovely place to stay!
reviews.body: Very relaxing and peaceful. Beautiful setting and just what you expect from a Westin property!

reviews.author: KRC 6
reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.body: The only part of my stay that disappointed me was the weather.  Unfortunately, rain kept me from golfing but everything that they could control was outstanding.  Looking forward to my next visit and getting to play the course!

reviews.author: Erin L
reviews.title: Amenities nice, but rooms need significant upgrades
reviews.body:
I want to start by saying the staff we encountered from the front desk to the hotel restaurants to the spa were all extremely professional and attentive. 

The grounds around the resort, including the pool area, are well kept and manicured. Our kids loved swimming in the pool and the other activities offered, including nightly smores by the pool at the fire pit. 

Ok now onto the negative and why we won’t be staying there again unless the rooms are updated. The room we were put in was filthy, unsafe and very outdated. I could overlook the outdated aspect (think no usb/usb c plugs, etc) but the rest was definitely not what I would expect given how this hotel bills itself a resort. 

To start, both the carpet and the furniture (couch) were stained, the carpet pretty significantly. The sofa mattress was also covered in yellow and dark brown (presumably blood) stains, a fact I was annoyed to discover when I went to make the bed for my children that first night after a long day of travel. I called the front desk and housekeeping initially sent up a mattress cover that was both way too large for the mattress and had a broken zipper. I requested a new mattress given the nature of the stains. They replaced the stained memory foam one with a thin, raggedy coil mattress that looked like it was manufactured 30 years ago. Luckily my children were okay with the coils poking their back but I can’t imagine any adult being able to sleep on it.

The room had one bathtub. As I mentioned, we have small children. We stayed four nights and five days and I didn’t feel comfortable bathing them in the tub once, resorting to showers (which as anyone who has small children knows, is quite difficult!). The bathtub looked like it had at one point been poorly reglazed or painted and the paint was coming off the basin of the tub in huge chunks. I was worried my children would try to ingest the paint chips not knowing what they were and frankly couldn’t believe the staff put someone in a room without fixing the bathtub first.

Finally, I am a nursing mother and our infant is young enough that she still only eats breastmilk. On the last night at 11 pm, I realized our in-room mini fridge broke and would only stay on until someone opened the door. Once the door was open, it would go off until you hit the on/off button again (and would only stay on until the door was opened again). Luckily I realized it in time to save my breastmilk, otherwise it would’ve been absolutely disastrous for my family. 

We were there with a family group to celebrate a big milestone birthday and my other family members reported similar conditions for their rooms (stained carpets, furniture, etc)

reviews.author: Great Hotel
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: This is a great place to stay.

reviews.author: Potter060
reviews.title: Not the Experience We Expected
reviews.body:
I recently stayed at the Westin Savannah Golf Resort at this location for a short, two-day family getaway to attend a Savannah Bananas baseball game. Unfortunately, several issues during our stay made the experience disappointing.

Upon arriving in our room, it did not appear that the room had been properly vacuumed. The bathroom also appeared very outdated and is definitely in need of some updates or upgrades. There was peeling paint on the walls and around the tub, and the overall condition of the bathroom appeared unclean.

The tub and sink both had significant drainage issues. I reported these problems to the front desk, but no one ever addressed them during our stay. While taking a shower, the water would fill the tub above my ankles because it was not draining properly. The sink would also nearly back up when washing our hands or brushing our teeth.

Throughout the day, I noticed several roaches in different areas of the property, including the lobby and around the corner from the kitchen preparation area. I reported this to the front desk, but the response I received was, “Well, what do you expect? There’s trees everywhere around here.” While I understand that being around trees and vegetation can contribute to insects, I have stayed at many other properties in similar environments and have never experienced this level of an issue. The employee also did not make any effort to investigate the locations I reported or ask me to show her where I had seen them.

The customer service the following morning was another disappointment. On Saturday morning, as we were preparing to leave, I asked where the snack bar was. I was told that they do not put the snacks out in the morning. I then asked if my younger children could have some of the cereal or Pop-Tarts that I could see were available, since it was breakfast time. The response was, “Well, if they’re hungry enough, they need to go over there,” while pointing toward a small coffee shop.

I understand that hotels have rules and policies, and I certainly respect that. However, basic customer service and a willingness to accommodate guests can go a long way. The response from the front desk was unnecessary and came across as disrespectful, particularly when traveling with young children.

Overall, between the condition of the room and bathroom, unresolved maintenance issues, roaches throughout the property, and the lack of professionalism and customer service from the front desk, our stay was far below what I expected. I hope management takes this feedback seriously and addresses these issues so future guests have a much better experience.

reviews.author: Carla T 1221
reviews.title: 16th Floor Balcony Room
reviews.body: Fabulous view of the historic river district

reviews.author: New Jersey Couple
reviews.title: Summer Getaway
reviews.body: Great stay on the river! We had a wonderful view of the river and staff were very hospitable and helpful.

reviews.author: Terry Oh
reviews.title: Underwhelming
reviews.body: A resort — with no bar or restaurant open between 3pm - 5pm and noon pool service. Very good food and service at Aqua for dinner. Very poor food at breakfast. Common areas have been upgraded. Our room was dismally outdated and the patio door didn’t close properly, leaving us to listen to neighbors socializing on the patios well into the night. Almost no Bonvoy recognition. Couldn’t find a king bed or an upgraded room in what appeared to be a near empty hotel.

reviews.author: SteveP
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.body: Fantastic hotel with a great pool and restaurant. The water taxi was right next to hotel which made it convenient for travel.

reviews.author: Westerner
reviews.title: A+ w/ one exception
reviews.body: Staff was friendly, considerate and professional from minute one of our stay. One late night hiccup did not ruin our overall experience.

reviews.author: Beverly
reviews.title: A Big Disappointment
reviews.body: The hotel was not worth the price

reviews.author: OSU Buckeye
reviews.title: Best on the River
reviews.body: A great place to stay and enjoy Savannah.

reviews.author: Golfers Dream Trip
reviews.title: Westin Golf Getaway
reviews.body: The Staff and amenities provided an excellent experience for the weekend getaway! Highly recommend if in the Savannah area to book a stay at the Westin Resort & SPA!

reviews.author: Stasi605
reviews.title: Could use improvement for a “higher end” resort
reviews.body: I was very disappointed in this resort…the food was TERRIBLE and the service at the pool bar was also TERRIBLE..The beds were very uncomfortable.  Also there are several “restaurants” on the resort and they are not clearly marked…. One of them  is on the second floor of the hotel and it should be marked in the elevator or by the elevator so you don’t have to search for it.

reviews.author: Amazing Stay
reviews.title: Amazing stay at SpringHills Suites
reviews.body: Stayed at SprngHill Suites for a 5 day conference. The location was okay. It was very quiet and safe, however about a 15 min walk to the ferry and shuttle area to the convention centre.  5-8 mins to restaurants.  Check in was quick and easy.  The room was very clean, spacious, well equipped and well maintained.  The facility was very clean and open.  The staff were very courteous, warm and helpful.  The breakfast was very fresh; wide variety and prepared food and drinks.  Lemon water and coffees throughout.  I didn't try the onsite restaurant "Toasters" however my colleagues said it was very good.  I would definitely book a stay here again, if I'm back in Savannah.

reviews.author: Anonymous GG
reviews.title: The staff was wonderful. The facility not so much
reviews.body:
The staff were wonderful!
The facility itself and room items are not. 
Considering the price of this room the facility was very lackluster. Carefully consider your stay.

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.title: Springhill Suites Savannah
reviews.body: This facility is clean, spacious and the staff are friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Abe
reviews.title: Labor Day week stay
reviews.body: The hotel is in a good location and valet parking is available. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel is within walking distance to most attractions, including bars and restaurants. There is a bar attached to the hotel and the drinks were well made and they had snack food like grilled cheese and chicken wings.

reviews.author: SCAD Parent
reviews.title: Great location. Nice staff.
reviews.body: Spent one night with my son who was starting college the next day. The location was very convenient and the room was clean and comfortable. Both breakfast and the attached restaurant were average, but overall a good stay and we’d return.

reviews.author: Alf4au
reviews.title: Nice stay, but plenty of room for improvement.
reviews.body: The room was nice but did need some minor repairs. I was caught off guard when I found out parking was going to cost me $40 per night. The food for breakfast was satisfactory for hotel food.

reviews.author: SCADmom
reviews.title: SCAD move in
reviews.body: This was a great location for move in week!

reviews.author: Boldmc1
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.body: Some things can be updated

reviews.author: Steverino
reviews.title: Springhill Suites Savannah
reviews.body: Very nicely appointed facility. Friendly and helpful staff. Convenient to Downtown Savannah restaurants and bars as well as activities.

reviews.author: Nancy Hearts
reviews.title: Hotel in a great location. Short walk to the Savannah theatre and we visited to see the Les Miserables performance.
reviews.body: Such a good value. Clean, nice staff-especially Bert, the concierge. She has a smile that lights up the lobby! She deserves a raise!

reviews.author: Government Employee
reviews.title: Worst Stay Ever
reviews.body: The worst stay ever. I have a video of an ant crawling in my bed. I also have a picture of the missing cover from my door where you place your electronic key.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Dirty room, manager didn’t seem empathetic or make it right
reviews.body: I’m sorry, I rarely ever write bad reviews. But my room was very dirty and was only offered 10k points as compensation. Manager was not empathetic. Please save yourself the hassle and disgust, stay somewhere else. Rented two rooms, asked for the filthy room to be comped. Human hairs and dirt and debris everywhere including in shower, toilette, kitchenette, desk, and floor. Dozens of hairs, what looked like human body fluids on table next to bed, chunks of food or other debris on shelf. Smears on wall. This is NOT up to Marriott standards. Had the nerve to send me email asking me to rate at least 9 or 10 because good reviews are important to them. Spend more time cleaning and less time angling for undeserved good reviews.

reviews.author: MikieG
reviews.title: Roominess in the heart of the city
reviews.body:
My reviews are generally a critique for the property owners on how to make a good property into an excellent one, and how to make an excellent one into a great one.

The location is tops. Set along the tree lined Oglethorpe Avenue, it's smack dab between the Old Town and Historic District, both of which are an easy walking distance. While the building is not new, it's in good shape and the staff were very friendly.

I do have to report three issues with the room. What's the most important thing about a hotel? Is it the lobby? Restaurant? Shower? No, it's the bed, and the one in my room (319) was very soft and dipped in the middle. Thinking that this may be an issue only with my room, I asked friends who were traveling with my wife and I about theirs and they reported the identical thing. So in other words, it's time for a hard-goods update. Another issue was with the A/C. While it blew plenty of cold air, the fan never turned off when the compressor was off, even though the fan control was set to "Auto". This meant that moist, humid air was constantly filling the room when the compressor was at rest. And lastly, the room only had one nightstand. This required me to use my roll aboard suitcase to hold my phone and eyeglasses. This must have been a one-up since my friends room did have two.

The size of the room was very good and the shower's hot water and pressure were excellent.

Should my comments dissuade you from checking into this property, probably not since the location can't be beat and the staff was friendly and inviting.

reviews.author: S12345
reviews.title: Cleaning Quality Needs Improvement
reviews.body:
Our room was dirty and had disgusting stuff in it. There was no body wash or conditioner.
The pool was also very dirty. After our stay, my child got hand, foot, and mouth disease.

This was not acceptable, and we are very disappointed

reviews.author: Mr and Mrs Meyers
reviews.title: Mr and Mrs
reviews.body: Excellent stay. People were great

reviews.author: Vacationers
reviews.title: Stop over
reviews.body: Very nice room with separate room with couch.  Very modern feel.  Great location to see the historic area.

reviews.author: Connecticut Guest
reviews.title: A great place to stay in Savannah!
reviews.body: Our stay at the Springhill Suite by Marriott Savannah Downtown/Historic District was most enjoyable.  the accommodations were updated and clean.  The Continental Breakfast which was offered daily offered a very nice variety of breakfast foods which were tasty.   The in-house restaurant - Toasted! had delicious offerings and a pleasant atmosphere.  The trip to downtown Savannah (restaurants and shops) was walkable and very convenient.  My only suggestion is that more hooks or towel racks be available in the showering bathroom.  Otherwise, I would highly recommend a stay at this Marriott.

reviews.author: Y wood
reviews.title: Excellence at its best
reviews.body:
I stayed at the Marriott Springfield historic district.  The service when you walked into the door was attentive.  They acknowledged  entrance with greeting.  They asked about your day and assigned your room timely. I ate breakfast at the hotel the next day and the food was hot. The buffet area was cleaned often. It was more than continental breakfast.  We had eggs, sausage, grits, oatmeal, bagels etc. 
The staff even was so attentive to the customers.  It was an awesome family type experience dining and staying at this location. I will return again when I’m in the area and recommend this location to my friends and family

reviews.author: MNDad
reviews.title: Nice weekend in Savannah
reviews.body: We had a great time during out stay! The hotel was nice and it was walking distance to all the downtown scenery and attractions.

reviews.author: Sharry
reviews.title: Awesome stay
reviews.body: Loved everything about our stay. Extremely clean and spacious room. Comfortable beds at pillows. Staff was so sweet and outgoing and ver Welcoming. Location is great and in the historic downtown district.

reviews.author: Jay4083
reviews.title: Amazing stay! Amazing staff!
reviews.body: My stay was great! Last minute to spend the day with my family. The front desk staff was very friendly and helpful. Got me set up with a room in less than 5 minutes! The women working at the information desk was super helpful and probably one of the nicest people I’ve ever met! Breakfast in the morning was very good. My room was clean and the bed was comfortable room was nice and cool and one of the best rates in town. All in all it was a great stay and would definitely stay there again!!!

reviews.author: Satisfied customer
reviews.title: Accessible and comfortable
reviews.body:
It's the 2nd time we have stayed there. Before and after refurbishment. It's lovely. Easily accessible to downtown, riverfront , forts and coast. Valet is necessary despite cost and tips as are all of the local hotel costs for this. 
A+ on the refurbishment. Lobby and rooms look great and it's all very comfortable.

reviews.author: Lois
reviews.title: An Amazing Stay for our Family Reunion!
reviews.body: Management and staff were phenomenal. There was no want, desire, need or request that wasn't  provided with gladness. Management was engaging. Both Management and staff were interactive and were extremely accommodating. The facility was clean and comfortable. The atmosphere was inviting. Smiles were everywhere. They aimed to please and succeeded.

reviews.author: Anna Y
reviews.title: affordable, quality stay in a great location
reviews.body: Really enjoyed out stay.  The room was big enough for 6 people.  Breakfast had something for everyone.  We weren't here long enough, but checked out the gym and were impressed by the spaciousness.  Best part was the location - close enough to lots of sights, shopping and dining!

reviews.author: Jacato13
reviews.title: Great Savannah hotel!
reviews.body: Great hotel with spacious rooms! Beds were all comfortable and it was nice to have the bathrooms with shower and toilet areas in their own separate rooms.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.title: Very Happy
reviews.body: Will return to this location again when in Savannah

reviews.author: Wheeler Family
reviews.title: Vacation Stay
reviews.body: SpringHill Suites by Marriott Savannah Downtown/Historic District Get a 10 out 10 will recommend

reviews.author: SG
reviews.title: Poor Cleaning and Management
reviews.body: Room was not clean: Mold in the bath tub, candy wrappers on the floor, carpet not vacuumed and we requested a vacuum to do it ourselves. When we arrived to our room the door was left opened so it was a little alarming for my family after we had traveled so long with three kids. We were offered a $5 credit for them saying our room was ready for our stay and us having to ask house keeping to clean. Not worth the price, expect your room to be dirty, and I would recommend bringing your own sheets as they are most likely dirty as well as our rooms sheets felt terrible.

reviews.author: Guest072026
reviews.title: Hotel was great with one exception.
reviews.body: Rooms were clean, breakfast excellent, housekeeping and front service desk friendly helpful and courteous.  The only exception was my experience with some valet attendants.  Two in particular tried to collect additional “tips” in order to park.  Parking is added to the bill.  They wanted these cash or funds transferred to a phone number separate from the hotel.  They were very insistent on additional funds.  It took my wife’s intervention and asking questions in order for the two young men to back down.  The hotel is great.  But, that was my only concern with the stay.

reviews.author: KB and Michael
reviews.title: Highly Recommend! Don’t miss Toasted Barrel!
reviews.body:
We love staying at SpringHill Suites in downtown Savannah! We come here a couple times a year for business and always choose this hotel. The location is perfect. Easy walk to all the downtown restaurants and parks and the river. Always friendly staff.
The best part is the Toasted Barrel. We always look forward to seeing our favorite bartender, Megan! Fast, efficient service every time! And so friendly and fun! Keianie is great, too! She runs a tight ship while being friendly and fun as well! And we love the food and the bourbon selection. We highly recommend this hotel, and be sure to say hi to Megan!!!

reviews.author: Blue
reviews.title: Nice Place/Location, Don’t Stay on Top Floor
reviews.body: We really liked the decor and amenities of the room, but I would have asked to change rooms if we were staying more than one night. We were in room 604. It must be just below the roof units for the air conditioning, because we heard constant loud mechanical noises throughout our stay. The ambient noise level in the bedroom was 47 dB (measured on Apple Watch). The quietest place was in the bathroom. So, I had a little trouble sleeping. That’s our only complaint. Nice hotel otherwise.

reviews.author: KJDudd
reviews.title: Gorgeous and stunning! You need The Ann in your life!
reviews.body: Words can not describe how nice this property is. I have been a Moxy fan until I stayed at The Ann. The design, cleanliness and friendliness of the staff were all added perks. I LOVED my solo retreat. The Ann made me feel at home while away from home.

reviews.author: L827
reviews.title: The Ann in Savannah is the Best
reviews.body: The Ann is easily walkable to the Riverfront. The Loft design is charming. The Staff were lovely. This is a great find for the price,

reviews.author: C1Galvez
reviews.title: Wonderful accommodations lacking basic customer service
reviews.body: We checked in during the late evening hours after a long out of state drive.  Upon check in things were fantastic until we inquired about the summary of charges to our account.  The front desk staff was aggressive & confrontational with our request to understand what the destination fee included.

reviews.author: PLK2626
reviews.title: Great choice for apartment style experience
reviews.body: Apartment style stay and steps away from the heart of Savannah. The only things missing were a pool and room service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kcfan001
reviews.title: Perfect for family
reviews.body: The two bedroom was almost perfect. It had almost everything we needed for a long weekend. It was nice having our own bedrooms, a fully stocked kitchen plus a washer and dryer in the unit. There was very little cabinet space in main bathroom, adding some shelves might be nice. Also had a difficult time getting the bedrooms as cool as we would've liked for sleeping.

reviews.author: K from FL
reviews.title: Rude staff
reviews.body: Pleasant stay until the afternoon associate was at the front desk. Very rude, frequently relaying information from a supervisor or manager that was denied by the supervisor and manager. Rude behavior never corrected. Checked out early than planned. First hotel review I’ve ever posted. Elite member.

reviews.author: Dan Bunch
reviews.title: THE PLACE TO STAY
reviews.body: You will not find a better place in Savannah.  It is unique and perfectly located.  Staff are flawlessly accommodating

reviews.author: Kellumbear
reviews.title: Our New Savannah Home!
reviews.body:
We stayed at The Ann Savannah, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy, last Sunday night, July 26, and from the moment we arrived, we knew we had found our new Savannah home away from home. The atmosphere was welcoming, polished, and full of energy, with a great vibe that started at the front desk, continued with the valet team, and carried right through to The James café.

We were faithful guests of The Westin Savannah Harbour from 2007 through 2024, but in recent years their customer service took a sudden and disappointing decline. Now we know why: the warmth, professionalism, and hospitality we had loved for so long seem to have found a new home at The Ann.

The apartment itself was beautifully appointed, with comfortable furniture, thoughtful touches throughout, and a well-stocked kitchen that made the stay feel easy and relaxed. Everything felt fresh, intentional, and designed for guests who appreciate both comfort and convenience.

The gym was another highlight. It was spacious, comfortable, and thankfully not too cold, which is something we often notice in other hotel gyms. We also loved being able to log into our YouTube account on the TVs, which made workouts feel more personal and enjoyable.

If I could ask for one improvement, it would be a little more water pressure in the shower. Even so, that small note did not take away from what was an outstanding stay. I am genuinely excited to call The Ann Savannah my new destination whenever I come to Savannah.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: This is an excellent hotel.  Everything about it is just wonderful.  Very clean, beautifully decorated, and comfortable.  About a 10 minute (or less) walk to the river walk and other local restaurants/bars.  I really can't say enough about this hotel.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Wal123
reviews.title: Add $83 for parking for 24 hrs
reviews.body: Rooms are great, but staff was not very friendly. Customer service lacking.

reviews.author: TravelMom
reviews.title: Great space and location
reviews.body: The Ann is well-staffed, well-appointed and in a great location. We walked everywhere and loved that we didn't have to come back to a cramped hotel room. Our only negative was the lack of pool despite the website saying there is a pool (with pictures included). We will definitely stay here again and otherwise loved it.

reviews.author: J Will
reviews.title: Nice Gem
reviews.body: The Ann was spacious apartment style hotel room with all the amenities you could neee including a washer and dryer. Only thing was shower pressure in the bathroom left a lot to be desired.

reviews.author: Chrissy D
reviews.title: Loved My Apartment
reviews.body: I wish I could’ve stayed longer. I felt at home and really comfortable. The unit smelled brand new and came with all the amenities that anyone would have in an apartment. The boat was comfortable, and the room was spacious. My only issue was the walls were really thin. I could hear everything, and I mean everything, that the neighbors were doing. I didn’t let that spoil my trip. The valley staff was wonderful.I would absolutely stay at The Ann again.

reviews.author: Dawn K
reviews.title: Perfect for a family stay
reviews.body: The location of the Ann is perfect. Could easily walk to anything that we wanted to do. The accommodation was industrial. We had 4 bdrms and 4 baths which was perfect for our family of 5. We didnt have room to all sit comfortably in the living area but honestly we were too tired most nights to take advantage. The only negative is that the pool was closed a lot (and the hours are perplexing when it was open..should be later than 6) We would stay here again without a doubt. Much better than an air b&b..thank you Southern Living for the write up..we would not have known about it otherwise!

reviews.author: 12dg
reviews.title: Poor communication
reviews.body:
The hotel staff and the cleaning staff were never on the same page. The cleaning crew kept coming and knocking on my door asking if I was checking out a few different times during my stay. The hotel staff also kept insisting that the hotel “doesn't do 4PM checkout” even though I requested it in the app, and it got approved by someone. If this is hotel policy then it needs to be displayed in multiple places so there’s no confusion. 

The hotel is also in a rough area and parking is not ideal because two days during the week, the streets are off limits for street cleaning. The hotel offers $50/night valet parking which is fine if you’re only staying a few nights. 

Our room had a small kitchen area with stove and microwave and a dishwasher. This was nice because we stayed for a few weeks waiting for the house to close that we bought. But honestly, the layout is still tight because the living area is really small as is the bedroom. 

Last thing I will say is that the hotel staff was just polite enough as they deemed necessary but definitely not friendly, which was evident when I brought issues to their attention that needed rectification.

reviews.author: Mvil4
reviews.title: Beautiful place and great location
reviews.body: We enjoyed the room very much. Nicely decorated. Good location to visit Savannah

reviews.author: Juliana
reviews.title: Great Place for Families!
reviews.body:
Here's a more balanced review that feels credible while 

We stayed at The Ann Savannah for several nights in June 2026 while visiting with our family, including our one-year-old. Overall, we had a great stay and would return, but there are a few areas where the hotel could improve.

The biggest strengths are the location and the property itself. The hotel is beautiful, the suites are spacious and well-designed, and it's within easy reach of Savannah's historic attractions. We also loved having Little James right next door—it became one of our favorite spots for coffee, breakfast, and a quick bite.

The valet team truly stood out. Shia and Ish were consistently warm, professional, and incredibly helpful. They greeted us every day with a smile and made coming and going effortless.

Where the experience fell a little short was housekeeping and the front desk. Our suite hadn't been cleaned as thoroughly as we expected before arrival—we found dust bunnies and small beads on the floor, which was concerning with a crawling toddler. We ended up doing a bit of cleaning ourselves. We also had to request additional supplies like trash bags and toilet paper more than once, and it took longer than expected to receive them. The first Pack 'n Play we were given was broken and had to be replaced, although the staff did resolve it.

The front desk was less welcoming than we had hoped. We completely understand that early check-in isn't always possible, but the interaction felt a bit dismissive rather than helpful or accommodating.

One thing to be aware of is that while the hotel itself felt safe and we never experienced any issues, there are a few surrounding blocks that seemed a little rougher than other parts of the Historic District, especially at night.

Overall, I'd give The Ann Savannah an 8/10. The beautiful property, excellent location, and exceptional valet staff outweighed the shortcomings, and we'd absolutely consider staying here again on a future visit to Savannah.

reviews.author: Naz80
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body:
We recently stayed at The Ann Savannah, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy, and it was an absolute delight! From the moment I arrived, I felt right at home in this beautiful all-suite property in the heart of Savannah’s Historic District. 
The location is fantastic—perfectly situated at 110 Ann Street on the western edge of the historic district, just steps from the Savannah College of Art and Design (SCAD) and within easy walking distance to iconic squares, River Street, great restaurants, and all the charming sights Savannah has to offer. It’s ideal whether you’re there for business, a romantic getaway, or exploring the city like a local. ￼
The cleanliness throughout the hotel was impeccable. The spacious suites felt fresh, modern, and thoughtfully maintained, with high-quality finishes and that signature residential-style comfort. Everything from the kitchenettes to the living areas was spotless, making it easy to truly relax and settle in.
What really stood out, though, was the friendly staff. Everyone—from the front desk to housekeeping—went out of their way to be welcoming and helpful. Their warm Southern hospitality made the stay feel personal and effortless. They were quick to offer recommendations and ensure every detail was taken care of.
The apartment-style suites are generously sized with modern comforts, and the overall vibe blends relaxed sophistication with a genuine sense of place. Whether you’re cooking a quick meal in your suite or unwinding after a day of sightseeing, The Ann delivers the perfect mix of hotel service and home-like freedom.
I highly recommend The Ann Savannah for anyone visiting Savannah. It’s more than just a hotel—it’s a wonderful base for making the city feel like your own. Can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: FSIstudent 1
reviews.title: My stay
reviews.body: Overall the stay was good for my needs. I did not like the polished concrete floors it felt too industrial. There was no slippers or robes which is normally available at a Marriott. The gym could use more variety of equipment, especially for long stay guests.

reviews.author: Lola
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.body: Apartments were spacious and very clean. Equipped with everything you need. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Ari15
reviews.title: Great concept
reviews.body: We definitely love the apartment experience with a hotel service

reviews.author: Shanekia
reviews.title: A1! Unimaginable
reviews.body: I really didn't know what to expect when booking The Ann Savannah, we have stayed in several Marriott. We normally do. And I am hardly ever disappointed. However, these apartments take Marriott to a different level. I was so impressed with the esthetics. The modernization, the amenities within the apartment. Just enough space with everything that you need. And just everywhere you look, things were intentionally placed. I really loved the fact that everything that you need is on-site. All the spaces are well-thought-out. And then there is a small cafe restaurant right across the walkway. Where you can have drinks, you can have breakfast or lunch, coffee is available. There is a sitting area for relaxing and gathering. The staff was wonderful, valet was wonderful and very convenient. There are plenty of restaurants within the area. You can walk everywhere you don't really need to drive. So I really love this, we'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Savannah local
reviews.title: Improve Hospitality
reviews.body: Work on the hospitality of your crew and you'll start to separate yourself from other hotels in the city.

reviews.author: FL510
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.body:
The first room I was given had several issues: the HVAC system was very noisy, the sink didn't drain, and the shower's sliding door didn’t close all the way. I requested a different room, which was better, but the HVAC was still a little noisy.

I also had problems with housekeeping. I asked for service on Monday instead of Saturday, but no one came. After speaking with the front desk, I was told housekeeping would come on Tuesday. They still didn't show up, and it wasn't until I followed up again that service was finally provided on Wednesday. What was especially disappointing was that no one offered an explanation or apology for the repeated oversight.

Overall, most of the front desk staff came across as uninterested and unwelcoming.

The valet service was generally good, but there were a couple of issues. On one occasion, no valet attendant was available, and I had to wait about 10 minutes. When I checked out of the hotel, I scheduled my car to be ready at 4:00 a.m., but it wasn't brought out until 4:23 a.m.

Lastly, this is not the hotel’s fault at all, but you need to be careful when you order something delivered to the hotel. I made 3 Amazon orders while I was staying there, and they delivered my packages to a wrong place twice.

reviews.author: Craig
reviews.title: Fraud by F&B staff - very disappointed and ruined stay
reviews.body: Great location and facility but unfortunately our stay was ruined by staff member fraudulently adding additional tip onto the bill without my consent and despite reporting the GM has failed to respond or come back to me.

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.title: Beautiful place to stay!
reviews.body: My husband and I were visiting Savannah for the first time and having enough space and amenities was very important to us, staying at The Ann Savannah was perfect! Plenty of space, everything we could need provided for us and the staff was wonderful! We felt safe and looked after!

reviews.author: RHawkins 318
reviews.title: You stay for the best in town but leave wanting much more
reviews.body: If you stay just for the room, you will be blown away, just at all means stay away from the check in staff, if you like rude privilege go for it, for us at 500.00 per Nite we are good. Had better service at any 2nd teer motels.

reviews.author: James
reviews.title: Great place in Savannah
reviews.body: Great rooms with great dinning and right in the heart of the historic district

reviews.author: I love Savannah
reviews.title: On your own
reviews.body: Space was beautiful, the service was awful. No forthcoming information on any amenities and most time no one at the desk. Parking was super expensive through 3rd party and the attendant felt it appropriate to mom talk to my wife. When we called after our trip about a billing issue got nothing but curt answers, hung up on and no call back.

reviews.author: Jennifer888
reviews.title: What a pleasure
reviews.body: Stepping out of your car you are warmly greeting, bags taken - true Southern hello!   The team at the Perry Hotel was fantastic, accomodating and on point!

reviews.author: Jean P
reviews.title: Perry Lane Hotel is an amazing experience
reviews.body: My friends and I were in Savannah for the first time. We chose Perry Lane for its central location. We didn't realize how luxurious the property was while also being very friendly. Savon was amazing and gave us many ideas for our trip.

reviews.author: MelB23
reviews.title: They knocked it out of the park!
reviews.body: Stayed at Perry Lane Hotel to celebrate my 50th birthday, with zero regrets. From the moment we pulled up out front until we left, the Perry Lane team excelled and went above and beyond to deliver a truly memorable, special experience for me and my friends (most who had traveled across the country). You guys really know how to make a gal feel special. I'll be back!

reviews.author: Jonathan E
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Excellent Staff
reviews.body: We loved our stay at Perry Lane Hotel. The rooms were impeccably clean, the hotel feels luxurious throughout, and the rooftop was a highlight. What really stood out was the exceptional hospitality. Every staff member was welcoming and helpful, making this the perfect place to end our trip. Easily our favorite hotel of the week.

reviews.author: Justin
reviews.title: Great staff sketchy AC
reviews.body: Everyone was nice AC would not stay cold

reviews.author: Marianne
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.body: Everything was perfect here. Comfortable bed, soft expensive  sheets and duvet, clean room, and a staff that was professional yet personable. The lp driver was awesome. Great central location and a fantastic restaurant (The Emporium)

reviews.author: Ron J
reviews.title: Souther Hospitality at its finest
reviews.body:
My stay at Perry Lane Hotel was exceptional from beginning to end. From the moment we arrived until the moment we departed, the entire staff consistently exceeded our expectations.

Every team member we encountered was attentive, pleasant, professional, and genuinely welcoming. What stood out most was the consistency of the service whether interacting with the front desk, valet, housekeeping, or other members of the hotel team, we were always greeted warmly and made to feel like valued guests.

The staff anticipated our needs, responded promptly to every request, and demonstrated the type of genuine hospitality that elevates a hotel stay from simply enjoyable to truly memorable. There was a noticeable attention to detail throughout our visit, and the team seemed genuinely committed to ensuring we had an outstanding experience.

Perry Lane Hotel is a beautiful property, but the people are what truly distinguish it. Exceptional hospitality requires more than a beautiful setting it requires a team that understands service, attentiveness, and how to make guests feel welcomed and appreciated. Perry Lane delivered on all three.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would absolutely return. I highly recommend Perry Lane Hotel to anyone visiting Savannah and looking for an elevated experience complemented by outstanding service. Thank you to the entire Perry Lane team for making our stay so memorable!

reviews.author: Kashuta
reviews.title: Top notch stay with all the amenities
reviews.body:
We absolutely loved our stay at your hotel and can’t wait to visit again soon! All of the staff was amazing and so friendly. The ladies at the front desk were always so helpful and accommodating.
 We adored the champagne while on breaks from exploring the city. The beautiful tray of sweets was divine and we loved snacking on it throughout the weekend. The complimentary hotel shuttle around the historic district was much appreciated. Our driver was fantastic and gave us great recommendations for the evening. The bedding and towels were luxurious and the beds were so comfy after a long day of exploring.

reviews.author: Syd1996
reviews.title: Fabulous stay!
reviews.body: 10/10 on everything! We had an amazing stay!

reviews.author: 76West
reviews.title: Magical Fun Stays at the Perry Lane Jotel
reviews.body: You will never regret staying at the Perry Lane Hotel.  You are greeted the moment you arrive.  Your luggage is taken in, door is opened and you are greeted at check-in.  You are asked if you would like a glass of wine, champagne or water.  Prior to arriving you work with Chef Randy Rodriguez who will work with you in setting up reservations for dinner and activities.  I tried on my own to get a reservation for dinner and the restaurant did not have availability.  When I talked to Chef Randy before arriving, he made a call to the restaurant and I had a reservation!  Chef Randy is outstanding!!!  Every time you leave for an adventure or return from an adventure the front door is always opened for you.  Everyone greets you with a smile, front desk, dining and bar area, roof top bar  and I mean everywhere!  You have great quiet areas where you can sit and read a book.  If you would like some ice, you simply ask the front desk and it will be delivered to your door.  If you come back from your adventure and your hands are full, someone immediately helps you with your bags.  Everyone at the Perry Lane goes above and beyond with customer service.  Such an outstanding place to stay!!  I keep coming back!!

reviews.author: Lost Again
reviews.title: Luxury hotel in Davannah
reviews.body:
From the moment we arrived to the moment we left we felt welcomed, as if we were long lost friends. From the valets who went out of their way to be helpful to the receptionists attending to our every need including a Welcoming Glass of Champagne on arrival. The check in process was quick and in no time we were heading for our room.
The hotel is as you would expect from a Luxury collection hotel top class and has every amenity you can wish for. The rooms are Luxurious, functional and were immaculately clean. The location of the hotel is excellent for everything that you may or may not want to do whilst in Savannah and as others have commented it's a short walk to the shops and the riverside. Top tip, Take Bull Street for lovely parks, squares and shade as you stroll towards the river. There is also a complementary limo service (gratuity based) that will whisk you anywhere in a two mile radius of the hotel.
Coffee is available just off the main reception area in the hotel which then links to the restaurant for Breakfast or other meals. It offers free coffee all day to residents and makes up for the lack of coffee making in the room, although I would say that I almost prefer the free coffee aspect to the sometimes, "dodgy" coffee makers, that I have come across in the past at other hotels. However, I can't complete my review with mentioning the stand out quality of all the Staff and naming them all would be Completely justified. However Randy really helped us with all our sightseeing and tickets, Precious and Reign at reception. Along with Kevin, Freddie and Iverson on the front door. Our room was also cleaned daily to a very high standard.
This is, in my opinion, thee place to stay in Savannah and I would highly recommend it to you.

reviews.author: Lee R
reviews.title: Musty stay on the floors and rooms
reviews.body:
We came back to Perry Lane for its convenience to the lovely squares, restaurants, and shopping. On our first visit, we noticed a strong musty and moldy smell on the floors and more disturbing in our roll when the air conditioner ran. 
We came back because we enjoyed the ability to walk to shopping and dinning

This time there was a machine outside the elevators that attempted to cover up the musty scent. Our room also smelled musty and moldy when the AC ran. This moldy scent caused both of us to find a supply of antihistamines to stop our noses from running  and eyes weeping. We will opt to stay elsewhere - the bedding was also soft and mushy. We will definitely stay elsewhere because we needef to avoid our room because of its uncomfortableness.

reviews.author: The Thompson Family
reviews.title: Great Hospitality in Savannah
reviews.body: We came for a weekend but we would have loved to have stayed longer due to the amazing Perry Hotel and The Team.  From the moment we arrived and checked in until we left we felt very well taken care of. The level of service was lovely and appreciated and the hotel was fun, hip, clean, lively and we are so glad we stayed here!  Thank you.

reviews.author: Floyd
reviews.title: One night in Savannah
reviews.body: Traveling a long distance can be stressful and the Perry Lane experience was a perfect respite on our journey. Everything we experienced was exceptional!

reviews.author: Vicki
reviews.title: 5 star experience in Savannah
reviews.body: Beautiful surroundings everywhere you look. Welcoming front desk staff, car park attendants, concierge Randy, cleaning personnel and restaurant/bartenders were all top of the mark. Relaxing, comfortable and charming experience.  Don’t pass up this wonderful splurge.

reviews.author: SiriM
reviews.title: Fantastic stay, made my trip.
reviews.body: Fantastic. Absolutely made my trip to Savannah. Everything from the aesthetics and attention to detail to the fitness room were excellent. The food was fantastic. The rooms were luxurious and comfortable. The blackout currents were essential. The staff was so helpful and kind. I’m so happy I left my original hotel and decided to stay at Perry Lane.

reviews.author: DMac
reviews.title: Beautiful roof top at and pool
reviews.body: This was a beautiful hotel. We loved our room and all the amenities. We like that we were able to walk to those places. It was in a great location. Staff was very friendly and helpful. We also liked that they offered a service to drop you off at local places.

reviews.author: Happy guest
reviews.title: Weekend getaway.
reviews.body: We enjoyed our weekend away from everything in Atlanta. Perry Lane is top notch and we would highly recommend.

reviews.author: East Coast Belle
reviews.title: Would stay here again!
reviews.body: Loved every aspect of Perry Lane from walking through the doors to our departure.  Staff was friendly, provided that great Southern Charm to an East Coaster, it definitely stands out and I loved and appreciated everyone's friendly and outgoing nature.  Everything was up to date, focus on customer experience is there and was happy with our decision.

reviews.author: ADAug26
reviews.title: Great place to stay in Savannah
reviews.body: We really liked our stay.  The room was nice.  We enjoyed the champagne upon arriving. We also enjoyed rooftop for drinks and small bites, the bar for tea and happy hour, and the breakfast at the restaurant. Byredo bath products were a great perk. Every employee we came across was polite and welcoming.

reviews.author: Disappointed client
reviews.title: Sleepless one night stay…disappointed
reviews.body: Disappointed to say the least! One night stay ended up with a sleepless night after two hour fire alarm in the middle of the night, requiring us to exit the building. Drove four hours to get there, had sleepless night, drove four hours back home.  I simply asked for enough Marriott points to compensate me to allow me to return for another one night stay.  After going back-and-forth several times I was offered minimal compensation and definitely not enough that would allow me to return.  Very disappointed.

reviews.author: T Eggers
reviews.title: A Fabulous Weekend At The Perry Lane Hotel
reviews.body:
We had a wonderful time this past weekend at the Perry Lane Hotel! From the moment we arrived for check-in, we were greeted at the door with a smile and champagne. Every staff member we interacted with was professional, kind, and welcoming.

Randy was incredibly helpful with information about tours and restaurant recommendations, and even assisted us with booking them. Taylor drove us to The Olde Pink House for dinner and was also extremely knowledgeable, kind, and accommodating.

We highly recommend the Perry Lane Hotel and will definitely be returning soon. Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so memorable!

reviews.author: Rhoda G
reviews.title: Top notch
reviews.body: We have an amazing time stopping at rhe Perry Lane on our to drop our son off at UF. The service was amazing, rooms beautiful and location was perfect.

reviews.author: Ukdiva
reviews.title: Cannot wait to return
reviews.body: From the initial welcome with Carter and Christian at check in to the pool staff , concierge to the valet everyone upheld the vision for delivering exceptional service.

reviews.author: Dhir737
reviews.title: Memorable Stay
