reviews.body: Exceptionally well run hotel with professional and hospitable staff - made memories which would last for long

reviews.author: Allie E
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.body:
We had an outstanding stay at the Perry Lane Hotel in Savannah. From the moment we arrived until we checked out, everything exceeded our expectations.

The beds were some of the most comfortable we've ever slept in—truly luxurious and made it hard to get out of bed each morning. The hotel has a beautiful wine bar with a fantastic happy hour, making it the perfect place to unwind after exploring the city. We also loved the coffee shop—the lattes were absolutely delicious and quickly became part of our morning routine.

What really set this hotel apart was the exceptional customer service. Concierge Carter was incredibly welcoming, knowledgeable, and always happy to offer great recommendations that made our trip even better. Jake, who helped with our luggage and valet service, was equally outstanding—friendly, professional, and always greeted us with a smile.

It's the combination of luxury accommodations, wonderful food and drinks, and genuinely caring staff that makes Perry Lane one of the best hotels we've stayed at. We can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: C2811
reviews.title: A superb experience at a magical city
reviews.body: Perry Lane Hotel is the perfect stay while visiting Savannah.  The staff attention to the details and even anticipating some of your needs is simple superb.

reviews.author: Lisa and Bob Better
reviews.title: Please give the 10 star review for staff excellence not a 9 I made a mistake and could not go back to fix.
reviews.body:
Sy at the front desk helped he went beyond what was expected by retrieving my luggage I left behind in the lobby and only noticed once we got home. 
 He provided a service in a 1.1 way, by following through and helping locate my luggage and making sure it was delivered to me at my home the next day. I am so grateful Shout out to Sy. Thank you!

reviews.author: Very satisfied customer
reviews.title: A must stay
reviews.body: This hotel anticipates and provides to all your needs.  The staff are exemplary, engaging, helpful, and offer help willingly.  The location is great as far enough from the crowds yet close enough to walk to so many of the towns areas of interest.  It is clean and very quiet and has areas to relax outside of your room.

reviews.author: Happy Convention Goer
reviews.title: Perfect first experience in Savannah!
reviews.body: This hotel is a wonderful place to stay. The staff is warm and friendly, and the rooms are comfortable and spacious. The conference meetings were set up and ready, and the snacks and meals were delicious. The hotel is conveniently located near restaurants, sites, tours, and shopping. It was a great first time trip to Savannah, and I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Penny New York
reviews.title: Fun vaca
reviews.body: Great location central to everything. The hotel was clean and modern. Staff was great. I would highly recommend and will stay again on our next visit to Savanah!

reviews.author: LTB
reviews.title: Not a good location for persons with a disability
reviews.body: Hotel was very clean and staff friendly. The major issue was the inability to access the tourist attractions without moving your car or calling an uber. Hotel parking was already $48 and then when you moved your car, all additional parking was paid. Breakfast was good and the hot items were refilled when required. Didn’t see as much as we would have liked but was a good weekend getaway.

reviews.author: Queen Quick
reviews.title: PH Guest
reviews.body: You need more employees like Alyeri

reviews.author: Heather G
reviews.title: Service with a smile
reviews.body: We were in town for a wedding. The bride did choose the courtyard for the guest, but we chose the Fairfield Inn for the amenities. Jada greeted us every day with a smile, and Danny made sure that our stay was exceptionally perfect.

reviews.author: KL
reviews.title: Cleanliness concern
reviews.body: Location is great. Staff is nice and friendly. Cleanliness concern.

reviews.author: Bad experience
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.body:
I didn't have a good experience at the hotel. The room had a very strong, unpleasant musty smell, the carpet was somewhat wet and damp, and the air conditioner sounded like an old car engine. The bathroom had cracks and a shower curtain that didn't keep the water in.
The breakfast was modest with limited options, but the service at F&B (Food & Beverage) was very good—the ladies were extremely attentive and kind.
Parking was expensive; I paid $12 a day at the building across the street…
Unfortunately, I will not be returning and would not recommend it.

reviews.author: Rene66
reviews.title: Nice Room, great location
reviews.body: Nice clean hotel, looks fairly new or updated, breakfast was good, nothing fancy, parking would have been expensive, but there were options to park within a block which we did.  Just a block or 2 from some of the busiest areas of Savanah, and just a few minutes walk to the riverside.

reviews.author: Amazing staff
reviews.title: Exemplary customer service from staff
reviews.body: Our stay was incredible. The staff was exceptional and very professional always available and ready to help one of the beds in the room was sagging in the middle so only one person could sleep on it. The other bed was fine.. The pool was closed, but they graciously let us use the pool at the hotel next-door. Breakfast was great. I would definitely recommend staying with them.

reviews.author: ClaudeeB
reviews.title: Customer service needs improvement!!
reviews.body:
My initial arrival was a disappointment because of the difficulty of finding the entrance to the hotel in the rain,
and the fact that the hotel looked nothing like the online advertisement. I travel often and usually prefer staying at a Marriott hotel. River Street and Market Street was within walkable distance to the hotel. Overall, the hotel was quiet but boring with no amenities of interest. Train your front desk personnel to be more knowledgeable and less rude! Your parking fees are ridiculous!! Probably would not stay at this hotel again.

reviews.author: Daunte Ford
reviews.title: Great staff and great location
reviews.body: We were looking for a clean place that was within walking distance to the river front attractions and this place was it to a "t". The staff was extremely helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: i am real
reviews.title: Real experience of marriot
reviews.body: DO NOT GO . I WANT A REFUND

reviews.author: Great location
reviews.title: Great location and staff
reviews.body: Very helpful with details on how to enjoy the city.

reviews.author: Kathy
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.body: Upon arriving I was welcomed by a wonderful front desk staff named Patrika. Her warmth, after a 15 hour drive was exactly what I needed. The breakfast the following morning was a perfect addition. Clean rooms and walking distance to everything.

reviews.author: Kelsey R
reviews.title: Would stay again in a heartbeat!
reviews.body: We had an amazing stay here! The location was amazing and the staff were friendly, especially Kimberle who worked on the breakfast. Breakfast had a lot of options. Would have appreciated if it went slightly later. Parking was $48 a day with mandatory valet so we parked at the State Street Parking Garage and only paid $24 total for 2 days. Besides not having affordable or free parking, everything else was great!

reviews.author: BTRoss
reviews.title: Great place to stay when in Savannah
reviews.body: Definitely would stay here again! This hotel had a very good breakfast and plenty of amenities. Close walking distance to most of the historic district. The staff was very informative and friendly!

reviews.author: Taylormade
reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.body: Had a wonderful time minus no internet tv.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Great location & staff!
reviews.body: This was by far one of my best hotel experiences. The staff was very nice & the hotel was super quiet at night. Walking distance to everything. Parking was easy. Breakfast was great. Very clean rooms. Pool wasn’t in use but we didn’t mind, they did say we could use the pool next door if we wanted.

reviews.author: Moises
reviews.title: Human beings always make the difference
reviews.body:
Most of the time, when we provide feedback about a hotel, we tend to focus on the facilities and amenities. But sometimes, the human element makes an even bigger difference in the overall guest experience.

That was certainly the case during our stay. While the property itself had a few challenges, the incredible attitude, kindness, and genuine desire to help from the staff completely outweighed them.

Jada at the front desk, Sharon in the restaurant, and the entire valet team went above and beyond to assist us in every way they could. Their warmth and hospitality made us feel truly welcome and helped us enjoy our time at the hotel.

Thank you to the entire team for reminding us that great hospitality is ultimately about people. Your service made a real difference in our stay!

reviews.author: Shikita S
reviews.title: Family Getaway
reviews.body: Nice clean establishment, Thanks to Mrs. Sharon at breakfast, she made breakfast warm and welcoming, she has a great personality, good spirit, and she was very warm/  welcoming to the guests at breakfast.

reviews.author: Brandon
reviews.title: Good hotel with great location in historic downtown
reviews.body:
Hotel is clean, affordable, and the staff is very friendly. Breakfast every morning is solid quality. Rooms were cozy well kept. 

Walking distance from most major attractions in historic downtown, perfect place to stay for a few days while your on a vacation or new to town.

reviews.author: Disgruntled
reviews.title: Chose a different hotel
reviews.body: The room air conditioner would not stay at the temperature set. The thermostat would turn itself up to 75 constantly. Additionally, the television completely stopped working the last three days of a week long stay. These issues were brought to the attention of staff who would apologize, but the issues were never fixed.

reviews.author: JEEPNUT
reviews.title: NO UP TO MARRIOTT'S STANDARDS
reviews.body: DOESN'T BOOK THIS MOTEL UNTIL POOL IS COMPLETED

reviews.author: Very Disappointed
reviews.title: Not worth the hassle
reviews.body: This hotel is in a great location  but the hotel itself is not friendly nor courteous.  They acted like we were bothering them.

reviews.author: TXFamily
reviews.title: Great location and super staff.
reviews.body: The location was great and the staff was super friendly. Thank you Jada for being so helpful and making it a great stay. We will be back.

reviews.author: Paul family reunion
reviews.title: Another disappointing year at Marriott
reviews.body: This was the 101 anniversary of the Paul family reunion. This is the fourth year that I am aware of that we have allowed Marriott to host this event Fairfield by Marriott to be exact. This is also the third year that I'm aware of that the pool has been shut down upon our arrival so we, as a collective family has also decided that this will be the last year that Fairfield inn by Marriott will be hosting the Paul family reunion. I am quite sure we occupied at least 75 rooms. That's neither here nor there because even if we were occupying one room, we should get the same service as everyone else. Some of our relatives including myself had mobility issues, bad facts, bad kids, etc. However, we were told that we needed to walk over to the neighboring building in order to swim. Quite the inconvenience. So while we had always been huge fans of the Marriott we won't be back. Thank you

reviews.author: A satisfied guest
reviews.title: Great surprise
reviews.body: Everything about this hotel is great! I haven’t had that breakfast yet, BUT I can bet money on it that it’ll match the same energy as the front desk rep Nena and the valet guy! First, the room is so reasonable, especially if you get the military rate. Second, I got an upgrade and boy was it an upgrade. Nena’s attitude is superb and she has the kindest smile. Valet parking is included and is $25 per day which isn’t bad. The breakfast bar was great: scrambled eggs, waffles, bacon, boiled eggs, fruit, coffee, yogurt, toast, bagels, oatmeal, cereal and more. The breasts attendants were exceptionally attentive and kind. Don’t be fooled by the location; it’s safe. This will be mine and my family’s spot from now on. Thanks Nena! ❤️

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.title: Quick Trip to Savannah
reviews.body: This hotel was wonderful for a variety of reasons. The hotel is in a great location, a quick walk to shops and many restaurants. The staff is friendly and helpful and the hotel was clean. I will plan to stay here my next visit.

reviews.author: Unsatisifed
reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.body: This location is not in an area suitable for families.  It is not within a safe walking distance to sites.  Valet parking was a nightmare.  The wait was well over an hour when checking out.  The valet lost my keys and could not find my car.  The sleeping arrangements were not ideal in the suite style room.  The mattress on the pull-out couch was total springs, no mattress.  The clerk at the front desk was not helpful.  I was not offered a different mattress and was told no other rooms were available.  Instead, I was given a worn comforter to help.

reviews.author: Customerservice9007
reviews.title: Answer the phone for your guests!
reviews.body: The room was clean, the lady who worked the breakfast area was very pleasant, but the young man who checked me in was a little rude. My biggest complaint was the fact that no one answered the phones when I called with questions from my room and the laundry room. That made things very inconvenient because I had to come to the front desk when they could have answered the phone to address my questions about vending machines and the laundry room.

reviews.author: G Smith
reviews.title: HOT ROOMS
reviews.body: Stay in room 208. Went down to talk to staff,was told they are motion activated air. We sweat all night. was nice and cool in common areas. The temperature stayed the same the whole time we were there.Air was working but the thermostat is just for looks. Will never stay here again.

reviews.author: Manda
reviews.title: Why go down when you can stay Aloft
reviews.body: Aloft by Marriott Savannah Downtown is Spacious, clean & dare I say a lil sexy providing us with luxury vibes at economical prices. From the beautiful rooms, friendly staff & its location which is next to almost everything you would be doing yourself/family a disservice. It’s our “must-stay” spot for quiet, comfort & quality.

reviews.author: MzNeNe501
reviews.title: Great Stay, Great Location. Book now!!
reviews.body: Great customer service, great location, friendly staff. Reasonable cost. Book Now!!

reviews.author: Weekend Get Away
reviews.title: Great Weekend
reviews.body: Clean and comfy space for the weekend.

reviews.author: Disappointed
reviews.title: Terribly disappointed
reviews.body: The hotel lobby is filthy and the rooms were equally as dirty.  I took and shower and after walking around on the floor in the room getting ready for the day, I had to take another shower to clean the bottom of my feet because they were so dirty.  Don’t stay here.

reviews.author: VMRoberts
reviews.title: GREAT Stay With Two Suggestions
reviews.body: This was my first time staying at an Aloft property. It is industrial modern which was such a great change. Two suggestions  - first add blackout curtains vs the shades that definitely were a bit worn and tattered. The curtains not only block out the light but also add privacy and some sound insulation for those facing the bus station. The second suggestion would be to list the valet daily pricing as I was a bit taken aback when I got my bill and saw it was $48 a day. I was super impressed that they carried the Drybar brand toiletries. The bed and pillows were what I expect from a Marriott property, which is why I use Marriott as much as possible. The staff were super attentive and kind and the breakfast was good, although I was shocked that there was no free breakfast as there is with other properties. Overall, I'd definitely stay at an Aloft again. It was a great stay.

reviews.author: Capri
reviews.title: Our Anniversary Spent at the Aloft
reviews.body: We had a great time. The staff was amazing and the food delicious. My only concern is the broken door from the garage that leads to the Hotel. I was very disturbed to see a homeless women just walk in at 1am asking to use a phone. Thankfully she wasn’t combative and the receptionist kindly escorted her back out. How can a door thats suppose to keep employees and guests safe be compromised that way for so long. Corporate just reach in your pockets from all the money you make and fix it.

reviews.author: AugustLeo
reviews.title: Location location location
reviews.body: This hotel is located at n the heart of downtown Savannah. You are on a route where the free trolley runs and next door to the transit station. About a 10 minute walk from Broughton Street which has restaurants and shops. And just a trolley ride away from River Street.

reviews.title: Nice Savannah
reviews.body: it's a great place to relax. good restaurants and sights are in walking distance

reviews.author: Ruth
reviews.title: Chill Hotel to stay in
reviews.body: Overall the vibe was good and the hotel was clean. There were lots of amenities. Parking was not desirable as the only options were $48 a day or paid street parking where you had to keep resetting the meter. The shower does not have a privacy door, so it is unusual if you are sharing a room with someone that you aren't that familiar with. For the price point, it was good.

reviews.author: Danny Atlanta
reviews.title: Recent Savannah stay
reviews.body: Very modern upscale hotel with supportive staff

reviews.author: Angie
reviews.title: Anniversary trip to Savannah
reviews.body: Aloft provided a clean and comfortable room at the end of our busy days exploring Savannah. It is a little further out from where our main activities were so will probably stay closer to riverfront in the future. We obtained a wonderful rate on Travelzoo and parked at Robinson Garage 1 1/2 blocks instead of valet parking to save money to splurge on other things instead.

reviews.author: Mia L
reviews.title: Aloft Savanah GA
reviews.body: Best hotel experience I’ve had.

reviews.author: KL24712
reviews.title: Recommend
reviews.body: I definitely recommend this hotel. It was a reasonable price, staff was always friendly. Room was worth every penny!

reviews.author: Alessia
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.body: I had a great time. The room was clean, comfortable and pleasant

reviews.author: bgm1234
reviews.title: disappointing check-in experience
reviews.body:
I arrived at the hotel with my family after a tiring four-hour drive from Atlanta, only to have a disappointing check-in experience. I had made my reservation online the night before, but it never made it into the hotel's system, and the receptionist couldn't find my booking.

I do want to recognize the receptionist, who was very friendly, professional, and genuinely helpful. He worked diligently to resolve the issue and was eventually able to get us checked in by creating a new reservation, although the process took about 30 minutes.

Unfortunately, the room we were assigned was not properly cleaned and had an unpleasant odor. In addition, the conditioner dispenser in the bathroom was empty and had not been refilled.

While I appreciated the excellent customer service from the front desk staff, the reservation issue and the condition of the room made for a disappointing start to our stay.

reviews.author: KESQ
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.body: Awesome experience. Aesthetically pleasing and exceptional staff!

reviews.author: No
reviews.title: Was ok
reviews.body: Good front desk people..parking to expensive. No healthy breakfast ofert

reviews.author: MayMay
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Pictures were misleading. The hotel is very outdated, rude night staff, pool was too cold to get in. Only upside was convenience to River street.

reviews.author: Boonelou
reviews.title: Mother and Daughter Reunion weekend
reviews.body:
The moment I walked into the lobby, I felt welcomed the staff was friendly and genuinely seemed happy to see me.. There was a little confusion during check-in, I had booked two nights with points and one night on the credit card. The front desk clerk thought I had booked two rooms. That was quickly resolved.
The room was clean and exactly what the website described. Housekeeping stopped by each day to replace towels and remove trash, on the second day, the bed was made while we were out. 
Coffee was available all day.
We did go down to the bar for happy hour, prices were very reasonable.
All in all, my daughter and I had a wonderful stay at the Aloft, and would consider coming back.
As for parking, we parked at the City Parking Garage, a 5 minute walk from the Aloft.

reviews.author: Avid Traveller
reviews.title: Unsafe Below Average Experience
reviews.body: Parking is billed separately. Wifi never worked. Had to change rooms due to a permanent malfunctioning room amenity (the service technician made the comment that they know this specific room is like this yet they continue to book it without fixing the problem.) The second room smelled like mildew, the flooring was peeling up, and there was alot of long black hair on the back shower wall. Next door to the bus station so non-stop transient traffic. Homeless encampment 50-100 feet away from the front door.. not a safe feeling. Aside from the one female bartender and female breakfast cook, the Staff's overall attitude was lack luster to put it nicely.

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.title: The best in Savannah
reviews.body: My stay was phenomenal. From the valet to the front desk staff, everyone was so welcoming. The entire hotel was fabulous and spotless. My room was immaculate and exactly what I wanted. The location is walking distance to everything.

reviews.author: Aigner
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.body: This is overall a nice hotel in a good location, but I will not be returning nor can I recommend it to anyone. It was terribly hot in my room. The only time it felt cool was when I was sitting at the table directly in front of the vent. I only had limited control of the thermostat with the front desk having control of it and not always answering the phone. It was weird and inconvenient to have to call down to get them to lower my thermostat or having to call to figure out why it was not working despite me having it on the lowest temp that I could put it on which was 68. The situation with the air made for a very uncomfortable stay. I've never not been able to fully control my thermostat. Bar service was also subpar with a "bartender" who had no idea what she was doing. There were things on the menu she could not answer questions about and the one drink she made was terrible which is why we only had one. There were also gnats in my room. I know they can be an issue in summer months, but it was quite annoying. The room was also not cleaned very well.

reviews.author: Great Stay
reviews.title: Passing Thru
reviews.body: I was there for one night, passing thru back to South Florida. Clean rooms and cold drinks. Stephanie at the Bar as well as all other staff members that I interacted with were very friendly and professional.

reviews.author: Jacob
reviews.title: Wheelchairs Watch Out
reviews.body:
My wife and I chose this hotel for her birthday trip and our long-overdue honeymoon. I am a full-time wheelchair user, and before booking I clearly explained that I needed a spacious king room with a roll-in shower. I called multiple times throughout the month to confirm it, and each time I was assured that the room would be available.

When we arrived, we were placed in a room with two queen beds. I am 6'8", so even a king bed barely accommodates my height. Although the room had a roll-in shower, the space between the beds was so narrow that I could barely maneuver my wheelchair to reach it.

After I brought this to management’s attention, it took approximately 30 minutes to move us. The second room had a king bed, but it was extremely small and the shower had a raised lip that prevented me from entering with my wheelchair. We were told there were no other rooms available. I was effectively forced to choose between having a bed I could sleep in and having a shower I could access.

I had also asked a month in advance whether there were any additional expenses we should prepare for. Despite that, we were not informed about the mandatory valet fee and refundable incidental hold until three days before arrival.

Expedia later created a separate complication by canceling our reservation without permission while attempting to help. However, that does not change the fact that this hotel never provided the accessible king room it repeatedly promised.

Accessible accommodations are basic necessities, not optional upgrades. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this hotel to wheelchair users or anyone who depends on the hotel honoring confirmed accessibility needs.

reviews.author: CindyH
reviews.title: We should have booked a longer stay!
reviews.body: We only had two days in Savannah but the location of the Marriott let us see it all without even getting in the car! We loved the progressive style and the cleanliness of the hotel. Super friendly staff and valet. Hopefully going again in autumn!

reviews.author: Desertnight
reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.body:
My stay at this Marriott was extremely disappointing. The hotel did not deliver on the level of service it promises. The service was consistently slow, and it was very difficult to get in touch with anyone for basic requests. I couldn't reach anyone to fix my phone or provide fresh towels, despite multiple attempts.

On top of that, charging $50 per day just to park a vehicle is excessive and added to an already frustrating experience.

Overall, the poor customer service and high parking fees made this stay far below expectations. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone and would not choose to stay here again.

reviews.author: Marriott Bonvoy member
reviews.title: Booked through Travelzoo but rate not honored
reviews.body: >We stayed at Aloft Downtown in Savannah GA on July 18th. We booked on May 18 through Travelzoo. The base price was supposed to be $142.85. Aloft has charged us $294.35 for this stay.

reviews.author: Power Ranger
reviews.title: Good location.
reviews.body:
The front desk agent, David, was incredible and provided excellent customer service, being polite and ready to help with all our questions. The room we stayed in, 417, appeared deteriorated: the toilet paper holder was detached, the sink was missing its stopper, the carpet looked dirty, and the laminate flooring was coming loose. My daughter suffered a small cut on her foot due to a raised corner on one of the floor planks. 

To be honest, I don't think we'll be staying at that property again.

reviews.author: Not normally picky
reviews.title: Disgusting. Found a dirty diaper!
reviews.body:
The room was filthy! Hair, dirt, and other small items all over the floor, the shower had hair and debris as well, and no door/privacy. Surfaces were covered in dust, hair/dirt on the bed, wobbly table, phone didn't work, and then we found a dirty diaper under the bed!

Absolutely disgusting. We cancelled ASAP, and got out of there.

reviews.author: good
reviews.title: good
reviews.body: parking is a bit of an issue

reviews.author: Frequent Traveler
reviews.title: Great location and stay!
reviews.body: Loved the room, hotel and amenities

reviews.author: Scott S
reviews.title: Excellent hotel in a great location
reviews.body: Really enjoyed staying at this hotel.  It has a nice modern vibe, with comfortable beds and an AC that no issue keeping up with the Savannah heat. The bar has a good vide and great views of teh waterfront.

reviews.author: Satisfied 28
reviews.title: Good Feeling
reviews.body: AC hotel is great for those who want easy access to river street and the Riverwalk, interior is beautiful and well maintained, great breakfast for a fee, enjoyed the trip to Savannah.

reviews.author: Les
reviews.title: Great Venue to Savannah
reviews.body: A perfect spot in a great city.  Easily walkable to all locations.  A very friendly and helpful staff !

reviews.author: PE
reviews.title: Some improvements needed
reviews.body:
This hotel room was clean to the eye. Staff were kind & eager to help. Housekeeping only every other day is not ideal. Soap containers in shower were empty & not refilled with housekeeping. The bed was made but pillows were not put back on the bed. 
There’s a motion detector for the lights & kept shutting the lights off while we were in the room.

The location is great as it’s a very short walk to River street attractions & an elevator to to the street level above

reviews.author: Accommodations
reviews.title: Accommodation
reviews.body: I’m providing this review as an average review. The room was clean, however; my accommodation of a balcony view was not provided.

reviews.author: Lynne C
reviews.title: Birthday Vibes in Savannah
reviews.body:
Took a little impromptu trip to the Coast for my birthday weekend. The AC Marriott Savannah Historic District Hotel was a pleasant surprise right in heart of the beautiful river district. Surrounded by historic buildings, the hotel boasted a crisp modern interior and was within walking distance to all the restaurants and shops. 

Morning and evening views of the Savannah River were enjoyed from our room balcony with additional views enjoyed from the rooftop restaurant. Very clean, green, serene views! 

 I wasn’t quite sure how I was going to feel about the cargo ships passing through, but I was pleasantly surprised how quietly they glided through  the water while leaving very little wake behind.  

The staff were friendly, helpful, and attentive. It truly was a wonderful stay and we will be back!

reviews.author: Treasure69
reviews.title: No AC in Savannah is diabolical
reviews.body: Air was out in room on first day, second day still out! Changed rooms..same size bed but a smaller room than reserved. Refund was 50 dollars.  I feel like that first night should have been fully compensated. Savannah at night is a 100 degrees.

reviews.author: E
reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.body: My stay was phenomenal!! I sincerely appreciated how CLEAN my room was! There was no mold or mildew on the grout lines, no ripped furniture, no dings or dents - everything was in fantastic shape and upkeep maintained. The hotel staff was welcoming and very friendly. The next time I’m in Savannah, I’ll be choosing this hotel!

reviews.author: Great
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: The staff exhibited excellent customer service and the accommodations are great. Easy access to the Savannah Convention Center and River Street

reviews.author: Felicia B
reviews.title: Delightful Stay
reviews.body: This was my first visit to The AC Hotel but it definitely not be my last!

reviews.author: Laura Dimaria
reviews.title: Ac Hotel Stay
reviews.body: Such an amazing overall stay! Beautiful hotel, great views from the balcony! The rooms were very utilized with the space! A long bench attached to the wall with adequate space underneath for luggage! Staff was so nice and engaging! Rooftop bar had a great atmosphere and staff was top notch!

reviews.author: Jim C
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.body: couldn't be more pleased. Room was clean, staff was great. little pricey for valet, but that what it costs for the location.

reviews.author: Juan VA
reviews.title: My First Savannah Trip
reviews.body: Visited Savannah for the first time. Stayed at the AC Hotel. Great location with direct access to river street. Modern facility, with friendly staff, and a spectacular rooftop view. We had a great time!

reviews.author: Jim
reviews.title: Fantastic location.
reviews.body: Fantastic location in the heart of Savannah’s historic waterfront. Beautiful hotel, great service from the staff. Great rooftop bar with excellent views.

reviews.author: citytravel
reviews.title: Staff was not welcoming and rooms were loud.
reviews.body: I wouldn’t recommend this location. The staff here were not friendl and did not respond to my issues. The room I was given was also next to a street and it was so loud, even with windows closed. Also did not love how anyone can access rooms on 8th floor.

reviews.author: DJOHNSON
reviews.title: Enjoyable Stay
reviews.body: My overall review would have been excellent; however, valet parking charged me more than the hotel quoted.  I am awaiting a response to my inquiry about the discrepancy in the parking cost.

reviews.author: PhillyYo
reviews.title: Great location with a couple of drawbacks.
reviews.body: Be aware that parking is $40 per day (self park, down the street) or $50 per day for valet.  When you've gotten over that take a deep breath before entering the lobby.  They are pumping in some sort of incense or cologne fragrance and they have it dialed up to 11.  It's cloying to say the least.  Rooms are decent, shower was low water pressure and location is great being right on the river.

reviews.author: Victoria
reviews.title: Cute quiet new place
reviews.body: Very modern hotel asked that love the overhead shower and the balcony views

reviews.author: Tori K
reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.body:
Beautiful room, clean and can’t beat the river view! 

Staff was always so kind and helpful! 

Valet was exceptional! 

Only thing I would change is the usb bed outlet didn’t work and the fridge isn’t great.

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.title: Excellent Experience!
reviews.body:
More than expected! 
AC Hotel by Marriott-Savannah Historic District exceeded my expectations!
Excellent location!

reviews.author: Savannah travaler
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.body: Excellent staff, best bed for sleep. The lavender roof top bar Excellent. However paid a premium for a wrap around balcony water side room. Ended up in basic balcony and the room furthest from water.

reviews.author: Jason3507
reviews.title: Really nice place
reviews.body: Really nice place just had the a/c and water issue in the room. Other than that facility was very nice

reviews.author: Ajaxs weekend
reviews.title: Nice long weekend
reviews.body: Very comfortable, peaceful and clean. Staff was attentive and responsive

reviews.author: FAMILY REUNION
reviews.title: Family Reunion
reviews.body:
We were given efficient service for our check in and rooms. The banquet was beautiful and the servers efficient in all ways.
Breakfast was excellent and the appetizers wonderful. The deck was enjoyable.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, service could be better
reviews.body:
The hotel itself is beautiful.

Unfortunately, the service didn’t match the quality of the hotel. At check-in, we were told that housekeeping only comes every other day, which seemed unusual for a hotel at this price point. We were okay with that, but housekeeping never came at all during our stay.

We called to request housekeeping and were assured someone would come, but after waiting an hour, no one showed up. We called again and simply asked for fresh towels instead. Another hour passed, and still nothing. In the end, I had to walk down the hall, find a staff member, and ask in person just to get two bath towels.

Overall, the property itself is excellent, but the lack of follow-through and attentiveness from the staff was disappointing. With better service, this would have been a great stay.

reviews.author: Jeaya4
reviews.title: July 2026
reviews.body: Great location, fabulous service, can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: MMP
reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.body: Our room was clean, the shower was great, front desk was so genuine and friendly, easy access to downtown walking.

reviews.author: Guest
reviews.title: Review
reviews.body:
Our stay was very comfortable and we had a convenient location to local restaurants and shops in the historic district. The food and amenities were good and staff members were very helpful.

The only complaints were that the closest parking deck is $40 a day and the hotel’s LEED Platinum certification sounds nice until you walk in the bathroom and have the lights cut off every 3 seconds.

reviews.author: Julie S
reviews.title: Nice property
reviews.body:
We only stayed for 1 night. The room was very nice and we liked the lavender station in the lobby. Bed was very comfortable. We did close the door to the bedroom, which caused the living area to be extremely cold and the bedroom got increasingly warmer throughout the night. We didn’t realize the bedroom door had to be left open. 

Robert at the front desk was very nice and helpful.

The luggage carts are AWFUL. Every single one we tried had a flat tire.

The biggest negative - we had a do not disturb sign on our door and we were packing up to leave by 11am checkout. About 5 minutes prior to 11am, a hotel staff member unlocked our door and attempted to enter. I immediately went to the door because my daughter was sitting on the couch near the door. The male staff member told us it was time to checkout - I said “I know, checkout is at 11 and we are loading up the luggage carts right now.” I have never been in a hotel where someone entered the room to tell us to checkout (especially when it wasn’t quite checkout time yet). That experience would give me pause in returning to this hotel, even though everything else was nice.

reviews.author: Alexia525
reviews.title: Marriott Savannah riverfront
reviews.body: We had a wonderful one-night stay at the Marriott Savannah Riverfront! The hotel was clean, comfortable, and in a beautiful location right on the river. The staff were friendly and helpful, and everything about our stay was easy and enjoyable. We especially loved the riverfront views and the overall atmosphere of the hotel. We would definitely stay here again when visiting Savannah!

reviews.author: Bud for Charleston
reviews.title: Great location and staff but needs some love from corporate!!
reviews.body:
I was a Marriott Titanium member for many years and remain a loyal Marriott guest. I visit Savannah 8–10 times a year and typically stay on or near the waterfront, most often at the JW Marriott, AC Hotel, or other Marriott properties in the area.
This was my first stay at this particular Marriott, and there were definitely some positives. The location is excellent, every staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful, and our room was very nice with a great view.
That said, the common areas of the property feel noticeably dated and could use a refresh. The biggest disappointment, however, was the pool area.
The pool feels like an afterthought rather than an amenity you would expect from a Marriott in such a desirable Savannah waterfront location. It is essentially a basic pool surrounded by a few chairs, with a towel closet and an awkward service-ramp/step combination for access. There is very little atmosphere or sense that it was designed as a place where guests would actually want to relax and spend time.
Unfortunately, the setting and access also don't provide the comfortable, inviting feeling you would expect from a hotel of this caliber. It reminded me much more of the pool area at a lower-end chain hotel than a full-service Marriott.
Overall, we liked the location, staff, room, and view, but the dated common areas—and especially the pool—keep this property from delivering the overall experience its location should make possible.
